b7dd5f6687b8ddbd8cbbd28d479657d14591bbb4.text: 邪恶的佐尔达克（Zaishen 任务）

04079740cccaa7630b648a8c764a9d34cf21d018.text: 因福尔图纳托斯·马克塞莱斯

eea7fd7a22d24ba3a7bfb039044ddfc13dac6c0e.text: 伦杜克 [烈阳之矛军阶军官]

b10914501fc5ad579fd77a93d5279cd5e2cf13af.text: Bujo 或 Ke Feng / Senjo Wah

4d7f10396208a515135a4322804c84c5bd877b74.source: Talking to her after completing the Bonus

078147ccb7e26c1c439f07c33707436f45854ec5.source: To get to the Fissure of Woe, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). Players must then either use a Passage Scroll to the Fissure of Woe (in Embark Beach or any of the following locations below), or pay 1000 gold to the Champion of Balthazar at a Statue of Balthazar in any of the following locations:
078147ccb7e26c1c439f07c33707436f45854ec5.text: 要到达悲痛裂缝，队伍中的所有玩家都必须是飞升者或 Weh no Su（埃洛尼亚角色可能会完成任务“猎杀！”）。然后，玩家必须使用通往悲痛裂缝的通道卷轴（在出发海滩或以下任何以下位置），或向位于以下任何位置的巴尔萨扎雕像的巴尔萨扎冠军支付 1000 金币：

67460328c4cf5edc0b1df861083e59f0bb31e37e.source: Your party has completed # of 11 quests.
67460328c4cf5edc0b1df861083e59f0bb31e37e.text: 你的队伍已完成#11个任务。

ba58d164d21f0a8ab653a33e18ba552578bdd7f9.source: Balthazar has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the forge in the Temple of War to claim your reward.
ba58d164d21f0a8ab653a33e18ba552578bdd7f9.text: 巴尔萨泽已经承认你所做的伟大事迹。返回战争神殿的熔炉领取奖励。

94c630fded4ed4d34d8ecfa5b32cc9d3712e8aa9.source: Only party members who are Ascended, Weh no Su or characters created in Guild Wars Nightfall who have completed Hunted! may enter the Fissure of Woe: Heroes may enter, but Henchmen may not.
94c630fded4ed4d34d8ecfa5b32cc9d3712e8aa9.text: 只有已升天、Weh no Su 或激战黄昏中创建的角色已完成狩猎的党员！可能会进入悲伤的裂缝：英雄可以进入，但追随者可能不会。

a1ea7b641ab8ef1d56dc925736dd3271a633c9e9.source: This area is one of the few locations where certain items drop:
a1ea7b641ab8ef1d56dc925736dd3271a633c9e9.text: 该区域是少数会掉落某些物品的位置之一：

c816107b0e3a097414d51d994409cc60f2a0e4ea.source: Shadow weapons (The only other locations are in Nightfall: the Nightfallen Garden and the Domain of Anguish.)
c816107b0e3a097414d51d994409cc60f2a0e4ea.text: 暗影武器（唯一的其他地点是夜幕降临：堕夜花园和痛苦领域。）

ed8671c687484784e8cabdd763defec6e00d61df.source: Obsidian Shards. (Although there is one Obsidian Furnace Drake in Nightfall that also drops them.)
ed8671c687484784e8cabdd763defec6e00d61df.text: 黑曜石碎片。 （尽管《黄昏》中有一只黑曜石熔炉幼龙也会掉落它们。）

8ba5913f8d6d87743cc883bef2e72d290f8babd6.source: Globs of Ectoplasm can, very rarely, drop from the Banshees that spawn after taking The Wailing Lord.
8ba5913f8d6d87743cc883bef2e72d290f8babd6.text: 在极少数情况下，捕获哀嚎领主后生成的女妖会掉落灵质球。

c216336dd50fd697421ddee828ece62b77ff9a71.source: The Fissure of Woe is where players can craft Obsidian Armor.
c216336dd50fd697421ddee828ece62b77ff9a71.text: 悲痛裂缝是玩家可以制作黑曜石护甲的地方。

3cc4ebc56f957999fdfb1a3169adc0d660013830.source: You can repeat the area's quests each time you enter the Fissure of Woe. After completing all eleven,
3cc4ebc56f957999fdfb1a3169adc0d660013830.text: 每次进入悲伤裂缝时，您都可以重复该区域的任务。全部十一点完成后，

60a16818ad7bd2cbfd3c8466a0b87cd806029faf.source: You will see the message, "Balthazar has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the forge in the Temple of War to claim your reward".
60a16818ad7bd2cbfd3c8466a0b87cd806029faf.text: 你会看到这样的消息：“巴尔萨扎已经承认你所做的伟大事迹。返回战争神殿的熔炉领取你的奖励”。

9d975884703944da0d590448b926984613ee03b7.source: A Chest of Woe will spawn near the Eternal Forgemaster.
9d975884703944da0d590448b926984613ee03b7.text: 痛苦宝箱会在永恒锻造大师附近生成。

0ff4f2bae31fb4cf9774606db945c1114fa398bb.source: After the first time, you can add the Eternal Conqueror of The Fissure of Woe statue to your "Honor" monument.
0ff4f2bae31fb4cf9774606db945c1114fa398bb.text: 第一次之后，你可以将悲伤裂缝的永恒征服者雕像添加到你的“荣誉”纪念碑中。

cf8f56aa0b716b9512c3d1ff61eec6fd0b1ceab7.source: The Eternal Forgemaster will buy items in your inventory when he returns to the forge, after you keep it safe from attack.
cf8f56aa0b716b9512c3d1ff61eec6fd0b1ceab7.text: 在你确保熔炉免受攻击后，永恒熔炉大师返回熔炉时会购买你库存中的物品。

55d3b41e6f5eb497cb934f6ad4bef008e10ff1a6.source: The Fissure of Woe area does not count towards any Cartographer title.
55d3b41e6f5eb497cb934f6ad4bef008e10ff1a6.text: 痛苦裂缝区域不计入任何制图师头衔。

7b8d1ccd661a6c0f9079a3dc879fbdf3c042aee7.source: You can get kicked out of the area in three situations:
7b8d1ccd661a6c0f9079a3dc879fbdf3c042aee7.text: 在三种情况下，您可能会被踢出该区域：

915fa3b9631dcf999839e948dd9b1898cf7930c4.source: If all members of your party die; there are no resurrection shrines, so a wipe results in mission failure.
915fa3b9631dcf999839e948dd9b1898cf7930c4.text: 如果你的队伍的所有成员都死了；没有复活神殿，所以擦除会导致任务失败。

4ec016428614359757f4e5ba897a6dde66fe9f61.source: In Hard mode, if everyone in the party has a Death Penalty of 60%.
4ec016428614359757f4e5ba897a6dde66fe9f61.text: 在困难模式下，如果队伍中每个人的死亡惩罚都是60%。

4e330ac71c3e65e905eb4b8e935d24b40fec558d.source: If you allow any of your allies to die. (Be sure to clear any nearby patrols to prevent this.)
4e330ac71c3e65e905eb4b8e935d24b40fec558d.text: 如果你允许你的任何盟友死亡。 （请务必清除附近的巡逻队以防止这种情况发生。）

deb8eb7e1c9cb986fe82a1377f7a404b28488a1d.source: The sole exception to this is Eternal Lord Taeres. However, should he die before you take his quest, Tower of Strength, you will be unable to spawn the Chest of Woe.
deb8eb7e1c9cb986fe82a1377f7a404b28488a1d.text: 唯一的例外是永恒领主泰雷斯。然而，如果他在你接受他的任务“力量之塔”之前就死了，你将无法生成悲痛宝箱。

84172d4e64934d664622b8370257741b73cf6b43.source: In Hard mode, foes have a constant seven pips of health regeneration.
84172d4e64934d664622b8370257741b73cf6b43.text: 在困难模式下，敌人有恒定的 7 点生命恢复。

676237eb2eee9c4494de47c4156d8afac1f68eff.source: The following Zaishen Quests take place here:
676237eb2eee9c4494de47c4156d8afac1f68eff.text: 以下再神任务发生在这里：

7f34be8b842add2ad937502cb76bdbcecd47c81e.source: Be sure to obtain the quest for the Miniature Ceratadon from Merrise, Sworn to Seas, at embark beach if attempting to do this dungeon in Hard Mode for the first time since the 2025 anniversary update.
7f34be8b842add2ad937502cb76bdbcecd47c81e.text: 如果自 2025 周年更新以来第一次尝试在困难模式下完成这个地下城，请务必在登船海滩上从宣誓海洋的梅里斯那里获得微型角龙的任务。

31e84c22e9eb8c1d64fbc437c0aea5c81df4bcfe.source: The lava in the Fissure of Woe is harmless. On rare occasions, a Shadow Ranger will spawn inside the Tower of Courage, preventing quest completion unless your party can kill it without having a line of sight.
31e84c22e9eb8c1d64fbc437c0aea5c81df4bcfe.text: 祸祸裂缝中的熔岩是无害的。在极少数情况下，暗影游侠会在勇气之塔内生成，从而阻止任务完成，除非你的队伍可以在视线之外杀死它。

6d47e61bc8cdd922b32d1faa77acb652100110d6.source: Relive the events of the Canthan plague.

7c836ed135896e6a8b4b3730c3f30c2b16677b38.source: Once you have completed Cleansing Morostav Trail, you can take this quest to restore default spawns in Cantha, except in an area affected by any other Winds of Change quest.
7c836ed135896e6a8b4b3730c3f30c2b16677b38.text: 一旦你完成了净化莫罗斯塔夫小道，你就可以接受这个任务来恢复凯萨的默认生成点，除了受任何其他变革之风任务影响的区域。

77756dcdd63f7c83bc6501457a91e695267d325e.source: This allows you to continue the Winds of Change storyline without abandoning Memories of Purity.
77756dcdd63f7c83bc6501457a91e695267d325e.text: 这使您可以继续变革之风的故事情节，而不会放弃纯粹的记忆。

264a14f31f5e3a4710874e845df874f2c783c63e.source: In areas with an active Winds of Change quest, you are likely to see the original spawns, in addition to those foes that spawn due to the quest.
264a14f31f5e3a4710874e845df874f2c783c63e.text: 在具有活跃的“变革之风”任务的区域中，除了因任务而生成的敌人之外，您还可能会看到原始的生成点。

181eba1679c455f4657b989e04d7c3f0578cd78b.source: The quest doesn't stop Winds of Change related dialogues between NPCs from happening.
181eba1679c455f4657b989e04d7c3f0578cd78b.text: 该任务不会阻止 NPC 之间发生与变革之风相关的对话。

62eb8d6b0415d074b1f701d24a90edca831a3b16.source: To return to the Winds of Change spawns, abandon the quest from your log.
62eb8d6b0415d074b1f701d24a90edca831a3b16.text: 要返回变革之风生成点，请放弃日志中的任务。

e78d0d454d97bcc822370dbcf48cab14b97c5174.source: To get to the Underworld, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). The party must be in one of the locations below and have a player either use a Passage Scroll to the Underworld or pay 1000 gold to the Voice of Grenth at a Statue of Grenth.
e78d0d454d97bcc822370dbcf48cab14b97c5174.text: 要到达地狱，队伍中的所有玩家都必须是飞升者或 Weh no Su（Elonian 角色可能会完成任务“猎杀”！）。队伍必须位于以下地点之一，并且让玩家使用通向地狱的通道卷轴或向古兰斯雕像处的古兰斯之声支付 1000 金币。

db452cfddbdb159795a5f6a8bbc53b04054af1dc.text: 登上海滩（没有雕像，只有卷轴）

23f9ed9f7ddf8885460149809c75742606361baf.source: Southeast corner of Lornar's Pass (Statue only, no scroll)
23f9ed9f7ddf8885460149809c75742606361baf.text: 洛纳通道东南角（仅雕像，无卷轴）

7b2d88e5f1e131791f3b96b428875313b617751e.source: Your party has completed [0...10] of 10 quests.
7b2d88e5f1e131791f3b96b428875313b617751e.text: 你的队伍已完成 10 个任务中的 [0...10] 个。

bd3ffb5f037524dd10fbb3af758c52b43150e4e3.source: Grenth has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the Hall of Judgement to claim your reward.
bd3ffb5f037524dd10fbb3af758c52b43150e4e3.text: 古伦斯已经承认了你所做的伟大事迹。返回审判大厅领取奖励。

5364054351c4a92a3a8d29e702ff48b10d9559e1.source: If your party wipes, you will be kicked out of the area. This will also happen if certain allies die.
5364054351c4a92a3a8d29e702ff48b10d9559e1.text: 如果你的队伍被消灭，你将被踢出该区域。如果某些盟友死亡，也会发生这种情况。

8fd9f6e2d0093fa96662fecf88288ac878dce8e8.source: Heroes can enter, but henchmen are not allowed.
8fd9f6e2d0093fa96662fecf88288ac878dce8e8.text: 英雄可以进，但追随者不能进。

cfa3191e3db1f8ee0f696091b0b3371a0effacfd.source: Successfully completing all of the quests in a single session once will unlock the quest The Nightman Cometh from King Frozenwind. After taking this quest players can go inside the Hall of Judgement. When every player is inside the Hall of Judgement, Dhuum, who resides there, will become aggressive and players can defeat him. Defeating Dhuum will unlock a statue in the Hall of Monuments and allow each party member to open the Underworld Chest once.
cfa3191e3db1f8ee0f696091b0b3371a0effacfd.text: 在一次会话中成功完成所有任务将解锁冰风国王的夜行者任务。完成该任务后玩家可以进入审判大厅。当所有玩家都进入审判大厅时，居住在那里的德姆会变得具有攻击性，玩家可以击败他。击败德姆将解锁纪念碑大厅中的雕像，并允许每个队伍成员打开地狱宝箱一次。

cdde258fb8effbbd48480c86b581970c5a014cc2.source: The Underworld is home to the Black Widow, which can only be found there and only after completing certain quests.
cdde258fb8effbbd48480c86b581970c5a014cc2.text: 地狱是黑寡妇的家园，只有在完成某些任务后才能在那里找到黑寡妇。

f032c10ede906fe9e5d2bbe131fd07a45d7c019e.source: This area is popular for farming Globs of Ectoplasm.
f032c10ede906fe9e5d2bbe131fd07a45d7c019e.text: 该地区以种植灵质球而闻名。

5a16b2d8afb965cf1b830b29b7dafb39d4c1fff7.source: Approximately 50 Skeletons of Dhuum, which can be farmed throughout the year for Every Bit Helps if you stockpiled Everlasting Mobstoppers, spawn in the Underworld without quests. From quests, there are additional spawns:
5a16b2d8afb965cf1b830b29b7dafb39d4c1fff7.text: 大约 50 个德姆骷髅，如果你储存了永恒的暴徒，可以全年种植，以获取每一点帮助，它们会在地下世界中生成，无需任务。从任务中，还有额外的生成点：

ee74a390515b862a84ed47656e576615e91c47f1.text: 不速之客会产生九个骷髅。

f3b19b888337d8000a279d3e396318b4ed10c4e9.text:
恐怖网女王会生成六只骷髅。

MAPPINGOUT_1baae3b6bc010f6_0
古兰斯之仆生成九个骷髅。每次任务演练的最佳猜测是不明确的

1baeae3b6bc010f6f956aaec553735c612cc10f7.source: Servants of Grenth spawns nine Skeletons.Best guess per walkthrough of quest which is ambiguous
1baeae3b6bc010f6f956aaec553735c612cc10f7.text: 古兰斯之仆生成九个骷髅。每次任务演练的最佳猜测是不明确的

9b22a4292620fe3e886d6d955f0ceb2f2547a25c.text: 被囚禁的灵魂会产生三个骷髅。

ff284488f4047ac8a983204f584b98e019641fb1.source: The Four Horsemen spawns four Skeletons. Off of memory, being either one or two skeletons per horseman
ff284488f4047ac8a983204f584b98e019641fb1.text: 四骑士生成四个骷髅。不记得了，每个骑兵要么是一具，要么是两具骷髅

530c5026b04d5f74c6e985cba919d62eb18e814e.source: If Gwen is a member of your party, you will see a conversation between her and her mother, Sarah. Yet another dialogue will be triggered if both Gwen and Keiran Thackeray are present.
530c5026b04d5f74c6e985cba919d62eb18e814e.text: 如果格温是你的派对成员，你会看到她和她母亲莎拉之间的对话。如果格温和凯兰·萨克雷都在场，就会触发另一场对话。

7820ab0e1aa98caba17869b3e8199d090628ed45.source: Dhuum will not become active until all players are present and can enter the hall together: be sure to bring skills or items to resurrect any dead party members and ensure that none of the others walk away from the computer too soon.
7820ab0e1aa98caba17869b3e8199d090628ed45.text: 直到所有玩家都在场并可以一起进入大厅后，Dhuum 才会激活：一定要带上技能或物品来复活任何死去的党员，并确保其他人不会过早离开电脑。

701da15a17090a2c80c6af933d3bb37c9dfc5468.source: When planning to complete this area in hard mode, it can be a good idea to first obtain the quest Miniature Companion: The Underworld from Merrise, Sworn to Seas in Embark Beach. This quest rewards 2025 experience, 2006 gold and the Miniature Mad King's Guard.
701da15a17090a2c80c6af933d3bb37c9dfc5468.text: 当计划以困难模式完成该区域时，最好首先从出发海滩的宣誓海洋的梅里斯那里获得任务微型伴侣：地狱。该任务奖励 2025 经验、2006 金币和微型疯王守卫。

edcc92e47ffd62753f8fea951e73ec250262d599.source: Allies created by summoning stones are not teleported with the party when talking to a Reaper. This can cause wipes on certain quests. One example is getting the Reaper of the Labyrinth killed during The Unwanted Guests. If your party begins the fight with Dhuum before King Frozenwind walks past the gate, he will be stuck outside. About a minute after your party defeats Dhuum, King Frozenwind and the Ice Elementals will spawn inside the Hall of Judgment. Sometimes King Frozenwind will not appear once Dhuum dies and the chest will not appear as a result.
edcc92e47ffd62753f8fea951e73ec250262d599.text: 与收割者交谈时，通过召唤石创建的盟友不会与队伍一起传送。这可能会导致某些任务被擦除。一个例子是在“不受欢迎的客人”中杀死迷宫收割者。如果你的队伍在冰风国王走过大门之前开始与德姆战斗，他将被困在外面。在你的队伍击败德姆后大约一分钟，冰风国王和冰元素将在审判大厅内生成。有时，一旦德姆死亡，冰风国王就不会出现，因此宝箱也不会出现。

4520a41fb4059320c94a13054aed7f596c18ada9.source: Go to North Kryta Province and follow the road to the fort in the D'Alessio Seaboard. Once there, report your presence to Mantle Knight Karriya.
4520a41fb4059320c94a13054aed7f596c18ada9.text: 前往北科瑞塔省，沿着路前往达莱西奥海岸的堡垒。到达那里后，向斗篷骑士卡里亚报告您的存在。

9860794d8bf07f6c2edb365aec9bd3445d258b81.text: 火焰伤害：7-13（需要 6 神圣恩惠）

e7e747835547423edf6645955619d1900b4e173c.text: 伤害 +10%（生命值高于 50% 时）

8875e55b61c31b90d2c0dc6455e9d4f601127aaa.source: Exit Lion's Arch into North Kryta Province and head west to D'Alessio Seaboard. Enter the outpost and talk with Mantle Knight Karriya to complete the quest. It's a short trip; however, a few Fire Imps may cause trouble for low level characters. Bring sufficient healing.
8875e55b61c31b90d2c0dc6455e9d4f601127aaa.text: 从狮子拱门驶出，进入北科里塔省，然后向西前往达莱西奥海滨。进入前哨站并与斗篷骑士卡里亚交谈以完成任务。这是一次短途旅行；然而，一些火小鬼可能会给低等级的角色带来麻烦。带来足够的治愈力。

f5805d4993baef41e7924980257169ef23eb3552.source: Speak to First Spear Dehvad to gain entrance to the Training Area.
f5805d4993baef41e7924980257169ef23eb3552.text: 与首席长矛德瓦德交谈以进入训练区。

89eb3224d18f692b295f743e0bbcccf9ea71301b.source: Report to Castellan Puuba in the Sunspear Great Hall for further orders.
89eb3224d18f692b295f743e0bbcccf9ea71301b.text: 向阳矛大厅的城主普乌巴报到以获取进一步的命令。

a18133924c2731dc649e40f32386f85539e3aaf6.source: Koss, Dunkoro, Melonni, and Tahlkora are unlocked after talking to Kormir. They will all be level 15, rather than the level they have during the quest.
a18133924c2731dc649e40f32386f85539e3aaf6.text: 与科米尔交谈后，科斯、邓科罗、梅洛尼和塔尔科拉被解锁。他们都将达到 15 级，而不是他们在任务期间的等级。

5b78a9ace94fab44073820901bf0e6fc6d9a0155.source: At the same time you will be given an extra copy of the weapons these heroes come with. These weapons are more powerful than the ones they're currently equipped with, and more adapted to their (higher) level.
5b78a9ace94fab44073820901bf0e6fc6d9a0155.text: 同时，您将获得这些英雄附带的武器的额外副本。这些武器比他们目前装备的武器更强大，并且更适合他们的（更高）等级。

968d65448b3934b239cf20c06b1eea7adbd0f008.source: When Nightfall was released, the 4 heroes were recruited at the same level that they were recruited in the Nightfall campaign (Koss at level 2, Dunkoro at level 6, Melonni at level 8 and Tahlkora at level 12). This was changed later, probably due to the fact that foreign characters were very soon faced with the Consulate Docks mission where all foes are level 20 (thus, rendering the heroes quite useless). At that time, Securing Champion's Dawn and A Land of Heroes didn't exist.
968d65448b3934b239cf20c06b1eea7adbd0f008.text: 当《夜幕降临》发布时，这 4 名英雄的招募级别与《夜幕降临》战役中招募的级别相同（Koss 为 2 级，Dunkoro 为 6 级，Melonni 为 8 级，Tahlkora 为 12 级）。后来这一点被改变了，可能是因为外国角色很快就面临着所有敌人都是20级的领事馆码头任务（因此，英雄变得毫无用处）。那时，《保卫冠军的黎明》和《英雄之地》还不存在。

ef5ea8a5dece71a2139563ca27fb7c49653b6f2d.source: Characters who obtained heroes under level 15 are stuck with them, even if they have not yet completed this quest:
ef5ea8a5dece71a2139563ca27fb7c49653b6f2d.text: 获得15级以下英雄的角色将被困在其中，即使他们尚未完成此任务：

d32498e17c5ae4034be5c939b7351ddb61396d0a.source: Abandoning the quest and retaking it will not fix their levels. (the levels were set when the heroes were first unlocked)
d32498e17c5ae4034be5c939b7351ddb61396d0a.text: 放弃任务并重新接受任务不会修复他们的等级。 （等级是在英雄首次解锁时设定的）

8705f480c5e7503a8a36361a03481bcd8421933a.source: It is not possible to delete the heroes via support request.
8705f480c5e7503a8a36361a03481bcd8421933a.text: 无法通过支持请求删除英雄。

c0a6850b0734d7feb96cd0ff03df696e1173a553.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Morostav Trail.
c0a6850b0734d7feb96cd0ff03df696e1173a553.text: 击败莫罗斯塔夫小道中的受难者。

7eb2ba6c3a3dc80ebef2fcdd5164d03bb9061ea8.source: See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.
7eb2ba6c3a3dc80ebef2fcdd5164d03bb9061ea8.text: 请参阅启蒙 Zei Ri 以获得奖励。

ba036e6bb6a8f1e1e3f56272837f7a4feccae193.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Morostav Trail, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn. The Ritualist's Construct also disappears after completion of this quest, which makes Soul Twisting much more time-consuming to capture without Memories of Purity active.
ba036e6bb6a8f1e1e3f56272837f7a4feccae193.text: 完成此任务会改变莫罗斯塔夫小道中出现的敌人，特别是，受苦者将不再生成。完成此任务后，仪式者的构装体也会消失，这使得在没有激活纯洁记忆的情况下捕获灵魂扭曲要花费更多时间。

ce615c9c05ba868138aa775c47849d3d5187074a.source: Leave from Durheim Archives and head west-north-west. You will fight through a few groups before arriving at a circular clearing filled with afflicted. There are 8 groups, each with its own boss representing one of the factions professions. Work your way around the circle, either clockwise or counter clockwise. Try to only engage one group at a time.
ce615c9c05ba868138aa775c47849d3d5187074a.text: 从杜尔海姆档案馆出发，向西北偏西方向行驶。在到达充满受折磨者的圆形空地之前，你将与几组战斗。有8个小组，每个小组都有自己的老板，代表一个派系职业。顺时针或逆时针绕圆圈工作。尝试一次只参与一组。

69d75b345cc94bce49a4f64d72b0397c209a9e1b.source: With the exception of Initiate Zei Ri, all ministry allies do not resurrect if they are killed.
69d75b345cc94bce49a4f64d72b0397c209a9e1b.text: 除了入门者 Zei Ri 之外，所有部族盟友如果被杀都不会复活。

a11d97a6eeaa08e79de5420ff68d1d1f9cf26073.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
* Reforged Mode is active
a11d97a6eeaa08e79de5420ff68d1d1f9cf26073.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色
* 重制模式已激活

330a24e65f1f5fbf8520dca3822209dbbd95ede3.source: Meet up with your profession trainer outside the city gate. Complete their test.
330a24e65f1f5fbf8520dca3822209dbbd95ede3.text: 在城门外与您的职业培训师会面。完成他们的测试。

a41b0f82b31d3ac92ce35bb58cf6d87d618ab84b.source: Meet up with Devona and complete her task.
a41b0f82b31d3ac92ce35bb58cf6d87d618ab84b.text: 与德沃娜会面并完成她的任务。

7c292714585b4663c69df63f459f6b407360eb65.source: Choose a secondary profession. Visit trainers to try out different skills from each profession. Once decided, return to Armin Saberlin.
7c292714585b4663c69df63f459f6b407360eb65.text: 选择第二职业。拜访培训师，尝试每个职业的不同技能。一旦决定，就回到阿明·萨柏林身边。

5f1d1de7c47ead73bd64b6f26595e12fb7a7a19b.source: Speak with Sir Tydus when you are ready to proceed.
5f1d1de7c47ead73bd64b6f26595e12fb7a7a19b.text: 当你准备好继续前进时，与泰达斯爵士交谈。

7f53836655a45a3524c86fea75a819f421163822.source: Speak with any Town Crier to receive your reward.
7f53836655a45a3524c86fea75a819f421163822.text: 与任何城镇公告员交谈即可获得奖励。

1e1589e4cbe24e43d18b9f9b67933d267c92eadf.source: Step out of the gates of Ascalon City into the idyllic meadows of Lakeside County. Your first task is to master the fundamentals of your chosen Primary Profession. Depending on your chosen profession, the available quest will vary:
1e1589e4cbe24e43d18b9f9b67933d267c92eadf.text: 走出阿斯卡隆城的大门，进入湖滨县田园诗般的草地。您的首要任务是掌握您选择的主要职业的基础知识。根据您选择的职业，可用的任务会有所不同：

56a26fc4f6947a1d2e5cea7298ba9afd9d40cee0.text: 催眠术 催眠术测试

873e44d56d9c2e040f854d1cb153f8937760dc20.text: 元素师 元素师测试

51ceb25b80266814334f44bca0b74a2d0f27db80.source: Accept your respective quest and complete it. Once you have proven your basic competence, travel southwest along the road to the village of Ashford to meet with Devona. She will task you with investigating some Unsettling Rumors.
51ceb25b80266814334f44bca0b74a2d0f27db80.text: 接受你各自的任务并完成它。一旦你证明了你的基本能力，就沿着公路向西南行驶，到达阿什福德村与德沃娜会面。她会让你调查一些令人不安的谣言。

dba602221710de41dae9039c44047af670b680c3.source: After you finish that quest, you must expand your horizons by selecting a secondary profession. Caution: Your choice of a secondary profession cannot be changed until much later in the game; therefore, it is advised not to lock in your choice until you are done with adventuring in this area.
dba602221710de41dae9039c44047af670b680c3.text: 完成该任务后，您必须通过选择第二职业来扩大视野。注意：你对次要职业的选择要到游戏后期才能改变；因此，建议您在完成该地区的冒险之前不要锁定您的选择。

4a2d04649a9ad563904ee43524af9c1a351839e8.source: The following quests unlock a secondary profession:
4a2d04649a9ad563904ee43524af9c1a351839e8.text: 以下任务解锁次要职业：

189f45d22a27655711b4a9a38e571fbb01a9da8c.text: 不 死灵法师的新手

e6d96b772f0880ad96df10ab818aab6eabe258f3.text: 催眠师 催眠师的负担

745ef800fe8c41752297f68888f4c1c827d51bcf.text: 元素师 元素师实验

a9de97f2f8b63993fecc9bf2dbcbf189ed7abcdd.source: After you have firmly locked in your secondary profession, return to Ascalon City and speak to Armin Saberlin. Accept the quest A Second Profession from him (if you haven't already done so) and accept the reward from that quest to proceed. Then speak to a Town Crier for your reward.
a9de97f2f8b63993fecc9bf2dbcbf189ed7abcdd.text: 当你牢牢锁定你的第二职业后，返回阿斯卡隆城并与阿明·萨伯林交谈。接受他的任务“第二职业”（如果您还没有这样做）并接受该任务的奖励以继续。然后与城镇公告员交谈以获得奖励。

53c3747a5c20e05dac18cd4128d832e48931b58a.source: This quest was added as part of the May 27th, 2026 update.
53c3747a5c20e05dac18cd4128d832e48931b58a.text: 此任务是作为 2026 年 5 月 27 日更新的一部分添加的。

af3a892823a04fc07de2abdaf89e53f6d3283e3e.source: If you accept this quest after completing A Second Profession, the objective to speak with a Town Crier will not appear and you will be unable to obtain the reward.
af3a892823a04fc07de2abdaf89e53f6d3283e3e.text: 如果您在完成第二职业后接受此任务，与城镇公告员交谈的目标将不会出现，并且您将无法获得奖励。

bbe61fdee698bd7f65d45a1da8c8dc80f20e6424.source: Help the Dwarves locate and flee through the Asuran Gate.
bbe61fdee698bd7f65d45a1da8c8dc80f20e6424.text: 帮助矮人找到并逃离阿苏兰之门。

b47e9129a16448c171d09dfdf4e5a953dc83534e.source: A timer will appear showing "Time remaining to escape", giving you 3 minutes. The easiest way to complete this quest is to click on Burol Ironfist or Kodan on the way in to the meeting. After the meeting is over (or you and your party members click the "skip" button), just press the space bar to follow them. Your character will follow them, trying to catch up as they run their way to the Asura Gate, possibly catching up to them once or twice on the run. If this happens, just hit the space bar again. A lot of Destroyers will spawn behind your party and chase after. They can be ignored, and it is best to do so as fighting them will eat up time. As you approach the gate, be prepared for your character to stop moving when the NPC you were following enters the gate. Using this strategy, you reach the gate with roughly 1 minute left — provided you didn't stop to fight.
b47e9129a16448c171d09dfdf4e5a953dc83534e.text: 将会出现一个计时器，显示“逃脱剩余时间”，给你 3 分钟的时间。完成此任务的最简单方法是在参加会议时单击布罗尔·铁拳或克丹。会议结束后（或者您和您的队伍成员单击“跳过”按钮），只需按空格键即可关注他们。你的角色会跟随他们，试图在他们跑向阿修罗门时追上他们，可能会在逃跑过程中追上他们一两次。如果发生这种情况，只需再次按空格键即可。许多驱逐舰会在你的队伍后面生成并追赶。可以忽略它们，最好这样做，因为与它们战斗会消耗时间。当您接近大门时，请做好准备，当您跟随的 NPC 进入大门时，您的角色会停止移动。使用这个策略，你可以在大约还剩 1 分钟时到达大门——前提是你没有停下来战斗。

7099ca8059e7b62c7d8115e8217cfd612d2b6745.source: This quest is automatically added to the Quest Log upon completion of the Encounter in the Depths cinematic of any one of the preceding quests. This quest is also automatically completed and removed upon entering the Asura Gate, and the follow-up quest, Against the Destroyers is automatically added.
7099ca8059e7b62c7d8115e8217cfd612d2b6745.text: 完成前述任一任务的“深渊遭遇”过场动画后，该任务会自动添加到任务日志中。该任务在进入修罗门时也会自动完成并移除，并自动添加后续任务“对抗毁灭者”。

aa96c5268e0dfbde42b0c38961b4f20bdf2b301a.source: The Quest Log says the quest is given in the Tunnels Below Cantha regardless of which continent you came from.
aa96c5268e0dfbde42b0c38961b4f20bdf2b301a.text: 任务日志显示，无论你来自哪个大陆，任务都会在凯萨下方的隧道中给出。

baa5d30b9c76b00412fb7fbaadf34e611b341d69.source: Trying to fight the Destroyers is a bad idea: the chance of winning is slim and it takes a great part of your time. Also, you can easily go to the gate without a speed boost and without any combat.
baa5d30b9c76b00412fb7fbaadf34e611b341d69.text: 试图与毁灭者战斗是一个坏主意：获胜的机会很小，而且会占用你大量的时间。此外，你可以轻松地到达大门，无需速度提升，也无需任何战斗。

e1b0a56314a564649e2b7a9d3b43919f01a9c5dc.source: If you do decide to fight the destroyers, some things to consider are:
e1b0a56314a564649e2b7a9d3b43919f01a9c5dc.text: 如果您决定与驱逐舰作战，需要考虑以下事项：

fb97085227c9c153713fd73466074b886f73b3d0.source: All destroyers during this mission are warriors, making them vulnerable to Blindness, Weakness and skills that can disable the attacks of multiple enemies, such as Clumsiness.
fb97085227c9c153713fd73466074b886f73b3d0.text: 此任务中的所有驱逐舰都是战士，使他们容易受到失明、虚弱和可以使多个敌人攻击的技能（例如笨拙）的影响。

faae1952e09f3fc8dd487a11977c6fc87ca87d79.source: The fact that they are all melee-fighters opens up for the possibility of clumping them up and knocking them down with area knockdowns like Meteor, Earth Shaker and Grasping Was Kuurong.
faae1952e09f3fc8dd487a11977c6fc87ca87d79.text: 事实上，他们都是近战战士，因此有可能将他们聚集在一起，并通过流星、撼地者和抓握瓦斯库隆等区域击倒来击倒他们。

2c574b1d2717b5db3566b4fcfb2304cf46a3f22c.source: Due to the time limitation, it is unlikely that you will have time to defeat all destroyers if fought individually; Consider running to the end of the mission and fight them all there.
2c574b1d2717b5db3566b4fcfb2304cf46a3f22c.text: 由于时间限制，如果单打独斗，你不太可能有时间击败所有驱逐舰；考虑跑到任务的终点并在那里与他们战斗。

c8e14bbb9e359450094ba7b997be4d44b6f826ee.source: Also see the Destroyer-page for general weaknesses of destroyers.
c8e14bbb9e359450094ba7b997be4d44b6f826ee.text: 另请参阅驱逐舰页面以了解驱逐舰的一般弱点。

42d7282f54ff27730a362ceb8b5743d239f69550.source: During the quest, the Guild Wars Eye of the North overture (from the login screen and character selection screen) plays.
42d7282f54ff27730a362ceb8b5743d239f69550.text: 在任务过程中，会播放激战北方之眼序曲（来自登录屏幕和角色选择屏幕）。

9083d4a78ad29f837f9edcb81383193ee970f7d8.source: Going through the portal will send you to the Into the North cinematic.
9083d4a78ad29f837f9edcb81383193ee970f7d8.text: 通过门户将带您进入电影《走进北方》。

a215adf11e4c62014aecf7f6330973be7a2d7892.source: When "Time remaining to escape" runs out, your party automatically dies and a "QUEST FAILED: Your group did not escape from the dungeon in time." message appears.
a215adf11e4c62014aecf7f6330973be7a2d7892.text: 当“逃脱剩余时间”耗尽时，你的队伍会自动死亡，并显示“任务失败：你的队伍没有及时逃离地牢”。出现消息。

dbecf0b79c08d91dd8b74bf8125cab3726e77dc4.source: Speak with Brother Mhenlo in Bukdek Byway.
dbecf0b79c08d91dd8b74bf8125cab3726e77dc4.text: 与布德克小路的曼洛修士交谈。

e5c386db3038522e4286da5529c451dd1bd921c9.source: Travel with Brother Mhenlo to find his old teacher, Master Togo.
e5c386db3038522e4286da5529c451dd1bd921c9.text: 与门洛修士一起前往寻找他的老师东哥大师。

86e315835162d5654ea0e49dd431fcfa4b921600.source: See Guardsman Chow for your reward.
86e315835162d5654ea0e49dd431fcfa4b921600.text: 请见卫兵周以获得奖励。

7df7832b2bf820fdac7d93752a38a4422d872823.source: After leaving Kaineng Center, speak with Mhenlo right outside. Then follow the marker to Emi and Chiyo in a large courtyard area. After Mhenlo and the twins talk for a moment, the quest will update and you, Mhenlo, and his gang will travel to the Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) entrance, where Guardsman Chow will let you enter Vizunah Square.
7df7832b2bf820fdac7d93752a38a4422d872823.text: 离开凯能中心后，在外面与 Mhenlo 交谈。然后沿着标记前往大庭院中的惠美和千代。在 Mhenlo 和双胞胎交谈了一会儿后，任务将会更新，你、Mhenlo 和他的帮派将前往 Vizunah 广场（外国区）入口，卫兵 Chow 会让你进入 Vizunah 广场。

9ce59e9eb304166f7bf04dde14433c7fc3697b13.source: If you keep this quest active, all the quest NPCs will travel and fight with you in Bukdek Byway.
9ce59e9eb304166f7bf04dde14433c7fc3697b13.text: 如果你保持这个任务活跃，所有任务 NPC 都会在 Bukdek Byway 中与你一起旅行和战斗。

552a548d59bfcd7fad19f2079c356d62f495aa88.source: The Quest Log displays "Dockhand Quangnai (Kaineng Docks)" even though Bejunkan Pier is where Dockhand Quangnai is located and the quest is acquired.
552a548d59bfcd7fad19f2079c356d62f495aa88.text: 任务日志显示“Dockhand Quangnai（Kaineng Docks）”，尽管 Bejunkan 码头是 Dockhand Quangnai 所在的位置并且任务已获得。

eece10f001c327a023917d42d0ea0a3c503e2d51.source: Investigate the Eye of the North.

78d6511de6bf3827321862ccc17a5d2edfb7f3c9.source: Seek assistance from the Asura. (The Knowledgeable Asura)
78d6511de6bf3827321862ccc17a5d2edfb7f3c9.text: 寻求阿修罗的帮助。 （知识渊博的阿修罗）

dbc94e366dc4a114f49917981545666b7455c38f.source: Gain the Norn as allies. (Northern Allies)
dbc94e366dc4a114f49917981545666b7455c38f.text: 与诺恩结为盟友。 （北方同盟国）

f2e8d77f958c24f00adff8dd89b70edab661d3df.source: Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands. (The Missing Vanguard)
f2e8d77f958c24f00adff8dd89b70edab661d3df.text: 在夏尔家园寻找黑锋先锋。 （失踪的先锋队）

43873bec859eff61d5896f178e8c9c71415863df.source: Look into the scrying pool at the Eye of the North.
43873bec859eff61d5896f178e8c9c71415863df.text: 看看北方之眼的占卜池。

58c0e44650c277d385c097199a5b7e66cf5224e4.source: Seek out Jalis Ironhammer and help summon the power of the Great Dwarf. (Heart of the Shiverpeaks)
58c0e44650c277d385c097199a5b7e66cf5224e4.text: 寻找贾利斯·铁锤并帮助召唤大矮人的力量。 （席瓦山脉之心）

c8d4e8232fa56cc2d77967f0b283aac0f7031fbd.source: Eliminate the Destroyers. (A Time for Heroes)

6a8f32d6bf909ebb0bdab78cbd2bf1089da57e7c.text: 前往卓克纳尔领取奖励。

5fc043e485a1fab0baca6143abe963ff70a788bb.source: Leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside. Follow the quest marker north and into the Eye of the North. Once there, you will be directed into the Hall of Monuments. Speak with Gwen and look into the Scrying Pool. Choose to keep your eyes open to receive The First Vision and three primary quests:
5fc043e485a1fab0baca6143abe963ff70a788bb.text: 离开北方车站并在外面与乔拉交谈。跟随任务标记向北进入北方之眼。到达那里后，您将被引导进入纪念碑大厅。与格温交谈并观察占卜池。选择睁大眼睛接受第一次愿景和三个主要任务：

7162bf83c41fe61e0b3d24d7b361a1d2ace01fdd.source: These three quests can be done in any order. When all three are completed, look into the Scrying Pool once more. Select "Look Deep into the Pool" to activate The Final Vision.
7162bf83c41fe61e0b3d24d7b361a1d2ace01fdd.text: 这三个任务可以按任何顺序完成。当这三个都完成后，再次查看占卜池。选择“深入池中”以激活“最终愿景”。

4f4e3153bcd3d63ecd0e35a8f7db1ba1c8f2a73b.source: Your next task is to travel to Jalis Ironhammer, receiving the quest Heart of the Shiverpeaks.
4f4e3153bcd3d63ecd0e35a8f7db1ba1c8f2a73b.text: 你的下一个任务是前往贾利斯·铁锤，接受任务“席瓦山脉之心”。

b58e2b1d9833fb19cd8fc222cf5af06f0bfea2fb.source: Upon completion, Jalis will give you the quest Destruction's Depths. While this is not part of the quest objectives, it is needed to reach the Central Transfer Chamber where the final task awaits.
b58e2b1d9833fb19cd8fc222cf5af06f0bfea2fb.text: 完成后，贾利斯会给你任务“毁灭之深”。虽然这不是任务目标的一部分，但需要到达中央传送室，那里等待着最终的任务。

f472f5b99906f7956f824e06353c6292e79c0166.source: Once inside the Central Transfer Chamber, talk to High Priest Alkar to receive the final quest, A Time for Heroes. Finishing it marks the end of Eye of the North's storyline and sends you to the Epilogue, where you can receive the quest reward and a Droknar's Key from Droknar.
f472f5b99906f7956f824e06353c6292e79c0166.text: 进入中央传送室后，与大祭司阿尔卡交谈以接受最终任务“英雄时刻”。完成它标志着北方之眼故事情节的结束，并将您带到尾声，在那里您可以从卓克纳尔那里获得任务奖励和卓克纳尔的钥匙。

a6f92677a21c78f169a791ea93bcc66aff1ccc18.source: Even if the quest objectives, markers and exclamation marks update properly at the scrying pool, the First Vision will not be available until you talk to Jora in Ice Cliff Chasms.
a6f92677a21c78f169a791ea93bcc66aff1ccc18.text: 即使探知池中的任务目标、标记和感叹号正确更新，在您与冰崖裂谷中的乔拉交谈之前，第一视觉也不会可用。

e38a3715f4da88fd67dc861e9d1d72941e8f7831.source: This quest is automatically added to the quest log upon completion of the preceding quest. Unlike most quests, it cannot be abandoned. This is due to not being able to reacquire it.
e38a3715f4da88fd67dc861e9d1d72941e8f7831.text:
完成前面的任务后，该任务会自动添加到任务日志中。与大多数任务不同，它不能被放弃。这是由于无法重新获得它。

MAPPINGOUT_afeb593d307bf28_0
一旦你离开北方车站并在外面与乔拉交谈，你可以步行回去或绘制地图回到车站，再次离开，并在复活神社收集诺恩赏金。如果你继续直接前往北方之眼，你就无法到达它，直到沿着路径走得更远。

afebb593d307bf2833ef36b3f97672f44ef6e0fd.source: Once you leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside, you can either walk back or map travel back to the station, leave again, and collect the Norn Bounty at the resurrection shrine. If you continue on directly to the Eye of the North, you cannot get it until further along the path.
afebb593d307bf2833ef36b3f97672f44ef6e0fd.text: 一旦你离开北方车站并在外面与乔拉交谈，你可以步行回去或绘制地图回到车站，再次离开，并在复活神社收集诺恩赏金。如果你继续直接前往北方之眼，你就无法到达它，直到沿着路径走得更远。

55cf770b347e841c7e07afb6ded78d6c55161219.source: Travel to the Sunspear watch post.

e6e4de79dd7bc8fd2205f80b0765c9b46ce10982.source: Start the Tutorial by speaking to Kormir. She will explain how to walk and how to interact with other characters. Go to the chest behind you, open it, and pick up the weapon. then go into your Inventory and equip it (either by double-clicking it, or dragging it to your weapon slot). Speak to Kormir once again to continue. She will then explain Quests and how to use the Compass. Follow her toward the gate, where she explains how Loot Drops work.
e6e4de79dd7bc8fd2205f80b0765c9b46ce10982.text: 通过与科米尔交谈来开始教程。她将解释如何行走以及如何与其他角色互动。走到你身后的箱子前，打开它，然后拿起武器。然后进入您的库存并装备它（通过双击它，或将其拖到您的武器槽中）。再次与科米尔交谈以继续。然后她将解释任务以及如何使用指南针。跟随她走向大门，在那里她解释了战利品掉落的工作原理。

a7d08517bc38504787af37ab1fefdb8ad911d5ac.source: Now you have to kill 3 Corsair Spies; just attack them and they will die quickly. Afterward, proceed towards the resurrection shrine…where you will die quickly (as Kormir explains Death and the Death Penalty). There you will also learn your first 3 skills and she will explain how to use them.
a7d08517bc38504787af37ab1fefdb8ad911d5ac.text: 现在你必须杀死 3 个海盗间谍；只要攻击他们，他们就会很快死去。然后，前往复活神殿……在那里你会很快死去（正如科米尔解释的死亡和死刑）。在那里您还将学习前 3 项技能，她将解释如何使用它们。

e4248b8ebefe0824acab28c26f3fd4620488bf29.source: Proceed to the next two groups of corsairs and kill them. While running, listen as Kormir explains the Aggro Range Circle on your compass. Speak to Kormir again to get your reward. She will explain what Attribute Points and Skill Points are. Speak to her again to get your next primary quest.
e4248b8ebefe0824acab28c26f3fd4620488bf29.text: 继续前往接下来的两组海盗并杀死他们。跑步时，听科米尔在指南针上解释仇恨范围圈。再次与科米尔交谈以获得奖励。她会解释什么是属性点和技能点。再次与她交谈以获得你的下一个主要任务。

d4f45f8ddf47cba4eae031a663361cafb402ffd9.source: Dying during the tutorial explanation of the resurrection shrine does not increase the number of deaths you have taken (see /deaths).
d4f45f8ddf47cba4eae031a663361cafb402ffd9.text: 在复活神殿的教程解释中死亡不会增加你的死亡次数（参见/deaths）。

f0b6584071f261709fa01f998d1f4dcd6be32036.source: Kneeling at the resurrection shrine will summon the Avatar of Dwayna, but she will not talk to you nor offer any blessings.
f0b6584071f261709fa01f998d1f4dcd6be32036.text: 跪在复活神殿前会召唤德薇娜的化身，但她不会和你说话，也不会提供任何祝福。

56b46449e51aed86bef840477739784268bcf530.source: Before talking to Kormir and beginning the tutorial, obtain your weapon from the Weapons Chest and scrape the entire area, which will add 0.5% toward the Elonian Cartographer title (as well as some experience and treasure from killing the Corsairs in the water -- you might have to engage in tactical retreats from the Corsair Healer, who is the same level as you, but who apparently cannot heal). After talking to Kormir and completing the tutorial, you should have a total of 0.8% toward the Elonian Cartographer title.
56b46449e51aed86bef840477739784268bcf530.text: 在与科米尔交谈并开始教程之前，从武器箱中获取你的武器并刮擦整个区域，这将为埃隆制图师头衔增加 0.5%（以及在水中杀死海盗的一些经验和宝藏——你可能必须从海盗治疗师那里进行战术撤退，他与你水平相同，但显然无法治愈）。与 Kormir 交谈并完成教程后，您应该总共获得 0.8% 的 Elonian 制图师头衔。

de586b1af1c1f926cfebb91a14fd48de0c4117c2.source: This quest will stay in your Quest Log when leaving the zone (such as when entering the Guild Hall or resigning), but will be automatically removed upon re-entry to the Island of Shehkah instance.
de586b1af1c1f926cfebb91a14fd48de0c4117c2.text: 当离开区域时（例如进入公会大厅或辞职时），该任务将保留在您的任务日志中，但在重新进入谢卡岛副本时将自动删除。

5dfd63b74db2449391196a072a34a1fb9ec096c9.text: 与首席长矛贾杜加尔交谈。

f360ac560f3e8d7def6e1efb7f6307a200ce8d9b.source: See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.
f360ac560f3e8d7def6e1efb7f6307a200ce8d9b.text: 请见第一矛贾杜加尔以获得奖励。

38863481e9720a388e6c5e8cacec98061c97d1fa.source: Walk to First Spear Jahdugar and speak with him. Choose to enter. That's it.
38863481e9720a388e6c5e8cacec98061c97d1fa.text: 走到第一矛贾杜加尔那里并与他交谈。选择进入。就是这样。

c3db20e5b22128d8bba3c83cb9e5d4666d4daa3c.source: Resigning after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't talked to First Spear Jahdugar.
c3db20e5b22128d8bba3c83cb9e5d4666d4daa3c.text: 接受此任务后辞职将导致你移动到前哨站，即使你还没有与第一矛贾杜加尔交谈过。

646bdaafc6c2ed85628638f98976357e39b5df3e.source: Meet Instructor Ng at the gate.

cc1d41c155293afbb238db8eabc6de2ba9068180.text: 击败 [18..0] 更多螳螂幼体。

4fb7faf7f3b2273c3c38dc4c7343c89aa1c05aac.source: See Instructor Ng for your reward.

2962cb6dc8ad7c06f0a09a847fbb3f21fc3ab813.source: Follow Instructor Ng and speak to him each time he requests. Kill all the mantids on the way. After you are resurrected at the resurrection shrine, you receive two skills.
2962cb6dc8ad7c06f0a09a847fbb3f21fc3ab813.text: 跟随吴教练并在每次他提出要求时与他交谈。杀死路上所有的螳螂。在复活神殿复活后，你将获得两个技能。

438cf2eb816c397e66383cc84680d829ba36bcbe.source: Despite Instructor Ng implying he has given Kisai and Mai two skills each, they actually both possess their full starting henchman skill bars, and use them against the two hatchlings before the resurrection shrine as well.
438cf2eb816c397e66383cc84680d829ba36bcbe.text: 尽管吴教练暗示他已经给了基西和麦两个技能，但他们实际上都拥有完整的起始追随者技能条，并在复活神社前用它们对抗两只幼体。

36b5f6bbb664a77d2caaa5de4e674f9e19cc39cf.source: Mai also uses Viper's Defense despite usually only gaining that skill at level 10.
36b5f6bbb664a77d2caaa5de4e674f9e19cc39cf.text: 麦也使用毒蛇防御，尽管通常只有在 10 级时才获得该技能。

fa2e7968468ace6df3093c9c66729309d783e910.source: If you resign while in the area the Krytan loading screen will be seen briefly, then quickly change to the Shing Jea loading screen.
fa2e7968468ace6df3093c9c66729309d783e910.text: 如果您在该区域辞职，将会短暂地看到 Krytan 加载屏幕，然后快速切换到 Shing Jea 加载屏幕。

969e952f98cd53037cb33c4ab1b8a31b49eb369a.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
969e952f98cd53037cb33c4ab1b8a31b49eb369a.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

d5fa73d2ab746d61628ac6a120e3b05ee6fd8b42.source: Go to the town square in Ascalon City. Talk to Sir Tydus.
d5fa73d2ab746d61628ac6a120e3b05ee6fd8b42.text: 前往阿斯卡隆市的城镇广场。与泰达斯爵士交谈。

6fb82f7722c635980f302149a5ad879bcbfd2f41.source: Head north from the Town Crier, crossing the stone bridge. You will find Sir Tydus on a podium just in front of the gate to the Ascalon Academy. Speak to him to claim your reward and learn of his news.
6fb82f7722c635980f302149a5ad879bcbfd2f41.text: 从 Town Crier 向北行驶，穿过石桥。您会在阿斯卡隆学院大门前的讲台上找到泰达斯爵士。与他交谈以领取奖励并了解他的消息。

26d775ae502c81aeace64df9b165ac4192979cef.source: While it acts as an introduction to the questing system, this quest is entirely optional. You can proceed directly to Sir Tydus to begin War Preparations. The only thing you will miss is a small amount of gold and experience.
26d775ae502c81aeace64df9b165ac4192979cef.text: 虽然它作为任务系统的介绍，但该任务完全是可选的。你可以直接前往泰达斯爵士那里开始战争准备。你唯一会错过的是少量的金币和经验。

21402e673b707e3a06955a6f1a6b7a751ca9326a.source: Speak to Vekk in the Hall of Monuments.
21402e673b707e3a06955a6f1a6b7a751ca9326a.text: 与纪念碑大厅的维克交谈。

166381da387400a92c9c2b360783de097c69df91.source: Journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations.
166381da387400a92c9c2b360783de097c69df91.text: 穿越 Vloxen 发掘区的阿修罗门。

959f86505934821108d35fc9ff5ef0d1ce06ab5d.source: Assemble a krewe for project G.O.L.E.M.
959f86505934821108d35fc9ff5ef0d1ce06ab5d.text: 为 G.O.L.E.M. 项目组装一个克鲁。

f2719e30fa44775d355d5c9394e59c94ff19cd0f.source: Recruit Gadd to help with the project. (Finding the Bloodstone)
f2719e30fa44775d355d5c9394e59c94ff19cd0f.text: 招募加德来帮助完成该项目。 （寻找鸡血石）

94f125407f25c0edf3bb4891d118a3a0f4863edc.source: Enlist Oola to help with the project. (The Elusive Golemancer)
94f125407f25c0edf3bb4891d118a3a0f4863edc.text: 让 Oola 帮助完成该项目。 （难以捉摸的傀儡师）

4d709cd3ef3875b6d97efb4c180b480dcd679608.source: Acquire Renk's help with the project.
4d709cd3ef3875b6d97efb4c180b480dcd679608.text: 获得伦克对项目的帮助。

ea560870e6780dafca106836cc834cdc8820e115.source: Protect the golem foundry from the Destroyers. (Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation)
ea560870e6780dafca106836cc834cdc8820e115.text: 保护傀儡铸造厂免受毁灭者的侵害。 （天才操作的生命魔法表现）

3102c4f3c097b315fb04cd7706f5f4266dc996b1.text: 请参阅 Mamp 获取奖励。

2ceff8eab16800b7a53cfc250723c7b66d335f56.source: If starting from Olafstead, journey south-west through Varajar Fells to Verdant Cascades. Continue traveling west to Umbral Grotto.
2ceff8eab16800b7a53cfc250723c7b66d335f56.text: 如果从奥拉夫斯特德出发，向西南穿过瓦拉贾丘陵到达翠绿瀑布。继续向西前往本影石窟。

16e90528e37af460863d40f8085242a8538108ff.source: For new characters starting from the Eye of the North, you can travel west into Battledepths then follow the northern route to reach Varajar Fells. The mini map will display where the exit is.
16e90528e37af460863d40f8085242a8538108ff.text: 对于从北方之眼开始的新角色，你可以向西进入战场深度，然后沿着北方路线到达瓦拉贾荒原。小地图上会显示出口的位置。

182abfe3b52dab0df60b417ed61799a00780e6f9.source: From Umbral Grotto, travel through the dungeon Vloxen Excavations to the south western exit on level 1. Be wary of rolling boulders, they will instantly kill anything in their path.
182abfe3b52dab0df60b417ed61799a00780e6f9.text: 从 Umbral Grotto 出发，穿过地牢 Vloxen Excavations，到达 1 层的西南出口。小心滚动的巨石，它们会立即杀死路上的任何东西。

e61260c2998f6559607d22cf7282dae81bd015a9.source: After the cinematic, adventurers will find themselves in Vlox's Falls. From here on, the story branches into three separate quest chains.
e61260c2998f6559607d22cf7282dae81bd015a9.text: 电影结束后，冒险家们会发现自己身处弗洛克斯瀑布。从这里开始，故事分为三个独立的任务链。

29b95e8ba8bc84fc1dc9bee4de720d241ad8b502.source: Take the quest Finding Gadd from Livia. Upon completion, you are offered the quest Finding the Bloodstone. Finish it to recruit Gadd.
29b95e8ba8bc84fc1dc9bee4de720d241ad8b502.text: 接受莉维亚的任务寻找加德。完成后，您将收到寻找鸡血石的任务。完成它来招募加德。

a891e9c17e9693f14288b9a4fa42cd2a3b1aca58.source: Take the quest Lab Space from Lork. It will lead you to Rata Sum. On your way there, consider making a little detour to advance Renk's quest chain (see below) or to unlock Tarnished Haven. Either way, completing Lab Space will directly lead to The Elusive Golemancer, gaining the support from Oola.
a891e9c17e9693f14288b9a4fa42cd2a3b1aca58.text: 接受洛克的任务实验室空间。它将带您前往 Rata Sum。在前往那里的路上，考虑绕道推进伦克的任务链（见下文）或解锁玷污的避风港。不管怎样，完成实验室空间将直接获得神出鬼没的傀儡师，并获得乌拉的支持。

f6d5cadc8f0b1b0fe76de6617a37a16ecb3e42d6.source: Take the quest A Little Help from Plaxx. As mentioned above, the first objective can be completed on your way to Rata Sum. The remaining objectives can only be completed after recruiting the other two Asura, making Renk the final addition to your krewe.
f6d5cadc8f0b1b0fe76de6617a37a16ecb3e42d6.text: 接受 Plaxx 的任务“一点帮助”。如上所述，第一个目标可以在前往拉塔苏姆的途中完成。剩下的目标只能在招募另外两个阿修罗后才能完成，使伦克成为你的克鲁的最后一个补充。

b8631b73bd9e8da55433b2972ead7aaf2d63c42f.source: When turning in the last quest at Mamp, pick the follow-up quest, Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation, and complete it.
b8631b73bd9e8da55433b2972ead7aaf2d63c42f.text: 当在曼普交出最后一个任务时，选择后续任务“天才操作的生命魔法显现”并完成它。

1d41245769c5e94dd7e5c02ab290e0c2a68b1bb1.source: Talk to Mamp again to finish the asuran storyline and claim your reward.
1d41245769c5e94dd7e5c02ab290e0c2a68b1bb1.text: 再次与曼普交谈以完成阿苏兰故事情节并领取奖励。

6ab25bf1fef1c0a820d98d2a35e1239449e3f954.source: Upon completion of the quest, you are automatically under the effect of Call of the Eye.
6ab25bf1fef1c0a820d98d2a35e1239449e3f954.text: 完成任务后，你会自动受到眼睛召唤的影响。

e819ef78ca8c55b04c4fb4be021102f32ab5e0f9.source: Despite the third objective asking the player to journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations, the objective is considered complete and the cinematic will begin if the player is able to enter Vlox's Falls from Arbor Bay.
e819ef78ca8c55b04c4fb4be021102f32ab5e0f9.text: 尽管第三个目标要求玩家穿过 Vloxen 发掘中的阿修罗之门，但如果玩家能够从阿伯湾进入 Vlox 瀑布，则该目标被认为已完成，并且电影将开始。

94e44642c7391b5f8e6ef467fe01eab7f8214ef1.source: Head southeast to the Shards of Orr. Use the Asura Gate inside the entrance to gain access to Gadd's Encampment. Rendezvous there with Bartholos.
94e44642c7391b5f8e6ef467fe01eab7f8214ef1.text: 向东南方向前往欧尔碎片。使用入口内的阿修罗门进入加德的营地。在那里与巴塞洛斯会合。

2acc8c8694e6912afbc5c2ead03d6fa919a09736.source: Join Livia and Gadd in Sparkfly Swamp.
2acc8c8694e6912afbc5c2ead03d6fa919a09736.text: 与莉维亚和加德一起前往火花飞沼泽。

16139da35fd29e18a19036e043f44b1c72a19780.source: Assist Livia with collecting inscriptions from the inscribed ettins. You have collected [0...3] of 3 inscriptions.
16139da35fd29e18a19036e043f44b1c72a19780.text: 协助莉维亚从铭文埃廷斯那里收集铭文。您已收集了 3 个铭文中的 [0...3] 个。

7349fdd42deb541c98a654deb733783329179486.source: Return to the entrance of the Bloodstone Caves.

13fdd13f9cd14c241042b3837a2a01ad7b6f9eb8.source: Activate the inscription and gain entrance to the Bloodstone Caves.
13fdd13f9cd14c241042b3837a2a01ad7b6f9eb8.text: 激活铭文并获得血石洞的入口。

4015633cf7b4bd51c45bdec0c46fbfb8e4948a7c.source: This is a fairly long quest and you should have around fifty minutes devoted to do it. To get to the Shards of Orr dungeon, start at Vlox's Falls and head southeast. The Krait along the way should be relatively easy.
4015633cf7b4bd51c45bdec0c46fbfb8e4948a7c.text: 这是一个相当长的任务，你应该有大约五十分钟的时间来完成它。要前往奥尔地牢碎片，请从弗洛克斯瀑布开始，然后向东南方向前进。一路上的Krait应该是比较容易的。

9953fa31217a439250a3cfcb7df6bdf6e6e0d814.source: Once inside the dungeon, it is very helpful to take your time with the skeletons and zombies. Two groups at once will be very dangerous to the party. Holy damage is effective, while physical attackers will have trouble due to the many blinding skills. One method is to bring seven heroes with "Charge!"/"Incoming!" and/or "Fall Back!" and stagger their uses in order to run right past the enemies. If the party racks up too much Death Penalty, the zombie groups can be impossible to kill. It's sometimes possible to get past them by creative flagging of henchmen/heroes. Flag your healers off to the sides and a strong tank in front of the first group. Flag the rest of your henchmen on the second group, off to the side so they don't get tangled up in the first group. An alternate way is to take the north side when you reach the breach halfway through the map, because there are only two groups up there and no healers (however there are more warriors to do heavy damage). After half a dozen tries you should be able to pass them and activate the next Resurrection Shrine. Once you activate the second shrine, you can follow the path on the quest map to avoid the remaining mobs all together.
9953fa31217a439250a3cfcb7df6bdf6e6e0d814.text: 一旦进入地牢，花点时间与骷髅和僵尸相处是非常有帮助的。两个团体同时出现对队伍来说将是非常危险的。神圣伤害是有效的，而物理攻击者会因为很多致盲技能而遇到麻烦。一种方法是带七个英雄一起“冲锋！”/“来袭！”和/或“撤退！”并错开它们的使用，以便从敌人身边跑过。如果队伍被判处过多的死刑，那么僵尸群就不可能被杀死。有时可以通过创造性地标记追随者/英雄来绕过它们。将你的治疗师标记到两侧，并在第一组前面放置一个强大的坦克。将你的其他追随者标记为第二组，放在一边，这样他们就不会与第一组纠缠在一起。另一种方法是当你到达地图中途的缺口时占领北侧，因为那里只有两个小组并且没有治疗者（但是有更多的战士可以造成严重伤害）。经过六次尝试后，您应该能够通过它们并激活下一个复活神殿。一旦你激活了第二个神殿，你就可以沿着任务地图上的路径前进，以避免剩下的小怪。

535dafbec1f13bd0912a9dad5ac3145e85e03275.source: Once Gadd's Encampment is reached, talk to Bartholos. Head outside and to the right towards the Bloodstone Caves to meet Gadd and Livia at point L on the quest map. At first you cannot enter the Bloodstone Caves, but Gadd will be able to lift the seal by deciphering inscriptions that are tattooed on nearby Inscribed Ettins. Follow the quest markers to each of the three Ettins marked 1-3 on the quest map to the right. After killing them, make sure Livia gets close enough to extract the inscriptions. There are many roaming Raptor groups in this area, you may want to take care of them before engaging the Ettins. Return to the cave entrance at point L to let Gadd decipher the inscriptions and collect your reward from the Inscription Stone.
535dafbec1f13bd0912a9dad5ac3145e85e03275.text: 到达加德营地后，与巴索洛斯交谈。向外向右走，前往血石洞穴，在任务地图上的 L 点与加德和莉维亚会面。起初你无法进入血石洞穴，但加德将能够通过破译附近铭文埃廷斯上纹身的铭文来解除封印。按照任务标记前往右侧任务地图上标记为 1-3 的三个埃廷斯。杀死他们后，确保莉维亚足够近以提取铭文。该地区有许多漫游猛禽群体，您可能需要在与埃廷人交战之前解决掉它们。返回 L 点的洞穴入口，让加德破译铭文并从铭文石中领取奖励。

ffbfdad4b7f59ceba355ed10a5f727ca6d9c69dd.source: You may wish to avoid bringing minion masters on this quest since there are many wandering groups around the Ettins that the minions will aggro. As a result, you will find yourself defending against more groups than you intended to fight.
ffbfdad4b7f59ceba355ed10a5f727ca6d9c69dd.text: 你可能希望避免在这个任务中带随从大师，因为埃廷斯周围有许多流浪团体，随从会聚集这些群体。结果，你会发现自己正在防御的群体比你原本打算对抗的群体还要多。

381c1d005112ec0d310e7894e009ff2808d79ff6.source: If you have not recruited Hayda, with Frogstomp active, you can meet her and either do that quest first, or just let her help you with the Sparkfly Swamp phase of the Gadd/Bloodstone quest.
381c1d005112ec0d310e7894e009ff2808d79ff6.text: 如果你还没有招募海达，并且青蛙践踏处于活动状态，你可以与她见面，然后要么先做那个任务，要么让她帮助你完成加德/血石任务的火花沼泽阶段。

c9dffc4647f4bac66b46036a114f75f13b6c2ccb.source: Leaving the area of Sparkfly Swamp at any part of the quest will reset it and make you repeat, including when you enter the Bloodstone Caves before Gadd completed deciphering the inscriptions.
c9dffc4647f4bac66b46036a114f75f13b6c2ccb.text: 在任务的任何部分离开火花蝇沼泽区域都会重置它并让你重复，包括当你在加德完成破译铭文之前进入血石洞穴时。

14e53dcf8c15b8845ebe69f365249959940a393e.source: Gadd and Livia do not attack or use any skills that exploit corpses (Well of Blood) or target foes, but they do bodyblock allies and foes. They can only be harmed by area of effect skills because foes cannot directly target them.
14e53dcf8c15b8845ebe69f365249959940a393e.text: 加德和莉维亚不会攻击或使用任何利用尸体（血之井）或目标敌人的技能，但他们会对盟友和敌人进行身体阻挡。他们只能受到范围技能的伤害，因为敌人无法直接瞄准他们。

1390d8a5bc4c346e65cda2378aace0515d2c0726.source: If you have the Lost Souls quest, abandon it or the portal will be blocked by an angry mob.
1390d8a5bc4c346e65cda2378aace0515d2c0726.text: 如果您有“失落的灵魂”任务，请放弃它，否则传送门将被愤怒的暴徒封锁。

5fa7838f0d88015487e73b11117ea9ef1474bb0b.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 主职业：战士

370091ce4d59ad2d019e2f85967450a672b888d7.source: Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
370091ce4d59ad2d019e2f85967450a672b888d7.text: 与卢多交谈即可进入修道院。

1fa1a7942fdd4a91c6741670a4b638bb40f0f7ac.source: Seek out Headmaster Zhan in the monastery.

130d52dbb2495f0f4049a85a8c4f154695042941.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the skills once you load into the Monastery.
130d52dbb2495f0f4049a85a8c4f154695042941.text: 与Shing Jea寺入口处的Ludo交谈即可进入。如果您跳过了螳螂幼体教程，您将在加载到修道院后学习技能。

8db3d44b16c28a58cc1402e3b95c8274e402881f.source: You will also gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a Starter Sword after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Zhan, who is nearby, for your reward.
8db3d44b16c28a58cc1402e3b95c8274e402881f.text: 进入修道院后你还将获得2000经验，并获得入门剑。如果您完成了教程，您就已经收到了这些。与附近的詹校长交谈以获得奖励。

04812de0d137771b12374b6098e35efb71afea56.source: If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
04812de0d137771b12374b6098e35efb71afea56.text: 如果放弃该任务，则无法重新接受，但可以立即接受以下任务。

8a2c6521e466606afe05a7057dbddd419648f8f4.source: Make your way to Chahbek Village.

c616dfe8b689713629b072b1badfa95d6d663015.text: 与首席长矛贾杜加尔交谈。

de39cbb3da9ff7ea57f81037160602840c6abc26.source: Escort Kormir, Koss and 3 Sunspear Recruits to First Spear Jahdugar just outside Chahbek Village. Along the way, 2 Corsairs will popup, however they are easily defeated.
de39cbb3da9ff7ea57f81037160602840c6abc26.text: 护送科米尔、科斯和 3 名烈阳之矛新兵前往恰贝克村外的第一矛者贾杜加尔。一路上会出现 2 艘海盗船，但他们很容易被击败。

126a9e36025d0008f4841ba91fd91f63f5329093.source: Accepting the quest unlocks three skills for the character to use.
126a9e36025d0008f4841ba91fd91f63f5329093.text: 接受任务会解锁三种技能供角色使用。

c999efe6a68d4dd7e806354968ec8fbfd8978e92.source: Resurrection Signet, and 2 profession skills as follows:
c999efe6a68d4dd7e806354968ec8fbfd8978e92.text: 复活徽记，以及2个职业技能如下：

32fddfd7313a21b97e24429be48d5a46a2378e42.source: Re-entering the Island of Shehkah zone by any means after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't completed any of the objectives.
32fddfd7313a21b97e24429be48d5a46a2378e42.text: 接受此任务后以任何方式重新进入谢卡岛区域都会导致你移动到前哨站，即使你还没有完成任何目标。

94d002113034a09950020e19ab2a8691456c31ee.source: Primary profession test (elementalist, mesmer, monk, necromancer, ranger, or warrior) not completed.
94d002113034a09950020e19ab2a8691456c31ee.text: 主要职业测试（元素师、幻术师、武僧、死灵法师、游侠或战士）未完成。

0027dc6b0a5360b07786777d4f159fcd7bb9bfca.source: Go out the gate to Lakeside County and talk to .
0027dc6b0a5360b07786777d4f159fcd7bb9bfca.text: 走出湖滨县大门并与 交谈。

eb92bf95a1e1fc90352005f34b1b541539a8a506.source: Go through the Lakeside County gate to the northwest and leave Ascalon City. Your profession trainer will be standing directly outside. Speak to them to complete the quest.
eb92bf95a1e1fc90352005f34b1b541539a8a506.text: 穿过湖滨郡门向西北方向离开阿斯卡隆城。您的专业培训师将直接站在外面。与他们交谈以完成任务。

2713b74622081f9fcd012599dc1e10c5f669a25c.source: Though this is a primary quest, it can actually be skipped. You can proceed directly to the profession trainer outside the city in Lakeside County. The only thing you will miss is the experience reward. This quest will then be unavailable upon completion of the Test quest.
2713b74622081f9fcd012599dc1e10c5f669a25c.text: 虽然这是一个主要任务，但实际上可以跳过。可以直接前往湖滨县城外的职业培训师处。你唯一会错过的就是经验奖励。完成测试任务后，该任务将不可用。

f2e52b3980fa30f36a348ec20c9c3a21e4de468f.source: This is marked as a Primary Quest but is not required to leave pre-Searing.
f2e52b3980fa30f36a348ec20c9c3a21e4de468f.text: 这被标记为主要任务，但不需要离开预灼烧。

f1c75de9739d3fee946ec201d4b92d899be20c38.source: To start the mission, Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Into Chahbek Village or Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial). However, they can be ferried into the mission by another character, and will receive full credit for mission completion.
f1c75de9739d3fee946ec201d4b92d899be20c38.text: 要开始任务，夜幕降临的角色必须接受进入恰贝克村或走捷径（跳过教程）的奖励。然而，他们可以由另一个角色运送到任务中，并会因任务完成而获得全额积分。

bbd8d44dba94ce4db85d6c1d51b63ef61f3dc039.source: Characters from other campaigns should talk to Historian Laharo, in the southeast corner of Churrhir Fields.
bbd8d44dba94ce4db85d6c1d51b63ef61f3dc039.text: 其他战役中的角色应该与丘里尔平原东南角的历史学家拉哈罗交谈。

e6c36df5f45d85c842568d66a7b0b7258c242598.source: Koss must be present in the party.

484f0f419c0b77a74232e4d4168c1999510fc0c1.source: Destroy the corsairs occupying the village.

af846ef0548fa6a414fb06fe5e40186f6336a6ff.source: Sink the corsair ship on the north side of the village.
af846ef0548fa6a414fb06fe5e40186f6336a6ff.text: 击沉村庄北侧的海盗船。

f9fafadfbadf39408358b7900d6566c228afb496.source: Sink the corsair ship on the south side of the village.
f9fafadfbadf39408358b7900d6566c228afb496.text: 击沉村庄南侧的海盗船。

2fdd17323e8c076e374d1c36b1e35f8051788fce.source: *BONUS* Keep as many Sunspear Recruits alive as possible.
2fdd17323e8c076e374d1c36b1e35f8051788fce.text: *奖励* 尽可能多地保住阳矛新兵的生命。

7430c240cb91bcad309ab7c0aa53722be12164d0.source: Eliminate all of the corsairs attacking the village, including those on the boats on the right and left sides of the map. You are aided in your efforts by the presence of a level 20 Kormir and a handful of Sunspear recruits.
7430c240cb91bcad309ab7c0aa53722be12164d0.text: 消灭所有攻击村庄的海盗，包括地图左右两侧船上的海盗。 20 级的科米尔和少数阳矛新兵的存在会为你的努力提供帮助。

cc2c8b4058d8c0fcff0222fe243a4aee5e6ac993.source: After killing the corsairs near the village's entrance, you have a choice: follow Kormir's advice and sink the two vessels using Istani Fire Oil fired from the catapults or kill the ship-based corsairs using ranged attacks. If you choose the first method, make your way to the fire oil and carry it to one of the catapults: click once to load the weapon and click again to fire it. Each ship you sink will provide a morale boost. Kill the boss next and then clear out the remainder of the corsairs.
cc2c8b4058d8c0fcff0222fe243a4aee5e6ac993.text: 杀死村庄入口附近的海盗后，你有一个选择：听从科米尔的建议，使用弹射器发射的伊斯坦尼火油击沉两艘船，或者使用远程攻击杀死船上的海盗。如果您选择第一种方法，请前往火油处并将其带到其中一个弹射器：单击一次以装载武器，然后再次单击以发射它。你击沉的每艘船都会鼓舞士气。接下来杀死老板，然后清除剩余的海盗。

7dd62a04d35f109075d96ba5cc6cdf7c5aa3a31e.source: You can speed things up by flagging koss and any henchmen to kill corsairs while you sink the ships.
7dd62a04d35f109075d96ba5cc6cdf7c5aa3a31e.text: 你可以通过标记科斯和任何追随者来杀死海盗，同时击沉船只，从而加快速度。

3b557b61b1f8ba6c02c4252c3cff60f1abd2ece5.source: The recruits sometimes are slow to engage mobs. If this happens, step closer to the enemy so that foes are within aggro range of the sunspears.
3b557b61b1f8ba6c02c4252c3cff60f1abd2ece5.text: 新兵有时会很慢地与暴徒交战。如果发生这种情况，请靠近敌人，使敌人处于阳矛的仇恨范围内。

2e196601917c8832bebd4b56ae4ccacc3d5de9a5.source: Keep as many of the Sunspear recruits alive as possible. If you confront one group at a time, there is almost no risk to losing any to the corsairs, especially if you sink the ships early.
2e196601917c8832bebd4b56ae4ccacc3d5de9a5.text: 尽可能多地保住阳矛新兵的生命。如果你一次面对一组，那么几乎没有失去任何一个海盗的风险，特别是如果你尽早击沉船只。

519bbd1a8e7ec2338707c6a603f782b400adc6ef.source: In hard mode, there are only two risky spots: attacking the boss (who can manage to kill one of the recruits) and confronting the 3-4 mobs of corsairs in the upper right. However, you can easily succeed with any balanced group that can deal some damage and heal the recruits as well as party members. When engaging groups, take out the Corsair Healers first and any of their spellcasters next. Take advantage of the morale boosts you get for sinking the ships and go after the boss before tackling the overlapping groups.
519bbd1a8e7ec2338707c6a603f782b400adc6ef.text: 在困难模式下，只有两个危险点：攻击boss（可以杀死一名新兵）和对抗右上角的3-4个海盗小怪。然而，你可以轻松地在任何可以造成一定伤害并治愈新兵和党员的平衡团队中取得成功。当与团体交战时，先干掉海盗船治疗师，然后干掉他们的施法者。利用击沉船只所获得的士气提升，在解决重叠的群体之前追击 Boss。

629afc9d919e33d72cb20a04667333419140fb6d.source: Bring condition removal skills, since nearly all foes inflict some condition.
629afc9d919e33d72cb20a04667333419140fb6d.text: 带上条件消除技能，因为几乎所有敌人都会造成一些条件。

fdc8544015402e1172ff6c5ff56d5668a20cb126.source: In normal mode, non-boss foes do not use any skills. In hard mode, all foes only use one skill, so you can easily disable them. This makes Wastrel's Demise and Worry effective in both modes.
fdc8544015402e1172ff6c5ff56d5668a20cb126.text: 普通模式下，非boss敌人不会使用任何技能。在困难模式下，所有敌人仅使用一种技能，因此您可以轻松禁用它们。这使得瓦斯特雷尔的死亡和忧虑在两种模式下都有效。

32060c0dca575d147445b244ce37c869f274ab8e.source: None of the foes carry hex spells or hex removal skills.
32060c0dca575d147445b244ce37c869f274ab8e.text: 没有一个敌人携带妖术或妖术去除技能。

475ef7d07ef04692223081fbf6e95760c5761397.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 0.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
475ef7d07ef04692223081fbf6e95760c5761397.text: 对该区域的完整探索将为 Elonian Cartographer 主打歌带来约 0.2% 的收益。

970f8773268be4e0f8376e3040edceea97b4ad5d.source: The boss (Midshipman Bennis) has Natural Resistance, unlike most in Elona. Consider bringing along Wastrel's Worry for damage as often as you can afford to cast it, or Lightning Surge, for an almost-instant knockdown.
970f8773268be4e0f8376e3040edceea97b4ad5d.text: 与伊洛娜中的大多数人不同，老板（海军见习官班尼斯）具有自然抵抗力。考虑尽可能频繁地使用荒野之忧来造成伤害，或者使用闪电涌动来几乎立即击倒对手。

a2ecb77a80fcf402b5f082cf77f9c25037108c5d.source: It is possible for a new paragon to acquire Harrier's Toss from the boss (instead of waiting to reach the skill trainer that has the skill for unlocking) if they visit their guild hall first and buy a Signet of Capture.
a2ecb77a80fcf402b5f082cf77f9c25037108c5d.text: 如果新的典范首先访问他们的公会大厅并购买捕获徽记，则有可能从老板那里获得鹞式投掷（而不是等待找到具有解锁技能的技能训练师）。

e32163b23f2b9a3eda8ab591c419287477e3c35c.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Churrhir Fields.
e32163b23f2b9a3eda8ab591c419287477e3c35c.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被传送到丘里尔平原。

d1428dc8d602025e3e633ccc7910359f3d51ab8c.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #11 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
d1428dc8d602025e3e633ccc7910359f3d51ab8c.text: 在困难模式下完成此任务将填充《泰瑞亚青年英雄》故事书第 11 页。

cdd6d47dfed6c42206ab43fc5e152955a664d20c.source: Locate the laboratory of Oola, the Asuran master golemancer.
cdd6d47dfed6c42206ab43fc5e152955a664d20c.text: 找到阿苏拉傀儡师大师乌拉的实验室。

668af063cc8cf8ea0a5432d0abc9765bf5c601f5.source: Find Oola's former assistant, Blimm, in Rata Sum.
668af063cc8cf8ea0a5432d0abc9765bf5c601f5.text: 在拉塔苏姆找到乌拉的前助手布利姆。

ac45c7ebee60d1fcb0f8fc43a8df7b7ec972c4dd.text: 在魔法石中遇见布利姆。

c52f94c9baa0cfa0f21bdbe0dddb24831565bb20.source: Travel with Blimm to the secret entrance to Oola's Lab in Magus Stones.
c52f94c9baa0cfa0f21bdbe0dddb24831565bb20.text: 与布利姆一起前往魔法石中乌拉实验室的秘密入口。

a774f22a07ce84cfea016167a34b2514f767750c.source: Defeat the timberland guardian and pick a vine seed from its remains to open the bridge to Oola's Lab.
a774f22a07ce84cfea016167a34b2514f767750c.text: 击败林地守护者并从其遗骸中采摘一颗藤蔓种子，以打开通往乌拉实验室的桥梁。

0bf563fba18e2286a68e7b8407ab002b966a2d08.source: Speak to Blimm about the secret entrance to Oola's Lab.
0bf563fba18e2286a68e7b8407ab002b966a2d08.text: 与布利姆谈谈乌拉实验室的秘密入口。

124a11c9932085a5c54dce8497a8e439c0d23a97.source: Start off by talking to Blimm in Rata Sum to update the quest. Meet him in Magus Stones (right outside Rata Sum) with the party you will need for The Elusive Golemancer (follows on). Fight your way through Magus Stones taking care about patrols of Wind Riders. Wind Riders move quickly and aggroing several mobs at once can easily result in healers being overwhelmed. The actual Timberland Guardian is very weak since it's on its own.
124a11c9932085a5c54dce8497a8e439c0d23a97.text: 首先与拉塔苏姆的布利姆交谈以更新任务。在 Magus Stones（就在 Rata Sum 外面）与他会面，并与你在《难以捉摸的傀儡师》（后续）中需要的队伍会面。在魔法石中杀出一条血路，同时照顾风骑者的巡逻队。驭风者移动速度很快，同时攻击多个小怪很容易导致治疗者被压垮。实际的 Timberland Guardian 非常弱，因为它是独立的。

473d6cabd026eed0a1451e75c05cfa28f945542e.source: Oola didn't fire me. I quit. She moved my desk into the cellar and stopped paying me. After a couple of months, I left. I think she took my staff, too...that's why I left. I loved that staff. Someday I'm going to burn her lab down if I don't get it back. Oh yes! Well anyway, you'll find Oola's lab below all the traps. Good luck disarming them. If I had my staff I'd help you. When you're ready to enter, speak to me and I'll use this vine seed to open the path to Oola's Lab.
473d6cabd026eed0a1451e75c05cfa28f945542e.text: 乌拉没有解雇我。我不干了。她把我的桌子搬进了地窖，并停止付钱给我。几个月后，我离开了。我想她也带走了我的手杖……这就是我离开的原因。我喜欢那个工作人员。如果我不把她的实验室拿回来，有一天我就会烧毁她的实验室。哦是的！无论如何，你会在所有陷阱下面找到乌拉的实验室。祝你好运，解除他们的武装。如果我有我的员工，我会帮助你。当你准备好进入时，跟我说话，我会用这颗藤蔓种子打开通往乌拉实验室的道路。

219c9778aff3f402ae154191118e9bd8e641a5f1.source: If someone in your party has the quest The Elusive Golemancer, he can teleport you across Magus Stones leading directly to Timberland Guardian by talking to Blimm a short distance west from the entrance of Rata Sum.
219c9778aff3f402ae154191118e9bd8e641a5f1.text: 如果你的队伍中有人有任务“难以捉摸的傀儡师”，他可以通过与拉塔苏姆入口以西不远的布利姆交谈，将你传送到魔法石，直接到达林地守护者。

af6c468f8a2bfae493dbba3bb1c3b5e727c96d25.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Talon Silverwing.
af6c468f8a2bfae493dbba3bb1c3b5e727c96d25.text: 在桑夸谷寻找利爪银翼。

1f2c41d9e167b2b89df504c73466919d22020451.source: Talon is in the northwest of the vale.
1f2c41d9e167b2b89df504c73466919d22020451.text: 泰隆位于山谷的西北部。

5b77e6ced5f821f4938df5b56d9d2581b0ef2b09.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: warrior
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
5b77e6ced5f821f4938df5b56d9d2581b0ef2b09.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：战士
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

268600d32e204eb6fb30d3d2b756c78d7c77b7bb.source: Go southwest along the road to find the skale. Clear the river of skale.
268600d32e204eb6fb30d3d2b756c78d7c77b7bb.text: 沿着路向西南走可以找到skale。清理斯卡莱河。

200b82d3e963d1612a9612702dd6283346f632f9.source: Return to Van the Warrior for your reward.
200b82d3e963d1612a9612702dd6283346f632f9.text: 返回战士范那里领取奖励。

213a464d63d36c4d1a466516ac743f0cbb260821.source: Follow your compass marker and kill the three skale in the area. Then return back to Van the Warrior.
213a464d63d36c4d1a466516ac743f0cbb260821.text: 跟随你的指南针标记并杀死该地区的三个骷髅。然后回到战士范那里。

74f0d29a19493b9c18416578a77ec63fa5c00d18.source: Seek Renk in Riven Earth and recruit him for the project.
74f0d29a19493b9c18416578a77ec63fa5c00d18.text: 在裂痕地球中寻找伦克并招募他参与该项目。

bb9d4dc651f97e9b349ccabe245ff93dd3f01ab6.source: Meet Renk at his laboratory in Alcazia Tangle once you've recruited Gadd and Oola.
bb9d4dc651f97e9b349ccabe245ff93dd3f01ab6.text: 一旦你招募了加德和乌拉，就可以在伦克位于阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔的实验室与他会面。

99da5a5ce0aa0adc18a7d9a0b5e8e56f92dced3d.source: Talk to Mamp in Rata Sum regarding the G.O.L.E.M. project.
99da5a5ce0aa0adc18a7d9a0b5e8e56f92dced3d.text: 与 Rata Sum 的 Mamp 谈论 G.O.L.E.M.项目。

c4fbbefeb2b0e2e0adebeacaf2d1424f7dac9789.source: This is a 3 part quest that begins with finding Renk, recruiting both Gadd and Oola (each requiring two more quests), and meeting up again with Renk.
c4fbbefeb2b0e2e0adebeacaf2d1424f7dac9789.text: 这是一个由 3 部分组成的任务，首先找到伦克，招募加德和乌拉（每个任务还需要两个任务），然后再次与伦克会面。

84db0e9458eb240d8ea9e8dc2edf21066cd521b8.source: Part 1: The quest begins after speaking with Plaxx in Vlox's Falls. Map travel to Rata Sum and either follow the quest marker east (map 1) or taking the alternative route with fewer foes (map 1a). You will find Renk by the base of the great waterfalls.
84db0e9458eb240d8ea9e8dc2edf21066cd521b8.text: 第 1 部分：任务在 Vlox's Falls 与 Plaxx 交谈后开始。地图旅行到拉塔苏姆，要么沿着任务标记向东走（地图 1），要么走敌人较少的替代路线（地图 1a）。您会在大瀑布的底部找到伦克。

c189dc1b7b45d2db4ca04d1e8d04f25cceec4e7a.source: Part 2: Next, you recruit both Gadd and Oola (in any order): Gadd requires completion of Finding Gadd and Finding the Bloodstone; Oola's recruitment requires Lab Space and The Elusive Golemancer.
c189dc1b7b45d2db4ca04d1e8d04f25cceec4e7a.text: 第 2 部分：接下来，你招募加德和乌拉（顺序不限）：加德需要完成“寻找加德”和“寻找血石”； Oola 的招募需要实验室空间和难以捉摸的傀儡师。

d99733ca9d701c4707c64da672c1cbb2c9a144f1.source: Part 3: Return to Rata Sum and exit into Magus Stones, follow quest map 2. Along the way, you will encounter 24 spiders (rangers, paragons, and monks); there are five groups, two of which are popups. You can directly zone into Alcazia Tangle or considering first killing the nearby group of Krait to obtain an additional Asura rank bonus.
d99733ca9d701c4707c64da672c1cbb2c9a144f1.text: 第三部分：返回拉塔苏姆，进入魔法石，按照任务地图2走。一路上，你会遇到24只蜘蛛（游侠、典范和僧侣）；有五个组，其中两个是弹出窗口。你可以直接进入阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区，或者考虑先杀死附近的金环蛇群以获得额外的阿修罗等级奖励。

e841d9a7731b6ede4f27442f199399c143194844.source: From the portal in Alcazia Tangle, cross the bridge and head south to southeast. This area is populated with Dinosaurs, the first of which you'll meet is 3 dervish Ferothrax on a patrol. The second patrol group you'll encounter is a Raptor group with the assassin boss, Pywatt the Swift.
e841d9a7731b6ede4f27442f199399c143194844.text: 从阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔的传送门过桥，向南向东南方向前进。该地区栖息着大量恐龙，您首先会遇到的是 3 只正在巡逻的苦行僧费罗斯拉克斯。你将遇到的第二个巡逻队是猛禽队，其刺客头目是迅捷的皮瓦特。

f07a6024fc7741735ded6b5db47bed5d4b3c09cc.source: From here, take the lower southern path. Hug the right stone wall and be wary of patrolling Raptors. After a short distance, turn right into a passage littered with Asuran corpses. Renk is here with a group of 4 Destroyers. Although your foes will also target Renk, you can safely ignore him because he will self-resurrect.
f07a6024fc7741735ded6b5db47bed5d4b3c09cc.text: 从这里出发，走较低的南边小路。拥抱右边的石墙并提防巡逻的猛龙。走了一小段路后，右转进入一条散落着阿修罗尸体的通道。 Renk 和 4 名驱逐舰在这里。虽然你的敌人也会瞄准伦克，但你可以放心地忽略他，因为他会自我复活。

d3c3c3c8bfdbe813f50a5b096083a2e2f5bc94c2.source: Alternatively, you can map to Tarnished Haven and follow the alternative route (map 2a) to Renk.
d3c3c3c8bfdbe813f50a5b096083a2e2f5bc94c2.text: 或者，您可以映射到 Tarnished Haven，然后沿着替代路线（地图 2a）前往 Renk。

751fb9cf4018ef2512a5bd1565c7154a15f8ca1b.source: Speak with Renk one last time, then travel to Rata Sum and speak to Mamp for your reward.
751fb9cf4018ef2512a5bd1565c7154a15f8ca1b.text: 与伦克最后一次交谈，然后前往拉塔苏姆并与曼普交谈以获得奖励。

401f5a7c63e80c1530b5a12907bbf4c291d8618f.source: You can actually complete Finding the Bloodstone and The Elusive Golemancer before initiating A Little Help. However, the story is written with the intent that A Little Help is initiated first.
401f5a7c63e80c1530b5a12907bbf4c291d8618f.text: 实际上，你可以在开始“一点帮助”之前完成“寻找血石”和“难以捉摸的傀儡师”。然而，写这个故事的目的是首先发起一点帮助。

847c15383eb4af48802d51e7bb0711ea7720189e.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: ranger
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
847c15383eb4af48802d51e7bb0711ea7720189e.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：游侠
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

3f9fd62208f2bad7221e0548c0bb6352b4bdcad1.source: Find the river skale queen and slay her.
3f9fd62208f2bad7221e0548c0bb6352b4bdcad1.text: 找到河流斯卡莱女王并杀死她。

2f7da1d9b934a8a58d41e66c360325045698cb8a.source: Return to Artemis the Ranger for your reward.
2f7da1d9b934a8a58d41e66c360325045698cb8a.text: 返回游侠阿耳忒弥斯处领取奖励。

48e04eb4499c2b81cfd21fc93b1927655e1dca72.source: Head south towards the river. The River Skale Queen should be on the other side of it. You can use the Control key (Ctrl) to see the name of any foes within the range of the radar. They will appear in red on your screen.
48e04eb4499c2b81cfd21fc93b1927655e1dca72.text: 向南朝河边走去。 River Skale Queen 应该在它的另一边。您可以使用 Control 键 (Ctrl) 查看雷达范围内任何敌人的名称。它们将在您的屏幕上显示为红色。

45bee3656de48748d25837cc0b68745a92c03b6b.source: Speak with Talon again when you are ready to begin the duel.
45bee3656de48748d25837cc0b68745a92c03b6b.text: 当你准备好开始决斗时，再次与泰隆交谈。

089b0e6eccbabbeb0ccf8f4f6c9a0cff5881ba46.text: 在战斗中击败利爪银翼。

3cb58d839ffb4df9544e384a31358750e2f49412.source: See Talon Silverwing for your reward.
3cb58d839ffb4df9544e384a31358750e2f49412.text: 前往利爪银翼领取奖励。

8824d502699844f5660aabd510584a33909d43fe.source: Talon teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
8824d502699844f5660aabd510584a33909d43fe.text: 当你接受这个任务时，泰隆会教你以下技能：

af9df2798a1e7edbc39319a1d2261a3f57d56b22.source: After accepting this quest talk to Talon Silverwing once again to start the duel, he will attack you as soon as you talk to him again so be prepared.
af9df2798a1e7edbc39319a1d2261a3f57d56b22.text: 接受这个任务后，再次与银翼鹰对话开始决斗，一旦你再次与他对话，他就会攻击你，所以要做好准备。

4a27a915d177bd29dcc132c2987bd3987abdb1a3.source: Right as he is about to die he turns friendly and you can turn in the quest.
4a27a915d177bd29dcc132c2987bd3987abdb1a3.text: 当他快要死时，他变得友好，你可以交任务。

2e3de924af3ef6e5de6b38f542a3e4f005e46e13.source: Talon Silverwing is very weak against earth damage, use this to your advantage if you need help.
2e3de924af3ef6e5de6b38f542a3e4f005e46e13.text: 利爪银翼对抗地球伤害非常弱，如果你需要帮助，请利用这一点。

91566e34aaa594fdc76a2fa271b406426ced154f.source: Talon will not use any skills.
91566e34aaa594fdc76a2fa271b406426ced154f.text: 泰隆不会使用任何技能。

51d0cf37096f0e20c86f63a4b169c59135267486.source: All party members must have received the reward for Finding Gadd.
51d0cf37096f0e20c86f63a4b169c59135267486.text: 所有小队成员都必须收到寻找加德的奖励。

70c3fae6ea3b4c4befd331e5394eb8305cec3f25.source: It is possible to enter the mission with just one person meeting the requirement, but anyone else will not receive any credit for mission completion.
70c3fae6ea3b4c4befd331e5394eb8305cec3f25.text: 只有一个人满足要求即可进入任务，但其他人不会获得任务完成的任何积分。

31f12ed215916f78cbee6c60c6c6b78226e74a58.source: Invoke the inscription stone in Sparkfly Swamp to unlock the path to the Bloodstone.
31f12ed215916f78cbee6c60c6c6b78226e74a58.text: 召唤火花沼泽中的铭文石来解锁通往血石的道路。

668bf1b78c2d85dce478cfc50550b36a0cf12968.source: Help Gadd and Livia reach the Bloodstone in the depths below.
668bf1b78c2d85dce478cfc50550b36a0cf12968.text: 帮助加德和莉维亚到达下方深处的血石。

2f4de38b5bd1fa8068d379257ec8612337ea894c.source: Defeat Inscribed Sentries and decipher their inscriptions to open passageways.
2f4de38b5bd1fa8068d379257ec8612337ea894c.text: 击败铭文哨兵并破译他们的铭文以打开通道。

aa00ce171ea0b6035bd1eb7ed8e8d194ea43c0d0.source: Destroy the Inscribed Guardian protecting the Bloodstone.
aa00ce171ea0b6035bd1eb7ed8e8d194ea43c0d0.text: 摧毁保护鸡血石的铭刻守护者。

8f6a7b64344a8a3cda0c8e4a5bca81c763a133b9.text: 重复次数：300（困难模式下为 450）

c8a3cd2ed833eb2d7a1225213ecf94501a0f4826.source: During the quest, all creatures will be under the effect of the Aura of the Bloodstone: all nearby creatures (including spirits) will be healed each time any other creature dies (by 20 on the first level and 20 more on each successive level). Proceed slowly; there are numerous popups along the way. Most enemies throughout the mission are in relatively small groups and thus are not very dangerous. However, there is a major exception to this in the form of the several, large pop-up groups of Incubi throughout Levels 1 and 2 which can easily remove protective Enchantments while the many Stormcloud Incubus will use their Mind Shock to Knockdown and spike down players and heroes to death.
c8a3cd2ed833eb2d7a1225213ecf94501a0f4826.text: 在任务期间，所有生物都会受到鸡血石光环的影响：每当任何其他生物死亡时，所有附近的生物（包括灵魂）都会得到治疗（第一级治疗 20 点，每个后续等级增加 20 点）。慢慢地进行；一路上有很多弹出窗口。整个任务中的大多数敌人都是相对较小的群体，因此不是很危险。然而，有一个主要的例外，即在第 1 级和第 2 级中出现的几个大型梦魇群体，它们可以轻松移除保护性结界，而许多暴云梦魇将使用他们的心灵震击来击倒并刺死玩家和英雄。

7f7bfae07a3724658cc0b61fa13c4e69798f39cd.source: Level 1: Walk down into the bigger area first. Gadd will then comment about an inscribed creature to the south-east. Walk to the east first, then, when he says so, to the south. Finish off the Inscribed Sentry and wait for the quest log to update (indicating that Livia has extracted its essence). Then, head north to the portal; wait for Gadd to open it.
7f7bfae07a3724658cc0b61fa13c4e69798f39cd.text: 第 1 层：先向下走到更大的区域。然后加德将对东南部的一个铭文生物发表评论。先向东走，然后听他说，再向南走。完成铭刻哨兵并等待任务日志更新（表明莉维亚已提取其精华）。然后，向北前往传送门；等待加德打开它。

2eda7698c4a8302f56ec77c358dac9a594234e42.source: There are several pop-up groups along the suggested path: on the way east from the starting point there are 3 small pop-up groups of 3 Arachnids each, and on the later, southern path there are 2 large pop-up groups of Incubi, the first at the bottom of the first stairs and then a second one at the bottom of the stairs just to the west/right of the first stairs.
2eda7698c4a8302f56ec77c358dac9a594234e42.text: 沿着建议的路径有几个弹出组：在从起点向东的路上有 3 个小的弹出组，每个组有 3 个蜘蛛，而在后来的南边路径上有 2 个大的梦魇弹出组，第一个在第一个楼梯的底部，然后第二个在楼梯底部，就在第一个楼梯的西/右侧。

59d6e03b13928f5415ccf4efc6c856959d987805.source: The Incubi pop-up groups on this level are composed entirely of the dangerous Mind Shock-using Stormclouds, making heavy protection and anti-spell shutdown essential for surviving.
59d6e03b13928f5415ccf4efc6c856959d987805.text: 这一层的梦魇弹出团体完全由危险的使用风暴云的心灵震击组成，这使得重度保护和反法术关闭对于生存至关重要。

e30ae8af755f4e3df0c5c12f4d82b8cca618a691.source: The second pop-up of Incubi can be avoided by keeping to the left, though this will often force a fight with a smaller, non-pop-up group of Incubi that patrols in the area.
e30ae8af755f4e3df0c5c12f4d82b8cca618a691.text: 通过保持向左行驶可以避免第二次弹出的梦魇，尽管这通常会迫使与在该地区巡逻的较小的、非弹出的梦魇群体发生战斗。

857f1c0ccf1433bcec31b258fa1caefba2dc334a.source: Level 2: Walk to the south-east. Eventually you will come to a huge chamber guarded by Skeletal Hounds. When you enter the room, the nearby Skeletons will start off friendly. Pull the patroling sentry away from them and kill him; once he dies, all the skeletons (except the neutral ones right next to the walls) will disappear. Should you get too close, they will become hostile, but you should still be able to pull the sentry away. Again, wait for Livia to extract the essence, then proceed to the portal and wait for Gadd to open it.
857f1c0ccf1433bcec31b258fa1caefba2dc334a.text: 第2层：向东南方向步行。最终你会来到一个由骷髅猎犬守卫的巨大房间。当你进入房间时，附近的骷髅会开始友善。把巡逻的哨兵从他们身边拉开并杀掉；一旦他死了，所有的骷髅（除了墙边的中立骷髅）都会消失。如果你离得太近，他们会变得充满敌意，但你仍然应该能够把哨兵拉开。再次等待莉维亚提取精华，然后前往传送门并等待加德打开它。

8903767182648397a28a3d369ef3cc5c8e034345.source: There are 3 mixed pop-up groups of Incubi throughout the level. The first one is after the initial groups of Skelk, near the bottom of an incline after a stone portal. The second one is on the path to the left of the central stone pillar, which can be avoided by keeping to the right and fighting the 2 Skelk there. The third one is just after the Resurrection Shrine at the top of the second incline, before the large group of Skeletal Hounds.
8903767182648397a28a3d369ef3cc5c8e034345.text: 整个关卡中有 3 个混合的梦魇弹出组。第一个是在最初的斯凯尔克群体之后，靠近石头传送门后的斜坡底部。第二个位于中央石柱左侧的道路上，可以通过保持右侧并在那里与 2 个斯凯尔克战斗来避免。第三处就在第二个斜坡顶部的复活神殿之后，在一大群骷髅猎犬之前。

8f5b5a7a76f956244ee6c13fc6b4788cae2aa8c3.source: Level 3: Go west, eventually reaching a cavern, at the center of which is the Inscribed Guardian guarded by several Enchanted weapons. There will also be four Enchanted Scythes farther from the center; although these are initially friendly, they will turn hostile after you aggro the Guardian. Once it dies, the quest is completed (so you need not bother with the other foes, if you can kill it fast enough).
8f5b5a7a76f956244ee6c13fc6b4788cae2aa8c3.text: 3级：向西走，最终到达一个洞穴，洞穴的中心是由几件魔法武器守卫的铭文守护者。距离中心较远的地方还会有四把魔法镰刀；尽管它们最初是友好的，但在你攻击守护者后它们会变得敌对。一旦它死了，任务就完成了（所以你不需要打扰其他敌人，如果你能足够快地杀死它的话）。

5c6a8a98484b88f47e9a5d94cc255419d14c7c05.source: The only real danger here is that the Enchanted Scythes will attack groups that don't pull the Guardian from a distance in the back.
5c6a8a98484b88f47e9a5d94cc255419d14c7c05.text: 这里唯一真正的危险是，魔法镰刀会攻击那些不从后方远处拉动守护者的团体。

c4bbecfcfd3d299cc17e5497658fe6bf3faa447b.source: The many Enchanted Shields surrounding the Guardian will make it difficult to attack it initially due to Protector's Defense and by Body blocking the path to it. However, it is fairly easy to get them to drop the skill by walking around the boss to make them move.
c4bbecfcfd3d299cc17e5497658fe6bf3faa447b.text: 由于保护者的防御和身体阻挡了通往守护者的道路，守护者周围的许多魔法盾牌将使最初攻击它变得困难。然而，通过绕着 Boss 走动让他们移动，让他们放弃技能是相当容易的。

f0c97483c2ea68ed2ce1095ff86ca70cafbe772c.source: Due to the heavy Enchantment Removal from the Incubi's Soulrending Shriek throughout most of the areas it is generally good to use something else for protection, such as Binding Rituals.
f0c97483c2ea68ed2ce1095ff86ca70cafbe772c.text: 由于梦魇的裂魂尖叫在大部分区域都需要大量的结界移除，因此通常最好使用其他东西来保护，例如束缚仪式。

878358bca79d5db6d6f5d099350eb5b31a345435.source: The Necromancer Skelks will quickly spread Disease throughout groups, making party-wide Condition Removal, such as Extinguish, potentially useful.
878358bca79d5db6d6f5d099350eb5b31a345435.text: 死灵法师骷髅会迅速在整个群体中传播疾病，使得全队范围内的状态消除（例如熄灭）可能有用。

c68de18574ae9957ac8348aec20f57459520d206.source: The ability to either provide Blocking towards all party members or Blind to several enemies is useful for neutralizing the massive group of Skeletal Hounds on Level 2, which can otherwise be a danger.
c68de18574ae9957ac8348aec20f57459520d206.text: 对所有队伍成员提供阻挡或对多个敌人进行致盲的能力对于消灭 2 级的大量骷髅猎犬非常有用，否则这可能会构成危险。

ab07c7ae0fa49431e7b3225a74ac9b41fdd88aa6.source: If you gained Death penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much DP while in this mission, you can simply resign to eliminate your death penalty before talking to the inscription stone again to restart the mission.
ab07c7ae0fa49431e7b3225a74ac9b41fdd88aa6.text: 如果你在执行此任务的过程中获得了死亡惩罚，或者在此任务中积累了过多的DP，你可以简单地辞职以消除死亡惩罚，然后再次与铭文石对话以重新开始任务。

5cc6109079cff8d95d312d9a85234ab95fd917d4.source: This mission takes place in a zone with an identical layout as the Bloodstone Caves in the Depths of Tyria; however, this area is considered to be Asura territory (Tarnished Coast), so Edification will grant its bonus.
5cc6109079cff8d95d312d9a85234ab95fd917d4.text: 该任务发生在与泰瑞亚深处的血石洞穴布局相同的区域；然而，该地区被认为是阿修罗领地（玷污海岸），因此熏陶将给予其加成。

cc306c8b74049a0188141cc75571e1a17cb771f4.source: After defeating the Inscribed Sentries, wait for Livia to extract the inscriptions before proceeding; Gadd cannot open the gates until she has done so. You can check that she has managed this by ensuring that the quest log has updated. However, the dialogue will continue whether Livia has succeeded or not.
cc306c8b74049a0188141cc75571e1a17cb771f4.text: 击败铭文哨兵后，等待莉维亚提取铭文后再继续；在她打开大门之前，加德无法打开大门。您可以通过确保任务日志已更新来检查她是否已完成此操作。不过，无论莉薇娅成功与否，对话都会继续。

44437bb26e0e38b0bbc8c1a579beabec32e8f974.source: At the beginning of the 2nd level, Livia or Gadd can get stuck at the bottom of the stairs in the corner. As with any NPC allies, watch that they stay with the party to avoid backtracking later.
44437bb26e0e38b0bbc8c1a579beabec32e8f974.text: 在第二关开始时，莉维亚或加德可能会被困在角落里的楼梯底部。与任何 NPC 盟友一样，注意他们留在队伍中，以免日后反悔。
