7abee26967e112496587f9b6ac1dad93468c4dc5.source: When repeating this quest, you can travel directly to the Inscription Stone outside Bloodstone Caves. (You could also visit the Scrying Pool first to obtain the quest, but this is not necessary.) Once you approach the site, the gate may open and if you zone in without clicking the Inscription Stone, Gadd and Livia will not join your party as you will be starting the dungeon instead.
7abee26967e112496587f9b6ac1dad93468c4dc5.text: 重复该任务时，可以直接前往血石洞外的铭文石。 （你也可以先访问占卜池来获得任务，但这不是必需的。）一旦你接近该地点，大门可能会打开，如果你在没有点击铭文石的情况下进入区域，加德和莉维亚将不会加入你的队伍，因为你将开始地下城。

0442cf3db61b2492a858781a801a1a80fe602f40.source: When repeating this quest, if you have already unlocked Livia, you will still receive the notification that you've unlocked her.
0442cf3db61b2492a858781a801a1a80fe602f40.text: 重复此任务时，如果您已经解锁了莉维亚，您仍然会收到已解锁她的通知。

95ae92b46cf3e88434dbcc4353ca153655a6aecf.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
95ae92b46cf3e88434dbcc4353ca153655a6aecf.text: 完成此任务将填写英雄手册故事书第 12 页。

f97078db64d1cfd76a6e52d64c27e6e0c39a7d24.source: Similar to Curse of the Nornbear with Jora, if a Livia hero is in your party, you will have two Livias in your party instead of the Livia hero being renamed "Shining Blade Necromancer".
f97078db64d1cfd76a6e52d64c27e6e0c39a7d24.text: 与诺恩熊与乔拉的诅咒类似，如果你的队伍中有利维亚英雄，你的队伍中将有两个利维亚，而不是利维亚英雄被重命名为“光刃死灵法师”。

00be6c21ea5dc471b1092928a53fc8835fe06d32.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: monk
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
00be6c21ea5dc471b1092928a53fc8835fe06d32.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：僧侣
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

72937f95e4b3723bd2299891f4d068d1cba43615.source: Go southwest up the road until you find skale. Cross the river and find the missing girl Gwen.
72937f95e4b3723bd2299891f4d068d1cba43615.text: 沿着路向西南走，直到找到斯凯勒。过河找到失踪的女孩格温。

47c1731172b122f642e5bfb55015fe7ce294c7d8.source: Lead Gwen back to Ciglo the Monk. Gwen will not move as long as the skale are in the way.
47c1731172b122f642e5bfb55015fe7ce294c7d8.text: 将格温带回僧侣西格洛身边。只要斯凯尔挡住了路，格温就不会移动。

3bedcf600c31712ba8d78290596797ca926c4676.source: Cross the river to the south of Ciglo the Monk and find Gwen. Once you find her, kill the three River Skale Tads that are in the river near her. Once you kill the skale, lead her back towards Ciglo and talk to him to receive your reward.
3bedcf600c31712ba8d78290596797ca926c4676.text: 过河到修道士西格洛以南找到格温。找到她后，杀死她附近河里的三个河斯卡莱泰德。杀死斯凯尔后，将她带回西格洛并与他交谈以获得奖励。

c60d2afaefaac381c1877ddd178c0c4098525d65.source: Travel to the Sunspear encampment near Chahbek Village.
c60d2afaefaac381c1877ddd178c0c4098525d65.text: 前往查贝克村附近的烈阳之矛营地。

2c9ce3f09b99ff317e70289a88df4dae315cd27a.source: Speak to at least one expert .

5a067818405ab83bd810e9ee5f8d0c1ff046dfca.source: See First Spear Dehvad for your reward.
5a067818405ab83bd810e9ee5f8d0c1ff046dfca.text: 前往第一矛德瓦德领取奖励。

13a7ebb5b6cacbd4a1359d0cda7393557dbf9b05.source: Speak to at least one expert of your character's profession. They will teach you some skills. Return to First Spear Dehvad. He will teach you all the other skills the experts offer for your profession, so you do not have to speak to all of them.
13a7ebb5b6cacbd4a1359d0cda7393557dbf9b05.text: 与至少一位你的角色所在职业的专家交谈。他们会教你一些技能。返回第一矛德赫瓦德。他会教您专家为您的职业提供的所有其他技能，因此您不必与所有专家交谈。

1f41769a1cec844442ba90cc9bfca736a89fb05a.source: Accepting the reward as a Ranger teaches Pin Down, even though none of the expert rangers offer the skill.
1f41769a1cec844442ba90cc9bfca736a89fb05a.text: 作为游侠接受奖励会教导“锁定”，尽管没有一个专家游侠提供这项技能。

c2af14b0e8699af2c14d3c14eb10ff3baea9b928.source: Look for Weng Gha in Panjiang Peninsula.

aa242d2595c63d62f40c9dd6b3c6f5c30ce26a50.source: Travel southwest until you reach Tsumei Village. Enter, and exit to the south. Weng Gha is close by, westwards.
aa242d2595c63d62f40c9dd6b3c6f5c30ce26a50.text: 向西南行驶，直至抵达津名村。进入，出站向南。 Weng Gha 就在附近，向西。

553f3063f65f7c3afef39304c8f2b93867de9d0c.source: Speak to Second Spear Binah to enter Kamadan.
553f3063f65f7c3afef39304c8f2b93867de9d0c.text: 与第二矛者比纳交谈以进入卡马丹。

a2bd176796013a6ea5b550798261ee7d2f342fab.source: Hone your skills by reaching level 5.
a2bd176796013a6ea5b550798261ee7d2f342fab.text: 达到 5 级来磨练你的技能。

5395ea76fb66786936a435610f1acdca0ce4d0aa.source: Complete quests or defeat enemies until you reach level 5. Talk to First Spear Dehvad for your reward.
5395ea76fb66786936a435610f1acdca0ce4d0aa.text: 完成任务或击败敌人，直到达到 5 级。与首席矛德瓦德交谈以获得奖励。

7c262a63d7fcb39f417aa6206a559aaec7f54212.source: If you map travel to Kamadan or if you received the quest from First Spear Dehvad in Kamadan, your compass will have a starburst to talk to Binah in Kamadan, to go into Churrhir Fields and then talk to Binah again to go back into Kamadan. Your world map will also say to go back into Churrhir Fields.
7c262a63d7fcb39f417aa6206a559aaec7f54212.text: 如果你地图旅行到卡马丹，或者如果你收到卡马丹第一矛德瓦德的任务，你的指南针将会有一个星爆，可以与卡马丹的比纳对话，进入丘里尔田地，然后再次与比纳对话返回卡马丹。你的世界地图也会说要返回丘里尔平原。

47da1f28b1907694a2bc27f1b12e6f6f951bb356.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: necromancer
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
47da1f28b1907694a2bc27f1b12e6f6f951bb356.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：死灵法师
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

9d47537c41284cdad626d0f0cf4d3fcceeddce36.source: Go south to the river. Slay a skale so that Verata can make use of its corpse.
9d47537c41284cdad626d0f0cf4d3fcceeddce36.text: 向南走到河边。杀死一只骷髅，以便维拉塔可以利用它的尸体。

23995815e4f2fe9f80fc71bf6201dfac34c8e07b.source: Return to Verata the Necromancer for your reward.
23995815e4f2fe9f80fc71bf6201dfac34c8e07b.text: 返回死灵法师维拉塔那里领取奖励。

7b4f8b103df7ec1a55b6840831b5ad8ab29b6355.source: After you obtain the quest, Verata will start following you. Follow the road and kill one of the River Skale Tads. Wait for Verata to animate a Bone Horror and collect the reward.
7b4f8b103df7ec1a55b6840831b5ad8ab29b6355.text: 获得任务后，维拉塔将开始跟随你。沿着路走，杀死一只斯卡勒河泰兹。等待维拉塔激活骨头恐怖并领取奖励。

31ce6431e84df7150a44ea38e382d0bc481c3222.source: Killing anything that can provide an exploitable corpse, not just a skale, will fulfil the quest requirements.
31ce6431e84df7150a44ea38e382d0bc481c3222.text: 杀死任何可以提供可利用尸体的东西，而不仅仅是骷髅，都可以满足任务要求。

62139b4d156284a6e897f895c8505c680c9ece7a.source: Prevent the thieves from stealing crops from the field.
62139b4d156284a6e897f895c8505c680c9ece7a.text: 防止小偷偷窃田里的庄稼。

38aa4d1ac10fb4bc01d221b82736281a8ebf8973.source: See Weng Gha for your reward.
38aa4d1ac10fb4bc01d221b82736281a8ebf8973.text: 前往翁嘎 (Weng Gha) 领取奖励。

a45b899861664cb694d077345b466ce6e63ee58a.source: Weng Gha teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
a45b899861664cb694d077345b466ce6e63ee58a.text: 当你接受这个任务时，Weng Gha 会教你以下技能：

eb2f01aed335e2e88f337f110a1925eab4f351f5.source: After you accept this quest, follow the path leading to Tsumei Village. When you near the marked spot on the mini-map 3 Crop Thieves dressed like the Crimson Skull appear. Kill them and then return to Weng Gha.
eb2f01aed335e2e88f337f110a1925eab4f351f5.text: 接受这个任务后，沿着通往津名村的路走。当你靠近小地图上的标记点时，就会出现 3 个穿着像猩红骷髅的作物盗贼。杀死他们然后返回翁加。

24aef2bdec2d3526843e676fe13c61cadd1bf581.source: This quest will sometimes register as completed before all the thieves have been defeated.
24aef2bdec2d3526843e676fe13c61cadd1bf581.text: 有时，在击败所有盗贼之前，此任务会被注册为已完成。

c51b556aefc968b847e2e9f2d842f8332c97cf44.source: All party members must have received the reward for Lab Space.
c51b556aefc968b847e2e9f2d842f8332c97cf44.text: 所有小队成员必须已获得实验室空间的奖励。

41c99c1da90aecf784ff818d7ca094b0b41bd300.source: Find Oola's workshop in the depths below and convince her to help with Mamp's project.
41c99c1da90aecf784ff818d7ca094b0b41bd300.text: 在下面的深处找到 Oola 的工作室并说服她帮助 Mamp 的项目。

d900aae8d2eeff3c8122e7c712ce20707fc50446.source: Find a golem to circumvent the security system.
d900aae8d2eeff3c8122e7c712ce20707fc50446.text: 找到一个傀儡来绕过安全系统。

ef611d467e3a387d3dee5de89621603d5cf52ffe.source: Discover a way to access the next laboratory level.
ef611d467e3a387d3dee5de89621603d5cf52ffe.text: 探索进入下一个实验室级别的方法。

51fd1a857a6bc7bff6ec761d3fc5eb1217885fa8.source: Search the room for a passage leading further into the laboratory.
51fd1a857a6bc7bff6ec761d3fc5eb1217885fa8.text: 在房间里搜索一条通向实验室的通道。

78d1b4458451b5be54be38c84274202f403f7dff.text: 在炽热的挑战中生存下来。

025db486895b648b7ec9b93b719966d9def43557.source: You begin this mission in a room filled with worker Sentry Golems. None of them are hostile at this point. There are two Worker Golems at the entrance followed by a line of 3 more workers. Click on the one to the far left of the first line and tell it to, "Go pull that lever." It will slowly walk to the other end of the cavern to flip the switch. At the same time, the sentries will become hostile and will attack both the party and the Worker Golem; if the worker dies, go back and select another and repeat. However, simply taking the sentries one or two at a time should be sufficient even in Hard mode.
025db486895b648b7ec9b93b719966d9def43557.text: 你在一个充满工人哨兵傀儡的房间里开始这个任务。此时他们都没有敌意。入口处有两个工人傀儡，后面跟着一排另外 3 个工人。单击第一行最左侧的一个并告诉它“拉动那个控制杆”。它会慢慢走到洞穴的另一端来打开开关。同时，哨兵会变得敌对，并会攻击队伍和工人傀儡；如果该工人死亡，请返回并选择另一个工人并重复。然而，即使在困难模式下，一次简单地控制一两个哨兵就足够了。

fa0cc9e2afde22372f45c5faaeb84173025a57a2.source: Occasionally, Worker Golem will fail to pull the lever; it will say "Invalid Command" when spoken to. (This seems to happen if you talk to it after activation but before it reaches the lever.) Should this happen, restart by typing the /resign emote; this returns you to Blimm (outside the dungeon) and allows you to start over without having to travel from Rata Sum.
fa0cc9e2afde22372f45c5faaeb84173025a57a2.text: 有时，工人傀儡无法拉动控制杆；当对其说话时，它会说“无效命令”。 （如果您在激活后但在它到达控制杆之前与它交谈，似乎会发生这种情况。）如果发生这种情况，请通过输入 /resign 表情重新启动；这会让你回到布利姆（Blimm）（地牢外），并让你无需从拉塔苏姆（Rata Sum）出发即可重新开始。

7f8ef89c89943d7a94e96caca2c53f417038c5ac.source: When you enter the second room, a mysterious voice warns against "pulling the lever" (at the far corner of the room). There is no choice, however, since the lever unlocks the exit to Level 2. It also activates the Sentry Golems. Make your way to the new exit, dispatching Sentry Golems as you go. (Again, only aggro as many as you can handle.)
7f8ef89c89943d7a94e96caca2c53f417038c5ac.text: 当您进入第二个房间时，一个神秘的声音警告不要“拉动控制杆”（在房间的最远角落）。然而，别无选择，因为杠杆可以解锁 2 层的出口。它还可以激活哨兵傀儡。前往新出口，一路上派遣哨兵傀儡。 （再次强调，只能仇恨尽可能多的人。）

02e7e3081405ceda61c81017fc1f28362e45d10c.source: There are two mystical keyholders: one near you when you enter and the other around the corner. Use the first device to receive a Crystalline Key. The sentries are hostile and active when you hold this bundle; dropping it deactivates them. These golems respawn indefinitely until the bundle is placed in the second mystical keyholder, at which point they deactivate completely.
02e7e3081405ceda61c81017fc1f28362e45d10c.text: 有两个神秘的钥匙扣：一个在您进入时就在您附近，另一个则在拐角处。使用第一个设备接收水晶钥匙。当你拿着这个包裹时，哨兵会表现出敌意和活跃；放下它会使它们失效。这些傀儡会无限期地重生，直到捆绑包被放置在第二个神秘钥匙扣中，此时它们会完全停用。

c4598793adb2d08b008d4df55b238a4532cb3577.source: One way of dealing with this is to flag all heroes and henchmen to the far keyholder and having a well-armored character carry the key. If things get hairy, drop the key, get healed, and repeat. This method avoids letting the sentries body block party members when they deactivate; if they are blocked, the only way to free them is to reach the next level.
c4598793adb2d08b008d4df55b238a4532cb3577.text: 解决这个问题的一种方法是将所有英雄和追随者标记为远处的钥匙持有者，并让一个全副武装的角色携带钥匙。如果事情变得棘手，放下钥匙，治愈，然后重复。此方法可以避免让哨兵身体在队伍成员停用时对其进行阻挡；如果它们被阻止，释放它们的唯一方法就是到达下一个级别。

d6eb54c16499f65b096a5e61965a3c7a4d2ebb05.source: When working with heroes and henchmen, the player can be surrounded by Golems and be unable to move or fight after picking up the crystal. If this happens, try to have your heroes kill the golem or golems trapping you, and then escape quickly because new golems will respawn. If this strategy fails, the only solution is to restart the quest. Another strategy is to use the key while flagging your heroes farther North towards the other keystone and lead all the golems together to body block you in a line so you can run around them after you drop the stone. Then move your heroes to body block the golems while you pick up the key and run it to the other keystone. No deaths or well armored units required. Just ensure your body block of the golems doesn't put them in the archway or you will have to pick it up and pull them back and may die from the attempt. (Again, typing /resign will result in being taken to Blimm in Magus Stones, giving you the chance to start again.)
d6eb54c16499f65b096a5e61965a3c7a4d2ebb05.text: 当与英雄和追随者合作时，玩家可能会被傀儡包围，并且在拾取水晶后无法移动或战斗。如果发生这种情况，请尝试让你的英雄杀死困住你的魔像，然后迅速逃脱，因为新的魔像会重生。如果这个策略失败了，唯一的解决办法就是重新开始任务。另一种策略是使用钥匙，同时标记你的英雄向北前往另一个基石，并带领所有傀儡一起用身体挡住你，这样你就可以在扔下石头后绕着他们跑。然后移动你的英雄以身体阻挡傀儡，同时你拿起钥匙并将其运行到另一个梯形石上。不需要死亡或装备精良的部队。只要确保你的傀儡身体块不会将它们放入拱门中，否则你将不得不捡起它并将它们拉回来，并且可能会因尝试而死亡。 （再次输入 /resign 将被带到 Magus Stones 中的 Blimm，让你有机会重新开始。）

c5ea74eea7ef63d50df6b4bec2aab08eebe2e1f5.source: The next challenge is a room filled with Fire Darts, Sentry Golems, and another Worker Golem. Some of the Sentry Golems are already hostile, and others will become hostile as you approach them. The mysterious voice will taunt you again. The sole Worker Golem has a fire protection aura that will protect your party against the Fire Darts. The Worker Golem will slowly walk back and forth from your end of the room to the other. The intent is that your entire party stay in its shielded area, which protects against damage and burning. This becomes difficult to do as you encounter Sentry Golems in your path. Body blocking can halt the worker's progression temporarily, giving you time to fight.
c5ea74eea7ef63d50df6b4bec2aab08eebe2e1f5.text: 下一个挑战是一个充满火镖、哨兵傀儡和另一个工人傀儡的房间。一些哨兵傀儡已经具有敌意，而另一些则在您接近它们时变得敌对。神秘的声音会再次嘲笑你。唯一的工人傀儡具有防火光环，可以保护您的队伍免受火镖的伤害。工人傀儡会慢慢地从房间的一端走到另一端。目的是让你的整个队伍留在其屏蔽区域，以防止损坏和燃烧。当你在路上遇到哨兵傀儡时，这变得很难做到。身体阻挡可以暂时阻止工人的前进，让你有时间战斗。

082b2ca3378ea8f751d551238fbee02f8705781d.source: The golem stops a few steps short of safety so your party will have to run a few steps under dart attacks. It is not possible to disable the Fire Dart machines. If part of your party is left behind, the Worker Golem will be back.
082b2ca3378ea8f751d551238fbee02f8705781d.text: 魔像会在距离安全区几步之遥处停下来，因此你的队伍将不得不在飞镖攻击下跑几步。无法禁用 Fire Dart 机器。如果你的队伍中有一部分人被抛在后面，工人傀儡就会回来。

cb1c0f81015fd2da491db31ae763b057d6b3c195.source: The Worker Golem can sometimes get stuck and stop moving. When this happens, the Golem Fire Shield will lose sync with the Worker Golem and continue to progress forward. If this happens, follow the shield, not the Golem, and advance like normal. Sometimes the Golem continues and the shield stops; stay with the shield, not the Golem.
cb1c0f81015fd2da491db31ae763b057d6b3c195.text: 工人傀儡有时会被卡住并停止移动。当这种情况发生时，傀儡火盾将与工人傀儡失去同步并继续前进。如果发生这种情况，请跟随盾牌，而不是傀儡，然后像平常一样前进。有时傀儡会继续而护盾会停止；留在盾牌旁，而不是魔像身边。

bcce3a190d94f828e1cb6fb20a3f8d0fd5ec1189.source: Up some stairs will be a large room with many golem bodies, Sentry Golems, and three Worker Golems. Some are hostile, some will become hostile when you approach them. The mysterious voice will, again, encourage you to give up. The objective here is to activate the Worker Golems ("follow mode engaged") and lead them to three touchplates near the door to the next room. They should "engage stationary mode" once on top of the touchplates. If not, activating the golem again should do so. One Worker Golem is already placed for you.
bcce3a190d94f828e1cb6fb20a3f8d0fd5ec1189.text: 爬上一些楼梯，会出现一个大房间，里面有许多傀儡尸体、哨兵傀儡和三个工人傀儡。有些是敌对的，有些是当你接近他们时就会变得敌对。神秘的声音会再次鼓励你放弃。这里的目标是激活工人傀儡（“启用跟随模式”）并将它们引导到下一个房间门附近的三个触摸板。一旦到达触摸板顶部，它们就应该“进入静止模式”。如果没有，再次激活傀儡应该可以。已经为您放置了一个工人傀儡。

4659bd332913aa5bea97f6dae07f2bf69275c0e5.source: In the last room of level 2 will be an Indestructible Golem, a bundle item (Flux Matrix) and an interactive Unstable Magical Energy Storage. The golem will not take damage from any normal means; but spells that cause life stealing and some forms of health degeneration work. This is not advised as the golem has a large amount of health.
4659bd332913aa5bea97f6dae07f2bf69275c0e5.text: 第 2 层的最后一个房间将有一个坚不可摧的傀儡、一个捆绑物品（通量矩阵）和一个互动的不稳定魔法能量存储。傀儡不会受到任何正常方式的伤害；但导致生命窃取和某些形式的健康退化的法术却起作用。不建议这样做，因为傀儡有大量生命值。

40e812e03c753068762cda82acc14e2dcb5e8dce.source: Run past the Indestructible Golem (it's usually best to circle around to the left) and pick up the Flux Matrix. Click on the Unstable Magical Energy Source to charge the bundle item. Drop it beside the Indestructible Golem to cause 1337 damage. Repeat the procedure and refill the bundle item at the Unstable Magical Energy Source after each drop. It will take 2 drops to destroy the golem.
40e812e03c753068762cda82acc14e2dcb5e8dce.text: 跑过坚不可摧的傀儡（通常最好绕到左边）并捡起通量矩阵。单击不稳定的魔法能量源可为捆绑物品充电。将其掉落在坚不可摧的魔像旁边，造成 1337 点伤害。重复该过程，并在每次掉落后在不稳定的魔法能量源处重新填充捆绑物品。需要 2 滴才能摧毁傀儡。

c68e3dd9513f01da63b03d97ba4b524fb979d731.source: The final level is filled with Sentry Golems and Golem Sentries. Only the Golem Sentries can become hostile. Oola is at the end of the room. As you approach her, a cinematic will trigger. You do not actually need to fight anything in this room as running to Oola will end the quest.
c68e3dd9513f01da63b03d97ba4b524fb979d731.text: 最终关卡充满了哨兵傀儡和傀儡哨兵。只有傀儡哨兵可以变得敌对。乌拉在房间的尽头。当你接近她时，就会触发电影。实际上你不需要在这个房间里与任何东西战斗，因为跑到乌拉就会结束任务。

6fa5c78540a2b1c0973cde346909ab109239ed98.source: Though there are no Hexes inside of the mission itself, there are quite a few Wind Riders on the path there and those carry quite a few. The prevention of most healing through Shame and shutdown of Adrenaline-reliant builds through Soothing Images are of especially heavy concern.
6fa5c78540a2b1c0973cde346909ab109239ed98.text: 虽然任务本身没有妖术，但那里的道路上有不少乘风者，而且它们携带着不少。通过羞耻来阻止大多数治愈，以及通过舒缓图像来关闭依赖肾上腺素的构建，这是特别值得关注的。

497e9fd9cf16ef71743cc34e076b1ca8580c5bca.source: Most of the damage comes from the melee golems, so sources of Block is very useful.
497e9fd9cf16ef71743cc34e076b1ca8580c5bca.text: 大部分伤害来自近战魔像，因此格挡来源非常有用。

a0229d18c802f64c7c6f0a183009a55edd52e116.source: Conditions are relatively unimportant outside and inside of the mission, with really only the Blind from the Elementalist Golems being important if the team is reliant on a martial attacker.
a0229d18c802f64c7c6f0a183009a55edd52e116.text: 任务外部和内部的条件相对不重要，如果团队依赖武术攻击者，实际上只有元素魔像的致盲才是重要的。

72f8a28d1be3fae01142c38d142a05835badcac4.source: Most of the Conditions can be prevented via blocking or Blinding.
72f8a28d1be3fae01142c38d142a05835badcac4.text: 大多数情况可以通过阻止或致盲来预防。

c2380086ed89f00819c9ff5529b348da1764cbc5.source: If your party gained Death Penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much Death Penalty while in this mission, you can simply resign in the mission dungeon, which causes your party to spawn next to Blimm and eliminate the Death Penalty. Talk to Blimm again to restart the mission.
c2380086ed89f00819c9ff5529b348da1764cbc5.text: 如果你的队伍在执行此任务的途中获得了死刑，或者在此任务中积累了太多的死刑，你可以简单地在任务地下城中辞职，这会使你的队伍在布利姆旁边重生并消除死刑。再次与布利姆交谈以重新启动任务。

faaf669aa8120cd74692fbe6774a9f7f3d77c563.source: None of the foes in this quest are fleshy, so skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
faaf669aa8120cd74692fbe6774a9f7f3d77c563.text: 此任务中的敌人都不是肉质的，因此造成流血、疾病或中毒或需要尸体的技能在这里效果较差。然而，这些技能对于到达魔法石中的布利姆来完成此任务仍然有用。

cc8b63bd4c1b0c25594dee7b7032540a6059bff2.source: None of the foes in this quest use hex spells, so hex removal skills are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
cc8b63bd4c1b0c25594dee7b7032540a6059bff2.text: 此任务中的敌人都没有使用十六进制法术，因此去除十六进制的技能在这里效果较差。然而，这些技能对于到达魔法石中的布利姆来完成此任务仍然有用。

8be94c02d73c0711c0174496c74fd8452514e7bf.source: In Level 3, the Golems that you need to fight are named Golem Sentry; the stationary ones are named Sentry Golems.
8be94c02d73c0711c0174496c74fd8452514e7bf.text: 在第3级中，你需要战斗的傀儡被命名为傀儡哨兵；固定的被称为哨兵傀儡。

79744c9552d11fb6bb27fdf6aff798038ca3b38c.source: A Shadow Form or Vow of Silence runner can run most of the mission for a significant time saving, most notably all the way through Magus Stones. The few occasions when fighting is unavoidable can be easily handled by the rest of the party.
79744c9552d11fb6bb27fdf6aff798038ca3b38c.text: 暗影形态或沉默誓言奔跑者可以运行大部分任务，从而节省大量时间，尤其是通过魔法石。少数不可避免的战斗情况可以由队伍的其他成员轻松处理。

977cb8a7916de0b446edf29ac49aa6280499f2c6.source: The endlessly respawning golems on level two do not give experience (which prevents them from being used as an AFK farm).
977cb8a7916de0b446edf29ac49aa6280499f2c6.text: 第二层不断重生的魔像不会提供经验（这会阻止它们被用作 AFK 农场）。

3eddedf6a7da2edf64475ef5800ae9377a8ccaa5.source: This quest (and all primary repeatable Eye of the North quests) may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments after completing it once.
3eddedf6a7da2edf64475ef5800ae9377a8ccaa5.text: 该任务（以及所有主要可重复的北方之眼任务）也可以在完成一次后从纪念碑大厅的占卜池中获得。

6a39488626aae466cd5186de6ce2ca7dfd8b9e18.source: The Asuran Skill Pain Inverter also works against the Indestructible Golem.
6a39488626aae466cd5186de6ce2ca7dfd8b9e18.text: 阿苏兰技能止痛器也能对抗坚不可摧的傀儡。

47356b66a4a827a3cf964e69ebd942a510b73fe4.source: This is not the TPS Regulator Golem quest. For that quest (Little Workshop of Horrors) talk with Blimm in Rata Sum, not in Magus Stones.
47356b66a4a827a3cf964e69ebd942a510b73fe4.text: 这不是 TPS 调节器傀儡任务。对于该任务（恐怖小作坊），请在拉塔苏姆而不是魔法石中与布利姆交谈。

ac6113d47f3721204e6c35e2300b00f3610cc51f.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
ac6113d47f3721204e6c35e2300b00f3610cc51f.text: 完成此任务将填写英雄手册故事书第 11 页。

d1d942a8c85a27112ad9e0f556dae0cb7587f742.source: The Edification energy boost is granted in this area, unlike most zones in the Depths of Tyria below Asuran territory.
d1d942a8c85a27112ad9e0f556dae0cb7587f742.text: 与阿苏拉领地以下的泰瑞亚深处的大多数区域不同，该区域会获得启迪能量提升。

a42b3ca0ed8d71ca572971ec06bb8ff9d64dc408.source: The Hero's Handbook lists this mission as Oola's Laboratory.
a42b3ca0ed8d71ca572971ec06bb8ff9d64dc408.text: 英雄手册将这个任务列为乌拉的实验室。

069fa5348d2517411448ee73453ed909dbfa89c8.source: Seek out Master Togo in Linnok Courtyard.
069fa5348d2517411448ee73453ed909dbfa89c8.text: 在林诺克庭院寻找多哥大师。

ccfbf6414fc70792588ee2825a2346f54bf82cf6.source: Open your world map (default: "M"), and click on Shing Jea Monastery. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into Linnok Courtyard. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it.
ccfbf6414fc70792588ee2825a2346f54bf82cf6.text: 打开你的世界地图（默认值：“M”），然后单击 Shing Jea Monastery。选择旅行。现在向东出口，进入林诺克庭院。东哥大师就在它的中间。

52c6875235a6b500df1e134ca3b30f722bec1b2f.source: The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one player, once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the followup quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
52c6875235a6b500df1e134ca3b30f722bec1b2f.text: 该任务的奖励可由一名玩家获得八次，每个职业一次。第一次将是你职业的主要追求。其他七次只是在选择第二职业之前与每个职业的校长交谈即可。完成他们的任务以及后续任务，最终会将其放入您的任务日志中。

8c899615235f9e8d91c4ebe28e9bac2181ebf47d.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: mesmer
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
8c899615235f9e8d91c4ebe28e9bac2181ebf47d.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：幻术师
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

5b69b822d0b65a10d5a3fce57c2678ba3a7e6a97.source: Follow the road southwest until you find skale. Clear the road of skale.
5b69b822d0b65a10d5a3fce57c2678ba3a7e6a97.text: 沿着路向西南方向行驶，直到找到斯凯勒。清理斯卡莱的道路。

2ae6d5d628cb0ae463013c8ad3ce632dcababb11.source: Return to Sebedoh the Mesmer for your reward.
2ae6d5d628cb0ae463013c8ad3ce632dcababb11.text: 返回幻术师塞贝多那里领取奖励。

26eb16e8bfc62ccddee55a10004f252e92dbb1a1.source: Haversdan appears in front of the gate to Ascalon City, while Sebedoh leaves and can no longer be found pre-Searing.
26eb16e8bfc62ccddee55a10004f252e92dbb1a1.text: 哈弗斯丹出现在阿斯卡隆城的大门前，而塞贝多则离开并在灼热前不再被发现。

1db982a741c4e674ebf79d9d572f64955aa88d33.source: The 4 River Skale Tads will no longer spawn on the road. Instead, creatures around the river will begin spawning as normal, with different low-level skale as well as devourers appearing in the eastern section of Lakeside County.
1db982a741c4e674ebf79d9d572f64955aa88d33.text: 4 个 River Skale Tads 将不再在路上生成。相反，河流周围的生物将开始正常产卵，不同的低级骷髅以及吞噬者会出现在湖滨县的东部。

6a16fc847ed51d34e8faf7f449779afef40e3150.source: Follow the road southwest until you come upon the 4 skale. Killing either of the two closest to the city triggers the rest of the pack to start fleeing toward the river, completing the quest condition. Killing either of the other two has no effect on the quest and does not trigger any reaction from the remaining skale, but is a quick source of a little extra XP.
6a16fc847ed51d34e8faf7f449779afef40e3150.text: 沿着路向西南方向行驶，直至到达 4 skale。杀死距离城市最近的两个中的任何一个都会触发狼群的其余部分开始逃向河流，从而完成任务条件。杀死另外两个人中的任何一个对任务没有任何影响，也不会触发剩余斯卡莱的任何反应，但可以快速获得一点额外的经验值。

df70c40999edce86580b0dd77691de2f8c0d3912.source: Speak to at least one non-[primary profession] expert.
df70c40999edce86580b0dd77691de2f8c0d3912.text: 与至少一位非[主要职业]专家交谈。

a962185f4397ac79e842c0febc63cf21754f4b9e.source: See First Spear Devhad for your reward.
a962185f4397ac79e842c0febc63cf21754f4b9e.text: 请见第一矛德夫哈德以获得奖励。

29ce168eb2f35d41e1b5fa89dce6d3e5b3375c99.source: Having M.O.X. in the party. (Doesn't have to be in the party during the three quests.)
29ce168eb2f35d41e1b5fa89dce6d3e5b3375c99.text: 拥有 M.O.X.在聚会中。 （三个任务期间不必在队伍中。）

df58422b638d62bc75fee579c3e9f9f5a22d00ac.text: 取回 R.O.X. 的能量水晶。

7759a6d0dbc59b99284b3956b475b871c6519fcc.text: 取回 N.O.X. 的能量水晶。

69331a17a3fdd240b191b72810aa5cf74df2b15e.text: 取回 P.O.X. 的能量水晶。

e1b7ee441ad2d351ec39fddf0ecd60e9eb2541c7.source: Zinn's Secret Underground Lair can be found in the explorable area The Falls. It is at the westernmost end, where the waterfall displayed on the last page of the golem manual is located. A person with M.O.X in their party must interact with "The Falls" in order to achieve entrance to the secret lair. The closest town to start from is Ventari's Refuge and you must pass through two other areas with a maximum party size of six members to reach it.
e1b7ee441ad2d351ec39fddf0ecd60e9eb2541c7.text: 津恩的秘密地下巢穴位于可探索区域瀑布。它位于最西端，也就是傀儡手册最后一页上显示的瀑布所在的地方。队伍中有 M.O.X 的人必须与“瀑布”互动才能进入秘密巢穴。最近的城镇是文塔里避难所，您必须穿过另外两个区域（队伍人数上限为六人）才能到达。

c80c2ffe205e8b718902763e5632967064db9978.source: MOX must be in your party in order to reach Zinn's lair; only the player bringing the golem hero can speak with Zinn to continue the quest.
c80c2ffe205e8b718902763e5632967064db9978.text: MOX 必须在你的队伍中才能到达 Zinn 的巢穴；只有携带傀儡英雄的玩家才能与辛恩交谈以继续任务。

a68b87679e965aeec3dc7021eb61c8e57803522a.source: Parties who haven't completed the quest will be returned to Ventari's Refuge, after Zinn's dialogue.
a68b87679e965aeec3dc7021eb61c8e57803522a.text: 与辛恩对话后，未完成任务的队伍将被送回文塔里避难所。

619073eaae606637eae7bf1aff9880a9b9d23759.source: Be careful in the area right before the secret lair, as it is easy to aggro the nearby Wind Riders (and their elementalist boss).
619073eaae606637eae7bf1aff9880a9b9d23759.text: 在秘密巢穴之前的区域要小心，因为很容易激怒附近的驭风者（以及他们的元素首领）。

399125f923165cdea30e0ae6e423d13e6973ce03.source: While in Zinn's Secret Lair, the map displays as if the party is beneath Oola's Lab; however, the Lair is northwest of that location. Page 5 of the manual says, "bring M.O.X. with you, as he will be able to bypass the security protocols;" however, the quest log fails to make this requirement clear.
399125f923165cdea30e0ae6e423d13e6973ce03.text: 在 Zinn 的秘密巢穴中时，地图显示队伍就好像在 Oola 的实验室下面；然而，巢穴位于该位置的西北部。手册第 5 页说：“随身携带 M.O.X.，因为他将能够绕过安全协议；”然而，任务日志未能明确这一要求。

ca66cfb0f0cf3821a6f7bb14c65e6f8198c99235.source: Accepting the reward as a secondary ranger teaches Pin Down, which is not taught by any of the expert rangers during the previous quest, instead of Power Shot, which is offered by Rakanja. You can abandon this quest after choosing your secondary and before accepting the quest reward and will get a new choice to choose your secondary. However, this will have no effect — your secondary profession has already been locked.
ca66cfb0f0cf3821a6f7bb14c65e6f8198c99235.text: 作为二级游侠接受奖励会教授“锁定”（在之前的任务中任何专家游侠都没有教授过），而不是“强力射击”（由 Rakanja 提供）。在选择你的次要之后、接受任务奖励之前，你可以放弃这个任务，并会得到一个新的选择来选择你的次要。然而，这不会有任何影响——你的第二职业已经被锁定了。

ec81781ae86bcede3bcd8585daee986f15f02ee1.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: elementalist
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
ec81781ae86bcede3bcd8585daee986f15f02ee1.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：元素师
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

91d5c7cde0754ddd0804425118ea27c20d4b2916.source: Kill the skale along the road southwest. Acquire a shimmering scale.
91d5c7cde0754ddd0804425118ea27c20d4b2916.text: 沿着西南方向的路杀掉斯凯尔。获得一个闪闪发光的秤。

4e194f0a703c0df7edf14bdc7d11ad5b7eef5979.text: 收集了 0...1 个闪闪发光的鳞片。

39b27e9384887e257a8c539aff7e6085d5ebd6cd.source: Return to Howland the Elementalist for your reward.
39b27e9384887e257a8c539aff7e6085d5ebd6cd.text: 返回元素师霍兰那里领取奖励。

f0d1e294ee1824fe7c572acd601ce44abafc95ad.source: After obtaining the quest, follow the road southwest and kill the skale along the road or the river nearby to acquire a shimmering scale. Present it to Howland the Elementalist for your reward.
f0d1e294ee1824fe7c572acd601ce44abafc95ad.text: 获得任务后，沿着西南方向的道路，击杀沿路或附近河流的斯凯尔即可获得闪光鳞片。将其交给元素师霍兰以获得奖励。

357adc7d7376efd5c9bc1dd18bd4f5b78b22be03.source: All party members must have received the reward for A Little Help.
357adc7d7376efd5c9bc1dd18bd4f5b78b22be03.text: 所有小队成员都必须获得“一点帮助”的奖励。

ebb1d164ec4bb94ad49f2a9303c1c5dd370862ea.source: Mamp in Rata Sum will brief you on the defenses.
ebb1d164ec4bb94ad49f2a9303c1c5dd370862ea.text: Rata Sum 的 Mamp 会向您介绍防御措施。

10867c0e4e2f3aab200b1b69aa01a1b90700814b.source: Protect each golem kiln as it heats up.
10867c0e4e2f3aab200b1b69aa01a1b90700814b.text: 在每个傀儡窑变热时保护它。

2c6776e9de744d193731196addd32dbe174413d1.source: Learn how to deploy golems into battle.
2c6776e9de744d193731196addd32dbe174413d1.text: 了解如何在战斗中部署傀儡。

282543f99f99d6300f4271a4538aa23ccfc56994.source: Drop an Asuran beacon obtained from Sokka to summon golem reinforcements.
282543f99f99d6300f4271a4538aa23ccfc56994.text: 掉落从索卡获得的阿苏兰信标来召唤魔像增援。

6eb8768e7b0cd673dc3ad972cf9fd6000fb98fb3.source: Defeat the Bringers of Destruction protecting the hive.
6eb8768e7b0cd673dc3ad972cf9fd6000fb98fb3.text: 击败保护蜂巢的毁灭使者。

243dffa71dfc1dc8b9fcc2fadccdda9fa10810f9.text: 重复次数：100（困难模式下为 150）

7961f8461cc9c718c25e778c313626a94e1a6f60.source: The mission is divided into three main parts: (1) defend a set of golem-producing kilns while Sokka makes them fully operational; (2) fight your way to the Destroyer spawning grounds (a burnt out area near the top of the map); and (3) defeat the Bringers of Destruction.
7961f8461cc9c718c25e778c313626a94e1a6f60.text: 任务分为三个主要部分：（1）保卫一套魔像生产窑炉，同时索卡让它们全面运作； (2) 一路杀到毁灭者产卵场（地图顶部附近的烧毁区域）； (3) 击败毁灭使者。

e786c151a1f158574db46bbf69f684fcc6d46e2e.source: If you only have heroes and henchmen, the second and third techniques below are more reliable.
e786c151a1f158574db46bbf69f684fcc6d46e2e.text: 如果你只有英雄和追随者，下面的第二个和第三个技术更可靠。

c6b8d17053a3ba86b1ad0d0793d81aaaf2e9c18d.source: Oola and Gadd will each help support one kiln; you must decide whether to split up your group or run back and forth between the kilns.
c6b8d17053a3ba86b1ad0d0793d81aaaf2e9c18d.text: Oola 和 Gadd 将各资助一座窑炉；你必须决定是分散队伍还是在窑炉之间来回奔跑。

5f2868d61b3705f503efff7d92140d53754e3d38.source: Split: stay behind the bridge to take full advantage of the NPCs. The Destroyers stop attacking after a kiln is heated; you can regroup then. Using heroes and henchmen, flag the henchmen to the eastern kiln and the heroes at the northern one. You can run between them as required by the situation. As long as you include a healer in each group, you should not have much trouble in normal mode; this will work in hard mode, albeit more slowly. Recommended henchmen are: Devona, Lo Sha, Mhenlo, and Talon.
5f2868d61b3705f503efff7d92140d53754e3d38.text: 分裂：留在桥后面充分利用 NPC。窑炉加热后，毁灭者停止攻击；然后你就可以重新组合了。使用英雄和追随者，将追随者标记到东窑，将英雄标记到北窑。您可以根据情况需要在它们之间运行。只要你每组都有一个治疗者，在正常模式下就不会有太大麻烦；这将在困难模式下工作，尽管速度较慢。推荐的追随者有：德沃娜、洛莎、姆恩洛和泰隆。

ec1bca2f4a3b42493c69ecfe73c9513ab0564f03.source: Back and forth: Ignore Oola and Gadd, who will respawn when no other enemies are in their range. Run between the kilns, defending whichever is most vulnerable.
ec1bca2f4a3b42493c69ecfe73c9513ab0564f03.text: 来回：忽略 Oola 和 Gadd，当他们的范围内没有其他敌人时，他们会重生。在窑炉之间奔跑，保护最脆弱的那个。

0bedd41e6576dba45b6b515e517650b2f295b620.source: After both kilns are ready, talk with Sokka so that he will follow you and offer you Asuran Beacons, which produce a pair of G.O.L.E.M. 1.0s. These golems will follow you, so you can start moving right away. Talk to a golem to switch it between wait- and follow-modes; drop a beacon to replace your golems.
0bedd41e6576dba45b6b515e517650b2f295b620.text: 两个窑炉准备好后，与索卡交谈，以便他跟随你并向你提供阿苏兰信标，它会生产一对 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0秒。这些傀儡会跟随你，所以你可以立即开始移动。与傀儡交谈以在等待和跟随模式之间切换；放下一个信标来替换你的傀儡。

22dd552a19ff52babb454819b1fd7f77d5a464c3.source: Fight your way to the spawning grounds and defeat the Bringer of Destruction pair; defeating them completes the mission (you do not have to kill the other Destroyers in that area).
22dd552a19ff52babb454819b1fd7f77d5a464c3.text: 杀出一条血路，到达产卵场并击败毁灭使者对；击败他们即可完成任务（您不必杀死该区域的其他驱逐舰）。

bf4dd97e57cc5cea7ccc106b0250ba6bd0a432e7.source: At start, you need to avoid Sokka; turn left, staying in the grass. Cross the tree-trunk bridge by the left kiln and clear the Destroyers occupying the hill including the group waiting to go down to the Eastern kiln. Once you have cleared the green area, you can leave your party just below the last tree on the green side of the hilltop at the edge of the burnt-out spawning grounds. One player must return to Sokka to trigger the kilns, then return to the party to confront the Destroyer spawns that occur within the spawning grounds. Finally, two Bringers of Destruction will appear with assorted other Destroyers. The party should move away and lose aggro at this time; the Destroyers will stay near their spawn point and not chase the party. Defeating the Bringers of Destruction at this point can trigger bugs that make the mission impossible to complete. You can then go talk with Sokka so that he will follow you and offer you Asuran Beacons, which produce a pair of G.O.L.E.M. 1.0s. These golems will follow you, so you can start moving right away. Talk to a golem to switch it between wait- and follow-modes; drop a beacon to replace your golems.
bf4dd97e57cc5cea7ccc106b0250ba6bd0a432e7.text: 一开始，你需要避开Sokka；左转，留在草地上。穿过左侧窑炉旁的树干桥，清除占据山头的破坏者，包括等待下东窑炉的队伍。一旦你清理了绿色区域，你就可以把你的队伍留在烧毁的产卵场边缘山顶绿色一侧的最后一棵树下面。一名玩家必须返回索卡来触发窑炉，然后返回队伍以对抗在产卵场内出现的毁灭者产卵。最后，两名毁灭使者将与其他各种毁灭者一起出现。此时队伍应该离开并失去仇恨；驱逐舰将停留在其重生点附近，不会追赶队伍。此时击败毁灭使者可能会触发错误，使任务无法完成。然后你可以和索卡交谈，这样他就会跟着你并向你提供阿苏兰信标，它会产生一对 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0秒。这些傀儡会跟随你，所以你可以立即开始移动。与傀儡交谈以在等待和跟随模式之间切换；放下一个信标来替换你的傀儡。

c0d87527569134aeebe930683423c1464e44bae3.source: Go back to the spawning grounds and defeat the Bringers; defeating them completes the mission (you do not have to kill the other Destroyers in that area).
c0d87527569134aeebe930683423c1464e44bae3.text: 返回产卵场并击败带来者；击败他们即可完成任务（您不必杀死该区域的其他驱逐舰）。

268ba882a6c29fee4a9bfb4d9a8f7eb3d2c9b9ec.source: If you have trouble with either of the above techniques, then return to the kilns with the entire party after clearing the area between the NPCs and the spawning groups ("Skipping the kilns" method.) The waves of Destroyers that come in afterwards should be easy to dispatch: the mobs are smaller and arrive less frequently. Spark up the Golems and bring them with you to tackle the spawning grounds.
268ba882a6c29fee4a9bfb4d9a8f7eb3d2c9b9ec.text: 如果您对上述任一技术有困难，请在清理 NPC 和产卵组之间的区域后与整个队伍返回窑炉（“跳过窑炉”方法）。之后出现的一波毁灭者应该很容易派遣：怪物较小且到达频率较低。激发傀儡并带着它们去探索产卵场。

46114cd7b181c90ba951561155ab90f9c0384eb1.source: You can finish the mission in about seven minutes using this technique. At least one player must equip Recall.
46114cd7b181c90ba951561155ab90f9c0384eb1.text: 使用这种技术，您可以在大约七分钟内完成任务。至少一名玩家必须装备召回。

118e0d215703d2d573ac6878da4bacc9516684ba.source: Start the countdown timer by flagging heroes and henchmen between the two sets of stairs. Circle backwards and around to the left, but remaining out of compass range of the eastern kiln. Continue along this path and stop near the chasm, with the northern kiln on the edge of your compass; this allows you to trigger just that one kiln, so that you do not have to defend the other.
118e0d215703d2d573ac6878da4bacc9516684ba.text: 通过在两组楼梯之间标记英雄和追随者来启动倒计时器。向后并向左绕一圈，但保持在东窑的罗盘范围之外。继续沿着这条路走，在峡谷附近停下来，北窑就在你指南针的边缘；这可以让你只触发一个窑炉，这样你就不必保卫另一个窑炉。

258c881e7f4dcbba18bebdb05f6c4f674f654c7c.source: While you are circling around and as soon as the mission text starts appearing, flag all but one of your party just across from the left-hand side bridge. Send the remaining hero across from your eventual position across the chasm; when that hero is close enough, cast Recall on them and then flag them back with the rest of the party (you might need to micromanage their pathing; they can get stuck on corners). Once the hero is with everyone else, cancel Recall so that you can teleport to the northern kiln (without having triggered the eastern one).
258c881e7f4dcbba18bebdb05f6c4f674f654c7c.text: 当你绕圈时，一旦任务文本开始出现，就在左侧桥对面标记你的队伍中除了一个人之外的所有人。将剩下的英雄从你最终的位置送过鸿沟；当该英雄足够接近时，对他们施放召回，然后将他们与队伍的其他成员一起标记回来（你可能需要对他们的路径进行微观管理；他们可能会卡在角落里）。一旦英雄和其他人在一起，取消召回，这样你就可以传送到北窑（而不触发东窑）。

71cbd9639e36ebd54c5310a683062f0803e0f5c7.source: While the kiln heats up, take the party to clear the route to the blackened area as usual. Wait until the kiln is ready before crossing the crest of the hill. Kill the Bringers to complete the mission.
71cbd9639e36ebd54c5310a683062f0803e0f5c7.text: 当窑炉升温时，像往常一样带领队伍清理通往黑色区域的路线。等到窑准备好了再翻过山顶。杀死使者以完成任务。

b69157090af855159bcdf5ad4ddfdd59add6c9e2.source: Alternatively, if your party has enough anti physical (weakness, Ineptitude, Wandering Eye, etc.), a minion master and a spirit spammer (bring Shadowsong), you can flag your heroes on top of the hill, run for the kilns and go AFK until all spawns are dead and the kilns are ready. Go back to your party and finish the mission.
b69157090af855159bcdf5ad4ddfdd59add6c9e2.text: 或者，如果你的队伍有足够的反物理能力（弱点、无能、游移之眼等）、小兵大师和精神垃圾邮件发送者（带上影歌），你可以在山顶上标记你的英雄，跑向窑炉并挂机，直到所有生成物都死了并且窑炉准备就绪。返回你的队伍并完成任务。

30662b85ad57b8d37cbb9c9ba28f5ab4e9e12593.source: The relevant quest may be obtained directly from Mamp (who will also take you into the mission). Alternatively, after completing it once, it may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments (like any quest from the Hero's Handbook).
30662b85ad57b8d37cbb9c9ba28f5ab4e9e12593.text: 相关任务可以直接从Mamp那里获得（他也会带你进入任务）。或者，完成一次后，也可以从纪念碑大厅的占卜池中获得（就像英雄手册中的任何任务一样）。

244b04ef52b1a575e383de4b6a01f17774a5877e.source: Those wishing to scrape the area can do so easily: follow the alternative walkthrough and postpone the activation of the kilns; the area will be free of foes.
244b04ef52b1a575e383de4b6a01f17774a5877e.text: 那些希望清理该区域的人可以轻松做到这一点：按照替代演练并推迟窑炉的激活；该地区将没有敌人。

ba79b5c267120d7ae243f5cb4c1cc718ee326ef8.source: This mission presents a good opportunity to farm Destroyers.
ba79b5c267120d7ae243f5cb4c1cc718ee326ef8.text: 这个任务提供了一个刷驱逐舰的好机会。

84ef5fc7fc4e62054397f29d090191d03470d863.source: Destroyers are immune to burning, resistant to fire damage, and vulnerable to cold damage. A common approach is to combine Winter with any elemental damage.
84ef5fc7fc4e62054397f29d090191d03470d863.text: 驱逐舰免疫燃烧，抵抗火焰伤害，并且容易受到寒冷伤害。一种常见的方法是将冬季与任何元素伤害结合起来。

7d65b8a11b20b36b9d17e627e9422c24f6fd907c.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #13 in the Hero's Handbook storybook.
7d65b8a11b20b36b9d17e627e9422c24f6fd907c.text: 完成此任务将填写英雄手册故事书第 13 页。

b7ef31baad4f3ecedbfd604d9da07b89fcc7e599.source: Unlike previous campaigns where missions are contained in outposts with visually distinct map icons and can be started from an NPC with a rotating green icon, the way in which this quest can be started is by going to Rata Sum and talking to Mamp which is marked in game with a green, rotating, shield-like icon, akin to the one of Mission NPCs.
b7ef31baad4f3ecedbfd604d9da07b89fcc7e599.text: 与以前的战役不同，任务包含在具有视觉上不同的地图图标的前哨站中，并且可以从具有旋转绿色图标的 NPC 开始，该任务的启动方式是前往 Rata Sum 并与 Mamp 交谈，Mamp 在游戏中标记为绿色、旋转、盾牌状图标，类似于任务 NPC 之一。

9f71e506e8c5a2eac7970545694b472f0249721c.source: Sometimes a G.O.L.E.M. spawns with unlimited health.
9f71e506e8c5a2eac7970545694b472f0249721c.text: 有时是 G.O.L.E.M.生成时具有无限生命值。

8ca1bee93376fef3128b3e94a3c0b1464e633352.source: There is a delay between when the Bringers spawn and the task to defeat them is added to the quest. A sufficiently powerful group camped on their spawn location can kill them before the task is added, making it impossible to finish the quest.
8ca1bee93376fef3128b3e94a3c0b1464e633352.text: 使者出现和击败它们的任务添加到任务之间有一段延迟。一个足够强大的团体扎营在他们的重生位置可以在任务添加之前杀死他们，从而使任务无法完成。

28e26f4cf4bb26f83c53dd6fc7d8929222b16d85.source: You can accidentally prevent the game from registering the completion of the mission if you kill the Bringers of Destruction before triggering their protectors. To avoid this, refrain from killing the two bosses until the very last objective (for a total of five objectives) appears in your quest log, i.e. even after you are told to kill the Bringers of Destruction.
28e26f4cf4bb26f83c53dd6fc7d8929222b16d85.text: 如果您在触发毁灭者的保护者之前杀死毁灭者，您可能会意外地阻止游戏注册任务的完成。为了避免这种情况，请不要杀死两个 Boss，直到最后一个目标（总共五个目标）出现在您的任务日志中，即即使在您被告知要杀死毁灭者之后。

569d545168af6ce4e4119b122ff4a3ca7ab0f684.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 主要职业：游侠

e204a6ec259f9833437b5547087134781ab4f620.source: Seek out Headmaster Greico in the monastery.
e204a6ec259f9833437b5547087134781ab4f620.text: 在修道院里寻找格雷科校长。

bd38aa7b539127dd032a233ab849a690d8b69da2.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the skills
bd38aa7b539127dd032a233ab849a690d8b69da2.text: 与Shing Jea寺入口处的Ludo交谈即可进入。如果您跳过了螳螂幼体教程，您将学习技能

130104eb22b3c0a9d6d07e1e10ef983aa2eb51cb.source: gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a Starter Bow after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Greico, who is nearby, for your reward.
130104eb22b3c0a9d6d07e1e10ef983aa2eb51cb.text: 获得2000经验，进入修道院后获得入门弓。如果您完成了教程，您就已经收到了这些。与附近的格雷科校长交谈以获得奖励。

a8dfe09efeda657579959d7fe4b9c91a7ae8d28e.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
a8dfe09efeda657579959d7fe4b9c91a7ae8d28e.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

c3404ec378bb48c321feeadd2de7a8a4d3c5f916.source: Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Talk to Devona.
c3404ec378bb48c321feeadd2de7a8a4d3c5f916.text: 沿着从城镇向西南方向行驶的道路前往阿什福德。与德沃娜交谈。

f50e18d281bbe18a146234496cc74d5af4d52d17.source: From Ascalon City, follow the road going southwest. As you approach Ashford Abbey, turn south and follow the quest marker to Devona.
f50e18d281bbe18a146234496cc74d5af4d52d17.text: 从阿斯卡隆市出发，沿着公路向西南方向行驶。当您接近阿什福德修道院时，转向南并沿着任务标记前往德沃纳。

8b73337eeb5ec934cb8a6af886617f52f204be4b.source: Despite being a primary quest, completing it is not necessary for receiving Unsettling Rumors or A Second Profession from Armin Saberlin and continuing with the story. Both quests can be obtained as soon as you complete your primary profession test.
8b73337eeb5ec934cb8a6af886617f52f204be4b.text: 尽管这是一个主要任务，但完成它并不是从阿明·萨柏林那里收到令人不安的谣言或第二职业并继续故事的必要条件。完成初级职业测试后即可获得这两个任务。

962ac5417509a5fb7d69248ee0501cd95e480ce8.source: Talk with Quarrymaster Bohanna about manning the excavation.
962ac5417509a5fb7d69248ee0501cd95e480ce8.text: 与采石场管理员博哈纳讨论挖掘工作的人员安排。

7fa3175c47987069cbf3dc3e8e445fafc950b308.source: Meet with Dunkoro on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
7fa3175c47987069cbf3dc3e8e445fafc950b308.text: 在多赫约克悬崖上与邓科罗会面。

3bc7e493789fcd1dff371cfbe2951df80c1effa5.source: Explain the plan to Hamar and start the assault.
3bc7e493789fcd1dff371cfbe2951df80c1effa5.text: 向哈马尔解释计划并开始攻击。

ec47332a2cf13ae5dbfe3e6efbfb58f39b57f896.source: Lead Hamar against the skree harpies holding Dohjok quarry. [5...0] of 5 harpy groups remaining.
ec47332a2cf13ae5dbfe3e6efbfb58f39b57f896.text: 带领哈马尔对抗占据多赫约克采石场的斯克雷鹰身女妖。剩余 5 个鹰身女妖组中的 [5...0]。

340ae0142becba176a4c41fb815af4a0baac97ad.source: See Digmaster Gatah for your reward.
340ae0142becba176a4c41fb815af4a0baac97ad.text: 请见 Digmaster Gatah 以获得奖励。

8f6d9010a2467ecd048c6f98fe514c0b995e0709.source: Head to Champion's Dawn to talk to Quarrymaster Bohanna. She will tell you to locate Dunkoro. Just follow the quest marker into Cliffs of Dohjok and find Dunkoro to continue the quest. Dunkoro will provide new information on the situation and inform you to join up with Hamar, the quarry supervisor. Just keep following the quest marker until you get to Hamar and a group of Diggers. Talking to Hamar will have them all follow your party as allies.
8f6d9010a2467ecd048c6f98fe514c0b995e0709.text: 前往冠军黎明与采石场大师博哈纳交谈。她会告诉你找到邓科罗。只需按照任务标记进入多赫约克悬崖并找到邓科罗即可继续任务。 Dunkoro 将提供有关情况的新信息，并通知您与采石场主管 Hamar 会合。继续跟随任务标记，直到到达哈马尔和一群挖掘者。与哈马尔交谈将使他们都作为盟友追随你的政党。

52f113814ce7fdf1be3350e6430038533f4e06e2.source: The next part of the quest involves clearing out the groups of Skree harpies from the quarry area. There are about five groups in total. Remember to grab the Skree Battle bounty from the nearby resurrection shrine before proceeding. Follow the quest marker down a slope towards the lower quarry area.
52f113814ce7fdf1be3350e6430038533f4e06e2.text: 任务的下一部分涉及清除采石场地区的斯克里鹰身女妖群。总共大约有五组。请记住在继续之前从附近的复活神殿获取 Skree 战斗赏金。沿着任务标记走下斜坡，前往较低的采石场区域。

bca7f3c66c6d3c5b220ce664bf14ee9431bbd47c.source: The first group of harpies is on the bridge along the downward path. With all the allies with you, the fighting will be relatively quick and easy. Beyond the first group, the second and third group are somewhat close together. Be wary of attracting too much attention. Each group of harpies consists of about 3 or 4 harpies of mixed professions. Once all five groups are cleared, the quest will update and you can head to Jokanur Diggings for your reward.
bca7f3c66c6d3c5b220ce664bf14ee9431bbd47c.text: 第一组鹰身女妖位于下行路径的桥上。有了所有盟友的陪伴，战斗将会相对快速和轻松。除了第一组之外，第二组和第三组的距离也有些接近。小心不要吸引过多的注意力。每组鹰身女妖由大约 3 到 4 个混合职业的鹰身女妖组成。一旦所有五个小组都被清除，任务就会更新，你可以前往乔卡努尔矿区领取奖励。

924828233178afcf4f5c7a2525bcaa50c47790d6.source: This quest can be done at the same time with a part of Identity Theft and Scholarly Affairs.
924828233178afcf4f5c7a2525bcaa50c47790d6.text: 该任务可以与身份盗窃和学术事务的一部分同时完成。

429c94b2fe4c1d047a4773646ab8ae7c252bf477.source: Dunkoro's potential death does not lead to failure.
429c94b2fe4c1d047a4773646ab8ae7c252bf477.text: 邓科罗的潜在死亡并不意味着失败。

2510fcd3634b37126c8531fc75154a2e0eb8bc59.source: Sujun can be found near the middle of Sunqua Vale.
2510fcd3634b37126c8531fc75154a2e0eb8bc59.text: Sujun 位于 Sunqua Vale 中部附近。

accc0bd8ec91d5bae0118e313260a971f7ebcaa3.source: Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands.
accc0bd8ec91d5bae0118e313260a971f7ebcaa3.text: 在夏尔家园寻找黑锋先锋。

647903ae9cdc158f5ca441f4d5b12b07c802928e.source: Speak to Gwen in the Hall of Monuments.
647903ae9cdc158f5ca441f4d5b12b07c802928e.text: 在纪念碑大厅与格温交谈。

914578484e259ed12807bf7bbcd2db0e49695456.source: Travel to Longeye's Ledge and search for clues about the Vanguard. (Against the Charr)
914578484e259ed12807bf7bbcd2db0e49695456.text: 前往长眼崖并寻找有关先锋队的线索。 （对阵夏尔）

2397dc0eae7cb6d8a2f3415c94f0777774f369c3.source: Free Pyre's warband and gain their aid. (Warband of Brothers)
2397dc0eae7cb6d8a2f3415c94f0777774f369c3.text: 释放柴堆的战帮并获得他们的援助。 （兄弟战队）

8b8e1ae71d9903ce6dbcd41fdca59ee9ec02f99e.source: Free the remaining Ebon Vanguard from the stronghold of Hierophant Burntsoul. (Assault on the Stronghold)
8b8e1ae71d9903ce6dbcd41fdca59ee9ec02f99e.text: 将剩余的黑檀先锋队从大祭司伯恩索尔的据点中救出。 （攻打要塞）

5c3d2fea1dade9ebec189c9545346e5f5d697664.source: See Captain Langmar for your reward.
5c3d2fea1dade9ebec189c9545346e5f5d697664.text: 去找朗玛船长领取奖励。

d0d06d5e96ad9f48fb024eaba5958f4dafe03c33.source: [Incomplete source section] Travel to Longeye's Ledge, and speak to Olfun Longeye. Then follow the quest chain which starts with Search for the Ebon Vanguard. See the walkthroughs for the individual quests in the chain for further details.
d0d06d5e96ad9f48fb024eaba5958f4dafe03c33.text: [不完整的来源部分] 前往长眼的壁架，并与奥尔芬·长眼交谈。然后跟随从搜索黑锋先锋开始的任务链。有关更多详细信息，请参阅链中各个任务的演练。

efcd9344b9d8c86ccf321ca04470db941c1a68ff.source: Upon completion of the quest, you will be under the effect of Call of the Eye the next time you enter a non-outpost instance.
efcd9344b9d8c86ccf321ca04470db941c1a68ff.text: 完成任务后，下次进入非前哨基地时，你将受到眼睛召唤的影响。

66e151520164df49bbb75e1491c6441a5521fdb5.source: Speak to Sujun once you are ready to go rescue the rabbits.
66e151520164df49bbb75e1491c6441a5521fdb5.text: 准备好去营救兔子后，与苏俊交谈。

cfcb65bef0b6815cf95f35f1812e8bfd51cea4b0.source: Release all the rabbits from the traps. 3..0 of 3 rabbits still trapped.
cfcb65bef0b6815cf95f35f1812e8bfd51cea4b0.text: 将所有兔子从陷阱中释放出来。 3..0 只兔子中的 3 只仍然被困。

d895eaddac7a0ea3a8fc2251e824a0c4b7bfa477.source: After accepting the quest, simply follow Sujun to each of the Rabbit Cages. Click on each of them to free the rabbits held inside. After freeing the second rabbit, a level 6 Hungry Kappa will show up. It must be defeated. With Sujun helping, it shouldn't be difficult. After three rabbits are freed, the quest is complete.
d895eaddac7a0ea3a8fc2251e824a0c4b7bfa477.text: 接受任务后，跟随苏俊前往各个兔笼即可。点击它们中的每一个来释放里面的兔子。释放第二只兔子后，会出现 6 级饥饿河童。它必须被击败。有苏俊帮忙，应该不难。当三只兔子被释放后，任务就完成了。

30455150c038c3a0742a9be249670fc629317c8a.source: Killing the Hungry Kappa is not mentioned as a quest objective, yet the quest cannot be completed without first killing it, even after opening the three cages. It is a good idea to wait at the second cage for this monster to show up, and kill it then.
30455150c038c3a0742a9be249670fc629317c8a.text: 任务目标中没有提到杀死饥饿的河童，但如果不先杀死它，即使打开了三个笼子，任务也无法完成。最好在第二个笼子里等待这个怪物出现，然后杀死它。

aa87b5937ad8826f58851380f5bd3adb07c17075.source: Sujun needs to survive, or the quest can't be completed.
aa87b5937ad8826f58851380f5bd3adb07c17075.text: 苏俊需要活下去，否则任务就无法完成。

ba90debaaa16d34f1f3965cc8254830da631a3bd.source: Discover the fate of the Ebon Vanguard.
ba90debaaa16d34f1f3965cc8254830da631a3bd.text: 探索黑檀先锋队的命运。

37f37ba7fd2d579f8c41894cc202ae18292128c3.source: Search Grothmar Wardowns for signs of the Vanguard.
37f37ba7fd2d579f8c41894cc202ae18292128c3.text: 搜索格罗斯玛战区寻找先锋队的迹象。

d5798a1bfe2a0390a79a5a1640f40cea7c0121ad.source: After exiting Longeye's Ledge, head southeast down the path to find the Vanguard Helmet. Examine it to complete the quest.
d5798a1bfe2a0390a79a5a1640f40cea7c0121ad.text: 离开长眼壁架后，沿着小路向东南走，找到先锋头盔。检查它以完成任务。

61fd7428044738be957d2d29c4882e475bf3bc40.source: If you instead see the Tattered Vanguard Clothing, head south from there to find the Vanguard Helmet; alternatively if you find the Old Campfire, head east instead. Interacting with either the clothing or the campfire are not necessary to complete the quest.
61fd7428044738be957d2d29c4882e475bf3bc40.text: 如果您看到破烂的先锋服装，请从那里向南寻找先锋头盔；或者，如果您找到了旧篝火，请向东行驶。完成任务不需要与衣服或篝火互动。

df5ef07cbe561a34d62e5c803cb03b129ec15938.source: Be sure to let each member of your team complete the quest before you begin the next step or they will not receive credit for the mini mission.
df5ef07cbe561a34d62e5c803cb03b129ec15938.text: 请务必让团队中的每个成员在开始下一步之前完成任务，否则他们将不会获得迷你任务的积分。

aeff2c2706a49e77ea46072d3382bd819932b345.source: If you do examine the helmet more closely, you will automatically start the next primary quest in the Ebon Vanguard chain, Against the Charr.
aeff2c2706a49e77ea46072d3382bd819932b345.text: 如果你更仔细地检查头盔，你将自动开始黑锋先锋链中的下一个主要任务，对抗夏尔。

4f989b3b308a948e9ae1f208afa74dc14a26d78e.source: Gain the rank of First Spear or Level 12.
4f989b3b308a948e9ae1f208afa74dc14a26d78e.text: 获得第一矛军衔或 12 级。

949b1ac5d7079dc2035efb5f0035539986e86904.source: See Emissary Dajmir for your reward.
949b1ac5d7079dc2035efb5f0035539986e86904.text: 请见达吉米尔使者以获得奖励。

e969030f69412dd75cbd8bef629a8472673e09ae.source: You will need to first acquire the necessary Sunspear rank. If you haven't already, talk to Runduk in the Sunspear Great Hall for two quests with similar aims of gaining Sunspear points.
e969030f69412dd75cbd8bef629a8472673e09ae.text: 您需要首先获得必要的阳矛等级。如果您还没有这样做，请与烈阳之矛大厅中的朗杜克交谈，完成两个具有相似目标的任务，以获得阳矛点数。

b55411c86407f38d0132c852209d020536dac25a.source: After that, look for General Morgahn and talk to him to begin the "fight". Your party will face off against five similarly-named (but different professions) Kournan Guards in a manner similar to a PvP fight. The kill count and the timer will appear on screen when the fight starts. Defeating them requires a good coordination among your party members (or good hero management) to both attacking their monks and protecting yourselves from the warriors. You win when all the Kournans are dead or if you scored better when the timer ends. If you lose, just leave the area and come back in to try again.
b55411c86407f38d0132c852209d020536dac25a.text: 之后，寻找摩根将军并与他交谈开始“战斗”。你的队伍将以类似于 PvP 战斗的方式对抗五个名称相似（但职业不同）的库南守卫。战斗开始时，击杀数和计时器将出现在屏幕上。击败他们需要你的队伍成员之间的良好协调（或良好的英雄管理），以攻击他们的僧侣并保护自己免受战士的伤害。当所有库南人都死了或者计时器结束时你得分更高时，你就赢了。如果你输了，只需离开该区域并返回再试一次。

70e0e965174acb63c44917a8ba62977c1731bdfd.source: When the timer ends, it appears that even if you draw with the Kournans, you will still be considered to have "won". As such, it is possible to complete this quest by simply not aggroing the Kournans when the timer starts, and then waiting for the timer to end.
70e0e965174acb63c44917a8ba62977c1731bdfd.text: 当计时器结束时，即使您与 Kournans 平局，您仍然会被视为“赢了”。因此，只要在计时器开始时不骚扰库南人，然后等待计时器结束，就可以完成此任务。

eea727f0edcb593b0a70cc26b06b39a308626d35.source: You do not have to meet the requirement to trigger the NPCs' spawning in the area and the dialogue starting, but if you have not met the requirements you will not be able to fight the Kournan Guards.
eea727f0edcb593b0a70cc26b06b39a308626d35.text: 你不必满足触发该区域 NPC 生成和对话开始的要求，但如果你没有满足要求，你将无法与库尔南守卫作战。

3ff0f3b04398a4fd31dd1436b76c6f454c19566e.source: Related quest Rising in the Ranks: First Spear
3ff0f3b04398a4fd31dd1436b76c6f454c19566e.text: 相关任务 排名上升：第一矛

359e1806c2f2526170dd0d02e94602663a661ed6.source: Varesh Ossa walks into The Astralarium after completing her conversation with General Morghann.
359e1806c2f2526170dd0d02e94602663a661ed6.text: 瓦雷什·奥萨 (Varesh Ossa) 与摩根将军交谈完毕后走进星宫。

3c8268148e67664497a0d2873d9228ebbdf12595.source: Speak with Meerak the Scribe in Ashford Abbey.
3c8268148e67664497a0d2873d9228ebbdf12595.text: 与阿什福德修道院的抄写员米拉克交谈。

59b95b8df82022a64a663e97f097b1eeacafd156.source: Deliver the message to Armin Saberlin. Use your map to travel to Ascalon City quickly.
59b95b8df82022a64a663e97f097b1eeacafd156.text: 将消息传递给阿明·萨柏林。使用您的地图快速前往阿斯卡隆市。

2ccac4916c691bf77ff7eaeb4642db66bbd6ec25.text: 护甲 +5（生命值高于 50% 时）

47dd50157e2348bc35dda9232a0a6f4ea94072ee.source: Head through the portal for Ashford Abbey to the northwest of Devona and speak with Meerak. He will advise you to use your map to travel to Ascalon City. Press the "M" key and a map of the area will appear. Double-click on the icon for Ascalon City on the map and you will travel directly there.
47dd50157e2348bc35dda9232a0a6f4ea94072ee.text: 穿过通往德沃纳西北部阿什福德修道院的传送门并与米拉克交谈。他会建议您使用地图前往阿斯卡隆市。按“M”键，将出现该区域的地图。双击地图上阿斯卡隆市的图标，您将直接前往那里。

723f91bb211f9a11925f797bca3c7a8bfe54aa7e.source: Despite being a primary quest, completing it is not necessary to receive A Second Profession from Armin Saberlin and continue with the story. You can obtain A Second Profession as soon as you complete your primary profession test.
723f91bb211f9a11925f797bca3c7a8bfe54aa7e.text: 尽管这是一个主要任务，但完成它并不需要从阿明·萨柏林那里获得第二职业并继续故事。一旦完成主要职业测试，您就可以获得第二职业。

6d66f27477342e6d1ad7d06eeb9eb6ddecf8a0f7.source: The Tall Shield rewarded by this quest has a unique skin when compared to the normal Tall Shield.
6d66f27477342e6d1ad7d06eeb9eb6ddecf8a0f7.text: 与普通高盾相比，此任务奖励的高盾具有独特的皮肤。

eafcc02f259aed26db2923b42b3d97cf9bfe02da.source: To take Warrior as your second profession, follow the road northwest from town, continue along the road as it turns to Green Hills County, and talk to Warmaster Grast.
eafcc02f259aed26db2923b42b3d97cf9bfe02da.text: 要将战士作为你的第二职业，请沿着城镇西北方向的道路前进，继续沿着道路转向青山县，并与战帅格拉斯特交谈。

223763284931e6fc2e4d852de9cabfc7e890aec0.source: To take Ranger as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town. Turn south at the bridge and follow the signs to Regent Valley. Talk to Master Ranger Nente.
223763284931e6fc2e4d852de9cabfc7e890aec0.text: 要将游侠作为你的第二职业，请沿着城镇西南方向的道路行驶。在桥处向南转，按照路标前往摄政谷。与游侠大师 Nente 交谈。

3049cda8e28ce7d287c9880046e6706156b5e659.source: To take Monk as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town, enter Ashford Abbey, and talk to Brother Mhenlo.
3049cda8e28ce7d287c9880046e6706156b5e659.text: 要选择僧侣作为你的第二职业，沿着城镇西南方向的道路，进入阿什福德修道院，并与门洛修士交谈。

e223b359167d6d1137d03686a71f8e8df0692baf.source: To take Elementalist as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town, continue past Ashford up into Wizard's Folly, and talk to Elementalist Aziure.
e223b359167d6d1137d03686a71f8e8df0692baf.text: 要将元素师作为你的第二职业，请沿着城镇西南方向的道路，继续经过阿什福德进入巫师愚蠢，并与元素师阿兹乌尔交谈。

6006462f73e263e85cf5cb6f51fbeea84afc6c97.source: To take Necromancer as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town, pass through Ashford Abbey into the catacombs, and talk to Mistress Munne.
6006462f73e263e85cf5cb6f51fbeea84afc6c97.text: 要将死灵法师作为你的第二职业，请沿着城镇西南方向的道路，穿过阿什福德修道院进入地下墓穴，并与穆妮女主人交谈。

763840f6c188c8f62f7b196028a5c89bb6fd9c67.source: To take Mesmer as your second profession, follow the road northwest from town to the theatre, and talk to Lady Althea.
763840f6c188c8f62f7b196028a5c89bb6fd9c67.text: 要将幻术师作为你的第二职业，请沿着城镇西北方向的道路前往剧院，并与阿尔西娅女士交谈。

a83e4795e76a65438bd05cc441f68439647a9356.source: Return to Armin Saberlin for your reward.
a83e4795e76a65438bd05cc441f68439647a9356.text: 返回阿明·萨柏林那里领取奖励。

e81d5655639617bb2f486bd08ed0ccd06e15dcc6.source: Head northwest along the path from Ascalon City, past the theatre and the gate, to Green Hills County. Here, talk to Warmaster Grast and complete Grawl Invasion to be able to become a secondary Warrior.
e81d5655639617bb2f486bd08ed0ccd06e15dcc6.text: 从阿斯卡隆市沿着小路向西北行驶，经过剧院和大门，到达格林希尔斯县。在这里，与战帅格拉斯特交谈并完成格罗尔入侵即可成为二级战士。

6604b46caac3023f44049a2ab9fb8c1813fcc492.text: 游骑兵第二职业——游骑兵

732d2df905b8095a9cea58b2cedb592c440c10ae.source: From Ashford Abbey, head southeast over a bridge, and into Regent Valley. Follow the path southeast past the devourers until you encounter Master Ranger Nente. Complete The Ranger's Companion to be able to become a secondary Ranger.
732d2df905b8095a9cea58b2cedb592c440c10ae.text: 从阿什福德修道院出发，向东南方向行驶，过一座桥，进入摄政谷。沿着东南方向经过吞噬者，直到遇到游侠大师南特。完成游侠的同伴即可成为二级游侠。

508e24747f6459fcf21880826647ced05ca66364.source: In Ashford Abbey, talk to Brother Mhenlo. Complete A Monk's Mission to be able to become a secondary Monk.
508e24747f6459fcf21880826647ced05ca66364.text: 在阿什福德修道院，与曼洛修士交谈。完成僧侣任务即可成为二级僧侣。

4b6b1a60f07d6cf256f3d601d248bad6e08c080e.text: 没有第二职业——死灵法师

d5a781241fd7daae05af0acb73874cdbf15346ac.source: From Ashford Abbey, leave through the west exit to enter the catacombs. Head north and talk to Necromancer Munne. Complete The Necromancer's Novice to be able to be come a secondary Necromancer.
d5a781241fd7daae05af0acb73874cdbf15346ac.text: 从阿什福德修道院出发，通过西出口进入地下墓穴。向北走，与死灵法师穆尼交谈。完成死灵法师的新手即可成为二级死灵法师。

82ed9ba0f45fbfe4ee586cb29c7fd8263083d175.text: 催眠师第二职业——催眠师

73290c5dfa2e154260a51e073f897d9a8aa6006d.source: Head northwest along the path from Ascalon City to the theatre. Talk to Lady Althea and complete A Mesmer's Burden to be able to become a secondary Mesmer.
73290c5dfa2e154260a51e073f897d9a8aa6006d.text: 沿着阿斯卡隆城的小路向西北前往剧院。与艾尔西娅女士交谈并完成催眠师的负担即可成为二级催眠师。

7a2a26d75b4ca951d31528f3540bf04bc1eb2880.text: 元素师第二职业——元素师

18255cff59d5040460aa73b60ee278b0786ac1dc.source: From Ashford Abbey, take the east exit then head southwest to Wizard's Folly. Follow the path through the mountains until you find Elementalist Aziure. Complete The Elementalist Experiment to be able to become a secondary Elementalist.
18255cff59d5040460aa73b60ee278b0786ac1dc.text: 从阿什福德修道院 (Ashford Abbey) 出发，从东出口出发，然后向西南方向前往 Wizard's Folly。沿着小路穿过山脉，直到找到元素师阿兹乌尔。完成元素师实验即可成为二级元素师。

502490f3ae732a0ddf4830ca83b7b4f7669dec46.source: This quest becomes available as soon as you complete your primary profession test. Completing Further Adventures or Unsettling Rumors is not required.
502490f3ae732a0ddf4830ca83b7b4f7669dec46.text: 一旦你完成初级职业测试，这个任务就变得可用。不需要完成进一步的冒险或令人不安的谣言。

0414bad45e2538c10571de5eac490e9274d92398.source: You cannot progress past pre-Searing without taking on a second profession. However, you do not need to accept A Second Profession to obtain one; simply completing the respective trainer's quest will allow you to do this.
0414bad45e2538c10571de5eac490e9274d92398.text: 如果不从事第二职业，你就无法通过预灼烧。但是，您无需接受第二职业即可获得第二职业；只需完成相应训练师的任务即可让您做到这一点。

e1fe50f5a2f92657d22a7ed558560e26437a0c66.source: Caution: Your choice of secondary profession cannot be changed until much later in the game. Explore the different possibilities and choose wisely.
e1fe50f5a2f92657d22a7ed558560e26437a0c66.text: 注意：你对次要职业的选择要到游戏后期才能改变。探索不同的可能性并做出明智的选择。

0b50dd947be9f2807d8edcfb960a455c308d4d0c.source: All party members must have received the reward for Search for the Ebon Vanguard.
0b50dd947be9f2807d8edcfb960a455c308d4d0c.text: 所有小队成员必须已获得寻找黑锋先锋的奖励。

f1fd6263692c98fad1a2297c388a45b40f6e2b37.source: Search the Charr camp to the east for signs of the Vanguard captives.
f1fd6263692c98fad1a2297c388a45b40f6e2b37.text: 搜索东部的查尔营地，寻找先锋队俘虏的踪迹。

d434571afde0e5404be9af880716e3274e15b248.source: *OPTIONAL* Find ways to weaken the Charr garrison.
d434571afde0e5404be9af880716e3274e15b248.text: *可选*寻找削弱夏尔驻军的方法。

4db478227f6b9caed16aa41fff706f8d5f14bd34.source: *OPTIONAL* Intercept the Charr supply caravan. Use Charr Explosive charges to disable it.
4db478227f6b9caed16aa41fff706f8d5f14bd34.text: *可选*拦截夏尔补给车队。使用夏尔爆炸装药将其禁用。

05a69af964263e681e2b3ab8a06ee6061d71c829.source: *OPTIONAL* Destroy the watchtowers with explosive charges. [0...2] of 2 destroyed.
05a69af964263e681e2b3ab8a06ee6061d71c829.text: *可选*用炸药摧毁了望塔。 [0...2] 2 个被摧毁。

dd5d99fa3484cc886adcd5b3bba1e01ea73697f6.source: *OPTIONAL* Employ the siege devourers to fire explosive charges at the garrison. [0...2] of 2 fired.
dd5d99fa3484cc886adcd5b3bba1e01ea73697f6.text: *可选*使用攻城吞噬者向要塞发射炸药。已发射 [0...2] 2 个。

2375a1f3bd8aaa046cb53e96e25ed6e81c148b77.source: Start the quest by interacting with the Vanguard Helmet. Shortly after the cinematic, your party will be attacked by a small group of Charr. Dispatch them, then move on. Your party has the choice of assaulting the Charr garrison, or participating in optional objectives to weaken the garrison. The optional objectives are not difficult as long as you don't get overwhelmed by the roaming patrols, otherwise, the quest is truly easy, fast and simple. Interrupting Firereigners should be a priority.
2375a1f3bd8aaa046cb53e96e25ed6e81c148b77.text: 通过与先锋头盔互动来开始任务。电影结束后不久，你的队伍将受到一小群夏尔的攻击。派遣他们，然后继续前进。你的队伍可以选择攻击查尔驻军，或者参与可选目标来削弱驻军。可选目标并不困难，只要你不被漫游巡逻队压垮，否则，任务真的很容易、快速和简单。打断Firereigners应该是首要任务。

1ed2ed47e19ba73291363548f919fe02ad64177c.source: Charr Firereigners drop explosive charges after they are defeated. These charges are used to destroy the supply caravan (optional objective 1), destroy the watchtowers (optional objective 2), and launched by the siege devourers at the garrison (optional objective 3). Either have a spellcaster in your party carry the charges, or wait until you are ready to use them. Once the charge is placed on the ground, it detonates.
1ed2ed47e19ba73291363548f919fe02ad64177c.text: 查尔火王被击败后会掉落炸药。这些炸药用于摧毁补给商队（可选目标 1）、摧毁瞭望塔（可选目标 2）以及由攻城吞噬者在要塞发射（可选目标 3）。要么让你队伍中的施法者携带这些费用，要么等到你准备好使用它们。一旦电荷被放置在地面上，它就会爆炸。

875cc6d5b2507b59e6b69a222aaf90cd70e4c7c0.source: The supply caravan is guarded by a few groups of Charr. Dispatch them, and then use an explosive charge to destroy the caravan. The siege devourers are guarded by one or two groups of Charr. Dispatch them, then feed an explosive charge to the devourer. Shortly after the devourer launches a charge, he will be bombarded and killed. The watchtowers are guarded by one or two groups of Charr. Again, dispatch them and destroy the tower.
875cc6d5b2507b59e6b69a222aaf90cd70e4c7c0.text: 补给车队由几组夏尔看守。消灭他们，然后使用炸药摧毁商队。攻城吞噬者由一到两群夏尔守卫。消灭他们，然后向吞噬者投掷炸药。吞噬者发起冲锋后不久，他就会被轰击而死。瞭望塔由一到两群夏尔守卫。再次派遣他们并摧毁塔楼。

459499170a031194be07238bbf7c6cf26ee42bf3.source: The garrison consists of several groups of Charr in a small area. Use normal pulling strategies to separate the groups and dispatch them accordingly. Then, move in and destroy Harvest Soulreign. This will lead to a cinematic and begin The Dawn of Rebellion.
459499170a031194be07238bbf7c6cf26ee42bf3.text: 驻军由小片区域内的几组夏尔组成。使用正常的拉动策略来分开组并相应地调度它们。然后，进入并摧毁收割灵魂统治。这将导致电影的出现并开始叛乱的黎明。

9f16d19254fca3309692af5c9fd0ac86ae604381.source: Having completed the quest once, you may want to rush through the mission when repeating it for your Hero's Handbook. If so, run to the Vanguard Helmet in Grothmar Wardowns to get the mission and:
9f16d19254fca3309692af5c9fd0ac86ae604381.text: 完成一次任务后，您可能想在为英雄手册重复该任务时快速完成任务。如果是这样，请跑到 Grothmar Wardowns 中的先锋头盔处获取任务并：

277b50de1c5d20c114c22298ff7bce597fbe7e97.source: As soon as the mission starts, set off to the southeast - the group approaching from the northeast will not follow you.
277b50de1c5d20c114c22298ff7bce597fbe7e97.text: 任务一开始，就向东南方向出发——从东北方向过来的队伍不会跟着你。

a73fbb9a0cd459ebea670c8c7ff40ec1bd693151.source: Cross the bridge, waiting for the two groups of Charr to separate before attacking them.
a73fbb9a0cd459ebea670c8c7ff40ec1bd693151.text: 过桥，等夏尔两队分开再攻击他们。

dbc14398c94693410723632dd5ef2bd023ec5873.source: Head east along the bottom of the area, avoiding the few groups of Charr nearby. When you reach a cliff, you will need to kill two more groups on the road.
dbc14398c94693410723632dd5ef2bd023ec5873.text: 沿着该地区的底部向东前进，避开附近的几群夏尔。当你到达悬崖时，你需要在路上再杀死两个群体。

2b770a676cbfe3d3ff57ddec2b0d4393b0957c3b.source: Head straight to the stronghold. If you wait just south of the mission objective star, a devourer catapult will come towards you separately from its group, making it easier to kill.
2b770a676cbfe3d3ff57ddec2b0d4393b0957c3b.text: 直奔要塞。如果你在任务目标星的南边等待，吞噬者弹射器将与它的群体分开向你飞来，使其更容易被杀死。

39e5eb411e837ef7353e7057523042044e3dd8e9.source: Kill the Charr in the fort. Be careful, as there will be more enemies than you might have previously encountered here (this is because you have not completed the optional objectives).
39e5eb411e837ef7353e7057523042044e3dd8e9.text: 杀死要塞里的夏尔。请小心，因为这里的敌人会比您之前遇到的还要多（这是因为您尚未完成可选目标）。

0dc3ddd1984d20394ee4553a9d078116a8192be8.source: If you follow the repeat map, from the moment you exit Longeye's Ledge until you finish the quest, it shouldn't take you more than 15 minutes.
0dc3ddd1984d20394ee4553a9d078116a8192be8.text: 如果你按照重复地图走，从你离开长眼壁架的那一刻起直到你完成任务，花费的时间不会超过 15 分钟。

e9de0d65783c213c6a5d7c4e3744d2aaab5142a0.source: Take a running build yourself. Build the rest of the party to be able to take out the two end bosses.
e9de0d65783c213c6a5d7c4e3744d2aaab5142a0.text: 自己进行运行构建。组建队伍的其余成员，以消灭两个末端首领。

d845f9de21093e52d55c79d79c105fc8f52c318d.source: Run to, and activate, the helmet. After the cinematic, flag your heroes and henchmen back up the hill you ran down towards the helmet (about half-way up), then run yourself in the opposite direction just to the edge of the burnt area. Your team will probably get hit a little by the incoming Charr, but they will survive. Once the Charr have gathered at the helmet, flag your party (using the Mission Map) across the bridge and along the road a bit.
d845f9de21093e52d55c79d79c105fc8f52c318d.text: 跑向并激活头盔。电影结束后，标记你的英雄和追随者回到你跑向头盔的山上（大约一半的高度），然后你自己朝相反的方向跑到烧毁区域的边缘。你的队伍可能会受到即将到来的夏尔的一点打击，但他们会生存下来。一旦夏尔聚集在头盔处，就标记你的队伍（使用任务地图）过桥并沿着路走一段路。

77b266191b6e0b33235f25f7b8dabbd93342d4a9.source: Keep flagging them a bit further along the road (at about 10 second intervals) till they get to the northern tower (at which stage you will get some dialogue). Continue to flag them south past the second tower, and then east into the Charr camp and onto the green star. A second dialogue will appear about now. Finally flag them into the mouth of the area with the two bosses.
77b266191b6e0b33235f25f7b8dabbd93342d4a9.text: 沿着路继续标记他们（大约每隔 10 秒），直到他们到达北塔（在这个阶段你会听到一些对话）。继续向南标记他们经过第二座塔，然后向东进入夏尔营地并到达绿色星星。现在将出现第二个对话。最后用两个boss标记他们进入该区域的入口。

8e03f7298a582c9be1d9017bee1de701826cc30c.source: If you don't mind dying, you can get yourself killed by the Charr at the start, which makes it easier to flag. But with practice it isn't necessary.
8e03f7298a582c9be1d9017bee1de701826cc30c.text: 如果你不介意死亡，你可以在一开始就被夏尔杀死，这样更容易被标记。但通过练习就没有必要了。

142effdcf632f9aa1ed3ef47988106ed44def218.source: During this mission Charr Firereigners drop Charr Explosives when killed.
142effdcf632f9aa1ed3ef47988106ed44def218.text: 在此任务中，夏尔火王被杀死时会掉落夏尔炸药。

04ff279cac2b426dd4f70b510424f2ad6d6a612a.source: It is difficult to capture skills from Harvest Soulreign, since the end cinematic triggers immediately after his death.
04ff279cac2b426dd4f70b510424f2ad6d6a612a.text: 捕捉收割灵魂统治的技能很困难，因为结束动画会在他死后立即触发。

19c37261dc20dc966d2a1216486bc42301b6a169.source: Completing this quest triggers The Charr Prisoner cinematic and returns players to Grothmar Wardowns.
19c37261dc20dc966d2a1216486bc42301b6a169.text: 完成此任务会触发《查尔囚徒》过场动画，并使玩家返回格罗斯玛战事。

ae90ed3ea69b64e614ef75e67709cd46a82b7e02.source: If Plan A quest is active, players will appear in the middle of the Charr camp, surrounded by about 8 groups of Charr.
ae90ed3ea69b64e614ef75e67709cd46a82b7e02.text: 如果A计划任务激活，玩家将出现在夏尔营地的中间，周围有大约8组夏尔。

5cea63ca4d007023c88f65f2fbf15cf337a01392.source: However if Failure to Communicate quest is active, the Charr camp will be devoid except for a single group. Which makes it easier to complete this quest.
5cea63ca4d007023c88f65f2fbf15cf337a01392.text: 然而，如果“沟通失败”任务处于活动状态，那么夏尔营地将除了一个小组之外空无一人。这使得完成这个任务变得更容易。

3366f74369e2e998463e17ba1a17bf70563e2081.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 in the Hero's Handbook storybook.
3366f74369e2e998463e17ba1a17bf70563e2081.text: 完成此任务将填写英雄手册故事书的第 3 页。

e825f26ed671681c3c5ef3b7b531504ce6d55cb0.source: Unlike previous campaigns where missions are contained in outposts with visually distinct map icons and started from an NPC with a rotating green icon, the way in which this quest can be started is by going to Longeye's Ledge, forming a party, exiting the outpost and navigating towards the Vanguard Helmet which is marked in game with a green, rotating, shield-like icon, akin to the one of Mission NPCs.
e825f26ed671681c3c5ef3b7b531504ce6d55cb0.text: 与以前的战役不同，任务包含在具有视觉上不同的地图图标的前哨站中，并从带有旋转绿色图标的 NPC 开始，该任务的启动方式是前往长眼壁架，组建队伍，退出前哨站并导航至先锋头盔，该头盔在游戏中标有绿色、旋转、盾牌状的图标，类似于任务 NPC 之一。

d45b685fff7d04d3a9d2e88b1d71578002e01ebe.source: If you enter this mission while riding a Siege Devourer you will not earn credit for completing it. If a certain quest (or quests) are active, Pyre Fierceshot will appear outside Longeye's Ledge before you have started this quest, and will help your party attack the roving bands of Charr, despite that a goal/part of this quest is freeing him.
d45b685fff7d04d3a9d2e88b1d71578002e01ebe.text: 如果您在骑乘攻城吞噬者时进入此任务，您将不会获得完成任务的积分。如果某个任务（或多个任务）处于活动状态，在您开始此任务之前，火葬场猛烈射击将出现在长眼的壁架外，并将帮助您的队伍攻击夏尔的流浪乐队，尽管此任务的目标/部分是释放他。

4ab74ca7767e5dc30098828b65420760e7078fa8.text:
* Elonian（夜幕降临）角色
* 所需英雄：科斯

493c62c86cb22ab73b13616b766f1bd95ef7f965.source: Koss must be present to continue.
493c62c86cb22ab73b13616b766f1bd95ef7f965.text: 科斯必须在场才能继续。

36056d0e8520e3a727b87741faaeb3f0bed05abb.source: Take Koss and meet Emissary Dajmir in Zehlon Reach.
36056d0e8520e3a727b87741faaeb3f0bed05abb.text: 带着科斯去泽隆河段与达吉米尔使者会面。

e4d13c921a78a5a57cf7058d2dd099d406d2c8f7.text: 找到 Melonni 并与其交谈。

5b699c4e453676d5bd1eff88faf850e58d4ca76b.source: Travel with Melonni to meet Kormir.
5b699c4e453676d5bd1eff88faf850e58d4ca76b.text: 和 Melonni 一起去见 Kormir。

e7dc0d417d89837d2a56d765ec7d543e29cf133c.source: Head out from The Astralarium into Zehlon Reach with at least Koss in your party. Get the nearby insect hunt bounty and head west and south a bit until you reach Melonni. A cutscene occurs when you talk to her, followed by another walk to just outside Jokanur Diggings and another cutscene.
e7dc0d417d89837d2a56d765ec7d543e29cf133c.text: 从星辰馆前往泽隆河段，至少科斯在你的队伍中。获得附近的昆虫狩猎赏金，然后向西和向南行驶一点，直到到达梅洛尼。当你和她说话时会出现一个过场动画，然后又走到乔卡努尔挖掘场外面，然后出现另一个过场动画。

f4129f84f3f657508df36fac789ffa6d2a71e25f.source: If you map travel at any point during this quest, you will have to start it from the beginning when you leave that outpost.
f4129f84f3f657508df36fac789ffa6d2a71e25f.text: 如果您在此任务期间的任何时刻绘制旅行地图，则必须在离开该前哨站时从头开始。

17a7882c99f92c2834a967619256e2f136ce6866.source: This quests removes the spawn of a Sunspear Scout at the resurrection shrine near where you first meet Melonni.
17a7882c99f92c2834a967619256e2f136ce6866.text: 该任务会移除你第一次见到 Melonni 附近的复活神殿中的阳矛斥候的生成。

004c8687319ffce6936f1246c9bc8ef47ae6067e.source: Search for Zho in Kinya Province.

73b25606727779b83a8300ca4cfc6d21d452f257.source: Travel northwest from Sujun through the mountains until you reach Kinya Province. Once there, go a short distance northwest and you will find Zho
73b25606727779b83a8300ca4cfc6d21d452f257.text: 从苏军向西北行进，翻山越岭，到达金亚省。到达那里后，向西北方向走一小段距离，你会发现Zho

66420d34eb083e25d245d55ed831529b702da43f.source: All Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Signs and Portents.
66420d34eb083e25d245d55ed831529b702da43f.text: 所有黄昏角色都必须接受征兆与预兆的奖励。

07629b7d41cd75de5f60154ac5ececaabc9e4020.source: Melonni must be present in the party.

72c2a1c70ef91716b22881a752a82d7dcd6e7dd5.source: Travel to the ancient Istani ruins.
72c2a1c70ef91716b22881a752a82d7dcd6e7dd5.text: 前往古老的伊斯坦尼遗址。

f9ba78cce367fa9a900e23970ccb34077ce06cdc.source: Obtain the tablet from Darehk and place it on the stone pedestal.
f9ba78cce367fa9a900e23970ccb34077ce06cdc.text: 从达雷克处获得石碑并将其放在石座上。

67641f5e81c3ae2c4927cc0afb9d4a00f751d528.source: Place the two tablets on the pedestals.
67641f5e81c3ae2c4927cc0afb9d4a00f751d528.text: 将两块平板电脑放在基座上。

166c61cc923123a3b96ef1a84727bd4f6d4479e1.source: Guard Kahdash while he places the tablet on the pedestal.
166c61cc923123a3b96ef1a84727bd4f6d4479e1.text: 当卡达什将平板电脑放在基座上时，看守他。

027c4fd0ab0d63dd1af0999d13ed08b0819c6d5a.source: *BONUS* Do not harm any Sunspear Ghosts.
027c4fd0ab0d63dd1af0999d13ed08b0819c6d5a.text: *奖励* 不要伤害任何阳矛幽灵。

247de32a40fe940438a2686d7b5aa77b52519e70.source:

54fce6045adaee0072dfe5401c66121f9eeaeab9.source: Make your way west to the ruins of Fahranur, The First City. The building has two crushing devices which can be detected by the noises and marks on the ground. Avoid death by walking under them when the weight is lifting - you have 13 seconds to do so. There are also traps that fire Madness Darts (first section) and Burning (second section) at the party.
54fce6045adaee0072dfe5401c66121f9eeaeab9.text: 向西前往第一城法赫拉努尔遗址。该建筑物有两个破碎装置，可以通过地面上的噪音和痕迹来检测。当重物举起时，在它们下面行走可以避免死亡 - 您有 13 秒的时间这样做。派对上还有发射疯狂飞镖（第一部分）和燃烧（第二部分）的陷阱。

62737313e9b17ae3544771baa984f8088368a255.source: Beyond the first crusher awaits Darehk the Quick, who is carrying a tablet. Kill him, retrieve the tablet and place it on the stone pedestal to enter the next area. Your party gains a morale boost each time a gate is opened. The undead will resurrect after a while, so do not stay in any one area too long.
62737313e9b17ae3544771baa984f8088368a255.text: 第一个破碎机后面等待着携带平板电脑的“敏捷者”达雷克。杀死他，取回牌匾并将其放在石座上，进入下一个区域。每次打开大门时，你的队伍就会士气提升。不死族过一段时间就会复活，所以不要在任何一个区域停留太久。

2f85c3e2c8e627187734e828212e0aa89c4464c4.source: The second area has two tablets which have to be placed on the pedestals together, as the Sunspear Ghosts will attempt to take them back.
2f85c3e2c8e627187734e828212e0aa89c4464c4.text: 第二个区域有两块石板，必须将它们一起放置在基座上，因为阳矛幽灵会试图将它们夺回。

9e764196640e03e8916cb0954e9a5e4a8270ceb9.source: Single players have to leave the first tablet on the ground (drop it near, but not on the pedestal) somewhere near the third gate and head east to pick up the second tablet, place it, and then re-take the one that was left on the floor on the second pedastal.
9e764196640e03e8916cb0954e9a5e4a8270ceb9.text: 单人玩家必须将第一块石碑留在第三个门附近的地面上（将其放在附近，但不要放在基座上），然后向东拾取第二块石碑，放置它，然后重新拿起留在第二个基座地板上的石碑。

e83fcee4d1841956e58a27962625bc5478513fa6.source: Groups with more than one player can assign two out of the three to carry the tablets, preferably caster professions.
e83fcee4d1841956e58a27962625bc5478513fa6.text: 超过一名玩家的团体可以指派三人中的两人携带平板电脑，最好是施法者职业。

657331c356e3f9a17375c451fe21db3b1b733358.source: Be careful of the fire and cripple causing flame jets, especially with Kormir as she can die if standing next to one, failing the mission.
657331c356e3f9a17375c451fe21db3b1b733358.text: 小心火焰喷射器引起的火灾和致残，尤其是科米尔，因为如果站在火焰喷射器旁边，她可能会死亡，从而导致任务失败。

caf84039d0b6a8a24b9e2dcb15989caf10a66433.source: In the third area, another ghost named Kahdash will be holding a tablet. But this time he will carry it to the pedestal for you, asking for protection from the undead. If Kahdash dies, he will respawn at his original location and begin again.
caf84039d0b6a8a24b9e2dcb15989caf10a66433.text: 在第三个区域，另一个名叫卡达什的鬼魂将拿着一块平板电脑。但这次他会为你把它带到基座上，请求保护你免受不死族的侵害。如果卡达什死亡，他会在原来的位置重生并重新开始。

9e597a64126c365170327287ab50498014f62d74.source: Finally at the sealed chamber, kill the Skeletons as you head down towards the Apocrypha, the final boss. The Apocrypha changes professions periodically between Mesmer, Dervish and Paragon by activating Reform Carvings.
9e597a64126c365170327287ab50498014f62d74.text: 最后，在密封室中，杀死骷髅，然后前往最终的 Boss Apocrypha。通过激活改革雕刻，伪经会定期在催眠师、苦行僧和典范之间更换职业。

0d0aeb08f9a345ed53fa806c52c691924a90db05.source: To gain the bonus, players have to complete the sequence in section two without harming the Sunspear Ghosts. By "not harming", the game means not killing them. (These NPCs can still sustain small amounts of damage, e.g. from Kormir's spear attacks.) Since Kormir will follow your party leader, pulling her away prevents her killing the ghosts. Abstain from summoning mindless allies (e.g. minions, spirits, NPCs from summoning stones, etc.) when nearby the Sunspear Ghosts. Also be careful when target calling, since henchmen and heroes can easily spike the ghosts - set heroes to Avoid Combat mode and disable aggressive skills when in the second room. Whilst the fire jets can harm other enemies, the ghosts are invulnerable to them. To get the Master's Reward, you must also prevent Kahdash from being killed.
0d0aeb08f9a345ed53fa806c52c691924a90db05.text: 为了获得奖励，玩家必须在不伤害阳矛幽灵的情况下完成第二部分中的序列。游戏中的“不伤害”意味着不杀死他们。 （这些 NPC 仍然可以承受少量伤害，例如科米尔的长矛攻击。）由于科米尔会跟随你的队伍领袖，将她拉开可以防止她杀死鬼魂。在阳矛幽灵附近时，避免召唤无意识的盟友（例如爪牙、精魂、召唤石的 NPC 等）。呼叫目标时也要小心，因为追随者和英雄可以轻松地秒杀幽灵 - 将英雄设置为避免战斗模式并在第二个房间时禁用攻击性技能。虽然火焰喷射器可以伤害其他敌人，但幽灵却对它们无懈可击。为了获得大师的奖励，你还必须防止卡达什被杀死。

5520e6097ed4492ff4fb411e694690b228f36346.source: The hazards in this mission will pressure the party healer. Luckily the required hero is Melonni and dervishes can perform roles other than just damage. (There is nothing to stop you from bringing more than one healer.)
5520e6097ed4492ff4fb411e694690b228f36346.text: 此任务中的危险会给队伍治疗师带来压力。幸运的是，所需的英雄是 Melonni，苦行僧还可以扮演除伤害以外的角色。 （没有什么可以阻止你带上不止一名治疗师。）

a6acb57e7cee99d858980091d5cf71949d0b1b15.source: It is unlikely that the players running tablets will be able to evade the undead without support due to tougher and more dogged opponents.
a6acb57e7cee99d858980091d5cf71949d0b1b15.text: 由于对手更强硬、更顽强，运行平板电脑的玩家不太可能在没有支持的情况下躲避亡灵。

58e0fd8e568c0986fe6f1ba68dbffcdebd771835.source: The undead's corpses do not disappear, and they resurrect after 2 and a half minutes. If more time is needed in an area with undead, consider killing them in a remote location so that when they resurrect you will be out of aggro.
58e0fd8e568c0986fe6f1ba68dbffcdebd771835.text: 亡灵的尸体不会消失，2分半钟后会复活。如果在有不死生物的区域需要更多时间，请考虑在远程位置杀死他们，这样当他们复活时你就会摆脱仇恨。

62b43b19915b5a922ffbff823ffcc7ef036a4aee.source: Holy damage skills to easily fight the undead.
62b43b19915b5a922ffbff823ffcc7ef036a4aee.text: 神圣伤害技能轻松对抗不死族。

5cb4d554a2deef92a3a1f204a46e358ba7707094.source: In Hard mode, the undead use Tainted Flesh, bring appropriate counters.
5cb4d554a2deef92a3a1f204a46e358ba7707094.text: 在困难模式下，不死族会使用腐肉，并携带适当的指示物。

3f8db91e95401dde3a88df0466090030b81eb174.source: Dying from being crushed by the falling crushers does not cause Death Penalty or count as a death against the Survivor title track.
