7ea67dd3966be0901b03d7fd05723bc230b35ad4.text: 在这个迷你任务中，有五种精英技能可供捕获。由于这些技能通常只能在游戏后期才能使用，因此新创建的本土出生的埃隆尼亚角色可能会发现加入旨在完成此任务的外国出生的队伍是有利的。

fce1f866854e4cc8cb9bd14b2234bbdc7de58c75.source: If your foreign-born character has fewer than 1,000 Sunspear rank points when entering the mini-mission, they will automatically receive bounties of double XP and 4 Sunspear points for each Corsair and Kournan killed.
fce1f866854e4cc8cb9bd14b2234bbdc7de58c75.text: 如果您的外国出生角色在进入迷你任务时的阳矛等级点少于 1,000 点，那么每击杀一个海盗船和库南，他们将自动获得双倍 XP 和 4 点阳矛点的赏金。

5b8cebf6a1a8eb71cd7fbe4b4ca4f93bc3e15a47.source: You also receive 20 points for each boss killed and 50 points for each of the three main objectives (holding off the initial assault, seizing all the landing points, and capturing the war camps). (These bonuses are not documented in the objectives.)
5b8cebf6a1a8eb71cd7fbe4b4ca4f93bc3e15a47.text: 每杀死一个 Boss，你还会获得 20 分，三个主要目标（阻止最初的攻击、夺取所有登陆点和占领战争营地）各获得 50 分。 （这些奖金没有记录在目标中。）

9062a493deb500502e94a7491c81f8af45515499.source: You can receive a maximum of 566 points by killing all available Corsairs and Kournans. (To maximize your Sunspear rank points, abandon and retake it when you are about to go above the 1,000 point threshold.)
9062a493deb500502e94a7491c81f8af45515499.text: 通过杀死所有可用的海盗船和库南船，您最多可以获得 566 点。 （为了最大化您的阳矛等级积分，请在您即将超过 1,000 点阈值时放弃并重新获得它。）

fcb8571039331acdde1b76834d8ff0e7b65ae0da.source: Gates of Kryta mission not complete
fcb8571039331acdde1b76834d8ff0e7b65ae0da.text: 科瑞塔之门任务未完成

4dae799088bdce330cce7c89cd6f332e49985eb5.source: Note: This quest is available to all nationalities, not just Tyria Tyrian (Prophecies) characters
4dae799088bdce330cce7c89cd6f332e49985eb5.text: 注意：此任务适用于所有国籍，而不仅仅是泰瑞亚泰瑞安（预言）角色

07c10bb589fa4fb791aea52675b85ef0f6c69db4.source: Deliver the letter to Ambassador Braun.

8eca0e91ae99bcb13b8745c988f2fd8c2e14a6af.source: See Witness Casori for your reward.
8eca0e91ae99bcb13b8745c988f2fd8c2e14a6af.text: 见证人卡索里以获得奖励。

ab2a6fb0f4d8eeeac1e46c16963fa1d740ca2dc8.source: After accepting the quest from Aidan, proceed through the portal to Scoundrel's Rise. Deliver Aidan's letter to Ambassador Braun, who will be waiting for you right outside, and he will direct you to the Gates of Kryta.
ab2a6fb0f4d8eeeac1e46c16963fa1d740ca2dc8.text: 接受艾丹的任务后，通过传送门前往流氓高地。将艾丹的信交给布劳恩大使，他将在外面等你，他将带你前往科瑞塔之门。

ce25b5b4e41851277e68cdcf9360254ce243b462.source: Several undead creatures will be scattered throughout Scoundrel's Rise, replacing many of its usual Mergoyle and Skale spawns. Stick to the southeastern side of the map as you head for the Gates of Kryta outpost, and you will only have to deal with single Zombie Warlocks and hidden groups of Grasping Ghouls, which should pose little threat to a party capable of fighting through Griffon's Mouth. Advance cautiously, since the ghouls often try to surprise you while you are engaging a different foe, and their Crippling Attack makes it difficult to retreat. Prioritize killing the Warlocks to prevent them from casting Death Nova and to avoid providing them with ghoul corpses to raise as minions. Illusion of Haste is a useful skill for mesmers trying to disengage from the ghouls, and other forms of condition removal are worth bringing.
ce25b5b4e41851277e68cdcf9360254ce243b462.text: 一些不死生物将散布在恶棍高地各处，取代了许多常见的墨高尔和斯凯尔生成点。当你前往科瑞塔之门前哨站时，坚持走在地图的东南侧，你只需要对付单个僵尸术士和隐藏的成群的抓握食尸鬼，这对能够通过狮鹫之口战斗的队伍几乎不构成威胁。小心前进，因为当你与不同的敌人交战时，食尸鬼经常试图给你一个惊喜，而他们的致残攻击会让你很难撤退。优先杀死术士，以防止他们施放死亡新星，并避免为他们提供食尸鬼尸体来培养小兵。急速幻象对于试图摆脱食尸鬼的催眠师来说是一项有用的技能，其他形式的状态消除也值得携带。

e4b99d6e8c1996f6d3cb9339515f42d12468a482.source: Alternatively, you can enter Scoundrel's Rise, deliver the letter to Ambassador Braun, and immediately use the Griffon's Mouth portal to re-zone, eliminating the quest spawns from Scoundrel's Rise. This will mean that most of the enemies between you and the Gates of Kryta outpost will be groups of Mergoyle Wavebreakers, so be prepared to deal with Deep Freeze. This version of Scoundrel's Rise has no hidden foes.
e4b99d6e8c1996f6d3cb9339515f42d12468a482.text: 或者，您可以进入恶棍高地，将信交给布劳恩大使，然后立即使用狮鹫之口传送门重新分区，消除恶棍高地的任务生成。这意味着你和科瑞塔之门前哨站之间的大多数敌人将是一群麦高伊破波者，所以要做好应对深寒的准备。此版本的 Scoundrel's Rise 没有隐藏的敌人。

d4c3e302f9a2a9c02ccae977d805dfc9354f179c.source: When you reach the Gates of Kryta, talk to Witness Casori to claim the reward.
d4c3e302f9a2a9c02ccae977d805dfc9354f179c.text: 当你到达科瑞塔之门时，与见证人卡索里交谈以领取奖励。

9c2866ce718d9699641458a8b17ead0313413837.source: Even though Ambassador Braun's dialogue suggests that he takes the letter and hands it back again, the item is not returned to your inventory. Simply talk to Witness Casori to complete the quest.
9c2866ce718d9699641458a8b17ead0313413837.text: 尽管布劳恩大使的对话表明他拿走了这封信并再次将其交还，但该物品不会返回到您的库存中。只需与证人卡索里交谈即可完成任务。

12f965134d70f3c416b408bae51429ecf2caa7dc.source: Completing the preceding quest, To Kryta: The Ice Cave, is not required to take this quest, even for native characters. Unlike other Northern Shiverpeaks quests, this quest is available to characters from other campaigns, despite chronologically coming before the Ascalonians' arrival in Lion's Arch. Despite Braun's claims to hate the undead, he will heal any injured undead that come near him.
12f965134d70f3c416b408bae51429ecf2caa7dc.text: 即使对于本地角色来说，完成前面的任务“前往科瑞塔：冰洞”也不需要完成此任务。与其他北席瓦山脉任务不同，此任务可供其他战役中的角色使用，尽管按时间顺序是在阿斯卡隆人抵达狮子拱门之前进行的。尽管布劳恩声称憎恨不死生物，但他会治愈任何靠近他的受伤不死生物。

b550868cdfb9c027da4b66877ce0fa2577ad4fc0.source: Look for Lo Sha in Kinya Province.
b550868cdfb9c027da4b66877ce0fa2577ad4fc0.text: 在基尼亚省寻找 Lo Sha。

42083a9fc47c3db98018aa24a1a9b3c49efb7b59.source: Travel northwest from Sujun through the mountains until you reach Kinya Province. Once there, go a short distance southwest and you will find Lo Sha.
42083a9fc47c3db98018aa24a1a9b3c49efb7b59.text: 从苏军向西北行进，翻山越岭，到达金亚省。到达那里后，向西南方向走一小段距离，就可以看到螺沙。

539d49360f03c64b9f3059dd6d9b14200e4d5d95.source: See Lo Sha for your reward.

d21618868359087692a546701dd60990aa642469.source: Follow the marker to the camp, it's just south of the exit to Sunqua Vale. Kill all Crimson Skull, make sure to bring a full party for this purpose, henchmen will do. Open the chest. No key required. Then just bring back the box.
d21618868359087692a546701dd60990aa642469.text: 沿着标记前往营地，它位于 Sunqua Vale 出口的南面。杀死所有猩红骷髅，确保为此目的带上完整的队伍，追随者就可以了。打开胸部。无需钥匙。然后把盒子带回来就可以了。

f0b46b063b98d0f3dd97c7c28d0fd4234b3372af.source: Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with the completion of this quest.
f0b46b063b98d0f3dd97c7c28d0fd4234b3372af.text: 已知端午节任务会干扰该任务的完成。

3d5394d084ab0995e6326856a5457cff2df8b705.source: Open your World Map (default: "M"), and click on Shing Jea Monastery. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into Linnok Courtyard. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it.
3d5394d084ab0995e6326856a5457cff2df8b705.text: 打开您的世界地图（默认值：“M”），然后单击 Shing Jea Monastery。选择旅行。现在向东出口，进入林诺克庭院。东哥大师就在它的中间。

8d33735bf14ac39f3ff3825591ce8f612c1df733.source: The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one character. Once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession, whatever that may be. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the quests given by the characters you are sent to in these quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
8d33735bf14ac39f3ff3825591ce8f612c1df733.text: 一名角色可以领取该任务的奖励八次。每个职业一次。第一次将是你对职业的主要追求，无论是什么。其他七次只是在选择第二职业之前与每个职业的校长交谈即可。完成他们的任务，以及这些任务中你被发送到的角色给出的任务，最终会将其放入你的任务日志中。

c33dc8e6b85270f0cd5298d8006581c07b0f250b.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Scoundrel's Rise and start the mission.
c33dc8e6b85270f0cd5298d8006581c07b0f250b.text: 任何角色都可以从恶棍高地走进前哨站并开始任务。

ab9390ccd0206ac4e138542adad89d1c6db66bb8.source: Secure a safe place for your people to settle.
ab9390ccd0206ac4e138542adad89d1c6db66bb8.text: 为您的人民提供一个安全的定居点。

76ba5a0beb958bff3e40f817a397a817efd6e4c0.source: Make contact with the local authorities at Lion's Arch.
76ba5a0beb958bff3e40f817a397a817efd6e4c0.text: 与狮子拱门当地政府联系。

3ef38d86be8bb8cb7f6d0aeef4dffe9a0845a955.source: Head south across the beach to find Justiciar Hablion.
3ef38d86be8bb8cb7f6d0aeef4dffe9a0845a955.text: 向南穿过海滩找到审判官哈布利恩。

98f1ec4d33d42c47f521869cf7a65321769097b0.source: Help Justiciar Hablion clear the swamp of undead.
98f1ec4d33d42c47f521869cf7a65321769097b0.text: 帮助审判官哈布利恩清除不死生物沼泽。

881fae31b98ef4a7605225f32bf8dfe280e36b8b.source: *BONUS* Retrieve the Orrian text and have it translated.
881fae31b98ef4a7605225f32bf8dfe280e36b8b.text: *奖励* 检索 Orrian 文本并进行翻译。

cbf6dfb7835cea04d62d49031d182fb01af1f984.source: Head south until you reach the village (point 2). To open the gate, you must defeat all the undead in the open area along the route. Once inside, speak to Justiciar Toriimo to open the southern exit from the village and head over the bridge at the beach.
cbf6dfb7835cea04d62d49031d182fb01af1f984.text: 向南行驶直至到达村庄（第 2 点）。要打开大门，你必须击败沿途空旷区域的所有不死生物。进入后，与Justiciar Toriimo交谈，打开村庄的南面出口，然后越过海滩上的桥。

285fe64202d1943bc77c30a32da8568c4c9e34b6.source: Follow the shore to the east and talk to Justiciar Hablion to trigger the first cinematic. Immediately afterwards, the White Mantle will rush forward to fight the undead. Players must ensure Hablion's survival or the mission will fail. After a while Hablion splits from the White Mantle troops, but the player must follow the group and keep killing the undead. Once all foes have been cleared, the second/final cinematic will trigger.
285fe64202d1943bc77c30a32da8568c4c9e34b6.text: 沿着海岸向东走，与审判官哈布利恩交谈以触发第一部动画。紧接着，白斗篷就会冲上前去与亡灵战斗。玩家必须确保 Hablion 的生存，否则任务就会失败。过了一段时间，哈布利恩与白斗篷军队分开，但玩家必须跟随这支队伍并继续杀死不死族。一旦所有敌人都被清除，第二个/最后一个过场动画就会触发。

7bc60ff163e93bf3b19a3854c0a07b00d8133e19.source: To increase the chance of success in keeping Hablion alive, you can simply not talk to him since you can complete the mission without him. While at it, if your party nearly wipes except for one player, that single survivor can return to Hablion; talking to him will trigger the first cinematic and result in your party's entire resurrection (at his location) which grants a second chance with the White Mantle reinforcements.
7bc60ff163e93bf3b19a3854c0a07b00d8133e19.text: 为了增加成功让哈比利恩存活的机会，你可以简单地不与他交谈，因为没有他你也可以完成任务。在此过程中，如果你的队伍除了一名玩家之外几乎全军覆没，那么该幸存者可以返回哈布利恩；与他交谈将触发第一个动画并导致你的队伍完全复活（在他的位置），从而获得白斗篷增援的第二次机会。

1b508957477533994fb68ce8000233dee17f9a4f.source: Alternatively you can take the "backway" in and finish the mission without triggering the cinematic and without risking Hablion getting killed. Coming back from retrieving the bonus Text and before leaving the beach (to the right), send one person back to collect bonus and the others stay left a little ways up the beach and then exit and up the ramp on the left. Join the main path and continue north and finish the mission.
1b508957477533994fb68ce8000233dee17f9a4f.text: 或者，你可以走“后路”并完成任务，而不会触发过场动画，也不会冒哈布利恩被杀的风险。取回奖金文本后，在离开海滩（右侧）之前，派一个人回来收集奖金，其他人留在海滩上靠左一点的地方，然后退出并爬上左侧的坡道。加入主路继续向北完成任务。

0cc87cf3d5a7cc221554e6143aa222d034199387.source: Talk to the pig named Oink (point 1) to get it to follow you; lead it back to Cheswick (the owner) (point 2). Follow the water north from the beach until you find a chest (point 3) that contains the Orrian Text. Picking up the book will popup several Smoke Phantoms: these should only present a problem for lower-level parties. Along the way, you will encounter several more trigger points; again, fight rather than run. You get credit for the bonus when you return the text to the Orrian Historian McClain (point 2).
0cc87cf3d5a7cc221554e6143aa222d034199387.text: 与名叫 Oink 的猪交谈（第 1 点），让它跟随你；将其带回 Cheswick（所有者）（第 2 点）。沿着海滩向北的水域前进，直到找到一个装有奥里安文本的箱子（第 3 点）。拿起这本书会弹出几个烟雾幻影：这些只会给较低级别​​的队伍带来问题。一路上，你会遇到更多的触发点；再次，战斗而不是逃跑。当您将文本返回给 Orrian Historian McClain 时，您将获得奖金（第 2 点）。

51159ecbd1771b8ba64d59eb4a9cfca3f29e7e59.source: Alternatively, you can go straight to the chest (point 3) after getting Oink to follow you, bypassing both McClain and Cheswick. Oink will tank your enemies, allowing you to easily defeat them (the pig's damage output is next to nothing, but it is invincible to your enemies). (You could retrieve the book without Oink, but (a) he must be with you to get credit for the bonus and (b) you would lose his help along the way.) If Oink is not with your party, Orrian Historian McClain will still take the Orrian text; you have to return again with the pig to get credit.
51159ecbd1771b8ba64d59eb4a9cfca3f29e7e59.text: 或者，你可以在让 Oink 跟随你后直接前往宝箱（第 3 点），绕过 McClain 和 Cheswick。奥因克会坦克你的敌人，让你轻松击败他们（猪的伤害输出几乎为零，但它对你的敌人来说是无敌的）。 （你可以在没有奥因克的情况下取回这本书，但是（a）他必须和你在一起才能获得奖金，（b）你会一路失去他的帮助。）如果奥因克不在你的队伍中，奥里安历史学家麦克莱恩仍然会带走奥里安文本；你必须带着猪再次返回才能获得积分。

a8b2723521db39e11303fd4e1b93d0c82c5d569a.source: The White Mantle NPCs will die very quickly, so it is wiser to run ahead of them and clear a path to ensure Justiciar Hablion's survival.
a8b2723521db39e11303fd4e1b93d0c82c5d569a.text: 白斗篷 NPC 会很快死去，所以明智的做法是跑在他们前面并清理出一条道路来确保审判官哈布利安的生存。

e98c1571c88e3606acfc8673dae6159ff27d6e1b.source: Phantoms and skeletons are not fleshy, so they don't leave exploitable corpses and are immune to bleeding, disease, and poison.
e98c1571c88e3606acfc8673dae6159ff27d6e1b.text: 幻影和骷髅不是肉质的，因此它们不会留下可利用的尸体，并且免疫流血、疾病和毒药。

1ea417a0d05518e8a9ce6b7b41fabeb1a3192d26.source: Most foes are undead and take double damage from Holy damage skills.
1ea417a0d05518e8a9ce6b7b41fabeb1a3192d26.text: 大多数敌人都是不死生物，会受到神圣伤害技能的双倍伤害。

be3e849b4d110457b65cbc330c9b245406b3d85c.source: Heart of Holy Flame and Judge's Insight can make attacks deal holy damage.
be3e849b4d110457b65cbc330c9b245406b3d85c.text: 圣火之心和审判者洞察力可以使攻击造成神圣伤害。

82628d08c3c804a54a8c4c223179721f2b6848ac.source: Condition removal and hex removal skills, to counter Skeleton Mesmer's Ineptitude and Fragility.
82628d08c3c804a54a8c4c223179721f2b6848ac.text: 状态移除和妖术移除技能，以对抗骷髅幻术师的无能和脆弱。

ba494d494c6f85d9448936675692a9340f2e5e05.source: Solo farming the entire Gates of Kryta mission is extremely popular for amassing large quantities of bones, dust, gold, runes, insignias, weapon upgrades, dye, and Decayed Orr Emblems (which have special collectors during Halloween and Wintersday), and to Power level.
ba494d494c6f85d9448936675692a9340f2e5e05.text: 单独耕作整个科瑞塔之门任务非常受欢迎，因为可以积累大量骨头、灰尘、黄金、符文、徽章、武器升级、染料和腐烂的欧尔徽章（在万圣节和冬日期间有特殊的收藏家），并达到能量等级。

9a6145e7af799f93d9d4d4584f3f2ee9d49e9ebf.source: Behind the house where you find Oink, there's a small hidden path that leads up a hill then goes back down. There's a lone Hellhound but once you get closer a few popups Grasping Ghouls will spawn near it. Also, attacking the hellhound and killing it will cause more undead to appear.
9a6145e7af799f93d9d4d4584f3f2ee9d49e9ebf.text: 在你找到奥因克的房子后面，有一条隐藏的小路，通向一座小山，然后又向下走。有一只孤独的地狱猎犬，但一旦你靠近，就会在它附近生成一些弹出窗口，抓握食尸鬼。另外，攻击地狱犬并杀死它会导致更多的亡灵出现。

93e36cf020ec4f64955c026dd7adb398927045c3.source: If you take Oink with you, you can run back and the undead will crowd around Oink, but be stuck unable to attack him, allowing you to easily kill them in the meantime.
93e36cf020ec4f64955c026dd7adb398927045c3.text: 如果你带着奥因克，你可以跑回去，不死生物会聚集在奥因克周围，但无法攻击他，让你同时轻松杀死他们。

7881a40ff809f8cd40d304b34e611e0ee40ea089.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Lion's Arch.
7881a40ff809f8cd40d304b34e611e0ee40ea089.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到狮子拱门。

a567cea14bcb57fab634be02414e090e37fe8eaa.source: Though it is implied, it is not explicitly stated that the mission is failed if Justiciar Hablion dies.
a567cea14bcb57fab634be02414e090e37fe8eaa.text: 尽管有暗示，但并没有明确指出如果正义哈布利恩死亡，任务就会失败。

257d4ad6c33b71596d6539e0ac39efb2257e560f.source: If you are having trouble keeping Hablion alive, you can bypass his dialogue and avoid activating him; travel via the water up the other side.
257d4ad6c33b71596d6539e0ac39efb2257e560f.text: 如果你无法让哈比利恩存活，你可以绕过他的对话并避免激活他；通过水到达另一边。

b07e81f3ce685ec3924b6dd10b1f524b0b391c26.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
b07e81f3ce685ec3924b6dd10b1f524b0b391c26.text: 完成该任务的探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 1.4%。

f1cf1a1e5d0d8ec0941c3b902fb84a5dd58572f1.source: Players looking for the cartographer title can find a hidden path behind the house where Oink is found.
f1cf1a1e5d0d8ec0941c3b902fb84a5dd58572f1.text: 寻找制图师头衔的玩家可以在发现奥因克的房子后面找到一条隐藏的小路。

fe983da60860e5a11f68ed27ee5ec829edebf71a.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #8 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
fe983da60860e5a11f68ed27ee5ec829edebf71a.text: 在困难模式下完成此任务将填充《泰瑞亚青年英雄》故事书的第 8 页。

e4a2e886f904acf5e3be53bf8fbb100fa237879a.source: In their dialogue, Josephine repeats the Merchant's last line. Some elements of the dialogue in the White Mantle encampment seem to happen in the wrong order, with one character lagging behind the other. After you return Oink to Cheswick, Orrian Historian McClain will tell you that there is a shipwreck to the southwest, even though it is northeast.
e4a2e886f904acf5e3be53bf8fbb100fa237879a.text: 在他们的对话中，约瑟芬重复了商人的最后一句话。白斗篷营地中的一些对话元素似乎以错误的顺序发生，一个角色落后于另一个角色。当你将奥因克送回切西克后，奥里安历史学家麦克莱恩会告诉你西南方向有一艘沉船，尽管它是在东北方向。

2cfbc37162208a808ef0f8a456a6742913c35de7.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh.
2cfbc37162208a808ef0f8a456a6742913c35de7.text: 所有党员都必须接受《时辰临近》的奖励。

a109bef659d7d28b8f4d4682d94a7260ad8ad0a3.source: Dunkoro must be present in the party.

c40e97ac2bf53964d8015f3c2b702f398d704ada.source: Unite the western and southern attack fronts.
c40e97ac2bf53964d8015f3c2b702f398d704ada.text: 联合西部和南部进攻战线。

7f6234fbe3050f6b96fb6003ea5bac123d1488a0.source: ADDED: Defeat the Kournan Gate Captain to prevent him from summoning Kournan troops.
7f6234fbe3050f6b96fb6003ea5bac123d1488a0.text: 新增：击败库尔南门队长以阻止他召唤库尔南军队。

4833bfe9bae58b8d02e949ee7d285472bf0f9bb3.source: ADDED: Kill the siege engineers manning the firespitters to clear the way for the southern attack front.
4833bfe9bae58b8d02e949ee7d285472bf0f9bb3.text: 补充：杀死操纵喷火者的攻城工兵，为南部进攻前线扫清道路。

b3aa21f143f62088f790d1c2eb9a826181ad826a.source: ADDED: Capture the Kournan bombard to gain entrance to the heart of Gandara.
b3aa21f143f62088f790d1c2eb9a826181ad826a.text: 添加：捕获库南轰炸机以进入甘达拉的中心。

f36d197a248fe87326cdc4c880b14ce5ee5d6c13.source: ADDED: Rally the attack force outside the Plaza of the Five Gods.
f36d197a248fe87326cdc4c880b14ce5ee5d6c13.text: 新增：在五神广场外集结攻击力量。

03a175a1c2be0ecf9533357789a90fb2f901884b.source: *BONUS* Eliminate the Kournan field marshal groups.
03a175a1c2be0ecf9533357789a90fb2f901884b.text: *奖励*消灭库尔南陆军元帅小组。

c1ec64a11d560047dbf0f640611bda4d126b9cf8.source: You have [3...0] of 3 Kournan field marshal groups remaining.
c1ec64a11d560047dbf0f640611bda4d126b9cf8.text: 您还剩下 3 个库尔南陆军元帅小组中的 [3...0] 个。

cb024b4b1c8cf400a205bceda1a43bf289bbbcdc.source: For this mission only, all party members will be buffed with Sunspear Battle Call, which increases maximum health and armor (but not attribute points) to the equivalent of a level 20 character. An effect that helps low level characters/heroes to get through the mission more easily.
cb024b4b1c8cf400a205bceda1a43bf289bbbcdc.text: 仅对于此任务，所有队伍成员都将获得阳矛战斗召唤的增益，这会将最大生命值和护甲值（但不包括属性点）提高到相当于 20 级角色。帮助低等级角色/英雄更轻松地完成任务的效果。

e05bfc690b3fb6a5a16b32fbc0348e3902025133.source: Leave the boat and start to attack. You will encounter several Kournan Bowmen, who tend to focus their arrows on one single target, making them deadly to unprepared players. Spellcaster characters should try to attack them from behind walls to cover from their projectiles.
e05bfc690b3fb6a5a16b32fbc0348e3902025133.text: 离开船开始攻击。你会遇到几名库南弓箭手，他们倾向于将箭集中在一个目标上，这对于毫无准备的玩家来说是致命的。施法者角色应该尝试从墙后攻击他们，以躲避他们的射弹。

0e5b2200ffa99463d04fe2bdd01c2532e4a9dfa1.source: Once you've killed the archers, go down to the western gate guarded by Captain Lumanda who is able to call in reinforcements and get rid of him to prevent additional Kournan soldier spawns.
0e5b2200ffa99463d04fe2bdd01c2532e4a9dfa1.text: 杀死弓箭手后，前往由卢曼达队长守卫的西门，他可以呼叫增援并除掉他，以防止出现更多的库南士兵。

f98501210340a9f8139166387921ad55cc59b62f.source: In the next area, your reinforcements will be obstructed by two firespitters. Kill the Kournan Engineers and their groups to turn them off and reform the army by speaking to Nerashi. Make sure your allies do not remain stuck behind ground obstacles (or you will lose offense).
f98501210340a9f8139166387921ad55cc59b62f.text: 在下一个区域，你的援军将被两个喷火者阻挡。杀死库南工程师和他们的团队，让他们失望，并通过与奈拉什交谈来改革军队。确保你的盟友不会被困在地面障碍物后面（否则你将失去进攻能力）。

d089584607f58ec69e5604f445768c2aeac255c3.source: Continue forward, killing Kournans to capture the bombard which can be used to breach the fortress. Captain Mwende and four Elite Kournans will be stationed behind the gate.
d089584607f58ec69e5604f445768c2aeac255c3.text: 继续前进，杀死库尔南斯以夺取可用于攻破堡垒的炮弹。 Mwende 队长和四名精英 Kournan 将驻扎在大门后面。

079bce8269776456e38c71871e60eed386b5aee8.source: Climb the stairs to reach the Plaza of the Five Gods, where Varesh is trapped by the invasion to finish the mission.
079bce8269776456e38c71871e60eed386b5aee8.text: 爬上楼梯到达五神广场，瓦雷什被困在那里以完成任务。

c948abfc9e65c6c2d8153739338dd5bbd1999015.source: To gain the bonus rewards, your party has to kill three additional Kournan Field Commanders and their groups. These Commanders make use of a skill called Kournan Siege, which deals massive damage and also interrupts actions.
c948abfc9e65c6c2d8153739338dd5bbd1999015.text: 为了获得额外奖励，你的队伍必须杀死另外三名库尔南战地指挥官及其团队。这些指挥官使用一种名为“库尔南围攻”的技能，该技能会造成巨大伤害并打断行动。

549a95163d11b20181ae9f7a388529ebdc810af8.source: The first is near mission start, at the top left stairs and before Captain Lumanda.
549a95163d11b20181ae9f7a388529ebdc810af8.text: 第一个是在任务开始附近，在左上方楼梯处，卢曼达队长之前。

428d0394e2e5e3e65c75bf6230ddce48f1131bb7.source: The second is situated past the Kournan bombard weapon and can be found after the cinematic but before Captain Mwende.
428d0394e2e5e3e65c75bf6230ddce48f1131bb7.text: 第二个位于库尔南轰炸武器的后面，可以在过场动画之后、姆文德上尉之前找到。

831f86a63464d3f86247210be1d51b15d9dd16c4.source: The third and final is after Captain Mwende but before the Plaza of the Five Gods. Do not proceed to engage Varesh; instead, detour northeast to find them, otherwise you might accidentally finish the mission before you're able to complete the bonus.
831f86a63464d3f86247210be1d51b15d9dd16c4.text: 第三个也是最后一个是在姆文德船长之后、五神广场之前。不要继续与 Varesh 交战；相反，绕道东北去找他们，否则你可能会在完成奖励之前意外完成任务。

fd3e6cb706c3b3fcf54021bb971b6df9e61c33a8.source: The first Field Commander or the Kournan Spotter may spawn beyond the closed gate. If you do not have any ranged spell attacks, you may need to restart the mission to get the Master's reward. You can also try to kill it if he is next to the closed gate (leave the area then return).
fd3e6cb706c3b3fcf54021bb971b6df9e61c33a8.text: 第一个战地指挥官或库南观察员可能会在关闭的大门之外生成。如果你没有任何远程法术攻击，你可能需要重新开始任务才能获得大师的奖励。如果他在关闭的门旁边，你也可以尝试杀死它（离开该区域然后返回）。

134e6f2f1e0285d4e6c72361ac0708f36a6c602a.source: Avoid over-aggro especially around the main gate and third Field Commander.
134e6f2f1e0285d4e6c72361ac0708f36a6c602a.text: 避免过度仇恨，尤其是在主门和第三个战地指挥官周围。

02af4e214b7ab8e79c9b0569656154cb3572653f.source: Skills that remove stances, bypass blocking or punish blocking to counter the Whirling Defense skill used by the Kournan Bowmen.
02af4e214b7ab8e79c9b0569656154cb3572653f.text: 消除姿态、绕过格挡或惩罚格挡的技能，以对抗库南弓箭手使用的旋转防御技能。

17a8e37537755de551e8e86c1dbf48b48c5a9bc4.source: Skills which defend against ranged attacks (e.g., "Shields Up!"), or provide damage reduction over time (e.g., Shielding Hands).
17a8e37537755de551e8e86c1dbf48b48c5a9bc4.text: 防御远程攻击的技能（例如，“护盾！”），或随着时间的推移提供伤害减少（例如，护盾之手）。

9d412c95006776ad6fb0d51cae9715d5b5bcc0f1.source: All foes are fleshy, so there will be many corpses for minion masters; Lonai is also a minion master.
9d412c95006776ad6fb0d51cae9715d5b5bcc0f1.text: 所有敌人都是肉质的，所以小兵大师的尸体会很多；洛奈也是一名随从大师。

7734317bbfc93aae5ce90f6081476708addfc244.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Kournan Oppressors and Seers.
7734317bbfc93aae5ce90f6081476708addfc244.text: 基于结界的构建很容易被库南压迫者和先知移除结界。

e8a5415c56efd3dd0eb4170b182de862311285ac.source: Hex removal skills could be unnecessary; the only hex spells your party will encounter are Enchanter's Conundrum (the hex that is applied has no impact if your party does not use enchantments) and Life Siphon (ends when its caster dies).
e8a5415c56efd3dd0eb4170b182de862311285ac.text: 去除六角形的技能可能是不必要的；你的队伍将遇到的唯一的十六进制咒语是附魔者的难题（如果你的队伍不使用结界，则应用的十六进制没有任何影响）和生命虹吸（当其施法者死亡时结束）。

d7546c7506631546d254de73d1e41ac75245e72c.source: Kormir follows the party leader, never attacks and rarely uses skills except for "Incoming!". Foes cannot target her but she does take damage from area of effect skills.
d7546c7506631546d254de73d1e41ac75245e72c.text: 科米尔跟随队伍领袖，从不攻击，也很少使用除“来袭！”之外的技能。敌人无法瞄准她，但她确实会受到范围技能的伤害。

ee000c4be274c21650ec1ee917700c55a4ee44dc.source: Firespitters will kill allies immediately, but it does not count as a death.
ee000c4be274c21650ec1ee917700c55a4ee44dc.text: 喷火者会立即杀死盟友，但这不算死亡。

d892d13d929fbc7403fd5dcc3b749f9959ceb7fa.source: As mentioned in the walkthrough, if you attempt to take the narrow passage between the firespitters and the wall, Nerashi, Rojis, and Lonai can become stuck and not follow you. This can be indicated by their names becoming gray in your Party Members list when you've run too far away. If this is the case, go back, regroup with them, and take the path around the wall.
d892d13d929fbc7403fd5dcc3b749f9959ceb7fa.text: 正如演练中提到的，如果你试图通过喷火者和墙壁之间的狭窄通道，奈拉什、罗吉斯和洛奈可能会被卡住而无法跟随你。当你跑得太远时，他们的名字在你的党员列表中会变成灰色，这可以表明这一点。如果是这样的话，就回去和他们重新集合，沿着围墙的小路走。

8eafaeb720a5c3ad11b79b6db5a60455ea879399.source: After this mission, nearly every single enemy has an elite skill.
8eafaeb720a5c3ad11b79b6db5a60455ea879399.text: 在这次任务之后，几乎每个敌人都拥有了精英技能。

c2ba9a8f9197afed219f7d589539458588ee2cd1.source: After the completion of this mission for the first time, Koss will become unavailable until the completion of The Great Escape quest.
c2ba9a8f9197afed219f7d589539458588ee2cd1.text: 第一次完成此任务后，科斯将变得不可用，直到大逃亡任务完成为止。

c7fbf2f8f15b1a2bd40950db9b9b5c107f570487.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Yohlon Haven.
c7fbf2f8f15b1a2bd40950db9b9b5c107f570487.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到 Yohlon Haven。

a5c29f5cafa1bfae442bf342e146ba84c67b9ed8.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 in the Night Falls storybook.
a5c29f5cafa1bfae442bf342e146ba84c67b9ed8.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 1 页。

48d6f248d831e663b87047271a3588ea91fba772.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 主要职业：元素师

4b4a479ef83db16a44dd0656acfe6f5862a94e71.source: Seek out Headmaster Vhang in the monastery.
4b4a479ef83db16a44dd0656acfe6f5862a94e71.text: 在修道院里寻找 Vhang 校长。

0bd60cc36079abdd7bbcecc2678abcd70d83cbb4.source: gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a Starter Elemental Rod after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Amara, who is to the right, for your reward.
0bd60cc36079abdd7bbcecc2678abcd70d83cbb4.text: 获得2000经验，进入修道院后获得入门元素棒。如果您完成了教程，您就已经收到了这些。与右边的阿马拉校长交谈以获得奖励。

b3032f797914c246e1720aa2c97d0bbf81731213.source: Headmaster Vhang teaches you the following skills upon accepting the quest:
b3032f797914c246e1720aa2c97d0bbf81731213.text: Vhang校长在接受任务后会教你以下技能：

b70bdfcd79b92ffb0ab7dccd44e367dd1be6b9fa.source: Ronsu can be found in the southern parts of Sunqua Vale, not far from the water.
b70bdfcd79b92ffb0ab7dccd44e367dd1be6b9fa.text: Ronsu位于Sunqua Vale的南部，离水不远。

5e398dcd5bf8d2094231fe02219b7aaea978dd83.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from North Kryta Province and start the mission.
5e398dcd5bf8d2094231fe02219b7aaea978dd83.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从北科瑞塔省走进前哨站并开始任务。

d8cd9f77b04abd0f3accc3bfeb756b1c74727bbf.source: Lend aid to the White Mantle in their fight against the undead.
d8cd9f77b04abd0f3accc3bfeb756b1c74727bbf.text: 帮助白斗篷对抗不死族。

065beebfe4079fd1835d5700ae98e5e954711d09.source: Hurry to the Temple of Tolerance.

d38f0fb45b4910ab544335bea3d9332f95937768.source: Discuss the undead menace with Confessor Dorian.
d38f0fb45b4910ab544335bea3d9332f95937768.text: 与忏悔者多里安讨论不死族的威胁。

78da5361a18a820e3cb336280036ce0a8a76367d.source: ADDED: Clear out the undead from the village of Hakewood.
78da5361a18a820e3cb336280036ce0a8a76367d.text: 新增：清除哈克伍德村的亡灵。

129cf64b6d418dfb9b42bc0ff41de6bdbf6e0063.source: ADDED: Protect Confessor Dorian from the undead.
129cf64b6d418dfb9b42bc0ff41de6bdbf6e0063.text: 添加：保护忏悔者多里安免受不死生物的侵害。

e2b8632a4aa1fca1570390b60b2c757d507e9cd2.source: ADDED: Head to the southwest. Locate Dinas and the Scepter of Orr.
e2b8632a4aa1fca1570390b60b2c757d507e9cd2.text: 补充：前往西南方向。找到迪纳斯和奥尔权杖。

5658b6e732a6c9358a9954b7918daf810d4af14f.source: *BONUS* Deliver the village's offering intact to the statue of Melandru.
5658b6e732a6c9358a9954b7918daf810d4af14f.text: *奖励* 将村庄的祭品完好无损地交付给梅兰德鲁雕像。

370e112f233cb59910d57418dfb37a10f7a22aaf.source: Follow the path until the nearby village (point 1 on the map) and eliminate all the undead there. You do not need to save any of the villagers, but a morale boost is gained each time you do. If you wish to complete the bonus, Benji Makala must survive.
370e112f233cb59910d57418dfb37a10f7a22aaf.text: 沿着小路一直走到附近的村庄（地图上的点1）并消灭那里的所有亡灵。你不需要拯救任何村民，但每次你这样做都会鼓舞士气。如果你想完成奖励，本吉·马卡拉必须活下来。

ecf41b769f01d5745301c025b132284e54672239.source: If ignoring the bonus, simply speak to the Gate Guard then travel through the swamp to the west.
ecf41b769f01d5745301c025b132284e54672239.text: 如果忽略奖励，只需与门卫交谈，然后穿过沼泽向西行进。

bd4cba3fbba4e4528b35280b94ee2ca9a753c77e.source: If going for the bonus, you have to take the path north instead (yellow on the map), behind Gate Guard Makala, and open the lever-operated door at the end to catch up with the initial path to the Temple of Tolerance (point A).
bd4cba3fbba4e4528b35280b94ee2ca9a753c77e.text: 如果要获得奖励，你必须走北边的路径（地图上的黄色），在门卫马卡拉后面，打开末端的杠杆门，赶上通往宽容神庙的最初路径（A点）。

51c38c160413017e5563dee9310081c6997a34ac.source: Upon arrival, Confessor Dorian is added to your party and the battle will begin against several waves of undead. There is a Shrine of Mending that provides +3 health regeneration to living creatures in its area of effect. After waves of skeletons and ghouls, a quest marker appears above Dorian, and one final wave of enemies will spawn 3–4 minutes later. Dorian instructs the player to retrieve the Scepter of Orr from his scribe Dinas, located further to the west. However, Dorian may still die if left alone, causing mission failure. It is highly recommended to stay and protect him from that final wave before heading to Dinas (and/or doing the bonus).
51c38c160413017e5563dee9310081c6997a34ac.text: 到达后，忏悔者多里安就会加入你的队伍，战斗将开始对抗几波不死族。有一座治愈神殿，可以为其作用范围内的生物提供 +3 生命恢复。在一波又一波的骷髅和食尸鬼之后，多利安上方会出现一个任务标记，最后一波敌人将在 3-4 分钟后出现。多里安指示玩家从位于更西边的抄写员迪纳斯那里取回奥尔权杖。然而，如果任由多里安独自一人的话，仍有可能死亡，从而导致任务失败。强烈建议在前往迪纳斯（和/或做奖励）之前留下来保护他免受最后一波攻击。

cf87e4374d1d22b1640f6e795558e20eb26d9888.source: Follow the ettin infested path to Dinas (who might be fighting a boss) and speak to him to end the mission.
cf87e4374d1d22b1640f6e795558e20eb26d9888.text: 沿着埃丁出没的道路找到迪纳斯（他可能正在与老板战斗）并与他交谈以结束任务。

d67fed831719d260343996e57fe1ef8bb867ba80.source: The bonus involves carrying the Offering to Melandru (point 3) to the offering stand (point 4). Since the bridge from the pick-up point to the drop-off point is broken, you have to go the long way around it, through the temple.
d67fed831719d260343996e57fe1ef8bb867ba80.text: 奖金包括将供品运送到 Melandru（第 3 点）到供品台（第 4 点）。由于从上车点到下车点的桥坏了，你必须绕桥绕很长一段路，穿过寺庙。

ca0d30206cea3ccfc998ea4c1bbd28c3af317c9c.source: First at the settlement, ensure Benji survives from the boss that spawns near him. Run straight towards him once he is added as ally to the party window.
ca0d30206cea3ccfc998ea4c1bbd28c3af317c9c.text: 首先在定居点，确保本吉从他附近生成的 Boss 中幸存下来。一旦他被添加为队伍窗口的盟友，就径直跑向他。

7cebfc48dc0bab7836b5b20835010e7d3c71e797.source: If having troubles, consider using a speed boost or alternatively flag heroes or henchmen ahead, as the boss will only start attacking the NPC when a player enters compass range. Note that this technique can be used for the bonus in the following mission (Divinity Coast) as well.
7cebfc48dc0bab7836b5b20835010e7d3c71e797.text: 如果遇到麻烦，请考虑使用速度提升，或者标记前方的英雄或追随者，因为只有当玩家进入罗盘范围时，Boss 才会开始攻击 NPC。请注意，该技术也可以用于以下任务（神界海岸）中的奖励。

46ecf840d8849e4822fb21a8d23afc2a1b4c0cfb.source: After the boss is killed, you can trigger the bonus from Benji immediately (a green marker appears above his head), however you still have to ensure he survives the entire assault, protecting him again on his way to the Shrine of Mending, as Gate Guard Makala (point 2) will not let you pass through the north gate until the village is cleared and his brother safe. Be careful not to overaggro, especially Zombie Warlocks and their minions.
46ecf840d8849e4822fb21a8d23afc2a1b4c0cfb.text: Boss被杀死后，你可以立即触发Benji的奖励（他的头顶上出现一个绿色标记），但是你仍然必须确保他在整个攻击中幸存，并在前往治愈神殿的路上再次保护他，因为门卫马卡拉（第2点）不会让你通过北门，直到村庄被清理干净并且他的兄弟安全为止。小心不要过度仇恨，尤其是僵尸术士和他们的爪牙。

2fc43725a951bd33af582f49bce96c8a3f87d5d0.source: At the end of the northern path (yellow on the map), a swamp populated by undead, you will reach the Offering and a door operated by a lever that connects to the main path.
2fc43725a951bd33af582f49bce96c8a3f87d5d0.text: 在北边小路的尽头（地图上的黄色），这是一片充满不死生物的沼泽，你将到达祭品和一扇由连接到主路的杠杆操作的门。

c9b1da5f0dca0645a3203c5a3789eedb7239cb5d.source: The offering in itself is a bundle item. As such, it will slow you down and prevent you from using your weapons while carried. If dropped, the offering will break, requiring you to return and retrieve another one.
c9b1da5f0dca0645a3203c5a3789eedb7239cb5d.text: 该产品本身就是一个捆绑项目。因此，它会减慢你的速度并阻止你在携带时使用武器。如果掉落，该产品将会损坏，需要您返回并取回另一件。

ce9b0d4e88a17af6e4c136d7e57056784b96dc2b.source: At this point you have to make a choice. You can choose to take the offering first, ignoring its drawbacks, or proceed with the mission objectives first, clear the path and come back to the Offering later. The first choice is usually faster since you avoid backtracking, while the second choice is safer.
ce9b0d4e88a17af6e4c136d7e57056784b96dc2b.text: 此时你必须做出选择。你可以选择先接受奉献，忽略其缺点，或者先完成任务目标，扫清道路，稍后再返回奉献。第一个选择通常会更快，因为您可以避免回溯，而第二个选择则更安全。

0062e6e4868d077b15269af40b2c546af44dd94f.source: Many foes will gather around Dorian before you have time to reach him. It is recommended to proceed directly to the temple and protect him first (ignoring the Grasping Ghouls; they will stop to fight the White Mantle Guard).
0062e6e4868d077b15269af40b2c546af44dd94f.text: 在你有时间接近多里安之前，许多敌人就会聚集在他周围。建议直接前往神殿并先保护他（无视抓食鬼；他们会停下来与白斗篷守卫战斗）。

995557ad909562ed52bbbb9bcb268a0f818b2f30.source: Holy damage is doubled against undead.
995557ad909562ed52bbbb9bcb268a0f818b2f30.text: 对不死生物的神圣伤害加倍。

a1a0b732f5d8eb048d2fcf4a9b796021f5986520.source: Smiting Prayers skills dealing such damage, notably Ray of Judgment, Signet of Judgment, Smite Hex and Smite Condition, are effective.
a1a0b732f5d8eb048d2fcf4a9b796021f5986520.text: 造成此类伤害的惩戒祈祷技能，尤其是审判射线、审判徽记、惩戒六角形和惩戒状态，非常有效。

7497c207dc5a5273da7f29eb8c5b5fcc7bc1e056.source: Judge's Insight and Heart of Holy Flame can temporarily change attacks' damage type to holy.
7497c207dc5a5273da7f29eb8c5b5fcc7bc1e056.text: 审判者的洞察力和圣火之心可以暂时将攻击的伤害类型变为神圣。

c09199a8de98f1821c6c712659f3c0d97751e39d.source: The undead's strategy revolves around conditions to trigger Fragility and "Victory is Mine!". Condition removal is effective as well as skills that benefit from conditions. Here are the details of conditions :
c09199a8de98f1821c6c712659f3c0d97751e39d.text: 亡灵的策略围绕触发脆弱性的条件和“胜利是我的！”。条件去除和受益于条件的技能一样有效。以下是条件详情：

f341e0173fa6cfb70d7afd0e71f023c244032f7f.source: Skeleton Rangers can inflict bleeding and poison;
f341e0173fa6cfb70d7afd0e71f023c244032f7f.text: 骷髅游侠可以造成流血和中毒；

5682d7102d8c6c155e8abfbc62f43fc9969d360a.source: Skeleton Sorcerers can inflict blind and cracked Armor;
5682d7102d8c6c155e8abfbc62f43fc9969d360a.text: 骷髅巫师可以造成护甲失明和破裂；

ded511afb1d396428a874323b89b7d833d5b6dba.text: 僵尸术士可以造成毒害；

9478331302984e2c95de11cd90fac8cde1b8fb92.source: Skeleton Mesmers can inflict deep wound and blind (only in Hard Mode);
9478331302984e2c95de11cd90fac8cde1b8fb92.text: 骷髅催眠师可以造成深伤和失明（仅在困难模式下）；

736b4fd1f06e8f20c3b8fbbb3f1c21f3cdfff1bc.text: 抓握食尸鬼会造成残废。

e429cb736d7f9aa51b416969a486bdf1746669bd.source: Corpse control is effective against Zombie Warlocks. Well of Silence works well as it denies the use of "Victory is Mine!".
e429cb736d7f9aa51b416969a486bdf1746669bd.text: 尸体控制对僵尸术士有效。沉默之井效果很好，因为它拒绝使用“胜利是我的！”。

75f949a7129f04239508c02c0a078f7835c7208c.source: Wells, notably Well of Power and Well of Blood, and Wards, notably Ward Against Elements and Ward Against Harm, are helpful when defending Dorian.
75f949a7129f04239508c02c0a078f7835c7208c.text: 水井，尤其是力量之井和鲜血之井，以及守卫，尤其是抗元素守卫和反伤害守卫，在保卫多里安时很有帮助。

afeb34dccf677b12a319d8f1179fe98d65efff00.source: The Skeleton Sorcerers are the biggest threat with their ability to inflict blind, their high AoE damage and knockdown. In addition to the aforementioned wards, Ward of Stability can be used to protect against Earthquake, while "Can't Touch This!" can be used against Lightning Touch. Interrupts work well too.
afeb34dccf677b12a319d8f1179fe98d65efff00.text: 骷髅巫师是最大的威胁，因为他们能够造成致盲、高范围伤害和击倒。除了上述的防护之外，稳定防护可以用来防御地震，而“不能碰这个！”可用于对抗闪电之触。中断也能很好地工作。

b9ef8e00c5fec0d2c0a984c6825831a6d680b55f.source: Enchantment removal can be effective to remove Death Nova and Vengeance.
b9ef8e00c5fec0d2c0a984c6825831a6d680b55f.text: 结界移除可以有效移除死亡新星和复仇。

3fc6cfec34312dba74f119bb44055e2e2a0d92fb.source: Hex removal against the skeleton mesmers and skales.
3fc6cfec34312dba74f119bb44055e2e2a0d92fb.text: 针对骷髅催眠师和骷髅的六角去除。

b9ae7c32456f04b2b5a7aca259789402153b9414.source: Hexes are less effective as Skeleton Mesmers and Monks carry Shatter Hex and Smite Hex respectively. On the opposite, none of the foes carry condition removal, so conditions are effective.
b9ae7c32456f04b2b5a7aca259789402153b9414.text: 由于骷髅幻术师和武僧分别携带粉碎十六进制和重击十六进制，十六进制效果较差。相反，没有一个敌人具有条件移除功能，因此条件有效。

fa5196245ca4946f2f5f09b3d757644160717212.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.47% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. (This area can be explored without interference by foes after completing the War in Kryta and speaking to Jiaju Tai in Lion's Arch. This only works if you have no Wanted quests in your quest log.)
fa5196245ca4946f2f5f09b3d757644160717212.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.47%。 （完成科瑞塔之战并与狮子拱门的贾居泰交谈后，即可在不受敌人干扰的情况下探索该区域。这仅在您的任务日志中没有通缉任务时才有效。）

754b3408ebeb9a046c095aa140941342171d0e1e.source: If you pull aggro to the Gate Guard and he dies, the gate will automatically open without needing to kill the undead. However, the enemies still need to be cleared if you want to complete the bonus.
754b3408ebeb9a046c095aa140941342171d0e1e.text: 如果你将仇恨拉向门卫并且他死了，门会自动打开，不需要杀死不死生物。然而，如果你想完成奖励，仍然需要清除敌人。

866c5713313adcadcae7c85fc0be6a8fc06b9898.source: Unlike other statues of Melandru, the statue of Melandru in this mission doesn't appear differently with Favor of the Gods active.
866c5713313adcadcae7c85fc0be6a8fc06b9898.text: 与其他梅兰朵雕像不同的是，在众神之恩激活的情况下，本次任务中的梅兰朵雕像看起来并没有什么不同。

7034465493e3123cf1f35fc678b00666fa0c69a6.source: In rare cases, a Lynx can spawn on the broken bridge.
7034465493e3123cf1f35fc678b00666fa0c69a6.text: 在极少数情况下，山猫会在断桥上生成。

1b4ef7a827dbd048b6eeb2b3bbbc6b4ddd397bb8.source: Contrary to the mission objective, it is not necessary to speak to Confessor Dorian. Keeping him alive and speaking to Dinas is sufficient to complete the mission.
1b4ef7a827dbd048b6eeb2b3bbbc6b4ddd397bb8.text: 与任务目标相反，没有必要与忏悔者多里安交谈。让他活着并与迪纳斯交谈就足以完成任务。

3248b0c7578678d54ea12f5fe88b11ba36cebf18.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
3248b0c7578678d54ea12f5fe88b11ba36cebf18.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 1 页。

eaf90df8745cee0081c2bd5ee77fc7b441127dea.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Divinity Coast.
eaf90df8745cee0081c2bd5ee77fc7b441127dea.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到神性海岸。

f4363d28111fbb719f71bcf4df3d590a5ac20955.source: Talk to Zudash Dejarin about a place for the Sunspears to hide.
f4363d28111fbb719f71bcf4df3d590a5ac20955.text: 与祖达什·德贾林讨论烈阳之矛队的藏身之处。

c952a969188fc2b1d6426d6926cb6c5f1259eed1.source: Journey to Ronjok and ask Elder Jonah about a sanctuary for the sundered Sunspears.
c952a969188fc2b1d6426d6926cb6c5f1259eed1.text: 前往罗约克，向乔纳长老询问有关为四分五裂的烈阳之矛队建立避难所的事情。

f4897867c4499076e758a89c32590c24e8b5b085.source: Speak with Guardsman Bahsi to gain access to the underground complex.
f4897867c4499076e758a89c32590c24e8b5b085.text: 与卫兵巴西交谈以进入地下建筑群。

c3f938ac83afa3ccbe0ef17308c4036ce96dbb2c.source: Clear the area of monsters and establish a Sunspear Command Post.
c3f938ac83afa3ccbe0ef17308c4036ce96dbb2c.text: 清除该区域的怪物并建立烈阳之矛指挥所。

a929809ef80a756a8e0b4516e53c7d60ba55517f.source: After talking to Zudash Dejarin, enter Marga Coast and head towards the village of Ronjok. Follow the quest marker to Elder Jonah (point J on the quest map). He will instruct you to speak with Guardsman Bahsi (point B). Speak to Guardsman Bahsi in order to enter Secure the Refuge, a mini-mission version of the Sunspear Sanctuary. Inside, you must kill the 5 groups of insects to trigger the cutscene and finish the quest. There are a few Bladed Veldt Termite patrols running around, but you are not required to kill them. After defeating the insects, speak to Lonai in the Sunspear Sanctuary to accept the quest reward.
a929809ef80a756a8e0b4516e53c7d60ba55517f.text: 与 Zudash Dejarin 交谈后，进入 Marga 海岸，前往 Ronjok 村。按照任务标记找到乔纳长老（任务地图上的 J 点）。他会指示你与卫兵巴西（B点）交谈。与卫兵巴西交谈，进入安全避难所，这是烈阳之矛庇护所的迷你任务版本。在里面，你必须杀死5组昆虫才能触发过场动画并完成任务。有一些刀锋白蚁巡逻队在周围奔跑，但你不需要杀死它们。击败昆虫后，与阳矛圣域的洛奈交谈以接受任务奖励。

ca196752fe19ea9ab8cd8d21803512cc55154b13.source: The quest log lists Zudash Dejarin as quest giver.
ca196752fe19ea9ab8cd8d21803512cc55154b13.text: 任务日志将 Zudash Dejarin 列为任务提供者。

68b8db4b942d0c9264bafaa44d679f0d9830554c.source: Upon completion, Nightfall characters will be able to change their secondary professions (at any profession changer) and gain the same non-exclusive benefits as Ascension in the Prophecies campaign or becoming Weh no Su in the Factions campaign.
68b8db4b942d0c9264bafaa44d679f0d9830554c.text: 完成后，夜幕降临角色将能够改变他们的次要职业（在任何职业变换器处），并获得与预言战役中的扬升或派系战役中成为 Weh no Su 相同的非排他性好处。

13b22e0f3f1d0fbc647e629784a5268037d3ec5c.source: Go to the beach and find a Stone of the Elements.

8a835ab082101a96f6dcbc3992b4b286ef7d0cfe.source: Defeat Huan to claim ownership of the Stone of the Elements.
8a835ab082101a96f6dcbc3992b4b286ef7d0cfe.text: 击败胡安，取得元素之石的所有权。

03389e001f0706c37636570d9b50576bc7fcab21.text: 去找 Ronsu 领取奖励。

dbca80e6906b08ea1cc99497e02e5ab8a0e799b5.source: Ronsu teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
dbca80e6906b08ea1cc99497e02e5ab8a0e799b5.text: 当你接受这个任务时，隆苏会教你以下技能：

96dc8564024033547b5c4313b6146077960cca36.source: Just go south to the sea, and out the pier. Huan should not be difficult, and if he is, fetch some allies from Shing Jea Monastery to help. Henchmen should do fine.
96dc8564024033547b5c4313b6146077960cca36.text: 往南走到海边，出码头就可以了。欢应该不难，如果他难的话，请从圣杰寺找一些盟友来帮忙。追随者应该做得很好。

fc6c42b111a3deed9bb25a456202025202e3629d.source: Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with completion of this quest.
fc6c42b111a3deed9bb25a456202025202e3629d.text: 已知端午节任务会干扰该任务的完成。

2b6e57e0e0c3f9b6540ab95e9b9ca6ef40e521fe.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Watchtower Coast and start the mission. Completing D'Alessio Seaboard also brings the party here.
2b6e57e0e0c3f9b6540ab95e9b9ca6ef40e521fe.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从瞭望塔海岸走进前哨站并开始任务。完成 D'Alessio Seaboard 后，聚会也会来到这里。

caa2a5f19e3fe8afec6a248e957552885b120593.source: Administer the Test of the Chosen.

f0ab43c2a01fa4b7dd31103b1f7c4311a3d230e7.source: Retrieve the Eye of Janthir from Justiciar Hablion in the upper courtyard of Shaemoor.
f0ab43c2a01fa4b7dd31103b1f7c4311a3d230e7.text: 从谢莫尔上院的审判官哈布利恩那里取回詹瑟尔之眼。

786c41c9b575060b7c2b3194d4aa4b859c967ec1.source: Deliver the Eye to the coastal city of Loamhurst.
786c41c9b575060b7c2b3194d4aa4b859c967ec1.text: 将眼睛送到沿海城市洛姆赫斯特。

d7fd0ae6d9ab46743fb286286228348e3b52fbbe.source: ADDED: Cleanse yourself in the Fountain of Truth on the hill to the southeast.
d7fd0ae6d9ab46743fb286286228348e3b52fbbe.text: 添加：在东南山上的真理之泉净化自己。

eace06d80a33f066acc5f4c485ee0119c36f18e4.source: *BONUS* Find and escort all the chosen to Loamhurst.
eace06d80a33f066acc5f4c485ee0119c36f18e4.text: *奖励* 找到并护送所有被选中的人前往洛姆赫斯特。

215ff7e67bb29b99dbf94073aef0e3ae5b56369d.source: There is an additional reward for saving the Chosen villagers. The whole party shares (100 gold * number of Chosen saved * number of human players). (I.e. a party of 6 humans saving 5 Chosen shares 3000 gold, and a party of 1 human + 5 heroes shares 500 gold.)
215ff7e67bb29b99dbf94073aef0e3ae5b56369d.text: 拯救被选中的村民还有额外奖励。全队共享（100金币*被拯救的天选者数量*人类玩家数量）。 （即 6 个人组成的队伍保存 5 个被选中者分享 3000 金币，1 个人 + 5 名英雄组成的队伍分享 500 金币。）

a3ed2af9531d6380fc9dcf27aaa8c5c734d7c8e1.source: Shaemoor is a short trip ahead from the start point. Justiciar Hablion will be waiting for you there, and speaking to him will trigger a cinematic which points you towards the Fountain of Truth where you will cleanse yourself by simply standing on it to receive the cleansed effect. Return to Hablion and acquire the Eye of Janthir. The eye will follow any cleansed party members and help you distinguish the Chosen from amongst the villagers. Those villagers who pass the test will now follow you to Loamhurst.
a3ed2af9531d6380fc9dcf27aaa8c5c734d7c8e1.text: Shaemoor 距起点仅一小段路程。审判官哈布利恩将在那里等你，与他交谈将触发一段动画，将你引向真理之泉，在那里你只需站在真理之泉上即可获得净化效果，从而净化自己。返回哈布利安并获得詹瑟尔之眼。眼睛将追踪任何被净化的党员，并帮助您将选民与村民区分开来。通过测试的村民现在将跟随你前往洛姆赫斯特。

46faaabfdeb3f2b0bd43f9bf075bb2737ebd9e4f.source: Head to the western gate in Shaemoor to continue. Head southwest to the bridge. While engaging foes, the Eye will assist by inflicting an area of effect knockdown using Janthir's Gaze.
46faaabfdeb3f2b0bd43f9bf075bb2737ebd9e4f.text: 前往谢莫尔的西门继续前进。向西南方向前往桥。在与敌人交战时，之眼将通过使用詹瑟尔的凝视造成一定范围的效果击倒来提供帮助。

b4b15f491e1a14fba2c1c5b666c060ec2afa698d.source: After crossing the high bridge, you'll find a caravan of merchants under attack. If you save the merchants, each one rescued will grant your party a 2% morale boost. (The villagers that appear in the party list are involved in the bonus task and do not give morale boosts.)
b4b15f491e1a14fba2c1c5b666c060ec2afa698d.text: 穿过高桥后，你会发现一支商队受到攻击。如果你拯救了商人，每拯救一个都会让你的队伍士气提升 2%。 （出现在队伍名单中的村民参与了奖励任务，并且不会提升士气。）

4bdf75ae772a33509728a7e63ad4a146913c3822.source: Keep walking west until you reach the second Tengu boss on the border of the swamp, and then head north through the Undead until you reach Loamhurst. Before taking the Eye to the pedestal, talking to Lionguard Minah will reward your party for any Chosen delivered to him.
4bdf75ae772a33509728a7e63ad4a146913c3822.text: 继续向西走，直到到达沼泽边界的第二个天狗首领，然后向北穿过亡灵，直到到达洛姆赫斯特。在将之眼放到基座上之前，与狮子卫士米纳交谈将为你的队伍奖励任何交付给他的神选者。

a52f8601a4fea927f5efb05bc1bb5f98f26c0ff0.source: To complete the bonus you need to rescue all five of the Chosen and escort them to Loamhurst unharmed. Chosen villagers will be added to the bottom of your party list as allies, which will help you tell which ones need to be saved. The second and fifth Chosen will be under attack by tengu immediately upon entering compass range, and the third and fourth will be dangerously close to wandering foes as well. Players should bring skills to assist in quickly killing the attackers or saving the Chosen with heals. Skills that hinder enemies at a distance (such as Ineptitude) are useful, as are speed boosts. Moving into close range to take advantage of Janthir's Gaze can significantly reduce the enemy's damage output. While fighting, don't forget about the Chosen you have already saved, since they can be attacked as you rush to the defence of the new Chosen.
a52f8601a4fea927f5efb05bc1bb5f98f26c0ff0.text: 为了完成奖励，你需要营救所有五名选民并护送他们毫发无伤地到达洛姆赫斯特。选定的村民将作为盟友添加到您的队伍列表底部，这将帮助您判断哪些村民需要被拯救。第二名和第五名选民在进入罗盘范围后将立即受到天狗的攻击，而第三名和第四名选民也将危险地接近徘徊的敌人。玩家应该携带技能来协助快速杀死攻击者或通过治疗来拯救选民。远距离阻碍敌人的技能（例如无能）和速度提升都很有用。进入近距离利用詹瑟尔的凝视可以显着减少敌人的伤害输出。在战斗时，不要忘记你已经拯救的选民，因为当你冲过去保护新的选民时，他们可能会受到攻击。

692ef995e0a9ba478aa45dc4f7020ada859cec30.source: The Chosen villagers and merchants are only added to the party list once a player enters compass range. Because of this, flagging heroes and henchmen to the locations of the Chosen using the Mission Map before the player enters compass range provides a very easy way to ensure survival of the Chosen. Moreover, the already saved Chosen will stay with the player and therefore be less vulnerable.
692ef995e0a9ba478aa45dc4f7020ada859cec30.text: 只有当玩家进入罗盘范围后，被选中的村民和商人才会被添加到队伍列表中。因此，在玩家进入罗盘范围之前使用任务地图将英雄和追随者标记到选民的位置提供了一种非常简单的方法来确保选民的生存。此外，已经保存的选民将留在玩家身边，因此不易受到攻击。

d1453b1fdf38e8ee552550e6d527c931bebb8692.source: File:Divinity Coast Bonus Villager 2.jpg File:Divinity Coast Bonus Villager 3.jpg File:Divinity Coast Bonus Villager 4.jpg File:Divinity Coast Bonus Villager 5.jpg
d1453b1fdf38e8ee552550e6d527c931bebb8692.text: 文件：神界海岸奖励村民 2.jpg 文件：神界海岸奖励村民 3.jpg 文件：神界海岸奖励村民 4.jpg 文件：神界海岸奖励村民 5.jpg

77fc8c2d0a7bf69ef8914661dfd64b84b2ead0b9.source: After saving the Chosen, the party leader must get close to them to make them follow; it is not enough just to have the Eye of Janthir reveal them as Chosen. The second Chosen also will not follow the party until he has been spoken to and the bonus objective has been displayed.
77fc8c2d0a7bf69ef8914661dfd64b84b2ead0b9.text: 拯救选民后，党魁必须接近他们，让他们跟随；仅仅让詹瑟尔之眼揭示他们是被选中的人是不够的。第二位选民也不会跟随队伍，直到与他交谈并且奖励目标已显示。

68243a53ea780cac6244a068f3b4522bf27db49c.source: Once all five have been secured, there will still be a short trip towards Loamhurst through an area with poisoned water and undead; avoid letting the Chosen step in the swamp water. Finally, you must talk to Lionguard Minah or else you will lose the bonus by skipping to the end of the mission. Make sure all five are with you or the game will consider you have lost one during your way towards the bonus claim. The names of Chosen in the party window will become greyed out if they have been left behind.
68243a53ea780cac6244a068f3b4522bf27db49c.text: 一旦所有五个人都安全了，仍然需要经过一个充满毒水和不死生物的区域前往洛姆赫斯特。避免让选民踏入沼泽水中。最后，你必须与狮子卫士米纳交谈，否则你将因跳到任务结束而失去奖励。确保所有五个都在你身边，否则游戏会认为你在领取奖金的过程中失去了一个。如果被遗忘，队伍窗口中的选民姓名将变灰。

4bab3597ae687a53cf19dd8500e3c55de2a319f3.source: The Chosen lose health in Hard mode much faster and getting to them in time may pose a problem. Consider bringing skills that increase the party's movement speed, as well as niche skills such as Ebon Escape. As all the Chosen will primarily be targeted by melee attacks, also consider skills as Gust and Withering Aura that can keep these targets from dying. Finally, a decent healer is most likely crucial to keep the Chosen alive throughout the mission. Taking an AoE skill will cause the enemies to scatter and change targets, which can help protect the Chosen.
4bab3597ae687a53cf19dd8500e3c55de2a319f3.text: 天选者在困难模式下失去生命值的速度要快得多，及时到达它们可能会带来问题。考虑携带可以提高队伍移动速度的技能，以及诸如黑锋逃亡之类的利基技能。由于所有神选者将主要成为近战攻击的目标，因此还要考虑使用阵风和枯萎光环等技能来防止这些目标死亡。最后，一个体面的治疗师对于让选民在整个任务中保持活力很可能至关重要。使用AoE技能会使敌人分散并改变目标，这可以帮助保护选民。

d936fc8e53e91111fddbab4f3c967732112ba83b.source: If you can successfully rescue the Chosen from their initial attackers but struggle to keep them alive during the rest of the journey, you can avoid approaching them as the party leader so that they will not follow the party, then double back to collect them once the road to Loamhurst is clear. Remember that the first Chosen in Shaemoor is very close to the Eye's initial location, so you will need to keep to the left as you descend the stairs if you intend to use this strategy.
d936fc8e53e91111fddbab4f3c967732112ba83b.text: 如果你能成功地从最初的攻击者手中救出选民，但在剩下的旅程中努力让他们活着，你可以避免以队伍领袖的身份接近他们，这样他们就不会跟随队伍，然后在通往洛姆赫斯特的道路畅通后折回收集他们。请记住，Shaemoor 的第一个选民非常靠近眼睛的初始位置，因此如果您打算使用此策略，则在下楼梯时需要保持向左行驶。

25bb774a3c9e3f7500d8f1a53e6793c359f77cec.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
25bb774a3c9e3f7500d8f1a53e6793c359f77cec.text: 完成此任务的探索大约为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了 1.0%。

1cb498947c355c501acff2aec1d0963497986f44.source: Crossing the river without using the bridge can jeopardise the bonus objective, since the additional tengu foes on alternative routes might block you from rescuing a vulnerable Chosen villager.
1cb498947c355c501acff2aec1d0963497986f44.text: 不使用桥梁过河可能会危及奖励目标，因为其他路线上的额外天狗敌人可能会阻止你拯救脆弱的选民村民。

8d70f1b9a3c3df9600e01c772b3c87d2ac15823f.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Druid's Overlook.
8d70f1b9a3c3df9600e01c772b3c87d2ac15823f.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到德鲁伊瞭望台。

709f6884e41ec38c4f44881adbe67956bf6e8140.source: When approaching the Fountain of Truth, the soundtrack Droknar's Forge will play in place of the usual Krytan soundtracks.
709f6884e41ec38c4f44881adbe67956bf6e8140.text: 当接近真理之泉时，卓克纳熔炉的原声音乐将取代通常的科瑞塔原声音乐。

0ad640ea07db1dc09591c065e421c5c178c054b9.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #2 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
0ad640ea07db1dc09591c065e421c5c178c054b9.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 2 页。

3ea8c4c469ef0fbfc1c2e8ff4116e835b3cd7e54.source: The objectives fail to state that one must talk to Lionguard Minah to complete the bonus. Sometimes the Eye will disappear if you separate too far from a human companion you're running the mission with.
3ea8c4c469ef0fbfc1c2e8ff4116e835b3cd7e54.text: 目标没有规定必须与雄狮卫士米纳交谈才能完成奖励。有时，如果你与一起执行任务的人类同伴距离太远，眼睛就会消失。

94c54107a1005c9e90c35bd2ab2ce51d3d28749d.source: When fighting the Mergoyle Wavebreakers at the cleansing fountain, a White Mantle Abbot, assumed to be running around panicking about the Mergoyles, will intentionally heal them with Heal Other. While up to five chosen are saved during the mission, the end cutscene only has four. The first chosen Villager becomes an ally before acquiring the Eye. Skipping the initial cutscene while the camera is focused on the Fountain of Truth will move Justicar Hablion from his position near the Eye of Janthir to stand by the fountain.
94c54107a1005c9e90c35bd2ab2ce51d3d28749d.text: 当在净化喷泉与墨高尔破波者战斗时，一名白斗篷方丈会因担心墨高尔人而四处奔波，故意用“治愈他人”来治愈他们。虽然在任务期间最多可以保存五个被选中的人，但最终的过场动画只有四个。第一个被选中的村民在获得眼睛之前成为盟友。当镜头聚焦在真理之泉时跳过最初的过场动画会将正义卡哈布利恩从詹瑟尔之眼附近的位置移动到喷泉边。

8cc063e502bbde99c6ee2908851e850c5d307ec4.source: Get the location of Koss and the captured Sunspears from Nerashi in Arkjok Ward.
8cc063e502bbde99c6ee2908851e850c5d307ec4.text: 从阿克乔克区的奈拉什处获取科斯和被俘虏的烈阳之矛的位置。

1917ba5ebaad90689d96791490b652691f67cde5.source: Rescue Koss and the captured Sunspears.
1917ba5ebaad90689d96791490b652691f67cde5.text: 营救科斯和被俘虏的烈阳之矛。

9f05df9a65742b85802e2707deed4608b2a9e523.source: Eliminate the Kournan scout patrols around the perimeter of the garrison.
9f05df9a65742b85802e2707deed4608b2a9e523.text: 消灭要塞周边的库尔南侦察兵巡逻队。

ef4ccaca66a105a66dc2787ed33bfdbc4b9d25fc.source: Kill Commander Kubeh and his elite guards.
ef4ccaca66a105a66dc2787ed33bfdbc4b9d25fc.text: 杀死库贝指挥官和他的精锐卫兵。

41f4658d909b22ead75f2a88e409f538bc73eff4.source: Acolyte of Grenth and Captain Chichor will not spawn in Arkjok Ward while this quest is active.
41f4658d909b22ead75f2a88e409f538bc73eff4.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，格伦斯侍僧和奇克队长不会在阿克约克守卫中生成。

5b1fd226b755e72147b85dbccca27ca4fdc8b6ef.source: Koss will spawn in Command Post after killing Commander Kubeh.
5b1fd226b755e72147b85dbccca27ca4fdc8b6ef.text: 杀死库贝指挥官后，科斯将在指挥所中生成。

f16af832342f12a437da9d1bd93c6584048631eb.source: Talk to Nerashi just outside the Command Post in Arkjok Ward. Follow her directions to the garrison where Koss is being held. You need to eliminate 3 groups of Kournans outside of the garrison, the doors will then open. Once inside you need to kill the group with Commander Kubeh. Talk to Koss then and head back to Lonai to get the reward.
f16af832342f12a437da9d1bd93c6584048631eb.text: 与阿克乔克区指挥所外的奈拉什交谈。按照她的指示前往关押科斯的驻军。你需要消灭驻军外的3组库南人，大门才会打开。进入后你需要和库贝指挥官一起杀死这群人。然后与科斯交谈并返回洛奈以获得奖励。

ee9f2923d4ecae11f49ec6016fe35a49fd6d6328.source: It is not actually necessary to talk to Nerashi, you can go straight to Koss (and from a closer outpost, as well), and free him.
ee9f2923d4ecae11f49ec6016fe35a49fd6d6328.text: 实际上没有必要与奈拉什交谈，你可以直接前往科斯（也可以从更近的前哨站）并释放他。

ca3171bfb30b2f121238beda4aea7279fee92a5a.source: Koss is level 2 and has no skills in this quest.
ca3171bfb30b2f121238beda4aea7279fee92a5a.text: Koss 等级为 2，在该任务中没有技能。

98d13785e4302d538dbd296cb65cd2dd717c15ca.source: Once freed, Koss will start dancing and the Sunspear Refugees will do the cheer emote.
98d13785e4302d538dbd296cb65cd2dd717c15ca.text: 获释后，科斯将开始跳舞，阳矛难民将做出欢呼表情。

9edf83329ea406dfe99ffb3179d5c97a7b569739.source: After receiving the reward for this quest, Koss will become available again.
9edf83329ea406dfe99ffb3179d5c97a7b569739.text: 收到该任务的奖励后，科斯将再次可用。

e610991d28c2c12a531443efbe8fdf99138be635.source: Exiting the east gate after talking to Koss leads to another small group of Kournans and the entrance to Pogahn Passage. You can take this opportunity to unlock this outpost.
e610991d28c2c12a531443efbe8fdf99138be635.text: 与科斯交谈后离开东门会到达另一小群库南人和波甘通道的入口。你可以借此机会解锁这个前哨站。

96c2f3fcacf051ee5e1bb85cfa8d4b9954d6c4ea.source: Search for Kai Ying in Panjiang Peninsula.

2de725454a7e34d125a5b8b3da47852088efa10e.source: Kai Ying can be found just south of Kaitan Village.

ab00e30b604b9c768671b8a82a83b26d5d61dde4.source: Gain the rank of Sunspear General (2,500) or be a leader Kormir recruited from a foreign land. To gain promotion points, talk to Kournan priests to earn the respect of the Kournan people.
ab00e30b604b9c768671b8a82a83b26d5d61dde4.text: 获得烈阳之矛将军军衔（2,500）或成为从异国招募的科米尔领袖。要获得晋升积分，请与库尔南牧师交谈，赢得库尔南人民的尊重。

97cfbea8aa5ae2d68d0309a455494ebdaf86fb29.source: Speak to Koss in the Command Post at the Sunspear Sanctuary.
97cfbea8aa5ae2d68d0309a455494ebdaf86fb29.text: 与阳矛庇护所指挥所的科斯交谈。

f4ffa83d6a1b437fa604579d512c3c8a5b9f1393.text: 营救剩余的烈阳之矛部队。

59ac6108f8af586d43673c3047210411d3355f6e.source: Watch out for long-range Kournan spotters.
59ac6108f8af586d43673c3047210411d3355f6e.text: 留意远距离的库南观察员。

10c2afcf67c2675da1e4fe42bdd7c7a24ddb5955.source: When playing a Nightfall character, you must be a Sunspear General (2,500 Sunspear Promotion Points) before you can continue with this quest.
10c2afcf67c2675da1e4fe42bdd7c7a24ddb5955.text: 当扮演 Nightfall 角色时，您必须成为阳矛将军（2,500 阳矛晋升点）才能继续此任务。

f0f6f67017a7daced44aabeff719dadb4fd1164d.source: By the time you reach this quest, you will likely have achieved the rank of Sunspear Commander (1,000 Sunspear Promotion Points). The following table provides a list of quests near the Sunspear Sanctuary that can be performed to gain enough points to move forward with this quest. Most characters can skip the quests highlighted in pink related to The Dejarin Estate unless you need more than 1,200 additional points.
f0f6f67017a7daced44aabeff719dadb4fd1164d.text: 当您完成此任务时，您很可能已经获得阳矛指挥官的军衔（1,000 阳矛晋升点）。下表提供了阳矛圣殿附近的任务列表，执行这些任务可以获得足够的积分来继续执行此任务。大多数角色可以跳过与德贾林庄园相关的粉红色突出显示的任务，除非您需要超过 1,200 点额外积分。

cc2395d5939a8c45804847af64c57752c74fc990.source: You can also refer to the Guide to farming Sunspear promotion points if you are short a few hundred points.
cc2395d5939a8c45804847af64c57752c74fc990.text: 如果你还缺几百点，也可以参考《阳矛升级指南》的耕种指南。

caaea51fe52283d83554a050c7b3e3a9a78b8409.source: Take Koss as one hero and go into the Sunward Marches. You will see the first pair of Sunspears. Defeat the Kournan Guards to rescue them. Go northwest and afterwards straight north to rescue the next two pairs. Watch out for sentry traps as they will cause 100 armor-ignoring damage to anyone in the area every 5 seconds. Talk to Commander Suha in the northeast to gain access to Venta Cemetery.
caaea51fe52283d83554a050c7b3e3a9a78b8409.text: 以科斯为英雄之一，前往向阳进军。 You will see the first pair of Sunspears. Defeat the Kournan Guards to rescue them.向西北走，然后一直向北去营救接下来的两对。小心哨兵陷阱，因为它们每 5 秒会对区域内的任何人造成 100 点无视护甲伤害。与东北方的苏哈指挥官交谈，即可进入文塔墓地。

28d6df4ed82960d928e9b95b8e4c11c661fa4702.source: Only one Captured Sunspear has to survive to complete the quest.
28d6df4ed82960d928e9b95b8e4c11c661fa4702.text: 只有一名被俘获的烈阳之矛必须存活下来才能完成任务。

cf112b67e88b65fa69e9274dfba57711e03fff05.source: A Nightfall character can complete this quest without the rank of Sunspear General if that character is in a party with another character who also has the quest and has the rank of Sunspear General or is a Factions or Prophecies character. Both characters are teleported to Rojis in Venta Cemetery to accept the reward.
cf112b67e88b65fa69e9274dfba57711e03fff05.text: 黄昏角色可以在没有阳矛将军军衔的情况下完成此任务，前提是该角色与另一个也有该任务且具有阳矛将军军衔的角色所在的队伍或者是派系或预言角色。两个角色都被传送到文塔公墓的罗吉斯接受奖励。

4de258831ceb1c681491529f8013d7d010506a7b.source: During the stage at which Nightfall characters must obtain the rank of Sunspear General, the quest marker will point to the Sunspear Great Hall, despite there being nothing there which will help with the objective.
4de258831ceb1c681491529f8013d7d010506a7b.text: 在《夜幕降临》角色必须获得阳矛将军军衔的阶段，任务标记将指向阳矛大厅，尽管那里没有任何有助于实现目标的东西。

c53e9c5d1d8590821d346fb8127b469ef8650249.source: Can be be completed at the same time as Building the Base: Prisoners of War.
c53e9c5d1d8590821d346fb8127b469ef8650249.text: 可以与建造基地：战俘同时完成。

65eb5dd126e7a40ff5a62b34e3bf511473939e29.source: See Kai Ying for your reward.
65eb5dd126e7a40ff5a62b34e3bf511473939e29.text: See Kai Ying for your reward.

7b226473d465a770a8901cdfa3c01ed5bf1ca52d.source: The combat is direct, and the only objective is to kill. If you have difficulty, nothing prevents you from bringing a full party to help you with this 'duel'.
7b226473d465a770a8901cdfa3c01ed5bf1ca52d.text: 战斗是直接的，唯一的目标就是杀人。如果你遇到困难，没有什么可以阻止你带上完整的队伍来帮助你进行这场“决斗”。

bc57e65bdb8e8184ea124051ffc2c07dae78c9eb.text: 与家族游侠拉纳尔特交谈。

9d12b55e66140872096da4ac6e77f317fc0370f8.text: 与护林员里奥内尔交谈。

8d9418175f10d15a69377d9dd9b663d9547176fb.source: See Witness Giselle for your reward.
8d9418175f10d15a69377d9dd9b663d9547176fb.text: See Witness Giselle for your reward.

7bccf292d9e3fea4cf43248e5961e2d8ce0d2c57.source: Lengthens Poison duration on foes by 33%
7bccf292d9e3fea4cf43248e5961e2d8ce0d2c57.text: Lengthens Poison duration on foes by 33%

6c73cbdb7ec40ed5501bd8559ab8263d3cb7c34d.source: Reduces Poison duration on you by 20%
6c73cbdb7ec40ed5501bd8559ab8263d3cb7c34d.text: Reduces Poison duration on you by 20%

95dfa21822e864107f5adbacf979a23a7b52c3f9.text: 黑暗伤害：9-16（需要 5 血魔法）

74a85a334fe7dd11128711c1889ec17fa8768a03.text: 法术技能回复减半（几率：5%）

1b3e74bb0bc756abe1632c5554f272eba34b832a.source: Exit Druid's Overlook into Sage Lands and speak with Justiciar Thommis. The quest markers will then lead you to each of his rangers in turn as you travel northwest. Speak with each of them to continue the quest. After speaking with Rionel, continue on to Witness Giselle in The Wilds; you may map travel straight there if you have already been to the outpost. Near the entrance of the outpost, Saidra and the Chosen Villagers will appear on the radar and as allies in the party window. Follow them into the outpost.
1b3e74bb0bc756abe1632c5554f272eba34b832a.text: 离开德鲁伊瞭望台进入贤者之地并与审判官托米斯交谈。当你向西北行进时，任务标记将依次引导你找到他的每个游侠。与他们每个人交谈以继续任务。与里奥内尔交谈后，继续前往荒野中见证吉赛尔；如果您已经去过前哨站，您可以直接在那里绘制旅行地图。在前哨站入口附近，赛德拉和被选中的村民将出现在雷达上，并作为盟友出现在队伍窗口中。跟着他们进入前哨站。

d55b7a38de213ab94c20d44e6b4415ba3381d46c.source: Having this quest active but not completed and entering the area from The Wilds (outpost), you can meet Saidra. If you have the assassin skill Recall equipped you can get past the zone into the outpost. After a short jog, Saidra and the chosen disappear.
d55b7a38de213ab94c20d44e6b4415ba3381d46c.text: 激活此任务但未完成并从荒野（前哨站）进入该区域，您可以遇到 Saidra。如果你装备了刺客技能召回，你就可以穿过该区域进入前哨站。短暂的慢跑后，赛德拉和被选中的人消失了。

96edb6e31c5efbcafda76b7ec05801263c6dd402.source: The Longbow from this quest reward is itself not salvageable, but the Poisonous Bowstring on it can be salvaged. Not to mention the Longbow is actually a Flatbow unlike the namesake, which can lead to some confusion if you miss reading the weapon type info.
96edb6e31c5efbcafda76b7ec05801263c6dd402.text: 该任务奖励中的长弓本身是不可回收的，但其上的毒弓弦是可以回收的。更不用说长弓实际上是一把与同名弓不同的平弓，如果您错过阅读武器类型信息，可能会导致一些混乱。

8b4d78f7afc82d2ce6efec96762099cbd7490b09.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for And a Hero Shall Lead Them.
8b4d78f7afc82d2ce6efec96762099cbd7490b09.text: 所有党员必须接受“英雄当领导他们”的奖励。

ffb2cf577e0fd6bb3652860321e55598d9695c78.source: Lead the Sunspear Evacuees to Dajkah Inlet without being discovered by the garrison.
ffb2cf577e0fd6bb3652860321e55598d9695c78.text: 带领烈阳之矛撤离者在不被驻军发现的情况下前往达吉卡湾。

14918ab164771098a6bb70e42842347f8a9facf0.source: Kill all the guards at the garrison posts before they sound an alert and blow your cover.
14918ab164771098a6bb70e42842347f8a9facf0.text: 在他们发出警报并揭穿你的掩护之前杀死驻军哨所的所有守卫。

b509d2807a0091482a4f7e99f40c0f39b6eeb834.source: Disarm the sentry traps before they discharge.
b509d2807a0091482a4f7e99f40c0f39b6eeb834.text: 在哨兵陷阱发射前解除它们的武装。

2876b096037634eaa912e65096ec4f2ccc9318fd.source: Start negotiations with Margrid the Sly.
2876b096037634eaa912e65096ec4f2ccc9318fd.text: 开始与狡猾的玛格丽德谈判。

8b3a282218727ae3411408a79af5f8390981fb41.text:
