b935315c6adda615c1b798807163e2ffcfff6c39.source: Your goal is simple: bring at least one of the eight Sunspear Evacuees to the coast at the opposite side of the map for evacuation. You can do this by avoiding or removing threats along the way. Since each of the evacuees is a monk, they are generally capable of healing themselves, although you should keep an eye on their health.
b935315c6adda615c1b798807163e2ffcfff6c39.text: 你的目标很简单：将八名烈阳之矛撤离者中的至少一名带到地图另一侧的海岸进行疏散。您可以通过避免或消除一路上的威胁来做到这一点。由于每个撤离者都是僧侣，因此他们通常能够自我治愈，但您应该留意他们的健康状况。

7230f40e1f6d4339ac4c47aa3c4e911a08423cea.source: Your task is complicated by four factors: patrols, Sentry Traps, guard posts, and the garrison:
7230f40e1f6d4339ac4c47aa3c4e911a08423cea.text: 你的任务因四个因素而变得复杂：巡逻、哨兵陷阱、哨所和驻军：

362e012b87bf87dd3bc92f608c2de2cd49066a1a.source: Patrols: The area is littered with Kournan military patrols. Avoid over-aggroing them, especially in hard mode.
362e012b87bf87dd3bc92f608c2de2cd49066a1a.text: 巡逻队：该地区遍布库尔南军事巡逻队。避免过度攻击他们，尤其是在困难模式下。

fba0ebf69b92c5c72c7d7e126bcf6f72e984f7ea.source: Sentry Traps dot the area (there is one close to nearly every guard post). As you approach, a bar timer appears to indicate a 5-second window within which you can use the Disarm Trap skill to disable it. If it activates, it will inflict 100 damage to all your allies in its area. Since the skill is easily interrupted, make sure that the Kournan rangers are targeted other members of the party before attempting to activate it. Anybody in the party - not just a player - can activate it. Activating the Disarm Trap skill while the timer is still running is enough to successfully deactivate the trap, unless Disarm Trap is interrupted.
fba0ebf69b92c5c72c7d7e126bcf6f72e984f7ea.text: 哨兵陷阱遍布该区域（几乎每个哨所附近都有一个）。当您接近时，会出现一个计时器，指示您可以在 5 秒的时间内使用解除陷阱技能来禁用它。如果它激活，它将对其区域内的所有盟友造成 100 点伤害。由于该技能很容易被打断，因此在尝试激活该技能之前，请确保库南游骑兵已瞄准队伍中的其他成员。队伍中的任何人 - 不仅仅是玩家 - 都可以激活它。在计时器仍在运行时激活解除陷阱技能足以成功解除陷阱，除非解除陷阱被打断。

a1f734aa39edb617bd103811ddc56703a5f69435.source: Twelve guard posts are located throughout this mission; they are marked on the map by a red flag if active and gray one if neutralized. If you approach and do not kill the guards quickly enough, you will be targeted by siege attacks. A progress bar indicates the amount of time you have, with different colors to indicate how rapidly they expire — from fastest to slowest, they are: red, blue, teal, green and gray.
a1f734aa39edb617bd103811ddc56703a5f69435.text: 整个任务区设有 12 个哨所；如果它们处于活动状态，则它们在地图上会标有红旗；如果被中和，则标有灰色旗。如果你接近但没有足够快地杀死守卫，你将成为围攻攻击的目标。进度条指示您拥有的时间量，并用不同的颜色指示它们过期的速度 - 从最快到最慢，它们是：红色、蓝色、青色、绿色和灰色。

3b860f4e31fa50fcf78e29fd7f6cecc36433f6ab.source: Morzek Garrison is the fort in the middle of the area; it is marked on the map by a red door. Moving too close will prompt a warning to avoid moving closer; if ignored, your team will be targeted by a massive siege attack, resulting in at least 600 area of effect (AoE) damage and almost certain loss of your evacuees (and consequently, mission failure). (You will not receive a warning if you have turned off Mission Progress via the Interface tab of the options panel.) The rest of the mission is fairly straight-forward. It is this mechanism that can cause players to have to repeatedly restart the mission as the warning does not give enough time to leave the attack range.
3b860f4e31fa50fcf78e29fd7f6cecc36433f6ab.text: 莫泽克要塞是该地区中部的堡垒；它在地图上被一扇红色的门标记。距离太近会提示警告，避免靠近；如果忽视，您的团队将成为大规模围攻攻击的目标，造成至少 600 范围（AoE）的伤害，并且几乎肯定会造成撤离人员的损失（因此任务失败）。 （如果您通过选项面板的“界面”选项卡关闭了“任务进度”，您将不会收到警告。）任务的其余部分相当简单。正是这种机制可能会导致玩家不得不反复重新启动任务，因为警告没有给玩家足够的时间离开攻击范围。

0991896f6a34fecfd2f9e6c05aec138dbb1538db.source: The fastest and safest route is to go along the the northern wall of the area and proceed west until you cannot go any farther, reaching the northwest corner of the map. From there, head south until you find Margrid the Sly. Talk to her to complete the mission.
0991896f6a34fecfd2f9e6c05aec138dbb1538db.text: 最快、最安全的路线是沿着该地区的北墙向西行进，直到无法再往前走，到达地图的西北角。从那里向南走，直到找到狡猾的玛格丽特。与她对话即可完成任务。

046a6ac91ae988f3199cfd2b50ee634281098969.source: Skipping the bonus reduces the length of the mission by 66% (e.g. less than ten minutes instead of 30 minutes).
046a6ac91ae988f3199cfd2b50ee634281098969.text: 跳过奖励会使任务长度缩短 66%（例如，少于 10 分钟而不是 30 分钟）。

4fcb8a12719ddd710747298895a6c819190e6092.source: The bonus is straight-forward but time-consuming: follow the suggested route to neutralize each of the 12 guard posts, periodically reviewing the mission map (default key: [U]) to ensure that each post's flag has turned gray. You get credit for the bonus regardless of whether you neutralize a post before or after they call for a siege attack, although obviously it is safer to avoid the extra AoE damage.
4fcb8a12719ddd710747298895a6c819190e6092.text: 奖励很简单，但很耗时：按照建议的路线消灭 12 个哨所中的每一个，定期检查任务地图（默认键：[U]）以确保每个哨所的旗帜变成灰色。无论你是在他们要求围攻攻击之前还是之后消灭一个帖子，你都会获得奖励，尽管显然避免额外的 AoE 伤害更安全。

e3f059a4811a015d3ae253f9c0d5455ad2b61f7c.source: The only difference for hard mode is that it can be fatal to over-aggro, especially near the guard towers. Be sure to avoid or destroy nearby patrols before approaching the towers.
e3f059a4811a015d3ae253f9c0d5455ad2b61f7c.text: 困难模式的唯一区别是过度仇恨可能是致命的，尤其是在守卫塔附近。在接近塔楼之前，请务必避开或摧毁附近的巡逻队。

ee6ca843876b83978eaf1d2421d327043a6860ce.source: Area damage over time against guard posts, as mobs tend to stay bunched together.
ee6ca843876b83978eaf1d2421d327043a6860ce.text: 随着时间的推移，对哨所的区域造成损害，因为暴民往往聚集在一起。

efcf3c60d69e35d7002d9dfd595c2ad813c85aa9.source: There are enough corpses for 3 (or more) minion masters.
efcf3c60d69e35d7002d9dfd595c2ad813c85aa9.text: 有足够 3 个（或更多）小兵大师的尸体。

367bac4c918c295450bc2b6e4dd5caa546bdf8eb.source: Kournan Bowmen use Infuriating Heat and Whirling Defense; bring stance-removal skills, skills that bypass blocking, or skills that punish blocking. You are unlikely to need Skills that increase adrenaline gain.
367bac4c918c295450bc2b6e4dd5caa546bdf8eb.text: 库南弓箭手使用真气热力和旋转防御；带来移除姿态的技能、绕过阻挡的技能或惩罚阻挡的技能。您不太可能需要增加肾上腺素增益的技能。

6bcd6690a6a42d16a706829190fdadd808567fd5.source: The evacuees are all minor healers; consider bringing less healing and more damage, control, or utility skills.
6bcd6690a6a42d16a706829190fdadd808567fd5.text: 撤离者都是小治疗师；考虑减少治疗量并增加伤害、控制或实用技能。

cf6a1e211cbbd226f70863ed0e5f18e71a0ed5cf.source: Since the evacuees all wield staves, their attacks will trigger the many Kournan Bowmen's Whirling Defense, potentially causing heavy damage to melee attackers on your team.
cf6a1e211cbbd226f70863ed0e5f18e71a0ed5cf.text: 由于撤离者都挥舞着法杖，他们的攻击将触发许多库南弓箭手的旋转防御，可能会对你团队中的近战攻击者造成严重伤害。

4a5007eb63ea2c8006d7077da7286f50664019ef.source: Speed boosts reduce the amount of time spent wandering, especially when keeping evacuees out of harm's way.
4a5007eb63ea2c8006d7077da7286f50664019ef.text: 速度提升可以减少徘徊的时间，尤其是在让疏散人员免受伤害时。

4e5cabaf5f91eeadd2ac48c9ff8a107cf5ac525b.source: Since it's not necessary to clear the guard posts, you can complete the mission without any fighting, and only receive a Standard reward.
4e5cabaf5f91eeadd2ac48c9ff8a107cf5ac525b.text: 由于不需要清除岗哨，所以无需任何战斗即可完成任务，并且只获得标准奖励。

c502bf2e7ce48591d92e2b7b6e4c95cd250c0d01.source: It is possible to clear the guard posts without starting the detection timer. Just set your melee Heroes to avoid combat, or flag them away and pull the Kournans with a Longbow.
c502bf2e7ce48591d92e2b7b6e4c95cd250c0d01.text: 可以在不启动检测计时器的情况下清除哨所。只需让你的近战英雄避免战斗，或者标记他们并用长弓拉开库尔南。

fe438b99b445823cc1962a0c928263773f26cbbf.source: Talk to Dockmaster Ahlaro for your next primary quest.
fe438b99b445823cc1962a0c928263773f26cbbf.text: 与码头管理员阿赫拉罗交谈以完成你的下一个主要任务。

fe7c0777be7f6ebdc0d206f5967fba6cc00be79b.source: After the completion of this mission, you can arrive at Kamadan, Jewel of Istan with a party larger than that allowed in that outpost (i.e. 4). See Kamadan, Jewel of Istan notes for details.
fe7c0777be7f6ebdc0d206f5967fba6cc00be79b.text: 完成此任务后，您可以带着比该前哨所允许的人数更多的队伍到达伊斯坦之珠卡马丹（即 4 人）。有关详细信息，请参阅卡马丹，伊斯坦宝石注释。

33acc6bf6a83022e1e4b391e0fffc482a843fb03.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #2 in the Night Falls storybook.
33acc6bf6a83022e1e4b391e0fffc482a843fb03.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 2 页。

f98f9106a573dba6f18c649ee0a00f063c7bcf52.source: If you fail to neutralize a guard post before your position is given away, the map marker will not change color. However, your quest log will still count it as neutralized. Guard Post Commanders may fail to spawn at guard posts. When all other enemies are slain it still counts as neutralized, but the timer will run out and incoming siege attacks strike the area after a short delay. Players have reported losing progress towards the Survivor title after dying due to a siege attack (from the fort), even though this type of death is not supposed to count.
f98f9106a573dba6f18c649ee0a00f063c7bcf52.text: 如果你在你的位置被泄露之前未能摧毁岗哨，地图标记将不会改变颜色。然而，你的任务日志仍会将其视为无效。哨所指挥官可能无法在哨所生成。当所有其他敌人都被杀死时，它仍然算作中和，但计时器将耗尽，传入的围攻攻击会在短暂的延迟后袭击该区域。玩家报告称，由于（来自堡垒的）围攻攻击而死亡后，他们失去了获得幸存者称号的进度，尽管这种类型的死亡不应该被计算在内。

1594be3e4a4c01739825f3c6a583009958ba6232.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 主要职业：刺客

ce8dd3b1bab4b032127872fb80fe9a6422af0cc2.source: Talk to Ludo to gain entrance into the monastery.
ce8dd3b1bab4b032127872fb80fe9a6422af0cc2.text: 与卢多交谈即可进入修道院。

962f31ff322c7ee82f874fc073503c95651136b2.source: Seek out Headmaster Lee in the monastery.

8334d9589e8d6ffed7033e6e4525e8571d35dbcc.source: gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a Starter Daggers after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Lee, who is nearby, for your reward.
8334d9589e8d6ffed7033e6e4525e8571d35dbcc.text: 获得2000经验，进入修道院后获得入门匕首。如果您完成了教程，您就已经收到了这些。与附近的李校长交谈以获得奖励。

a2f1ccef4727197554316471d52f87a4dec4f47a.source: Give your report of the assault to the consulate.
a2f1ccef4727197554316471d52f87a4dec4f47a.text: 向领事馆报告袭击事件。

f0302f139c137df0bc55fe4fa8e9ba1fc829b9bc.source: Give your report to Elder Nahlo.
f0302f139c137df0bc55fe4fa8e9ba1fc829b9bc.text: 将你的报告交给纳洛长老。

cf322e7fa352304ee6587274150286a6c9e8b168.source: Find Elder Dahut and make your report.
cf322e7fa352304ee6587274150286a6c9e8b168.text: 找到达胡特长老并进行报告。

69dcf859a22f5e0bfe318bc74f7fbed70958e64a.source: See Elder Suhl for your reward.
69dcf859a22f5e0bfe318bc74f7fbed70958e64a.text: 去找苏尔长老领取奖励。

47ee69c54f1581639830973b7774432d3542929e.source: Walk through the portal into the Consulate and talk to each of the three elders.
47ee69c54f1581639830973b7774432d3542929e.text: 穿过传送门进入领事馆，与三位长老分别交谈。

b8e0fab7a143027dcb06a7bb5da0db037de931a1.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Sage Lands and start the mission.
b8e0fab7a143027dcb06a7bb5da0db037de931a1.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从圣人之地走进前哨站并开始任务。

03475c10a26c9583f543c0099b820d2710f45dd0.source: Hunt down the Shining Blade kidnappers, and rescue the Chosen they have taken hostage.
03475c10a26c9583f543c0099b820d2710f45dd0.text: 追捕光刃绑匪，并营救被他们扣为人质的神选者。

b1daaec4a0983d02f0c20d8b41a7fa1f24cab817.source: Discover how the Shining Blade navigates the jungle.
b1daaec4a0983d02f0c20d8b41a7fa1f24cab817.text: 了解光刃如何在丛林中航行。

c675dafadc86e72cae34805750a7eeb3d7b798b8.source: This mission is one long trek through the jungle, with confusing branching paths and a wide variety of enemies along the way. Start out heading north and join a pair of White Mantle Knights heading into a clearing. Here you will meet the first of several Entangling Roots. When approached, these creatures will trigger the appearance of a gate of vines at each entrance to the clearing, cutting off your retreat and potentially stranding party members outside. They are also surrounded by hidden spawns including multiple Life Pods, which can make killing them a chore even with the White Mantle's help. Consider keeping back any warriors in the group to avoid triggering all of the popups at once. The vine gate does not block line of sight, and is not triggered by pets, minions, or your White Mantle allies. All gates disappear as soon as the Entangling Roots is killed.
c675dafadc86e72cae34805750a7eeb3d7b798b8.text: 这项任务是一次穿越丛林的长途跋涉，沿途有令人困惑的分支路径和各种各样的敌人。开始向北行驶，与一对白斗篷骑士一起前往一片空地。在这里你会遇到几个纠缠根中的第一个。当接近时，这些生物会在空地的每个入口处触发藤蔓门的出现，切断你的退路，并可能将队伍成员困在外面。它们还被隐藏的产卵所包围，其中包括多个生命舱，即使有白斗篷的帮助，杀死它们也变得一件苦差事。考虑保留队伍中的任何战士，以避免同时触发所有弹出窗口。藤蔓之门不会阻挡视线，也不会被宠物、小兵或你的白斗篷盟友触发。一旦缠结根被杀死，所有的门就会消失。

53eacf30c90973b26dd405f13e0f87e3451fecfd.source: As soon as everything is dead, the White Mantle will continue into the next clearing to the west, where there are multiple exits and converging patrols of Moss Scarabs. You might notice a Shining Blade Scout shouting and running deeper into the jungle; you do not have to catch these scouts, but take note of them, as they will always indicate the correct route to take. When in doubt, follow the map. Take the middle westward road along with any surviving White Mantle Knights; all three paths lead to an Entangling Roots, but on the correct path you will also see a boss ahead on the far side, which also has some hidden scarabs around it. Past the boss, you will come to an overlook where a cutscene will trigger, showing a Shining Blade Scout on another path creating a vine bridge to cross the gorge.
53eacf30c90973b26dd405f13e0f87e3451fecfd.text: 一旦一切都消失了，白斗篷就会继续进入西边的下一个空地，那里有多个出口和苔藓圣甲虫的巡逻队。您可能会注意到一名光刃侦察兵大喊着跑进丛林深处；你不必抓住这些侦察兵，但要记下他们，因为他们总是会指示正确的路线。如有疑问，请按照地图操作。与幸存的白斗篷骑士一起走中西路；所有三个路径都通向纠缠根，但在正确的路径上，你还会在远端看到一个 Boss，它周围也有一些隐藏的圣甲虫。经过老板，你会来到一个观景台，在那里会触发一个过场动画，显示一个光刃侦察兵在另一条路上建造了一座跨越峡谷的藤桥。

6cddba218fda7bac5c48dc0abefe2a7ab1160e48.source: The White Mantle Knights will give up here, but continue north and you will find numerous Centaurs ahead. The Shining Blade Scouts will indicate a path to the left, and you can cut across here, but pay attention to the Centaur patrols, some of which move quite fast and can easily catch your party from behind. Their rangers also leave Flame Traps and spirits of Symbiosis while moving; triggering the traps or attacking the spirit will aggro the group. It may be safer and easier to continue northeast a way before turning back to the west, especially if you are attempting the bonus.
6cddba218fda7bac5c48dc0abefe2a7ab1160e48.text: 白斗篷骑士团会在这里放弃，但继续向北，你会发现前面有许多半人马。光刃斥候会向左指示一条路径，你可以从这里抄过去，但要注意半人马巡逻队，其中一些移动速度相当快，可以轻松从后面追上你的队伍。他们的游侠在移动时也会留下火焰陷阱和共生之灵；触发陷阱或攻击灵魂会激怒团队。在返回西边之前继续向东北走一段路可能会更安全、更容易，尤其是当您尝试获得奖励时。

78aa6c651cff3045dcd0f0ced5f9eb00362c5ce8.source: You will reach the bridge created by the Shining Blade before, and on the far side the enemies will change again, with Wind Riders and Jungle Trolls becoming prevalent. The path forks ahead, with two paths in front and a bridge behind; take the right path ahead, and it will lead you to the last Entangling Roots. This time there are no hidden foes, but numerous visible ones which should be pulled out of the clearing before you engage. Turn sharply northeast and you will soon reach the water. From here on, you will be encountering hidden Maguuma Spiders frequently. Follow the Shining Blade Scouts down the southward turn of the stream, and when you encounter one last random boss, turn to the west.
78aa6c651cff3045dcd0f0ced5f9eb00362c5ce8.text: 你将到达之前由光辉之刃创建的桥梁，而在远端，敌人将再次发生变化，风骑士和丛林巨魔变得普遍。前方有岔路，前有两条路，后有一座桥；走正确的路，它会带你到达最后的纠缠根。这次没有隐藏的敌人，而是许多可见的敌人，在交战之前应该将它们从空地上拉出来。急转向东北，很快就会到达水面。从现在开始，你将经常遇到隐藏的迈古玛蜘蛛。跟随光刃侦察兵沿着溪流向南转弯，当你遇到最后一个随机 Boss 时，转向西边。

05aadea3631f9b28a5ae6c6cabb2bb53a4e62cc9.source: After a short journey, you will see the Chosen under attack by spiders, so move in and fight through several spider waves culminating in the boss Kezra Spindleweb. They are not very threatening, and Evennia will be healing you from the overlook, so you should have little trouble. As soon as the spiders are all dead, the mission is complete.
05aadea3631f9b28a5ae6c6cabb2bb53a4e62cc9.text: 短暂的旅程后，你会看到选民受到蜘蛛的攻击，因此进入并与几波蜘蛛战斗，最终在 Boss Kezra Spindleweb 中达到高潮。它们并没有太大的威胁，埃文尼亚会在俯瞰中治愈你，所以你应该不会遇到什么麻烦。一旦蜘蛛全部死亡，任务就完成了。

acbde2b35b20ea4392f82510bf6c42882c479a4c.source: The bonus requires that you defeat two Centaur bosses. Instead of following the White Mantle, head south after proceeding past the first Entangling Root. You will find two Centaurs talking to each other (point 1), do not attack them yet; doing so will cause the bonus objective to be incompletable. To initiate the bonus, you have to eavesdrop on their conversation. After their dialogue finishes with the line "I will guard Ramtha Brokenhoof and Horm Frostrider with my life.", kill them. Pick up the Vine Seed that eventually appears by the glowing plants, which is needed to reach the two Centaur chieftains. You can drop the Vine Seed during combat; it will grow branches, knocking down adjacent foes and dealing 20 damage, and finally it will return to bundle form. Carry this item and backtrack to the middle road again.
acbde2b35b20ea4392f82510bf6c42882c479a4c.text: 奖励要求您击败两个半人马首领。不要沿着白斗篷走，而是在经过第一个纠缠根之后向南走。你会发现两个半人马正在互相交谈（第1点），先不要攻击他们；这样做会导致奖励目标无法完成。要启动奖金，你必须窃听他们的谈话。当他们的对话结束并说出“我将用我的生命守护拉姆萨·断蹄和霍姆·霜行者”时，杀死他们。捡起发光植物最终出现的藤蔓种子，这是到达两个半人马酋长所需要的。你可以在战斗中掉落藤蔓种子；它会长出树枝，击倒相邻的敌人并造成 20 点伤害，最后会恢复成束状。携带此物品并再次原路返回中路。

cd0e0c08067ce2afbd3d1d93bdd127a0ad208ff3.source: After fighting the roaming Centaurs, take a detour again to the east (point 2). Place the Vine Seed over the round mark to form a bridge. Head South to where you will find the two Centaur chieftains (point 3): Ramtha Brokenhoof and Horm Frostrider. You can use the high-ground advantage of the entry slope to pull separate groups of Centaurs. Two other centaur bosses will spawn close to your objective bosses, so be careful not to mix them up. After killing Ramtha and Horm, the bonus completion message will display.
cd0e0c08067ce2afbd3d1d93bdd127a0ad208ff3.text: 与漫游的半人马战斗后，再次绕道向东（第2点）。将藤蔓种子放在圆形标记上以形成一座桥。向南走，你会发现两个半人马酋长（第 3 点）：拉姆萨·断蹄和霍姆·霜行者。你可以利用入口斜坡的高地优势来拉动单独的半人马群。另外两个半人马 Boss 会在你的目标 Boss 附近生成，所以要小心不要混淆它们。杀死拉姆萨和霍姆后，将显示奖励完成消息。

b387ae4af298efd6ee8476fa355490af4eee95fa.source: Moss Scarabs use Vampiric Touch, take skills that protect against life stealing (e. g. Shielding Hands).
b387ae4af298efd6ee8476fa355490af4eee95fa.text: 苔藓圣甲虫使用吸血鬼之触，采取防止生命窃取的技能（例如盾手）。

5a98277a030e66c2e0d6c6e90d4fe23cbb828606.source: Life Pods spawn together and heal each other, use anti-caster skills (e. g. Backfire).
5a98277a030e66c2e0d6c6e90d4fe23cbb828606.text: 生命豆荚一起生成并互相治疗，使用反施法者技能（例如逆火）。

03c9c9398738ff691155404afe60f26f1101d17c.source: Enchantment-heavy parties will benefit from the Centaurs' Symbiosis, but be aware that Wind Riders have Shatter Enchantment.
03c9c9398738ff691155404afe60f26f1101d17c.text: 重结咒的队伍将从半人马的共生中受益，但要注意风骑者拥有粉碎结界。

1550c8a04828c153a45cac8b2e3dba88476a557e.source: Favor slashing and fire damage, since Plants (Life Pods and Entangling Roots) are weak to it, and avoid cold damage, as Centaurs have bonus resistance against it.
1550c8a04828c153a45cac8b2e3dba88476a557e.text: 喜欢砍伐和火焰伤害，因为植物（生命豆荚和缠绕根）对此很弱，并避免寒冷伤害，因为半人马对它有额外的抵抗力。

2696ad77088584b69d43ff51dd71d1eb43c7208e.source: Early in the mission, Moss Scarabs with Verata's Gaze present difficulty to a minion master, but you will not encounter any more after the first bridge. Maguuma Enchanters with Blackout, Wind Riders with Arcane Conundrum, and Maguuma Spiders with Punishing Shot threaten healers.
2696ad77088584b69d43ff51dd71d1eb43c7208e.text: 在任务初期，带有维拉塔凝视的苔藓圣甲虫会给小兵大师带来困难，但在第一座桥之后你将不会再遇到。拥有停电的迈古玛附魔师、拥有奥术难题的驭风者和拥有惩罚射击的迈古玛蜘蛛会威胁治疗者。

e6fb6b9b2a15c75f66d30f849b83cf8eaeefdf1a.source: Runic stones are found around the north-east lake.
e6fb6b9b2a15c75f66d30f849b83cf8eaeefdf1a.text: 在东北湖周围发现了符文石。

5a7894392330818602aab50ac96b242282ab5d40.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
5a7894392330818602aab50ac96b242282ab5d40.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 3 页。

0f09d6fb9527ae6f5f1798fa2cf6cccc8fad32e3.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Bloodstone Fen.
0f09d6fb9527ae6f5f1798fa2cf6cccc8fad32e3.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到血石沼泽。

48c778c31c6586f27a0623029ae6b4137311c287.source: In the line "The leaders of the two strongest Centaur tribes are on the verge of an agreement." the word "verge" is sometimes censored by the game's chat filter. It is possible that after destroying an Entangling Roots, the vine wall will vanish but still be impassable, preventing you from progressing with the mission. It is suspected this happens when the Entangling Roots is killed (by other creatures or from a distance) before the wall appears. It is possible that killing both Centaur chieftains will not give credit for completion of the bonus objective. The bonus will have to be repeated in this case, although the mission can still be completed as normal.
48c778c31c6586f27a0623029ae6b4137311c287.text: 一行中“两个最强的半人马部落的领袖即将达成协议。” “边缘”这个词有时会被游戏的聊天过滤器审查。摧毁缠绕树根后，藤蔓墙可能会消失，但仍然无法通行，从而阻止你完成任务。人们怀疑，当缠绕之根在墙壁出现之前被杀死（被其他生物或从远处杀死）时，就会发生这种情况。杀死两个半人马酋长可能不会奖励完成奖励目标。在这种情况下，尽管任务仍然可以正常完成，但必须重复奖励。

b09fba721018450a5839af175d3f7937ea8c9eb6.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Silverwood and start the mission. Completing The Wilds also brings the party here.
b09fba721018450a5839af175d3f7937ea8c9eb6.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从银林走进前哨站并开始任务。完成荒野也将聚会带到这里。

f94af1824feda43d4a1414101392598c135dd03c.source: Seek the truth about the White Mantle.
f94af1824feda43d4a1414101392598c135dd03c.text: 寻找有关白斗篷的真相。

3653256b2b48b50c6d5a584be95d3a48b45a7ba3.source: Locate Blade Scout Ryder. He'll take you to the Bloodstone.
3653256b2b48b50c6d5a584be95d3a48b45a7ba3.text: 找到刀锋侦察兵莱德。他会带你去血石。

962f67e385d8812904dcd995df642cdf073153ef.source: Use the vine bridges to traverse the jungle.

7370a43ac73beb5d9cf76e34bd32d6657e8962cc.source: ADDED: Travel on to the Bloodstone on your own.

1487d2d42754c530343e217470c840b3b263726d.source: ADDED: Avenge the chosen by killing Justiciar Hablion and his personal guards.
1487d2d42754c530343e217470c840b3b263726d.text: 新增：杀死审判官哈布利恩和他的私人卫士，为选民报仇。

3c39ae1fc88f39e627a21e2f94e28862c1fef83b.source: *BONUS* Awaken the Druids while preserving their guardians.
3c39ae1fc88f39e627a21e2f94e28862c1fef83b.text: *奖励* 唤醒德鲁伊，同时保护他们的守护者。

a1d055e841e0f688a1e58912303c4086ad35cd51.source: Players start the mission looking for Blade Scout Ryder and his party. Saidra informs the party that Ryder has gone ahead and drops a Vine Seed. Drop the seed on the designated spot to create a vine bridge. Along the way there are 3 more Vine Seed Flowers (points A and C) which, when clicked, yield a Vine Seed to create bridges at spots marked by a glowing circle on the jungle floor (several of which are marked B on the map).
a1d055e841e0f688a1e58912303c4086ad35cd51.text: 玩家开始寻找刀锋侦察兵莱德和他的队伍的任务。赛德拉通知队伍，莱德已经继续前进并掉落了一颗藤蔓种子。将种子撒在指定地点，形成一座藤桥。沿途还有另外 3 朵藤蔓种子花（A 点和 C 点），点击它们会产生藤蔓种子，可以在丛林地面上以发光圆圈标记的地点（其中有几个在地图上标记为 B）处建造桥梁。

c7ccfe0e18a2282b9c6fc6db43756102f8dacf3f.source: You will be told to find Bloodstone on your own after speaking with Blade Scout Ryder (point D) or after creating the vine bridge at the location where the bonus path (blue) merges back with the mission path. Eventually the party will find itself at the Bloodstone, and must engage Justiciar Hablion upon the stone itself.
c7ccfe0e18a2282b9c6fc6db43756102f8dacf3f.text: 在与刀锋侦察兵莱德（D点）交谈后或在奖励路径（蓝色）与任务路径合并的位置创建藤桥后，你会被告知要自己找到血石。最终，队伍会发现自己来到了血石，并且必须与审判官哈布利安在血石上交战。

b9ae73c361da7da43fa0d96b969ec4b5770adfe4.source: Each Vine Seed Plant produces only one Vine Seed and, when taken, Moss Scarabs popup. The number of Vine Seed Flowers at a location is a good indication of about how many Vine Seeds the party will need to pick up. If your party has fewer than three players, you will have to re-trace ground sometimes. There is a second cluster of Vine Seed Flowers (point C) that is closer to the last bridge. Mobs encountered include Wind Riders, Jungle Trolls, and Moss Scarabs in medium-sized groups so be prepared for Hexes, Conditions, and Melee damage.
b9ae73c361da7da43fa0d96b969ec4b5770adfe4.text: 每个藤蔓植物只能生产一颗藤蔓种子，服用后会弹出苔藓圣甲虫。某个地点的藤蔓种子花的数量可以很好地表明该队伍需要收集多少藤蔓种子。如果你的队伍少于三名玩家，有时你将不得不重新追踪地面。还有第二簇藤籽花（C 点），更靠近最后一座桥。遇到的生物包括中等规模的驭风者、丛林巨魔和苔藓圣甲虫，因此要做好应对六角形、条件和近战伤害的准备。

21edbf3049b11b1fd2265f64350cf17cc642c1d0.source: This mission is not all that difficult if you keep one or two things in mind while completing the main objectives and the bonus. The beginning of the mission follows the formatted run, just kill all foes in your path. Once you reach the Bloodstone, the Curse of the Bloodstone slows the casting of Resurrection skills on allies who perish on the Bloodstone's surface. Instead of charging into the fray, scurry to one side of the stone. Take out the White Mantle Abbot and the fellow with him. Then, run over to the other side of the stone (without going past Justiciar Hablion) and defeat that White Mantle Abbot and his companion. It will make taking out Justiciar Hablion much easier!
21edbf3049b11b1fd2265f64350cf17cc642c1d0.text: 如果您在完成主要目标和奖励时牢记一两件事，那么这个任务并不是那么困难。任务的开始遵循格式化的运行，只需杀死你路径上的所有敌人即可。一旦你到达血石，血石诅咒就会减慢对在血石表面死亡的盟友施放复活技能的速度。不要冲入战斗，而是跑到石头的一侧。干掉白斗篷方丈和他的同伴。然后，跑到石头的另一边（不要越过审判官哈布利恩）并击败白斗篷方丈和他的同伴。这将使消灭审判官哈布利恩变得更加容易！

ff33423a21fbd31530a26231045d7bcf1801b5c7.source: The bonus for this mission is to use Vine Seeds to awaken four Druids so that they, in turn, may awaken the Elder Druid. This must be done without killing any of the Jungle Guardians who protect the sleeping Druids: if even one guardian dies, the bonus is failed and Ravagers are summoned instead. Guardians can easily be killed by accident due to heroes, henchmen, or other NPC allies in the party. Players can use several tactics to manage these allies:
ff33423a21fbd31530a26231045d7bcf1801b5c7.text: 此任务的奖励是使用藤蔓种子唤醒四个德鲁伊，这样他们就可以唤醒长老德鲁伊。必须在不杀死任何保护沉睡的德鲁伊的丛林守护者的情况下完成此操作：即使只有一名守护者死亡，奖励也会失败，并且会召唤掠夺者。守护者很容易因为队伍中的英雄、追随者或其他 NPC 盟友而被意外杀死。玩家可以使用多种策略来管理这些盟友：

6c77b86b4b85195e486416d1207b437b49257873.source: Do not use summoning stones during the mission until the bonus has been completed.
6c77b86b4b85195e486416d1207b437b49257873.text: 在奖励完成之前，请勿在任务期间使用召唤石。

6c774463abf1f16ff90a27030cec58e1131fa4c5.source: Set heroes to Avoid Combat and pets to Heel.
6c774463abf1f16ff90a27030cec58e1131fa4c5.text: 将英雄设置为避免战斗，将宠物设置为跟随。

f4c1a5e21015e4b2c9645bce9b9545187c7fe480.source: Disable hero skills that create minions or offensive binding ritual spirits.
f4c1a5e21015e4b2c9645bce9b9545187c7fe480.text: 禁用创造仆从或进攻性绑定仪式灵魂的英雄技能。

39a918a28e50169d4f3fa425110663055dbe2efe.source: Flag henchmen using the compass to ensure that they run clear of any guardians.
39a918a28e50169d4f3fa425110663055dbe2efe.text: 使用指南针标记追随者，以确保他们避开任何监护人。

d98ad0de2f1574f4d878efd896d40e0851074a6a.source: The bonus is triggered when the party awakens the first Druid (1 on the map) by dropping a Vine Seed on the glowing circle. The first Druid speaks, creates a Vine Bridge and slowly walks across it. The first Druid stops where the Elder Druid is to be summoned (point 4 on the map). Players will find other Vine Seed Plants (2 on the map) near this spot that they can use to awaken the other three Druids (marked 3 on the map). Several Moss Scarabs will also spawn in and around the areas where the druids are to be awakened; these (unlike the Guardians) can safely be killed without endangering the bonus.
d98ad0de2f1574f4d878efd896d40e0851074a6a.text: 当队伍通过将藤蔓种子扔到发光圆圈上唤醒第一个德鲁伊（地图上的 1）时，就会触发奖励。第一个德鲁伊开口说话，创造了一座藤桥并慢慢地走过它。第一个德鲁伊停在召唤长老德鲁伊的地方（地图上的点 4）。玩家会在这个地点附近找到其他藤蔓植物（地图上的 2 个），他们可以用它们来唤醒其他三个德鲁伊（地图上标记为 3）。一些苔藓圣甲虫也会在德鲁伊被唤醒的区域及其周围生成；这些（与守护者不同）可以安全地被杀死，而不会危及奖金。

b1403fa8c87fac341526ad3f2465ab6eca495d84.source: The guardians won't chase very far and they deal low amount of damage. It is relatively safe to simply run past them, which also poses the least risk of accidentally killing them. There is always a nearby "safe" area where the guardians will not pursue, so you can stop and recover without risking a battle with them, although Moss Scarabs will tend to pop up in these areas. The path to the farthest druid in the north has a safe spot by a tree in the western edge. In hard mode, bring a speed boost and projectile protection or your NPCs will get caught in the crossfire from two groups.
b1403fa8c87fac341526ad3f2465ab6eca495d84.text: 守护者不会追得很远，而且造成的伤害也很低。从他们身边跑过去相对安全，意外杀死他们的风险也最小。附近总有一个“安全”区域，守护者不会追击，因此您可以停下来恢复，而不必冒与他们战斗的风险，尽管苔藓圣甲虫往往会出现在这些区域。通往北方最远的德鲁伊的道路在西边的一棵树旁有一个安全的地方。在困难模式下，请提高速度并提供射弹保护，否则您的 NPC 将陷入两支队伍的交火中。

e46f8edff3e18ab08f234dd2ad90015bf6c8f292.source: Once all four Druids have been awakened the Elder Druid will appear. Killing the Jungle Guardians after their appearance no longer affects the bonus, but will still trigger the Ravagers (which are now relatively easy to kill, should you want the experience). Speak to the Elder Druid to complete the bonus. After completing the bonus, the Jungle Guardians will no longer be aggressive (although they will fight back if you attack them).
e46f8edff3e18ab08f234dd2ad90015bf6c8f292.text: 一旦所有四个德鲁伊都被唤醒，长老德鲁伊就会出现。在丛林守护者出现后杀死他们不再影响奖励，但仍然会触发掠夺者（如果你想要体验的话，现在相对容易杀死它们）。与长老德鲁伊交谈以完成奖励。完成奖励后，丛林守护者将不再具有攻击性（尽管如果你攻击他们，他们会反击）。

d2da1e31fed57b58ecff8f462321efc8753d68ac.source: If going via the back route after the bonus (blue on the map), it is not necessary to talk to Blade Scout Ryder to complete the mission.
d2da1e31fed57b58ecff8f462321efc8753d68ac.text: 如果在奖励后走后路（地图上的蓝色），则无需与刀锋侦察兵莱德交谈即可完成任务。

c4a157888d8ed527ae730632af23c1e8aa2cf9c1.source: The first Druid can get stuck on the first pair of Jungle Guardians, a bad chest spawn, or a boulder. You can attempt to free the Druid from the Guardians by pulling them a short distance to the side, until the Druid can pass.
c4a157888d8ed527ae730632af23c1e8aa2cf9c1.text: 第一个德鲁伊可能会卡在第一对丛林守护者、坏箱子或巨石上。您可以尝试将德鲁伊从守护者手中解救出来，方法是将他们拉到侧面一小段距离，直到德鲁伊可以通过。

5710f3d8173063a96b3e5064d451c3a44f5139c1.source: A Druid can get stuck on one of the spirits summoned by the Guardians. You can kill the spirits without failing the bonus.
5710f3d8173063a96b3e5064d451c3a44f5139c1.text: 德鲁伊可能会被守护者召唤的灵魂之一困住。你可以在不失败奖励的情况下杀死灵魂。

c1d38c42d78445092eba8f3f0d22cabf8cd830e7.source: The bonus objective can still be completed by talking to the Elder Druid as long as all four Druids have been spawned prior to the death of any Jungle Guardian, despite notification of the bonus objective having been failed.
c1d38c42d78445092eba8f3f0d22cabf8cd830e7.text: 尽管奖励目标已失败，但只要所有四个德鲁伊在任何丛林守护者死亡之前生成，奖励目标仍然可以通过与长老德鲁伊交谈来完成。

4fda8b231ab84708090b2fc8887cc499197a4b4f.source: You do not have to talk to Blade Scout Ryder as it states in the mission objectives — the mission can still be completed if you ignore him.
4fda8b231ab84708090b2fc8887cc499197a4b4f.text: 你不必像任务目标中所述那样与刀锋侦察兵莱德交谈——如果你忽略他，任务仍然可以完成。

36a2f9fc360421e83994454eb0c9c015ab1aefae.source: If you drop the Vine Seeds in the wrong location, they will try to sprout a bridge, fail, and then return to their original state. (Picking them up a second time will not generate Moss Scarabs.)
36a2f9fc360421e83994454eb0c9c015ab1aefae.text: 如果你将藤蔓种子扔到错误的位置，它们会尝试长出一座桥，失败，然后恢复到原来的状态。 （第二次拾取它们不会生成苔藓圣甲虫。）

91a4c270f95deff67b21525d45b5ede1551b9f58.source: When a Vine Seed sprouts, it deals 20 damage to adjacent foes and knocks them down. The extra Vine Seeds throughout the mission can be kept to be used for combat in this manner.
91a4c270f95deff67b21525d45b5ede1551b9f58.text: 当藤蔓种子发芽时，会对邻近的敌人造成 20 点伤害并将他们击倒。整个任务中多余的藤蔓种子可以通过这种方式保留下来用于战斗。

3fb4b174238a29585751489b06d3d7dc0e737d39.source: To make it slightly easier to navigate, you can drop an item on either side of the bridge. When you want to return to the bridge (to gather more seeds, for example), target the item (default key: ;) and follow (default key: space); the game will take you on the most efficient route to the item.
3fb4b174238a29585751489b06d3d7dc0e737d39.text: 为了使导航更容易一些，您可以将一个项目放在桥的两侧。当您想要返回桥时（例如，收集更多种子），请瞄准该项目（默认键：;）并跟随（默认键：空格）；游戏将带您走上获取物品的最有效路线。

c9ccbb67f938fd944f823abddd70e18b56f1d42f.source: Complete exploration of this mission, including the bonus, contributes approximately 1.35% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. To fully explore the area before the final cinematic, first follow the White Mantle Abbot and White Mantle Knight on each side, as noted above, but then run past Justiciar Hablion to the rear of the Bloodstone and follow the trail until it ends, then return and dispatch Hablion.
c9ccbb67f938fd944f823abddd70e18b56f1d42f.text: 完成此任务的探索，包括奖金，为泰尔制图师头衔贡献约 1.35%。要在最终过场动画之前充分探索该地区，首先如上所述，跟随两侧的白斗篷方丈和白斗篷骑士，然后跑过审判者哈布利恩到血石的后方，沿着小路直到尽头，然后返回并消灭哈布利恩。

68bcd14697397dd1ff834c43dd3489f3a1deb995.source: There is an area on the northern end of the Bloodstone, near the right side of the trail mentioned above, where you can climb up the wall a ways.
68bcd14697397dd1ff834c43dd3489f3a1deb995.text: 鸡血石的北端有一个区域，靠近上面提到的小路的右侧，你可以在那里爬上一段路。

704a52887525cf8d8ed3890c108a7c2f8095a720.source: The Vine Seed Flower at point A yields 3 Vine Seeds: 2 for mission path continuation, 1 for yellow bonus path. The Vine Seed Flower near point 4 yields 5 Vine Seeds.
704a52887525cf8d8ed3890c108a7c2f8095a720.text: A 点的藤蔓种子花会产生 3 颗藤蔓种子：2 颗用于任务路径延续，1 颗用于黄色奖励路径。点 4 附近的藤蔓种子花会产生 5 个藤蔓种子。

3c5ac4c77c148f2fe2798fec8eb94998813df63f.source: In the last cinematic, you see the back of Markis, who is presumed to be the person who informed Confessor Dorian of Justiciar Hablion's demise.
3c5ac4c77c148f2fe2798fec8eb94998813df63f.text: 在上一部电影中，你可以看到马基斯的背影，他被认为是向忏悔者多里安通报正义哈布利恩死亡的人。

b521a3019b3716b5a6b36343f87bc48e78e87f16.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #4 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
b521a3019b3716b5a6b36343f87bc48e78e87f16.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 4 页。

ea02fb53d58d76bb932834202046ad01380b9111.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Quarrel Falls.
ea02fb53d58d76bb932834202046ad01380b9111.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被传送到夸雷尔瀑布。

704d0ef86c806335baf4a46a7728caef7edf9d07.source: Headmaster Lee will teach you the following skills upon accepting the quest:
704d0ef86c806335baf4a46a7728caef7edf9d07.text: 接受任务后，李校长将教你以下技能：

739f7586433ffe7c7dcc9d76e22161900432cebb.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and speak with Headmaster Lee to obtain the quest. Exit Shing Jea Monastery and run north towards Sunqua Vale. You will find Jinzo standing in front of a large stone wall by the side of the road.
739f7586433ffe7c7dcc9d76e22161900432cebb.text: 地图旅行到Shing Jea寺并与李校长交谈以获得任务。离开 Shing Jea 寺，向北前往 Sunqua Vale。你会发现金藏站在路边的一堵大石墙前。

06280bb750ed9d8c2c4154a96abdc3d4656c0d9f.source: Consult with Dunkoro at the Command Post in Kourna to find a way to Vabbi.
06280bb750ed9d8c2c4154a96abdc3d4656c0d9f.text: 与库尔纳指挥所的邓科罗协商，找到前往瓦比的方法。

810ce42400c2891190e7a294b6c233be59f8f48c.source: Scout with Nerashi to find passage through Jahai.
810ce42400c2891190e7a294b6c233be59f8f48c.text: 与奈拉什一起侦察，寻找穿过贾海的通道。

efd65829e31dc36389c8097f3719b64665ad3af2.text: 让库尔南巡逻队保持沉默。

5700f04b4bbfa583be0871e37994fa923eb724ba.source: Simply follow the checkpoints through the Jahai Bluffs until you reach the Kournan patrol. Kill them and map travel back to Sunspear Sanctuary for your reward.
5700f04b4bbfa583be0871e37994fa923eb724ba.text: 只需沿着检查站穿过 Jahai Bluffs 即可到达 Kournan 巡逻队。杀死他们并在地图上返回烈阳之矛庇护所以获得奖励。

67687c1ff032953448dc4329aac047ffc6ef5efc.source: Note that the quest will reset if changing zones before completion.
67687c1ff032953448dc4329aac047ffc6ef5efc.text: 请注意，如果在完成之前更改区域，任务将重置。

13b167f9d041e60675b25fd834e7e777f3077c39.source: Walking to the Kodonur Crossroads outpost after the quest has ended is mostly a waste of time as the follow-up quest also leads to it.
13b167f9d041e60675b25fd834e7e777f3077c39.text: 任务结束后步行到科多努尔十字路口前哨站基本上是浪费时间，因为后续任务也会通向那里。

3444e734fb6f15c945b45879f3ff5f67f9696222.source: Nerashi won't attack and cannot be targeted or damaged by foes, making it impossible to capture any of her elite skills.
3444e734fb6f15c945b45879f3ff5f67f9696222.text: 奈拉什不会攻击，也不会被敌人瞄准或伤害，因此无法捕获她的任何精英技能。

a6cd346d49a80e547ba7f3070bfc176902aec980.source: Must have access to Lion's Arch Keep, see flowchart for details.
a6cd346d49a80e547ba7f3070bfc176902aec980.text: 必须有权进入狮子拱门，详情请参阅流程图。

88d3297a3e09f07edec4b381292b3d8255c84ce7.source: Kill Inquisitor Lashona in North Kryta Province
88d3297a3e09f07edec4b381292b3d8255c84ce7.text: 杀死北科瑞塔省的审判官拉修纳

c0a5622319b648acd3cec512eb459c42d9a15d51.source: *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Lashona in Hard Mode
c0a5622319b648acd3cec512eb459c42d9a15d51.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死审判官拉索纳

df066572dc71d394d7d56d2561feae134f8cf686.source: See Princess Salma for your reward
df066572dc71d394d7d56d2561feae134f8cf686.text: 见萨尔玛公主领取奖励

6e1368646756ea00bf928e598a2777ceeff47e36.source: Complete the Base Objective for 20 War Supplies
6e1368646756ea00bf928e598a2777ceeff47e36.text: 完成 20 件战争物资的基本目标

7ff7a566bb63586b9c890411e477a6f9a8fe5868.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 10 War Supplies
7ff7a566bb63586b9c890411e477a6f9a8fe5868.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外 10 件战争物资

a6b901e90a870352c19b5b4e21e00faefcf34588.source: Follow the road from Lion's Arch to the Ascalon Settlement. Inquisitor Lashona is found talking to Captain Greywind. Once he is dead, you can map out or resign, as killing his minions is not part of the quest.
a6b901e90a870352c19b5b4e21e00faefcf34588.text: 沿着狮子拱门的路前往阿斯卡隆定居点。审判官拉修纳被发现与格雷温德船长交谈。一旦他死了，你就可以计划或辞职，因为杀死他的爪牙不是任务的一部分。

c55c5a424492ff315fbfb04561469f241b00e1b9.source: It is also possible (and easier) to travel from Bergen Hot Springs.
c55c5a424492ff315fbfb04561469f241b00e1b9.text: 从卑尔根温泉出发也可以（而且更方便）前往。

5c00cdd84d5452c16af5337676c45206b31aa6e6.source: Lashona will not spawn if Evil Residents (the Halloween quest) is active.
5c00cdd84d5452c16af5337676c45206b31aa6e6.text: 如果邪恶居民（万圣节任务）处于活动状态，拉绍纳将不会生成。

bcf40cb9822570791081a8cdae528b8e3af7cf5e.source: This quest cannot be combined with Merchant's Plea and only under certain circumstances with Defend North Kryta Province; Captain Greywind refuses to talk about shipment.
bcf40cb9822570791081a8cdae528b8e3af7cf5e.text: 该任务不能与商人的恳求结合使用，并且仅在某些情况下与保卫北科瑞塔省结合使用；格雷温德船长拒绝谈论运输问题。

77fe583111bfc6a1da6df69ba81638f2b82b7391.source: This quest was available again for some characters, after completion of the first two quests of the Thackeray's Missions in Hearts of the North campaign.
77fe583111bfc6a1da6df69ba81638f2b82b7391.text: 在完成北方之心萨克雷任务的前两个任务后，某些角色可以再次完成此任务。

adec95272fcbff21356c76d940972d9153698f96.source: This quest refers to Salma as queen before she becomes queen.
adec95272fcbff21356c76d940972d9153698f96.text: 该任务指的是萨尔玛在成为女王之前就已经是女王了。

499b68d4e630c225e6b06708d880dd51237cd9a3.source: Players who started the three required Wanted quests before the 19 November 2010 update might be forced to take the official umbrella quest, which is optional otherwise. If you are unable to move on to Riverside Assassination, speak to Murro in Lion's Arch and add The War in Kryta to your quest log.
499b68d4e630c225e6b06708d880dd51237cd9a3.text: 在 2010 年 11 月 19 日更新之前开始三个必需的通缉任务的玩家可能会被迫接受官方的保护伞任务，否则这是可选的。如果你无法继续进行河滨刺杀，请与狮子拱门的穆罗交谈，并将科瑞塔之战添加到你的任务日志中。

bc7a857bc6ae0452cfc549ab4c5160d72290ef01.source: Speak with the Centaur in the Command Post at the Sunspear Sanctuary.
bc7a857bc6ae0452cfc549ab4c5160d72290ef01.text: 与阳矛庇护所指挥所的半人马交谈。

d80afcc095e751ec83cc4479ac5824d9e83307a3.source: Journey to the Jahai Bluffs and meet with Zhed Shadowhoof and his informant.
d80afcc095e751ec83cc4479ac5824d9e83307a3.text: 前往贾海悬崖并会见杰德·影蹄和他的线人。

e3dd3d2c074f02bc5626c161549ac06bf9eaf6b5.source: Talk to the Master of Whispers.

9b31ede8d6820263614ce9e98ce6d813ba259d7c.source: Make your way toward Kodonur Crossroads and speak to Haroj Firemane.
9b31ede8d6820263614ce9e98ce6d813ba259d7c.text: 前往科多努尔十字路口并与哈罗吉·火鬃交谈。

3b4d8ecafb28365293382c9b2ad664703db0e1c8.source: See Estate Guard Rikesh for your reward.
3b4d8ecafb28365293382c9b2ad664703db0e1c8.text: 向庄园警卫 Rikesh 寻求奖励。

cfca7cb83182fad6039712c3dad48162ad36a41a.text: 杰德·影蹄加入你的队伍。

ac15abeb8fa8c00c8be8ee6607498a28e0710b15.source: Zhed needs to stay alive, and he is very squishy. If he dies while you are traveling to Kodonur, the quest log will be updated with the message that the quest failed. You will need to map travel to an outpost and re-enter the area to trigger the quest again.
ac15abeb8fa8c00c8be8ee6607498a28e0710b15.text: 哲德需要活下去，而他非常脆弱。如果他在你前往科多努尔时死亡，任务日志将更新为任务失败的消息。您需要将旅行映射到前哨站并重新进入该区域以再次触发任务。

0696f95c69c20395c7f9b869f14b90f40dcc3ee2.source: Two suggestions to handle this issue -
0696f95c69c20395c7f9b869f14b90f40dcc3ee2.text: 处理这个问题的两个建议 -

90ddf65c150b0c690095b871dc568de29c110320.source: Work backwards starting from Kodonur Crossroads; once you clear the road to Zhed you can walk back without fighting
90ddf65c150b0c690095b871dc568de29c110320.text: 从科多努尔十字路口开始向后走；一旦你清理了通往哲德的道路，你就可以不战而回了

01336046f7e22a473e4fcd1bd050dc70ffa941e8.source: Use the peasant fort and bodyblock Zhed in there until you have killed the Mandragor boss, then go back and get him. If you are having issues bodyblocking him, bring a few pets.
01336046f7e22a473e4fcd1bd050dc70ffa941e8.text: 使用农民堡垒并在那里阻挡哲德，直到杀死曼德拉戈尔老板，然后回去抓住他。如果您在身体阻挡他时遇到问题，请带几只宠物。

29e2c5f8f5e3a36d6a2315ce2cbf0450ed64f42f.source: Remember to allow dialogue between the centaurs; talk to Haroj before entering the town.
29e2c5f8f5e3a36d6a2315ce2cbf0450ed64f42f.text: 记住允许半人马之间对话；进入城镇之前与 Haroj 交谈。

481fd5b2fe7624e9bbdbcd326afce8df3a4e132f.source: Talk to Jinzo again when you are ready to kill the target minions.
481fd5b2fe7624e9bbdbcd326afce8df3a4e132f.text: 当你准备好杀死目标小兵时，再次与 Jinzo 交谈。

3c37b8cb7b988e2648c18bbaaa72989eb41c2c8b.source: Kill 5 target minions. [5..0] target minions remaining.
3c37b8cb7b988e2648c18bbaaa72989eb41c2c8b.text: Kill 5 target minions. [5..0] 剩余目标小兵。

29bfc8290aae05ca70099a787b0a0afc8d83050b.source: Jinzo will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
29bfc8290aae05ca70099a787b0a0afc8d83050b.text: 当你接受任务时，金藏会教你以下技能：

f61a0f1ad26e57af769fed7f64223f80a8e57271.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Headmaster Lee. Walk outside Shing Jea Monastery to Sunqua Vale. Then head up north, and walk for about 1 minute to reach Jinzo. Talk to Jinzo again to start the quest proper. Simply kill the five Bone Horrors as they appear to complete the quest. Vun Ying, your fellow student, will help you out.
f61a0f1ad26e57af769fed7f64223f80a8e57271.text: 地图前往Shing Jea寺并与李校长交谈。从Shing Jea 寺外步行至Sunqua Vale。然后向北步行约1分钟即可到达神藏。再次与 Jinzo 交谈以正确开始任务。只要在五个骸骨怪物出现时杀死它们即可完成任务。你的同学 Vun Ying 会帮助你。

dc28b5e3519310bdcfb23ddacb98e2da15f49214.source: Kill Inquisitor Bauer in Scoundrel's Rise
dc28b5e3519310bdcfb23ddacb98e2da15f49214.text: 在恶棍崛起中杀死审判官鲍尔

ef91513dbff543e4b635584a87c9c8c823b030b2.source: *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Bauer in Hard Mode
ef91513dbff543e4b635584a87c9c8c823b030b2.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死审判官鲍尔

9c34cd113e2a91faf32ae161f4753176ee0d2318.source: Start from Gates of Kryta (outpost) and fight through three groups of mergoyles. As you arrive to the wider area, Bauer's dialogue will trigger. Make sure you don't aggro surrounding groups or pull his group with a bow. Kill him and return to Salma for your rewards.
9c34cd113e2a91faf32ae161f4753176ee0d2318.text: 从科瑞塔之门（前哨站）出发，与三组水蛇进行战斗。当你到达更广阔的区域时，鲍尔的对话就会触发。确保你不会激怒周围的队伍或用弓拉他的队伍。杀死他并返回萨尔玛那里领取奖励。

6d9474377db321958559451938c37b3447e7fafa.source: Some players find it easy to vanquish the area with this quest active: by the time you have killed Bauer, a large portion of the total number of foes have already been defeated.
6d9474377db321958559451938c37b3447e7fafa.text: 有些玩家发现激活此任务后很容易征服该地区：当你杀死鲍尔时，敌人总数的很大一部分已经被击败。

92e0ee5f05095e6375bb3409394476336bf2f2c5.source: You can also kill Joh the Hostile who is nearby. If you are a warrior or a necromancer and capturing elite skills, consider capturing both of these elites in the same run.
92e0ee5f05095e6375bb3409394476336bf2f2c5.text: 你也可以杀死附近的敌对者乔。如果您是一名战士或死灵法师并掌握了精英技能，请考虑在同一回合中捕获这两种精英。

039fec42dd74e2104ba017fb81d08fbd0393dcd6.source: Bauer will not spawn if Heirlooms of the Mad King (the Halloween quest) is active.
039fec42dd74e2104ba017fb81d08fbd0393dcd6.text: 如果疯狂国王的传家宝（万圣节任务）处于活动状态，鲍尔将不会生成。

bef3a2ddf05693e123f3c335335c4c9de56942e1.source: Destroy the three groups of White Mantle vanguard marching to Quarrel Falls.
bef3a2ddf05693e123f3c335335c4c9de56942e1.text: 消灭向夸雷尔瀑布进军的三组白斗篷先锋队。

c08e190757fcec12a68919908526b21a2990ff3f.source: See Councilor Vaylor for your reward.

5cdc41f282afc7b822e5bc21e62b83829de90107.source:
Chaos Dmg: 9-16 (Requires 5 Domination Magic)
Health +10
Health +10 (while Hexed)
Health +10 (while Enchanted)
5cdc41f282afc7b822e5bc21e62b83829de90107.text:
混沌伤害：9-16（需要 5 支配魔法）
生命值+10
Health +10 (while Hexed)
生命值+10（附魔时）

a4fe7e4a2c4111f1dc694f49634be4be72363886.source: This quest is quite straightforward: walk into Silverwood and kill the three groups of White Mantle located where the quest markers indicate. Each group consists of two White Mantle Knights and a White Mantle Sycophant. The final group is located very close to the entrance to Ettin's Back. Dispatch them and then head into Ettin's Back to locate Councilor Vaylor for the reward. Councilor Vaylor is located right outside the entrance to Ventari's Refuge.
a4fe7e4a2c4111f1dc694f49634be4be72363886.text: 这个任务非常简单：走进银林并杀死位于任务标记指示处的三组白斗篷。每组由两名白斗篷骑士和一名白斗篷谄媚者组成。最后一组非常靠近埃丁背脊的入口。派遣他们，然后前往埃丁之背寻找韦勒议员以获得奖励。韦勒议员就位于文塔里避难所入口外。

830807a8f22fb028c46e22aa4c0b1d7a25e88fa8.source: The Cane awarded has the Deadly Cesta skin. The stats on that wand cannot be replicated, since there are no Wand Wrappings nor Inscriptions that increase maximum health.
830807a8f22fb028c46e22aa4c0b1d7a25e88fa8.text: 授予的手杖具有致命的 Cesta 皮肤。该魔杖上的统计数据无法复制，因为没有魔杖包装或铭文可以增加最大生命值。

0f5cf9b63407b9e1c7188a1c6c227641351c1c82.source: Additional White Mantle groups will spawn in Ettin's Back, but they are likely to be attacked by Centaurs, and do not have to be fought for the quest.
0f5cf9b63407b9e1c7188a1c6c227641351c1c82.text: 其他白斗篷团体将在埃丁之背生成，但他们很可能会受到半人马的攻击，并且不必为任务而战斗。

7b14cd0d29da5300e407f05018e1a714a4be282c.source: This quest may be taken prematurely if the player follows the quests Mysterious Message and The Price of Steel to Quarrel Falls. In doing so, the player could miss the storyline of The Wilds and Bloodstone Fen, which precedes White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard, as indicated by the quest's dialogue. There's a chance of Centaurs spawning and attacking the last group of White Mantle. If they kill any White Mantle before the player, the quest might not update, forcing the player to restart from Quarrel Falls.
7b14cd0d29da5300e407f05018e1a714a4be282c.text: 如果玩家按照“神秘消息”和“钢铁的价格”任务前往争吵瀑布，则该任务可能会提前完成。这样做时，玩家可能会错过《荒野》和《血石沼泽》的故事情节，该故事情节先于《白斗篷之怒：煽动者先锋》，如任务对话所示。半人马有可能生成并攻击最后一批白斗篷。如果他们在玩家之前杀死任何白斗篷，任务可能不会更新，迫使玩家从争吵瀑布重新开始。

befdd643d0daf1115c7f12de5440a8a32eb86143.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Centaur Blackmail.
befdd643d0daf1115c7f12de5440a8a32eb86143.text: 所有队伍成员必须接受半人马勒索的奖励。

65da9f1326c0f382ca652ca0d81c68fd7d4492f9.source: Zhed Shadowhoof must be present in the party.
65da9f1326c0f382ca652ca0d81c68fd7d4492f9.text: 杰德·影蹄必须出现在队伍中。

131328dc1292cbaf10fa7beaa36f634a1e8854d4.source: Rescue Mirza Veldrunner from the Kournans.
131328dc1292cbaf10fa7beaa36f634a1e8854d4.text: 从库南家族手中救出米尔扎·维德伦纳。

c37068c423952d09419ccd885078be512b768272.source: Defeat Kournan Taskmasters to get cell keys.
c37068c423952d09419ccd885078be512b768272.text: 击败库尔南模仿者以获得细胞钥匙。

bb12ee8a511270727c73d2f150ab66ec8497ce4e.source: Your party has [0...6] cell keys. Use a cell key to open a cell.
bb12ee8a511270727c73d2f150ab66ec8497ce4e.text: 你的队伍有 [0...6] 个手机键。使用单元键打开单元。

d47bbafb18c80ce17a6a12e9dd3ecf641e05a97d.source: Free additional Veldrunner Centaurs to build a resistance force. You have [6...0] more cells to unlock.
d47bbafb18c80ce17a6a12e9dd3ecf641e05a97d.text: 释放更多的 Veldrunner 半人马来建立抵抗力量。您还有 [6...0] 个单元格需要解锁。

6ad57168adbbe30d976ea4024994f0bcf3d029b5.source: Defeat Overseer Boktek and Overseer Haubeh.
6ad57168adbbe30d976ea4024994f0bcf3d029b5.text: 击败督军博克泰克和督军豪贝。

7fe79c7edd24dc4244617aac3cafb51f30e69593.source: You have [3...0] of 3 cruel Taskmasters remaining.
7fe79c7edd24dc4244617aac3cafb51f30e69593.text: 您还剩下 [3...0] 个残忍的监工。

3f29d159122017b494717a2ea8c023889398823b.text:
夜幕降临

0e99f47383cd6718fb5f90ba154d66225d4fc6cd.source: Your goal is to rescue the leader of the last free Centaur pride in Elona with the aid of other captive members. There are six Centaurs to liberate before assaulting the fort where Mirza Veldrunner is imprisoned. Each of their cells can be unlocked by obtaining a key from six taskmasters. These keys can be used by any party member to open any cell, but one at a time. Keep in mind that opening the cell in the middle, as well as the one closest to the fort, will trigger one patrol each to rush to the location.
0e99f47383cd6718fb5f90ba154d66225d4fc6cd.text: 你的目标是在其他俘虏成员的帮助下营救伊洛纳最后一支自由半人马狮群的首领。在攻击囚禁米尔扎·维德伦纳的堡垒之前，有六只半人马需要解放。他们的每个牢房都可以通过从六名监工那里获得一把钥匙来解锁。任何党员都可以使用这些钥匙打开任何单元格，但一次只能打开一个。请记住，打开中间的牢房以及最靠近堡垒的牢房，将触发每个巡逻队赶往该位置。

bbe78e6e2aa6db6645d4acf9465f3db6fb973dac.source: Open your Mission Map (U) to pick a course and take care of patrols without engaging multiple groups at the same time. The far eastern cell holds a level 24 Veldrunner Centaur (boss) while the rest are level 20 regulars. It will not join the party window but will follow and help you fight. Haroj Firemane on the other hand, doesn't engage ever.
bbe78e6e2aa6db6645d4acf9465f3db6fb973dac.text: 打开你的任务地图（U）来选择路线并进行巡逻，而无需同时与多个小组交战。远东牢房里有一个 24 级的半人马狂奔者（boss），而其余的则是 20 级的常客。它不会加入队伍窗口，但会跟随并帮助你战斗。另一方面，Haroj Firemane 则永远不会参与。

297126148a84f66193cb3e1fd9cb467e56a16ca8.source: Once all Veldrunner Centaurs are freed, use these new trapper allies to rescue their leader.
297126148a84f66193cb3e1fd9cb467e56a16ca8.text: 一旦所有 Veldrunner 半人马被释放，请使用这些新的捕猎者盟友来营救他们的领袖。

15b705c736ce8a001c059eb5f20604dff6467242.source: Since the endeavour is time-consuming, it is wise to ensure the last step success by:
15b705c736ce8a001c059eb5f20604dff6467242.text: 由于这项工作非常耗时，因此明智的做法是通过以下方式确保最后一步成功：

8db1e49b8e8602e3babb2cf9e01148d7ee223ce0.source: Clearing both guarding groups at each side stairs before pressing to the main gate.
8db1e49b8e8602e3babb2cf9e01148d7ee223ce0.text: 在冲向大门之前，先清除两侧楼梯上的两个守卫组。

571d33c85f1eeb672fd0e0228056246590b63b45.source: With a lot of casters in the player group, it is possible to eliminate many of the enemies inside beforehand (only the final 2 Overseers and the few mobs right next to them are unreachable). Keep in mind that this is only possible before freeing all 6 captive centaurs, and that the gate and walls will block projectile-based attacks.
571d33c85f1eeb672fd0e0228056246590b63b45.text: 玩家群体中施法者较多的情况下，可以提前消灭掉里面的很多敌人（只有最后的2个督军和旁边的几个小怪是无法到达的）。请记住，这只有在释放所有 6 个被俘虏的半人马之前才有可能，并且大门和墙壁将阻止基于投射物的攻击。

d07cd976986e41f662a8c50b1d74604f0726e576.source: The main gate itself will blast open and a few extra enemies will instantly spawn inside the fort, but only when a player approaches. It is possible to flag heroes/henchmen at the stairs (Centaur allies may follow a player) and once it opens, rush back to the stairs and then use one hero to lure enemies out of the fort. This method secures outnumbering the enemies and not the other way around.
d07cd976986e41f662a8c50b1d74604f0726e576.text: 主门本身会炸开，一些额外的敌人会立即在堡垒内产生，但只有当玩家接近时。可以在楼梯上标记英雄/追随者（半人马盟友可能会跟随玩家），一旦打开，冲回楼梯，然后使用一名英雄将敌人引诱出堡垒。这种方法可以确保在数量上超过敌人，而不是相反。

1dc6f5045c9d8bf76ed991804fed99789e08d6a7.source: Finally, eliminate the remaining forces plus the two Overseers (Boktek and Haubeh) to complete the mission.
1dc6f5045c9d8bf76ed991804fed99789e08d6a7.text: 最后，消灭剩余部队加上两名督军（Boktek 和 Haubeh）即可完成任务。

149cab4a73e4060bb8cc77204e9b7327a3fc88c7.source: After being freed, avoid the first group and go directly east to take out Taskmaster Suli. Make your way counter-clockwise across the estate killing the remaining Bonus Taskmasters. Since the fortress forces only spawn after all 6 centaurs have been freed, one can walk near the fortress without much concern.
149cab4a73e4060bb8cc77204e9b7327a3fc88c7.text: 获释后，避开第一组，直接向东去干掉模仿大师苏力。逆时针穿过庄园，杀死剩余的奖励模仿者。由于要塞部队只有在所有 6 个半人马都被释放后才会出现，因此人们可以毫无顾虑地在要塞附近行走。

36eb342b9088a90d1aa50a9e33dd7f046731a3f2.source: The bonus is to find and kill 3 cruel Taskmasters and their groups before the fort assault.
36eb342b9088a90d1aa50a9e33dd7f046731a3f2.text: 奖励是在攻击堡垒之前找到并杀死 3 个残忍的模仿大师和他们的团队。

ede8f741c88b218e434418c6de3c3b03a25e3ca1.source: Taskmaster Sadi-Belai, is to the east just past the eastern most cell. This boss spams Zealous Benediction which makes her difficult to overcome, engage her only after getting rid of the approaching patrol.
ede8f741c88b218e434418c6de3c3b03a25e3ca1.text: 监工萨迪-贝莱 (Sadi-Belai) 位于东边，刚刚经过最东边的牢房。这个老板会向她发送垃圾邮件“热心祝福”，这使得她很难被克服，只有在摆脱逼近的巡逻队后才能与她交战。

1ad21e05ebd65e2f2c1ff80b2ff61479f110bdaa.source: Taskmaster Vanahk is on the small island at the east.
1ad21e05ebd65e2f2c1ff80b2ff61479f110bdaa.text: 监工瓦纳克就在东部的小岛上。

76c26ca487bfda86279fa418005633e5e658b7bc.source: Taskmaster Suli is south of the fort.

8a713c2aed2290e2a716346b3d2d18cf54273d7d.source: The final groups of foes within the fortress are primarily tightly packed casters. Panic and other AoE denial will have great impact on them.
8a713c2aed2290e2a716346b3d2d18cf54273d7d.text: 要塞内的最后一批敌人主要是紧密拥挤的脚轮。恐慌和其他 AoE 否认会对他们产生很大的影响。

4d280fcf6261a411c26d11186948fecd421bf6bd.source: If you let the level 24 Veldrunner Centaur (boss) die, you can capture the elite skill Smoke Trap from him.
4d280fcf6261a411c26d11186948fecd421bf6bd.text: 如果你让24级的狂行者半人马（boss）死亡，你可以从他身上夺取精英技能烟雾陷阱。

070e26ac118425242b7ba4e41e0d239be42e3fa1.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Sunspear Sanctuary.
070e26ac118425242b7ba4e41e0d239be42e3fa1.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到烈阳之矛保护区。

869d317d86d2f587a52561797c7e32d43f69bf96.source: Sometimes when the mission is finished, The Hunger will appear briefly, presumably for the cinematic's sake.
869d317d86d2f587a52561797c7e32d43f69bf96.text: 有时，当任务完成时，饥饿会短暂出现，大概是为了电影的缘故。

c7c7def6e4d5e6b60d33771d2b7b59bb7541d64d.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 in the Night Falls storybook.
c7c7def6e4d5e6b60d33771d2b7b59bb7541d64d.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 3 页。

138eace87352b85c7a5097f04f7a4766dc8498e0.source: Unlike the other Veldrunner Centaurs, the Veldrunner Centaur boss does not appear in the party window and gives the party a morale boost if killed by enemies. It is sometimes possible for NPCs to walk through the final gate while it is still closed. This is most likely to happen to the Kournan Priests inside, as they try to heal enemies outside. Because the Veldrunner Centaur and Haroj Firemane allies only follow the party leader and do not follow Hero/Henchmen "flag" move commands, it is possible to get permanently boxed into corners by these allied NPCs with no escape, forcing the player to resign or quit.
138eace87352b85c7a5097f04f7a4766dc8498e0.text: 与其他 Veldrunner 半人马不同，Veldrunner 半人马 Boss 不会出现在队伍窗口中，并且如果被敌人杀死，会给队伍带来士气提升。有时，NPC 有可能在最后一道门仍关闭时穿过它。这最有可能发生在内部的库尔南祭司身上，因为他们试图治愈外部的敌人。由于 Veldrunner Centaur 和 Haroj Firemane 盟友只跟随队伍领袖，而不遵循英雄/追随者“旗帜”移动命令，因此有可能被这些盟友 NPC 永久困在角落里，无法逃脱，迫使玩家辞职或退出。

e6dfdbcab833f2e3b3cde3c3fa2fababe6d61127.source: Seek out Panaku in Kinya Province.

8c4faacd293c90936d3d94c9513a66a4c2f23190.source: After completing the Opening Strike quest, speak with Jinzo at point A on the map. After accepting this quest, take the path to the north-west, then west through the courtyard of Minister Cho's Estate. Just past the courtyard you will encounter a group of 2-3 Crimson Skull. You'll find two more groups further down the path, along with a boss, Yingko the Skull Claw. You will likely not be high enough level to take him on, so simply continue through Tomaat Pass to Kinya Province; following the path on the map until you reach Panaku.
8c4faacd293c90936d3d94c9513a66a4c2f23190.text: 完成“开局打击”任务后，与地图上 A 点的金藏交谈。接受这个任务后，沿着小路向西北走，然后向西穿过赵部长庄园的庭院。刚过庭院你就会遇到一群 2-3 只猩红骷髅。沿着这条路，你会发现另外两个小组，还有一个 Boss，骷髅爪英科。你的等级可能不够高，无法与他较量，所以只需继续穿过托马特山口到达基尼亚省即可；沿着地图上的路径行驶，直到到达帕纳库。

2f67dade5e3ac85e39b342b9f2c4be39fbdafdfb.source: Kill Inquisitor Lovisa in Watchtower Coast
2f67dade5e3ac85e39b342b9f2c4be39fbdafdfb.text: 在瞭望塔海岸杀死审判官洛维萨

55078cd3b1577934367b6c3c14cd07414f6649d7.source: *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Lovisa in Hard Mode
55078cd3b1577934367b6c3c14cd07414f6649d7.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死审判官洛维萨

995020a23f1c2a2641ac383498a610d7a831f0e1.source: Carefully clear the surrounding groups before engaging Lovisa's. Pull her group out of range of the Missing Children's Adoration. It is possible to lure all other White Mantle units away from Lovisa.
995020a23f1c2a2641ac383498a610d7a831f0e1.text: 在与洛维萨的队伍交战之前，请小心清除周围的队伍。将她的队伍拉出失踪儿童崇拜的范围。可以将所有其他白斗篷单位引诱远离洛维萨。

73806bdc17bfe70454e3561e036011c94b67027e.source: Lovisa refers to the spell Adoration when she tells the Missing Children to "give me your strength".
73806bdc17bfe70454e3561e036011c94b67027e.text: 当洛维萨告诉失踪的孩子们“给我你的力量”时，她提到了崇拜咒语。

1799fa4470742d36fa5bc12c8f2320f5c4f869fd.source: If The Undead Hordes is active, waves of undead will engage the Mantle on the northeast route from Beetletun towards the beach.
1799fa4470742d36fa5bc12c8f2320f5c4f869fd.text: 如果亡灵部落活跃，一波又一波的亡灵将会在从 Beetletun 到海滩的东北路线上与地幔交战。

784d86f8b1e8335f0a58381fc3a77acd7426062b.source: Lovisa might not spawn if Riverside Assassination is active for one or more party members.
784d86f8b1e8335f0a58381fc3a77acd7426062b.text: 如果河滨暗杀对一名或多名队伍成员有效，洛维萨可能不会生成。

654abde6143ec2102955ec7a1d24f788dd4bdb5a.source: If a White Mantle Ritualist appears with Lovisa, the spirits it summons will be allied with you but you do not receive any benefits from them, nor can you attack them.
654abde6143ec2102955ec7a1d24f788dd4bdb5a.text: 如果白斗篷仪式师与洛维萨一起出现，它召唤的灵魂会与你结盟，但你不会从他们那里得到任何好处，也不能攻击他们。

12e5a24e2b6631f43ab12f53e5c1a400794436db.source: This quest was available again for some characters, after completion of the first three Hearts of the North missions.
12e5a24e2b6631f43ab12f53e5c1a400794436db.text: 在完成前三个北方之心任务后，某些角色可以再次使用此任务。

3e53feedf7dca9fba78c75700bca0151d81ca7be.source: Defeat the forces surrounding Ventari's Refuge.
3e53feedf7dca9fba78c75700bca0151d81ca7be.text: 击败文塔里避难所周围的军队。

a53f0085020c0846ed3a400564f3c807cabff46d.source: Return to Councilor Vaylor for your reward.
a53f0085020c0846ed3a400564f3c807cabff46d.text: 返回韦勒议员处领取奖励。

aec889cd166fafe0fab52fe33895f858ec34ae0c.source: The Shining Blade allies outside Ventari's Refuge remain present after the quest is completed.
aec889cd166fafe0fab52fe33895f858ec34ae0c.text: 任务完成后，文塔里避难所外的光刃盟友仍然存在。

ea822337a96dd61c237383c95521b63f2c54ed43.source: Go into Ventari's Refuge and speak with Ventari. He is an old centaur who has become a pacifist, and will offer no help in fighting the White Mantle or anything else. Return outside and fight off the three groups of Mantle that have caught up with you.
ea822337a96dd61c237383c95521b63f2c54ed43.text: 进入文塔里避难所并与文塔里交谈。他是一个年迈的半人马，已成为和平主义者，不会在对抗白斗篷或其他任何事情上提供任何帮助。返回外面，击退追上你的三组地幔。

66b334493321080466ae1a5b73ef2412bc1ec72b.source: All three groups consist of 2 White Mantle Knights and 1 White Mantle Sycophant. You will also get help from 3 groups of Shining Blade, each consisting of a Shining Blade Elementalist, a Shining Blade Mesmer, and a Shining Blade Necromancer. Once the White Mantle are defeated, return to Councilor Vaylor and claim the reward.
66b334493321080466ae1a5b73ef2412bc1ec72b.text: 这三个团体均由 2 名白斗篷骑士和 1 名白斗篷谄媚者组成。你还将获得 3 组光刃的帮助，每组由光刃元素师、光刃催眠师和光刃死灵法师组成。白斗篷被击败后，返回韦勒议员处领取奖励。

02f721b14265171176d874e6c6dba817129ab448.source: Speak with Panaku again when you are ready to go to the Tengu village.
02f721b14265171176d874e6c6dba817129ab448.text: 当你准备好去天狗村时，再次与帕纳库交谈。

c1cf72d9716d4671257b39df435987589bb56971.source: Travel with Panaku to the Tengu village of Aerie and assassinate Swift Honorclaw.
c1cf72d9716d4671257b39df435987589bb56971.text: 与帕纳库一起前往艾利的天狗村并刺杀迅捷荣耀爪。

b198dbfb78e84c2cb26d18a520c7901111afb793.source: Panaku will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
b198dbfb78e84c2cb26d18a520c7901111afb793.text: 当你接受任务时，帕纳库会教你以下技能：

512dc719eeff14345bd9712c0633a668992365ee.source: After setting your new skills in your skillbar, talk to Panaku at point A on the map and go west towards the beach. At the beach turn right (north). You will see a group of Naga there, kill those and continue by following the road on your right hand (going east at first then north again). Here Panaku will speak again twice. As you approach Swift Honorclaw he will taunt you and then turn hostile. Kill him and speak to Panaku to collect your reward.
512dc719eeff14345bd9712c0633a668992365ee.text: 在技能栏中设置新技能后，与地图上 A 点的帕纳库交谈，然后向西前往海滩。在海滩右转（向北）。你会在那里看到一群纳迦，杀死他们，然后沿着你右手边的路继续走（首先向东，然后再向北）。这里帕纳库又要讲两遍。当你接近迅捷荣誉爪时，他会嘲笑你，然后变得充满敌意。杀死他并与帕纳库交谈以领取奖励。

5521fa1de08e22ca390eb8a4903b1c8748682bd4.source: Your target doesn't spawn until you tell Panaku to start the assassination. Dragon Festival quests will interfere with the completion of this quest.
5521fa1de08e22ca390eb8a4903b1c8748682bd4.text: 在你告诉帕纳库开始暗杀之前，你的目标不会出现。端午节任务会干扰该任务的完成。

188d136c736db4404497a6d31da4fd9bfa4e9fe5.text: 与格雷琴的侦察兵会面。

23545cd6cc76d1af7a7e996b6a46c5a5155a0211.source: See Elder Gretchen for your reward.
23545cd6cc76d1af7a7e996b6a46c5a5155a0211.text: 去找格雷琴长老领取奖励。

83a22a2571080b4f56bd2d55a875d666a77d2241.text: 切割伤害：6-25（需要 8 斧头精通）

1de14c6046b011967ab682c17d37386528c82852.text: 黑暗伤害：9-16（需要 8 血魔法）

e18bcf1cad8b16839f9279e2505ef0d83310ca8b.source: This quest is very straightforward: journey your way towards Snakebite, then head northeast to Aurora Glade, and speak to Elder Gretchen for your reward.
e18bcf1cad8b16839f9279e2505ef0d83310ca8b.text: 这个任务非常简单：一路前往蛇咬，然后向东北方向前往奥罗拉林地，并与格雷琴长老交谈以获得奖励。

2fff811ec5200ef55be4b37df47dbe8477f316aa.source: Originally, the Battle Axe given as a reward had lower maximum damage and different modifiers, those being "Energy +3 (while Enchanted)" and "Energy +5 (while Hexed)". It is unknown in which update this was modified.
2fff811ec5200ef55be4b37df47dbe8477f316aa.text: 最初，作为奖励的战斧具有较低的最大伤害和不同的修饰符，即“能量+3（附魔时）”和“能量+5（妖术时）”。目前尚不清楚这是在哪个更新中修改的。

f791c29564fb6c265c21e118f771d5a3936f34b7.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Ettin's Back and start the mission.
f791c29564fb6c265c21e118f771d5a3936f34b7.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从埃丁之背走进前哨站并开始任务。

3e1d46b5e37c5e8157bf8f425d0f2b9d98aca006.source: Gain access to the Henge of Denravi.

46ebcf4835f8057c52df479f1e72f5b44a10db71.source: Attune the Henge Portal before the White Mantle do.
46ebcf4835f8057c52df479f1e72f5b44a10db71.text: 在白斗篷之前调整巨石传送门。

a1cd80f37884b546ea31bb30dc048a1c97ef232b.source: ADDED: Attune the thorn pedestal to clear the vine gate.
a1cd80f37884b546ea31bb30dc048a1c97ef232b.text: 添加：调整荆棘基座以清除藤蔓门。

d1421ea868bf6e409482d3a0df95feb758e69cfe.source: ADDED: Attune both thorn pedestals to clear the vine gate.
d1421ea868bf6e409482d3a0df95feb758e69cfe.text: 添加：调整两个荆棘基座以清除藤蔓门。

90315d3ddabadcced6e779b61474ad0c985e71c4.text: 添加：杀死巨石阵守护者。

b68ddee681ed2f3af6be5738ad591c07bba924bb.source: The first part of this mission is typical: hack and slash through the usual Maguuma Jungle foes and bosses. Things change drastically when you reach the Druids.
b68ddee681ed2f3af6be5738ad591c07bba924bb.text: 这个任务的第一部分是典型的：砍杀常见的迈古玛丛林敌人和头目。当你到达德鲁伊时，事情就会发生巨大的变化。

ef0ed03a9bbcc32e8c07076a8d476d9e0be97c8f.source: The goal of the mission is to attune a set of three thorn pedestals simultaneously, while preventing the White Mantle from doing the same thing. Attuning the set clears the Vine Gate, giving your party access to the Henge Guardian; defeating it completes the mission.
ef0ed03a9bbcc32e8c07076a8d476d9e0be97c8f.text: 任务的目标是同时调整一组三个荆棘基座，同时防止白斗篷做同样的事情。调整该装置可清除藤蔓之门，使您的队伍能够访问巨石阵守护者；打败它就完成了任务。

004b784529a0e590842bcdda40522b6f21d3ea4b.source: There are two types of pedestals:

73a8521ab8221bf30a242ae4d01b3c29341fb809.source: Spawn-pedestals are attended by a single Druid. Talk to the Druid once to enable the pedestal to produce crystals; click on the pedestal to get a crystal. That pedestal will not produce a crystal until the currently-carried one is dropped or used.
73a8521ab8221bf30a242ae4d01b3c29341fb809.text: 生成基座由一名德鲁伊负责。与德鲁伊对话一次，使底座能够产出水晶；点击底座即可获得水晶。在当前携带的水晶被掉落或使用之前，该底座不会产生水晶。

4733582b095178390a814d17667757f9c82a0900.source: Attunement-pedestals are empty until your party or the Mantle add a crystal; they also have a beam of light pointing upwards. The light is white when the pedestal is empty; it changes to blue when your team claims it; and it becomes red when the Mantle attune it.
4733582b095178390a814d17667757f9c82a0900.text: 协调基座是空的，直到您的队伍或斗篷添加水晶为止；它们还有一束指向上方的光束。当基座空时，灯为白色；当你的团队认领它时，它会变成蓝色；当地幔对其进行调谐时，它会变成红色。

b29e7b992a8905fbf50e57287aeaea6b109be4de.source: If you drop a crystal, it will break and you must grab a new one (and you will drop it anytime you switch weapons or shadowstep). As with any bundle, while carrying crystals, you do not gain the benefit of any of your weapon mods.
b29e7b992a8905fbf50e57287aeaea6b109be4de.text: 如果你掉落了一颗水晶，它就会破碎，你必须抓住一个新的（并且每当你切换武器或暗影步时你都会掉落它）。与任何捆绑包一样，携带水晶时，您不会获得任何武器模组的好处。

901ab41871cc853f12f671d0dc9cfea8c0795933.source: When you attune the southernmost pedestal, it opens a vine-gate allowing you to proceed northward. (The Mantle do not attempt to attune this pedestal.) After following the path, you will find Less Longbow: dispose of his attackers and talk to him to unlock the Bonus.
901ab41871cc853f12f671d0dc9cfea8c0795933.text: 当你调整最南端的基座时，它会打开一扇藤门，让你可以向北前进。 （斗篷不会尝试调整这个基座。）沿着路径走后，你会发现Les Longbow：消灭他的攻击者并与他交谈以解锁奖励。

0bcce0dbec98641feabbd0aed64d911c65d6dd80.source: East of Less is another area with three thorn-pedestals. One is a spawn-pedestal, one attunement-pedestal has already been claimed by the Mantle, and the third will be unclaimed. There are several ways to proceed at this point. Generally, you want to defeat the two groups of Mantle (including a Boss), visit the spawn-pedestal, talk to the Druid, grab a crystal, claim the right attunement-pedestal and eventually claim the leftmost pedestal, which opens another vine-gate at the eastern end of the area.
0bcce0dbec98641feabbd0aed64d911c65d6dd80.text: 莱斯东边是另一个拥有三个荆棘基座的区域。一个是生成基座，一个协调基座已被地幔认领，第三个将无人认领。此时有几种方法可以继续。一般来说，你想要击败两组地幔（包括 Boss），访问重生基座，与德鲁伊交谈，抓住水晶，占领右边的协调基座，并最终占领最左边的基座，这会在该区域的东端打开另一个藤蔓门。

adbb88ef2ead376655a13ac881e07b9609388466.source: Once this gate opens, the race is on between your team and the White Mantle to claim the three pedestals in the large area to the East. A group of White Mantle will be escorting a single runner around the map to capture the pedestals, the crystal carrier will not engage in combat while the escorts will. There are several ways you can proceed at this point.
adbb88ef2ead376655a13ac881e07b9609388466.text: 一旦这扇门打开，你的团队和白斗篷之间的竞赛就开始了，争夺东部大片区域的三个基座。一群白斗篷将护送一名跑者在地图上绕行以占领基座，水晶运输者不会参与战斗，而护送者则会参与战斗。此时您可以通过多种方式继续操作。

f084d4810948d801a19af41291b9fd7927984456.source: Method 1: Kill all the Mantle at the left shrine
f084d4810948d801a19af41291b9fd7927984456.text: 方法一：杀死左边神殿的所有斗篷

008994072fb18feaaf38c1be1262395ca1a06bb6.source: This works with a single player. Pick up a crystal and go to the left-most (east) pedestal; ignoring the shrine near the gate. You should arrive as the Mantle are leaving after capturing it. Do not engage at this point. Attune the pedestal, then flag your party around it. As the Mantle return to reclaim this pedestal first, go back to the entrance to grab another crystal, and then go to the pedestal at the far right (south-west) side and attune it. Alternate between claiming the left and right pedestals, as the Mantle will usually succeed in capturing your AI-held pedestal; however, if you have a good team, your party will kill the runner's escort each time. Because you never attuned the top right pedestal, the Mantle will never attempt to get it back, so you can focus on cycling between the other two pedestals without worrying about that one. An added benefit of leaving that pedestal is that even if the Mantle are slightly faster than you and hold both pedestals for a few seconds, you will not fail the mission since they never control all three. Eventually the only Mantle left will be the runner. You will know this when you no longer see your party taking damage. (Be careful not to capture all of the pedestals at once!) Rejoin your party and kill the runner, either by using snare/spike skills if you have them, or by positioning your team in the runner's path as they head to a pedestal. Kill the Demagogue (who will now be standing alone in the Mantle camp) and claim any remaining pedestals.
008994072fb18feaaf38c1be1262395ca1a06bb6.text: 这适用于单人玩家。拿起一个水晶并前往最左边（东）的基座；忽略了大门附近的神社。你应该在捕获地幔后离开时到达。此时请勿参与。调整基座，然后在其周围标记您的队伍。当地幔返回并首先收回这个基座时，返回入口处获取另一个水晶，然后前往最右侧（西南）侧的基座并调整它。交替占领左右基座，因为斗篷通常会成功占领你的人工智能持有的基座；但是，如果你有一支优秀的团队，你的队伍每次都会杀死跑步者的护卫。因为您从未调整过右上方的基座，所以地幔永远不会尝试将其恢复，因此您可以专注于在其他两个基座之间骑行，而不必担心那个基座。离开该基座的另一个好处是，即使地幔比你稍快并保持两个基座几秒钟，你也不会失败任务，因为他们永远不会控制所有三个基座。最终剩下的唯一的地幔将是跑步者。当你不再看到你的队伍受到伤害时你就会知道这一点。 （小心不要一次占领所有基座！）重新加入你的队伍并杀死跑步者，可以使用圈套​​/尖刺技能（如果有的话），或者在跑步者前往基座时将你的团队定位在跑步者的路径上。杀死煽动者（他现在将独自站在地幔营地中）并夺取所有剩余的基座。

e603f57c8f37ab2cf8578857981c60730ede9435.source: Remember that killing the runner gives the Mantle an advantage: a living runner will have to return to grab a crystal, while reinforcement runners spawn near their team's crystal-supply pedestal. It also means that you might have to confront two teams of Mantle (the original escorts and the new runner's team).
e603f57c8f37ab2cf8578857981c60730ede9435.text: 请记住，杀死奔跑者会给斗篷带来优势：活着的奔跑者将必须返回以获取水晶，而增援奔跑者会在其团队的水晶供应基座附近产卵。这也意味着你可能要面对两支曼特尔队伍（原来的护卫队和新的跑者队）。

3f2fc94bf74f22774c34ce3ee18d37c6b99aa302.source: Your build should include a Speed Boost (or you could use a Birthday Cupcake or Rock Candy) for the first part and one of the following: a Snare, crippling skill or a Spike for dealing with the White Knight runner. Signet of Spirits is an ideal choice, since it distracts your opponents while doing noticeable damage.
3f2fc94bf74f22774c34ce3ee18d37c6b99aa302.text: 你的构建应该包括第一部分的速度提升（或者你可以使用生日蛋糕或冰糖）和以下之一：圈套、致残技能或用于对付白骑士跑者的尖刺。灵魂徽记是一个理想的选择，因为它会分散对手的注意力，同时造成明显的伤害。

ca5b1b8e14ed871f804093597fde59129a623152.source: If using heroes and/or henchmen, position their flags such that they are, behind the left-most pedestal (towards the Druid) but still in range of it; this way the number of White Mantle encountered at once will not overwhelm them (especially true in Hard mode). After the heroes/henchmen fight off the first wave, spread their flags out.
ca5b1b8e14ed871f804093597fde59129a623152.text: 如果使用英雄和/或追随者，请将他们的旗帜放置在最左边的基座后面（朝向德鲁伊），但仍在其范围内；这样，一次遇到的白斗篷数量就不会压倒他们（尤其是在困难模式下）。英雄/追随者击退第一波后，展开旗帜。

2224e58c334c9cb0ce7b4d6b6054c68773447267.source: A frequently successful variation is to attune the bottom (west) pedestal (closest to the crystal spawn point) and the pedestal at the far right (south-west) side alternately while having the party flagged slightly west of the center. Alternatively, particularly in Hard Mode when the runner moves faster, you could flag your party in Guard mode along the runner's return route from the left (east) pedestal in order to body block them without killing them, and give you more time to capture the remaining pedestals.
2224e58c334c9cb0ce7b4d6b6054c68773447267.text: 一个经常成功的变化是交替调整底部（西）基座（最接近水晶生成点）和最右侧（西南）侧的基座，同时让队伍在中心稍微西边标记。或者，特别是在困难模式下，当跑步者移动速度更快时，你可以在守卫模式下沿着跑步者从左侧（东）基座返回的路线标记你的队伍，以便用身体阻挡他们而不杀死他们，并给你更多的时间来占领剩余的基座。

a92f3490144da6b17791f30b3701051a12546666.source: This approach needs at least two human players in the party, with three players being preferred. Using this method, you can complete this objective without engaging the White Mantle contingent at all (excepting the Demagogue for the bonus). Simply run a crystal to each of the three pedestals. You should have some speed boosts in your skillbar to allow you to outrun the White Mantle teams; each time they claim a pedestal, another team immediately heads out to claim the next.
a92f3490144da6b17791f30b3701051a12546666.text: 这种方法需要队伍中至少有两名人类玩家，最好是三名玩家。使用这种方法，你可以在完全不与白斗篷小队交战的情况下完成这个目标（煽动者除外）。只需在三个基座上各放置一颗水晶即可。你的技能栏中应该有一些速度提升，让你能够超越白斗篷队伍；每当他们获得一个基座时，另一支队伍就会立即出发去获得下一个基座。

729bfe34ff5ead2f4dfd1b689f041686c16435aa.source: Just remember to keep at least one pedestal claimed to avoid failing the mission.
729bfe34ff5ead2f4dfd1b689f041686c16435aa.text: 请记住至少保留一个声称的基座，以避免任务失败。

cef9f911c8a478724dc70785644f32af2304cd73.source: You should have two or three players standing by the druid and the crystals. One player should pick up a crystal and run to the nearest thorn pedestal. As soon as it is set in place, a new crystal will spawn, which the second player should grab and head to the next pedestal. If you only have two runners, the first runner should return to the crystal spawn point while the second runner is out. Either way, once the crystal spawns again, repeat the process. If this is coordinated properly, you should have no trouble at all.
cef9f911c8a478724dc70785644f32af2304cd73.text: 你应该有两到三名玩家站在德鲁伊和水晶旁边。一名玩家应该捡起一颗水晶并跑到最近的荆棘基座。一旦放置到位，就会产生一个新的水晶，第二个玩家应该抓住它并前往下一个基座。如果您只有两个跑步者，则第一个跑步者应该返回水晶生成点，而第二个跑步者则退出。不管怎样，一旦水晶再次产生，就重复这个过程。如果协调得当，你应该不会有任何麻烦。

275a953d4b99bc760d756423100d7c929e48695b.source: To make sure the White Mantle do not capture any pedestals, you can station the balance of your party (including any heroes/henchmen) at the chokepoint in the center pathway.
275a953d4b99bc760d756423100d7c929e48695b.text: 为了确保白斗篷不会占领任何基座，你可以将你的队伍的其余部分（包括任何英雄/追随者）驻扎在中央通道的阻塞点。

7a5f36cb9b32b405ba08ccea2ffd04a7c2a0ceaa.source: Note that this method can be used, with slight modification, to easily gain mission and bonus. Have two people run crystals, the second waiting by the crystal spawn point to pick it up the moment the other has attuned a pedestal. It is important that these two do not attune the last pedestal until the bonus is gained. A third person, or the rest of the party, kills the Demagogue. This can easily be done by following the south wall, you should not need to kill any White Mantle other than him if you take this path. Now the most important part: do not aggro the White Mantle runners. Two non-buffed runners can easily keep the portals attuned without hindering the White Mantle. If a third human player is not present, then this method can be done using only two. The Demagogue slayer (with the bulk of the team) retraces steps and becomes the second runner after the bonus has been gained.
7a5f36cb9b32b405ba08ccea2ffd04a7c2a0ceaa.text: 请注意，此方法只需稍加修改即可轻松获得任务和奖励。让两个人跑水晶，第二个在水晶产卵点等待，当另一个人调整了底座时捡起它。重要的是，在获得奖金之前，这两个人不要调整最后一个基座。第三个人，或者队伍的其他人，杀死了煽动者。沿着南墙走就可以很容易地做到这一点，如果你走这条路，你不需要杀死除了他之外的任何白斗篷。现在最重要的部分是：不要激怒白斗篷狂奔者。两个未抛光的奔跑者可以轻松地保持传送门协调一致，而不会妨碍白斗篷。如果第三个人玩家不存在，则可以仅使用两个人来完成此方法。煽动者杀手（与团队的大部分成员）在获得奖金后折返并成为第二名跑步者。

4cf350eb761010e1baefab1eb33523123018bfef.source: It can be accomplished with a single 33% speed-boosted runner while the bulk of the team circles counter clockwise, keeping right arm against the outer wall, to kill the Damagogue. Do not engage or aggro any of the other White Mantle. The runner attunes the nearby shrine, then the team grabs the next crystal and attunes the far right shrine on its way around. The Runner then attunes the left shrine, comes back, and attunes whatever shrine has been recaptured. It is unlikely but possible the runner can outrace the team killing the Demogogue, make sure not to cap the last shrine until the bonus is complete.
4cf350eb761010e1baefab1eb33523123018bfef.text: 只需一名速度提升 33% 的跑步者即可完成，同时大部分团队逆时针旋转，右臂靠在外墙上，以杀死达马古格。不要与任何其他白斗篷交战或仇恨。跑步者调整附近的神殿，然后团队抓住下一个水晶并在周围调整最右边的神殿。然后，奔跑者调整左边的神殿，回来，调整任何被夺回的神殿。跑步者不太可能但有可能超过杀死演示者的团队，请确保在奖金完成之前不要限制最后一个神殿。

4c2d0c4836219f100b3a25bbb6580eab252015c8.source: Alternatively: Push The White Mantle Garrison

7b5f77b7dda1825842f1cc728b0327e0e31cdae3.source: Proceed to the White Mantle garrison (where the Demagogue is located) directly Southeast off the main entrance of the Henge Portal - Defeat the whole White Mantle army coming from the garrison, then proceed with the Thorn Pedestal and attune the Henge Portal with no White Mantle taking the Rune Crystal from you. (It is a bonus objective as well which is a plus)
7b5f77b7dda1825842f1cc728b0327e0e31cdae3.text: 直接前往巨阵传送门主入口东南方的白斗篷要塞（煽动者所在的地方）——击败来自要塞的整支白斗篷军队，然后前往荆棘基座并调整巨阵传送门，不要让白斗篷从你手中夺走符文水晶。 （这也是一个奖励目标，这是一个优点）

975c29c2681a0c8e074a6a8eb5b3f5f51a065c35.source: Summoned creatures will not be teleported with the party. Allies from summoning stones will remain alive and cannot be re-summoned in the next area.
975c29c2681a0c8e074a6a8eb5b3f5f51a065c35.text: 召唤的生物不会随队伍传送。召唤石的盟友将保持活着，并且无法在下一个区域重新召唤。

d6290036e5b973d777df672f69208230fbb2d9c7.source: Regardless of which of the above methods you use, when you finally claim all three pedestals, a cinematic will play showing your party being teleported to the Henge. Make your way through the token resistance there to confront the Henge Guardian. He is flanked by two Root Behemoths that can wear down your party if they are not eliminated quickly. When you take out all three of them, the mission ends. The best way of killing them is by using damage over time spells such as Fire Storm, as the enemies are stationary.
d6290036e5b973d777df672f69208230fbb2d9c7.text: 无论您使用上述哪种方法，当您最终获得所有三个基座时，都会播放一部电影，显示您的队伍被传送到巨石阵。穿过那里象征性的抵抗，对抗巨石阵守护者。他的两侧是两只根部巨兽，如果不尽快消灭它们，它们可能会削弱你的队伍。当你把他们三个都干掉后，任务就结束了。杀死他们的最佳方法是使用持续伤害的法术，例如火焰风暴，因为敌人是静止的。

da8153d5ffc6dd2733b1fb2381a95edff857aa77.source: Just before you enter the area with the three pedestals, you will see a Shining Blade warrior named Less Longbow near two White Mantle Knights. As you approach (to within 2 aggro circles), the Mantle will engage him in combat if Less is close enough. You will have to join the fight and save Less. If Less dies the bonus cannot be completed. To avoid this, it is possible to flag heroes/henchmen ahead; use the mission map to position them before triggering. After the two Knights are dead, speak to Less to trigger the bonus. Note: to receive credit for the bonus, you must speak to this NPC before you kill the Demagogue. Less must complete the dialogue before the Demagogue is killed to receive the bonus. (However, once you have done so, you will receive credit even if he dies later.)
da8153d5ffc6dd2733b1fb2381a95edff857aa77.text: 就在您进入拥有三个基座的区域之前，您会看到一名名为“Less Longbow”的光刃战士靠近两名白斗篷骑士。当你接近（2个仇恨圈内）时，如果Less足够接近，斗篷将会与他交战。你必须加入战斗并节省更少的钱。如果Less死亡，奖金就无法完成。为了避免这种情况，可以在前面标记英雄/追随者；在触发之前使用任务地图来定位它们。两名骑士死亡后，与Less交谈即可触发奖励。注意：要获得奖励，您必须在杀死煽动者之前与该 NPC 交谈。莱斯特必须在煽动者被杀死之前完成对话才能获得奖励。 （但是，一旦你这样做了，即使他稍后去世，你也会获得积分。）

209e4dd2e7b9ed96610c4e9f99cee1cb781a9083.source: Less will start attacking the White Mantle Knights once he is within compass range; however, the knights themselves will not do anything until the player gets close. If the player stays far outside aggro range, Less will kill both of the knights without risk to himself.
209e4dd2e7b9ed96610c4e9f99cee1cb781a9083.text: 一旦莱斯特进入罗盘范围，他就会开始攻击白斗篷骑士团；然而，在玩家靠近之前，骑士本身不会采取任何行动。如果玩家远离仇恨范围，Less 会杀死两名骑士，而不会危及自己。

d35a7f782fe3c17c34c593bdc52c4d35df1dc8b0.source: The Demagogue is located in the White Mantle starting area, on the other side of the arena with the three pedestals. You must kill him before placing the last crystal in the pedestal. The troops stationed here are also the ones that will run the crystals out to claim the pedestals, so if you killed them all previously using Method 1 described above, he will be alone. Otherwise, you will need to deal with them in addition to the Demagogue himself.
d35a7f782fe3c17c34c593bdc52c4d35df1dc8b0.text: 煽动者位于白斗篷起始区域，在竞技场的另一侧，有三个基座。你必须在将最后一块水晶放入基座之前杀死他。驻扎在这里的部队也是会跑出水晶来夺取基座的部队，所以如果你之前使用上述方法1将他们全部杀死，他将独自一人。否则，除了煽动者本人之外，你还需要对付他们。

89b5f710d034f9d8f7bb3fcf238cdb636dfdfe09.source: If you do not want to fight all of them, in fact any of them, one approach is to head to the pedestal on the far right from the entrance, where you will find a path that leads past the bulk of his forces. From there, provided you hug the side furthest from them you can eliminate the Demagogue and if you are lucky, his troops will not aggro. Tread mindfully near the wall to make sure following Heroes and Henchmen stay close. The Demagogue group might as well take a crystal and attune the right pedestal on their way.
89b5f710d034f9d8f7bb3fcf238cdb636dfdfe09.text: 如果你不想与他们所有人战斗，实际上是他们中的任何一个，一种方法是前往入口最右侧的基座，在那里你会找到一条穿过他的大部分部队的路径。从那里开始，只要你拥抱离他们最远的一侧，你就可以消灭煽动者，如果你幸运的话，他的部队将不会发生仇恨。小心地靠近墙壁行走，以确保跟随的英雄和追随者保持在附近。煽动者小组不妨带上一块水晶，并在途中调整正确的基座。
