150332a4c415d87b74432e67de67b0851458fd9c.source: If you are having trouble holding the pedestals, one method is to keep your heroes/henchmen at one pedestal (preferably the one to the far right) and then capture 2 and keep 2 at all times, that way when the runners capture one you will still have another and can easily regain it until all the White Mantle are dead.
150332a4c415d87b74432e67de67b0851458fd9c.text: 如果你在守住基座时遇到困难，一种方法是将你的英雄/追随者保持在一个基座上（最好是最右边的那个），然后捕获 2 个并始终保留 2 个，这样当跑腿者捕获一个时，你仍然可以拥有另一个，并且可以轻松地重新获得它，直到所有白斗篷都死了。

2dbb6e234b9ccbccf966bfb2cc764603648ed7b9.source: If you are only going for the bonus, you can effectively skip the shuffling and take the back route directly to the Demagogue. The following method works very well even with hero/henchmen parties, especially in hard mode: Grab the crystal from the Thorn Pedestal, and place it in the center shrine's pedestal. Run back and grab another crystal, and take it to the one on the far right. Without running skills, you will still have a few seconds to spare. Taking the back route, avoid the rest of the troops and go straight to the Demagogue. You will be able to kill him with just enough time to spare; you will fail the mission, but you will get the bonus. This is a very simple and reliable method. It works even better if you bring party-wide speed boosts (such as "Fall Back!") and interrupts or knock downs to prevent him from activating Healing Signet.
2dbb6e234b9ccbccf966bfb2cc764603648ed7b9.text: 如果你只是为了奖金，你可以有效地跳过洗牌并直接走后路到煽动者。即使对于英雄/追随者队伍，以下方法也非常有效，尤其是在困难模式下：从荆棘基座上抓住水晶，并将其放置在中央神殿的基座上。跑回去拿另一块水晶，然后把它带到最右边的水晶那里。如果没有跑步技巧，你还有几秒钟的空闲时间。走后路，避开其余部队，直奔煽动者。你只要有足够的时间就可以杀死他；你会失败任务，但你会得到奖金。这是一种非常简单且可靠的方法。如果你带来全队速度提升（例如“后退！”）并打断或击倒以防止他激活治疗印章，效果会更好。

0a5b4c72d785ec9983735d0b2a7580e57f285cc7.source: Snares help considerably in slowing down the runners (although many players report success without them).
0a5b4c72d785ec9983735d0b2a7580e57f285cc7.text: 圈套对于减缓跑步者的速度有很大帮助（尽管许多玩家报告说没有它们也能成功）。

45959063388e87e221a16667468d7e6e5d4886f3.source: Area of effect skills come in handy, as White Mantle groups tend to clump. They can also be used against the Henge Guardian and his Behemoths.
45959063388e87e221a16667468d7e6e5d4886f3.text: 区域效果技能会派上用场，因为白斗篷团体往往会聚集在一起。它们也可以用来对抗巨阵守护者和他的巨兽。

130fae2886a144b908a765cab417cfe479464d5d.source: Signet of Spirits builds on player character allows for damage dealing at the same time as running.
130fae2886a144b908a765cab417cfe479464d5d.text: 精神徽记建立在玩家角色之上，允许在奔跑的同时造成伤害。

f8ca08f906fcc388bed953bf3364a3857331b4c3.source: White Mantle Seekers use Dryder's Defenses to block attacks. This can make it difficult to hit them with attacks if they are carrying the crystals. Use stance removal skills to end it or non-attack skills.
f8ca08f906fcc388bed953bf3364a3857331b4c3.text: 白斗篷探索者使用德莱德的防御来阻止攻击。如果他们携带水晶，这会使攻击变得困难。使用姿态消除技能来结束它或非攻击技能。

624060fe0471163229828daef21e195453b6c2fd.source: Spread your team out to avoid standing in Energy Surge and Searing Heat, and deal with the White Mantle Sycophants and Savants first in enemy groups.
624060fe0471163229828daef21e195453b6c2fd.text: 将你的队伍分散开来，避免陷入能量涌动和灼热热浪中，并首先对付敌方队伍中的白斗篷谄媚者和学者。

a9555495efbeb26b14691b101cc7260e7b050498.source: If there's a White Mantle Abbot in the group, consider dealing with them first while merely disabling the Sycophants and Savants until then. Searing Heat especially is easy to interrupt due to its long and somewhat distinct casting animation.
a9555495efbeb26b14691b101cc7260e7b050498.text: 如果队伍中有白斗篷方丈，请考虑先解决他们，然后在此之前仅禁用阿谀奉承者和学者。由于其漫长且有些独特的施法动画，灼热之热尤其容易被打断。

e399f098f28088bfeaab5aff6fadca48220466c2.source: Before and after the Henge Portal section the only enemies that should be particularly hard with a competent team are the Moss Scarabs, due to their large groups.
e399f098f28088bfeaab5aff6fadca48220466c2.text: 在巨石阵传送门之前和之后，对于一支有能力的团队来说，唯一应该特别困难的敌人是苔藓圣甲虫，因为它们的群体很大。

5dd8aab9b899f1df5fe8aa783fb1091522443bbe.source: The large amounts of White Mantle foes at the Henge Portal and their increased movement speed makes capturing the shrines without killing them all significantly more difficult.
5dd8aab9b899f1df5fe8aa783fb1091522443bbe.text: 巨阵传送门上有大量的白斗篷敌人，而且他们的移动速度更快，这使得在不杀死他们的情况下占领神殿变得更加困难。

69a55a3b3c5f9271f57c55aea9471230c951e543.source: To prevent them from overwhelming the party do not kill the runner, instead snare them and try to kill a few of the White Mantle accompanying them, withdrawing with the whole party after the runner gets out of Earshot to get a new crystal yourself. When only two or fewer enemies accompany the runner it should be safe to kill the runner and the rest, and then the Demagogue and also attune the shrines.
69a55a3b3c5f9271f57c55aea9471230c951e543.text: 为了防止他们压倒队伍，不要杀死奔跑者，而是诱捕他们并尝试杀死一些伴随他们的白斗篷，在奔跑者离开耳朵后与整个队伍一起撤退，自己去获取新的水晶。当只有两个或更少的敌人陪伴跑步者时，杀死跑步者和其他人应该是安全的，然后杀死煽动者并调整神殿。

fcbb66b36394bf88a3771a49ab672de8b71ba5ff.source: Sometimes Less Longbow will not be under attack when you find him. When he is under attack, preventing his death will give you a Morale Boost.
fcbb66b36394bf88a3771a49ab672de8b71ba5ff.text: 有时，当你找到Less Longbow时，他不会受到攻击。当他受到攻击时，阻止他死亡会给你带来士气提升。

8c45c70b48abca9dad549c63b066565dfa5cc697.source: This is one of only a few Morale Boosts that also apply to Animal companions.
8c45c70b48abca9dad549c63b066565dfa5cc697.text: 这是仅有的少数也适用于动物伙伴的士气提升之一。

a588bd54fba83a745b7dfd27045fd613d92edee9.source: You can also use the crystals located near the Demagogue.
a588bd54fba83a745b7dfd27045fd613d92edee9.text: 您还可以使用煽动者附近的水晶。

3a37f0f448f6ff4ffae77c6254803076a89e30b8.source: Complete exploration of the mission area will add approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. The first 0.7% can be explored before the cinematic that teleports you to the last bit of the mission, leaving 0.3% to be explored before you kill the Henge Guardian.
3a37f0f448f6ff4ffae77c6254803076a89e30b8.text: 完成任务区域的探索将为泰尔制图师头衔增加约 1.0%。前 0.7% 可以在将你传送到任务最后一部分的过场动画之前探索，剩下 0.3% 可以在你杀死巨石阵守护者之前探索。

05e210bb826445b58f248dae3c9cc277fe967cdf.source: Placing all crystals before killing the Demagogue will start the end cinematic, preventing bonus completion.
05e210bb826445b58f248dae3c9cc277fe967cdf.text: 在杀死煽动者之前放置所有水晶将开始结束动画，从而阻止奖励完成。

5192452ce56570e05e678ac56df13ae3ea723f41.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Henge of Denravi.
5192452ce56570e05e678ac56df13ae3ea723f41.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被传送到丹拉维巨阵。

e9251975e90dc5cae901067253443780d775ef45.source: Although Less Longbow refers to him as a champion, the Demagogue is not a boss: he does not give a morale boost when killed and you cannot cap skills from him.
e9251975e90dc5cae901067253443780d775ef45.text: 尽管Less Longbow将他称为冠军，但煽动者并不是boss：他被杀时不会提高士气，而且你无法限制他的技能。

655a1e47a0104d4ec1460fa7e637a0ccf082ecce.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
655a1e47a0104d4ec1460fa7e637a0ccf082ecce.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 5 页。

5e9afbda5f1af37457b62863365db4f9460ee58b.source: Travel to the rendezvous point on the Jahai Bluffs to discover the origin of the mysterious message.
5e9afbda5f1af37457b62863365db4f9460ee58b.text: 前往贾海悬崖上的集合点，寻找神秘信息的来源。

d1c6ed850c0fd9baf49bcaa55dc4a073c5b851d9.source: See Whispers Adept for your reward.
d1c6ed850c0fd9baf49bcaa55dc4a073c5b851d9.text: 请参阅低语专家以获得奖励。

3d262b31f106792e124932be1221fd97cc77b092.source: To obtain this quest talk to Lonai. Then go out to Jahai Bluffs and speak to the Whispers Adept for the reward. Margrid the Sly and the Master of Whispers will each offer a quest. These two quests are mutually exclusive, meaning you can choose only one of them. You now have to decide if you prefer Margrid or the Master of Whispers as a hero until you complete the campaign.
3d262b31f106792e124932be1221fd97cc77b092.text: 要获得此任务，请与洛奈交谈。然后前往贾海悬崖并与低语专家交谈以获得奖励。狡猾的玛格丽特和密语大师将各自提供一个任务。这两个任务是互斥的，这意味着你只能选择其中之一。现在你必须决定你是否喜欢玛格丽特或低语大师作为英雄，直到你完成战役。

68a77bd3d19e7e06f1aab1f20deb1a4b79eafb3d.source: After accepting the quest reward for this quest, both Master of Whispers and Margrid will offer their follow-up quest. Do note that these quests are mutually exclusive and accepting one will cancel the other. Player characters who accept the quests leading to obtaining one hero will not be able to participate in another PC's mission (although they will be able to participate in the quests) to obtain the other hero until their own mission is complete. Each of their branches eventually lead to your character unlocking the hero you selected.
68a77bd3d19e7e06f1aab1f20deb1a4b79eafb3d.text: 在接受该任务的任务奖励后，低语大师和玛格丽德都会提供后续任务。请注意，这些任务是相互排斥的，接受一个任务将取消另一个任务。接受导致获得一名英雄的任务的玩家角色将无法参与另一台电脑的任务（尽管他们能够参与任务）以获得另一名英雄，直到他们自己的任务完成。他们的每个分支最终都会导致你的角色解锁你选择的英雄。

6a6f7cbb6ed00ed29beb29728e5c38daac1dbda4.source: When multiple players are in the party, once a player accepts one of the follow-up quests, the quest exclamation mark will no longer show above that corresponding hero's head. This is just a graphical issue; that hero will still offer their quest to players who have not selected. All players in the party can make their own choice about which quest to take.
6a6f7cbb6ed00ed29beb29728e5c38daac1dbda4.text: 当队伍中有多名玩家时，一旦有玩家接受其中一个后续任务，相应英雄头上将不再显示任务感叹号。这只是一个图形问题；该英雄仍然会向未选择的玩家提供任务。队伍中的所有玩家都可以自行选择接受哪个任务。

11841950e888c9535f0e44805608885340955850.source: Speak with Blade Operative Paulina in Sanctum Cay to garner passage to Riverside Province.
11841950e888c9535f0e44805608885340955850.text: 与圣岛的刀锋特工宝琳娜交谈，获得前往河滨省的通道。

f9c0f3e93c660c4ab34cae37428c20efa698bb5d.source: Kill Willem the Demeaning, currently residing in the Temple of the Unseen, located in Riverside Province
f9c0f3e93c660c4ab34cae37428c20efa698bb5d.text: 杀死卑鄙的威廉，目前居住在河滨省的隐形神殿中

012cfa4fd188b60000f5a19d4fa526bd0ac62f46.source: Speak with Blade Operative Paulina to be briefed on the temple's defenses.
012cfa4fd188b60000f5a19d4fa526bd0ac62f46.text: 与刀锋特工宝琳娜交谈，了解神庙防御的简报。

03aed4e29ad4c79397b272971a5fcb0473df141b.source: Gain access to the heart of the Temple of the Unseen, either by assaulting the front gate or acquiring the keys to the rear entrance.
03aed4e29ad4c79397b272971a5fcb0473df141b.text: 通过攻击前门或获取后门的钥匙，进入隐形神殿的中心。

b4b8c658dfa61cf05282e6aa50ec8f8c923d3238.source: Defeat Ven the Conservator to acquire the blue key.
b4b8c658dfa61cf05282e6aa50ec8f8c923d3238.text: 击败管理员文恩以获得蓝色钥匙。

0d13bd9f10fbbbd2ec87d5ac3342b903ed3a35f5.source: Defeat Degaz the Cynical to acquire the red key.
0d13bd9f10fbbbd2ec87d5ac3342b903ed3a35f5.text: 击败愤世嫉俗者德加兹以获得红色钥匙。

6eff23015f7ef4b6dc980e3bfdaeeb8589c90cf7.source: See Princess Salma for your reward.
6eff23015f7ef4b6dc980e3bfdaeeb8589c90cf7.text: 去找萨尔玛公主领取奖励。

c3aae2c33818bf9b2dbfec90c8ed73fb945b9bea.source: Speak to Blade Operative Paulina (in Sanctum Cay) to get started; she will transport you via sea to Riverside Province. (Your transport vessel also serves as the only resurrection in the area; if you wipe, you will have to retrace your steps.)
c3aae2c33818bf9b2dbfec90c8ed73fb945b9bea.text: 与刀锋特工宝琳娜（位于圣岛）交谈即可开始；她将通过海运将您运送到河滨省。 （你的运输船也是该地区唯一的复活点；如果你抹掉了，你将不得不折回你的脚步。）

d4d6185f5f38c31058cd82ca3ac45c832b934962.source: Head north across the beach, killing the White Mantle opposing your progress. Beware of the Jade Cloaks who attack you from the safety of their towers; they can can be avoided by moving out of casting range.
d4d6185f5f38c31058cd82ca3ac45c832b934962.text: 向北穿过海滩，杀死阻碍你前进的白斗篷。小心玉袍人，他们会从安全的塔楼里攻击你；可以通过移出施法范围来避免它们。

c13bdd7c44a6217344fd839a2838fdc78423fc3f.source: Proceed south-west until you come to the passage heading off to the North. Before you attack the group in front of the gate, be sure to eliminate the two White Mantle who try to sneak up on you from the open ground. Head around the bend until you can see the main entrance to the Temple of the Unseen. Try to pull the Mantle and Jade mobs out of the Mursaat tower effect separately (the Jade all possess high armor ratings meaning they die slower than the rest and pose more of a risk). After you have killed the mobs in the entrance, kill the Ether Seal producing the Ether Tower effect. The tower will quickly reduce your energy level to zero, making it hard to attack or heal with spells. Alternatively, kill the mobs nearby and then run past the seal; its effect does not reach into the next room.
c13bdd7c44a6217344fd839a2838fdc78423fc3f.text: 继续向西南方向行驶，直到到达通往北方的通道。在你攻击门前的队伍之前，一定要消灭掉从空地上偷袭你的两只白斗篷。绕过拐弯处，直到您可以看到隐形神殿的主入口。尝试将地幔和翡翠生物分别从Mursaat塔效应中拉出来（翡翠生物都拥有很高的装甲等级，这意味着它们比其他生物死得慢并且构成更大的风险）。杀死入口处的小怪后，杀死产生以太塔效果的以太封印。塔会迅速将你的能量水平降至零，使其难以攻击或用法术治疗。或者，杀死附近的小怪，然后跑过封印；它的影响不会到达隔壁房间。

312ad496c56faf8e19d359b466d71cfa4649ded8.source: Continue across the courtyard to the gate, either pulling the White Mantle group or avoid them completely by using the Eastern side. Pull the Jade Bow, Cloak & Armor away from the mesmer boss. Finally kill Willem the Demeaning to complete the quest.
312ad496c56faf8e19d359b466d71cfa4649ded8.text: 继续穿过庭院到达大门，要么拉动白斗篷队伍，要么从东侧完全避开他们。将玉弓、斗篷和盔甲从催眠老大身上拉开。最后杀死卑鄙的威廉来完成任务。

865b4c2fcc0943ca5bfda6d0434fc03b34e9735c.source: If you want to avoid the Ether Seal, you can take 30 extra minutes by going the long way around. Kill the two other bosses marked on the map, pick up their keys, then head for the green gate, which leads to your target.
865b4c2fcc0943ca5bfda6d0434fc03b34e9735c.text: 如果你想避开以太封印，可以绕很远的路多花30分钟。杀死地图上标记的另外两个头目，拿起他们的钥匙，然后前往通向目标的绿色大门。

05269b2019362b7f86c78d88b8087ae4f15da3b5.source: 15 seconds after killing Willem, the party will be returned to Sanctum Cay.
05269b2019362b7f86c78d88b8087ae4f15da3b5.text: 杀死威廉后 15 秒，队伍将返回圣殿岛。

6132cbdd439796c34591edd36ea85a9b608af6b2.source: Frozen Soil can be helpful, to suppress the Mantle's hard resurrection skills (usually carried by at least one foe in each group).
6132cbdd439796c34591edd36ea85a9b608af6b2.text: 冰冻土壤可以帮助抑制地幔的硬复活技能（通常由每组中至少一个敌人携带）。

36ef151f2566ecfc0deaa61cd7405d98ab87691a.source: You can take down the Ether Seal quickly by placing attack spirits just outside of its spell range.
36ef151f2566ecfc0deaa61cd7405d98ab87691a.text: 你可以通过将攻击灵放置在以太封印的法术范围之外来快速拿下以太封印。

416c95db29fea59718451f3332ca12bb323a538f.source: Remember to switch back into normal mode; unlike the previous three assassinations, there are no extra rewards for completing the quest in hard mode.
416c95db29fea59718451f3332ca12bb323a538f.text: 记得切换回正常模式；与前三场刺杀不同的是，在困难模式下完成任务没有额外的奖励。

d1bcc29a09ba9b7c01f9e06c2d6c2ccb6830a61f.source: Travel to the Asuran Lab via the Secret River Passage in Talmark Wilderness
d1bcc29a09ba9b7c01f9e06c2d6c2ccb6830a61f.text: 经由塔尔马克荒野的秘密河道前往阿苏兰实验室

fa85f3b3c2b415d48dafb0eeb883aa1bb257ef56.source: Speak with Livia to plan your raid on Shaemoor
fa85f3b3c2b415d48dafb0eeb883aa1bb257ef56.text: 与莉维亚交谈以计划对谢莫尔的突袭

2d4947de14dedf6019bb9cc2fbdf9d6f4d0334f7.source: Acquire the Key to the Fountain of Truth by killing Cairn the Berserker in Loamhurst
2d4947de14dedf6019bb9cc2fbdf9d6f4d0334f7.text: 杀死洛姆赫斯特的狂战士凯恩，获得真理之泉的钥匙

75ef06a2ddf6fdca15ffd8fbd9c3082034ba428a.source: Speak with Zinn to find out what weapons he has prepared for you.
75ef06a2ddf6fdca15ffd8fbd9c3082034ba428a.text: 与津交谈，了解他为你准备了哪些武器。

60a9a2ef488406ca5d2ac28102b75bb4db13e85b.source: Clear the way to the Fountain of Truth by defeating Justiciar Sevaan and his forces in Shaemoor. [10...0] of 10 groups remaining.
60a9a2ef488406ca5d2ac28102b75bb4db13e85b.text: 击败谢莫尔审判官塞瓦安和他的军队，扫清通往真理之泉的道路。剩余 10 组中的 [10...0]。

63b8904819314a027c2777e715e9dd115f76cd06.source: Open the gate to the Fountain of Truth, and kill Aily the Innocent.
63b8904819314a027c2777e715e9dd115f76cd06.text: 打开真理之泉的大门，杀死无辜者艾莉。

7d4126db7f5ec0567ef2022889a73b12f70c1db3.source: Return to Princess Salma for a reward.
7d4126db7f5ec0567ef2022889a73b12f70c1db3.text: 返回萨尔玛公主那里领取奖励。

bc5090bb2f1e89850a95302b2d6c7a542adea290.source: Begin at the Temple of the Ages and head west into the Talmark Wilderness. Once there, hug the east wall to reach the Secret River Passage which takes you to the Divinity Coast (1). Head west to Zinn's laboratory to receive further instructions from Livia (2). Zinn's lab (4) will also function as a resurrection shrine should your party wipe.
bc5090bb2f1e89850a95302b2d6c7a542adea290.text: 从时代神殿出发，向西进入塔尔马克荒野。到达那里后，沿着东墙到达秘密河道，将您带到神性海岸 (1)。向西前往 Zinn 的实验室，接受 Livia 的进一步指示 (2)。如果你的队伍被消灭，津恩的实验室 (4) 也将充当复活神殿。

2e07ad9c98e8322e4ea8ba2ab52c0f7b26cf6ab0.source: Next, head to Loamhurst (west of 3) on the northern part of the map (this is the destination for the Chosen during Divinity Coast). As before, you have to traverse through the western swamps while battling Peacekeeper groups. Avoid fighting in the water, which inflicts poison. Cairn the Berserker waits at the drawbridge to Loamhurst's small fort (3) and can be pulled away from his allies. Vess the Disputant is inside the fort itself, but killing Cairn is enough to update the quest.
2e07ad9c98e8322e4ea8ba2ab52c0f7b26cf6ab0.text: 接下来，前往地图北部的洛姆赫斯特（3号以西）（这是神圣海岸期间选民的目的地）。和以前一样，你必须穿越西部沼泽，同时与维和人员战斗。避免在水中打斗​​，否则会造成中毒。狂战士凯恩在洛姆赫斯特小堡垒 (3) 的吊桥处等待，可以将其从盟友身边拉开。争论者维斯就在堡垒内部，但杀死凯恩就足以更新任务。

e4fd7d3c4e11a732e15d50c4b05f890c437045ce.source: Once Cairn is dead, head back to Zinn's lab (4). Unfortunately, you will get ambushed 10 times along the return route until reaching the Villagers again. The hidden groups are random assortments of 4–5 White Mantles and possibly a Jade construct. These groups can be avoided by wiping and rezzing at Zinn's lab.
e4fd7d3c4e11a732e15d50c4b05f890c437045ce.text: 凯恩死后，返回津恩的实验室 (4)。不幸的是，你会在返回途中遭到伏击 10 次，直到再次到达村民那里。隐藏组是 4-5 个白斗篷的随机组合，也可能是翡翠构造体。可以通过在 Zinn 实验室擦拭和重新调整来避免这些群体。

56c30fcea1f4a040494209dcf48dd9fddea85bab.source: When you get back to Zinn, he will give you an Asuran Beacon to carry. When it is dropped, it summons three Fire Bit Golems to your location that self-destruct using Bit Golem Crash, damaging all nearby enemies. (Zinn will keep supplying beacons as long as you need them, but you have to return to his lab to get them.) Take a beacon with you to clear Shaemoor (near 5) of the White Mantle presence. Follow the road east and across the long bridge, taking out enemy forces along the way. The gate is heavily guarded, so pull carefully.
56c30fcea1f4a040494209dcf48dd9fddea85bab.text: 当你回到辛恩时，他会给你一个阿苏兰信标供你携带。当它掉落时，它会召唤三个火比特傀儡到您的位置，并使用比特傀儡崩溃来自毁，对附近的所有敌人造成伤害。 （只要你需要信标，津恩就会持续提供信标，但你必须返回他的实验室才能获得它们。） 随身携带信标，清除谢莫尔（靠近 5）的白斗篷存在。沿着道路向东，穿过长桥，消灭沿途的敌军。大门戒备森严，小心拉动。

6b720546bb390bf369fa5fcbfbefc1fc319f1263.source: After removing foes from the gate area, you have to clear out 10 enemy groups from the area. Seven are within Shaemoor proper, including Justiciar Sevaan's (5). The other three groups spawn outside the city and charge in later; pay attention to avoid getting pinned. Once all 10 groups are defeated, use the lever to raise the gate, and head up to the fountain to kill Aily the Innocent (6). Aily is guarded by 4 other Jade constructs and is a potent healer. However, dropping an Asuran Beacon at his feet will damage him enough to make him a quick kill. Any remaining Jade constructs die the moment Aily dies, so focus your attention on him. The party will automatically be brought to the western end of Talmark Wilderness 15 seconds after Aily dies.
6b720546bb390bf369fa5fcbfbefc1fc319f1263.text: 清除大门区域的敌人后，您必须清除该区域的 10 个敌人群体。七个位于谢莫尔境内，其中包括法官塞瓦安 (Justiciar Sevaan) (5)。其他三支队伍在城外产卵，稍后冲锋；注意避免被压住。一旦所有 10 组都被击败，使用杠杆升起大门，前往喷泉杀死无辜者艾莉 (6)。艾莉由另外 4 个翡翠构造体守护，是一位强大的治疗者。然而，将阿苏兰信标扔在他的脚下将会对他造成足够的伤害，足以让他被快速杀死。艾莉死亡后，任何剩余的翡翠构造体都会死亡，因此请将注意力集中在他身上。艾莉死亡后 15 秒，队伍将自动被带到塔尔马克荒野的西端。

a61d245befc131a0004a11a5b12d6cbe85c8351a.source: Frozen Soil suppresses resurrection, which is carried by almost every type of White Mantle and Peacekeeper.
a61d245befc131a0004a11a5b12d6cbe85c8351a.text: 冻土会抑制复活，几乎所有类型的白斗篷和和平守护者都带有复活功能。

8c950c48a78469b0836e7f77ec0de181041fa0fc.source: Proper pulling is critical; make sure that the enemy runs to you, so that they waste their first strike and their preparatory skills.
8c950c48a78469b0836e7f77ec0de181041fa0fc.text: 正确的拉动至关重要；确保敌人跑向你，这样他们就浪费了第一击和准备技能。

26d2896374dfc0d4110492ee780bdc374f3256ce.source: Target healers, unless you can quickly spike-kill key combatants.
26d2896374dfc0d4110492ee780bdc374f3256ce.text: 瞄准治疗者，除非你能快速秒杀关键战斗人员。

8f19594f423bb6f072054fa5c1ba3a2a644c8341.source: Keep the party spread out; the enemies have lots of dangerous AoE skills.
8f19594f423bb6f072054fa5c1ba3a2a644c8341.text: 保持聚会分散；敌人有很多危险的 AoE 技能。

26a8d5f0a29f49d15fa6c48beb98e7c49797b637.source: Infusion helps, but is essential if you are having any trouble in the presence of Mursaat or Jade Constructs.
26a8d5f0a29f49d15fa6c48beb98e7c49797b637.text: 输液会有所帮助，但如果您在穆尔萨特或翡翠构造体的存在下遇到任何麻烦，则输液是必不可少的。

54e93385a555f6e681bd2e0382c54360e52dc5e8.source: Retreat quickly if the tide of battle turns against you.
54e93385a555f6e681bd2e0382c54360e52dc5e8.text: 如果战局对你不利，请迅速撤退。

57d6d4608ed26bb3b68c0fc2ca241c2c900182e1.source: Take advantage of the environment: use choke points to increase the effectiveness of AoE skills (and slow down the enemy); use terrain to protect you from ranged martial attacks.
57d6d4608ed26bb3b68c0fc2ca241c2c900182e1.text: 利用环境：利用阻塞点来提高 AoE 技能的有效性（并减慢敌人的速度）；利用地形来保护你免受远程军事攻击。

c6d201cf0f7bd42629e27e8b41e9e5c8c27099aa.source: Tips for the 5 most difficult points

6ba8e9474cf2075dfb11b3c3c0d30c7b4588cda8.source: These are tips to getting through the 5 most difficult points of the quest:
6ba8e9474cf2075dfb11b3c3c0d30c7b4588cda8.text: 以下是解决任务中 5 个最困难点的技巧：

b0eed52625300018377b9dae172b66450c4b3fd2.source: Two large groups overlap this area: one just in front of the gate to Loamhurst, one just behind it. Unless you can unleash extreme AoE damage (thus killing most of them at once) you must successfully pull them apart. Station/flag the group apart just around the corner (closer to the gate than to the last bridge along the route). Use a long- or flatbow and ensure that only the puller approaches. If your troops turn the corner too soon, you risk attracting the attention of the second group.
b0eed52625300018377b9dae172b66450c4b3fd2.text: 两大群人在此区域重叠：一组位于洛姆赫斯特大门的前面，另一组位于洛姆赫斯特大门的后面。除非你能释放出极大的 AoE 伤害（从而一次性杀死大部分敌人），否则你必须成功地将他们拉开。在拐角处驻站/标记小组分开（距离大门比沿路线的最后一座桥更近）。使用长弓或平弓，并确保只有拉弓者靠近。如果你的部队过早扭转局势，你就有可能吸引第二批人的注意。

da12da281ab8506c6271e1c82679d78c56c5c9aa.source: Vess' group patrols close to the castle bridge, so they can easily be within aggro distance of Cairn's. Accordingly, pull Cairn's group away from the castle gate; they should go down quickly. If need be, you can pull Cairn's allies away from Cairn (or vice-versa). If you need to, use the gate area as a choke point to use AoE skills on Vess' team.
da12da281ab8506c6271e1c82679d78c56c5c9aa.text: 维斯的小队在城堡桥附近巡逻，因此他们可以轻松地进入凯恩的小队的仇恨范围内。因此，将凯恩的队伍拉离城堡大门；他们应该很快就下去。如果需要，您可以将凯恩的盟友从凯恩拉开（反之亦然）。如果需要，可以使用大门区域作为阻塞点，对 Vess 的团队使用 AoE 技能。

e267be6493b689a7d0fcd75a3edd9a71c2adab65.source: There are 10 groups along the way, but you can skip them all by allowing your team to die; you will resurrect at the lab. (Remember to flag those heroes without resurrection skills away, so they do not end up with death penalty.) You are not required to pick-up Asuran Beacons to complete the quest, but they are very helpful. However, if you are doing this using only heroes and henchmen, hold off on grabbing one so that it does not slow you down; once you have cleared Shaemoor, you can return to Zinn.
e267be6493b689a7d0fcd75a3edd9a71c2adab65.text: 一路上有 10 组，但你可以通过让你的团队死亡来跳过所有组；你将在实验室复活。 （记得标记那些没有复活技能的英雄，这样他们就不会被判处死刑。） 你不需要拿起阿苏兰信标来完成任务，但它们非常有帮助。然而，如果你只使用英雄和追随者来做到这一点，请推迟抓住一个，这样它就不会减慢你的速度；一旦你清除了谢莫尔，你就可以返回辛恩。

5f55f55eb777f7ed1d8659388733ef018cdc12dc.source: Shaemoor can be difficult to clear for two reasons: (1) there are overlapping patrols and (2) reinforcements spawn right on top of you. Start out by making sure that you clear the patrols from the west gate into the village, lest they return before you have occupied that area. Next, take advantage of the terrain: the gate is an excellent choke point and it is also elevated from the surrounding area. Station your troops outside the village, so that they can pound the enemy as it comes up the hill and through the gate. By carefully pulling one group at a time, you should be able to clear 2-3 groups from this spot.
5f55f55eb777f7ed1d8659388733ef018cdc12dc.text: 谢莫尔可能很难清除，原因有两个：(1) 巡逻队重叠，(2) 增援部队就在你的上方生成。首先确保清除从西门进入村庄的巡逻队，以免他们在你占领该区域之前返回。接下来，利用地形：大门是一个极好的咽喉要道，而且它也比周围区域高。将你的部队驻扎在村外，这样他们就可以在敌人上山并穿过大门时对其进行打击。通过一次小心地拉一组，您应该能够从该位置清除 2-3 组。

3f0976daa9695b9fe2b1fd5c575d02acd5e7e9da.source: Just across from the gate is a set of stairs with a group that spawns out of reach of the gate; take them out. Now, clear the lowest level, hugging the western wall, so that you do not attract aggro from other groups. Defeat the guards at the remaining open gate and then use this gate to defend against the reinforcements that will approach from outside the village. You will not need a bow to attract these groups; just take a few steps outside the gate and they should approach you. After clearing them out, you should be able to defeat all but the boss group from either this spot or the stairway nearest the western gate.
3f0976daa9695b9fe2b1fd5c575d02acd5e7e9da.text: 大门对面是一组楼梯，其中有一群人在大门够不到的地方产生；把他们拿出来。现在，清除最低层，紧靠西墙，这样你就不会吸引其他团体的仇恨。击败剩下的打开的门处的守卫，然后利用这个门来防御从村外逼近的援军。你不需要弓箭来吸引这些群体；只要向门外走几步，他们就会接近您。清除掉他们后，你应该能够从这个地点或最靠近西门的楼梯击败除了头目组之外的所有人。

ade4e10f3ae6cdaeafcd7294d2aae5c442cf02f9.source: The boss group should not be much harder than any of the others, but if you have trouble, you can use one of the stairways as a choke point and pull the group down the stairs.
ade4e10f3ae6cdaeafcd7294d2aae5c442cf02f9.text: Boss组应该不会比其他组难多少，但如果你遇到麻烦，你可以使用其中一个楼梯作为阻塞点，将组拉下楼梯。

2bc1aa0c456760dd7ba42e5a70c7489e1dcf9d89.source: Players that are not infused are at risk and should take a back seat to heroes, henchmen, and players that are infused. If you need to, it is worth the time for each player to return to the lab and grab an Asuran Beacon.
2bc1aa0c456760dd7ba42e5a70c7489e1dcf9d89.text: 未注入的玩家面临风险，应该让位于英雄、追随者和已注入的玩家。如果需要的话，每个玩家都值得花时间返回实验室并获取阿苏兰信标。

5cd34df0e0879859f0592b1aced64150e9ff8563.source: Avoid going up the stairs: it is all too easy for the party to get snared together and be easy pickings for the final group's AoE. Instead, take a left before the stairs and head up the path. Position the team as you turn the corner, well away from aggro range. This position gives your team full view of the approaching enemies and requires them to waste time walking to you, which costs them initiative and some of their buffs.
5cd34df0e0879859f0592b1aced64150e9ff8563.text: 避免上楼梯：队伍很容易被困在一起，并很容易成为最后一组的 AoE 目标。相反，请在楼梯前左转，然后沿着小路走。当你转弯时，将团队定位在远离仇恨范围的地方。这个位置让你的团队可以全面看到正在逼近的敌人，并要求他们浪费时间走到你身边，这会损失他们的主动性和一些增益。

37ca88d01376d4007983775681d835ae28c43f52.source: From this position, pull Aily's group by using a non-line-of-sight skill; you might need a bow to maintain aggro, so that they continue towards you after rounding the corner. Wait until they reach range for all party members before dropping any beacons (any sooner, and you lose initiative and waste some of the beacon power as your team moves in). You do not need to defeat Aily's allies, so concentrate all power on the boss. If things go well, 1-2 beacons should weaken him enough that you can kill him. On the other hand, if any of his teammates are near death, kill them and retreat quickly; Aily alone is not much of a threat (if you have made it this far).
37ca88d01376d4007983775681d835ae28c43f52.text: 从这个位置，使用非视距技能拉动艾莉一行人；你可能需要一把弓来保持仇恨，以便他们在拐过拐角后继续向你靠近。等到他们到达所有队伍成员的范围后再放下任何信标（如果太早，你就会失去主动性，并在你的团队进入时浪费一些信标能量）。你不需要打败艾莉的盟友，所以把所有的力量集中在老板身上。如果一切顺利，1-2 个信标应该足以削弱他，让你可以杀死他。另一方面，如果队友濒临死亡，则击杀他们并迅速撤退；艾莉一个人并不算太大的威胁（如果你已经做到了这一步）。

26f3db521e5b077d8ab6db76c0859b40f34b4457.source: After completing the quest, the party will be returned to Talmark Wilderness, by the portal to Majesty's Rest.
26f3db521e5b077d8ab6db76c0859b40f34b4457.text: 完成任务后，队伍将通过通往陛下之眠的传送门返回塔尔马克荒野。

ee7d379136490486581ae6735bbe99b5390b1844.source: Cairn the Berserker will not appear unless you talk to Livia first.
ee7d379136490486581ae6735bbe99b5390b1844.text: 除非你先与莉维亚交谈，否则狂战士凯恩不会出现。

8f4f6afab37fc0d89b15c36d4d0fa978d14dda6e.source: The lever does not open the gate until you have killed all the 10 groups within Shaemoor (the monitor will show that you possess the key).
8f4f6afab37fc0d89b15c36d4d0fa978d14dda6e.text: 除非你杀死了 Shaemoor 内的所有 10 个小组，否则杠杆不会打开大门（监视器将显示你拥有钥匙）。

457e43e4875725307718f9dd838f54748875dab8.source: Be careful at the main gate to Shaemoor; it is possible to aggro several small groups from inside the town creating a 20-foe mob. Should this happen (often after a party wipe), it can appear to be difficult to pull the groups apart. Take advantage of the gate as a natural choke point for blocking and using AoE skills.
457e43e4875725307718f9dd838f54748875dab8.text: 在谢莫尔的大门处要小心；可以从城镇内部聚集几个小团体，形成 20 人的暴民。如果发生这种情况（通常是在聚会结束后），似乎很难将团体分开。利用大门作为阻挡和使用 AoE 技能的天然阻塞点。

a3eadd63c3a9b9f1ad08fba0f8a595ef01704b02.source: In Russian, Italian, Spanish and French translations, the number of groups remaining is not posted. Some of the tablets of Janthir are on hills or sloping terrain; they appear to float above the ground (this is most easily observed before the main bridge to Shaemoor).
a3eadd63c3a9b9f1ad08fba0f8a595ef01704b02.text: 在俄语、意大利语、西班牙语和法语翻译中，未公布剩余组数。詹瑟尔的一些石碑位于山丘或斜坡上；它们似乎漂浮在地面之上（这在通往谢莫尔的主桥之前最容易观察到）。

fc1219599b75fef29688609a4fdde8547f179b6e.source: Talk to Old Joness to gain passage down the Ullen River.
fc1219599b75fef29688609a4fdde8547f179b6e.text: 与老琼斯交谈，获得沿着尤伦河顺流而下的通道。

cf956b9f5f1890f80d32889581f3a4055529765a.source: Deliver Evennia's message to Derrikk Deathblade.
cf956b9f5f1890f80d32889581f3a4055529765a.text: 将艾文妮娅的信息传递给德里克·死刃。

de9801a1fc9ad7cbc16cc16b06f4adc7c340aff3.text: 能量 +10（需要 8 土系魔法）

d7334151e8cbaf2ca7faaf519af7e02701b4e66e.source: Follow Carlotta right after exiting Henge of Denravi. Along the way are many groups of Jungle Trolls and Moss Scarabs, with the odd Life Pod thrown in for good measure. Stopping to fight these groups will not cause Carlotta to pause in her trek towards Old Joness, but this doesn't matter as the spider drops Marking Webs every so often to mark the path as the group continues onward. Follow these (there is no need to pick them up) and eventually Old Joness will be located. Carlotta will not be attacked by aggressive mobs in the area, but you cannot auto-follow her either.
d7334151e8cbaf2ca7faaf519af7e02701b4e66e.text: 从 Denravi 的 Henge 出口后，立即跟随 Carlotta 行驶。沿途有许多群丛林巨魔和苔藓圣甲虫，还有奇怪的生命舱。停止与这些群体战斗不会导致卡洛塔暂停前往老琼斯的旅程，但这并不重要，因为蜘蛛会时不时地掉落标记网，以在群体继续前进时标记路径。遵循这些（不需要捡起它们），最终就会找到老琼斯。卡洛塔不会受到该地区侵略性怪物的攻击，但你也不能自动跟随她。

65c3dd720d58590c35c83b5f38087d6d7e985c0b.source: It should be noted that you do not have to wait for Carlotta to reach Old Joness in order to speak with him.
65c3dd720d58590c35c83b5f38087d6d7e985c0b.text: 应该注意的是，您不必等待卡洛塔到达老琼斯才能与他交谈。

dfe751cbf3a6a5009bb9d1d714b1e3145925abeb.source: When speaking with Old Joness, follow the dialogue tree that is indicated by Shadow when taking the quest: speak about his son, the White Mantle, and he will eventually take you to Riverside Province (outpost) to get the quest reward by delivering Evennia's Secret Orders to Blade Warrior Derikk.
dfe751cbf3a6a5009bb9d1d714b1e3145925abeb.text: 与老琼斯交谈时，按照影子在接受任务时指示的对话树进行操作：谈论他的儿子白斗篷，他最终会带你前往河滨省（前哨站），通过将埃文尼亚的秘密命令交付给刀锋战士德里克来获得任务奖励。

f0c12d1e263a99496bffdcb1a84f0249f13afa95.source: Alternatively, if you already have Riverside Province on your map, you can simply map travel there and collect your reward.
f0c12d1e263a99496bffdcb1a84f0249f13afa95.text: 或者，如果您的地图上已经有河滨省，您可以简单地绘制那里的旅行地图并领取奖励。

c75b0a96d07a9f1c5f70e2dffd8990090df75729.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 主要职业：仪式师

616fcef8c9764733b4274d156d339e62819cdbcb.source: Seek out Headmaster Quin in the monastery.
616fcef8c9764733b4274d156d339e62819cdbcb.text: 在修道院里寻找奎因校长。

8c5039722cb9c98960bcaab219109862080ae1a2.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the following skills:
8c5039722cb9c98960bcaab219109862080ae1a2.text: 与Shing Jea寺入口处的Ludo交谈即可进入。如果您跳过了螳螂幼体教程，您将学到以下技能：

ae39978d0477073fa4d3ed4f645533889a7df2e2.source: You also gain 2,000 experience, and acquire Starter Ritualist Wand after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Quin, who is nearby, for your reward.
ae39978d0477073fa4d3ed4f645533889a7df2e2.text: 进入修道院后你还将获得2000点经验，并获得入门仪式师魔杖。如果您完成了教程，您就已经收到了这些。与附近的奎恩校长交谈以获得奖励。

9da95f207de7e546fdab45979fee9b4e1eb08347.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Professor Gai.

72b9feb7b5ace23bbbc3298451c188548d5742c1.source: Gai can be found in Sunqua Vale, southwest of the exit from the monastery. Look for Kaabo Cemetery if you have trouble finding him.
72b9feb7b5ace23bbbc3298451c188548d5742c1.text: 盖位于修道院出口西南方向的桑夸谷 (Sunqua Vale)。如果您找不到他，请前往卡博公墓。

f21ceb76d99321909cc37018e88c2bcfd71cd27e.source: Avoid detection on your way to the temple.
f21ceb76d99321909cc37018e88c2bcfd71cd27e.text: 在前往寺庙的途中避免被发现。

ad90d0039156f8e7bf9af759e2aef20a69c6ed1b.source: Talk to Dinas to get the scepter.
ad90d0039156f8e7bf9af759e2aef20a69c6ed1b.text: 与迪纳斯交谈以获得权杖。

b2bb284a5337735cf4bc91b8c96e7e4cedf8ed9e.source: Escape to the bridge to the northeast.

eaaa7b140942aee9b245e555769fcb2471b5fde5.source: *BONUS* Take out the Watchman at each tower, so Saidra can get the weapons through.
eaaa7b140942aee9b245e555769fcb2471b5fde5.text: *奖励*干掉每座塔楼的守望者，这样 Saidra 就可以拿到武器了。

526fc52d462d9dbdbfa4c851f7176c142f83e460.source: This mission can be done without fighting much of anything by avoiding enemies or running past them. The first half is guarded by undead for the most part. All nine of the towers can be completely avoided by having one person walk up close. This will have the effect of the watchtower guards calling the other troops in, allowing your party to sneak by on the outside. When you reach Dinas you will get the Scepter of Orr and there will be a cut-scene. Open the nearby door and follow the path to the northeast. Eventually you will reach a boss blocking a bridge. In theory you are supposed to kill it and run the Scepter of Orr across the bridge, but you can walk to the left of him and the cutscene will activate anyway.
526fc52d462d9dbdbfa4c851f7176c142f83e460.text: 通过避开敌人或跑过他们，可以在不进行任何战斗的情况下完成此任务。前半部分大部分都是由不死族守卫。一个人走近就能完全避开九座塔。这将产生瞭望塔守卫呼叫其他部队的效果，让你的队伍可以从外面溜过去。当你到达迪纳斯时，你会得到奥尔权杖，并且会有一个过场动画。打开附近的门，沿着小路向东北方向走。最终你会遇到一个阻挡桥梁的boss。理论上你应该杀死它并运行奥尔权杖过桥，但你可以走到他的左边，无论如何过场动画都会激活。

310db49554aba8233487df46e788fea326476d79.source: The bonus is quite a different story. Instead of sneaking around the entire White Mantle, the bonus requires defeating the guards in the towers. First, you need to defeat the enemies on the first tower (1). Then head southwest and talk to Saidra (2). She will speak of a need to allow supply trains to slip through the area, which requires the towers be neutralized. There are nine towers in all (positions 1 and 3), each with about a dozen White Mantle guarding it.
310db49554aba8233487df46e788fea326476d79.text: 奖金则完全是另一回事。奖励不需要在整个白斗篷周围潜行，而是需要击败塔楼中的守卫。首先，您需要击败第一座塔 (1) 上的敌人。然后向西南方向前进并与 Saidra (2) 交谈。她将谈到需要允许补给列车穿过该地区，这需要摧毁塔楼。共有九座塔楼（位置 1 和位置 3），每座塔都有大约十几名白斗篷守卫。

d8fa1d05a4bbc1c1db752ff61d853e9efe1d8001.source: There are a couple of stationary enemies in front of each tower, but the watchtower guard will sound the alarm as you approach, causing all nearby White Mantle to return to the tower. To counter the reinforcements, start by setting your team back from the tower (e.g. by flagging party NPCs). Next, send in just one character to trigger the mantle, back away a bit, and wait for the troops to begin dispersing. Pull just a few mantle at a time, defeat them, and repeat until you are left with just the stationary troops.
d8fa1d05a4bbc1c1db752ff61d853e9efe1d8001.text: 每个塔楼前都有几个静止的敌人，但当你接近时，了望塔守卫会发出警报，导致附近的所有白斗篷人返回塔楼。为了对抗援军，首先让你的队伍离开塔楼（例如标记队伍 NPC）。接下来，只派出一个角色来触发斗篷，后退一点，等待部队开始分散。一次只拉几个斗篷，击败他们，然后重复，直到只剩下驻扎的部队。

8068d32685c6535838fd5074f58df14fba4e2aa4.source: The guards are not within your line of sight, so you usually cannot hit them with projectiles or projectile-based spells. Melee characters can sometimes attack the guards through the doors of the tower; however, they are easy prey to non-projectile damage (e.g. via many caster skills): while you hurt them with health degeneration or non-projectile skills, they will have trouble doing any damage to your party.
8068d32685c6535838fd5074f58df14fba4e2aa4.text: 守卫不在你的视线范围内，所以你通常无法用射弹或基于射弹的法术击中他们。近战角色有时可以通过塔门攻击守卫；然而，他们很容易受到非投射伤害（例如通过许多施法者技能）：当你用健康退化或非投射技能伤害他们时，他们将很难对你的队伍造成任何伤害。

82c40448d28286917da77f436eb6eb673b65fa5b.source: Do not cross the bridge with the Scepter until you receive notice that the bonus has been completed.
82c40448d28286917da77f436eb6eb673b65fa5b.text: 在您收到奖金已完成的通知之前，请勿携带权杖过桥。

9bdc96703c3c5d29724a2fc7e0aa764b49568644.source: Consider completing the bonus before going to collect the sceptre, as it leaves you with a very clear run to the bridge.
9bdc96703c3c5d29724a2fc7e0aa764b49568644.text: 考虑在去收集权杖之前完成奖励，因为它可以让你非常清楚地跑到桥上。

92bc482f30b8d11fa35a0c80c2580da92a9ff5ac.source: Area of effect spells are helpful in clearing the towers.
92bc482f30b8d11fa35a0c80c2580da92a9ff5ac.text: 范围法术有助于清除塔楼。

d2bfda31ec246308700c0e8f4c243f1e69803468.source: Consider bringing skills that benefit from holding a bundle on the character that carries the Scepter.
d2bfda31ec246308700c0e8f4c243f1e69803468.text: 考虑给携带权杖的角色带来可以受益的技能。

3007a3702380377479ef98ec82497b3e77f07d9f.source: Anti-caster skills to counter White Mantle Savant's Searing Heat and Ward Against Elements.
3007a3702380377479ef98ec82497b3e77f07d9f.text: 反施法者技能可以对抗白斗篷学者的灼热和元素防御。

15374a0c1f2f1d76ec335a098d46522b12efd9c3.source: If your party has physical attackers, stance removal skills are useful to end White Mantle Seekers's Dryder's Defenses.
15374a0c1f2f1d76ec335a098d46522b12efd9c3.text: 如果你的队伍有物理攻击者，姿态移除技能对于结束白斗篷探索者的干燥者的防御非常有用。

f5620950bf18ff672e042a8e67791dd102c0212d.source: Saidra: "You must be more discreet. If the Mantle see you talking to me, they may become suspicious."
f5620950bf18ff672e042a8e67791dd102c0212d.text: Saidra：“你必须更加谨慎。如果地幔看到你在跟我说话，他们可能会起疑心。”

5511ba86185f6b5672456b5301522649807c2949.source: Saidra: "Well done. Now go finish what you were sent here for, and I'll rendezvous with you on the other side."
5511ba86185f6b5672456b5301522649807c2949.text: Saidra：“干得好。现在去完成你被派到这里的任务，我会在另一边与你会合。”

75d0b9db41ea4be2b0283d345c7691f0430a59b5.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "Listen up, there's talk of raiders on the prowl. If you see any, they are to be terminated on sight"
75d0b9db41ea4be2b0283d345c7691f0430a59b5.text: 白斗篷审判官：“听着，有传言说有袭击者在潜行。如果你看到任何人，一见到他们就会被处决”

3a00678957b9fd8ef6961f0d732fb435222560f9.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "The Unseen Ones are awfully quiet tonight."
3a00678957b9fd8ef6961f0d732fb435222560f9.text: 白斗篷正义者 (1)：“隐形者今晚非常安静。”

1be892bbedf80a4cd5576f0e229e13b04d192b8e.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "When have they ever been noisy?"
1be892bbedf80a4cd5576f0e229e13b04d192b8e.text: 白斗篷审判官（2）：“他们什么时候吵过？”

0de26417e186cd859080bb7922afaab67bac1745.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "You know what I mean."
0de26417e186cd859080bb7922afaab67bac1745.text: 白斗篷审判官(1)：“你知道我的意思。”

e6aa05ccfca9e7ad11dbc2da5343bc9f0204a0c1.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "Yeah, you're right. I wonder what's up?"
e6aa05ccfca9e7ad11dbc2da5343bc9f0204a0c1.text: 白斗篷审判官（2）：“是啊，你说得对。我想知道发生了什么事？”

3c78b57dd97c9aa77ee6b4d735b36d2c492e693c.source: White Mantle Knight (1): "Last night I saw a bone dragon."
3c78b57dd97c9aa77ee6b4d735b36d2c492e693c.text: 白幔骑士（1）：“昨晚我看到了一条骨龙。”

d08a1818e629510836878672a321957329644767.source: White Mantle Knight (2): "A bone dragon? Really? Where?"
d08a1818e629510836878672a321957329644767.text: 白幔骑士（2）：“骨龙？真的吗？在哪里？”

6e70ab8a4329db518ed9046469a5f0749c01cdc8.source: White Mantle Knight (1): "Down in the swamp. A couple of ghouls were leading it around on a leash."
6e70ab8a4329db518ed9046469a5f0749c01cdc8.text: 白斗篷骑士 (1)：“在沼泽里。几个食尸鬼用皮带牵着它。”

4313a347246b131f8ce9ccb051a25b86524297c4.source: South of Temple of the Unseen

0a2eb341c62542b290d3d7dc3756586ef9585732.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "The prophecies of the Unseen Ones talk about the coming of the undead."
0a2eb341c62542b290d3d7dc3756586ef9585732.text: 白斗篷正义者 (1)：“隐形者的预言谈到了不死族的到来。”

31ca0b7063e88793217d5924a12226e6e17a1b1c.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "You really believe that stuff?"
31ca0b7063e88793217d5924a12226e6e17a1b1c.text: 白斗篷审判官（2）：“你真的相信那些东西？”

1de689a48fa08ed4bdebbc78081a9e873c631cdf.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "Yeah, and you should too!"
1de689a48fa08ed4bdebbc78081a9e873c631cdf.text: 白斗篷审判官（1）：“是啊，你也应该这么做！”

65737434175eb940cbe013f4c411664465d10936.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "All right. All right. Don't blow your top."
65737434175eb940cbe013f4c411664465d10936.text: 白斗篷审判官（2）：“好吧。好吧。别发脾气。”

82a4110b450fbaaefc2a0137f0b45306229f7bb2.text: 乔纳斯和格里姆纳尔特

e78bef17e9d491d6333a8cb2fef7ab9489cb03d5.source: Jonas: "What's all this talk about a scepter?"
e78bef17e9d491d6333a8cb2fef7ab9489cb03d5.text: 乔纳斯：“这么多关于权杖的讨论是什么？”

4be030104e640c2c8473823035cedd7cca6cd63a.source: Grimnalt: "I don't know, but it's got the White Mantle all in a huff."
4be030104e640c2c8473823035cedd7cca6cd63a.text: 格里姆纳尔特：“我不知道，但这让白斗篷勃然大怒。”

0ee4cdb7dedfbcd08b90bc35609d684b93b17a77.source: Jonas: "You don't think it could be the famed Scepter of Orr, do you?"
0ee4cdb7dedfbcd08b90bc35609d684b93b17a77.text: 乔纳斯：“你认为这不会是著名的欧尔权杖，对吗？”

71d85d15ae85c22e662d9f8aa84b2d60f9be3c92.source: Grimnalt: "Bah, don't be silly. That's just a legend, nothing but an old wives' tale."
71d85d15ae85c22e662d9f8aa84b2d60f9be3c92.text: 格里姆纳尔特：“呸，别傻了。这只是一个传说，只不过是一个老太太的故事。”

005da4d224e899efca31ba93eb8e54a1fa51cfac.source: Jonas: "Well, there was such a place as Orr, I visited there when I was a little boy."
005da4d224e899efca31ba93eb8e54a1fa51cfac.text: 乔纳斯：“嗯，有一个像奥尔这样的地方，我小时候去过那里。”

14baaf1a45ebdb47a1c4e24e3c245931d8953a9e.source: Grimnalt: "I wasn't sayin' there wasn't a place called Orr."
14baaf1a45ebdb47a1c4e24e3c245931d8953a9e.text: 格里姆纳尔特：“我并没有说没有一个叫奥尔的地方。”

8d1931ccc6cd6149cfeb56873348279ab52a5f5c.text: 乔纳斯：“那你刚才说什么？”

cd236ac8d30b820c55cd9c966c4c2b89dc1f350d.source: Grimnalt: "I was sayin' their ain't no magical scepter, that's all."
cd236ac8d30b820c55cd9c966c4c2b89dc1f350d.text: 格里姆纳尔特：“我只是说他们不是魔法权杖，仅此而已。”

98c2902a89a7447e1c0a560be9a72808fb46578d.source: Jonas: "And I says there is a magical scepter."
98c2902a89a7447e1c0a560be9a72808fb46578d.text: 乔纳斯：“我说有一根神奇的权杖。”

7c0159dd77c8e0cd7749cbafd11caaf687a2f012.source: Grimnalt: "Well, then you'd be as dumb as an ox then wouldn't ya be?"
7c0159dd77c8e0cd7749cbafd11caaf687a2f012.text: Grimnalt：“好吧，那你就傻得像头牛了，不是吗？”

246745916b6e28691cf4c0c5cefcf39473c41c87.text: 乔纳斯：“我？笨得像头牛吗？”

6e040eaacaf3707e0b4749e79562d05b7568ed2a.text: 格里姆纳尔特：“我就是这么说的。”

8256f5bcf1af9098f6a7b7cc0d8e49a11c627115.source: "My friends, it is good to see you again."
8256f5bcf1af9098f6a7b7cc0d8e49a11c627115.text: “我的朋友们，很高兴再次见到你们。”

d1a7f32ad2c20d3b25988703e3750283a7042bd8.source: "I didn't think when we met off in D'Alessio Seaboard that I would be giving you the Scepter of Orr."
d1a7f32ad2c20d3b25988703e3750283a7042bd8.text: “我没想到当我们在达莱西奥海滨见面时，我会把奥尔权杖送给你。”

8e566c7fc031d76c681bd86f1efcb230ef0f16fc.source: "Come, you must not linger here.The Zealots will be back soon."
8e566c7fc031d76c681bd86f1efcb230ef0f16fc.text: “走吧，你不能在这里逗留，狂热者很快就会回来。”

4997a2959a292c72eece16ce0f5e15926366a63f.source: "I will show you the quickest escape route."
4997a2959a292c72eece16ce0f5e15926366a63f.text: “我会告诉你最快的逃生路线。”

c494a3e2acb9b2344f1c6ca024eae5f231a93a8d.source: "To the east is a bridge that will take you over the Ullen River to safety."
c494a3e2acb9b2344f1c6ca024eae5f231a93a8d.text: “东边有一座桥，可以带你越过尤伦河到达安全地带。”

00d953c7befc1f9b62f1b09e9f88cf6ea6e6726c.source: "Stay off the beaten path, and whatever you do, avoid the watchtowers!"
00d953c7befc1f9b62f1b09e9f88cf6ea6e6726c.text: “远离人迹罕至的地方，无论你做什么，都要避开瞭望塔！”

4507dd9485cb90b17e1fd3c03a285c715169d376.source: "Many men have died for this. Guard it with your life."
4507dd9485cb90b17e1fd3c03a285c715169d376.text: “很多人为此而死。用你的生命来守护它。”

e1ac9ec39ebe3b405bbff128a5922e4d20c8ac47.source: White Mantle Knight: "The Scepter of Orr. It's been stolen,"
e1ac9ec39ebe3b405bbff128a5922e4d20c8ac47.text: 白斗篷骑士：“奥尔权杖。它被偷了。”

09d47f520a610bc68107fd8809b4047c77189eb2.source: White Mantle Knight: "The thieves are heading east, toward the Ullen River."
09d47f520a610bc68107fd8809b4047c77189eb2.text: 白斗篷骑士：“盗贼们正在向东前进，前往尤伦河。”

07c4c753bb747fd95d10ffb1b8879f8aa3737d4b.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "They won't get far."
07c4c753bb747fd95d10ffb1b8879f8aa3737d4b.text: 白斗篷审判官：“他们不会走多远的。”

a5fc00bdc05df88ea6b414f3aed6a6078cccde95.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "There are two watchtowers between here and the river. If they try to go past, they will be caught. If they stop to ponder a way around, we will catch them."
a5fc00bdc05df88ea6b414f3aed6a6078cccde95.text: 白斗篷审判官：“这里和河流之间有两座瞭望塔。如果他们试图过去，就会被抓住。如果他们停下来想办法，我们就会抓住他们。”

6bf7a337b19099917b9bb7d0cc1caee35dbe8f69.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "No one who steals from the White Mantle lives long enough to enjoy the spoils."
6bf7a337b19099917b9bb7d0cc1caee35dbe8f69.text: 白斗篷审判官：“从白斗篷偷窃的人都没有活得足够长的时间来享受战利品。”

fbbc7cab9554737c548f583c38fe11e97e034302.source: Evennia: "The time for retribution against our oppressors has finally arrived."
fbbc7cab9554737c548f583c38fe11e97e034302.text: 埃文尼亚：“对压迫者进行报复的时刻终于到来了。”

1c5779c52af040ea5be4dd36de46239b2931b6cc.source: : "I thought the point of stealing the Scepter was to keep it from the Mantle."
1c5779c52af040ea5be4dd36de46239b2931b6cc.text: ：“我认为偷走权杖的目的是为了让它远离斗篷。”

b842052b25c2b6ccac2f92c08d7434c02a715f6b.source: : "How are we going to use it?"

c70a89c8f5a6547cb9be7a7046f8ae28ab6a3a58.source: Evennia: "We can't, but Vizier Khilbron can."
c70a89c8f5a6547cb9be7a7046f8ae28ab6a3a58.text: Evennia：“我们不能，但 Vizier Khilbron 可以。”

dd567474fee9c62aafae1ceab4122191183e2890.source: Evennia: "I negotiated a treaty with the former adviser to the King of Orr."
dd567474fee9c62aafae1ceab4122191183e2890.text: Evennia：“我与奥尔国王的前顾问谈判达成了一项条约。”

c9ced23f85356c2cc86c653287adb8798d1fde9e.source: Evennia: "In exchange for the Scepter, the good vizier has agreed to aid us in our fight against the Mantle."
c9ced23f85356c2cc86c653287adb8798d1fde9e.text: 埃文尼亚：“作为权杖的交换，善良的维齐尔同意帮助我们对抗斗篷。”

4e972c030dfb03e0e0a543f9dd3f2cafa5e2ea99.source: : "Vizier Khilbron? What can one man do for us that we can't do for ourselves?"
4e972c030dfb03e0e0a543f9dd3f2cafa5e2ea99.text: ：“Vizier Khilbron？有什么事情是一个人能为我们做而我们自己却做不到的呢？”

76b3c130dba7fef929a9d6d411f71b8bb335e374.source: Evennia: "The Vizier is a very powerful mage. He can show us the path that will lead to our victory."
76b3c130dba7fef929a9d6d411f71b8bb335e374.text: Evennia：“维齐尔是一位非常强大的法师。他可以向我们展示通往胜利的道路。”

e2472d8a3964eb13799e15c1401ab43dc8558ade.source: Evennia: "Come now. The sun will be rising soon, and we must prepare for our journey to meet the vizier."
e2472d8a3964eb13799e15c1401ab43dc8558ade.text: 埃文尼亚：“快来吧。太阳马上就要升起了，我们必须准备去见维齐尔了。”

7d28897cfcc35c5d34a6a7b1cc5eb5877d5a0c64.source: : "Markis? Why would we have news of him?"
7d28897cfcc35c5d34a6a7b1cc5eb5877d5a0c64.text: ：“马基斯？为什么我们会得到他的消息？”

90fc148391e3af281cdcf936ec2a6aff6233784a.source: Saidra: "He didn't meet you outside the Temple?"
90fc148391e3af281cdcf936ec2a6aff6233784a.text: Saidra：“他没有在圣殿外遇见你？”

7bc7d8b29d028f2a3500421b3fbdcddc53c09ae0.source: : "No. We knew of no such plan."
7bc7d8b29d028f2a3500421b3fbdcddc53c09ae0.text: ：“不。我们不知道有这样的计划。”

d5aafa55f634297a76172fe2341a45a6fdfaa323.source: Saidra: "Hmm. Maybe he'll catch up with us at the docks."
d5aafa55f634297a76172fe2341a45a6fdfaa323.text: Saidra：“嗯。也许他会在码头追上我们。”

9e0b4b9233110ff6232f43fb23dedaa51680bdbe.source: Saidra: "Let's go. Even the Mantle are smart enough to find their way across that river."
9e0b4b9233110ff6232f43fb23dedaa51680bdbe.text: Saidra：“我们走吧。即使是地幔人也足够聪明，能够找到穿过那条河的路。”

ed791ae577ea83bf803defc0f63d15784eec6a1e.source: Saidra: "We'd best not be here when they do."
ed791ae577ea83bf803defc0f63d15784eec6a1e.text: Saidra：“他们来的时候我们最好不要在这里。”

b64e87bf66348ffbe6c5c9ec5fc32e51ac406d0c.source: All watchtowers seems to share the same alert trigger, at the very least the last two towers. If you get into range of one of those, enemies will also gather at the other.
b64e87bf66348ffbe6c5c9ec5fc32e51ac406d0c.text: 所有瞭望塔似乎都共享相同的警报触发器，至少最后两座瞭望塔是如此。如果你进入其中一个的范围，敌人也会聚集到另一个。

ce2d7a004e544fb63054e8d1e9890fc684cac788.source: If you talk to Dinas after you get the scepter he will follow you; he doesn't use any skills.
ce2d7a004e544fb63054e8d1e9890fc684cac788.text: 如果你在拿到权杖后与迪纳斯交谈，他就会跟着你；他不使用任何技能。

7e1c7199249a52ccad5dfb3863ba13ed341680f7.source: You are not required to carry the Scepter at all times: you can drop it at any time and return to pick it up later. For example, you can drop it before each battle or drop it near Dinas, defeat all the guards, and then return to pick it up and run it back to the bridge.
7e1c7199249a52ccad5dfb3863ba13ed341680f7.text: 你不需要一直携带权杖：你可以随时放下它，稍后再回来取。例如，你可以在每次战斗前将其掉落，或者将其掉落在迪纳斯附近，击败所有守卫，然后返回捡起并跑回桥上。

85d15cd13152437836dde0bbc504dd4a6a7f293d.source: The White Mantle and the undead are hostile to each other, you can sometimes lure one group into fighting another.
85d15cd13152437836dde0bbc504dd4a6a7f293d.text: 白斗篷和不死族彼此敌对，你有时可以引诱一组人与另一组人战斗。

638aa74f1a885d78aebc54a2f3c455fbd0b1a4ac.source: Complete exploration of the mission area contributes 1.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. The easiest way to do this is to completely clear the entire area as you scrape, thus securing the bonus as well. Be careful at the bridges near the final boss, lest you prematurely trigger the mission's end. Drop the Scepter of Orr before fighting the boss and continue exploring past the bridge. Then, return for the Scepter and take it back to the bridge to get credit for the mission.
638aa74f1a885d78aebc54a2f3c455fbd0b1a4ac.text: 完成任务区域的探索将为泰尔制图师头衔贡献 1.8%。最简单的方法是在刮擦时完全清理整个区域，从而确保奖金。小心最终boss附近的桥梁，以免过早触发任务结束。在与 Boss 战斗之前放下奥尔权杖，然后继续探索桥梁。然后，返回权杖并将其带回舰桥以获得任务奖励。

1edd4890cebe810af2447f0706bb94c2ef8e1c15.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #6 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
1edd4890cebe810af2447f0706bb94c2ef8e1c15.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 6 页。

74beab7943be8fa5c7cabb4885788646b7260eac.source: After completing this mission, your party will appear in Sanctum Cay.
74beab7943be8fa5c7cabb4885788646b7260eac.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将出现在圣岛。

8ed82c02e67c37e3761cd2a6e6bd46159015b3d6.source: Unlike other Prophecies missions, chests do not appear during this mission. To complete the bonus objective, only the Seekers in the towers need to be killed even though the bonus text suggests that the Watchtower Guards must be defeated.
8ed82c02e67c37e3761cd2a6e6bd46159015b3d6.text: 与其他预言任务不同，此任务期间不会出现宝箱。要完成奖励目标，只需要杀死塔中的探索者，即使奖励文本表明必须击败了望塔守卫。

7942877c3012114a2def9eacfb8faaa9309f39aa.source: Speak with Jiaju Tai and arrange passage to D'Alessio Seaboard
7942877c3012114a2def9eacfb8faaa9309f39aa.text: 与 Jiaju Tai 交谈并安排前往 D'Alessio Seaboard 的行程

4a4fe306662507b8f2e060a815c54137a2fb3479.text: 在哈克伍德寻找迪纳斯。

5efddc485f63ca3d5ec63a589cc485ef751a0b3e.source: Fight your way to the Temple of Tolerance.

af1749c5cd5510aabf9dd991ec2bddcca916fee4.source: Jiaju Tai (at the pier, in Lion's Arch) takes you to the beach. From there, head to Hakewood to speak with Dinas. After he opens the gate, travel towards Temple of Tolerance. Inside the temple, you will face multiple groups of mantles from both entrances. Clear out the groups on the platforms below Koril the Malignant, to give you room to maneuver and a place to retreat. Koril calls in reinforcements when his health drops, one time each at 75%, 50%, 25% and even 10% health. Since the April 28, 2026 update, Koril will often use Well of Blood when engaged, dropping his health and immediately summoning reinforcements.
af1749c5cd5510aabf9dd991ec2bddcca916fee4.text: 家居台（位于狮子拱门的码头）带您前往海滩。从那里前往哈克伍德与迪纳斯交谈。打开大门后，前往宽容寺。在寺庙内部，您将在两个入口处看到多组披风。清除恶毒者科里尔下面平台上的队伍，给你回旋的空间和撤退的地方。当科里尔的生命值下降时，他会呼叫增援，每次生命值下降到 75%、50%、25% 甚至 10% 时。自 2026 年 4 月 28 日更新以来，科里尔在交战时经常会使用鲜血之井，降低生命值并立即召唤援军。

11ed7fe69d1504bd161d7f061abe1b3bc52db7c7.source: When attacking Koril, flag heroes and hench at his location so as not to lure Patrols accidentally. If a patrol comes during the fight against Koril, retreat and deal with the patrol, then return. If more than one appears, pull them apart first. Like his reinforcements, once killed, these patrols do not return. Alternatively, kill most of the patrols and then pull Koril away from his spawn point towards the entrance stairs. Koril's reinforcements spawn at his original position, so this makes the fight much easier.
11ed7fe69d1504bd161d7f061abe1b3bc52db7c7.text: 攻击科里尔时，标记英雄并在他的位置驻守，以免意外引诱巡逻队。如果在与科里尔的战斗中出现巡逻队，请撤退并解决巡逻队，然后返回。如果出现多个，请先将它们分开。就像他的援军一样，一旦被杀，这些巡逻队就不会回来。或者，杀死大部分巡逻队，然后将科里尔从他的重生点拉向入口楼梯。科里尔的援军会在他原来的位置出现，因此这使得战斗变得更加容易。

b64c6a1227fe6c3c31ff3d5c137f95314e63ea8a.source: Once Koril dies, the quest is complete, and a 15-second countdown will start, automatically sending the party back to Lion's Arch upon its conclusion.
b64c6a1227fe6c3c31ff3d5c137f95314e63ea8a.text: 一旦科里尔死了，任务就完成了，15 秒的倒计时将开始，结束后自动将队伍送回狮子拱门。

62cd7415eea9f05d09af8b7e1a9a5dcdbc7e34fe.source: Flag your party at edge of the balcony where Koril stands. Next, Pull (and kill) Koril's allies. Finally, pull and kill Koril. This allows you to avoid any patrols and reinforcements (since the latter spawn only on/near the altar).
62cd7415eea9f05d09af8b7e1a9a5dcdbc7e34fe.text: 在科里尔所在的阳台边缘标记你的队伍。接下来，拉（并杀死）科里尔的盟友。最后，拉并杀死科里尔。这可以让你避免任何巡逻和增援（因为后者只在祭坛上/附近产生）。

fb9b1b8f2b7c6e6a4b9491652171bc5843ad3975.source: There are plenty of corpses to power minion masters. However, use caution against Koril; the minions can easily over-aggro patrols or otherwise undermine your efforts to pull Koril separately.
fb9b1b8f2b7c6e6a4b9491652171bc5843ad3975.text: 有大量的尸体可以为小兵大师提供能量。然而，要谨慎对待 Koril；小兵很容易过度仇恨巡逻，或者以其他方式破坏你单独拉动科里尔的努力。

6219690272bf3ebf08d5e7a9826d1c0c1b9fd95e.source: Interrupts shorten the fight by preventing Koril from using life stealing skills.
6219690272bf3ebf08d5e7a9826d1c0c1b9fd95e.text: 打断可以阻止科里尔使用生命窃取技能，从而缩短战斗时间。

14c74ecec986316c32340f378ff3951123913a41.source: Manage your team carefully: pull groups, flag your team apart, and avoid accidentally aggroing the wrong groups. For this mission, the caster and ranger henchmen are easier to control.
14c74ecec986316c32340f378ff3951123913a41.text: 小心管理您的团队：拉动小组，标记您的团队，并避免意外地激怒错误的小组。对于这个任务，施法者和游侠追随者更容易控制。

4959d1fa89bdf12f8abb5da02a500a6940a6a922.source: There is a resurrect point that shares the spawn point for this quest.
4959d1fa89bdf12f8abb5da02a500a6940a6a922.text: 有一个复活点与该任务共享重生点。

cd36f7aaa7f326ca3cae8d9bb081b79afd595c30.source: It is possible to walk onto a Mursaat tower inside the temple.
cd36f7aaa7f326ca3cae8d9bb081b79afd595c30.text: 可以步行到寺庙内的Mursaat 塔。

dad0d536d42e239f40ec4353b245355697c5b82d.source: The Shining Blade bounties for Justiciar Kasandra and Zaln the Jaded can be completed at the same time as this mission.
dad0d536d42e239f40ec4353b245355697c5b82d.text: 正义者卡珊德拉和玉质扎恩的光刃赏金可以与此任务同时完成。

126ad109492eb03e34996405676605032d802886.source: Speak with Professor Gai when you are ready to begin your test.
126ad109492eb03e34996405676605032d802886.text: 当您准备好开始测试时，请与盖教授交谈。

dcd536bdae6e62a1bddbf71d9f3b92dfdf819936.source: Destroy the wild minions in the mausoleum. [5...0] minions remaining.
dcd536bdae6e62a1bddbf71d9f3b92dfdf819936.text: 消灭陵墓中的野生爪牙。剩余 [5...0] 个小兵。

e7bb430d5f0e94a38261509e3c6d6bb30183eefa.source: See Professor Gai for your reward.

25fe44a820b2d8e034e1d453c12b83025096e645.source: Professor Gai will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
25fe44a820b2d8e034e1d453c12b83025096e645.text: 当你接受任务时，盖教授将教你以下技能：

5e41ac2c322bc7ee9853af7c4a49d31c34f99a31.source: When you talk to Professor Gai again, a level 3 Wild Minion will appear nearby for you to kill, another after the first dies, and so on until you have killed all 5.
5e41ac2c322bc7ee9853af7c4a49d31c34f99a31.text: 当你再次与盖教授交谈时，附近会出现一个 3 级野生小兵供你杀死，第一个死亡后会出现另一个，依此类推，直到你杀死所有 5 个。

3be1642cb8c365a66274b02a1787fe0ae17306fc.source: Hurry to Dakutu Camp in Talmark Wilderness, and bring word to Bartholos of the impending attack on Lion's Arch.
3be1642cb8c365a66274b02a1787fe0ae17306fc.text: 赶紧前往塔尔马克荒野的达库图营地，并向巴索洛斯通报狮子拱门即将遭到袭击的消息。

cf9bbf19e07519597e161a31969d98d9bd932f74.source: Take the Secret River Passage to Divinity Coast, and order Livia to bring the Asuran weapon to Lion's Arch.
cf9bbf19e07519597e161a31969d98d9bd932f74.text: 沿着秘密河道前往神性海岸，命令莉薇娅将阿苏拉武器带到狮子拱门。

8b0adcfe8093d14af4085bed639e967467c0481f.source: Warn Elder Hezron in Beetletun of the armies marching south.
8b0adcfe8093d14af4085bed639e967467c0481f.text: 警告贝特勒顿的赫兹伦长老军队正在向南进军。

5b3e02914f34d2456cdc64dbadcd9e3f230bea73.source: Meet Livia, Zinn, and Blimm outside Beetletun, and protect them while they travel with you to North Kryta Province. They must all survive the journey.
5b3e02914f34d2456cdc64dbadcd9e3f230bea73.text: 在 Beetletun 外与 Livia、Zinn 和 Blimm 会面，并在他们与你一起前往北科瑞塔省时保护他们。他们必须在旅途中幸存下来。

4a1f83ef59b64b0b4e288a68a6f8dacabaf73bc0.source: Warn Elder Sobel of the coming attack, and advise her to evacuate Nebo Village.
4a1f83ef59b64b0b4e288a68a6f8dacabaf73bc0.text: 警告索贝尔长老即将到来的袭击，并建议她撤离尼波村。

5b3c98f19ca6bf5492cdf877bc6dbac6438c308f.source: Meet Livia, Zinn and Blimm in North Kryta Province, and continue protecting them on the journey to Lion's Arch. They must all reach Lion's Arch safely.
5b3c98f19ca6bf5492cdf877bc6dbac6438c308f.text: 在北科瑞塔省与利维亚、津恩和布利姆会面，并在前往狮子拱门的途中继续保护他们。他们必须安全到达狮子拱门。

4b2e12554db099b167c1acd3a0623d80969cb9d6.source: Convince Captain Greywind to evacuate the Ascalon Settlement.
4b2e12554db099b167c1acd3a0623d80969cb9d6.text: 说服格雷温德船长撤离阿斯卡隆定居点。

07523937fd779881872b9643a66698667eb84562.source: Protect the Ascalonian Settlers on their way to take refuge in Lion's Arch. Do not let them all die.
07523937fd779881872b9643a66698667eb84562.text: 保护前往狮子拱门避难的阿斯卡隆定居者。不要让他们全部死去。

23d73c9fe74d7521868c6b98808473fff696f31d.source: Your goal is to gather all of Kryta's allies to prepare for the impending Battle for Lion's Arch. Since this requires running rather than fighting, bring lots of shouts or other skills without activation times.
23d73c9fe74d7521868c6b98808473fff696f31d.text: 你的目标是聚集科瑞塔的所有盟友，为即将到来的狮子拱门之战做好准备。由于这需要奔跑而不是战斗，因此请带上大量的喊叫或其他无需激活时间的技能。

099349811b31bddcbb23130034d8cd1cec72a140.source: Start from Temple of the Ages, cross the portal to the Talmark Wilderness, make your way to the Shining Blade Camp, and speak to Bartholos. Next, head to Zinn's laboratory via the Secret River Passage; once there, speak to Livia. (Single-player teams should map back to the Temple; multiple-player teams can split up when they cross into Talmark and have one person wait by the passage.) Resign and map to Beetletun to speak with Elder Hezron.
099349811b31bddcbb23130034d8cd1cec72a140.text: 从世纪神殿出发，穿过传送门前往塔尔马克荒野，前往光刃营地，并与巴索洛斯交谈。接下来，通过秘密河道前往津恩的实验室；到达那里后，与莉维亚交谈。 （单人团队应该映射回圣殿；多人团队可以在进入塔尔马克时分开，并让一个人在通道旁等待。）辞职并映射到 Beetletun 与长老 Hezron 交谈。

e5e3896574b0cf65528bcbe826efaefa25d2c6b0.source: The next set of activities involve escorting various NPCs towards various stops along the way to Lion's Arch, while being pursued by various groups of White Mantle. Instead of trying to fight the mobs, concentrate on boosting everyone's speed with shouts such as "Charge!", "Fall Back!", and/or "Incoming!". Also bring spirits and traps to distract or slow your foes: anytime foes start closing in, drop a spirit or trap and/or sacrifice a hero (by flagging them near the mobs).
e5e3896574b0cf65528bcbe826efaefa25d2c6b0.text: 接下来的一系列活动包括护送各个 NPC 前往狮子拱门沿途的各个站点，同时遭到白斗篷各个团体的追击。不要试图与小怪战斗，而是集中精力通过喊声“冲锋！”、“后退！”和/或“来袭！”来提高每个人的速度。还要带上灵魂和陷阱来分散敌人的注意力或减慢敌人的速度：每当敌人开始逼近时，就扔下灵魂或陷阱和/或牺牲英雄（通过在小怪附近标记他们）。

c2e5c91cebd1102d1837e00a574a0dd270f4235f.source: First, accompany Livia, Zinn, and Blimm from Beetletun to Lion's Arch (with several stops). Head east into Nebo Terrace and wait for the dialogue to complete. When the NPCs begin running, follow them to Nebo Village and speak to Elder Sobel. Next, head to North Kryta Province, but wait outside the portal until the quest updates. (The Mantle will not catch you here, even if you forgot to bring party-wide speed boosts.)
c2e5c91cebd1102d1837e00a574a0dd270f4235f.text: 首先，陪伴 Livia、Zinn 和 Blimm 从 Beetletun 前往 Lion's Arch（经停数站）。向东进入尼波台并等待对话完成。当 NPC 开始奔跑时，跟随他们前往尼波村并与索贝尔长老交谈。接下来，前往北科瑞塔省，但要在传送门外等待，直到任务更新。 （即使你忘记带全队速度提升，斗篷也不会在这里抓住你。）

72990ed9d929814e8eceb450e1c42a31d2cfe138.source: After entering North Kryta Province, speak to Captain Greywind and, again, wait for the dialogue to finish. Some Ascalonian Settlers will join your caravan. The Mantle will start pursuing you in earnest as you enter the narrow passage to the south. This time, you must use the speed boosts and delaying tactics to ensure that the relevant NPCs (Blimm, Livia, Zinn, and at least one of the settlers) make it safely to LA. Using heroes, flag them ahead of your route and stay behind to help stragglers get unstuck or to delay the enemy; with multiple players, have at least one keep ahead of the group while the other brings up the rear. As long as you are careful, you should have little trouble making it to LA safely.
72990ed9d929814e8eceb450e1c42a31d2cfe138.text: 进入北科瑞塔省后，与格雷温德队长交谈，然后再次等待对话结束。一些阿斯卡隆定居者将加入你的商队。当你进入南面的狭窄通道时，地幔将开始认真追击你。这次，你必须使用加速和拖延战术来确保相关 NPC（Blimm、Livia、Zinn 和至少一名定居者）安全抵达洛杉矶。使用英雄，在你的路线前面标记他们，并留在后面帮助掉队的人摆脱困境或拖延敌人；当有多名玩家时，至少让一个人保持在队伍的前面，而另一个则在后面。只要您小心，安全抵达洛杉矶应该不会有什么困难。

505b3bd9a4a6f100ae2a6b697ff21cdedac2fd4e.source: Once you reach LA, do not enter until your allies are removed from the party window. (There is no danger once you are within compass distance of the portal.)
505b3bd9a4a6f100ae2a6b697ff21cdedac2fd4e.text: 一旦你到达洛杉矶，在你的盟友被从队伍窗口中移除之前不要进入。 （一旦您处于传送门的罗盘距离内，就不会有危险。）

fd3ce78f411ccd3074ce70dd8b1076d46a0b9454.source: During the Nebo Terrace and North Krytan Province sections of this quest, Gwen is listed as Vanguard Mesmer.
fd3ce78f411ccd3074ce70dd8b1076d46a0b9454.text: 在该任务的尼波台地和北克里坦省部分，格温被列为先锋幻术师。

c171c5a437295401d1dc1987bdbeb5faf55473e5.source: Upon claiming the reward for the preceding quest Temple of the Intolerable, you might have to rezone to allow Dinas to spawn and talk with Princess Salma.
c171c5a437295401d1dc1987bdbeb5faf55473e5.text: 在领取前一个任务“难以忍受的神庙”的奖励后，您可能需要重新区域以允许迪纳斯重生并与萨尔玛公主交谈。

0fa8dc2a2f8f6302078c0d22ecbac8bec0964e04.source: During the last leg of this quest, you can zone to Lion's Arch and go back to North Kryta Province to find that there are substantially less foes making a vanquish of North Kryta Province easier. Just do not talk to Captain Greywind as that will trigger the quest. This essentially empties the northwest field of Tengu and the pathway to Nebo Terrace.
0fa8dc2a2f8f6302078c0d22ecbac8bec0964e04.text: 在这个任务的最后一段中，你可以前往狮子拱门并返回北科瑞塔省，你会发现敌人的数量大大减少，这使得征服北科瑞塔省变得更加容易。只是不要与格雷温德船长交谈，因为这会触发任务。这基本上清空了天狗的西北地区和通往尼波台地的道路。

c077b07ff1a9cf726bb975e4f72ce4df837ec465.source: Starting the last leg of the quest in Lion's Arch and running north to the dialogue point (few or no enemies along the way) has the added benefit of activating the resurrection shrine along the way, allowing the possibility of still completing the mission if your party wipes.
c077b07ff1a9cf726bb975e4f72ce4df837ec465.text: 从狮子拱门开始任务的最后一段，并向北跑到对话点（沿途很少或没有敌人）还有一个额外的好处，那就是沿途激活复活神殿，这样即使你的队伍被消灭，仍有可能完成任务。

94545672fcf549428affb5dc6cc0d2c85e7ac32d.source: Although the dialogue for this quest will be triggered upon entering Lion's Arch Keep, you must first accept any rewards for completed Wanted quests before Princess Salma will give you this quest.
94545672fcf549428affb5dc6cc0d2c85e7ac32d.text: 虽然进入狮子拱门要塞时会触发此任务的对话，但您必须先接受完成通缉任务的任何奖励，然后萨尔玛公主才会给您此任务。

3cc8a8414aa7af4ee9a4a5fd904ebdad1e5951e9.source: In Nebo Terrace, 6 groups of White Mantle will spawn, each consisting of 4 White Mantle and 1-3 jade constructs. The first three will spawn one at a time as you reach the point where the NPCs pause and wait for you, and the last three will spawn simultaneously once you enter the open plain, then march towards the exit to North Kryta Province where they will spread away from each other and stop.
3cc8a8414aa7af4ee9a4a5fd904ebdad1e5951e9.text: 在尼波台，会生成 6 组白斗篷，每组由 4 个白斗篷和 1-3 个玉石构造体组成。当你到达 NPC 停下来等待你的地方时，前三个会一次生成一个，而当你进入开阔的平原时，后三个会同时生成，然后向北科瑞塔省的出口前进，在那里它们会彼此分散并停止。

f6fad389f76dcbb13f9a8e20fbe5ae14571f6570.source: After talking with Captain Greywind, about 8 or more groups of 3 White Mantle and 2 jade constructs each will rapidly spawn beyond the portal to Nebo Terrace and start marching towards Lions Arch along the main road. Two of these groups will split off where Captain Grewyind stood and head north further into Ascalon Settlement. Once you get into compass range of Sarnia the Red-Handed, she and the nearby White Mantle will join the chase against the settlers.
f6fad389f76dcbb13f9a8e20fbe5ae14571f6570.text: 与格雷风船长交谈后，大约 8 组或更多组（每组 3 个白斗篷和 2 个玉石构造体）将在通往尼波台的传送门之外快速生成，并开始沿着主路向狮子拱门行进。其中两支队伍将在格鲁因德船长所在的地方分开，向北进一步进入阿斯卡隆定居点。一旦你进入赤手者萨尼亚的指南针范围，她和附近的白斗篷就会加入对定居者的追捕。

3737ca8af945bda52f5e41fa269f5240c4902d89.source: The chasing White Mantle do not drop any loot.
3737ca8af945bda52f5e41fa269f5240c4902d89.text: 追逐的白斗篷不会掉落任何战利品。

c7e52e48a8094e2e08e2f59b3470966fd188c831.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Stingray Strand and start the mission. Completing Riverside Province also brings the party here.
c7e52e48a8094e2e08e2f59b3470966fd188c831.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从 Stingray Strand 走进前哨站并开始任务。完成河滨省后，聚会也会来到这里。

6c9e92cf8cfe180c09a4871a80e748f141c927ea.source: Deliver the Scepter of Orr to Vizier Khilbron and rendezvous with Evennia on the other side of the island.
6c9e92cf8cfe180c09a4871a80e748f141c927ea.text: 将奥尔权杖交给维齐尔基尔布隆，并与岛另一边的埃文尼亚会合。

3684e6841e097f4e7ddca8a91e0bd195eed26808.source: Locate the Vizier and deliver the Scepter.
3684e6841e097f4e7ddca8a91e0bd195eed26808.text: 找到维齐尔并交出权杖。

cde374d3678976f0483cdadfb3412b047f63151b.source: Make your way to the docks on the opposite side of the island.

70641753efcd22f5b39dbfb26afaeffbe055f500.source: *BONUS* Help the Restless Spirit find his final resting place.
70641753efcd22f5b39dbfb26afaeffbe055f500.text: *奖励*帮助不安的灵魂找到他最后的安息之地。

1c410a085098cfb742658783d4df0f1d67f7293f.source: ADDED: You have been betrayed! Evennia has been taken. Meet the Vizier at the docks to make your escape.
1c410a085098cfb742658783d4df0f1d67f7293f.text: 补充：你被背叛了！埃文尼亚已被带走。在码头与维齐尔会面以逃脱。

ba3d307e1aabd850681ba1629930534a157cf232.source: ADDED: Defend the Vizier while he summons a ship for your escape. Get on the boat when he is done.
ba3d307e1aabd850681ba1629930534a157cf232.text: 新增：当维齐尔召唤一艘船帮助你逃跑时，保卫他。等他忙完了就上船。

fb30773f6be1f47a0b16c981bbdf0c704cea9d2e.source: Talk to Evennia and get the Scepter of Orr. Holding it grants +1 energy regeneration, and when dropped it increases the maximum energy of nearby allies by 10.
fb30773f6be1f47a0b16c981bbdf0c704cea9d2e.text: 与埃文尼亚交谈并获得奥尔权杖。持有它可以获得 +1 能量回复，掉落时会使附近盟友的最大能量增加 10。

093e704b6c0921a60123a831024cab9a5f58799a.source: Head south past the Inferno Imps onto the beach with Lightning Drakes, then follow the river north. There are undead patrols at the bridge; consider pulling the mobs apart for safety.
093e704b6c0921a60123a831024cab9a5f58799a.text: 与闪电幼龙一起向南经过地狱小鬼到达海滩，然后沿着河流向北行驶。桥上有亡灵巡逻队；为了安全起见，考虑将小怪分开。

24bf8b495d90e0182c59b590a3e8e7200bc74c9c.source: Cross the poisonous swamp with the Bone Dragons and find a gate lever - pull it once to open the gate. Continue up the hill to meet Vizier Khilbron (point A), and a cinematic will trigger. He will summon undead allies to aid the party. The party leader can talk to the Smoke Phantoms so that they follow the party, instead of running off on their own (and soon thereafter die to the White Mantle).
24bf8b495d90e0182c59b590a3e8e7200bc74c9c.text: 与骨龙一起穿越有毒沼泽，找到门杆 - 拉动一次即可打开门。继续上山与 Vizier Khilbron（A 点）会面，然后会触发一个过场动画。他将召唤亡灵盟友来协助队伍。队伍领袖可以与烟雾幻影交谈，以便他们跟随队伍，而不是自行逃跑（并很快死于白斗篷）。

af8334c1655b05f7d565477e8b7a9be83622cf23.source: Escape to the eastern shore defeating the White Mantle on the way. Find the docks (point B) and the Vizier will appear again. Protect the Vizier while he summons a ship. White Mantle groups will then approach from both sides. Finish each group before the next wave comes or the party may be overwhelmed. When the boat appears, any one player boarding it will end the mission. Sending heroes or henchmen onto it will not end the mission.
af8334c1655b05f7d565477e8b7a9be83622cf23.text: 途中击败白斗篷逃往东海岸。找到码头（B点），维齐尔将再次出现。在维齐尔召唤一艘船时保护他。然后白斗篷团体将从两侧接近。在下一波浪潮到来之前完成每一组，否则队伍可能会被淹没。当船出现时，任何登上它的玩家都会结束任务。派遣英雄或追随者登上它并不会结束任务。

8f6513fd4d81318b19aed1381df9faffa6d6d410.source: The bonus requires that the party escorts a Restless Spirit to his final resting place. Although it is invulnerable to damage, the bonus can be tricky because (a) the spirit can get stuck on fixed objects or body blocked by allied spirits or minions, (b) it changes its following mechanic midway through the mission, (c) it lags behind the party, and (d) it is not necessarily affected by party-wide speed boosts.
8f6513fd4d81318b19aed1381df9faffa6d6d410.text: 奖励要求队伍护送不安的灵魂到他最后的安息之地。虽然它不会受到伤害，但奖励可能会很棘手，因为（a）灵魂可能会卡在固定物体或被盟军灵魂或小兵阻挡的身体上，（b）它在任务中途改变其跟随机制，（c）它落后于团队，并且（d）它不一定受到团队范围内速度提升的影响。

480625ac4b448a69b66030534b5e93d254e2b868.source: The spirit can be found after getting past the Fire Imps, at the end of the Lightning Drake beach (point 1). Have the scepter-bearer speak to it once and it will follow the scepter around, depending on who is carrying it. Once the party reaches the lever of the fort where the Vizier awaits, make sure that the spirit follows inside (and is not lagging behind); after the Vizier takes the scepter the cinematic is triggered, the gate will be locked, and the spirit will be stuck outside (preventing completion of the bonus).
480625ac4b448a69b66030534b5e93d254e2b868.text: 经过火小鬼后，可以在闪电龙海滩的尽头找到灵魂（第 1 点）。让权杖持有者对它说话一次，它就会跟随权杖四处走动，具体取决于谁携带它。一旦队伍到达维齐尔等待的堡垒杠杆处，请确保灵魂跟随进入（并且不落后）；维齐尔拿走权杖后，过场动画被触发，大门将被锁定，灵魂将被困在外面（阻止奖励的完成）。

d3780afb11b60453935ddc234cb58afa51eca28a.source: After talking to Khilbron, speak to the spirit again so that it begins following the party. Without the scepter, the spirit will usually follow the nearest player, but (as with any ally or follower), it might instead move towards the nearest player in motion (and within compass range). Keep an eye on the spirit at all times to make sure it remains close to the party.
d3780afb11b60453935ddc234cb58afa51eca28a.text: 与基尔布伦交谈后，再次与灵魂交谈，以便它开始跟随队伍。如果没有权杖，灵魂通常会跟随最近的玩家，但是（与任何盟友或追随者一样），它可能会移向最近的移动玩家（并且在罗盘范围内）。时刻关注精神，确保它与党保持密切联系。

1d9ffb01e7a9a8f7f4f2674c16023095a710ede1.source: The bonus only requires a slight detour from the docks to reach the cemetery (point 2), which can be done by hugging the cliffs. The event will not trigger until you get close to the docks. Alternatively, head for the docks first, defend the Vizier and exterminate all opponents and then lead the spirit to its resting place before getting on the boat.
1d9ffb01e7a9a8f7f4f2674c16023095a710ede1.text: 奖励只需要稍微绕道从码头到达墓地（第2点），这可以通过拥抱悬崖来完成。在您靠近码头之前，该事件不会触发。或者，先前往码头，保卫维齐尔并消灭所有对手，然后将灵魂带到安息之地，然后再上船。

8d1aef52560e4f05719e56862bcb90cfc1cc1646.source: Consider anti-caster skills against the Inferno Imps who use Rodgort's Invocation.
8d1aef52560e4f05719e56862bcb90cfc1cc1646.text: 考虑使用反施法者技能对抗使用罗德戈特召唤的地狱小鬼。

caa100aee1cc42e817beba8ff78b1508de6d80cc.source: Be wary of Lightning Drakes spiking with Mind Shock and Lightning Orb.
caa100aee1cc42e817beba8ff78b1508de6d80cc.text: 警惕带有心灵震击和闪电球的闪电幼龙。

4dcd821cadb84bd9a67afee948e278eae6e3d67b.source: Hugging the rocks "walls" both north and west of the docks will not trigger the Vizier on the docks. Hugging the northernmost rocks will spawn the White Mantle enemies that would otherwise spawn while the Vizier performs his ritual. This allows the party to dispatch them without having to worry about protecting an NPC. When the waves from the east have stopped spawning, the waves from the south will have stopped and be standing on the pier. To avoid spawning the Vizier next to them, use a longbow or flatbow from the raised platform directly west of the docks to draw enemies away. This allows a safe pull, as well as a nicely balled up group of enemies. It's not recommended though, because Vizier sometimes spawns and gets oneshoted.
4dcd821cadb84bd9a67afee948e278eae6e3d67b.text: 拥抱码头北部和西部的岩石“墙”不会触发码头上的维齐尔。拥抱最北端的岩石会生成白斗篷敌怪，否则这些敌怪会在维齐尔执行仪式时生成。这使得队伍可以派遣他们而不必担心保护 NPC。当来自东方的波浪停止产生时，来自南方的波浪也将停止并站在码头上。为了避免在他们旁边产生维齐尔，请从码头正西的凸起平台上使用长弓或扁弓来吸引敌人。这样可以安全地拉动，也可以很好地聚集一群敌人。但不建议这样做，因为维齐尔有时会生成并被单射。

36679e6e8d1be80dbd5a811c4597ebf25b3bf81e.source: If the party is worried that the charging waves may be overwhelming, consider clearing the areas south and east of the docks first. Just out of sight north of the beach in the east is a narrow pathway, at the end of which is the location of all the foes that will charge the docks. The path is a great bottleneck for skills such as Panic, and Psychic Instability. The foes that charge the docks from the south side are not already present on the map and must be cleared once spawned.Searching the entire south area for hidden areas, these foes seem to materialize out of thin air once triggered. This will greatly reduce pressure and the party can focus on clearing only waves from the south.
36679e6e8d1be80dbd5a811c4597ebf25b3bf81e.text: 如果该方担心充电波可能会势不可挡，请考虑首先清理码头以南和以东的区域。东部海滩以北的视线之外有一条狭窄的小路，小路的尽头是所有冲锋码头的敌人的所在地。该路径对于恐慌和精神不稳定等技能来说是一个很大的瓶颈。从南侧冲锋的敌人尚未出现在地图上，一旦产生就必须清除。在整个南部地区寻找隐藏区域，这些敌人一旦被触发，似乎会凭空出现。这将大大减轻压力，党可以集中精力清除来自南方的波浪。

6fea1c5f73e530b82181b7fa6dabe16966d8508a.source: Anti-caster skills to counter White Mantle Savant's Searing Heat and Ward Against Elements, as well as most other enemies encountered during this mission.
6fea1c5f73e530b82181b7fa6dabe16966d8508a.text: 反施法者技能可以对抗白斗篷学者的灼热和元素防御，以及在该任务中遇到的大多数其他敌人。

959d8ec13101ca7ce3c7faee8d21599d1c9a9ae7.source: It takes approximately 2 minutes and 20 seconds to summon the boat.
959d8ec13101ca7ce3c7faee8d21599d1c9a9ae7.text: 召唤船只大约需要 2 分 20 秒。

70d85c01990b320daaca9dfd2bd676dc09506d09.source: This time can be speed up by casting Time Ward in range of Vizier Khilbron.
70d85c01990b320daaca9dfd2bd676dc09506d09.text: 这个时间可以通过在维齐尔基尔布隆的范围内施放时间结界来加速。

9a86a1983bcfd4b370a82eecef1c5a5039ff9dde.source: The Restless Spirit will follow the party onto the boat if the bonus was not completed before the cinematic triggers.
9a86a1983bcfd4b370a82eecef1c5a5039ff9dde.text: 如果在过场动画触发之前奖励未完成，不安的灵魂将跟随队伍上船。

2e12e21152c627e9ff6491eed8a5516ba316ea8a.source: Despite the objectives and Vizier's dialogue stating that Evennia has been taken by the White Mantle, she remains in her initial spawn point for the entirety of the mission.
2e12e21152c627e9ff6491eed8a5516ba316ea8a.text: 尽管目标和维齐尔的对话表明埃文尼亚已被白斗篷占领，但她在整个任务中仍停留在最初的重生点。

b9c79bbfa3caf85bf2e6bbad1a3ee80dbc762cfd.source: Complete exploration of the mission area contributes 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
b9c79bbfa3caf85bf2e6bbad1a3ee80dbc762cfd.text: 完成任务区域的探索将为泰尔制图师头衔贡献 1.4%。

604c664c6e55f20475c1b188ce932207e6c5a56d.source: This includes a large chunk of the ocean, which is cleared by viewing the end-cinematic.
604c664c6e55f20475c1b188ce932207e6c5a56d.text: 这包括一大片海洋，通过观看片尾动画即可清除。

27ccd15a76cd3f2d26ad525d942b3877a4c59e0f.source: Hug the cliffs while passing the docks to avoid summoning the Vizier, otherwise mantle will likely spawn near the docks and will instantly kill the Vizier when he appears (failing the mission).
27ccd15a76cd3f2d26ad525d942b3877a4c59e0f.text: 经过码头时拥抱悬崖以避免召唤维齐尔，否则地幔很可能会在码头附近生成，并在维齐尔出现时立即杀死他（任务失败）。

cbc29a22fdb5544d572b5b2c4407524d5ab4b3e2.source: Alternatively, stand with the Vizier and outlast the foe spawns, without loading onto the boat when he tells you to. You may explore once there are no more waves incoming, and move onto the boat when you are ready to complete the mission.
cbc29a22fdb5544d572b5b2c4407524d5ab4b3e2.text: 或者，与维齐尔站在一起，在敌人出现后存活下来，但不要在他告诉你的时候装上船。一旦不再有海浪袭来，您就可以进行探索，并在准备好完成任务时上船。

0adc2108450a46950b6a9ca7d4663a37c7286d41.source: After completing this mission, the party will be moved to The Amnoon Oasis.
0adc2108450a46950b6a9ca7d4663a37c7286d41.text: 完成此任务后，队伍将转移至安努绿洲。

280f56848a3bc12c18aea5b3de2e19e8c85c33ec.source: As with all enemies spawned by triggers or skills, the group of White Mantle that approaches the docks from the south can be pulled away from the docks and when aggro is subsequently broken, these enemies will attempt to run back to the pier in a straight line. This can cause them get stuck on walls or other obstructions, splitting up the large group into smaller, more manageable groups.
280f56848a3bc12c18aea5b3de2e19e8c85c33ec.text: 与所有由触发器或技能产生的敌人一样，从南边接近码头的白斗篷队伍可以被拉离码头，当仇恨随后被打破时，这些敌人将尝试直线跑回码头。这可能会导致它们卡在墙壁或其他障碍物上，将大组分成更小、更易于管理的组。

e4294d2200d69396439683b87637e18df35e6832.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #7 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
e4294d2200d69396439683b87637e18df35e6832.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书的第 7 页。

765268f265d8eb11eab9cdd1c09ede4d75f23278.source: Even before the first cinematic, Vizier Khilbron holds the Scepter of Orr despite the fact that it was not yet given to him. When pulled away from the pier in their final location, the White Mantle from the south side of the docks can run off in a straight line away from the pier and get stuck on the first obstacle they run into. These foes will not return to the pier afterwards, but will still attack any opponent that enters their range.
765268f265d8eb11eab9cdd1c09ede4d75f23278.text: 甚至在第一部电影之前，维齐尔·希尔布隆就持有奥尔权杖，尽管事实上它还没有被授予他。当在最终位置离开码头时，码头南侧的白斗篷可以沿直线跑离码头，并卡在他们遇到的第一个障碍物上。这些敌人之后不会返回码头，但仍会攻击任何进入其范围的对手。

f727561694f46c761a1b00de10763a9643593265.source: Speak with Bartholos in Lion's Arch Keep to assist with defending the city.
f727561694f46c761a1b00de10763a9643593265.text: 与狮子拱门要塞的巴索洛斯交谈，协助保卫城市。

94fab25e26fbf3dde2fd5dfbf57faa0b2733b56a.source: Order Firstwatch Sergio to open the front gates.
94fab25e26fbf3dde2fd5dfbf57faa0b2733b56a.text: 命令第一哨兵塞尔吉奥打开前门。

58c10a1adefc4ff212c9546b850d419e971a4cd4.source: Defend Lion's Arch from the White Mantle onslaught pouring into the city.
58c10a1adefc4ff212c9546b850d419e971a4cd4.text: 保卫狮子拱门免受白斗篷涌入城市的攻击。

20ed82a72b203530271cc4cad760f47c24d29ee3.source: Kill High Inquisitor Toriimo and his men.
20ed82a72b203530271cc4cad760f47c24d29ee3.text: 杀死大审判官托里莫和他的部下。

b63e9a88b299ab840221be2119c543d6336d8077.source: Kill Confessor Isaiah and his followers.
b63e9a88b299ab840221be2119c543d6336d8077.text: 杀死忏悔者以赛亚和他的追随者。

4b2f4079cde9bacf68f463e7aee52dfe0f2fe046.source: Kill Oizys the Miserable and the two Cairns.
4b2f4079cde9bacf68f463e7aee52dfe0f2fe046.text: 杀死悲惨者奥伊兹和两个凯恩。

c743e03c6ba7d7805b3ac60436b3b9d4461bedb7.source: Kill Ambrillus the Guardian and Talios the Resplendent.
c743e03c6ba7d7805b3ac60436b3b9d4461bedb7.text: 杀死守护者安布里鲁斯和光辉塔利奥斯。

2fd65c201e29fa41b28f34f718ae88146bddb28f.source: Defend Princess Salma with your life. Her death is your defeat.
2fd65c201e29fa41b28f34f718ae88146bddb28f.text: 用你的生命保卫萨尔玛公主。她的死就是你的失败。

9efa9a8b9b15b34a3f90415b98b889dbbffd9e0d.source: After the completion of this quest, explorable areas in Kryta will return to their pre-War in Kryta versions. However, if you have any active Wanted bounty, every Krytan zone will include the WiK foes. Dropping the bounties (or accepting the reward for their completion) will restore the original spawns.
9efa9a8b9b15b34a3f90415b98b889dbbffd9e0d.text: 完成此任务后，科瑞塔的可探索区域将恢复到战前的科瑞塔版本。然而，如果你有任何活跃的通缉赏金，每个科瑞塔区域都会包括 WiK 敌人。放弃赏金（或接受完成奖励）将恢复原来的生成。

afae9ef2845a5a3e32f460d9c69bbbc2accf5093.source: You can continue to accept Wanted bounties.
afae9ef2845a5a3e32f460d9c69bbbc2accf5093.text: 您可以继续接受通缉赏金。

d6ba6d21c5a561a84b7dee27778c1ec66b0fa955.source: Enter Lion's Arch Keep and talk to Bartholos to be transported into a new instance and begin the quest. Once there, the front gate will not open until you speak to Sergio; this gives you time to familiarize your team with the area and discuss strategy. If Princess Salma dies at any point, you will fail the mission. However, you will succeed if you can efficiently defend the various choke points along the path to the Keep.
