d6ba6d21c5a561a84b7dee27778c1ec66b0fa955.text: 进入狮子拱门并与巴索洛斯交谈以传送到新实例并开始任务。到达那里后，除非您与塞尔吉奥交谈，否则前门不会打开；这让您有时间让您的团队熟悉该领域并讨论策略。如果萨尔玛公主在任何时候死亡，你的任务就会失败。然而，如果你能有效地防守通往要塞的道路上的各个阻塞点，你就会成功。

7f7f5e8afba224953fe520e809975515fa9d3905.source: After Sergio opens the gate, White Mantle groups will approach the city. Throughout the mission, enemy mobs will travel down a set path, making their way towards Salma.
7f7f5e8afba224953fe520e809975515fa9d3905.text: 塞尔吉奥打开城门后，白斗篷小队将逼近这座城市。在整个任务过程中，敌方暴徒将沿着设定的路径行进，前往萨尔玛。

7e769adc55e71ef3e9e1b0ea5516d35ba1577d86.source: The first few groups will be made up of White Mantle only, beginning with a mix of martial classes. After a number of waves, High Inquisitor Toriimo will launch his attack, reinforced by spellcaster groups.
7e769adc55e71ef3e9e1b0ea5516d35ba1577d86.text: 最初的几个小组将仅由白斗篷组成，从武术类别的混合开始。经过几轮攻击后，高级审判官托里莫将在施法者队伍的增援下发起攻击。

3a8fc07c205f29305be6cecf0fe494ad0b167285.source: After a couple more waves, Confessor Isaiah's troops will arrive, attacking primarily using ranged attacks. His group also includes the first Jade Construct (the only foe in the first phase that can cast Spectral Agony).
3a8fc07c205f29305be6cecf0fe494ad0b167285.text: 再过几波之后，忏悔者以赛亚的部队就会到达，主要使用远程攻击。他的队伍还包括第一个翡翠构造体（第一阶段中唯一可以施放幽灵痛苦的敌人）。

9de9771d77720011ce7b7ca162ff1d93ec318441.source: After the Mantle bosses die, the mobs will start to include more Jade constructs and fewer humans. As this happens, Blimm will activate their secret weapon which gives all allies in Lion's Arch (including spirits and minions) Spectral Infusion, an effect that protects them from Spectral Agony and reflects back some damage. This shield lasts for a set duration and will not affect allies created after it is initially used.
9de9771d77720011ce7b7ca162ff1d93ec318441.text: 地幔首领死亡后，暴徒将开始包含更多的翡翠构造体和更少的人类。当这种情况发生时，布利姆将激活他们的秘密武器，为狮子拱门中的所有盟友（包括灵魂和小兵）提供光谱注入，这种效果可以保护他们免受光谱痛苦并反射一些伤害。该护盾会持续一定的时间，并且不会影响最初使用后创建的盟友。

8ca6d9f6aac3dd13424c9fcc7edf2ebdd0f66378.source: Jade Armors and Jade Bows will begin to replace the White Mantle mobs until only Jade constructs spawn. A Perfected Armor and Perfected Cloak will spawn in different waves, one before and one after Lucent the Spectral's wave.
8ca6d9f6aac3dd13424c9fcc7edf2ebdd0f66378.text: 翡翠盔甲和翡翠弓将开始取代白斗篷生物，直到只有翡翠构造体生成。完美盔甲和完美斗篷会在不同的波次中生成，一波在光谱朗森的波之前，一波在之后。

39961868fcbed1d5996922cf7966580669609f76.source: Oizys the Miserable and the two Cairns
39961868fcbed1d5996922cf7966580669609f76.text: 悲惨者奥伊兹和两个凯恩斯

57e8dd1a496fc648e582d524f5703944aa280fc7.source: Jade Cloaks will begin to spawn in addition to the Armors and the Bows. After a couple waves Oizys the Miserable and the two Bow constructs, Cairn the Malignant and Cairn the Vengeful, will spawn.
57e8dd1a496fc648e582d524f5703944aa280fc7.text: 除了盔甲和弓之外，翡翠斗篷也将开始生成。在几波波之后，悲惨者奥伊兹和两个弓构造体，恶毒者凯恩和复仇者凯恩将会出现。

40d4126073e543656d3b9c07f64cff0a0ec49807.source: Ambrillus the Guardian and Talios the Resplendent
40d4126073e543656d3b9c07f64cff0a0ec49807.text: 守护者安布里洛斯和光辉塔利奥斯

40f0eff19ee520fb04e505411f96465787a3467b.source: A few more groups will spawn, with the second to the last consisting of mainly Jade Cloaks and a Perfected Aegis. The final wave will include Ambrillus the Guardian, Talios the Resplendent, six Jade Cloaks, four Jade Armors, and four Jade Bows. Once they are defeated, a one minute timer will begin before the entire party is transported to a post-battle Lion's Arch.
40f0eff19ee520fb04e505411f96465787a3467b.text: 还会出现更多组，倒数第二组主要由翡翠斗篷和完美神盾组成。最后一波将包括守护者安布里鲁斯、辉煌塔利奥斯、六件翡翠斗篷、四件翡翠铠甲和四把翡翠弓。一旦他们被击败，在整个队伍被传送到战后的狮子拱门之前，一分钟计时器就会开始。

a33b86d9a8e7bbba1016bca2d445554fcb4b301a.source: If your party wipes, it will resurrect next to Princess Salma.
a33b86d9a8e7bbba1016bca2d445554fcb4b301a.text: 如果你的队伍被消灭，它将在萨尔玛公主旁边复活。

9ef94320dc419cdf0a2a11a8f41c66eea7559e95.source: Since the foes do not take advantage of this, if you lose more than 2-3 party members, it is usually more efficient to completely wipe and resurrect rather than try to use a reduced team to fight.
9ef94320dc419cdf0a2a11a8f41c66eea7559e95.text: 由于敌人不会利用这一点，因此如果你失去了超过 2-3 名队员，那么完全消灭并复活通常比尝试使用减少的队伍进行战斗更有效。

a4e9ea74bd4cf9379720cac4c912454164d67673.source: As soon as you spawn, return quickly to the fight; the more distance you can keep between Salma and your opponents, the safer she will be.
a4e9ea74bd4cf9379720cac4c912454164d67673.text: 一旦出现，就迅速返回战斗；萨尔玛和对手之间保持的距离越远，她就越安全。

fc8ee64260f7d49eacac1b06158fa11d91dddc23.source: Party-wide and area of effect (AoE) skills are especially effective for both you and the besieging forces; make sure you ball them up and keep your own team spread out.
fc8ee64260f7d49eacac1b06158fa11d91dddc23.text: 全队范围和范围（AoE）技能对你和围攻部队都特别有效；确保你把他们聚集起来并让你自己的团队分散开来。

308f1185dcfd05178b573fd80c47a2ed52f44b3a.source: The design of Lion's Arch lends itself well to Rangers: from the bluffs, they can use a flat- or longbow to do large amounts of damage before mobs reach the first staircase.
308f1185dcfd05178b573fd80c47a2ed52f44b3a.text: 狮子拱门的设计非常适合游骑兵：在悬崖上，他们可以使用平弓或长弓在怪物到达第一个楼梯之前造成大量伤害。

ad7cbfba0e71c353a8b614b907dbca9aef83dbff.source: Minion masters have plenty of fleshy enemies from which to summon allies, even during the middle waves of mostly Jade constructs (when allied NPCs are dying fast enough to fodder).
ad7cbfba0e71c353a8b614b907dbca9aef83dbff.text: 小兵大师有大量的肉质敌人可以召唤盟友，即使是在主要是翡翠建筑的中波期间（当盟友 NPC 死亡速度足够快时）也是如此。

3eaa61dc8f3d2b7c6cbb6714029857a76fc27403.source: Take advantage of the areas natural choke points: the main gate and the stairways.
3eaa61dc8f3d2b7c6cbb6714029857a76fc27403.text: 利用该地区的天然咽喉要道：正门和楼梯。

acd719f1c86b6d141ac6e645390644437a928ec9.source: Tanks can keep mobs at choke points (or elsewhere), forcing them to ball up; this maximizes the effectiveness of AoE skills, especially with other team members applying defensive skills, e.g. from a Bonder.
acd719f1c86b6d141ac6e645390644437a928ec9.text: 坦克可以将怪物困在阻塞点（或其他地方），迫使他们聚集在一起；这可以最大限度地发挥 AoE 技能的有效性，尤其是在其他团队成员应用防御技能的情况下，例如来自邦德。

ee5ea050c277a86cb79a7d2e69e4e462106eb9cd.source: Minion and spirit walls are effective at blocking incoming mobs.
ee5ea050c277a86cb79a7d2e69e4e462106eb9cd.text: 小兵墙和灵魂墙可以有效阻挡传入的小怪。

ef9b5f5921d01786ecaf3f4d697adabcce35df87.source: Combine walls and/or tanks with snares, slowing down the enemy and getting to focus on the renewable defenses (walls) or well-armored ones (tanks), e.g. Grasping Earth, Ward Against Foes, or Tryptophan Signet, or "Save Yourselves!".
ef9b5f5921d01786ecaf3f4d697adabcce35df87.text: 将墙壁和/或坦克与圈套结合起来，减慢敌人的速度，并专注于可再生的防御（墙壁）或装甲良好的防御（坦克），例如抓住地球、抵御敌人、色氨酸印章或“拯救自己！”。

9f527faf7962c701ecfabea352c77ea3356a51c6.source: AoE skills like Panic, Spiteful Spirit, Ancestors' Rage, and Barrage with Splinter Weapon are very useful due to the large mobs players will face.
9f527faf7962c701ecfabea352c77ea3356a51c6.text: 由于玩家将面对大量的小怪，诸如恐慌、恶意之魂、祖先之怒和碎片武器弹幕等 AoE 技能非常有用。

a8688646dc90dc7b03bf733167aad7def7230c05.source: Defensive skills which limit damage taken are especially helpful to tanks, e.g. Defy Pain, Dervish avatars, or various Weapon Spells.
a8688646dc90dc7b03bf733167aad7def7230c05.text: 限制所受伤害的防御技能对坦克特别有帮助，例如抗拒痛苦、苦行僧化身或各种武器法术。

6d5f36a92039f714751ef0667d03b370bd13b1f7.source: Armor of Unfeeling helps to maintain spirit walls.
6d5f36a92039f714751ef0667d03b370bd13b1f7.text: 无情之甲有助于维持灵墙。

bc8b8d5491d35ed7731f29180ffcc9ebca5cc529.source: Since you remain stationary for long periods of times, ward spells are useful for protecting and buffing your allies.
bc8b8d5491d35ed7731f29180ffcc9ebca5cc529.text: 由于你长时间保持静止，守卫法术对于保护和增强你的盟友非常有用。

3332203ee2b61665ab48dc2713ec13fcbd833fde.source: Traps are very effective at the choke points, notably the main gate and the staircases. Using Trapper's Focus enables you to plant traps before and during combat.
3332203ee2b61665ab48dc2713ec13fcbd833fde.text: 陷阱在阻塞点非常有效，尤其是大门和楼梯。使用捕兽者的专注可以让你在战斗前和战斗中设置陷阱。

6193440da93fee8b3aab5b9f3d4067d749d00007.source: Bosses have Natural Resistance and are especially susceptible to hexes with an effect on end, e.g. Wastrel's Worry.
6193440da93fee8b3aab5b9f3d4067d749d00007.text: Boss 具有自然抵抗力，并且特别容易受到对末端有影响的六角形的影响，例如废物的担忧。

4f3cd8c903e88b6b6f7e62fe16ce2d5d86475970.source: After completing the battle, you will have an extra minute to pick up drops. Grab the gold, because any nearby/assigned items will be made available to you after zoning (via the Unclaimed Items window). You might also want to pick up valuables as the battle progresses — it lasts longer than 10 minutes, which is enough time for drops to become unassigned.
4f3cd8c903e88b6b6f7e62fe16ce2d5d86475970.text: 完成战斗后，你将有额外的一分钟时间来拾取掉落物。抓住黄金，因为任何附近/指定的物品都将在分区后提供给您（通过“无人认领的物品”窗口）。随着战斗的进行，你可能还想捡起贵重物品——战斗持续超过 10 分钟，这足以让掉落物变得未分配。

4aed471c2424ab8a12c1b090359e79692b484ce8.source: The NPC counterparts of two heroes have roles during the battle and their names will appear differently in the party window:
4aed471c2424ab8a12c1b090359e79692b484ce8.text: 两位英雄的 NPC 对应角色在战斗中各有角色，他们的名字在队伍窗口中的显示方式会有所不同：

8bf1d146ace82dd3e5ed0a508c3e2ea34153d3ce.source: Gwen will display as Vanguard Mesmer, signifying that she remains stationed at the Eye of the North in Captain Langmar's absence.
8bf1d146ace82dd3e5ed0a508c3e2ea34153d3ce.text: 格温将显示为先锋幻术师，这意味着她在朗玛船长不在的情况下仍驻扎在北方之眼。

e2e3da25af0bf68d98736c12a2bcc28c30b36602.source: Livia appears as Shining Blade Necromancer, since she is present as an NPC near the Keep's entrance.
e2e3da25af0bf68d98736c12a2bcc28c30b36602.text: 莉维亚以光刃死灵法师的身份出现，因为她作为 NPC 出现在城堡入口附近。

92027f8387f2179021532bed397031f7ee9c7baf.source: You can leave your Medals of Honor in storage: they can be exchanged later in Lion's Arch Keep for War in Kryta related weapons. You may also exchange them in Lion's Arch immediately after the battle.
92027f8387f2179021532bed397031f7ee9c7baf.text: 你可以将你的荣誉勋章留在存储中：稍后可以在狮子拱门城堡中用科瑞塔相关武器兑换战争勋章。您也可以在战斗结束后立即在狮子拱门兑换它们。

977daf57d72386feb51fffbf6136553a67774d8c.source: Some players have used this mission to capture the 12 elite skills, via "Rinse and Repeat" of mission.
977daf57d72386feb51fffbf6136553a67774d8c.text: 有些玩家通过这个任务通过“冲洗和重复”任务来捕获12个精英技能。

7338adc66bf99c303b7ac8bc70c9f4209266b836.source: Once the quest is over, take time to do additional exploration of a small ledge past the lighthouse (south) for the Tyrian Cartographer title. If you forgot to do so, you can gate glitch the southern gate in Lion's Arch Keep to get there.
7338adc66bf99c303b7ac8bc70c9f4209266b836.text: 任务结束后，花点时间对灯塔（南边）后面的一个小壁架进行额外的探索，以获得泰尔制图师头衔。如果您忘记这样做，您可以通过狮子拱门城堡的南门到达那里。

0045d395490fa9c9ef048efe954eb109a28fa482.source: Completing this stage of The War in Kryta before this stage appears in your quest log can make it difficult to proceed with the intermediary quests. If this happens, you can work around the issue by either following the manual walkthrough or by completing any of the available wanted quests and waiting to accept its reward until you have completed all the intermediary quests and The Battle for Lion's Arch.
0045d395490fa9c9ef048efe954eb109a28fa482.text: 在这个阶段出现在你的任务日志中之前完成科瑞塔战争的这个阶段可能会导致中间任务难以继续。如果发生这种情况，您可以通过遵循手动演练或完成任何可用的通缉任务并等待接受其奖励，直到完成所有中间任务和狮子拱门之战来解决该问题。

ed4f59fc30d53e084527e055a17b6cf26611aa7b.source: Find Ang the Ephemeral in Panjiang Peninsula.
ed4f59fc30d53e084527e055a17b6cf26611aa7b.text: 在盘江半岛找到短暂的安。

d61921dfeb2ce81b0740e9c0b5972fe4862151b6.source: Ang is located near Qi Falls. To get there, make your way to Tsumei Village. Exit the town heading south west, then west until you get to the spirit.
d61921dfeb2ce81b0740e9c0b5972fe4862151b6.text: Ang位于Qi Falls附近。要到达那里，请前往津名村。离开城镇，向西南方向行驶，然后向西行驶，直到到达精灵。

b98f29d46b8d8806d170ab18c745de6eb9efb65b.source: * Secrets in the Shadow neither active nor completed
b98f29d46b8d8806d170ab18c745de6eb9efb65b.text: * 暗影中的秘密既不活跃也不完成

6a518acb1f0f6ed67df7adc7007c1b2e698bc674.source: Meet Margrid the Sly on the Marga Coast.
6a518acb1f0f6ed67df7adc7007c1b2e698bc674.text: 在玛加海岸遇见狡猾的玛格丽德。

31bc72a2cc2de203d3f15e2e927efce8ba8abf20.source: Collect the map of Gandara from Unlucky Simon.
31bc72a2cc2de203d3f15e2e927efce8ba8abf20.text: 从不幸的西蒙那里收集甘达拉地图。

c066ef6921988aee026c4697f0a3a8b40c124840.source: Strong-arm Shifty Lem until he gives up the map.
c066ef6921988aee026c4697f0a3a8b40c124840.text: 对 Shifty Lem 施以强力，直到他交出地图。

59acb6e089916a159943b617961a11f50e0dd650.source: See Margrid the Sly for your reward.
59acb6e089916a159943b617961a11f50e0dd650.text: 去见狡猾的玛格丽德以获得奖励。

07539c53dc5231b68f3c8235e8edf45d9bcec1dc.source: Margrid the Sly is outside of Yohlon Haven. Take her to Unlucky Simon, who tells her that the map was taken by Shifty Lem. Go westward and talk to him. He will become hostile, so defeat him and his party. Shifty Lem will turn friendly again and you can complete the quest.
07539c53dc5231b68f3c8235e8edf45d9bcec1dc.text: 狡猾的玛格丽特位于 Yohlon Haven 外。带她去找倒霉的西蒙，后者告诉她地图被狡猾的莱姆拿走了。向西走去和他说话。他会变得充满敌意，所以击败他和他的队伍。狡猾的莱姆将再次变得友好，你可以完成任务。

685ed27b7e984fca46a9f0d7adc9300fb0f99002.source: Mutually exclusive with Secrets in the Shadow.

42f8822acfe5d7cbd6c3bd7ae0a2b534a7f7bf2a.source: If you leave the map while doing the quest you will have to start at the beginning.
42f8822acfe5d7cbd6c3bd7ae0a2b534a7f7bf2a.text: 如果您在执行任务时离开地图，则必须从头开始。

0cd49e9ea0c7928434624832b9cd30416fa6e82e.source: If, however, you leave after completion Margrid will wait for you in Marga Coast in front of Yohlon Haven where you first picked her up.
0cd49e9ea0c7928434624832b9cd30416fa6e82e.text: 但是，如果您在完成后离开，玛格丽德将在您第一次接她的 Yohlon Haven 前面的玛加海岸等您。

439762a427fab6a75862baeae8422bc4c647d72f.source: Speak to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut.
439762a427fab6a75862baeae8422bc4c647d72f.text: 与大仪式牧师扎赫穆特交谈。

1ed39dc48c4bc95febb4c08f2c9d69c8bbd5c6d6.source: Travel to Augury Rock, or go on foot from The Amnoon Oasis. In case of the latter, fight or run up to the teleporter in the southeast. The teleporter is activated by standing in the circle and turning back to view the switches. These will light up in a sequence and the player must touch them in the same order. Use the activated teleporter to cross the canyon and move on. From there, follow the monoliths up to Augury Rock.
1ed39dc48c4bc95febb4c08f2c9d69c8bbd5c6d6.text: 前往占卜岩，或从安努绿洲步行前往。如果是后者，请战斗或跑到东南方的传送器处。站在圆圈中并回头查看开关即可激活传送器。这些将按顺序亮起，玩家必须按相同的顺序触摸它们。使用激活的传送器穿过峡谷并继续前进。从那里，沿着巨石到达占卜岩。

ad60ccf29d250f1dd38ed74ec82656cd7f3ae89a.source: This quest is not necessary for the completion of the Augury Rock mission.
ad60ccf29d250f1dd38ed74ec82656cd7f3ae89a.text: 该任务对于完成占卜岩任务不是必需的。

83343a6412834054b657f0968dc93ae5bc8eb699.source: Despite not being a primary quest or a requirement to progress, new players will do well to take this quest as it leads them to Augury Rock, where the next events in the storyline unfold.
83343a6412834054b657f0968dc93ae5bc8eb699.text: 尽管不是主要任务或进步的要求，但新玩家最好接受这个任务，因为它会引导他们到达占卜岩，故事情节中的下一个事件将在那里展开。

1d0eb3ddd3d98bb033670ffe06f6f492304d4446.source: There are no quests following this quest that lead players to the three mission outposts.
1d0eb3ddd3d98bb033670ffe06f6f492304d4446.text: 此任务之后没有任何任务可以引导玩家前往三个任务前哨站。

9534df6b654be949a1ad462ebf49c1d23c8fd949.source: This quest does not show up as a primary quest in the quest log, though it is similar to other primary quests.
9534df6b654be949a1ad462ebf49c1d23c8fd949.text: 尽管该任务与其他主要任务类似，但它不会在任务日志中显示为主要任务。

eaec4bfe6c087999926d40f94cf749f1131d91e2.source: Speak with Ang again to begin eliminating the shackled spirits.
eaec4bfe6c087999926d40f94cf749f1131d91e2.text: 再次与昂交谈，开始消除被束缚的灵魂。

b684f040a5b2cfb94736991856ac6bdb02c5334e.source: Defeat the 5 shackled spirits. You have [5...0] shackled spirits remaining.
b684f040a5b2cfb94736991856ac6bdb02c5334e.text: 击败5个被束缚的灵魂。你还剩下 [5...0] 个被束缚的灵魂。

7149fd7cebc3347a459a0af785a7aedfcb041b87.source: See Ang the Ephemeral for your reward.
7149fd7cebc3347a459a0af785a7aedfcb041b87.text: 去见短暂的安格以获得奖励。

9c6059d4497d54f13488817399f065d73fdc00a5.source: Ang the Ephemeral will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
9c6059d4497d54f13488817399f065d73fdc00a5.text: 当你接受任务时，短暂的安会教你以下技能：

e2ba2706ec3ba1e1cce738b7bf880a563641799b.source: Follow the green markers and open the Soul Keepers, disposing of each spirit before moving on to the next. The spirits are fairly harmless, and Ang will heal you if needed. Even though they are spirits, they are able to move so it's possible to click the Soul Keepers and move to the next immediately.
e2ba2706ec3ba1e1cce738b7bf880a563641799b.text: 按照绿色标记打开灵魂守护者，处理掉每个灵魂，然后再继续下一个。这些灵魂相当无害，如果需要的话，安会治愈你。尽管它们是灵魂，但它们能够移动，因此可以单击灵魂守护者并立即移动到下一个。

2697e7ddbde5284057dea6d0237971cd10b24377.source: Show the Map of Gandara to Jack of Truths in Pogahn Passage.
2697e7ddbde5284057dea6d0237971cd10b24377.text: 向波甘通道的真理杰克出示甘达拉地图。

1509593d64eed6bda06ce037892a39c1a9a805b8.source: Waylay a squad of Kournan guards and "borrow" their armor.
1509593d64eed6bda06ce037892a39c1a9a805b8.text: 伏击一队库尔南守卫并“借用”他们的盔甲。

c2128386fbea92cac3c787418083e02ba3b5fd07.source: See Jack of Truths for your reward.
c2128386fbea92cac3c787418083e02ba3b5fd07.text: 请参阅真相杰克以获得奖励。

b700fab3a6904b216d546075211443067ca2f632.source: Margrid the Sly joins your party.
b700fab3a6904b216d546075211443067ca2f632.text: 狡猾的玛格丽特加入你的队伍。

beb28e60a88bfa7daf0a09ca6c8066631546f704.source: Just walk from Yohlon Haven to the east through the Arkjok Ward. When walking through the fortress, be careful not to aggro the Acolyte of Grenth. When you reach Pogahn Passage, you will find the doors shut. Just walk north a bit and you will find the entrance. At the other end of Pogahn Passage, you will find Jack of Truths. Follow the quest-marker in Pogahn Passage through the water and out to Gandara. Kill the Kournans and pick up the Sets of Kournan Armor. As soon as you "put them on", the cinematic starts. Talk to Jack of Truths for your reward.
beb28e60a88bfa7daf0a09ca6c8066631546f704.text: 从 Yohlon Haven 向东步行穿过 Arkjok Ward 即可。穿过要塞时，小心不要激怒古兰斯侍僧。当您到达波甘通道时，您会发现门已关闭。往北走一点就可以找到入口。在波加恩通道的另一端，您会找到真理杰克。跟随波甘通道的任务标记穿过水域，到达甘达拉。杀死库南人并拾取库南盔甲套装。一旦你“穿上它们”，电影就开始了。与真相杰克交谈以获得奖励。

ea645c8d311b4b47e9a6c0d71ef17fa881b363aa.source: Should you abandon the quest, Margrid can be found in Marga Coast just outside Yohlon Haven, where she will offer you the quest again.
ea645c8d311b4b47e9a6c0d71ef17fa881b363aa.text: 如果你放弃任务，玛格丽德可以在约伦港外的玛加海岸找到，她会在那里再次为你提供任务。

a5ebdbae4d0bb0314ef0cf1c8b90d300271d8250.source: If you have already been to Pogahn Passage you can travel there directly by map. You can alternatively start in Kodonur Crossroads, but you will have to defeat many more enemies.
a5ebdbae4d0bb0314ef0cf1c8b90d300271d8250.text: 如果您已经去过Pogahn Passage，您可以通过地图直接前往那里。你也可以从科多努尔十字路口开始，但你必须击败更多的敌人。

f660aafa6207999179e5d457e4707c47e1ca40c4.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Vulture Drifts and start the mission.
f660aafa6207999179e5d457e4707c47e1ca40c4.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从秃鹫漂流走进前哨站并开始任务。

dcb4f81749708d4a442c4c7fdc110a6a50efb044.source: Help the Ghostly Hero reclaim his throne.
dcb4f81749708d4a442c4c7fdc110a6a50efb044.text: 帮助幽灵英雄夺回王座。

cbd922caea729bf246f25dd586d0c456e3fa191c.source: Escort the Ghostly Hero to the Temple of Ascension.
cbd922caea729bf246f25dd586d0c456e3fa191c.text: 护送幽灵英雄前往升天神殿。

2f775096d4fc2552f87299d1c59b4fccaccebb5a.source: Hold out while the Ghostly Hero performs his ritual.
2f775096d4fc2552f87299d1c59b4fccaccebb5a.text: 在幽灵英雄执行他的仪式时坚持下去。

835295006fb41546892361350c06f9ed082480ea.source: *BONUS* Gain more glory by defeating the three forgotten generals and their minions within their forts.
835295006fb41546892361350c06f9ed082480ea.text: *奖励*通过击败三位被遗忘的将军及其堡垒内的爪牙来获得更多荣耀。

1805dcc8fc80a028a100e3b18593e9ad5dfae239.source: At the beginning, you meet the Ghostly Hero who asks you to help him reclaim his throne. During the mission, he will use Claim Resource to open any drawbridge gates. Speaking to him toggles his movement behavior between following and staying put: he will follow the player who spoke to him when he was in stay-mode and continue doing so until that player speaks to him again.
1805dcc8fc80a028a100e3b18593e9ad5dfae239.text: 一开始，你遇到了幽灵英雄，他要求你帮助他夺回王位。在任务期间，他将使用索取资源来打开任何吊桥大门。对他说话会在跟随和原地不动之间切换他的移动行为：他会跟随在停留模式下与他说话的玩家，并继续这样做，直到该玩家再次与他说话。

a9e36abebe5ac4dcd225d411242ee8cbe2477bcc.source: After he lowers the first bridge, cross the gorge. At the other side, you can continue south with the mission killing the mesmer boss Goss Aleessh and his cohorts to trigger a cinematic, or detour west to gain the Slow Totem (an optional tool) and come back. When dropped, this item creates a ward effect that slows movement of any foe passing through.
a9e36abebe5ac4dcd225d411242ee8cbe2477bcc.text: 当他放下第一座桥后，穿过峡谷。在另一边，你可以继续向南执行任务，杀死幻术师头目戈斯·阿利斯什和他的同伙以触发过场动画，或者绕道西行以获得慢速图腾（可选工具）并返回。掉落时，该物品会产生结界效果，减缓任何经过的敌人的移动。

985bb44035f88d2bdf6e21f64fa3c25622a3e799.source: Aleessh's death triggers a cinematic, placing you near the next drawbridge; again, use the Ghostly Hero to lower it. You will now be attacked by Enchanted armors. To protect your ally, lead the Ghostly Hero back from the bridge and use the gateway as a choke point to fend off the incoming foes. If you have the Slow Totem, drop it slightly ahead of where the party is waiting. Now, the only foe left in sight should be the enemy Ghostly Hero at the Throne. Defeat him and have your Ghostly Hero approach to capture it and begin the last stage of the mission. You will have to protect him for the next ten minutes.
985bb44035f88d2bdf6e21f64fa3c25622a3e799.text: 阿利斯什的死触发了一个过场动画，让你靠近下一座吊桥；再次使用幽灵英雄将其降低。您现在将受到魔法盔甲的攻击。为了保护你的盟友，带领幽灵英雄从桥上返回，并使用网关作为阻塞点来抵御来袭的敌人。如果你有慢速图腾，请将其稍微放在队伍等待的地方之前。现在，唯一剩下的敌人应该就是王座上的敌人幽灵英雄了。击败他并让你的幽灵英雄接近捕获它并开始任务的最后阶段。接下来的十分钟你必须保护他。

7f28f8fe82581949329024cc6fc1d705c5ed6a20.source: Again, if you have the Slow Totem, drop it in front of the Ghostly Hero to delay melee foes. Now, Forgotten Arcanists will come in pairs from the West, East and South. Afterwards, a Siege Wurm will start to attack your party from the East. It is possible to kill the wurm after the Arcanists are dead and before the first melee group approaches, but you can simply heal your allies and ignore it.
7f28f8fe82581949329024cc6fc1d705c5ed6a20.text: 再次强调，如果你有缓慢图腾，请将其放在幽灵英雄面前以延迟近战敌人。现在，被遗忘的奥术师将从西方、东方和南方成对出现。之后，攻城亚龙将从东方开始攻击你的队伍。在奥术师死后和第一个近战团体接近之前杀死亚龙是可能的，但你可以简单地治愈你的盟友并忽略它。

64dc264c6045c1a0aa6fd094a2af858326c9e30b.source: At the five or six minute mark, more groups of Forgotten and a boss will approach the altar. Another pair of siege wurms will appear on the West, and then on the South. If you defeat the Forgotten, there will be no more groups attacking the altar, and you can use the remaining time to kill off the wurms. When the timer reaches zero and the ghostly hero is still alive, the mission will complete.
64dc264c6045c1a0aa6fd094a2af858326c9e30b.text: 在五六分钟的时候，更多的被遗忘者和一个boss会接近祭坛。另一对攻城亚龙将出现在西边，然后是南边。如果你击败了被遗忘者，就不会再有团体攻击祭坛，你可以利用剩余的时间杀死亚龙。当计时器归零并且幽灵英雄还活着时，任务就会完成。

63a1e0a326b642385112962a751b1e3cffa44265.source: To complete the mission, you need tools to deal with the Arcanists (i.e. interrupts). The rest of the defence is spent doing more or less nothing - you can kill the wurms quickly if you have the right skills. The bonus is another matter.
63a1e0a326b642385112962a751b1e3cffa44265.text: 为了完成任务，你需要一些工具来对付奥术师（即中断）。其余的防御几乎什么都不做——如果你有正确的技能，你可以快速杀死亚龙。奖金是另一回事。

45f2fd4ebb2ae4ed7e476a062c3b8c9d650a90df.source: You must protect the Ghostly Hero for 10 minutes, during which time:
45f2fd4ebb2ae4ed7e476a062c3b8c9d650a90df.text: 你必须保护幽灵英雄10分钟，在此期间：

32661f3c3ee86e59f303d0e8528c781b6cbe1c31.source: Four pairs of Forgotten Arcanists appear: from the East → West → South → East (again).
32661f3c3ee86e59f303d0e8528c781b6cbe1c31.text: 四对被遗忘的奥术师出现：从东→西→南→东（再次）。

bcc165698de986070227a7cbc6d42b866fcadfc1.source: Two pairs of Enchanted bows: South → West → West (again, with a boss)
bcc165698de986070227a7cbc6d42b866fcadfc1.text: 两对魔法弓：南→西→西（同样，有一个老板）

2044a7a94842cc7263196316af3b003223b17f2c.source: Siege Wurms appear at fixed times:
2044a7a94842cc7263196316af3b003223b17f2c.text: 攻城亚龙会在固定时间出现：

9e2b9e5be539cc7573b670787bb5b10965d916ad.source: During the bonus: three Forgotten foes spawn after killing each boss. They will attack from the West (northernmost general's reinforcements), South (southeast general) and East (southwest general).
9e2b9e5be539cc7573b670787bb5b10965d916ad.text: 奖励期间：杀死每个 Boss 后会生成三个被遗忘的敌人。他们将从西边（最北将军的援军）、南边（东南将军）和东边（西南将军）进攻。

e05be2803e7bc7ef7436c53b595ae710a483f177.source: Players consider this bonus to be one of the most difficult in the game: you have a limited amount of time (some of which must be spent unlocking the bonus area), you need to split your group to protect an Ally (threatened by increasing numbers of foes), and your party is limited to six characters.
e05be2803e7bc7ef7436c53b595ae710a483f177.text: 玩家认为这个奖励是游戏中最困难的奖励之一：你的时间有限（其中一些必须用来解锁奖励区域），你需要分裂你的团队来保护盟友（受到越来越多的敌人的威胁），并且你的队伍最多只能有六个角色。

73fefae6fdf93be52f4fb7beb0829ea4c2ae8cde.source: During the final siege where you defend the Ghostly Hero, you must kill three bosses and their groups located south of the fortress without letting the hero die and before the ten minute timer hits zero. The first boss is to the south behind the drawbridge. The second and third bosses are in the building behind the first boss. As you kill each general, a small group of Forgotten spawn outside the southern temple and head directly towards the Ghostly Hero.
73fefae6fdf93be52f4fb7beb0829ea4c2ae8cde.text: 在保卫幽灵英雄的最后围攻中，您必须在十分钟计时器归零之前杀死位于要塞南部的三个头目及其团队，而不让英雄死亡。第一个 Boss 位于吊桥后面的南边。第二个和第三个boss位于第一个boss后面的建筑物中。当你杀死每位将军时，一小群被遗忘者会在南部神庙外生成，并直接朝幽灵英雄前进。

0c385258aa55e25c431cfa9ede4af6ed65cf613d.source: You will get credit for the bonus as long as you kill all three generals, even if the ghostly hero dies later (which would cause you to lose the mission).
0c385258aa55e25c431cfa9ede4af6ed65cf613d.text: 只要你杀死所有三名将军，你就会获得奖励，即使幽灵英雄稍后死亡（这会导致你失去任务）。

985f00da37b2a102dd5368620309bb8e70380527.source: Method one: Focus first on the mission
985f00da37b2a102dd5368620309bb8e70380527.text: 方法一：首先聚焦于使命

cab3ab2a7d5580363a7119a21f095c76db01d007.source: The simplest method is to focus first on eliminating the foes attacking the Hero before going for the bonus. Wait until the Forgotten Boss attacks from the west gate. If all goes well, you should have nearly five minutes in which to complete the bonus.
cab3ab2a7d5580363a7119a21f095c76db01d007.text: 最简单的方法是首先集中精力消灭攻击英雄的敌人，然后再获得奖励。等到被遗忘的Boss从西门攻击。如果一切顺利，您应该有近五分钟的时间来完成奖金。

7d11033ec23c485a20540417c1f4220e502ef641.source: To maximize the time, be sure to aggro the first group of reinforcements that spawn after killing the first general to prevent them from going after the Ghostly Hero. You can ignore the group that spawns after killing the second general until you have defeated the third, which completes the bonus.
7d11033ec23c485a20540417c1f4220e502ef641.text: 为了最大限度地延长时间，请务必聚集在杀死第一个将军后生成的第一组增援部队，以防止他们追击幽灵英雄。你可以忽略杀死第二个将军后生成的队伍，直到你击败第三个将军，这完成了奖励。

e2860d317a8ff77b65768789c3633344bf7801ab.source: If you still need to complete the mission, stop the last group of reinforcements from reaching the Ghostly Hero as you return to the altar. When you arrive back at the Ghostly Hero, the Forgotten spawn that you left from the death of the second general will arrive. Even if left alone this group often has no time remaining to destroy the Ghostly Hero.
e2860d317a8ff77b65768789c3633344bf7801ab.text: 如果还需要完成任务，请在返回祭坛时阻止最后一批援军到达幽灵英雄。当你回到幽灵英雄时，你因第二位将军死亡而留下的被遗忘者将会到来。即使独自一人，这群人也常常没有时间消灭幽灵英雄。

4c5b2585dcc541202fbf446510e97a718676df07.source: Method two: Take advantage of the pause

9463b90e8a1d5efd948a1b6ae8cd7eba3979a190.source: After clearing the Arcanists, you have some time before the Forgotten attack the altar again. Instead of attacking the siege wurms, head south to rush the generals. You will need extremely high damage output and a speed boost is nearly essential. Take out as many of the generals (and their reinforcements) as possible before heading back to the altar to defend the Ghostly Hero. You can give yourself some extra time by leaving a healer to protect your ally, e.g. a bonder or a spirit spammer.
9463b90e8a1d5efd948a1b6ae8cd7eba3979a190.text: 清除奥术师后，在被遗忘者再次攻击祭坛之前你还有一段时间。与其攻击攻城亚龙，不如南下冲去将军们。你将需要极高的伤害输出，而速度提升几乎是必不可少的。在返回祭坛保卫幽灵英雄之前，消灭尽可能多的将军（及其援军）。你可以给自己一些额外的时间，留下一个治疗者来保护你的盟友，例如契约者或精神垃圾邮件发送者。

eca72a654eb530f057cce97f71987a1514e242d3.source: If you are worried about the timing, killing even just one general during this pause is enormously helpful. Head back to the altar afterwards and then proceed as if you are using method one.
eca72a654eb530f057cce97f71987a1514e242d3.text: 如果你担心时机，那么在这段暂停期间即使只杀死一名将军也会非常有帮助。之后返回祭坛，然后像使用方法一一样继续进行。

a5c9f44a6f34abf074cbd4092b2a01584df7ddaf.source: With heroes/henchmen, it's sometimes easiest to simply do the bonus, letting the Ghostly Hero die and then re-do the mission.
a5c9f44a6f34abf074cbd4092b2a01584df7ddaf.text: 对于英雄/追随者，有时最简单的方法是简单地执行奖励，让幽灵英雄死亡，然后重新执行任务。

dbd7b1235a716d1dd3c1350bf86246e7aadafc75.source: The Forgotten and Enchanted will resume attacking with around 6:05 minutes on the clock. The Ghostly Hero can endure the Siege Wurms and the first wave of Forgotten; he can't endure the rest of them. You need to be back at the Ghostly Hero at 4:50 to ensure his survival. You can get away with it at 4:30 if you (the player) have spells that can rapidly heal the Hero - a speed boost is necessary.
dbd7b1235a716d1dd3c1350bf86246e7aadafc75.text: 被遗忘者和魔法者将在 6 点 05 分左右恢复攻击。幽灵英雄可以承受攻城亚龙和第一波被遗忘者；他无法忍受其他人。你需要在 4:50 回到幽灵英雄以确保他的生存。如果你（玩家）拥有可以快速治愈英雄的法术，那么你可以在 4:30 逃脱惩罚 - 速度提升是必要的。

c39913e3f068b0bf9c5bcae103c10c55875a4ef8.source: Method three: Signet of Spirits solo
c39913e3f068b0bf9c5bcae103c10c55875a4ef8.text: 方法三：单独使用灵魂印记

46b2868126577851dfcbc7ec4948a47c1c954a31.source: A spirit spammer can solo the bosses while the rest of the party stays back and defends the fort. The build should include a self-heal, e.g. Mend Body and Soul or Spirit Light. Set up the spirits, pull the boss groups one at a time, and repeat.
46b2868126577851dfcbc7ec4948a47c1c954a31.text: 精神垃圾邮件发送者可以单独对付 Boss，而队伍的其他成员则留在后面保卫堡垒。构建应该包括自我修复，例如修补身体和灵魂或灵光。设置好精神，一次拉一个boss组，然后重复。

e9f91482e8444affe135c7318749f124b0f76d4e.source: Alternatively, if you leave a Signet of Spirits hero with the Ghostly Hero, they will both survive until you come back in to visual range of the Hero. This allows you to charge the three bosses.
e9f91482e8444affe135c7318749f124b0f76d4e.text: 或者，如果您将灵魂纹章英雄与幽灵英雄一起留下，他们都会存活下来，直到您回到英雄的可视范围内。这允许你向三个老板收费。

bba8c04b9ba4bbdde553da78c6003fe2a4293670.source: Method four: Kill Goss Aleessh's group after starting the timer
bba8c04b9ba4bbdde553da78c6003fe2a4293670.text: 方法四：启动计时器后杀掉Goss Aleesh的队伍

838b9bfae268ff750160ec5b7f230db76c242a5e.source: This method takes advantage of quirks in the game's mechanics, the first moves the Ghostly Hero to a safe spot after watching the mid-mission cinematic and the second is that the foes target the throne not the Ghostly Hero.
838b9bfae268ff750160ec5b7f230db76c242a5e.text: 这种方法利用了游戏机制中的怪癖，第一个是在观看任务中期电影后将幽灵英雄移动到安全位置，第二个是敌人的目标是王座而不是幽灵英雄。

9d253c46d24b8963843bd9fb9385bbd3651b041d.source: Killing all three members of Goss Aleessh's group will trigger a cutscene, where all allies including the Hero are teleported to where Aleessh originally patrols. Have your team utilize the slow totem to lure the last remaining member away from the bridge and enter the fortress. Once inside, before making the Ghostly Hero claim the altar, flag your H/H outside the fortress in preparation to kill Aleessh's team's remaining foe. Once the Hero begins to claim the altar and the timer begins, kill the remaining team member as quickly as possible before the enemies begin to surround the Ghostly Hero at the altar. Doing so will teleport the Ghostly Hero outside the fortress via the cutscene trick. Once outside the fortress, talk to the Hero to make him stay (safe spot). Now you have over nine minutes to complete the bonus while ensuring mission completion at the same time. The Ghostly Hero can remain alone and will be completely safe because the mission script sends the foes to the altar, not to the Hero.
9d253c46d24b8963843bd9fb9385bbd3651b041d.text: 杀死高斯·阿利斯的三名成员将触发过场动画，包括英雄在内的所有盟友都会被传送到阿利斯原来巡逻的地方。让你的团队利用缓慢的图腾来引诱最后剩下的成员离开桥梁并进入堡垒。进入内部后，在让幽灵英雄占领祭坛之前，在要塞外标记你的 H/H，准备杀死阿利什团队的剩余敌人。一旦英雄开始占领祭坛并且计时器开始，请在敌人开始包围祭坛上的幽灵英雄之前尽快杀死剩余的团队成员。这样做将通过过场动画将幽灵英雄传送到要塞外。出了堡垒后，与英雄交谈让他留下来（安全点）。现在您有超过九分钟的时间来完成奖励，同时确保任务完成。幽灵英雄可以保持孤独并且完全安全，因为任务脚本将敌人发送到祭坛，而不是英雄。

f390820076e8d70ec6d8ba132fd7adc19f48e6b1.source: You don't actually need the slow totem. One team member can lure Aleessh's entire team to one side letting the rest of the party sneak into the temple from the other. That team member with Spirits and Summon Spirits can lure and escape easily.
f390820076e8d70ec6d8ba132fd7adc19f48e6b1.text: 你实际上并不需要缓慢图腾。一名团队成员可以将阿利斯什的整个团队引诱到一侧，让团队的其他成员从另一侧潜入寺庙。拥有武魂和召唤武魂的队员可以轻松引诱和逃脱。

e1dfc70d9c9677379388fdbae20500d3f5fe3e41.source: There are several points where the party should take special care:
e1dfc70d9c9677379388fdbae20500d3f5fe3e41.text: 有几点需要党特别注意：

f7cebc5fa49cd1ef5214add0fd6784768c146a53.source: Passing Goss Aleessh: to prevent this boss' group from following, use the Slow Totem or distract them with minions or spirits.
f7cebc5fa49cd1ef5214add0fd6784768c146a53.text: 通过Goss Aleesh：为了防止这个老板的队伍跟随，使用缓慢图腾或用小兵或灵魂分散他们的注意力。

2f99dc102aadd5f0d551ffc988f81acb0ece6206.source: Single-player teams can use heroes and henchmen to draw his aggro, while the player sneaks the Ghostly Hero to a safe spot just before the bridge.
2f99dc102aadd5f0d551ffc988f81acb0ece6206.text: 单人团队可以使用英雄和追随者来吸引他的仇恨，而玩家则将幽灵英雄偷偷带到桥前的安全地点。

3f725afba3dcad17e8a8c716792d91623925b66c.source: Multiple-player teams can choose to have one player pull Goss Aleessh's group northeast, safely out of the way.
3f725afba3dcad17e8a8c716792d91623925b66c.text: 多人团队可以选择让一名玩家将 Goss Aleesh 的队伍安全地拉到东北方。

688c481097ebe176a239d642a7be53ed626bc0f1.source: Be careful to avoid popping up the Jade Scarabs southwest of the fortress' entrance ramp. Also, try to avoid letting the hero lower the bridge before you are ready.
688c481097ebe176a239d642a7be53ed626bc0f1.text: 小心避免翡翠圣甲虫出现在要塞入口坡道的西南方向。另外，尽量避免在你准备好之前让英雄放下桥。

cdfe80ac822d411a2055affbcffe2868e6466e14.source: Entering the fortress: as with the other methods, use the drawbridge gate as a choke-point against the first few groups of Enchanted Hammers and Swords.
cdfe80ac822d411a2055affbcffe2868e6466e14.text: 进入要塞：与其他方法一样，使用吊桥门作为对抗前几组魔法锤和剑的咽喉要道。

0baadc4a4cb3d78aeca51388822ef558d9c2a78d.source: Re-entering the fortress: you are likely to find a mob (including a re-incarnated Enemy Ghostly Hero) waiting for you at the shrine after the post-Aleessh cinematic. Again, use the entrance gate as a choke-point and pull the easily-separable mobs towards your party. Take your time; at worst, you will still have over seven minutes to complete the bonus.
0baadc4a4cb3d78aeca51388822ef558d9c2a78d.text: 重新进入堡垒：在后阿利斯什电影结束后，你可能会发现一群暴徒（包括转世的敌人幽灵英雄）在神社等着你。再次，使用入口门作为阻塞点，将容易分离的小怪拉向你的队伍。慢慢来;在最坏的情况下，您仍然有超过七分钟的时间来完成奖金。

b3b27c8464fbaa76f1d9be935d59fa5a8da4f2f4.source: Warning to Survivors: During the end scene you will see the swarm of Enchanted & Forgotten which has been completely avoided, those foes will still be attacking the party who "appear" to be invulnerable. However, behind the cinematic, the party actually wipes but still successfully completes the mission and bonus, and is therefore sent to Augury Rock.
b3b27c8464fbaa76f1d9be935d59fa5a8da4f2f4.text: 对幸存者的警告：在最后的场景中，你会看到被完全避开的魔法和遗忘群，那些敌人仍然会攻击“看起来”无敌的队伍。然而，在电影背后，队伍实际上被消灭了，但仍然成功完成了任务和奖金，因此被送往占卜岩。

56fa3a8dea3562c4537fc62a0c9efed0b1856e01.source: If the Ghostly Hero dies after capturing the shrine but before the party manages to trigger the cutscene, and Goss dies at the same time or shortly after the party is wiped, the cutscene will still trigger. After the cutscene the party and the Hero will be resurrected, but the party leader will have a "return to outpost"-prompt. The party can still continue the mission as long as the prompt is not hit, and even the mission timer will keep counting. The bonus objective can even be completed as normal when using this approach, but once the timer hits zero, the mission itself will not complete. However, a Zaishen Mission will update for both normal and bonus objectives.
56fa3a8dea3562c4537fc62a0c9efed0b1856e01.text: 如果幽灵英雄在占领神殿后但在队伍触发过场动画之前死亡，而高斯同时或在队伍被消灭后不久死亡，过场动画仍然会触发。过场动画结束后，队伍和英雄都会复活，但队伍领袖会有“返回前哨”的提示。只要不点击提示，队伍仍然可以继续任务，甚至任务计时器也会继续计时。使用这种方法时，奖励目标甚至可以正常完成，但一旦计时器为零，任务本身将无法完成。然而，再神任务将针对普通目标和奖励目标进行更新。

5bd06632db9fedcc84381866460f356686156c26.source: Each of these tricks can be used in combination with any of the methods above.
5bd06632db9fedcc84381866460f356686156c26.text: 这些技巧中的每一个都可以与上述任何方法结合使用。

bf0bcd1503835ba55da2a855436daa65c3a84e5d.source: Partial completion before the timer begins: You can sometimes kill the first general before the timer begins by forcing the Ghostly Hero to wait outside the fortress before capturing the altar. Head to the southern part of the compound and use distance attacks to aggro the general's group and kill them.
bf0bcd1503835ba55da2a855436daa65c3a84e5d.text: 计时器开始前部分完成：有时，您可以通过迫使幽灵英雄在占领祭坛之前在要塞外等待来在计时器开始前杀死第一个将军。前往大院的南部，使用远程攻击来攻击将军的队伍并杀死他们。

637bf99699bdcdf581c4bcf8a983a5f9c4028192.source: Ignore less-threatening wurms: You can avoid spending time on the siege wurms that do not threaten the Ghostly Hero; they only begin attacking if you get within aggro range or attack them.
637bf99699bdcdf581c4bcf8a983a5f9c4028192.text: 忽略威胁较小的亚龙：你可以避免花时间在对幽灵英雄没有威胁的攻城亚龙上；只有当你进入仇恨范围或攻击他们时，他们才会开始攻击。

d1667a54d1fdc1a69b1567844149e3600428f1b7.source: All of the techniques above work in hard mode, however there is less room for error.
d1667a54d1fdc1a69b1567844149e3600428f1b7.text: 上述所有技术都适用于困难模式，但出错的空间较小。

34c044e954879ead68a7d032412cf3390706241f.source: Backfire or Visions of Regret helps to counter the spellcasting bosses.
34c044e954879ead68a7d032412cf3390706241f.text: 逆火或遗憾幻象有助于对抗施法的 Boss。

ede16b123533b30690f712c74a2a40c30488c6b6.source: The wurms can be defeated using Pain Inverter or a combination of Wastrel's Worry/Wastrel's Demise, Power Drain, and Leech Signet.
ede16b123533b30690f712c74a2a40c30488c6b6.text: 亚龙可以使用痛苦反转器或废者的忧虑/废者的灭亡、能量吸取和水蛭徽记的组合来击败。

d441c032203cdf8fd774f98495c3286f10593ac2.source: Signet of Spirits spirit spammer-builds can solo the bonus bosses or defend the altar.
d441c032203cdf8fd774f98495c3286f10593ac2.text: 精神印章精神垃圾邮件制造者可以独奏奖励 Boss 或保卫祭坛。

9e9b7a16546b7efce4191b1792e03b8c19f005ff.source: To protect the Ghostly Hero, bring a bonder or spirit spammer. The safest spot for the bonder is in the north doorway (where you entered); only go closer to cast heals. Be wary in hard mode, since the Forgotten Cursebearers have Strip Enchantment.
9e9b7a16546b7efce4191b1792e03b8c19f005ff.text: 为了保护幽灵英雄，请携带绑定器或灵魂垃圾邮件发送器。对于粘合者来说，最安全的位置是北门口（您进入的地方）；只有靠近才能施放治疗。在困难模式下要小心，因为被遗忘的诅咒者有脱衣结界。

904ea6c35f02ac12f84bad5d6a54b1cdffd68ad4.source: Bring condition removal to remove blindness caused by Enchanted Bows (especially during the bonus).
904ea6c35f02ac12f84bad5d6a54b1cdffd68ad4.text: 移除条件以消除由魔法弓造成的失明（特别是在奖励期间）。

dfe47bbb7098e97294e1a7632137e462aa5d2f14.source: There is a large amount of desert to uncover for the cartographer title beyond and around the fort. The large area amounts to approximately 0.7% of Tyria. To access it all a player must run across at least one invisible bridge (never lowers graphically) into the South West fortress.
dfe47bbb7098e97294e1a7632137e462aa5d2f14.text: 堡垒之外和周围有大量的沙漠等待制图师的称号。面积约占泰瑞亚的0.7%。要访问这一切，玩家必须跑过至少一座看不见的桥（永远不会以图形方式降低）进入西南堡垒。

c458bf535c8ad5751a0ee53050ce57f843af911a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #8 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
c458bf535c8ad5751a0ee53050ce57f843af911a.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 8 页。

b085fa8d1dea2c366f0d6bce128d1a8a9bf8991f.source: The bridge will still fall if you talk to the Ghostly Hero before he uses Claim Resource at the start of the mission. The third bridge leading to the altar will sometimes not lower even if the Ghostly Hero has used Claim Resource. Occasionally the Ghostly Hero will become stuck while under attack by the first Siege Wurm or Goss Aleessh, in which case he will not activate Claim Resource to lower the bridge and stops following the player. He won't continue onward until you slay the enemy that is distracting him. It is possible to enter the buildings to the southwest and southeast of the Throne of Pellentia even when the bridges appear to be up.
b085fa8d1dea2c366f0d6bce128d1a8a9bf8991f.text: 如果你在任务开始时幽灵英雄使用索取资源之前与他交谈，桥仍然会倒塌。即使幽灵英雄使用了资源，通向祭坛的第三座桥有时也不会降低。有时，幽灵英雄会在受到第一个攻城亚龙或高斯阿利斯的攻击时被卡住，在这种情况下，他不会激活索取资源来降低桥梁并停止跟随玩家。在你杀死分散他注意力的敌人之前，他不会继续前进。即使桥梁看起来已经升起，也可以进入佩伦蒂亚王座西南和东南部的建筑物。

dbcfdceda67c7588dbc50250fe5d1ccaed5313ae.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Augury Rock.
dbcfdceda67c7588dbc50250fe5d1ccaed5313ae.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到占卜岩。

6ba1a1290cdc8d32c1c0edb1866095a38b1eedec.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for No Me, No Kormir or To Kill a Demon.
6ba1a1290cdc8d32c1c0edb1866095a38b1eedec.text: 所有党员必须接受《No Me》、《No Kormir》或《To Kill a Demon》的奖励。

32cec98e9534fefae934b93ae1fd23637186a7bd.source: Margrid the Sly must be present in the party.
32cec98e9534fefae934b93ae1fd23637186a7bd.text: 狡猾的玛格丽德必须出席聚会。

8929cbe240c8e65560b23187cfb980a59a81826f.text: 从甘达拉手中救出科米尔。

c6d8ae5c1c45507f95f089150bcfb87305378e98.source: Escort Margrid to the Gandaran treasure vault to retrieve the Diadem of Lady Glaive.
c6d8ae5c1c45507f95f089150bcfb87305378e98.text: 护送玛格丽德前往甘达拉宝藏，取回格莱夫人王冠。

67c877310d5273fdb1bf5c731bfd270938327f08.source: Free Kormir from the Kournan prison.
67c877310d5273fdb1bf5c731bfd270938327f08.text: 将科米尔从库南监狱中解救出来。

8eeed734e26d36cdffbb37e990c8690ca17bd7e6.source: Escape from Gandara with Kormir and Shahai.
8eeed734e26d36cdffbb37e990c8690ca17bd7e6.text: 与科米尔和沙海一起逃离甘达拉。

ccbe8b477a61705abda186b14d59f2e30dd4d1fb.source: Optional: Escort the Sunspear prisoners to the prison.
ccbe8b477a61705abda186b14d59f2e30dd4d1fb.text: 可选：护送烈阳之矛囚犯到监狱。

158cf594af224111f4442e2b8dff379651a67256.source: Optional: Obtain the prison code for entry into the prison.
158cf594af224111f4442e2b8dff379651a67256.text: 可选：获取进入监狱的监狱代码。

095a84f5e6cb6aabdcc8f7bea19863aff348dca4.source: Optional: The demon is out of control! You can either help the guards or stand aside and let them fight on their own.
095a84f5e6cb6aabdcc8f7bea19863aff348dca4.text: 可选：恶魔失控了！你可以帮助守卫，也可以站在一边让他们自己战斗。

a21846644e114c623e1645e0e13cbbf7e11a98d1.source: Optional: Take over gate duty for some guards.
a21846644e114c623e1645e0e13cbbf7e11a98d1.text: 可选：接管一些警卫的门禁职责。

200e2a6cb7bccdb3e2bc584a3968386dcd255417.text:

2ddb0b50aecd61fb395a2b468fd9a90769a8bb48.source: Your party starts under the Kournan Guardsman effect, disguised as Kournan guards to avoid early confrontations. During this time, players can accomplish the bonus objectives which are very simple.
2ddb0b50aecd61fb395a2b468fd9a90769a8bb48.text: 你的队伍在库南卫兵效应下开始，伪装成库南守卫以避免早期对抗。在此期间，玩家可以完成非常简单的奖励目标。

30b3f40a23e637e8336ce95a412e08c3faafc191.source: Proceed to the treasure vault (point 5) to trigger Margrid's dialogue to retrieve the Diadem of Lady Glaive and now head to the prison gate (point 6). Prison Keeper Shelkesh will ask the code to clear passage.
30b3f40a23e637e8336ce95a412e08c3faafc191.text: 前往宝库（第 5 点），触发玛格丽德的对话，取回格莱夫人王冠，然后前往监狱大门（第 6 点）。监狱看守谢尔凯什会要求输入密码才能通行。

e7df8710ec8e7402eed96437fc1ed197925a1673.source: If you acquired the password from the guard at the entrance of the fort, you can pass through unobstructed.
e7df8710ec8e7402eed96437fc1ed197925a1673.text: 如果你从要塞入口处的守卫那里得到了密码，你就可以畅通无阻地通过。

1ce7ffc994ff831a8b8cc897c71cadf8dd6818a1.source: However, should you not have the password or choose the option to give the wrong password, the 3 hostile Kournans will spawn, and Shelkesh will turn hostile, although he will not move or attack. The gate will open when all 4 foes are dead.
1ce7ffc994ff831a8b8cc897c71cadf8dd6818a1.text: 但是，如果您没有密码或选择提供错误密码的选项，则会生成 3 个敌对的 Kournan，而 Shelkesh 将变得敌对，尽管他不会移动或攻击。当 4 个敌人全部死亡时，大门就会打开。

7a8d7e2eba3028e0c16acdabac201477157fe236.source: Upon reaching the prison, kill Jailer Gahanni and the other guards and a cinematic will start (point 7).
7a8d7e2eba3028e0c16acdabac201477157fe236.text: 到达监狱后，杀死狱卒加汉尼和其他守卫，电影就会开始（第 7 点）。

d95bf3ff10dedf7ab8254b94592b46d4b4b7d188.source: Now, you have fifteen minutes to escape by reaching the docks with Kormir and Shahai. The exit can be found in only half the counter's time so there is no need to rush through as the clock may imply. There are two deadly spots:
d95bf3ff10dedf7ab8254b94592b46d4b4b7d188.text: 现在，你有十五分钟的时间与科米尔和沙海一起到达码头来逃脱。只需柜台一半的时间就可以找到出口，因此无需像时钟所暗示的那样匆忙通过。有两个致命点：

ccd272468843d35b8d36a92f97efacf605dc399e.source: The second and third Kournan groups after crossing back the bridge: Players will find the second group to be small and static, but a third larger group is on its way towards the bridge. Instead of engaging the second group, wait until the third climbs the stairs and move far ahead from the second group. This will help avoid over-aggroing and having to fight a large mob with two Kournan Priests healing each other. Since Margrid the Sly is a required hero, she can be used to lure the third group (flag and un-flag), because if a player attempts to pull, Kormir and Shahai will follow, risking mission failure.
ccd272468843d35b8d36a92f97efacf605dc399e.text: 过桥后的第二组和第三组 Kournan 组：玩家会发现第二组规模较小且静止，但第三组较大的组正在朝桥走去。不要与第二组交战，而是等到第三组爬上楼梯并远离第二组时。这将有助于避免过度仇恨和不得不与两名库南牧师互相治疗的大群怪物战斗。由于狡猾的玛格丽特是必需的英雄，她可以用来引诱第三组（标记和取消标记），因为如果玩家试图拉动，科米尔和沙海就会跟随，冒着任务失败的风险。

d075c884093d19efa8a001cd4d0eab9f7438e1f6.source: After dispatching these groups, you may either travel north through the fort or south along the docks, both paths rejoin at the dock.
d075c884093d19efa8a001cd4d0eab9f7438e1f6.text: 派遣完这些队伍后，你可以向北穿过堡垒，也可以沿着码头向南行驶，两条路都会在码头汇合。

557e1b7fcf15cd3dda37f98b884a7877c0683941.source: The final battle at the docks has four static guards and another group behind them lead by Captain Nebo, a powerful elementalist boss capable of dealing massive area damage with Fire Magic spells. Lure the four guards first to reduce enemies and only then engage the last group.
557e1b7fcf15cd3dda37f98b884a7877c0683941.text: 码头的最后一场战斗有四名静态守卫，他们身后的另一组由尼波船长领导，尼波船长是一位强大的元素首领，能够用火焰魔法造成大规模区域伤害。先引诱四名守卫减少敌人，然后再与最后一组交战。

a59c1dab923faeffb0033455b5b6530a135b6094.source: Finally, walk to the end of the dock to complete the mission.
a59c1dab923faeffb0033455b5b6530a135b6094.text: 最后走到码头尽头即可完成任务。

f523d9910d77ed970dfb76b6eb45f30b91976e02.source: These are four tasks that need to be accomplished before Kormir and Shahai's cinematic:
f523d9910d77ed970dfb76b6eb45f30b91976e02.text: 在科米尔和沙海的电影制作之前需要完成以下四项任务：

d6983534f5bf32537e2c9f9b1abd28ffbce6b722.source: Talk to Guard Captain Kahturin to obtain the prison code.
d6983534f5bf32537e2c9f9b1abd28ffbce6b722.text: 与警卫队长卡图林交谈以获取监狱密码。

79481de4378e3f4a661fe64727279cd53d02422e.source: Talk to Captain Nahnkos to escort Sunspear Prisoners, who will assist in battles but are not required to survive.
79481de4378e3f4a661fe64727279cd53d02422e.text: 与纳科斯队长交谈以护送烈阳之矛囚犯，他们将协助战斗，但不需要生存。

654b888a5719fb2e1ef5bfc24946375d4058728c.source: Trigger the Kourna Guards dialogue involving the Demon Spawn, either helping them or not will count as done.
654b888a5719fb2e1ef5bfc24946375d4058728c.text: 触发涉及恶魔之子的库尔纳守卫对话，无论是否帮助他们都算完成。

be38fda8b1d669ae3582af5d6e22eb3147b321ef.source: Talk to Guard Linko to take over gate duty. You don't need to watch them leave nor stay, just continue with the mission.
be38fda8b1d669ae3582af5d6e22eb3147b321ef.text: 与守卫林科交谈以接管登机口职责。你不需要看着他们离开，也不需要留下来，只需继续执行任务即可。

6ee97edf16fc5e07685168d89fdf834c15a1c570.source: If your party has anyone that deals damage via attacks, consider bringing skills that remove stances, bypass blocking or punish blocking to use against the Kournan Bowman, who use Whirling Defense.
6ee97edf16fc5e07685168d89fdf834c15a1c570.text: 如果你的队伍中有任何人通过攻击造成伤害，请考虑使用消除姿态、绕过阻挡或惩罚阻挡的技能来对抗使用旋转防御的库南弓箭手。

24b34b4a646f2065382ced43ebfef5c19bc6a233.source: The final elementalist boss is dangerous to the NPCs you must keep alive.
24b34b4a646f2065382ced43ebfef5c19bc6a233.text: 最终的元素首领对您必须保证存活的 NPC 来说非常危险。

f58328f5473eb9869b9d71cde6fe25962b138719.source: Ward Against Harm and/or Ward Against Elements help reduce the damage, until they move outside the wards. Shelter and Union will also help keep the NPCs alive
f58328f5473eb9869b9d71cde6fe25962b138719.text: 防御伤害和/或防御元素有助于减少伤害，直到他们移出防御区。庇护所和联盟也将有助于维持 NPC 的生存

ae10d5dacc9f77bb7516a100b825c4e427ca8182.source: Interrupts also help against the boss. Since Margrid is required for the mission, equip her with Distracting Shot and/or Savage Shot and lock her on the boss to help suppress damage.
ae10d5dacc9f77bb7516a100b825c4e427ca8182.text: 打断也有助于对抗boss。由于任务需要玛格丽德，请为她配备分散射击和/或野蛮射击，并将她锁定在 Boss 上以帮助抑制伤害。

4856f7a9b6dc28ba8f6e412562a9608526087d08.source: Occasionally, Kormir and/or Shahai may get stuck in the prison around the bridge. Make sure they are following as they are required to reach the docks to complete the mission.
4856f7a9b6dc28ba8f6e412562a9608526087d08.text: 有时，科米尔和/或沙海可能会被困在桥周围的监狱里。确保他们跟随，因为他们需要到达码头才能完成任务。

2093f1220baa12296e05a8f824141eb5a327d26e.source: Before entering the fortress gate, you can explore the Gandara, the Moon Fortress area, which is completely free of foes.
2093f1220baa12296e05a8f824141eb5a327d26e.text: 在进入要塞大门之前，你可以探索完全没有敌人的月亮要塞甘达拉地区。

93825d9a5f20b2a0113c2d3c3d0440643c854233.source: There is a dialogue sequence between a Kournan Guard and a Kournan Captain that seems to be reversed, that is, the Guard speaks the Captain's lines, and the Captain, the Guard's.
93825d9a5f20b2a0113c2d3c3d0440643c854233.text: 库尔南守卫和库尔南上尉之间的对话顺序似乎颠倒了，即守卫说上尉的台词，而上尉则说守卫的台词。

2e05bf068bf8f65c5ece3bf620a73374d11e906d.source: Using your keyboard to move around during the end mission cinematic will contribute about 0.1% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
2e05bf068bf8f65c5ece3bf620a73374d11e906d.text: 在最终任务过场动画中使用键盘移动将为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献约 0.1%。

28b2c49414c262638285dfa6c772cc8b3baed6ec.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Moddok Crevice.
28b2c49414c262638285dfa6c772cc8b3baed6ec.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到莫多克裂缝。

9961424414f2cb9995709dc15a71d305c02c92c6.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 in the Night Falls storybook.
9961424414f2cb9995709dc15a71d305c02c92c6.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 5 页。

17bad5c7f65f834589add154f35d7a7450fe0e14.source: Sometimes Guard Linko will not show up. In that case you will have to re-do the mission for the bonus. Mercenary Heroes will always transform into a male Kournan soldier even if they are female. For some characters the map will not be uncovered during the cinematic, even after moving using the keyboard. Sometimes the mission will fail when encountering the last group of enemies even without Kormir / Shahai dying and with time still available. Of the two groups that have to be killed to free Kormir, the northern one will sometimes spawn inside of a prison cell, out of reach of melee attacks for both them and players.
17bad5c7f65f834589add154f35d7a7450fe0e14.text: 有时守卫林科不会出现。在这种情况下，您将不得不重新执行任务以获得奖金。雇佣英雄即使是女性，也总是会变身为男性库尔南士兵。对于某些角色来说，即使在使用键盘移动后，地图也不会在过场动画中被发现。有时，即使科米尔/沙海没有死亡并且还有时间，遇到最后一批敌人时任务也会失败。在必须杀死才能释放科米尔的两个群体中，北方的一个有时会在牢房内生成，他们和玩家都无法受到近战攻击。

8323ec51f8a5851be58bb8560c0ca815d6ac7e54.source: Speak with Headmaster Zhan in the monastery

ec96b9acc8893e034802865d6b6a69991521ff9b.source: Go to southeastern Shing Jea Monastery. The headmasters are gathered in one place.
ec96b9acc8893e034802865d6b6a69991521ff9b.text: 前往东南部的Shing Jea寺。校长们都聚集在一处。

5f06d3cb03982e9362928b3c10b069f6725138a9.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from The Scar and start the mission.
5f06d3cb03982e9362928b3c10b069f6725138a9.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从疤痕走进前哨站并开始任务。

15da7f85a12af83de7bb7483b732857bde39b626.text: 击败戈斯·阿利斯什的队伍。

27f9741fa181e430a47804ba32db5dfb59d5bbce.text: 击败 Issah Sshay 的团队。

48e65bb89d77eefa5079903435eb46bb2779b67f.text: 击败赫斯珀·萨索的队伍。

66cab502847b92a359ca41b780f3dff92894682a.text: 击败乔索·埃舍尔的队伍。

a3d24ccc36a84cd9d8e4b01f848f1277c01d74f8.text: 击败凯斯卡·希什的队伍。

e3fad1173d056b6db4ae6545a9cff0c03fea04c0.source: *BONUS* Cleanse the area before King Khimaar's spirit is driven away.
e3fad1173d056b6db4ae6545a9cff0c03fea04c0.text: *奖励* 在希玛尔国王的灵魂被驱走之前净化该地区。

7a4a2040a0c19754bc7a1b2005afe667cd8e29f1.source: Before you fight the six teams mentioned in the objectives, there is an opportunity to gain Morale Boosts by killing the five Sand Giants which grant a 2% boost each. These Sand Giants are not mission critical.
7a4a2040a0c19754bc7a1b2005afe667cd8e29f1.text: 在与目标中提到的六支队伍战斗之前，有机会通过杀死五个沙巨人来获得士气提升，每只沙巨人都会获得 2% 的提升。这些沙巨人并不是关键任务。

b7c1f5e093a57fdc833554da1230ea6dad9fd3bd.source: The mission has three more sections, each with some Forgotten, a boss and a priest. A timer starts and at every two minutes mark, if the priest of a group is still alive, all defeated foes are resurrected; thus timing is highly important. Focus your firepower on the Priest first but if your party shows difficulty, pull back to prevent being instantly swarmed by the respawned foes. Defeating all foes opens the gate to the next section. Between sections, the timer stops and will reset when the next gate is opened, allowing enough time to regenerate and recharge before tackling the next area. Remember that if the Ghostly Hero dies, the mission is over. If you're unsure whether your healers can keep him alive, leave him behind the gate by talking to him once.
b7c1f5e093a57fdc833554da1230ea6dad9fd3bd.text: 该任务还有三个部分，每个部分都有一些被遗忘者、一个老板和一个牧师。计时器开始计时，每两分钟，如果队伍的牧师还活着，所有被击败的敌人都会复活；因此，时机非常重要。首先将你的火力集中在牧师身上，但如果你的队伍表现出困难，请向后撤退，以防止立即被重生的敌人包围。击败所有敌人将打开通往下一部分的大门。在各个部分之间，计时器会停止，并在下一个门打开时重置，以便在处理下一个区域之前有足够的时间进行再生和充电。请记住，如果幽灵英雄死亡，任务就会结束​​。如果你不确定你的治疗师能否让他活下去，请与他交谈一次，将他留在门后。

d18f530bba41830124cabfa57ee80860ef296217.source: Talk to the Ghostly Hero and enter the first section which has a single group led by Goss Aleessh. Be wary of the Forgotten's Chaos Storms, as it tends to confuse Hero and Henchmen AI, making them run in-and-out of the effect repeatedly.
d18f530bba41830124cabfa57ee80860ef296217.text: 与幽灵英雄交谈并进入第一部分，其中有一个由 Goss Aleessh 领导的小组。警惕被遗忘者的混沌风暴，因为它往往会迷惑英雄和追随者 AI，使他们反复陷入和退出该效果。

520fc7f35fd31f7ef161a70bce62cd2beef602db.source: Section two has two groups, one headed by Issah Sshay and the other by Hessper Sasso. Finish off one group at a time. After defeating the first boss, wait until the 2 minute timer mark has passed, then continue. There is little space to fight so instead of rushing ahead, wait by the recently opened gate as both groups have patrols headed towards it. In particular, sticking to the left wall can let one avoid the groups connected to Hesper Sasso entirely, making it easier to kill the Elementalist groups undisturbed.
520fc7f35fd31f7ef161a70bce62cd2beef602db.text: 第二部分有两个小组，一组由 Issah Sshay 领导，另一组由 Hessper Sasso 领导。一次完成一组。击败第一个boss后，等待2分钟计时器过去，然后继续。战斗的空间很小，所以不要冲在前面，而是在最近打开的大门前等待，因为两支队伍都有巡逻队朝它走去。尤其是紧贴左边的墙壁，可以完全避开与海斯帕·萨索有关的队伍，更容易不受干扰地杀死元素法师队伍。

a5f9739427b1bfda097876aab3da42a923888735.source: The third section has three groups. Custodian Hulgar is to the right, Josso Essher to the left, and Custodian Phebus in between. In this section the right group will attack King Khimaar. Of the six groups, Josso's (Word of Healing) is the most difficult as you will be facing two monks. Only groups from Custodian Hulgar will enter the center as long as no one wanders too close to the other groups.
a5f9739427b1bfda097876aab3da42a923888735.text: 第三部分分为三组。监护人赫尔加在右边，乔索·埃舍尔在左边，监护人菲比斯在中间。在本节中，右方队伍将攻击希玛尔国王。在这六个组中，Josso（治愈之言）是最困难的，因为你将面对两个僧侣。只要没有人离其他团体太近，只有监护人赫尔加的团体才会进入中心。

7905759174b7548e9d3732a75646c583b3a1eb3e.source: The bonus requires keeping King Khimaar alive in the third (and final) area. This is complicated by three factors that can cause you to fail the bonus: first, as soon as you enter the area, Custodian Hulgar's group will start attacking him. If he survives, he is also at risk from other foes in the area, especially if you draw them away from their original locations. Finally, if you take more than ten minutes to clear the area, the king will leave (usually at least one 2 minute cycle is needed per group, leaving only two possible extra cycles).
7905759174b7548e9d3732a75646c583b3a1eb3e.text: 奖励要求让基马尔国王在第三个（也是最后一个）区域存活。这会因为三个因素而变得复杂，这些因素可能会导致你无法获得奖励：首先，一旦你进入该区域，禁军赫尔加尔的队伍就会开始攻击他。如果他幸存下来，他也会面临来自该地区其他敌人的风险，特别是如果你将他们从原来的位置引走的话。最后，如果你花了十分钟以上清理该区域，国王就会离开（通常每组至少需要一个2分钟的循环，只留下两个可能的额外循环）。

9443136719dc68a11a5ba5064711aa72cba43b06.source: Accordingly, immediately send your party to protect the king (e.g. by flagging heroes and henchmen) and clear the central area of all foes before going after any of the other groups. Be prepared to return to protect the king if any foes respawn and head in his direction.
9443136719dc68a11a5ba5064711aa72cba43b06.text: 因此，立即派你的队伍去保护国王（例如，通过标记英雄和追随者）并清除中心区域的所有敌人，然后再追击任何其他队伍。如果有任何敌人重生并朝他的方向前进，请准备好返回保护国王。

06a7ac09e1c87210a12d3ea5470957ec66a4ef89.source: Besides increasing the level of all foes, Hard mode also adds a few skills to all non-boss enemies. In the Sand Giant section the Devourers will add effective area damage through Barrage while the Sand Giants become a bit more tanky through Vampiric Touch.
06a7ac09e1c87210a12d3ea5470957ec66a4ef89.text: 除了提高所有敌人的等级外，困难模式还为所有非头目敌人增加了一些技能。在沙巨人部分，吞噬者将通过弹幕增加有效的区域伤害，而沙巨人则通过吸血鬼之触变得更加坦克。

6b6aab0ef519914c4ff49ff8ad1671a03aa1ce4d.source: For the Forgotten section, the Mesmers gain Power Drain to interrupt while the Necromancers can remove enchantments due to Strip Enchantment. For the Bonus, it becomes much more important to avoid drawing foes to Khimaar and to protect him quickly. Not only can they kill him much quicker, but their increased movement speed means that one of the patrols from either the Ranger boss or the Monk boss area will very likely encounter the backline of the party if they haven't moved forwards.
6b6aab0ef519914c4ff49ff8ad1671a03aa1ce4d.text: 对于被遗忘的部分，催眠师获得能量吸取来打断，而死灵法师可以通过剥离结界来移除结界。对于奖励来说，避免将敌人吸引到希玛尔并快速保护他变得更加重要。他们不仅可以更快地杀死他，而且移动速度的提高意味着来自游侠 Boss 或武僧 Boss 区域的巡逻队如果不向前移动，很可能会遇到队伍的后线。

987e1e4287c94d206284d89c86b24602f459376b.source: Area of effect skills as all sections are tight.
987e1e4287c94d206284d89c86b24602f459376b.text: 由于所有部分都很紧张，所以影响技能的区域。

2c9a2b5d9ac2cc648e8725e42d827721e59c4277.source: Anti-caster skills, such as Scourge Healing, Backfire, and Broad Head Arrow.
2c9a2b5d9ac2cc648e8725e42d827721e59c4277.text: 反施法者技能，例如天灾治疗、逆火和宽头箭。

159383d1b2fde91980cb4099745d20a192908062.source: Technobabble can prove useful to daze both the Priest and the boss at once (if used properly).
159383d1b2fde91980cb4099745d20a192908062.text: 事实证明，科技语言可以有效地同时迷惑牧师和老板（如果使用得当）。

4b8bef13aa7ee58f2971c366b40aa8e617abbf03.source: A minion master helps corpse control as enemies use Consume Corpse to heal themselves and dodge players attacks.
4b8bef13aa7ee58f2971c366b40aa8e617abbf03.text: 当敌人使用消耗尸体来治愈自己并躲避玩家攻击时，小兵大师可以帮助控制尸体。

0410351658e999212c7c24f7d4175e494f283741.source: Blind skills to use against warriors and rangers but not versus Sand Giants as they use Plague Touch.
0410351658e999212c7c24f7d4175e494f283741.text: 盲目技能可用于对抗战士和游侠，但不能用于对抗沙巨人，因为他们使用瘟疫之触。

a20ebd5b5be05d0a6b3a62e0caa49d13ed8fd0dc.source: Spike Builds can be especially good to quickly kill Enemy Priest such as Star Burst, Mind Blast, Lightning Surge Nuker, Moebius Strike, Way of the Assassin Dagger Spam, Strike as One Packmaster
a20ebd5b5be05d0a6b3a62e0caa49d13ed8fd0dc.text: 尖刺构建特别适合快速杀死敌方牧师，例如星爆、心灵爆炸、闪电冲击核克、莫比乌斯打击、刺客匕首垃圾邮件之道、一人包主打击

fc99bdb773b797890bd229a1e40549b7ac0266f0.source: The groups led by the different bosses are hostile toward each other, and it is possible to have two enemy teams engage in combat if pulled correctly.
fc99bdb773b797890bd229a1e40549b7ac0266f0.text: 不同boss领导的队伍彼此敌对，如果拉动得当，有可能让两支敌方队伍交战。

94eb85a0c569b2d238abeb918068397374e2cd57.source: Lyssha Suss and Kesskah Shissh are not present in the mission. Their teams are actually headed by Custodian Phebus and Custodian Hulgar, respectively.
94eb85a0c569b2d238abeb918068397374e2cd57.text: Lyssha Suss 和 Kesskah Shissh 没有参加此次任务。他们的团队实际上分别由监护人菲布斯和监护人赫尔加领导。

6121d6143ba39130fb49eafe0cd550647174fee9.source: Consistent with the rest of the game, respawning enemies do not yield any experience or drops. However, they do leave exploitable corpses.
6121d6143ba39130fb49eafe0cd550647174fee9.text: 与游戏的其他部分一致，重生的敌人不会产生任何经验或掉落物。然而，他们确实留下了可利用的尸体。

110067568e070ca57ea42deee1891a959f328f20.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #9 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
110067568e070ca57ea42deee1891a959f328f20.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 9 页。

95dd6d0f6d45a9ee5ef291e76f0ebd88ced86544.source: The Morale Boost granted upon killing a Sand Giant also affects animal companions. In the last round, Lyssha Suss's (Custodian Phebus's) team may be tagged as Defeated without even having been engaged. If this happens, the player can ignore this group and finish the mission by just killing the other two teams. Sometimes, a chest will spawn at the entrance to Issah Sshay's chamber which the Ghostly Hero may become stuck on. If this happens the team must resign and begin the mission again. If you pull enemies to the Ghostly Hero before he opens the first gate, he may spend too long fighting them and never open the gate.
95dd6d0f6d45a9ee5ef291e76f0ebd88ced86544.text: 杀死沙巨人后获得的士气提升也会影响动物伙伴。在最后一轮中，莱莎·苏斯（Lyssha Suss）（守护者菲比斯）的队伍甚至可能在没有交战的情况下就被标记为“击败”。如果发生这种情况，玩家可以忽略这支队伍，只需杀死另外两支队伍即可完成任务。有时，伊萨·谢伊房间的入口处会出现一个箱子，幽灵英雄可能会被卡在上面。如果发生这种情况，团队必须辞职并重新开始任务。如果你在幽灵英雄打开第一扇门之前将敌人拉到他身边，他可能会花很长时间与他们战斗，而永远不会打开大门。

304c7ea80c2ad7507eb5955a2c7a8255aa50cb03.source: Complete exploration during this mission contributes approximately 0.7% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
304c7ea80c2ad7507eb5955a2c7a8255aa50cb03.text: 本次任务期间完成的探索大约为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了 0.7%。

63da0ff1cf92f9839476a8200360fb196b1307a8.source: This mission can be used for levelling up your character or your heroes. A Scroll of Hunter's Insight will increase the experience gained as you will be killing bosses on a regular basis.
63da0ff1cf92f9839476a8200360fb196b1307a8.text: 该任务可用于升级您的角色或英雄。猎人洞察卷轴将增加您获得的经验，因为您将定期杀死老板。

d4913eab7e7b7f49304842e32bd8f744a64b729b.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Diviner's Ascent and start the mission.
d4913eab7e7b7f49304842e32bd8f744a64b729b.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从占卜者上升站走进前哨站并开始任务。

dc3150e50e1a86b6d9207790e9eb5b592bf8d691.source: Help the Ghostly Hero complete the ritual that will combine the three pieces of the Vision Crystal.
dc3150e50e1a86b6d9207790e9eb5b592bf8d691.text: 帮助幽灵英雄完成将三块幻象水晶结合在一起的仪式。

5198c01bbb8a2848ba11330935efb44dae736c4e.source: Return Crystal Shard 1 to the Ghostly Hero.
5198c01bbb8a2848ba11330935efb44dae736c4e.text: 将水晶碎片 1 归还给幽灵英雄。

ec750762d8e5312f1fd285a3e70e2b5d52c09a00.source: Return Crystal Shard 2 to the Ghostly Hero.
ec750762d8e5312f1fd285a3e70e2b5d52c09a00.text: 将水晶碎片 2 归还给幽灵英雄。

42ca6818c1ae471cfff7a4fdadaab883c4ce871a.source: Return Crystal Shard 3 to the Ghostly Hero.
42ca6818c1ae471cfff7a4fdadaab883c4ce871a.text: 将水晶碎片 3 归还给幽灵英雄。

f4bd0b7f96c603bf80f0d0062c76bd84c034df96.source: *BONUS* Use the Crystal Shards to awaken the three Ritual Priests of Elona.
f4bd0b7f96c603bf80f0d0062c76bd84c034df96.text: *奖励* 使用水晶碎片唤醒伊洛娜的三位仪式牧师。

92e90c382136780ab670256e8786626ccb4eb143.source: This mission is split into two parts. The first part is to take the first Crystal Shard from the Ghostly Priest to the Ghostly Hero (Warrior on the article map). He can be found northwest of the starting location. In the valley, beware of the large Minotaur patrol and the Dune Burrowers.
92e90c382136780ab670256e8786626ccb4eb143.text: 该任务分为两部分。第一部分是从幽灵牧师那里拿到第一块水晶碎片给幽灵英雄（文章地图上的战士）。他可以在起始位置的西北找到。在山谷中，要提防大型牛头怪巡逻队和沙丘穴居者。

258d59f447364b5332427b6102b3dff41a43886c.source: Watch out for the Splinter Mines spread throughout the mission. When any party member triggers it, a ward briefly appears and after a few seconds, it causes crippled and bleeding to anyone within the area. The mine will continue to do this unless its core is removed by touching it. The core becomes a bundle and the mine will no longer activate once picked up (although it will finish its current cycle, often inflicting those conditions to the player who picked up the bundle unless they move away fast). Furthermore, the core can be dropped and cause the same conditions to nearby foes after a few seconds. It has one use only.
258d59f447364b5332427b6102b3dff41a43886c.text: 小心遍布整个任务的碎片地雷。当任何队员触发它时，一个守卫会短暂出现，几秒钟后，它会导致该区域内的任何人瘫痪和流血。地雷将继续这样做，除非通过接触它的核心来移除它。核心变成了一个捆绑包，地雷一旦被拾起就不再激活（尽管它会完成当前的循环，通常会对拾起捆绑包的玩家造成这些情况，除非他们快速离开）。此外，核心可能会掉落，并在几秒钟后对附近的敌人造成相同的情况。它只有一种用途。

6befc5d6391320dd43650f096ad21f58177f003e.source: When a player hands the Crystal Shard to the Ghostly Hero, a cinematic triggers and the second part of the mission begins. The party has now 30 minutes to find and deliver the last two Crystal Shards to the Ghostly Hero (who will now remain close to the Vision Crystal). There is plenty of time to move carefully and pull groups, even for the bonus and in Hard Mode. South of the Ghostly Hero lies two gates. These provide access to a large area home to another two crystals. It is recommended to use the more southerly gate since it avoids the potential aggro of two patrols.
6befc5d6391320dd43650f096ad21f58177f003e.text: 当玩家将水晶碎片交给幽灵英雄时，就会触发电影并开始任务的第二部分。队伍现在有 30 分钟的时间找到最后两块水晶碎片并将其交给幽灵英雄（他现在将保持在幻象水晶附近）。即使是在困难模式下，也有足够的时间来小心移动和拉队。鬼雄南侧有两门。这些提供了通往另外两个晶体的大面积区域的通道。建议使用更南边的大门，因为它可以避免两个巡逻队潜在的仇恨。

2f466d9f89cedcbfc52640396b1c63116585f43b.source: There is a crystal to the east, past the bridge and two bosses. Retrieve this crystal and either: take it back to the ghostly hero, or take it to the remains of the nearby Ritual Priest as per the bonus objectives.
2f466d9f89cedcbfc52640396b1c63116585f43b.text: 东边有一个水晶，过了桥和两个 Boss。取回这颗水晶，然后：将其带回给幽灵英雄，或根据奖励目标将其带到附近仪式牧师的遗骸处。

c1e52ebdc4c3bfe6f2026ba1ead51c67e3688dfb.source: If the party contains more than one player, then the team can continue westward to the last crystal. If alone, the player can take the first crystal back to the ghostly hero and return. The last crystal is again located behind a random boss. Picking up the crystal will cause the spawn of an additional two groups of forgotten. Taking this crystal back to the Ghostly Hero will complete the mission.
c1e52ebdc4c3bfe6f2026ba1ead51c67e3688dfb.text: 如果队伍中有不止一名玩家，那么队伍可以继续向西到达最后一个水晶。如果独自一人，玩家可以将第一个水晶带回给幽灵英雄并返回。最后一个水晶再次位于随机 Boss 后面。捡起水晶会导致另外两组被遗忘者的产生。将这块水晶带回幽灵英雄手中即可完成任务。

92fa504aacb8a1d36519d14403d3188211ca6a04.source: To achieve the bonus, players must prompt the appearance of three ghosts at their gravesites (Elementalist on the article map) by using the Crystal Shards, before delivering all of them to the Ghostly Hero. These awakened ghosts will walk towards the Ghostly Hero without following the party and fight foes but their survival is not required.
92fa504aacb8a1d36519d14403d3188211ca6a04.text: 为了获得奖励，玩家必须使用水晶碎片促使三个幽灵出现在他们的墓地（文章地图上的元素师），然后将它们全部交给幽灵英雄。这些觉醒的幽灵将走向幽灵英雄，而不跟随队伍并与敌人战斗，但他们的生存不是必需的。

9efe7f2e9f084fb109ffd29979f01686a6077870.source: The first gravesite is east of the starting location, behind two Dune Burrowers.
9efe7f2e9f084fb109ffd29979f01686a6077870.text: 第一个墓地位于起始位置以东，在两个沙丘挖掘者后面。

a4eb471be719c890a327dee025436c5a9c3c971d.source: The second gravesite is behind the boulder. Use the hidden path to travel between the second and third crystal sites.
a4eb471be719c890a327dee025436c5a9c3c971d.text: 第二个墓地位于巨石后面。使用隐藏路径在第二个和第三个水晶站点之间移动。

3f2ddbacaf92ad4447411e9d911fe7a9fecd4d11.source: The third gravesite is north of the western crystal, thus northwest of the courtyard.
3f2ddbacaf92ad4447411e9d911fe7a9fecd4d11.text: 第三个墓地位于西水晶以北，即庭院的西北方向。

49eafd9a306030c13385500a9aded9564394f76c.source: Note that the ghosts can be awakened by any shard, although awakening the third priest before collecting the third shard is a slower route unless your party consists of atleast 2 players.
49eafd9a306030c13385500a9aded9564394f76c.text: 请注意，鬼魂可以被任何碎片唤醒，尽管在收集第三个碎片之前唤醒第三个牧师是一个较慢的路线，除非你的队伍由至少 2 名玩家组成。

12f1fa1896b131d84a07aa39b2ba603ac1089832.source: Cripple removal to ease trouble from the Splinter Mines and Hamstring.
12f1fa1896b131d84a07aa39b2ba603ac1089832.text: 去除残废以缓解碎片地雷和腿筋带来的麻烦。

3d8f9dfb0b1f3537fff7d07e544e2a16d50ee167.source: Anti-caster skills to dispatch Sages faster.
3d8f9dfb0b1f3537fff7d07e544e2a16d50ee167.text: 反施法者技能可以更快地派遣贤者。

b31e0aa2894ce7f3aea6b8011b2c90b876ddd8dd.source: A running skill to speed up the delivery of the vision crystals.
b31e0aa2894ce7f3aea6b8011b2c90b876ddd8dd.text: 加速传送异象水晶的奔跑技能。

2a4d99d3f7f7037d9edf231216e8a3e89047ca07.source: This mission can be run by a solo character:
2a4d99d3f7f7037d9edf231216e8a3e89047ca07.text: 该任务可以由单人角色执行：

5da756e179dc4855e3d92a91e9b9a1b3ca412d25.source: Crippled counters such as "I Am Unstoppable!".
5da756e179dc4855e3d92a91e9b9a1b3ca412d25.text: 残缺的计数器，例如“我势不可挡！”。

cf6515f7ac3307babb5b8dfc0712c8358798a6fc.source: The mission area includes several landmarks: The Divine Fire shrine holding the assembled Vision Crystal, the three ascension runes, and the Mesa.
cf6515f7ac3307babb5b8dfc0712c8358798a6fc.text: 任务区域包括几个地标：持有组装好的幻象水晶的神火神殿、三个飞升符文和台地。

0d9daf734fe3a696fabbe858448627e085d07c89.source: After completing this mission, your character will be taken to The Dragon's Lair.
0d9daf734fe3a696fabbe858448627e085d07c89.text: 完成此任务后，您的角色将被带到龙穴。

660323bd5559900889edf556a0c08b5e393dc761.source: None of the walls in the mesa block line of sight; projectiles will travel through them.
660323bd5559900889edf556a0c08b5e393dc761.text: 台面上没有任何墙壁阻挡视线；射弹将穿过它们。

1e8793c53ac88fdc9e3817d5bb40e5e4c5a5956c.source: If you and the Doppelganger both die, you will get credit for the mission.
1e8793c53ac88fdc9e3817d5bb40e5e4c5a5956c.text: 如果你和分身都死了，你就会获得任务的荣誉。

ed180de55d48e9342954d8a087eb00cd124ccf50.source: If you die first, you will get credit for the mission but may not trigger the cutscene or move on to The Dragon's Lair.
ed180de55d48e9342954d8a087eb00cd124ccf50.text: 如果你先死，你将获得任务奖励，但可能不会触发过场动画或前往龙穴。

4f426f3fa56ce57a64e2e8ee11d5b3ee8bc429d1.source: If the doppelganger dies first, you will be resurrected for the cinematic, and will move on normally).
4f426f3fa56ce57a64e2e8ee11d5b3ee8bc429d1.text: 如果分身先死，你将在过场动画中复活，并正常继续前进）。

df55b54085f51a2941bfbf7b65c62440c83fe7c9.source: If you disconnect during the mission, you will not get credit (and will find yourself in either the Dragon's Lair or Augury Rock outposts).
df55b54085f51a2941bfbf7b65c62440c83fe7c9.text: 如果您在任务期间断开连接，您将不会获得积分（并且会发现自己位于龙穴或占卜岩前哨站）。

cc65896e3eec1baf0293b8511682ed2d5950e38a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
cc65896e3eec1baf0293b8511682ed2d5950e38a.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 11 页。

22dc67839e6eec210395b9bd968f7e410d6d9943.source: Meet the Master of Whispers in the Floodplain of Mahnkelon.
22dc67839e6eec210395b9bd968f7e410d6d9943.text: 在马恩科隆的洪泛平原遇见低语大师。

276c23ca27a4f956cad57836e8008059a3159a79.source: Weaken the Drought by killing the droughtlings at the Floodplain of Mahnkelon, outside the Waterworks. [5...0] of 5 groups remain.
276c23ca27a4f956cad57836e8008059a3159a79.text: 通过杀死水厂外马恩科隆洪泛区的旱生物来减弱干旱。剩下 5 个组中的 [5...0] 个。

e4a76619e7cf4ecbe2a8f4338874a76526f3aab1.source: Report to Dehjah for further instructions.
e4a76619e7cf4ecbe2a8f4338874a76526f3aab1.text: 向 Dehjah 报告以获取进一步指示。

7b237dafe3ea8381561b335673c3828e39875c92.text: 去找 Dehjah 领取奖励。

5624e8c2de6b1845dfb285fec719e3a5c0a2c351.source: Master of Whispers joins your party.
5624e8c2de6b1845dfb285fec719e3a5c0a2c351.text: 密语大师加入你的队伍。

59adec9038080f6411d7fd605d6ded10ef130273.source: From Kodonur Crossroads exit into The Floodplain of Mahnkelon. Talk to the Master of Whispers who can be found next to the resurrection shrine. Make your way northeast to the water's edge where you will find the 5 groups of Droughtlings. Each group will contain 3 Droughtlings each and in total all 15 must be killed to advance the quest. The groups can be killed in any order. Just be aware that there are large groups of Heket in the area, so try not to aggro these or pull the Droughtlings to make the job easier.
59adec9038080f6411d7fd605d6ded10ef130273.text: 从科多努尔十字路口出口进入曼克隆洪泛区。与复活神殿旁边的低语大师交谈。向东北方向前往水边，您会发现 5 组旱苗。每组各包含 3 只旱生物，总共必须杀死 15 只旱生物才能推进任务。这些群体可以按任何顺序被杀死。请注意，该地区有大群赫克特人，因此请尽量不要攻击这些人或拉走旱生物，以使工作变得更容易。

bae10ec59aab89f8ad36fdc425a162735140c2d9.source: Once all 5 groups have been killed, talk to Dehjah who is standing on a small hill to the west. Once you are ready, she will take you to the mission outpost Rilohn Refuge. Talk to her again here (note that she is now disguised as a human) for your reward.
bae10ec59aab89f8ad36fdc425a162735140c2d9.text: 当所有 5 个小组都被杀死后，与站在西边一座小山上的 Dehjah 交谈。一旦你准备好了，她就会带你去任务前哨站里洛恩避难所。在这里再次与她交谈（注意她现在伪装成人类）以获得奖励。

489d693313e67b0be88a29208b12f2e3fcafa33a.source: Bring skills that deal massive damage to break through Stoneflesh Aura or enchantment removal skills to remove Stoneflesh Aura.
489d693313e67b0be88a29208b12f2e3fcafa33a.text: 使用造成大量伤害的技能来突破石肉光环，或使用结界移除技能来移除石肉光环。

656e1fd0211ce76f57f701fa39bf04dcdf458c08.source: Interruption skills are also a viable option.
656e1fd0211ce76f57f701fa39bf04dcdf458c08.text: 打断技能也是一个可行的选择。

7f7bcce89202d7af2019831f7996080bffb249b0.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Bukdek Byway
7f7bcce89202d7af2019831f7996080bffb249b0.text: 击败 Bukdek Byway 中的受苦者

ec230184e7346a625ea75be2d2823c6c016f5600.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Bukdek Byway, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
ec230184e7346a625ea75be2d2823c6c016f5600.text: 完成此任务会改变 Bukdek Byway 中出现的敌人，具体来说，受苦者将不再生成。

83c2956ce6a7e90c38b5787f34e6f2d7a7d3bf74.source: Start from Kaineng Center and follow the quest markers through Bukdek Byway, and destroy three groups of Afflicted. Non-Dervishes should avoid bringing enchantments, or be prepared to deal with an over-abundance of enchantment removal skills.
83c2956ce6a7e90c38b5787f34e6f2d7a7d3bf74.text: 从凯能中心出发，沿着任务标记穿过 Bukdek Byway，消灭三组受折磨者。非苦行僧应该避免携带结界，或者准备好应对过多的结界移除技能。

ce449bf0ffb02c5300e6cde2ed877a77504e5210.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for To Kill a Demon or No Me, No Kormir.
ce449bf0ffb02c5300e6cde2ed877a77504e5210.text: 所有队伍成员必须接受《杀死恶魔》或《没有我，没有科米尔》的奖励。

320392c58d3e6c3edb17a0c896eafbb8cdeb8e7a.source: Master of Whispers must be present in the party.
320392c58d3e6c3edb17a0c896eafbb8cdeb8e7a.text: 密语大师必须出席聚会。

de6c8183f3c95ebf3ef31141543ade5301c45d70.source: Protect Dehjah until she opens the entrance to the Mahnkelon Waterworks.
de6c8183f3c95ebf3ef31141543ade5301c45d70.text: 保护 Dehjah，直到她打开 Mahnkelon 水厂的入口。

2dc5c532235411a56c1bf6e48e5b065aebd43f61.source: Make your way to the central reservoir.

50f587c5077f5c029c21143b5132b7bd4837b6e1.source: Weaken the Drought by shutting off the water pumps. [5...0] of 5 remain active.
50f587c5077f5c029c21143b5132b7bd4837b6e1.text: 通过关闭水泵来减轻干旱。 [5...0]（共 5 个）保持活动状态。

bc8b9238c6ef704311b1a83bffb148b4f0c5841f.source: *BONUS* Defeat the Drought without shutting down water pumps.
bc8b9238c6ef704311b1a83bffb148b4f0c5841f.text: *奖励* 在不关闭水泵的情况下战胜干旱。

56217655ff7d49baddecaf6e9015b2c44c84df4a.source: Shadow stepping will cause you to drop the crystals (so avoid using these skills while carrying them).
56217655ff7d49baddecaf6e9015b2c44c84df4a.text: 暗影踏会导致你掉落水晶（所以避免在携带水晶时使用这些技能）。

6f915bf3239fccaabf138e29aa31c5e589a21dbc.source: Complete exploration during this mission contributes approximately 0.2% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
6f915bf3239fccaabf138e29aa31c5e589a21dbc.text: 在此任务期间完成的探索大约为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了 0.2%。

bf632fec8feb5891ec60614973db5effec08b996.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #10 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
bf632fec8feb5891ec60614973db5effec08b996.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 10 页。

c08397b2c56ff6c935542c5b6c326d28c66fb129.source: The mission can be failed if the Ghostly Hero dies. This can happen occasionally if enemies spawn inside the complex near to his location.
c08397b2c56ff6c935542c5b6c326d28c66fb129.text: 如果幽灵英雄死亡，任务可能会失败。如果敌人在靠近他的位置的建筑群内生成，这种情况偶尔会发生。

b1825626a97c25721b513aa2b63127ee02c65cbf.source: * For a Price neither active nor completed
b1825626a97c25721b513aa2b63127ee02c65cbf.text: * 对于既不活跃也不完成的价格

a7e1a642cb03fc48a07e023e448d3f3c0a6dfb4d.source: Meet with Dehjah, an ally of the Master of Whispers.
a7e1a642cb03fc48a07e023e448d3f3c0a6dfb4d.text: 与低语大师的盟友德贾会面。

ad22d58c22430d521c075ca8aba7fe305fb83e30.source: Destroy the demons from the earth. [3...0] of 3 groups remain.
ad22d58c22430d521c075ca8aba7fe305fb83e30.text: 消灭地球上的恶魔。剩下 3 组中的 [3...0]。

8f9e91f872d62b95fb90d5da13b75a5a86f541a3.source: See Master of Whispers for your reward.
8f9e91f872d62b95fb90d5da13b75a5a86f541a3.text: 请参阅密语大师以获得奖励。

230cb8fd0b6cea067e75dbfae915250442394f71.source: Dehjah and Water Djinn will no longer spawn in Dejarin Estate after this quest is completed.
230cb8fd0b6cea067e75dbfae915250442394f71.text: 此任务完成后，德贾和水巨灵将不再在德贾林庄园中生成。

757cfc2e4cc6671b16e205d08d0a7c78b501615e.source: Secrets in the Shadow is offered right after completion of the Mysterious Message quest, together with a mutually exclusive primary quest For a Price. Note: Secrets in the Shadow leads to the recruitment of Master of Whispers and For a Price leads to the recruitment of Margrid the Sly.
757cfc2e4cc6671b16e205d08d0a7c78b501615e.text: 完成“神秘消息”任务后即可获得“阴影中的秘密”，以及一个互斥的主要任务“有价”。注意：《暗影中的秘密》会招募低语大师，而《有价》则会招募狡猾的玛格丽特。

536e148af5a2c1e8b87793cd75ae3c6933417a5d.source: Travel to Kodonur Crossroads then leave through the portal there into Dejarin Estate. Head to the marker and speak with Dehjah. She will summon 3 groups of Droughtlings that will converge on Dehjah's location. It is advisable to move away immediately after you have talked with Dehjah to avoid being attacked by all 3 groups of Droughtlings simultaneously - doing this allows you to engage each group separately. Defeat them and talk to Master of Whispers to collect the reward.
536e148af5a2c1e8b87793cd75ae3c6933417a5d.text: 前往科多努尔十字路口，然后通过那里的传送门进入德贾林庄园。前往标记处并与 Dehjah 交谈。她将召唤 3 组旱灵，并聚集到 Dehjah 的位置。建议您在与 Dehjah 交谈后立即离开，以避免同时受到所有 3 组 Droughtlings 的攻击 - 这样做可以让您分别与每个组交战。击败他们并与密语大师交谈以领取奖励。

2746c2411514b10cc11c268cba832ad56160acf2.source: Mutually exclusive with For a Price.

7ca44a1a015ca875fc43245ecd239546334c0757.source: Some have claimed that the Master of Whispers will not give out the reward if one party member is dead on completion of the quest. As such, make sure that all party members are alive before talking to the Master of Whispers.
7ca44a1a015ca875fc43245ecd239546334c0757.text: 有些人声称，如果任务完成后一名队员死亡，低语大师将不会发放奖励。因此，在与低语大师交谈之前，请确保所有队员都还活着。

c13777e8e2a1bb99b3dfbce517dac9e02b76efbd.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Prophet's Path or Skyward Reach and talk to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut to start the mission. Completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach also brings the party here.
c13777e8e2a1bb99b3dfbce517dac9e02b76efbd.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从先知之路或天空之境走进前哨站，并与大仪式牧师扎赫穆特交谈以开始任务。完成绝望沙丘、口渴河或伊罗娜河段也可以将派对带到这里。

f78047a5b1f0769d7eb683eda2febf154745d4d4.source: Although it is possible to enter the mission without completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach, you do need to complete these to activate the ascension glyphs, which is necessary to complete Augury Rock.
f78047a5b1f0769d7eb683eda2febf154745d4d4.text: 尽管可以在不完成绝望沙丘、口渴河或伊洛娜河段的情况下进入任务，但您确实需要完成这些任务才能激活升天雕文，这是完成占卜岩所必需的。

dbd7245a2e6c99fb82b1f1ff76a2c9514aae2fe7.source: *BONUS* Defeat the Doppelganger in under 10 minutes. (In Normal mode.)
dbd7245a2e6c99fb82b1f1ff76a2c9514aae2fe7.text: *奖励* 在 10 分钟内击败分身。 （在正常模式下。）

05f1ca63deb0a4f7c670d0cf95313963a711e39e.source: *BONUS* Defeat the Doppelganger in under 2 minutes. (In Hard mode.)
05f1ca63deb0a4f7c670d0cf95313963a711e39e.text: *奖励* 在 2 分钟内击败分身。 （在困难模式下。）

8ba6c09b4c6c811c4ed730f46be1f48faa734e82.source: 1 Only for first time character ascension.
8ba6c09b4c6c811c4ed730f46be1f48faa734e82.text: 1 仅适用于第一次角色提升。

55400e0f95dfa5083e641c539932a6b80460d16f.source: Augury Rock/Guide for a detailed walkthrough

0d979e408bafb3f3f78105feb6ed9a3ec04ecddf.source: Your only objective is to defeat the Doppelganger; you meet the bonus objective by killing it within 10 minutes (2 minutes on Hard mode).
0d979e408bafb3f3f78105feb6ed9a3ec04ecddf.text: 你唯一的目标就是打败分身；你可以在 10 分钟内杀死它（困难模式为 2 分钟），从而达到奖励目标。
