c258e2a47993b026cbadae132a5f7c6cc8d19e65.source: To reach your opponent's location, speak to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut, who will take you to the area with the ghosts you met during the previous three missions. Walk past them and step on each of the three stones marked with ascension runes (the order does not matter). After a brief cinematic (showing the rock break open), you will be face to face with the doppel.
c258e2a47993b026cbadae132a5f7c6cc8d19e65.text: 要到达对手的位置，请与大仪式牧师扎赫穆特交谈，他将带你前往你在前三个任务中遇到的鬼魂所在的区域。走过它们，踩上三块标有提升符文的石头（顺序无关紧要）。在一段简短的电影（显示岩石破裂）之后，您将与分身面对面。

fdd4566dfc24501544644783bedf8f1bef8971bc.source: This mission is one of the few missions a player can walk out of. By standing on the teleporter in the beginning, players are teleported back to the Augury Rock outpost.
fdd4566dfc24501544644783bedf8f1bef8971bc.text: 该任务是玩家可以退出的少数任务之一。通过一开始站在传送器上，玩家会被传送回占卜岩前哨站。

f886a539530d4180e626a851955ea1a6a4fcea3b.source: Consumables, such as Candy Apples, can be used during the fight; however, summoning stones cannot.
f886a539530d4180e626a851955ea1a6a4fcea3b.text: 战斗中可以使用糖苹果等消耗品；然而，召唤石却不能。

f15e83ea4bf6fc570c13618cc829e6703e45e31c.source: At the beginning of the mission you follow Dehjah as she leads the way to an entrance of the waterworks. She seems to be in a hurry to get rid of the Drought, as she tends to run ahead as soon as each group of enemies is eliminated. Be very careful as she turns left off the land to head to the fort as you can be detained by the group of Kournans whom she will often not aggro. This almost always results in her being killed by the Steelfang Drakes. She will be overwhelmed if you don't keep up, so stick with her. Do not waste any time looting after each encounter as she will not wait. If she dies the mission is over.
f15e83ea4bf6fc570c13618cc829e6703e45e31c.text: 在任务开始时，你跟随 Dehjah，她带路前往自来水厂的入口。她似乎急于摆脱干旱，每当敌人被消灭后，她就会跑到前面。当她左转离开陆地前往堡垒时要非常小心，因为你可能会被一群库南人拘留，而她通常不会激怒他们。这几乎总是导致她被钢牙龙杀死。如果你不跟上，她会不知所措，所以坚持下去。每次遭遇后不要浪费时间进行抢劫，因为她不会等待。如果她死了，任务就结束了。

4b4a857efd7b8b926e341d8d56b17b7efb70383d.source: Dehjah is the only one who can open the gates to the waterworks. If you miss this by chance, by straying off fighting, you'll be frustrated when you get back to the main gate and it remains locked (even if Dehjah is still alive). If you miss her opening the door just resign and start over because you cannot get in.
4b4a857efd7b8b926e341d8d56b17b7efb70383d.text: Dehjah 是唯一能够打开自来水厂大门的人。如果你偶然错过了这一点，因为偏离了战斗，当你回到大门并且门仍然锁着时你会感到沮丧（即使德贾还活着）。如果你错过了她开门的机会，那就辞职重新开始吧，因为你进不去。

bba7da827fe054d995420ccdf033e5c7ec5ab9b6.source: Dehjah leaves you at the entrance to the waterworks. There is an environmental effect in this area, Thirst of the Drought, which increases the damage you take from earth damage by 50%. This can make fighting Droughtlings more annoying, but really becomes a problem against the Drought itself who is an elementalist boss specializing in Earth Magic. You can get rid of this effect by turning off each of the pumps in the waterworks, of which there are 5 in total. Each pump gives a 2% morale boost and reduces the environmental effect by 10% until there is no effect at all; however, turning off a pump will cause your party to not gain the Master's Reward.
bba7da827fe054d995420ccdf033e5c7ec5ab9b6.text: Dehjah 将您留在自来水厂入口处。该区域有一种环境效果“干旱之渴”，它会使你受到的地球伤害提高 50%。这可能会让与干旱生物的战斗变得更加烦人，但对于干旱本身来说，这确实是一个问题，因为干旱是一个专门研究土系魔法的元素主义老板。您可以通过关闭自来水厂中的每台水泵（总共有 5 个）来消除这种影响。每泵一次可提升 2% 的士气，并减少 10% 的环境影响，直至完全没有影响；然而，关闭泵将导致你的队伍无法获得大师的奖励。

90e6c1c549c53de983633d70c3e0588992f4ef86.source: Travel to each pump indicated by the flags on the area map, killing anything which gets in your way. Switch off as many pumps as you feel is necessary as you make your way inwards to the Drought.
90e6c1c549c53de983633d70c3e0588992f4ef86.text: 前往区域地图上旗帜指示的每个泵，杀死任何挡道的东西。当您进入干旱地区时，请关闭您认为有必要的尽可能多的泵。

1d714cee35b57f3f2beec78b9dcb1b2b2480593a.source: The Drought is accompanied by two Droughtlings and there are several more groups of Droughtlings in the area. Take care of any Droughtling groups you think will get in the way first. Then utilize the skills recommended below when you take on the Drought and stay spread out watching for Sandstorm. Kill the Drought and the Droughtlings in its group to finish the mission.
1d714cee35b57f3f2beec78b9dcb1b2b2480593a.text: 干旱伴随着两群干旱，并且该地区还有几群干旱。首先处理掉你认为会妨碍的任何干旱群体。然后，当您应对干旱并分散注意沙尘暴时，请利用下面推荐的技能。杀死干旱和其群体中的干旱幼虫以完成任务。

c8db9926c6086727aa6450fb1926364775eac655.source: This is one of the few missions where you must do less, rather than more, to achieve the bonus. Take the most direct route, forgetting the water pumps, and head straight to the Drought. Make sure that you can handle its increased damage output; preprotting, interrupting and/or dazing are all recommended.
c8db9926c6086727aa6450fb1926364775eac655.text: 这是为数不多的任务之一，您必须少做而不是多做才能获得奖励。走最直接的路线，忘记水泵，直奔干旱之地。确保你能够承受其增加的伤害输出；建议进行预保护、打断和/或眩晕。

21212212c3b2c8fc60d1fdd434d8876249578638.source: Bring anti-caster skills for the Drought and Droughtlings. Examples would be skills which cause daze, spell interrupts, shutdown (such as Panic or Power Block) or hexes which cause damage to spellcasters (such as Backfire).
21212212c3b2c8fc60d1fdd434d8876249578638.text: 为干旱和干旱生物带来抗施法技能。例如，导致眩晕、法术中断、关闭的技能（例如恐慌或能量封锁）或对施法者造成伤害的咒语（例如逆火）。

d5385cfa78789c3e8c3c6fe1a8e5387f153cb040.source: Pain Inverter is especially useful if you bring lots of minions - the Drought will kill itself very quickly.
d5385cfa78789c3e8c3c6fe1a8e5387f153cb040.text: 如果你带了很多小兵，疼痛逆变器特别有用——干旱会很快杀死自己。

f10b69bb7e77f846bb3cf6e5853cbb8ed2100150.source: The Thirst of the Drought environmental effect increases earth damage taken by your party by up to 50%:
f10b69bb7e77f846bb3cf6e5853cbb8ed2100150.text: 干旱之渴环境效果使你的队伍受到的地球伤害提高高达 50%：

2c8319ba2cbeee2be4745bbb2de3bf9f12c01104.source: Winter can be used to change the Drought's earth damage to cold damage, negating the Thirst of the Drought effect.
2c8319ba2cbeee2be4745bbb2de3bf9f12c01104.text: 冬天可以用来将干旱的土伤害改为寒冷伤害，抵消干旱的渴求效果。

0ae65e59458fc13c3bb0da3e62b54c44de58c35b.source: Bring skills that protect against earth or elemental damage.
0ae65e59458fc13c3bb0da3e62b54c44de58c35b.text: 带来抵御土或元素伤害的技能。

3a59a6fbcdd2d931b83a4ac84b3a833b7b8c10fe.source: Damage reduction can be helpful, e.g. Protective Spirit or Shelter.
3a59a6fbcdd2d931b83a4ac84b3a833b7b8c10fe.text: 减少伤害可能会有所帮助，例如保护精神或庇护所。

0a1153496c38399bdc1cee2713e36c2b2b8ec0cc.source: The Mesmer skill Aneurysm can be used as a spike against the Droughtlings.
0a1153496c38399bdc1cee2713e36c2b2b8ec0cc.text: 催眠术技能动脉瘤可以用作对抗旱生物的尖峰。

f0647620ac149975bd104d1553d00a5ab970d1f6.source: Restoration helps to prevent wipes, especially during the boss battle.
f0647620ac149975bd104d1553d00a5ab970d1f6.text: 恢复有助于防止擦除，尤其是在 Boss 战中。

116d6fbe646a48fe65c34967d1ffbdffa94b48a5.source: Since you gain the standard reward if you switch off any more than one pump, the only practical benefit for skipping pumps after turning off two is that it will make the mission slightly faster.
116d6fbe646a48fe65c34967d1ffbdffa94b48a5.text: 由于如果您关闭超过一个泵，您将获得标准奖励，因此在关闭两个泵后跳过泵的唯一实际好处是，它将使任务稍微快一些。

ffd1ad03a7451ff4acc0079bb3cecb4401fdcdb2.source: To capture Sandstorm from the Drought, ensure it is killed before the two Droughtlings adjacent to it.
ffd1ad03a7451ff4acc0079bb3cecb4401fdcdb2.text: 要从干旱中捕获沙暴，请确保它在邻近的两个干旱生物之前被杀死。

59d1a063006488d8d440b00e3a0947ed1250812c.source: If you are having trouble keeping Dehjah alive to open the gate, do not approach her as you start the mission. Stay tight into the shadow of the cliffs, and clear the route to the gate. Then have a party member run back to trigger Dehjah.
59d1a063006488d8d440b00e3a0947ed1250812c.text: 如果你很难让德贾活着来打开大门，请不要在任务开始时接近她。紧紧地躲在悬崖的阴影里，清理通往大门的道路。然后让一名队员跑回去触发 Dehjah。

cba8b010f5467297f78fe984c0822c8335793c71.source: Survivors beware, for even in Normal mode, the Drought could kill a player in a single hit when going for the Master's reward.
cba8b010f5467297f78fe984c0822c8335793c71.text: 幸存者要小心，因为即使在正常模式下，当玩家寻求大师的奖励时，干旱也可能会一击杀死玩家。

3bf39275d72d28b733e8893cf1135fd4eaa2bbef.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Moddok Crevice.
3bf39275d72d28b733e8893cf1135fd4eaa2bbef.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被传送到莫多克裂缝。

88fa17a1a999474c6772ad20840dc50560d464d8.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #4 in the Night Falls storybook.
88fa17a1a999474c6772ad20840dc50560d464d8.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 4 页。

b3a0ca2ff7f3519c8bb499379a0868ea28e26705.source: This mission is not required to complete the campaign.
b3a0ca2ff7f3519c8bb499379a0868ea28e26705.text: 完成战役不需要此任务。

9da6c76478402b389b7a67e9753b1786b1bc626a.source: Completing Augury Rock brings you here.
9da6c76478402b389b7a67e9753b1786b1bc626a.text: 完成占卜岩后你就会来到这里。

67c8f3e1dcbe0e4ba0535e520915610403d2a8b0.source: Gain audience with the prophet Glint.

6f5e01bbc8290d5a107289d072085ac4ad2d59f2.source: To reach Glint, you must pass through six chambers, each representing one of the core professions. Four of these rooms have a global environmental effects to hinder players from reaching the Facet at the opposite end of the chamber. Each Facet represents one profession, and when defeated opens a portal to the next chamber. The order of the chambers is always the same. The portal to the first Facet's chamber is opened after a player talks with the Forgotten Gate Keeper.
6f5e01bbc8290d5a107289d072085ac4ad2d59f2.text: 要到达格林特，你必须穿过六个房间，每个房间代表一种核心职业。其中四个房间具有全局环境影响，阻碍玩家到达房间另一端的 Facet。每个方面代表一种职业，当被击败时，会打开通往下一个房间的门户。腔室的顺序始终相同。玩家与被遗忘的门卫交谈后，第一个分面房间的传送门就会打开。

3522b5ad2387325c4e0d0432b520b4392eb70dc8.source: Note: Each gate has a brief cinematic that shows your party being teleported. Most people skip these, but be warned: the last cinematic also contains your conversation with Glint. If you wish to see this conversation do not skip the teleportation cinematic after the Facet of Strength.
3522b5ad2387325c4e0d0432b520b4392eb70dc8.text: 注意：每个门都有一个简短的动画，显示您的队伍被传送。大多数人都会跳过这些，但请注意：最后一部电影还包含您与格林特的对话。如果您想观看这段对话，请不要跳过力量方面之后的传送动画。

7fa2e4ae3631a65bbdba10512dc01b99e82e3bfc.source: Domain of Health Draining - While you are in this area you suffer from -3 Health degeneration.
7fa2e4ae3631a65bbdba10512dc01b99e82e3bfc.text: 健康消耗领域 - 当您处于该区域时，您会遭受 -3 健康恶化。

bd5159589b841bbb6e2ad201d480ee58ec9d3c14.source: As a result of the environmental effect healers will be constantly active, and group-healing spells such as Heal Party are helpful to combat the effect. Luckily, the foes you face in this room are not difficult. As with the desert missions, Forgotten Sages should be the priority target. You'll also fight Enchanted Sword and Hammer pairs. Typically, players follow the western edge of the room, sometimes avoiding a few foes. Try to kill off the groups before engaging the Facet of Light boss. It uses Shield of Regeneration and Guardian as its primary defense. Enchantment removal, knock down or simply overwhelming damage per second should kill it quickly, opening the portal to the next room. Before the slope down towards the Facet's chamber, there is a small area where the Domain of Health Draining does not work. This might be used to prepare and regenerate.
bd5159589b841bbb6e2ad201d480ee58ec9d3c14.text: 由于环境影响，治疗者将持续活跃，而诸如治愈派对之类的团体治疗法术有助于对抗这种影响。幸运的是，你在这个房间里面对的敌人并不困难。与沙漠任务一样，被遗忘的贤者应该是优先目标。您还将与魔法剑和魔法锤对战。通常，玩家会沿着房间的西边移动，有时会避开一些敌人。在与光之面 Boss 交战之前，尝试消灭这些队伍。它使用再生之盾和守护者作为主要防御。结界移除、击倒或者只是每秒压倒性的伤害应该会很快杀死它，打开通往下一个房间的传送门。在通往小面室的斜坡之前，有一小块区域的生命吸取领域不起作用。这可用于准备和再生。

e90802cc5ccf2fb8d3cf9abb99efb566297adcff.source: Domain of Slow - While you are in this area your movement is slowed.
e90802cc5ccf2fb8d3cf9abb99efb566297adcff.text: 缓慢领域 - 当您处于该区域时，您的移动速度会减慢。

acefae385e023a8d53812f7a35f59244de82f3e7.source: In this room, you'll fight numerous Enchanted Bows, many of which start up on ledges. However, a long/flatbow shot usually will cause them to run around to lower ground. Again, it is common for players to hug the left wall when going through this room to attempt to avoid a group or two. The Facet of Nature uses Melandru's Resilience, so either avoid using weak hexes/conditions or have a player prepared with a stance removing skill (which is useful to bring along for the bonus anyway).
acefae385e023a8d53812f7a35f59244de82f3e7.text: 在这个房间里，你将与许多魔法弓战斗，其中许多是在壁架上开始的。然而，长弓/扁弓射击通常会导致他们跑到较低的地面。同样，玩家在穿过这个房间时通常会紧贴左墙以试图避开一两个人。自然的侧面使用梅兰德鲁的弹性，因此要么避免使用弱的六角形/条件，要么让玩家准备好姿势移除技能（无论如何，携带该技能对于获得奖励很有用）。

49f463262beccdd3eb9a40f1d04fc3e5596e2243.source: This room has no environmental effect. Instead, you'll fight swarms of Crystal Spiders, with Forgotten Illusionists backing them up. The spiders spam Shatter Enchantment and Hex Breaker, so be wary of hex and enchantment usage. Some of the Illusionists hide behind solid crystal walls that do not hinder their indirect spells, but which shield them from melee and projectile assault. As such, a few strong indirect spells of your own are useful here, but be sure to watch out for their Chaos Storm. It's worth taking the time to destroy them with spells before engaging new groups of spiders, because together these opponents can present a tough battle, especially in hard mode. The back of the room has a twisted path leading to the Facet of Chaos. Pairs of Illusionists will cast across the low walls of the path, but projectile attacks can reach them.
49f463262beccdd3eb9a40f1d04fc3e5596e2243.text: 该房间对环境没有影响。相反，你将与成群的水晶蜘蛛作战，并有被遗忘的幻术师作为后盾。蜘蛛会垃圾邮件粉碎结界和十六进制破坏者，所以要小心十六进制和结界的使用。一些幻术师隐藏在坚固的水晶墙后面，这不会妨碍他们的间接法术，但可以保护他们免受近战和投射物攻击。因此，你自己的一些强大的间接法术在这里很有用，但一定要小心他们的混沌风暴。在与新的蜘蛛群交战之前，值得花时间用法术消灭它们，因为这些对手在一起可以带来一场艰苦的战斗，尤其是在困难模式下。房间的后面有一条通往混沌面的扭曲路径。成对的幻术师会穿过道路的矮墙施法，但投射物攻击可以到达他们。

ded091c67a8e08253e018e11f9b2e1f2e53fbdcd.source: Domain of Energy Draining - While you are in this area you suffer from -1 Energy degeneration.
ded091c67a8e08253e018e11f9b2e1f2e53fbdcd.text: 能量消耗领域 - 当您处于该区域时，您会遭受 -1 能量衰退。

7fbcda7e1551fa0b2bc9f2e6a8157b7d138e1b23.source: In addition to the environmental effect, both allies and foes alike are kept enchanted under a low powered Death Nova that deals 26 damage and poisons for 15 seconds. The Rock-Eater Scarabs like to use Frenzy, and die easily because of it. If many die at once, the damage from the Death Novas can add up quickly. Also, Forgotten Cursebearers will use the corpses to heal, but they shouldn't pose much of a threat. Thanks to the constant Death Nova, minion armies can make this room very quick. The Facet of Darkness at the back is quite easy.
7fbcda7e1551fa0b2bc9f2e6a8157b7d138e1b23.text: 除了环境效果之外，盟友和敌人都会在低能量死亡新星的作用下保持着魔状态，造成 26 点伤害和毒素，持续 15 秒。食岩圣甲虫喜欢使用狂乱，因此很容易死亡。如果许多人同时死亡，死亡新星造成的伤害会迅速增加。此外，被遗忘的咒使者会使用尸体来治疗，但他们不应该构成太大的威胁。由于不断的死亡新星，小兵军队可以很快地占领这个房间。后面的黑暗面很容易。

de6899fe22f5e2ca2614e755eb36ad4b740654bc.source: Domain of Elements - While you are in this area you are the target of chaotic natural forces, specifically environmental versions of Fire Storm, Maelstrom, Chain Lightning and Eruption
de6899fe22f5e2ca2614e755eb36ad4b740654bc.text: 元素领域 - 当你在这个区域时，你是混乱自然力量的目标，特别是火焰风暴、大漩涡、连锁闪电和喷发的环境版本

c406bd23a6a97c22dcc8be3ddd5619798e2d898d.source: The environmental effects in this room are limited to inside the wards throughout the area. Try not to stand in these wards while fighting. Crystal Guardians guard the halls here and carry a nasty Shock/Aftershock combo. Luckily, they rarely use the combo in the correct sequence. Forgotten Arcanists will often be in side rooms, intercepting players in the main corridor as they pass by. Defeat the Facet of Elements at the back to proceed to the last Facet.
c406bd23a6a97c22dcc8be3ddd5619798e2d898d.text: 该房间的环境影响仅限于整个区域的病房内部。战斗时尽量不要站在这些守卫中。水晶守护者守卫着这里的大厅，并携带令人讨厌的震击/余震组合。幸运的是，他们很少以正确的顺序使用组合。被遗忘的奥术师通常会出现在侧室中，在主走廊上拦截经过的玩家。击败后面的元素面，进入最后一个面。

699141e46246dfa218b46706a0d6ad685f38c5db.source: Every 25 seconds, all players are knocked down for 5 seconds. Skills such as "I Am Unstoppable!", "Don't Trip!", Ward of Stability, Balanced Stance and Dolyak Signet will prevent the knock down. Your foes are mostly Sword/Hammer pairs, although you may run into groups with a Crystal Spider and Crystal Guardian. Kill the Guardians first, as Aftershock is more likely to deal its extra damage while the healers are helpless on the ground; this is especially true in Hard Mode. Defeat the Facet of Strength to finally meet Glint.
699141e46246dfa218b46706a0d6ad685f38c5db.text: 每 25 秒，所有玩家都会被击倒 5 秒。 “我势不可挡！”、“别绊倒！”、稳定结界、平衡姿态和多利亚克徽记等技能将防止被击倒。你的敌人大多是剑/锤对，尽管你可能会遇到水晶蜘蛛和水晶守护者的群体。首先杀死守护者，因为余震更有可能造成额外伤害，而治疗者在地面上无能为力；在困难模式下尤其如此。击败力量之面，最终见到格林特。

0c972d598c0a7d5255dc44d308daef00a74d3843.source: To gain the bonus you need to defeat Glint. Instead of using the portal opened during the cinematic, pick up one of her Dragon Eggs and she will turn hostile. This bonus is unique in that even if the entire party wipes while attempting it, they will still receive credit for the mission and continue to Droknar's Forge.
0c972d598c0a7d5255dc44d308daef00a74d3843.text: 要获得奖金，您需要击败格林特。不要使用电影中打开的传送门，而是拿起她的一颗龙蛋，她就会变得敌对。这个奖励的独特之处在于，即使整个队伍在尝试时被消灭，他们仍然会获得任务的积分并继续前往卓克纳尔的熔炉。

5ff355865d0e58646c1f1e8034ae9cc40703c546.source: Since Glint is friendly until the eggs are touched, set up traps and spirits before she turns hostile.
5ff355865d0e58646c1f1e8034ae9cc40703c546.text: 由于格林特在接触鸡蛋之前都是友好的，因此请在她变得敌对之前设置陷阱和灵魂。

48873cf40f73a7e43a60667a0bf700e4ab69af46.source: Crystal Haze - An AoE hex that can render casters useless, spread before the battle. Revealed Hex/Inspired Hex are optimal counters as with all monster skill hexes, they are not replaced and recharge instantly. For those using henchmen/heroes, set the heroes to avoid combat and block healing skills for the duration of this dangerous hex.
48873cf40f73a7e43a60667a0bf700e4ab69af46.text: 水晶雾霾 - 一种可以使施法者变得无用的 AoE 六角形，在战斗前传播。与所有怪物技能十六进制一样，显露十六进制/启发十六进制是最佳计数器，它们不会被替换并立即充电。对于那些使用追随者/英雄的人，请设置英雄在这个危险的六角形期间避免战斗并阻止治疗技能。

e870e43558f8ab0dbd453474b3c49ac787dc8d3c.source: Jagged Crystal Skin - A stance that causes massive damage to melee attackers since it triggers on physical damage. Use elemental weapons, or skills that convert your damage types e.g.: Judge's Insight, Heart of Holy Flame and/or Greater Conflagration to negate its effects.
e870e43558f8ab0dbd453474b3c49ac787dc8d3c.text: 锯齿状水晶皮肤 - 这种姿势会对近战攻击者造成巨大伤害，因为它会在物理伤害时触发。使用元素武器或技能来转换你的伤害类型，例如：审判者洞察力、圣火之心和/或大火焰来抵消其效果。

706dca073c09dca0f667f8e34f8bf0802c7c870a.source: Crystal Bonds - A hex spell that removes and prevents enchantments to target but doesn't apply to self-enchantments (dervish) nor party wide spells e.g. Aegis. It only inhibits protection monks.
706dca073c09dca0f667f8e34f8bf0802c7c870a.text: 水晶债券 - 一种十六进制法术，可以消除并防止目标结界，但不适用于自我结界（托钵僧）或派对范围的法术，例如宙斯盾。只抑制防护修士。

aceb4d9d5da8e58aa058c2f32165764c5673c27e.source: Crystal Hibernation - Used at half way through the battle. Grants her health regeneration and converts taken damage to heals. But takes five second to activate, leaving it vulnerable to interrupts.
aceb4d9d5da8e58aa058c2f32165764c5673c27e.text: 水晶休眠 - 在战斗进行到一半时使用。使她恢复健康并将受到的伤害转化为治疗效果。但需要五秒钟才能激活，因此很容易受到中断。

3c22f80fdb40df23f8c81bee2b01cb4611d911e0.source: If using henchmen/heroes, avoid melee characters since they tend to die very fast under the effects of Jagged Crystal Skin. Ranged attacks put less stress on your healers. Flag the non-melee away from the dragon to avoid Jagged Crystal Skin.
3c22f80fdb40df23f8c81bee2b01cb4611d911e0.text: 如果使用追随者/英雄，请避免近战角色，因为他们在锯齿状水晶皮肤的影响下往往会很快死亡。远程攻击可以减轻治疗师的压力。将非近战者标记为远离龙以避免锯齿状水晶皮肤。

28e8faf9a3e4fedc6754ae9ad384a5a7421a1d5c.source: Party wide healing skills such as Heal Party, Protective Was Kaolai or Heaven's Delight.
28e8faf9a3e4fedc6754ae9ad384a5a7421a1d5c.text: 队伍范围内的治疗技能，如治愈队伍、保护性考莱或天堂之悦。

24c04dcc5825c0874d5432d9e738170dba904750.source: Skill interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Cry of Pain or Leech Signet.
24c04dcc5825c0874d5432d9e738170dba904750.text: 技能中断，例如沮丧呐喊、痛苦呐喊或水蛭徽记。

5379e95f0a7284d536d86d49f44ad8a45c2ebb05.source: Stance removal. It is also useful versus the Facets of Nature and Strength as well as removing Jagged Crystal Skin on Glint.
5379e95f0a7284d536d86d49f44ad8a45c2ebb05.text: 立场移除。它对于对抗自然和力量的刻面以及去除闪光上的锯齿状水晶皮肤也很有用。

6aae38f92b4bcf54f3bc3811943f143efa5737b4.source: Spoil Victor - effective due to her high health.
6aae38f92b4bcf54f3bc3811943f143efa5737b4.text: 宠坏维克多 - 由于她的健康状况良好而有效。

e8299cd9095e23da42228a705c72b2ae36e2107d.source: Wastrel's Worry - effective because hexes expire twice as fast, leading to a very high damage rate.
e8299cd9095e23da42228a705c72b2ae36e2107d.text: 废物之忧 - 有效，因为六角形的失效速度是原来的两倍，导致极高的伤害率。

383eb21f606af703591995b4b1dbea37877e7390.source: Pain Inverter - particularly effective versus Jagged Crystal Skin. Also useful against Crystal Guardians due to their AoE damage.
383eb21f606af703591995b4b1dbea37877e7390.text: 疼痛逆变器 - 对锯齿状水晶皮肤特别有效。由于水晶守卫的 AoE 伤害，对它们也很有用。

45729b61203bc7e94905accafedf42ea6aab2f6e.source: Hex removal such as Inspired Hex or Revealed Hex to counter Crystal Haze. The overcast this hex causes will quickly shut down spellcasters if it is not removed.
45729b61203bc7e94905accafedf42ea6aab2f6e.text: 去除咒语，例如启发咒语或揭示咒语，以对抗水晶雾霾。如果不将其移除，该巫术造成的阴霾将很快使施法者停止活动。

c2dd5f355725232d5dcf9f2416bcc54ab4dc8f8d.source: Two of the Facets have elite skills that cannot be captured anywhere else in Prophecies: Gladiator's Defense and Shield of Regeneration.
c2dd5f355725232d5dcf9f2416bcc54ab4dc8f8d.text: 其中两个方面拥有在预言中其他任何地方都无法获得的精英技能：角斗士的防御和再生之盾。

b0b5ae8fc5786d3741d69e2ef72ffe8d79e51f0c.source: After killing each Facet, a player must cross a portal-like gate that triggers a cinematic. When it concludes, party members are teleported to another enclosed domain within the area, leaving behind miniatures, spirits, allies from summoning stones, and Heroes of players that have left the area or disconnected. Minions are brought along with the party however.
b0b5ae8fc5786d3741d69e2ef72ffe8d79e51f0c.text: 杀死每个 Facet 后，玩家必须穿过一个类似传送门的大门，从而触发过场动画。当它结束时，队伍成员会被传送到该区域内的另一个封闭区域，留下模型、灵魂、召唤石的盟友以及离开该区域或断开连接的玩家的英雄。然而，小黄人是随队伍一起来的。

1d94a65152fef1d28cf406123404830ed01dee9c.source: This mission will be completed after reaching Glint. A final portal will appear, and going through it will take the entire party to Droknar's Forge. Make sure you warn other party members not to cross that portal, if you want to attempt the bonus objective.
1d94a65152fef1d28cf406123404830ed01dee9c.text: 该任务将在到达格林特后完成。最后一个传送门将会出现，通过它，整个队伍将到达卓克纳尔的熔炉。如果您想尝试奖励目标，请确保警告其他党员不要穿过该门户。

32b62d90170ea135c637b82faabafeaa2954a0e3.source: Looking up in the sky towards the center of the area, players will see a crystal pillar with 6 crystal rings around it. They show the progress in the area by changing from crystal rings to rings of light.
32b62d90170ea135c637b82faabafeaa2954a0e3.text: 抬头望向区域中心的天空，玩家会看到一根水晶柱，周围有 6 个水晶环。他们通过从水晶环变为光环来展示该领域的进展。

fb7990f7ce29910459c2b03f37d48499f11c754a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
fb7990f7ce29910459c2b03f37d48499f11c754a.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 12 页。

c1e27844fe068cafd9186068e04b1e24a4fe747a.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Shadow's Passage.
c1e27844fe068cafd9186068e04b1e24a4fe747a.text: 击败暗影通道中的受灾者。

34dd25131622a93c7b3de3a613c7a25b31561943.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Shadow's Passage, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
34dd25131622a93c7b3de3a613c7a25b31561943.text: 完成此任务会改变暗影通道中出现的敌人，具体来说，受苦者将不再生成。

8d8f8078ebec45b9fd57c2170ae81a0762dd1199.source: Start from Dragon's Throat and follow the quest markers and eliminate three groups of Afflicted. Just before the third, a small group of Jade Brotherhood will pop up; they are hostile to the Afflicted, so if you maneuver carefully, they can do some of your work for you.
8d8f8078ebec45b9fd57c2170ae81a0762dd1199.text: 从龙喉开始，按照任务标记消灭三组受折磨者。就在第三个之前，一小群翡翠兄弟会会突然出现；他们对受苦者怀有敌意，所以如果你小心操作，他们可以为你做一些工作。

afe3a6d8c2d0afb403740e64bd3af7865c1100c0.source: Pogahn Passage or Rilohn Refuge mission completed
afe3a6d8c2d0afb403740e64bd3af7865c1100c0.text: 波加恩通道或里洛恩避难所任务已完成

505542d293fc0709308c728c7a76d50adcfcb484.source: Travel through the Bahdok Caverns to escape to Vabbi.
505542d293fc0709308c728c7a76d50adcfcb484.text: 穿过巴多克洞穴逃往瓦比。

91984344fc3b4bc2ca6cea43a9c55e12b7946384.source: ADDED: Defeat Bayel and the Hunger to open the passage to Vabbi.
91984344fc3b4bc2ca6cea43a9c55e12b7946384.text: 添加：击败巴耶尔和饥饿以打开通往瓦比的通道。

96503190ee0eb60a79bc92d0c7a5855ca85fb1d3.text: *奖励*遵循 Dunkoro 的其余建议。

4e118ec4423c0612d469ac45e37090e5378740bb.source: You have followed [0...4] of Dunkoro's 4 remaining suggestions.
4e118ec4423c0612d469ac45e37090e5378740bb.text: 您已遵循 Dunkoro 剩余 4 条建议中的 [0...4] 条。

2ce476bc80dba4ac7df3abe11d14cbc6146f9c4e.source: At the start of the mission you are blocked in by some Corsairs, who claim to be your guides. Eventually their leader, Captain Bohseda, gets a quest marker and you can talk to him. You have two options, either to trust him or to not trust him. If you trust him, he will lead you up the corridor then he and the rest of the Corsairs will turn on the party and you will be ambushed by more Corsairs. If you don't trust him, he and the rest of the Corsairs turn hostile straight away and you can fight them and the ambushing group of Corsairs separately. Otherwise the choice has no impact on the rest of the mission or the bonus.
2ce476bc80dba4ac7df3abe11d14cbc6146f9c4e.text: 在任务开始时，你会被一些自称是你的向导的海盗拦住。最终，他们的领袖博赫塞达队长获得了一个任务标记，你可以与他交谈。你有两个选择，要么信任他，要么不信任他。如果你信任他，他会带领你穿过走廊，然后他和其他海盗将攻击队伍，你将遭到更多海盗的伏击。如果你不信任他，他和其他海盗会立即转为敌对，你可以分别与他们和伏击的海盗团作战。否则，该选择不会影响任务的其余部分或奖金。

613046f679b18ec6022dcb8bc0d66cc134b989cd.source: If you choose to ignore Dunkoro, the mission is pretty straight-forward. From the area where you kill the ambushing Corsairs there are two exits which head to the north. Head up the one which will take you west, you'll meet a group of Corsairs coming down. Follow the river here until you get to an open area and follow the wall running perpendicular to the river, that is, turn right. After following this you'll come to another exit to the right. Walk into this area. You should see two Corsair Runners. Head up to where they are and follow the runner which goes straight north - the one that doesn't run through the insects. Additional Corsairs will arrive. Continue the way the Corsair was running after finishing this group and follow the path as it goes downwards.
613046f679b18ec6022dcb8bc0d66cc134b989cd.text: 如果你选择忽略邓科罗，任务就非常简单。从你杀死伏击的海盗的区域有两个通向北方的出口。前往将带您向西的那条船，您会遇到一群海盗正在降落。沿着这里的河流，直到到达一片空旷的地方，沿着垂直于河流的墙走，即右转。沿着这条路走后，您将到达右侧的另一个出口。走进这个区域。您应该看到两个 Corsair Runner。前往它们所在的地方，跟随直接向北的跑步者——不会穿过昆虫的跑步者。更多海盗将会抵达。完成这组任务后，继续沿着海盗船的路线行驶，并沿着它向下的路径行驶。

54131aa5a2ed1394337228bb4ba1a24af3ec2dda.source: You will come to where the Kournan forces are. General Bayel and the Hunger are on the other side of a narrow bridge which is well protected by several Kournan Bowman with an excellent height advantage and are difficult for melee party members to get to. Rather than trying to eliminate the Kournan Bowmen from the bridge, run right under the bridge and use it to shelter the party from the bow attacks. You can now either use non-projectile skills to kill the Kournan Bowmen or ignore them and make sure that any melee party members are protected while they attack in the open. The simplest option is to stay under the bridge with the Kournan Bowmen above you and hence obstructed. It is possible to aggro only General Bayel from a set position under the bridge. It will take some time, but if you're not too focused on melee damage, you should be able to take him out and safely pull the Hunger towards you. Kill both General Bayel and then the Hunger to end the mission. Alternatively if you run across the second bridge, past both General Bayel and the Hunger, the Hunger will follow your party to almost across the bridge. Attack him near the end of the second bridge and you will be fighting him alone. If he starts to almost die, he will try to go back to General Bayel. If you cripple him, you should be able to kill him before the General has the chance to heal him.
54131aa5a2ed1394337228bb4ba1a24af3ec2dda.text: 你会来到库南部队所在的地方。巴耶尔将军和饥饿者在一座窄桥的另一边，桥上有几名库南弓箭手保护得很好，具有极好的高度优势，近战党员很难到达。不要试图从桥上消灭库南弓箭手，而是直接跑到桥下并用它来保护队伍免受弓箭攻击。现在，您可以使用非投射技能杀死库南弓箭手，也可以忽略他们并确保任何近战队员在公开攻击时受到保护。最简单的选择是呆在桥下，库南弓箭手在你上方，因此受到阻碍。可以从桥下的固定位置仅攻击巴耶尔将军。这需要一些时间，但如果你不太关注近战伤害，你应该能够干掉他并安全地将饥饿拉向你。杀死巴耶尔将军和饥饿来结束任务。或者，如果你跑过第二座桥，经过巴耶尔将军和饥饿，饥饿将跟随你的队伍几乎穿过桥。在第二座桥的尽头攻击他，你将独自对抗他。如果他快要死了，他会尝试回到巴耶尔将军身边。如果你削弱了他，你应该能够在将军有机会治愈他之前杀死他。

f8a1cd978da6ce32795b77bf2321eda985ab73c5.source: The bonus is to follow the advice that Dunkoro offers at various points through the mission. There are 4 suggestions, the notification of which sometimes comes quite late and the update of the success of the objective is sometimes a long way after you followed the suggestion.
f8a1cd978da6ce32795b77bf2321eda985ab73c5.text: 好处是遵循 Dunkoro 在任务中各个阶段提供的建议。有 4 条建议，有时通知会来得很晚，而目标成功的更新有时会在您遵循建议之后很久才通知。

ead15ab174b40db67a35a482e3581ac50a667b57.source: Head towards (1) on the map and you will see a path leading up with Mandragors patrolling down. After reaching the path Dunkoro will suggest you go to the western exit. Do not walk on the path at all as this can mean the failure of the objective, this applies to minions, heroes and henchmen. If the Mandragors are patrolling down when you reach the path, wait for them to make it to the water before engaging them to ensure safety of this bonus. The success of this suggestion is often confirmed when you reach the waterfall. You do not have to actually hear this suggestion to get credit for it, so feel free to simply head past the waterfall to begin with; however, if the suggestion does not update, you may have to go back over to the path to get Dunkoro to suggest anyway, just flag your party under the waterfall and go and get the suggestion yourself to risk no mistakes.
ead15ab174b40db67a35a482e3581ac50a667b57.text: 朝地图上的 (1) 方向走，你会看到一条通向上方的小路，曼陀罗在下方巡逻。到达小路后，Dunkoro 会建议您前往西出口。根本不要走在这条路上，因为这可能意味着目标的失败，这适用于小兵、英雄和追随者。如果当你到达路径时曼陀罗正在巡逻，请等待它们到达水中后再与它们交战，以确保此奖励的安全。当你到达瀑布时，往往会证实这个建议的成功。您不必真正听到这个建议才能获得认可，所以请随意简单地从瀑布开始；然而，如果建议没有更新，你可能必须返回到让 Dunkoro 提出建议的路径，只需在瀑布下标记你的队伍，然后自己去获取建议，以免出错。

ca0124fc353c223ee4f0982f2db6b84f5847ad54.source: As you pass the waterfall and head up the western entrance, Corsairs at the top of the hill will begin patrolling toward you. Part way up the slope, Dunkoro will suggest you hide your presence from this group by falling back to the spot near the waterfall. It is best actually not to wait for this suggestion, because it can put you in an awkward situation. Kill Mandragor groups at the bottom of the waterfall before approaching the path. Station your party at the bottom of the waterfall and send one member on the path. As soon as this party member starts on the path, the Corsairs will start toward you, so you can move back to a safe distance without risking walking up the path.
ca0124fc353c223ee4f0982f2db6b84f5847ad54.text: 当您经过瀑布并前往西入口时，山顶的海盗将开始向您巡逻。在爬上斜坡的途中，邓科罗会建议你退回到瀑布附近的地方，以躲避这群人。实际上最好不要等待这个建议，因为它会让你陷入尴尬的境地。在接近小路之前，先杀死瀑布底部的曼德拉戈群体。将你的队伍驻扎在瀑布底部，并派一名成员走在路上。一旦该队员开始走上这条路，海盗就会开始向你驶来，这样你就可以回到安全距离，而不必冒险走上这条路。

32aba4f3ff1761d197f5587573f7216a11c23fbe.source: The Corsairs will continue patrolling north and east. Sneak back unnoticed onto the western path to get credit for the suggestion. Keep in mind you will only be notified of your success after you complete the third suggestion. Also, if henchmen and heroes are caught by the Corsairs you won't be able to obtain this objective. When running back to the path, with only henchmen and heroes, disable any spirits and flag them to the top of the path so they won't stop with the Toxicity spirit in aggro range - they may attack it. If there are minions in your party, wait for the spirit to expire and die before starting suggestion two.
32aba4f3ff1761d197f5587573f7216a11c23fbe.text: 海盗船将继续在北部和东部巡逻。不被注意地偷偷溜回西边的小路上，以获得建议的荣誉。请记住，只有在完成第三个建议后，您才会收到成功通知。此外，如果追随者和英雄被海盗抓住，你将无法实现此目标。当跑回路径时，只有追随者和英雄，禁用任何灵魂并将它们标记到路径的顶部，这样它们就不会在仇恨范围内停止与毒性灵魂 - 他们可能会攻击它。如果你的队伍中有小兵，请等待灵魂耗尽并死亡后再开始建议二。

2f54ca74d933c34f5312b381fca50d5e35bcef7a.source: It should be noted that attacking the Spirit of Toxicity, and subsequently aggroing the group of Corsairs does not fail this second suggestion, if they are aggroed after they reach the water. In Hard mode, it is often impossible not to aggro this spirit, especially with minions. Because you do not get credit for this achievement for a little while, it is easy to assume failure, when the party has not actually failed.
2f54ca74d933c34f5312b381fca50d5e35bcef7a.text: 需要注意的是，攻击剧毒之灵，然后攻击这群海盗，如果他们到达水中后被攻击的话，这并不会导致第二个建议失败。在困难模式下，通常不可能不激怒这种精神，尤其是对于小兵来说。因为你暂时不会因为这一成就而获得荣誉，所以当一方实际上并没有失败时，很容易假设失败。

fca87f7ff2e40813bf09ac7da9ec4dd8cdf34384.source: Dunkoro suggests you follow the eastern wall to keep away from the Corsair camps. As this is the most efficient route through, this shouldn't be a problem. You will receive credit for this suggestion (along with credit for the previous one) when you reach the area where the next one is triggered. Do not continue following the eastern wall past the point where you need to pursue the runners or you will fail the bonus.
fca87f7ff2e40813bf09ac7da9ec4dd8cdf34384.text: 邓科罗建议你沿着东墙走，远离海盗营地。由于这是最有效的路线，因此这应该不成问题。当您到达触发下一个建议的区域时，您将获得此建议的积分（以及上一个建议的积分）。不要继续沿着东墙越过你需要追赶跑步者的点，否则你将无法获得奖励。

68f76e6d8e6c132581f787f150f547f6d86bee81.source: The last suggestion is the most difficult to complete. Dunkoro suggests that you stop the Corsair Runners from warning the Corsairs that you are coming. There are two Corsair Runners and true to their name, once you get close enough they run... in different directions. The fourth suggestion has a short delay before triggering - it follows the notification that you have completed the previous three. Don't wait for this, because by this time the Corsairs will be already on the move.
68f76e6d8e6c132581f787f150f547f6d86bee81.text: 最后一个建议是最难完成的。邓科罗建议你阻止海盗行军警告海盗你即将到来。有两个海盗船奔跑者，正如他们的名字一样，一旦你足够接近，他们就会跑向不同的方向。第四个建议在触发前有短暂的延迟 - 它遵循您已完成前三个建议的通知。不要等这个，因为这个时候海盗们已经开始行动了。

9da5fd14518590e9fae76a8ad32b051d6648b5b9.source: If possible split and take on both runners at once. Use snares and speed boosts to make sure you can kill them before they reach their destination. By inflicting conditions on the Corsair Runners, you can cause them to stop running for a moment to activate Antidote Signet.
9da5fd14518590e9fae76a8ad32b051d6648b5b9.text: 如果可能的话，分开并同时与两名参赛者较量。使用陷阱和速度提升来确保你可以在他们到达目的地之前杀死他们。通过对海盗船奔跑者施加条件，你可以让他们停止奔跑一段时间以激活解药徽记。

47eb60d04aafb75841de217d35ca801fe5eb7df9.source: The runners take a few seconds to start moving which you could use to your advantage. If you are playing with heroes, lock them on the runner which is closest to you before you reach the open area where they stand. Then proceed forward to attack the other one, starting with a snare. The heroes will probably kill the first runner even before it has a chance to start moving. The henchmen will follow you and help you kill the one you snared.
47eb60d04aafb75841de217d35ca801fe5eb7df9.text: 跑步者需要几秒钟的时间才能开始移动，您可以利用这一优势。如果您正在与英雄一起玩，请在到达他们所在的开放区域之前将他们锁定在离您最近的跑步者身上。然后继续向前攻击另一只，从陷阱开始。英雄们可能会在第一个奔跑者有机会开始移动之前就杀死它。追随者会跟随你并帮助你杀死你捕获的人。

844b1292bfa455a52550526f6243a8c9fd485380.source: Once the last suggestion is completed continue on and finish the mission.
844b1292bfa455a52550526f6243a8c9fd485380.text: 一旦最后的建议完成，继续并完成任务。

b12265962a2b51b3fb40aa3fff86b03e8bdcef56.source: The above tactics work just as well in Hard mode as in normal. The runners at suggestion 4 are tougher due to them running faster, and more powerful snares such as Mind Freeze may be needed in addition to other snares. In addition, the Kournan Bowmen at the end of the mission may be difficult to fight because of their increased damage output. The tactic of sheltering under the bridge is recommended.
b12265962a2b51b3fb40aa3fff86b03e8bdcef56.text: 上述策略在困难模式下和正常模式下一样有效。建议 4 中的跑步者由于跑得更快而更强硬，除了其他圈套之外，可能还需要更强大的圈套，例如心灵冻结。此外，任务结束时的库南弓箭手可能会因为伤害输出增加而难以战斗。建议采用桥下躲避的策略。

698e0883ba83071728f710153b4eaa0dd36ed9b5.source: Alternatively, if using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them directly under the bridge. The bridge will obstruct the Kournan Bowmen while allowing you to attack the Hunger.
698e0883ba83071728f710153b4eaa0dd36ed9b5.text: 或者，如果使用英雄和/或追随者，请将他们直接标记在桥下。这座桥会阻碍库南弓箭手，同时让你可以攻击饥饿。

e9584b36f7959d6f5609195f3535919130565b72.source: Several members of the party should bring snares (such as "You Move Like a Dwarf!", Tryptophan Signet, Summon Ice Imp, Deep Freeze, Ethereal Burden/Kitah's Burden, and Imagined Burden) or other methods to slow the Corsair Runners, unless one party member brings a build specifically for it.
e9584b36f7959d6f5609195f3535919130565b72.text: 队伍中的几名成员应该携带圈套（例如“你像矮人一样移动！”、色氨酸印记、召唤冰小鬼、深度冻结、空灵负担/基塔的负担和想象的负担）或其他方法来减缓海盗船奔跑者的速度，除非一名队伍成员专门为其带来了构建。

83afd72c284db7ef58687dce657a3126312e152e.text: 类似圈套的策略也很有效：

30665541ba65c79eb98c38790d03a836dbfeae5a.source: Conditions work as snares here, because the runners stop running to activate Antidote Signet. If inflicting cripple, interrupt Antidote Signet to prevent it from being removed.
30665541ba65c79eb98c38790d03a836dbfeae5a.text: 这里的条件就像圈套一样，因为跑步者停止跑步以激活解药徽记。如果造成残废，请打断解药徽记以防止其被移除。

da92ea20a73d4b91ef7187685000e82acef0f4ca.source: Skills which cause knock down are also very effective against the runners (such as "You Move Like a Dwarf!", which can also snare the runner).
da92ea20a73d4b91ef7187685000e82acef0f4ca.text: 导致击倒的技能对逃跑者也非常有效（例如“你像矮人一样移动！”，这也可以诱捕逃跑者）。

e7a7377388ec3c2e4f7aad1c882b551419313317.source: Assassins bringing Spike builds using Shadow Prison together with Skills such as Iron Palm, Black Mantis Thrust can quickly shadowstep to the Runners and burst them down.
e7a7377388ec3c2e4f7aad1c882b551419313317.text: 刺客使用暗影监狱和铁掌、黑螳螂突刺等技能将斯派克构建起来，可以快速暗影步攻击奔跑者并击倒他们。

d4ac73dbe5e12097583312186107823a9b4e3a55.source: Bringing skills which boost speed can also be useful.
d4ac73dbe5e12097583312186107823a9b4e3a55.text: 带来提高速度的技能也很有用。

fa3d68f39a42ac98f7c9c18e763ecfab502704a3.source: Ranged attacks and skills can be useful in taking down the runners and during the fight against General Bayel and the Hunger if you take refuge under the bridge to hide from the Kournan Bowmen.
fa3d68f39a42ac98f7c9c18e763ecfab502704a3.text: 如果您躲在桥下躲避库南弓箭手，那么远程攻击和技能对于击倒逃跑者以及对抗巴耶尔将军和饥饿者来说非常有用。

81fe15b6e0d5834dfa3a1987bda86ea07f2fada6.source: A Mesmer with Clumsiness and Wandering Eye will make short work of both the Kournan Bowmen on the bridge and the Hunger.
81fe15b6e0d5834dfa3a1987bda86ea07f2fada6.text: 具有笨拙和游移之眼的幻术师将很快解决桥上的库南弓箭手和饥饿者。

b0bc549d7008f87cd7d4c647222a49d84aa46d47.source: Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party members do not have signets or enchantments equipped. The only hex spells you will encounter are Rust (Corsair Wind Master), Defender's Zeal and Scourge Enchantment (General Bayel).
b0bc549d7008f87cd7d4c647222a49d84aa46d47.text: 如果你的队伍成员没有装备图章或结界，则不需要去除六角形技能。你会遇到的唯一十六进制法术是锈（海盗风大师）、防御者的热忱和天灾附魔（巴耶尔将军）。

4163d8e1adac6b1d98f9f007801d8edf249c60cc.source: As with any underground location, the area is represented on the world map with a slightly larger, inset version of the mission map.
4163d8e1adac6b1d98f9f007801d8edf249c60cc.text: 与任何地下地点一样，该区域在世界地图上以稍大的插入版本的任务地图表示。

7505febe50565d980c45a32acd0c7fc8f28594fc.source: You can use Return on the friendly Corsairs at the beginning, allowing you to shadow step towards your original spawning location after being betrayed.
7505febe50565d980c45a32acd0c7fc8f28594fc.text: 你可以在开始时使用返回友好的海盗，让你在被背叛后可以向原来的生成位置移动。

db389991f9b5724b045938ff078033aa5cbba8be.source: If you are going for the bonus don't kill any of the insect bosses. Even if you have already achieved all 4 suggestions, the game mechanics will "think" that you haven't followed the first suggestion and all the work you've done will be lost.
db389991f9b5724b045938ff078033aa5cbba8be.text: 如果你想获得奖金，请不要杀死任何昆虫首领。即使您已经实现了所有 4 个建议，游戏机制也会“认为”您没有遵循第一个建议，并且您所做的所有工作都将丢失。

33e95261edbb2b9a7b2223f9992f5bc477a224e2.source: You cannot capture any of General Bayel's skills during the mission; he is not considered a boss.
33e95261edbb2b9a7b2223f9992f5bc477a224e2.text: 任务期间你无法捕获巴耶尔将军的任何技能；他不被视为老板。

b16213bfa31bc1c84f23d46fe1a5fa7a395e4dc8.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Wehhan Terraces.
b16213bfa31bc1c84f23d46fe1a5fa7a395e4dc8.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被传送到维汉梯田。

abc813f09d3c6a772b9e97c8499239517a63eed9.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #6 in the Night Falls storybook.
abc813f09d3c6a772b9e97c8499239517a63eed9.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 6 页。

3ff8a75f725077fe3c29e30d5502de0e7d2cb78e.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Shenzun Tunnels.
3ff8a75f725077fe3c29e30d5502de0e7d2cb78e.text: 击败神尊隧道中的受苦者。

4d0bea96f360cd872f39c23da02c45a023caad2e.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Shenzun Tunnels, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
4d0bea96f360cd872f39c23da02c45a023caad2e.text: 完成此任务会改变出现在神尊隧道中的敌人，特别是，受苦者将不再生成。

0d14564579330a6863d2e544e4a4881f2c87d8fb.source: Leave from either Maatu Keep or Sunjiang District (outpost) and follow the starburst towards the center of the map (north from Maatu, west from Sunjiang). Choosing Maatu Keep will mean that you will end up fighting Rai Zhon the Manipulator, whilst the selection of Sunjiang District means that you will fight 3 mobs instead of 2 en route to the quest marker, but don't have to face any bosses provided that you hug the wall when passing by Xi Lin of the Flames.
0d14564579330a6863d2e544e4a4881f2c87d8fb.text: 从马图城堡或孙江区（前哨站）出发，沿着星芒走向地图中心（马图以北，孙江以西）。选择马图要塞意味着你最终将与操纵者雷忠战斗，而选择孙江区意味着你在前往任务标记的途中将与3个小怪而不是2个小怪战斗，但只要你在经过火焰的西林时紧贴墙壁，就不必面对任何老板。

6fb62898f7e479bec4a105fdb867ca85fcd41e64.source: At the starburst you will meet the five Initiates and the dialogue will begin. After the first bit of dialogue, groups of Afflicted will head towards where the starbust now is - within the middle of sewage water, just north of the initiates. From here you can take multiple actions:
6fb62898f7e479bec4a105fdb867ca85fcd41e64.text: 在星爆时，您将遇到五位入门者，对话将开始。在第一段对话之后，一群受折磨的人将前往现在星象所在的地方——污水中间，就在起始者的北边。从这里您可以执行多项操作：

ec2f8ed54ae0f0707dafa377fe99dcef7e6b2d14.source: Head west to where the first group will come from and kill the groups from this area first. From here, they will come one right after the other from two directions and it is easy to avoid half of the mobs. After killing the waves that come from the west, you can head back to the center and pull those that remain away.
ec2f8ed54ae0f0707dafa377fe99dcef7e6b2d14.text: 向西前往第一支队伍的来源地并首先杀死来自该地区的队伍。从这里开始，他们会从两个方向一前一后而来，很容易就能避开一半的小怪。在消灭了来自西方的海浪后，你可以回到中心并把剩下的海浪拉开。

4545db6eb654867475bfa7e10a712c17d32451f9.source: You can retreat to the way you came from and deal with fewer groups and more pulling up a closer ramp, allowing better ranged damage. After four or so groups approach down the other ramps, a group will turn up behind you.
4545db6eb654867475bfa7e10a712c17d32451f9.text: 你可以退回原来的路，对付更少的队伍和更多的人，拉上更近的坡道，允许更大的范围伤害。当大约四组人走下其他坡道后，一组人会出现在您身后。

427d32169eb05752d9e752fab938f5f8711c8afc.source: Stay in the middle and brace yourself. Doing this will most likely end in a wipe, but you won't fail the quest and can simply return to the spot to finish what remains.
427d32169eb05752d9e752fab938f5f8711c8afc.text: 留在中间并做好准备。这样做很可能会导致任务失败，但你不会失败任务，只需返回该地点即可完成剩下的任务。

befeb156c9095275b08d4e2a7be8e1c422ea2e90.source: After killing the waves, the party leader character will state that there's one more group left - this group will pop up in the center of the sewage water. Killing them will complete the quest.
befeb156c9095275b08d4e2a7be8e1c422ea2e90.text: 消灭波浪后，党魁角色会说还剩下一组 - 该组将出现在污水中心。杀死他们即可完成任务。

47590afedce3f750a1f00a6a50780eef17d910d4.source: Killing the last group of Afflicted will complete the quest even if foes from previous groups remain.
47590afedce3f750a1f00a6a50780eef17d910d4.text: 即使之前的敌人仍然存在，杀死最后一批受折磨者也会完成任务。

84737e5895b6164ea4d27c4ea35bc2f0848e28ba.source: Among your allies, only Zei Ri self-resurrects (the other remain dead once they lose all their health once).
84737e5895b6164ea4d27c4ea35bc2f0848e28ba.text: 在你的盟友中，只有泽里会自我复活（其他人一旦失去所有生命值就会保持死亡状态）。

785461a788e6a4aad836fa1887370e4436d293c9.source: If Zei Ri fails to resurrect after a death, you will be unable to complete the quest; you must rezone and start over.
785461a788e6a4aad836fa1887370e4436d293c9.text: 如果泽里死后无法复活，你将无法完成任务；你必须重新分区并重新开始。

685fa46ab82ee40ce24ed716ee667d69bfa5282d.source: The final wave of Afflicted can spawn even if there are foes remaining from previous waves. If this happens, you need only defeat the final group to receive credit for quest completion.
685fa46ab82ee40ce24ed716ee667d69bfa5282d.text: 即使前一波中还剩下敌人，最后一波受折磨者也会生成。如果发生这种情况，您只需击败最后一组即可获得完成任务的积分。

5feeefc5738e4e4216ad40cee10abaa26eb93ff6.source: Speak with Onar Ironblood Missing a period

42974975980825f3aafbc33d6d368b4aa90fc900.source: See Blade Scout Shelby for your reward.
42974975980825f3aafbc33d6d368b4aa90fc900.text: 前往刀锋侦察兵谢尔比处领取奖励。

42d7e7038f329b61e9f7a15505e0828c96c5dc7d.source: While following the quest marker, the player will come across Korg Snowfoot. Korg will be attacked by Stone Summit dwarves as soon as he is in range. If he survives, speak to him to complete part of the quest (it remains completed as long as the player does not zone out of the area, or until the next objective is completed).
42d7e7038f329b61e9f7a15505e0828c96c5dc7d.text: 在跟随任务标记时，玩家会遇到科格·雪足。库格一进入射程就会受到石峰矮人的攻击。如果他幸存下来，与他交谈以完成部分任务（只要玩家不离开该区域，或者直到完成下一个目标，任务就会保持完成）。

05a5a5226a4bbdc88eaaa5a5d23b0216f3872316.source: Follow the new quest marker to locate and speak with Onar Ironblood. Follow the final quest marker to arrive at Ice Caves of Sorrow. Speak to Blade Scout Shelby to finish the quest.
05a5a5226a4bbdc88eaaa5a5d23b0216f3872316.text: 跟随新的任务标记找到奥纳尔·铁血并与其交谈。跟随最后的任务标记到达悲伤冰洞。与刀锋斥候谢尔比交谈以完成任务。

60a1b0f1b65863ad10adfd7dd5700edfc18cf5e9.source: This does not show up in the Quest Log as a primary quest, but behaves as one: it is the quest leading to the next mission (Ice Caves of Sorrow).
60a1b0f1b65863ad10adfd7dd5700edfc18cf5e9.text: 这不会作为主要任务出现在任务日志中，但表现为一个：它是导致下一个任务（悲伤冰穴）的任务。

e1ebd1487b9a38dcf8b100b3bb06fdc4dda5093d.source: Although the NPC's involved in this quest refer to the Seer as male, Seers are considered genderless.
e1ebd1487b9a38dcf8b100b3bb06fdc4dda5093d.text: 虽然参与此任务的 NPC 将预言家称为男性，但预言家被认为是无性别的。

943d617df3e1bb01a220c3f15ba94b19111d4762.source: Captain Hugo Bronzebeard states that "The Mursaat have taken Thunderhead Keep!", but in the mission, it is in fact held by the Stone Summit.
943d617df3e1bb01a220c3f15ba94b19111d4762.text: 雨果·铜须队长声称“穆萨特已经占领了雷头要塞！”，但在任务中，它实际上是由石峰掌控的。

b81989d3484b1a2e84289e6d9b5d3d0d95835589.source: Unlike other quest names, "The" in this quest's name is capitalized.
b81989d3484b1a2e84289e6d9b5d3d0d95835589.text: 与其他任务名称不同，此任务名称中的“The”是大写的。

431664e7797ecb9f5a40296a196efd792edbc21a.source: Defeat the Afflicted in the Undercity.
431664e7797ecb9f5a40296a196efd792edbc21a.text: 击败幽暗城中的受折磨者。

11028950dd48f3411bb9a19fc5cd38b72cccc608.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in the Undercity, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
11028950dd48f3411bb9a19fc5cd38b72cccc608.text: 完成此任务会改变出现在幽暗城中的敌人，特别是，受苦者将不再生成。

1c8dab1d2b48c88d43d3dcf13421aa3bcdba7c25.source: If you have access to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) you can begin this quest from there and head directly to the Undercity. If you don't have access to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), then start in the Marketplace, exit to either Bukdek Byway or Wajjun Bazaar, and enter the Undercity from there.
1c8dab1d2b48c88d43d3dcf13421aa3bcdba7c25.text: 如果你可以进入维祖纳广场（当地街区），你可以从那里开始这个任务并直接前往幽暗城。如果您无法进入 Vizunah 广场（当地街区），则从市场开始，从 Bukdek Byway 或 Wajjun Bazaar 出口退出，然后从那里进入幽暗城。

2d501be21ea104b2c71c7885fee64b889c011c9f.source: Once in the Undercity, just follow the quest markers to eliminate the five groups of Afflicted. The Am Fah shouldn't be a challenge and are hostile to the Afflicted; take advantage of this. If patient, the Kappa will be eliminated, reducing needless distractions to your heroes, minions, etc. For two of the final three groups, you can make use of the Am Fah to weaken the Afflicted.
2d501be21ea104b2c71c7885fee64b889c011c9f.text: 进入幽暗城后，只需按照任务标记即可消灭五组受折磨者。 Am Fah 不应该是一个挑战，也不应该对受苦者怀有敌意；利用这一点。如果有耐心，河童将会被消灭，减少对你的英雄、小兵等不必要的干扰。对于最后三组中的两组，你可以利用 Am Fah 来削弱受折磨者。

0838d67c44db7b84da4297b58261bc7de9ebaaec.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Talus Chute and start the mission.
0838d67c44db7b84da4297b58261bc7de9ebaaec.text: 任何角色都可以从 Talus Chute 走进前哨站并开始任务。

8a8b79be283d3e85834a85f1cb9c5b3e702810aa.text: 营救埃文尼亚 月经消失

15165545af3da2d59fd9980c64d6a20a9d27ef8f.source: Find a way into the holding area.
15165545af3da2d59fd9980c64d6a20a9d27ef8f.text: 找到进入等待区域的方法。

ee2faba72e40d8d1e94d9e5aeef71add911783ac.source: Break Evennia out of her cell.
ee2faba72e40d8d1e94d9e5aeef71add911783ac.text: 把埃文尼亚从她的牢房里救出来。

69d8b4ccc0c3372f77479c08ac8f05d005f5b7e7.source: Escape with Evennia to the awaiting ice ship.
69d8b4ccc0c3372f77479c08ac8f05d005f5b7e7.text: 与埃文尼亚一起逃往等待的冰船。

482688e79d866b86220792259a080f6c21f6ed90.source: *BONUS* Return news of Rornak Stonesledge to Hamdor Grandaxe.
482688e79d866b86220792259a080f6c21f6ed90.text: *奖励* 将罗纳克石狮的消息返回给哈姆多·巨斧。

3961bebba874a795cf30bc7a2a6ca5ccf0476e3b.source: The goal of this mission is to rescue Evennia by fighting your way through Stone Summit, White Mantle, and Mursaat forces. Players will encounter the Mursaat and their Jade constructs for the first time here. These creatures use a skill called Spectral Agony which causes massive damage. Their threat can be countered by infusing a character's armor, a feature that becomes available later. In the meantime, use a tank to draw all their attacks away from the rest of the team. Better yet, they all can be avoided excepting one group when doing the bonus.
3961bebba874a795cf30bc7a2a6ca5ccf0476e3b.text: 该任务的目标是通过与石峰、白斗篷和穆尔萨特军队的战斗来营救埃文尼亚。玩家将在这里第一次遇到穆尔萨特和他们的翡翠构造体。这些生物使用一种名为“幽灵痛苦”的技能，会造成巨大伤害。他们的威胁可以通过注入角色的盔甲来应对，这一功能稍后会提供。与此同时，使用坦克将他们的所有攻击从团队其他成员身上转移开。更好的是，除了一组在获得奖金时外，所有这些都可以避免。

8f1ddb756a787a631671d246bb8c8a44fd02f1a7.source: At the beginning, you will be under siege from the Stone Summit's catapults. The first two are firing from a frozen river. Killing their Engineer will stop their attacks and provide a Morale Boost. Using the firing lever of the second catapult will then trigger an optional cinematic, provoking a Dolyak stampede that destroys the White Mantle's ballistae and kills all of the enemies gathered around them on the other side of the bridge.
8f1ddb756a787a631671d246bb8c8a44fd02f1a7.text: 一开始，你会受到石峰弹射器的围攻。前两发是从结冰的河流中发射的。杀死他们的工程师将阻止他们的攻击并提供士气提升。使用第二个弹射器的发射杆将触发一个可选的过场动画，引发多利亚克的踩踏，摧毁白斗篷的弩炮并杀死桥另一侧聚集在他们周围的所有敌人。

66096087c4b1e0215a68a9eae4ac01c443e9b82a.source: Head north, and you will find a closed gate that can be destroyed by dropping a powder keg from the Dwarven Powder Keg Station, clearing a way to the caves. There are four exits: west, south-west, south-east, and east. The second one takes you to the bonus, while the last two continue the mission. Once out of the caves, you will find an open area with Mursaat Elementalists patrolling. The cell holding Evennia and Saidra is located south of this place, with another keg station nearby. Clear the area of hostiles or bypass most of them through a cave on your left, and use another keg to free the Shining Blade allies. Saidra will sacrifice herself to allow the party escape with Evennia. Evennia must survive the rest of the mission. Take another powder keg to destroy the gate and escape to a short cave that leads to the frozen lake.
66096087c4b1e0215a68a9eae4ac01c443e9b82a.text: 向北走，你会发现一扇关闭的大门，可以通过从矮人火药桶站扔下一个火药桶来摧毁它，从而清理出一条通往洞穴的道路。有四个出口：西、西南、东南、东。第二个将带您获得奖金，而最后两个则继续任务。走出洞穴后，你会发现一片空地，有穆萨特元素师在巡逻。关押埃文尼亚和赛德拉的牢房位于此地以南，附近还有另一个小桶站。清除区域内的敌人，或者通过左边的洞穴绕过大部分敌人，然后使用另一个小桶来释放光刃盟友。赛德拉将牺牲自己，让队伍与埃文尼亚一起逃脱。埃文尼亚必须在余下的任务中幸存下来。拿另一个火药桶摧毁大门，然后逃到一个通向冰冻湖的矮洞里。

35e16d52debed846cd985159c20397ad38bca48e.source: Once you leave the cave, two large groups of Mursaat Elementalists will start to move towards you together with the intent of chasing you along the winding path across the lake. They move slowly, but you will be hindered along the way by groups of Stone Summit and White Mantle. It is not recommended that you fight the Mursaat, as there are 12 of them and they are powerful spikers even without Spectral Agony. Furthermore, Evennia is not infused, and her death will result in mission failure.
35e16d52debed846cd985159c20397ad38bca48e.text: 一旦你离开洞穴，两大群穆尔萨特元素师就会开始向你靠近，沿着湖畔蜿蜒的小路追赶你。他们移动缓慢，但一路上你会受到石峰和白斗篷的阻碍。不建议您与穆尔萨特战斗，因为它们有 12 个，即使没有幽灵痛苦，它们也是强大的尖刺者。此外，埃文尼亚没有被注入，她的死亡将导致任务失败。

9def1935d5ae6685d7c880f0aafb479770b9728f.source: As an alternative to fleeing across the lake, you may retreat back into the cave until the Mursaat patrol has moved ahead of the party. They will clear out the Stone Summit foes on the path, but they might stop moving when they reach Darda Goldenchief. If they stop at this boss, they will need to be killed. They can be pulled into separate groups of six Mursaat each, and if you are patient a nearby catapult will thin their numbers. Try to avoid letting Evennia aggro the Mursaat; in particular, the party member whom she is following should not be the one to pull. Regardless, the Mursaat that remain alive will need to be killed, before you reach the boat.
9def1935d5ae6685d7c880f0aafb479770b9728f.text: 作为逃离湖面的替代方案，你可以撤退到洞穴中，直到穆萨特巡逻队走在队伍前面。他们将清除路上石峰的敌人，但当他们到达达达金酋时，他们可能会停止移动。如果他们停在这个boss面前，他们就需要被杀死。他们可以被分成单独的小组，每组有六个穆尔萨特，如果你有耐心，附近的弹射器会减少他们的数量。尽量避免让埃文尼亚激怒穆萨特；尤其是她所跟随的党员，更不应该是拉的人。无论如何，在你到达船上之前，仍然活着的穆萨特需要被杀死。

07ff0e903c71b5c55bad586ca8c4a20aa94efbaa.source: A safer alternative is to retreat back to the cave exit until the Mursaat patrol has moved ahead of your party, follow them at a safe distance to avoid combat as they clear out the Stone Summit on the road. The Mursaat will split up at the first fork in the path, half the patrol will head east to engage Virag Bladestone, while the other half goes west, crossing a section of the road under catapult fire. Siege damage won't kill the Mursaat as they keep moving, but you can send in a hero or use a long-range weapon to kite the Mursaat, keeping them in the fire zone so the catapults can quickly finish them off for you. Repeat this process with the remaining Mursaat patrol when they reach the next area under catapult fire. Try to wait until they are well within the fire zone before you pull, if you do it too soon, they will follow you before the catapults can finish them, risking Evennie to be killed and failing the mission.
07ff0e903c71b5c55bad586ca8c4a20aa94efbaa.text: 一个更安全的选择是撤退到洞穴出口，直到穆尔萨特巡逻队移动到你的队伍前面，在安全距离内跟随他们，以避免在他们清理路上的石峰时发生战斗。穆尔萨特将在道路的第一个岔路口分开，一半的巡逻队将向东前往与维拉格·刀石交战，而另一半则向西，在弹射器的火力下穿过一段路。围攻伤害不会杀死持续移动的穆萨特，但你可以派出英雄或使用远程武器风筝穆萨特，将它们保持在火力范围内，以便弹射器可以快速为你消灭它们。当剩余的穆尔萨特巡逻队到达弹射器火力下的下一个区域时，对他们重复此过程。尝试等到他们完全进入火力区域后再拉，如果你拉得太早，他们会在弹射器完成他们之前跟随你，冒着埃文尼被杀和任务失败的风险。

7549a7a5fd6a597e899e3e748fe129bf0e817aef.source: Whichever strategy is used, follow the path until you reach the Deldrimor Dwarves' ice ship. The mission completes as soon as Evennia boards.
7549a7a5fd6a597e899e3e748fe129bf0e817aef.text: 无论使用哪种策略，沿着路径走，直到到达德尔德里莫矮人的冰船。埃文尼亚一登机，任务就完成了。

6c87aeee2e2ea60e2c0812becda37e1e3cc4e1d4.source: The bonus is straightforward: free Rornak Stonesledge (1 on the map) from his prison and carry a verbal message from him to Hamdor Grandaxe (2 on the map). You can initiate the bonus by talking to either NPC first. Also make sure that you blow open the right door, there is a door guarded by Mursaat before the actual door where the Bonus starts. Furthermore there are two main complications:
6c87aeee2e2ea60e2c0812becda37e1e3cc4e1d4.text: 奖励很简单：将 Rornak Stonesledge（地图上的 1）从监狱中释放出来，并将他的口头信息传递给 Hamdor Grandaxe（地图上的 2）。您可以先与任一 NPC 交谈来启动奖励。还要确保你炸开右边的门，在奖励开始的实际门之前有一扇由 Mursaat 守卫的门。此外，还有两个主要的并发症：

8ced3fd1aaedc30b6d26212c9cd602054d1be394.source: You need two extra powder kegs to blast your way open, which is tedious for single-player teams. (Even with an individual speed boost, this takes an extra minute or three.)
8ced3fd1aaedc30b6d26212c9cd602054d1be394.text: 你需要两个额外的火药桶来炸开道路，这对于单人团队来说是乏味的。 （即使单独提高速度，这也需要额外一到三分钟的时间。）

0da682a92600241f7f8987a3baa061ecabb198ec.source: The bonus route requires dealing with Jade Constructs (near Rornak's cell) and Mursaat Elementalists (in front of Hamdor's cave): their Spectral Agony can quickly kill unprotected characters (characters without infused armor). Therefore it is wise to send in a Hero to tank the spectral agony for you since they take the damage as if they were infused.
0da682a92600241f7f8987a3baa061ecabb198ec.text: 奖励路线需要对付翡翠构造体（Rornak 的牢房附近）和穆尔萨特元素师（哈姆多的洞穴前）：他们的幽灵痛苦可以快速杀死未受保护的角色（没有注入盔甲的角色）。因此，明智的做法是派出一名英雄来为你承受幽灵般的痛苦，因为他们会像被注入一样承受伤害。

afb043f95db949baa017b1685d1fd56be05946b4.source: The first group of constructs blocking the route to Rornak must be dealt with. There are several approaches for a single player, none of which are entirely reliable for characters tackling Prophecies for the first time:
afb043f95db949baa017b1685d1fd56be05946b4.text: 必须处理第一组阻挡通往罗纳克路线的构造体。对于单个玩家来说有几种方法，对于第一次处理预言的角色来说，没有一种方法是完全可靠的：

bb4fcb3f39940871d341d479c4c2b5df68e102c9.source: Go directly into the fight and be willing to absorb a few deaths on the team. (You can recharge resurrection signets by killing the last remaining Stone Summit Engineer.)
bb4fcb3f39940871d341d479c4c2b5df68e102c9.text: 直接投入战斗并愿意吸收团队中的一些死亡。 （你可以通过杀死最后剩下的石峰工程师来充值复活印章。）

d450d95297eab7d19d472fef6848545ab38218ff.source: Use a party member to tank the constructs; with enough healing, they can survive Spectral Agony's direct damage and health degeneration.
d450d95297eab7d19d472fef6848545ab38218ff.text: 使用一名党员来坦克建筑；只要有足够的治疗能力，他们就可以在光谱痛苦的直接伤害和健康退化中幸存下来。

23a3e4b728a8b35306ef033f76f526b7337bdacf.source: Carefully pull the constructs away from each other and spike one at a time. With enough damage, you can take down one of the constructs and (if needed) retreat to heal before returning for the others.
23a3e4b728a8b35306ef033f76f526b7337bdacf.text: 小心地将结构彼此拉开，并一次钉入一个。有了足够的伤害，你就可以摧毁其中一个构造体，并（如果需要）撤退以治疗其他构造体，然后再返回其他构造体。

96f0565709f49ae5e883d3aa7b1aba69fc6eac80.source: If you have heroes and/or animal companions, use them to defeat the constructs, since their armor is always infused.
96f0565709f49ae5e883d3aa7b1aba69fc6eac80.text: 如果你有英雄和/或动物伙伴，请用他们来击败构装体，因为他们的盔甲总是被注入的。

55f0633bca8bdbd448f5f2cc8cb866bff36b442d.source: For the bonus, the second group of Mursaat Elementalist can be easily avoided by briefly stepping out of the cave to Hamdor's west, retreating south, and then waiting for the Mursaat to pass by; this leaves the route to Hamdor free of enemies and letting you complete the bonus objective without more complications. If you still need to complete the main mission, The Mursaat Elementalist must be dealt with. To do so, consider the following:
55f0633bca8bdbd448f5f2cc8cb866bff36b442d.text: 额外的好处是，第二组穆萨特元素师可以很容易地避开，只需短暂走出洞穴到哈姆多的西边，向南撤退，然后等待穆萨特经过即可；这使得通往哈姆多的路线没有敌人，让你可以在没有更多复杂性的情况下完成奖励目标。如果你还需要完成主线任务，就必须解决穆萨特元素师。为此，请考虑以下事项：

8f5b27a24c341ac2a84c1bac2942eeb56261bfe5.source: Make use of the Stone Summit catapults to get the Mursaat killed without direct confrontation, as detailed previously.
8f5b27a24c341ac2a84c1bac2942eeb56261bfe5.text: 如前所述，利用石峰弹射器在没有直接对抗的情况下杀死穆萨特。

ffb4d70f31177ea699d166ec7190fddd9b6235fc.source: If you rather face the mursaat, keep in mind they will split up into two groups shortly after the first battle between White Mantle and Stone Summit, around the large rock where Virag Bladestone guards one route and a catapult guards the other. The group facing Virag will most likely waste the initial cast of their dangerous Thunderclap but are unlikely to take much damage before the battle, while the catapult group will end up softened by the raining projectiles but will have all their skills ready
ffb4d70f31177ea699d166ec7190fddd9b6235fc.text: 如果你更愿意面对莫萨特，请记住，在白斗篷和石峰之间的第一次战斗之后不久，他们会分成两组，围绕着大岩石，维拉格·刀石守卫着一条路线，而弹射器守卫着另一条路线。面对维拉格的队伍很可能会浪费他们危险的雷霆一击的初始施法，但在战斗前不太可能受到太大伤害，而弹射器队伍最终会被雨点般的射弹软化，但他们的所有技能都准备好了

757934c1152f79519fdc5f7f3dfe40df5915b905.source: Reaching Rornak is the only section of the mission that requires exposing you to Spectral Agony. If none of the above strategies work for you to overcome that part of the mission, you can finish the main quest and return for the bonus after getting your armor infused during the next mission.
757934c1152f79519fdc5f7f3dfe40df5915b905.text: 到达罗纳克是任务中唯一需要让你经历幽灵痛苦的部分。如果上述策略都无法帮助您完成该部分任务，您可以完成主线任务，并在下一个任务中注入护甲后返回以获得奖励。

bf8cad5f7df454d1a187ff502581a88ebf9b28c1.source: Anti-caster skills to counter Mursaat Elementalists.
bf8cad5f7df454d1a187ff502581a88ebf9b28c1.text: 对抗穆萨特元素师的反施法者技能。

76e6536c925e4811413dfa0e087e54aefa68cc6e.source: Interrupts, especially to stop Spectral Agony.
76e6536c925e4811413dfa0e087e54aefa68cc6e.text: 中断，尤其是停止幽灵痛苦。

3fa2ff9e778eb2eebe523297a61a86155aae2574.source: Minions and Spirits ease battles versus two or more groups.
3fa2ff9e778eb2eebe523297a61a86155aae2574.text: 小兵和灵魂可以缓解两个或更多团体的战斗。

a803e53a1ae18019b426dc8deec8107ae1b70a96.source: During Saidra and Evennia's rescue, blast the back gate before breaking their cell; the cave can provide a safe place for your party if it has not been cleared yet. Also, if you are struggling to keep Evennia alive at the frozen lake, you can clear the path including the Mursaat Elementalists before freeing her from her cell. This method only adds a few minutes to the mission time, but more or less guarantees Evennia's survival.
a803e53a1ae18019b426dc8deec8107ae1b70a96.text: 在拯救 Saidra 和 Evennia 的过程中，先炸开后门，然后再破坏他们的牢房；如果洞穴尚未被清理干净，它可以为你的队伍提供一个安全的地方。另外，如果你在冰冻的湖面上努力保住埃文尼亚的生命，你可以先扫清道路，包括穆尔萨特元素师，然后再将她从牢房中释放出来。这种方法只是增加了几分钟的任务时间，但或多或​​少保证了埃文尼亚的生存。

b6dc7ed66a4bea2daa4e74bde1d0af29b72c17cc.source: You cannot save Saidra; if you manage to kill off her attackers, she will run off and disappear.
b6dc7ed66a4bea2daa4e74bde1d0af29b72c17cc.text: 你无法拯救赛德拉；如果你成功杀死了袭击她的人，她就会逃跑并消失。

51572ba1d96fd10fa2f780ecae6402d912535ba5.source: You can infuse your armor even before this mission by trekking up to Mineral Springs and killing the Ice Beast, then giving the Spectral Essence it drops to the Seer immediately south of it.
51572ba1d96fd10fa2f780ecae6402d912535ba5.text: 甚至在执行此任务之前，您就可以通过长途跋涉前往矿泉并杀死冰兽，然后将其掉落的光谱精华给予其南边的先知来注入您的盔甲。

7af7655ca62a0efc8debd344aac3fb099c0ba653.source: This mission adds approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title track.
7af7655ca62a0efc8debd344aac3fb099c0ba653.text: 此任务为 Tyrian Cartographer 的主打歌增加了约 1.1%。

24c840753a92b2083b2ec30120115e0a465dbf8d.source: Non-human heroes will not bow during the final cinematic; they apparently lack the animation.
24c840753a92b2083b2ec30120115e0a465dbf8d.text: 非人类英雄不会在最后的过场动画中鞠躬；他们显然缺乏动画。

e8f6f3613b2e8b67f9e8c8753779a92fefdac6c2.source: When reaching Rornak, for the bonus, there are two gates leading off from the caves: if you try to blow up the wrong one, it won’t be destroyed and may appear to be bugged. Double-check the map: the gate you are trying to blow up is in the southern blue patch of the mountain and should turn a corner off the main path before the gate.
e8f6f3613b2e8b67f9e8c8753779a92fefdac6c2.text: 当到达罗纳克时，为了奖励，有两扇门通向洞穴：如果你试图炸毁错误的一扇门，它不会被摧毁，而且可能看起来被窃听了。仔细检查地图：你要炸毁的大门位于山脉南部的蓝色区域，应该在大门前从主路拐一个弯。

a822b0d5fa4504b50f0b675cea0c4d36e8e9b93b.source: When letting the Mursaat go in front of your party at the frozen lake, you have to stay in compass range of them if you want them to clear the Stone Summit along the path for you.
a822b0d5fa4504b50f0b675cea0c4d36e8e9b93b.text: 当让穆尔萨特在结冰的湖面上走在你的队伍前面时，如果你想让他们为你清理沿途的石峰，你必须保持在它们的指南针范围内。

786a74e9aa8c750fadb591d8f8b50e26c8e80e76.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #13 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
786a74e9aa8c750fadb591d8f8b50e26c8e80e76.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 13 页。

f28f864d457e3f4ea0a0e7d1c772653df58f38ec.source: After completing this mission, your party appears in Iron Mines of Moladune.
f28f864d457e3f4ea0a0e7d1c772653df58f38ec.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍会出现在莫拉杜恩的铁矿中。

dd8e483994bd77c57ed7e5743c3b3ccf68d22c9e.source: A little while after the first Stone Summit group the mob of Mursaat passes on the frozen lake, there is a Shiverpeak Chest which the Mursaat sometimes will get stuck on and stop moving. If this happens, you will have to retry the mission or attempt to have an infused player pull them away from it. The Mursaat stops after the stone bridge. Sometimes Evennia will not follow you; sometimes she may follow Saidra and gets killed by Mursaat; you must restart the mission if this happens. Sometimes Rornak Stonesledge will not be at his location, making it impossible to claim the bonus without restarting the mission. Occasionally, a stray barrage from the siege weapons will land near the spawn of Virag Bladestone, harming the party. The Mursaat are not hostile to Darda Goldenchief's group. Sometimes, a Shiverpeak Chest will spawn in an unreachable location near the ice boat siege engines.
dd8e483994bd77c57ed7e5743c3b3ccf68d22c9e.text: 在第一个石峰小组经过冰冻湖面后不久，穆萨特的暴民会发现一个席瓦峰宝箱，穆萨特有时会被卡住并停止移动。如果发生这种情况，你将不得不重试任务或尝试让被注入的玩家将他们拉离任务。 Mursaat 在石桥后停了下来。有时Evennia不会跟着你；有时她可能会跟随 Saidra 并被 Mursaat 杀死；如果发生这种情况，您必须重新启动任务。有时罗纳克·石狮不会出现在他所在的位置，因此在不重新启动任务的情况下无法领取奖金。有时，攻城武器发出的杂散弹幕会落在维拉格·刃石的出生点附近，对队伍造成伤害。穆尔萨特人对达尔达·金奇夫的团队并不怀有敌意。有时，席瓦峰宝箱会在冰船攻城引擎附近无法到达的位置生成。

69fa55e2311cf94385b6cb19c5de74c86079a740.source: Travel to Yatendi Canyons and find Kehanni Nutu, priestess of Lyssa.
69fa55e2311cf94385b6cb19c5de74c86079a740.text: 前往亚坦迪峡谷并找到莱莎的女祭司科汉尼·努图。

6d9eb3d04b0c97d736af9cc94bebe8ee1633a842.source: Meet with the Seeker of Whispers.

cc235fd95a88c7ea21a016cf1f452e5d3fb897a2.source: Meet Kehanni in Vehtendi Valley. Obtain an invitation to the Festival of Lyss.
cc235fd95a88c7ea21a016cf1f452e5d3fb897a2.text: 在 Vehtendi 山谷与 Kehanni 见面。获得利斯节的邀请。

0b5cee60da656abc23aeb033156fa8256012b885.source: Travel through the Forum Highlands. Meet Priestess Haila.
0b5cee60da656abc23aeb033156fa8256012b885.text: 穿越论坛高地。认识女祭司海拉。

18367611151843733f3db00af60a82aea69c9e36.source: Wash the dirt, grime, and heket blood from your armor and gear in the Font of Lyss.
18367611151843733f3db00af60a82aea69c9e36.text: 在利斯之泉中清洗盔甲和装备上的污垢、污垢和血迹。

7bcc154ff8c82bd11e3bcc19f3a9aa04ed08faff.source: Speak with Priestess Haila to gain a sneak peek at the party.
7bcc154ff8c82bd11e3bcc19f3a9aa04ed08faff.text: 与女祭司海拉交谈，抢先一睹派对的风采。

bdee797ef4a7429688d323d8af4031bebbab46d8.source: See Event Planner Kazsha for your reward.
bdee797ef4a7429688d323d8af4031bebbab46d8.text: 请参阅活动策划者 Kazsha 以获得奖励。

afcbd1bcca11eb4b590ddb4ab4c9e910931fc42b.source: While this quest is active, the bosses Bohdalz the Furious and Jarimiya the Unmerciful do not spawn in Vehtendi Valley.
afcbd1bcca11eb4b590ddb4ab4c9e910931fc42b.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，Boss“狂怒者博赫达尔兹”和“无情者贾里米亚”不会在维赫滕迪山谷中生成。

0daa0bd0381886a8b5c9331a531781534befa8e0.source: Start in Wehhan Terraces. Follow the path in the map to point 1 and talk to Kehanni. Follow the path to Chantry of Secrets, and talk to the Seeker of Whispers inside (point 2). Follow the path into and through Vehtendi Valley to point 3, where the quest will update. Follow either the green (through Forum Highlands) or the red path (via the Kodash Bazaar) to Priestess Haila outside the Kodash Bazaar. If you wish to enter the Kodash Bazaar, you can also follow the green path and then continue into the Bazaar before talking to the priestess. There you can wash yourself in the Font of Lyss and she will send you into Tihark Orchard.
0daa0bd0381886a8b5c9331a531781534befa8e0.text: 从维汉梯田开始。沿着地图上的路径到达地点 1 并与 Kehanni 交谈。沿着路径前往秘密教堂，并与里面的低语探索者交谈（第 2 点）。沿着进入并穿过 Vehtendi 山谷的路径到达第 3 点，任务将在那里更新。沿着绿色路径（穿过论坛高地）或红色路径（穿过科达什集市）前往科达什集市外的女祭司海拉。如果你想进入Kodash集市，也可以沿着绿色小路继续进入集市，然后与女祭司交谈。在那里，你可以在里斯之泉中沐浴，她会送你进入提哈克果园。

f1eec64422ef197837748d2e219d4695fc00a214.source: If you already have the Kodash Bazaar unlocked, you can skip most of this quest by starting from the objective that requires using the Font of Lyss.
f1eec64422ef197837748d2e219d4695fc00a214.text: 如果您已经解锁了 Kodash Bazaar，则可以从需要使用 Lyss 字体的目标开始，跳过此任务的大部分内容。

c52ab7e8eef8ecb95ca1800bde67fc93af7daf85.source: After completion of Tihark Orchard you will find yourself in Kodash Bazaar. The only point in going there before you complete the Tihark Orchard mission is to unlock it a little bit earlier.
c52ab7e8eef8ecb95ca1800bde67fc93af7daf85.text: 完成 Tihark Orchard 后，您将发现自己身处 Kodash Bazaar。在完成提哈克果园任务之前去那里的唯一一点是提前解锁它。

ec5af1de9022b5c85d774323a00b3d1693a0d4a8.source: If you accept the quest reward for this quest with a full inventory, you will not receive the trade contracts and you might not be able to continue the primary quest line.
ec5af1de9022b5c85d774323a00b3d1693a0d4a8.text: 如果您在库存已满的情况下接受此任务的任务奖励，您将不会收到贸易合同，并且您可能无法继续主要任务线。

110b93e17d695e6da16b92f2f797c6f2ea942504.source: Speak with Headmaster Greico in the Shing Jea Monastery.
110b93e17d695e6da16b92f2f797c6f2ea942504.text: 与 Shing Jea 寺的校长 Greico 交谈。

b466830313d3f5c993d9ca7bd109d46adec45438.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Sunjiang District.

d3ee6477135bf76e4df2dc6996cab445ab78edc6.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Sunjiang District; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
d3ee6477135bf76e4df2dc6996cab445ab78edc6.text: 完成此任务会改变孙江区出现的敌人；具体来说，受苦者将不再生成。

a5e5a232d88ed0c19e6370220751a8012fdff49a.source: To complete this quest, your character must have successfully completed the missions: Boreas Seabed, Arborstone, and Sunjiang District, otherwise a gate will block the path to the last group of Afflicted that must be defeated.
a5e5a232d88ed0c19e6370220751a8012fdff49a.text: 要完成此任务，你的角色必须成功完成任务：北风之神海底、阿博斯通和孙江区，否则一扇大门将挡住通往最后一组必须击败的受折磨者的道路。

72bc2ba764c7e4374728c29659da09a04fc207e8.source: Start from Zin Ku Corridor and head south into the Sunjiang District. The Am Fah encountered on the way to the first quest marker do not use Winds of Change builds and so are trivial to defeat. Follow the quest markers and kill off the Afflicted groups.
72bc2ba764c7e4374728c29659da09a04fc207e8.text: 从津库走廊出发，向南进入孙江区。在前往第一个任务标记的路上遇到的 Am Fah 不使用变革之风构建，因此很容易击败。跟随任务标记并杀死受折磨的群体。

1bfbb8a6108af0773120003bb060609f089f1de4.source: While it might look like an equidistant route to approach this quest from the south, the Am Fah in Pongmei Valley do use the Winds of Change builds and so are much more difficult than the Zin Ku Corridor route.
1bfbb8a6108af0773120003bb060609f089f1de4.text: 虽然它看起来像是从南方接近此任务的等距路线，但庞美山谷的阿姆法确实使用了变革之风建筑，因此比津库走廊路线困难得多。

7cd484e3d89f705bd20377031717921b77e7416f.source: The final group spawns very near the fourth group, namely near the Ranger's Construct boss. There's a risk of aggro before recuperating from the previous fight; consider pulling the fourth group further away from the tunnel, and then pulling the final group away from the Shiro'ken.
7cd484e3d89f705bd20377031717921b77e7416f.text: 最后一组出现在第四组附近，即游侠的构造体 Boss 附近。在从之前的战斗中恢复过来之前，存在仇恨的风险；考虑将第四组拉离隧道更远，然后将最后一组拉离Shiro'ken。

7c2663cf8159cb625bf8182b8bfb1d0a9c3d372f.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Frozen Forest and start the mission. Completing Ice Caves of Sorrow also brings the party here.
7c2663cf8159cb625bf8182b8bfb1d0a9c3d372f.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从冰冻森林走进前哨站并开始任务。完成悲伤冰洞后，聚会也会来到这里。

0ae8a4ade0cf73d84b2afc2b873930975e7e52f0.source: Kill Markis and his Jade Armor guards.
0ae8a4ade0cf73d84b2afc2b873930975e7e52f0.text: 杀死马基斯和他的玉甲守卫。

62ccc3de3efec6104787c53930c05edb0eed59ba.source: ADDED: Deliver the Spectral Essence to the Seer to infuse your armor.
62ccc3de3efec6104787c53930c05edb0eed59ba.text: 添加：将光谱精华交给先知以注入你的盔甲。

7b5a84fed5a9ac5d75ffa87f783971c7483b01e5.source: *BONUS* Defeat The Inquisitor before he leaves with the information about the Shining Blade.
7b5a84fed5a9ac5d75ffa87f783971c7483b01e5.text: *奖励* 在审判官带着光刃的信息离开之前击败他。

93583adeeb91b6de8157e81ebf44a8aefc046619.source: The goal of this mission is to kill Markis at the point marked M on the map. To do so the players first have to meet with the Seer at the point marked S, who will offer to infuse players armor to protect them against Spectral Agony.
93583adeeb91b6de8157e81ebf44a8aefc046619.text: 该任务的目标是在地图上标记为M的地点杀死马基斯。为此，玩家首先必须在标记为 S 的地点与先知会面，后者将向玩家注入护甲以保护他们免受幽灵痛苦的伤害。

b71c83262224f0ede33711bd590e95d5943af69f.source: Maximum-stat armor (e.g. from Droknar's Forge) is strongly advised for this mission, not only because it gives an edge in the fights, but also because infusion will only be applied to the armor set players are currently wearing. As you encounter the Mursaat throughout the rest of the campaign, you want to make sure that you are protected against their most deadly attack. Should you miss the opportunity, you will need to repeat the first part of the mission or alternatively infuse another set later in the game in Mineral Springs, or the Ring of Fire or Abaddon's Mouth missions.
b71c83262224f0ede33711bd590e95d5943af69f.text: 强烈建议在此任务中使用最大属性盔甲（例如来自德罗克纳尔的熔炉），不仅因为它在战斗中具有优势，而且因为输注只会应用于玩家当前穿着的盔甲套装。当你在剩下的战役中遇到穆尔萨特时，你需要确保自己免受他们最致命的攻击。如果你错过了这个机会，你将需要重复任务的第一部分，或者在游戏后期的矿泉、火环或阿巴顿之口任务中注入另一组任务。

5b6913da23beeece9f6314b3b45b9e742312c72e.source: Do not engage the Mursaat in combat until your armor is infused, or use an infused tank, such as any hero or pet (henchmen are not infused), to draw attacks away from the rest of the team.
5b6913da23beeece9f6314b3b45b9e742312c72e.text: 在你的护甲被注入之前，不要与穆萨特交战，或者使用被注入的坦克，例如任何英雄或宠物（追随者没有被注入），来吸引团队其他成员的攻击。

8e52dd2a5011695fc128aeeb2d18f7e99c5e4558.source: At the beginning, there's a battle between the Stone Summit and White Mantle. You can ignore them and simply run past them. Head along the frozen river and then keep heading north. Again you will sight a very large group of Stone Summit and White Mantle in combat, head east to avoid it since there is no need to fight them.
8e52dd2a5011695fc128aeeb2d18f7e99c5e4558.text: 一开始，石峰和白斗篷之间发生了一场战斗。您可以忽略它们并直接跑过去。沿着结冰的河流前进，然后继续向北行驶。你会再次看到一大群石峰和白斗篷在战斗，向东走以避免它们，因为没有必要与他们战斗。

a404ae076ae3c7ca5c3fbb43e4f449d3d8892608.source: At this point you will hear Shining Blade Scout Ryder calling out for help but safe from harm. She gives the bonus objective but her rescue is not needed to complete the mission. In any case, ignore her for the time being.
a404ae076ae3c7ca5c3fbb43e4f449d3d8892608.text: 此时，您会听到光刃侦察兵莱德呼救，但不会受到伤害。她给出了奖励目标，但完成任务不需要她的救援。无论如何，暂时不理她吧。

4379ae10c9ca5939fe5a6e3b0f98b61b8fe31777.source: Cross another bridge and keep traveling north-west until you reach the snowfields populated by Azure Shadows. Kill them and proceed to the Seer (marked S on the map above).
4379ae10c9ca5939fe5a6e3b0f98b61b8fe31777.text: 穿过另一座桥，继续向西北行驶，直到到达蔚蓝阴影居住的雪原。杀死他们并前往先知（上图标记为 S）。

c806246d9e3a7f468b66a48443fd4772a66278b6.source: Approaching the Seer will trigger a cutscene where players are instructed to kill the Eidolon (at point E) and obtain its Spectral Essence to infuse your armor. The Eidolon is not difficult to defeat and once killed will drop the Spectral Essence as a bundle that you have to carry back to the Seer. Once done, talk to the Seer to have your armor infused with the essence.
c806246d9e3a7f468b66a48443fd4772a66278b6.text: 接近先知将触发一个过场动画，玩家被指示杀死幻灵（在 E 点）并获取其幽灵精华来注入你的盔甲。击败幻灵并不难，一旦被杀死，就会掉落光谱精华，你必须将其带回给先知。完成后，与先知交谈，让你的盔甲注入精华。

b04ebb6512706d80b83d69b190ad0969f3198eeb.source: Follow then the passage north of the Seer to reach Markis' location.
b04ebb6512706d80b83d69b190ad0969f3198eeb.text: 然后沿着先知号以北的通道到达马基斯的位置。

51def6151ec70583350674f7f4b0e6b5a856cbb1.source: You can either immediately kill him and his Jade guards to complete the mission or ignore him for now and proceed south to do the bonus.
51def6151ec70583350674f7f4b0e6b5a856cbb1.text: 你可以立即杀死他和他的玉卫来完成任务，也可以暂时忽略他并继续向南以获得奖励。

c2fb364055df6da230abd761b13addbe3de29e8c.text: 前往马基斯的替代路线

a97ceb99ab61c29542d827083b1bb297bfe5b407.source: Talking to the Seer is not necessary to finish the mission. If players are already infused against Spectral Agony, do not follow the river north. Instead, follow Markis northeast through the Mursaat stronghold to save time. This path is marked in green and yellow on the map above, and you will encounter the bonus NPC Shining Blade Scout Ryder along the way.
a97ceb99ab61c29542d827083b1bb297bfe5b407.text: 完成任务不需要与先知交谈。如果玩家已经注入了对抗幽灵痛苦的能力，请不要沿着河流向北行驶。相反，沿着马基斯向东北方向穿过穆萨特要塞以节省时间。这条路径在上面的地图上用绿色和黄色标记，沿途你会遇到额外的 NPC 光刃侦察兵莱德。

ba07b666d505804affcea985da634974f30561fc.source: Shining Blade Scout Ryder, found at point B on the map, urges players to kill The Inquisitor before it escapes with intelligence. Accepting the bonus will spawn the mentioned boss and a few Mursaat, which will move north towards the Mursaat teleporter.
ba07b666d505804affcea985da634974f30561fc.text: 光刃侦察兵莱德位于地图上的 B 点，他敦促玩家在审判官带着情报逃跑之前将其杀死。接受奖励将产生上述 Boss 和一些 Mursaat，它们将向北移动到 Mursaat 传送器。

cbd58899ba45297b92fd42076a9695a2db6d9962.source: To get to Ryder in the first place, head south of Markis and kill the Mursaat you encounter. Alternatively if you followed the green path above, kill the Mursaat up to the next bridge.
cbd58899ba45297b92fd42076a9695a2db6d9962.text: 首先，要到达莱德，请前往马基斯以南并杀死你遇到的穆萨特。或者，如果你沿着上面的绿色路径走，就可以杀死下一座桥上的穆萨特。

8a42555ce5f140c1ac38f5fc26bcdef1767bc031.source: Clear out the surrounding mobs between Ryder and the bridge before talking to Ryder to avoid over-aggro. Send only one player to Ryder while the rest of the party awaits at the Inquisitor spawn point (which is just outside the gates, a little up the hill).
8a42555ce5f140c1ac38f5fc26bcdef1767bc031.text: 在与莱德交谈之前先清除莱德和桥之间的周围小怪，以避免过度仇恨。只派一名玩家前往莱德，而其他人则在审判官重生点等待（就在大门外，在山上一点点）。

b973d145675d09527b9adf2d927a9205b57c69d0.source: Although the foes are notably tougher in hard mode, the basic strategies are the same.
b973d145675d09527b9adf2d927a9205b57c69d0.text: 尽管困难模式下的敌人明显更强悍，但基本策略是相同的。

f1a77493317bae8335f5dc7a33dd3c2c82f4f936.source: Snares and knockdowns to prevent The Inquisitor from running away.
f1a77493317bae8335f5dc7a33dd3c2c82f4f936.text: 用陷阱和击倒来防止审判官逃跑。

19682f6b2cc8c7ee0980621b5ccef0712c3eb62b.source: Anti-caster skills for players without infused armor.
19682f6b2cc8c7ee0980621b5ccef0712c3eb62b.text: 没有注入护甲的玩家的反施法者技能。

d4b6799d1dd2d9541a9921ad1f84ae1cdfb9c42f.source: Despite being mentioned in the mission objectives, it is not necessary to visit the Seer in order to finish the mission.
d4b6799d1dd2d9541a9921ad1f84ae1cdfb9c42f.text: 尽管任务目标中提到了，但完成任务并不需要拜访先知。

522b1b2c8ed749129a25ce942dbee2c6dfae7b03.source: Shining Blade Scout Ryder can die, preventing you from beginning the bonus.
522b1b2c8ed749129a25ce942dbee2c6dfae7b03.text: 光刃斥候莱德可能会死亡，从而阻止你开始奖励。

a6873c54739e647081d5aff81b31801912f2d810.source: Henchmen are not infused at the beginning of mission and become infused only after delivering the Spectral Essence to the Seer.
a6873c54739e647081d5aff81b31801912f2d810.text: 追随者在任务开始时不会被注入，只有在将光谱精华交给先知后才会被注入。

ce395a9dce8fc3eb078d5bf6bed87af8e94e7d35.source: The popular "Infusion run" follows the red path on the map above to only trigger the Seer cinematic.
ce395a9dce8fc3eb078d5bf6bed87af8e94e7d35.text: 流行的“输液跑”沿着上面地图上的红色路径，只会触发“先知”过场动画。

c766a4767bb38f0cccd0bfbf034a04b4b4e459d3.source: Players wanting to capture Barrage from Markis need to kill him before finishing off the four Jade Armor guards or the mission will end.
c766a4767bb38f0cccd0bfbf034a04b4b4e459d3.text: 想要从马基斯手中夺取弹幕的玩家需要在消灭四名玉甲守卫之前杀死他，否则任务就会结束。

9a7347684e9c41b2489f840dd3ab620e84bcbe89.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #14 in The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
9a7347684e9c41b2489f840dd3ab620e84bcbe89.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 14 页。

fcdbe964190407e72a80bd331d1bd0c6a0c2cfb9.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Thunderhead Keep.
fcdbe964190407e72a80bd331d1bd0c6a0c2cfb9.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到雷头城堡。

6364cb2968320a6d43c72925796ba32aa22a71ef.source: Sometimes, Markis will get stuck in a chest and will not arrive to the fortress. Players will have to backtrack his route from the original spawning location to find him.
6364cb2968320a6d43c72925796ba32aa22a71ef.text: 有时，马基斯会被卡在箱子里而无法到达要塞。玩家必须从最初的生成位置原路返回才能找到他。

0b3b1f6ffb99a5d919a862848a7d3c0e71be33bb.source: Rally The Princes primary quest completed
0b3b1f6ffb99a5d919a862848a7d3c0e71be33bb.text: 集结王子主要任务已完成

8d84e7ddde6a56dc53461dc32b52847dc68ff07f.source: Convince the three Princes of Vabbi to join the fight against Varesh.
8d84e7ddde6a56dc53461dc32b52847dc68ff07f.text: 说服瓦比的三位王子加入对抗瓦雷什的战斗。
