e14f49cad70d2b7878b4b3af31c7aacd1b618b58.source: Recruit Prince Mehtu the Wise for your war against Varesh.
e14f49cad70d2b7878b4b3af31c7aacd1b618b58.text: 招募智者梅图王子来对抗瓦雷什。

6d21bdbfc17e2e5f018737e220f4f754ecda2c6d.source: Persuade Prince Bokka the Magnificent to join the Sunspears in the struggle against Warmarshal Varesh.
6d21bdbfc17e2e5f018737e220f4f754ecda2c6d.text: 说服伟大的博卡王子加入阳矛军团对抗瓦雷什元帅。

7b8120c0d8d10376293eb4ef3dbf6a28e5a09fd9.source: Coerce Prince Ahmtur the Mighty to rally against Warmarshal Varesh.
7b8120c0d8d10376293eb4ef3dbf6a28e5a09fd9.text: 强迫强大的阿姆图尔王子集结起来对抗战帅瓦雷什。

01543deccbe8cf8f59f6264f4f314e719b867d0c.source: Prince Ahmtur the Mighty wishes to speak with you again. Find out what he has to say.
01543deccbe8cf8f59f6264f4f314e719b867d0c.text: 强大的阿姆图尔王子希望再次与您交谈。找出他要说的话。

5579a2978c6fe25685a73be1568a22480bbe9e12.source: Defend the garden and its guests by slaying the harpies.
5579a2978c6fe25685a73be1568a22480bbe9e12.text: 杀死鹰身女妖，保卫花园及其客人。

a9ddae3dbcaa25624bba24c13c97595aab8cfa5a.source: *Bonus* Participate in the Festival of Lyss.

9593f19a18884af9ebe3705e14e8659f45380b97.source: You have participated in [0...5] of 5 festivities.
9593f19a18884af9ebe3705e14e8659f45380b97.text: 您已参加了 5 个庆祝活动中的 [0...5] 个。

0e896bc6b015dfe6471bcd587ceee5e09794a87f.source: The aim of this mission is to try to convince the three Vabbian princes that they should join the fight against Varesh. However, to gain an audience with them, you must participate in some of the festival's mini-games. Although this can be done without any fighting, gaining the master's reward requires that you defeat at least one foe. Towards the end of the mission, you must also help the guards defeat several mobs of harpies. This means you need to bring a build that includes some damage and some self-healing.
0e896bc6b015dfe6471bcd587ceee5e09794a87f.text: 这次任务的目的是试图说服三位瓦比亚王子加入对抗瓦雷什的战斗。然而，要获得他们的观众，您必须参加节日的一些小游戏。虽然这可以在不进行任何战斗的情况下完成，但获得大师的奖励需要你击败至少一个敌人。在任务结束时，你还必须帮助守卫击败几只鸟身女妖。这意味着你需要带来一个包含一些损坏和一些自我修复的构建。

6d8b0a6f384ad02bd8417e54df1f6052a0bb764d.source: The quickest way to get permission to speak to the princes is:
6d8b0a6f384ad02bd8417e54df1f6052a0bb764d.text: 获得与王子交谈的许可的最快方法是：

5d3d8ee373092dae7008a17b3ebc2ee467764d89.source: Prince Mehtu the Wise: (One of the following)
5d3d8ee373092dae7008a17b3ebc2ee467764d89.text: 智者梅图王子：（以下之一）

ec7e564b39595ec4931f8ced83b82469a9bbe429.source: Teach his niece or nephew to dance by using the /dance emote after speaking to Dende (female characters) or Mina (male characters). This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
ec7e564b39595ec4931f8ced83b82469a9bbe429.text: 与 Dende（女性角色）或 Mina（男性角色）交谈后，使用 /dance 表情教他的侄女或侄子跳舞。这算作奖金的庆祝活动之一。

221900d2f23faa32941d55a6d273d1d4772f49a7.source: Win the Mime Duel against Lumo the Mime. This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
221900d2f23faa32941d55a6d273d1d4772f49a7.text: 赢得与哑剧鲁莫的哑剧决斗。这算作奖金的庆祝活动之一。

65b539b3522bd80755824b1320433f66b6f91140.source: Prince Bokka the Magnificent: (One of the following)
65b539b3522bd80755824b1320433f66b6f91140.text: 伟大的博卡王子：（以下之一）

307342fd8cb60585911a2b76391be91d3c00c77f.source: Present Royal Finance Minister Oluda with a gift of the Rare Antique Elonian Vase, obtained from Jejumba via one of the following methods. This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
307342fd8cb60585911a2b76391be91d3c00c77f.text: 向皇家财政部长奥鲁达赠送稀有古董埃洛尼安花瓶作为礼物，该花瓶是通过以下方法之一从 Jejumba 获得的。这算作奖金的庆祝活动之一。

e980f6c0f6ae11a67e53f2a5dc4115ba0cf2c9a5.source: Obtain the Golden Phoenix Feather from the Royal Guard Captain, located in the eastern corridor, by defeating him.
e980f6c0f6ae11a67e53f2a5dc4115ba0cf2c9a5.text: 击败东部走廊的皇家侍卫队长，获得金凤凰羽毛。

156c629b53d2daf45fde871fdf9f00800b68b57e.source: Bribe Royal Finance Minister Oluda (cost: 5000 gold) If done after presenting the gift, this counts as another one of the festivities for the bonus as well.
156c629b53d2daf45fde871fdf9f00800b68b57e.text: 贿赂皇家财政部长奥鲁达（费用：5000金币） 如果在赠送礼物后完成，这也算作奖金的另一项庆祝活动。

bbd701b2bb5aa0a6347f3fdefc9bbc09161d740c.source: Prince Ahmtur the Mighty: (One of the following)
bbd701b2bb5aa0a6347f3fdefc9bbc09161d740c.text: 强大的阿姆图尔王子：（以下之一）

d52446bdd2164c0255ecf846dec764254a2e6e00.source: Defeat "Palawa Joko" in the re-enactment of the Battle of Jahai (requires fighting). This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
d52446bdd2164c0255ecf846dec764254a2e6e00.text: 在贾海战役的重演中击败“Palawa Joko”（需要战斗）。这算作奖金的庆祝活动之一。

1ea3658a5e1b45240c1f5ac1762eec7624a46980.source: Beat Zilo the Drunkard in a drinking contest (does not require combat). This counts as another one of the festivities for the bonus as well.
1ea3658a5e1b45240c1f5ac1762eec7624a46980.text: 在饮酒比赛中击败酒鬼齐洛（不需要战斗）。这也算作奖金的另一项庆祝活动。

11ab5841b0fdf06d77e48df6219bae252a23ca0f.source: Speak to each prince in turn, after which Ahmtur will request that you speak with him again, triggering a cinematic of a harpy invasion of the event. You will need to complete the bonus before doing this.
11ab5841b0fdf06d77e48df6219bae252a23ca0f.text: 依次与每位王子交谈，之后阿姆图尔会要求你再次与他交谈，从而触发该事件的鹰身女妖入侵的电影。在执行此操作之前，您需要完成奖金。

61f103945714d7f7eeb114df5fedc6b82402769b.source: Tihark Orchard/Guide for a detailed walkthrough To obtain the Master's Reward, you have to participate in five festival events, which in practical terms means just two more mini-games than the minimum you need to complete the primary mission. The two optional activities listed above will meet the requirements for the bonus; it is usually a choice between dueling the mime (not required for the primary mission) or spending 5000 gold on the bribe.
61f103945714d7f7eeb114df5fedc6b82402769b.text: 提哈克果园/详细攻略指南要获得大师的奖励，您必须参加五个节日活动，这实际上意味着比完成主要任务所需的最少游戏多两个迷你游戏。上面列出的两项可选活动将满足奖金要求；通常是与哑剧决斗（主任务不需要）或花费 5000 金币进行贿赂之间的选择。

91368e78e4030b785d3e7c25b630213f12d4ff78.source: The mini-games work the same in hard or normal mode; only the harpy fight is different. However, in either case, you have enough support from the various guards and NPCs in the area that you just need to stay alive while leading your allies to the harpies (or pulling the foes towards your allies).
91368e78e4030b785d3e7c25b630213f12d4ff78.text: 迷你游戏在困难或普通模式下的工作方式相同；只是鹰身女妖的战斗有所不同。然而，无论哪种情况，你都会从该地区的各种守卫和 NPC 获得足够的支持，你只需要在带领你的盟友走向鹰身女妖（或将敌人拉向你的盟友）的同时保持活力即可。

31c98f7157f61790474b3be62a2556abcedb01e2.source: Four groups of skree will invade the orchard: one near the battle re-enactment, one at the bottom of the main stairwells, and the last near Dende and Mina's original location. To confront the invasion, you will be joined by two Palace Guards and two Vabbi Guard Captains. In addition, various NPCs will also attack the harpies, although many will flee. Even in hard mode, these allies are strong enough to defeat the skree invaders: lead the guards to each of the groups of harpies, step back a bit until the mob is killed, and repeat until the last group is killed.
31c98f7157f61790474b3be62a2556abcedb01e2.text: 四组斯克里鱼将入侵果园：一组在战斗重演地点附近，一组在主楼梯井的底部，最后一组在丹德和米娜原来的位置附近。为了对抗入侵，两名宫殿守卫和两名瓦比守卫队长将加入您的行列。此外，各种 NPC 也会攻击鹰身女妖，尽管许多人会逃跑。即使在困难模式下，这些盟友也足够强大，足以击败斯克里入侵者：带领守卫找到每组鹰身女妖，后退一步直到怪物被杀死，然后重复直到最后一组被杀死。

072066bade8801e550995977908942a1ad24f7b3.source: Tihark Orchard/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
072066bade8801e550995977908942a1ad24f7b3.text: 蒂哈克果园/详细演练指南

bc75a58f6f5091677783ad716d57c8956a7f1950.source: This is a solo mission, so you need to bring some Self-healing skills.
bc75a58f6f5091677783ad716d57c8956a7f1950.text: 这是一个单人任务，所以你需要带一些自愈技能。

f7ecd2da0eb301ad2afd760219895f302b058f22.source: Although the mission can be completed without damage-dealing skills, it goes more quickly if you bring a few.
f7ecd2da0eb301ad2afd760219895f302b058f22.text: 虽然任务可以在没有伤害处理技能的情况下完成，但如果你带一些技能的话，任务会完成得更快。

2d71de43454eb0dc0062c259074d5002dd0b9124.source: A spirit spammer can easily win all the fights, including the mini-games (you can typically create the spirits and proceed to the next game while these spirits kill any foes).
2d71de43454eb0dc0062c259074d5002dd0b9124.text: 精神垃圾邮件发送者可以轻松赢得所有战斗，包括迷你游戏（您通常可以创建精神并继续下一场游戏，同时这些精神杀死任何敌人）。

b525dc958787738c2a62d5df3521084dd6bbeed7.source: Speed boosts help you move quickly between the mini-games, which are spread far apart. You can also use shadow steps to jump between floors.
b525dc958787738c2a62d5df3521084dd6bbeed7.text: 速度提升可帮助您在相距较远的迷你游戏之间快速移动。您还可以使用影子步在楼层之间跳跃。

4abaaff844bc40ee51c2677bbb9b7a7ea4e834d8.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
4abaaff844bc40ee51c2677bbb9b7a7ea4e834d8.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献了约 3.2%。

f210e9c142fa9619bdffc0fb1a8cfa1a56889d3d.source: If you let the guards by the north stairwell fall to the Harpies and leave the Harpies on the south balcony (near Dende and Mina), you can take the north stairwell to explore the entire orchard area for the Elonian Cartographer title. You can come back to the south Harpies to finish the mission after you have finished exploring. Exploring the whole map this way takes about 25 minutes with speed boosts.
f210e9c142fa9619bdffc0fb1a8cfa1a56889d3d.text: 如果你让北楼梯间的守卫落到鹰身女妖身上，并将鹰身女妖留在南阳台（靠近丹德和米娜），你就可以走北楼梯间探索整个果园区域以获得埃洛尼安制图师头衔。探索完成后可以回到南鹰身女妖那里完成任务。以这种方式探索整个地图大约需要 25 分钟，并且速度会有所提升。

318b7476c34dbdf14136cea7d5fa338169c09b14.source: Alternatively, bring Death's Retreat, Return, Heart of Shadow or Ebon Escape and shadow step past the guards (e.g. by using the skill on a dropped item).
318b7476c34dbdf14136cea7d5fa338169c09b14.text: 或者，将死亡撤退、归来、暗影之心或黑檀逃生以及暗影步带过守卫（例如，通过在掉落的物品上使用该技能）。

6200e3daad6cee703d8548e88d201c52816e4316.source: Looting a Food or Drink tray before the final Harpies are killed by the guards will cause your character to be holding it in the final cinematic. This has no impact on the story.
6200e3daad6cee703d8548e88d201c52816e4316.text: 在最终的鹰身女妖被守卫杀死之前抢劫食物或饮料托盘将导致你的角色在最终的过场动画中拿着它。这对故事没有影响。

f7c20ef7f4488b33519a6666b9fa6f5429a7b839.source: If you leave the Harpies be and take the north-eastern way to the back of the garden, you will see the princes, Norgu, Goren, Talhkora and Vabbi Guards standing ready for the final cinematic.
f7c20ef7f4488b33519a6666b9fa6f5429a7b839.text: 如果你离开鹰身女妖，沿着东北方向到达花园后面，你会看到王子、诺尔古、戈伦、塔尔科拉和瓦比守卫正准备好迎接最后的过场动画。

46743895bd8e322145006200d099b174ad7f2170.source: Tahlkora appears in the mission as a level 12 Monk, wearing her own armor and weapons (wand and focus item).
46743895bd8e322145006200d099b174ad7f2170.text: 塔尔科拉在任务中以 12 级武僧的身份出现，穿着她自己的盔甲和武器（魔杖和焦点物品）。

f7163b05181e0913661be0ba384f13129122562c.source: Death during this mission will cause a note to come up saying "MISSION FAILED: You died during the party. Drink responsibly next time!"
f7163b05181e0913661be0ba384f13129122562c.text: 在此任务期间死亡将导致出现一条提示，上面写着“任务失败：你在聚会期间死亡。下次请负责任地饮酒！”

6d7153bcbf1da59de3c0118fb29518f75c9c21f1.source: You can participate in six festival activities: the dance, the mime duel, the re-enactment, the drinking duel, obtaining the vase, and bribing the finance minister. To obtain Master's Reward, you only need to participate in five.
6d7153bcbf1da59de3c0118fb29518f75c9c21f1.text: 你可以参加六种节日活动：舞蹈、默剧决斗、重演、饮酒决斗、获得花瓶、贿赂财政部长。想要获得大师奖励，只需要参加五个即可。

5e77f58a5a4828c0b24010288a3ef484698671ec.source: After completing this mission, your character will be taken to The Kodash Bazaar.
5e77f58a5a4828c0b24010288a3ef484698671ec.text: 完成此任务后，您的角色将被带到 Kodash Bazaar。

300871379b75e3ce7967ea8e18e8e7ca883cef77.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #7 in the Night Falls storybook.
300871379b75e3ce7967ea8e18e8e7ca883cef77.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 7 页。

67bcd71f1c713e3f09fca5948ef8b313f232eaa2.source: Unlike Augury Rock, you can use summoning stones during this mission. As with Margrid in "No Me, No Kormir", Morgahn will call you an Istani even if you are a Prophecies or Factions character.
67bcd71f1c713e3f09fca5948ef8b313f232eaa2.text: 与占卜岩不同的是，您可以在此任务中使用召唤石。就像《No Me, No Kormir》中的玛格丽特一样，即使你是预言或派系角色，摩根也会称你为伊斯塔尼。

75542f8f34b45d2012009bd19f586ec8761a5057.source: Meet Kehanni in the the Mirror of Lyss.
75542f8f34b45d2012009bd19f586ec8761a5057.text: 在利斯之镜中遇见科汉尼。

0a2499fd7a1a41b764a3e557f4798428786afbd7.source: Schmooze with Bokka the Magnificent at his palace in Resplendent Makuun.
0a2499fd7a1a41b764a3e557f4798428786afbd7.text: 与博卡大帝在辉煌马库恩的宫殿里闲聊。

92614801c378a71cf603ead6a0674cf90c0a5273.source: Hobnob with Vaughn the Venerable at the Bokka Amphitheatre.
92614801c378a71cf603ead6a0674cf90c0a5273.text: 与沃恩尊者在博卡圆形剧场霍布诺布。

98c39173f412e054699067ae0204fdb8cf31a69f.source: It's a trap! Defeat the Kournan elite forces.
98c39173f412e054699067ae0204fdb8cf31a69f.text: 这是一个陷阱！击败库尔南精锐部队。

77c42b8e022826a66da7e5b0e0fbbb59d9406518.source: See Royal Finance Minister Oluda for your reward.
77c42b8e022826a66da7e5b0e0fbbb59d9406518.text: 前往皇家财政部长奥鲁达领取奖励。

27725f3f638a9718b2693e6598215d57471b7e24.source: After accepting the quest from Rendu, head North out of the Kodash Bazaar through The Mirror of Lyss and follow the map to Kehanni, who is just outside of the Grand Court of Sebelkeh. Before continuing, enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh to save traveling time later.
27725f3f638a9718b2693e6598215d57471b7e24.text: 接受伦杜的任务后，从科达什集市向北穿过里斯之镜，按照地图到达塞贝尔克大庭院外的科汉尼。在继续之前，请先进入 Sebelkeh 大法院，以节省稍后的旅行时间。

998b29b9a5349db73d2ca1b5e93fdb94677a1424.source: Exit back into The Mirror of Lyss and head southeast to enter the Honur Hill outpost.
998b29b9a5349db73d2ca1b5e93fdb94677a1424.text: 返回里斯之镜并向东南方向进入荣誉山前哨站。

ba077962e1c93d136bf282880a402a3c622e4640.source: Follow the map through Resplendent Makuun to talk to Prince Bokka the Magnificent, and then follow the quest marker which leads to Bokka Amphitheatre. Head through the portal and watch the play until Ernald the Exact says "This is my favorite part." - at which point the actors reveal themselves to be a Kournan ambush.
ba077962e1c93d136bf282880a402a3c622e4640.text: 沿着地图穿过辉煌的马库恩与宏伟的博卡王子交谈，然后按照任务标记前往博卡露天剧场。穿过传送门观看比赛，直到埃纳德说“这是我最喜欢的部分”。 - 此时，演员们发现自己是库南的伏击者。

904dd67fe505015d5b9c3b3c5446ebcbaa320724.source: Once you have defeated the Kournans, travel back to Honur Hill and talk to Royal Finance Minister Oluda for your reward and the next quest (if you want to see a cinematic, approach the exit to Resplendent Makuun before map travel).
904dd67fe505015d5b9c3b3c5446ebcbaa320724.text: 一旦你打败了库南人，就回到荣誉山并与皇家财政部长奥鲁达交谈以获得奖励和下一个任务（如果你想看电影，请在地图旅行之前接近辉煌马库恩的出口）。

f3f1e31e863a7fe54468a25a12b2d57cfaaaf579.source: It is advisable, after talking to Kehanni, to proceed past her (to the northeast) and enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh. This outpost will make later exploration, quests and missions easier to complete if you can map travel to this location. Outposts exist at each corner of The Mirror of Lyss and all are important to the storyline.
f3f1e31e863a7fe54468a25a12b2d57cfaaaf579.text: 与凯汉妮交谈后，建议经过她（向东北方）进入塞贝尔克大庭院。如果您可以绘制前往该位置的旅行地图，该前哨将使以后的探索、任务和任务更容易完成。前哨站存在于里斯之镜的每个角落，并且对故事情节都很重要。

4ec4297c7118fd2def1e746dc8b58559c24f0975.source: Tyrian players will recognize the play as a loosely told story of the events of Prophecies leading up to the refugees' arrival in Kryta
4ec4297c7118fd2def1e746dc8b58559c24f0975.text: 泰瑞亚玩家会认为该剧是一个松散讲述的故事，讲述了导致难民抵达科瑞塔的预言事件

c0c4f65f8d1a08d5eeeae122799f83f30d930ecf.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Pongmei Valley.

2273907b736599ee572caf75b2614244f229ffec.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Pongmei Valley, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
2273907b736599ee572caf75b2614244f229ffec.text: 完成此任务会改变庞美谷中出现的敌人，具体来说，受折磨的将不再生成。

ca2b7e6354bb5b4f37d774665317e193de6826b9.source: Leave from Boreas Seabed or Maatu Keep. Follow the quest marker to an Afflicted group with an abnormally large Afflicted warrior boss; use melee counters (such as Empathy and Soothing Images). Avoid applying conditions to the boss, as it will use its only heal. You must kill all the Afflicted there, so it pays to focus on the healers first and leave the boss until the end.
ca2b7e6354bb5b4f37d774665317e193de6826b9.text: 从北风之神海底或马图城堡出发。跟随任务标记到达一个受苦群体，那里有一个异常庞大的受苦战士首领；使用近战对抗物（例如移情和舒缓图像）。避免对 Boss 施加条件，因为它会使用唯一的治疗。你必须杀死那里所有的受折磨者，所以首先集中精力治疗治疗者并离开老板直到最后是值得的。

855090fb9d0c97adcda8b392ae0635ab9b4f655d.source: If you wait a short while after defeating the Afflicted, you will see a Ministry Captain approach and initiate a dialogue.
855090fb9d0c97adcda8b392ae0635ab9b4f655d.text: 如果你在击败受折磨者后稍等片刻，你会看到部委队长走近并发起对话。

b9bd2f07b7d023a6cdfa940fd67388478c34457e.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Ice Floe and start the mission. Completing Iron Mines of Moladune also brings the party here.
b9bd2f07b7d023a6cdfa940fd67388478c34457e.text: 任何角色都可以简单地从浮冰走进前哨站并开始任务。完成莫拉杜纳铁矿后，聚会也会来到这里。

d192cdd1b7c2e328ff674c454b6674c1938b21b3.text: 杀死达格纳尔·斯通佩特。

8bf959be9c48c6aa461ac0572f73b2855a0b3581.source: Help King Jalis Ironhammer hold Thunderhead Keep.
8bf959be9c48c6aa461ac0572f73b2855a0b3581.text: 帮助贾利斯·铁锤国王守住雷头要塞。

187b4b5ab54ac1be0cfb2ed482ee0dd680ece689.text: 与贾利斯·铁锤国王交谈。

7d53a1768ab96234594064112e3cd269b02518d4.source: *BONUS* Light the beacons to draw additional Mursaat forces into Thunderhead Keep.
7d53a1768ab96234594064112e3cd269b02518d4.text: *奖励* 点亮信标以吸引更多的穆萨特部队进入雷头堡。

8ba5d8d544d07f9fd6ced8df62e4b740f731b7af.source: The goal is to recover the Deldrimor Dwarves' capital city and fort while protecting King Jalis Ironhammer. The mission is divided into four stages: getting to the capital, clearing it of foes, breaching the fort, and then defending it against a siege.
8ba5d8d544d07f9fd6ced8df62e4b740f731b7af.text: 目标是收复德尔德里莫矮人的首都和要塞，同时保护贾利斯·铁锤国王。任务分为四个阶段：到达首都、清除敌人、攻破堡垒、然后防御围攻。

3582087f453a6200e4befc6ea65950cd3a67efb2.source: Reaching the city is straightforward: talk to King Jalis Ironhammer to open the first gate; he will then follow whichever party member talked to him first - he will follow that player until the cutscene. Cross the bridge and then head north-west. There is an incoming patrol at the end of this bridge, so pull the first mob towards the bridge and kill them before the other one arrives.
3582087f453a6200e4befc6ea65950cd3a67efb2.text: 到达城市很简单：与贾利斯·铁锤国王交谈以打开第一道门；然后他将跟随第一个与他交谈的党员 - 他将跟随该玩家直到过场动画。过桥，然后向西北方向行驶。这座桥的尽头有一支巡逻队即将到来，因此将第一批暴徒拉向桥并在另一只暴徒到达之前杀死他们。

b1ad26dc1478f4e2a496a4605addde2ff638bc3d.source: Once inside the city, bring Jalis to the gate at the eastern side of the city and he will open it with Claim Resource. The mission objective says to clear the groups inside the city, but this is not required. Now follow the path leading to the fort.
b1ad26dc1478f4e2a496a4605addde2ff638bc3d.text: 进入城市后，将贾利斯带到城市东侧的大门，他将通过索取资源打开大门。任务目标是清除城市内的团体，但这不是必需的。现在沿着通往堡垒的小路走。

7fb13e9ffb7c8e095a4cfa1c804eec1b618ed709.source: Defeat the Stone Summit led by Dagnar Stonepate inside the fort. When the western groups are killed, Jalis will say "Deldrimor declares war!". Killing all the fort groups triggers a cutscene, teleporting Jalis to the top of the fort; he will no longer follow the party.
7fb13e9ffb7c8e095a4cfa1c804eec1b618ed709.text: 击败堡垒内达格纳尔·石板领导的石峰。当西方群体被杀时，贾利斯会说“德尔德里莫宣战！”。杀死所有堡垒群体会触发过场动画，将贾利斯传送到堡垒顶部；他将不再追随党。

bb9ce9a183dd5642a38c306c037029af8d0f603b.source: When Deldrimor declares war, waves of Stone Summit and Jade constructs start spawning and approaching the fort. After 2 minutes and 15 seconds, a Stone Summit boss group spawns. When this entire group dies, Jalis says "The Mantle followed you! Stand fast friends! This will be our finest hour!". Waves of White Mantle start spawning to the north of the fort, and Jade constructs near the teleporter further to the north. After exactly 3 minutes, a Mursaat boss group spawns. When this entire group dies, Jalis says "Be on your guard. The left hand of Grenth himself comes for us.". Waves of Mursaat start spawning near the teleporter. After 9 minutes and 40 seconds, Confessor Dorian and a group of White Mantle spawn near the teleporter. They take a strange route to the fort, stopping for a while to the north-east before turning back and entering through the west. Kill this entire group and then talk to Jalis to complete the mission.
bb9ce9a183dd5642a38c306c037029af8d0f603b.text: 当德尔德里莫宣战时，一波又一波的石峰和玉石建筑开始生成并接近堡垒。 2 分 15 秒后，石峰 Boss 群出现。当整个团队死去时，贾利斯说：“斗篷追随着你！朋友们，坚守住！这将是我们最美好的时刻！”。一波又一波的白斗篷开始在要塞的北边生成，而杰德则在更北边的传送器附近建造。正好 3 分钟后，穆萨特 Boss 组就会出现。当整个团队死亡时，贾利斯说：“保持警惕。古伦斯本人的左手会来抓我们。”。穆尔萨特的浪潮开始在传送器附近生成。 9 分 40 秒后，忏悔者多里安和一群白斗篷在传送器附近产卵。他们沿着一条奇怪的路线到达堡垒，在东北方停留了一会儿，然后折回并从西边进入。杀死整个队伍，然后与贾利斯交谈以完成任务。

90b9ffa7b3aaef0454ccd2ff024319181905883f.source: It is possible to interact with the Firing Levers to harm the waves of enemies as they approach the fort.
90b9ffa7b3aaef0454ccd2ff024319181905883f.text: 当敌人接近堡垒时，可以与发射杆互动来伤害他们。

991c8b562c8b0ecfc14846ed217c4837b02e8766.source: The bonus requires the party to prevent the death of Dwarven allies located outside the fort by lighting two Storm Beacons with Enchanted Torches that spawn after the cutscene, which draw enemies to the fort and away from the unprotected Dwarves. Both beacons are on opposite sides of the fort, on the east and west walls.
991c8b562c8b0ecfc14846ed217c4837b02e8766.text: 奖励要求队伍通过在过场动画后生成的魔法火把点燃两个风暴信标来防止位于堡垒外的矮人盟友死亡，这会将敌人吸引到堡垒并远离未受保护的矮人。两个信标分别位于堡垒的两侧、东墙上和西墙上。

ba342ecee8379e6a00f2c64ca9191fafc1d79391.source: The bonus fails if the beacons are not lit within about a minute of Deldrimor declaring war. There is enough time for a single player without speed boosts to light both beacons. Do not try to carry a torch between the beacons; otherwise the bundle will slow the runner down too much. There is a torch at either beacon, allowing the player to drop and leave the torch at the lit beacons. With more players in the party, both beacons can be lit simultaneously.
ba342ecee8379e6a00f2c64ca9191fafc1d79391.text: 如果德尔德里莫宣战后大约一分钟内信标没有点亮，奖励就会失败。对于没有速度提升的单个玩家来说，有足够的时间来点亮两个信标。不要试图在信标之间携带火炬；否则捆绑包会使跑步者减慢太多。两个信标处都有一个火炬，允许玩家将火炬放下并留在点亮的信标处。随着队伍中玩家的增多，两个信标可以同时点亮。

10f76db03b67d6f3820a2aef15b02f8a04e489e7.source: Unfortunately, the quest log does not update on the Dwarves' survival. The only indication the bonus was failed is if the Dwarves cry out, "The end is here! Great Dwarf save us!" If that text does not appear in party chat, it is an indirect confirmation of success.
10f76db03b67d6f3820a2aef15b02f8a04e489e7.text: 不幸的是，任务日志没有更新矮人的生存情况。奖金失败的唯一迹象是矮人喊道：“末日来了！伟大的矮人救救我们！”如果该文本没有出现在群组聊天中，则间接确认成功。

6e920364728c8f9c2ec029384bd31982ef5428dd.source: Once the last attacker dies, the quest log will update, and a quest marker will appear over Ironhammer's head. Speaking with him concludes the mission. The bonus will be awarded at that point, if it was completed successfully.
6e920364728c8f9c2ec029384bd31982ef5428dd.text: 一旦最后一个攻击者死亡，任务日志就会更新，并且任务标记将出现在铁锤的头上。与他交谈就结束了任务。如果成功完成，奖金将在此时颁发。

82a053b475fc598230e2c2214e30a6f4bca85693.source: There are three main techniques for successfully defending against the siege, based on where you confront the mobs: at the gates, with the king, or by taking the fight to the teleporter.
82a053b475fc598230e2c2214e30a6f4bca85693.text: 成功防御围攻的主要技巧有3种，具体取决于你面对暴民的地点：在门口、与国王一起战斗，或者在传送点战斗。

5f764fc74a61c1fafb45dfdb0d1bfbb6d159ad23.source: Split the party into two groups to block each gate; this keeps the King safely away. The courtyard's width prevents the two groups from working together, but they will be close enough that one or two members can run back and forth to assist. Ranged characters can fight from atop the walls. Use the ballistae to weaken foes before they reach a gate.
5f764fc74a61c1fafb45dfdb0d1bfbb6d159ad23.text: 将队伍分成两组，封锁每个大门；这可以让国王安全地远离。庭院的宽度阻止了两个小组一起工作，但他们足够近，一两个成员可以来回跑来帮忙。远程角色可以在城墙上进行战斗。在敌人到达大门之前使用弩炮削弱敌人。

549e3e3657d84ed3be1262508b1044525f88b073.source: Pro: The King is never at risk.
549e3e3657d84ed3be1262508b1044525f88b073.text: 优点：国王永远不会面临风险。

7ed20e74e7ee647c86912e343c45fad0cb641146.source: Con: The split groups are weak against strong assaults.
7ed20e74e7ee647c86912e343c45fad0cb641146.text: 缺点：分裂的群体对于强力攻击来说很弱。

cfd9a1a785f8882a6ad18b445705d800986d8e4b.source: Hold your ground between the center beacon and the King. Regardless from which gate these small mobs enter, they always converge at the top of the stairs. However, if enemies enter the King's aggro area, he will join the fight, which makes him difficult to protect as he will not move back.
cfd9a1a785f8882a6ad18b445705d800986d8e4b.text: 坚守在中心灯塔和国王之间。这些小怪物无论从哪扇门进入，总是会聚集在楼梯顶上。然而，如果敌人进入国王的仇恨区域，他就会加入战斗，这使得他很难保护，因为他不会后退。

b6c0fec10dba47287b8cf6f77b107f7ef43ccb36.source: Pro: The party outnumbers enemies. Easier to manage with heroes and henchmen.
b6c0fec10dba47287b8cf6f77b107f7ef43ccb36.text: 优点：党的数量多于敌人。更容易管理英雄和追随者。

cd2a312489403cdedb5ea7d210ec211330b65ed4.source: Con: The King will be at risk. Also, the King will run after enemies if they get in his range and may take some time to return to his normal position.
cd2a312489403cdedb5ea7d210ec211330b65ed4.text: 缺点：国王将面临危险。此外，如果敌人进入他的射程，国王会追赶敌人，并且可能需要一些时间才能恢复到正常位置。

9ebbe6f0e169c11314c70efdacc578e4c72d6cda.source: Parties with strong firepower can push back the incoming waves to their spawn point to the north since they all pass through a choke point. Players will stand at full force while keeping the King completely away from battle. Jades along the way (not the ones that spawn) can be ignored, as they are part of the bonus and will not attack the King. Single foes that split during this procedure can be killed by Smoke Phantom allies.
9ebbe6f0e169c11314c70efdacc578e4c72d6cda.text: 拥有强大火力的队伍可以将来袭的海浪推回其北部的重生点，因为它们都会经过阻塞点。玩家将全力站立，同时让国王完全远离战斗。沿途的玉石（不是生成的玉石）可以忽略，因为它们是奖励的一部分，不会攻击国王。在此过程中分裂的单个敌人可以被烟雾幻影盟友杀死。

e37f4711a24e4a12e767404f7cf362922f14c10a.source: Pro: Allows the party to be at full strength.
e37f4711a24e4a12e767404f7cf362922f14c10a.text: 优点：让队伍处于全力状态。

12072076860853f5a97d10ca97db0b1fcea06bae.source: Con: Difficult in Hard mode to reach the Mursaat teleporter or to regroup if any foe slips.
12072076860853f5a97d10ca97db0b1fcea06bae.text: 缺点：在困难模式下很难到达穆尔萨特传送器，或者在任何敌人滑倒时很难重新集结。

c5f3743b5dced55e0d35ff6a30df2e488e66b9f7.source: Although the foes are considerably more difficult in hard mode, the techniques are the same. Keep a more careful eye on the king's health throughout the mission.
c5f3743b5dced55e0d35ff6a30df2e488e66b9f7.text: 尽管困难模式下的敌人要困难得多，但技术是相同的。在整个任务过程中要更加密切地关注国王的健康状况。

efa7272285797c6fba57dea48f888ea32d8b2225.source: Ward of Stability to counter Summit Giant Herders's Giant Stomp.
efa7272285797c6fba57dea48f888ea32d8b2225.text: 稳定结界可以对抗山顶巨人牧民的巨人践踏。

0ccce97e01b51a37d3b8f3a4a6499400896fa86a.text: 仆从/灵魂数量超过敌人。

11ab58fd4b696d862dc210a5259a0f853ef33179.source: AoE skills, especially if using the defend the king method.
11ab58fd4b696d862dc210a5259a0f853ef33179.text: AoE技能，尤其是使用守王法时。

4a0e311f2c1c624c70632adcb0e0138603c103d8.source: Hex removal skills, or the king will often die from hex overload.
4a0e311f2c1c624c70632adcb0e0138603c103d8.text: 去除妖术的技能，否则国王经常会因妖术过载而死亡。

be453a06a41da10a91b58d9917d8aac309be002a.source: When facing Dagnar there are two walls which each hold two ballistae. The ballista on the left can be fired to kill a mob of eight enemies before killing Dagnar, giving you fewer enemies to fight in the siege.
be453a06a41da10a91b58d9917d8aac309be002a.text: 当面对达格纳尔时，有两堵墙，每堵墙都有两把弩炮。在杀死达格纳尔之前，可以发射左侧的弩炮来杀死八名敌人，从而减少围攻中需要战斗的敌人。

63ec208d2118d39b0c110199fd29e488690e4774.source: The siege portion of the mission can be managed (even in hard mode) without effort by a player with 7 heroes/henchmen (i.e. while AFK):
63ec208d2118d39b0c110199fd29e488690e4774.text: 任务的攻城部分可以由拥有 7 个英雄/追随者的玩家轻松管理（即使在困难模式下）（即 AFK 时）：

5b882359e7016253a19d2e3edf0151da4ef789d6.source: Flag heroes at the top of the stairs, somewhat apart.
5b882359e7016253a19d2e3edf0151da4ef789d6.text: 在楼梯顶部标记英雄，稍稍分开。

ec9cf72e2f0b9b3829bb84bab7dfca759d454fbb.text: 将他们的模式更改为战斗。

2d3d6901fc4509e8d1fc891de03886e391e44f8b.source: Ensure you have a balanced party.
2d3d6901fc4509e8d1fc891de03886e391e44f8b.text: 确保你有一个平衡的聚会。

2f6310d8462df2a8639658fd5c02608a77342abd.source: This is the first of only four missions required to reach the end of the Prophecies storyline.
2f6310d8462df2a8639658fd5c02608a77342abd.text: 这是到达预言故事情节结尾所需的四个任务中的第一个。

58126e77be9b31361d6931a73bba734f6cbd984f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
58126e77be9b31361d6931a73bba734f6cbd984f.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.1%。

b52c7866f00c4e88209541e1c7a70c19ecddcdef.source: You can easily explore the north part of the map after Confessor Dorian has been killed. No more mobs will spawn after him, and the mission will not end until you speak to King Jalis.
b52c7866f00c4e88209541e1c7a70c19ecddcdef.text: 忏悔者多里安被杀后，你可以轻松探索地图的北部。在他之后不会再出现任何小怪，并且在您与贾利斯国王交谈之前任务不会结束。

3a6f0c537b97f8f01738d2ed140d4b3f979514e7.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #15 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
3a6f0c537b97f8f01738d2ed140d4b3f979514e7.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 15 页。

60e0f935884e78cc34cfc6322c5f0926836dbc1b.source: After completing this mission, your party travels to Ember Light Camp using the Mursaat teleporter.
60e0f935884e78cc34cfc6322c5f0926836dbc1b.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将使用穆尔萨特传送器前往灰烬之光营地。

a1228c97fd9eeb65ac2448647d36d4e879ecc2ed.source: Sometimes King Jalis Ironhammer will get stuck on a hill near the beginning of the mission. If this occurs, you must restart the mission, and try again. Sometimes if you take the bonus the first boss will stay outside the walls. Even if you kill that mob the spawns will stop. If this occurs, you must restart the mission, and try again. King Jalis may open the gates to the fort before killing all the mobs of city foes. After you clear the fort, the first objective will be counted as completed and you can complete the mission with remaining foes in the city. The extra foes sent to the fort from the Bonus are hostile towards all other enemies, even of the same kind. The bonus timer can be started before the cutscene depending on which foes you kill first. This will cause you to easily fail the bonus due to not enough time. The White Mantle and Mursaat foes that are supposedly spawned from the portal at the northernmost point of the mission actually appear in the clearing just south of the portal before running up to it and then starting their patrol route.
a1228c97fd9eeb65ac2448647d36d4e879ecc2ed.text: 有时，贾利斯·铁锤国王会在任务开始时被困在一座小山上。如果发生这种情况，您必须重新启动任务，然后重试。 Sometimes if you take the bonus the first boss will stay outside the walls.即使你杀死了那个怪物，生成也会停止。如果发生这种情况，您必须重新启动任务，然后重试。贾利斯国王可能会在杀死所有城市敌人之前打开堡垒的大门。清除堡垒后，第一个目标将被视为已完成，您可以与城市中剩余的敌人一起完成任务。从奖励发送到堡垒的额外敌人对所有其他敌人充满敌意，即使是同类敌人。奖励计时器可以在过场动画之前启动，具体取决于您首先杀死的敌人。这会导致你很容易因为时间不够而无法获得奖金。据称是从任务最北端的传送门生成的白斗篷和穆萨特敌人实际上出现在传送门以南的空地上，然后跑到传送门并开始巡逻路线。

64902fef63b0a06b94b116661c28896450f992e8.source: During the ending cinematic, the Undead Lich and Spoiler-related boss can be seen near a cave to the north guarded by some jade.
64902fef63b0a06b94b116661c28896450f992e8.text: 在结尾动画中，可以在北部的一个洞穴附近看到不死巫妖和与剧透相关的 Boss，该洞穴由一些玉石守卫。

e4ee273d5a5ffb1c1405fac535537280b6d26b31.source: Completion of Minister Cho's Estate mission to gain access to Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area).
e4ee273d5a5ffb1c1405fac535537280b6d26b31.text: 完成赵部长庄园任务，进入赵部长庄园（可探索区域）。

48537dace98dea3036d1afa82af09230d00d1194.source: Search for survivors at Minister Cho's Estate.
48537dace98dea3036d1afa82af09230d00d1194.text: 在赵部长的庄园寻找幸存者。

96c6d2808fbf2de2709179f44380d57440395b21.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Minister Cho's Estate. Afflicted will no longer spawn, being replaced by Scavengers.
96c6d2808fbf2de2709179f44380d57440395b21.text: 完成此任务会改变出现在赵部长庄园中的敌人。受折磨的生物将不再生成，取而代之的是拾荒者。

1db71b6ac4ef7f952600d39320672381cff15fb4.source: Start from Ran Musu Gardens and take the northern exit. There are three peasants whom you have to save: one is in the Menagerie, one is in the Foh Wing, and one is on the island to the northeast. You must kill all the mobs near each peasant for the quest to progress - if you don't get the update dialogue, keep hunting.
1db71b6ac4ef7f952600d39320672381cff15fb4.text: 从冉木宿花园出发，从北出口走。你必须拯救三名农民：一名在动物园，一名在福翼，一名在东北的岛上。你必须杀死每个农民附近的所有小怪才能取得进展 - 如果你没有收到更新对话，请继续狩猎。

238b8bbaca0f3b957a20fe7b3d770f77b361272b.source: Most Afflicted mobs in this area are groups of four and can be taken down by a moderately powerful party, but the mobs are close together and their patrol patterns can overlap. Careful pulling is essential to avoid being overwhelmed, especially for the first few groups near the start.
238b8bbaca0f3b957a20fe7b3d770f77b361272b.text: 该地区大多数受影响的生物都是四人一组，可以被中等实力的队伍击倒，但这些生物距离很近，巡逻模式可能会重叠。小心拉动对于避免被淹没至关重要，特别是对于开始时的前几组。

1d3def71dc36a97296d69a23bb8cbedbee95f35e.source: After rescuing the first peasant the player can choose between two paths on the way to the second peasant: The short northern path or the longer and more difficult southern path.
1d3def71dc36a97296d69a23bb8cbedbee95f35e.text: 拯救第一个农民后，玩家可以在前往第二个农民的两条路径之间进行选择：较短的北方路径或较长且更困难的南方路径。

f94f5e8c083ef8518b301c1d2bbef75ab16c46be.source: The shorter northern path is filled with yet more Sickened animals.
f94f5e8c083ef8518b301c1d2bbef75ab16c46be.text: 较短的北边小路充满了更多生病的动物。

a09acc9a1b47c066bf096b0c0712ddeed2c034f1.source: The longer southern path, which heads south before U-turning back up north, is filled with Afflicted, which are tougher than the animals with more diverse skills.
a09acc9a1b47c066bf096b0c0712ddeed2c034f1.text: 较长的南部道路向南延伸，然后掉头返回北方，充满了受折磨的动物，它们比具有更多样化技能的动物更坚韧。

baad622ed1f91803264b7bb4d36f7844d34174e9.source: The player should pick the path that is easiest for their party's design. After saving the second peasant, the player has two options when saving the last peasant: the beach path and the island path.
baad622ed1f91803264b7bb4d36f7844d34174e9.text: 玩家应该选择最适合其队伍设计的路径。拯救第二个农民后，玩家在拯救最后一个农民时有两个选择：海滩路径和岛屿路径。

738d1aeb473924b49fa813498ed99adcce2980c0.source: Eliminate any Assassins first - they will likely shadow step to your party and away from their allies.
738d1aeb473924b49fa813498ed99adcce2980c0.text: 首先消灭所有刺客——他们可能会暗步到你的队伍中并远离他们的盟友。

6e7079f35f192425b8f188830c416f2be166204e.source: Pull each group of Afflicted, this will assist in moving any Ritualists away from their spirits and can help avoid over-aggro due to close placement of Afflicted groups.
6e7079f35f192425b8f188830c416f2be166204e.text: 拉动每组受灾者，这将有助于使任何仪式者远离他们的精神，并有助于避免由于受灾者群体的紧密放置而导致过度仇恨。

6700adaa255cacac4cfa149917615daf5ad4226f.source: Spirit spammers and minion masters are very helpful, since you are limited to four party members.
6700adaa255cacac4cfa149917615daf5ad4226f.text: 精神垃圾邮件发送者和仆从大师非常有帮助，因为你的队伍成员仅限于四名。

37d23b418250cfa0a7cbf0ca369a4ddcbcfc7764.source: Proceed slowly. If using spirits, wait for them to recharge so you can setup spirit walls.
37d23b418250cfa0a7cbf0ca369a4ddcbcfc7764.text: 慢慢地进行。如果使用灵魂，请等待它们充电，以便您可以设置灵魂墙。

c27039320ada39c0a5ee8f2bd0ec13e7eaf734c8.source: If using heros, follow the yellow path - the other route has points where the heroes will not listen to flags.
c27039320ada39c0a5ee8f2bd0ec13e7eaf734c8.text: 如果使用英雄，请沿着黄色路径走 - 另一条路线有英雄不会听旗帜的点。

7bb1b6db97eac6fbecf22e61589ded5c8c6d06bd.source: Consider consumables such as Death Penalty removal and/or summoning stones.
7bb1b6db97eac6fbecf22e61589ded5c8c6d06bd.text: 考虑消耗品，例如消除死刑和/或召唤石。

e4e48854e24a2b6c542e25ada443f3af1883bd84.source: Quest markers do not display the peasants' locations. The final dialogue "our work here is done" can be shown and the quest can still fail. This happens when you lure Afflicted far away from the last peasant and kill this group of Afflicted when the peasant is outside the party area.
e4e48854e24a2b6c542e25ada443f3af1883bd84.text: 任务标记不显示农民的位置。可以显示最终对话“我们的工作已经完成”，但任务仍然可能失败。当你将受苦者引诱到远离最后一个农民并在农民位于聚会区域之外时杀死这群受苦者时，就会发生这种情况。

2e074799ad1b65a0bd5a184e211740f38de0dab1.text: 警告科汉尼瓦雷什的军队。

f103bdca6e67a6b20da01dd7a1adc50fbf20a7c7.source: Destroy the vanguard assaulting the temple.
f103bdca6e67a6b20da01dd7a1adc50fbf20a7c7.text: 消灭袭击圣殿的先锋队。

6bdabc313926460690758d5d667e08b4ee31c8a4.source: See Head Priest Vahmani for your reward.
6bdabc313926460690758d5d667e08b4ee31c8a4.text: 去见祭司长瓦赫玛尼以获得奖励。

318c36761965590e9193aa758840fe3096f38d67.source: This quest will lead you to Grand Court of Sebelkeh if you don't already have it on your World Map. If you do have it, map travel to it, exit west into the Mirror of Lyss and follow the quest arrow to meet Kehanni nearby.
318c36761965590e9193aa758840fe3096f38d67.text: 如果你的世界地图上还没有塞贝尔克大庭院，这个任务将引导你前往它。如果你确实拥有它，请在地图上前往它，向西退出进入利斯之镜，然后按照任务箭头在附近与凯汉尼会面。

f249cec85544bf2812eb48a390830180f7d78a6a.source: A mob of Margonites led by the Paragon boss, Overseer Juntahk, are also nearby and as you approach Kehanni, they will start to advance towards her. Defeat the Margonites to continue the quest. It's worth noting that Kehanni is accompanied by three level 20 Lyssan Priests who are monks, staying near them and allowing the Margonites to approach instead, ensures the party can remain fully healed throughout the fight.
f249cec85544bf2812eb48a390830180f7d78a6a.text: 由Paragon Boss、督军Juntahk领导的一群Margonites也在附近，当你接近Kehanni时，他们会开始向她前进。击败玛贡尼特以继续任务。值得注意的是，Kehanni 身边有三名 20 级的 Lyssan 牧师，他们是僧侣，呆在他们附近并允许 Margonites 接近，确保队伍在整个战斗中能够保持完全治疗。

475f1885b933ac6c5a39acb15e21c857988e7c37.text: 杀死内部议会成员阿盖尔。

7030c4e3dba92e99341e110dbacfeac076b78094.text: 杀死内部委员会成员玻利瓦尔。

ab6936d11977ef152b48fe4a955efcb7757f1d09.text: 杀死内部议会成员卡斯伯特。

d66ef29bf11e848d9d33819f30b316a5181d773a.source: See Fogard Axemighty for your reward.
d66ef29bf11e848d9d33819f30b316a5181d773a.text: 请参阅 Fogard Axemighty 以获得奖励。

350b46b0b32f9b5b6f0dee62ea6e0074ac160b75.source: After accepting this quest's reward, the Inner Council Members (Argyle, Bolivar, and Cuthbert) and White Mantle will no longer spawn in Perdition Rock.
350b46b0b32f9b5b6f0dee62ea6e0074ac160b75.text: 接受此任务的奖励后，内部议会成员（阿盖尔、玻利瓦尔和卡斯伯特）和白斗篷将不再在毁灭岩中生成。

be32f511f9b7c45558b193fc306151c4b79a65c7.source: This quest may prove difficult for players discovering Perdition Rock for the first time due to the high density of foes and patrols that can easily cause aggro.
be32f511f9b7c45558b193fc306151c4b79a65c7.text: 对于第一次发现毁灭岩的玩家来说，这个任务可能会很困难，因为敌人和巡逻队的密度很高，很容易引起仇恨。

e017bf2335149253bbec8cf3c1c02e3e1ab81ab2.source: Exit Ember Light Camp into Perdition Rock. The first area has many patrols of Mahgo Hydras, Flesh Golems and Dark Flame Dryders that will gather in front of you, then go counterclockwise around the central pit of lava.
e017bf2335149253bbec8cf3c1c02e3e1ab81ab2.text: 离开余烬之光营地进入毁灭岩。第一个区域有许多马戈九头蛇、血肉傀儡和暗焰烘干机的巡逻队，它们会聚集在你面前，然后绕着中央熔岩坑逆时针移动。

0e7abfc0c04e95e0785af171ea2c59d643030218.source: It is possible to follow them and clear them one by one, but it is faster to wait until after the last patrol of Flesh Golems is gone and head north, with only a lone hydra that may spawn along the way.
0e7abfc0c04e95e0785af171ea2c59d643030218.text: 可以跟踪它们并一一清除它们，但等到最后一批血肉魔像消失后向北前进会更快，因为沿途可能会生成一只孤独的九头蛇。

825c8a9c2964914d63d9993c86bfcc2329c94971.source: Be careful around the Mahgo Hydras, as they possess Meteor Shower. Either spread your team, or interrupt the skill, but note that their elite Glyph of Renewal may cause it to recharge instantly.
825c8a9c2964914d63d9993c86bfcc2329c94971.text: 在玛戈九头蛇周围要小心，因为它们拥有流星雨。要么分散你的团队，要么中断技能，但请注意他们的精英更新雕文可能会导致它立即充电。

cf247db6b4d0fc5e4f416bdf6bcef70197c780c7.source: You should arrive at your first Ether Seal. It is an Air Magic elementalist foe that is a massive annoyance to spellcasters due to its ward effect Mursaat Tower causing high energy denial and enchantment removal. You should try to deal as much damage as possible and as quickly as possible. Martial professions are at an advantage; a Ranger with a longbow or flatbow can do significant damage to the seal without needing to enter the ward, by standing on the promontory, and a warrior can rely on adrenaline skills to get damage through. Some Jade Bows and another group of foes are also in the vicinity, but it is generally possible to engage the Ether Seal without aggroing them.
cf247db6b4d0fc5e4f416bdf6bcef70197c780c7.text: 你应该到达你的第一个以太封印。它是一种空气魔法元素敌人，对施法者来说是一个巨大的烦恼，因为它的守卫效果穆萨特塔会导致高能量拒绝和结界移除。你应该尝试尽可能快地造成尽可能多的伤害。武术职业有优势；拥有长弓或扁弓的游侠无需进入守卫，站在海角上即可对海豹造成重大伤害，而战士则可以依靠肾上腺素技能来获得伤害。一些玉弓和另一群敌人也在附近，但通常可以在不攻击他们的情况下与以太封印交战。

a03123738c6101d17d89346c49ea84c28204cd25.source: Then take the central road to the northwest, defeating the members of the White Mantle along the way. Aside from a few Breeze Keepers, most of the wildlife of Perdition Rock can be avoided.
a03123738c6101d17d89346c49ea84c28204cd25.text: 然后走中央路向西北走，一路击败白斗篷成员。除了少数微风守护者外，毁灭岩的大部分野生动物都可以避开。

d1405038648281f5ac6bda136e0ed6eebc4a18e4.source: Eventually you should arrive at the docks, with the three members of the inner council, one Warrior and two Mesmer bosses, atop a shrine guarded by two pull-able groups of White Mantle. The bosses are not part of the surrounding groups, so you can safely clear the area before running up the steps and take on the bosses.
d1405038648281f5ac6bda136e0ed6eebc4a18e4.text: 最终你应该到达码头，与内议会的三名成员，一名战士和两名幻术师老大一起，在由两支可拉的白斗篷守卫的神殿顶上。首领不属于周围群体，因此您可以安全地清理该区域，然后跑上台阶并对抗首领。

9eb575b6cae26d5b64e73574d91665fc2a266e2f.source: After the fight, talk to Captain Grumby who will send the party directly to the Ring of Fire.
9eb575b6cae26d5b64e73574d91665fc2a266e2f.text: 战斗结束后，与格鲁比队长交谈，他会将队伍直接送往火环。

8251bc65833e4b06757248c24172861f0685c63d.source: If you have killed the council but keep the quest in your Quest Log without accepting the reward, then the council and the White Mantle will still spawn when you revisit Perdition Rock but you don't need to kill them again in order to have Captain Grumby send you to the Ring of Fire.
8251bc65833e4b06757248c24172861f0685c63d.text: 如果你已经杀死了议会，但将任务保留在你的任务日志中而不接受奖励，那么当你重新访问毁灭岩时，议会和白斗篷仍然会生成，但你不需要再次杀死它们，以便让格鲁比船长将你送到火环。

88b654ba3aad493e223ea34886c2b2505d920351.source: You must have chosen Margrid the Sly during Mysterious Message.
88b654ba3aad493e223ea34886c2b2505d920351.text: 你一定在神秘讯息中选择了狡猾的玛格丽特。

1a62c801bf524219478c0972fb854d6782d3727c.source: Search the Halls of Chokhin with Margrid. Look for information on the Hidden City.
1a62c801bf524219478c0972fb854d6782d3727c.text: 与玛格丽特一起搜索乔欣大厅。寻找有关隐秘之城的信息。

ca50bffbd5230e01d85a1254d566531ad6d21b57.source: Pick up and examine the "Duality of Lyssa."
ca50bffbd5230e01d85a1254d566531ad6d21b57.text: 拿起并检查“莱莎的二元性”。

9c5f8126ba057631d120345d1ce7e066499ee90b.source: Find Goren in the Mirror of Lyss.

33b492716cafc4dab2438099ac414ad91848be59.source: Do the magic dance to gain entrance to the Hidden City of Ahdashim. (Use the /dance emote near the spot marked by Goren.)
33b492716cafc4dab2438099ac414ad91848be59.text: 跳魔法舞蹈即可进入艾达希姆隐秘之城。 （在 Goren 标记的地点附近使用 /dance 表情。）

b703222fe370296e8d11777b1792a68a4ae6ffbd.source: Speak to the Lock of Ahdashim.

9ae5638a4b12f0950662d6333e6c9efad8d50bcf.source: See Lock of Ahdashim for your reward.
9ae5638a4b12f0950662d6333e6c9efad8d50bcf.text: 前往艾哈达希姆之锁获取奖励。

094a842eb84131213bcd8c39e0508fe504df8416.source: Start from the Grand Court of Sebelkeh outpost, and head north west through Mihanu Township into the Holdings of Chokhin. Once there, follow the quest pointer to "explore" for clues, then head into the Halls of Chokhin to pick up and examine the Duality of Lyssa.
094a842eb84131213bcd8c39e0508fe504df8416.text: 从 Sebelkeh 前哨站的大法院出发，向西北方向穿过 Mihanu 镇进入 Chokhin 领地。到达那里后，按照任务指针“探索”线索，然后前往乔欣大厅拿起并检查莱莎的二元性。

7464c0ec49eb02e3bf1155d4b08d77e427f91013.source: Clicking on the Duality will spawn the library defenses in the form of several Djinn, of which the fire elementalist Ruby Djinn are probably the most dangerous and should be defeated first. Since the djinn only spawn when the Duality is examined, your party can setup or prepare skills first. After defeating the library defenses, Goren will direct you to meet him in the Mirror of Lyss explorable zone. Although the conversation between Margrid and Goren is triggered by picking up the book and will suggest the party proceed immediately to the Mirror of Lyss, the player must talk to Goren to update the quest after the conversation and prior to leaving Holdings of Chokhin.
7464c0ec49eb02e3bf1155d4b08d77e427f91013.text: 点击二元性将会产生数个巨灵形式的图书馆防御，其中火元素红宝石巨灵可能是最危险的，应该首先被击败。由于巨灵仅在检查二元性时产生，因此您的队伍可以首先设置或准备技能。击败图书馆防御后，戈伦将引导你在利斯之镜探索区与他会面。虽然玛格丽特和戈伦之间的对话是通过拿起这本书触发的，并且会建议队伍立即前往里斯之镜，但玩家必须在对话之后和离开乔金控股之前与戈伦交谈以更新任务。

7414735de7786ad3ea78d4f39d7fb86b71b0a6cb.source: On meeting Goren, perform a magic dance (use the /dance emote) to summon the Lock of Ahdashim and open the way into the Dasha Vestibule outpost to collect your reward.
7414735de7786ad3ea78d4f39d7fb86b71b0a6cb.text: 与 Goren 见面时，表演一段魔法舞蹈（使用 /dance 表情）来召唤 Ahdashim 之锁，并打开进入 Dasha Vestibule 前哨站的道路以收集奖励。

c90ff5c7b21275154c2ea0f915426a597bc0d509.source: A cinematic between Varesh and General Morgahn will be triggered after speaking to the Lock of Ahdashim.
c90ff5c7b21275154c2ea0f915426a597bc0d509.text: 与阿达希姆之锁交谈后，瓦雷什和摩根将军之间的电影将会被触发。

2496050a35e6b8d7662985c64aa19e9276f0ff59.source: The quest pointer will not be present if you do not have the hero Margrid the Sly present in your party.
2496050a35e6b8d7662985c64aa19e9276f0ff59.text: 如果你的队伍中没有英雄狡猾的玛格丽特，任务指针将不会出现。

5994f55c92fb01b4a5bae7699452e7004b628c7d.source: The Vabbian Scout just outside Mihanu Township gives a plant hunt blessing, which is quite useful since the route to the first objective is patrolled by several plant creatures.
5994f55c92fb01b4a5bae7699452e7004b628c7d.text: 米哈努镇外的瓦比安侦察兵会给予植物狩猎祝福，这非常有用，因为通往第一个目标的路线上有一些植物生物在巡逻。

bf6f87b3226c9b774106a1ae84d660b9ccc3d1ba.source: In Halls of Chokhin, you can also take a quest Botanical Research from Librarian Kahnu just near the Duality of Lyssa.
bf6f87b3226c9b774106a1ae84d660b9ccc3d1ba.text: 在乔欣大厅，你还可以从靠近莱莎二元性的图书馆员卡努那里接受植物学研究任务。

388f209dd7a2be41bfdd1cb5a285104c08fcd127.source: When going to meet Goren to have the secret entrance revealed, Honur Hill is the closest outpost to proceed from, which you will almost certainly have passed through earlier during the All's Well That Ends Well primary quest.
388f209dd7a2be41bfdd1cb5a285104c08fcd127.text: 当去见戈伦以揭开秘密入口时，荣誉山是最近的前哨站，你几乎肯定会在“一切顺利，结局好”的主要任务中早些时候穿过它。

5b750801091e067cebded95dd3f0b949f0b23a60.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is through Final Blow.
5b750801091e067cebded95dd3f0b949f0b23a60.text: 进入任务没有任何要求，但进入前哨站的唯一方法是通过“最后一击”。

388ef3ab1043cb3e0e5080ba017a117c0e826d6d.source: Establish a foothold on the Ring of Fire Island Chain
388ef3ab1043cb3e0e5080ba017a117c0e826d6d.text: 在火环岛链上建立据点

2b23091050bcd6f9940322bb5152ed1b66e0a8a6.source: Gain access to the Citadel Guardhouse

70eeb10cd84e09a66d93d0d38d70be65f1d9c0a8.source: Open the main gate to the Citadel Guardhouse
70eeb10cd84e09a66d93d0d38d70be65f1d9c0a8.text: 打开城堡警卫室的大门

8d581e0da4f7e1421243e49b1b460b825a984d73.text: 清理穆尔萨特的警卫室

8c76bfb9bc2dd73bab0bf847b00c748e1d155b4c.source: At the beginning, Brechnar Ironhammer sacrifices his life to buy time and open the field by luring the Mursaat away. You cannot save him, he is scripted to die once he reaches his destination (even without being attacked and regardless of his health). Head north, engage the Mursaat patrols carefully to avoid over-aggro.
8c76bfb9bc2dd73bab0bf847b00c748e1d155b4c.text: 一开始，布雷奇纳尔·铁锤牺牲了自己的生命，通过引诱穆尔萨特来赢得时间和打开战场。你无法拯救他，一旦他到达目的地，他就会死亡（即使没有受到攻击，无论他的健康状况如何）。向北前进，小心地与穆尔萨特巡逻队交战，避免过度仇恨。

3554e136db845b95e11bdd0d3e383ba01f6e56fb.source: From here onwards players will encounter Mursaat towers. These structures will remove your team's enchantments and also drain energy fast. Destroy its Ether Seal to turn the effects off. The towers are always guarded by Jade Bows, and it is unwise to fight them together. Either use a long/flat bow to pull the Jade away from the tower, or spike the seal first. Sometimes Nightmares spawn around the tower.
3554e136db845b95e11bdd0d3e383ba01f6e56fb.text: 从这里开始玩家将遇到Mursaat 塔。这些结构会消除你团队的魔力并快速消耗能量。摧毁其以太封印即可关闭效果。塔楼总是由玉弓守卫，一起战斗是不明智的。要么使用长/扁弓将玉从塔上拉开，要么先钉住封印。有时噩梦会在塔周围生成。

2af71f01aa22afa95a08bf1fb031163f42d25526.source: Following the north-west path from the first tower you will encounter an Ettin boss followed by a fork in the road: the northern path leads to the bonus giver and the southern proceeds with the mission.
2af71f01aa22afa95a08bf1fb031163f42d25526.text: 从第一座塔沿着西北路径走，你会遇到一个 Ettin Boss，然后是一个岔路：北边的路径通向奖励提供者，南边的路径继续执行任务。

4454da4780d92be6a20be2a62909bab269cd10da.source: The area also features lava pools with ettins on the other side. Choose between either pulling the ettins across the lava or rushing out of it to the other side to battle them. Avoid standing in the lava while fighting the Ettins.
4454da4780d92be6a20be2a62909bab269cd10da.text: 该地区还设有熔岩池，另一侧有埃廷斯。选择是拉着埃廷人穿过熔岩还是冲出熔岩到另一边与他们战斗。与埃廷人战斗时避免站在熔岩中。

29e4a42a49e85e22a0b95e9cb410cda7cd39def3.source: Vizier Khilbron will appear after the first lava pool to warn the party and suggest an alternative route. Despite his advice, most players find the front gate easier than the back route. The choice is up to you.
29e4a42a49e85e22a0b95e9cb410cda7cd39def3.text: 维齐尔·基尔布伦（Vizier Khilbron）将出现在第一个熔岩池之后，警告队伍并建议替代路线。尽管有他的建议，大多数玩家还是发现前门比后门更容易。选择权取决于您。

344dd83743f124a8eee7a884238656f5409cd0bf.source: The front gate is heavily guarded by the Mursaat and four towers, two outside the gate and two inside. Pull the Mursaat away from the towers first and then take out the two outer towers. You can clear the Mursaat patrols behind the gate with spells before destroying the seals to open it.
344dd83743f124a8eee7a884238656f5409cd0bf.text: 前门由穆尔萨特和四座塔楼重兵把守，两座在门外，两座在门内。先把穆萨特从塔上拉开，然后再干掉两座外塔。你可以用法术清除门后的穆尔萨特巡逻队，然后摧毁封印以打开门。

6768439b55ac0237f5565e54526b8927b68fd4c8.source: The two inner towers effects radii overlap just past the stairs making it hard to turn them off. Clear the patrols by pulling them to the stairs. The Ether Seals of these two towers face away from the gate, so the safest way to destroy them is to run past them first and start the attack from the opposite side. But beware of the Mursaat at the back, you will have to dispatch them first.
6768439b55ac0237f5565e54526b8927b68fd4c8.text: 两个内塔的效果半径在楼梯上方重叠，因此很难将其关闭。把巡逻队拉到楼梯上来清除他们。这两座塔的以太封印背向大门，所以摧毁它们最安全的方法就是先跑过去，从对面开始攻击。但要小心后面的穆萨特，你必须先干掉他们。

29e6ff230b83d8a3ca5479ff5db2eb96b3e6defb.source: Now break the seal to access the lever of the main gate and defeat the boss guarding it. Touch the lever to open the main gate. Cross the jade bridge and defeat the last Mursaat boss to complete this mission.
29e6ff230b83d8a3ca5479ff5db2eb96b3e6defb.text: 现在打破封印，进入大门的杠杆并击败守卫大门的头目。触摸控制杆即可打开大门。穿过玉桥并击败最后的穆萨特首领来完成此任务。

aec35f8f74d6fd7aa8bc686b786c8cc61012c2de.source: Back road (blue way on the wikimap)
aec35f8f74d6fd7aa8bc686b786c8cc61012c2de.text: 后路（维基地图上的蓝色路）

7677f7613c37d33f19708c8f49358aba8bc40c95.source: Is a large and dangerous circular detour on an area inhabitated by Lava Spitters and numerous Lava Imps with strong nuking capabilities, especially in groups (Meteor Showers). The last tend to cluster, so make use of AoE interrupt skills (e.g. Cry of Frustration, Maelstrom).
7677f7613c37d33f19708c8f49358aba8bc40c95.text: 是一个巨大而危险的环形绕道，位于熔岩喷射者和众多具有强大核武器能力的熔岩小鬼居住的区域，尤其是在群体中（流星雨）。最后一个往往会聚集，所以要利用 AoE 中断技能（例如挫败呐喊、漩涡）。

6b5d721872f629e1d359c9f50e1576af230f9e46.source: There is an Ether Seal at the back of the Citadel Guardhouse, destroy it to enter. Clear the area of Mursaat, break the seal to access the lever of the main gate and defeat the boss guarding it. Touch the lever to open the main gate. Cross the jade bridge and defeat the last Mursaat boss to complete this mission.
6b5d721872f629e1d359c9f50e1576af230f9e46.text: 城堡守卫室后面有一个以太封印，摧毁它才能进入。清理穆尔萨特区域，打破封印，进入大门的杠杆，并击败守卫它的 Boss。触摸控制杆即可打开大门。穿过玉桥并击败最后的穆萨特首领来完成此任务。

1f3dd9d37274af7adc874e5791e41eeac5029916.source: To activate the bonus, speak to the Ancient Seer found by the northern turn of the first fork. The Ancient Seer tells you to bring the Spectral Essence from an Eidolon who will appear once the four towers of the Citadel Guardhouse are deactivated. Take the Spectral Essence to the Ancient Seer to complete the bonus. This Ancient Seer will infuse your armor.
1f3dd9d37274af7adc874e5791e41eeac5029916.text: 要激活奖励，请与第一个岔路口北转处找到的古代先知交谈。远古先知告诉你从幻灵那里取来光谱精华，一旦城堡守卫室的四座塔被停用，幻灵就会出现。将幽灵精华交给古代先知即可完成奖励。这位远古先知将注入你的盔甲。

faf04be998405aff9a8106a76af4365a5a506b10.source: When players pick up the Spectral Essence, the quest log will update to say the bonus is complete. However, players will not receive credit for bonus until the party member carrying the Essence takes it to the Ancient Seer.
faf04be998405aff9a8106a76af4365a5a506b10.text: 当玩家拾取光谱精华时，任务日志将更新以表明奖励已完成。然而，在携带精华的队伍成员将其交给古代先知之前，玩家不会获得奖励。

ab75572fa8023c8eac58bd67dedc5f304c093c6d.source: To counter the Mursaat Towers energy drain, use Glyph of Lesser Energy, signets and adrenaline-based damage. Healers can stand out of range and use party healing spells. A Signet of Spirits-based build can be used to destroy the Ether Seals without the need of staying inside the energy drain radius.
ab75572fa8023c8eac58bd67dedc5f304c093c6d.text: 为了对抗穆萨特塔的能量消耗，请使用次级能量雕文、图章和基于肾上腺素的伤害。治疗师可以站在射程之外并使用队伍治疗法术。基于精神徽记的构建可用于摧毁以太封印，而无需停留在能量消耗半径内。

f36129f63ea4d4857117c3e35cb7469d8593952b.source: Stance breaker skills e.g. Wild Blow to remove Dryder's Defenses from Lava Spitters (if taking the back road), Whirling Defense from Jade Bows, and Physical Resistance/Mantra of Flame from Mursaat Mesmers.
f36129f63ea4d4857117c3e35cb7469d8593952b.text: 破坏立场的技能，例如狂野打击可消除熔岩喷射者的德莱德防御（如果走后路），玉弓的旋转防御，以及穆尔萨特幻术师的物理抵抗/火焰咒语。

11914354b450f95689aa975a38717f2caa2fd33e.source: The four Mursaat and two Jade bosses will always appear during the mission in one of the six shared spawn points.
11914354b450f95689aa975a38717f2caa2fd33e.text: 四个穆萨特和两个翡翠首领将始终出现在任务期间的六个共享重生点之一。

977c0fe6686cc8347670574a861146e2c16333ac.source: The two Ettin bosses will appear at one of the two shared spawn points.
977c0fe6686cc8347670574a861146e2c16333ac.text: 两个埃丁 Boss 将出现在两个共享生成点之一。

18e04b14cd5d7b6abc8abc40358669042597b1e3.source: The mission ends once you kill the last boss and the small Mursaat group. If you want to capture the elite skill of this boss, kill it before the group so that you have enough time to activate the Signet of Capture.
18e04b14cd5d7b6abc8abc40358669042597b1e3.text: 一旦你杀死了最后一个 Boss 和穆萨特小队，任务就结束了。如果你想捕获这个boss的精英技能，请在队伍之前击杀它，这样你就有足够的时间来激活捕获徽记。

15c0ab94b275ac122f55c2a66b5bfdd0d1a43a91.source: Despite the Seer's words that the Eidolon will spawn after destroying the Mursaat towers, you need to accept the bonus objective from the Seer as well. Otherwise the Eidolon will not spawn.
15c0ab94b275ac122f55c2a66b5bfdd0d1a43a91.text: 尽管预言家说幻灵会在摧毁穆萨塔塔后生成，但你也需要接受预言家的奖励目标。否则夜灵不会生成。

b191c6f2856ac3691489cfeb18da6bc5a70b86e5.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #16 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
b191c6f2856ac3691489cfeb18da6bc5a70b86e5.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 16 页。

92e1de4586a8045ef12dfdb05fccc9b46a519dcb.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Abaddon's Mouth.
92e1de4586a8045ef12dfdb05fccc9b46a519dcb.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到阿巴顿之口。

6daede9a1a8b171dd9862336bb20f9e331fad9f8.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is by completing Ring of Fire.
6daede9a1a8b171dd9862336bb20f9e331fad9f8.text: 进入任务没有任何要求，但进入前哨站的唯一方法是完成火环。

8e3bd1ebf6abc0525a32bb1ae2bca7df4501fcbd.source: Disable the seals to power down the Onyx Gate.
8e3bd1ebf6abc0525a32bb1ae2bca7df4501fcbd.text: 禁用密封件以关闭玛瑙门。

6c91c0d2a8cb505b566299459dde16ce76cad898.source: Climb the path into Abaddon's Mouth.
6c91c0d2a8cb505b566299459dde16ce76cad898.text: 爬上小路进入阿巴顿之口。

4985c95ee91fd076bb6b6788d9dfd1a18c769c61.source: Break the magical seals holding closed the Door of Komalie.
4985c95ee91fd076bb6b6788d9dfd1a18c769c61.text: 打破关闭科玛利亚之门的魔法封印。

2364303a73640063d304d640888ec522e1e561d1.source: *BONUS* Escort the spirit of Leah Stone to its final resting place.
2364303a73640063d304d640888ec522e1e561d1.text: *奖励* 护送利亚·斯通的灵魂到最后的安息之地。

1185c5e4df1a7362efbb5b1247e9a48952f25ca8.source: This mission requires you to break through a Mursaat fortress by powering down the Onyx Gate to finally reach the Door of Komalie. Vizier Khilbron will periodically enchant the party with Chimera of Intensity, but this only lasts two minutes so is little help overall. The complex includes many gates that prevent access to the fortress; destroy each gate's Ether Seal to open them. Some of the gates are close to nearby groups of foes and guarded by Jade Bows; it is unwise to fight them together. You can spike the seal first or pull the jade away from it.
1185c5e4df1a7362efbb5b1247e9a48952f25ca8.text: 这个任务要求你通过关闭玛瑙之门来突破穆尔萨特堡垒，最终到达科马利之门。维齐尔·基尔布隆会定期用强度奇美拉迷惑队伍，但这只能持续两分钟，所以总体来说没什么帮助。该建筑群包括许多阻止进入堡垒的大门；摧毁每扇门的以太封印来打开它们。有些大门靠近附近的敌人群，并由玉弓把守；有些则靠近敌人。一起对抗他们是不明智的。你可以先钉住封印，或者把玉石从封印上拉开。

887b4126c70d8b83f710ec4018d67cf0d81a001e.source: You will start outside the Mursaat fortress; the vizier will enchant you when you get close to the main entrance. Before targeting the first Ether Seal, dispatch the side guards on top of the wall. All the Mursaat troops are stationed close to each other, so pull them apart to avoid over-aggro. Destroy the Ether Seals on either side of the Onyx Gate to open it. Leave through the Onyx Gate to continue with the mission.
887b4126c70d8b83f710ec4018d67cf0d81a001e.text: 你将从穆尔萨特堡垒外开始；当您靠近主入口时，维齐尔会让您着迷。在瞄准第一个以太封印之前，先派遣墙顶上的侧卫。所有穆尔萨特部队都驻扎得很近，所以要把他们分开以避免过度仇恨。摧毁玛瑙门两侧的以太封印以打开它。通过玛瑙门离开继续执行任务。

ee6f7d8132d00bfce2e1625c5a4ef80b45ced96e.source: Intermediately after leaving the Onyx Gate, the Vizier will re-enchant the party. You have to destroy three more gates; the two pairs of bosses between them can be easily defeated, if you keep them away from the seals.
ee6f7d8132d00bfce2e1625c5a4ef80b45ced96e.text: 离开玛瑙之门后，维齐尔将重新为队伍附魔。你必须再摧毁三扇门；如果你让他们远离海豹，他们之间的两对 Boss 很容易被击败。

00698decfa9ccbb8aaaab60b30aeac50137e8585.source: After entering the caldera, Khilbron will aid you for a third and last time. Players arrive to a platform with six seals that lock the Door of Komalie and must be destroyed.
00698decfa9ccbb8aaaab60b30aeac50137e8585.text: 进入火山口后，基尔布隆将第三次也是最后一次帮助你。玩家到达一个带有六个封印的平台，这些封印锁住了科玛利亚之门，必须将其摧毁。

1e07b47b2af68d5caf96a65f7b1d6af7dd6fafe8.source: Each time you destroy a singular seal, four level-10 (lvl 20 in Hard Mode) Seal Guards will spawn while Mursaat Guardians will join the battle from the north and south. Clear the area of the current crop of foes before destroying another seal, otherwise you will get overwhelmed. As with other similar missions, patience is the key to success.
1e07b47b2af68d5caf96a65f7b1d6af7dd6fafe8.text: 每次你摧毁一个单一封印时，四名 10 级（困难模式下为 20 级）封印守卫就会出现，而穆萨特守护者将从北方和南方加入战斗。在摧毁另一个封印之前，先清除当前区域的敌人，否则你会不知所措。与其他类似任务一样，耐心是成功的关键。

dae1793b769000835543d40da7535827817afbda.source: After the last seal is destroyed, a cinematic will trigger, then a Burning Titan will spawn at the center of the bloodstone. Defeat it to complete the mission.
dae1793b769000835543d40da7535827817afbda.text: 最后一个封印被摧毁后，将触发一个过场动画，然后燃烧泰坦将在鸡血石的中心生成。击败它即可完成任务。

f7c2f5a5a5ec874777dda49479a9adaaef3871cb.source: Your goal is to escort the spirit of Leah Stone from the fortress to a small island in the west. She only appears once the Ether Seal at the docks near her spawn point is defeated. The main difficulty is that this NPC is fragile and can be easily killed. She stops moving if you move out of compass range; and she slows down once she leaves the fortress. Finally, she is affected by burning from the lava, requiring you to stop frequently and wait for her to regenerate her health.
f7c2f5a5a5ec874777dda49479a9adaaef3871cb.text: 你的目标是护送利亚·斯通的灵魂从堡垒到西部的一个小岛。只有在她重生点附近的码头上的以太封印被击败后，她才会出现。主要的困难是这个NPC很脆弱，很容易被杀死。如果您超出指南针范围，她就会停止移动；离开堡垒后她就放慢了速度。最后，她会受到熔岩燃烧的影响，需要你经常停下来等待她恢复健康。

534702596717201f7d472f2a9a53bb83dbb8955f.source: In hard mode, your best bet is to clear the path of foes before releasing her spirit; she takes the largest coast road bordering the island from north to west. Be sure to trigger any pop-ups in the area past the Eidolon and remove the dryders, Crag Behemoths, wurms and possibly Snyk the Hundred Tongue, any of which can kill her. Once you have removed these threats, return to the fortress, kill the nearby boss, and then lead her back towards the island. Note that if you clear the path first, then free her, that she will stop after the lava if unescorted (no players in compass range).
534702596717201f7d472f2a9a53bb83dbb8955f.text: 在困难模式下，你最好的选择是在释放她的灵魂之前清除敌人的道路；她走的是从北到西与该岛接壤的最大的海岸公路。一定要触发夜灵附近区域的任何弹出窗口，并移除干燥者、峭壁巨兽、亚龙，可能还有百舌斯奈克，其中任何一个都可以杀死她。一旦你消除了这些威胁，返回要塞，杀死附近的头目，然后带她回岛上。请注意，如果您先清理道路，然后释放她，如果无人护送，她将在熔岩后停下来（罗盘范围内没有玩家）。

82c42a0cd967657368b82bdb11535f956afe29f4.source: In normal mode, if you are confident of your team's strength, you can trigger her appearance earlier, which will save you from retracing your steps.
82c42a0cd967657368b82bdb11535f956afe29f4.text: 普通模式下，如果你对自己队伍的实力有信心，可以提前触发她的出现，这样你就不用走回头路了。

68b0b2485b223a40603176dbbf55f1194ba289b4.source: If you let Leah Stone run ahead of you, and out of your compass range, it is possible for her to make it to her resting place unharmed, successfully granting you bonus.
68b0b2485b223a40603176dbbf55f1194ba289b4.text: 如果你让利亚·斯通跑在你前面，并且超出你的罗盘范围，她有可能毫发无伤地到达她的安息之地，成功地为你提供奖励。

a794f0c23bccd8b6b41969a5fc771e0d867fadb7.source: Area damage over time skills to kill the Ether Seals since they cannot flee.
a794f0c23bccd8b6b41969a5fc771e0d867fadb7.text: 随着时间的推移，区域伤害技能可以杀死以太封印，因为它们无法逃跑。

18315fea264bc9c09b1c065ec4e07d7ceebf7569.source: Damage reduction, e.g. Protective Spirit, to negate some of the Ether Seal's spike.
18315fea264bc9c09b1c065ec4e07d7ceebf7569.text: 减少伤害，例如防护精灵，可以抵消部分以太封印的尖刺。

928a79c58fcb3da890a528ed458248accaa813a7.source: Interrupts and Daze are useful against the hydras and some of the bosses.
928a79c58fcb3da890a528ed458248accaa813a7.text: 打断和发呆对于对付九头蛇和一些 Boss 非常有用。

c9d4900a036838b3e66dce0da87a93678f66452e.source: Party-wide speed boosts help reduce the time spent backtracking during the bonus.
c9d4900a036838b3e66dce0da87a93678f66452e.text: 全队速度提升有助于减少奖励期间回溯所花费的时间。

16fc78c8e8ac628d55aa46598f37feaf9808a39f.source: Sometimes, chests spawn in Leah Stone's scripted path, making the bonus impossible. Checking her route before attempting bonus might therefore save a lot of time.
16fc78c8e8ac628d55aa46598f37feaf9808a39f.text: 有时，箱子会在莉娅·斯通的脚本路径中生成，从而使奖励变得不可能。因此，在尝试奖励之前检查她的路线可能会节省大量时间。

75ee8a34b0dd500f334e743b715237c40395ad5e.source: Occasionally, if you kill the Burning Titan at the end too quickly, the mission will fail. Give it a couple of seconds after the last cut scene.
75ee8a34b0dd500f334e743b715237c40395ad5e.text: 有时，如果你在最后太快杀死燃烧泰坦，任务就会失败。在最后一个过场动画结束后等待几秒钟。

23718cdf1a4e42d538508dea9414fd93d09b40b4.source: The Ancient Seer stands on the south western coast of the island. Give him the Eidolon's Spectral Essence to infuse your armor together with any other player who talks to him. This is a good opportunity to infuse a second set of armor.
23718cdf1a4e42d538508dea9414fd93d09b40b4.text: 远古先知矗立在该岛的西南海岸。给他幻灵的光谱精华，将你的盔甲与任何与他交谈的其他玩家一起注入。这是注入第二套盔甲的好机会。

43abc7f88c43563cd39bcad3f9234271d7fed44d.source: Some of the elite skills found in this mission cannot be captured anywhere else. If attempting the bonus, it may be wise to bring a Signet of Capture.
43abc7f88c43563cd39bcad3f9234271d7fed44d.text: 在这次任务中发现的一些精英技能是其他地方无法获得的。如果尝试获得奖励，最好带上捕获徽记。

1dcfeb686e03f0f678004a04a71a47fbfa9e05f5.source: The Jade and Mursaat bosses share 3 spawn points. 2 of the six bosses will spawn at each point.
1dcfeb686e03f0f678004a04a71a47fbfa9e05f5.text: Jade 和 Mursaat Boss 共享 3 个重生点。六个 Boss 中的 2 个会在每个点生成。

2f0e1361867b4beab1f3e488f4465a7515d82e35.source: The Dryder bosses share 4 spawn points.
2f0e1361867b4beab1f3e488f4465a7515d82e35.text: 烘干机 Boss 共享 4 个生成点。

bae89ff64b36ad34f077a1133f6f7a87c66c3bb5.source: Complete exploration of this mission adds about 1.3% to the Tyrian Explorer title.
bae89ff64b36ad34f077a1133f6f7a87c66c3bb5.text: 完成此任务的探索使泰瑞安探险家头衔增加约 1.3%。

e0db9df312401d7bec782b06f66120aa113bf60b.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #17 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
e0db9df312401d7bec782b06f66120aa113bf60b.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 17 页。

be076ffbbdf49e440296655ec01cec5524baad97.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Hell's Precipice.
be076ffbbdf49e440296655ec01cec5524baad97.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到地狱悬崖。

f7897213ffb559ac64356349dcd5b090e736c267.source: Dryder bosses may not spawn at all. If the western Ether Seal is fighting Dryders and isn't allowed to finish them off, its gate will not open after being killed.
f7897213ffb559ac64356349dcd5b090e736c267.text: 烘干机 Boss 可能根本不会生成。如果西方以太封印正在与干燥者战斗并且不被允许消灭他们，那么它的大门在被杀死后将不会打开。

850f85002ab849176420ff3c3f16fe6117ce90b1.source: Travel to Haiju Lagoon with Initiate Tsuriai.
850f85002ab849176420ff3c3f16fe6117ce90b1.text: 与 Initiate Tsuriai 一起前往海州泻湖 (Haiju Lagoon)。

355508938659418bfd2dc4a1f1ad39a145932dff.source: Protect Initiate Tsuriai while she cleanses the lagoon.
355508938659418bfd2dc4a1f1ad39a145932dff.text: 在新兵 Tsuriai 清理泻湖时保护她。

bc66a663c20be7980d2a6ecc855370fa3ea3cdea.source: See Initiate Tsuriai for your reward.
bc66a663c20be7980d2a6ecc855370fa3ea3cdea.text: 请参阅启动 Tsuriai 以获得奖励。

18ef8b8ca8d0d7ed723ad5afe2ac5c6445f4959b.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Haiju Lagoon; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn but are replaced by Scavengers.
18ef8b8ca8d0d7ed723ad5afe2ac5c6445f4959b.text: 完成此任务会改变海州泻湖中出现的敌人；具体来说，受折磨者将不再生成，而是被拾荒者取代。

7d0cd17ed2b741e9db5d9a0f649bf63d8fd29634.source: Cleansing Haiju Lagoon/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
7d0cd17ed2b741e9db5d9a0f649bf63d8fd29634.text: 净化海州泻湖/详细演练指南

6c8938f56135f47b2c4f6987c7cbcd83fdb9c5b7.source: Your goal is to protect Tsuriai while she stands in the lagoon to conduct her cleansing ritual. Several groups of Afflicted will attack her from three directions (west, south, and east). After completing the ritual, any remaining Afflicted will disappear. If she dies, the quest fails and you must rezone to try again.
6c8938f56135f47b2c4f6987c7cbcd83fdb9c5b7.text: 你的目标是在 Tsuriai 站在泻湖中进行清洁仪式时保护她。几群受折磨者将从三个方向（西、南、东）攻击她。完成仪式后，任何剩余的受折磨者都会消失。如果她死了，任务就会失败，你必须重新分配区域才能重试。

a75bc0a2c399d4baff866176a88ddd8a437b1131.source: Head northwest from Zen Daijun to meet up with Tsuriai then head north to the starburst on the map. After she begins her chanting you have a few moments to organize your party before being confronted by the Afflicted. Keep her alive for the minute or two she needs; you do not actually have to kill any of the foes (although this will obviously make keeping her alive easier).
a75bc0a2c399d4baff866176a88ddd8a437b1131.text: 从禅代君向西北方向与 Tsuriai 会合，然后向北前往地图上的星爆点。在她开始吟唱后，你有一些时间来组织你的队伍，然后再面对受折磨者。让她活一两分钟；你实际上不必杀死任何敌人（尽管这显然会让她更容易活下去）。

4f7a59ffc0cb2071812778b053a397630402c586.source: While standing in the water you will be under the Corrupted Haiju Lagoon Water effect until the ritual is complete.
4f7a59ffc0cb2071812778b053a397630402c586.text: 站在水中时，您将处于腐化的海珠泻湖水效果之下，直到仪式完成。

16c59677074dd156da5c2ecf927040922dc489e9.source: As Initiate Tsuriai is compelled to healing the player, she can be pulled out of the aggro-range of the enemies by using life-sacrificing skills and moving to the other side of the island.
16c59677074dd156da5c2ecf927040922dc489e9.text: 当新手 Tsuriai 被迫治疗玩家时，可以通过使用牺牲生命的技能并将她拉出敌人的仇恨范围并移动到岛的另一边。

14cf6ec32b291b357c8cebda638ca15dc65b2ab4.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Greed and Regret or Calling the Order.
14cf6ec32b291b357c8cebda638ca15dc65b2ab4.text: 所有党员必须接受“贪婪与遗憾”或“命令”的奖励。

7ef1c155bcdde6569b3624e87c2b80a99b191e52.source: Gain access to the vault's inner sanctum and rescue the two princes.
7ef1c155bcdde6569b3624e87c2b80a99b191e52.text: 进入金库的内部密室并营救两位王子。

dbe5e31694ead3269e0a02098c50bcc0d3d187f4.source: Complete the trial in each chamber to open the way into the inner sanctum. [0...3] of 3 trials completed.
dbe5e31694ead3269e0a02098c50bcc0d3d187f4.text: 完成每个房间的试炼，打开进入内部密室的道路。已完成 3 项试验中的 [0...3]。

5578009f8e345af078c981230a15f688540154f9.source: Defeat the Eternal Guardians to complete the Trial of Eternity.
5578009f8e345af078c981230a15f688540154f9.text: 击败永恒守护者以完成永恒试炼。

08ef70e7ca246c68a4b7afeb16c33cc765771021.source: Answer the riddles posed by the Divine Djinn to pass the Trial of Divinity.
08ef70e7ca246c68a4b7afeb16c33cc765771021.text: 回答神灵提出的谜语以通过神性试炼。

93773c20d954a1e8497f954c8f30147fe5e1a7db.source: Solve the crystal key puzzle to complete the Trial of Wisdom.
93773c20d954a1e8497f954c8f30147fe5e1a7db.text: 解决水晶钥匙谜题，完成智慧试炼。

d017547ee5c81f095634a5a87420f36fa4120a9d.source: Defeat the enraged djinn to reach the two princes.
d017547ee5c81f095634a5a87420f36fa4120a9d.text: 击败愤怒的神灵，找到两位王子。

18b93eba00a288c3848ccfe7da1bbf2047f51dd6.source: *Bonus* Help Margrid collect the Treasure of Ahdashim.
18b93eba00a288c3848ccfe7da1bbf2047f51dd6.text: *奖励* 帮助玛格丽德收集阿达希姆的宝藏。

405c2f1056e4a66fc892444ef348a53a4ac67c2a.text: 已发现 [0...3] 件宝藏，共 3 件。

7c1c3cd13a56bcf3c9c1b6da3a8d776bbc16aacf.source: Talk to the Lock of Ahdashim in the Dasha Vestibule outpost to start the mission. Goren will be in the starting area; speak to him and he will join the party. He will need to survive the mission. The entrance to the three chambers has a number of groups of Djinn. Tackle them one group at a time. When fighting groups of Djinn, the Ruby Djinns using Searing Flames should be a priority target as they can deal massive amounts of damage to the party. Proceed towards the far wall where you will find three paths. The central path leads to the Trial of Eternity, the left the Trial of Divinity, and the right leads to the Trial of Wisdom. The only path open at this time is the Trial of Eternity.
7c1c3cd13a56bcf3c9c1b6da3a8d776bbc16aacf.text: 与达莎前厅前哨站的阿达希姆锁交谈以开始任务。戈伦将在起始区域；与他交谈，他就会加入队伍。他需要在任务中生存下来。三个房间的入口处有许多群神灵。一次对付一组。当与巨灵群体战斗时，使用灼热火焰的红宝石巨灵应该是优先目标，因为它们可以对队伍造成大量伤害。朝远处的墙走，你会发现三条路。中央的道路通往永恒的试炼，左边的道路通往神性的试炼，右边的道路通往智慧的试炼。此时唯一开放的道路就是永恒试炼。

b1800631a805589065fe4266b8e0b2cebaedb98b.source: There are six Eternal Guardians which produce global environmental effects for this trial. Defeating a guardian will remove its effect. Complete the trial by defeating all six guardians.
b1800631a805589065fe4266b8e0b2cebaedb98b.text: 有六名永恒守护者为本次试验产生全球环境影响。击败守护者将消除其效果。击败全部六名守护者即可完成试炼。

f6310a24877ca901a7b5e384511cdad483a1e6d1.source: The guardians may produce one of three environmental effects. The guardians at the base of the stairs produce lesser effects than those further back. These effects are as follows:
f6310a24877ca901a7b5e384511cdad483a1e6d1.text: 守护者可能会产生三种环境影响之一。楼梯底部的守卫者产生的效果比后面的守卫者要小。这些效果如下：

e26de35277e84984732ebbf03d8228262c4d6f62.source: Note that when you reach the stairs, the left path is slightly more difficult, as the guardians of the sapphire chest will spawn once the party gets close to the chest and augment the group of Djinn and guardians already there. Either pull the Djinns away from the chest or take the path to the right. This requires defeating the Ruby of Ahdashim which is needed for the bonus.
e26de35277e84984732ebbf03d8228262c4d6f62.text: 请注意，当你到达楼梯时，左边的路径会稍微困难一些，因为一旦队伍靠近宝箱，蓝宝石宝箱的守护者就会出现，并增加已经在那里的巨灵和守护者队伍。要么把巨灵从箱子里拉开，要么走右边的路。这需要击败奖励所需的阿达希姆红宝石。

38398f009855a73b2f40550f0c62249b35c5edbb.source: Upon completing the trial, the door to the Trial of Divinity will open.
38398f009855a73b2f40550f0c62249b35c5edbb.text: 完成试炼后，神性试炼之门就会打开。

98067561bb76a42b765b8cb618102e97a5c0b343.source: There are two traps placed just after the left turn in the entrance corridor to this trial (one fire, and one water). It is imperative that you pull the Djinn away from the traps to battle them, in order to avoid accidentally being caught in the traps.
98067561bb76a42b765b8cb618102e97a5c0b343.text: 在这次审判的入口走廊左转弯后放置了两个陷阱（一个火，一个水）。你必须将巨灵从陷阱中拉出来与它们战斗，以避免意外陷入陷阱。

bbee61a6323f0eb57a8cc467e38cacdc6ddb0638.source: Towards the back of the room stands a row of Divine Guardians. They will ask questions regarding the Gods of Tyria, and you must choose the answer that fits the clue the best. The clues change during each run of the mission, but the answers are always the same. From left to right, the correct answers are as follows:
bbee61a6323f0eb57a8cc467e38cacdc6ddb0638.text: 房间的后方，站着一排神卫。他们会询问有关泰瑞亚众神的问题，你必须选择最适合线索的答案。每次执行任务时线索都会发生变化，但答案总是相同的。从左到右，正确答案如下：

6780dd3ed611df1c9923e6f46a875777c3e42e71.source: If you give the wrong answer, a group of foes will spawn around you, but the Divine Guardian will still count as completed.
6780dd3ed611df1c9923e6f46a875777c3e42e71.text: 如果你给出错误的答案，一群敌人会在你周围产生，但神圣守护者仍然算作已完成。

c7851d3b71709dfd4dd745981297a8a749e8e255.source: After answering all six questions (one way or the other), the door to the Trial of Wisdom will open.
c7851d3b71709dfd4dd745981297a8a749e8e255.text: 回答完所有六个问题（以一种或另一种方式）后，智慧试炼的大门将会打开。

88020076c04ca461de87723657088c2d5fb08ae5.source: Like the Trial of Divinity, the first turn is greeted with a pair of Djinn and a pair of water traps. Pull the Djinn away from the traps to battle before proceeding.
88020076c04ca461de87723657088c2d5fb08ae5.text: 与神性试炼一样，第一个回合会遇到一对神灵和一对水陷阱。将巨灵从陷阱中拉出来进行战斗，然后再继续。

4dd6e434f0fe405097316bd23b81c160c23f887e.source: The main chamber includes four Thunder of Ahdashim — these are essentially Diamond Djinn that use Quake Of Ahdashim, a skill that knocks down and damages characters in the area. Since it also destroys any crystal keys they may be carrying, you should kill them before attempting the puzzle.
4dd6e434f0fe405097316bd23b81c160c23f887e.text: 主房间包括四个阿达希姆之雷——这些本质上是使用阿达希姆之锤的钻石巨灵，该技能可以击倒并伤害该区域的角色。由于它还会破坏他们可能携带的所有水晶钥匙，因此你应该在尝试解谜之前杀死他们。

f1c92538207c44dab6c1386a95da723df3441b9f.source: The puzzle itself involves two Crystal Keys, four obelisks numbered 2, 3, 5, and 7 (the first four prime numbers), and six pedestals numbered 6, 10, 14, 15, 21, and 35. Your objective is to activate (using the keys) two of these pedestals whose numbers are divisible by the numbers on the obelisks. As you place a key, the matching obelisks will display keys (meaning they are activated). Make sure you do not overlap. Proper combinations are suggested below.
f1c92538207c44dab6c1386a95da723df3441b9f.text: 该谜题本身涉及两把水晶钥匙、四个编号为 2、3、5 和 7（前四个素数）的方尖碑，以及六个编号为 6、10、14、15、21 和 35 的基座。您的目标是激活（使用钥匙）其中两个基座，其数字可以被方尖碑上的数字整除。当您放置钥匙时，匹配的方尖碑将显示钥匙（意味着它们已被激活）。确保不重叠。下面建议了适当的组合。

c0df92e323fd6fdb5377d783108d80679141af42.source: Incorrectly matching pedestals resets the puzzles and spawns new Ahdashim. After completing this puzzle, the final set of doors (leading to the end-bosses) will open.
c0df92e323fd6fdb5377d783108d80679141af42.text: 不正确匹配的基座会重置谜题并产生新的阿达希姆。完成这个谜题后，最后一组门（通向最终首领）将会打开。

bfa65d194caec0eeaef0c3a3275367448c495a5e.source: There are three combinations that work, each matching pedestal pairs the same distance from the center:
bfa65d194caec0eeaef0c3a3275367448c495a5e.text: 共有三种有效组合，每种匹配的基座与距中心的距离相同：

4d34754ba5877f36429d98ab415b74fd6f4133b4.source: If doing the bonus, don't forget to pick up the Sapphire Treasure as you make your way to the final room.
4d34754ba5877f36429d98ab415b74fd6f4133b4.text: 如果要获得奖励，请不要忘记在前往最后一个房间时拿起蓝宝石宝藏。

b66948c070e257f9392a2cf37d131748902ae2b9.source: The final stage of the mission contains three Djinn bosses. Luckily, each boss may be pulled and fought separately from the others. The mission ends after defeating the last one.
b66948c070e257f9392a2cf37d131748902ae2b9.text: 任务的最后阶段包含三个巨灵 Boss。幸运的是，每个 Boss 都可以被单独拉动并与其他 Boss 单独战斗。击败最后一个任务后任务结束。

7606e0c61c3b111983413c21d0f2e92c8bdf53d5.source: Most groups find Kormab (the elementalist boss) to be the most dangerous. Kormab uses several AoE spells and can quickly wipe out clustered parties; be sure to spread before taking him on. Alternatively, you can shut down his offense (e.g. using interrupts) or use anti-caster hexes (e.g. Backfire). Pain Inverter is also very effective.
7606e0c61c3b111983413c21d0f2e92c8bdf53d5.text: 大多数团体认为科尔马布（元素师 Boss）是最危险的。科尔玛布使用多种 AoE 法术，可以快速消灭集群队伍；在对付他之前一定要传播出去。或者，你可以阻止他的进攻（例如使用中断）或使用反施法者六角形（例如逆火）。疼痛逆变器也非常有效。

c6b71b3003bc460f78064f704574a7430e5a8e40.source: Goren must stay alive, so make sure he does not rush ahead into the group of bosses while you are pulling.
c6b71b3003bc460f78064f704574a7430e5a8e40.text: 戈伦必须活下去，所以当你拉动时，请确保他不会冲进 Boss 群中。

0b7c3b864027221bf3bbc46872f0e5e4e513ce69.source: If you want to capture skills, be sure to pull the relevant Djinn first or second; the mission ends as soon as the third boss dies.
0b7c3b864027221bf3bbc46872f0e5e4e513ce69.text: 如果你想捕捉技能，一定要先拉相关的巨灵，然后再拉；第三个老板死后任务就结束。

4965bf50c589ebb8c7faa392195d2e64352317e4.source: The bonus requires you to pick up three treasures from various chests: each chest is located in one of the trial areas and the key is held by a Djinn of Ahdashim with a similar name. Very little extra effort is required for the bonus: if you follow the standard mission order (Eternity→Divinity→Wisdom), you will pick up each key before you come across the corresponding chest.
4965bf50c589ebb8c7faa392195d2e64352317e4.text: 奖励要求你从不同的宝箱中拾取三件宝藏：每个宝箱都位于其中一个试验区域，钥匙由同名的阿达希姆神灵持有。奖励只需很少的额外努力：如果您遵循标准任务顺序（永恒→神性→智慧），您将在遇到相应的宝箱之前拿起每个钥匙。

892f786363f61e465ecb9e7a743f4fd151dd6782.source: There are only two complications: as you approach each chest, a group of three Djinn will pop up (including a Ruby Djinn), but these are no harder than any of the other groups you encounter. There is a fire trap in the left trial room behind the Diamond chest, so be careful. You must also pick up the third treasure before you kill the third Djinn boss in the final room.
892f786363f61e465ecb9e7a743f4fd151dd6782.text: 只有两个复杂之处：当你接近每个箱子时，会弹出一组三个巨灵（包括一个红宝石巨灵），但这些并不比你遇到的任何其他群体更难。左边审判室钻石箱后面有一个火陷阱，要小心。在杀死最后一个房间中的第三个巨灵 Boss 之前，您还必须拾取第三个宝藏。

40bdca4aaf54c46de4d8a76c68e412f382da0558.source: The chests and keys appear as follows:

efb6c6c7e923a7e53565672d5c8eb083a4b83e9b.source: The key to victory will depend on how you make good use of Margrid. Rangers have 30 extra armor against elemental damage and are the best suited for these occasions. Since she is a required hero, use one of the first three individual hero flags to position her in the party composition. The hardest enemies in this mission are the Ruby Djinns and the Elementalist boss which spam Searing Flames, to reduce their damage output, disable their elite with skills like Distracting Shot, Magebane Shot and Diversion. Due to the Roaring Ethers energy removal, your hero will need a generous energy base pool in order to use skills, e.g.:30~40 and a good spec in Expertise. Once the Elementalist foe has been killed, only the Dervish Djinns will remain. Flagging this hero ahead of the main team is essential to survival, she can be placed just over the aggro bubble or a bit ahead, so that all foes target lock on her rather the entire team. At the central room, eliminate the enemies that cause environmental effects to remove pressure and make sure to use this hero to trigger the chest pop-ups. While performing this technique, it is vital to pay close attention to the radar and watch enemy positioning, make sure your projectile attacks and skills will not be obstructed by the walls of each narrow corridor.
efb6c6c7e923a7e53565672d5c8eb083a4b83e9b.text: 胜利的关键取决于你如何充分利用玛格丽德。游骑兵拥有 30 额外护甲值来抵御元素伤害，最适合这些场合。由于她是必需的英雄，请使用前三个个人英雄旗帜之一将她定位在队伍构成中。此任务中最难对付的敌人是红宝石神灵和元素师 Boss，它们会发射灼热火焰，以减少他们的伤害输出，并使用分散射击、魔剑射击和转移等技能来禁用他们的精英。由于咆哮以太能量消除，你的英雄将需要大量的能量基础池才能使用技能，例如：30~40 和良好的专业知识规格。一旦元素使敌人被杀死，就只剩下苦行僧巨灵了。将这个英雄标记在主队之前对于生存至关重要，她可以放置在仇恨气泡上方或稍靠前的位置，以便所有敌人的目标锁定她而不是整个团队。在中央房间，消灭造成环境影响的敌人以消除压力，并确保使用该英雄触发宝箱弹出窗口。在执行此技术时，密切关注雷达并观察敌人的位置至关重要，确保你的投射物攻击和技能不会被每个狭窄走廊的墙壁阻挡。

d443967be631739405433ba92b10fed0a025b75b.source: The Ruby Djinns and Roaring Ethers have strong AoE skills. There are a number of ways to counter:
d443967be631739405433ba92b10fed0a025b75b.text: 红宝石巨灵和咆哮以太拥有强大的 AoE 技能。对抗的方法有很多种：

cac42f001badb368c1a13795d3a04e3d64d75f24.text: 疼痛逆变器很快就会杀死他们。

c762f7a1b11f3b3cbd00e452fc2883eae18fc41c.source: They can be interrupted, dazed, or knocked down.
c762f7a1b11f3b3cbd00e452fc2883eae18fc41c.text: 他们可能会被打断、晕眩或击倒。

723e43637357cf2c2c8b0f0250797248f379217a.source: The Djinni are vulnerable to cold damage, making Winter a good choice.
723e43637357cf2c2c8b0f0250797248f379217a.text: 神灵很容易受到寒冷的伤害，因此冬季是一个不错的选择。

d2e74112624172636b3f28b6f45120d6c32ab5be.source: Burning (caused by Searing Flames) can be countered with Extinguish or Breath of the Great Dwarf.
d2e74112624172636b3f28b6f45120d6c32ab5be.text: 燃烧（由灼热火焰引起）可以用熄灭或大矮人之息来对抗。
