c560dd1ba1133d389b1f55ee6ac1daa0c6e12e2e.source: Frozen Soil or interrupts (e.g. Complicate) can be useful to counter the Roaring Ethers' Resurrection Signets.
c560dd1ba1133d389b1f55ee6ac1daa0c6e12e2e.text: 冰冻土壤或中断（例如复杂）可用于对抗咆哮以太的复活徽记。

043c4d6cd9a30c5f90dd54d838bc0cc7ac52088e.source: Protection skills are very useful, including Protective Spirit and Shelter; henchman Kihm uses Protective Spirit.
043c4d6cd9a30c5f90dd54d838bc0cc7ac52088e.text: 防护技能非常有用，包括防护精神和庇护所；追随者基姆使用保护精神。

7b88f605cda2d3c848343f4d466fcc78180d3c8b.source: Bonders are very effective; none of the foes can remove enchantments.
7b88f605cda2d3c848343f4d466fcc78180d3c8b.text: 粘合剂非常有效；没有一个敌人能够移除结界。

a2ee48e5fab40efb54b6c30eaa5a668645ecde43.source: Very few of the foes are fleshy (just the Ethers); avoid skills that exploit corpses or inflict Bleeding, Disease, and Poison.
a2ee48e5fab40efb54b6c30eaa5a668645ecde43.text: 很少有敌人是肉质的（只有以太）；避免使用尸体或造成流血、疾病和中毒的技能。

dbac3b005649a66a8c5053769e21fe26b9e0efbc.source: For most of the mission, Goren should sustain little damage. The most dangerous times are if you try to run away, as Goren will usually be last to follow and thus be the focus of enemy fire. This is especially true in the Central Chamber fight where the bosses may deal lethal damage to Goren should you need to flee. Traps also have a possibility to deal substantial damage to Goren if not careful.
dbac3b005649a66a8c5053769e21fe26b9e0efbc.text: 在大部分任务中，戈伦受到的伤害应该很小。最危险的时候是当你试图逃跑时，因为戈伦通常会最后一个跟随，从而成为敌人火力的焦点。在中央密室战斗中尤其如此，如果你需要逃跑，头目可能会对戈伦造成致命伤害。如果不小心的话，陷阱也有可能对鬣蜥人造成重大伤害。

2f35214f9992625aa8fa3fcb8c7307bf2af255bc.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to the Kodash Bazaar.
2f35214f9992625aa8fa3fcb8c7307bf2af255bc.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到 Kodash Bazaar。

ed56886cc1476644d03fe7d88d0f614ab76c721b.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #9 in the Night Falls storybook.
ed56886cc1476644d03fe7d88d0f614ab76c721b.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 9 页。

a7fa84b23e7884c7544a9452d1340669f1b5dfcc.source: Speak with Headmaster Amara in the monastery.
a7fa84b23e7884c7544a9452d1340669f1b5dfcc.text: 与修道院的阿马拉校长交谈。

a4e9ff107e9bbfe5267b0caaae1235efca8f2ecc.source: You must have chosen to go with Master of Whispers in the Mysterious Message quest.
a4e9ff107e9bbfe5267b0caaae1235efca8f2ecc.text: 您一定选择了与低语大师一起进行神秘消息任务。

6854619290a59ec680ba8a2fa964a7582cdf2a04.source: You must have Masters of Whispers in your party
6854619290a59ec680ba8a2fa964a7582cdf2a04.text: 你的队伍中必须有密语大师

e9269d67c34618fe5f56cac48e1ad57a0941c01f.source: Call upon the Order of Whispers.

68aef2cc004b4e3a0e124c77799c44d01b84d3c7.source: Bring the Master of Whispers with you and use the Acolytes to defend against the Margonite threat.
68aef2cc004b4e3a0e124c77799c44d01b84d3c7.text: 带上低语大师并使用追随者来防御玛贡尼特的威胁。

adf837b25420aed5480083fe7579f507f3e7dec0.source: Use the Acolytes to defend against the onslaught of demons.
adf837b25420aed5480083fe7579f507f3e7dec0.text: 使用侍僧来抵御恶魔的攻击。

49c8efb4707bfcb3c66423b8da27c9b75e1b2552.source: Defend Norgu from the attacking forces.
49c8efb4707bfcb3c66423b8da27c9b75e1b2552.text: 保卫诺尔古免受攻击部队的攻击。

5a316c5ba01e300519d768dc1eecc4ab2b23670e.source: Inform Prince Ahmtur the Mighty that the Order of Whispers will help protect the Citadel of Dzagon.
5a316c5ba01e300519d768dc1eecc4ab2b23670e.text: 通知强大的阿姆图尔王子，低语骑士团将帮助保护扎贡城堡。

ad7470378027083e07b013d934fcd91c18c84c77.source: See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.
ad7470378027083e07b013d934fcd91c18c84c77.text: 去找穆伦达中尉领取奖励。

ff3f49e19e402bd70008ec7560673329e3422974.source: Make your way north from Chantry of Secrets to the map marker.
ff3f49e19e402bd70008ec7560673329e3422974.text: 从秘密教堂向北前往地图标记。

dd918e5b46d52a532707e9e5e4144e3ab8882eb8.source: Tip: Kill Lieutenant Vanahk for a 2% morale boost.
dd918e5b46d52a532707e9e5e4144e3ab8882eb8.text: 提示：杀死 Vanahk 中尉可获得 2% 的士气提升。

12f984be0e50918174f30158b0ea436baa426054.source: When you arrive Disciple of Secrets tells you to choose a side that the Order of Whispers should fight. For an easy fight choose Rangers and stay with Norgu and kill the Warriors that will appear. The Whispers Acolytes use "Shields Up!", so they are more suited to fight the Rangers. Your party should be able to kill the Warriors before they gain enough adrenaline to use their adrenaline attack skills.
12f984be0e50918174f30158b0ea436baa426054.text: 当你到达时，秘密门徒会告诉你选择低语骑士团应该战斗的一方。为了轻松战斗，选择游骑兵并留在诺古并杀死将出现的勇士。低语追随者使用“护盾升起！”，因此他们更适合与游骑兵作战。你的队伍应该能够在勇士获得足够的肾上腺素来使用他们的肾上腺素攻击技能之前杀死他们。

eb0e7f4107b413fdf396725bd54c479119d5697d.source: Talk to Norgu after both sets of Margonites are killed.
eb0e7f4107b413fdf396725bd54c479119d5697d.text: 杀死两组玛贡尼特后与诺尔古交谈。

48fbad7ecf47b9b65ed9ca60d9f4fbeb0a0fb3be.source: Map travel to Grand Court of Sebelkeh and then exit on the east side to make your way towards Dzagonur Bastion in the north-east
48fbad7ecf47b9b65ed9ca60d9f4fbeb0a0fb3be.text: 沿地图前往 Sebelkeh 大法院，然后从东侧出口前往东北部的 Dzagonur 堡垒

0f513b84566a1cfbd6cfb1ad160719027fa392da.source: Alternatively, map travel directly to Dzagonur Bastion if you unlocked it previously then simply exit southwest and speak with Prince Ahmtur the Mighty who is just outside.
0f513b84566a1cfbd6cfb1ad160719027fa392da.text: 或者，如果您之前解锁了扎贡努尔堡垒，则可以直接在地图上前往扎贡努尔堡垒，然后只需从西南方向退出并与外面的强大的阿姆图尔王子交谈即可。

330f7dafe21e6f97285712cb536716180cfd388b.source: Sending the Order of Whispers to a side too early (not triggering Norgu) may cause them to miss their Margonite group, allowing Norgu to be attacked and killed.
330f7dafe21e6f97285712cb536716180cfd388b.text: 过早将低语骑士团发送到一方（不触发诺古）可能会导致他们错过他们的玛贡尼特小队，从而使诺古受到攻击并被杀死。

7f18d8c0e41c98e97b7f63f82c7b66d58a691407.source: If your quest log does not update properly after sending the Whispers to the Ranger side, check near the bridge for remaining Margonites. On very rare occasions, your allies can get killed by a nearby group of Kournans.
7f18d8c0e41c98e97b7f63f82c7b66d58a691407.text: 如果您的任务日志在将低语发送到游侠一侧后没有正确更新，请检查桥附近是否有剩余的玛贡尼特。在极少数情况下，你的盟友可能会被附近的一群库南人杀死。

b4415bbc170521b50e0306fe1bbde297e8e63c1b.source: Access to Zen Daijun (explorable area), which requires completing the Zen Daijun mission.
b4415bbc170521b50e0306fe1bbde297e8e63c1b.text: 进入禅代君（可探索区域），需要完成禅代君任务。

8afee68abc3a351b3d7f1d6aafd5fe5e2e21db59.source: Defeat the plagued aspect of Zunraa.
8afee68abc3a351b3d7f1d6aafd5fe5e2e21db59.text: 击败受瘟疫困扰的祖拉。

fe7655758bafa9c1112f1a2174f69ba6063ac1a9.source: Defeat the rotten aspect of Zunraa.
fe7655758bafa9c1112f1a2174f69ba6063ac1a9.text: 击败 Zunraa 腐烂的一面。

f3b6fbc71416875b16e63039170e856e5809eb71.source: Defeat the tainted aspect of Zunraa.
f3b6fbc71416875b16e63039170e856e5809eb71.text: 击败 Zunraa 的污染面。

e37ef2d624d4d11196a82bdd41052f572b9eedcc.source: Defeat the infected aspect of Zunraa.
e37ef2d624d4d11196a82bdd41052f572b9eedcc.text: 击败 Zunraa 的感染者。

a6d13d63409aeca70006df76f0e4dd54cb7d1cab.source: Defeat the diseased aspect of Zunraa.
a6d13d63409aeca70006df76f0e4dd54cb7d1cab.text: 击败 Zunraa 的患病部分。

b1b0be3ffc2f9873bffc21c4573507bf87929a65.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Zen Daijun; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn but are replaced by Scavengers.
b1b0be3ffc2f9873bffc21c4573507bf87929a65.text: 完成此任务会改变禅代君中出现的敌人；具体来说，受折磨者将不再生成，而是被拾荒者取代。

bb4b58d566b6a83482fb2c6ad4554d49871f90bc.source: The standard enemy party size here is 4 or 6, and the enemy party size around each Shrine of Zunraa is 6, not including the afflicted aspect of Zunraa. Careful pulling is recommended as the groups tend to bunch up near each other.
bb4b58d566b6a83482fb2c6ad4554d49871f90bc.text: 这里的标准敌方人数为 4 或 6，每个 Zunraa 神殿周围的敌方人数为 6，不包括 Zunraa 的受灾方。建议小心拉动，因为这些群体往往会聚集在一起。

44b5e71abecc21caf3b8aeea7f5e9c98cb20331c.source: Caution: when approaching some of the Shrines of Zunraa, a nearby mobile group of 4 enemies will approach to attack you. Take care of them first, before engaging the group around the shrine itself.
44b5e71abecc21caf3b8aeea7f5e9c98cb20331c.text: 注意：当接近某些 Zunraa 神殿时，附近的 4 名敌人组成的机动部队会靠近并攻击你。先解决掉他们，然后再与神社周围的队伍交战。

2b2e715ab56d8789be28d68d71767a3e482fd443.source: The groups surrounding the afflicted aspects of Zunraa can be pulled separately. It appears that the afflicted aspects of Zunraa do not heal or interact with them in any way.
2b2e715ab56d8789be28d68d71767a3e482fd443.text: 围绕 Zunraa 受影响区域的团体可以单独拉动。看来 Zunraa 的受折磨的方面不会以任何方式治愈或与他们互动。

391209a461a44318931a4918bd6cc48d61d28f69.source: Pain Inverter is extremely effective against the aspects of Zunraa, as well as Afflicted Elementalists.
391209a461a44318931a4918bd6cc48d61d28f69.text: 疼痛反转器对于对抗 Zunraa 以及受折磨的元素师非常有效。

7a1d37cf46c649dc5f3d9cd520c95d7d60b0b09c.source: Mesmers capable of interrupt and skill disabling are a good idea here.
7a1d37cf46c649dc5f3d9cd520c95d7d60b0b09c.text: 能够打断和禁用技能的催眠师在这里是个好主意。

dea94be127ec1c5d9731a020cad5fce131acd134.source: AoE skills will not be highly effective, as enemies tend to spread out somewhat.
dea94be127ec1c5d9731a020cad5fce131acd134.text: AoE 技能不会非常有效，因为敌人往往会分散一些。

c5ea76f1536013fbde8f473031f53abe6e0f70d8.source: Five of the Elite skills in Smiting Prayers are available for capture during this quest.
c5ea76f1536013fbde8f473031f53abe6e0f70d8.text: 在此任务中可以捕获《击杀祈祷》中的五种精英技能。

af9b9564a20eadf687a1ab3fb5713107db40feae.source: If you have the "unwelcome guest" quest. The area will bug and you will not get Zunraa spawns
af9b9564a20eadf687a1ab3fb5713107db40feae.text: 如果你有“不速之客”的任务。该区域将会出现 bug，并且您不会获得 Zunraa 的生成

468ab864368a4d1561300f5015ebef0004e1d4ec.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is by completing Abaddon's Mouth.
468ab864368a4d1561300f5015ebef0004e1d4ec.text: 进入任务没有任何要求，但进入前哨站的唯一方法是完成阿巴顿之口。

130d05f2eaaf624e3323cc13901b8e5440c93e68.source: Stop the Lich from destroying the world.

f12ba86159db8cc6a1e763dcbd0e59f982b28ac5.text: *奖励* 摧毁所有三个哈米吉多顿领主。

4a7ce20f0d928dadec6a4c9069802ead04891173.source: The Door of Komalie has been opened and now the Lich has gained control over the Titans through the Scepter of Orr. He has opened three portals to teleport these servants onto different regions of Tyria. Players must close them to save the world and finally defeat the Lich. The portals are located south-west of the island. The major difficulty players meet here is the combined strength of two types of foes, the Titans and the Imps called Spark of the Titans. The Imps deal massive area of effect fire damage (Rodgort's Invocation/Mind Burn) and are very dangerous as a group. The Titans cause burning condition to adjacent foes and also spawn other titans when killed in the following sequence: Burning Titan, Risen Ashen Hulk, Fist of the Titans and Hand of the Titans together. Always target the Imps first.
4a7ce20f0d928dadec6a4c9069802ead04891173.text: 科马利之门已经打开，现在巫妖已经通过奥尔权杖控制了泰坦。他打开了三个传送门，将这些仆人传送到泰瑞亚的不同地区。玩家必须关闭它们来拯救世界并最终击败巫妖。门户位于岛的西南部。玩家在这里遇到的主要困难是两种敌人的综合实力，泰坦和被称为泰坦火花的小恶魔。小恶魔会造成大面积火焰伤害（罗德戈特的召唤/心灵灼烧），并且作为一个群体非常危险。泰坦会对邻近的敌人造成燃烧状态，并在按以下顺序被杀死时生成其他泰坦：燃烧泰坦、复活灰浩克、泰坦之拳和泰坦之手。始终首先瞄准 Imp。

df346b0ee12c0547a0cafef37327bb19ae8428a2.source: At the beginning of the mission, there are two bridges to the south; avoid fighting over them and use those structures as choke points instead. After crossing the second bridge, players will encounter a fork (both roads merge afterwards) and an overwhelming number of foes. Soon, a boss will spawn and all present patrols will rush towards it. Instead of engaging this huge army, it is advised to wait for them to go away and proceed to the south-east path to avoid such deadly threat. Another group of foes will be there. Before fighting these, make sure the big group has moved far enough away to avoid fighting both mobs. The Ancient Seer will be standing on the path to the south, "guarded" by at least (1) Burning Titan and must be saved for those willing to start the bonus. The Ancient Seer will not be attacked until within radar range of a party member. Continue to the south-west and you will arrive at a small area with different groups with overlapping patrols. The ground has ruptures and standing over them causes burning; watch positioning. Fight those foes separately to avoid over-aggro. Cross a third bridge to find the large open area where the three portals are located with numerous groups of foes.
df346b0ee12c0547a0cafef37327bb19ae8428a2.text: 任务开始时，南边有两座桥；避免争夺它们，而是将这些建筑物用作咽喉要道。穿过第二座桥后，玩家将遇到一个岔路口（两条路随后合并）和大量的敌人。很快，一个boss就会出现，所有在场的巡逻队都会冲向它。建议不要与这支庞大的军队交战，而是等待他们走开，然后向东南方向前进，以避免这种致命的威胁。另一群敌人将会在那里。在与这些怪物战斗之前，请确保大群已经移得足够远，以避免与这两个怪物战斗。古代先知将站在通往南方的道路上，至少由 (1) 燃烧泰坦“守卫”，并且必须为那些愿意开始奖励的人保存。远古先知只有在队员的雷达范围内才会受到攻击。继续向西南方向走，你会到达一个小区域，有不同的小组，巡逻重叠。地面有裂缝，站在裂缝上会引起燃烧；手表定位。分别与这些敌人战斗以避免过度仇恨。穿过第三座桥，找到三个传送门所在的大片开放区域，那里有许多敌人。

40f6152c28bbeb8cca1f2ca42e1133db4426ce52.source: This section features a large lava pool to the north-east from where more foes emerge until two bosses have spawned. Take out isolated foes that are scattered across the field to reduce their numbers. The very large number of mobs here can all be pulled in ones or twos if one waits patiently enough; Risen Ashen Hulk don't spawn any further Titans either. Then pull the roaming patrol away from the portals. Finally, close the portals by killing the three Portal Wraiths guarding them.
40f6152c28bbeb8cca1f2ca42e1133db4426ce52.text: 该区域的东北部有一个大型熔岩池，更多的敌人会从那里出现，直到出现两个 Boss。消灭分散在战场上的孤立敌人以减少他们的数量。这里的怪物数量非常多，只要耐心等待，三两两的都能被拉过来。复活的灰烬浩克也不会再生成任何泰坦。然后将漫游巡逻队拉离传送门。最后，杀死守卫传送门的三个传送门幽灵来关闭传送门。

db3cfd7e90825b6e925551f2849b13f1d9e601db.source: A cinematic will trigger and players will be taken north to face the Undead Prince Rurik with a pair of Spark of the Titans, in addition to two groups of Fist of the Titans. It can be easier to pull Rurik and the two imps from the platform to isolate them away from their titan allies. Once the two imps and Rurik are dead, the next cinematic will trigger.
db3cfd7e90825b6e925551f2849b13f1d9e601db.text: 将会触发一段动画，玩家将被带到北方，带着一对泰坦火花和两组泰坦之拳面对亡灵王子鲁里克。将鲁里克和两个小鬼从平台上拉出来，将他们与泰坦盟友隔离开来会更容易。一旦两个小鬼和鲁里克死了，下一个过场动画就会触发。

4b85816ae6bd8e7181c5de1478255b3b831c1271.source: Defeat the very end boss, the Lich, who has the ability to cast characters into the lava, as well as teleport himself to escape the party's attack. He can also resurrect with full life from one to three times, every time accompanied by two Fists. It is recommended to take care of these servants immediately and before targeting the revived Lich again. Contrary to Rurik's cinematic dialogue, the Lich can be killed anywhere and not just while standing on the Bloodstone.
4b85816ae6bd8e7181c5de1478255b3b831c1271.text: 击败最后的首领巫妖，他有能力将角色投入熔岩中，并传送自己以逃避队伍的攻击。他还可以满血复活一到三次，每次都伴随着两个拳头。建议立即处理掉这些仆人，然后再再次瞄准复活的巫妖。与留里克的电影对话相反，巫妖可以在任何地方被杀死，而不仅仅是站在血石上。

781a707ec59cb8dd50bbc1dc8981e74ece117e1c.source: Parties with heroes/henchmen should flag them at the center of the Bloodstone so that they won't run into the lava.
781a707ec59cb8dd50bbc1dc8981e74ece117e1c.text: 有英雄/追随者的队伍应该在鸡血石的中心标记他们，这样他们就不会陷入熔岩中。

eb292fd7885ede1e04251a14ae36bf4f1a01231e.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Droknar's Forge (explorable area). Each player will receive a Deldrimor Talisman (once only) from Jalis Ironhammer which can be exchanged for a unique item.
eb292fd7885ede1e04251a14ae36bf4f1a01231e.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到卓克纳尔的熔炉（可探索区域）。每个玩家都会从贾利斯·铁锤那里收到一个德尔德里莫护身符（仅限一次），可以兑换一个独特的物品。

9608af955fc154c8433ef17e3551eb043663ef17.source: The bonus goal is to kill three Armageddon Lords (they also spawn Risen Ashen Hulks) at the large lava pool in front of the portals.
9608af955fc154c8433ef17e3551eb043663ef17.text: 奖励目标是在传送门前的大型熔岩池中杀死三名末日领主（他们还会生成复活的灰烬浩克）。

2d3248579c097968020814431117d98b043964bd.source: To obtain the objectives, players must first save the Ancient Seer located after the large spawn that moves toward the boss. A Burning Titan will be near the Seer, but will not attack them until a player reaches within spirit range. Pulling the mob just north of the Seer can therefore make the rescue easier. The bonus will fail if the Seer dies, even if you kill all the Armageddon Lords. The party healers can protect the Seer until the enemy is defeated. Once the foes are defeated, interact with the Seer, who will give you the bonus.
2d3248579c097968020814431117d98b043964bd.text: 为了获得目标，玩家必须首先拯救位于向 Boss 移动的大型生成体后面的古代先知。燃烧泰坦将靠近先知，但在玩家到达精神范围内之前不会攻击他们。因此，将怪物拉到先知号以北可以让救援变得更容易。如果先知死亡，即使你杀死了所有的末日领主，奖励也会失败。队伍治疗者可以保护先知，直到敌人被击败。一旦敌人被击败，与先知互动，他会给你奖金。

b854453750e5074421debca6407475fa9da90e15.source: The Armageddon Lords are themselves relatively easy to defeat and can be pulled individually from the lava pool. Do not close the portals before defeating the Armageddon Lords; doing so will trigger the cinematic, and players will have to backtrack twice--once to finish off the Armageddon Lords and then to engage Undead Prince Rurik later.
b854453750e5074421debca6407475fa9da90e15.text: 世界末日领主本身相对容易击败，并且可以单独从熔岩池中拉出。在击败哈米吉多顿领主之前不要关闭传送门；这样做会触发过场动画，玩家将不得不原路返回两次——一次是为了消灭哈米吉多顿领主，然后是稍后与不死王子鲁里克交战。

49ce654064f65bdedae81938c03fa4fd7de5f259.source: Note: There is a chance to face a bad spawn where all the Hulks and Sparks appear very close to the Seer and aggro much more easily, which makes it practically impossible to save the Seer. It is recommended to approach the Seer from the north, as it is possible to trigger these foes on your way south.
49ce654064f65bdedae81938c03fa4fd7de5f259.text: 注意：有可能会遇到糟糕的重生，所有浩克和火花都出现在距离先知非常近的地方，并且更容易产生仇恨，这使得拯救先知几乎不可能。建议从北方接近先知，因为有可能在向南的途中触发这些敌人。

7c4b731bacb95e90972e2c7856cf8ddb8ce62eaf.source: Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm, Mantra of Flame, interrupts like Maelstrom and Panic, and daze-inflicting skills like Technobabble.
7c4b731bacb95e90972e2c7856cf8ddb8ce62eaf.text: 元素防御或伤害防御、火焰咒语、漩涡和恐慌等打断，以及技术喋喋不休等造成眩晕的技能。

47934ef7e3dd10fd34f8380af21bb600ef0615cf.source: Party-wide heals to counter the massive AoE damage.
47934ef7e3dd10fd34f8380af21bb600ef0615cf.text: 全队范围内的治疗可以对抗巨大的 AoE 伤害。

853271472dd5da455608416350c1eba88b55387d.source: A Frigid Armor tank to draw damage away from the rest of the party.
853271472dd5da455608416350c1eba88b55387d.text: 冰冷装甲坦克可以将伤害从队伍的其他成员身上转移开。

d671d95defb76724c9506edc0350f49cbac7099b.source: Cold damage skills are more effective against titans.
d671d95defb76724c9506edc0350f49cbac7099b.text: 冰冷伤害技能对抗泰坦更有效。

4af520e9309663e728950903a66e3e8fbb05dd87.source: Area of effect Weakness such as Enfeebling Blood to mitigate damage from multiple Fists and Hands of the Titans.
4af520e9309663e728950903a66e3e8fbb05dd87.text: 影响范围弱点，例如虚弱之血，可减轻多个泰坦之拳和之手的伤害。

21609759d3c14e8a0421f92fe7902e981b55b5e6.source: Only Sparks and Risen Ashen Hulk are fleshy. Other titans are not and thus are immune to conditions such as Bleeding, Poison and Disease, and don't leave a corpse. Since Risen Ashen Hulks also carry Aura of the Lich, this can make it difficult for minion masters. Steal their minions with Verata's Gaze or Verata's Aura, and bring Jagged Bones if you have access to it.
21609759d3c14e8a0421f92fe7902e981b55b5e6.text: 只有斯帕克斯和复活灰浩克是肉质的。其他泰坦则不然，因此对流血、毒药和疾病等情况免疫，并且不会留下尸体。由于复活的灰烬浩克也带有巫妖光环，这可能会给随从大师带来困难。用维拉塔的凝视或维拉塔的光环偷走他们的爪牙，如果你有能力的话，还可以带上锯齿骨。

ae2f24868c89048e4bbbe9079c794a8af6aacacc.source: Risen Ashen Hulks use Strip Enchantment. Bring cover enchantments if dependent.
ae2f24868c89048e4bbbe9079c794a8af6aacacc.text: 复活的灰烬浩克使用脱衣附魔。如果有依赖性，请带上掩护结界。

ff96907e4441574538790d01ef0080a511d5f9ce.source: An Avatar of Melandru Dervish can be helpful for elemental armor and party-wide condition removal, as well as applying blindness with Dust Cloak against Fists and Hands of the Titans.
ff96907e4441574538790d01ef0080a511d5f9ce.text: 梅兰德鲁苦行僧的化身可以帮助元素护甲和全队条件移除，以及用尘斗篷对泰坦之拳和之手施加失明。

78d1ac3ead12a3f962a28c554398faf2a35eefaa.source: Meteors will randomly fall throughout the mission, knocking down, and slightly damaging those they hit. The points at which they fall are predetermined and will not change, but how often they fall is varied.
78d1ac3ead12a3f962a28c554398faf2a35eefaa.text: 流星会在整个任务中随机落下，击落并轻微损坏被击中的人。它们掉落的点是预先确定的并且不会改变，但是它们掉落的频率是不同的。

7c0f3ddfe61b2513379cce23d453cd6c6e489d53.source: Offensive Binding rituals placed outside earshot range may help against the Lich, as he will not move toward you from the center. Make sure you can inflict enough damage to overcome the Lich's health regeneration.
7c0f3ddfe61b2513379cce23d453cd6c6e489d53.text: 放置在听力范围之外的进攻性束缚仪式可能有助于对抗巫妖，因为他不会从中心向你移动。确保你可以造成足够的伤害来克服巫妖的生命恢复。

09ad271b9766ebc7e5b5eacbbb6267f3b63edab0.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.06% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
09ad271b9766ebc7e5b5eacbbb6267f3b63edab0.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.06%。

9fdb66891ee69a8938d0b1e2eef6bc1426bea3cf.source: For the best chance of survival and for minimization of damage, kill enemies in this order: Spark of the Titans · Armageddon Lords · Scelus Prosum (Elementalist boss) · Burning Titans · Fist of the Titans · Hand of the Titans · Bosses (excluding Elementalist boss) · Risen Ashen Hulk · Bone Horror
9fdb66891ee69a8938d0b1e2eef6bc1426bea3cf.text: 为了获得最大的生存机会并最大限度地减少伤害，请按以下顺序杀死敌人：泰坦火花·世界末日领主·斯塞鲁斯·普罗苏姆（元素师老板）·燃烧泰坦·泰坦之拳·泰坦之手·老板（不包括元素师老板）·复活的灰烬浩克·白骨恐怖

a661698d7d21225482faf68a8e2c75abdd9e1030.source: (When you have defeated a Risen Ashen Hulk, be sure to finish the spawning Fists/Hands before moving to the next one.)
a661698d7d21225482faf68a8e2c75abdd9e1030.text: （当你击败了复活的灰烬绿巨人后，请务必完成生成的拳头/手，然后再进行下一个。）

dbee277ecbc4c7b9725281abca58981cdb7e94f1.source: Though she's referred to as Glint, the dragon does not appear in the flesh during the end cinematic but rather in the same ghostly form as her Vision.
dbee277ecbc4c7b9725281abca58981cdb7e94f1.text: 尽管她被称为格林特，但这条龙在影片结尾并没有以肉身出现，而是以与她的幻视相同的幽灵形式出现。

89c78447ee1375ac54016fc89034ac2271dc3977.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #18 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
89c78447ee1375ac54016fc89034ac2271dc3977.text: 完成此任务将填写《寻火者预言》故事书第 18 页。

c9349c71a04f85b3434a8947525d8f0fbce62edc.source: Occasionally, one of the portals does not appear. In this case, closing the other two portals does not help, but should be attempted. On rare occasions, the seer will be dead before you can trigger the bonus, even if you stayed out of compass distance.
c9349c71a04f85b3434a8947525d8f0fbce62edc.text: 有时，其中一个门户不会出现。在这种情况下，关闭其他两个门户没有帮助，但应该尝试。在极少数情况下，即使您处于罗盘距离之外，预言家也会在您触发奖励之前死亡。

0b1a0e6e5c97d27d9d02e0b810c1e588b5a9ed59.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Rhea's Crater.
0b1a0e6e5c97d27d9d02e0b810c1e588b5a9ed59.text: 击败瑞亚陨石坑中的受折磨者。

f70f111bbc607d405e254d405235983bf756e312.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Rhea's Crater. Specifically, Afflicted and Focus of Hanaku will no longer spawn.
f70f111bbc607d405e254d405235983bf756e312.text: 完成此任务会改变瑞亚陨石坑中出现的敌人。具体来说，受苦者和花库焦点将不再生成。

5ae57decb8602641418cfcfa5de0f011864913eb.source: Starting from Seafarer's Rest, follow the quest markers and eliminate the three mobs of afflicted.
5ae57decb8602641418cfcfa5de0f011864913eb.text: 从海员之眠开始，按照任务标记消灭三个受影响的小怪。

f7c4f14e6603cd7ede0108aec8dfa7579ff5604f.source: The subsequent groups will not spawn until the previous group has been defeated, forcing you to finish the groups in order.
f7c4f14e6603cd7ede0108aec8dfa7579ff5604f.text: 在前一组被击败之前，后续组不会产生，迫使您按顺序完成组。

2ee589ac0d77b2d08a6014e3f5546889ea8f0e81.source: Initiate Zei Ri leaves the party list before defeating the final group of afflicted, resulting in Zei Ri attempting to heal the Afflicted.
2ee589ac0d77b2d08a6014e3f5546889ea8f0e81.text: 新人 Zei Ri 在击败最后一批受折磨者之前离开了队伍名单，导致 Zei Ri 试图治愈受折磨者。

83ad7ba40c9bc4e452afb05c513fd5a9a08e3be3.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Calling the Order or Greed and Regret.
83ad7ba40c9bc4e452afb05c513fd5a9a08e3be3.text: 所有党员都必须接受过“号令”或“贪婪与悔恨”的奖励。

b2b4d06d5388a3692080e6d6ee7ff7bd9a6ff7d0.source: Defeat the Margonite generals before their forces take the Citadel. Preserve the perimeter bombards to aid you in the battle. Defend the gates to prevent enemy forces from reaching the Citadel.
b2b4d06d5388a3692080e6d6ee7ff7bd9a6ff7d0.text: 在玛贡尼特将军的军队占领城堡之前击败他们。保留外围轰炸以帮助你在战斗中。保卫大门，防止敌军到达城堡。

54abbd2279de1fe6d0994753487f90657a3cc53d.source: Speak to Prince Ahmtur the Mighty.
54abbd2279de1fe6d0994753487f90657a3cc53d.text: 与强大的阿姆图尔王子交谈。

39e984f83303d9f54df2a31cde3853077bbdcdbc.text: 3 个城门中的 [3...0] 仍然矗立。

6013e559d5bef8ca16d88240206de079ba704941.text: 3 枚轰炸中的 [3...0] 仍在发挥作用。

40bdded35553f81af82acc2bc42d8a543e196b49.text: 剩下 4 位将军中的 [4...0] 位。

e78a9d39621b0975eb7b7804949ad4314ee106c7.text: *奖励*保持堡垒防御完好无损。

83522437a3f1bbd448f884ffde5a059601b8b857.source: The aim of this mission is to make sure that the citadel is not captured. You aren't alone in this task; you have several groups of Vabbi defenders to help you out and siege support from the citadel. You start out in the citadel and use a teleporter to exit the stronghold and begin the mission.
83522437a3f1bbd448f884ffde5a059601b8b857.text: 此任务的目的是确保城堡不被占领。您并不孤单地执行这项任务；你有几组瓦比防御者来帮助你，并从城堡提供围攻支援。你从城堡开始，使用传送器离开要塞并开始任务。

eca4887cf5d9de171b0da4d6ad24f5f4e64317ca.source: In front of the citadel there are 3 groups of Vabbi defenders. The Disciple of Secrets which leads each group can be given instructions on where they should be defending. It is recommended that you send 2 groups to defend one side, and defend the middle with the last group.
eca4887cf5d9de171b0da4d6ad24f5f4e64317ca.text: 城堡前有3组瓦比守军。带领每个小组的秘密弟子可以得到指示，告诉他们应该防守哪里。建议派2组去防守一侧，最后一组去防守中间。

da0282e594a82ccf362fe7cb4bf06dc7dd52716c.source: Initially a few groups of Kournan soldiers will come towards the citadel. Focus your defense on the center with the Vabbi defenders, but you may need to travel widely to help control the Kournans. In a team with 2 or more human players, split into two teams of 4 for mobility and better defense. If you are alone it is best to stay with your team and defend the middle and the side without Vabbi defenders - Master of Whispers as a minion master is a good choice. 2 groups of Vabbi defenders will have trouble defending a side without some assistance.
da0282e594a82ccf362fe7cb4bf06dc7dd52716c.text: 最初，几组库尔南士兵将前往城堡。将你的防守集中在瓦比后卫的中路，但你可能需要广泛移动以帮助控制库南。在有 2 名或更多人类玩家的队伍中，分成两队，每队 4 人，以提高机动性和更好的防守。如果你独自一人，最好留在你的团队中，在没有瓦比防守者的情况下防守中路和边路——密语大师作为随从大师是一个不错的选择。如果没有一些帮助，两组瓦比后卫将很难防守一支球队。

e0a75682d29e70a966b7b98748d8ddfbd2825411.source: After several waves of Kournan groups, four Margonite bosses (the Generals) will spawn at the far edge of the area in front of the citadel. The Chaos rifts which they control will continue to spawn groups of Kournan soldiers accompanied by a single Margonite demon as long as the boss is alive. The bosses must be killed to reduce the defensive workload for the team and complete the mission. The Generals will only come down towards the fort when each defense is broken - so the elementalist boss will come down to the East Bombard when the East Bombard is destroyed by the Kournan forces and will move onto the gate and beyond when the Kournan forces have destroyed the East Gate. The generals in order from west to east are; WarriorGeneral Doriah, MonkGeneral Nimtak, ParagonGeneral Kumtash, ElementalistGeneral Tirraj.
e0a75682d29e70a966b7b98748d8ddfbd2825411.text: 在库南集团的几波攻击之后，四个玛贡尼特 Boss（将军）将在城堡前面区域的最边缘生成。只要 Boss 还活着，他们控制的混沌裂隙就会继续产生一群库南士兵，并伴随着一个玛贡尼特恶魔。必须杀死boss才能减少队伍的防守工作量并完成任务。将军们只会在每次防御被破坏时才会朝堡垒下降 - 因此，当东炮台被库南部队摧毁时，元素主义者 Boss 会来到东炮台，而当库南部队摧毁东门时，元素主义者 Boss 会移至大门并超越。将军从西向东依次是：战士将军多利亚、僧侣将军尼姆塔克、典范将军库姆塔什、元素师将军蒂拉吉。

3483e788a2a76e3c7200d091f52a81e5a13ff4c6.source: Go to the side which does not have the Vabbi defenders. Kill any group of Kournans which emerge after the boss spawn and then push up to take out the boss. Fall back if need be to defend the middle, but each time you attack try to kill the boss or at least one of the Margonites in the boss' group. When that boss is killed get on top of the defensive situation on the other side and middle then work on the next boss along from the one you just killed. When the second boss is killed the worst is over and it should now be easy for you to get the situation under control as the attackers and defenders are focused in the same spot. Take out the remaining two bosses to finish the mission.
3483e788a2a76e3c7200d091f52a81e5a13ff4c6.text: 前往没有瓦比防守者的一侧。杀死 Boss 出现后出现的任何一群 Kournan，然后向上推去消灭 Boss。如果需要的话可以撤退以防守中间，但每次攻击时都尝试杀死老板或老板团队中的至少一个玛贡尼特。当那个老板被杀后，控制另一侧和中间的防御情况，然后从你刚刚杀死的老板开始处理下一个老板。当第二个头目被杀死后，最糟糕的情况就已经过去了，现在你应该很容易控制局势，因为攻击者和防御者都集中在同一个地方。干掉剩下的两个boss即可完成任务。

07f9c948eddee82ef3c643c1a789a5d786cd3cfa.source: Remember that the mission becomes easier the more generals you kill as they will no longer summon more troops, so be assertive even if it means you suffer a few losses. If you send the Vabbians to the east gate (you should) then you can work from west to east, i.e. starting with General Doriah (the warrior). This will mean you have less running to do, and by the time you get to General Tirraj you should have a sizeable Vabbian force left to help you out (and absorb some of Tirraj's ridiculous spike damage). Go in for the kill - take out the priest (if there is one) and then the general - massive spike damage is your best friend, so a high-damage assassin build, air elementalist (or AoE fire elementalist if you've got snares) and mesmers are effective. When you go in for the kill, commit to it. Make sure you've got the energy reserves to get it, then you can retreat to regenerate before finishing off the group.
07f9c948eddee82ef3c643c1a789a5d786cd3cfa.text: 请记住，你杀死的将军越多，任务就会变得越容易，因为他们将不再召唤更多的部队，所以要自信，即使这意味着你会遭受一些损失。如果你把瓦比人送到东门（你应该），那么你可以从西向东工作，即从多利亚将军（战士）开始。这意味着你需要跑的次数更少，当你到达提拉吉将军时，你应该有一支相当大的瓦比亚军队来帮助你（并吸收提拉吉的一些荒谬的尖刺伤害）。去杀戮 - 干掉牧师（如果有的话），然后一般 - 巨大的尖刺伤害是你最好的朋友，所以高伤害刺客构建，空气元素师（或AoE火元素师，如果你有陷阱）和催眠师是有效的。当你想要杀戮时，就要全身心投入。确保你有足够的能量储备来获得它，然后你可以在消灭队伍之前撤退以恢复活力。

988d6b5a049db3e7de3a7cc2ff95246bb448f05b.source: You lose this mission (and bonus) by getting worn down. The Kournans and Margonites are fighting a war of attrition against you - you have very little time to recuperate between battles as you constantly need to be fighting somewhere else. That means your team needs to be relatively self-sufficient - bring a self-heal and something to help you regenerate energy quickly. The longer the mission goes on, the harder it will get as death penalty starts to rack up and you have no reserves left you will find it harder to eliminate groups quick enough and you'll find yourself overwhelmed. Consequently, end it as soon as possible - be ready to eliminate at least one general the moment they spawn. While this is a tough mission, well-equipped teams shouldn't have too much trouble.
988d6b5a049db3e7de3a7cc2ff95246bb448f05b.text: 你会因为疲惫而失去这个任务（和奖金）。库尔南人和玛贡尼特人正在与你进行一场消耗战——你在战斗之间几乎没有时间恢复，因为你经常需要在其他地方战斗。这意味着你的团队需要相对自给自足——带来自我修复和帮助你快速恢复能量的东西。任务持续的时间越长，任务就会变得越困难，因为死刑开始累积，而你没有剩余的储备，你会发现很难足够快地消灭团体，你会发现自己不知所措。因此，尽快结束它——准备好在他们出现时消灭至少一名将军。虽然这是一项艰巨的任务，但装备精良的团队应该不会遇到太多麻烦。

53350177f51389fa0c9d6e7a09b9284433b31020.source: For the Master's reward on this mission only 5 of the 6 defensive structures need to remain.
53350177f51389fa0c9d6e7a09b9284433b31020.text: 大师在这次任务中的奖励只需要保留 6 个防御结构中的 5 个即可。

cc014831a1041b4fc53e5a3258b9952672e78f65.source: If you are attempting the bonus with heroes and henchmen, it may take a few attempts to be successful. Assign all the Vabbi defenders to either the western or eastern bombard, and use your party to defend the remaining two. It may also be easier to let one of the bombards fall after the bosses spawn, since this will prompt the boss at that bombard to move towards the center; you can then engage him without having to move too far away from the other bombards. However, if any other defensive structures are lost you'll have to restart the mission for the bonus. You should also keep an eye on the status of the Vabbians; while they can usually hold their own against the Kournans, you may have to come to their aid.
cc014831a1041b4fc53e5a3258b9952672e78f65.text: 如果您尝试英雄和追随者的奖励，可能需要几次尝试才能成功。将所有瓦比防御者分配到西部或东部炮击，并使用你的队伍来保卫剩下的两个。在 Boss 生成后让其中一颗轰炸机落下也可能更容易，因为这会促使该轰炸机上的 Boss 向中心移动；然后你就可以与他交战，而不必距离其他轰炸机太远。但是，如果任何其他防御结构丢失，您将必须重新启动任务才能获得奖励。您还应该关注瓦比亚人的状况；虽然他们通常可以对抗库南人，但你可能必须帮助他们。

c225445565ec7fea81d8a3b30eb35af69c70ffb4.source: Tactically, the Eastern Bombard is easier for the Vabbian defenders to hold because the difference in elevation between the attacking position and the Vabbian defenders is less significant, so the Kournan archers receive a smaller height advantage against the defenders. Furthermore, General Doriah is typically easier for smaller parties to defeat due to his lack of area of effect damage and generally weaker healing ability. Defeating him early in the battle will make it much easier for you to manage against the other generals, because the Western Bombard is much farther from the other two bombards.
c225445565ec7fea81d8a3b30eb35af69c70ffb4.text: 从战术上来说，东部炮击更容易被瓦比亚守军守住，因为攻击位置与瓦比亚守军之间的海拔差异较小，因此库尔南弓箭手对守军的高度优势较小。此外，多利亚将军通常更容易被较小的队伍击败，因为他缺乏有效伤害范围并且治疗能力通常较弱。在战斗初期击败他将使你更容易对付其他将军，因为西方轰炸机距离其他两架轰炸机要远得多。

3df8535082661bd7c86c43680b7febeb5f0b0055.source: It helps to bring a minion master (especially Master of Whispers) and/or a spirit spammer to provide additional allies to hold the enemies' attention.
3df8535082661bd7c86c43680b7febeb5f0b0055.text: 它有助于带来一个随从大师（尤其是低语大师）和/或一个精神垃圾邮件发送者，以提供额外的盟友来吸引敌人的注意力。

bfa019410c450fbc2ac90e6b78109116e5c6c441.source: Party-wide speed boosts, such as "Fall Back!", to move between bombards more quickly.
bfa019410c450fbc2ac90e6b78109116e5c6c441.text: 全队范围内的速度提升，例如“后退！”，可以更快地在轰炸之间移动。

99047b9f0c6b5c5d0801de0fe7215b1d8e2b1fe2.source: Shutdowns to prevent General Tirraj from dealing heavy damage, including interrupts and daze (along with martial players/heroes). Alternatively, damage mitigation skills, e.g. Shelter or Ward Against Elements.
99047b9f0c6b5c5d0801de0fe7215b1d8e2b1fe2.text: 关闭以防止提拉吉将军造成严重伤害，包括打断和眩晕（以及武术玩家/英雄）。或者，减轻伤害的技能，例如避难所或防御元素。

3d6e1aecea8a15a72dbc648fc7baf8c8accf80bb.source: Along with The Eternal Grove, this is one of the hardest missions to complete with only heroes and henchmen, due to having to defend multiple points against large numbers of foes.
3d6e1aecea8a15a72dbc648fc7baf8c8accf80bb.text: 与永恒丛林一样，这是仅靠英雄和追随者完成的最难的任务之一，因为必须防御大量敌人的多个点。

9d759f351cc1acf3c256760394e3fc0786b77ab0.source: You can force the generals to come forward as soon as they spawn by allowing one or more of the bombards to fall early on. The two central generals will come forward if the middle bombard is taken; the others will move closer if the bombard nearest to them falls.
9d759f351cc1acf3c256760394e3fc0786b77ab0.text: 你可以通过让一枚或多枚炮弹尽早落下来迫使将军们在出现后立即挺身而出。中炮，则两中将出面；如果离他们最近的炮弹落下，其他人就会靠近。

d98d5098086e703e25b21e1fdadeac5797a1b1b6.source: If the generals are killed near where they spawned, their summoned groups usually will not move towards the bombards after their deaths. This allows you to specifically aim to kill only the general, before disengaging and running off to kill the next general.
d98d5098086e703e25b21e1fdadeac5797a1b1b6.text: 如果将军在他们出生的地方附近被杀，他们的召唤团体通常不会在他们死后朝炮击方向移动。这允许你专门瞄准只杀死将军，然后脱离并跑去杀死下一个将军。

c3589003ae02057e1e6ce272534510c055d40c1c.source: Cartographers can choose to ignore all the foes and make a run for the portal in the south, normally leading to Resplendent Makuun. Because it's a mission, you'll just run through the portal and encounter an end-of-the-world glitch. This makes for an extra, non-required 0.1% - 0.2%.
c3589003ae02057e1e6ce272534510c055d40c1c.text: 制图师可以选择忽略所有敌人并跑向南部的传送门，通常通向辉煌的马库恩。因为这是一个任务，你只会穿过门户并遇到世界末日的故障。这会产生额外的、非必需的 0.1% - 0.2%。

9d92d5ecab39046a496d2355d56b91ed800caaf4.source: If Prince Ahmtur dies, the mission fails.
9d92d5ecab39046a496d2355d56b91ed800caaf4.text: 如果阿姆图尔王子死亡，任务就会失败。

ca89929d3736133bbc42dc71dd165defa01ed8fc.source: After completing this mission, your party will appear in the Kodash Bazaar.
ca89929d3736133bbc42dc71dd165defa01ed8fc.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将出现在 Kodash Bazaar 中。

640b66af65b2811ce8c2c36a69c98f7616346e3c.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #8 in the Night Falls storybook.
640b66af65b2811ce8c2c36a69c98f7616346e3c.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 8 页。

3c1bf2550c31bad44fc0984767e63235a44cf164.source: The waves of Kournan soldiers that spawn after the Generals provide experience but do not drop items or gold.
3c1bf2550c31bad44fc0984767e63235a44cf164.text: 在将军之后产生的库南士兵浪潮会提供经验，但不会掉落物品或金币。

35eb9537c2c27aa394cbf76188b365027c9b4b88.source: Defeat the Afflicted in the Silent Surf.
35eb9537c2c27aa394cbf76188b365027c9b4b88.text: 在寂静的海浪中击败受折磨的人。

becbd67baa094b7a07565ab30e7818a14e57d3ad.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Silent Surf, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
becbd67baa094b7a07565ab30e7818a14e57d3ad.text: 完成此任务会改变《寂静冲浪》中出现的敌人，具体来说，受折磨的将不再生成。

5bfe8b139a834dea69c459ff638475e52ddb5b58.source: There are 2-3 waves with several groups in each wave. The groups in each wave stagger from each other, but do overlap. It is easy to get quickly overwhelmed. Fortunately, there is a resurrection shrine nearby, either at the entrance if aligned with the Luxons or on the island to the northeast if aligned with the Kurzicks.
5bfe8b139a834dea69c459ff638475e52ddb5b58.text: 有2-3波，每波有几组。每个波浪中的群体彼此交错，但确实重叠。很容易很快就不知所措。幸运的是，附近有一个复活神殿，如果与卢克森人对齐，则在入口处；如果与库兹克人对齐，则在东北部的岛上。

8163caf53e56733298200b5b194640c1b75161ce.source: However, you can stay away from where the Afflicted converge and pull foes away from the area to make the encounter less deadly. You do not need to kill all the afflicted to complete this quest. This quest can be completed by only killing five (1-5) groups of Afflicted:
8163caf53e56733298200b5b194640c1b75161ce.text: 然而，你可以远离受影响者聚集的地方，并将敌人拉离该区域，以减少遭遇的致命性。你不需要杀死所有受苦的人来完成这个任务。此任务只需杀死五组 (1-5) 受折磨者即可完成：

ee1a19a6804113a96c6f84c428634d820f259cf2.source: Start from Unwaking Waters (Luxon), hug the west (left) wall towards the boats, and flag your team near the Mob (3) spawn point. Pull the starting Mob (1); once eliminated, use speed boosts to swiftly aggro Mob (2) that spawns near/behind one of the further boats before it moves to the center. After these are killed, Mob (3) will spawn behind you, near the original flag-point. Mob (4) will spawn right behind the boat that's closest to you. The last group, Mob (5), spawn relatively far away to the east of your likely location, but will move towards the boats before moving towards the center. After killing this group, the quest should be completed.
ee1a19a6804113a96c6f84c428634d820f259cf2.text: 从 Unwaking Waters (Luxon) 出发，紧靠西（左）墙朝向船只，并在生物 (3) 重生点附近标记你的团队。拉动起始生物（1）；一旦被消灭，使用速度提升来快速攻击在其中一艘船附近/后面产生的生物 (2)，然后再移动到中心。这些被杀死后，生物 (3) 将在你身后、靠近原始旗点的地方产卵。怪物 (4) 会在离你最近的船后面生成。最后一组，怪物（5），在您可能的位置以东相对较远的地方产卵，但会在向中心移动之前向船移动。杀掉这群人后，任务就应该完成了。

f56768a847b3052704e1680f9b8f395e5a6fd4e1.source: You do not need to kill all of the Afflicted. There is a spawn point to the southeast of the Afflicted gathering spot. During the second wave, the mob that triggers the end quest spawns from there.
f56768a847b3052704e1680f9b8f395e5a6fd4e1.text: 你不需要杀死所有的受折磨者。受影响者聚集点的东南方有一个重生点。在第二波期间，触发最终任务的生物会从那里产生。

d596a938f661e40f5916c367b6c16ba214eb1074.source: The Princes of Vabbi await you in the Halls of Chokhin.
d596a938f661e40f5916c367b6c16ba214eb1074.text: 瓦比王子在乔欣大厅等待着您。

847bfbb644f9f117c84c4197b6cf3787f64859f7.source: Defeat the invading forces and protect the messenger of Lyssa.
847bfbb644f9f117c84c4197b6cf3787f64859f7.text: 击败入侵势力并保护莱莎的使者。

3c781bb8dfb44f6817998141707b86bd205e603e.source: Speak with the messenger of Lyssa.

88aaed712b6d561934f8f106b259da77c31d13f3.source: Hurry to the Mirror of Lyss and investigate what's happening at the Grand Court of Sebelkeh.
88aaed712b6d561934f8f106b259da77c31d13f3.text: 赶紧前往里斯之镜并调查塞贝尔克大法庭发生的事情。

16cf887cd9866c1480e99a20a08951c4922f378f.source: If you have Mihanu Township unlocked, you can map travel there and head north to the Hall of Chokhin; however if you don't, it is easiest to leave from the Grand Court of Sebelkeh outpost and head west to Mihanu Township.
16cf887cd9866c1480e99a20a08951c4922f378f.text: 如果你解锁了米哈努镇，你可以在那里绘制旅行地图，然后向北前往乔欣大厅；但如果您不这样做，最简单的方法是从 Sebelkeh 大法院前哨站出发，向西前往 Mihanu 镇。

e74122dbd3300bf4959b6603b0c58af28b892715.source: After you walk near the princes, the quest evolves. You have to protect the Messenger of Lyssa against the four Margonites. After you talked to the messenger, map to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh and enter The Mirror of Lyss through the eastern exit. After talking to Morgahn, you see a cinematic. Now you can enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh mission.
e74122dbd3300bf4959b6603b0c58af28b892715.text: 当你走近王子之后，任务就会发生变化。你必须保护莱莎的使者免受四个玛贡尼特的侵害。与信使交谈后，前往塞贝尔克大法庭并从东边出口进入里斯之镜。与摩根交谈后，你会看到一部电影。现在你可以进入Sebelkeh大法庭任务了。

3191392f4b62ef19b8fdff929d66ad32a2fdbed3.source: If the Messenger of Lyssa dies at any point - even after talking to her - you will have to restart the quest.
3191392f4b62ef19b8fdff929d66ad32a2fdbed3.text: 如果莱莎的使者在任何时候死亡——即使是在与她交谈之后——你也必须重新开始任务。

fca2e3738384d26d9a877574b76f52c141bb570e.source: During this quest, you can find another Prince Mehtu standing in the left chamber of the halls, in addition to the Prince Mehtu that spawns for the quest. It is possible to skip the first three objectives by talking to Morgahn. When doing this quest in Hard Mode, Vabbi Guards are occasionally able to outheal the damage output from the Margonites if a Margonite Cleric is present, causing them to never reach the Halls of Chokhin.
fca2e3738384d26d9a877574b76f52c141bb570e.text: 在这个任务中，除了为任务生成的梅图王子之外，你还可以在大厅的左室中找到另一个梅图王子。与摩根交谈可以跳过前三个目标。在困难模式下执行此任务时，如果有玛贡尼特牧师在场，瓦比守卫偶尔能够治愈玛贡尼特人输出的伤害，导致他们永远无法到达乔欣大厅。

fc4e94c08b66c237b72269675fd491cab2475219.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Pledge of the Merchant Princes.
fc4e94c08b66c237b72269675fd491cab2475219.text: 所有党员必须接受商业王子誓言的奖励。

5bdde3a8f5fc26d9757b8ab3ab21e68e7d5719f3.source: The Altar of Lyssa must not be captured by the Blasphemy.
5bdde3a8f5fc26d9757b8ab3ab21e68e7d5719f3.text: 莱莎祭坛不能被亵渎者占领。

190a8472203d42f52a2afefd437a55292b5227b2.source: Capture the torment rifts guarded by the Margonites. Stand near a rift to claim it. [0...3] of 3 rifts captured.
190a8472203d42f52a2afefd437a55292b5227b2.text: 占领玛贡派守卫的折磨裂缝。站在裂痕附近夺取它。已捕获 3 个裂痕中的 [0...3] 个。

a29c79ced2553ae08652c55c8e0d661b7723df44.text: 摩根将军加入你的队伍。

691ef370fcbd54fdb18d8a9ffc4647d40bc200de.source: The Sebelkeh Basilica has an octagonal lay out with the Altar of Lyssa at the center and three surrounding platforms to the south, northwest, and northeast. Each platform is initially occupied by 7 Margonites, a Torment Claw, and a Torment Rift. The goal of this mission is to capture all three Torment Rifts without losing the Altar of Lyssa. For each Torment Rift that is captured the first time, your party gains a 2% Morale Boost.
691ef370fcbd54fdb18d8a9ffc4647d40bc200de.text: 塞贝尔克大教堂呈八角形布局，以莱莎祭坛为中心，周围有南部、西北和东北部的三个平台。每个平台最初由 7 个玛贡尼特、一个折磨利爪和一个折磨裂缝占据。该任务的目标是在不失去莱莎祭坛的情况下占领所有三个折磨裂缝。对于第一次占领的每个折磨裂缝，你的队伍会获得 2% 的士气提升。

d89d33f79214d3124ad14776a4112fc5c71d648c.source: Capturing a rift (or the altar) works the same as similar mechanics in other missions: each character standing on or near the object adds one pip towards capturing it; each foe subtracts a pip; this is capped at a maximum of 4 pips in either direction.
d89d33f79214d3124ad14776a4112fc5c71d648c.text: 占领裂缝（或祭坛）的工作原理与其他任务中的类似机制相同：站在该物体上或附近的每个角色都会为占领该物体增加一个点；每个敌人减去一个点；任一方向的上限为 4 点。

1bca59f17b5f5a72f92bd5b1a61d3174d9b854f7.source: The party starts standing in a teleportation circle, north from the Altar of Lyssa; leaving the circle starts the countdown timer and triggers the first wave of Margonites: two will rush from each of the three platforms to attempt to capture the Altar. As soon as possible, position party members close to the altar to prevent this from happening.
1bca59f17b5f5a72f92bd5b1a61d3174d9b854f7.text: 队伍开始站在莱莎祭坛以北的传送圈中；离开圆圈会启动倒计时器并触发第一波玛贡尼特：两个将从三个平台中冲出，试图占领祭坛。尽快将党员安置在靠近祭坛的位置，以防止这种情况发生。

f2b167f3eddd60167458a7c95185f12605bfe682.source: As soon as you kill the pair of Margonites from a single Rift, a second pair spawns and moves towards the Altar.
f2b167f3eddd60167458a7c95185f12605bfe682.text: 一旦你从一个裂缝中杀死了一对玛贡尼特，第二对就会生成并移向祭坛。

37d8818fc4626f26b267ed1af79f0f0846479278.source: The Blasphemy will spawn at a random Rift and move towards the center; to speed up its recapture of the altar, it will use Summon Torment. Kill it to counter this. Unfortunately, its death hexes the entire party with Last Rites of Torment and triggers the spawning of three Unbound Energies; they deal considerable damage to those under the hex.
37d8818fc4626f26b267ed1af79f0f0846479278.text: 亵渎者会在随机裂缝处生成并向中心移动；为了加快夺回祭坛的速度，它会使用召唤折磨。杀死它来对抗这一点。不幸的是，它的死亡用最后的折磨仪式对整个队伍施咒，并触发了三个未束缚能量的产生；它们对那些被诅咒的人造成了相当大的伤害。

1a7c176d259c4f028f0126df7f7b957ad4b20071.source: The Blasphemy continues to respawn throughout the mission; it appears faster with each time you capture a rift. Make sure you kill any remaining Unbound Energies before killing it again. If it heads towards a Rift (to re-open it), send one or more party members to prevent this.
1a7c176d259c4f028f0126df7f7b957ad4b20071.text: 亵渎在整个任务中不断重生；每次捕获裂缝时，它都会出现得更快。确保在再次杀死它之前杀死任何剩余的未束缚能量。如果它走向裂缝（重新打开它），请派遣一名或多名党员来阻止这种情况。

d17008001f40fcc5f2e4c77e4d952c1481331d7d.source: Each time the Blasphemy successfully activates Summon Torment, the rift status bars will fill 25%, allowing the rifts to be reopened and additional margonites to spawn. To prevent this, interrupt the Blasphemy's first use of the skill and kill it before it can cast it again. Keep an eye on the rift bars; if they get to 75%, send a party member to return the rift bar back to blue (or at least, reduce the amount of red).
d17008001f40fcc5f2e4c77e4d952c1481331d7d.text: 每次亵渎成功激活召唤折磨时，裂痕状态栏将填充 25%，从而允许裂痕重新打开并生成更多玛贡石。为了防止这种情况发生，请打断亵渎者第一次使用该技能并在其再次施放该技能之前将其杀死。留意裂缝条；如果达到 75%，请派一名党员将裂痕条恢复为蓝色（或者至少减少红色数量）。

344dd600a839ab4215ee1efac593fe26a75ec0eb.source: You can ignore The Blasphemy when it first spawns and capture one of the Rifts instead. You must kill all foes in addition to capturing it or they will re-open the Rift later. To speed up the capture, stand near each rift during the fight. Stay spread out while confronting the Torment Claws to avoid massive area of effect damage or take advantage of Torment Slash's long activation time and interrupt it. You can also dodge the slash by moving away.
344dd600a839ab4215ee1efac593fe26a75ec0eb.text: 当亵渎第一次出现时，你可以忽略它并捕获其中一个裂缝。除了捕获敌人之外，你还必须杀死所有敌人，否则他们稍后会重新打开裂缝。为了加快捕获速度，请在战斗中站在每个裂缝附近。面对折磨利爪时保持分散，以避免大范围的效果伤害，或者利用折磨斩的长激活时间并打断它。您也可以通过移动来躲避斜线。

e384b1e7dcc6d0d766cec0feef0de739a770e1e8.source: After capturing the first Rift, go back to the Altar and kill The Blasphemy plus the Unbound Energies. Once you have ensured the safety of the Altar, go capture a second Rift. Then return to kill The Blasphemy again and finally capture the last Rift. The mission will often take a few seconds to complete once all the rifts are closed.
e384b1e7dcc6d0d766cec0feef0de739a770e1e8.text: 占领第一个裂缝后，返回祭坛并杀死亵渎者和未束缚的能量。一旦确保了祭坛的安全，就去占领第二个裂缝。然后再次返回击杀亵渎者，最终占领最后一个裂缝。一旦所有裂缝都关闭，任务通常需要几秒钟才能完成。

0348db610267ea6ffd1ed0206a20b0af03484874.source: Successful completion of the mission in hard mode requires being able to kill the initial Margonite groups quickly, otherwise you will get overwhelmed and wipe. Bring either teams that can spike or create overlapping areas of effect (to damage several foes at once).
0348db610267ea6ffd1ed0206a20b0af03484874.text: 在困难模式下成功完成任务需要能够快速杀死最初的玛贡尼特群体，否则你会被淹没并消灭。派出可以刺杀或创造重叠效果区域的队伍（同时伤害多个敌人）。

6582cf53999c4e45e8c9702f28794183b98a1e31.source: After clearing out the initial foes from the center, most parties split into two groups: 1-2 characters to hold the altar and the rest to capture the rifts. There are a variety of ways to accomplish this, the most popular of which include a healer with party-wide skills, a minion master, and/or a spirit spammer for the stationary team. The roving team should include mostly damage dealers.
6582cf53999c4e45e8c9702f28794183b98a1e31.text: 在清除了中心的最初敌人后，大多数队伍分成两组：1-2个角色负责守卫祭坛，其余角色负责占领裂缝。有多种方法可以实现这一点，其中最流行的包括具有全队技能的治疗师、小兵大师和/或固定团队的精神垃圾邮件发送者。巡回团队应该主要包括伤害经销商。

4f92218e9e05367098e79524dcbefb7832899c89.source: If you don't split up, it's advised to close the southern rift first since it's much further away from the other two rifts. This means that when attempting to close the two much closer northwestern and northeastern rifts, The Blasphemy can be spotted much quicker should it spawn from the other rift.
4f92218e9e05367098e79524dcbefb7832899c89.text: 如果不分头的话，建议先关闭南部裂谷，因为它距离另外两个裂谷比较远。这意味着，当试图关闭两个更近的西北和东北裂痕时，如果亵渎者从另一个裂痕中产生，可以更快地被发现。

b9143f4da050dcbe78c689a1b6f2a08b4748c976.source: Lightbringer's Gaze is a useful interrupt against all enemies, especially the Torment Claws.
b9143f4da050dcbe78c689a1b6f2a08b4748c976.text: 光明使者的凝视可以有效打断所有敌人，尤其是折磨之爪。

55f5474dbda9e19a515014cc3e211a9d98a87ca7.source: Wastrel's Worry and Wastrel's Demise are very useful against both the claws and Unbound Energies — the latter do not use any skills and the claws use only one skill with a long activation time.
55f5474dbda9e19a515014cc3e211a9d98a87ca7.text: 废人之忧和废人之灭对于利爪和无束缚能量都非常有用——后者不使用任何技能，而利爪只使用一种技能，且激活时间较长。

2df4ca0d0fbe40e42efad15beabbd896c7e1446a.source: Last Rites of Torment can be removed from the entire party nearly-instantly using Inspired or Revealed Hex. Hex Eater Signet will remove that hex from over half the team, if they are within range.
2df4ca0d0fbe40e42efad15beabbd896c7e1446a.text: 使用启发或揭示的十六进制几乎可以立即从整个队伍中移除最后的折磨仪式。食妖符徽记会将一半以上的队伍中的妖怪移除（如果他们在射程内）。

6c02f5f9e2e7047f24f4ed0523c567ab054a82f1.source: Wards are especially useful, since the party and opposing mobs are restricted to small spaces.
6c02f5f9e2e7047f24f4ed0523c567ab054a82f1.text: 守卫特别有用，因为队伍和敌对生物都被限制在狭小的空间内。

c4e31f21789da99502928def421b3ad81997a4ad.source: With sufficient energy management, Dark Apostasy can work well to remove Spell Breaker.
c4e31f21789da99502928def421b3ad81997a4ad.text: 有了足够的能量管理，黑暗叛教可以很好地消除破法者。

80a09b90f9f6da858f317189a65d0e02a101f0ac.source: The center altar can be held by two heroes: one useful combination is an Aura of the Lich minion master and a Necromancer/Ritualist healer.
80a09b90f9f6da858f317189a65d0e02a101f0ac.text: 中央祭坛可以由两名英雄占据：一个有用的组合是巫妖光环随从大师和死灵法师/仪式治疗师。

a89101ccbde025c108bbb13e1850d5f1adb8a3ac.source: Sometimes when playing the mission, The Blasphemy will immediately cast Summon Torment once upon respawning. If this happens it will continue to do so when respawning throughout the mission, making the task of completing it more stressful and potentially much more difficult.
a89101ccbde025c108bbb13e1850d5f1adb8a3ac.text: 有时在执行任务时，亵渎者重生后会立即施放一次召唤折磨。如果发生这种情况，它将在整个任务重生时继续这样做，从而使完成任务的压力更大，并且可能会更加困难。

e7eafcafa0ee3f1a97cd923e1d99e34fc1374ec1.source: After completing this mission for the first time, Garden of Seborhin is replaced by Nightfallen Garden until the completion of Abaddon's Gate.
e7eafcafa0ee3f1a97cd923e1d99e34fc1374ec1.text: 第一次完成此任务后，塞伯林花园将被堕夜花园取代，直到亚巴顿之门完成。

e2f7133853bf8ef3013f0fc6719985d6508b3874.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #10 in the Night Falls storybook.
e2f7133853bf8ef3013f0fc6719985d6508b3874.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 10 页。

334061c48b4ca1cffb2620a526425a2d8264f93b.text: 所需英雄：科斯和梅洛尼。

8ab1c759c8b1609f91b63600cfc73f6d63863cb3.source: Take Koss and Melonni to speak with Butoh the Bold to prepare the defenses of the Grand Forum of Vabb. (Koss and Melonni must be equipped heroes)
8ab1c759c8b1609f91b63600cfc73f6d63863cb3.text: 带科斯和梅洛尼去与大胆的布托交谈，准备瓦布大广场的防御。 （科斯和梅隆尼必须是装备英雄）

9014fc0611fd8d87b51f7919beffe66890f5f431.source: Help defend the Grand Forum of Vabb. If it should fall, so will the Kodash Bazaar.
9014fc0611fd8d87b51f7919beffe66890f5f431.text: 帮助保卫瓦布大论坛。如果它倒塌，Kodash Bazaar 也会倒塌。

e4334ca66f40aabc0fdea4e4cfc10d08467ccc1c.source: See Zerai the Learner for your reward.
e4334ca66f40aabc0fdea4e4cfc10d08467ccc1c.text: 请见学习者泽莱以获得奖励。

b226db91ff9b2979e1a3306cf47ef7b48584cd46.source: Start in The Kodash Bazaar. Head out southwest and walk to Butoh the Bold. After talking to him, five groups of Margonites will spawn one after each other. Don't wait in the center for them to arrive, but head directly toward the first group in the southwest. The Ruby Djinn will help you, therefore it is a good idea to heal them. Proceed with the next groups. Don't worry about Margonites massing in the center, they won't do anything until/unless you're in aggro range. After killing all groups, talk again to Butoh the Bold. Map back to The Kodash Bazaar for your reward.
b226db91ff9b2979e1a3306cf47ef7b48584cd46.text: 从 Kodash Bazaar 开始。向西南方向走，步行至勇敢的舞踏 (Butoh the Bold)。与他交谈后，五组玛贡尼特会依次生成。不要在中心等待他们到来，​​而是直接朝西南方向的第一批人走去。红宝石巨灵会帮助你，因此治疗它们是个好主意。继续进行下一组。不要担心玛贡尼特会聚集在中心，他们不会做任何事情，除非/除非你处于仇恨范围内。杀死所有队伍后，再次与无畏的舞踏交谈。地图返回 Kodash Bazaar 领取奖励。

621c5e2bc504507770eb3cdc8fa0a3d3e19b0fc0.source: "Please take this as thanks. I fear this is only the beginning. The Garden of Seborhin has fallen and Ronjok may be in peril. It seems you must now make a choice, hero."
621c5e2bc504507770eb3cdc8fa0a3d3e19b0fc0.text: “请以此表示谢意。恐怕这只是一个开始。塞伯林花园已经陷落，罗恩乔克可能陷入危险。看来你现在必须做出选择，英雄。”

d8d98c57d6ce082853895c7b6c660369b66b5db9.source: A paragon with "They're on Fire!" will greatly reduce the damage dealt by the Margonites.
d8d98c57d6ce082853895c7b6c660369b66b5db9.text: “他们着火了！”的典范。将大大减少玛贡尼特造成的伤害。

0de6ec4eb1f8432d5f7f2f2423ef8c439655121a.source: If you have the quest Norgu's Nightfall active, Butoh the Bold will not spawn.
0de6ec4eb1f8432d5f7f2f2423ef8c439655121a.text: 如果您激活了诺尔古的夜幕任务，大胆的布托将不会生成。

f2028dc3ea935af1224f185389ee6e2844da40f2.source: Sometimes even after killing all groups that have spawned you still won't complete the quest. This might be caused by one of the Vabbian Commoners being stuck behind a Vabbian Chest.
f2028dc3ea935af1224f185389ee6e2844da40f2.text: 有时，即使杀死了所有产生的群体，你仍然无法完成任务。这可能是由于一名瓦比安平民被卡在瓦比安宝箱后面造成的。

2b0cffbd64cd644c5b77014828050352f79da82c.text: 主要职业不是死灵法师

1943712e24cf6f63533b31b50e47145f59f6ed2f.source: Speak with Headmaster Kuju in the monastery.
1943712e24cf6f63533b31b50e47145f59f6ed2f.text: 与修道院的久久校长交谈。

dc7a00b4190203fbefcc4e7249cc80a5d3772492.source: Koss must be in your party.
dc7a00b4190203fbefcc4e7249cc80a5d3772492.text: 科斯一定在你的队伍中。

179385e03109a739d42a26c204d753ead7ffe7a5.source: Bring Koss and find Hedge Wizard Lohhaj in the Nightfallen Garden.
179385e03109a739d42a26c204d753ead7ffe7a5.text: 带上科斯去堕夜花园找到树篱巫师洛哈吉。

ba81cd75ab28b80e205068b76040682a54a4b82d.source: See Master Gardener Kobahl for your reward.
ba81cd75ab28b80e205068b76040682a54a4b82d.text: 去找园丁大师科巴尔领取奖励。

65e176318425c86a3ff444e04c789137a8283137.source: This is a short, straightforward quest. Starting from Tihark Orchard, go out the west exit and head into the now Nightfallen Garden of Seborhin. Hedge Wizard Lohhaj is just a short distance to the north.
65e176318425c86a3ff444e04c789137a8283137.text: 这是一个简短而直接的探索。从提哈克果园出发，从西出口出来，前往现在的塞博欣堕夜精灵花园。树篱巫师 Lohaj 位于北部不远的地方。

d33727f6a48162e7b217077f432552ce98937fba.source: Contrary to Zerai the Learner telling you to choose one or the other, you can take both this quest and Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger at the same time to do both subsequent missions. Only one mission is needed to continue the storyline.
d33727f6a48162e7b217077f432552ce98937fba.text: 与学习者泽莱告诉你选择其中之一相反，你可以同时接受此任务和心或思想：处于危险中的罗约克来完成后续任务。只需要执行一项任务即可继续故事情节。

484e1817a1b9efd22b65a5217590086acf007942.source: This quest is the key in retaining access to the Nightfallen Garden after completion of the Nightfall campaign.
484e1817a1b9efd22b65a5217590086acf007942.text: 该任务是完成夜幕战役后保留进入夜幕花园的关键。

8256270b69faafb544e36916ab399fa4bb4e0b66.text: 阻止 Am Fah 快递员。

5a5738f832bdf803bca6ad6a7d4b206104235152.source: See Xan Hei for your reward.

b2fe679c6e2e13a6715273eb22a23ed8522b0e66.source: Your stated goal is to prevent the courier from reaching his vessel in Bejunkan Pier. However the quest will succeed as long as you kill him and pick up his Am Fah Case; it does not matter if he reaches the boat. As he runs to the docks, he will taunt you. Groups of Am Fah will popup along the way and attempt to prevent you from following. This allows you to take several distinct approaches:
b2fe679c6e2e13a6715273eb22a23ed8522b0e66.text: 您的既定目标是阻止快递员到达他在 Bejunkan 码头的船只。然而，只要你杀死他并拿起他的Am Fah Case，任务就会成功；他是否到达船并不重要。当他跑到码头时，他会嘲笑你。沿途会出现一群 Am Fah 并试图阻止您跟随。这允许您采取几种不同的方法：

6bd4446a0791629fa6a264000d0c1a999c0e9f3c.source: Simple: follow the courier slowly, spawning one group of foes at a time. You can use the same 8-member party that has worked for you for other Winds of Change quests (these Am Fah are weaker than most Afflicted groups). There is no need to follow the courier all the way down to the lowest level of the docks. Once he gets to his end point, he can be reached by longbow from the platform one level higher and will merrily run all the way up to you, reducing the number of groups that spawn by three.
6bd4446a0791629fa6a264000d0c1a999c0e9f3c.text: 简单：慢慢跟随信使，一次生成一组敌人。你可以使用与你其他风变任务相同的 8 人队伍（这些 Am Fah 比大多数受折磨的团体弱）。无需一路跟随快递员到达码头的最底层。一旦他到达终点，就可以从更高一层的平台用长弓到达他，并且他会愉快地跑到你身边，从而将生成的群体数量减少三个。

f983951897ac1beaf083915285d4ba54a0f74922.source: Snare: using a combination of Dash (to catch up with the courier), "You Move Like A Dwarf!" (to knock him down early), and Mind Freeze or other hexes (to prevent him from getting away). The courier and his Am Fah allies will heal him and remove his conditions, so you will have to be able to spike him quickly.
f983951897ac1beaf083915285d4ba54a0f74922.text: 圈套：使用冲刺组合（追上快递员），“你像矮人一样移动！” （提前击倒他），以及心灵冻结或其他咒语（以防止他逃脱）。信使和他的 Am Fah 盟友会治愈他并消除他的状况，所以你必须能够快速消灭他。

15c3499f3c94a2756dc2d17c80217395b47a5ac6.source: Degen: Instead of chasing or snaring the courier, let him go down the stairs. Kill just the first group and then spam health degeneration skills on him. Be careful not to go down the stairs yourself (or let any heroes do so), which will spawn a new group of Am Fah (that could heal and/or remove hexes and conditions). Useful skills include Life Siphon, Conjure Nightmare, and Illusion of Pain.
15c3499f3c94a2756dc2d17c80217395b47a5ac6.text: 德根：与其追赶或诱捕快递员，不如让他下楼梯。只杀死第一组，然后向他发送健康退化技能。小心不要自己下楼梯（或让任何英雄这样做），这会产生一组新的 Am Fah（可以治愈和/或移除咒语和状况）。有用的技能包括生命虹吸、召唤噩梦和痛苦幻象。

e3d491571f9b06d1654a5bc7532dd058e3c89afc.source: Shadow step: equip all party members and heroes with a shadow step skill, the remainder of their builds can be as normal. Allow the courier to run down the stairs then kill the first group. While remaining up the top, edge into the corner closest to where the courier stops. You can then shadow step the team to him and kill him; as this bypasses the normal trigger point, the courier does not attempt to run off. If high damage skills are used the team can easily spike him and retrieve the case before the surrounding Am Fah pop.
e3d491571f9b06d1654a5bc7532dd058e3c89afc.text: 暗影步：为所有队员和英雄装备暗影步技能，其余的构建可以正常进行。让信使跑下楼梯，然后杀死第一组。在保持顶部的同时，边缘进入最靠近快递停止处的角落。然后你可以用影子步将团队带到他身边并杀死他；由于这绕过了正常的触发点，因此快递员不会尝试逃跑。如果使用高伤害技能，团队可以轻松地秒杀他并在周围的 Am Fah 爆炸之前取回箱子。

d57d7366d0919d491325c777821d8c69181bc4cd.source: Bodyblock upon entering dash to the courier and use "You Move Like a Dwarf!" on him, bodyblock him on the stairs as he used antidote signet preventing him from escaping.
d57d7366d0919d491325c777821d8c69181bc4cd.text: 冲向快递员时用身体阻挡并使用“你像矮人一样移动！”在他使用解毒印章时，用身体把他挡在楼梯上，防止他逃跑。

d6ff8ede249a878cab98fcda3332609c090f01d6.source: Long range damage: Take casters with you and after you killed the first spawn the courier will be standing still. You can hit him with long range damage from the top and he will not run away, if you have enough firepower you can kill him this way.
d6ff8ede249a878cab98fcda3332609c090f01d6.text: 远程伤害：随身携带脚轮，在杀死第一个生成后，信使将静止不动。你可以从上面对他进行远程伤害，他不会逃跑，如果你有足够的火力，你可以这样杀死他。

d564d6b1158f7b28f622ef2cc01297250fc3e5f8.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger.
d564d6b1158f7b28f622ef2cc01297250fc3e5f8.text: 所有党员必须接受《心与心：危险花园》的奖励。

5c5ab6289ab7d1df28a49aa5ea22594a0ef24e73.source: Defeat the Harbinger of Nightfall before it summons enough demons to destroy Seborhin.
5c5ab6289ab7d1df28a49aa5ea22594a0ef24e73.text: 在夜幕降临号召唤足够的恶魔来摧毁塞伯辛之前击败它。

c474051b949c7ca0c5e17b1126d182640c616eb6.source: Protect the Spirits of Seborhin from the onslaught of torment demons.
c474051b949c7ca0c5e17b1126d182640c616eb6.text: 保护塞博欣的灵魂免受折磨恶魔的攻击。

ecc4182646f136ef5e09a0eb9e5ca14ae31ffc27.source: The Light of Seborhin is the only thing that can harm the Harbingers. Drop the Light of Seborhin when you are close enough to an enemy to release its energy.
ecc4182646f136ef5e09a0eb9e5ca14ae31ffc27.text: 塞伯林之光是唯一可以伤害先驱者的东西。当您距离敌人足够近以释放其能量时，放下塞伯林之光。

1b0ce069c601041bc4dd59680c6db5fc55c563cc.source: You have defeated [0...2] of 2 additional Harbingers.
1b0ce069c601041bc4dd59680c6db5fc55c563cc.text: 您已击败另外 2 个先驱者中的 [0...2] 个。

860062d6c6827ed22cfaf1e4c80c9c57a18b05e1.text:
夜幕降临
