233fec9e1486721024fbaf721917802fbf0f3be5.source: The goal of this mission is to stop the corruption of the entire Garden by defeating the Harbinger of Nightfall.
233fec9e1486721024fbaf721917802fbf0f3be5.text: 该任务的目标是通过击败夜幕降临者来阻止整个花园的腐败。

dae5ea2f84bcc215f80d6c7f4f8a8660c935f2ba.source: There are regular Harbingers and also two types of Margonite groups; stationary groups and groups that spawn every two minutes and patrol towards Horticulturist Hinon - who must survive. The patrol will either go north or south around the large trench in the floor, but they always start in the same place. Any character with a speed boost should be able to lure the patrol back to the party before they run to Hinon.
dae5ea2f84bcc215f80d6c7f4f8a8660c935f2ba.text: 有常规的先驱者和两种类型的玛贡尼特团体；固定群体和每两分钟生成一次的群体，并向必须生存的园艺师 Hinon 巡逻。巡逻队将围绕地板上的大沟渠向北或向南行驶，但他们总是从同一个地方开始。任何具有速度提升的角色都应该能够在巡逻队跑向 Hinon 之前将他们引诱回队伍。

d5e0dc8c09ff81eeeb148d9a9f93ede02532bdfa.source: At the start, Horticulturist Hinon will create a Light of Seborhin (bundle) which is the only tool that can harm the Harbingers and the final boss, the Harbinger of Nightfall. Dropping a Light of Seborhin beside a Harbinger will kill it (granting a morale boost) - and then the Harbinger will be replaced by a Spirit of Seborhin, which will create another Light of Seborhin. Try and keep these Spirits alive since they shorten the distance the player has to run to fetch a Light of Seborhin. (Note that although the Lights of Seborhin are destroyed when they kill a Harbinger, if they are dropped in the wrong place they can be picked up again.)
d5e0dc8c09ff81eeeb148d9a9f93ede02532bdfa.text: 一开始，园艺师 Hinon 将创建一个 Seborhin 之光（捆绑包），这是唯一可以伤害先驱者和最终 Boss 黄昏先驱者的工具。在先驱者旁边掉落一盏塞博欣之光会杀死它（提高士气） - 然后先驱者将被塞博欣之魂取代，这将创造另一个塞博欣之光。尝试让这些灵魂保持活力，因为它们会缩短玩家获取塞博欣之光所需的跑动距离。 （请注意，虽然塞博欣之光在杀死先驱者时会被摧毁，但如果它们掉落在错误的地方，则可以再次捡起。）

5b301b143b6c6991d41266b6ac7f4f2d75c7ab8a.source: The easiest tactic to avoid the threat of being overwhelmed by the patrol is to alternate between killing a stationary group and a patrol group of Margonites.
5b301b143b6c6991d41266b6ac7f4f2d75c7ab8a.text: 避免被巡逻队淹没的威胁的最简单策略是交替杀死固定队伍和巡逻队的玛贡尼特人。

5afab44fb98eea2934c805db4cf2df11dd168932.source: To make things easier for you, only eliminate the Harbinger located at the top of the stairs, so the groups of Margonites that appear every two minutes will be limited to 4 members. To do this, quickly tag your group where this Harbinger is located, and thus avoid the two located in your path.
5afab44fb98eea2934c805db4cf2df11dd168932.text: 为了让事情变得更容易，只消除位于楼梯顶部的先驱者，因此每两分钟出现的玛贡尼特群体将被限制为 4 名成员。为此，请快速标记该先驱者所在的小组，从而避开您路径中的两个。

fb0dc829e313a298062aaccd052a1bdbfb0d5dc4.source: Repeat this same pattern (i.e. Patrol → Stationary → Patrol → Stationary, etc.) until you reach the Harbinger of Nightfall. This end boss will only die after three Lights of Seborhin have been dropped on it. Either have the three needed ready somewhere nearby before engaging, or have three players carry each of them.
fb0dc829e313a298062aaccd052a1bdbfb0d5dc4.text: 重复相同的模式（即巡逻→固定→巡逻→固定等），直到到达黄昏的预兆。这个最终boss只有在三颗Seborhin之光落在它身上后才会死亡。要么在交战前将所需的三个人准备在附近的某个地方，要么让三名玩家分别携带它们。

e581ad9a2cc1691f44b39a5e80e581d6b48a5296.source: The bonus consists of killing the two additional Harbingers and their Margonite company located at the top of the north and south stairs. Ideally, lure some of the foes down the stairs towards where the patrol will cross - so that you can catch the patrol before they escape your party - walking next to the edge of the staircase and then away, is usually enough to pull the Margonites down the stairs. Note that killing only the Harbinger is not enough, and you must kill the entire group of Margonites near the Harbinger to get credit.
e581ad9a2cc1691f44b39a5e80e581d6b48a5296.text: 奖励包括杀死另外两名先驱者和他们位于南北楼梯顶部的玛贡尼特连。理想情况下，引诱一些敌人下楼梯到巡逻队将要经过的地方 - 这样你就可以在他们逃离你的队伍之前抓住他们 - 走到楼梯边缘然后离开，通常足以将玛贡尼特人拉下楼梯。注意，仅仅杀死先驱者是不够的，你必须杀死先驱者附近的整群玛贡尼特才能获得功劳。

3aac371b396d79c6c5d0f6f5cddb3eed56540336.source: Lightbringer skills and Lightbringer title active.
3aac371b396d79c6c5d0f6f5cddb3eed56540336.text: 光明使者技能和光明使者称号处于激活状态。

dc34b2e3dfb755e0b1b429c0c1ef9185dd12cf94.source: A speed boost to intercept the patrols and transport Lights of Seborhin.
dc34b2e3dfb755e0b1b429c0c1ef9185dd12cf94.text: 拦截巡逻队和运输塞伯林之光的速度提升。

e82ecc1e9b7cbf0c2b99a31c5bad2f0181a1dee2.source: A minion master to provide a meat shield and prevent Margonite Warlocks creating wells.
e82ecc1e9b7cbf0c2b99a31c5bad2f0181a1dee2.text: 一个仆从大师提供肉盾并阻止玛贡尼特术士创建水井。

d72305c36a6c226b7eeeb12c809c8809678df84d.source: Martial professions should focus on bursting down Margonite Clerics who use Spell Breaker.
d72305c36a6c226b7eeeb12c809c8809678df84d.text: 武术职业应该专注于击垮使用破法器的玛贡尼特牧师。

d1d93bd674bcf5351deacd473c4d5d160d550842.source: Abilities that blind such as Blinding Surge and or Ineptitude can be helpful against the melee Margonite Reapers and Executioners.
d1d93bd674bcf5351deacd473c4d5d160d550842.text: 诸如致盲涌动和/或无能之类的致盲能力有助于对抗近战的玛贡尼特收割者和刽子手。

961b57c81cca471dc01705389f399d38e2accbd6.source: Interrupts are important to bring, not just for Margonite Clerics, Sorcerers and Warlocks, but also to interrupt the Margonite monster skill Abaddon's Chosen which will lengthen a fight drastically.
961b57c81cca471dc01705389f399d38e2accbd6.text: 打断很重要，不仅对于玛贡尼特牧师、术士和术士来说，而且还可以打断玛贡尼特怪物技能阿巴顿的选民，这将大大延长战斗时间。

b4fa8e6ed4381a8a99f8e7d3bcf53ee17e2ffe74.source: Martial professions should bring unblockable skills or Asuran Scan as Margonite Clerics use Aegis.
b4fa8e6ed4381a8a99f8e7d3bcf53ee17e2ffe74.text: 武术职业应该带上不可阻挡的技能或阿苏兰扫描，因为玛贡尼特牧师使用神盾。

22fce7e1825be2c2f03490ad4fabce3f042a3158.source: The types of Margonites found in the patrol group depends on how many Harbingers have been killed. However, the composition of the teams does not affect the above strategy.
22fce7e1825be2c2f03490ad4fabce3f042a3158.text: 巡逻队中发现的玛贡尼特的类型取决于有多少先驱者被杀死。不过，球队的构成并不影响上述策略。

df4a0619619dca6dff2e80f91317e3450008ea22.source: The Margonite patrols do not drop loot or give experience, possibly to prevent farming exploitation.
df4a0619619dca6dff2e80f91317e3450008ea22.text: 玛贡尼特巡逻队不会掉落战利品或提供经验，可能是为了防止农业剥削。

510caf7db0be3557d4711ed4b208a52c9b2cdede.source: On rare occasion, killing both additional Harbingers and their support groups will not progress the bonus objective (You have defeated [0 or 1] of 2 additional Harbingers.). Players will have to restart the mission to get master's reward. (Let the Bonus Harbingers hit you before you drop the Light and kill them, the bug seems to trigger when they get killed before they have the chance to land a single blow.)
510caf7db0be3557d4711ed4b208a52c9b2cdede.text: 在极少数情况下，杀死额外的先驱者及其支持小组不会推进奖励目标（您已击败 2 个额外先驱者中的 [0 或 1] 个。）。玩家必须重新开始任务才能获得大师的奖励。 （在你放下圣光并杀死他们之前，让奖励先驱击中你，当他们在有机会进行一击之前被杀死时，该错误似乎会触发。）

f403c1dd5f5ffda4c5d4a49f4a332220c850bcbf.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to The Kodash Bazaar.
f403c1dd5f5ffda4c5d4a49f4a332220c850bcbf.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到 Kodash Bazaar。

46dde20cd48c2205f4438d289607f41b9b7be7b7.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 in the Night Falls storybook.
46dde20cd48c2205f4438d289607f41b9b7be7b7.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书的第 11 页。

8dbd9a00110ba80922e5b578cbbc8a20dc8c9aee.source: Melonni must be in your party.
8dbd9a00110ba80922e5b578cbbc8a20dc8c9aee.text: Melonni 一定在你的队伍中。

786b607a171e8903b3786b4d490a39453286a876.source: Take Melonni to Ronjok in the Marga Coast and speak with Elder Jonah.
786b607a171e8903b3786b4d490a39453286a876.text: 带梅洛尼去马尔加海岸的龙约克，与乔纳长老交谈。

629c62b278ba52caaaac61fd002010ac80c3e8f9.source: Follow Melonni's directions and investigate the area around Ronjok.
629c62b278ba52caaaac61fd002010ac80c3e8f9.text: 按照 Melonni 的指示并调查 Ronjok 周围的区域。

1165a91c81b650e3811b31d73fdcf7f5d94ca747.source: Quell Hahla's nightmares. Defeat the torment demons.
1165a91c81b650e3811b31d73fdcf7f5d94ca747.text: 平息哈拉的噩梦。击败折磨恶魔。

30b292cbf0349a16637fa8ab5dc71f968886e1a7.source: See Dreamer Raja for your reward.
30b292cbf0349a16637fa8ab5dc71f968886e1a7.text: 前往梦想家 Raja 领取奖励。

af53a4f9497482691599a4b3af821f1ee5872694.source: After accepting the quest, map to the Sunspear Sanctuary. Take Melonni with you and head out the Marga Coast exit into the village of Ronjok and talk to Elder Jonah. Melonni will want to investigate the area and will lead you to three points in the vicinity of the village. At the third point, you will find Dreamer Hahla. As you approach her, a group of six Torment creatures will spawn, which you will have to fight off. After a cinematic, you are at Nundu Bay.
af53a4f9497482691599a4b3af821f1ee5872694.text: 接受任务后，前往阳矛保护区的地图。带上 Melonni，从 Marga Coast 出口前往 Ronjok 村，与 Jonah 长老交谈。梅洛尼会想要调查该地区，并会带你到村庄附近的三个地点。在第三点，你会找到梦想家哈拉。当你接近她时，会生成一组六只折磨生物，你必须击退它们。看完电影后，您就到达了南杜湾。

e1ae53f4adb7279a86c9ad7b86a598c4fc00baa4.source: Contrary to Zerai the Learner telling you to choose one or the other, you can take both this quest and Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger at the same time to do both subsequent missions. Only one mission is needed to continue the storyline.
e1ae53f4adb7279a86c9ad7b86a598c4fc00baa4.text: 与学习者泽莱告诉你选择其中之一相反，你可以同时接受这个任务和《心与思想：危险花园》来完成后续任务。只需要执行一项任务即可继续故事情节。

3baacdd31c55e796db74f7ed5b16c43ede6d4460.source: Find information regarding the chalice. Good responses: [0...3] of 3.
3baacdd31c55e796db74f7ed5b16c43ede6d4460.text: 查找有关圣杯的信息。好的回复：[0...3]，共 3 个。

68b3afba8d5d6684bcf2dc55da5a92742ed4a788.source: Find information regarding the chalice. Bad responses: [0...3] of 3
68b3afba8d5d6684bcf2dc55da5a92742ed4a788.text: 查找有关圣杯的信息。错误回复：[0...3]（共 3 个）

1544c23c998221f0bf658804b30c37862bcbcc66.source: Start from Senji's Corner and exit to Xaquang Skyway to talk to Xan Hei who is a few steps from the town. He will transport you to a small area in The Marketplace where you must talk to the people in order to further the quest.
1544c23c998221f0bf658804b30c37862bcbcc66.text: 从 Senji's Corner 出发，从 Xaquang Skyway 出口出去，与距离城镇仅几步之遥的 Xan Hei 交谈。他将把你带到市场的一个小区域，你必须在那里与人们交谈才能进一步完成任务。

5c5af4c78a44bf45b368ef1011349daa4e09fff9.source: There are two parts to the quest. The first requires that you obtain intel about the Chalice by questioning the locals; you succeed by getting three good or three bad responses. Fortunately, there are five NPCs, so you will inevitably get three responses of the same type no matter how they respond.
5c5af4c78a44bf45b368ef1011349daa4e09fff9.text: 任务分为两个部分。第一个要求你通过询问当地人来获得有关圣杯的情报；如果你得到三个好的或三个坏的反应，你就成功了。好在NPC有五个，所以无论他们如何反应，你都不可避免地会得到三个相同类型的反应。

7725670955caaedbb2d5c3b4fcca5a04eb908e1f.source: Unfortunately, as soon as you accomplish this task, Fah Yu the Shadow's Eye and a couple of Am Fah mobs spawn and rush toward the center of The Marketplace area (the red platform in the middle). Initially there are two mobs from each direction, then after they are dead there is another group from each side. As long as you are spread out when this happens, you should not expect too much trouble, since these foes are not any tougher than the ones you have seen so far. After killing Fah Yu and company, listen to the brief dialogue, then return to Xan Hei to claim your reward.
7725670955caaedbb2d5c3b4fcca5a04eb908e1f.text: 不幸的是，一旦你完成这个任务，暗影之眼 Fah Yu 和几个 Am Fah 怪物就会生成并冲向市场区域的中心（中间的红色平台）。最初，每个方向都有两个小怪，然后在它们死后，每个方向都会有另一组小怪。当这种情况发生时，只要你分散开来，你就不会遇到太多麻烦，因为这些敌人并不比你迄今为止见过的敌人更难对付。杀死Fah Yu和他的同伴后，听简短的对话，然后返回Xan Hei领取奖励。

0a688abd9272fa13a0c81726723f69842ae6f1a6.source: Since the area is small, certain skills are especially effective: those with AoE damage or protection, Shouts, Wards, and Wells. To prevent getting wiped by the Am Fah's Chaos Storms, replace any wands or staves with martial weapons (preferably spears for heroes, so that they do not follow foes into melee range).
0a688abd9272fa13a0c81726723f69842ae6f1a6.text: 由于区域较小，某些技能特别有效：具有 AoE 伤害或保护、喊叫、守卫和水井的技能。为了防止被阿姆法赫的混沌风暴消灭，请用军用武器替换任何魔杖或法杖（英雄最好是长矛，这样他们就不会跟随敌人进入近战范围）。

d976e2ca237927c46caea90f646821800cbdc0f0.source: In hard mode, the typical strategy is to park the party in the northwest corner, near Kaineng Docks exit, where enemies are least likely to go towards. Having a bonder hero eases the difficulty in this quest. Am Fah that spawn out of the Bukdek Byway exit will head west along the north side, and are easy to aggro from the Kaineng Docks exit; meanwhile the enemies from Wajjun Bazaar exit will head east to the spawn point and can be pulled later by players at their leisure. It is best to leave Kun Yao last to talk to be in position without aggroing a Wajjun group.
d976e2ca237927c46caea90f646821800cbdc0f0.text: 在困难模式下，典型的策略是将队伍停在西北角，靠近凯能码头出口的地方，那里是敌人最不可能靠近的地方。拥有一个邦德英雄可以减轻这个任务的难度。从 Bukdek Byway 出口出来的 Am Fah 会沿着北侧向西行进，并且很容易从 Kaineng Docks 出口被仇恨；与此同时，来自 Wajjun Bazaar 出口的敌人将向东前往重生点，稍后玩家可以在闲暇时将其拉走。最好把坤耀留在最后，以便在不激怒瓦军团体的情况下就位。

e8daa3d92defcc342bee0521d02c21f3325994d7.source: To get the desired response, choose the listed dialogue as it becomes available during your conversations:
e8daa3d92defcc342bee0521d02c21f3325994d7.text: 要获得所需的响应，请选择在对话期间可用的列出的对话：

9b2a0baf9cae60c3b62aede30df8309d5fe184fe.source: Speaking with Ja Wen, Vai Di, Jeiff, or Sho Ri will not advance the quest.
9b2a0baf9cae60c3b62aede30df8309d5fe184fe.text: 与 Ja Wen、Vai Di、Jeiff 或 Sho Ri 交谈不会推进任务。

fa72c49a60f8ecd6e48466808fd845bf9254a58d.source: Enter Nahpui Quarter from Senji's Corner. Follow the walkthrough map.
fa72c49a60f8ecd6e48466808fd845bf9254a58d.text: 从 Senji's Corner 进入 Nahpui Quarter。按照演练地图进行操作。

8873c41dac6564783655a65024f61325c9bccf22.source: There is a very large battle at the first map marker on your mission map. While going up the last ramp, be prepared for a battle. Also, midway between the first and second marker there are an extremely large number of Am Fah. It is recommended to pull them in small groups back through the door.
8873c41dac6564783655a65024f61325c9bccf22.text: 在你的任务地图上的第一个地图标记处有一场非常大的战斗。爬上最后一个坡道时，请做好战斗准备。此外，在第一个和第二个标记之间，有大量的 Am Fah。建议将他们分成小组拉回门口。

31d32c2db3225345c1498cc7652cc28372e223a2.source: When you get to Jeijou, he appears to be alone, but soon spawns a large number of Am Fah before engaging in combat. Once you have killed him, return to Xan Hei. Because you only have to kill Jeijou, you can map out once he's dead even if the rest of the final groups are not.
31d32c2db3225345c1498cc7652cc28372e223a2.text: 当你到达 Jeijou 时，他似乎是孤身一人，但很快就会产生大量 Am Fah，然后开始战斗。一旦你杀了他，就回到Xan Hei。因为你只需要杀死 Jeijou，一旦他死了你就可以制定计划，即使最后一组的其他人还没有死。

80103e5d1cfdf76819edfb9d8ec1c964c8a393d3.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger.
80103e5d1cfdf76819edfb9d8ec1c964c8a393d3.text: 所有队伍成员必须已接受《心与心：危险中的罗约克》的奖励。

8df50ded6d4c04a9233d4c24fa0c05fa0a32f2f4.source: Defeat the Harbingers of Nightfall before they can destroy the village of Ronjok.
8df50ded6d4c04a9233d4c24fa0c05fa0a32f2f4.text: 在黄昏先驱者摧毁隆乔克村之前击败他们。

01b6ee16691142c72aa2f27c08f4d9db08a7c4e9.source: The Harbingers of Nightfall can only be damaged once they are affected by the purified water of the vials.
01b6ee16691142c72aa2f27c08f4d9db08a7c4e9.text: 黄昏预兆只有受到小瓶中纯净水的影响才会受到伤害。

56bbd65e0df3a2c62c8e4c8d41320efa43595af2.source: Protect and defend Elder Jonah. He must survive.
56bbd65e0df3a2c62c8e4c8d41320efa43595af2.text: 保护并捍卫约拿长老。他必须生存。

f93aaa0d1ec7a171f73061eb7cc8818647591a2c.source: You start in the village (point 1 on the map); after some dialogue you will be told that the only way in which the Harbingers may take any damage is by using the skill Vial of Purified Water on them. Talk to Elder Jonah to receive this skill, a hex spell which at least one player character needs to equip (heroes cannot equip the skill). Taking the Vial of Purified Water is the trigger for additional Margonite forces to spawn and begin attacking the village. Consider waiting to take the skill from him until you kill some of the Margonite groups around the village along the bone crag path, up to the location where the Harbinger of Nightfall will spawn, as doing this will make the fight to defend the village easier.
f93aaa0d1ec7a171f73061eb7cc8818647591a2c.text: 你从村庄开始（地图上的点 1）；经过一些对话后，你会被告知先驱者可能受到伤害的唯一方法是对他们使用技能“一瓶纯净水”。与乔纳长老交谈以获得此技能，这是至少一个玩家角色需要装备的十六进制咒语（英雄无法装备该技能）。拿走一瓶纯净水会触发额外的玛贡尼特部队生成并开始攻击村庄。考虑等待从他那里获取技能，直到你沿着骨岩路径杀死村庄周围的一些玛贡尼特群体，直到黄昏先驱者将产生的位置，因为这样做将使保卫村庄的战斗变得更容易。

3918ac9643ea61e4d1c2d64aa7dca0728a1fcad6.source: Several waves of Margonites, starting with groups of two and increasing to groups of six, will approach the village, attacking through alternating entrances. The last group of the first wave will be led by the Monk boss Priest Zein Zuu. When he has been defeated, a Harbinger of Twilight will spawn. From close range, use the Vial of Purified Water against it to ensure you're doing damage and dispatch it. After that, a group led by Elementalist boss Scribe Wensal will spawn, followed by a group led by Paragon boss Commander Chutal. Another Harbinger of Twilight will spawn next, and finally a group led by Zealot Sheoli. Once she is defeated you are free to travel out of the village to the old Kournan fort, as there are no more groups which might come and kill Elder Jonah.
3918ac9643ea61e4d1c2d64aa7dca0728a1fcad6.text: 几波玛贡尼特人，从两人一组开始，逐渐增加到六人一组，将接近村庄，通过交替的入口进行攻击。第一波的最后一组将由武僧boss牧师Zein Zuu领导。当他被击败后，暮光先驱者将会出现。从近距离使用一瓶纯净水来对付它，以确保你能造成伤害并消灭它。之后，将出现由元素师 Boss 抄写员温萨尔 (Scribe Wensal) 领导的队伍，随后是由典范 Boss 指挥官楚塔尔 (Chutal) 领导的队伍。接下来会出现另一个暮光先驱者，最后是由狂热者希奥利领导的团队。一旦她被击败，你就可以自由地离开村庄前往古老的库尔南堡垒，因为不再有团体可能来杀死乔纳长老。

2cc0e472dfb30d7ce177d6a9d29b370b949003d4.source: Sometimes the Margonites will stop spawning. This is irrelevant, you may safely exit the village and kill the Harbinger of Nightfall.
2cc0e472dfb30d7ce177d6a9d29b370b949003d4.text: 有时玛贡尼特会停止产卵。这无关紧要，你可以安全离开村庄并杀死夜幕先驱者。

fe403252ec1163e16fe25a1f94999e130faac85a.source: Sometimes the Harbinger of Twilight will not spawn after defeating Priest Zein Zuu, and you must restart the mission.
fe403252ec1163e16fe25a1f94999e130faac85a.text: 有时，击败牧师 Zein Zuu 后，暮光先驱者不会出现，你必须重新开始任务。

d6b8e2aafa761f659b40c1ddf57ae2de1594198b.source: Kill the groups of Margonites up to the Harbinger of Nightfall (point 2 on the map). The Harbinger does not share aggro with the groups around it, so pulling is a good tactic. Try killing everything around the Harbinger before directing attention to the Harbinger itself. As the Harbinger of Nightfall becomes weaker, he will summon two additional groups of Margonites, once at 50% health and another at 25% health. The summoned Margonites will take some time to arrive so it may be a good strategy to retreat and engage the newly summoned foes before returning to the Harbinger, although he can be defeated before the arrival of the additional Margonites. Destroy the Harbinger of Nightfall the same way you killed the Harbingers of Twilight to complete the mission.
d6b8e2aafa761f659b40c1ddf57ae2de1594198b.text: 杀死夜幕降临前的玛贡尼特群（地图上的第 2 点）。先驱者不会与周围的队伍分享仇恨，因此拉动是一个很好的策略。在将注意力集中到先驱者本身之前，尝试杀死先驱者周围的一切。当夜幕降临的预兆变得更弱时，他会召唤另外两组玛贡尼特，一组生命值为 50%，另一组生命值为 25%。召唤的玛贡尼特需要一些时间才能到达，因此在返回先驱者号之前撤退并与新召唤的敌人交战可能是一个不错的策略，尽管他可以在额外的玛贡尼特到达之前被击败。按照杀死暮光先驱者的方式摧毁黄昏先驱者以完成任务。

1b177df01adfcd3ee097f994cf5455978c92bbc6.source: The group at the Harbinger of Nightfall will be there before you grab the Vial, making it easier to fight the Harbinger of Nightfall when he spawns.
1b177df01adfcd3ee097f994cf5455978c92bbc6.text: 在你拿到瓶子之前，夜幕降临的预兆的队伍就会在那里，这样当夜幕降临的预兆出现时，你就可以更容易地与他战斗。

3149a8581be39d9ce10af312ac22a06eb1e06d1e.source: Sometimes Elder Jonah will follow and heal your minions when you leave the village to go fight the Harbinger of Nightfall. As you must protect him or the mission fails, consider sacrificing your minions before leaving the village to avoid this bug. If Elder Jonah starts to follow the group, you can bring the minion master near the entrance of the Sanctuary to lure him back to safety.
3149a8581be39d9ce10af312ac22a06eb1e06d1e.text: 有时，当您离开村庄去对抗夜幕降临的预兆时，乔纳长老会跟随并治愈您的爪牙。由于你必须保护他，否则任务就会失败，因此请考虑在离开村庄之前牺牲你的爪牙以避免这个错误。如果乔纳长老开始跟随队伍，你可以将仆从大师带到圣所入口附近，将他引诱回安全地带。

e7defd7eaf5a6c7787cc57bbbd78e87bc8133798.source: The bonus is to kill additional two Harbingers of Twilight and their associated Margonite mobs. These are located inside the Kournan fort surrounded by Margonites to the south of where the Harbinger of Nightfall spawns. You will need the Vial of Purified Water to defeat these, so you must complete the siege on the village first. The first Harbinger is at the entrance to the fort area, while the second is located further into the fort; they can be killed like the other Harbingers using the Vial of Purified Water. When fighting near or in the fort, take note of your party's position, especially heroes and henchmen, and ensure that the walls of the fort are not obstructing your attacks. It is recommended to pull the mobs into more level or open spaces before engaging them.
e7defd7eaf5a6c7787cc57bbbd78e87bc8133798.text: 奖励是杀死另外两个暮光先锋及其相关的玛贡尼特小怪。它们位于库南堡垒内，周围环绕着玛贡尼特，位于黄昏先驱者生成处的南部。你需要一瓶纯净水来击败它们，所以你必须首先完成对村庄的围攻。第一个先驱者位于要塞区域的入口处，而第二个先驱者则位于要塞的更深处；他们可以像其他先驱者一样使用一瓶纯净水被杀死。当在堡垒附近或堡垒内战斗时，请注意你的队伍的位置，尤其是英雄和追随者，并确保堡垒的墙壁不会阻碍你的攻击。建议在与怪物交战之前将它们拉到更高的水平或开放空间。

ef8cda1083b924566f15dd140914aff0c53af821.source: Unlike the Harbinger of Nightfall, the bonus Harbingers of Twilight cannot be pulled away from the Margonite mobs accompanying them.
ef8cda1083b924566f15dd140914aff0c53af821.text: 与黄昏预兆不同的是，暮光预兆的奖励不能从伴随它们的玛贡尼特小怪身上被拉走。

c7580f8d980bbbb7e817f43fbc7f8a3d8cd79e7f.source: As with Jennur's Horde, killing only the two additional Harbingers does not complete the bonus. You must kill the entire group to get credit.
c7580f8d980bbbb7e817f43fbc7f8a3d8cd79e7f.text: 与詹努尔的部落一样，仅杀死另外两个先驱者并不能完成奖励。你必须杀死整个队伍才能获得荣誉。

315ad69871d8759d2e0c2ee1e087fe41986c774b.source: Backtrack to head north once both have been dispatched to kill the Harbinger of Nightfall to complete the mission.
315ad69871d8759d2e0c2ee1e087fe41986c774b.text: 当两人都被派去杀死夜幕降临者以完成任务后，原路返回北方。

b98444da4c31e3fb8cbcf11a3bed7ab0cc5731a7.source: At least one party member needs to equip the Vial of Purified Water. Ideally, have two members do so, since its recharge time of 15 seconds exceeds its 10 second duration. In single-player teams, you could use Arcane Echo and/or Echo to duplicate Vial of Purified Water, but it is not essential.
b98444da4c31e3fb8cbcf11a3bed7ab0cc5731a7.text: 至少一名队员需要装备一瓶纯净水。理想情况下，有两名成员这样做，因为 15 秒的充电时间超过了 10 秒的持续时间。在单人团队中，您可以使用奥术回声和/或回声来复制一瓶纯净水，但这不是必需的。

d59e40fa70f052cbedc9c34ff0decb1f2d893ce9.source: There are plenty of corpses around Elder Jonah at the beginning of the mission; bringing a minion master (or even two) also helps prevent Margonite Warlocks from using those corpses to create Wells of Silence.
d59e40fa70f052cbedc9c34ff0decb1f2d893ce9.text: 任务开始时，乔纳长老周围有很多尸体；带来一个仆从大师（甚至两个）也有助于防止玛贡尼特术士使用这些尸体来创造沉默之井。

7cf87ca9fc49294d7ad8a81daaf2759953a40a23.source: Bring skills to interrupt the Wave of Torment spell that is cast by both types of Harbingers. Distracting Shot is particularly effective, since it disables the skill for 20 additional seconds.
7cf87ca9fc49294d7ad8a81daaf2759953a40a23.text: 带来技能来打断两种类型先驱者施放的折磨之波法术。分散射击特别有效，因为它会额外使该技能失效 20 秒。

e60d5917607028f6c12e145ef0a29f48aeb333b4.source: All the foes in this mission are affected by Lightbringer skills. Lightbringer's Gaze can be used to interrupt Wave of Torment.
e60d5917607028f6c12e145ef0a29f48aeb333b4.text: 此任务中的所有敌人都会受到光明使者技能的影响。光明使者的凝视可以用来打断折磨之波。

c30dd1ded23e688deb1a9a1abef8ba04c37b5189.source: The area behind the village, near where the entrance to the Sunspear Sanctuary would normally be, still keeps the normal, non Nightfallen terrain.
c30dd1ded23e688deb1a9a1abef8ba04c37b5189.text: 村庄后面的区域，靠近阳矛庇护所通常入口的地方，仍然保留着正常的、非堕夜精灵的地形。

45eaefda0b281da5a5f4784fb1b4cedd6a611494.source: Due to the number and frequency of boss appearances, Scroll of Hunter's Insight may last longer than other types.
45eaefda0b281da5a5f4784fb1b4cedd6a611494.text: 由于 Boss 出现的数量和频率，猎人洞察卷轴可能比其他类型的持续时间更长。

c2f2b39fac0a7498d5373be6125c0ae82fe50e01.source: The Harbinger of Nightfall is not spawned at the beginning of the mission, so it is therefore impossible to rush up the middle path and kill him from the start. It is, however, possible to kill the two additional Harbingers at the beginning by splitting up a strong party.
c2f2b39fac0a7498d5373be6125c0ae82fe50e01.text: 黄昏预兆并不是在任务开始时出现的，所以不可能从一开始就冲上中路杀死他。然而，一开始就可以通过分裂一个强大的队伍来杀死另外两个先驱者。

d9262eac4cbb04f166f8f6e197e88a7f5eef5b34.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Sunspear Sanctuary.
d9262eac4cbb04f166f8f6e197e88a7f5eef5b34.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被传送到烈阳之矛庇护所。

1f2402e4cdebd05341b1cca20d68298c3394e484.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 in the Night Falls storybook.
1f2402e4cdebd05341b1cca20d68298c3394e484.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书第 12 页。

fa4b1ae982fb06de0d3988f958644f8ea6dff4bb.source: The overland and world maps still show the character on the normal Marga Coast when in this mission, unlike other Nightfallen regions.
fa4b1ae982fb06de0d3988f958644f8ea6dff4bb.text: 与其他堕夜精灵地区不同，在执行此任务时，陆路和世界地图仍然显示正常玛加海岸的特征。

48bdcd8d668c3bdb40b932106da8ff0c61f4958f.source: Zhed Shadowhoof must be in your party.
48bdcd8d668c3bdb40b932106da8ff0c61f4958f.text: 杰德·影蹄一定在你的队伍中。

d77ddc4e62e1c40fa02a8792c63d41b068728de4.source: Talk to Kormir in the Command Post to find a way across the Desolation.
d77ddc4e62e1c40fa02a8792c63d41b068728de4.text: 与指挥所的科米尔交谈，找到穿越荒凉之地的方法。

cbecc2706e230b2cdd033f28fc4c761af8f52628.source: Travel with Zhed to speak with Mirza about crossing the Desolation.
cbecc2706e230b2cdd033f28fc4c761af8f52628.text: 与哲德一起前往与米尔扎谈论穿越荒凉之地的事情。

de61d62740893ded5f339a2147f16a211a31dbda.source: Meet Mirza on the outskirts of the Desolation.
de61d62740893ded5f339a2147f16a211a31dbda.text: 在荒凉之地的郊区与米尔扎会面。

b0b91f562c81188f34bb79356a04ba81c4e592d7.source: Meet with Kormir at the monument to Palawa Joko's defeat.
b0b91f562c81188f34bb79356a04ba81c4e592d7.text: 在帕拉瓦·佐科战败纪念碑处与科米尔会面。

a12224d958828fba46ca1106e30664baea2e0533.source: Examine the monument to Palawa Joko's defeat.
a12224d958828fba46ca1106e30664baea2e0533.text: 检查帕拉瓦·佐科战败纪念碑。

aa1cc7945d5056a95449b05f8397fbd87741b69c.source: Have Zhed help track Palawa Joko. Take Zhed to speak with Dirah Traptail.
aa1cc7945d5056a95449b05f8397fbd87741b69c.text: 让哲德帮忙追踪帕拉瓦·乔科。带杰德去见迪拉·特拉普泰尔。

605f0b6de4d0272ed4aa5eb6d6635ebff68c503f.source: See Laph Longmane for your reward.
605f0b6de4d0272ed4aa5eb6d6635ebff68c503f.text: 请见拉夫·朗迈恩以获得奖励。

b94c523864ee89d40b7aa9e8092f6311796f8786.source: 200 Gold (if this quest is acquired from Lonai)
b94c523864ee89d40b7aa9e8092f6311796f8786.text: 200 金币（如果这个任务是从洛奈那里获得的）

fa2559a3d75ca4ddd7d04dda7890d08a6269c79e.source: 250 Gold (if this quest is acquired from Zerai the Learner)
fa2559a3d75ca4ddd7d04dda7890d08a6269c79e.text: 250 金币（如果此任务是从学习者泽莱那里获得的）

12b841e6d3d7bdc51067cba1b3657721719302c1.source: After accepting the quest from Zerai or Lonai, travel to the Sunspear Sanctuary and exit to the Command Post. Speak with Kormir and head out to Turai's Procession through the nearby portal. Follow the quest marker to Mirza Veldrunner. (Most of the enemies can be avoided or a group of hero/henchmen should be able to handle anything you come across.)
12b841e6d3d7bdc51067cba1b3657721719302c1.text: 接受泽莱或洛奈的任务后，前往阳矛圣域并退出指挥所。与科米尔交谈并通过附近的传送门前往图莱的队伍。跟随任务标记前往米尔扎·维德行者。 （大多数敌人都可以避免，或者一群英雄/追随者应该能够处理你遇到的任何事情。）

56c784dcece7afb10cb2349a7fdb76d0653ca4cc.source: The next quest marker is misleading: it is northwest from your location, but the only way to reach it is to head northeast (see this article's map). Meet up with Mirza in The Sulfurous Wastes, then head back to the Command Post to speak with Kormir again, who will instruct you to meet her in Jahai Bluffs. After she leaves, inspect the monument; this releases Palawa Joko himself. He departs quickly after his dialogue; as Zhed points out, there is no point in following him.
56c784dcece7afb10cb2349a7fdb76d0653ca4cc.text: 下一个任务标记具有误导性：它位于您所在位置的西北方向，但到达它的唯一方法是向东北方向行驶（请参阅本文的地图）。在硫磺荒原与米尔扎会面，然后返回指挥所再次与科米尔交谈，科米尔会指示你在贾海悬崖与她会面。她离开后，检查纪念碑；这释放了帕拉瓦·佐科本人。对话结束后他很快就离开了。正如杰德指出的那样，跟随他是没有意义的。

0b476109217052d9a59ac9ad408b515709027200.source: Map travel to the Gate of Desolation, exit into Turai's Procession to find Palawa Joko trapped by Dirah Traptail and his band of centaurs. Speak with Dirah to start the cinematic and speak with Laph Longmane to complete the quest.
0b476109217052d9a59ac9ad408b515709027200.text: 地图旅行到荒凉之门，退出图莱的队伍，找到被迪拉·特拉普泰尔和他的半人马队伍困住的帕拉瓦·约科。与迪拉交谈以开始动画，并与拉夫·朗迈恩交谈以完成任务。

608f324ab6fdb643100b1ec688aded1bbaaa18d2.source: Since this quest does not require you to kill any foes, you can complete this by running.
608f324ab6fdb643100b1ec688aded1bbaaa18d2.text: 由于此任务不需要你杀死任何敌人，因此你可以通过跑步来完成此任务。

3caffaef458fe9e73b29bbfaa044d337124b116c.source: This quest can only be acquired from:
3caffaef458fe9e73b29bbfaa044d337124b116c.text: 该任务只能从以下位置获得：

0788daf434b9306b4e90f286e496abb1e4e8d36e.source: Lonai if your character has completed Nundu Bay.
0788daf434b9306b4e90f286e496abb1e4e8d36e.text: Lonai（如果您的角色已完成 Nundu Bay）。

27c8727a1600412121263cd6fa37c57e72893981.source: Zerai the Learner if your character has completed Jennur's Horde.
27c8727a1600412121263cd6fa37c57e72893981.text: 学习者泽莱（Zerai the Learner），如果你的角色已经完成了詹努尔的部落。

3f3099f8dde050e3cfb35027ab36babb4c629411.source: Combine this with Centaur Concerns, which is on the way from Sunspear Sanctuary.
3f3099f8dde050e3cfb35027ab36babb4c629411.text: 将其与从阳矛庇护所出发的半人马忧虑结合起来。

ed84c488a7c5c86cbb5178a18b97de10a4c33c74.source: You can combine this quest with Mirza's Last Stand, if you have previously completed Centaur Concerns.
ed84c488a7c5c86cbb5178a18b97de10a4c33c74.text: 如果你之前完成了半人马担忧，你可以将此任务与米尔扎的最后一战结合起来。

becbb8fe6cdb496b8bd59073cee1ea32f9c006fe.source: This quest presents an opportunity to capture elite skills from Sergeant Behnwa and Chiossen, Soothing Breeze on the way through Turai's Procession.
becbb8fe6cdb496b8bd59073cee1ea32f9c006fe.text: 该任务提供了一个机会，让您有机会在图莱的游行途中从本瓦中士和舒缓微风奇奥森那里获得精英技能。

bf04ec1b317dc2c02b6e779c0245ce848f086176.source: Palawa Joko sometimes fails to appear when the monument is activated; however, the quest still updates (even though there is no dialogue after Kormir leaves). If you acquire the quest from Lonai, she will claim to not know where the Sunspear Sanctuary is even though she is standing in it. The gold reward, some of the dialogue, and quest game link differs depending on which NPC this quest is acquired from.
bf04ec1b317dc2c02b6e779c0245ce848f086176.text: 当纪念碑被激活时，帕拉瓦·约科有时不会出现；然而，任务仍然更新（即使科米尔离开后没有对话）。如果你从洛奈那里获得任务，她会声称不知道阳矛圣域在哪里，即使她站在其中。黄金奖励、部分对话和任务游戏链接根据从哪个 NPC 处获得该任务而有所不同。

11cd4a030efafa9d7b52bddd86cea7a5fbc5f34f.source: Defeat Ganshu the Scribe, and obtain the Jade Brotherhood Text.
11cd4a030efafa9d7b52bddd86cea7a5fbc5f34f.text: 击败文士甘树，获得玉兄弟文本。

3bb2a196453d91c995aa518d25867f8f8c12bd98.source: Leave from The Marketplace and head west, fighting through several large groups of Jade Brotherhood. You will receive many allies in the form of members of the Ministry of Purity as well as some regular Canthan Peasants. The Peasants are not very useful, but provide excellent fodder for minion masters. Upon reaching Ganshu the Scribe, his group and one more behind him will initially be friendly; after some brief dialogue they will turn hostile. Defeat Ganshu and pick up the Jade Brotherhood Text to complete the quest.
3bb2a196453d91c995aa518d25867f8f8c12bd98.text: 从市场出发，向西前进，与几支翡翠兄弟会的大部队作战。您将收到许多以纯洁部成员以及一些普通凯珊农民形式出现的盟友。农民不是很有用，但为奴才大师提供了极好的素材。到达文士甘书后，他的团队和他身后的其他团队一开始会表现得很友善；经过一些简短的对话后，他们会变得充满敌意。击败甘树并拾取玉兄弟文本即可完成任务。

826062be8737e353eff5d698d2e54331cd2dc297.source: Alternatively, leave from Nahpui Quarter and head north. This route takes a few more minutes, but it is safer. There will be some regular Am Fah mobs and Mantids along the way, but nothing dangerous. Once you reach the island stronghold, a large brawl will already be going on between some Peasants and Ministry forces; you can either try to save some by rushing in head first, or forget about them and play it safe, pulling the Jade groups apart for easier killing. After this, proceed to Ganshu as normal.
826062be8737e353eff5d698d2e54331cd2dc297.text: 或者，从纳普伊区 (Nahpui Quarter) 出发，向北行驶。这条路线多花几分钟，但比较安全。沿途会定期出现一些 Am Fah 怪物和螳螂，但没有什么危险。一旦你到达岛上的据点，一些农民和魔法部部队之间就会发生一场大规模的争吵；你可以尝试先冲进去来拯救一些人，或者忘记他们并谨慎行事，将玉石群拉开以便更容易杀死。之后，如常前往甘肃。

3f42fcb0fa2622bee33ba1df28f501bc5ab90e7e.source: Another option using a party with strong spiking skills and speed boosts is to run west from The Marketplace, ignoring the enemies along the way until you reach the westernmost bridge from the main landmass to the island containing the Jade Brotherhood guild hall. Using this bridge, run north and west past two packs of enemies until you reach a small courtyard with a central dais within compass range just south of Ganshu. Prepare, flag heroes (possibly locking targets for shutdown), precast spirits and protective spells as necessary and then spike down Ganshu. Pick up the text when Ganshu dies and you may freely resign or map out. These tactics work even with small party sizes (where they benefit greatly from accompanying summoned allies).
3f42fcb0fa2622bee33ba1df28f501bc5ab90e7e.text: 使用具有强大尖峰技能和速度提升的队伍的另一个选择是从市场向西跑，忽略沿途的敌人，直到到达从主陆地到包含玉兄弟会会馆的岛屿的最西边的桥梁。使用这座桥，向北和向西跑，经过两群敌人，直到到达甘肃以南罗盘范围内的一个小庭院，有一个中央讲台。准备，标记英雄（可能锁定目标以使其关闭），根据需要预制精神和保护法术，然后刺杀甘树。甘书死后拿起文字，可以自由辞职或出谋划策。这些策略甚至适用于小规模的队伍（他们从伴随召唤的盟友中受益匪浅）。

4d8dbdeda71e1aa485fdb7689ad339e546be814a.source: It is also worth noting that Ganshu does not pull with either of the packs to his immediate west and south. If you lack the means to fight him with his allies, you can pull the west pack first and then pull Ganshu independently for an easy kill.
4d8dbdeda71e1aa485fdb7689ad339e546be814a.text: 还值得注意的是，甘树并没有将任何一个狼群拉到他紧邻的西部和南部。如果你没有办法和他的盟友一起对抗他，你可以先拉西群，然后独立拉甘树，轻松击杀。

d4e07d2993a4fd9ce883789dcdb443cbd74663bb.source: Speak With Headmaster Kaa in the Shing Jea Monastery.
d4e07d2993a4fd9ce883789dcdb443cbd74663bb.text: 与 Shing Jea 寺的 Kaa 校长交谈。

157448937e8997ce226c3636e0785f5e647c1b72.source: Locate and defeat Reisen the Phoenix.

c6a0a4b1cf543a40c47906a73915150715f266fb.source: Speak to Xan Hei again, who will transport your party to an altered Dragon's Throat.
c6a0a4b1cf543a40c47906a73915150715f266fb.text: 再次与 Xan Hei 交谈，他会将你的队伍传送到经过改造的龙之喉咙。

a71d90a47b42a87078d76e3b7a0e682ebf00d72f.source: There is only one route to Reisen the Phoenix, requiring you to fight through group after group of Jade Brotherhood. If you deviate from it, you will have to fight additional foes, including additional bosses. Each time you kill one of these bosses, additional foes will spawn with Reisen and along the path itself. Stick to the path, if you want things to be as easy as possible.
a71d90a47b42a87078d76e3b7a0e682ebf00d72f.text: 通往凤凰雷森的路线只有一条，需要你与一批又一批的翡翠兄弟会战斗。如果你偏离了它，你将不得不与更多的敌人战斗，包括更多的首领。每次你杀死其中一个 Boss 时，就会有更多的敌人与雷森一起出现并沿着路径本身。如果你想让事情尽可能简单，就坚持走这条路。

dc3c6a7041b13e439bcb918afb02941c06938f58.source: As with most of Winds of Change, groups here spawn close to one another and have overlapping patrol routes. Sometimes, a healer from one group will separate to heal one of their allies in another, so it can be hard to avoid over-aggroing. Do your best to pull groups apart and be ready to retreat before you get overwhelmed.
dc3c6a7041b13e439bcb918afb02941c06938f58.text: 与大多数变革之风一样，这里的队伍彼此靠近生成，并且巡逻路线重叠。有时，一个群体中的治疗者会分开去治疗另一个群体中的一位盟友，因此很难避免过度仇恨。尽最大努力将团体拉开，并在不知所措之前做好撤退的准备。

0c81d1720a6fac29605a841875494ace0a1219ea.source: The layout of Dragon's Throat lends itself well to balling up, both for you and for the enemies; there are plenty of choke points (e.g. corners, narrow hallways, or stairways). Take advantage of this by positioning the party before the choke point, pulling groups towards you, forcing them to clump; then use AoE skills and effects to wipe out entire mobs at a time. Avoid letting this happen to the party, since your foes can return the favor (particularly their Splinter Weapon-wielding Warriors).
0c81d1720a6fac29605a841875494ace0a1219ea.text: 龙喉的布局非常适合你和敌人的聚集；有很多阻塞点（例如角落、狭窄的走廊或楼梯）。利用这一点，将队伍放置在阻塞点之前，将队伍拉向你，迫使他们聚集在一起；然后使用 AoE 技能和效果一次消灭整个小怪。避免让这种情况发生在队伍中，因为你的敌人可以回报你的恩惠（特别是他们挥舞着碎片武器的战士）。

4ff2aadf1d38e351f91afd697c95dbc1ba7e08ab.source: Bring skills that can take advantage of the choke-point tactics: Wards, AoE damage/effects (especially damage over time), defensive spirits (since they can be setup safely behind your group), and multiple-foe interrupts. Melee characters should consider bringing Asuran Scan due to the enemies' propensity to use blocking and blind-inflicting skills.
4ff2aadf1d38e351f91afd697c95dbc1ba7e08ab.text: 带来可以利用阻塞点战术的技能：守卫、AoE伤害/效果（尤其是随着时间的推移造成的伤害）、防御精神（因为它们可以安全地设置在你的团队后面）和多敌人打断。近战角色应该考虑使用阿苏兰扫描，因为敌人倾向于使用格挡和致盲技能。

14e709d8e201ddb3b1062d82ea5973e9f5f4e8f0.source: After defeating Reisen the Phoenix, be sure to wait for the conversation between you and Xan Hei to end before leaving the map.
14e709d8e201ddb3b1062d82ea5973e9f5f4e8f0.text: 击败凤凰雷森后，一定要等你和赞黑的对话结束后再离开地图。

27481c7313b3748c0a94e521c21dae98b8939499.source: Although there is no visible Resurrection Shrine on the Mission Map, you will respawn at the beginning of the quest if you die.
27481c7313b3748c0a94e521c21dae98b8939499.text: 虽然任务地图上没有可见的复活神殿，但如果你死了，你会在任务开始时重生。

ddfd12d6704c0b454ab7daf97c8b0873a776be90.source: Each member of Reisen's group, including Reisen himself, can be pulled separately from other members of the group.
ddfd12d6704c0b454ab7daf97c8b0873a776be90.text: 雷森团队的每个成员，包括雷森本人，都可以与该团队的其他成员分开拉动。

540046c8d6e2be178d515e18ba403e6701404b09.source: The Jade Brotherhood Warriors that accompany Lai, Graceful Blade as well as Sheng Pai will not always say their line of dialogue.
540046c8d6e2be178d515e18ba403e6701404b09.text: 陪伴赖、刀风云以及胜排的玉兄弟，也不会一直说出自己的台词。

3df084daec897e49c5348dcfc8b42ead79ccf724.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Crossing the Desolation.
3df084daec897e49c5348dcfc8b42ead79ccf724.text: 所有小队成员都必须接受穿越荒凉的奖励。

dc6821d31454e10d58247f220076a1e28aac4d15.source: Tame Queen Aijundu and gain control of the junundu wurms.
dc6821d31454e10d58247f220076a1e28aac4d15.text: 驯服艾君杜女王并控制朱南杜亚龙。

ec21814dbb2e91b19584c8ad73f6ecd63b388632.source: ADDED: Defeat Queen Aijundu and her undead minions.
ec21814dbb2e91b19584c8ad73f6ecd63b388632.text: 新增：击败艾君杜女王和她的不死爪牙。

6ad5b707c037c378c5650cc28d00f6940af1d3b7.source: ADDED: Call forth a junundu so you may ride it through the sulfur.
6ad5b707c037c378c5650cc28d00f6940af1d3b7.text: 添加：召唤一个朱南杜，这样你就可以骑着它穿过硫磺。

1dd772d3deb665bd997b37d274c9a7d22b9b94d4.source: ADDED: Guide the junundu to the Remains of Sahlahja.
1dd772d3deb665bd997b37d274c9a7d22b9b94d4.text: 添加：引导 junundu 前往 Sahlahja 遗迹。

08ca61da03da7a8f6937bbe8a24362d39e244273.source: *Bonus* Protect the junundu young from the demon hordes.
08ca61da03da7a8f6937bbe8a24362d39e244273.text: *奖励* 保护朱南杜幼崽免受恶魔部落的侵害。

9c2061ec6693ba9a942ab627c9f3b01574e911be.source: You have saved [0...3] of 3 junundu young.
9c2061ec6693ba9a942ab627c9f3b01574e911be.text: 您已拯救了 3 个 junundu 幼崽中的 [0...3] 个。

6d51cc0346110133a8638b977065d3b23b83959f.source: As you enter the mission Palawa Joko starts to talk and will lead you to a Wurm Spoor to the left of the entrance. The Wurm Spoor is situated in a hole beyond which the yellow Sulfurous Haze begin. To walk in human form on the areas which show as bright yellow on the map means near immediate death. Stay clear.
6d51cc0346110133a8638b977065d3b23b83959f.text: 当你进入任务时，Palawa Joko 开始说话，并会带你到入口左侧的 Wurm Spoor。亚龙足迹位于一个洞中，黄色的硫磺雾霾从洞外开始。以人类形态行走在地图上显示为亮黄色的区域意味着立即死亡。保持清醒。

c05c29adc2e30498cf0b939216c64f883baf0090.source: It is at this Wurm Spoor (1 on the map) that you will tame Queen Aijundu, so set up for the fight. You should stage the fight from the hill over looking the Wurm Spoor which will give you a height advantage and keeps you away from the sulfur. If you are using heroes and henchmen, they should be pinned at the top of the hill at the point furthest from the sulfur and set to defensive mode. For a better idea, when Palawa Joko runs to the Wurm Spoor, he will stop before reaching it, then move to the other side, and then remain in that spot until you tame Aijundu. Flag your heroes and henchmen at the point he stops at before moving to his final position. If there is a minion master in your party, avoid fighting near Palawa Joko, since he will use Well of Darkness on recharge, exploiting the corpses that the minion master could have used; however, if your party doesn't have a minion master, it is recommended to fight near Palawa Joko, so he will create Wells of Darkness that will hinder hexed undead physical attackers and at the same time prevent Awakened Defilers from using those corpses to create Wells of Darkness that will hinder your party.
c05c29adc2e30498cf0b939216c64f883baf0090.text: 正是在这个 Wurm Spoor（地图上的 1）处，您将驯服艾君杜女王，因此做好战斗准备。你应该在山上进行战斗，俯瞰Wurm Spoor，这会给你带来高度优势，让你远离硫磺。如果你使用英雄和追随者，他们应该被钉在山顶距离硫磺最远的地方，并设置为防御模式。更好的想法是，当帕拉瓦·约科跑向亚龙史普尔时，他会在到达之前停下来，然后移动到另一边，然后留在那个地方直到你驯服艾军杜。在他移动到最终位置之前，在他停下来的地方标记你的英雄和追随者。如果你的队伍中有小兵大师，请避免在帕拉瓦约科附近战斗，因为他会在充电时使用黑暗之井，利用小兵大师本可以使用的尸体；但是，如果你的队伍没有小兵大师，建议在帕拉瓦·约科附近战斗，这样他会创造黑暗之井，阻碍施咒的不死物理攻击者，同时防止觉醒污染者利用这些尸体创造黑暗之井，阻碍你的队伍。

5599385b56559a64b5d7568b2d50b2d377f546d4.source: After a few groups of undead have attacked and been defeated, Queen Aijundu will approach and attack. Once her health has been reduced a bit she will retreat and further undead will attack. There are quite a few bosses who spawn in the undead groups - keep an eye out for them. Aijundu will attack again when all the undead are killed, this time when you've damaged her enough she will allow you to use the wurms to cross the Desolation. Look out for enemies with hard resses: Awakened Acolytes, Awakened Cavaliers and especially the boss Chakeh the Lonely. Left alone these will resurrect fallen enemies on top of the new groups approaching you, which might overwhelm the party. Tip: If you feel your party is overwhelmed with attacking foes try running away from the Wurm Spoor. Not all enemies will follow you all the way to your new destination. This smaller group of enemies will be easier to individually target and take down. This also gives your party a chance to regroup, heal, and target the remaining foes left guarding the Wurm Spoor. Also it's not necessary to fight next to the Wurm Spoor. You can flag your party a fair distance away at the start and simply pull the successive groups of enemies.
5599385b56559a64b5d7568b2d50b2d377f546d4.text: 当几群亡灵攻击并被击败后，艾君杜女王就会逼近并攻击。一旦她的生命值减少一点，她就会撤退，更多的不死生物将会攻击。有不少 Boss 会在不死族中生成 - 请留意他们。当所有不死族都被杀死后，艾军杜将再次攻击，这一次当你对她造成足够的伤害时，她将允许你使用亚龙穿越荒凉之地。留意那些凶猛的敌人：觉醒的追随者、觉醒的骑士，尤其是 Boss 孤独者查克 (Chakeh the Lonely)。如果不去管它们，它们会在接近你的新队伍之上复活倒下的敌人，这可能会压垮队伍。提示：如果你觉得你的队伍被攻击的敌人压得喘不过气来，试着逃离亚龙的足迹。并非所有敌人都会跟随你一路到达新目的地。这一小群敌人将更容易单独瞄准并击倒。这也让你的队伍有机会重新集结、治疗并瞄准守卫亚龙足迹的剩余敌人。也没有必要在亚龙孢子旁边战斗。你可以在开始时将你的队伍标记在距离较远的地方，然后简单地拉动连续的敌人群。

6ba27e42e82ba75a5e599d53c56380b0cdafe685.source: The order of appearance of the bosses is as follows: first Chakeh the Lonely (Paragon); second Avah the Crafty (Warrior); third Chundu the Meek (Dervish); fourth and fifth appear together, Nehmak the Unpleasant (Necromancer) and Amind the Bitter (Mesmer).
6ba27e42e82ba75a5e599d53c56380b0cdafe685.text: Boss出现的顺序如下：首先是孤独者恰克（Paragon）；第二个狡猾的阿瓦（战士）；第三位是温顺的春杜（苦行僧）；第四个和第五个一起出现，不愉快的内马克（死灵法师）和痛苦的阿明德（催眠师）。

14d9ebf17ca2054c06135f777ff84b8a6b4b0452.source: Click on the Wurm Spoor. This will summon wurms to transport you and the party. You now have control of the wurm and will use Junundu skills rather than those you have equipped on your character. You can now travel on the sulfur areas without dying.
14d9ebf17ca2054c06135f777ff84b8a6b4b0452.text: 单击亚龙足迹。这将召唤亚龙来运送你和队伍。你现在可以控制亚龙，并将使用朱南杜技能，而不是你角色上装备的技能。你现在可以在硫磺地区旅行而不会死亡。

16836fda371c10799bd16a067c8a8c5ca724a15f.source: Follow Palawa Joko as he leads you to the Remains of Sahlahja. Along the way you will fight groups of Margonites and Elementals. Margonites are easy to take down in the Desert Wurm disguise, but take care with the Elementals, especially the Sandstorm Crags whose earth damage attacks prove dangerous to the wurms. Mind that both these and Cracked Mesas cannot be knocked down for healing through Junundu Bite nor leave corpses for Junundu Feast. Remember to use Junundu Wail to resurrect fallen party members and heal once a fight is over.
16836fda371c10799bd16a067c8a8c5ca724a15f.text: 跟随帕拉瓦·约科 (Palawa Joko)，他会带您前往萨赫拉贾 (Sahlahja) 遗迹。一路上你将与玛贡人和元素人战斗。伪装成沙漠亚龙的玛贡尼特很容易被击倒，但要小心元素生物，尤其是沙暴峭壁，它们的地球伤害攻击对亚龙来说是危险的。请注意，这些和裂纹台地都不能通过朱南杜咬击击倒进行治疗，也不能在朱南杜盛宴中留下尸体。请记住使用朱南杜哀嚎来复活倒下的队员并在战斗结束后进行治疗。

ebd992866021c763f1b25659437e71b4b9bc3a90.source: During the journey you will encounter rocky ground which the wurms cannot travel through. You will have to abandon the wurm until you find another Wurm Spoor which will allow you to travel on the sulfur again. By timing your movement, you can avoid the Margonite group nearby and proceed to the next Wurm Spoor. You complete the mission when you reach the Remains of Sahlahja.
ebd992866021c763f1b25659437e71b4b9bc3a90.text: 在旅途中你会遇到亚龙无法穿越的岩石地面。你将不得不放弃这条亚龙，直到找到另一个亚龙孢子，它可以让你再次在硫磺上旅行。通过调整你的移动速度，你可以避开附近的玛贡尼特队伍并前往下一个亚龙足迹。当您到达萨赫拉贾遗迹时，您就完成了任务。

90038e72779a9e177ac5ac9226edf578e68c6db1.source: The bonus is not difficult, but it detours from Joko's direct route in order to rescue 3 Junundu Young. There is no need to exit Junundu to reach them.
90038e72779a9e177ac5ac9226edf578e68c6db1.text: 奖励并不难，但是为了营救3个Junundu Young，它绕开了Joko的直接路线。无需离开朱南杜即可到达他们。

52a4c6f57b3350823076fb470a687fa120718698.source: Each Junundu Young is surrounded by a group of a half-dozen Margonites. Follow the bonus route on the map and kill each group in turn. As you do, an advice box appears stating that the young has been saved and you can move on to the next objective along the path. You still receive credit for a rescue even if the young dies after you have disposed of the foes that threatened it.
52a4c6f57b3350823076fb470a687fa120718698.text: 每个朱南杜年轻人都被六名玛贡尼特人包围。沿着地图上的奖励路线依次杀死每一组。当您这样做时，会出现一个建议框，提示幼体已获救，您可以沿着路径继续下一个目标。即使幼崽在你消灭了威胁它的敌人后死去，你仍然会因为救援而获得荣誉。

adc4b91a5cbc879b1e9eba6052f9f4d92ba97445.source: Although the Margonites do not attack the young directly, these wurms can be hurt by area of effect skills, including your own — most notably, the young can be damaged by Junundu Smash. To guarantee the bonus, pull the Margonites away from the young before engaging them in combat.
adc4b91a5cbc879b1e9eba6052f9f4d92ba97445.text: 虽然玛贡尼特不会直接攻击幼龙，但这些亚龙可能会被范围技能伤害，包括你自己的——最值得注意的是，幼龙可能会被朱南杜粉碎伤害。为了保证奖金，在与年轻人交战之前将玛贡尼特人从他们身边拉开。

e31bb8d5e10e692019dbddc96e459dd2b27ed837.source: As the Elementals are tough and dangerous foes, especially for the Desert Wurm (disguise), one may wish to take a safer route around them, while still completing the bonus objective.
e31bb8d5e10e692019dbddc96e459dd2b27ed837.text: 由于元素是艰难而危险的敌人，尤其是对于沙漠亚龙（伪装）来说，人们可能希望采取一条更安全的路线绕过它们，同时仍然完成奖励目标。

a9e592f15faf491ad19741766f0e873aa0586d46.source: After having gained access to the wurm form and having first reached solid ground again, continue west instead of taking the route north. This will bring the party to a second route leading directly to the first (the second for the normal route) Junundu Young. Continuing north after rescuing gets you to the second (the first for the normal route) Junundu Young (remember to stick close to the wall to avoid aggroing more groups of Margonites). After mounting up again, avoid the first Elemental group on the way by sticking close to the north wall and taking the northern passage.
a9e592f15faf491ad19741766f0e873aa0586d46.text: 在进入亚龙形态并再次到达坚实的地面后，继续向西而不是向北走。这会将队伍带到第二条路线，直接通往第一条路线（正常路线的第二条路线）Junundu Young。救援后继续向北，你会到达第二个（正常路线的第一个）Junundu Young（记住靠近墙壁，以避免激怒更多的玛贡尼特群体）。再次上马后，靠近北墙并走北面通道，避开途中的第一批元素组。

396cddba33a2cb810749333994fd43351c9a1df0.source: Don't take the first canyon north as it is full of Elementals, instead head for the Margonites to the northeast and save the third Junundu Young, guarded by two groups of Margonites. From there, going north and then west will bring you to one last Wurm Spoor, and from there to the end point where there is only one Elemental group and maybe one Margonite group. Simply use Junundu Tunnel to bypass them and run the last bit to finish the mission.
396cddba33a2cb810749333994fd43351c9a1df0.text: 不要向北走第一个峡谷，因为那里充满了元素，而是前往东北方的玛贡尼特，并拯救由两组玛贡尼特守卫的第三个朱南杜·杨。从那里，向北然后向西，你会到达最后一个亚龙史普尔，从那里到终点，那里只有一个元素群体，也许还有一个玛贡尼特群体。只需使用 Junundu 隧道绕过他们并运行最后一点即可完成任务。

1ea1249d4c23359e5432396b98b424a7fcdaf650.source: Holy damage does double damage to undead.
1ea1249d4c23359e5432396b98b424a7fcdaf650.text: 神圣伤害对不死生物造成双倍伤害。

52c0c1e1dcb3315bd57f632cefa3ac1ae0e521f9.source: Area of effect spells, non-spell skills, and certain enchantment removal skills can help to overcome Obsidian Flesh and Vow of Silence, used by the Carven Effigies and Awakened Dune Carvers respectively.
52c0c1e1dcb3315bd57f632cefa3ac1ae0e521f9.text: 范围法术、非法术技能和某些结界移除技能可以帮助克服分别由雕刻雕像和觉醒沙丘雕刻师使用的黑曜石肉身和沉默誓言。

f54ec607f34e0743942f53321df14c97105c1f9c.source: Minions created outside the wurms can run through the Sulfurous Haze; however, while in the Desert Wurm disguise, the party will not be able to heal or create new minions.
f54ec607f34e0743942f53321df14c97105c1f9c.text: 在亚龙之外创造的小兵可以穿过硫磺烟雾；然而，在沙漠亚龙伪装中，队伍将无法治愈或创造新的仆从。

7a769ab1c52a3a5fe5804ec2a4dee832b88ce004.source: Bring plenty of party-wide heals, protective wards, and/or anti-melee and anti-caster skills — the undead at the start can be overwhelming to an unprepared party.
7a769ab1c52a3a5fe5804ec2a4dee832b88ce004.text: 带来大量的全队治疗、保护病房和/或反近战和反施法者技能——一开始的不死生物可能会让毫无准备的队伍不知所措。

39e2ae93f4ed09b9b5251af0da202e2af74cca01.source: Comfort Animal/Heal as One or a beast master build, since animal companions each enter a Junundu in this mission (unlike other locations with Wurm Spoors), which results in your party having more than eight Junundu wurms. They deal damage with attacks; however, they will not use Junundu skills and will not be resurrected by Junundu Wail (but will reappear, alive, beside their owner when they leave the Junundu).
39e2ae93f4ed09b9b5251af0da202e2af74cca01.text: 舒适动物/治疗作为一个或野兽大师建立，因为动物伙伴在这个任务中每个进入朱南杜（与其他有亚龙足迹的地点不同），这会导致你的队伍拥有超过八只朱南杜亚龙。他们通过攻击造成伤害；然而，它们不会使用朱南杜技能，也不会被朱南杜哀嚎复活（但当它们离开朱南杜时，它们会活着重新出现在主人身边）。

ffe539f9038d6da08be8a021c1973093847d9852.source: Rebirth or Sunspear Rebirth Signet for resurrection, since they are more convenient for any party members who die on the sulfur.
ffe539f9038d6da08be8a021c1973093847d9852.text: 重生或阳矛重生徽记用于复活，因为它们对于任何死于硫磺的党员来说更方便。

0b97685a29efeacbe1f68713e63d399b34d643c5.source: Lightbringer skills are not very useful, since your party will encounter the majority of Margonites while inside the Junundu and the other foes in this mission are not affected by those skills.
0b97685a29efeacbe1f68713e63d399b34d643c5.text: 光明使者技能不是很有用，因为你的队伍会在朱南杜内部遇到大多数玛贡尼特，而此任务中的其他敌人不会受到这些技能的影响。

929cbfb5178ceea4afc6d8f4e82484abb5f03e24.source: When crossing the desolation, Palawa Joko does not need to be with you to complete the mission - you may as well rush forward without his guidance.
929cbfb5178ceea4afc6d8f4e82484abb5f03e24.text: 穿越荒凉的时候，帕拉瓦·约科并不需要和你一起完成任务——你不妨在没有他指引的情况下向前冲去。

f230fa8573c5220d444ed17d03f4518cf3e1e52a.source: The mission does not progress past the fifth boss, unless you return to Joko, who will say his remaining lines and then you'll become able to use the Wurm Spoor.
f230fa8573c5220d444ed17d03f4518cf3e1e52a.text: 任务不会进展到第五个 Boss，除非你回到 Joko 那里，他会说出他剩下的台词，然后你就可以使用 Wurm Spoor。

2a650f74442848d494196c3c166ef18d863dd952.source: If Joko is missing, retrace your steps back towards the start of the mission; he may have gone a different way and stopped once you became separated.
2a650f74442848d494196c3c166ef18d863dd952.text: 如果乔科失踪了，则原路返回任务开始处；当你们分开后，他可能会走不同的路并停止。

13888e345d49262c2e00e76986874b53e2eb2aaf.source: When riding junundu, remember to switch heroes from Avoid Combat to Guard or Fight mode, otherwise they will be ineffective during battle.
13888e345d49262c2e00e76986874b53e2eb2aaf.text: 骑junundu时，记得将英雄从避免战斗切换到守卫或战斗模式，否则他们在战斗中会失效。

456117f940b7836daa2c5a07199b34f374973769.source: It is fairly easy to die while in a junundu since your team members cannot heal you. The death resets progress toward the Survivor title. Flagging heroes can be done to avoid that.
456117f940b7836daa2c5a07199b34f374973769.text: 在 junundu 中很容易死亡，因为你的团队成员无法治愈你。死亡重置了幸存者称号的进度。可以通过标记英雄来避免这种情况。

9f897ed4af109c2388c2136c0a02ef60c8999fa3.source: Bringing a Signet of Capture overrides one of the Junundu skills. The position of the Signet of Capture on the skill bar will correspond to the Junundu skill that is removed.
9f897ed4af109c2388c2136c0a02ef60c8999fa3.text: 携带捕获徽记会覆盖朱南杜技能之一。技能栏上的捕获徽记的位置将与被移除的朱南杜技能相对应。

ab589adba7dbbd082fc5c33cae30c7f225c4918c.source: It is recommended to place it at the fourth position before using a Wurm Spoor, since Unknown Junundu Ability is an unusable skill that usually takes that slot1.
ab589adba7dbbd082fc5c33cae30c7f225c4918c.text: 建议在使用Wurm Spoor之前将其放置在第四个位置，因为未知的Junundu能力是一个无法使用的技能，通常占据该位置1。

52a6f9cb217cca92c0cdaa171060bb435a31160e.source: It is not necessary to be inside the junundu to rescue the young. All three of the young are in sandy areas that you can traverse without being in the wurms. Consider dismounting from the junundu and fighting outside the wurms if you prefer to use your build over the Junundu skills.
52a6f9cb217cca92c0cdaa171060bb435a31160e.text: 没有必要在朱南杜内部来营救幼崽。所有三只幼龙都在沙地里，你可以穿越这些沙地而不必身处亚龙之中。如果您更喜欢使用自己的构建而不是朱南杜技能，请考虑从朱南杜下马并在亚龙外战斗。

fb6c052037d4bb780df8f7eb760c06a3bef760d0.source: You no longer have to keep the young worms alive to get credit for the bonus, just approach them and the bonus note will update.
fb6c052037d4bb780df8f7eb760c06a3bef760d0.text: 你不再需要让幼虫活着来获得奖金，只需接近它们，奖金就会更新。

8ccf3c95cba791699c8747faf48787b5abdabb36.source: After completing this mission, your party will be sent to the Remains of Sahlahja.
8ccf3c95cba791699c8747faf48787b5abdabb36.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被送往萨赫拉贾遗迹。

6141f63d16f5a161682f454bc4e49436b4a2a6a0.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #13 in the Night Falls storybook.
6141f63d16f5a161682f454bc4e49436b4a2a6a0.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书第 13 页。

ec840e1bdb47be5fbdef9435d10cb319917ed481.source: The Junundu Young will travel through the rocky terrain that your party must cross in human form.
ec840e1bdb47be5fbdef9435d10cb319917ed481.text:
朱南杜年轻人将穿越岩石地形，你的队伍必须以人类形态穿越。

MAPPINGOUT_6bf8cfae3a1f267_0
如果你在与Aijundu交谈之前拯救了所有的幼崽，那么当你这样做时，它会说你已经拯救了3个junundu幼崽中的0个，但任务完成时你仍然会得到Master的奖励。

018d90d619328046d8c99c73c37eac031f073a34.source: Speak with Palawa Joko outside the Remains of Sahlahja, wait until he is finished speaking (point P on the wiki map). Palawa Joko and the paragon Minion of Joko will now follow your party. Take the left path towards the Wurm Spoor (point W in the south) and fight your way towards General Huduh (point H).
018d90d619328046d8c99c73c37eac031f073a34.text: 在 Sahlahja 遗迹外与 Palawa Joko 交谈，等到他说完（维基地图上的 P 点）。帕拉瓦·约科和约科的典范小黄人现在将跟随您的队伍。沿左侧道路前往 Wurm Spoor（南边的 W 点），并一路杀向 Huduh 将军（H 点）。

0b236655eb26e3f319e2f138c48dac1a9427d94f.source: As this area is rocky, you can't fight him from within your wurms. Concentrate your attacks on General Huduh and try not to kill his four Minions of Joko (although if you do, the monk Minion of Joko will resurrect the ones that were killed, unless the monk was killed). Talk to General Huduh when he is no longer a foe, which causes eight allied elementalist Minions of Joko to spawn. General Huduh and all the Minions of Joko will follow the party.
0b236655eb26e3f319e2f138c48dac1a9427d94f.text: 由于这个区域布满岩石，你无法从你的亚龙中与他战斗。将你的攻击集中在Huduh将军身上，并尽量不要杀死他的四个约科爪牙（尽管如果你这么做了，约科和尚爪牙会复活那些被杀的爪牙，除非和尚被杀）。当胡杜将军不再是敌人时与他交谈，这会导致八个盟军的约科元素仆从生成。胡杜将军和所有佐科的爪牙将跟随该党。

8bab6f3a3ce60efa478d33dd136cbe59bb76088a.source: Activate the Wurm Spoor to the north (point W) and travel towards the Bone Palace (the rest of the quest is easier as it is fought within a wurm) and kill the groups of Margonites and Restless Dead. Before you can get to Zadukar the Blessed, you have to get past three Torment Claws. To complete the quest, you have to defeat Zadukar's entire group. After a cinematic, your party appears in the Bone Palace.
8bab6f3a3ce60efa478d33dd136cbe59bb76088a.text: 激活北边的亚龙足迹（W点）并前往白骨宫殿（任务的其余部分更容易，因为它是在亚龙中战斗）并杀死玛贡尼特和不安死者的队伍。在你到达受祝福的扎杜卡之前，你必须通过三个折磨之爪。要完成任务，你必须击败扎杜卡的整个团队。电影结束后，你的队伍出现在白骨宫殿中。

0c69916bef5f57c94f959c8d3f0148ce90ac988d.source: Only the paragon and elementalist Minions of Joko can be spoken to (i.e. has dialogue). The other Minions of Joko can be followed but cannot be spoken to, possibly because those Minions of Joko were initially foes.
0c69916bef5f57c94f959c8d3f0148ce90ac988d.text: 只能与约科的典范和元素奴仆交谈（即进行对话）。约科的其他小兵可以被跟随，但不能与之交谈，可能是因为那些约科的小兵最初是敌人。

7b539bd8aeaea725e726894bf30b9b1467586d71.source: Credit is not given for vanquishing Joko's Domain while this quest is active, even if the party defeats the last foe before triggering the cinematic.
7b539bd8aeaea725e726894bf30b9b1467586d71.text: 在此任务激活期间，即使队伍在触发过场动画之前击败了最后一个敌人，也不会获得征服约科领域的功劳。

87f8b08b09dbc8215c48d4f9d89021adcc86a4bd.source: The Alkali Pan back entry is unlocked when the party leader has this quest marked as (Completed) in their quest log to allow the option of running to Bone Palace.
87f8b08b09dbc8215c48d4f9d89021adcc86a4bd.text: 当队伍领导者在任务日志中将此任务标记为“已完成”时，碱锅后部条目就会解锁，以允许选择跑到骨宫。

d33c0543936e5c5d34eec17defae792337dde5cd.source: The quest will be completed and the party will be teleported to Bone Palace after a cinematic once the group of Zadukar the Blessed is defeated.
d33c0543936e5c5d34eec17defae792337dde5cd.text: 一旦祝福扎杜卡的队伍被击败，任务就会完成，并且在电影结束后队伍将被传送到白骨宫殿。

0181fa51d192d752040c9bb7ef504d980ba7681d.source: This means if a player abandons this quest after having reached Bone Palace, the quest can quickly be completed again by exiting from Bone Palace into Joko's Domain, and going south east to kill Zadukar's group.
0181fa51d192d752040c9bb7ef504d980ba7681d.text: 这意味着如果玩家在到达白骨宫殿后放弃该任务，则可以通过从白骨宫殿退出进入约科的领域，然后向东南杀死扎杜卡的队伍来快速完成该任务。

ce8af699ba6136e361765d3e920084f0bd427b86.source: Teach your great wurm to siege by devouring an elder siege wurm.
ce8af699ba6136e361765d3e920084f0bd427b86.text: 通过吞噬一只年长的攻城亚龙来教导你的巨龙进行攻城。

f79363de285ee6019f50f1efea38d9e1912dde21.source: Destroy the Horde of Darkness guarding access to the Ruins of Morah by using Junundu Siege.
f79363de285ee6019f50f1efea38d9e1912dde21.text: 使用朱南杜围攻摧毁守卫莫拉废墟通道的黑暗部落。

563ae457b26fd3a393b24add30b5dca5d96c290a.source: Strike down the Solitary Colossus with your wurm siege attacks to create a path to the Ruins of Morah.
563ae457b26fd3a393b24add30b5dca5d96c290a.text: 用你的亚龙攻城攻击击倒孤独巨像，开辟一条通往莫拉废墟的道路。

9b1b6c8687750856222e79542180e83a38445206.source: See Captain Mehhan for your reward.
9b1b6c8687750856222e79542180e83a38445206.text: 去找梅汉队长领取奖励。

e74d73754dd30fbc99a0d052b41da0462bfc3a77.source: While active, this quest prevents the spawning of Saushali the Frustrating in the Shattered Ravines.
e74d73754dd30fbc99a0d052b41da0462bfc3a77.text: 激活时，该任务可以防止令人沮丧的索沙利在破碎峡谷中生成。

a18b8a3f903116b845be370e4e9e5a6eafc1a8f8.source: Once this quest has been completed, Hordes of Darkness will no longer spawn in The Alkali Pan.
a18b8a3f903116b845be370e4e9e5a6eafc1a8f8.text: 一旦完成此任务，黑暗部落将不再在碱锅中生成。

4c577d504f133cfb4d79d4bbf84320bbbca36097.source: Travel northwards to The Shattered Ravines. The Elder Siege Wurms that your wurm needs to devour are located to the north east (location "a" on the map). There is a chance Desert Wurms spawn among the Elder Siege Wurms too. Defeat all the Elders, to receive the elite skill Junundu Siege. Once you have acquired this skill and the quest updates, it will be available any time your character uses a junundu wurm.
4c577d504f133cfb4d79d4bbf84320bbbca36097.text: 向北前往破碎峡谷。你的亚龙需要吞噬的长老攻城亚龙位于东北部（地图上的“a”位置）。沙漠亚龙也有可能在远古攻城亚龙中生成。击败所有长老，获得精英技能朱南杜攻城。一旦你获得了这项技能并且任务更新，只要你的角色使用朱南杜亚龙，它就可以使用。

6fb7785e0714548d482775062dac314c7b819154.source: Map travel back to the Bone Palace and exit west into The Alkali Pan. Destroy the three groups of Horde of Darkness (location "b") by firing Junundu Siege several times.
6fb7785e0714548d482775062dac314c7b819154.text: 地图返回骨宫并向西退出进入碱锅。通过多次射击“朱南杜围攻”来摧毁黑暗部落（位置“b”）的三支队伍。

0bc032b038d8c7adb9bb5f1cecac36d4e6e53c34.source: Finally, siege the Solitary Colossus to create a bridge to enter the Ruins of Morah (location "c"). Speak to Captain Mehhan for your reward.
0bc032b038d8c7adb9bb5f1cecac36d4e6e53c34.text: 最后，围攻孤独巨像，建造一座进入莫拉废墟（位置“c”）的桥梁。与梅汉队长交谈以获得奖励。

6bf8cfeae3a1f2672c5667172f81b3f2e35bb5cd.source: If you save all of the young before talking to Aijundu, when you do, it will say you have saved 0 of 3 junundu young, but you will still get the Master's reward when the mission is complete.
6bf8cfeae3a1f2672c5667172f81b3f2e35bb5cd.text: 如果你在与Aijundu交谈之前拯救了所有的幼崽，那么当你这样做时，它会说你已经拯救了3个junundu幼崽中的0个，但任务完成时你仍然会得到Master的奖励。

77a40f29b5816ce28ef2bd85ca46f92748e8c58b.source: Guild Wars Nightfall regarding events leading up to the next mission 1: Junundu Siege will not be available during this mission even for players who already unlocked it through learning it during Horde of Darkness by consuming an Elder Siege Wurm).
77a40f29b5816ce28ef2bd85ca46f92748e8c58b.text: 《激战黄昏》关于导致下一个任务 1 的事件：朱南杜围攻在此任务期间将无法使用，即使对于已经在黑暗部落期间通过消耗远古攻城亚龙学习它来解锁它的玩家也是如此。

bea9bd301e82aab0ad00d09f9797bddf3fa5bf09.source: Attend the Ministry of Purity's rally.

7591d72250039f4fc42293dbb266eae118195c9a.source: Prevent the Ministry of Purity from killing Miku.

43adf38f452c02e57efa3282b384a3d6a4f06536.source: Escape from the Ministry of Purity.

46ba184c284eb6f031efffdc617516b536767bdd.source: Suunshi Haisang and Leijun Ano spawn in Shenzun Tunnels in place of Rai Zhon the Manipulator and Xi Lin of the Flames, respectively.
46ba184c284eb6f031efffdc617516b536767bdd.text: Suunshi Haisang和Leijun Ano在神尊隧道中生成，分别代替操纵者Rai Zhon和火焰的Xi Lin。

773db4f7bf320c5ecd8733bf7638b3061f023da2.source: Heifan Kanko and Shensang Jinzao spawn in Sunjiang District in place of Zu Jin the Quick and Fah Yu the Shadow's Eye, respectively.
773db4f7bf320c5ecd8733bf7638b3061f023da2.text: 黑饭康科和神桑金早分别在孙江区生成，代替了迅捷祖金和影眼法羽。

5afef9030ce600a3b7600b5c70fa7ca7889eb214.source: Dimsur Cheefai and Yinnai Qi spawn in the Undercity in place of Ming the Judgment and En Fa the Awakened, respectively.
5afef9030ce600a3b7600b5c70fa7ca7889eb214.text: 迪姆苏尔·奇法伊 (Dimsur Cheefai) 和因奈奇 (Yinnai Qi) 分别在幽暗城生成，代替审判者明 (Ming the Judge) 和觉醒者恩法 (En Fa the Awakened)。

45e3ac1632330fe51c9bd53b74e99a0d725c1abe.source: Talking to the Herald of Purity again will move your party to the Winds of Change explorable Kaineng Center.
45e3ac1632330fe51c9bd53b74e99a0d725c1abe.text: 再次与纯洁先驱交谈会将你的队伍移至变革之风可探索的凯能中心。

dfefdcaf772db0503825b8722e2acb45e1d3f26d.source: Listen to Reiko's pretentious speech, dispose of her posse, and then flee the scene. In the event you fail, you'll be spared most of the initial dialogue if you try again without abandoning the quest.
dfefdcaf772db0503825b8722e2acb45e1d3f26d.text: 聆听玲子的自命不凡的演讲，处理掉她的队伍，然后逃离现场。如果你失败了，如果你在不放弃任务的情况下重试，你将省去大部分最初的对话。

4d2667432a3398b2356aa534c361ff4a8207e8ba.source: The initial group of Ministry use a lot of AoE skills which can easily wipe the entire party if you aren't careful. Remember to protect Miku; Shield of Absorption can usually handle everything but the Ministry's special monster skills. Spread out to make the fight easier.
4d2667432a3398b2356aa534c361ff4a8207e8ba.text: 部门初期使用大量AoE技能，一不小心就可以轻松消灭整个队伍。记得保护初音；吸收之盾通常可以处理除了魔法部的特殊怪物技能之外的所有事情。分散开来让战斗变得更容易。

532a11bda0c62e338de6c84202ac32237710b2c3.source: After defeating the initial group of Ministry, follow Miku and avoid fighting. When she says, "There's an exit to the east of here," split off from her and head toward the portal to Bukdek Byway. Xan Hei and Initiate Zei Ri are waiting just in front of the portal, and will attack after more dialogue. You must kill Xan Hei twice to gain credit for the quest; this can be done even if you lost most of your team along the way (unless the ministry troops followed you to the portal).
532a11bda0c62e338de6c84202ac32237710b2c3.text: 击败第一批魔法部后，跟随 Miku 并避免战斗。当她说“这里东边有一个出口”时，他从她身边分开，朝 Bukdek Byway 的入口走去。 Xan Hei和新人Zei Ri就在传送门前等待，更多对话后将发起攻击。你必须杀死Xan Hei两次才能获得任务的功劳；即使您一路上失去了大部分团队，也可以这样做（除非部委部队跟随您到达传送门）。

9fc12a346a76d74bd36f8cb7e3811314e74537cd.source: To claim the reward, talk to Miku in Shenzun Tunnels just outside Tahnnakai Temple.
9fc12a346a76d74bd36f8cb7e3811314e74537cd.text: 要领取奖励，请在塔纳凯神庙外的神尊隧道中与 Miku 交谈。

b93fb02fdd6e265b21fa4a0b32cffa032dc0f675.source: This quest is the most common farming place for Ministerial Commendations.
b93fb02fdd6e265b21fa4a0b32cffa032dc0f675.text: 这个任务是部长级嘉奖最常见的农耕地点。

c290370e9e8e3d5b4918ecf57bc97a464646e7e1.source: Sometimes the Spirit of Life summoned by Ministry Purgers appears as an allied target.
c290370e9e8e3d5b4918ecf57bc97a464646e7e1.text: 有时，魔法部净化者召唤的生命之灵会作为盟友目标出现。

928955d6ea65b1e7aff77a99b7657c4dc5673426.source: Meet Palawa Joko in Joko's Domain.
928955d6ea65b1e7aff77a99b7657c4dc5673426.text: 在佐科领地遇见帕拉瓦佐科。

0c812917dccca37f50e089c2196676e2d4512a90.source: Help Palawa Joko regain control of some of his army by defeating General Huduh.
0c812917dccca37f50e089c2196676e2d4512a90.text: 击败胡杜将军，帮助帕拉瓦·佐科重新控制部分军队。

994ab9314c54ce8be1789652ac59a2d636cc3501.source: Retake the Bone Palace from Varesh's rear Vanguard and defeat Zadukar the Blessed.
994ab9314c54ce8be1789652ac59a2d636cc3501.text: 从瓦雷什后方先锋队手中夺回白骨宫殿并击败受祝福的扎杜卡。

4d772b2dd90ff061dbfa67b9e659bf01d8f50b39.source: See Priest Kehmtut for your reward.
4d772b2dd90ff061dbfa67b9e659bf01d8f50b39.text: 去找克姆图牧师领取奖励。

70bcdaa1f64ec28001924e7794b1b9463e34e26e.source: Shekoss the Stony and its group will not spawn during this quest.
70bcdaa1f64ec28001924e7794b1b9463e34e26e.text: 石质谢科斯及其群体不会在此任务中生成。

b93289a0a3729290d53d6ac0d3795a320ac47dc8.source: It's possible to skip most of the quest, saving a lot of time. Equip a ranged degen or life steal skill and head out into The Alkali Pan. Don't bother fighting any of the enemies on the way to Ruins of Morah. Just get close enough to the barrier so that the Resurrection Shrine on the far side activates. Wipe your party (walking on the sulfur is the quickest way to do this and does not interfere with the Survivor title) and you'll res behind the barrier. Use your degen/life steal on the Solitary Colossus to kill it, cross the bridge, and speak to Captain Mehhan. You will unlock Junundu Siege on quest completion.
b93289a0a3729290d53d6ac0d3795a320ac47dc8.text: 可以跳过大部分任务，节省大量时间。装备远程德根或生命窃取技能并前往碱锅。在前往莫拉废墟的路上，不要费心与任何敌人战斗。只要足够靠近屏障，以便激活远端的复活神殿。消灭你的队伍（在硫磺上行走是最快的方法，并且不会干扰幸存者称号），你就会在障碍物后面。使用你的 degen/生命偷取孤独巨像来杀死它，过桥并与 Mehhan 队长交谈。任务完成后，您将解锁朱南杜围攻。

e627f4e3311c2674e9953feda5c7b03ab7343205.source: You will receive Junundu Siege during the course of this quest, or when you complete the quest if you take the shortcut (see next note).
e627f4e3311c2674e9953feda5c7b03ab7343205.text: 在这个任务过程中，或者当你走捷径完成任务时，你将收到朱南杜围攻（见下一条注释）。

d1a6cef62643d18cd133e2eaa0cfd2a9a29e83c5.source: There are two shortcuts for this quest.

e4721710e634f0e011e2cfd45715b1dc8107dd89.source: If you get a character with Junundu Siege to join your character's party, they can kill the Horde of Darkness and the Solitary Colossus for your character, allowing your character to complete the quest without going to get the siege skill first.
e4721710e634f0e011e2cfd45715b1dc8107dd89.text: 如果你让一个拥有朱南杜围攻的角色加入你的角色队伍，他们可以为你的角色杀死黑暗部落和孤独巨像，让你的角色无需先获得攻城技能即可完成任务。

32115f9dc7e96de61040b8ddf87d9c1238b2f9c5.source: If you trigger the shrine on the other side of the gate and die, you can resurrect on the other side and kill the Colossus with degen hexes. If you've already acquired the outpost this way, you can complete the quest by simply walking out and talking to Captain Mehhan.
32115f9dc7e96de61040b8ddf87d9c1238b2f9c5.text: 如果你触发了门另一侧的神殿并死亡，你可以在另一侧复活并用德根六角杀死巨像。如果你已经通过这种方式获得了前哨站，那么你只需走出去并与梅汉队长交谈即可完成任务。

f16c01e55ef8da80f986c0e71375b4650227b162.source: There may be a Desert Wurm in the cave before the Elder Siege Wurms. Ensure he is not there or kill it before going for the wurms, or it may pop out in the middle of the fight.
f16c01e55ef8da80f986c0e71375b4650227b162.text: 在远古攻城亚龙之前的洞穴中可能有一只沙漠亚龙。确保他不在那里或在去追亚龙之前杀死它，否则它可能会在战斗中突然跳出来。

8ceceba76725e14b6de00d30d64861a2a91c6ca4.source: Since you are headed in that direction, Strange Bedfellows followed by Under New Management from Palawa Joko have great synergy with this quest.
8ceceba76725e14b6de00d30d64861a2a91c6ca4.text: 既然你正朝着这个方向前进，那么《奇怪的同床异梦》和来自帕拉瓦·约科的《新管理下》与这个任务有很大的协同作用。

3250183498e9c80a3b026c90e72e70fbff9358a3.source: You may wish to go and unlock the Lair of the Forgotten outpost before going to the Elder Siege Wurms.
3250183498e9c80a3b026c90e72e70fbff9358a3.text: 在前往远古围城亚龙之前，您可能希望先去解锁被遗忘者巢穴前哨站。

eb217f607a04260539e3136ba17a42d301f5498d.source: Locate the Jade Brotherhood at Mount Qinkai.
eb217f607a04260539e3136ba17a42d301f5498d.text: 在秦开山找到翡翠兄弟会。

5b1701d0b116b135b9366df77511bc086941a1f4.text: 营救翡翠兄弟会的俘虏。

668c7caa80be07ed34a1b9c59443cdca4b58c449.source: See Guardsman Qao Lin for your reward.
668c7caa80be07ed34a1b9c59443cdca4b58c449.text: 去找卫兵乔林领取奖励。

2bd6a1ceecf175afd3ca4e6ad0d334571ae8d833.source: Start from Aspenwood Gate (Luxon). Listen to Meijun, Vengeful Eye and then head north to the yeti cave (refer to the map). The cave has two entrances: the southwest and the east. As you approach, a dialogue between Yuun, Kisai, and Mai will trigger. Soon after that, the trio will be attacked by waves of yeti. Your task is to protect them; the quest is failed if any of them dies.
2bd6a1ceecf175afd3ca4e6ad0d334571ae8d833.text: 从阿斯彭伍德门（Luxon）出发。听美君、复仇之眼的歌后向北前往雪人洞（参考地图）。洞有两个入口：西南面和东面。当你接近时，Yuun、Kisai 和 Mai 之间的对话将会触发。不久之后，三人就会遭到雪人的攻击。你的任务是保护他们；如果其中任何一个死亡，任务就会失败。

e19cffea3bff4e663ae3297a89a43358705994f9.source: The yetis will attack from both entrances in groups of three: all but two groups will come from the east. As Meijun ends his dialogue (and you approach the cave), two groups will spawn close to cave entrance; there is plenty of time to kill them and return inside before the main assault begins. You can also use a spirit wall to delay the approach of the next group.
e19cffea3bff4e663ae3297a89a43358705994f9.text: 雪人将以三人一组的方式从两个入口发起攻击：除了两组外，所有雪人都将来自东部。当Meijun结束他的对话（并且你接近洞穴）时，两个群体将在洞穴入口附近产卵；在主要攻击开始之前，有足够的时间杀死他们并返回内部。您还可以使用精神墙来延迟下一组的接近。

90fe69fe9c8d405240cff31f127fce6147d6a47a.source: That small cliff overlooking the east entrance is a good place to make your stand. Keep an eye on the NPC health bars, especially Mai's, since she has a tendency to shadow step right into the fray. Although the yeti are light damage dealers, they are capable of wearing down your party due to their large numbers, especially in hard mode. After you've killed all the Yetis, Yuun will thank you and you will finish the quest.
90fe69fe9c8d405240cff31f127fce6147d6a47a.text: 俯瞰东入口的那个小悬崖是你站立的好地方。密切关注 NPC 的生命条，尤其是麦的生命条，因为她倾向于直接进入战斗。虽然雪人造成的伤害较低，但由于数量众多，他们有能力消耗你的队伍，尤其是在困难模式下。当你杀死所有的雪人后，尤恩会感谢你，你就会完成任务。

42eeda27ac6f03b66dcf992d8dc7206f7f461146.source: If you have trouble keeping Mai alive, you can buy yourself some extra time by avoiding triggering the quest dialogues until after you have cleared out a path to the cave entrance. If you follow the colored dots on the legend in order, you should be fine!
42eeda27ac6f03b66dcf992d8dc7206f7f461146.text: 如果你很难让麦活着，你可以通过避免触发任务对话来为自己赢得一些额外的时间，直到你清理出通往洞穴入口的路径。如果您按照图例上的彩色点按顺序操作，应该没问题！

9a2156697edebce1c0d4c575f521e9d66965a023.source: Starting from Aspenwood Gate, clear your way north through the Rot Wallows and the Island Guardian. Take a left along the path and defeat the hidden Oni before continuing north (beware the wandering group of Rot Wallows). Then flag your heroes just south of the western cave entrance. Now make your way back to the outpost along the clear path, and go near enough to Meijun, Vengeful Eye to begin the dialogue. (You can alternatively trigger his dialogue from the ledge to his northeast where the Oni were hidden). Once Meijun begins talking, head back along the clear route to the cave and when the dialogue stops the yeti will spawn - due to your direction of approach, the vulnerable NPCs will not immediately be added to the party list.
9a2156697edebce1c0d4c575f521e9d66965a023.text: 从阿斯彭伍德之门出发，向北穿过腐烂泥沼和岛屿守护者。沿着小路左转，击败隐藏的鬼，然后继续向北（小心腐烂泥沼的流浪群体）。然后在西洞穴入口以南标记你的英雄。现在沿着畅通无阻的路径返回前哨站，并靠近复仇之眼美君开始对话。 （你也可以从鬼隐藏的东北方的壁架触发他的对话）。一旦 Meijun 开始说话，就沿着清晰的路线返回洞穴，当对话停止时，雪人就会生成 - 由于你的接近方向，易受攻击的 NPC 不会立即添加到队伍列表中。

c8a90da3bf40d049af264b722664b46d8afd2638.source: Now sweep your way through the cave past the now invulnerable NPCs to kill the various incoming Yeti groups. Once you have killed the waves of yeti immediately moving into the cave, you can head east to kill the stationary foes - just bear in mind that moving far enough north will trigger the NPCs to become vulnerable. If more dialogue begins, run back to the cave to protect the NPCs.
c8a90da3bf40d049af264b722664b46d8afd2638.text: 现在扫过洞穴，穿过现在无敌的 NPC，杀死各种即将到来的雪人群体。一旦你杀死了立即进入洞穴的雪人浪潮，你就可以向东去杀死静止的敌人 - 请记住，向北移动足够远会导致 NPC 变得脆弱。如果开始更多对话，跑回洞穴保护 NPC。

cc220c0404e95cec69e731d6455b74800cc7bc63.source: See talk page for further elaboration of this method.
cc220c0404e95cec69e731d6455b74800cc7bc63.text: 有关此方法的进一步详细说明，请参阅讨论页。

a3b8e8b576e7cbca2f32b8460c2d82dd58f6fc68.source: Spirit spammers and/or minion masters, to help distract the yeti.
a3b8e8b576e7cbca2f32b8460c2d82dd58f6fc68.text: 灵魂垃圾邮件发送者和/或仆从大师，以帮助分散雪人的注意力。

2f4b9f274dce59e267e20c099e5902379c6b0609.source: Blood is Power to replenish energy.

321dd28380c494ad82ab282d3f6b2950138f1447.source: Well spells, such as Well of Silence and Well of Suffering.
321dd28380c494ad82ab282d3f6b2950138f1447.text: 井咒语，例如沉默之井和痛苦之井。

7979f4698b24d3925107044e80fe7cb11be1f1c9.source: The quest log fails to mention the gold and experience rewards. If you run to the three students before the initial dialogue is complete, the quest will not trigger properly. You must run about halfway back to him and re-approach the cave.
7979f4698b24d3925107044e80fe7cb11be1f1c9.text: 任务日志没有提及金币和经验奖励。如果你在初始对话完成之前跑向三名学生，任务将无法正确触发。你必须跑回他身边并重新接近洞穴。

66ea7a9e36cf86b7c257c59ac48e5353415b787a.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Horde of Darkness.
66ea7a9e36cf86b7c257c59ac48e5353415b787a.text: 所有队伍成员都必须接受黑暗部落的奖励。

56bc11e550581f5819b9b18b374e39b8997acca3.source: General Morgahn must be present in the party.
56bc11e550581f5819b9b18b374e39b8997acca3.text: 摩根将军必须出席聚会。
