f2942553693cf5d6ac54cd6ee1b9858c97de2f2c.source: The dervish form of Prophet Varesh is awaiting the ritual to break Abaddon's prison with three Margonite Clerics in the middle of the crater. Kill the clerics first or pull her away alone.
f2942553693cf5d6ac54cd6ee1b9858c97de2f2c.text: 先知瓦雷什的托钵僧形态正在等待仪式，以打破阿巴顿的监狱，三名玛贡尼特牧师在火山口中央。先杀掉牧师或者单独把她拉走。

19423f4543d49e6c61f978fcb881b141f626d120.source: Killing her is easy—but she will be resurrected after with a variety of Torment creatures—so it is recommended to fight away from the crater and close to the entry point of the mission. Use anti-melee skills (i.e. blind, snares and/or knock downs). Do not stand in either of her Earth or Frost Vortices.
19423f4543d49e6c61f978fcb881b141f626d120.text: 杀死她很容易——但她会被各种折磨生物复活——所以建议远离火山口并靠近任务入口点进行战斗。使用反近战技能（即致盲、圈套和/或击倒）。不要站在她的地球或冰霜漩涡中。

b2a79051d61b081435d74f42f9bbd09a3a8b6c87.source: There is a short interval between her first death and her new form as the paragon Commander Varesh. Use the time delay to rush back towards your entry point and flag henchmen/heroes. The new form will not leash as far, so staying next to the door will cause her to run back to the centre of the crater where she spawns. Torment creatures with the skill Call to the Torment (which allows them to duplicate) appear around the crater and start to patrol counter-clockwise. Her new form also has a monster skill called Enemies Must Die! which will focus all of the torment creatures' attacks on one of your allies - just like players targeting priority foes for heroes. Either take out a few demons first to finally strike her, or focus your entire firepower on her to kill her as quickly as possible. The second death of Varesh ends the mission.
b2a79051d61b081435d74f42f9bbd09a3a8b6c87.text: 从她第一次死亡到她成为模范指挥官瓦雷什的新形象之间有很短的间隔。利用时间延迟冲回你的入口点并标记追随者/英雄。新形态不会拴那么远，所以呆在门旁边会让她跑回她出生的火山口中心。具有召唤折磨技能（允许它们复制）的折磨生物会出现在火山口周围，并开始逆时针巡逻。她的新形态还拥有一个怪物技能，叫做敌人必须死！这会将所有折磨生物的攻击集中在你的一位盟友身上 - 就像玩家针对英雄的优先敌人一样。要么先干掉几只恶魔，最终击中她，要么集中全部火力，以最快的速度杀死她。瓦雷什的第二次死亡结束了任务。

d13a2fd1b975fadeb790e3caaf68177227355f93.source: Since the spawns of the torment creatures are limited (only 2 spawns of 2 per spawn point and 4 spawn points) it is possible to kill all nearby demons while holding the entrance, making the fight against Varesh's second form much easier.
d13a2fd1b975fadeb790e3caaf68177227355f93.text: 由于折磨生物的生成是有限的（每个生成点只有 2 个生成，每个生成点只有 2 个生成），因此可以在占领入口的同时杀死附近的所有恶魔，从而使与 Varesh 的第二形态的战斗变得更加容易。

5e9dde0abe9fdb8cd46f5638dfe86e2d1d58e35a.text: 替代方案：保持中心位置

c7ae1535fb25d7c9717b121004011f018f10fcac.source: Do not use summoning stones, spirits, or minions for this method.
c7ae1535fb25d7c9717b121004011f018f10fcac.text: 此方法请勿使用召唤石、灵魂或仆从。

b96282d3f4c153eb00d729570456ded44be2245d.source: Using caster heroes and henchmen only, move to where Varesh initially spawns in the mission. After killing the Clerics and then the first form of Varesh, instead of flagging your allies atop the hill, keep them with you in the center. If you stay in the center, most of the torment demons should patrol around the area without aggroing your party. Some demons might wander into your Danger Zone but by that time they hopefully shouldn't represent much of a threat.
b96282d3f4c153eb00d729570456ded44be2245d.text: 仅使用施法者英雄和追随者，移动到瓦雷什在任务中最初生成的地方。在杀死牧师和瓦雷什的第一个形态后，不要在山顶上标记你的盟友，而是让他们和你一起呆在中间。如果你留在中心，大多数折磨恶魔应该在该区域巡逻，而不会骚扰你的队伍。有些恶魔可能会徘徊到你的危险区域，但到那时他们希望不会构成太大的威胁。

da9a66dadfb023d560d5b6a18a15afb72631015d.source: Display your Lightbringer title and bring Lightbringer's Gaze.
da9a66dadfb023d560d5b6a18a15afb72631015d.text: 显示你的光明使者头衔并带上光明使者的凝视。

157d29235403d2e7f3986240e36eafa6d64e6c6a.source: Melee counter, blind, punishment hexes (such as Spoil Victor and Visions of Regret) for Varesh.
157d29235403d2e7f3986240e36eafa6d64e6c6a.text: 瓦雷什的近战反击、致盲、惩罚六角（例如破坏胜利者和遗憾幻象）。

57427e6b2febcdaa1275a80f36f1a836c8b79ca4.source: Inspired Hex or Revealed Hex to quickly remove Varesh's hexes, since they recharge instantly due to being monster skills.
57427e6b2febcdaa1275a80f36f1a836c8b79ca4.text: 灵感十六进制或显露十六进制可快速消除瓦雷什的十六进制，因为它们是怪物技能，因此会立即充电。

a79374f5d894bdc3479f9f08462e1fbb19e00521.source: Pain Inverter can hurt Varesh because of her various powerful skills.
a79374f5d894bdc3479f9f08462e1fbb19e00521.text: 痛苦反转器可以伤害瓦雷什，因为她有各种强大的技能。

864e049368a378fc128d4e515c1a878932af40cc.source: Party wide and single protective skills like Shield of Absorption and Spirit Bond to counter the spike from enemies when Varesh uses Enemies Must Die!.
864e049368a378fc128d4e515c1a878932af40cc.text: 当瓦雷什使用“敌人必死！”时，可以使用吸收之盾和灵魂束缚等全队范围内的单一保护技能来对抗敌人的尖峰。

f2576eb193a2e30ea580b43a29295d80c9ef7584.source: Ursan Blessing is extremely helpful and easy way to defeat both first and second versions of Varesh.
f2576eb193a2e30ea580b43a29295d80c9ef7584.text: 乌尔桑祝福是击败瓦雷什第一版和第二版的极其有用且简单的方法。

d97e10b3969f936f9e1e4c0c8e2c8515385ee1fb.source: Sometimes, Commander Varesh doesn't move at all.
d97e10b3969f936f9e1e4c0c8e2c8515385ee1fb.text: 有时，瓦雷什指挥官根本不动。

00adf9a835f9475e718c19da2c95a579e4163f0f.source: After completing this mission, your party will be in the Gate of Torment.
00adf9a835f9475e718c19da2c95a579e4163f0f.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将进入折磨之门。

d3672ebd92410e8175a06b408022635a1f914c67.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #14 in the Night Falls storybook.
d3672ebd92410e8175a06b408022635a1f914c67.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书第 14 页。

4d12cb2ffc2ed300e37813ce95c946690b9e298b.source: Clear the Jade Brotherhood out of Seitung Harbor.
4d12cb2ffc2ed300e37813ce95c946690b9e298b.text: 将翡翠兄弟会从塞通港清除。

3e1be339264a65d7c49ee7c9a22278e289707003.source: Work your way through the zone to clear out the Jade Brotherhood forces. Pay attention to the Jade Brotherhood Demolitionists, who can easily wipe your party using the suicide skill, Jade Brotherhood Bomb. The Jade groups stand still before you aggro them, making them vulnerable to area of effect skills. It should be easy to pull the Demolitionists away from the adjacent groups, since they are not connected to the other mobs. Demolitionists activate their self-destruct skill as soon as an enemy is close, so you can get them to waste their bomb by sending in one token character to trigger it.
3e1be339264a65d7c49ee7c9a22278e289707003.text: 穿过该区域清除翡翠兄弟会的势力。注意翡翠兄弟会爆破手，他们可以使用自杀技能“翡翠兄弟会炸弹”轻松消灭你的队伍。在你攻击翡翠群体之前，他们会保持静止，这使得他们很容易受到范围技能的影响。将爆破专家从相邻的群体中拉开应该很容易，因为他们与其他怪物没有联系。一旦敌人靠近，爆破专家就会激活他们的自毁技能，因此你可以通过发送一个令牌角色来触发它，让他们浪费炸弹。

56e97ace159d48f947f5a1ac931f2803657bc8af.source: As you approach the dock, Miku joins the party; she will respawn if she dies. However, while alive she has a tendency to over-aggro, so try to pull foes toward your group. Due to the minimal spacing between enemy groups in this quest it is necessary to carefully manage your aggro and it is advisable therefore to avoid Miku as long as possible.
56e97ace159d48f947f5a1ac931f2803657bc8af.text: 当你接近码头时，Miku 加入了队伍；如果她死了，她会重生。然而，在活着的时候，她有过度仇恨的倾向，所以试着把敌人拉向你的队伍。由于在这个任务中敌人群体之间的间距很小，因此有必要仔细管理你的仇恨，因此建议尽可能长时间地避开 Miku。

b89d155d0399caf9e6714d66137b0582f9e1c41a.source: There are no resurrection shrines in the area — a party wipe will result in mission failure.
b89d155d0399caf9e6714d66137b0582f9e1c41a.text: 该地区没有复活神殿——小队消灭将导致任务失败。

9a47e2b3c505850a2e53961873ecfa2e58e8e221.source: The Demolitionists are considered bosses. If you kill them before they blow up, you gain a morale boost.
9a47e2b3c505850a2e53961873ecfa2e58e8e221.text: 拆除者被认为是老板。如果你在他们爆炸之前杀死他们，你的士气就会得到提升。

cda9d93d71e23e2b144af4437f449fe0c77fe95d.source: AoE skills, especially Panic, since your opponents are heavily clumped.
cda9d93d71e23e2b144af4437f449fe0c77fe95d.text: AoE 技能，尤其是恐慌技能，因为你的对手非常密集。

014ea957cc03e074d9cde8587733f1489accde21.source: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support will trigger them well away from the party.
014ea957cc03e074d9cde8587733f1489accde21.text: 黑锋先锋刺客支援将在远离队伍的地方触发他们。

87b3aaab92956f8d4785e1fc48642e9c0ecfff2b.source: snares, minions, or spirit walls will also keep them away from the party.
87b3aaab92956f8d4785e1fc48642e9c0ecfff2b.text: 圈套、爪牙或灵魂墙也会让他们远离队伍。

21b47b85be8f6ceaece70ae5a9e650bc70b4a8ff.source: Their bombing skill can be interrupted during its long activation time.
21b47b85be8f6ceaece70ae5a9e650bc70b4a8ff.text: 他们的轰炸技能在较长的激活时间内可能会被打断。

30d8d3960cd73b24f08f5bdea011021899260d66.source: Damage cappers like Shelter can allow your party to survive the explosions.
30d8d3960cd73b24f08f5bdea011021899260d66.text: 像庇护所这样的伤害上限可以让你的队伍在爆炸中幸存下来。

274571a9b8dd21c2307721d12200d2f75ce367e2.source: The quest log notes for Deadly Cargo fail to list the gold or experience rewards.
274571a9b8dd21c2307721d12200d2f75ce367e2.text: 致命货物的任务日志注释未能列出金币或经验奖励。

b0b880b07ce9b8ea73a63652e49aef7b453ab5cf.source: Speak with Headmaster Vhang in the Shing Jea Monastery.
b0b880b07ce9b8ea73a63652e49aef7b453ab5cf.text: 与 Shing Jea 寺的 Vhang 校长交谈。

f613b1d4d203aa0b3829fd1ae382f1b992f737ba.source: Search for signs of suspicious activity.

4d8766a1b6c383848256e2dd8c4ff83d09c8fb8a.source: While this quest is active, neither Darkroot Entrop, Milefaun Mindflayer, nor Foalcrest Darkwish, and their respective groups, spawn.
4d8766a1b6c383848256e2dd8c4ff83d09c8fb8a.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，Darkroot Entrop、Milefaun Mindflayer 和 Foalcrest Darkwish 以及它们各自的群体都不会生成。

728bcb05883f4273dddc3d3541df9b4f7b2365c9.source: Start from Amatz Basin, follow the quest markers through Mourning Veil Falls, and protect the Kurzick Diplomats. They are high level healers, but you will get attacked by enemies that spawn from three different directions, be sure not to leave them unprotected against attacks from behind.
728bcb05883f4273dddc3d3541df9b4f7b2365c9.text: 从阿马兹盆地出发，跟随任务标记穿过哀悼面纱瀑布，并保护库尔兹克外交官。他们是高水平的治疗者，但你会受到从三个不同方向产生的敌人的攻击，请确保不要让他们免受来自后方的攻击。

c99161bd5f1aee30f3aa9a7faaae3e80d76f6cdf.source: Alternatively you can fight at the slope directly across from where the diplomats were standing. The diplomats should be able to keep themselves alive as long as you distract the incoming enemies enough. Keep your healers just in range so that they can still heal the diplomats. This will allow your party to avoid most of the area of effect (AoE) damage, making the fight much easier.
c99161bd5f1aee30f3aa9a7faaae3e80d76f6cdf.text: 或者，您可以在外交官站立的地方正对面的斜坡上战斗。只要你足够分散即将到来的敌人的注意力，外交官就应该能够保住自己的生命。让你的治疗者保持在攻击范围内，这样他们仍然可以治疗外交官。这将使你的队伍避免大部分效果区域（AoE）伤害，使战斗变得更加容易。

ba996361ecd222e150f24ddf4760832c5d098cd9.source: If having difficulty with the waves of foes, use a minion master hero and flag it into the shallow stream to the south of the Diplomats (and slightly east) - they will follow the minions to heal and be out of range of the majority of spawns.
ba996361ecd222e150f24ddf4760832c5d098cd9.text: 如果在应对一波又一波的敌人时遇到困难，请使用小兵大师英雄并将其标记到外交官以南（稍偏东）的浅溪中 - 他们将跟随小兵进行治疗并超出大多数重生的范围。

87c236309f1c338cf956404569672fe75876c7fd.source: Note that the Jade Brotherhood and Ministry of Purity are hostile towards each other; if you can get the Kurzicks out of the way, the enemies will thin themselves.
87c236309f1c338cf956404569672fe75876c7fd.text: 请注意，玉石兄弟会和纯洁部是敌对的；如果你能把库兹克人赶走，敌人就会减少。

68ecae9c1b932ea0ce56a702756e3ff5f30e72f7.source: Blood is Power and/or minions for exploiting the Kurzick Diplomats' AI.
68ecae9c1b932ea0ce56a702756e3ff5f30e72f7.text: 血就是力量和/或利用库尔齐克外交官人工智能的爪牙。

6173cd36ad6e51e6a946281c4255efb7f95328f9.source: AoE damage and control skills, especially Pain of Disenchantment, Ineptitude and/or Panic.
6173cd36ad6e51e6a946281c4255efb7f95328f9.text: AoE 伤害和控制技能，尤其是幻灭之痛、无能和/或恐慌。

b1107a766905d4b20057a16cfeb5d002bf385c46.source: AoE support skills (so that your allies benefit), especially Recuperation, Shelter and/or Union.
b1107a766905d4b20057a16cfeb5d002bf385c46.text: AoE 支持技能（让你的盟友受益），特别是恢复、庇护所和/或联盟。

0c2069d0b768afbc38b497982126b3c2c6dcec01.source: Start from Leviathan Pits, follow the quest markers through Gyala Hatchery, and protect the Luxon Diplomats. They are high level healers, but you will get attacked by enemies that spawn from three different directions, be sure not to leave them unprotected against attacks from behind.
0c2069d0b768afbc38b497982126b3c2c6dcec01.text: 从利维坦坑开始，跟随任务标记穿过加拉孵化场，并保护卢克森外交官。他们是高水平的治疗者，但你会受到从三个不同方向产生的敌人的攻击，请确保不要让他们免受来自后方的攻击。

3b78f658127de1579f9a2edc0f6e3ab22a09ad27.source: The best place to defend is behind the diplomats, just under the bridge that leads up to the ship, and between the two rocks there. There your party is protected from ranged attacks and projectile spells at nearly all sides. This greatly reduces the damage that your party takes. Your healer is also within range to heal the diplomats as needed.
3b78f658127de1579f9a2edc0f6e3ab22a09ad27.text: 最好的防御地点是外交官后面，就在通向船的桥下，以及那里的两块岩石之间。在那里，你的队伍几乎在所有方面都受到保护，免受远程攻击和投射法术的伤害。这大大减少了你的队伍受到的伤害。你的治疗师也在范围内，可以根据需要治疗外交官。

ab68892c19dc579a826df6118f83c381dc52a15f.source: You can use the technique of flagging a minion master hero near the Diplomats to have the NPCs follow away from the initial location (such as to the southwest) to heal minions, meaning that you can fight in one direction rather than three.
ab68892c19dc579a826df6118f83c381dc52a15f.text: 你可以使用在外交官附近标记一名小兵大师英雄的技术，让 NPC 离开初始位置（例如西南方向）来治疗小兵，这意味着你可以朝一个方向而不是三个方向战斗。

af623094c348c0c13c77a4d7003e98561f4bcee1.source: Dunkoro must be in your party.
af623094c348c0c13c77a4d7003e98561f4bcee1.text: Dunkoro 一定在你的队伍中。

d3edbe9334bc1e3d396116e0f9c36a71ff61c1db.source: Bring Dunkoro to meet with Kormir in Nightfallen Jahai.
d3edbe9334bc1e3d396116e0f9c36a71ff61c1db.text: 带邓科罗到堕夜者贾海与科米尔会面。

6164822df9e08bf875a27f56f130c9b5e81797b4.source: Travel through Nightfallen Jahai with Kormir and Dunkoro.
6164822df9e08bf875a27f56f130c9b5e81797b4.text: 与科米尔和邓科洛一起穿越堕夜精灵贾海。

4add5c52459e1e08701a6921f65126f0385bb7d0.text: 与受折磨的烈阳之矛交谈。

511e31376884bd44b2a4c0883aa9447917182d67.text: 前往贾林多克领取奖励。

7780ebee9b656bfc801860895be73335774b8106.source: Walk out north at Gate of Torment into Nightfallen Jahai. Speak with Kormir and follow the way north. Take care to aggro only one group at a time as two groups will probably kill you; the mobs here are significantly more difficult than those in Kourna and Vabbi and you're under the effect of Edge of Reason. Speak with the Tortured Sunspear. After a cinematic you will find yourself in Gate of Pain.
7780ebee9b656bfc801860895be73335774b8106.text: 从折磨之门向北走到堕夜精灵贾海。与科米尔交谈并沿路向北走。注意一次只能攻击一组，因为两组可能会杀死你；这里的小怪比库尔纳和瓦比的小怪要困难得多，而且你受到理性边缘的影响。与受折磨的烈阳之矛交谈。看完电影后，您会发现自己身处痛苦之门。

a0949cf384b83b450ca333a7692c967ab048e3f4.source: Alternatively, this quest can be done easily with a single player equipped to run through enemies. Go out into Nightfallen Jahai with Dunkoro in your party to trigger Kormir's appearance, then talk to her to trigger the next objective to bring the two of them to the Tortured Sunspear. Rather than fighting through numerous groups of enemies, use speed boosts and skills such as Shadow Form to run to Gate of Pain. After the whole party is brought into the outpost, zone back out and talk to the Tortured Sunspear with Dunkoro in your party.
a0949cf384b83b450ca333a7692c967ab048e3f4.text: 或者，这个任务可以通过一个装备有穿过敌人的玩家来轻松完成。与你的队伍中的邓科洛一起前往堕夜精灵贾海，触发科米尔的出现，然后与她交谈以触发下一个目标，将他们两个带到折磨烈阳之矛。不要与众多的敌人战斗，而是使用速度提升和暗影形态等技能跑向痛苦之门。当整个队伍被带入前哨站后，退出区域并与你队伍中的邓科洛一起与受折磨的阳矛交谈。

423ffafc29d71603d20788c4958348156c4c292d.source: Since you are unlikely to return to this area except to capture elite skills, it would be worth the time to open the treasure on the eastern side of Nightfallen Jahai near the Shepherd of Dementia as you pass by.
423ffafc29d71603d20788c4958348156c4c292d.text: 由于除非获得精英技能，否则你不太可能返回该区域，因此值得花时间在路过的失智牧羊人附近的堕夜精灵贾海东侧打开宝藏。

349b2880df757873f31036b6bb43968dd9f635ee.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Uncharted Territory.
349b2880df757873f31036b6bb43968dd9f635ee.text: 所有队员必须已接受《神秘海域》的奖励。

0fb662f936dcb7e0ec3e26c405a0b1e26e8e8565.source: Find a way to release the tortured souls from the River of Souls.
0fb662f936dcb7e0ec3e26c405a0b1e26e8e8565.text: 找到一种方法将受折磨的灵魂从灵魂之河中释放出来。

abef9c3e6f4786922f25c1919abb9f50a21bd170.source: ADDED: Destroy the Emissary of Dhuum.

a6cfe458b62e9370880eed3e66853889e6437545.source: ADDED: Kill Tortureweb Dryders to free the souls they captured from the River of Souls.
a6cfe458b62e9370880eed3e66853889e6437545.text: 添加：杀死折磨网干燥者以释放他们从灵魂之河中捕获的灵魂。

ba578e47732e51c8410e4f1fefb9f77144c4dcd0.source: During this mission you are constantly affected by Dreadful Pain. Keep to the left in the Leech Tunnels until you reach the River of Souls. You will encounter Torment groups and Terrorweb Dryders with Meteor Shower. Note that Terrorwebs are creatures from the Underworld so Lightbringer title skills do not work on them.
ba578e47732e51c8410e4f1fefb9f77144c4dcd0.text: 在此任务期间，你会不断受到可怕疼痛的影响。在水蛭隧道中保持左侧行驶，直到到达灵魂之河。你会遇到折磨团体和带有流星雨的恐怖网烘干机。请注意，恐怖网是来自地狱的生物，因此光明使者称号技能对它们不起作用。

2466c27ed7250fa9491ad6fdf79c5dddcca2d8fd.source: After the tunnels, cross the river using the bridge to the right. Kill the six Tortureweb Dryder bosses on the other side. These creatures are "fishing" the (ten) Lost Souls players must free to complete the mission. The now freed spirits are invulnerable and will run to a safe spot before they are counted for the objectives; you do not need to follow them.
2466c27ed7250fa9491ad6fdf79c5dddcca2d8fd.text: 穿过隧道后，使用右侧的桥梁过河。杀死另一边的六个折磨网烘干机 Boss。这些生物正在“钓鱼”（十个）失落的灵魂，玩家必须自由地完成任务。现在获得自由的灵魂是无敌的，并且会在被计入目标之前跑到安全的地方；您不需要遵循它们。

632f498b3e33a14408df762b9cc7bd34bb9109d3.source: You must kill the elite Emissaries of Dhuum and their three Terrorweb escorts to get credit for the bonus.
632f498b3e33a14408df762b9cc7bd34bb9109d3.text: 你必须杀死德姆的精锐使者和他们的三名恐网护卫才能获得奖励。

6c472caac4ae70b8e90a624a2919c7c5fa2b9900.source: The first one is located before crossing the River of Souls. The group is behind a wall, but can be killed by ranged damage, including projectiles. It can also be accessed by a bridge near the southwestern Tortureweb Drider.
6c472caac4ae70b8e90a624a2919c7c5fa2b9900.text: 第一个位于穿越灵魂之河之前。该小组位于墙后，但可以通过远程伤害（包括射弹）杀死。也可以通过西南 Tortureweb Drider 附近的一座桥到达。

950085a4d77aa5991d61a723ddcdedad9dfc6c61.source: The second one is inside the center Fort. There is no need to kill the other foes. Stand/flag away over the stairs and send one character to pull.
950085a4d77aa5991d61a723ddcdedad9dfc6c61.text: 第二个位于中心堡垒内。没有必要杀死其他敌人。站在楼梯上/挥旗，并派出一名角色来拉。

53b1e7c458403dfe562f8a41a05999fcc871d330.source: The third and last is on the opposite side of the map from the first Emissary. There is no "visible" bridge over the stream of souls but you can still cross it.
53b1e7c458403dfe562f8a41a05999fcc871d330.text: 第三个也是最后一个位于地图上第一个使者的对面。灵魂之流上没有“可见”的桥梁，但你仍然可以跨越它。

8abf4f96a1f6cbee960c0ebae3c6a8f500587089.source: While performing the bonus, leave a Tortureweb alive until you have killed all the "Elite" Emissaries first. Otherwise the 10th spirit approaching the safe spot can trigger the end cinematic before you kill all three Emissaries. Contrary to the quest objective, the Emissary near the first Tortureweb does not have to be killed, although it may be tricky to avoid aggro.
8abf4f96a1f6cbee960c0ebae3c6a8f500587089.text: 在执行奖励时，让酷刑网保持活力，直到您首先杀死所有“精英”使者。否则，第 10 个灵魂接近安全点可能会在您杀死所有三名使者之前触发结束动画。与任务目标相反，第一个折磨网附近的使者不必被杀死，尽管避免仇恨可能很棘手。

e71db410df08acd7636e397ef867d3ac23bd240e.source: Area of effect anti-caster skills to counter Terrorweb Dryders nukes (e.g. Cry of Frustration), as well as interrupts, knock down skills, Mistrust, etc.
e71db410df08acd7636e397ef867d3ac23bd240e.text: 用于对抗恐怖网烘干机核武器的效果区域反施法者技能（例如挫败之声），以及打断、击倒技能、不信任等。

2233b8870952033cc9d197b6574712675987aced.source: Vigorous Spirit to counter Dreadful Pain environmental effect.
2233b8870952033cc9d197b6574712675987aced.text: 旺盛的精神可以对抗可怕的痛苦环境效果。

6608de43b8db2bc6a640b77a9e4c604b904bd9eb.source: Damage reduction skills, such as Protective Spirit or Shelter to avoid the Tortureweb Dryders killing you and your party in a single usage of Liquid Flame.
6608de43b8db2bc6a640b77a9e4c604b904bd9eb.text: 减少伤害的技能，例如“保护精神”或“庇护所”，可以避免酷刑网烘干机在一次使用液体火焰时杀死您和您的队伍。

9a4dfec5202c7536dd71bf7900ffff984108c7d5.source: Dunkoro might show up twice during the ending cinematic.
9a4dfec5202c7536dd71bf7900ffff984108c7d5.text: 邓科罗可能会在结局动画中出现两次。

58e5ef3d64b438afba23a5484d38dcab255daa79.source: Kormir will follow the party leader. She never attacks and rarely uses any skills apart from "Incoming!". Foes cannot target her directly but she gets harmed by area of effect skills.
58e5ef3d64b438afba23a5484d38dcab255daa79.text: 科米尔将追随党领袖。她从不攻击，也很少使用除了“来袭！”之外的任何技能。敌人无法直接瞄准她，但她会受到范围技能的伤害。

e396686a65cc80b74b0b5fa86e5f8b403d29443f.source: The Terrorweb Dryders belong to the Underworld army. Thus, in this mission, it is possible to get inscribable Underworld-related drops.
e396686a65cc80b74b0b5fa86e5f8b403d29443f.text: 恐怖网烘干机隶属于地狱军队。因此，在这个任务中，有可能获得与Underworld相关的铭文掉落物。

8dbf6679d657ecc1c427f80d77cc77f12747a2ad.source: If a Lost Soul appears to be stuck behind an invisible obstacle, run out of their compass range. This allows the Lost Soul to continue its path. Sometimes, even moving out of compass range will not fix the problem and you will have to restart the mission.
8dbf6679d657ecc1c427f80d77cc77f12747a2ad.text: 如果失落的灵魂似乎被困在看不见的障碍物后面，请跑出他们的指南针范围。这使得迷失的灵魂能够继续它的道路。有时，即使移出罗盘范围也无法解决问题，您将不得不重新开始任务。

eeed04c93a60c41e886ac1e480225e6899aa39ff.source: If you are going after the bonus:

a8c1a85107ebc220708191733c66f6af6a86c29e.source: It may be wiser to go around the west of the shrine to kill the last Emissary, since the Tortureweb in the map above is often further east than depicted.
a8c1a85107ebc220708191733c66f6af6a86c29e.text: 绕过神殿的西边杀死最后一个使者可能是更明智的选择，因为上图中的酷刑网通常比描绘的更东。

ca50671a43bd4d62d8dee2cb0cfe5dd86009cb62.source: The Emissaries are tied to the Terrorwebs that accompany them - the bonus goal will not have its text updated until the Emissary and the related Terrorwebs are killed.
ca50671a43bd4d62d8dee2cb0cfe5dd86009cb62.text: 使者与伴随他们的恐怖网联系在一起 - 在使者和相关的恐怖网被杀死之前，奖励目标的文本不会更新。

538b1ebf01d7134d8e564481f62a2802fa1637bf.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to the Gate of Fear.
538b1ebf01d7134d8e564481f62a2802fa1637bf.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到恐惧之门。

40924248ae3d91a9fb4c771d8b72fa6a612880bd.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #15 in the Night Falls storybook.
40924248ae3d91a9fb4c771d8b72fa6a612880bd.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书第 15 页。

ba03fdc9c6bc63b8ca12ef932233908d6607e3a8.source: Find a way to end the fighting.

4334b9b8bd481cf66d41eb0d8f0ab95da5c246f8.source: Speak to Guardsman Qao Lin again, who will transport your party to a Wajjun Bazaar infested with Ministry, Jade Brotherhood and Am Fah.
4334b9b8bd481cf66d41eb0d8f0ab95da5c246f8.text: 再次与卫兵 Qao Lin 交谈，他将把你的队伍运送到充满魔法部、翡翠兄弟会和 Am Fah 的 Wajjun 集市。

765a6ddff37b9ee8d744120ff86a777bf3b4c13e.source: Head straight west towards the docks. You will encounter two groups of hostile Ministry of Purity NPCs that are battling other hostile foes. To make the fight easier, wait until the Ministry of Purity has defeated the other hostiles before engaging them.
765a6ddff37b9ee8d744120ff86a777bf3b4c13e.text: 一直向西前往码头。您将遇到两组敌对的纯洁部 NPC，他们正在与其他敌对敌人作战。为了使战斗更容易，请等到纯洁部击败其他敌人后再与他​​们交战。

f20d50a440272e0fafd653ed8fccfb9f0d4f662d.source: At the docks you will encounter a large neutral mob made up of Am Fah and Jade Brotherhood. After a short discussion, Reisen the Phoenix and Apep, Unending Night will turn hostile. Defeat both, then watch the conversation to finish the quest.
f20d50a440272e0fafd653ed8fccfb9f0d4f662d.text: 在码头，你会遇到由 Am Fah 和 Jade Brotherhood 组成的大型中立暴民。经过短暂的讨论后，凤凰雷森和阿佩普、永夜将转为敌对。击败两者，然后观看对话以完成任务。

8fc4c3f82236dfce2070fbb008a45cb5efc083c4.source: A: It is possible to run to the location of Reisen the Phoenix and Apep, Unending Night, avoiding any fighting yourself. After the dialogue reaches the appropriate stage, the two will fight, and then you can lure the nearby Ministry of Purity group to the bosses to finish off the last one. Spell target protection may be useful.
8fc4c3f82236dfce2070fbb008a45cb5efc083c4.text: A：可以跑到凤凰雷森和阿佩普、永夜的所在地，避免与自己发生战斗。对话到了适当的阶段后，两人就会打斗，然后你可以把附近的纯洁部队伍引诱到boss那里，干掉最后一个。法术目标保护可能有用。

06b6b97733c463724a3695887928b3ad2fc06b10.source: B: The only required kill is Reisen the Phoenix. Stay on the south side of the bridge directly away from the mob only Reisen the Phoenix will turn hostile. Use a hero to lure him onto the bridge without the rest of the mob becoming hostile. Once he goes down, just wait for the dialogue to finish and the quest to update.
06b6b97733c463724a3695887928b3ad2fc06b10.text: B：唯一需要杀死的是凤凰雷森。留在桥的南侧，远离暴民，只有凤凰雷森才会转而敌对。使用英雄将他引诱到桥上，而其他暴徒不会变得敌对。一旦他倒下，只需等待对话完成和任务更新即可。

ace53e5f7553504024d8492378c8eaf56ff3c4fa.source: The quest log fails to mention the experience and gold rewards. However, they are noted in the various dialogues.
ace53e5f7553504024d8492378c8eaf56ff3c4fa.text: 任务日志没有提及经验和金币奖励。然而，它们在各种对话中都被注意到。

0d719612c1a33213529fc18b3eada6bbb6fe32ef.source: Attempting to stray from the path along the shore will cause the message "You are going the wrong way. Travel towards the Jade Brotherhood Stronghold." to appear, followed by being teleported back within the allowed grounds of the area.
0d719612c1a33213529fc18b3eada6bbb6fe32ef.text: 试图偏离海岸小路将会出现“你走错路了，前往翡翠兄弟会据点”的信息。出现，然后被传送回该区域允许的范围内。

778f883845cf2fdfde231b5b61e04647535a6855.source: Meet Kormir in the Domain of Fear.
778f883845cf2fdfde231b5b61e04647535a6855.text: 在恐惧领域与科米尔见面。

05aae02bca0b764cbf2858552ff145e8408f404b.source: Travel to the Gate of Secrets with Kormir.
05aae02bca0b764cbf2858552ff145e8408f404b.text: 与科米尔一起前往秘密之门。

ca4c45d6bf407b2ae5e3692f0b1a928b395c6c42.source: See Keeper Halyssi for your reward.
ca4c45d6bf407b2ae5e3692f0b1a928b395c6c42.text: 向守护者哈利西寻求奖励。

0301c297cb3bbd15d3e5a03f6e67c94c5061c9a3.source: Enter the Domain of Fear from the Gate of Fear and wait for Kormir to finish her speech, then talk to her. You need to escort her to the Gate of Secrets. There are two possible routes: following the quest marker south will lead to the longer, more difficult one. Instead, proceed north (as indicated on the map to the right).
0301c297cb3bbd15d3e5a03f6e67c94c5061c9a3.text: 从恐惧之门进入恐惧领域，等待科米尔说完，然后与她交谈。你需要护送她到秘密之门。有两种可能的路线：沿着任务标记向南走会通向更长、更困难的路线。相反，继续向北行驶（如右侧地图所示）。

4754ecea8559ccc5787f47af20e89ae52d2528e3.source: Dispatch or evade the demon patrols until you reach a narrow passage. Beware of the Torment Claws that popup. Follow the path, dispatching Shiro'ken and Titans along the way. This may be your first encounter with the larger Titans; be aware that they will spawn smaller Titans on death (see Titan spawning patterns).
4754ecea8559ccc5787f47af20e89ae52d2528e3.text: 派遣或躲避恶魔巡逻队，直到到达狭窄的通道。小心弹出的折磨爪。沿着路径走，一路上消灭白肯和泰坦。这可能是您第一次遇到更大的泰坦；请注意，它们在死亡时会生成较小的泰坦（请参阅泰坦生成模式）。

3b85a9fe6ce2fb844a39287e1215dc28b2f59e9c.source: At the end of the yellow area, the path opens up again. Instead of fighting straight through the patrols, you can circle around them to the south to avoid most of the groups.
3b85a9fe6ce2fb844a39287e1215dc28b2f59e9c.text: 在黄色区域的尽头，路径再次打开。你不必直接穿过巡逻队，而是可以绕着他们向南绕行，以避开大部分巡逻队。

c66cc07c2f897607c6055a438ccd8473125b8246.source: Do not enter the Gate of Secrets until Kormir reaches the quest marker. Wait for the quest to update and then you can safely enter the portal.
c66cc07c2f897607c6055a438ccd8473125b8246.text: 在科米尔到达任务标记之前，不要进入秘密之门。等待任务更新即可安全进入传送门。

d03b9de04695bdb58d88c9c04027f96d3dbd5b2e.source: This quest can be completed at the same time as The Apostate or A History of Violence. The Apostate follows the northern path while A History of Violence follows the southern path.
d03b9de04695bdb58d88c9c04027f96d3dbd5b2e.text: 该任务可以与叛教者或暴力史同时完成。 《叛教者》走的是北方的道路，而《暴力史》则走的是南方的道路。

78be7446180666d950b285652fae281c91d4f938.source: The Shiro'ken that spawn during this quest are not affected by Lightbringer skills.
78be7446180666d950b285652fae281c91d4f938.text: 在此任务中生成的白肯不受光明使者技能的影响。

7448be20a4562398c2592b81f01464c775ccef90.source: This quest can relatively easily be run through by any secondary assassin using Deadly Paradox + Shadow Form + Shroud of Distress + any speed buff (cupcakes work well). Wait for Kormir to arrive at the gates and the quest to update before you zone into the outpost, otherwise you will need to repeat the whole run.
7448be20a4562398c2592b81f01464c775ccef90.text: 使用致命悖论+暗影形态+苦恼裹尸布+任何速度增益（纸杯蛋糕效果很好）的任何辅助刺客都可以相对轻松地完成此任务。等待科米尔到达大门并更新任务，然后再进入前哨站，否则您将需要重复整个运行。

0d755947bab579c2ef6be048e403425dc785efd7.source: Meet Kormir in the Domain of Secrets.
0d755947bab579c2ef6be048e403425dc785efd7.text: 在秘密领域与科米尔见面。

8ebe1c7228ae9eb9f811dc953581994cd3c0d3f7.source: Search for the missing scout in the Domain of Secrets with Kormir.
8ebe1c7228ae9eb9f811dc953581994cd3c0d3f7.text: 与科米尔一起在秘密领域寻找失踪的侦察兵。

058850cbca1016887eb78247b1b370a3636457fd.source: Rescue Ahtok from the attacking Margonites.
058850cbca1016887eb78247b1b370a3636457fd.text: 从进攻的玛贡内特手中救出阿托克。

b969f27ad93c8dae16e2f0070d10835c60690e57.source: See Runic Oracle for your reward.
b969f27ad93c8dae16e2f0070d10835c60690e57.text: 请参阅符文神谕以获得奖励。

95d4be6ca1cb6ea96b49258a4d8183b79e77ab04.source: Enter the Domain of Secrets and speak to Kormir. While in this area, your party suffers from Veiled Nightmare (skills cost 40% more Energy to activate). Follow the quest arrow and make your way to Scout Ahtok avoiding over-aggro. Once within radar range, you must rescue him from the attacking Margonites. If he dies, the quest fails. Talking to him will trigger a cinematic. Do not walk into the portal before talking to Ahtok.
95d4be6ca1cb6ea96b49258a4d8183b79e77ab04.text: 进入秘密领域并与科米尔交谈。在此区域中，你的队伍会遭受蒙面噩梦（技能激活需要额外花费 40% 的能量）。按照任务箭头前往侦察兵阿托克，避免过度仇恨。一旦进入雷达范围，你必须将他从攻击的玛贡尼特手中救出来。如果他死了，任务就会失败。与他交谈会触发过场动画。在与阿赫托克交谈之前不要走进传送门。

18379629afc6a016db2c2f725d2e64b48b956825.source: Kormir follows the party leader. Never attacks and rarely uses skills but "Incoming!". Foes cannot target her but she gets harmed by AoE skills.
18379629afc6a016db2c2f725d2e64b48b956825.text: 科米尔跟随党的领袖。从不攻击，很少使用技能，但“来了！”。敌人无法瞄准她，但她会受到 AoE 技能的伤害。

b646fbbaa65b24931bb75f3aec9f8b6efd49655b.source: You may consider doing Escape from the Torment at the same time as this quest since it is in the same area.
b646fbbaa65b24931bb75f3aec9f8b6efd49655b.text: 您可以考虑与此任务同时进行“逃离折磨”，因为它位于同一区域。

35cd8fc355df6544342d8f0a5fc31a61b5162f53.source: If you select to help Scorch Emberspire with A Flickering Flame and its follow-up quest Dismember the Titans, he will accompany you, but not help in any way, nor does he take any damage.
35cd8fc355df6544342d8f0a5fc31a61b5162f53.text: 如果你选择用闪烁的火焰帮助焦土灰塔及其后续任务肢解泰坦，他会陪伴你，但不会以任何方式提供帮助，也不会受到任何伤害。

bec466920891fe83159e965b2621243b8588ceb4.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for All Alone in the Darkness.
bec466920891fe83159e965b2621243b8588ceb4.text: 所有小队成员都必须接受《独自在黑暗中》的奖励。

78c8fc6a94bf1b5af38633bbc5f898d37e5480fb.source: Travel to the Temple of the Six Gods.

8d98b321fbca5f61e1ba8618a23e9a024ac8baf8.source: Close the torment rifts by slaying the portal wraiths. [5...0] of 5 rifts remain open.
8d98b321fbca5f61e1ba8618a23e9a024ac8baf8.text: 杀死传送门幽灵来关闭折磨裂缝。 5 个裂痕中的 [5...0] 个仍然开放。

10af68e92bf222bbaef4a62391813209dc9ba4eb.source: Activate the shrines to the Five Gods to aid you in battle.
10af68e92bf222bbaef4a62391813209dc9ba4eb.text: 激活五神的神殿来帮助你战斗。

6d45facfd9054308817a2ca42166f53616da05d9.source: Destroy the Undead Lich and Shiro Tagachi.
6d45facfd9054308817a2ca42166f53616da05d9.text: 消灭亡灵巫妖和田加白郎。

af142d1067bd08849b53ade15ed0dd665819aab8.source: You have rallied [0...5] of 5 god avatars.
af142d1067bd08849b53ade15ed0dd665819aab8.text: 您已集结了 [0...5] 个 5 个神化身。

377c5dc0962619d8f233479e84642550ec8bdf84.source: The mission can be divided into three parts plus the bonus:
377c5dc0962619d8f233479e84642550ec8bdf84.text: 任务加上奖励可以分为三个部分：

013e2848cdbd7df339b6a635353e0454a90dacbb.source: Defeating Shiro and the Undead Lich.

e8da2a66698a97f2c7d50c3e60b8e82947e05a1a.text: 盖上神社的盖子（作为奖励）。

9867e414411402994d3534ace8424c4035bec353.source: While in this area, your party members suffers from Depths of Madness environment effect (causes -15% healing). Non-party members (summoned creatures, pets, summoning stone NPCs) are not affected.
9867e414411402994d3534ace8424c4035bec353.text: 在此区域中，您的队伍成员会受到疯狂深度环境影响（导致-15% 治疗效果）。非队伍成员（召唤生物、宠物、召唤石 NPC）不受影响。

844d39196b4ed4207184c6939a1ea9d5270588b7.source: Cross the ravine by using either of two routes. The shortest route is a bridge across the chasm occupied by Titans, and the other option is to walk around the chasm along the path occupied by the Margonites (including the boss Champion Puran) and the Torment creatures.
844d39196b4ed4207184c6939a1ea9d5270588b7.text: 使用两条路线之一穿越峡谷。最短的路线是跨越泰坦占据的裂缝的桥梁，另一个选择是沿着玛贡尼特（包括老板冠军普兰）和折磨生物占据的路径绕过裂缝。

7d5a23b89e7a710fdb6543e545e6ffba9a03b217.source: You will then arrive at a gate (point 1 on the map) where Shiro will summon four groups of Shiro'kens. You can avoid two late groups by running through the open gate immediately. Alternatively, retrace your steps to only engage single groups, or simply run back to the base of the hill, watch the Shiro'ken run atop and then sweep through the gate at the bottom of the hill used by the Shiro'ken.
7d5a23b89e7a710fdb6543e545e6ffba9a03b217.text: 然后你将到达一个大门（地图上的点 1），在那里 Shiro 将召唤四组 Shiro'kens。您可以通过立即跑过敞开的大门来避开两个迟到的群体。或者，折回你的脚步，只与单个群体交战，或者干脆跑回山脚，看着 Shiro'ken 跑到山顶，然后扫过 Shiro'ken 使用的山脚下的大门。

19cc52c38da8e14404b30a8e0a4a0e9b26c5776d.source: After the Shiro'ken, the Undead Lich will open five Chaos Rifts, which will spawn a variety of enemies (Prophecies Titans, Margonites and Torment Claws) continuously as long as they remain open. These portals are guarded by three Portal Wraiths each, which must be defeated to close them. The Wraiths themselves are not servants of Abaddon and so the Lightbringer title and skills are ineffective.
19cc52c38da8e14404b30a8e0a4a0e9b26c5776d.text: 在白肯之后，亡灵巫妖会打开五个混沌裂隙，只要它们保持打开状态，就会不断产生各种敌人（预言泰坦、玛贡尼特和折磨利爪）。这些传送门各由三个传送门幽灵守卫，必须击败它们才能关闭它们。幽灵本身并不是阿巴顿的仆人，因此光明使者的头衔和技能是无效的。

122d97698a498271d791cefc61efa40193b114ef.source: Progressively destroy the rifts one by one, pulling roving enemies to the recently closed portals. Foes only respawn if their entire group is killed, so consider leaving one alive before defeating the wraiths of the portal (Titans other than the continually spawning group do not respawn). There is also an Armageddon Lord at the northern rift.
122d97698a498271d791cefc61efa40193b114ef.text: 逐步一一摧毁裂痕，将流动的敌人拉至最近关闭的传送门。敌人只有在整个群体被杀死后才会重生，因此在击败传送门的幽灵之前，请考虑让其中一个活着（除了不断生成的群体之外的泰坦不会重生）。北部裂谷也有一位末日之主。

aa0a66c2e05adb03a6fd7db582ba94d7d99e0822.source: After all portals are closed, the Temple of the Six Gods's gate opens. This instance is often used to take a break. Margonite groups, Shiro and the Undead Lich are awaiting inside the temple.
aa0a66c2e05adb03a6fd7db582ba94d7d99e0822.text: 当所有传送门关闭后，六神殿的大门打开。这个例子经常被用来休息。玛贡尼特小队、白和亡灵巫妖正在神殿内等待。

261fc038fab8a01396e63e38c2468b5dbc42b47a.source: If you are completing the mission with heroes and henchmen, now is the time to read and carry out the bonus objectives.
261fc038fab8a01396e63e38c2468b5dbc42b47a.text: 如果您正在与英雄和追随者一起完成任务，那么现在是时候阅读并执行奖励目标了。

d1604940ded42d6b307b2f52565c70101de43830.source: Defeating Shiro and the Undead Lich

0e1e931d4bddbc86f0cada9cf632bdcffcade1b9.source: Most groups encounter some difficulty defeating one or both of these foes. The most important step is to pull them apart and it is almost always easier to have Shiro chase you. Set up your party just outside of the temple gate; if you have them, you can use spirits and/or minions and/or tanks to block each boss from reaching your backline.
0e1e931d4bddbc86f0cada9cf632bdcffcade1b9.text: 大多数团体在击败其中一个或两个敌人时都会遇到一些困难。最重要的一步是将他们拉开，让白追你几乎总是更容易。在寺庙门外举办聚会；如果你有它们，你可以使用灵魂和/或小兵和/或坦克来阻止每个老板到达你的后线。

510580271291e200ff758da1c4826946b1807739.source: Initially, Shiro is not difficult; he starts by dishing out manageable amounts of damage and seems to lose health quickly enough. However, once he is reduced to 25% of his health, he will use Impossible Odds, which can do large amounts of damage, remove any hexes, and transfer conditions to any opponent he hits. There are several strategies that work well:
510580271291e200ff758da1c4826946b1807739.text: 最初，Shiro 并不难；他首先会造成可控制的伤害，并且似乎很快就会失去生命值。然而，一旦他的生命值减少到 25%，他就会使用不可能的赔率，这可以造成大量伤害，移除任何六角形，并将状况转移给他击中的任何对手。有几种效果很好的策略：

2854efdbce9ee34a548ba273037f1e4ca601b943.source: Use Pain Inverter at this point

4428bdbd5b9f439279e790eb769128105775b6b6.source: Use a tank to draw aggro and keep it protected using wards, protection spells, and/or maintained enchantments. Keep your backline away from him and, as long as you have enough damage, he will not survive long enough to do any significant harm.
4428bdbd5b9f439279e790eb769128105775b6b6.text: 使用坦克吸引仇恨并使用守卫、保护法术和/或维持的结界对其进行保护。让你的后排远离他，只要你有足够的伤害，他就不会存活足够长的时间来造成任何重大伤害。

c49952bcc41da68d8ac01b2f347e66a489791c57.source: As suggested above, use a spirit wall and/or minions to prevent Shiro from reaching most of the party.
c49952bcc41da68d8ac01b2f347e66a489791c57.text: 如上所述，使用精神墙和/或小兵来阻止 Shiro 到达队伍的大部分成员。

73ed42bf8e1b7c673c75c41f0e94937c9cc8a6fd.source: Bring stance-removal skills to cancel Shiro's Battle Scars and bring interrupts to prevent Impossible Odds.
73ed42bf8e1b7c673c75c41f0e94937c9cc8a6fd.text: 带来消除姿态的技能来消除四郎的战斗伤痕，并带来中断来防止不可能的机会。

b8accb76e773711cea27e953585c15a0accd0f71.source: The two biggest threats from the lich are his high damage output and his ability to turn enchantments against the enchanted. You can counter him easily using party-wide heal, healing spirits, and/or non-enchantment protections (such as stances or non-typed skills).
b8accb76e773711cea27e953585c15a0accd0f71.text: 巫妖的两个最大威胁是他的高伤害输出和他将结界转化为结界的能力。你可以使用全队治疗、治疗精神和/或非结界保护（例如姿势或非类型技能）轻松对抗他。

1217b061d427f93511e9ed53ad9983a9be61e318.source: To complete the bonus, you have to rally the five deity shrines in the temple before killing Shiro and the Lich (killing them would end the mission early, eliminating any chances at the bonus). You capture them the same way as you have seen in other missions (e.g. Grand Court of Sebelkeh): as each party member stands near the shrine, the ownership transfers to the party; the rate goes up with each new character present and goes down with each foe. You can capture the shrines in any order.
1217b061d427f93511e9ed53ad9983a9be61e318.text: 要完成奖励，你必须在杀死白和巫妖之前集结神庙中的五个神殿（杀死他们会提前结束任务，消除任何获得奖励的机会）。你捕获它们的方式与你在其他任务中看到的相同（例如Sebelkeh大法院）：当每个党员站在神社附近时，所有权就会转移给党；随着每个新角色的出现，该比率会上升，并随着每个敌人的出现而下降。您可以按任意顺序占领神殿。

053a4a412117437f74f5dcebdffb371961195c89.source: Each shrine is devoted to a particular god and is defended by 2-4 corresponding Margonites (e.g. Mesmers at Lyssa's shrine). For each shrine you have captured, the shrine will grant the party with all the blessings of that god (the generic blessings that can be applied to all professions, and also blessings for your primary profession). If you lose a shrine, you lose the blessings but will still get credit for the bonus; you do not have to retain control to obtain the Master's level reward. For each shrine that is captured the first time, your party gains a 2% Morale Boost.
053a4a412117437f74f5dcebdffb371961195c89.text: 每个神殿都供奉着一位特定的神，并由 2-4 个相应的玛贡尼特（例如莱莎神殿中的催眠师）保卫。对于你占领的每个神殿，神殿都会给予队伍该神的所有祝福（可以应用于所有职业的通用祝福，也可以应用于你的主要职业的祝福）。如果你失去了一座神殿，你就会失去祝福，但仍然会获得奖金；您不必保留控制权即可获得大师级别的奖励。每首次占领一座神殿，你的队伍就会获得 2% 的士气提升。

3ee1b8d2331843fe1fec70ed5deb8d760bdbe148.source: The easiest way to get the bonus is to exploit a hole in the game mechanics, using heroes and henchmen to capture the shrines. You must do this after closing the rifts, but before entering the corridor to the shrine area. The guards of each shrine will not attack your heroes and henchmen unless you have entered compass range of the shrine (i.e. don't go too close to the portals near the temple when capturing them).
3ee1b8d2331843fe1fec70ed5deb8d760bdbe148.text: 获得奖励的最简单方法是利用游戏机制中的漏洞，使用英雄和追随者占领神殿。您必须在关闭裂缝之后、进入神殿区域的走廊之前执行此操作。每个神殿的守卫不会攻击你的英雄和追随者，除非你已经进入神殿的罗盘范围（即捕获他们时不要太靠近神殿附近的门户）。

8724225b3e599f6103da4e47dfa58b64b4e6333b.source: Open the mission map (U), and zoom in towards the shrines, which will be marked on the map. Flag all of your heroes and henchmen to a shrine, and then wait for the color of the icon to change from red to grey to blue. When the icon changes to blue, your party will receive the god bonus, and the objectives will update. Repeat this for the other four shrines on the map (not the Abaddon shrine). To keep them from losing their way, consider flagging your heroes back to the center of the temple after capturing each shrine. If you have trouble with flagging heroes, consider sacrificing yourself with vampiric weapons or skills, and then clicking on a hero/henchman's name to view from their perspective and then move the flag appropriately.
8724225b3e599f6103da4e47dfa58b64b4e6333b.text: 打开任务地图（U），然后放大神社，这些神社将在地图上标记。将所有英雄和追随者标记到神社，然后等待图标的颜色从红色变为灰色再变为蓝色。当图标变为蓝色时，您的队伍将获得上帝奖励，并且目标将更新。对地图上的其他四个神殿（不是亚巴顿神殿）重复此操作。为了防止他们迷路，请考虑在占领每个神殿后将您的英雄标记回寺庙中心。如果您在标记英雄时遇到困难，请考虑使用吸血鬼武器或技能牺牲自己，然后单击英雄/追随者的名字以从他们的角度查看，然后适当地移动旗帜。

889bb65de4baf73edaa7ff69baf01c2a4a767cb9.source: Another exploit is to take advantage of Shiro's AI: he has a preference to pick low health targets (e.g. spirits), so leave them at the back of either shrine and near the column. This structure prevents Shiro from returning to the center of the temple. Since there are a total of five rooms to cap, you have four chances to get him out of the way while you complete the bonus.
889bb65de4baf73edaa7ff69baf01c2a4a767cb9.text: 另一个漏洞是利用 Shiro 的 AI：他更喜欢选择生命值较低的目标（例如烈酒），因此将它们留在任一神殿的后面和柱子附近。这种结构阻止了白返回寺庙的中心。由于总共有五个房间上限，因此在完成奖金时您有四次机会把他赶走。

12ebabedbd14edd8562de19135ce0c319d9fe9b6.source: If you are in a group primarily composed of players (or if you do not wish to use the exploit), take on the bosses one at a time; which you choose is a matter of taste:
12ebabedbd14edd8562de19135ce0c319d9fe9b6.text: 如果你在一个主要由玩家组成的团队中（或者如果你不想使用该漏洞），请一次对抗一个老板；您选择哪个取决于品味：

0e89d3f0672555695598a0170f96d49e37c7df08.source: The Undead Lich deals heavy damage with his wand that can be painful to a moving party. However, he also walks very slowly, and breaks off pursuit more quickly. Running in and out of his aggro radius or using walls/captured shrines to block him can keep him busy without the party enduring his damage output.
0e89d3f0672555695598a0170f96d49e37c7df08.text: 不死巫妖用他的魔杖造成严重伤害，这对于移动的队伍来说可能会很痛苦。不过，他也走得很慢，很快就脱离了追击。跑进跑出他的仇恨半径或使用墙壁/捕获的神殿来阻挡他可以让他忙碌而无需队伍承受他的伤害输出。

8f632be63d2f53920cce52fad27491baa13def30.source: Shiro is easier and safer to pull: he deals relatively minor damage until his health runs low and he is a dogged pursuer with a very large aggro radius.
8f632be63d2f53920cce52fad27491baa13def30.text: Shiro 更容易拉，也更安全：他造成的伤害相对较小，直到他的生命值耗尽，而且他是一个顽强的追击者，仇恨半径非常大。

5ccde02a255c67d8f33e78f3c16fdbf049a80f67.source: Whichever you target first, as you capture each shrine, kill its attending guards (so that they do not pester you during the boss battles and so you maintain the bonus from holding the shrines).
5ccde02a255c67d8f33e78f3c16fdbf049a80f67.text: 无论你首先瞄准哪个，当你占领每个神殿时，杀死它的守卫（这样他们就不会在头目战斗中纠缠你，这样你就可以保持占领神殿的奖励）。

b89fd67f20bf25361989a8dad40d242c472271f8.source: The Lightbringer title helps immensely against nearly all the foes in the mission. Also consider Lightbringer's Gaze and Lightbringer Signet, as appropriate substitutes for other interrupt or energy/adrenaline management skills.
b89fd67f20bf25361989a8dad40d242c472271f8.text: 光明使者称号对对抗任务中几乎所有的敌人都有很大帮助。还可以考虑使用光明使者凝视和光明使者徽记作为其他中断或能量/肾上腺素管理技能的适当替代品。

4227aab8657a93f89c6c6d5be9e8562a18fd428f.source: Punishment hexes are always useful and especially against Shiro, e.g. Pain Inverter, Empathy, Price of Failure, Insidious Parasite, Spiteful Spirit, and Spoil Victor.
4227aab8657a93f89c6c6d5be9e8562a18fd428f.text: 惩罚六角总是有用的，尤其是针对白，例如痛苦转换器、同理心、失败的代价、阴险的寄生虫、恶意的精神和破坏胜利者。

1586508b164a956597c91938ebc2120aed0ab217.source: Interrupts work well against the Undead Lich and are generally useful throughout.
1586508b164a956597c91938ebc2120aed0ab217.text: 打断在对付不死巫妖时效果很好，并且通常在整个过程中都很有用。

790cf3d80599b059122df9676d06084b3165498c.source: Rebirth or Unyielding Aura for recovering from near-wipes.
790cf3d80599b059122df9676d06084b3165498c.text: 重生或不屈光环用于从近乎擦拭中恢复。

0f63a2c2d165687fc0d3167b29359d33bd398cad.text: “我们会回来的！”为了全党的恢复。

5771c6c9a26e5f3efaa6ff182aaf37f80ffcd77e.source: Sunspear Rebirth Signet (or Resurrection Signet for heroes): there are plenty of morale boosts that will recharge these fast-activating skills.
5771c6c9a26e5f3efaa6ff182aaf37f80ffcd77e.text: 阳矛重生徽记（或英雄复活徽记）：有大量的士气提升可以为这些快速激活的技能充电。

cd29e8d35e3447b6b30cc29355bd48aa1a561b7b.source: Enchantment heavy builds are vulnerable to one or more foes from each group and especially to the Undead Lich's Hunger of the Lich
cd29e8d35e3447b6b30cc29355bd48aa1a561b7b.text: 结界重型建筑很容易受到每个群体中一个或多个敌人的攻击，尤其是不死巫妖的巫妖之饥

bbe4c1addee67f7cd82795a02f7c022602fd9c7f.source: Stance removing skills, such as Wild Blow or Wild Throw, to end Battle Scars.
bbe4c1addee67f7cd82795a02f7c022602fd9c7f.text: 消除姿态的技能，例如狂野打击或狂野投掷，可以结束战斗伤痕。

704e27c1c85e28d6513c9251e9a3003cd26d8640.source: Blocking skills, especially Critical Defenses (which can be maintained indefinitely when tanking Shiro).
704e27c1c85e28d6513c9251e9a3003cd26d8640.text: 格挡技能，尤其是暴击防御（坦克Shiro时可以无限期维持）。

02d3d8a7303043300bafbc45a2fcebb352b2f278.source: Conditions can be dangerous against Shiro, since he can spread them using Impossible Odds.
02d3d8a7303043300bafbc45a2fcebb352b2f278.text: 条件对白来说可能是危险的，因为他可以使用不可能的赔率来传播它们。

9eaaeefcfb4f09ad18310ef4d34a6c157acca2bd.source: Blind is great when bringing spellcaster-heavy parties, e.g. from Blinding Flash, Eruption, Ebon Dust Aura, Shadowsong, or Sneak Attack.
9eaaeefcfb4f09ad18310ef4d34a6c157acca2bd.text: 当带来大量施法者的聚会时，盲人非常有用，例如来自致盲闪光、爆发、黑檀之尘光环、影歌或偷袭。

77559ee81040994dba6e9d509da7978ab28444bb.source: Deep Wound can be very useful if managed carefully.
77559ee81040994dba6e9d509da7978ab28444bb.text: 如果小心处理，深度伤口会非常有用。

ec5c7a6cd851ced97375ed79be206c4f756b103b.source: Shadowsong plus Displacement can render Shiro harmless; he will either miss (due to blindness) or get blocked (preventing him from removing blindness).
ec5c7a6cd851ced97375ed79be206c4f756b103b.text: 影歌加上位移可以使白无害；他要么错过（由于失明），要么被阻挡（阻止他消除失明）。

c19a8896b8b33364fd1e6b211b8e639536f1eb43.source: Shiro cannot be knocked down, unless the knock down lasts at least three seconds.
c19a8896b8b33364fd1e6b211b8e639536f1eb43.text: 白无法被击倒，除非击倒持续至少三秒。

4ea7d21f332c4063e44cd9d7b75c2df4a70cada1.source: Shield of Judgment will activate continually.

21f6903fcff8323896c3b86a4d9cd1de197dbc5d.source: Earthbind can cause him to be vulnerable to knock down.
21f6903fcff8323896c3b86a4d9cd1de197dbc5d.text: 地缚会让他很容易被击倒。

c6bb90cbc27f7817d274fbadb35c65f38c5876f4.source: Kormir follows the party leader during this mission. She doesn't use any skills unless damaged, and never attacks. However, she can only be harmed by area of effect skills because foes can't directly target her.
c6bb90cbc27f7817d274fbadb35c65f38c5876f4.text: 科米尔在执行任务期间跟随党的领导人。除非受到伤害，否则她不会使用任何技能，并且从不攻击。然而，她只能受到范围技能的伤害，因为敌人无法直接瞄准她。

7ac062b82237bea229fbbe4af5221598ece8afbb.source: Torment creatures will popup in some points.
7ac062b82237bea229fbbe4af5221598ece8afbb.text: 折磨生物会在某些地方出现。

2e1e03518b29ac1dbd66d0ebda363bf35eaf1126.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Abaddon's Gate.
2e1e03518b29ac1dbd66d0ebda363bf35eaf1126.text: 完成此任务后，你的队伍将被带到阿巴顿之门。

7646f93e72e24184926018231c987b024134bd79.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #16 in the Night Falls storybook.
7646f93e72e24184926018231c987b024134bd79.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书第 16 页。

74637b0fb7c745e0379f2a8594652eaaf7b67df5.source: The respawn mechanic of the Titan Abominations from the portals seems to be tied to their aggro. Once they are aggroed, it takes roughly 15 seconds for the next two to spawn at the portal.
74637b0fb7c745e0379f2a8594652eaaf7b67df5.text: 泰坦憎恶从传送门重生的机制似乎与它们的仇恨有关。一旦它们被攻击，大约需要 15 秒的时间，接下来的两只才会在传送门处生成。

e977a8d2e2fd3dabdfebaa9b28338f437582932d.source: When fighting Shiro Tagachi and the Undead Lich don't back too far away from the temple or your whole party will die. Undead Lich occasionally stays an ally. Lyssa's Muse in the end cinematic says "You must make a choice a mortal can make" While the text reads "Only a mortal can make". Sometimes, despite having killed the Lich, Shiro and all Margonites in the shrine area, the mission will not end. This forces you to redo the entire mission, despite having completed all requirements. This can happen when sending heroes/henchmen ahead to capture the shrines and aggroing Shiro or the Lich before the dialogue begins. Breaking aggro and waiting for the dialogue may be enough to avoid this. The way to avoid this is to recall all of your heroes/henchmen back to you, outside of the Temple, then run in as a group. Running into the Temple while your heroes/henchmen are already inside will result in the dialogue not triggering, which may result in the bug. Sometimes, the gates will not open, you will have to restart the mission if this happens.
e977a8d2e2fd3dabdfebaa9b28338f437582932d.text: 当与白田田和不死巫妖战斗时，不要离开神庙太远，否则你的整个队伍都会死。不死巫妖偶尔会成为盟友。莱莎的缪斯在最后的电影中说“你必须做出凡人可以做出的选择”，而文字则写着“只有凡人可以做出”。有时，尽管杀死了神殿区域内的巫妖、白和所有玛贡教徒，任务也不会结束。尽管已完成所有要求，这仍会迫使您重做整个任务。当在对话开始之前派遣英雄/追随者去占领神殿并骚扰白或巫妖时，可能会发生这种情况。打破仇恨并等待对话可能足以避免这种情况。避免这种情况的方法是将你所有的英雄/追随者召回到你身边，在圣殿外面，然后作为一个团队跑进去。当你的英雄/追随者已经在里面时跑进圣殿将导致对话无法触发，这可能会导致错误。有时，大门不会打开，如果发生这种情况，您将不得不重新启动任务。

b774707659f8063bc8d020218d37fde60b44ecdf.source: Destroy the graven monoliths to power the chains of Abaddon.
b774707659f8063bc8d020218d37fde60b44ecdf.text: 摧毁雕刻的巨石，为阿巴顿的锁链提供动力。

9932b4f921da26db78267dc2c1947fcbf62478d5.source: Attack Abaddon while he is vulnerable.
9932b4f921da26db78267dc2c1947fcbf62478d5.text: 趁阿巴顿脆弱时攻击他。

ff1ed8342430404faa55312a85f830069b5a7ab0.source: Run along the passage until you get to the end, there is only one way you can go. You'll come to a bridge which looks down on the spot where Abaddon is imprisoned. There are three paths down to Abaddon from here, two to the binding points for each of his hands which are situated to the left and right and one which leads to where his head is bound in the middle. Two Graven Monoliths guard each of the binding points, a maximum of six are on the map at any one time.
ff1ed8342430404faa55312a85f830069b5a7ab0.text: 沿着通道一直跑到尽头，只有一条路可以走。你会来到一座桥前，俯瞰着阿巴顿被囚禁的地方。从这里到阿巴顿有三条路，两条路通往他左右两侧的双手绑扎点，一条通向他的头被绑在中间的地方。每个绑定点都有两个坟墓巨石守卫，地图上同时最多有六个。

9a22b6ac42de95c838e546e7ae62f6a5be970753.source: Abaddon will break free as you approach and you must kill the Monoliths to rebind him and get the opportunity to attack him. It is best to attack the Monoliths at the hands first, as killing those at the head first, without first rebinding the hands means the Monoliths will respawn at the head, wasting your effort.
9a22b6ac42de95c838e546e7ae62f6a5be970753.text: 当你接近时，阿巴顿会挣脱束缚，你必须杀死巨石才能重新束缚他并获得攻击他的机会。最好先攻击手部的巨石，因为先杀死头部的巨石，如果不先重新束缚手，巨石就会在头部重生，浪费你的努力。

07dd54225431ad578a324652af6c7475b0ef7ca5.source: When the Monoliths at each of the binding points are destroyed Abaddon's head will be lowered and you will have a short while to lay down as much damage on him as possible before he breaks free and you have to start over again at rebinding the hands to get another opportunity to attack. It will take several cycles of binding, damaging and breaking-free before Abaddon is killed. Get into a rhythm, agree before-hand which side you will go to first each time so your party can kill off the Monoliths with least effort. Each time you rebind part of Abaddon by defeating a pair of Monoliths you will receive a morale boost. Every time Abaddon is fully bound, he loses 1000 health.
07dd54225431ad578a324652af6c7475b0ef7ca5.text: 当每个束缚点的巨石被摧毁时，阿巴顿的头将会低下，在他挣脱之前你将有一段时间对他造成尽可能多的伤害，你必须重新开始重新束缚双手以获得另一次攻击的机会。在阿巴顿被杀死之前，需要经过几个循环的束缚、破坏和挣脱。进入节奏，事先商定每次先去哪一边，这样你的队伍就可以毫不费力地杀死巨石。每次你通过击败一对巨石来重新绑定阿巴顿的一部分时，你都会获得士气提升。每次阿巴顿完全束缚时，他都会失去 1000 点生命值。

6d45c07c41fc33ef5d4cc9b5216f80790e092f9a.source: Abaddon isn't entirely defenseless while you complete this ritual, he has a number of attacks which can be rather frustrating and damaging for a party. Of particular note is Words of Madness which causes the party to be knocked down, dazed and to take damage; key to coping with this is timing your skill use to avoid getting interrupted. Of particular note is when Abaddon is in his prone state, invariably this skill is used about 5 seconds after he is bound just when you're launching into your best spell. The party has to be prepared to remove daze or to operate with it on. Party healing is a good counter to the area of effect damage which Abaddon deals.
6d45c07c41fc33ef5d4cc9b5216f80790e092f9a.text: 当你完成这个仪式时，阿巴顿并不是完全没有防御能力，他有很多攻击，这对队伍来说可能是相当令人沮丧和破坏的。特别值得注意的是疯狂之言，它会导致队伍被击倒、眩晕并受到伤害；解决这个问题的关键是计时你的技能使用以避免被打断。特别值得注意的是，当阿巴顿处于俯卧状态时，这个技能总是在他被束缚后大约 5 秒内使用，此时你正要发动最好的法术。当事人必须准备好消除茫然或带着它进行操作。队伍治疗可以很好地对抗亚巴顿造成的范围伤害。

420ba9ef03c704ef19f0bac51316f76520f2fb82.source: Finally, Torment Claws appear from time to time during the battle. They have a nasty area of effect attack which can devastate your party if they're not noticed and taken care of. Keep a wary eye out for them to interrupt their attack skill and kill them.
420ba9ef03c704ef19f0bac51316f76520f2fb82.text: 最后，在战斗中，折磨之爪会不时出现。他们有令人讨厌的范围攻击，如果不注意和照顾他们，可能会摧毁你的队伍。小心他们打断他们的攻击技能并杀死他们。

df02aaa52c238b8d4c11679874af115a33e99ff1.source: Bring Lightbringer's Gaze for the Torment Claws. Alternatively, any skill interrupt will do.
df02aaa52c238b8d4c11679874af115a33e99ff1.text: 将光明使者的凝视带给折磨之爪。或者，任何技能中断都可以。

b312d774074a431d1f7d8ea5ed08c8aa4a7cf499.source: The real premium is not in dealing inordinate damage, but in staying alive. An additional healer instead of a damage dealer can make the difference. The healers should concentrate on party-wide condition removal and heals, such as:
b312d774074a431d1f7d8ea5ed08c8aa4a7cf499.text: 真正的优势不在于造成过度伤害，而在于保持活力。额外的治疗者而不是伤害制造者可以发挥作用。治疗师应该专注于全队范围内的状况消除和治疗，例如：

45137b2d822a39436abe70c670638029f9fde478.source: Light of Deliverance, Heal Party, Recuperation, Protective Was Kaolai
45137b2d822a39436abe70c670638029f9fde478.text: 拯救之光、治愈派对、恢复、保护是考莱

4923bf25f37321bab9632c57d3c28861c11a0d85.source: Martyr, Extinguish, Cautery Signet, Recovery, Pure Was Li Ming
4923bf25f37321bab9632c57d3c28861c11a0d85.text: 烈士、熄灭、烧灼印章、恢复、纯粹是李明

26fb60c2a9b19f0f18b2e603826c28a36fd3cf01.source: Healer's Boon is very effective in countering Words of Madness as it also halves casting time allowing the dazed effect to be minimal.
26fb60c2a9b19f0f18b2e603826c28a36fd3cf01.text: 治疗者的恩赐对于对抗疯狂之言非常有效，因为它还可以将施法时间减半，从而将眩晕效果降至最低。

07e0156c5493dd85f45532109eafca6e99f349ee.source: Heal Area is a cheap and very effective spell in this mission, as even a secondary monk with a rank of 3 Healing Prayers will counter a lot of the AoE damage (60 health per adjacent creature).
07e0156c5493dd85f45532109eafca6e99f349ee.text: 在此任务中，治疗区域是一个廉价且非常有效的法术，因为即使是具有 3 级治疗祈祷的二级僧侣也能抵消大量 AoE 伤害（每个相邻生物 60 点生命值）。

c91a292b10de9923e10884dd47091d61c4f38d87.source: Secondary monks can be very effective using Extinguish, Purge Conditions, Martyr, or Empathic Removal.
c91a292b10de9923e10884dd47091d61c4f38d87.text: 二级僧侣使用熄灭、净化条件、烈士或移情移除可以非常有效。

80c509388df312ca0286ffa217a185b4029ae4ff.source: Resurrection Signet or Sunspear Rebirth Signet are preferable to hard resurrection skills, as you will be receiving many morale boosts throughout the mission. Or even better, a hero with Unyielding Aura, to resurrect instantly with full health and energy. Avoid resurrection spells as they will be affected by dazed caused by Words of Madness.
80c509388df312ca0286ffa217a185b4029ae4ff.text: 复活徽记或阳矛重生徽记比硬复活技能更可取，因为您将在整个任务中获得许多士气提升。或者更好的是，一个拥有不屈光环的英雄，可以立即复活并充满生命值和能量。避免使用复活法术，因为它们会受到疯狂之语造成的眩晕的影响。

1726c84c0496abb9fe682c040b798d4f84de4bdd.source: Consider skills that prevent knock downs (such as Ward of Stability and/or "Don't Trip!") from Earth Shattering Blow and Words of Madness.
1726c84c0496abb9fe682c040b798d4f84de4bdd.text: 考虑防止被“碎地一击”和“疯狂之言”击倒的技能（例如稳定结界和/或“不要绊倒！”）。

a3d7b7c105467fe44a8ad4b3ff67b13a7fc091b4.source: Bring plenty of direct damage and armor-ignoring damage.
a3d7b7c105467fe44a8ad4b3ff67b13a7fc091b4.text: 带来大量直接伤害和无视护甲伤害。

ce4342a11b41edb6453b8baf9d8b24ff0d29fd15.source: Consider spells with short activation times to avoid getting interrupted.
ce4342a11b41edb6453b8baf9d8b24ff0d29fd15.text: 考虑使用较短激活时间的法术以避免被打断。

762594cedd604e7b2c2414b26c14f58ecf842cf1.source: A Paragon with "Fall Back!" or a Warrior with "Charge!" helps a lot when Abaddon breaks free and your party needs to move away from him before being attacked by the recently spawned Monoliths.
762594cedd604e7b2c2414b26c14f58ecf842cf1.text: 具有“后退！”的典范或战士发出“冲锋！”当阿巴顿挣脱束缚并且你的队伍需要在受到最近生成的巨石攻击之前远离他时，这会很有帮助。

de44009d532ac80c168f4d9d35d8bb34ba202672.source: Hexbreaker Aria works when the Monoliths are in their Mesmer form where they cast Conjure Phantasm on each party member and Song of Purification helps when cripple and dazed occurs. Having two Paragons, one casting Hexbreaker Aria and the other casting Song of Purification with different skill bars is recommended instead of having one Paragon with both of these skills.
de44009d532ac80c168f4d9d35d8bb34ba202672.text: 当巨石处于催眠师形态时，破咒者咏叹调就会发挥作用，他们会对每个队伍成员施展召唤幻象，净化之歌会在瘫痪和眩晕发生时提供帮助。建议拥有两名Paragon，一名施放破咒者咏叹调，另一名施放具有不同技能栏的净化之歌，而不是让一名Paragon同时具备这两种技能。

344783f1fb3cbf86ec87719f95f63b1aee475388.source: Wastrel's Worry is quite effective against Abaddon.
344783f1fb3cbf86ec87719f95f63b1aee475388.text: 荒野之忧对阿巴顿非常有效。

1ce443d207a1dd01244461934c72cc639b097a8d.source: Area damage over time skills (see Nuker), such as Chaos Storm and Fire Storm, work very well against Abaddon.
1ce443d207a1dd01244461934c72cc639b097a8d.text: 随着时间的推移造成区域伤害的技能（参见核弹），例如混沌风暴和火焰风暴，在对抗阿巴顿时非常有效。

ddcb67f14763e94ad83b15e5e6166466932a7064.source: Powerful skills with long recharge times work well here, because frequent morale boosts recharge them instantly.
ddcb67f14763e94ad83b15e5e6166466932a7064.text: 具有较长恢复时间的强大技能在这里效果很好，因为频繁的士气提升可以立即为它们充电。

fd3f408d9d2c3cc3ab9a1456f6db88aa559d0650.source: Upon completion of this mission, the players will end up in the Throne of Secrets.
fd3f408d9d2c3cc3ab9a1456f6db88aa559d0650.text: 完成此任务后，玩家将进入秘密王座。

d6e4c9b0eaec69de70f623422f734568a901fe3d.source: If this is the first time your character has completed this mission, remember to talk to Keeper of Secrets in Throne of Secrets. There will not be any quest or reward indicator over his head. Keeper of Secrets will give you the Book of Secrets. You can then go to one of the nearby keepers and trade the book for a unique item. You can only receive this book once per character. If for some reason you forget to talk to Keeper of Secrets and leave the Throne of Secrets, you can perform the mission again and talk to Keeper of Secrets to receive the book. Note completing the mission in hard mode does not give the Book of Secrets again.
d6e4c9b0eaec69de70f623422f734568a901fe3d.text: 如果这是你的角色第一次完成此任务，请记得与《秘密王座》中的秘密守护者交谈。他的头顶上不会有任何任务或奖励指示器。秘密守护者会给你秘密之书。然后，您可以去找附近的一位管理员，用这本书换取一件独特的物品。每个角色只能收到这本书一次。如果由于某种原因忘记与秘密守护者交谈并离开秘密王座，你可以再次执行任务并与秘密守护者交谈以领取书籍。请注意，在困难模式下完成任务不会再次获得秘密之书。

971cecd4c9e425aff975e3b15f66b0b7e847af40.source: She sometimes body blocks her own allies.
971cecd4c9e425aff975e3b15f66b0b7e847af40.text: 她有时会用身体阻挡自己的盟友。

14ad330257b27dae3e22af93b94a3d01847eb2e9.source: The Torment Claws and Graven Monoliths in this mission do not drop loot.
14ad330257b27dae3e22af93b94a3d01847eb2e9.text: 此任务中的折磨之爪和坟墓巨石不会掉落战利品。

1fda7c662f8ac99d0d4e763e14fb388f7418e54c.source: After completing this mission, all players in the party are taken to the Throne of Secrets and subsequently may enter Kamadan, Jewel of Istan with a party larger than 4.
1fda7c662f8ac99d0d4e763e14fb388f7418e54c.text: 完成此任务后，队伍中的所有玩家都会被带到秘密王座，随后可以带着超过 4 人的队伍进入卡马丹，伊斯坦的宝石。

d1e5d65bb35ee533dc7b9bae7866d6ee0b14e82b.source: After completing this mission, Nightfallen Garden is reverted back to Garden of Seborhin unless Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger is active.
d1e5d65bb35ee533dc7b9bae7866d6ee0b14e82b.text: 完成此任务后，堕夜花园将恢复为塞伯林花园，除非“心与意：危险花园”处于活动状态。

466c824c631063cdb162ee9abe8a4db712d1505a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #17 in the Night Falls storybook.
466c824c631063cdb162ee9abe8a4db712d1505a.text: 完成此任务将填写《夜幕降临》故事书第 17 页。

4ca3534dd916993f38d342fdf8d55f7c92099039.source: Speak with Headmaster Lee in the Shing Jea Monastery.
4ca3534dd916993f38d342fdf8d55f7c92099039.text: 与成杰寺的李校长交谈。

a0235e331b2424abc0ccc63834037654d9bd17b6.source: Go to Shing Jea Monastery and find Headmaster Lee in the courtyard with all the other headmasters. Talk to her to complete this quest.
a0235e331b2424abc0ccc63834037654d9bd17b6.text: 前往Shing Jea寺并在院子里找到李校长和所有其他校长。与她交谈以完成此任务。

758313d7effca69d648b38c389117b8bc160003d.text: 帮助 Miku 找到 Ashu。

038c06b20dba407171e138fb82ffde173d6680d3.source: Leave from Tahnnakai Temple and head directly south to meet up with Miku. Once the mission has begun, follow the map route to eventually bring Miku to Ashu's location at the temple's center. Ministry of Purity groups spawn in each room that must be killed before moving onto the next. Furthermore, clearing the first group and every consecutive group within the temple will spawn more foes periodically at the temple's entrance, which will then chase after you. Note: These foes will not stay dead if you choose to fight them; they rez after being knocked out for a minute. Since it is not advised to fight the spawning foes, try to trigger every Hidden Switch in each room in order to close the gate to the previous room behind you. The important thing is to move quickly (kill group, trigger Hidden Switch, move on) because the gates do not stay closed forever, and eventually the Ministry forces will build up and easily outnumber you towards the end. Once Miku is brought to Ashu their dialogue will begin, and at that point the quest is completed (even if the Ministry rushes and wipes your party).
038c06b20dba407171e138fb82ffde173d6680d3.text: 从塔纳凯神庙出发，直接向南前往与 Miku 会合。任务开始后，按照地图路线最终将 Miku 带到寺庙中心的 Ashu 位置。纯洁部小组在每个房间中生成，必须在进入下一个房间之前将其杀死。此外，清除寺庙内的第一组和每个连续组会定期在寺庙入口处产生更多敌人，然后它们会追赶你。注意：如果你选择与这些敌人战斗，他们就不会死。他们在被击倒一分钟后重新站起来。由于不建议与生成的敌人战斗，请尝试触发每个房间中的每个隐藏开关，以关闭您身后的前一个房间的大门。重要的是要快速移动（杀掉队伍，触发隐藏开关，继续前进），因为大门不会永远关闭，最终魔法部的军队会集结起来，并在最后的时候轻松超过你。一旦 Miku 被带到阿舒，他们的对话就会开始，此时任务就完成了（即使魔法部冲过去并消灭了你的队伍）。

05c5202e37209e1eacbcaf5f12b3594fafc94b97.source: It is possible to shadow step to each Hidden Switch as they technically count as allies.
05c5202e37209e1eacbcaf5f12b3594fafc94b97.text: 可以对每个隐藏开关进行影子步，因为它们在技术上算作盟友。

f0d7efb3ba33ac8d26794ba547af1216fb47a1b6.source: Miku must reach Ashu in order to trigger the final dialogue. If Miku dies along the way, she risks resurrecting behind a closed gate and staying there forever. Unless you can quickly trace her back before the pursuing ministry forces reach her, or are able to overwhelm you instead, you must restart the quest.
f0d7efb3ba33ac8d26794ba547af1216fb47a1b6.text: Miku 必须到达 Ashu 才能触发最终对话。如果 Miku 在途中死亡，她就有可能在关闭的大门后复活并永远留在那里。除非你能在追击的魔法部部队到达她之前快速追踪到她，或者能够压倒你，否则你必须重新开始任务。

877a51412dc7faf1f154ce650d95837276cc66bb.source: Warn Soar Honorclaw of the Ministry of Purity's deceit.
877a51412dc7faf1f154ce650d95837276cc66bb.text: 警告索尔·荣爪注意纯洁部的欺骗行为。

b4384c352e23ac3f6cb0b97f068dbe3a676a0b36.source: Defeat the Ministry of Purity forces.

999fc0994e0da4539a7211f7fd22d94002ac3922.source: See Soar Honorclaw for your reward.
999fc0994e0da4539a7211f7fd22d94002ac3922.text: 请参阅翱翔荣誉爪以获得奖励。

b4ce4838d671740801596c4dc1e388c4ccbb6140.source: Start from Ran Musu Gardens and head southwest to the Tengu camp. The initial group of Ministry troops will be reinforced by two groups, one from the west and another from the south. Since your party is small:
b4ce4838d671740801596c4dc1e388c4ccbb6140.text: 从乱木须庭园出发，向西南方向前往天狗营地。第一批部队将得到两支部队的增援，一支来自西部，另一支来自南部。由于您的聚会规模较小：

c596fdefb8b672b0b9eefed21288ccac2c79bf9e.source: The Tengu can be used to grab initial aggro, if desired.
c596fdefb8b672b0b9eefed21288ccac2c79bf9e.text: 如果需要的话，天狗可以用来获取初始仇恨。

b83d0285de25846fb82f51c701256a1832ba6744.source: Consider bringing a Minion Bomber hero for extra meat shields (Ministry of Purity healers will keep them alive during dialogue).
b83d0285de25846fb82f51c701256a1832ba6744.text: 考虑带一个小兵轰炸机英雄来获得额外的肉盾（纯洁部治疗师将在对话期间让他们保持活力）。

fa620cd15a58d05c878f90f4c87d96d2da9e8bd4.source: A Spirit wall is also recommended to help body block foes.
fa620cd15a58d05c878f90f4c87d96d2da9e8bd4.text: 还建议使用精神墙来帮助身体阻挡敌人。

040d7e7d3ac2b0a9ff33d617000d6e290dafbf8f.source: The Ministry foes stand around in a large group while the dialogue takes place; consider abusing this by bringing a trapper to cover the ground under them with traps that will all trigger at once when they turn hostile, effectively wiping them out, or at least thinning their numbers.
040d7e7d3ac2b0a9ff33d617000d6e290dafbf8f.text:
对话期间，魔法部的敌人们围成一大群站着；考虑滥用这一点，让一个捕兽者用陷阱覆盖他们下面的地面，当他们变得敌对时，这些陷阱会立即触发，有效地消灭他们，或者至少减少他们的数量。

MAPPINGOUT_675231becdcecfb_0
当您接受此任务时，部长法令将添加到您的库存中。

401b478f816b8234c98d098721f4431fe0dbc4cf.source: Talk to Ryun Grayfeather to travel to Tsumei Village.
401b478f816b8234c98d098721f4431fe0dbc4cf.text: 与雷恩·灰羽交谈，前往津名村。

dc9fac681261a568bac290773e5a608790d9f6a3.source: Defend Tsumei Village from the attacking Sensali Tengu.
dc9fac681261a568bac290773e5a608790d9f6a3.text: 保卫津名村，抵御森萨利天狗的攻击。

72ae65fbbc504b4529a1dca88f511fe3b17c3a40.source: Defeat the Ministry of Purity's Forces.

3714dc1873bc1282850c7749ebd845f90d41d285.source: Ryun Grayfeather waits for you in Jaya Bluffs just outside Seitung Harbor. Talk to him to be sent into an explorable area version of Tsumei Village, which you must defend from attacking forces.
3714dc1873bc1282850c7749ebd845f90d41d285.text: 瑞恩·灰羽 (Ryun Grayfeather) 在塞通港 (Seitung Harbour) 外的贾亚悬崖 (Jaya Bluffs) 等您。与他交谈，将被送往可探索的津名村版本，你必须保卫该村免受攻击。

85f396e6d960783039f71de75bee9c4f762e1891.source: The Sensali attack first; midway into the battle, Ryun Grayfeather will arrive to reinforce your position with the Angchu Tengu. After you defeat the Sensali, the Ministry of Purity's forces will arrive, entering the village. After a brief dialogue, the Ministry forces become hostile. Defeat these enemies to complete the quest.
85f396e6d960783039f71de75bee9c4f762e1891.text: 森萨利首先发起攻击；战斗进行到一半时，雷恩·灰羽将会到来，用安楚天狗来加固你的阵地。当你击败森萨里人后，纯洁部的军队将会到达，进入村庄。短暂对话后，魔法部部队变得敌对。击败这些敌人即可完成任务。

67c690e4868e6224da12702b2c8b04c72c1685c0.source: All attacks come from the east; if you are farther than earshot range outside the gate, you will be teleported back to the village. The gate is a natural choke point: use this to ball up the Sensali so you can maximize your area of effect skills. Alternatively you can fight at the high ground in the center of town.
67c690e4868e6224da12702b2c8b04c72c1685c0.text: 所有的攻击都来自东方；如果您距离门外听力范围较远，您将被传送回村庄。大门是一个天然的阻塞点：用它来聚集 Sensali，这样你就可以最大化你的技能效果范围。或者，您也可以在市中心的高地进行战斗。

925045845da4d8e53729b064dafa703e97157175.source: Bring corpse exploitation skills to counter the enemy's use of Aura of the Lich.
925045845da4d8e53729b064dafa703e97157175.text: 带上尸体剥削技能来对抗敌人使用巫妖光环。

36a2c4ad3ee0bc19a4f2759ff78c5548f8ef8e85.source: Alternatively, bring your own minion master, Verata's Aura, or other minion counters.
36a2c4ad3ee0bc19a4f2759ff78c5548f8ef8e85.text: 或者，带上你自己的随从大师、维拉塔的光环或其他随从指示物。

654737b3ed4b06f04fbae2ae7d9aa9893e2a5aba.source: If you flag heroes near the first Ministry group, while they are non-hostile, they will attempt to heal any minions. Shortly after combat begins, the minions will expire and explode (if you bring Death Nova and other minion bomber skills).
654737b3ed4b06f04fbae2ae7d9aa9893e2a5aba.text: 如果你在第一个魔法部组附近标记英雄，当他们没有敌意时，他们会尝试治疗任何小兵。战斗开始后不久，小兵就会过期并爆炸（如果你带了死亡新星和其他小兵轰炸机技能）。

e37d6fb546e4b87038d5afd52784004ff2c84f68.source: Trappers are very effective since you can funnel all incoming enemies through the village gate. They have plenty of time to set traps for the final battle, since the next-to-last dialogue is long-winded.
e37d6fb546e4b87038d5afd52784004ff2c84f68.text: 陷阱非常有效，因为你可以通过村门将所有进来的敌人集中起来。他们有足够的时间为最后的战斗设置陷阱，因为倒数第二个对话很冗长。

61d89333dc30b0427928bb3f52a2eeed49b6592f.source: If players stray too far outside the portals in the village, players are teleported back inside the village walls and the message "You must not abandon the village!" displays.
61d89333dc30b0427928bb3f52a2eeed49b6592f.text: 如果玩家在村庄的传送门外走得太远，玩家会被传送回村庄墙内，并显示“你不能放弃村庄！”的信息。显示。

68a6f792beda264cbb7d278d3cf977293b737d03.source: Speak with Headmaster Quin in the Shing Jea Monastery
68a6f792beda264cbb7d278d3cf977293b737d03.text: 与 Shing Jea 寺的 Quin 校长交谈

7ce1ffb81799eb2805a08f2915a918316c99ea4f.source: Defeat the attacking Ministry of Purity forces. Jinnai has placed traps in the area that will aid you.
7ce1ffb81799eb2805a08f2915a918316c99ea4f.text: 击败进攻的纯洁部军队。阵内在该区域设置了陷阱，可以帮助你。

c524122fc7e0c2b07eebf10e29cde40a74d174bf.source: Talk to Miku in the Shenzun Tunnels Shenzun Tunnels (Winds of Change) (just south of Tahnnakai Temple). This will transport your party to Jinnai's location. After a brief dialogue between Jinnai and Miku, Ministry of Purity will appear all over the map. They will slowly approach your location. Defeat them all to complete the quest. Be aware that neither Jinnai nor Miku can use the teleporters found throughout the area.
c524122fc7e0c2b07eebf10e29cde40a74d174bf.text: 与神尊隧道中的 Miku 交谈神尊隧道（变革之风）（就在塔纳凯神庙南面）。这将把你的队伍运送到阵内的位置。阵内和初音短暂对话后，地图上就会出现纯洁部。他们会慢慢接近你的位置。击败他们所有人即可完成任务。请注意，阵内和未来都无法使用整个区域中的传送器。

0d73cba19d8ed228be013a4b7aeac67cb330d051.source: There are two basic approaches: find a good place to defend or keep moving around.
0d73cba19d8ed228be013a4b7aeac67cb330d051.text: 有两种基本方法：找到一个好地方进行防守或继续移动。

675231becdcecffbb4878095215951b6eb27ae07.source: When you accept this quest, a Ministerial Decree is added to your inventory.
675231becdcecffbb4878095215951b6eb27ae07.text: 当您接受此任务时，部长法令将添加到您的库存中。

b4b1d8e514cf75f30961af97b249745de8528519.source: Meet Soar Honorclaw and his forces in Xaquang Skyway.
b4b1d8e514cf75f30961af97b249745de8528519.text: 在 Xaquang Skyway 与 Soar Honorclaw 和他的部队会面。

c43fddf469201c80a6ca11d9bd75e1ada13dd07f.source: Fight your way inside the "Tengu Containment Zone."
c43fddf469201c80a6ca11d9bd75e1ada13dd07f.text: 在“天狗收容区”内杀出一条血路。

1824a6d7e5b19086a67f834c1b1c3bd03654c2f1.source: Locate and free the Tengu Prisoners.

271c31c8b25c4dc897b1c2d908c6121d38eb5e05.source: Escort the prisoners to the Shenzun Tunnels.

eb9e72e9fe7df9065d32fd965474602efdf56be4.source: At least one Tengu Prisoner must survive.
eb9e72e9fe7df9065d32fd965474602efdf56be4.text: 至少一名天狗囚犯必须生存。

566b9bb499bfa35b1ec90a3521b3d3671aef6ae0.source: Meet up with Soar Honorclaw and her Angchu Tengu allies east of the entrance to Senji's Corner. Note that Soar's group of Angchu will resurrect after a short time out of earshot of foes. Head north, being careful not to aggro too many Ministry fighters at the same time. Once you reach The Roost, wait for the short dialogue between Elite Ministry Captain and the party leader, after which the Ministry will turn hostile and Tengu from the Roost will become allies. More Ministry fighters will arrive; defeat them and lead the Tengu to the exit to Shenzun Tunnels. Map travel back to Ran Musu Gardens and return to Aerie to claim your reward.
566b9bb499bfa35b1ec90a3521b3d3671aef6ae0.text: 在森吉之角入口东边与翱翔荣爪和她的昂楚天狗盟友会合。请注意，索尔的安楚队会在敌人听不到的短时间内复活。向北前进，小心不要同时激怒太多魔法部战士。一旦你到达栖息地，等待精英部门队长和党领袖之间的简短对话，之后部门将转为敌对，来自栖息地的天狗将成为盟友。更多魔法部战士将会抵达；击败他们并带领天狗到达神尊隧道的出口。地图返回冉木苏花园，然后返回鹰巢领取奖励。

7e5957045f779c67ead47769af384b5115b25a21.source: The Ministry foes here are very aggressive: they will chase your party farther than most other foes.
7e5957045f779c67ead47769af384b5115b25a21.text: 这里魔法部的敌人非常具有侵略性：他们会比大多数其他敌人追赶你的队伍更远。

80e54f8735cae4f119b8d0bc5b92434ee3e79cd5.source: If you're having trouble keeping the prisoners alive, you can take several steps before approaching the prisoners.
80e54f8735cae4f119b8d0bc5b92434ee3e79cd5.text: 如果你很难让囚犯活下去，你可以在接近囚犯之前采取几个步骤。

f144079f4ce15e0ec722b3c38963ce3c61578c0f.source: Clear the path to Shenzun Tunnels.
f144079f4ce15e0ec722b3c38963ce3c61578c0f.text: 清理通往神尊隧道的道路。

7f6e660e86e8e2d38dfdd0ca37f9d062b4452dc2.source: Setup a Spirit wall before the fight begins, to delay the Ministry reinforcements from south.
7f6e660e86e8e2d38dfdd0ca37f9d062b4452dc2.text: 在战斗开始前设置精神墙，以拖延魔法部从南方来的援军。

310bf8e83f74ded4080128b1a9b66dafffac5193.source: Bring speed boosts for two reasons
310bf8e83f74ded4080128b1a9b66dafffac5193.text: 带来速度提升有两个原因

c8bfce28c0a5a530620d888b1a95dbf15f1cb01d.source: This will help you pull speed-boosted foes away from the slower-moving casters.
c8bfce28c0a5a530620d888b1a95dbf15f1cb01d.text: 这将帮助您将速度提升的敌人从移动速度较慢的施法者身边拉开。

beb99692c529cbc9c1650c664373104bf933b4fd.source: To help counter the snares used by the Ministry.
beb99692c529cbc9c1650c664373104bf933b4fd.text: 帮助对抗魔法部使用的圈套。

6447b910a0c21692924f103805c5e30551031011.source: Skills that affect allies in an area are very effective due to the large amount of allies in this quest, especially Ebon Battle Standard of Honor.
6447b910a0c21692924f103805c5e30551031011.text: 由于此任务中有大量盟友，影响区域内盟友的技能非常有效，尤其是黑檀荣誉战旗。

36e15f82922e58289596412891853b9f228a5f27.source: Find and rescue Ryun Grayfeather at Jaya Bluffs.
36e15f82922e58289596412891853b9f228a5f27.text: 在贾亚悬崖找到并营救瑞恩·灰羽。

34a52fe808a1008ea81207bb97af87093f7fc321.source: Defeat the Ministry of Purity Forces engaging you.
34a52fe808a1008ea81207bb97af87093f7fc321.text: 击败与你交战的纯洁部部队。

bc62a68695db4a8b70a27fd3948493f4ba3dae6a.source: Catch the Ministry of Purity Sergeant.

c7fea0f4b0084fb157c7e82d98d520094be38f06.source: Survive the battle between the Sensali and the Ministry of Purity.
c7fea0f4b0084fb157c7e82d98d520094be38f06.text: 在森萨利人和纯洁部之间的战斗中幸存下来。

157bb23e2d678d53a246f6a4ee4b35a083226b4e.source: Follow the quest markers from Seitung Harbor in order to locate Ryun Grayfeather; it is possible to avoid the Ministry of Purity and Sensali forces battling it out as you make your way north. Once Ryun is found and his dialogue with the Sensali concludes, they will turn hostile and attack. The quest will not fail if Ryun dies, as he will automatically revive after the skirmish if your party does not wipe. Shortly after disposing of the Sensali, Ministry troops led by Jiao Kuai the Swift will approach from the east, and will also turn hostile after dialogue is completed. Continue following quest markers as you "chase" Jiao Kuai, being careful not to over-aggro enemies other than the Ministry groups you'll fight along the way.
157bb23e2d678d53a246f6a4ee4b35a083226b4e.text: 跟随 Seitung 港的任务标记找到 Ryun Grayfeather；当你向北前进时，可以避开纯洁部和森萨利军队的战斗。一旦 Ryun 被发现并且他与 Sensali 的对话结束，他们就会转而敌对并发起攻击。如果 Ryun 死亡，任务也不会失败，因为如果你的队伍没有消灭，他会在小冲突后自动复活。消灭森萨利后不久，迅捷者焦快率领的部族部队将从东面逼近，对话完成后也会转入敌对状态。当你“追赶”焦快的时候，继续跟随任务标记，小心不要过度仇恨除了你一路上要战斗的部族之外的敌人。

6786346ae938e5ec5f26be5246390b498a21b87f.source: Once Jiao Kuai reaches Sizhou Hall, he will confront the player alongside Commander Chui Kantu just before a Sensali group appears as well, and both will attack the player. Note: In order to avoid wiping at this stage, flag your team just outside Sizhou to the southeast along the ridge protected by a rock wall before triggering the quest dialogue and let both sides take each other out. If you're lucky there will only be a handful of enemies left for you to handle, resulting in an easy finish.
6786346ae938e5ec5f26be5246390b498a21b87f.text: 一旦焦快到达司州厅，他将与指挥官崔坎图一起对抗玩家，然后森萨利小队也会出现，两人都会攻击玩家。注意：为了避免在这个阶段被消灭，请在触发任务对话之前将你的队伍标记在泗州城外东南方有岩壁保护的山脊上，让双方互相消灭对方。如果你幸运的话，你将只剩下少数敌人需要对付，从而轻松完成任务。

5b7bbeef82dfc1307fcf329f18e6e3beb580057d.source: Find and speak with Ryun Grayfeather in Jaya Bluffs.
5b7bbeef82dfc1307fcf329f18e6e3beb580057d.text: 在贾亚悬崖找到瑞恩·灰羽并与其交谈。

dc4233ffef73ac4d299f10f118651980ba79461b.source: Immediately after initiating the opening dialogue, use the teleporter near your starting location and head to the cemetery due south of where you get teleported to; it's one of several decent defensive locations. Regardless of your choice, keep the party spread out to counter the enemy's AoE skills. Defeat the groups as they spawn. Jinnai and Miku will remain at their initial location, diverting the enemy until you are ready to pull them towards you. Or you can wait for the Ministry to find you.
dc4233ffef73ac4d299f10f118651980ba79461b.text: 开始对话后，立即使用起始位置附近的传送器前往传送到的正南墓地；它是几个不错的防御地点之一。无论您如何选择，都要保持队伍分散以对抗敌人的 AoE 技能。在群体产生时击败它们。阵内和未来将留在他们的初始位置，转移敌人的注意力，直到你准备好将他们拉向你。或者你可以等待魔法部来找你。

3e1afc00192503ff35d6c4148642f17ec3466d59.source: If you use the cemetery, use the stairs as a choke point and block it with a spirit wall, minions, or a tank. You can also walk to your chosen spot, in which case, the NPCs will follow you and aid in the fight.
3e1afc00192503ff35d6c4148642f17ec3466d59.text: 如果你使用墓地，请使用楼梯作为阻塞点，并用精神墙、小兵或坦克来阻挡它。你也可以步行到你选择的地点，这样NPC就会跟着你并协助战斗。

ac970ce89644e3798c9522e66d54d6ada4da5a54.source: Alternatively, head north from the first teleporter's exit (instead of south to the cemetery). Defeat the 2-3 ministry groups that spawn at this location and leave any heroes flagged here. Go south to find the next ministry group and draw them back to your heroes. Keep repeating this until there are no more ministry troops. Be careful approaching Miku and Jinnai, since they will also attract foes towards your heroes.
ac970ce89644e3798c9522e66d54d6ada4da5a54.text: 或者，从第一个传送器的出口向北（而不是向南前往墓地）。击败在此位置生成的 2-3 个部委小组，并将所有英雄标记在此处。向南寻找下一个事工小组，并将他们吸引回你的英雄身边。不断重复此操作，直到不再有部委部队为止。接近 Miku 和 Jinnai 时要小心，因为他们也会吸引敌人来攻击你的英雄。

ebd16015bbe821698a8c2ae898d7a9fff20bd005.source: Since Jinnai has spiked the area with traps, you can move between teleporters, drawing the ministry foes to each trap in turn. The traps are not likely to kill all your opponents, but they will weaken them sufficiently to allow your team to mop up the remnants. do the traps do any damage at all? talk page seems to suggest not
ebd16015bbe821698a8c2ae898d7a9fff20bd005.text: 由于阵内在该区域布满了陷阱，你可以在传送器之间移动，依次将部委敌人吸引到每个陷阱。这些陷阱不太可能杀死你所有的对手，但它们会充分削弱他们的力量，让你的团队能够清理残余物。这些陷阱会造成任何损害吗？讨论页面似乎建议不要

8a3d9560f8290e7cef1d1bf7120fa337301200a4.source: Bringing a Minion Bomber or two is useful due to the sheer number of available corpses.
8a3d9560f8290e7cef1d1bf7120fa337301200a4.text: 由于可用尸体的数量巨大，因此携带一两个小兵轰炸机非常有用。

7f97eb406230a4b3f945484f75b3f783333ff533.source: A Soul Twisting hero is recommended for additional protection.
7f97eb406230a4b3f945484f75b3f783333ff533.text: 建议使用灵魂扭曲英雄以获得额外的保护。

b8e48555d0d8c96c2fb2c34c5e3223b2a6b38256.source: Synergy with MM Protection spells greatly increases survivability if too many enemies are accidentally aggroed.
b8e48555d0d8c96c2fb2c34c5e3223b2a6b38256.text: 如果有太多敌人被意外攻击，与 MM 保护法术的协同作用会大大提高生存能力。

ea04d2c8346dcbbd4345d9f18f10c3b959f4ea17.source: An effective body block method if using the cemetery defense, such as a Signet of Spirits hero or melee hero capable of AoE damage.
ea04d2c8346dcbbd4345d9f18f10c3b959f4ea17.text: 如果使用墓地防御，这是一种有效的身体阻挡方法，例如能够造成范围伤害的灵魂徽记英雄或近战英雄。

14f90cae7ebd227c1e75754d226ca13458da2906.source: A Vow of Strength Dervish or Hundred Blades Warrior is highly recommended, or:
14f90cae7ebd227c1e75754d226ca13458da2906.text: 强烈推荐力量苦行僧或百刃战士的誓言，或者：

abd2ec9d2fdd35926327474512e88b7fe2910f2b.source: An Assassin with Death Blossom if protection/healing capability is high.
abd2ec9d2fdd35926327474512e88b7fe2910f2b.text: 如果保护/治疗能力较高，则具有死亡之花的刺客。

62b994d4fae509c116f2c2cc846463ad17566626.source: This quest takes place in an explorable version of Altrumm Ruins.
62b994d4fae509c116f2c2cc846463ad17566626.text: 该任务发生在阿尔特鲁姆废墟的可探索版本中。

63a29c298329fd4d43dd7328af9019dbe2f4b052.source: Travel to Shadow's Passage and investigate the meeting.
63a29c298329fd4d43dd7328af9019dbe2f4b052.text: 前往暗影通道并调查这次会议。

7a87560d6d2d10a0684b666db121d14c26b19e66.source: Speak with the attendees to find out what the criminals are planning. Avoid the group you are disguised as and mind your tongue. The wrong words will draw unwanted attention.
7a87560d6d2d10a0684b666db121d14c26b19e66.text: 与与会者交谈，了解犯罪分子的计划。避开你所伪装的群体并注意你的舌头。错误的用词会引起不必要的注意。

476b2574496325b3f67886875fedd5222321e132.source: Go listen to the criminal's speech. Leaving early will blow your cover.
476b2574496325b3f67886875fedd5222321e132.text: 去听听罪犯的讲话吧。提早离开会暴露你的身份。

50707ee0e61ff7ba08e84d09704611c10f32035c.source: During this solo quest, you will be under the effects of the Dastardly Disguise, which makes you look like a member of one of various thug groups.
