4eaab92e1b93de4acef8abffbecade4c9453f2c5.source: The objective of the mission is to destroy four Spirit Rifts (energy spheres) and defeat four Shiro's Constructs. Kill the guarding Spirit of Portals to close the Spirit Rift. These guards also summon more Shiro'kens to replace fallen ones.
4eaab92e1b93de4acef8abffbecade4c9453f2c5.text: 任务的目标是摧毁四个精神裂缝（能量球）并击败四个白的构装体。杀死守卫传送门的灵魂以关闭灵魂裂缝。这些守卫还会召唤更多的白肯来代替倒下的白肯。

4f251851de3dd7b565c8296d37d4ed3855e0ebc5.source: At the beginning, the party has access to the Spear of Archemorus and the Urn of Saint Viktor. These tools are provided as boosts only and carrying them is not required to complete the mission. If your party consists mainly of heroes and can only take one of the bundles, consider taking the Spear instead of the Urn, since heroes are not affected by the Urn's effect.
4f251851de3dd7b565c8296d37d4ed3855e0ebc5.text: 一开始，队伍可以使用阿彻摩洛斯之矛和圣维克托圣瓮。这些工具仅作为助推器提供，完成任务不需要携带它们。如果你的队伍主要由英雄组成，并且只能拿走其中一个捆绑包，请考虑拿矛而不是瓮，因为英雄不受瓮效果的影响。

042188952aebdaa0690ca1a8b9341efe5e609a9b.source: A bridge will come down and the mission will start.
042188952aebdaa0690ca1a8b9341efe5e609a9b.text: 一座桥将会倒塌，任务将会开始。

9ffc02e336e6fbb5b3f4eb367e5143af52f49acd.source: The first area has Flame Fissures that cause burning and crippled to anyone who walks over them. The first Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Assassins will be there. The party can now proceed either left or right. If taking right, Shiro can be sighted but will be unreachable at this time.
9ffc02e336e6fbb5b3f4eb367e5143af52f49acd.text: 第一个区域有火焰裂缝，任何走过它们的人都会被灼伤并致残。第一个灵魂裂缝和白剑刺客将会在那里。队伍现在可以向左或向右前进。如果向右走，可以看到白，但此时无法到达。

0c1fc1ff28e5df9fa41e2fc1d529d90ca7e8872e.source: There is another fork ahead. The second Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Rangers will be to the right. This area has several spikes squares that cause bleeding and crippled when walked over. Pull carefully to avoid over-aggro.
0c1fc1ff28e5df9fa41e2fc1d529d90ca7e8872e.text: 前面还有另一个岔路口。第二个灵魂裂缝和白肯游骑兵将位于右侧。该区域有几个尖刺方块，走过时会导致流血和残废。小心拉动以避免过度仇恨。

ecae1d99ed0a2e52e63d65b6afdf5d5226922050.source: The party should double back to the previous fork. The third Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Necromancers will be down that path atop a small hill surrounded with poisoned water.
ecae1d99ed0a2e52e63d65b6afdf5d5226922050.text: 队伍应该返回前一个岔路。第三个灵魂裂谷和白肯死灵法师将沿着那条小路来到一座被毒水包围的小山顶上。

39d1da370e61947a567987a30c9a7bf485c4d334.source: Turn right and out of the poisoned water to find the fourth and final Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Warriors. The spike plates in this area cause dazed, casters should be careful.
39d1da370e61947a567987a30c9a7bf485c4d334.text: 右转，走出毒水，找到第四个也是最后一个灵魂裂缝和白肯战士。该区域的尖刺板会造成眩晕，脚轮应小心。

5fde33b002a819a7e8fd604d6a27b89491819c45.source: After the fourth Spirit of Portals and its mob are destroyed, a cinematic will play and then the party will be in the central area where Shiro was previously seen, facing four Construct bosses. Finish off all four to complete the mission. If you are playing with henchmen/heroes, immediately flag them to the nearest corner as they tend to run to the center between all bosses, causing a quick wipe. Then slowly pull the bosses one or two at a time.
5fde33b002a819a7e8fd604d6a27b89491819c45.text: 第四个传送门之灵及其生物被摧毁后，将播放一段过场动画，然后队伍将位于之前看到白的中心区域，面对四个构造体 Boss。完成所有四个即可完成任务。如果您正在与追随者/英雄一起玩，请立即将他们标记到最近的角落，因为他们往往会跑到所有 Boss 之间的中心，从而导致快速消灭。然后慢慢地一次拉一两个老板。

78eab447e32f0f300810c1d5ccdfff83dd8d9a74.source: Spirit of Portals can be defeated quickly by using Gaze of Fury on them.
78eab447e32f0f300810c1d5ccdfff83dd8d9a74.text: 对传送门之魂使用愤怒凝视可以快速击败它们。

54c41860f38b49932679b8f74f8e8ec5e503f998.source: This mission's environment traps also affect enemies.
54c41860f38b49932679b8f74f8e8ec5e503f998.text: 该任务的环境陷阱也会影响敌人。

96986107793ed93bfdc77dc8b67aed66d5da7a62.source: Shiro Tagachi is passive and has Invulnerability in this mission; however, allied minions that wander into his aggro circle will still attempt to engage him in combat. He may be killed by means such as Agony and Unholy Feast, but doing so appears to have no effect on the mission besides preventing him from speaking his lines. In the cinematic after closing all the rifts, he appears as normal.
96986107793ed93bfdc77dc8b67aed66d5da7a62.text: 田胜史郎在此任务中处于被动且无敌状态；然而，进入他的仇恨圈的盟友小兵仍然会试图与他交战。他可能会被痛苦和邪恶盛宴等手段杀死，但这样做除了阻止他说出台词之外，似乎对任务没有任何影响。在消除所有裂痕后的动画中，他看起来像正常人一样。

a3c42794cdc7be0f4740dd9c4ddb9993c517a600.source: This mission does not provide a reliable opportunity to capture skills, because you have to go through the entire mission to reach the bosses, only four of eight potential bosses spawn, and there is very little time to capture the skill of the fourth-defeated boss.
a3c42794cdc7be0f4740dd9c4ddb9993c517a600.text: 这个任务并没有提供可靠的捕获技能的机会，因为你必须完成整个任务才能到达boss，八个潜在boss中只有四个产生，并且几乎没有时间捕获第四个被击败的boss的技能。

f430e7c945309b54244d401ddd4330ed52146d74.source: After completing the mission for the first time, the sectioned off area of Sunjiang District (explorable area) will be accessible, and in turn so will the six construct bosses.
f430e7c945309b54244d401ddd4330ed52146d74.text: 第一次完成任务后，孙江区的隔离区域（可探索区域）将可以进入，六大建筑boss也将进入。

618a1510e6c598f255ca8260026a88edb9f3e8a2.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #6 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
618a1510e6c598f255ca8260026a88edb9f3e8a2.text: 完成此任务将填写《白郎归来》故事书的第 6 页。

1d6e81a227d509fb6458b8e72ce0bce07cf4e8f5.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Maatu Keep.
1d6e81a227d509fb6458b8e72ce0bce07cf4e8f5.text: 完成此任务后，您的队伍将被带到马图城堡。

3bd49132bc5e7dda54e2be3f14173998e2d90171.source: Although they are not fleshy (with the exception of Flesh Golems), Celestial Summoning Stone and minion allies can be affected by the bleeding traps and poisoned water. Both the Spear of Archemorus and the Urn of Saint Viktor are supposed to be destroyed at the end of the mission; however, if a player was holding them (or dropped them just before the defeat of the final boss), both can be seen briefly during the cinematic.
3bd49132bc5e7dda54e2be3f14173998e2d90171.text: 虽然它们不是肉质的（血肉傀儡除外），但天界召唤石和小兵盟友可能会受到流血陷阱和毒水的影响。阿基莫洛斯之矛和圣维克多圣瓮都应该在任务结束时被摧毁；然而，如果玩家持有它们（或在击败最终 Boss 之前掉落它们），则在过场动画中可以短暂看到两者。

83c5da1a5c2d7fa562813aa9ba1bb2640598fd75.source: Your party will not be able to enter this mission unless it has eight members.
83c5da1a5c2d7fa562813aa9ba1bb2640598fd75.text: 除非你的队伍有八名成员，否则你的队伍将无法进入此任务。

3e4d6e206fbbf021f3acb25ba2370854da6e7096.source: If the party contains any characters that have not completed Into the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Morostav Trail will be closed, and if the party contains any characters that have not completed Journey to the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Silent Surf will be closed.
3e4d6e206fbbf021f3acb25ba2370854da6e7096.text: 如果队伍中有未完成“漩涡之旅”（无需接受奖励）的角色，则“莫罗斯塔夫小道”的大门将关闭，如果队伍中有未完成“漩涡之旅”的角色（无需接受奖励），“寂静冲浪”的大门将关闭。

30a4e548f34c5d5df9c6c795b63c80e969c56793.source: Into the Whirlpool and Journey to the Whirlpool grant access, but any characters that have not completed The Eternal Grove will be left behind in Morostav Trail.
30a4e548f34c5d5df9c6c795b63c80e969c56793.text: 进入漩涡和漩涡之旅可以进入，但任何未完成永恒丛林的角色都将被留在莫罗斯塔夫小道中。

d528c9f17bd900eefd6d9036d172775526096886.source: Weaken Kuunavang to destroy the barrier.
d528c9f17bd900eefd6d9036d172775526096886.text: 削弱库纳旺以摧毁屏障。

e69b6ffef3012f073b49771ab52ef79450083ef5.source: Continue to weaken Kuunavang until the next barrier is destroyed.
e69b6ffef3012f073b49771ab52ef79450083ef5.text: 继续削弱库纳旺直到下一个屏障被摧毁。

9109b2026bcbd78e6eede76660bb0d3def857412.source: Continue weakening Kuunavang until the last barrier is destroyed.
9109b2026bcbd78e6eede76660bb0d3def857412.text: 继续削弱库纳旺，直到最后一个屏障被摧毁。
