fa616b1f970a0ce12412d19f888f94c638a8aa62.source: At the beginning of this mission, be sure to acquire a Celestial skill from Kuunavang. These skills are very powerful, and will recharge each time you defeat one of the many bosses in this mission. Take note that only player characters and henchmen can get Celestial skills; heroes cannot. As such, it is worth considering whether or not your hero build really is more effective than the warrior and elementalist henchmen as they get Storm of Swords and Celestial Storm respectively.
fa616b1f970a0ce12412d19f888f94c638a8aa62.text: 在这个任务开始时，一定要从库纳旺那里获得一项天体技能。这些技能非常强大，每次您在此任务中击败众多头目之一时，它们都会重新充电。请注意，只有玩家角色和追随者才能获得天神技能；英雄不能。因此，值得考虑的是，你的英雄构建是否真的比战士和元素主义者的追随者更有效，因为他们分别获得了冰雨风暴和天体风暴。

d5dd38033a27ef08a8e8e28e81ab07ec3a5dfe54.source: After that, the party leader has to choose two NPCs to join as allies. These NPCs will fight with you, but cannot be resurrected if they die, and will leave your party at a prescribed point during the mission (if they are still alive) to let your party skip a small section of the mission:
d5dd38033a27ef08a8e8e28e81ab07ec3a5dfe54.text: 之后，党魁必须选择两名 NPC 作为盟友加入。这些 NPC 会与你一起战斗，但如果他们死了就无法复活，并且会在任务期间的指定地点离开你的队伍（如果他们还活着），让你的队伍跳过任务的一小部分：

9f96b50e7ee06250f5effaf7bc9fe3504456fefb.source: Argo - Lets the party skip the first groups of Shiro'ken; thereby allowing the party to head straight to the Warrior boss.
9f96b50e7ee06250f5effaf7bc9fe3504456fefb.text: Argo - 让队伍跳过第一组 Shiro'ken；从而允许队伍直接前往战士老板。

c715dc3030ff5cc2e15471f38297bfa99f66f5f2.source: Cynn - Lets the party skip the group of Shiro'ken; this occurs before the bridges after the Elementalist boss.
c715dc3030ff5cc2e15471f38297bfa99f66f5f2.text: Cynn - 让队伍跳过 Shiro'ken 队伍；这发生在元素师 Boss 之后的桥梁之前。

eb1ad142f37a5d57f969409d2cce6357bef1ab2a.source: Danika - Closes a gate in a large room full of Shiro'ken; thereby providing the party with a faster alternate route to the Ritualist boss.
eb1ad142f37a5d57f969409d2cce6357bef1ab2a.text: Danika - 关闭一个装满 Shiro'ken 的大房间的门；从而为队伍提供了一条更快的通往仪式者老板的替代路线。

21b1818b07284ebd9302a7f91c11de06a6c4f2b1.source: Nika - Lets the party skip the Ranger boss.
21b1818b07284ebd9302a7f91c11de06a6c4f2b1.text: 尼卡 - 让队伍跳过游侠老板。

b3da3cd4538fc479bc80d4979c583bf4d97a764d.source: Panaku - Disables the Acid Traps in the corridor that leads to the Ritualist boss.
b3da3cd4538fc479bc80d4979c583bf4d97a764d.text: 帕纳库 - 禁用通向仪式者 Boss 的走廊中的酸性陷阱。

4bcf997bc72aa7643713c51b28f8b05ccafc3eb2.source: Talon Silverwing - Closes the gates on the portal rooms after the Warrior boss; thereby containing the Shiro'ken in those rooms.
4bcf997bc72aa7643713c51b28f8b05ccafc3eb2.text: 利爪银翼 - 在战士 Boss 之后关闭传送室的大门；从而将 Shiro'ken 限制在这些房间中。

c131ffc035bd3ca0b7a8f68b13a01b043b2f970e.source: Choosing Danika, in addition to Talon, is recommended as being the most "time-efficient". If you chose Talon, you can skip the most combat-intensive segment of the mission that has the largest number of Shiro'ken. After the elementalist boss, if you chose Danika, the party can run past where Cynn's shortcut would be and activate Danika's; effectively giving you the benefits of both. Argo only skips an insignificant group of six or seven Shiro'ken. Panaku only disables the traps (that only deal 10-20 damage each and can be easily avoided); Panaku can also get body blocked by enemies during the cinematic and end up not disabling the traps.
c131ffc035bd3ca0b7a8f68b13a01b043b2f970e.text: 除了Talon之外，推荐选择Danika是最“省时”的。如果你选择利爪，你可以跳过任务中战斗最激烈、白剑数量最多的部分。在元素BOSS之后，如果你选择丹妮卡，队伍可以跑过辛恩的捷径所在并激活丹妮卡的捷径；有效地为您提供两者的好处。阿尔戈只跳过了一小群六七个白肯。 Panaku 仅禁用陷阱（每个陷阱仅造成 10-20 点伤害，并且可以轻松避开）；在过场动画中，帕纳库的身体也可能被敌人阻挡，最终无法禁用陷阱。

f17f9371a5787cb06d5a281fad964eb70041a83e.source: The timer for the mission does not actually start until after the party leader has selected two allies, and walked through the gate that opens after the allies have been selected. In addition to the two allies selected, Master Togo and Mhenlo will also be accompanying the party.
f17f9371a5787cb06d5a281fad964eb70041a83e.text: 直到队长选择了两名盟友，并走过选择盟友后打开的大门后，任务计时器才真正开始。除了选定的两名盟友之外，多哥大师和门洛也将随行。

43ab5c1d2ca017bde8ecde16bb5cb6fcc5668e4a.source: Room one, unless you chose Argo, you must go left or right around the outside of the room to reach the Warrior boss. It is advised to pull the boss as to not aggro the group behind him.
43ab5c1d2ca017bde8ecde16bb5cb6fcc5668e4a.text: 第一号房间，除非你选择阿尔戈，否则你必须从房间外面向左或向右走才能到达战士老板。建议拉boss，不要激怒他后面的队伍。

bbc27b5ea465991d5f97b187571a4ea829584c13.source: Boss two, if you chose Talon, the doors to the spawn portals close and you can approach and kill the Necromancer boss with ease. If you did not choose Talon, your party should run through the middle into the Necromancer group and be careful not to aggro the growing group of Shiro'ken forming in the middle of the room.
bbc27b5ea465991d5f97b187571a4ea829584c13.text: Boss 2，如果你选择 Talon，重生传送门的门就会关闭，你可以轻松接近并杀死死灵法师 Boss。如果你没有选择利爪，你的队伍应该从中间跑进死灵法师队伍，并小心不要激怒在房间中间形成的越来越多的白肯队伍。

da81f46eeedb17e2626d032e57a197cdb5dde410.source: Boss three, if you chose Nika, you will skip the Ranger boss. Otherwise, you must defeat the Ranger boss atop the ramp. After killing the boss, turn left or right and begin pulling the small patrolling groups of enemies carefully in order to eliminate them before engaging the Elementalist boss. If you try and take Nika's route without having Nika with you, the Ranger boss runs around and onto the high point and engages you anyway.
da81f46eeedb17e2626d032e57a197cdb5dde410.text: 第三个boss，如果你选择Nika，你就会跳过游侠boss。否则，你必须击败坡道顶上的游侠头目。杀死 Boss 后，左转或右转，开始小心地拉动小股巡逻的敌人，以便在与元素师 Boss 交战之前消灭它们。如果你尝试在没有尼卡陪伴的情况下走尼卡的路线，游侠老板会绕着高点跑，无论如何都会与你交战。

5b97ab7d249dd9e81543423d71f3ac4f115bbe46.source: Boss four, after pulling the groups near the Elementalist boss, engage and kill the boss group. Be mindful that Ritualists and Monks tend to hide on the stairs behind the boss and can resurrect or heal without pressure. If you chose Danika, be prepared to run.
5b97ab7d249dd9e81543423d71f3ac4f115bbe46.text: Boss 4，将队伍拉到元素师 Boss 附近后，与 Boss 队伍交战并杀死他们。请注意，仪式主义者和僧侣往往隐藏在 Boss 后面的楼梯上，并且可以毫无压力地复活或治愈。如果你选择了丹妮卡，就做好逃跑的准备。

b10b42b588c7e6c52458d171ab813b77778a1416.source: Boss five, if you chose Danika, you must make a dash across the bridge behind this room, ignoring enemies from the spawn portals until the cinematic engages. You may be followed by a group from behind which you will have to defeat. This can be hard to do if your party has not discussed the run. After the cinematic, you must turn left and follow the outside wall until reaching the Ritualist boss. Stay on the carpet to avoid the Acid Traps.
b10b42b588c7e6c52458d171ab813b77778a1416.text: 第五号老板，如果你选择丹妮卡，你必须冲过这个房间后面的桥，忽略重生门户中的敌人，直到电影开始。你可能会被一群人追随，你必须击败他们。如果你的政党没有讨论竞选，这可能很难做到。电影结束后，您必须左转并沿着外墙行驶，直到到达仪式者 Boss。留在地毯上以避免酸陷阱。

f02c63ce3b6bc38d844fec52ac3d4147f4fa086e.source: Boss five, if you chose Cynn, the spawn portals are closed and you can fight your way across the bridge in the middle of the room. Once across, you must follow the multiple groups of enemies until reaching the Ritualist boss. Stay on the carpet to avoid the Acid Traps.
f02c63ce3b6bc38d844fec52ac3d4147f4fa086e.text: Boss 5，如果你选择 Cynn，重生传送门会关闭，你可以通过房间中间的桥杀出一条血路。一旦穿过，你必须跟随多组敌人，直到到达仪式者老板。留在地毯上以避免酸陷阱。

593ba28407df7a86633824c3bac236a09bc1b708.source: Boss five, if you chose Panaku, and he is still alive, the Acid Traps will be disabled making it possible for the party to stand where you like.
593ba28407df7a86633824c3bac236a09bc1b708.text: 老大五，如果你选择了帕纳库，并且他还活着，酸性陷阱将被禁用，使队伍可以站在你喜欢的地方。

f17f407319c5ee43669e165ce5bca1c4c33bb9c0.source: Boss six/seven/eight, the bosses in this mission are all just health and energy tank versions of their Shiro’ken offspring. Use the same kill order as before, making the Monk a priority, followed by the Assassin and Mesmer.
f17f407319c5ee43669e165ce5bca1c4c33bb9c0.text: 六号/七号/八号老板，这个任务中的老板都是他们的白肯后代的健康和能量罐版本。使用与之前相同的杀戮顺序，优先选择武僧，然后是刺客和幻术师。

989d6f67435986334540eed1aae4cff7b564ece1.source: Consider area damage over time skills, such as Ray of Judgment, to deal with the spirits created by Shiro'ken Ritualist.
989d6f67435986334540eed1aae4cff7b564ece1.text: 考虑随时间推移造成区域伤害的技能，例如审判之光，来对付白肯仪式师所创造的灵魂。

7fd382d5257aa8978dd86626982bc9f50a29681f.source: Minion masters should consider Blood of the Master to keep their minions alive from the Elementalist health degeneration.
7fd382d5257aa8978dd86626982bc9f50a29681f.text: 随从大师应该考虑使用大师之血来让他们的随从免受元素师健康退化的影响。

01a2308c54365592bab6842467e50812265b8050.source: Because Shiro'ken Monks use Spell Breaker and Spell Shield, consider non-spell skills like "You Move Like A Dwarf!", "Finish Him!", or Brawling Headbutt to spike the Monks.
01a2308c54365592bab6842467e50812265b8050.text: 由于白肯武僧会使用法术破坏者和法术护盾，因此请考虑使用非法术技能，例如“你像矮人一样移动！”、“干掉他！”或“争吵头撞”来刺杀武僧。

285a93077dee4a78c5064a9713f1cd7f6d3ddd7c.source: Bring enchantment removal skills to deal with the Shiro'ken Elementalist's Sliver Armor and Shiro'ken Monk's Spell Breaker and Spell Shield.
285a93077dee4a78c5064a9713f1cd7f6d3ddd7c.text: 带上结界消除技能来对付白肯元素师的银甲和白肯武僧的破法者和法术护盾。

d0ca95e3ec3e32686f81a7a6a50f9983d8885eac.source: The foes in this mission have hex removal skills (Shiro'ken Monks have Reverse Hex and Shiro'ken Mesmers have Shatter Hex), but lack condition removal, so consider bringing skills that inflict conditions instead of hex spells. Consider bringing hex spells with an end effect that triggers when removed by a hex removal skill, such as Phantom Pain.
d0ca95e3ec3e32686f81a7a6a50f9983d8885eac.text: 此任务中的敌人具有去除妖术的技能（白肯武僧拥有逆向妖术，白肯幻术师拥有粉碎妖术），但缺乏条件去除能力，因此请考虑使用造成条件的技能而不是妖术法术。考虑使用具有最终效果的十六进制法术，当被十六进制移除技能（例如幻痛）移除时会触发该效果。

59299b4d3a0cb4f6188e44769506dfd65165286a.source: Consider bringing skills that can affect multiple allies, since they will also affect the four non-party member allies.
59299b4d3a0cb4f6188e44769506dfd65165286a.text: 考虑引入可以影响多个盟友的技能，因为它们也会影响四个非党员盟友。

84af5099293e0c472322dd5a7fa5078a5803cb99.source: Consider bringing skills that prevent and remove burning as Shiro'ken Elementalists use Star Burst and Burning Speed.
84af5099293e0c472322dd5a7fa5078a5803cb99.text: 考虑引入防止和消除燃烧的技能，因为白肯元素师使用星爆和燃烧速度。

22e58cd843f99b26bedc5e5ffeecd46f87b6ea1c.source: If you speak to Kuunavang you get a temporary Celestial skill which recharges when a boss is killed. If you replace Charm Animal, Comfort Animal, or Heal as One with a Celestial skill, your pet will still remain.
22e58cd843f99b26bedc5e5ffeecd46f87b6ea1c.text: 如果你与 Kuunavang 交谈，你会获得一个临时的天体技能，当 Boss 被杀死时，该技能会重新充电。如果你用天界技能替换魅惑动物、舒适动物或治愈一体，你的宠物仍然会保留。

3ff7fbc728e4c0ce63eb912d5de0a691d14c3443.source: The Gate Guard spawns immediately before the ending cinematic, as such, it cannot be killed.
3ff7fbc728e4c0ce63eb912d5de0a691d14c3443.text: 门卫在电影结束前立即生成，因此无法将其杀死。

a2ff4b417ef58cecf6283e9b26c16ae69a4d6f7a.source: Make sure that the two ally henchmen you choose survive until the part that you want them to help you skip. If they die before they get there, they are unable to perform the action that will allow you to skip the room/boss.
a2ff4b417ef58cecf6283e9b26c16ae69a4d6f7a.text: 确保你选择的两名盟友能够存活到你希望他们帮助你跳过的部分。如果他们在到达那里之前死亡，他们将无法执行允许您跳过房间/老板的操作。

5a5174adb0073b5edc945bd07ccc76a79f2dc91c.source: If you choose Danika, once you get past the elementalist boss run until you cross the bridge and a cinematic will start where you will see her lock the next room and reveal an alternate route that is far more pleasant. Be aware that you will be attacked from behind by a group of Shiro'ken once the alternate route is revealed.
5a5174adb0073b5edc945bd07ccc76a79f2dc91c.text: 如果你选择丹妮卡，一旦你通过了元素主义老板，一直跑到过桥，电影就会开始，你会看到她锁上下一个房间，并揭示一条更令人愉快的替代路线。请注意，一旦发现替代路线，您将被一群白剑从后面攻击。

70c2c08494c8da74d7ccd470eb239c84f2f61d6b.source: You must defeat all of the Shiro'ken bosses, including the final three, in order to complete the mission. This prevents the mission from being easily run by a single person.
70c2c08494c8da74d7ccd470eb239c84f2f61d6b.text: 您必须击败所有 Shiro'ken Boss，包括最后三个，才能完成任务。这使得任务无法由一个人轻松执行。

98b38b65d95bd92a2de077d1b84357a209642317.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #10 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
98b38b65d95bd92a2de077d1b84357a209642317.text: 完成此任务将填写《白郎归来》故事书的第 10 页。

3395a2a35581373e08548d0dac8c9afe9305b4d1.source: If one of the allies you choose at the beginning of the mission dies near an enemy's Restoration spirit, that ally will be revived when the spirit dies. Since you need to kill all the Shiro'ken bosses, this can make it impossible to finish the mission should you pick a character such as Cynn.
3395a2a35581373e08548d0dac8c9afe9305b4d1.text: 如果你在任务开始时选择的盟友之一在敌人的恢复灵魂附近死亡，则该盟友将在该灵魂死亡时复活。由于你需要杀死所有的 Shiro'ken Boss，如果你选择像 Cynn 这样的角色，这可能会导致任务无法完成。

c7c61c45a619c7c71701c38fccf9e80d3f98501a.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is by completing Raisu Palace.
c7c61c45a619c7c71701c38fccf9e80d3f98501a.text: 进入任务没有任何要求，但进入前哨站的唯一方法是完成 Raisu Palace。

dd4d6d19c170536305d585998392c1790607ef68.source: Imperial Sanctum/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
dd4d6d19c170536305d585998392c1790607ef68.text: 帝国圣殿/详细演练指南

63ce2ccb191c7042f958dbcca1288bfbc6466cc1.source: Upon completion of this mission, the players will end up in the Divine Path.
63ce2ccb191c7042f958dbcca1288bfbc6466cc1.text: 完成此任务后，玩家将踏上神道。

22b482f6220881264d51646b66d95ea89cd54cd1.source: If this is the first time your character has completed this mission, remember to talk to Suun in Divine Path. There will not be any quest nor reward indicator over his head. Suun will give you the Amulet of the Mists. You can then go to one of the nearby adepts and trade the amulet for a unique item. You can only receive this amulet once per character. If for some reason you forget to talk to Suun and leave the Divine Path, you can perform the mission again and talk to Suun to receive the amulet.
22b482f6220881264d51646b66d95ea89cd54cd1.text: 如果这是你的角色第一次完成这个任务，记得和神道里的苏恩交谈。他的头顶上不会有任何任务或奖励指示器。苏恩会给你迷雾护身符。然后你可以去找附近的一位行家，用护身符换取一件独特的物品。每个角色只能收到此护身符一次。如果因为某种原因忘记与苏恩对话而离开神道，可以再次执行任务并与苏恩对话领取护身符。

3cf362ff13c6e608e81853753480033f129cd62e.source: Banished Paragons or Dervishes are replaced by Bound Warriors.
3cf362ff13c6e608e81853753480033f129cd62e.text: 被放逐的典范或苦行僧被束缚的战士取代。

59c51a8ce8991903218577eb2e372ffd4b1082c4.source: You gain a morale boost each time a bound foe is killed.
59c51a8ce8991903218577eb2e372ffd4b1082c4.text: 每次杀死被束缚的敌人时，你都会获得士气提升。

fcb2d066c622beee1e200fc7a81d8f9d53faff36.source: The mission will succeed even if Mhenlo dies.
fcb2d066c622beee1e200fc7a81d8f9d53faff36.text: 即使门洛死了，任务也会成功。

e58b12ef72221a8b323332ad918c77900fb916ed.source: Some elementalists run this mission for money, echo chaining Celestial Storm to quickly solo Shiro and getting Master's reward.
e58b12ef72221a8b323332ad918c77900fb916ed.text: 一些元素主义者为了金钱而执行此任务，回响连锁天体风暴以快速单打白并获得大师的奖励。

b81aede25b055ab790aebc7641f42ea636ffd79e.source: The area to which Shiro banishes players contributes approximately 0.2% towards the Canthan Grandmaster Cartographer title.
b81aede25b055ab790aebc7641f42ea636ffd79e.text: Shiro 放逐玩家的区域对 Canthan 制图大师头衔的贡献约为 0.2%。

e3ea6707985f9ba123dda6d02725b8a436ef2351.source: You need to team up with at least one other player to uncover this area, as Shiro doesn't banish you if you're the only player.
e3ea6707985f9ba123dda6d02725b8a436ef2351.text: 你需要与至少一名其他玩家合作才能发现这个区域，因为如果你是唯一的玩家，Shiro 不会驱逐你。

50326c3a67f6d0cd455ebd171c2e7e89d4579db9.source: The Spirits of the Mists in that area do not respawn after being killed, so spirit-killing skills such as Gaze of Fury help considerably if more than one banishment is planned for zone scraping at leisure.
50326c3a67f6d0cd455ebd171c2e7e89d4579db9.text: 该区域的迷雾之灵在被杀死后不会重生，因此，如果计划在闲暇时进行多次放逐，那么诸如愤怒凝视之类的杀死灵魂的技能会有很大帮助。

5a814ff8f2eb88ea8b1c6c5a2aa5e0a3e2af3b51.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
5a814ff8f2eb88ea8b1c6c5a2aa5e0a3e2af3b51.text: 完成此任务将填写《白郎归来》故事书第 11 页。

6d22a24bd1dcdd22865174de5128c34fe666c9e4.source: Sometimes there is a malfunction with Shiro's skill: Meditation of the Reaper. He will be able to take damage while in meditation, but the skill won't register any damage taken. It will therefore last the maximum of 30sec.
6d22a24bd1dcdd22865174de5128c34fe666c9e4.text: 有时，白的技能“死神冥想”会出现故障。他在冥想时能够受到伤害，但该技能不会记录受到的任何伤害。因此它最多会持续 30 秒。

861ef4de09781d5b9a10090b453fe9288e957221.source: Sometimes there is a malfunction with Shiro's skill: Echoing Banishment. Heroes sometimes get taken with you when Shiro uses Echoing Banishment.
861ef4de09781d5b9a10090b453fe9288e957221.text: 有时，白的技能“回响放逐”会出现故障。当白使用回响放逐时，英雄有时会被带走。

01d9ccccd343fd98233481fa53044d118f28355d.source: {{Research needed| Henchmen cannot be banished, can they return if flagged and/or led by the party leader? Usually at such a distance, they'd try a direct approach to the party leader which would lead them into a wall in this case. }}
01d9ccccd343fd98233481fa53044d118f28355d.text: {{需要研究|追随者不能被驱逐，如果党领袖标记和/或领导，他们可以返回吗？通常在这样的距离下，他们会尝试直接接近党的领导人，但在这种情况下，他们会陷入困境。 }}

e3792fa424c69d256d5b6445fed14b5b42deea49.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
* Across the Wall completed
* Reforged Mode is active
e3792fa424c69d256d5b6445fed14b5b42deea49.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色
* 翻墙完成
* 重制模式已激活

b57f66a1cffb8d22e350c02752f158faec833c3f.source: Carve a path through the Northlands and retake Piken Square.
b57f66a1cffb8d22e350c02752f158faec833c3f.text: 开辟一条穿过北地的道路并夺回皮肯广场。

b57928faca85d5c38799213f87be5900f76e324d.source: Hold off the Charr forces to secure Piken Square.
b57928faca85d5c38799213f87be5900f76e324d.text: 抵挡夏尔军队，确保皮肯广场的安全。

0361c8d2b5e591a9774c10902e1dc866c14a3736.source: Upon accepting the reward, portals appear in the Northlands leading to the Piken Square outpost and the Forsaken Tunnels dungeon.
0361c8d2b5e591a9774c10902e1dc866c14a3736.text: 接受奖励后，北地就会出现通往皮肯广场前哨站和被遗忘隧道地牢的传送门。

8d3d1b0c9c75c6872da86a1252c2df813cb6a9c3.source: If all party members have completed the quest, two gates in the Northlands will open, allowing passage into the northern section of the map.
8d3d1b0c9c75c6872da86a1252c2df813cb6a9c3.text: 如果所有队员都完成了任务，北地的两扇大门将会打开，允许进入地图的北部部分。

84e989544b642469815fd316014478fee86ab565.source: Pull the lever above the gate and enter the Northlands, where Devona, Vell and Bock await you. (If they are not present, ensure no party members have Across the Wall active in the quest log and rezone.) While Vell and Bock are expendable, Devona's survival is mandatory; if she is killed at any point during the quest, you will need to restart.
84e989544b642469815fd316014478fee86ab565.text: 拉动大门上方的控制杆，进入北地，德沃娜、维尔和博克在那里等待着您。 （如果他们不存在，请确保没有队伍成员在任务日志中激活“越过墙”并重新分区。）虽然维尔和博克是可牺牲品，但德沃娜的生存是强制性的；如果她在任务期间的任何时候被杀，你将需要重新开始。

4f9d40d77cfc82af27d8afdfbb0004da52c17d8f.source: Proceed north toward Piken Square. Six groups of two or three Charr each are scattered along the path, replacing most of the Grawl and Oakheart spawns in the area. It is not necessary to kill these patrols, and several of them can be easily bypassed. Inside Piken Square itself, there are four more Charr groups which must be eliminated. Pull them carefully to make sure your allies (especially Devona) do not get overwhelmed.
4f9d40d77cfc82af27d8afdfbb0004da52c17d8f.text: 继续向北前往皮肯广场。六组每组两到三名夏尔沿着路径分散，取代了该地区大部分的穴居人和橡树之心生成点。没必要杀掉这些巡逻队，几个都可以轻松绕过。在皮肯广场内部，还有四个夏尔集团必须消灭。小心地拉动它们，以确保你的盟友（尤其是德沃娜）不会被压垮。

ee4901b3f4d35c729172eef7f0afd6aa528fc7b9.source: Once the square is clear, Devona, Vell, and Bock will stop following you and gather at the bottom of the stairs. At this point, you only have a few seconds to prepare for a counterattack. Two Charr Hunters and the warrior boss Scarl the Slicer will move into the square through the same gate you did and engage your allies. Be wary of heavy projectile damage from the hunters, which can easily kill Devona if she is allowed to aggro the group.
ee4901b3f4d35c729172eef7f0afd6aa528fc7b9.text: 一旦广场清空，德沃娜、维尔和博克将停止跟随你并聚集在楼梯底部。此时，你只有几秒钟的时间来准备反击。两名夏尔猎人和战士首领切片机斯卡尔将通过你之前进入的同一扇门进入广场并与你的盟友交战。警惕猎人的重型射弹伤害，如果允许德沃娜攻击队伍，这很容易杀死她。

a640f5e8681b54fb68d81966009bf9fbf1eeab79.source: After Scarl's warband is defeated, you can return to Ascalon City and talk to Prince Rurik to get your reward.
a640f5e8681b54fb68d81966009bf9fbf1eeab79.text: 斯卡尔的战帮被击败后，你可以返回阿斯卡隆城并与鲁里克王子交谈以获得奖励。

465935963baf0540ced961eb83cff7cc0c2c0e45.text: 在 2026 年 2 月 25 日更新中引入。

af1db5333655e4178c2e5af8484b6d4407f0987f.source: Completing this quest unlocks access to the Piken Square (pre-Searing) outpost.
af1db5333655e4178c2e5af8484b6d4407f0987f.text: 完成此任务即可解锁皮肯广场（灼热前）前哨站。

f87dc76c85c37dd08054aa11818e6c294f455efa.source: Players who have completed this quest can also ferry players to the outpost.
f87dc76c85c37dd08054aa11818e6c294f455efa.text: 完成该任务的玩家还可以将玩家运送到前哨站。

889c3f539bac510f8550622a01af7cb1178e6ba5.source: You do not need to turn in Across the Wall to get this quest. After leading Ben Wolfson to the exit, simply zone into Lakeside County, wait for Ben to finish his two dialogs, and then accept the quest. Once the new quest is taken, you are free to go back to an outpost and abandon Across the Wall.
889c3f539bac510f8550622a01af7cb1178e6ba5.text: 你不需要上交“跨越长城”来完成这个任务。在带领本·沃尔夫森到达出口后，只需进入湖滨县，等待本完成他的两个对话，然后接受任务。一旦完成新的任务，你就可以自由地返回前哨站并放弃“跨越长城”。

664dc3ccbf137d99027c785fa25fb5b00d10dd93.source: Other players in the party can also take the quest from Ben Wolfson regardless of their advancement of Across the Wall.
664dc3ccbf137d99027c785fa25fb5b00d10dd93.text: 队伍中的其他玩家也可以接受本·沃尔夫森的任务，无论他们的跨墙进度如何。

1f0a29f960f00171122789b1db9f9d97e665ac21.source: If any player has Across the Wall active in their quest log, the quest NPCs for A Bastion In the North will not appear in the Northlands.
1f0a29f960f00171122789b1db9f9d97e665ac21.text: 如果任何玩家的任务日志中激活了“跨越长城”，北方堡垒的任务 NPC 将不会出现在北地。

e640e24b459f613884f50d695916013e0f9543e3.source: If a party enters the Northlands from Piken Square with this quest active, at least one party member must reach Devona at the gate to Lakeside County before the four Charr groups in the square will spawn.
e640e24b459f613884f50d695916013e0f9543e3.text: 如果一支队伍从皮肯广场进入北地并激活此任务，则至少有一名队伍成员必须在广场上的四个夏尔团体出现之前到达湖滨县门口的德沃纳。

73159c9e0a640638c1b72bd3135fc26ea8e25141.source: Devona will speak her line "There's the square!" almost immediately after she is reached.
73159c9e0a640638c1b72bd3135fc26ea8e25141.text: 德沃娜将说出她的台词“那就是广场！”几乎是在到达她身边后立即。

0a657fef79d42031f4f77eee4783e468456ac88a.source: Reforged mode is only necessary to start the quest. If you opt out of reforged mode using the Shrine to Godly Accoutrements, the quest will still be in your quest log, the quest NPCs will still spawn and the quest can be progressed normally.
0a657fef79d42031f4f77eee4783e468456ac88a.text: 重铸模式只需要开始任务即可。如果您选择使用神殿装备退出重铸模式，该任务仍将出现在您的任务日志中，任务 NPC 仍会生成并且任务可以正常进行。

a1b82de8bc8318734001647f25bf5f10e7c863e0.source: "In" in the quest title is in upper case, which is inconsistent with other quests (e.g. Fire in the Sky, Fire in the Hole)
a1b82de8bc8318734001647f25bf5f10e7c863e0.text: 任务标题中的“In”是大写的，这与其他任务不一致（例如Fire in the Sky、Fire in the Hole）

1b4a506ee1a7fa306a3a2c5800bccb80c794e552.source: Find out what has become of Tirzah's beloved Chebar in the Salt Flats.
1b4a506ee1a7fa306a3a2c5800bccb80c794e552.text: 了解提尔扎 (Tirzah) 心爱的切巴尔 (Chebar) 在盐滩的遭遇。

4059cbd87461d37e6867a483b381ac1e93b66b46.source: Take the silver ring to Tirzah.

c075f9295b69565190c00f3cda51ffdf194cb57f.source: Starting from Seeker's Passage, go southeast until you go through a narrow channel, then round the wall to your left and up another narrow channel with wooden plank steps and platforms. You will reach Chebar, the objective of this quest, at the top of the channel beside the teleporter.
c075f9295b69565190c00f3cda51ffdf194cb57f.text: 从探索者通道开始，向东南走，直到穿过一条狭窄的通道，然后绕过左侧的墙壁，爬上另一条带有木板台阶和平台的狭窄通道。您将到达该任务的目标切巴尔（Chebar），位于通道顶部传送器旁边。

60ef5a058bbde45f9d3c49cff1b2b61c4c6b4dec.source: Alternatively, you can travel around the north side of the wall, through some narrow channels and around to the south, reaching Chebar by using the teleporter from the other side. Both routes are approximately the same length, but you may need to move more carefully to avoid wandering hydra on the northern path.
60ef5a058bbde45f9d3c49cff1b2b61c4c6b4dec.text: 或者，你可以绕着城墙的北侧移动，穿过一些狭窄的通道，然后绕到南边，从另一侧使用传送器到达切巴尔。两条路线的长度大致相同，但您可能需要更加小心地移动，以避免在北部路径上徘徊的九头蛇。

febe2d385f82c85b52f8c2ba7f37da1129d2f957.source: If you are fighting enemies along the way, take it slowly. You will encounter Rockshot Devourers, Jade Scarabs and a pretty large number of Storm Kin. The Storm Kin patrol in small groups but can move very quickly along their patrol routes, so it is easy to aggro more than you would like.
febe2d385f82c85b52f8c2ba7f37da1129d2f957.text: 如果你一路上与敌人战斗，慢慢来。你会遇到岩弹吞噬者、翡翠圣甲虫和大量的风暴近亲。风暴亲属以小群形式巡逻，但可以沿着巡逻路线快速移动，因此很容易引起比你想要的更多的仇恨。

3ddb3627ae4c35d181e757f50c3810217c1a7b70.source: It is also possible to simply run to Chebar, even without a running skill, going headlong through the groups of enemies. Hire a full party of henchmen and let them serve as distractions. Assuming you don't trigger any traps, the most dangerous thing you'll face is constant Health degeneration from Conjure Phantasm and Parasitic Bond, but this is unlikely to be fatal as the run is not a very long distance. If you choose to bring a self-healing skill, be aware that the Rockshot Devourers use Distracting Shot.
3ddb3627ae4c35d181e757f50c3810217c1a7b70.text: 即使没有奔跑技能，也可以简单地跑到切巴尔，一头扎进敌人群中。雇佣一整队的追随者，让他们分散注意力。假设你没有触发任何陷阱，你将面临的最危险的事情是召唤幻象和寄生债券造成的持续健康退化，但这不太可能是致命的，因为跑步的距离不是很长。如果您选择携带自我治疗技能，请注意岩弹吞噬者会使用分散射击。

2b6d5c9a7830994ab05f81197d683dea095995e9.source: The quests Ancient Secrets and The Ranger's Path lead to nearby places in the Salt Flats, on the far side of the teleporter from where Chebar is found, so doing these quests together can save time.
2b6d5c9a7830994ab05f81197d683dea095995e9.text: 任务“古代秘密”和“游侠之路”会通往盐滩附近的地方，位于发现切巴尔的传送器的远端，因此一起完成这些任务可以节省时间。

12ba2829771b78ad6dcf5513c787088e917e9995.source: Speak with Herder Tsiyingju about getting treated hides.
12ba2829771b78ad6dcf5513c787088e917e9995.text: 与 Herder Tsiyingju 讨论如何处理生皮。

f8f7a44dd408cc75e992743ba1411cf7064aa7d4.source: Destroy the group of Crimson Skull plaguing Kaitan Village.
f8f7a44dd408cc75e992743ba1411cf7064aa7d4.text: 消灭困扰凯坦村的红骷髅大军。

ec0b474f2359e29c90eb97bb0e93536ced26b44f.source: See Neing the Tanner for your reward.
ec0b474f2359e29c90eb97bb0e93536ced26b44f.text: 前往 Neing the Tanner 领取奖励。

47a0d57b92fcc4314bc4686c7aedfd59d965555e.source: If you don't have Tsumei Village on your map, exit Shing Jea Monastery into Sunqua Vale, and follow the westward leading road. If you already have Tsumei Village on your map you can simply map-travel to it.
47a0d57b92fcc4314bc4686c7aedfd59d965555e.text: 如果您的地图上没有 Tsumei Village，请从 Shing Jea Monastery 出来进入 Sunqua Vale，然后沿着向西的主路行驶。如果您的地图上已经有津名村，您可以简单地通过地图旅行前往那里。

45b27f0b73818ff1ff63aeeebd97fbab96924733.source: From Tsumei Village exit into Panjiang Peninsula. Follow the quest marker to Herder Tsiyingju and talk to her. She will then send you off to fight and kill a group of 4 Crimson Skull. Follow the quest marker again to the nearby Crimson Skull. Killing the Ritualist and the Mender before the other foes will make the fight significantly easier. Return to Herder Tsiyingju to collect the Treated Hides (they will appear in your inventory). Map-travel back to Shing Jea Monastery to collect your reward.
45b27f0b73818ff1ff63aeeebd97fbab96924733.text: 从津名村出口进入盘江半岛。跟随任务标记找到牧者齐英居并与她交谈。然后她会派你去战斗并杀死一群 4 个猩红骷髅。再次跟随任务标记到达附近的猩红骷髅。在其他敌人之前杀死仪式者和治愈者将使战斗变得更加容易。返回牧民 Tsiyingju 处收集经过处理的兽皮（它们将出现在您的库存中）。地图-返回Shing Jea寺以领取你的奖励。

3378eccbce4db7890d84066230f75f5fbca481b6.source: If you have the quest The Siege at Tsumei Village active, you cannot complete this quest.
3378eccbce4db7890d84066230f75f5fbca481b6.text: 如果您激活了围攻津名村的任务，则无法完成该任务。

62cc7a84bb722d490ffcabd188c8b72b33779ddf.source: Verify if the Tomb of Saevio Proelium is intact.
62cc7a84bb722d490ffcabd188c8b72b33779ddf.text: 验证 Saevio Proelium 之墓是否完好无损。

785c116a704940558b533c6146cdaef0ef3f5a20.source: The tomb has been breached! The Order of Whispers must know right away!
785c116a704940558b533c6146cdaef0ef3f5a20.text: 坟墓被攻破了！低语教团必须立刻知道！

c999f25a216f308087e6f4df6cfd324182f147f2.source: See Whispers Acolyte for your reward.
c999f25a216f308087e6f4df6cfd324182f147f2.text: 请参阅低语侍僧以获得奖励。

55ffebfde7659c799576814ce9f85359fcf40454.source: Verify the Tomb of Saevio Proelium has been breached at the Monument to the Defeat of Palawa Joko in Jahai Bluffs, just outside the Command Post entrance to the zone. Report to Whispers Acolyte at the Chantry of Secrets for your reward.
55ffebfde7659c799576814ce9f85359fcf40454.text: 确认 Jahai Bluffs 的 Palawa Joko 战败纪念碑上的 Saevio Proelium 墓已被攻破，该纪念碑位于该区域指挥所入口外。向秘密教堂的低语侍僧报到以获得奖励。

f04156c2a96460be53438b07aadce4b60cfb6632.source: Find Yera Swiftsight in the Sunward Marches and ask him about the corrupted plants.
f04156c2a96460be53438b07aadce4b60cfb6632.text: 在向阳边疆找到耶拉·迅视，向他询问腐化植物的情况。

0af712a15d3628660044850b342638b8f3d270c9.source: Examine 10...0 more suspicious shrubs for signs of corruption.
0af712a15d3628660044850b342638b8f3d270c9.text: 检查另外 10...0 个可疑灌木是否有腐败迹象。

1e7bcc81650fb9766be5a2d956aaba3c49eaa5de.source: Report your findings to Mirza Veldrunner in Turai's Procession.
1e7bcc81650fb9766be5a2d956aaba3c49eaa5de.text: 向图莱队伍中的米尔扎·维德伦纳报告你的发现。

a523ad1818becea0b4cdcb771c18a4fac94d6b63.source: Start from Venta Cemetery and speak to Yera Swiftsight just outside. Yera will direct you to investigate 10 Suspicious Shrubs in the Sunward Marches, simply follow your quest pointer to each one. To examine the shrubs, click on them as if you are trying to pick it up.
a523ad1818becea0b4cdcb771c18a4fac94d6b63.text: 从文塔公墓出发，与外面的耶拉·斯威夫特塞交谈。耶拉将引导你调查向阳行进中的 10 个可疑灌木，只需按照你的任务指针找到每一个即可。要检查灌木，请单击它们，就像您试图将其捡起一样。

1d3a288581f5dd01969542e91a3818752d2633ec.source: At any suspicious shrubs which display the "dark aura" dialogue (see below), a pack of Vicious Seedlings will popup and attack the party.
1d3a288581f5dd01969542e91a3818752d2633ec.text: 在任何显示“黑暗光环”对话的可疑灌木处（见下文），一群邪恶幼苗将会弹出并攻击队伍。

5fdd39df65b19a32ece91030d8aa79a769318c17.source: After examining 10 bushes, return to Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.
5fdd39df65b19a32ece91030d8aa79a769318c17.text: 检查完 10 个灌木丛后，返回米尔扎·维德行者那里领取奖励。

2acbc8c41646b3e2c038c6a75bd8ea3e4f1453a1.source: Reiko's speech is reduced considerably in the hard mode version.
2acbc8c41646b3e2c038c6a75bd8ea3e4f1453a1.text: 在困难模式版本中，玲子的讲话被大大减少。

05d4fb973e7806cd41cf0fa87d7f6d029d49e453.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: mesmer
05d4fb973e7806cd41cf0fa87d7f6d029d49e453.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：催眠师

df0605c61b3ccaabb7cb97dfc35bec81046ce10d.source: Return to Vassar for your reward.

02f8e1627eca93addc34ac4db5a3a81a9e36f455.source: Go north after exiting the Sanitarium. Nente is standing next to the Statue of Balthazar, where the portal into Green Hills County used to be.
02f8e1627eca93addc34ac4db5a3a81a9e36f455.text: 出了疗养院后向北走。南特 (Nente) 矗立在巴尔萨扎 (Balthazar) 雕像旁边，那里曾经是通往格林希尔斯县 (Green Hills County) 的门户。

518d42d4418e4ac93d2ad339ebc52c7549ba7d11.source: Keep an eye on the monument while Vadben gets his tools.
518d42d4418e4ac93d2ad339ebc52c7549ba7d11.text: 瓦德本拿起工具时，请留意纪念碑。

0ad209eec51ee4b2196032f4e0cd4fdff6b9e860.source: This quest can be hard for low level players in a small group (four or less). Since it is not a primary quest but optional, wait until you are stronger or have other outposts available such as Beknur Harbor. Doing this quest from Beknur Harbor is advantageous as you can bring a party of eight from there, and the henchmen are level 12 rendering the challenge safer and simple.
0ad209eec51ee4b2196032f4e0cd4fdff6b9e860.text: 对于小团体（四人或更少）中的低等级玩家来说，此任务可能会很困难。由于它不是主要任务而是可选任务，请等到您变得更强或有其他可用的前哨站（例如贝克努尔港）。从贝克努尔港做这个任务是有利的，因为你可以从那里带一个八人小队，而且追随者等级为 12，使得挑战更安全、更简单。

dc0a9259435f05853cbebaa59601121f03c4c990.source: Make sure to pick up the Skale Hunt bounty from outside either Beknur Harbor or Champion's Dawn for the additional sunspear reputation points.
dc0a9259435f05853cbebaa59601121f03c4c990.text: 确保从贝克努尔港或冠军黎明之外领取斯凯尔狩猎赏金，以获得额外的阳矛声望点。

9cca00b4c2fcb9074950799f1ea502235a321f9f.source: The quest tells you to "protect" a monument but there is no "health" bar that degenerates per skale attack nor a countdown timer that tells you when Vadben will be back. Instead, the quest is about remaining alive after several waves of skales spawn near the monument, starting from a group of level 4 skales up to a group of level 13 and 14 skales. The frequency of each new group of skales is fast, so be sure to finish the waves off quickly before a new one arrives to prevent becoming outnumbered.
9cca00b4c2fcb9074950799f1ea502235a321f9f.text: 该任务告诉你“保护”一座纪念碑，但没有每次斯卡莱攻击都会退化的“健康”条，也没有倒计时器告诉你瓦德本何时会回来。相反，任务是在纪念碑附近出现几波 skales 后保持活力，从一组 4 级 skales 到一组 13 和 14 级 skales。每组新的骷髅出现的频率都很快，所以一定要在新的骷髅到来之前快速完成一波波的攻击，以免寡不敌众。

d1abe81cdd9bbae21c4ee82441e32779cb74e6dd.source: The quest Queen of the Quarry provides some additional Sunspear guards that can double the party size and make the defense much easier. M.O.X. and/or Mercenary Heroes could also assist as level 20 allies.
d1abe81cdd9bbae21c4ee82441e32779cb74e6dd.text: 任务“采石场女王”提供了一些额外的烈阳之矛守卫，可以使队伍规模加倍并使防御变得更加容易。 M.O.X.和/或雇佣英雄也可以作为 20 级盟友提供协助。

8f7651821a55de03d9763d18485594872db880ee.source: It is possible to talk to Vadben to accept your reward before all of the enemies in the area are entirely defeated.
8f7651821a55de03d9763d18485594872db880ee.text: 在该地区的所有敌人被完全击败之前，可以与瓦德本交谈以接受你的奖励。

aa2730a0a0e60578970412ea13d83f42e3b34479.source: Save Farmer Foneng from the corsairs.
aa2730a0a0e60578970412ea13d83f42e3b34479.text: 从海盗手中拯救农民弗能。

b3385f556c5757e69925e212336ccf9501022193.source: Get a sack of grain from Farmer Foneng for Scholar Chago.
b3385f556c5757e69925e212336ccf9501022193.text: 从农民 Foneng 处为学者 Chago 获取一袋谷物。

e011106174fe54c713651785b75093be1930262e.source: See Scholar Chago for your reward.
e011106174fe54c713651785b75093be1930262e.text: 去找学者查戈领取奖励。

e5b53f7f2881186f44c1efc9f2417a1a14411004.source: Map to Kodlonu Hamlet. Travel into Issnur Isles and head west towards the small gathering of people. As you approach Farmer Foneng, a small group of corsairs will spawn. Take out the group of corsairs, and speak with Farmer Foneng afterward to receive the sack of grain.
e5b53f7f2881186f44c1efc9f2417a1a14411004.text: 前往科德洛努哈姆雷特的地图。前往伊斯努尔群岛并向西前往一小群人的聚集地。当您接近 Farmer Foneng 时，一小群海盗将会生成。干掉这群海盗，然后与农民佛能交谈，领取一袋谷物。

dc581e212bff433f732b28c73cd69b49c6f3b0a8.source: Travel back to the Astralarium to receive your reward from Scholar Chago.
dc581e212bff433f732b28c73cd69b49c6f3b0a8.text: 返回星体馆，从学者查戈那里领取奖励。

b13303aa2471e76cb9239da514a59076b6fa3d8d.source: Defeat the Lady of the Dead and free the soul of Sinni's father.
b13303aa2471e76cb9239da514a59076b6fa3d8d.text: 击败亡灵女士并释放辛尼父亲的灵魂。

a9971fe03bf2f37bc2e4d6e7dddf5f316927bf55.source: Venture south of Sinni's village to find the Ancient Remains. Activate the altar to summon the Lady of the Dead, and defeat her to complete the quest. Low-level parties should spread out when fighting, as the Lady is a dervish and can deal a lot of AoE damage with her attacks.
a9971fe03bf2f37bc2e4d6e7dddf5f316927bf55.text: 前往辛尼村以南探索远古遗迹。激活祭坛召唤亡灵女士，并击败她来完成任务。低等级队伍在战斗时应该分散开来，因为这位女士是一名苦行僧，她的攻击可以造成大量 AoE 伤害。

5991805f5b4d8fad5be5769ac832501e28259599.source: Free the other Orrian spirits from the Leech Tunnels. You have rescued [0...3] of 3 spirits.
5991805f5b4d8fad5be5769ac832501e28259599.text: 将其他奥里安灵魂从水蛭隧道中释放出来。您已拯救了 3 个灵魂中的 [0...3] 个。

9f8f5b0f3da15d4165aa5dd9a9bbf6f3fd336b9e.source: Lead Orrian Spirit Gildran to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels.
9f8f5b0f3da15d4165aa5dd9a9bbf6f3fd336b9e.text: 带领奥里安灵魂吉尔德兰到达水蛭隧道的入口。

0878d687b3124eebb3023d4c6b6a0f0c9fd4f24f.source: Lead Orrian Spirit Minos to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels.
0878d687b3124eebb3023d4c6b6a0f0c9fd4f24f.text: 带领奥里安灵魂米诺斯到达水蛭隧道的入口。

86696c22cf4b3f1c0294be150e2824b78f6b8949.source: Lead Orrian Spirit Kandril to the entrance of the Leech Tunnels.
86696c22cf4b3f1c0294be150e2824b78f6b8949.text: 带领奥里安灵魂坎德里尔到达水蛭隧道的入口。

be767ebb41782cff7705f5ad86b18cb588a0b6e0.source: See Wandering Soul for your reward.
be767ebb41782cff7705f5ad86b18cb588a0b6e0.text: 请参阅《流浪灵魂》以获得奖励。

fdcd18d80333fc6eb97770cb3ff68b1058650f4d.source: Following on from the previous quest, head to each of the three markers to find different groups of stationary awaiting torment creatures. Orrian Spirit Minos also has some awaiting titans. The Orrian spirits cannot be attacked and so you don't need to worry about them.
fdcd18d80333fc6eb97770cb3ff68b1058650f4d.text: 继上一个任务之后，前往三个标记中的每一个，找到不同组的静止等待折磨的生物。奥里安精神米诺斯也有一些等待的泰坦。奥里安灵魂无法被攻击，所以你不需要担心他们。

30a49c0485b58e03b7e68291505307f4387dcb52.source: After saving all three spirits, head to where you picked up the previous quest - the resurrection shrine at the entrance to the Leech Tunnels.
30a49c0485b58e03b7e68291505307f4387dcb52.text: 拯救了所有三个灵魂后，前往您接受上一个任务的地方 - 水蛭隧道入口处的复活神殿。

3c920dd90a219e9ba3ceffe2781d118afe4df6c5.source: As the spirits are capable of body blocking characters, there may be a little trouble moving through the narrow Leech Tunnels.
3c920dd90a219e9ba3ceffe2781d118afe4df6c5.text: 由于灵魂能够阻挡角色的身体，因此在狭窄的水蛭隧道中移动可能会遇到一些麻烦。

0e2913227edb7856f820fbbe679715305d45f8fd.source: Defeat the demons blocking the path to the Titan. 4...0 groups remain.
0e2913227edb7856f820fbbe679715305d45f8fd.text: 击败阻挡通往泰坦之路的恶魔。剩余 4...0 组。

54ed09d03769bd4e6e714bb7d8daf91b70f625c2.source: Seek council with the Titan, Ignis Cruor.
54ed09d03769bd4e6e714bb7d8daf91b70f625c2.text: 寻求泰坦伊格尼斯·克鲁尔的建议。

3284415d20513cf6c51a9343f217d69679acaf28.source: See Scorch Emberspire for your reward.
3284415d20513cf6c51a9343f217d69679acaf28.text: 前往 Scorch Emberspire 获取奖励。

6b3c62c48434d2571e3a8311971df560a64937ac.source: After exiting the Gate of Secrets to the Domain of Secrets, follow the quest marker west and clear the groups as marked on the map. If you have the quest Escape from the Torment, you might run into the Margonite ambush from that quest along the way.
6b3c62c48434d2571e3a8311971df560a64937ac.text: 离开秘密之门到达秘密领域后，沿着任务标记向西走，清除地图上标记的队伍。如果你有任务“逃离折磨”，你可能会在途中遇到玛贡尼特的伏击。

228d24c9be3c6754edec260cb9a0dc9c4d5470ff.source: After defeating the demon groups, you will be able to approach the titan boss, Ignis Cruor. He will remain green until you walk past him, then suddenly turn hostile. He is a high level elementalist who hits very hard, so be ready with interrupts. Two Titan Abominations behind him will come to his aid. If you came from the other side you will be able to finish them off first.
228d24c9be3c6754edec260cb9a0dc9c4d5470ff.text: 击败恶魔群后，你将能够接近泰坦老大伊格尼斯·克鲁尔。他会一直保持绿色，直到你从他身边走过，然后突然变得充满敌意。他是一名高级元素师，攻击力非常猛烈，所以要做好被打断的准备。他身后的两只泰坦憎恶会来帮助他。如果你来自另一边，你就能先解决掉他们。

1bbb4d08c562c389300ba04724dd86eb42563c93.source: Combines well with Escape from the Torment.

45e78ec52ce2d89b49e18fcd49268f808996a46e.source: Despite the quest instructions, it is not necessary to kill the four groups of demons. If you avoid them by taking alternate paths, the quest will still update when you reach Ignis Cruor, and will be marked as completed as soon as the titan dies.
45e78ec52ce2d89b49e18fcd49268f808996a46e.text: 尽管有任务指示，但并没有必要杀死四群恶魔。如果你通过采取替代路径来避开它们，当你到达伊格尼斯·克鲁尔时任务仍然会更新，并且一旦泰坦死亡就会被标记为已完成。

8b309048bfe54db70bfb553b8ecc52217e6d3e6a.source: Visit Ruthless Sevad to collect Koss's winnings.
8b309048bfe54db70bfb553b8ecc52217e6d3e6a.text: 拜访无情的塞瓦德，领取科斯的奖金。

d1d1829ff52bb24b4645092be7ae9cfdaa840848.source: Find Jerob No-Spine on the Barbarous Shore and inquire about his debt to Ruthless Sevad.
d1d1829ff52bb24b4645092be7ae9cfdaa840848.text: 在野蛮海岸找到杰罗布·无脊椎，询问他欠无情塞瓦德的债。

47550cb9e3c9c767167cae179d2bcb574e3d3090.source: Seek Ruthless Sevad's loot keeper and slay it to free the treasure.
47550cb9e3c9c767167cae179d2bcb574e3d3090.text: 寻找无情的塞瓦德的战利品守护者并杀死他以释放宝藏。

4a3e90d4f402ba57636d15d50cc09859054b8280.source: Give Ruthless Sevad 5 Tarnished Platinum Coins.
4a3e90d4f402ba57636d15d50cc09859054b8280.text: 给无情的塞瓦德 5 个失去光泽的白金币。

a5110939004a8303df0aa17600005502ea71984b.source: This is a fairly interesting quest, since the point at which players receive it, they are unlikely to have ventured very far east, so following this quest can provide a great opportunity for exploration.
a5110939004a8303df0aa17600005502ea71984b.text: 这是一个相当有趣的任务，因为当玩家收到它时，他们不太可能冒险到很远的东方，所以跟随这个任务可以提供一个很好的探索机会。

dcfe9d5b627cc9d5991a45087ab2430a74da818b.source: Potentially there are two routes to take from the Command Post:
dcfe9d5b627cc9d5991a45087ab2430a74da818b.text: 从指挥所出发可能有两条路线：

f8a20f0e19897dc1582f55da865570b50adbf9d8.text: Arkjok 区 -> Pogahn 通道，或

433acafe07df0f3f7b1d88d3ed75431155849e8c.text: 贾海悬崖 -> 科多努尔十字路口，

f7286f818eeac7e639378aac7201acdd4dc6c547.source: both of which then lead into Dejarin Estate -> Camp Hojanu -> Barbarous Shore. Alternatively, hold the quest until the primary storyline takes you to one of Pogahn Passage or Kodonur Crossroads.
f7286f818eeac7e639378aac7201acdd4dc6c547.text: 两条路都通向 Dejarin Estate -> Camp Hojanu -> Barbarous Shore。或者，继续执行任务，直到主要故事情节将您带到波加恩通道或科多努尔十字路口之一。

ede873e9d4d808d4e4fe2cf5cf7e54e8724ead94.source: This quest fits right in with The Foolhardy Father since both have you talk with Ruthless Sevad.
ede873e9d4d808d4e4fe2cf5cf7e54e8724ead94.text: 这个任务非常适合愚勇父亲，因为两者都让你与无情的塞瓦德交谈。

3eebbdefed5f382bb852529c194ac3baac25d3cb.source: If a player with at least 51 platinum talking to Ruthless Sevad selects the "Thief! Here's your five platinum..." option but hasn't clicked the following "Here's the money..." option, the player can drop all of their gold on the ground, click the "Here's the money..." option, and pick their gold back up to skip to the reward objective without actually paying the 51 platinum.
3eebbdefed5f382bb852529c194ac3baac25d3cb.text: 如果与无情塞瓦德交谈的至少 51 白金的玩家选择“小偷！这是你的 5 白金...”选项，但没有单击下面的“这是钱...”选项，则玩家可以将所有金币扔在地上，单击“这是钱...”选项，然后捡起他们的金币以跳到奖励目标，而无需实际支付 51 白金。

c0e00f26f2c585680cf463e5e868daa0b43bda26.source: Although Koss says he won the debt collection ticket from Megundeh, you can accept the quest before getting him as a rune trader for the command post.
c0e00f26f2c585680cf463e5e868daa0b43bda26.text: 尽管科斯说他从梅根德那里赢得了追债票，但你可以在让他成为指挥所的符文商人之前接受任务。

21bfff9b6b234b605a0834cd512ec63441984763.source:
* Elonian (Nightfall) character
* Never Fight Alone neither active nor completed
21bfff9b6b234b605a0834cd512ec63441984763.text:
* Elonian（夜幕降临）角色
* 永不孤军奋战，既不活跃也不完成

f873adb1b440131f2ea8d01949b9e18229b0c9fc.source: Add a henchman to your party and meet Kina in the Plains of Jarin.
f873adb1b440131f2ea8d01949b9e18229b0c9fc.text: 在你的队伍中添加一名追随者，并在贾林平原与基娜会面。

e92cbfa39f55241daecd58e7ca6578ae5860ba20.source: Destroy the Asura Gate in the temple near Raven's Point.
e92cbfa39f55241daecd58e7ca6578ae5860ba20.text: 摧毁乌鸦角附近寺庙中的阿修罗门。

d6c27d3ed5508d5d4c338059211eca0b9682080c.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
d6c27d3ed5508d5d4c338059211eca0b9682080c.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下完成任务。

aa40394f0da5d9aa38def5e92601c1b6ef276a08.source: See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

5d38ab2e72d04c6e6b1e6001c731c45722b31a52.source: Complete the Base Objective for 40 Zaishen Copper Coins.
5d38ab2e72d04c6e6b1e6001c731c45722b31a52.text: 完成 40 个再神铜币的基本目标。

27d6e9567a8d03be010a9bc79dd3fd2467712675.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.
27d6e9567a8d03be010a9bc79dd3fd2467712675.text: 完成*奖励*目标可获得额外 100 个再神铜币。

75488f1b6b0e0f366a7afa0422ceb8ed84dba16e.source: As per A Gate Too Far.

e4ac8311e128e849da7af7636c99b001ed5be18f.source: Hunt down Wianuyo to bring peace to the ghost of Sehwanu
e4ac8311e128e849da7af7636c99b001ed5be18f.text: 追捕 Wianuyo 为 Sehwanu 的幽灵带来和平

a1d1c51ac480f7c0ea8e529c50be0ed3b88aa1f6.text: 前往 Sehwanu 领取奖励

93553378fae8c59c05bb088b37d7e41bcaf2b7fa.source:
The Ghost of Sehwanu spawns randomly — empirically at a rate of roughly 5% (i.e. about one time in twenty). When she does spawn, she will be staring out to sea on the beach behind Bloodback Morrob and his cultists.
She is guaranteed to spawn for any member of the party due to receive the reward after killing Wianuyo - this can remove the random element of her spawning for picking up the quest.
93553378fae8c59c05bb088b37d7e41bcaf2b7fa.text:
塞瓦努之魂随机生成——根据经验，生成率约为 5%（即大约二十分之一）。当她产卵时，她会在血背莫罗布和他的信徒身后的海滩上凝视大海。
由于在杀死 Wianuyo 后获得奖励，她保证会为队伍中的任何成员生成 - 这可以消除她在接任务时生成的随机元素。

6da64860a2d533273595247c822b74b5c022ccc0.source: Wianuyo himself is on the south-eastern edge of Lahtenda Bog, near a lagoon.
6da64860a2d533273595247c822b74b5c022ccc0.text: Wianuyo 本人位于拉滕达沼泽的东南边缘，靠近泻湖。

50f01130acc68116d7c50494506d1bfadeee305a.source: Enter Lahtenda Bog through Blacktide Den, making your way through the lagoon to the quest marker. The enemies encountered are the local insects and the two quest related corsair groups around Wianuyo. Consider luring some Corsairs away from the other group of Corsairs to make them easier to pick off.
50f01130acc68116d7c50494506d1bfadeee305a.text: 通过黑潮巢穴进入拉滕达沼泽，穿过泻湖到达任务标记。遇到的敌人是当地的昆虫和威亚努约周围的两个与任务相关的海盗团。考虑引诱一些海盗远离另一群海盗，以便更容易消灭他们。

e4dd49bbab4e6129313c1f6da444efb4cc0f35c0.source: Your party may wish to consider bringing condition removal since the area is rife with poison, disease and the other conditions. Also consider bringing weakness since a lot of the foes encountered are either melee or attacking with bows and spears.
e4dd49bbab4e6129313c1f6da444efb4cc0f35c0.text: 你的队伍可能希望考虑去除条件，因为该地区充满了毒物、疾病和其他条件。还要考虑带来弱点，因为遇到的许多敌人要么是近战，要么是用弓和矛攻击。

643c75023551ac3e5b571ff5c248a4aeb26e5baa.source: Wianuyo himself is a renamed Corsair Seer and will be no challenge for a coordinated group.
643c75023551ac3e5b571ff5c248a4aeb26e5baa.text: 维阿努约本人是一名更名为“海盗船先知”的人，对于协调一致的团队来说不会构成任何挑战。

5c7f4faab799efd157a2e97a4b9821823bdcd1d9.source: Map back to Kodlonu Hamlet and travel to Sehwanu again for your reward.
5c7f4faab799efd157a2e97a4b9821823bdcd1d9.text: 地图返回科德洛努哈姆雷特，然后再次前往塞瓦努以获得奖励。

742ba083267c4f5dd3a87780d752b89fa09d845e.source: Charr at the Gate not active

5fd63832f2e0dd64ba1e2389d5a5b795af8bc8a8.source: Prince Rurik and Captain Osric have finished conversing
5fd63832f2e0dd64ba1e2389d5a5b795af8bc8a8.text: 鲁里克王子和奥斯里克船长已经结束对话

a9012081c066f25b430dba88d3981a0b8a599d72.source: Find the perfect gift for Lady Althea. It must be something beautiful.
a9012081c066f25b430dba88d3981a0b8a599d72.text: 寻找送给 Althea 女士的完美礼物。它一定是美丽的东西。

7c8bb7f71a595974a68e6fba1b168c8352a194e9.source: Give the Beautiful Feather to Captain Osric.
7c8bb7f71a595974a68e6fba1b168c8352a194e9.text: 将美丽的羽毛交给奥斯里克队长。

ccf82c32e95e90ad54296d6c0e6b852cddc224b6.source: Give the Beautiful Pearl to Captain Osric.
ccf82c32e95e90ad54296d6c0e6b852cddc224b6.text: 将美丽的珍珠交给奥斯里克船长。

5b3bad5767a6c7b9f9a1c0ca72c79880377cdadc.source: Give the Beautiful Pendant to Captain Osric.
5b3bad5767a6c7b9f9a1c0ca72c79880377cdadc.text: 将美丽的吊坠交给奥斯里克船长。

ec475d448d7c3a6868cb9099f9a946daa88c7049.source: Return to Captain Osric for your reward.
ec475d448d7c3a6868cb9099f9a946daa88c7049.text: 返回奥斯里克队长那里领取奖励。

3c5b0ac89edf38c5e99f25b9ea6d40f00ba37e87.source: Upon accepting the quest, Prince Rurik will no longer spawn next to the city walls with Captain Osric.
3c5b0ac89edf38c5e99f25b9ea6d40f00ba37e87.text: 接受任务后，鲁里克王子将不再与奥斯里克队长一起出现在城墙旁边。

b747713908852c8a69799b3d7fdc16df8a72cbc3.source: To trigger the quest, first listen to a conversation between Prince Rurik and Captain Osric that takes place just west of the Ascalon City portal, on the path toward the Actors' Stage. When they finish, talk to Osric to accept the quest. You can collect all of the three beautiful items at any time.
b747713908852c8a69799b3d7fdc16df8a72cbc3.text: 要触发任务，首先要听一下鲁里克王子和奥斯里克队长之间的对话，对话发生在阿斯卡隆城门户以西，通往演员舞台的路上。当他们完成后，与奥斯里克交谈以接受任务。您可以随时收集所有三件精美物品。

7a6b241a1d687fa64ebd5b8459a89737363a6cab.source: All three items are located in Lakeside County:
7a6b241a1d687fa64ebd5b8459a89737363a6cab.text: 所有三个项目均位于湖滨县：

8ff8abc1457bde4a061d99f460108a39664012cd.source: The Beautiful Feather can be found on a fenced-in hill in the center of Ashford.
8ff8abc1457bde4a061d99f460108a39664012cd.text: 美丽的羽毛位于阿什福德中心一座用栅栏围起来的山上。

23bced08210e8e7461627c3aa1536886078b8953.source: The Beautiful Pearl is hidden inside a Beautiful Shell near the watermill.
23bced08210e8e7461627c3aa1536886078b8953.text: 美丽的珍珠隐藏在水磨附近的美丽贝壳内。

1d686657652e0a03bf96891c78f7cc59d50b100a.source: The Beautiful Pendant is in a chest in a mountain pass, northeast of the bandit camp above Ashford Abbey.
1d686657652e0a03bf96891c78f7cc59d50b100a.text: 美丽的吊坠位于阿什福德修道院上方强盗营地东北部山口的一个箱子里。

77c9b0d1532441ed86b66ba7285c54f29af99eae.source: There are two ways to complete the quest, neither of which alters the storyline:
77c9b0d1532441ed86b66ba7285c54f29af99eae.text: 有两种方法可以完成任务，这两种方法都不会改变故事情节：

5763029df09cab7c5f0d94d71277e3e145be7119.source: Collect all three items:: Obtain all three items and return to Captain Osric. No matter the order you present them, he will fuss over and reject the first two before finally accepting the third, granting your reward. Regardless of the order you present them, he will reject the first two and select the third as the gift, allowing you to conclude the quest and obtain the reward. Or...
5763029df09cab7c5f0d94d71277e3e145be7119.text: 收集所有三件物品：：获得所有三件物品并返回给奥斯里克船长。无论你呈现的顺序如何，他都会大惊小怪并拒绝前两个，然后最终接受第三个，并给予你奖励。无论你以什么顺序呈现，他都会拒绝前两个并选择第三个作为礼物，让你完成任务并获得奖励。或者...

ace6cca554cf80f56a834df463c684f66d42b6dd.source: Speak with Althea: Collect any one of the items, then speak to Lady Althea in front of the Actors' Stage. She will accept the single beautiful item, concluding the quest and granting you the reward.
ace6cca554cf80f56a834df463c684f66d42b6dd.text: 与阿尔西娅交谈：收集任意一件物品，然后在演员舞台前与阿尔西娅女士交谈。她会接受一件漂亮的物品，完成​​任务并给你奖励。

2166298de4a3dd3346f21f4947e26496bf1ecef7.source: If you are carrying more than one of the items, Lady Althea will take all of them when completing the quest.
2166298de4a3dd3346f21f4947e26496bf1ecef7.text: 如果您携带超过一件物品，Althea 女士将在完成任务时带走所有物品。

997a54a47186de3724f26c55c53a7f361197f01c.source: Having Charr at the Gate active means the Beautiful Feather, the chest holding the Beautiful Pendant, and the Beautiful Shell do not spawn. Otherwise, even without A Gift for Althea active, all 3 will spawn.
997a54a47186de3724f26c55c53a7f361197f01c.text: 让夏尔在门口活跃意味着美丽的羽毛、装有美丽吊坠的箱子和美丽的贝壳不会生成。否则，即使没有激活《阿尔西娅的礼物》，所有 3 个都会生成。

a371c4fe2f2d7b8488d002e6c2908c7d4605a3bf.source: Similarly, having Charr at the Gate active makes it impossible to initiate this quest, since Osric and Rurik will not initiate their conversation about Althea. You can begin the quest once you re-zone and talk to Osric.
a371c4fe2f2d7b8488d002e6c2908c7d4605a3bf.text: 同样，让夏尔在门口处于活动状态使得无法启动此任务，因为奥斯里克和鲁里克不会启动他们关于阿尔西娅的对话。一旦你重新定位并与奥斯里克交谈，你就可以开始任务。

a0c36b87229fdeceb7e892329e3c6e70f3da61b9.source: Captain Osric's appearance and weapon during his conversation with Prince Rurik differ from those he has when he accepts the quest items.
a0c36b87229fdeceb7e892329e3c6e70f3da61b9.text: 奥斯里克队长在与鲁里克王子交谈时的外表和武器与他接受任务物品时的不同。

0414c923ad206cb97f7189b3ec51aeb2535ced97.source: Escort all three Forest Griffons safely to the Tower of Courage.
0414c923ad206cb97f7189b3ec51aeb2535ced97.text: 护送所有三只森林狮鹫安全到达勇气之塔。

cc217a4bd4c8ecb549ba9747f3c98c3bb66a22bf.source: See Rastigan the Eternal for your reward.
cc217a4bd4c8ecb549ba9747f3c98c3bb66a22bf.text: 去见永恒的拉斯蒂根以获得奖励。

bafa17051b9562f61712cef1912f28f89e715a2f.source: Upon accepting the quests, go near the griffons to get them to follow your team and then head back to where Rastigan the Eternal was (the Tower of Courage). There will be groups that appeared upon accepting the quest along the way, as seen in the map to the right. Be wary that the Forest Griffons can be killed easily and if just one dies the quest fails and the team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. Also, the griffons will follow moving party members in radar range.
bafa17051b9562f61712cef1912f28f89e715a2f.text: 接受任务后，靠近狮鹫，让它们跟随你的队伍，然后返回永恒拉斯蒂根所在的地方（勇气之塔）。沿途会出现一些接受任务后出现的队伍，如右图所示。请注意，森林狮鹫很容易被杀死，如果只有一只死亡，任务就会失败，团队将被从悲痛裂缝中踢出。此外，狮鹫将在雷达范围内跟踪移动的队伍成员。

dc0c1402e2c2de113cc121359c18d9c70b394e8b.source: An alternative method which takes a little bit more time but ensures not failing the quest is to head back to Rastigan and kill all the popup groups along the way before going near the Forest Griffons. Once the enemies are killed, have a party member go near the Griffons to lead them back to Rastigan.
dc0c1402e2c2de113cc121359c18d9c70b394e8b.text: 另一种方法会花费更多时间，但确保任务不会失败，那就是返回拉斯蒂根并杀死沿途的所有弹出群体，然后再靠近森林狮鹫。一旦敌人被杀死，让一名队员靠近狮鹫，将他们带回拉斯蒂根。

1796b139b40a7b964ba6fca60573bfb805f76c0c.source: If any Forest Griffon dies after the quest is completed, your party still will be defeated (even if you have done all other quests). If you turn in the quest while not all three griffons are near Rastigan the Eternal you will get the reward, but the quest log won't be updated, stopping you from progressing (the remaining griffons who were out of range will remain in your party).
1796b139b40a7b964ba6fca60573bfb805f76c0c.text: 如果任何森林狮鹫在任务完成后死亡，你的队伍仍然会被击败（即使你已经完成了所有其他任务）。如果您在并非所有三只狮鹫都在永恒拉斯蒂根附近的情况下提交任务，您将获得奖励，但任务日志不会更新，从而阻止您前进（超出范围的剩余狮鹫将保留在您的队伍中）。

2b5cf8a991f838eb4c0b2a659fbcb0a3654c0893.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: elementalist
2b5cf8a991f838eb4c0b2a659fbcb0a3654c0893.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：元素师

d271032cae279197c69a47490ceb3de984839fe2.source: Find Greplak Froststaff and obtain the Heart of Ice from him.
d271032cae279197c69a47490ceb3de984839fe2.text: 找到格雷普拉克·霜杖并从他那里获得冰之心。

751efa8fad0ae24596220cb336edb8691b98c39c.source: Deliver the Heart of Ice to Howland the Elementalist.
751efa8fad0ae24596220cb336edb8691b98c39c.text: 将冰之心交给元素师霍兰。

980551944f8345c0147cfc89a8ab17c1aefd9d3c.source: Follow the path on the map posted above to find Greplak. He can control Ice Golems, so when you get close to him he will try and summon more to defend himself with. All you have to do to finish this quest is talk to Greplak. He'll get scared and give you the Heart of Ice.
980551944f8345c0147cfc89a8ab17c1aefd9d3c.text: 按照上面发布的地图上的路径找到 Greplak。他可以控制冰傀儡，所以当你靠近他时，他会尝试召唤更多冰傀儡来保卫自己。要完成这个任务，你所要做的就是与格雷普拉克交谈。他会感到害怕并给你冰之心。

b8965c2e178c7b4e15714f365436a3b864096336.source: Follow Elonbel as he patrols the western riverbank.
b8965c2e178c7b4e15714f365436a3b864096336.text: 跟随埃隆贝尔在西河岸巡逻。

3b2adcb8a8f4867698f0e795a8291dc1100dd8b7.source: Now that Elonbel's true allegiance has been revealed, deal with him and his cohorts accordingly.
3b2adcb8a8f4867698f0e795a8291dc1100dd8b7.text: 既然埃隆贝尔的真正效忠已经暴露，就相应地处理他和他的同伙吧。

017aa07e3d9446462eb7dbe078c58618da44e832.source: Exit the Sunspear Great Hall and travel west to the river to find Elonbel. Once the player get close, he'll begin his patrol up the river. Along the way, he'll walk by a Level 10 Irontooth Drake surrounded by a swarm of Level 2 Juvenile Bladed Termites. Depending on the levels of the party members, players may want to avoid catching the Irontooth Drake's attention.
017aa07e3d9446462eb7dbe078c58618da44e832.text: 离开阳矛大厅并向西前往河边寻找埃隆贝尔。一旦玩家靠近，他就会开始沿河巡逻。一路上，他会路过一只 10 级铁牙幼龙，周围环绕着一群 2 级幼年刃白蚁。根据队伍成员的等级，玩家可能希望避免引起铁牙幼龙的注意。

5ddfa144f063fc291209e4b55524ac207ffb88fe.source: Elonbel will walk to camp just outside the Astralarium where the player finds him meeting with the corsairs. However, they discover Elonbel's been followed, and become hostile.
5ddfa144f063fc291209e4b55524ac207ffb88fe.text: 埃隆贝尔将步行前往星界馆外的营地，玩家会在那里与海盗们会面。然而，他们发现埃隆贝尔被跟踪，并变得敌对。

e3bd8010e981c2cdb9a90a8267b64fe4fa9e10fc.source: The corsairs are a minimal threat due to their low levels. However, Elonbel is Level 15 and can deal some moderate damage with his attacks. Low leveled players may want to consider bringing a full party with a Monk. Additionally, keeping the quests Quality Steel, Hog Hunt, and Proof of Courage active will provide players with additional allies to help as well.
e3bd8010e981c2cdb9a90a8267b64fe4fa9e10fc.text: 由于海盗的级别较低，因此威胁很小。然而，埃隆贝尔的等级为 15，他的攻击可以造成一些中等伤害。低等级的玩家可能会考虑带一个僧侣来一个完整的队伍。此外，保持任务“优质钢铁”、“猎猪”和“勇气证明”的活跃状态也将为玩家提供更多盟友的帮助。

38ca4664a663a3bdb68b0dfd5a0f81f5e94578ef.source: If the player stays out of range, the corsairs and Elonbel will fight each other. Players can use this to their advantage by leaving the corsairs alive to whittle away at Elonbel's health, then finishing them off afterwards.
38ca4664a663a3bdb68b0dfd5a0f81f5e94578ef.text: 如果玩家超出范围，海盗和埃隆贝尔就会互相战斗。玩家可以利用这一点，让海盗活着来削弱埃隆贝尔的生命值，然后再消灭他们。

d1fd0025377157a2b1ff46978bee38c3e791c9c8.source: After defeating Elonbel and the corsairs, return to Shaurom in the Sunspear Great Hall to receive your reward.
d1fd0025377157a2b1ff46978bee38c3e791c9c8.text: 击败埃隆贝尔和海盗后，返回阳矛大厅的沙罗姆处领取奖励。

a83f107c97b1c3f5c7c98d9c7629a9e3853ff498.source: If the player arrives at the meeting point ahead of Elonbel, the Corsair Commandant may become hostile before the dialogue begins. Defeating him and Elonbel early will stop the Corsair Spotters from spawning. This will prevent the quest from being completed, and the player will have to start again.
a83f107c97b1c3f5c7c98d9c7629a9e3853ff498.text: 如果玩家在埃隆贝尔之前到达集合点，海盗船指挥官可能会在对话开始之前变得充满敌意。尽早击败他和埃隆贝尔将阻止海盗船观察者生成。这将阻止任务完成，玩家将不得不重新开始。

0f1ebe5b90569ea5749abb126fe14fef61eac5d4.source: Free the bound souls of the Imperial guards from Shiro's constructs. You have freed 0...3 of 3 souls.
0f1ebe5b90569ea5749abb126fe14fef61eac5d4.text: 将帝国守卫被束缚的灵魂从白的构造体中解放出来。您已经释放了 3 个灵魂中的 0...3 个。

0889091a6218265613bd54b9618763b2ce751074.source: Speak to Imperial Guard Hao Li.

f303928c0c187f83447cdfa062909cb3472a006d.text: 与帝国卫队蒂恩迪交谈。

2b45bc5afda3fdae50585d37d1284f846155d9fc.source: See Imperial Captain Shi Wang for your reward.
2b45bc5afda3fdae50585d37d1284f846155d9fc.text: 去见帝国队长石王领取奖励。

0181e33aae211ddcc27df42f0eacc710e61222a6.source: Leave the Gate of Fear and head south into the swampy area of the Domain of Fear, where you will find the first 2 bound constructs to free. Each construct is accompanied by a mob of Margonites, and there are also patrols of Terrorweb Dryders and hidden creatures to defeat. The final construct is found north on the plain just outside the Gate of Secrets. Particular care should be take here due to the number of patrolling mobs present on the plain.
0181e33aae211ddcc27df42f0eacc710e61222a6.text: 离开恐惧之门，向南进入恐惧领域的沼泽区域，在那里你会发现前 2 个需要释放的束缚构造体。每个构造体都伴随着一群玛贡尼特暴徒，还有恐怖网干燥者的巡逻队和隐藏的生物需要击败。最终的建筑位于秘密之门外的北部平原上。由于平原上有大量巡逻的怪物，所以这里应该特别小心。

c8d7e75c255dd6b49101bde9d6acc4beb754b4d8.source: Combines well with The Last Patrol for some much needed extra allies.
c8d7e75c255dd6b49101bde9d6acc4beb754b4d8.text: 与《最后的巡逻队》完美结合，为一些急需的额外盟友提供帮助。

c7096cc2b13ef29edd3f34fee4d73caccc6afd52.source: Travel to Jaga Moraine and track down the polar bear.
c7096cc2b13ef29edd3f34fee4d73caccc6afd52.text: 前往贾加冰碛并追踪北极熊。

eb535623b6d1ded4afa35ad447a06c9daf1406cd.source: Use the bear to drive the hunters away. You have driven away [0-5] of 5 hunters.
eb535623b6d1ded4afa35ad447a06c9daf1406cd.text: 利用熊来赶走猎人。你已经赶走了 [0-5] 个 5 名猎人。

8b3a2676363a935e1260b804c314f0647a224c76.source: See Hogni Truthseeker for your reward.
8b3a2676363a935e1260b804c314f0647a224c76.text: 请参阅 Hogni Truthseeker 以获得奖励。

43f12a5cbf6ed6a51d58a8e2d07146fe19a4eeef.source: Travel to Jaga Moraine from Sifhalla and head for the Branch with Honey (location 1 on the map) near one of the resurrection shrines. Carry the branch to the hunter group (location 2 on the map). The hunters will run away when the bear approaches. Return to Hogni for your reward.
43f12a5cbf6ed6a51d58a8e2d07146fe19a4eeef.text: 从 Sifhalla 前往 Jaga Moraine，前往复活神殿之一附近的蜂蜜树枝（地图上的位置 1）。将树枝带到猎人组（地图上的位置2）。当熊靠近时，猎人就会逃跑。返回霍格尼处领取奖励。

7db8df53bdba2a2fa87d457b63b7e3ff536d1ce4.source: The bear can be killed by foes in the area and if it dies, you have to rezone and start over. To avoid this, drop the honey branch in a safe area (e.g. near Egil's Perch) and clear a path to the hunters. The bear will wait for your return; pick up the branch again so that it follows you to the hunters.
7db8df53bdba2a2fa87d457b63b7e3ff536d1ce4.text: 熊可以被该地区的敌人杀死，如果它死了，你就必须重新分区并重新开始。为了避免这种情况，请将蜂蜜树枝放在安全区域（例如靠近埃吉尔的栖息处）并为猎人清理道路。熊会等待你的归来；再次拿起树枝，让它跟着你找到猎人。

b7a2df2ae25a9b451e20e322a332ea3dfe3294f5.source: The bear can get trapped in corners; be careful not to lead it into one.
b7a2df2ae25a9b451e20e322a332ea3dfe3294f5.text: 熊可能会被困在角落里；小心不要把它引向一处。

56bcc88ec7735ad87cdd5066df7fe5bed75d0c8d.source: Quest is fully runable from Olafstead, using a build that includes running skills and an anti-cripple and/or KD skill.
56bcc88ec7735ad87cdd5066df7fe5bed75d0c8d.text: Quest 完全可以从 Olafstead 运行，使用包含运行技能和反瘫痪和/或 KD 技能的构建。

d786dd9aaa3a058fe1c3d4a1016e101a2d638510.source: The Polar Bear involved in quest is not tameable.
d786dd9aaa3a058fe1c3d4a1016e101a2d638510.text: 参与任务的北极熊是不可驯服的。

bfb7123630a872e49aa8a61db14d7bcfb2f0889a.source: You can save time by combining this quest with Krak's Cavalry, Prenuptial Disagreement, and Anything You Can Do.
bfb7123630a872e49aa8a61db14d7bcfb2f0889a.text: 你可以通过将此任务与克拉克的骑兵、婚前分歧和任何你能做的事情结合起来来节省时间。

d0273ae1f18d99fcb87a00929012d6aa4c0fb827.source: Thackeray's scavenger hunt requires a set of Votive Candles, which can be acquired for the three honeycombs rewarded by this quest.
d0273ae1f18d99fcb87a00929012d6aa4c0fb827.text: 萨克雷的寻宝游戏需要一套许愿蜡烛，可以通过该任务奖励的三个蜂窝来获得。

ece7f6c5068e515c673a3b6ac10cc8d01f779105.source: Any player in the party may complete the objectives for quest-holders by bringing the branch, for example, with a specialized running build. This may be useful for saving time when combining multiple quests at once.
ece7f6c5068e515c673a3b6ac10cc8d01f779105.text: 队伍中的任何玩家都可以通过携带分支来完成任务持有者的目标，例如，使用专门的运行版本。当同时组合多个任务时，这可能有助于节省时间。

42e16c3fd58af35d64602c69154d85acabac31f8.source: Having Isle of the Dead active or completed

e396539e947a2ada6598b9732c99fd874f739f7a.source: Talk to Sahreh's father, Dalz, just outside Beknur Harbor. Tell him about Sahreh's behavior and request he meet with the two lovers.
e396539e947a2ada6598b9732c99fd874f739f7a.text: 在贝克努尔港外与萨赫雷的父亲达尔兹交谈。告诉他 Sahreh 的行为并要求他见见这两个恋人。

593c29871a5d1b89dd11d24869d1fe82550cb26e.source: Meet Dalz on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
593c29871a5d1b89dd11d24869d1fe82550cb26e.text: 在多赫约克悬崖上与达尔兹见面。

1f6279e24586ec90d8f542b3175076754ac5c0f6.source: Bring Dalz to Behron and Sahreh.
1f6279e24586ec90d8f542b3175076754ac5c0f6.text: 将达尔兹带到贝伦和萨赫雷那里。

75f72dade6f79c2c819f4575c89426ef732747dc.source: Witness the duel. You can choose to aid Behron or simply let the duel resolve.
75f72dade6f79c2c819f4575c89426ef732747dc.text: 见证决斗。你可以选择帮助贝伦或干脆让决斗解决。

1d8bdd8e96c7e43f7525a7d41ce49b4cba693bc3.source: See Dalz Jelon for your reward.
1d8bdd8e96c7e43f7525a7d41ce49b4cba693bc3.text: 请前往 Dalz Jelon 领取奖励。

9b49fd62100421decceb0812f07cddcd54d07bca.source: Quest Failed. Travel to a nearby outpost or area, return and try again.
9b49fd62100421decceb0812f07cddcd54d07bca.text: 任务失败。前往附近的前哨站或区域，返回并重试。

694c33acfeb2791f5603d762a32de662cb09b65d.source: Once this quest is completed, Behron will no longer spawn in Cliffs of Dohjok.
694c33acfeb2791f5603d762a32de662cb09b65d.text: 一旦完成此任务，贝隆将不再在多赫约克悬崖中生成。

f217b3165c7dd239d7927edc0d4265120bc791dd.source: Behron and Sahreh are standing above the south-west tip of the quarry. At first this is a straight objective to either run to or map travel to Beknur Harbor. Dalz isn't 50 feet from the exit. The argument can seem drawn-out, but it is recommended to stand well-away from the 3 until all have turned hostile. Behron and Sahreh will turn hostile first, so if there are spirits or minions in the area, they will take after those two first. Also of note: Sahreh is a Monk, and if you send minions out of her range, she will chase them to heal them. If you have them, or have a hero who does, send them away before approaching Sahreh.
f217b3165c7dd239d7927edc0d4265120bc791dd.text: 贝伦和萨赫雷站在采石场的西南端上方。起初，这是一个直接目标，要么跑到贝克努尔港，要么绘制前往贝克努尔港的地图。达尔兹距离出口不到 50 英尺。争论可能看起来很漫长，但建议远离这三个人，直到所有人都变得敌对为止。 Behron和Sahreh会首先变得敌对，所以如果该地区有灵魂或爪牙，他们会首先攻击那两个。另外值得注意的是：Sahreh 是一名武僧，如果你将小兵送出她的范围，她会追赶他们并治愈他们。如果你有它们，或者有一个英雄有，请在接近萨赫赫之前将它们送走。

bcde6d8506067b897ad646babf6a4bc3440e0604.source: Use precision to pick off your villain of choice and avoid AoE's to spare nearby Sahreh.
bcde6d8506067b897ad646babf6a4bc3440e0604.text: 使用精确度干掉你选择的恶棍并避开 AoE，以饶过附近的 Sahreh。

b533de0b17395920a4e8f5debf43156e08815877.source: If you accidentally kill someone you didn't want to, traveling to any town and re-entering the area will reset the quest to the point of meeting Dalz on the Cliffs.
b533de0b17395920a4e8f5debf43156e08815877.text: 如果你不小心杀死了你不想杀死的人，前往任何城镇并重新进入该区域都会将任务重置为在悬崖上与达尔兹会面。

cbe5e29e86075528ff1bb06c8ab6d8dc37004f52.source: If Sahreh dies, and neither Behron or Dalz have turned friendly yet, both Behron and Dalz remain hostile, forcing you to restart the quest to finish it.
cbe5e29e86075528ff1bb06c8ab6d8dc37004f52.text: 如果萨赫死了，而贝隆和达尔兹都还没有变得友好，贝隆和达尔兹都会保持敌对状态，迫使你重新开始任务来完成它。

59a0f0209e28f40274aafb9fbc58a9403cc009f7.source: If both Behron and Dalz have been killed near simultaneously, the quest will count as failed and you must restart from the meeting.
59a0f0209e28f40274aafb9fbc58a9403cc009f7.text: 如果贝隆和达尔兹几乎同时被杀，任务将被视为失败，你必须从会议中重新开始。

995a6176134acd2ca9250294b8955f13ce884702.source: After receiving the quest, map travel to Zos Shivros Channel and head out the northern exit into the Boreas Seabed. The Halcyon is the large ship just to the north.
995a6176134acd2ca9250294b8955f13ce884702.text: 接到任务后，按地图前往佐斯希夫罗斯海峡，从北出口前往北风之神海底。翡翠号是北边的一艘大船。

e8389d22085debb97bf240aebe8c9fe8fbcb5fd3.source: Several large groups of Outcasts patrol the area immediately around the Halcyon. However if you're careful you should only have to fight one group located at the left rear of the ship. The other groups will move away giving you access to the inside of the ship. Arani is inside the ship on the scaffolding (effectively the "2nd floor"), to get to her go up the ramps.
e8389d22085debb97bf240aebe8c9fe8fbcb5fd3.text: 几大群流放者在翡翠号周围区域巡逻。然而，如果你小心的话，你应该只需要与位于船左后部的一组作战。其他小组将离开，让你可以进入船的内部。阿拉尼在船内的脚手架上（实际上是“二楼”），要爬上坡道去找她。

6e38ae0d7592572460fc69d74282b20349ac7277.source: Take Koss to Arkjok Ward and talk to Herbalist Umjabwe. Find out what's upsetting the villagers.
6e38ae0d7592572460fc69d74282b20349ac7277.text: 带科斯去阿克约克病房并与草药师乌姆贾布韦交谈。找出是什么让村民们感到不安。

a29f03c085989dab7b9d4fce128fb56cc248319e.source: Create a diversion to help the villagers escape.
a29f03c085989dab7b9d4fce128fb56cc248319e.text: 建立疏导通道，帮助村民逃生。

55bc76a4f77eb155b84d19e51ba72a2fbaa9bdc5.source: Seek out Herbalist Umjabwe in the north-east section of Arkjok Ward. After talking to him, go to the location of the conscripted villagers. When the Kournan military escort turns hostile, kill them.
55bc76a4f77eb155b84d19e51ba72a2fbaa9bdc5.text: 在 Arkjok Ward 的东北部寻找草药师 Umjabwe。与他交谈后，前往被征召的村民所在地。当库尔南护卫队变得敌对时，杀死他们。

c049b7b32531fc56856d6dc6a335506b0d062f70.source: Some Heroes and Henchmen do not attack when Koss's Elixir is done in the same run, but Jagged Horrors are able to inflict damage and Bleeding Condition when they replace Shambling Horrors. Occasionally, a nearby group of plants will patrol by the Kournan soldiers. If the Kournan soldiers do not become hostile (if you stay out of range of that quest trigger) the Kournans will peacefully stand by while the plants kill them. The quest can be completed in this fashion with little combat. The Plants will not attack the Kournan Captain.
c049b7b32531fc56856d6dc6a335506b0d062f70.text: 当科斯的长生不老药在同一轮中完成时，一些英雄和追随者不会攻击，但锯齿恐怖在取代蹒跚恐怖时能够造成伤害和流血状态。偶尔，附近的一群植物会由库尔南士兵巡逻。如果库南士兵没有变得敌对（如果你不在该任务触发器的范围内），库南人将安静地待命，而植物会杀死他们。可以用这种方式完成任务，几乎不需要战斗。植物不会攻击库南队长。

3bf57a2a1af94537f4e4be32ea33a29d218e39b8.source: A Peaceful Solution not active or completed
3bf57a2a1af94537f4e4be32ea33a29d218e39b8.text: 和平解决方案尚未启动或完成

5060836ad77baa8b31cf6d812a98262627f218ed.source: Travel with Shaudok to the merchant's camp.
5060836ad77baa8b31cf6d812a98262627f218ed.text: 与肖多克一起前往商人的营地。

e1d1eb2288b34abcdd4cef1bfdbd1876c7e0e7cb.source: Teach the merchant and his bodyguards the error of their ways.
e1d1eb2288b34abcdd4cef1bfdbd1876c7e0e7cb.text: 教导商人和他的保镖他们的错误做法。

06af7bb597e3c0b02c3bbb4b05486e302024acb5.source: After taking the quest from Kohanu you have to speak to Shaudok. He will now come along with you to wherever you are going. Upon arriving at the merchant Dashon a dialogue will take place after which you get attacked. The bodyguards Merkod and Nadara are both warriors. With a 4 man team (human or hero/henchman) they should be no problem to beat. You will not have to kill them only bring down their health to about 20% and then they will turn friendly. You can do that one at the time. A second dialogue will now take place and after that you can return to Kohanu for your reward.
06af7bb597e3c0b02c3bbb4b05486e302024acb5.text: 接受科哈努的任务后，你必须与肖多克交谈。现在，无论你要去哪里，他都会和你一起去。到达商人 Dashon 后，将会发生对话，然后你就会受到攻击。保镖梅尔科德和纳达拉都是战士。对于 4 人团队（人类或英雄/追随者）来说，击败他们应该没有问题。你不必杀死他们，只需将他们的生命值降低到 20% 左右，然后他们就会变得友好。到时候你就可以做这件事。现在将进行第二次对话，之后您可以返回科哈努以获得奖励。

c684127da1ec4ba46d40d8a854a4f2923b0b7c61.source: Mutually exclusive with A Peaceful Solution.
c684127da1ec4ba46d40d8a854a4f2923b0b7c61.text: 与和平解决方案相互排斥。

e8e0278b218e5aa46a3bb31c2c56bf3378af5da1.source: Shaudok is shown holding a sword and shield rather than the spear Kohanu refers to. The pre-quest offer dialogue will always get initiated for non-Nightfall characters despite the fact that non-Nightfall characters will not be offered this quest.
e8e0278b218e5aa46a3bb31c2c56bf3378af5da1.text: 沙多克手持剑和盾，而不是科哈努所指的长矛。尽管非夜幕降临角色不会被提供此任务，但任务前的任务对话始终会为非夜幕降临角色启动。

61013b91802ee9117ceeb4ea6c8118ed913c754c.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: mesmer
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
61013b91802ee9117ceeb4ea6c8118ed913c754c.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：幻术师
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

53784280ae9d776b5fd2e383801e07f148dee520.source: Kill the rogue bull that is threatening Althea's theatre.
53784280ae9d776b5fd2e383801e07f148dee520.text: 杀死威胁阿尔西娅剧院的流氓公牛。

cb2bf43589f5cd2977103546612933d51fa20b02.source: Return to Lady Althea for your reward.
cb2bf43589f5cd2977103546612933d51fa20b02.text: 返回阿尔西娅女士那里领取奖励。

edf551825f1c9c38fea93230b5616b140924b5bb.source: Lady Althea will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
edf551825f1c9c38fea93230b5616b140924b5bb.text: 接受任务后，Althea 女士将为您提供以下技能：

3182b6b343bd67a95bfe2077a5e344e27a4e8497.source: Upon completing the quest, even before accepting the reward, the Rogue Bull will no longer spawn at the watering hole. Instead, Old Mac will appear near the gate and offer The Rogue's Replacement after having a word with Althea.
3182b6b343bd67a95bfe2077a5e344e27a4e8497.text: 完成任务后，甚至在接受奖励之前，流氓公牛将不再在水坑中生成。相反，老麦克会出现在大门附近，并在与阿尔西娅交谈后提供盗贼的替代品。

72d4df02debf812fefaeef9a0aeeae5a75ea78a4.source: This change requires that all members of the party have completed the quest.
72d4df02debf812fefaeef9a0aeeae5a75ea78a4.text: 此更改要求所有党员都完成任务。

857872ea8c6c8238b1329cc17e89ea5e1a454cb0.source: Head roughly southwest from Lady Althea towards the pool of water to find the Rogue Bull. As a level 5 beast, the bull boasts a high armor rating that blunts standard physical attacks and can deal a significant amount of damage.
857872ea8c6c8238b1329cc17e89ea5e1a454cb0.text: 从阿尔西娅女士出发，大致向西南方向前往水池，找到流氓公牛。作为 5 级野兽，公牛拥有很高的护甲等级，可以削弱标准物理攻击并造成大量伤害。

dba3e5d1302b4eeb7ac85e5c439486a997ff43a7.source: Begin the encounter by casting Imagined Burden to severely cripple the bull's movement speed. Follow up with Conjure Phantasm to apply steady health degeneration, bypassing its armor. Also be wary of its Bull's Charge, with which it can quickly close the gap and inflict a knock down, particularly if you are attempting to flee. Once the bull is dead, return to Lady Althea for your reward.
dba3e5d1302b4eeb7ac85e5c439486a997ff43a7.text: 通过施放想象负担来严重削弱公牛的移动速度来开始战斗。接下来使用召唤幻象来绕过其装甲，施加稳定的生命值退化。还要小心它的公牛冲锋，它可以快速缩小差距并造成击倒，特别是当你试图逃跑时。公牛死后，返回阿尔西娅女士那里领取奖励。

40ffe9e71ddb9fdca51248327953375dba87534e.source: Skills which ignore armor, such as Bane Signet, Banish or Empathy
40ffe9e71ddb9fdca51248327953375dba87534e.text: 无视护甲的技能，例如祸根徽记、放逐或移情

e5c2ad98f31b22b757a9de6b17ceb6c8fa6c5524.source: Health degeneration skills, such as Conjure Phantasm or Sever Artery
e5c2ad98f31b22b757a9de6b17ceb6c8fa6c5524.text: 健康退化技能，例如召唤幻象或切断动脉

ef38897d1bfa06f64caa6bd6258e8f6622da96b6.source: Healing skills, such as Orison of Healing or Troll Unguent
ef38897d1bfa06f64caa6bd6258e8f6622da96b6.text: 治疗技能，例如奥里森治疗或巨魔药膏

bc2d6acf1f9d4c87381c3ce1f28cfe3ac47cfabe.source: Must have talked to Ruthless Sevad before bringing the supplies to Elder Jonah.
bc2d6acf1f9d4c87381c3ce1f28cfe3ac47cfabe.text: 在把物资带给乔纳长老之前，一定是和冷酷的塞瓦德谈过。

0292e416b8719b48a4bd3b1e5a7f84be036daf7f.source: Bring Janeera the message from Ruthless Sevad.
0292e416b8719b48a4bd3b1e5a7f84be036daf7f.text: 把无情的塞瓦德的消息带给珍妮拉。

7047bde686263f13c0671ef072aeb29252b0c607.source: See Ruthless Sevad for your reward.
7047bde686263f13c0671ef072aeb29252b0c607.text: 见无情的塞瓦德以获得奖励。

c55c608a7b8758807134c4bd5dbbd10f996baa2a.source: Nice and easy. Map to the Sunspear Sanctuary and walk out into the Marga Coast, where Janeera is waiting in Ronjok village just outside. After speaking to Janeera, map to Camp Hojanu and return to Ruthless Sevad in the Barbarous Shore.
c55c608a7b8758807134c4bd5dbbd10f996baa2a.text: 又好又容易。映射到阳矛保护区，然后步行到玛加海岸，Janeera 就在外面的 Ronjok 村等待着。与珍妮拉交谈后，前往霍贾努营地并返回野蛮海岸的无情塞瓦德。

77319224cf37351f73a44c7b2be8eb45fdd67f6f.source: Since this quest is picked up during one of the steps of A Question of Morality, Janeera can be very easily spoken to when you come to complete the latter quest.
77319224cf37351f73a44c7b2be8eb45fdd67f6f.text: 由于该任务是在“道德问题”的其中一个步骤中完成的，因此当您完成后一个任务时，可以很容易地与 Janeera 交谈。

3d52bad12ed100ea35ad082ce492e00497cb8a99.source: Travel to Kamadan and speak with Clerk Arlon.
3d52bad12ed100ea35ad082ce492e00497cb8a99.text: 前往卡马丹并与书记员阿尔隆交谈。

44609731fea7501e96759a06bd0cfcb626a3b367.source: Acquire official papers to grant Jatoro diplomatic status.
44609731fea7501e96759a06bd0cfcb626a3b367.text: 获得官方文件以授予贾托罗外交地位。

77bc529f64be86846a69366cd90f751d8891e2c5.source: Relieve the clerk of some of his duties so he can draft Jatoro's diplomatic papers.
77bc529f64be86846a69366cd90f751d8891e2c5.text: 解除该职员的部分职责，以便他可以起草贾托罗的外交文件。

96d8c48c01dc1c6c122e2a8b238ee3b508b79210.source: Bring Jatoro the official papers proving he has ambassador status
96d8c48c01dc1c6c122e2a8b238ee3b508b79210.text: 带上 Jatoro 证明他具有大使身份的官方文件

718d5b363f44b7345d3d84678ad807521ef998f3.source: After accepting the quest, travel to Kamadan and speak with Clerk Arlon; he stands near the exit to Consulate Docks. He gives you the quest One Good Turn Deserves Another. Complete that quest and then speak again with Clerk Arlon. Now you have the diplomatic papers for Jatoro. All you now need to do is get your reward from Jatoro Musagi at Kodlonu Hamlet.
718d5b363f44b7345d3d84678ad807521ef998f3.text: 接受任务后前往卡马丹并与书记员阿尔隆交谈；他站在领事馆码头出口附近。他给了你任务“一报还一报”。完成该任务，然后再次与书记员阿尔隆交谈。现在你有了杰托罗的外交文件。您现在需要做的就是从科德洛努哈姆雷特的加托罗·穆萨吉那里获得奖励。

87b5b20deda11d7e3eba6bc730f0d2d810e1bc67.source: Unlike other quests, the quest item Official Papers will only be taken once you accept the reward.
87b5b20deda11d7e3eba6bc730f0d2d810e1bc67.text: 与其他任务不同，任务物品“官方文件”只有在您接受奖励后才会被获取。

75106df222aeb514c033f95111a7c8e371c8b56f.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* The Ambassador's Quandary completed
75106df222aeb514c033f95111a7c8e371c8b56f.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 大使的困境已完成

4db9bf47af01cf240e812bc8ce84315873f6e78e.source: Find Gate Guard Hollis at the eastern gate in Old Ascalon]. Give him Zain's strongbox.
4db9bf47af01cf240e812bc8ce84315873f6e78e.text: 在旧阿斯卡隆的东门找到门卫霍利斯]。把扎因的保险箱给他。

abb771f3d75c335ae351e80d9c4cd7eb810d2286.source: Return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.
abb771f3d75c335ae351e80d9c4cd7eb810d2286.text: 返回扎因大使处领取奖励。

c3723a6c97dead147360fa7df509c59b474a3a31.source: Walk northwest from Ambassador Zain. Keep going west along the Wall until you reach the portal leading out into The Breach. Gate Guard Hollis is standing in front of the sign. Speak with him and return to Zain for your reward.
c3723a6c97dead147360fa7df509c59b474a3a31.text: 从扎因大使处向西北走。沿着长城继续向西走，直到到达通往裂口的传送门。门卫霍利斯站在标志前。与他交谈并返回扎因以获得奖励。

b02fe58580d3d0028a52d8b126ebd4238c0cf98d.source: The rewarded Jeweled Chalice has what would normally be the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chakram. Conversely, the quest Frontier Gate Fugitives rewards a Jeweled Chakram with the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chalice.
b02fe58580d3d0028a52d8b126ebd4238c0cf98d.text: 奖励的宝石圣杯具有宝石环轮通常的皮肤和属性。相反，任务边境之门逃亡者会奖励带有宝石圣杯皮肤和属性的宝石环轮。

05212f3479aee52a6b256d5edb49380ab92bb0fb.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: monk
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
05212f3479aee52a6b256d5edb49380ab92bb0fb.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：僧侣
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

5a05d6c6914cfb31b101a734028ba642887a5a3d.text: 在地下墓穴内与保卢斯见面。

2c38eb8b1a4d084f53e7bbea838546984967cc3f.source: Go with Paulus and use your healing prayers to make sure he survives.
2c38eb8b1a4d084f53e7bbea838546984967cc3f.text: 和保卢斯一起去，用你的治愈祈祷来确保他活下来。

f3332cc3d04fdf8011b4bf572ebc766bcbbac963.source: Return to Brother Mhenlo for your reward.
f3332cc3d04fdf8011b4bf572ebc766bcbbac963.text: 返回曼洛修士那里领取奖励。

5f6a95cb22fc4079992b01b5a0484a28135f361d.source: Brother Mhenlo will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
5f6a95cb22fc4079992b01b5a0484a28135f361d.text: 接受任务后，曼洛修士会给你以下技能：

dcb356761d417ab3ff7c78cf05672f2eee0f34da.source: Upon receiving the quest from Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey, head through the portal into the Catacombs. Paulus will be waiting just outside the entrance. When you approach him, he will start walking. Simply follow him, staying close by at all times so he doesn't stop walking.
dcb356761d417ab3ff7c78cf05672f2eee0f34da.text: 在阿什福德修道院接到门洛的任务后，通过传送门进入地下墓穴。保卢斯将在入口外等候。当你接近他时，他就会开始走路。只需跟随他，始终靠近，这样他就不会停止行走。

5ec90d461411fd80a5e57bc93883e31932511100.source: Although your primary duty is to keep Paulus breathing, he is surprisingly self-sufficient. His Bane Signet is enough to nearly one-shot a Raging Cadaver or Restless Corpse when they ambush you along the path. Combined with a couple attacks of your own, you can easily dispatch most of them before they lay a rotting finger on him. If you want to make sure of that, stay slightly ahead of Paulus to draw the initial aggression.
5ec90d461411fd80a5e57bc93883e31932511100.text: 尽管你的主要职责是保持保卢斯的呼吸，但他却能自给自足。当愤怒的尸体或不安的尸体沿路伏击你时，他的祸根徽记足以几乎一击毙命。结合你自己的几次攻击，你可以在他们对他施加腐烂的手指之前轻松消灭他们中的大部分。如果你想确保这一点，请稍微领先保卢斯以吸引最初的进攻。

280b6cb85c9cc332219d1ff0348144d2879eba60.source: Eventually, Paulus leads you into the Swamp Water section. While inside, it inflicts continuous health degeneration on both of you. Unless Paulus was damaged earlier or either of you gets bogged down by an enemy, he can actually survive the trip without needing to be healed even once. In fact, you might want to keep a closer look on your own health. For peace of mind (and to practice your new skill), tossing one or two Orisons of Healing his way while in the water will guarantee a safe retrieval.
280b6cb85c9cc332219d1ff0348144d2879eba60.text: 最终，保卢斯带你进入沼泽水区。在里面时，它会给你们俩带来持续的健康恶化。除非保卢斯早些时候受到伤害，或者你们中的任何一个被敌人陷入困境，否则他实际上可以在旅途中幸存下来，甚至不需要被治愈一次。事实上，您可能想密切关注自己的健康状况。为了安心（并练习你的新技能），在水中投掷一两颗奥里森治疗剂将保证安全恢复。

014901d7b350a2ba82fd065dccc23df6d76946f1.source: You shouldn't encounter any enemies on the way back, as you've already cleared the path of undead. Follow Paulus until you both reach the entrance to Ashford Abbey. Wait for the quest to update then walk through the portal and collect your reward from Mhenlo.
014901d7b350a2ba82fd065dccc23df6d76946f1.text: 你在回来的路上不应该遇到任何敌人，因为你已经清除了不死族的道路。跟随保卢斯直到你们到达阿什福德修道院的入口。等待任务更新，然后穿过门户并从 Mhenlo 那里收集奖励。

13fdb073c0864f6cf942fdde37785e983aee88ba.source: You must defeat 10 more Am Fah
13fdb073c0864f6cf942fdde37785e983aee88ba.text: 您必须再击败 10 个 Am Fah

5a8aef887bdda9faa389e3d07b4d07d1967a3ff5.source: See Imperial Agent Hanjo for your reward
5a8aef887bdda9faa389e3d07b4d07d1967a3ff5.text: 见帝国特工半条以获得奖励

e3b6fe03dbe575ec90fc4b5c172d446a936d0d2d.source: This quest does not have a green quest marker to follow until completed. Instead, simply killing the required number of Am Fah is tallied while the quest is active.
e3b6fe03dbe575ec90fc4b5c172d446a936d0d2d.text: 该任务在完成之前没有绿色任务标记可供遵循。相反，只要在任务进行期间杀死所需数量的 Am Fah 即可进行统计。
