ee6e11470e761c2c22d64f79f0a6fcc3dd31448c.source: Mirza Veldrunner can die without affecting the success of this quest. If he dies, just rezone and turn it in.
ee6e11470e761c2c22d64f79f0a6fcc3dd31448c.text: 米尔扎·维德行者即使死亡也不会影响该任务的成功。如果他死了，只需重新分区并将其上交即可。

55ae8ed8f5df6f3f41bd5e1373709cbc2a232272.source: If a group doesn't come for some time, they may have become stuck behind a rock and need to be found.
55ae8ed8f5df6f3f41bd5e1373709cbc2a232272.text: 如果一群人有一段时间没有来，他们可能被困在岩石后面，需要被发现。

b862c9594e33e2da917c4063bb652adba718f6a5.source: Kill Baubao Wavewrath in the Undercity.
b862c9594e33e2da917c4063bb652adba718f6a5.text: 在幽暗城杀死巴巴波·波怒。

b3766c5b287bb6b7daa9692f38f9f0980f21e4f0.source: *BONUS* Kill Baubao Wavewrath in Hard Mode.
b3766c5b287bb6b7daa9692f38f9f0980f21e4f0.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Baubao Wavewrath。

3218d203664330c0adeb39b74baadc28e96316a9.source: The shortest route would be to enter the Undercity from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), if unlocked. There are plenty of Kappa surrounding Baubao who use Turtle Shell, so plan accordingly.
3218d203664330c0adeb39b74baadc28e96316a9.text: 如果解锁的话，最短的路线是从维祖纳广场（当地街区）进入幽暗城。 Baubao 周围有很多使用龟壳的河童，因此请做好相应的计划。

3cf84025e119f6745e3412004a66012939a7d736.source: Baubao will not spawn if When Kappa Attack is active.
3cf84025e119f6745e3412004a66012939a7d736.text: 如果河童攻击处于活动状态，Baubao 将不会生成。

d189a10baecc95f8fe183b98b87642e3f59d6d52.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Chung, the Attuned Zaishen quest, since that quest is available from the Zaishen Bounty signpost on the third day after this quest (based on the Zaishen Bounty cycle) and both bosses are found in the Undercity.
d189a10baecc95f8fe183b98b87642e3f59d6d52.text: 考虑与“Chung”（调和的 Zaishen 任务）同时完成此任务，因为该任务可在该任务后的第三天从 Zaishen 赏金路标处获得（基于 Zaishen 赏金周期），并且两个 Boss 都在幽暗城中找到。

6ad40961299de218e56bd4f68f251d0ecfb409fb.source: Sometimes Baubao's mob will aggro a mob of Am Fahs nearby, making the fight easier for you.
6ad40961299de218e56bd4f68f251d0ecfb409fb.text: 有时巴包的暴徒会攻击附近的阿姆法赫暴徒，让你的战斗变得更轻松。

5b00f1a236b0b5e13fa6da8413f20654c8025ffd.source: Consider using this to your advantage as it only has to be attacked by you once to be "killed" by you.
5b00f1a236b0b5e13fa6da8413f20654c8025ffd.text: 考虑利用它来发挥你的优势，因为它只需要被你攻击一次就会被你“杀死”。

1416886c6a1c37d39b7e444c8111fd2040531c61.source: Must have witnessed Vael's first dialogue with the player in Grothmar Wardowns, completed The Missing Vanguard, and have re-zoned. See Vael's Notes for details.
1416886c6a1c37d39b7e444c8111fd2040531c61.text: 一定见证了维尔在《格罗斯玛战争》中与玩家的第一次对话，完成了《失踪的先锋》，并重新分区。详细信息请参阅 Vael 的注释。

667bf0f4cb8a3d2f635f30cb60ab679cc6c90e77.source: Follow Torch Harrowkeeper. Do not alert him to your presence.
667bf0f4cb8a3d2f635f30cb60ab679cc6c90e77.text: 跟随火炬守耙者。不要提醒他你的存在。

34bdab840bee30e4809cdc2bd2c819b5881ff523.source: Eavesdrop on the Charr while they discuss their plans.
34bdab840bee30e4809cdc2bd2c819b5881ff523.text: 在夏尔讨论计划时偷听他们的谈话。

5afad6d1b2d4a6ceb7faf9864f4b7ee8df8f60f1.source: Talk to Vael. See how he wants to proceed.
5afad6d1b2d4a6ceb7faf9864f4b7ee8df8f60f1.text: 与维尔交谈。看他想如何继续。

fa14c0a55110bfa85233e08b23f96e830e332ed1.source: Follow the Charr to their meeting with the Grawl leaders. Crash the meeting and eliminate all hostiles.
fa14c0a55110bfa85233e08b23f96e830e332ed1.text: 跟随夏尔前往与格罗尔领袖的会面。破坏会议并消灭所有敌对分子。

8992dda7b3239b5c62af50f7aa39ad0c252d2a89.source: Bring the Charr Intelligence to Captain Langmar.
8992dda7b3239b5c62af50f7aa39ad0c252d2a89.text: 将查尔情报交给朗玛船长。

575cd719276d0e6950ca453181ca4b23625d6cd3.source: This quest is very straightforward and can easily be done with heroes and henchmen. Keep out of Torch Harrowkeeper's range when you follow him until the quest updates with crashing the party. Continue following him out of range until they reach the meeting. When Torch Harrowkeeper says his line "GREETINGS GRAWL..." you can safely kill them, or listen to the rest of the dialogue. Regardless, one of the Charr will drop the Charr Intelligence quest item which you will have to take to Captain Langmar, claiming your reward.
575cd719276d0e6950ca453181ca4b23625d6cd3.text: 这个任务非常简单，英雄和追随者可以轻松完成。当你跟随火炬耙守者时，请远离他的射程，直到任务更新并导致队伍崩溃。继续跟踪他超出范围，直到他们到达会议地点。当火炬耙守者说出他的台词“问候GRAWL...”时，你可以安全地杀死他们，或者听其余的对话。无论如何，其中一个夏尔会掉落夏尔情报任务物品，你必须将其交给朗玛船长，领取奖励。

d54b2a6aac93fdff97d540048e7ff16e62948281.source: It is advised to map-travel to Longeye's Ledge to get to Captain Langmar. Not only is it faster, but you won't receive the next quest until you rezone.
d54b2a6aac93fdff97d540048e7ff16e62948281.text: 建议通过地图旅行到长眼岩礁去寻找朗玛船长。它不仅更快，而且在重新分配区域之前你不会收到下一个任务。

59fd4f5a425659a41e37bbedc16893abbfc5a29f.source: This quest is given by Vael west of the forest in Grothmar Wardowns. Torch Harrowkeeper will be spawned just east of Vael and you have to follow him to the beach.
59fd4f5a425659a41e37bbedc16893abbfc5a29f.text: 这个任务是由格罗斯玛战争中森林以西的瓦尔给出的。火炬耙耙者将在瓦尔东部生成，你必须跟随他到海滩。

a9e755f030a19786ff2e053d424809901a072703.source: When the Charr meet with the Grawl, do not engage immediately, even if the quest log tells you to "eliminate all hostiles". Wait until the Grawl has responded "*oot!*" or else the quest will fail.
a9e755f030a19786ff2e053d424809901a072703.text: 当夏尔与穴居人相遇时，不要立即交战，即使任务日志告诉你“消灭所有敌人”。等到 Grawl 响应“*oot!*”，否则任务将会失败。

b3f24dc2e4850f7fc0893f048250fb305fc49028.source: After completing this quest, Chaelse Flameshielder will not spawn again until after you have completed Plan A.
b3f24dc2e4850f7fc0893f048250fb305fc49028.text: 完成此任务后，在您完成 A 计划之前，Chaelse Flameshielder 不会再次生成。

d13df9556a4bee821b8701d40427bb60505f9bd7.source: After completing this quest, you must leave and re-enter Grothmar Wardowns before Plan A becomes available.
d13df9556a4bee821b8701d40427bb60505f9bd7.text: 完成此任务后，您必须在 A 计划可用之前离开并重新进入 Grothmar Wardowns。

3303f87dde3ab081b84aadab922dd2bbdb1bc759.source: If Torch Harrowkeeper dies and is resurrected, he will drop a second Charr Intelligence. It is possible for a chest to spawn in the Sacnoth Valley portal, preventing the Grawl from attending the meeting.
3303f87dde3ab081b84aadab922dd2bbdb1bc759.text: 如果火炬守耙者死亡并复活，他会掉落第二个夏尔情报。萨克诺斯谷门户中可能会生成一个箱子，从而阻止穴居人参加会议。

7e6700a075e35a8b6819121a11c7aaec26699a23.source: Speak to Olrun about the bear.

b527d01cdca8a402bac86bfd7d16bf28accd672c.source: Clutch the Club of a Thousand Bears.

df3af025c8f6772bcc1a9a8f191bbb319aadf04b.source: Defeat the bear using the club given to you.
df3af025c8f6772bcc1a9a8f191bbb319aadf04b.text: 使用给你的棍棒打败熊。

96fa126d57ef122d225284a8cecd994fdc26d895.source: See Olrun Olafdottir for your reward.
96fa126d57ef122d225284a8cecd994fdc26d895.text: 前往奥尔伦·奥拉夫多蒂尔领取奖励。

63cf1bce28d06a6f405ac8430f47136da2ed8e16.source: You get a hammer to kill the bear with:
63cf1bce28d06a6f405ac8430f47136da2ed8e16.text: 你会得到一把锤子来杀死熊：

1d20f5f9fbe244c3dd5f06999eff6de84854fc44.source: Although you are given a bear club, you only have to be wielding it when the bear dies for the quest to be considered successfully completed. This means that you can fight the bear normally using other weapons to weaken it, and then switch to the club for the killing blow.
1d20f5f9fbe244c3dd5f06999eff6de84854fc44.text: 虽然你得到了一根熊棒，但你只需要在熊死亡时挥舞它，任务就被视为成功完成。这意味着你可以正常与熊战斗，使用其他武器削弱它，然后切换到棍棒进行致命一击。

c0338b96eed52a9a84dea775fc1ec34deabf590b.source: Bear Club/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
c0338b96eed52a9a84dea775fc1ec34deabf590b.text: 熊俱乐部/详细演练指南

bc6086ac489bdded1794f3501589a69caa0b7314.source: Hammer attacks can be used when the club is equipped.
bc6086ac489bdded1794f3501589a69caa0b7314.text: 装备了球杆后可以使用锤子攻击。

8e3d9e4156fed2eae1d65eb3cdff60756f91c76c.source: Female characters receive the quest Bear Club for Women instead of this quest which is given by the smitten Olaf Olafson inside the Olafstead.
8e3d9e4156fed2eae1d65eb3cdff60756f91c76c.text: 女性角色会收到“女性熊俱乐部”任务，而不是由奥拉夫斯特德内的奥拉夫·奥拉夫森所提供的任务。

35218d627b6bbc5fcc8df32a131e6f523789c062.source: This quest has a special map zone it shares with the female version. This map zone is named Varajar Fells, but is not the same as the explorable area.
35218d627b6bbc5fcc8df32a131e6f523789c062.text: 该任务有一个与女性版本共享的特殊地图区域。该地图区域名为Varajar Fells，但与可探索区域不同。

f575303ea85bf060b435881be791e717c661f05b.source: You can use any weapon to beat on the bear, only the finishing blow must be with the Club of a Thousand Bears equipped. Degeneration and interrupting the bear's Troll Unguent work, as does spirits and traps. Using the Ursan Blessing elite skill can be effective.
f575303ea85bf060b435881be791e717c661f05b.text: 你可以使用任何武器来击败熊，但最后一击必须装备千熊俱乐部。退化和打断熊的巨魔药膏的作用，就像烈酒和陷阱一样。使用乌尔桑祝福精英技能可以有效。

f99f1603b74ac5b1a57b25c1dd86668fd2172958.source: When resigning in the mission area you will not die, after the timer runs out you will be transported back to Olrun Olafdottir in Varajar Fells but you will be alone without your party members if you had any to begin with.
f99f1603b74ac5b1a57b25c1dd86668fd2172958.text: 在任务区辞职时，你不会死，计时器耗尽后，你将被传送回瓦拉贾荒原的奥尔伦·奥拉夫多蒂尔，但你将独自一人，没有你的队友（如果你一开始就有队友的话）。

665c3721fab54e0babe566b020b7c279b4ce4d73.source: It is possible by shadow stepping past the Norn Guards to explore Varajar Fells and reveal additional parts of the map by walking through the inactive portals to Battledepths, Raven's Point and Verdant Cascades. However, the map is populated with foes, so be prepared to deal with them or run past them.
665c3721fab54e0babe566b020b7c279b4ce4d73.text: 可以通过影子踏过诺恩守卫来探索瓦拉贾荒原，并通过穿过未激活的传送门前往战场深处、乌鸦角和翠绿瀑布来揭示地图的其他部分。然而，地图上到处都是敌人，所以要做好对付他们或跑过去的准备。

57de15af43121ccde37cdf25e166629b62f1719b.source: Quest can glitch making the bear un-killable even when the Bear club is equipped the entire fight.
57de15af43121ccde37cdf25e166629b62f1719b.text: 即使熊俱乐部在整个战斗中都装备有，任务也可能会出现故障，使熊无法被杀死。

bfbefc82f41f225597085af9f7b18363f73c44de.source: Speak to Olaf about the bear.

c7396a8a0dcfe4091ebb875cc4eb1b64579629e1.source: See Olaf Olafson for your reward
c7396a8a0dcfe4091ebb875cc4eb1b64579629e1.text: 见奥拉夫·奥拉夫森以获得奖励

a69d8185cdca24c828b4779b014c590c861cd327.source: Male characters receive the quest Bear Club for Men instead of this quest which is given by the smitten Olrun Olafdottir in Varajar Fells on the way to the Raven's Point entrance.
a69d8185cdca24c828b4779b014c590c861cd327.text: 男性角色会收到“男性熊俱乐部”任务，而不是由瓦拉贾荒原中的奥伦·奥拉夫多蒂尔在前往渡鸦点入口的途中给予的任务。

74c334b90f56b47e15534778b2229657aa3b39bf.source: This quest has a special map zone it shares with the male version. This map zone is named Varajar Fells, but is not the same as the explorable area. Notably, the portals to Battledepths, Raven's Point and Verdant Cascades are inactive.
74c334b90f56b47e15534778b2229657aa3b39bf.text: 该任务有一个与男性版本共享的特殊地图区域。该地图区域名为Varajar Fells，但与可探索区域不同。值得注意的是，通往 Battledeeps、Raven's Point 和 Verdant Cascades 的传送门均处于非活动状态。

3765d3fe0f24059bee00248ca9e9f1d6e0f08eee.source: It is possible by shadow stepping past the Norn Guards to explore and reveal additional parts of the map by walking through the inactive portals. However, the map is populated with foes, so be prepared to deal with them or run past them.
3765d3fe0f24059bee00248ca9e9f1d6e0f08eee.text: 影子可以跨过诺恩守卫，通过不活跃的传送门来探索和揭示地图的其他部分。然而，地图上到处都是敌人，所以要做好对付他们或跑过去的准备。

4b6c30c08a55e288fbdce363b17cc49ed5794f0c.source: When resigning in the mission area you will not die, after the timer runs out you will be transported back to Olaf Olafson in Olafstead but you will be alone without your party members if you had any to begin with.
4b6c30c08a55e288fbdce363b17cc49ed5794f0c.text: 在任务区辞职时，你不会死，计时器耗尽后，你将被传送回奥拉夫斯特德的奥拉夫·奥拉夫森，但你将独自一人，没有你的队友（如果你有任何队友）。

d963381104b4d9333b137ed024a259f8d9ff08f2.source: On rare occasions the quest can glitch making the bear un-killable even when the Bear club is equipped the entire fight.
d963381104b4d9333b137ed024a259f8d9ff08f2.text: 在极少数情况下，即使熊俱乐部配备了整场战斗，任务也会出现故障，导致熊无法被杀死。

c7cb39268e730b99986d38ca2247fc207f9f21c6.source: Protect the villages of the Yatendi Canyons from attack. You have [6...0] Margonite groups left to destroy.
c7cb39268e730b99986d38ca2247fc207f9f21c6.text: 保护亚坦迪峡谷的村庄免受攻击。你还有 [6...0] 个玛贡尼特队伍需要摧毁。

019dff130387f4dc52a8184fe7a09ddc823bf90d.source: See Whispers Adept for your reward
019dff130387f4dc52a8184fe7a09ddc823bf90d.text: 请参阅低语专家以获得奖励

bedaf30811cecabd35cf45e135a3f645fc8da481.source: This is quite a straight-forward defensive type quest, however to get to the initial trigger point, you will have to defeat several groups along the way (including 4 bosses: Corporal Suli, Hajok Earthguardian (Insect), Makdeh the Aggravating and Tain the Corrupter).
bedaf30811cecabd35cf45e135a3f645fc8da481.text: 这是一个相当直接的防御型任务，但是要到达最初的触发点，你必须击败沿途的几个小组（包括 4 个 Boss：苏利下士、哈约克地球卫士（昆虫）、恼怒者马克德和腐蚀者泰恩）。

3b636b2fc9f95ae247be98cfe4ec0b827869131e.source: The deeper reaches of the fortress hold several Kournan and Margonite groups, but you can ignore those, you only need to defend the fortress gate from the units arriving from the north.
3b636b2fc9f95ae247be98cfe4ec0b827869131e.text: 要塞的更深处有几支库尔南和玛贡尼特部队，但你可以忽略它们，你只需要保卫要塞大门，抵御来自北方的部队。

bfe463d8ba4f1b4613c90c14c51e6c6aaa0f3b1e.source: When you arrive at the quest point (the gate of the fortress), this is the trigger for 6 Margonite groups to advance and attack at the quest point, coming to you as three waves of two groups to kill. The first two groups are mostly Warlocks and Bowmasters, the next two waves are primarily Executioners and Reapers, and the final two waves are a mix of Bowmasters, Sorcerers, Executioners, and Reapers.
bfe463d8ba4f1b4613c90c14c51e6c6aaa0f3b1e.text: 当你到达任务点（要塞门口）时，触发6个玛贡尼特小队向任务点进发攻击，分三波两队向你袭来。前两波主要是术士和弓箭手，接下来的两波主要是刽子手和收割者，最后两波是弓箭手、术士、刽子手和收割者的混合体。

c76e492571c6b82d26b83fa8217b9fc5dd2a3969.source: Elementalist ward spells that cover the gate, or Necromancer wells that buff the party (or debuff the enemies) can be very useful on this quest. Good use of aggro and body blocking may also enable use of area of effect spells to quickly wipe out the Margonites.
c76e492571c6b82d26b83fa8217b9fc5dd2a3969.text: 覆盖大门的元素守卫法术，或为队伍提供增益（或对敌人减益）的死灵法师井在这个任务中可能非常有用。充分利用仇恨和​​身体阻挡也可以使用范围法术来快速消灭玛贡尼特。

36011e8adad51bcb6e20f895bb0d8338b9584d24.source: When the Margonites have been defeated, return to the Chantry of Secrets for your reward.
36011e8adad51bcb6e20f895bb0d8338b9584d24.text: 击败玛贡尼特后，返回秘密教堂领取奖励。

307933d7cd2651d0caf8714efe928a045c74916d.source: There is a resurrection shrine near to the trigger point, with a Margonite hunt blessing, so this quest can be used to farm Lightbringer points.
307933d7cd2651d0caf8714efe928a045c74916d.text: 触发点附近有一个复活神殿，有玛贡尼特狩猎祝福，所以这个任务可以用来刷光明使者点数。

3fbf6e21a6fb38842231857f0ea876265db8417e.source: If using heroes and/or henchmen, it can be helpful to pin them to the middle of the gateway where the quest fights take place, to ensure they do not run far or overaggro.
3fbf6e21a6fb38842231857f0ea876265db8417e.text: 如果使用英雄和/或追随者，将他们固定在发生任务战斗的网关中间会很有帮助，以确保他们不会跑得太远或过度仇恨。

5cdced73b55f237f41b9ec0bd51e2390bc829b65.source: Clear the Bjora Marches in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
5cdced73b55f237f41b9ec0bd51e2390bc829b65.text: 在困难模式下清除远席瓦山脉比约拉边境的所有敌人。

ac851a23fbed3acf3bb471d3baf8fdf1532e09ac.text:
3,500 诺恩声望点

MAPPINGOUT_d8d0dbe77a1d107_0
从古纳尔城堡镇向北行驶，找到通往比约拉边境的传送门。该区域也紧邻长眼壁架。

9acc9c5bc514a0c172d4fc1deca34d3e4a3b5234.source: A locked chest will occasionally spawn behind the zone portal leading to Norrhart Domains; there is no way to reach it.
9acc9c5bc514a0c172d4fc1deca34d3e4a3b5234.text: 通往诺拉特领域的区域门户后面偶尔会生成一个上锁的箱子；没有办法达到它。

6818779e39d0984070d58024ef6eae71d4b153a4.source: Be mindful of Wurm and Mandragor pop-ups.
6818779e39d0984070d58024ef6eae71d4b153a4.text: 请注意 Wurm 和 Mandragor 弹出窗口。

2c2e23e0ab1bf37d6e12c7a3453ae48aaa519a93.source: Lord Glacius the Eternal appears only as your party approaches its spawn location amongst a group of Stone Summit Gnashers.
2c2e23e0ab1bf37d6e12c7a3453ae48aaa519a93.text: 永恒领主格拉修斯只有在你的队伍接近其重生位置并置身于一群石峰咬人之中时才会出现。

f6c98f65f6b91d568676f6f4a7bdbccf87328634.source: Consider vanquishing this area with the quest Leader of the Pack active. Although it will increase the amount of foes you must kill (Destroyers), you'll also gain one Alpha Tundra Wolf and five Tundra Wolf allies that will follow your party, even after you defeat all of the Destroyers.
f6c98f65f6b91d568676f6f4a7bdbccf87328634.text: 考虑激活狼群首领任务来征服这个区域。虽然它会增加你必须杀死的敌人（毁灭者）的数量，但你也会获得一只阿尔法苔原狼和五名苔原狼盟友，他们会跟随你的队伍，即使你击败了所有毁灭者。

558cda7ae0fe2b6bd0207665b7796a4eacc7aedf.source: Take Tahlkora and stop the general from making a deal with the Corsairs in Blacktide Den.
558cda7ae0fe2b6bd0207665b7796a4eacc7aedf.text: 占领塔尔科拉并阻止将军与黑潮巢穴的海盗们做交易。

9951fde6d43decb59cc6f76a3164ec937c515bc9.text: *奖励*杀死五名 Rinkhal 监视器。

3220d395cd42d6104a6618974ac722c6509ccb7a.source: Complete the Base Objective for 15 Zaishen Copper Coins.
3220d395cd42d6104a6618974ac722c6509ccb7a.text: 完成 15 个再神铜币的基本目标。

d7fd6d897bdf4e932eea9836fcd95cd2b643eb61.source: Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
d7fd6d897bdf4e932eea9836fcd95cd2b643eb61.text: 完成第一个*奖励*目标可获得额外 22 个再神铜币。

3ad08fc6ab47026ff99008e02bb322004774c180.source: Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.
3ad08fc6ab47026ff99008e02bb322004774c180.text: 完成第二个*奖励*目标可获得额外的 37 个再神铜币。

a59f371713e09e9dba022fee563fa6ee591ecb70.source: As per the Blacktide Den mission.

280da70cd410a21c5098c31426454ada2a5367f2.source: In order to receive credit for the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission.
280da70cd410a21c5098c31426454ada2a5367f2.text: 为了获得第一个奖励目标的积分，您必须完成任务。

ea27f2769a7c7df5db35bfba75fad6da92035c6f.source: Go to Nebo Village with the Militia Weapons. Talk to Etham the Artisan and trade the weapons for blankets.
ea27f2769a7c7df5db35bfba75fad6da92035c6f.text: 带着民兵武器前往尼波村。与工匠埃瑟姆交谈，用武器换毯子。

fb4ed019c6c256c3daab162bc2cf846b875665fd.source: Take the blankets to Captain Greywind.
fb4ed019c6c256c3daab162bc2cf846b875665fd.text: Take the blankets to Captain Greywind.

667ccf71a35c9a6cfaf741637e60981670a2d241.text: 穿刺伤害 13-25（需要 6 枪法）

c2143ee464898df288574b6ecf189f7906195690.source: Received physical damage -2 (while in a Stance)
c2143ee464898df288574b6ecf189f7906195690.text: 受到物理伤害 -2（处于姿态时）

d2c11b85984e3b481f38e87229495cd894d8fb91.source: Captain Greywind will give you a Militia Weapon chest. Take it west with you to Nebo Village. You will encounter some tengu just after entering Nebo Terrace, and you may pass some ettins in the fields, but most if not all of the enemies should be easy to avoid.
d2c11b85984e3b481f38e87229495cd894d8fb91.text: 格雷温德队长会给你一个民兵武器箱。 Take it west with you to Nebo Village.进入尼波台后你会遇到一些天狗，你可能会在田野中经过一些天狗，但大多数（如果不是全部）敌人应该很容易避开。

f6a3fd2a89bf7b9cfbdcf0f851cb5652c53cd884.source: Talk to Etham the Artisan in Nebo Village and trade the weapons for blankets. Then simply return the way you came and give the blankets to Captain Greywind to complete the quest.
f6a3fd2a89bf7b9cfbdcf0f851cb5652c53cd884.text: 与尼波村的工匠伊瑟姆交谈，用武器换取毯子。然后按原路返回，将毯子交给格雷温德船长即可完成任务。

866ef3692bba23dc7ea018cc6bd3a56d7b5007bc.source: This quest pairs well with The Weaver of Nebo, since both require talking to Etham the Artisan.
866ef3692bba23dc7ea018cc6bd3a56d7b5007bc.text: 该任务与尼波织工非常匹配，因为两者都需要与工匠埃瑟姆交谈。

cfecbb2a09e51590b2be92a1e7a0bbed6e604ab6.source: If it is your first time visiting Nebo Terrace, consider unlocking Beetletun or Bergen Hot Springs while there for easier return trips.
cfecbb2a09e51590b2be92a1e7a0bbed6e604ab6.text: 如果您是第一次访问 Nebo Terrace，请考虑在那里解锁 Beetletun 或卑尔根温泉，以便更轻松地返程。

a4fd270411b1dd69adabd22b0ea6041e9daec79c.source: Find Scout Melthoran in Reed Bog.
a4fd270411b1dd69adabd22b0ea6041e9daec79c.text: Find Scout Melthoran in Reed Bog.

a8a5f2c659df536e21d82ce76d963a1f73ceade8.source: Find Dark Oak in the Falls to the southwest.
a8a5f2c659df536e21d82ce76d963a1f73ceade8.text: 在西南瀑布找到黑橡树。

6488989405d8a0f86e7fb827ca3f81be39bae3fb.source: Return the bloody heart to Dark Oak.
6488989405d8a0f86e7fb827ca3f81be39bae3fb.text: 把该死的心脏还给黑橡树。

e002e1e5bd803cfd353cf70d5785fb51f87ed22a.source: Return to Deep Root and tell him of Dark Oak's warning.
e002e1e5bd803cfd353cf70d5785fb51f87ed22a.text: 返回深根处并告诉他黑橡树的警告。

d8d0dbee77a1d1072326962b51ae1db466f69693.source: Travel due north from the town of Gunnar's Hold to find the portal to Bjora Marches. This area is also directly adjacent to Longeye's Ledge.
d8d0dbee77a1d1072326962b51ae1db466f69693.text: 从古纳尔城堡镇向北行驶，找到通往比约拉边境的传送门。该区域也紧邻长眼壁架。

f0ca67084ac621217d89a46cd2722ff437353e74.source: On entry to Reed Bog from Ettin's Back talk to Scout Melthoran, then take the left hand route heading south. This way, you can encounter and slay Drogo Greatmane (located at the "A" on the map) and pick up his Bloody Heart before meeting Dark Oak, which can help speed up the quest immensely. Otherwise, you'd have to re-zone between The Falls and Reed Bog and re-fight all the enemies on the way.
f0ca67084ac621217d89a46cd2722ff437353e74.text: 从埃丁后背进入里德沼泽时，与侦察兵梅尔索兰交谈，然后沿左侧路线向南行驶。这样，你就可以遇到并杀死卓戈·巨鬃（位于地图上的“A”）并在遇到黑橡树之前拾取他的血腥之心，这可以帮助极大地加快任务速度。否则，你必须在瀑布和芦苇沼泽之间重新划分区域，并重新与途中的所有敌人战斗。

8e196232167eba9a24cf8159270038553662f2f1.source: In the Falls, head south and follow the map to reach Dark Oak. There are a lot of Maguuma Spiders and Redwood Shepherds on the way, so warriors might want to bring "Shields Up!", or monks bring Aegis, to help defend the party and mitigate some damage. Condition removal or Healing Breeze can also be helpful.
8e196232167eba9a24cf8159270038553662f2f1.text: 在瀑布中，向南行驶，按照地图到达黑橡树。路上有很多迈古玛蜘蛛和红木牧羊人，所以战士可能想要带上“护盾！”，或者僧侣带上神盾，以帮助保卫队伍并减轻一些伤害。去除病症或治愈微风也有帮助。

83468cca0ea987e6e17d34fe0d022f6dfbd5f180.source: Even if you are on a female character, Scout Melthoran will refer to you as a "braver man than I".
83468cca0ea987e6e17d34fe0d022f6dfbd5f180.text: 即使你扮演的是女性角色，斯考特·梅尔索伦也会称你为“比我更勇敢的男人”。

0144b66a88d4d269337978847c8d0b1181df79cf.source: The vision may refer to the coalition of the White Mantle (lions) and the winged, claw-footed Mursaat (angels/carrion birds).
0144b66a88d4d269337978847c8d0b1181df79cf.text: 该愿景可能指的是白斗篷（狮子）和有翼、爪足的穆尔萨特（天使/腐肉鸟）的联盟。

92d170e3c7b241e2f91edfc036a62159baa86b93.source: Kill the Charr trespassers on Jora's homeland in Bjora Marches.
92d170e3c7b241e2f91edfc036a62159baa86b93.text: 在比约拉边境杀死乔拉故乡的夏尔入侵者。

560966deeccab09d1faec8ea0bdc068e3f5a9601.source: As per Blood Washes Blood walkthrough.

43a4072765b18620a460ede06412f33d785f6cfd.source: Avenge the White Mantle Chosen by killing their murderer.
43a4072765b18620a460ede06412f33d785f6cfd.text: 杀死凶手，为白斗篷神选者报仇。

be0453bb7d884315460351d1d4cdc160a0a042f7.source: *BONUS* Awaken the four druids and speak with the Elder Druid.
be0453bb7d884315460351d1d4cdc160a0a042f7.text: *奖励* 唤醒四个德鲁伊并与长老德鲁伊交谈。

e3055f733bd8801761a95f00c0b6d9e08ae0ad35.source: As per the Bloodstone Fen mission.

3260deb1ee4b236e1367df3116c4e7654e997096.source: Seek out Terick in the Domain of Secrets and learn the truth of his intentions.
3260deb1ee4b236e1367df3116c4e7654e997096.text: 在秘密领域寻找泰里克并了解他的真实意图。

5d77e953b68484d6570379898a86fe9452c1317c.source: Head out into the Domain of Secrets and make your way to Terick situated due west. When you find him, he will make a short taunting speech, turn hostile and attack the party. Upon his defeat, Terick will respawn as the demonic necromancer boss, Razakel. Once Razakel is defeated, return to the Gate of Secrets for your reward.
5d77e953b68484d6570379898a86fe9452c1317c.text: 前往秘密领域，前往位于正西的泰里克。当你找到他时，他会发表简短的嘲讽言论，变得充满敌意并攻击政党。失败后，泰里克将重生为恶魔死灵法师老大拉扎克尔。击败拉扎克尔后，返回秘密之门领取奖励。

2052e716b14a4fb6c11496100daa2d0c74e1f97e.source: Lightbringer's Gaze can be used on Razakel, but not Terick.
2052e716b14a4fb6c11496100daa2d0c74e1f97e.text: 光明使者的凝视可以用在拉扎克尔身上，但不能用在泰里克身上。

aec4f1ac98a1ab3b4ed4703451524da265f18a06.source: This quest combines well with the quest Open Season.
aec4f1ac98a1ab3b4ed4703451524da265f18a06.text: 该任务与开放季节任务完美结合。

2aa1812c34abc1016f62af79a2b7a4c9d9b57e62.text: 重复次数：500（困难模式下为 750）

d205b49d0b1accdda98e358354bf9099ef2b0538.source: If you do not have one of the two required quests, you cannot pass the door next to the Scrap of Parchment. You can still access the portal to Heart of the Shiverpeaks.
d205b49d0b1accdda98e358354bf9099ef2b0538.text: 如果您没有完成两个必需任务之一，则无法通过羊皮纸碎片旁边的门。您仍然可以访问席瓦山脉之心的传送门。

208fb5b0308e8a2b5e4249a85a532414bfbb33f6.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #10 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
208fb5b0308e8a2b5e4249a85a532414bfbb33f6.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 10 页。

00371dfe796fd0af460c965a30f3a51ef28bd056.source: You only need to complete one of the two quests to receive credit towards completion of Master of the North and the Master Dungeon Guide.
00371dfe796fd0af460c965a30f3a51ef28bd056.text: 您只需完成两个任务之一即可获得完成《北方大师》和《地下城大师指南》的学分。

9dbddcf3dc0b7ba62fe5ccc275e88e9703e95e01.source: This dungeon can be repeated immediately after clearing it as long as you claim the quest reward before waiting out the clock. When you return to Sparkfly Swamp, you can pick up either of the two quests.
9dbddcf3dc0b7ba62fe5ccc275e88e9703e95e01.text: 只要您在等待时间结束之前领取任务奖励，这个地下城就可以在清除后立即重复。当你返回火花蝇沼泽时，你可以接取这两个任务中的任何一个。

63bae4622adeb629d5ab2a64a0291bd1bf236fae.source: Because mobs are composed of large numbers of the same creature types, Disease and Edge of Extinction can be devastating.
63bae4622adeb629d5ab2a64a0291bd1bf236fae.text: 由于生物由大量相同的生物类型组成，因此疾病和灭绝边缘可能是毁灭性的。

91f01f9da757016fdc5cafe37f9d99af0a9ee88e.source: There are enough corpses for several minion masters; however, Ghosteater Beetles (with Consume Soul) and Khabuus during Giriff's War (with Spiritual Pain) have skills that deal additional damage to summoned creatures.
91f01f9da757016fdc5cafe37f9d99af0a9ee88e.text: 尸体足够几个小兵大师了；然而，食鬼甲虫（具有吞噬灵魂）和吉里夫之战期间的卡布斯（具有精神痛苦）拥有对召唤生物造成额外伤害的技能。

a454322e67ec222cdb62a7e6cc17005de5ee4438.source: Blooming Nettles spawn Nettle Spores which turn into Nettle Seedlings; killing the Blooming Nettles first will prevent the party from being overrun.
a454322e67ec222cdb62a7e6cc17005de5ee4438.text: 开花的荨麻会产生荨麻孢子，荨麻孢子会变成荨麻幼苗；首先杀死盛开的荨麻可以防止队伍被淹没。

e5984681b92d12dfc6e042ac1363869833254639.source: When the spores become seedlings, they trigger on-death effects, including Soul Reaping and Assassin's Promise.
e5984681b92d12dfc6e042ac1363869833254639.text: 当孢子变成幼苗时，它们会触发死亡效果，包括灵魂收割和刺客的承诺。

c4cadc395b27a3d8948af2385e051aa1226655f2.source: The collector, Blonk, stands between the two portals; Heart of the Shiverpeaks and Sparkfly Swamp.
c4cadc395b27a3d8948af2385e051aa1226655f2.text: 收藏家 Blonk 站在两个传送门之间；席瓦山脉中心和火花沼泽。

a24846c1a6e4bf93a900a09fe11837b769c44e25.source: Giriff's War (Red Side): Involves fighting Khabuus, a Mesmer boss known for Energy Surge; often seen as simpler for hero teams if you handle the boss well.
a24846c1a6e4bf93a900a09fe11837b769c44e25.text: 吉里夫之战（红方）：涉及与卡布斯战斗，卡布斯是一位以能量涌动而闻名的幻术师 Boss；如果你能很好地处理老板，通常会被认为对于英雄团队来说会更简单。

b71a3b7f3efaa6f5becba10af75d661f2b0ce804.source: Tekks's War (Yellow Side): Involves fighting Z'him Monns, a Ritualist boss using Spirit Rifts, which some find harder to manage but others find easier to counter with specific builds.
b71a3b7f3efaa6f5becba10af75d661f2b0ce804.text: Tekks 的战争（黄方）：涉及与 Z'him Monns 的战斗，Z'him Monns 是一个使用灵魂裂痕的仪式首领，有些人觉得很难管理，但另一些人则认为通过特定的构建更容易对抗。

3cf40a89391a5c94dcb7516f2a4481d4356269f8.source: You cannot get past the first room unless everyone in the party has at least one of the two quests in their quest log.
3cf40a89391a5c94dcb7516f2a4481d4356269f8.text: 除非队伍中的每个人的任务日志中都至少有两个任务中的一个，否则你无法通过第一个房间。

6c2acafeb449533586c1bc4477ff5ebe979fe1b4.source: Only one of the two quests can be active for the party; if Giriff joins you, Tekks will leave and vice-versa.
6c2acafeb449533586c1bc4477ff5ebe979fe1b4.text: 队伍中只能执行这两个任务之一；如果吉里夫加入，泰克斯就会离开，反之亦然。

b1e7cece502940bc8ab759ba8e604dcddce6e799.source: If one member of the party has one of the quests active, that quest will become active for the other players upon entry into the dungeon.
b1e7cece502940bc8ab759ba8e604dcddce6e799.text: 如果队伍中的一名成员激活了其中一个任务，则该任务将在进入地牢后对其他玩家激活。

94bf0e5b040d3071a522631fa4be60081e54ef4e.source: A boulder trap can be seen on first level on the upper part of the map but it apparently doesn't trigger. Sometimes the two hekets near shrine, are invincible. Re-zone to continue the dungeon.
94bf0e5b040d3071a522631fa4be60081e54ef4e.text: 在地图上部的第一层可以看到一个巨石陷阱，但它显然不会触发。有时神殿附近的两个赫克特，是无敌的。重新区域以继续地牢。

2177a214eaafe061c23c61a8ab84563f75593572.source: Get this quest from Tekks in Sparkfly Swamp and cross the log to Bogroot Growths. Killing one of the two duelling frogmen in the entrance room will cause the initial dungeon gate to open. The first level of the dungeon consists of two groups of Red Gokir, one with a Boss, and a number of swarms of Blooming Nettles, Nettle Seedlings and Nettle Spores. The Gokirs are tenacious, but can be handled by separating the swarms into manageable groups. Avoid the nettles, as much as possible, but if forced to fight them, kill the spores first. That may allow your group to bypass the rooted nettles and seedlings.
2177a214eaafe061c23c61a8ab84563f75593572.text: 从 Sparkfly 沼泽的 Tekks 那里接这个任务，穿过原木到达 Bogroot Growths。杀死入口处两个决斗蛙人之一将导致最初的地牢门打开。地牢的第一层由两组红戈基尔组成，一组有一个 Boss，以及一些盛开的荨麻、荨麻幼苗和荨麻孢子群。戈基人很顽强，但可以通过将群体分成易于管理的群体来对付。尽可能避开荨麻，但如果被迫与荨麻战斗，请先杀死孢子。这可能会让你的团队绕过生根的荨麻和幼苗。

eeddcb6f64f8f30e7e496fca494d074a4eded75b.source: This level also contains an exit into another dungeon in the Central Shiverpeaks, very close by the entrance.
eeddcb6f64f8f30e7e496fca494d074a4eded75b.text: 该关卡还包含通往中央席瓦山脉另一个地牢的出口，距离入口非常近。

c5faad21d02592224cd5d8b15d35273f6c0448ee.source: The second level is populated with plants in the initial area, followed by appearances of Incubi. Beyond the second shrine the party will meet a snaking corridor of beetles. After the corridor the Gokir await. Walking to the right hand side of the room will trigger a boulder that will kill all of the Gokir in this room - when they are dead the door to the penultimate room will open. Killing the Gokir Patriach near the boss lock will provide the key required to open the door.
c5faad21d02592224cd5d8b15d35273f6c0448ee.text: 第二层的初始区域长满了植物，随后出现了梦魇。越过第二个神殿，队伍会遇到一条蜿蜒的甲虫走廊。穿过走廊后，戈基尔人正在等待。走到房间的右手边会触发一块巨石，它会杀死这个房间里的所有戈基尔——当他们死后，倒数第二个房间的门就会打开。杀死 Boss 锁附近的戈基尔族长将提供打开门所需的钥匙。

7def41c8890e6eb208d2726cd4e9c8d78ae8324d.source: In in the final room, the dungeon boss Z'him Monns and the two Gokir Amini with him must be defeated to spawn the Bogroot Chest. It is recommended to pull away one of the groups of frogmen before pulling Z'him Monns.
7def41c8890e6eb208d2726cd4e9c8d78ae8324d.text: 在最后一个房间中，必须击败地下城首领齐姆·蒙斯 (Z'him Monns) 和与他在一起的两个戈基尔·阿米尼 (Gokir Amini)，才能生成博格鲁特宝箱。建议在拉 Z'him Monns 之前先拉开其中一组蛙人。

1ff9885391ae39b53e384d70324c2b1f05639a4d.source: Upon activating this quest by speaking to Tekks, the quest Giriff's War will be reset. The same will count the other way around.
1ff9885391ae39b53e384d70324c2b1f05639a4d.text: 通过与泰克斯交谈激活此任务后，任务吉里夫的战争将被重置。反之亦然。

e78dde589271ed9331225fb648b888df4de6c460.source: Due to the large amounts of corpses in Bogroot Growths dungeon, minion masters are useful.
e78dde589271ed9331225fb648b888df4de6c460.text: 由于博格鲁特生长地牢中有大量尸体，小兵大师很有用。

b9cb3c65f3d0c6843e5dadcb81974f96f831b792.source: Help Master Togo win the Luxon convocation.
b9cb3c65f3d0c6843e5dadcb81974f96f831b792.text: 帮助多哥大师赢得卢克森集会。

79d9789f3b9d69b8781d39fc74fad72bfb557024.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes.
79d9789f3b9d69b8781d39fc74fad72bfb557024.text: *奖励* 在 20 分钟内完成任务。

8bc52baa634c974ff6a5704c2b93f07731be034c.source: As per the Boreas Seabed mission.
8bc52baa634c974ff6a5704c2b93f07731be034c.text: 根据北风之神海底任务。

ddadf2af22c4a229c38d7d21db787f2a60ffb293.source: Clear the Boreas Seabed in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
ddadf2af22c4a229c38d7d21db787f2a60ffb293.text: 在困难模式下清除玉海北风之海海底的所有敌人。

1dd7af1bea7294e291ca418fe7beea6f6203116d.source: Light the storm beacons along Borlis Pass.
1dd7af1bea7294e291ca418fe7beea6f6203116d.text: 点亮博利斯山口沿线的风暴灯塔。

40bd0d8e37be3d91925bbfd6f2649bbb0aede55a.source: As per the Borlis Pass mission.

dd3c02eaaebb87229ec611930065de4e39531e60.source: The 2 Frostfire Dryders that accompany the Ice Drake also have to be killed to complete the first bonus objective.
dd3c02eaaebb87229ec611930065de4e39531e60.text: 伴随着冰龙的 2 个霜火烘干机也必须被杀死才能完成第一个奖励目标。

37a2d331c52040dcb5f25966076b861085a248ef.source: Kill Borrguus Blisterbark in Sacnoth Valley.
37a2d331c52040dcb5f25966076b861085a248ef.text: 杀死萨克诺斯谷的博尔格斯·泡树皮。

3aac082bca1bab2e8f6b97e52c71ebfceb99498b.source: *BONUS* Kill Borrguus Blisterbark in Hard Mode.
3aac082bca1bab2e8f6b97e52c71ebfceb99498b.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死博尔格斯·泡树皮。

6a76888fe45a95cad5c2e6ca894a4fe6e4f23e6c.text: 根据 Borrguus Blisterbark 的注释。

38c893cceb0ad4241d45a595598c199dcb8fc51c.text: 塔尔科拉（除非你完成了阿巴顿之门）

d70419c00d87fa12a894504d6b9b40c7cf15af3d.source: Talk to Horticulturist Hinon and find the whereabouts of the mehkuunah plant.
d70419c00d87fa12a894504d6b9b40c7cf15af3d.text: 与园艺师 Hinon 交谈并找到 mehkuunah 植物的下落。

510bf51158eb9f5c4d79608380b21e0f55e52428.source: Bring back a sample of the mehkuunah plant to Librarian Kahnu for analysis.
510bf51158eb9f5c4d79608380b21e0f55e52428.text: 将 mehkuunah 植物的样本带回图书馆员卡努进行分析。

89c9aa7706c9eca8a9ca02a9852991472526d96e.source: See Librarian Kahnu for your reward.
89c9aa7706c9eca8a9ca02a9852991472526d96e.text: 向图书管理员卡努寻求奖励。

fc262b0b046935407408a1774ef1a3a3afc73c36.source: Start out from Tihark Orchard and head out of the west exit to speak to Seborhin Protector Zuor to gain entry to the Garden of Seborhin. Tahlkora must be in your party to explore this area before conversion to Nightfallen Garden.
fc262b0b046935407408a1774ef1a3a3afc73c36.text: 从蒂哈克果园出发，从西出口与塞博欣保护者祖尔交谈，即可进入塞博欣花园。在转换为堕夜精灵花园之前，塔尔科拉必须在您的队伍中探索该区域。

bc61d357036ebdb2b239886d2e7820fb49ae3ad5.source: Although the plant sample is a short walk due north from the entry point to the Garden, the party will have to go and speak to Hinon first in the central ampitheatre. Be aware that there is a mob of djinn and roaring ethers nearby, and on approaching the plant, rain beetles and behemoth gravebanes will spawn.
bc61d357036ebdb2b239886d2e7820fb49ae3ad5.text: 虽然植物样本距离花园入口处向北步行不远，但小队必须先去中央圆形剧场与 Hinon 交谈。请注意，附近有一群巨灵和咆哮的以太，在接近植物时，会生成雨甲虫和巨兽坟墓。

805aa7bd41621090edbbb03f8faa4c6a59a9a206.source: Once the plant sample has been acquired, map back to Mihanu Township and return to Kahnu in the Halls of Chokhin for your reward.
805aa7bd41621090edbbb03f8faa4c6a59a9a206.text: 获取植物样本后，绘制回米哈努镇并返回乔欣大厅的卡努处以获得奖励。

8fcef084cae1d2ab7f0b152372862fe9a23037e4.source: If this is first time exploring the area, then Hinon may also have 2 additional quests to give: Plague of Frogs and Which Way Did He Go?, which can easily be completed at the same time as this quest.
8fcef084cae1d2ab7f0b152372862fe9a23037e4.text: 如果这是第一次探索该地区，那么希农可能还会有2个额外的任务要给：青蛙瘟疫和他走了哪条路？，这些任务可以轻松地与此任务同时完成。

a4523eda4754f12a67a17b2f879127d15cc12d0d.source: Also, you cannot use the Horticulturist Hinon who spawns during the Tihark Orchard mission. You must find your way to the one in the Garden of Sebhorin explorable area.
a4523eda4754f12a67a17b2f879127d15cc12d0d.text: 此外，您不能使用在提哈克果园任务期间生成的园艺师希农。您必须找到前往塞布霍林花园 (Garden of Sebhorin) 探索区的那一处的路。

fcffe399fe3f92b63b23d120a3f167fee56729f5.source: If you have completed the Grand Court of Sebelkeh mission, you will not be able to complete this quest until you complete Abaddon's Gate, as Garden of Seborhin will be replaced with Nightfallen Garden.
fcffe399fe3f92b63b23d120a3f167fee56729f5.text: 如果您已完成塞贝尔克大庭院任务，则在完成亚巴顿之门之前，您将无法完成此任务，因为塞博欣花园将被堕夜精灵花园取代。

f3f99b6ed221d247555a6e7a3982b41b7c44b32a.source: Hinon in the dialogue refers to Kahnu as "old herbalist" and "he", however, Librarian Kahnu is a young female.
f3f99b6ed221d247555a6e7a3982b41b7c44b32a.text: 希农在对话中称卡努为“老草药师”和“他”，然而图书管理员卡努是一位年轻女性。

27f9847c48d632174b55363972d7840e8531b9ce.source: Help Zerai the Learner decide between Norgu and Goren.
27f9847c48d632174b55363972d7840e8531b9ce.text: 帮助学习者泽莱在诺古和巨人之间做出选择。

5ab71991609a6ab00bc7b097ef4937cb989481da.source: Map to Honur Hill, head into Resplendent Makuun and follow your quest marker to Zerai the Learner who is nearby. Speak to Zerai, and decide which of the two heroes: Norgu or Goren, should be sent away to act as bodyguard for Midauha.
5ab71991609a6ab00bc7b097ef4937cb989481da.text: 地图到荣誉山，前往辉煌的马库恩，然后按照你的任务标记找到附近的学习者泽莱。与泽莱交谈，并决定应该派诺尔古或戈伦这两个英雄中的哪一个去担任米道哈的保镖。

583091ed8bc15717dd4db382702d1157e1bbd804.source: Choose carefully: The one you choose will not be your hero until after the completion of the Nightfall Campaign.
583091ed8bc15717dd4db382702d1157e1bbd804.text: 谨慎选择：在夜幕降临战役完成后，你选择的英雄才会成为你的英雄。

dd1f6c9ed75883474f831e6f81791aae6502bb46.source: This is the start of the quest chain that leads to a new hero, either Norgu (a mesmer) or Goren (a warrior).
dd1f6c9ed75883474f831e6f81791aae6502bb46.text: 这是通往新英雄的任务链的开始，这个英雄要么是诺尔古（Norgu）（催眠师），要么是戈伦（Goren）（战士）。

c072569278fa84052f48f4c81e9b1f77e6b791c9.source: You get the hero that you do not recommend to Zerai. If you want Norgu, recommend that he take Goren.
c072569278fa84052f48f4c81e9b1f77e6b791c9.text: 你得到了你不推荐给泽莱的英雄。如果你想要诺尔古，建议他带戈伦。

a1e1157b2a771e04aa20dec3480d8459d750e526.source: If you chose incorrectly, do not speak to Norgu or Goren. Head back to an outpost and abandon this quest. You can start over by accepting it again from Zerai.
a1e1157b2a771e04aa20dec3480d8459d750e526.text: 如果您选择错误，请不要与 Norgu 或 Goren 交谈。返回前哨站并放弃此任务。你可以通过再次从 Zerai 接受它来重新开始。

fcc09da3f03e5a2a56ea1461d267a894f7722418.source: Once you have made your selection, the other hero is not available for that character until that character completes the Nightfall campaign.
fcc09da3f03e5a2a56ea1461d267a894f7722418.text: 一旦您做出选择，在该角色完成夜幕降临战役之前，该角色将无法使用其他英雄。

475bc8102c8a4cab33c7c3b18131880c94c69d7e.source: If you leave this quest unaccepted until the campaign is completed, you can get both the "Gain Goren" and "Gain Norgu" quests. Take this quest, and speak to Zerai in Resplendent Makuun, sending away Norgu, but do NOT speak to Goren. Speak to Prince Bokka without leaving the zone to complete "Gain Goren", and return to Goren to complete this quest. You gain both rewards this way.
475bc8102c8a4cab33c7c3b18131880c94c69d7e.text: 如果您在战役完成之前不接受此任务，您可以获得“获得戈伦”和“获得诺尔古”任务。接受这个任务，并与辉煌马库恩的泽莱交谈，送走诺尔古，但不要与戈伦交谈。在不离开区域的情况下与博卡王子交谈以完成“获得戈伦”，然后返回戈伦完成此任务。您可以通过这种方式获得两种奖励。

e4cb697ae80215084e83fca744e03bdc3c6a9cef.source: If you have the Gain Norgu and Gain Goren quests in your quest log, or complete them Confirmed that abandoning both quests allows the follow-up to be picked up. Have not confirmed if it is available after completing either quest or if only the one corresponding to the opposite hero is in the quest log or completed., this quest will still be available, but the follow up quests will not.
e4cb697ae80215084e83fca744e03bdc3c6a9cef.text: 如果你的任务日志中有获得诺尔古和获得鬣蜥人任务，或者完成它们并确认放弃这两个任务可以接续后续任务。尚未确认完成其中一个任务后是否可用，或者如果任务日志中只有与对面英雄对应的英雄或已完成，则该任务仍然可用，但后续任务将不再可用。

6403be7aab18f65b0c687312e3c3f532a382c460.source: Destroy the Demon Underlords to release the magical bindings placed on the entrance to the spawning tunnels. 0...2 of 2 Demon Underlords remain.
6403be7aab18f65b0c687312e3c3f532a382c460.text: 消灭恶魔霸主，释放放置在产卵隧道入口处的魔法束缚。剩余 2 个恶魔领主中的 0...2 个。

2206b9075c9529c0142148e07328ef8d87f57adf.source: See Adept of Whispers for your reward.
2206b9075c9529c0142148e07328ef8d87f57adf.text: 请参阅低语专家以获得奖励。

0ac6ed2d13666111da9337c93bf9e2934f162d83.source: During the first part of this quest, eighteen groups of six Stygians attack, organized into three sets of six groups. The first three groups attack once the quest is taken, and converge near the Adept of Whispers. Whenever a group is defeated, the next group in the set will attack. For group composition, see below; the most common foes will be Stygian Hungers, which make tanking ineffective due to using skills that bypass spell prevention, armor, and damage reduction.
0ac6ed2d13666111da9337c93bf9e2934f162d83.text: 在此任务的第一部分中，十八个由六名斯泰吉亚人组成的小组发起攻击，分成三组，每组六人。一旦完成任务，前三组就会发起攻击，并在低语专家附近汇聚。每当一组被击败时，该组中的下一组就会发起攻击。对于团体组成，请参见下文；最常见的敌人是冥河饥饿，由于使用绕过法术预防、护甲和伤害减免的技能，坦克会变得无效。

d2602552d5a9530c5b6e18b7a234cdac3c32599d.source: Effective strategies include trapping, spiking, "Can't Touch This!", and Panic to avoid damage or increasing the tank's maximum health with skills such as Signet of Stamina. Traditional tanking is effective against other monsters in the area. Alternatively, each group can be individually pulled, and it is easiest to take on one set of group at a time as each set of groups, if encountered before they converge at the Adept of Whispers, are far from the other two and do not spawn the other sets.
d2602552d5a9530c5b6e18b7a234cdac3c32599d.text: 有效的策略包括诱捕、尖刺、“不能碰这个！”和恐慌以避免伤害或使用耐力印章等技能增加坦克的最大生命值。传统坦克对抗该地区的其他怪物非常有效。或者，每个组都可以单独拉动，并且最容易一次接受一组组，因为每组组如果在聚集于低语专家之前遇到，则距离其他两组很远，并且不会产生其他组。

c8deab0479b2c28f7974fcd8ecc92c843c44d11f.source: For inexperienced teams it's worth noting that a Blinding Flash air elemantalist equipped with Extend Conditions can completely negate physical damages, and can easily keep crowds both crippled and blind when using "You Move Like A Dwarf!" simultaneously with Blinding Flash (since it has no cast time). This can help inexperienced groups to get through this area until they become more confident and switch to more offensive builds. In conjunction with Extend Conditions, a source of Deep Wound could be considered. An intermediate step for groups could then be to force crowds to stick with the tank by using Shared Burden since the AI prefers to target the nearest target when subject to movement impeding skills.
c8deab0479b2c28f7974fcd8ecc92c843c44d11f.text: 对于缺乏经验的队伍来说，值得注意的是，配备了延长条件的致盲闪光空气元素师可以完全消除物理伤害，并且在使用“你像矮人一样移动！”时可以轻松地使人群瘫痪和失明。与致盲闪光同时进行（因为它没有施法时间）。这可以帮助缺乏经验的团队通过这个区域，直到他们变得更加自信并转向更具进攻性的构建。结合扩展条件，可以考虑深度伤口的来源。对于团体来说，一个中间步骤可能是通过使用共享负担来迫使人群坚持坦克，因为人工智能在受到移动阻碍技能时更喜欢瞄准最近的目标。

2c4ed1e956eaa7ae8de526086ff3d42d5e1b3da8.source: After all the waves have been defeated, your party must defeat the two Stygian Underlords; the first is located at the far end of the southwestern hill while the second is located at the far end of the northern hill. The southwestern hill is fairly straightforward, merely requiring careful pulling to prevent being overwhelmed. The northern hill has numerous popups that can easily overpower the party if they do not trigger them slowly. Most monsters on the hills can be individually pulled. The Underlords themselves are similar in power to the regular Stygians.
2c4ed1e956eaa7ae8de526086ff3d42d5e1b3da8.text: 当所有的浪潮都被击败后，你的队伍必须击败两个冥河霸主；第一个位于西南山的远端，第二个位于北山的远端。西南山丘相当简单，只需要小心拉动以防止被淹没即可。北山有许多弹出窗口，如果不缓慢触发，很容易压倒队伍。山上的大部分怪物都可以单独拉。地下领主本身的力量与普通的斯泰吉亚人相似。

68a2109a1740d8306a3bdb50b1d059c2216cfca0.source: Stave off the assault of Abaddon's forces in Nightfallen Jahai.
68a2109a1740d8306a3bdb50b1d059c2216cfca0.text: 在堕夜者贾海抵御阿巴顿军队的进攻。

de64076bb328fed42b09523766d487fd408a1437.source: See Keeper Jinyssa for your reward.
de64076bb328fed42b09523766d487fd408a1437.text: 向守护者吉妮萨寻求奖励。

a10c3bd492c439b6504e5cee9ca2f4616b2ffeab.source: Go into Nightfallen Jahai from the Gate of Torment and wait for the demons to come. They will come in 4 waves. The third wave consists of multiple Arm of Insanity demons plus a boss generically labelled as a Blade of Corruption (you can recognize the boss profession by the color). The final wave contains several Rain of Terror plus another generic boss labelled as a Shadow of Fear. In each wave, it is imperative to bring down the spellcasters first, since they can cause the most trouble.
a10c3bd492c439b6504e5cee9ca2f4616b2ffeab.text: 从折磨之门进入堕夜精灵贾海并等待恶魔的到来。他们将分 4 波来。第三波由多个疯狂之臂恶魔和一个通常标记为腐败之刃的 Boss 组成（您可以通过颜色识别 Boss 职业）。最后一波包含几个恐怖之雨以及另一个标记为恐惧之影的通用 Boss。在每一波浪潮中，必须首先击倒施法者，因为他们会造成最大的麻烦。

a481cad635ad31b6344d1a048d00609b4d25282b.source: If you can use a tank as a barrier, keeping the enemies at a distance, this quest becomes a lot easier versus having your whole party take the aggro. Also, the monoliths to your right as you enter the area will inevitably be aggroed at some point, so you may as well pull them over early, either before the waves start or at least during the early, easier waves. For this quest, your Lightbringer skills and title will be invaluable.
a481cad635ad31b6344d1a048d00609b4d25282b.text:
如果你可以使用坦克作为屏障，使敌人保持一定距离，那么这个任务就会变得比让你的整个队伍承担仇恨要容易得多。此外，当你进入该区域时，你右边的巨石将不可避免地在某些时候被攻击，所以你最好尽早把它们拉过来，要么在波浪开始之前，要么至少在早期、更容易的波浪期间。对于这个任务，你的光明使者技能和头衔将是无价的。

MAPPINGOUT_1297e6acad25d38_0
在任务The Oddbodies期间，你将有6个额外的盟友，他们可以在不死的情况下对抗3波恶魔（不过你必须先从堕夜之地之门开始招募他们）。只要尝试尽快击倒每一波即可。

5dd5eb7f72f3ac8a466c986af351c24067beb09c.source: The four Stygian Lords are each at a different place in the area. Each trench has a few hidden spawns that will ambush the party. Upon entering any trench and getting near the half-way point, a large spawn of melee creatures will appear at either end of the trench and then run to the opposite side (sandwiching whoever is inside). Also, one or two Tormentor demons will spawn on the two cliffs overlooking the trench. It's recommended that the party have someone go in and trigger this spawn first before they enter the trench. This player can either just die in there and get Rebirthed from the cliff above or they can use a teleportation skill like Recall to return to their party members.
5dd5eb7f72f3ac8a466c986af351c24067beb09c.text: 四位斯泰吉亚领主各自位于该地区的不同地点。每个战壕都有一些隐藏的产卵，它们会伏击队伍。进入任何战壕并接近中间点后，战壕的两端都会出现大量近战生物，然后跑到另一侧（夹住里面的人）。此外，一两个折磨恶魔会在俯瞰战壕的两个悬崖上生成。建议队伍在进入战壕之前先派人进去并触发这个生成。该玩家可以死在那里并从上面的悬崖重生，也可以使用像召回这样的传送技能回到他们的队友身边。

70ac08a5e2c9bfdace1e17da720ecbe2c63514dd.source: The Stygian Lords on the map are as follows:
70ac08a5e2c9bfdace1e17da720ecbe2c63514dd.text: 地图上的斯泰吉亚领主如下：

a2d9f85f103892de96b4d35e9852b02be2ef0fc8.source: A monk with a stationary group of Tormentor demons as well as a hidden spawn of the Stygian creatures that will appear upon entering the alcove he is found in.
a2d9f85f103892de96b4d35e9852b02be2ef0fc8.text: 一个僧侣，带着一群固定的折磨恶魔，以及隐藏的冥河生物的后裔，这些生物会在进入他所在的壁龛时出现。

452d9315614234881a37d4a3f2a533d4b503cdf6.source: An elementalist with a large hidden spawn in the alcove he is found in.
452d9315614234881a37d4a3f2a533d4b503cdf6.text: 一个元素师，在他所在的凹室里有一个巨大的隐藏产卵。

aad3a8dc65327832a036e19ed35d80d54ea2d94b.source: A mesmer with a stationary group of Tormentor creatures and a few hidden Torment Claws.
aad3a8dc65327832a036e19ed35d80d54ea2d94b.text: 一名催眠师，拥有一群静止的折磨者生物和一些隐藏的折磨爪。

5b8cfa6d256d9f72145b39197e1db5371e40ce5c.source: A necromancer with a stationary group of Tormentor creatures.
5b8cfa6d256d9f72145b39197e1db5371e40ce5c.text: 一名死灵法师与一群固定的折磨者生物。

896a44ca48e8a52e1b7b6a6f056162e40d12db66.source: The party should pay attention to the patrols roaming near each boss, especially in the case of the elementalist, as one patrol can come from behind the party and surprise them.
896a44ca48e8a52e1b7b6a6f056162e40d12db66.text: 队伍应该注意在每个 Boss 附近漫游的巡逻队，特别是在元素师的情况下，因为一支巡逻队可以从队伍后面出现并给他们一个惊喜。

9613e463251f9a9c3874156130188df908a62660.source: After taking the reward for the quest, six Smothering Tendrils will appear and the Dreadspawn Maw will open. Make sure, before taking the reward, that the area with the large maw is clear and that all party members clear are up by the Adept of Whispers so they do not get killed by the Tendrils' special attack. Killing each of the Tendrils will spawn a group of Torment Claws and Stygian creatures.
9613e463251f9a9c3874156130188df908a62660.text: 获得任务奖励后，会出现六个窒息卷须，并且恐惧之卵之口将会打开。在领取奖励之前，请确保大嘴所在的区域已被清空，并且清空的所有队伍成员都已被低语专家所保护，这样他们就不会被卷须的特殊攻击杀死。杀死每个卷须都会产生一群折磨之爪和冥河生物。

7c66865711eca75d5989e24ab3d6aee94ffcc08a.source: Killing the Dreadspawn Maw spawns a Stygian Chest and progresses the quest Mallyx the Unyielding. See there for a walkthrough.
7c66865711eca75d5989e24ab3d6aee94ffcc08a.text: 杀死恐惧之卵巨口会生成一个冥河宝箱并继续任务“不屈者马里克斯”。请参阅此处的演练。

ed65bc05a254ab6f4278ae7053fb49909fe2e599.source: Make your way to the intercept point with Dunkoro.
ed65bc05a254ab6f4278ae7053fb49909fe2e599.text: 与 Dunkoro 一起前往拦截点。

acb647d494d55cc0a4b2e28602afe1589010e092.source: Split your forces. Attack the Kournan scouts without alerting the others.
acb647d494d55cc0a4b2e28602afe1589010e092.text: 分散你们的力量。在不惊动其他人的情况下攻击库南斥候。

f8d0b97f9c9d6a9bdf058c4118676cc042be5203.source: Upon completion of this quest, Libeh and all four NPC allies that spawn during this quest will spawn in the Command Post.
f8d0b97f9c9d6a9bdf058c4118676cc042be5203.text: 完成此任务后，Libeh 和在此任务中生成的所有四个 NPC 盟友将在指挥所中生成。

a3e110955257e9b70622d41a234f046187a9a5fe.source: This is a quest mainly to acquaint you with the power of the Command Post.
a3e110955257e9b70622d41a234f046187a9a5fe.text: 这个任务主要是为了让你熟悉指挥所的力量。

2bc055e0b03e8e8cfc4e87487b0a07bc1b03708c.source: Move through the portal to the Sunward Marches in the Command Post, then head north. Few enemies will engage you.
2bc055e0b03e8e8cfc4e87487b0a07bc1b03708c.text: 通过传送门前往指挥所的向阳行军，然后向北前进。很少有敌人会与你交战。

3ed103f469ea06d9bbe21b6892f413ae3ad39ae4.source: The guards and the captives are resting when you come upon them. Use your heroes (or do it yourself) to pull the other group of scouts towards the first group, and kill them all. Then kill the guards.
3ed103f469ea06d9bbe21b6892f413ae3ad39ae4.text: 当你遇到守卫和俘虏时，他们正在休息。使用你的英雄（或你自己做）将另一组侦察兵拉向第一组，并将他们全部杀死。然后杀掉守卫。

5c35b8cb4c0a02bd31fc82027f16dc9b4c5dfc72.source: Alternatively, you can ignore the "Split your forces. Attack the Kournan scouts without alerting the others" objective and attack the entire group of the Kournans at once.
5c35b8cb4c0a02bd31fc82027f16dc9b4c5dfc72.text: 或者，你可以忽略“分散你的部队。在不惊动其他人的情况下攻击库南斥候”目标并立即攻击整个库南队伍。

b1273598b40497995dc6b7f004be1547190c4d95.source: This quest can be completed from Venta Cemetery. Simply walking up and killing the guards around the prisoners is sufficient to complete the quest, without needing to reach the intercept point. There are no other foes or patrols to deal with if approaching this way.
b1273598b40497995dc6b7f004be1547190c4d95.text: 该任务可以从文塔墓地完成。只需走上前杀死囚犯周围的守卫就足以完成任务，无需到达拦截点。如果以这种方式接近，就没有其他敌人或巡逻队需要对付。

c969d5b251b475dff16768d1f8ea199aa6311fad.source: Can be be completed at the same time as And a Hero Shall Lead Them.
c969d5b251b475dff16768d1f8ea199aa6311fad.text: 可以与“英雄将带领他们”同时完成。

b91a73f74b09b9540401626d772b6a63ac310c64.source: The Kournan Phalanx will not attack until he says "Did you hear that? We're being followed! Move the prisoners to the back and prepare for attack!"
b91a73f74b09b9540401626d772b6a63ac310c64.text: 库尔南方阵不会攻击，直到他说“你听到了吗？我们被跟踪了！把囚犯移到后面，准备攻击！”

365a0c426f505fc43666aeea96e0de1b20a9a9cf.source: Meet Nerashi on the Marga Coast. She is holding a Kournan scout prisoner there.
365a0c426f505fc43666aeea96e0de1b20a9a9cf.text: 在马尔加海岸遇见 Nerashi。她在那里关押着一名库尔南侦察兵囚犯。

d15b520e7dac96db7ea37c77d94519ce1383e922.source: Interrogate Kehtur and extract any valuable information you can.
d15b520e7dac96db7ea37c77d94519ce1383e922.text: 审问凯图尔并尽可能提取任何有价值的信息。

d96c26dff60f81291ce234cc6b58a53cc1e58bc5.text: 将凯图尔的命运交给奈拉什。

b0c9f98293481edcdbd60a58960c16065f6329f8.source: Destroy the scout group guarding the Kournan peasants and liberate the prisoners.
b0c9f98293481edcdbd60a58960c16065f6329f8.text: 摧毁看守库尔南农民的侦察小组并释放囚犯。

1297e6acacd25d38d77524841dbc6bdb3fb78a16.source: During the quest The Oddbodies, you will have 6 extra allies who can make the difference against the 3 waves of demons without dying (you would however have to start from the Gate of the Nightfallen Lands to recruit them first). Just try to take down each wave as quickly as possible.
1297e6acacd25d38d77524841dbc6bdb3fb78a16.text: 在任务The Oddbodies期间，你将有6个额外的盟友，他们可以在不死的情况下对抗3波恶魔（不过你必须先从堕夜之地之门开始招募他们）。只要尝试尽快击倒每一波即可。

ea99cef99118beff86bd5455c0410f9fb96fb9f9.source: Journey into the trenches of the Stygian Veil and kill the Stygian Lords. 4...0 of 4 still remaining.
ea99cef99118beff86bd5455c0410f9fb96fb9f9.text: 前往斯泰吉亚面纱的战壕并杀死斯泰吉亚领主。还剩下 4...0 个。

1e80730cb7131bb4548db3c8826b4d3f4af75749.source: Without those three quests active, you can still reduce the kill count to less than 60: approach Bryan from the west, but send only heroes and henchmen to him; do not let any players get within compass range. Defeat the three Jade Brotherhood groups that this triggers and clean-up the remaining mobs on the eastern side of the area (do not venture further west, as this will trigger additional foes, potentially raising the required number to the default).
1e80730cb7131bb4548db3c8826b4d3f4af75749.text: 如果没有激活这三个任务，你仍然可以将杀戮数减少到 60 以下：从西边接近布莱恩，但只向他派遣英雄和追随者；不要让任何玩家进入指南针范围内。击败这会触发的三个翡翠兄弟会团体，并清理该地区东侧的剩余怪物（不要冒险进一步向西，因为这会触发更多的敌人，可能会将所需数量提高到默认值）。

481cf4b6cca67f91369140c7ee4808e490d5117f.source: Any party members that have completed Cleansing Bukdek Byway must also take Memories of Purity.
481cf4b6cca67f91369140c7ee4808e490d5117f.text: 任何已完成净化 Bukdek Byway 的队伍成员还必须完成纯洁的回忆。

ae57a1eca4f9f7f4451f26ff80c84e4e63321724.source: Initiate Zei Ri will help you vanquish if you have the quest Cleansing Bukdek Byway (or its hard mode equivalent) active, but only until the last Afflicted is killed.
ae57a1eca4f9f7f4451f26ff80c84e4e63321724.text: 如果你激活了净化 Bukdek Byway（或其困难模式同等）任务，入门者 Zei Ri 将帮助你获胜，但只有在最后一个受折磨者被杀死之前。

5075ebe3a4052b349d2621a946c8fbeb79e719ab.source: Meet up with the Krytan courier in Kaineng Docks.
5075ebe3a4052b349d2621a946c8fbeb79e719ab.text: 在凯能码头与科瑞坦信使会面。

ced4d738b25265a7c301a91e39604c30e78747f5.source: Talk to Courier Falken to get a new move.
ced4d738b25265a7c301a91e39604c30e78747f5.text: 与信使法尔肯交谈以获得新动作。

9f82def04857ffbcdc49e8ba764d9f65dea8e12d.source: Defeat all enemies on the way back to Kaineng Center. Don't get knocked out.
9f82def04857ffbcdc49e8ba764d9f65dea8e12d.text: 击败返回凯能中心途中的所有敌人。别被淘汰了。

5e0e004147634d87c48ff066a0055c46bdc7a6dc.source: See Lei Jeng for your reward.

d1bebfaa40bbf64294312a41b84ff95c77b26150.source: In Kaineng Docks, you need to equip a pair of Brass Knuckles or Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles in order to begin. If you have not completed any of the other brawling quests, Falken will give you a pair. Talk to him again so that he transports you to the quest area.
d1bebfaa40bbf64294312a41b84ff95c77b26150.text: 在凯能码头，你需要装备一对指节铜套或雷拳的指节铜套才能开始。如果你还没有完成任何其他的争吵任务，Falken 会给你一对。再次与他交谈，以便他将你传送到任务区域。

a3f734e27cb4e216a456f6d58e4990fe28da1c46.source: After you arrive in Bukdek Byway, talk to the courier again to start the quest. As is implied from the dialogue, Falken has no idea where to go and will lead you on one of the longest possible routes to Kaineng Center. Most foes will either pop-up or start off as friendly (green dots), which forces you to wait for the required dialogues to trigger before moving between groups.
a3f734e27cb4e216a456f6d58e4990fe28da1c46.text: 到达Bukdek Byway后，再次与信使交谈即可开始任务。正如对话所暗示的那样，法尔肯不知道该去哪里，他会引导你走一条通往凯能中心的最长路线之一。大多数敌人要么会突然出现，要么一开始是友好的（绿点），这迫使你等待所需的对话触发，然后才能在群体之间移动。

fbf5dedb80efd2224e632979431a82bfabde2dec.source: If you do not like brawling, an easy way to complete the quest in normal mode is to follow him and let him kill all the foes. If he dies, he will self-resurrect, allowing you to avoid fighting altogether. However, this takes much longer (about 2-3x longer, i.e. around 50 minutes or more) and you will not receive any drops or experience from the foes unless they are within your aggro bubble.
fbf5dedb80efd2224e632979431a82bfabde2dec.text: 如果你不喜欢打架，在普通模式下完成任务的一个简单方法就是跟随他并让他杀死所有敌人。如果他死了，他会自我复活，让你完全避免战斗。然而，这需要更长的时间（大约长 2-3 倍，即大约 50 分钟或更长时间），并且除非敌人位于您的仇恨气泡内，否则您不会从敌人那里获得任何掉落物或经验。

511188226d8e5701aea8aee43a9e31a0312ec07e.source: The quickest (and most profitable) method is to take the lead and stay slightly ahead of him, attacking red dots as they appear and getting close to green dots before they turn red. Several of your opponents use ranged attacks: either take them out first or move out of their line-of-sight (e.g. around a corner) while you tackle their melee-range allies. As with any brawling quest, if you get knocked out, click on the icon for STAND UP! and press the keypad shortcut (default: 8) simultaneously — this practically guarantees that you will recover in time.
511188226d8e5701aea8aee43a9e31a0312ec07e.text: 最快（也是最有利可图）的方法是领先并稍微领先他，在红点出现时攻击它们，并在绿点变红之前接近它们。你的一些对手使用远程攻击：要么先干掉他们，要么在你对付他们的近战盟友时移出他们的视线（例如在拐角处）。与任何争吵任务一样，如果您被击倒，请单击“站起来”图标！并同时按下键盘快捷键（默认值：8）——这实际上可以保证您能够及时恢复。

b5e4a9a895f9c5e16a96d8e0ac886902830547b7.source: The toughest fight is in the central square, where you might face several groups at once, especially if you have trouble defeating the first few before the next mobs pop up. Worse, unlike the rest of the zone, there are few obstacles to block ranged attacks. You can just keep standing up and trying again, but if that proves unreliable, start to move backtrack your original path. This takes you away from the spawn points and brings you closer to natural barriers. Falken will continue to self-rez and will eventually whittle down your opponent to a manageable number.
b5e4a9a895f9c5e16a96d8e0ac886902830547b7.text: 最艰难的战斗发生在中心广场，在那里你可能会同时面对几个群体，特别是如果你在下一个暴徒出现之前很难击败前几个群体。更糟糕的是，与该区域的其他地方不同，几乎没有什么障碍可以阻挡远程攻击。你可以继续站起来再试一次，但如果事实证明这不可靠，那就开始原路返回。这会让你远离重生点，让你更接近自然屏障。 Falken 将继续自我调整，最终将你的对手减少到可控制的数量。

f259c26c5f22231368ef4027c10fcb510ba69f1a.source: The final fight is just outside of town. The pre-fight dialogue is long enough that you will lose any built-up adrenaline. Falken will target Li Ho Yan; you can either gang-up on him or focus on Tai Soon; either way, you can probably just mash keys to successfully defeat the pair.
f259c26c5f22231368ef4027c10fcb510ba69f1a.text: 最后一场战斗就在城外进行。战斗前的对话足够长，你会失去任何积累的肾上腺素。 Falken将针对李浩彦；你可以联合起来对付他，也可以专注于泰顺；无论哪种方式，你都可以通过组合按键来成功击败这一对。

88f2a1929ebd6a76dfac3908d98d42f0fa9e65e8.source: This is a valuable place to farm experience or cash:
88f2a1929ebd6a76dfac3908d98d42f0fa9e65e8.text: 这是一个积累经验或现金的宝贵场所：

550a57804e798fcde4bb297a99e92ccd8b09b547.source: Since the quest is not repeatable, it must be abandoned and retaken. Alternatively, map to the Marketplace before the quest updates.
550a57804e798fcde4bb297a99e92ccd8b09b547.text: 由于该任务不可重复，因此必须放弃并重新进行。或者，在任务更新之前映射到市场。

d99de39a286aaf88720faf59269be4dc2dad706e.source: Assuming you identify and sell all drops, players can expect to earn 1 — 31 platinum per run.
d99de39a286aaf88720faf59269be4dc2dad706e.text: 假设您找到并出售所有掉落物，玩家每次运行有望赚取 1 - 31 白金。

2e7ec1641750e731c26cd952f49c71f593f74730.source: Lead the Kournan peasants to the safety of the Sunspear Sanctuary.
2e7ec1641750e731c26cd952f49c71f593f74730.text: 带领库南农民前往阳矛圣域的安全。

20a7043f6a8c102b6b156f969013140b10ea805e.source: Upon completion of this quest, Benera, Dzawan, and Megundeh will spawn in the Command Post.
20a7043f6a8c102b6b156f969013140b10ea805e.text: 完成此任务后，贝内拉、扎万和梅根德将在指挥所中生成。

3e42d8cba7884005e8bb06aed8b04e7c341cda59.source: Meet up with Nerashi in the western part of Marga Coast, at point 1. Talk to Kehtur; the dialog choices don't matter. A group of Kournan Bowmen have spawned with the three prisoners to the North, at point 2. Kill them and then escort the prisoners to the entrance of the Sunspear Sanctuary, at point 3 (luckily, they will run as fast as you). Make sure the quest updates before leaving the zone. Consider bringing "Charge!" or similar party-wide Increased Movement Speed in order to get back to the Command Post faster.
3e42d8cba7884005e8bb06aed8b04e7c341cda59.text: 在马尔加海岸西部的第 1 点与 Nerashi 会面。与 Kehtur 交谈；对话框的选择并不重要。在第 2 点，一群库南弓箭手带着三名囚犯来到了北方。在第 3 点杀死他们，然后护送囚犯到阳矛圣所的入口（幸运的是，他们跑得和你一样快）。在离开区域之前确保任务已更新。考虑带上“冲锋！”或类似的全队范围内增加移动速度，以便更快地返回指挥所。

b2773137d499b24c1d9acb14ef04c51ef6b344e1.source: After interrogating Kehtur, you must select the dialogue option "I don't have any more questions for you." to progress the quest.
b2773137d499b24c1d9acb14ef04c51ef6b344e1.text: 审问凯图尔后，你必须选择对话选项“我没有更多问题要问你了”。来推进任务。

4aa111875e8abbff7436e0fa46a204a8cdf3b572.source: An additional chest might spawn near the scout group that guards the peasants.
4aa111875e8abbff7436e0fa46a204a8cdf3b572.text: 一个额外的箱子可能会在保卫农民的侦察小组附近生成。

fd49f715406518f149c8f7d59f72f6862b081415.source: Whether you instruct Nerashi to let Kehtur live or not, she escorts him slowly to Nundu Bay.
fd49f715406518f149c8f7d59f72f6862b081415.text: 无论你指示 Nerashi 是否让 Kehtur 活着，她都会护送他慢慢前往 Nundu 湾。

7d42b6221fba844048d4df97c9d6e261c7cba889.source: Meet with Kerendu and his sons to discuss how they might assist the Sunspears.
7d42b6221fba844048d4df97c9d6e261c7cba889.text: 与克伦杜和他的儿子们会面，讨论他们如何协助烈阳之矛队。

033ba85e410f7fe25856559e9f3ea827945c7456.source: Destroy the Kournan scout unit before it reports your meeting with Kerendu.
033ba85e410f7fe25856559e9f3ea827945c7456.text: 在库南侦察部队报告你与克伦杜的会面之前摧毁它。

ece6778fcd48806c5df9a96e0bf14c14691efa7c.source: Lead Kerendu to safety at the Sunspear Sanctuary.
ece6778fcd48806c5df9a96e0bf14c14691efa7c.text: 带领克伦杜前往烈阳之矛庇护所的安全地带。

088643d41f182ba9230487d101d87a42204e2b7d.source: Upon completion of this quest, Kerendu, Mubata, and Sinbi will spawn in the Command Post.
088643d41f182ba9230487d101d87a42204e2b7d.text: 完成此任务后，Kerendu、Mubata 和 Sinbi 将在指挥所中生成。

215aa5ab7588e32cac2f42e6aaf507fbe1b1aac8.source: Meet up with Kerendu in Sunward Marches. After some dialogue, Kournan soldiers will approach and attack. After defeating them, lead Kerendu to the Command Post entrance. Although there will be few enemies en route, Kerendu and his two sons will not fight.
215aa5ab7588e32cac2f42e6aaf507fbe1b1aac8.text: 在向阳边疆与克伦杜会面。经过一番对话后，库尔南士兵将接近并攻击。击败他们后，带领克伦杜前往指挥所入口。虽然途中敌人很少，但克伦杜和他的两个儿子不会打架。

fd29459fb9df4926ede8535d9478e96729dfcbae.source: Make sure to wait for the NPCs to catch up before leaving the Sunward Marches, as the quest is only marked as complete when they have almost reached a point just before stepping through the portal.
fd29459fb9df4926ede8535d9478e96729dfcbae.text: 确保在离开向阳行军之前等待 NPC 赶上来，因为只有当他们几乎到达即将穿过传送门之前的某个点时，任务才会被标记为完成。

a61f8946830503e5e72b4f424fb91b8398a6e2e2.source: If you have the quest And a Hero Shall Lead Them active, you can obtain two additional Sunspear allies near the Command Post resurrection shrine; they are guarded by a small group of Kournan Bowmen and Priests.
a61f8946830503e5e72b4f424fb91b8398a6e2e2.text: 如果你激活了任务“英雄将带领他们”，你可以在指挥所复活神社附近获得两个额外的烈阳之矛盟友；他们由一小群库南弓箭手和牧师看守。

093219a90b0e6dcf8f711bc9007ba7f03a6b02ce.source: The group of Kournan soldiers spawns in mid-air.
093219a90b0e6dcf8f711bc9007ba7f03a6b02ce.text: 库南士兵群在半空中生成。

d59578e40426b2289e6cad063532ed3450b2782a.source: Clear at least 25 enemies in the Bukdek Byway near Kaineng City 'near Kaineng City' instead of 'in Kaineng City' or 'near Kaineng Center' in hard mode.
d59578e40426b2289e6cad063532ed3450b2782a.text: 在困难模式下，清除凯能市附近“凯能市附近”的 Bukdek Byway 中至少 25 个敌人，而不是“在凯能市内”或“凯能中心附近”。

b32c36b3bba99b5222506b6480fe112d6549eb45.source: Despite the objective description, this quest does not require killing 25 foes, but requires vanquishing the area. The quest is still completed if the area is vanquished by killing less than 25 foes. See Bukdek Byway#Notes for details on 0-kill or low-count vanquishes.
b32c36b3bba99b5222506b6480fe112d6549eb45.text: 尽管有客观描述，但该任务并不需要杀死 25 个敌人，而是需要征服该地区。如果该地区因杀死少于 25 名敌人而被征服，任务仍然完成。有关零杀或低计数征服的详细信息，请参阅 Bukdek Byway#Notes。

d31155c76aaf39e0deb620fc25d3787d66cbc0cc.source: Factions characters will travel north from the Marketplace through here on their way to Kaineng Center for the first time. Non-Factions characters will be required to leave Kaineng Center and travel through this area as part of the primary quest Welcome to Cantha. Many secondary quests take place here.
d31155c76aaf39e0deb620fc25d3787d66cbc0cc.text: 派系角色将从市场向北行进，经过这里，首次前往凯能中心。作为主要任务“欢迎来到凯珊”的一部分，非派系角色将需要离开凯能中心并穿越该区域。许多次要任务都发生在这里。

d2b4133bdce8239c7a0d40cad8ade310b71d6e28.source: If Chasing Zenmai is active, there are several ways you can get credit for vanquishing by killing fewer than 10 foes (depending on your starting outpost), since that quest allows you to enter a section initially devoid of any foes. Party members must not have Eliminate the Am Fah or Eliminate the Jade Brotherhood active.
d2b4133bdce8239c7a0d40cad8ade310b71d6e28.text: 如果“Chasing Zenmai”处于活动状态，您可以通过多种方式通过杀死少于 10 个敌人（取决于您的起始前哨站）来获得胜利，因为该任务允许您进入最初没有任何敌人的部分。党员不得参与消灭阿姆法赫或消灭玉石兄弟会活动。

465d709358fef0f27201980539c9ce9cc3b6f483.source: With The Afflicted Guard active, only one kill is needed (start from Kaineng Center).
465d709358fef0f27201980539c9ce9cc3b6f483.text: 当受苦守卫激活时，只需要击杀一次（从凯能中心开始）。

67d6daaf4ad3f44431c52c21e49b1fde2a955cbe.source: With The Drunken Master active and with The Afflicted Guard inactive; to get credit for the vanquish, you only need to defeat Drinkmaster Tahnu (if you start from Kaineng Center).
67d6daaf4ad3f44431c52c21e49b1fde2a955cbe.text: 醉拳活跃，痛苦守卫不活跃；要获得胜利的功劳，你只需要击败饮料大师塔努（如果你从凯能中心开始）。

fcaf6d8f8a47f336696b3703a9f050cbc10d1352.source: With neither of those active, take the Missing Daughter, which spawns around 10 foes.
fcaf6d8f8a47f336696b3703a9f050cbc10d1352.text: 当这些都没有激活时，选择失踪的女儿，它会产生大约 10 个敌人。

91e64c833ffcd184687b63406d859c5a507bc3a4.source: If the inventory fills up, there is a Merchant (Peasant Shopkeeper) about 2/3 of the way through (near the last big fight). Players can return here before rezoning, to sell a few items and pick up anything left behind.
91e64c833ffcd184687b63406d859c5a507bc3a4.text: 如果库存已满，则在进行到 2/3 左右（靠近最后一场大战）时会出现一个商人（农民店主）。玩家可以在重新分区之前返回这里，出售一些物品并捡起留下的任何东西。

04c672f9d1fe9b0de33294218dc1789b078c35d5.source: With practice, players can gain ~135,000 experience points per hour using experience scrolls.
04c672f9d1fe9b0de33294218dc1789b078c35d5.text: 通过练习，玩家可以使用经验卷轴每小时获得约 135,000 经验点。

629acc4fce49b022fdce0ed6dd50c4786a300db1.source: Players can use this as a less-risky method of gaining experience towards the Survivor title, as they have 10 seconds after being knocked out to STAND UP!. (The death counter will not increase unless the timer runs out before standing up successfully.)
629acc4fce49b022fdce0ed6dd50c4786a300db1.text: 玩家可以将此作为获得幸存者称号的风险较小的方法，因为他们在被击倒后有 10 秒的时间站起来！ （除非在成功站立之前计时器耗尽，否则死亡计数器不会增加。）

578dc5caa4d02cab4b2334064360125905abd358.source: If Falken does more damage to an enemy when it dies, the player will gain the experience but any experience scroll effects will not be renewed.
578dc5caa4d02cab4b2334064360125905abd358.text: 如果Falken在敌人死亡时对敌人造成更多伤害，玩家将获得经验，但任何经验卷轴效果都不会更新。

c2ea724c74fe20acec6a5441637a7c6b989dfb5f.source: The drops are significantly better in hard mode, although some players find it easier to kill foes quickly in normal mode.
c2ea724c74fe20acec6a5441637a7c6b989dfb5f.text: 尽管有些玩家发现在普通模式下更容易快速杀死敌人，但在困难模式下掉落明显更好。

a3d5ddcb3e09dd29a8cb1d3a27269c484d9401d1.source: It can be difficult to maintain the experience-multiplier for experience scrolls that require killing a foe every 30 seconds, since there are three places where there are built-in delays. However, it is possible to use a single 5-minute scroll no matter how long it takes you to complete the mission.
a3d5ddcb3e09dd29a8cb1d3a27269c484d9401d1.text: 对于需要每 30 秒杀死一个敌人的经验卷轴来说，维持经验倍数可能很困难，因为有三个地方存在内置延迟。然而，无论你需要多长时间来完成任务，都可以使用一个 5 分钟的卷轴。

8d513be1ecb8abd8fc03fc80af3495af4fc040e7.source: Players can maintain both adrenaline and any experience bonus if they drag out the last fight before the end-bosses: Rush the last three foes and Falken will move forward (after pausing briefly), triggering the final dialogue. Players need to keep the fight going for about 45 seconds before the bosses become hostile. However, it's easier to just use an extra scroll for the final battle: the cost is relatively low compared to the average drops and the lost adrenaline is not a deciding factor in the final fight.
8d513be1ecb8abd8fc03fc80af3495af4fc040e7.text: 如果玩家在最终boss之前拖延最后一场战斗，则可以保持肾上腺素和任何经验奖励：冲向最后三个敌人，Falken将向前移动（短暂暂停后），触发最终对话。玩家需要让战斗持续大约 45 秒，然后 Boss 才会变得敌对。然而，在最后的战斗中使用额外的卷轴会更容易：与平均掉落相比，成本相对较低，并且失去的肾上腺素并不是最终战斗的决定性因素。

192e07b12b5157540f154126ded1ad42bf8935e3.source: Alternatively, it's fairly trivial to maintain a Scroll of Slayer's Insight for the entire duration of the quest so long as you deal more damage to the bosses than Courier Falken.
192e07b12b5157540f154126ded1ad42bf8935e3.text: 或者，只要你对 Boss 造成的伤害比信使法尔肯更多，那么在整个任务期间保持杀手洞察卷轴就相当简单了。

a56da1322405716cb4142fcc7cf837291a3836d4.source: Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles can be used, instead of regular Brass Knuckles.
a56da1322405716cb4142fcc7cf837291a3836d4.text: 可以使用雷拳的指节铜套代替普通的指节铜套。

9a9dd312ca4f5b26c99ebe2e8ba6083257b414d9.source: Although Falken is affected by standard attacks, players are only subject to damage from skills.
9a9dd312ca4f5b26c99ebe2e8ba6083257b414d9.text: 虽然Falken受到标准攻击的影响，但玩家只会受到技能伤害。

192924d08273588fc83636d377518cc6b75f7c86.source: Unlike the player, Falken does not gain health after a foe dies. To keep him alive, lead the way.
192924d08273588fc83636d377518cc6b75f7c86.text: 与玩家不同的是，法尔肯在敌人死亡后不会获得生命值。为了让他活下去，带路。

a57abae2b56808f6f1979e7bd9a26adc6de30078.source: As with other solo quests, summoning stones cannot be used. However, sweets that increase speed or reduce skill activation times can be (e.g. Red Rock Candy or Birthday Cupcakes).
a57abae2b56808f6f1979e7bd9a26adc6de30078.text: 与其他单人任务一样，不能使用召唤石。然而，可以提高速度或减少技能激活时间的糖果（例如红冰糖或生日纸杯蛋糕）。

1191afebe17f517bcafe3700057d29af865ec732.source: If a player dies shortly before finishing the quest and Falken manages to kill Li Ho Yan and Tai Soon by himself, the quest will still update and count as completed.
1191afebe17f517bcafe3700057d29af865ec732.text: 如果玩家在完成任务前不久死亡，并且 Falken 成功独自杀死了李浩彦和泰顺，任务仍然会更新并算作已完成。

4d8bbbc9b31afc8094032e5bf7f883527cb6ece3.source: Beyond the square where you encounter Jade Brotherhood mobs appearing in waves, there's a chance that if you trigger hidden mobs when Falken is knocked out, he may stand there and no longer move. If this happens, you are forced to restart the quest.
4d8bbbc9b31afc8094032e5bf7f883527cb6ece3.text: 在你遇到一波又一波出现的翡翠兄弟会小怪的广场之外，如果你在法尔肯被击倒时触发隐藏小怪，他可能会站在那里不再移动。如果发生这种情况，您将被迫重新开始任务。

99436e8130928863bd5a5458bb1a1cb105a17bad.source: There is at least one difference between this quest and the same quest in Normal mode:
99436e8130928863bd5a5458bb1a1cb105a17bad.text: 该任务与普通模式下的相同任务至少有一个区别：

7dde993f5d120075163275b7c2ca22428549b685.source: There are 4 more bosses to fight.
7dde993f5d120075163275b7c2ca22428549b685.text: 还有 4 个 Boss 需要战斗。

908059d13aa8824fcb7880d4137b5465346952a4.source: Find the kidnapped guard in Wajjun Bazaar.
908059d13aa8824fcb7880d4137b5465346952a4.text: 在 Wajjun Bazaar 找到被绑架的警卫。

4728704f9074e0fbd937371c25c5fccff1a7b5a3.source: Kill the Am Fah guarding the captive.
4728704f9074e0fbd937371c25c5fccff1a7b5a3.text: 杀死看守俘虏的阿姆法赫。

b371ddb5d693b3875332348412a46bc632963497.source: See Emperor's Hand for your reward.
b371ddb5d693b3875332348412a46bc632963497.text: 前往皇帝之手领取奖励。

db320059a060fde8cbb9a0ef6e9960877ddbd8fb.source: This quest is straight-forward. Entering from either The Marketplace or Nahpui Quarter, make your way to the area just past the entrance to The Undercity. A large group of hostile Am Fah guard the guardsman. Take them out and the quest is complete.
db320059a060fde8cbb9a0ef6e9960877ddbd8fb.text: 这个任务很简单。从市场或纳普伊区进入，穿过幽暗城入口即可到达该区域。一大群充满敌意的 Am Fah 守卫着卫兵。把他们干掉，任务就完成了。

a930b20b421f8a1b9462863f27df5bc73ee63869.source: You can still complete this quest even if It Ends Here is active in your quest log.
a930b20b421f8a1b9462863f27df5bc73ee63869.text: 即使任务日志中的“一切就此结束”处于活动状态，您仍然可以完成此任务。

47637da3203f1bdd9034d32e43714a972cf832f9.source: Even with Seek out Brother Tosai active in your quest log, the Am Fah surrounding the guard will be hostile.
47637da3203f1bdd9034d32e43714a972cf832f9.text: 即使你的任务日志中活跃着“寻找东斋兄弟”，守卫周围的阿姆法赫也会充满敌意。

31d4feadb31b3eae58d2fbef2083c4a55f68db58.source: Infiltrate the Am Fah and eavesdrop upon the Am Fah, without being noticed, to learn the location of the Orrian Tomes.
31d4feadb31b3eae58d2fbef2083c4a55f68db58.text: 潜入 Am Fah 并在不被发现的情况下窃听 Am Fah，以了解 Orrian Tomes 的位置。

2edd0c5df6191839bd0f82b939f4f195f64c7374.source: Capture the Orrian Tome from the Am Fah.
2edd0c5df6191839bd0f82b939f4f195f64c7374.text: 从阿姆法赫手中夺取奥里安巨著。

d58f866239e46735ce9672f5ce7ae21085bcb4e1.source: See Minister Jaisan for your reward.
d58f866239e46735ce9672f5ce7ae21085bcb4e1.text: 去找杰桑部长领取奖励。

6ee9a73435c4e8d40dcb4c5c1dd01e66dee3935a.source: For the quickest route, enter Wajjun Bazaar from Nahpui Quarter, then head to the entrance of the Undercity. Soon after entering, at point 1, you'll come across 2 bandits standing on a bridge. Wait until they finish talking before you attack, that way the quest will update. After the quest updates, kill the bandits and follow the path to 2, where the Am Fah Leader is. Kill him and the Orrian Tome will drop. Return the Tome to Minister Jaisan to complete the quest.
6ee9a73435c4e8d40dcb4c5c1dd01e66dee3935a.text: 最快的路线是从 Nahpui 区进入 Wajjun Bazaar，然后前往幽暗城的入口。进入后不久，在第 1 点，你会遇到 2 个强盗站在桥上。等到他们说完再攻击，这样任务就会更新。任务更新后，杀死强盗并沿着路径前往 2，Am Fah 领袖所在的地方。杀了他，奥里安圣典就会掉落。将书归还给 Jaisan 部长以完成任务。

ee7396a2c1d36dd47382986a1d40d72c2d498911.source: Destroy a suitable target and use the Signet of Capture to acquire a skill.
ee7396a2c1d36dd47382986a1d40d72c2d498911.text: 摧毁一个合适的目标并使用捕获徽记来获得技能。

f11072bc1a5d8e4b8dd5349459109a42d57082c9.source: See Elder Jonah for your reward.
f11072bc1a5d8e4b8dd5349459109a42d57082c9.text: 去找约拿长老领取奖赏。

2055f16d9dafe68122361547244964f4a3434c10.source: You receive a Signet of Capture after obtaining this quest for the first time.
2055f16d9dafe68122361547244964f4a3434c10.text: 第一次完成此任务后，您会收到捕获徽记。

e19dda639e3f2463da8238c70197484c5697357b.source: There are quite a few bosses in the general area; see Marga Coast for image of Boss locations. Any boss will do, though.
e19dda639e3f2463da8238c70197484c5697357b.text: 普通区域的boss不少；请参阅玛加海岸查看 Boss 位置的图片。不过，任何老板都可以。

211ed00b53d53de8bf3242c99f9e4b13634b087f.source: Help Cynn and Mhenlo rescue the Merchant Caravan.
211ed00b53d53de8bf3242c99f9e4b13634b087f.text: 帮助辛恩和门洛营救商队。

9c80188a85e3604450a5650d8e0f75aaea1a0ca3.source: See Laris Dankworth for your reward.
9c80188a85e3604450a5650d8e0f75aaea1a0ca3.text: 请见拉里斯·丹克沃斯以获得奖励。

6a4810457c20a478a2bb1b2a465170013ab0969b.source: You'll find Cynn and Mhenlo near the Resurrection shrine by the Pockmark Flats exit. After accepting the quest from Cynn, take your group into Pockmark Flats. When you reach the Merchant Caravan, a group of Storm riders will attack; defeat them. Then speak with Laris Dankworth (who may be back toward the Resurrection shrine) for your reward.
6a4810457c20a478a2bb1b2a465170013ab0969b.text: 您会在 Pockmark Flats 出口的复活神殿附近找到 Cynn 和 Mhenlo。接受辛恩的任务后，带你的队伍进入波克马克公寓。当你到达商队时，一群风暴骑士会攻击；击败他们。然后与拉里斯·丹克沃斯（Laris Dankworth）（他可能会回到复活神殿）交谈以获得奖励。

8545e44f697090a409595b95374e20387a522f8a.source: If you start the quest and then enter Pockmark Flats from Serenity Temple, Laris will be swarmed easily and die. However, if you proceed to the area where Laris should be, you can kill the swarm and complete that step of the quest, but you must leave through the north portal into Eastern Frontier and return to Pockmark Flats in order to speak to Laris for the reward.
8545e44f697090a409595b95374e20387a522f8a.text: 如果你开始任务然后从宁静神殿进入波克马克平原，拉里斯很容易就会被包围而死。然而，如果你前往拉里斯应该所在的区域，你可以杀死蜂群并完成任务的这一步，但你必须通过北部门户进入东部边境并返回波马克平原才能与拉里斯交谈以获得奖励。

3fb3b6a4dc271fc046110d48099af9a611aed3f4.source: If NPCs are aggroed, Mhenlo may say his second line before the Caravan Guard's answer. The initial dialogue plays even for non-Tyrian characters, who cannot accept the quest.
3fb3b6a4dc271fc046110d48099af9a611aed3f4.text: 如果 NPC 被激怒，Mhenlo 可能会在商队守卫回答之前说出他的第二句话。最初的对话甚至适用于无法接受任务的非泰尔角色。

721ea8f1a5e44d3c6f2e6dc7c9b0aedf986b3186.text: 与农民 Xeng Jo 交谈。

f810d4e87ab1eeaf3fa5e14ef3e45844cc041da9.source: Kneel and plant seeds in each of the farmer's fields.
f810d4e87ab1eeaf3fa5e14ef3e45844cc041da9.text: 跪下，在每一块农田里播种种子。

6a2e119d42d72791625bdd0b2364ac3c95b50e17.source: See Villager Hijai for your reward.
6a2e119d42d72791625bdd0b2364ac3c95b50e17.text: 去找村民 Hijai 领取奖励。

e04ecac3e5eb8031c8964db6c2274c16290dd71e.source: This is a relatively simple quest involving no fighting, and takes only about 1-2 minutes.
e04ecac3e5eb8031c8964db6c2274c16290dd71e.text: 这是一个相对简单的任务，不涉及战斗，只需要大约 1-2 分钟。

0d9c4ee9f108a2f47e5027a903e93adf82e79786.source: Use the emote /kneel to plant the seeds at each location.
0d9c4ee9f108a2f47e5027a903e93adf82e79786.text: 使用表情/跪在每个位置播种种子。

747e28859ca8a1ce834a28735ddc4f9c04e510d8.source: Similar to Study Buddy, if you completed the Zen Daijun mission with this quest in your Quest Log, you can go accept the reward even though the quest objectives do not display as being completed.
747e28859ca8a1ce834a28735ddc4f9c04e510d8.text: 与学习伙伴类似，如果您在任务日志中完成了禅宗大君任务，即使任务目标没有显示为已完成，您也可以去接受奖励。

2f0aacfbee7e31e18559fc897f9a4aa726dd87cf.source: Deliver the Casualty Report to Warmaster Tydus.
2f0aacfbee7e31e18559fc897f9a4aa726dd87cf.text: 将伤亡报告交给战帅泰杜斯。

2e5bf1c1bca159a44030906fe6df8bf88b057d5d.source: Return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.
2e5bf1c1bca159a44030906fe6df8bf88b057d5d.text: 返回送葬者科蒂斯处领取奖励。

ea5fd748652485a2274ab10ba03df793d894bbc1.source: Simply map travel to Ascalon City and talk to Warmaster Tydus, then return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.
ea5fd748652485a2274ab10ba03df793d894bbc1.text: 只需在地图上前往阿斯卡隆城并与战帅泰杜斯交谈，然后返回送葬者科蒂斯即可获得奖励。

fcd197e03352b2f7b8418842a935735eea7a4f9c.source: All professions can do this quest, but only necromancers get a skill as a reward.
fcd197e03352b2f7b8418842a935735eea7a4f9c.text: 所有职业都可以完成这个任务，但只有死灵法师才能获得技能作为奖励。

469d17f00ed4fb54ca93990ef8726361fa72dba6.source: This is a non-repeatable quest. If completed under any other profession(s), this skill reward will have to be acquired from a skill trainer.
469d17f00ed4fb54ca93990ef8726361fa72dba6.text: 这是一个不可重复的任务。如果在任何其他职业下完成，则必须从技能训练师处获得该技能奖励。

6c00a7b5d4d99a9222a2c2759ebe4ee61b30264d.source: This quest continues the storyline of Fallen Soldiers, even though this quest can be completed before Fallen Soldiers.
6c00a7b5d4d99a9222a2c2759ebe4ee61b30264d.text: 该任务延续了阵亡士兵的故事情节，尽管该任务可以在阵亡士兵之前完成。

19f1687cdd014c94be86ddc39e98269d6c9e44e1.text: 重复次数：750（困难模式下为 1,125）

535d4f4445ccdee69b5577fe48b09f0c537ea30e.source: If you do not have the required quest, you cannot advance beyond the door on the first level before the first collector near the Torn Cloth.
535d4f4445ccdee69b5577fe48b09f0c537ea30e.text: 如果您没有所需的任务，则无法在撕裂布附近的第一个收集者之前超越第一层的门。

27f73655d9b57b024d6e703cebc12671b86e869a.source: Killing a Becalmed Djinn on level 3 will cause a number of hidden monsters to spawn.
27f73655d9b57b024d6e703cebc12671b86e869a.text: 杀死第 3 级平静的巨灵会导致大量隐藏的怪物出现。

f6fdc3808aae02926484c5031718972a124a905e.source: Fire Jet and Fire Dart turrets can be disabled by killing the Flame Guardians.
f6fdc3808aae02926484c5031718972a124a905e.text: 杀死火焰守护者可以使火焰喷射器和火焰镖炮塔失效。

e7e85c013f3439027a64e3a216b8682f69863ea1.source: This dungeon has many foes that are not fleshy.
e7e85c013f3439027a64e3a216b8682f69863ea1.text: 这个地下城有很多非肉身的敌人。

f61d8e1898a246b34b3a0b8eeec0312bb1a4703d.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #1 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
f61d8e1898a246b34b3a0b8eeec0312bb1a4703d.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 1 页。

1302ca2da39ded82f42665d986d8605e1f56afde.source: Roaring Ethers sometimes spawn inside a wall and walk through a wall in level 2 and get stuck.
1302ca2da39ded82f42665d986d8605e1f56afde.text: 咆哮以太有时会在墙内生成，并在第 2 关中穿过墙并被卡住。

3efa98efc5f9b0bf760c1b507bebf250c0e6d459.source: The main issues with this dungeon are the groups of Elementals, bring spell caster shutdown and spread out when facing them.
3efa98efc5f9b0bf760c1b507bebf250c0e6d459.text: 这个地下城的主要问题是元素群体，在面对他们时会导致施法者关闭并分散开来。

8b1b59f5a5c87128f7d6f218aacb6ae35b53bace.source: Go north through the tunnel and head left through the flame traps, then proceed northwest. You need to kill the Infernal Siege Wurm in the trench for the Dungeon Key - casters and ranged attacks can reach it from the cliffs east of the wurm, but you will have to venture into the pit to pick up the key (be wary of flame traps). Head west for the dungeon gate and to the portal to level 2.
8b1b59f5a5c87128f7d6f218aacb6ae35b53bace.text: 向北穿过隧道，向左穿过火焰陷阱，然后向西北行进。你需要杀死战壕中的地狱攻城亚龙以获得地牢钥匙 - 施法者和远程攻击可以从亚龙东边的悬崖到达它，但你必须冒险进入坑中拿起钥匙（小心火焰陷阱）。向西前往地牢门并通过传送门到达 2 层。

36cbb56ed813fb4ffc93528eb7fe24d8837c2b11.source: Kill the southern Regent of Flame to obtain the Dungeon Key. The southern route is shorter and poses fewer problems for melee characters as there are fewer burning surfaces. After unlocking the gate be wary of the burrowing Infernal Wurm.
36cbb56ed813fb4ffc93528eb7fe24d8837c2b11.text: 杀死南部的火焰摄政王以获得地牢钥匙。南部路线较短，并且由于燃烧表面较少，因此对近战角色造成的问题较少。打开大门后，要小心挖洞的地狱亚龙。
