d98b99078bed95136f1dfc77d2ee9d980a4b446e.text: 敌人无法瞄准或伤害 Jenn 和 Chance。

823ac89c39975c7134b7618ab5bbe4f026a349c7.source: Find Imperial Guard Miyuki in Wajjun Bazaar.
823ac89c39975c7134b7618ab5bbe4f026a349c7.text: 在 Wajjun Bazaar 找到帝国卫队 Miyuki。

0cb379804660cff5451ebe5187e96ea37f0ffda1.source: Ask around to find out where Imperial Guard Natsumi has been.
0cb379804660cff5451ebe5187e96ea37f0ffda1.text: 四处打听，看看帝国卫队夏海去了哪里。

9c5938a09db6dc4c2a579ba09d142c9897229586.source: Head to the location Miyuki has suggested.

6514f4e7975f7cdaf50b86bc3502fac38a5bfa3d.source: Defeat Meijun, Vengeful Eye and his allies.
6514f4e7975f7cdaf50b86bc3502fac38a5bfa3d.text: 击败美君、复仇之眼和他的盟友。

73278108a3dac3c02175f0780d2b2ba656c92914.source: See Lei Jeng For your reward.

8553f4710d5d4735df12460cdd2c81a1a173e4ad.source: Miyuki is just south of The Marketplace, battling a single Jade Brotherhood member. Help her defeat and interrogate him. Search for more Jade Brotherhood Members and Peasants in Wajjun Bazaar. Depending on the NPC you speak to, some of the options will increase the progress bar more than the other options, while other options won't increase the progress bar at all. Jade Brotherhood Members have a higher effect on the bar than the peasants with one exception. If you ask Peasant 1, "Who's your daddy?" he tells you his father is Yon Ruino. Speaking to Yon Ruino will greatly increase the bar's progress. After you have found enough evidence, head towards the Jade Brotherhood headquarters on the dock north of Wajjun Bazaar. Defeat Meijun's party to finish the quest. Make sure that Miyuki follows you while you gather information, or you will not be able to finish the quest, as Miyuki tends to get stuck between the NPCs and gets left behind.
8553f4710d5d4735df12460cdd2c81a1a173e4ad.text: 美雪位于市场南边，正在与一名翡翠兄弟会成员作战。帮助她击败并审问他。在 Wajjun Bazaar 寻找更多玉石兄弟会成员和农民。根据与您交谈的 NPC，某些选项会比其他选项增加更多进度条，而其他选项则根本不会增加进度条。翡翠兄弟会成员对酒吧的影响力高于农民，但有一个例外。如果你问农民1：“你爸爸是谁？”他告诉你他的父亲是Yon Ruino。与Yon Ruino交谈将大大增加酒吧的进度。找到足够的证据后，前往位于 Wajjun Bazaar 北部码头的翡翠兄弟会总部。击败美君一行人即可完成任务。确保 Miyuki 在收集信息时跟随您，否则您将无法完成任务，因为 Miyuki 往往会被困在 NPC 之间并被落在后面。

a184b32d60fd2b0297a1ca0b69e8b879e548c792.source: The most efficient way of gathering evidence:
a184b32d60fd2b0297a1ca0b69e8b879e548c792.text: 收集证据最有效的方法：

0a4b510a0f7177077c1719856ac437b11fce42ab.source: Head to Miyuki at the start

4b5d039b2251dffc0f1326dcc5fd0476965a7b97.source: Continue past her to defeat and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 1, picking the first option.
4b5d039b2251dffc0f1326dcc5fd0476965a7b97.text: 继续越过她击败并与翡翠兄弟会成员 1 交谈，选择第一个选项。

832fa2820ec3cb64ef787b320743024bf1148ff7.source: Head directly west to speak to Peasant 1, picking the third option.
832fa2820ec3cb64ef787b320743024bf1148ff7.text: 直接向西前往与农民 1 交谈，选择第三个选项。

1a1f6993a0f99717ffd81ef782c29415948d2d24.source: Retrace your steps northeast until Yon Ruino is visible and speak to him.
1a1f6993a0f99717ffd81ef782c29415948d2d24.text: 向东北方向折回，直到看到 Yon Ruino 并与他交谈。

a852d15fb98143fee2b71fc9bf7d6e34c1d8ceb7.source: Head west along the waterfront and speak to Peasant 5, picking the first option. This will be enough to fill the bar in Normal Mode.
a852d15fb98143fee2b71fc9bf7d6e34c1d8ceb7.text: 沿着海滨向西走，与农民 5 交谈，选择第一个选项。这足以填充正常模式下的栏。

87f4e77a6bf539c11ab55be94602553510d0a058.source: For Hard Mode, continue west along the dock and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 5, choosing option two, which will be enough to fill the bar.
87f4e77a6bf539c11ab55be94602553510d0a058.text: 对于困难模式，沿着码头继续向西，与翡翠兄弟会成员 5 交谈，选择选项二，这将足以填满酒吧。

eee57eece4ee320639c9c18b21558262f044b722.source: From here, continue on as normal to defeat Meijun and his group.
eee57eece4ee320639c9c18b21558262f044b722.text: 从这里开始，继续正常前进，击败美君一行人。

c64652016dbab922b06f67cbe260855c9daa47c5.source: Peasants don't have much information to share. You gain the most progress by speaking to the Jade Brotherhood Members.
c64652016dbab922b06f67cbe260855c9daa47c5.text: 农民没有太多信息可以分享。通过与翡翠兄弟会成员交谈，你可以获得最大的进步。

013195c58e91e10f6ef77fab5060270f41e03838.source: Make sure Miyuki is following you to "the location Miyuki has suggested", as she can get stuck on the way there, and the quest won't update without her presence.
013195c58e91e10f6ef77fab5060270f41e03838.text: 确保 Miyuki 跟随你到达“Miyuki 建议的位置”，因为她可能会被困在去那里的路上，并且如果没有她在场，任务就不会更新。

909b0a2c20292e1d089254e9ec28e014616fbbba.source: Miyuki will become stuck on NPCs along the way, a simple fix is get her unstuck on any she does so that the quest will update when you head to the location of Natsumi.
909b0a2c20292e1d089254e9ec28e014616fbbba.text: Miyuki 一路上会被 NPC 困住，一个简单的解决办法就是让她摆脱她所做的任何事情，这样当你前往 Natsumi 的位置时，任务就会更新。

5a9969c5a96bf3d24a82d70db5820e5d37d55bc9.source: Guild Wars Prophecies installed on the account
5a9969c5a96bf3d24a82d70db5820e5d37d55bc9.text: 帐户上安装的激战预言

759236959b6ce08ada4ff46992172909cd837f12.source: Travel to the Arid Sea in Tyria and find the bones of Shanrah's husband.
759236959b6ce08ada4ff46992172909cd837f12.text: 前往泰瑞亚的干旱海并找到香拉丈夫的骸骨。

00887bce16eff8fb07581e3e31dcace6ceb6f9b4.source: Strike down Khepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path and free the souls of Rotal's daughters.
00887bce16eff8fb07581e3e31dcace6ceb6f9b4.text: 击倒先知之路上的凯普赫特骨髓盛宴并释放罗塔尔女儿们的灵魂。

9e15ccd8d3e9c9298372e3d6c66e45de0f115cf7.text: 去香拉那里领取奖励吧。

0470c61093558fbf96323206b5fa7c380e97f2ca.source: Shanrah will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.
0470c61093558fbf96323206b5fa7c380e97f2ca.text: 此任务完成后，香拉将不再生成。

5c6a2fe57f1163b57499e5d127b4de629eafad82.source: Rotal's bones are located at the south end of the Arid Sea. Rather than using map travel, it is faster to find the Forgotten Guardian at the northwestern end of Crystal Overlook and have him teleport you to the Arid Sea.
5c6a2fe57f1163b57499e5d127b4de629eafad82.text: 罗塔尔的骨头位于干旱海的南端。与使用地图旅行相比，在水晶眺望台西北端找到被遗忘的守护者并让他将你传送到干旱海会更快。

5b0337aa9516a498f3f810d2a3b6d448b4b35a7d.source: After speaking with Rotal, you will need to kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path.
5b0337aa9516a498f3f810d2a3b6d448b4b35a7d.text: 与罗塔尔交谈后，你需要杀死先知之路上的凯普赫特·骨髓盛宴。

8e3f64970f3700d60e59d696eb5d9def97310393.source: Travel back to Shanrah in Elona for your reward.
8e3f64970f3700d60e59d696eb5d9def97310393.text: 返回伊洛纳的香拉以获得奖励。

a58a6bd6c4997c947c37f3eb20e203440a6b5fc7.source: When you return to Shanrah for your reward, her daughters, Kyrisah and Meymo, will be standing next to her.
a58a6bd6c4997c947c37f3eb20e203440a6b5fc7.text: 当您返回香拉领取奖励时，她的女儿 Kyrisah 和 Meymo 将站在她旁边。

be7d1a4c5e0eae080ce911a5f5929926e2eded39.source: The Bleached Bones east of the Dunes of Despair in The Arid Sea was the first mention of this story, which remained incomplete until Nightfall was released. If a player does not already have the quest from Shanrah, it will make no mention of either the quest or trying to find her.
be7d1a4c5e0eae080ce911a5f5929926e2eded39.text: 干旱海绝望沙丘以东的漂白骨头是这个故事的第一次提及，直到《夜幕降临》发布之前，这个故事仍然不完整。如果玩家还没有收到 Shanrah 的任务，则不会提及该任务或试图找到她。

40bef76abd70431e50bc5323cc2f85551b723b1f.source: This quest can be completed at the same time as the Kepkhet Marrowfeast Zaishen quest.
40bef76abd70431e50bc5323cc2f85551b723b1f.text: 该任务可以与 Kepkhet Marrowfeast Zaishen 任务同时完成。

25568b156ab4e9f0bc3312ed132f035bec0b3188.source: This is one of very few quests requiring you to kill a pre-existing boss.
25568b156ab4e9f0bc3312ed132f035bec0b3188.text: 这是极少数要求你杀死预先存在的 Boss 的任务之一。

91c69e425f6c857f764581da2d7d4bc237f3d066.source: Talk to Ailonseh Dejarin about Koss and the family estate.
91c69e425f6c857f764581da2d7d4bc237f3d066.text: 与 Ailonseh Dejarin 谈论科斯和家族庄园。

620670b9614e1528b81f791f184d1ae0ab8d582f.source: Deliver Ailonseh's letter to Zudash Dejarin.
620670b9614e1528b81f791f184d1ae0ab8d582f.text: 将艾隆塞的信交给祖达什·德贾林。

bffd00b38e354f452e0811d5760d7a652c5c8dfd.source: Exit into Arkjok Ward from Yohlon Haven. Ailonseh is just a little way to the East of the portal, she will give you a letter when she sees Koss. Talk to Zudash Dejarin in Yohlon Haven for your reward.
bffd00b38e354f452e0811d5760d7a652c5c8dfd.text: 从 Yohlon Haven 出口进入 Arkjok Ward。艾隆塞就在传送门东边不远的地方，她见到科斯时会给你一封信。与 Yohlon Haven 的 Zudash Dejarin 交谈以获得奖励。

93713f609c44feec60dea1c55e99822e3869f9f7.source: Find the ghosts of Barris and Tamra Lefey.
93713f609c44feec60dea1c55e99822e3869f9f7.text: 找到巴里斯和塔姆拉·莱菲的鬼魂。

a18705b9a65d07f24f70566084fb6311aee5cc86.source: Lead the ghosts to the gates of Ascalon City.
a18705b9a65d07f24f70566084fb6311aee5cc86.text: 带领鬼魂来到阿斯卡隆城门口。

00bdcb9430bb30404c66a4fa4d694850e422f5b1.source: See Elise Lefey for your reward.
00bdcb9430bb30404c66a4fa4d694850e422f5b1.text: 请见 Elise Lefey 领取奖励。

db6e6b748b2b75fd8a8a411c79a1c646174bd3e7.source: Kneel at the statue of Dwayna in Sardelac Sanitarium. The Avatar of Dwayna will appear with a quest marker over her head. Speak with her to get the quest.
db6e6b748b2b75fd8a8a411c79a1c646174bd3e7.text: 在沙德拉疗养院的德薇娜雕像前跪下。德薇娜的化身将会出现，头上会出现一个任务标记。与她交谈以获得任务。

5979ae0c91208204a4447923a8c72460e644f067.source: This quest is easiest to do if you leave from Ascalon City. Head west and keep along with the Wall, and continue to hug the wall. You'll fight some Gargoyles and Hulking Stone Elementals while hugging the walls. You'll pass Master Ranger Nente and a collector at the statue of Balthazar (the former entrance to Green Hills County in pre-Searing Ascalon). Continue heading west, and you'll encounter some Devourers that pop out of the ground. Once the hills break, veer southwest (the exit to the Breach will be to the northwest). You'll have to clear any enemies surrounding the ghosts before they'll follow you, but approach the ghosts and they'll speak (point A on the wiki map).
5979ae0c91208204a4447923a8c72460e644f067.text: 如果你从阿斯卡隆城离开，这个任务最容易完成。向西走，沿着墙走，继续紧贴墙。你将在紧贴墙壁的同时与一些石像鬼和巨大的石元素战斗。您将在巴尔萨泽雕像（前灼热阿斯卡隆绿山县的入口）处经过游侠大师南特和一位收藏家。继续向西前进，你会遇到一些从地下冒出来的吞噬者。一旦山丘破裂，就转向西南（突破口的出口将在西北）。你必须清除幽灵周围的所有敌人，然后他们才会跟随你，但接近幽灵，他们就会说话（维基地图上的 A 点）。

ca4245ebf748f97bcea36ece5098168befa71a89.source: Head back east once you've found the ghosts. It should be an easy walk back, but you may encounter some stray Hulking Stone Elementals. You'll lead the ghosts back down near the clearing between Ambassador Zain's caravan and Warmaster Grast (point B). Elise and Toby Lefey will run down from the broken wall, and another dialogue will ensue between the ghosts, later joined by Elise and Toby. The ghosts disappear when the dialogue is finished, and you can speak with Elise to get your reward.
ca4245ebf748f97bcea36ece5098168befa71a89.text: 找到鬼魂后，向东返回。回去应该很容易，但你可能会遇到一些流浪的巨石元素。你将带领鬼魂回到扎因大使的商队和战帅格拉斯特之间的空地附近（B点）。伊莉丝和托比·莱菲将从断墙上跑下来，鬼魂之间将进行另一场对话，随后伊莉丝和托比也加入其中。对话结束后鬼魂就会消失，你可以与伊莉丝交谈以获得奖励。

4dba36802d1cf26b7e4439344f3f4652177b4fe8.source: Obtain a Drake Kabob from Chef Lonbahn in Kamadan.
4dba36802d1cf26b7e4439344f3f4652177b4fe8.text: 从卡马丹的厨师 Lonbahn 处获得德雷克烤肉串。

9ddb6984f59e27a53fc0aa09f9ef6fee62f1fe2b.source: Obtain a bowl of Skalefin Soup from Chef Panjoh in the Astralarium.
9ddb6984f59e27a53fc0aa09f9ef6fee62f1fe2b.text: 从 Astralarium 的厨师 Panjoh 处获得一碗 Skalefin 汤。

7585f57b01cdb5ae70e3a179a3cc59aeb13e7a2f.source: Obtain a plate of Pahnai Salad from Chef Volon at Champion's Dawn.
7585f57b01cdb5ae70e3a179a3cc59aeb13e7a2f.text: 从 Champion's Dawn 的厨师 Volon 处获得一盘 Pahnai 沙拉。

2a6587cdeda9c5387f5f33411c36e12751ebf323.source: See Royal Chef Hatundo for your reward.
2a6587cdeda9c5387f5f33411c36e12751ebf323.text: 请见皇家厨师 Hatundo 领取奖励。

3040ce676bcf0a61401047c00abb10c0ffc77744.source: Since the locations of all the chefs can be looked up in your Quest Log, the only problem you're faced with is actually acquiring the ingredients for each dish. All three chefs function like collectors - you'll be able to exchange one Chunk of Drake Flesh for a drake kabob in Kamadan, two Skale Fins for skalefin soup in The Astralarium, and two Iboga Petals for pahnai salad in Champion's Dawn. As for where to get those:
3040ce676bcf0a61401047c00abb10c0ffc77744.text: 由于所有厨师的位置都可以在任务日志中查找，因此您面临的唯一问题实际上是获取每道菜的原料。所有三位厨师的功能都像收藏家一样 - 您可以在卡马丹用一块龙肉换取龙肉烤肉，在星辰中用两块斯卡勒鳍换取龙鳍汤，在冠军黎明中用两片伊博加花瓣换取帕纳伊沙拉。至于从哪里获得这些：

8f3fa14c81ed3a76ffb510314e5ba143c683765f.source: Iboga Petals are the easiest to get. Simply farm your way through all the Fanged Iboga wandering across the Plains of Jarin. If you're somewhat low-level, you'll have to watch out for some of the level 6 variety crawling around, but in all, it won't be difficult to gain the two petals for the salad. You can also go to Churrhir Fields and fight Iboga Root if you are low level.
8f3fa14c81ed3a76ffb510314e5ba143c683765f.text: 伊博加花瓣是最容易获得的。只需在贾林平原上的所有尖牙伊博加中耕种即可。如果你的等级比较低，你就得小心一些爬来爬去的6级品种，但总的来说，获得沙拉的两片花瓣并不困难。如果你等级低的话，你也可以去丘里尔田地和伊博加鲁特战斗。

f76e8a97ef94bcfbdc2745f695af6ed031b8201e.source: Skale Fins will, as the name implies, drop from any of the Skale species. There are some low-level Skale in the Plains of Jarin, but it won't be easy solo-farming them for the fins. You'll be fighting your way through quite a lot of these critters if you explore Istan, though, so if you just try to finish all quests in the region, you'll most likely end up with more than two of these.
f76e8a97ef94bcfbdc2745f695af6ed031b8201e.text: 顾名思义，斯卡勒鳍会从任何斯卡勒物种中掉落。贾林平原上有一些低等级的斯凯尔鱼，但单独养殖它们来获取鱼鳍并不容易。不过，如果你探索伊斯坦，你将会与很多这样的生物战斗，所以如果你只是尝试完成该地区的所有任务，你很可能最终会遇到两个以上的这些生物。

217febac6dfa167edfd78ec14463237e5ff7852f.source: A Chunk of Drake Flesh is the hardest to acquire. They drop off Irontooth Drakes, which are quite rare in the starting areas (though you can find one surrounded by termites near the Astralarium, and a couple in the shallow water just east and north of the Champion's Dawn portal in Plains of Jarin), and even then, they're level 10. The drop rate isn't all that magnificent, either. Trying to get this immediately will become tedious very quickly. If you're desperate to complete the quest without leveling up first, you can always buy some from another player. Beware, though, because the prices charged for these items are definitely not of the 'cheap' variety.
217febac6dfa167edfd78ec14463237e5ff7852f.text: 一块龙肉是最难获得的。他们会掉落铁牙幼龙，这在起始区域相当罕见（尽管你可以在星界附近找到一只被白蚁包围的幼龙，以及贾林平原冠军黎明传送门东部和北部浅水中的一对），即便如此，它们的等级也只有 10 级。掉落率也不是那么高。试图立即得到这个很快就会变得乏味。如果您迫切希望在不升级的情况下完成任务，您可以随时从其他玩家那里购买一些。但请注意，因为这些商品的价格绝对不是“便宜”的。

b9d58d48944f53996e15d9afaaeb3cac7846917e.source: Hint: Try to do this quest alone, it will increase the drop rate for all the ingredients. If you have any higher level characters you can use them to solo and then place the items in your Xunlai Storage for your other characters.
b9d58d48944f53996e15d9afaaeb3cac7846917e.text: 提示：尝试单独完成这个任务，它会增加所有材料的掉落率。如果您有任何更高级别的角色，您可以使用它们单独使用，然后将物品放入您的寻来存储中以供其他角色使用。

bce4cdf53efca710d737fba8d8502f505420f66b.source: Unlike most quests, there appears to be no chat screen notice about Royal Chef Hatundo taking the items.
bce4cdf53efca710d737fba8d8502f505420f66b.text: 与大多数任务不同，聊天屏幕上似乎没有关于皇家厨师哈通多拿走物品的通知。

1ef669b2c0d553dc0bd02b58bf52ad2305a34721.source: Protect the emperor's cook as he serves soup to the poor.
1ef669b2c0d553dc0bd02b58bf52ad2305a34721.text: 保护皇帝的厨师，因为他为穷人提供汤。

564878d510cce9cd1ac7563e347c25279ca069fe.source: See Imperial Guardsman Kintae for your reward.
564878d510cce9cd1ac7563e347c25279ca069fe.text: 前往帝国卫队金泰处领取奖励。

6d5891e0dbad948ce418e23af317f3664191fd8e.source: Follow the western edge of the Bukdek Byway until you reach Imperial Chef Yileng. You can wait for the two mobs of Afflicted to approach your position, but it is safer to move up the ramp the Chef faces and block the Afflicted right on the bridge, fighting them there.
6d5891e0dbad948ce418e23af317f3664191fd8e.text: 沿着 Bukdek Byway 的西边行驶，直至抵达御厨一冷。你可以等待两个受苦者小怪接近你的位置，但更安全的做法是爬上厨师面对的坡道并在桥上阻挡受苦者，在那里与他们战斗。

43ac10de48338e49dd3dcebed85cf464ce6a58ee.source: Sometimes the second group of Afflicted gets stuck with fighting the peasants by the big hole before both of the bridges. If so, you'll have to run all the way down to the hole and kill them there.
43ac10de48338e49dd3dcebed85cf464ce6a58ee.text: 有时，第二组受苦者会在两座桥前的大洞里与农民战斗。如果是这样，你就必须一路跑到洞里并在那里杀死他们。

b2e1f56fa0eb042eaaa1ee575748ba050338e801.source: Sate Toma's appetite. Lower the Health of a targeted enemy to 20% to activate Toma's Feeding Frenzy skill.
b2e1f56fa0eb042eaaa1ee575748ba050338e801.text: 满足托马的胃口。将目标敌人的生命值降低至 20%，以激活托玛的疯狂进食技能。

19155d9753fdc707c325317d3398dadbefdaa8d2.source: Take Toma around the Marga Coast and attack enemies, but do not kill them, so that Toma can use Feeding Frenzy. Toma's hunger level decreases with each enemy eaten. When it is zero, return to Chuno to collect the reward.
19155d9753fdc707c325317d3398dadbefdaa8d2.text: 带着托玛在马尔加海岸周围攻击敌人，但不要杀死他们，这样托玛就可以使用狂暴喂养。每吃掉一个敌人，托马的饥饿程度就会降低。当为零时，返回Chino领取奖励。

c51885d37c53723ad885294840d2b0a04e3f7b1e.source: Once Toma has eaten his fill, he will remain with the party until within compass range of Chuno. He will continue to fight for you, and swallow opponents, which makes him a valuable ally. Since this quest is not repeatable, consider saving this quest for a skill capture or vanquishing run.
c51885d37c53723ad885294840d2b0a04e3f7b1e.text: 一旦托马吃饱了，他就会留在队伍中，直到进入丘诺的罗盘范围内。他会继续为你而战，并吞噬对手，这使他成为一个有价值的盟友。由于此任务不可重复，请考虑将此任务保存为技能捕获或征服运行。

7af9886f96ea516d7461a23c7b9050a05b4803f5.source: If Toma dies after eating his fill, the game informs you that you have failed the quest, but your quest log indicates that the quest has been completed. It seems the log is accurate, since you can claim the reward even with Toma dead. Simply rezone and accept the reward.
7af9886f96ea516d7461a23c7b9050a05b4803f5.text: 如果托马吃饱后死亡，游戏会通知你任务失败，但你的任务日志显示任务已完成。看来日志是准确的，因为即使托马死了你也可以领取奖励。只需重新分区并接受奖励即可。

68fb4de69815fef43bd48fbb921a4cebe43dcc51.source: Toma does not spawn during Undead Defenders.
68fb4de69815fef43bd48fbb921a4cebe43dcc51.text: 托马不会在亡灵防御者期间生成。

a0f6c2e146791c16e29d3c0287b5fc89546b163e.source: Kill Fendi Nin in the Shards of Orr.
a0f6c2e146791c16e29d3c0287b5fc89546b163e.text: 在奥尔碎片中杀死芬迪·宁。

b8ae10318194c385b9c904dab75d0ed003925fea.source: *BONUS* Kill Fendi Nin in Hard Mode.
b8ae10318194c385b9c904dab75d0ed003925fea.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Fendi Nin。

af03050123baffa6cbe0081d59c879ff2973f0bb.text: 在诺拉特领地杀死芬里尔。

62a06f2d21aa2f4de41a5825ce3d700472996615.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死芬里尔。

13490f5370623d23afe71a2174860a661547d38e.source: Leave Gunnar's Hold into Norrhart Domains and travel west. Continue to proceed to the cave system that is marked with the Warning to Travelers sign. Once inside the cave you will find Fenrir directly to the left - surrounded by Kveldulf.
13490f5370623d23afe71a2174860a661547d38e.text: 离开古纳的要塞进入诺拉特领地并向西行进。继续前往标有“旅行者警告”标志的洞穴系统。进入洞穴后，您会在左侧找到芬里尔 - 被克维尔杜夫包围。

a9bcbff425ee9061f076be1e5a97442fee413b97.source: Clear Ferndale in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
a9bcbff425ee9061f076be1e5a97442fee413b97.text: 在困难模式下清除 Echovald 森林中芬代尔的所有敌人。

edd7295725b3902a081a43fe2d9a56850fbcdaaf.source: All of the primary quests acquired in House zu Heltzer lead through here, including the Defenders of the Forest, Defend Fort Aspenwood, and the Jade Quarry.
edd7295725b3902a081a43fe2d9a56850fbcdaaf.text: 在 House zu Heltzer 中获得的所有主要任务都会经过这里，包括森林保卫者、保卫阿斯彭伍德堡和翡翠采石场。

888aacae08fb94d80108556d09ca853aa25f82cb.source: Most of the secondary quests from the town will also require the player to travel through this area.
888aacae08fb94d80108556d09ca853aa25f82cb.text: 大多数来自城镇的次要任务也需要玩家穿越这个区域。

fc2b072cafe29ffb916da7f0d80bf47e0e495dac.source: Kurzick Supply Lines (Adds 8 hidden groups of six Luxons; although, they will sometimes spawn even if the quest is not in your Quest Log.)
fc2b072cafe29ffb916da7f0d80bf47e0e495dac.text: Kurzick 补给线（添加 8 个隐藏组，每组 6 个 Luxons；不过，即使任务不在您的任务日志中，它们有时也会生成。）

f9b70cb6a822c714c4e94809475e505adbbf56c8.source: Scouting Ferndale (Adds 4 groups of six Luxons.)
f9b70cb6a822c714c4e94809475e505adbbf56c8.text: 侦察芬代尔（添加 4 组，每组 6 名 Luxons。）

c09819442debaca173a7234db70404425c1fbbaa.source: There are white mists that cause Stone Spores effect.
c09819442debaca173a7234db70404425c1fbbaa.text: 有白色雾气会产生石孢子效果。

0406e05eaf2cb33f5a7aecae90bd8127db8f1d5f.source: Exploring this area will contribute approximately 3.6 - 3.7% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
0406e05eaf2cb33f5a7aecae90bd8127db8f1d5f.text: 探索该领域将为 Canthan 制图师头衔贡献大约 3.6 - 3.7%。

cc9cda89865a92406150275fe53b8aa57170e800.source: There are several spots on narrow paths that contain small groups of hidden Wardens.
cc9cda89865a92406150275fe53b8aa57170e800.text: 狭窄的道路上有几个地方有小群隐藏的守望者。

f71e2ab71448665617c389fed2b08403c4053318.source: There are 5 spots that contain hidden Oni groups (3 per group):
f71e2ab71448665617c389fed2b08403c4053318.text: 有 5 个地点包含隐藏的鬼群（每组 3 个）：

eeb3a3ace6d03bbd447a2953eb9687e20fd595ee.source: On a small rise shared with Wardens at the first crossroads northwest from Lutgardis Conservatory.
eeb3a3ace6d03bbd447a2953eb9687e20fd595ee.text: 位于卢特加迪斯音乐学院西北第一个十字路口与典狱长共用的一座小高地上。

c17bd2464185204db8fecefd8bbd14870236c1cf.source: At a dead-end path near the midpoint between Lutgardis Conservatory and Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick).
c17bd2464185204db8fecefd8bbd14870236c1cf.text: 位于卢特加迪斯音乐学院和阿斯彭伍德门 (Kurzick) 之间的一条死胡同中点附近。

cc5f5442b95ade3fdd3c23e7cf37dd40ba85a5df.source: A short way southeast from Tarnen the Bully's location.
cc5f5442b95ade3fdd3c23e7cf37dd40ba85a5df.text: 距离恶霸塔南的位置东南不远。

555e37ecbe75eb10627faa2e98e571430989733c.source: Northern side of the central open space.

0115829768f7fea3201ca46911f10b83ccd66ee2.source: In a corner directly north of Saint Anjeka's Shrine (green area).
0115829768f7fea3201ca46911f10b83ccd66ee2.text: 在圣安杰卡神社（绿色区域）正北的一个角落。

4ea59b311593506be1dc1fcbe5183030dc2ce169.source: Defeat your final opponent to claim victory in the Norn fighting tournament.
4ea59b311593506be1dc1fcbe5183030dc2ce169.text: 击败最后的对手，在诺恩格斗锦标赛中取得胜利。

56e6b51cef5dc6e6e8f90865da52d2869cba5558.source: See Magni the Bison for your reward.
56e6b51cef5dc6e6e8f90865da52d2869cba5558.text: 见野牛麦格尼以获得奖励。

9a2598b6f2d3cf5f6634613c5f1a30ab9e3e333c.source: Note: This reward is actually first mentioned in Round 1: Fight!, the start of this quest chain.
9a2598b6f2d3cf5f6634613c5f1a30ab9e3e333c.text: 注意：这个奖励实际上是在第 1 轮：战斗！（该任务链的开始）中首次提到的。

ad0c1064617804f4845c63dcd171109ae6a3b33d.source: Until you win the Norn Fighting Tournament for the first time, you will instead have Final Round: Fight! as your final round instead of this quest.
ad0c1064617804f4845c63dcd171109ae6a3b33d.text: 在您第一次赢得诺恩格斗锦标赛之前，您将进行最后一轮：战斗！作为你的最后一轮而不是这个任务。

b5029d0a26e4331b23df6176c8cd765b4ac08694.source: The opponent for the final round, or round 6, is usually Magni the Bison. Rarely, Palawa Joko with two Minions of Joko may appear instead of Magni. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
b5029d0a26e4331b23df6176c8cd765b4ac08694.text: 最后一轮或第六轮的对手通常是野牛麦格尼。极少数情况下，帕拉瓦·约科和两个约科小黄人可能会代替麦格尼出现。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

c35d35bd349be26227eb56fbfeff3dc6fbf3acb0.source: This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 5 of the tournament).
c35d35bd349be26227eb56fbfeff3dc6fbf3acb0.text: 完成前面的任务（即赢得锦标赛第 5 轮）后，该任务将自动接受。

14ddbfafcd726ca29a816dbd9a479d3894c8349e.source: Defeat Magni the Bison and claim victory in his tournament.
14ddbfafcd726ca29a816dbd9a479d3894c8349e.text: 击败野牛麦格尼并赢得锦标赛胜利。

95423fd7b81f7ae528833dcf2b257c4f99c9f588.source: Unlike the other quests in this quest chain, this one is not repeatable. Once a character wins the Norn Fighting Tournament, the next time this quest chain is started, this quest will be replaced by Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight! instead.
95423fd7b81f7ae528833dcf2b257c4f99c9f588.text: 与此任务链中的其他任务不同，此任务不可重复。一旦角色赢得诺恩格斗锦标赛，下次该任务链开始时，该任务将被最终回合冠军版：战斗！反而。

cc423263b0e8fdef3da603f4cebee0793012e1b2.source: Speak to Keeper Shafoss to gain entrance to the Heart of Abaddon.
cc423263b0e8fdef3da603f4cebee0793012e1b2.text: 与守护者沙福斯交谈以进入地狱之心。

9229f0662ec025623881843f832883c77f0769f8.source: Destroy the binding guardians and free Razah. [3...0] of 3 guardians remain.
9229f0662ec025623881843f832883c77f0769f8.text: 消灭束缚的守护者并释放拉扎。 3 名守护者中的 [3...0] 仍然存在。

ce626edfa90ee1a04acc1d56946cd9ab239dedca.source: See Chaplain Phyratyss for your reward.
ce626edfa90ee1a04acc1d56946cd9ab239dedca.text: 去找牧师菲拉蒂斯领取奖励。

6f1c42f534aa737c1bfa2a689fd22cf0e327ae7f.source: Travel to Abaddon's Gate and speak to Keeper Shafoss who will send you to Heart of Abaddon.
6f1c42f534aa737c1bfa2a689fd22cf0e327ae7f.text: 前往阿巴顿之门并与守护者沙福斯交谈，他将带你前往阿巴顿之心。

e8759d777a0ba5d475031b14069dfc2fac4fc3de.source: After you enter the Heart of Abaddon, dispose of the patrols around the first Binding Guardian. There are four separate groups, so take care to draw them in one at-a-time. Remain close to the portal until you have dispatched at least two of the groups. There are 3 neutral Binding Guardians in the area protected by hostile foes. They will turn hostile when you reach Razah and first talk to him. If you bring Gaze of Fury or Spirit to Flesh to take them out while neutral on your way to Razah, you won't have to back-track to defeat them and their reinforcements, which will easily cut the quest time by a half.
e8759d777a0ba5d475031b14069dfc2fac4fc3de.text: 进入地狱之心后，消灭第一个束缚守护者周围的巡逻队。有四个独立的组，因此请注意一次将它们绘制为一组。保持靠近传送门，直到您派遣了至少两个小组。在受敌对敌人保护的区域内有 3 个中立的束缚守护者。当你到达拉扎并第一次与他交谈时，他们会变得充满敌意。如果你在前往拉扎的途中将愤怒凝视或灵魂带到血肉中以中立状态干掉他们，你就不必原路返回来击败他们和他们的援军，这将轻松地将任务时间缩短一半。

45829e8ded1e6a66edc14f9b8fb444bf8335357b.source: Once it is safe, follow the quest markers towards Razah, dealing with the all the patrols you see as you head up the hill. Approach each group carefully and pull them to you as there are several popup groups you'd prefer to deal with separately.
45829e8ded1e6a66edc14f9b8fb444bf8335357b.text: 一旦安全，沿着任务标记前往拉扎，处理上山时看到的所有巡逻队。小心地接近每个组并将它们拉到您身边，因为您希望单独处理多个弹出组。

4ea232ea79777f493fbb5d46f3f9da75d22519d3.source: Talk to Razah to trigger his dialogue; if you have already removed the guardians, talk to him again to complete the quest.
4ea232ea79777f493fbb5d46f3f9da75d22519d3.text: 与拉扎交谈以触发他的对话；如果你已经移除了守护者，请再次与他交谈以完成任务。

269325f7db93492ec7d3a86cb0be59082f0a4c28.source: Otherwise head back down the hill to take care of the guardians one by one. If you get too close to them, you will trigger reinforcements. At the two shrines nearest Razah, they will consist of a Margonite and 4 creatures from the Shadow Army; these are probably easier to deal with than the demonic patrols. The reinforcements at the shrine closest to the portal are more annoying: 4 Titan Abominations; as each dies, it turns into two Madness Titans. Fortunately, you only have to defeat the guardian; once that is done, you can retreat to speak to Razah to finish the quest.
269325f7db93492ec7d3a86cb0be59082f0a4c28.text: 否则就下山去一一解决守护者。如果你离他们太近，就会触发增援。在距离拉扎最近的两个神殿中，他们将由一名玛贡尼特和 4 名来自暗影军团的生物组成；这些恐怕比恶魔巡逻队更容易对付。距离传送门最近的神社的援军更烦人：4 个泰坦憎恶；当每个人死亡时，它会变成两个疯狂泰坦。幸运的是，你只需击败守护者即可；完成后，你可以撤退并与拉扎交谈以完成任务。

e8e6f92956648d85d53425139364c524f9f802cc.source: You can avoid triggering the reinforcements by killing the guardians using long-range attacks, e.g. using long- or flatbows or spells. Since these spirits are weak, you can manage this with a single ranger with sufficient fire power or using any nuking build.
e8e6f92956648d85d53425139364c524f9f802cc.text: 您可以通过使用远程攻击杀死守护者来避免触发增援，例如使用长弓或扁弓或咒语。由于这些灵魂很弱，您可以使用具有足够火力的单个游侠或使用任何核武器构建来解决此问题。

debcd2b44705864351e5d6ec5ff0cd07598f6b97.source: Lightbringer skills; all of the foes are demonic servants of Abaddon.
debcd2b44705864351e5d6ec5ff0cd07598f6b97.text: 光明使者技能；所有的敌人都是阿巴顿的恶魔仆人。

71ee07595b80c037af2e880b9ee72efe445c3071.source: Panic or Psychic Instability to help shutdown foes, especially if dealing with two or more patrols.
71ee07595b80c037af2e880b9ee72efe445c3071.text: 恐慌或精神不稳定有助于阻止敌人，特别是在应对两个或更多巡逻队时。

bb6e2821b0e048bb4dec1021141013b5a1921249.source: Gaze of Fury or Spirit to Flesh will remove the Binding Guardians. The latter only works while they are friendly while the former can also be used to destroy Quickening Zephyrs.
bb6e2821b0e048bb4dec1021141013b5a1921249.text: 愤怒凝视或灵肉将移除束缚守护者。后者仅在友好时有效，而前者也可用于摧毁加速和风。

e9cca65b1a044d14b3d74bdf7d6f81b23ca62d7d.source: Margonite Sorcerers and Rain of Terrors use skills that snare; however, it is possible to complete this quest within minutes by using speed boosts without fighting, in conjunction with Gaze of Fury or Spirit to Flesh to destroy the Binding Guardians along the way.
e9cca65b1a044d14b3d74bdf7d6f81b23ca62d7d.text: 玛贡尼特巫师和恐怖之雨使用的技能是诱捕；然而，通过使用速度提升而无需战斗，结合愤怒凝视或灵肉结合摧毁沿途的束缚守护者，可以在几分钟内完成此任务。

05a7a0d2546b737a90f2bb94e9a51f317dd679c1.source: Ask Keeper Millzesh about gaining entrance to the Heart of Abaddon.
05a7a0d2546b737a90f2bb94e9a51f317dd679c1.text: 询问守护者米尔泽什有关进入地狱之心的信息。

da9628936a5d02090581d887fa0ec1d93cabc2a0.source: Explore and investigate the Heart of Abaddon.
da9628936a5d02090581d887fa0ec1d93cabc2a0.text: 探索并调查亚巴顿之心。

e197c08efec44473031a4d6e712d01cf72ca2116.source: Free Razah by destroying the Binding Guardians.
e197c08efec44473031a4d6e712d01cf72ca2116.text: 摧毁束缚守护者来释放拉扎。

15caa3e0c3f01f5e691d8e1c29650afc4b68b676.source: QUEST FAILED: Keeper Mirzesh is missing! Return to Chaplain Phyratyss in the Gate of Anguish for more information.
15caa3e0c3f01f5e691d8e1c29650afc4b68b676.text: 任务失败：守护者米尔泽什失踪了！返回苦痛之门的牧师菲拉蒂斯以获取更多信息。

22b2c6d9d0bd6d94faec28c93dfb94cb36665b3d.source: Help Gadd acquire the Bloodstone from Sparkfly Swamp on the Tarnished Coast.
22b2c6d9d0bd6d94faec28c93dfb94cb36665b3d.text: 帮助加德从黯淡海岸的火花沼泽获取血石。

df5142c48e9c778b9f40f30311727c0a88b95620.source: An item related to Gwen's childhood in your inventory
df5142c48e9c778b9f40f30311727c0a88b95620.text: 你的物品栏中有与格温童年有关的物品

79e5384e0f6e5d76c85242af0b24621cc6358b56.source: Gwen must be present to continue.
79e5384e0f6e5d76c85242af0b24621cc6358b56.text: 格温必须在场才能继续。

9cbeb7a599fb587f776341e940c08dc3216bc8b9.source: Travel to Sacnoth Valley to investigate the reports of the new Charr force amassing.
9cbeb7a599fb587f776341e940c08dc3216bc8b9.text: 前往萨克诺斯谷调查新查尔部队集结的报告。

94e4b5e60acc7efe0ae361fc3bad18e6da41b195.source: Locate the Charr Shaman's ceremony site.
94e4b5e60acc7efe0ae361fc3bad18e6da41b195.text: 找到查尔萨满的仪式地点。

04c01bd20670827341d50117ca6f1df92b6e211b.source: Destroy the Charr forces to prevent the ritual from being completed. You have [3…0] groups remaining.
04c01bd20670827341d50117ca6f1df92b6e211b.text: 摧毁夏尔军队以阻止仪式完成。您还剩下 [3…0] 组。

b93e8177038e9138944d1163fcb9621b7cc8aa8e.source: To obtain the quest, first get a Red Iris Flower or one of the other suitable items. Then visit Gwen in your Hall of Monuments. Afterwards head out to Longeye's Ledge or Doomlore Shrine and do not forget to wear your Ebon Vanguard rank.
b93e8177038e9138944d1163fcb9621b7cc8aa8e.text: 要获得任务，首先获得红色鸢尾花或其他合适的物品之一。然后去纪念碑大厅拜访格温。然后前往长眼壁架或末日神殿，别忘了佩戴你的黑檀先锋军衔。

2eabd3c0fbf3a91fec43c798c0cd4ccb2040dec8.source: When coming from Grothmar Wardowns into Sacnoth Valley, if Vael has revealed himself to you, he may appear near the resurrection shrine, and help you. Follow towards the marker and you will run into two Charr that are talking to each other, and continue walking. Follow them, and after hearing the needed information, they will become aggressive and you must kill them. A new marker appears in the burning forest.
2eabd3c0fbf3a91fec43c798c0cd4ccb2040dec8.text: 当从格罗斯玛战区进入萨克诺斯山谷时，如果瓦尔向你显现，他可能会出现在复活神殿附近，并帮助你。沿着标记走，你会遇到两个正在互相交谈的夏尔，然后继续走。跟随他们，在听到所需的信息后，他们会变得具有攻击性，你必须杀死他们。燃烧的森林中出现了一个新的标记。

a202025d2d1ce34fe2af8319324a17efb434e106.source: Entering the burning forest from west or the south is the shortest way. Wipe out patrolling groups first. Be careful not to aggro too much, and pay attention as the nearby boss Borrguus Blisterbark will be running around with a group. Try to spread out your party as many of the enemies have AoE fire skills that can easily wipe out your party. After wiping out surrounding enemies, proceed closer the quest marker.
a202025d2d1ce34fe2af8319324a17efb434e106.text: 从西边或南边进入燃烧的森林是最近的方法。先消灭巡逻队。小心不要过度仇恨，并且要注意附近的 Boss 波古斯·水泡树皮会带着一群人到处乱跑。尝试分散你的队伍，因为许多敌人都拥有范围射击技能，可以轻松消灭你的队伍。消灭周围的敌人后，靠近任务标记。

b6f5b7935e5fe53ab2410a102c8223b97a65249e.source: There are three groups of Charr you have to defeat, and they start off non-aggro and clustered fairly close to one another until you reach the quest marker. Two of them are fairly easy, but the third group starts out as a lone boss named Straut Flamebourne, who, when attacked, will cause a Charr Effigy to spawn.
b6f5b7935e5fe53ab2410a102c8223b97a65249e.text: 你必须击败三组夏尔，他们一开始是非仇恨的，并且彼此相当接近地聚集在一起，直到你到达任务标记。其中两个相当简单，但第三组一开始是一个名为 Straut Flamebourne 的孤独 Boss，当他受到攻击时，会导致夏尔雕像生成。

f1c0dc41e3d169612756eac9b9498997bb75132d.source: It is advised to bring skills and spells that interrupt or slow down spell casting; otherwise, both Strout Flamebourne and his Charr Effigy will cast Breath of Fire frequently, enough to quickly wipe your group. Both Straut Flamebourne and his Effigy have to be killed.
f1c0dc41e3d169612756eac9b9498997bb75132d.text: 建议携带能打断或减慢施法速度的技能和法术；否则，斯特劳特·弗莱伯恩和他的夏尔雕像都会频繁施放火焰呼吸，足以快速消灭你的队伍。斯特劳特·弗莱伯恩和他的雕像都必须被杀死。

12e616490093ecf1d794efd2d70d2c382c2361a7.source: After killing these two, Gwen will talk and mention to inform Captain Langmar of the events. Map back to Longeye's Edge, proceed outside towards Grothmar Wardowns, and see Captain Langmar for your reward.
12e616490093ecf1d794efd2d70d2c382c2361a7.text: 杀死这两个人后，格温会说话并提到向朗玛船长通报此事。地图回到长眼边缘，向格罗斯玛战区前进，并见到兰玛船长以获得奖励。

75b50b84ed92319eaf3d41750f86a79c389141b1.source: Several items can trigger the quest dialogue; whichever is used will be removed upon accepting the quest. (If you wish to keep any particular item, do not accept the quest and return later with a different one.) The possible items are:
75b50b84ed92319eaf3d41750f86a79c389141b1.text: 有几个项目可以触发任务对话；接受任务后，无论使用哪个都会被删除。 （如果您想保留任何特定物品，请不要接受任务并稍后返回另一件。）可能的物品有：

8e4e819f7261e5dbfda60229546a55a15550b2bc.source: Red Iris Flower (easily obtained from Gwen's garden, just outside of Eye of the North).
8e4e819f7261e5dbfda60229546a55a15550b2bc.text: 红色鸢尾花（很容易从格温的花园获得，就在北方之眼外面）。

3be2e1c0ef6db50879a48b57bff1382ae42bf72b.text: 挂毯碎片（仅限预言角色）

26287491b18535c8acd3d66e218b026f1fcd4daa.source: Gwen will self-resurrect if needed to complete the end-quest dialogue.
26287491b18535c8acd3d66e218b026f1fcd4daa.text: 如果需要完成最终任务对话，格温会自我复活。

b91ff077bf5317e0d5d4236c85207f18c387873c.source: This quest is more difficult to complete with The Smell of Titan in the Morning active; Ignus the Eternal and other groups will spawn along the quest route.
b91ff077bf5317e0d5d4236c85207f18c387873c.text: 当“清晨泰坦的气味”处于激活状态时，该任务会更难完成；永恒者伊格努斯和其他团体将沿着任务路线生成。

ff7d11948c8c8566547cffa5f6057042762722ab.source: The reward dialogue seems to suggest that this quest takes place after The Smell of Titan in the Morning; however, the two quests can be completed in either order or together.
ff7d11948c8c8566547cffa5f6057042762722ab.text: 奖励对话似乎表明该任务发生在清晨泰坦的气味之后；然而，这两个任务可以按顺序完成，也可以一起完成。

3c0e086c9cfad1da0d360926c4a4841d96206957.source: Go to the last place where the flame djinn was last seen.
3c0e086c9cfad1da0d360926c4a4841d96206957.text: 前往最后一次见到火焰精灵的地方。

c9bb229c906e4e77facdf9c09aac451850c6fe2f.source: Hunt down and destroy the flame djinn.

2271db2e721d4f574bd9543152daa7dba547f62e.source: On the path to the Flame Djinn, you will encounter four burnt corpses. When you get close enough, the djinn will charge after you. The djinn has a monster skill, Consuming Flames, that could be problematic if your party does not stay close together. Consuming Flames will heal the djinn as well as any party members close to it, so minor healing is all that is needed. To quickly kill the djinn, follow the green star on your compass to the right. There will be dredge there who will help you fight it, as well as give you a boon that makes you hit for 15 points extra. Doing this will drop the djinn quickly. Note, the djinn will follow you anywhere you go, so you do not have to continually draw him to the dredge. Return to Krak Flamewhip for your reward when you have destroyed the djinn.
2271db2e721d4f574bd9543152daa7dba547f62e.text: 在通往火焰巨灵的路上，你会遇到四具被烧焦的尸体。当你足够接近时，神灵会追随你。神灵有一个怪物技能，消耗火焰，如果你的队伍没有保持紧密联系，这可能会出现问题。消耗火焰会治愈神灵以及任何接近它的小队成员，因此只需要轻微的治疗即可。要快速杀死巨灵，请沿着指南针上的绿色星星向右移动。那里会有挖掘者帮助你对抗它，并给你一个恩惠，让你额外获得15点。这样做会很快掉落巨灵。请注意，无论你走到哪里，神灵都会跟着你，所以你不必不断地把他吸引到挖泥机上。当你消灭了巨灵后，返回克拉克·火鞭那里领取奖励。

e9566c97a237452d8e9b4808a5c7d8268298434d.source: The Iron Arch can be scouted for Summit Slaves while fighting the Flame Djinn.
e9566c97a237452d8e9b4808a5c7d8268298434d.text: 在与火焰巨灵战斗时，可以在铁拱门中侦察山顶奴隶。

cfd0d37351d21a3ad7042dd45edc3b89d2824e6d.source: Enable the Gathering Resources quest prior to attempting this one -- you will pass a number of iron ore boxes on the way to the djinn.
cfd0d37351d21a3ad7042dd45edc3b89d2824e6d.text: 在尝试此任务之前启用“收集资源”任务 - 在前往神灵的路上，您将经过许多铁矿石箱。

dfe7c82abb83ab9ba61a302d45b074b26390fa10.source: The quest name is likeley a pun on the fact that the Flame Djinn is found in a room with multiple levels (the "hole")
dfe7c82abb83ab9ba61a302d45b074b26390fa10.text: 任务名称很可能是双关语，因为火焰巨灵是在一个多层的房间（“洞”）中找到的

a1ce5f37744a214019d601d6795c127a60096f1f.source: Find the Charr fires northeast of the Frontier Gate. Kill the Flame Keepers and extinguish the flames.
a1ce5f37744a214019d601d6795c127a60096f1f.text: 找到边境门东北方的查尔火。杀死火焰守护者并扑灭火焰。

22a4a187bc76e43eb631a89a853255da29007db6.source: Return to Captain Arne for your reward.
22a4a187bc76e43eb631a89a853255da29007db6.text: 返回阿恩船长那里领取奖励。

ce2b97df3488004c12d81924a41c4392602934d0.text: 混沌伤害：4-7（需要 3 个统治魔法）

3b31c5ecae99309d2d389faf4c098aca9a21fc19.text: +3 能量（当生命值高于 80% 时）

e9c9e32c468a35a522410f24fb0e9e5cf4c3ef58.text: +3 能量（当生命值高于 60% 时）

47d13a70fc3922752bbfcddca3824a1e2f789f69.text: +3 能量（当生命值高于 40% 时）

5e0534e500a8f964c962d2332f85dff614609d5e.text: 伤害 +15%（相对于施咒的敌人）

5f32afed8c8c5da87265276a6c275dee48403c81.source: Start from Frontier Gate heading northeast. Soon you can find several Flame Keepers. After eliminating them you can travel back to Ascalon City for your reward.
5f32afed8c8c5da87265276a6c275dee48403c81.text: 从边门出发，向东北方向行驶。很快你就能找到几个火焰守护者。消灭他们后，你可以返回阿斯卡隆城领取奖励。

01494a02e3b0cdb43667ae91f438e860dbbd6064.source: The 10/10 Sundering Sword Hilt can be salvaged from the Long Sword.
01494a02e3b0cdb43667ae91f438e860dbbd6064.text: 10/10 破碎剑柄可以从长剑中回收。

da57e57581a1b1c1efe579de32f513c1de05dcc2.source: Find the Charr fires along the southern edge of the Diessa Lowlands. Kill the Flame Keepers and extinguish the flames.
da57e57581a1b1c1efe579de32f513c1de05dcc2.text: 沿着迪萨低地的南部边缘寻找夏尔大火。杀死火焰守护者并扑灭火焰。

674cd93fd409101212a36e845a9ae6bb16a2c083.source: Return to Duke Barradin for your reward.
674cd93fd409101212a36e845a9ae6bb16a2c083.text: 返回巴拉丁公爵那里领取奖励。

58d587f78068b83c401c8e7386532fb7a4d6f12c.text: 神圣伤害：4-7（需要 3 次重击祈祷）

ecb5d770f18f8c5d8969153b06f6782568e06b0d.source: Exit Nolani Academy into Diessa Lowlands and head north east around the stairs and across the bridge. When fighting the first mob of Gargoyles, be sure to target and kill Resurrect Gargoyles first. If you aggro the Storm Riders under the bridge, just move across it and ignore them. Once across the bridge, take the east fork in the path and then head north and east around the edge of the valley carefully so as not to aggro the very large mob of Charr below. Move through the ruins with the fountain and continue east up the stairs and then down into the next valley toward the quest marker. Kill the three Flame Keepers to complete the quest.
ecb5d770f18f8c5d8969153b06f6782568e06b0d.text: 从诺拉尼学院出来进入迪萨低地，然后沿着楼梯向东北方向走，穿过桥。当与第一批石像鬼战斗时，一定要先瞄准并杀死复活石像鬼。如果你在桥下激怒了风暴骑士，只需穿过桥并忽略他们即可。过了桥后，走东边的岔路，然后小心地绕着山谷边缘向北和向东走，以免激怒下面一大群夏尔。穿过有喷泉的废墟，继续向东走上楼梯，然后向下进入下一个山谷，前往任务标记。杀死三名火焰守护者即可完成任务。

2365f2a5a10d790fa97aaf6bdab0447f66200896.source: Alternatively, exit Grendich Courthouse and head west down the path until you can turn south to go over the hill. Follow the path of Charr until you reach the Flame Keepers. Make sure not to head east immediately exiting Grendich Courthouse; it leads to a bridge that veers away and around the Flame Keepers' location.
2365f2a5a10d790fa97aaf6bdab0447f66200896.text: 或者，从格伦迪奇法院 (Grendich Courthouse) 出口出来，沿着小路向西行驶，直到您可以向南翻越小山。沿着夏尔的道路前进，直到到达火焰守护者。确保离开格伦迪奇法院后不要立即向东行驶；它通向一座桥，该桥转向远离火焰守护者的位置。

42c944ad6411352c5f4ff8b21c006a238af34232.source: When also working towards completing The Duke's Daughter, the objective for that quest can sometimes be found adjacent to the location of the Flame Keepers.
42c944ad6411352c5f4ff8b21c006a238af34232.text: 当努力完成公爵的女儿时，有时可以在火焰守护者的位置附近找到该任务的目标。

3a2c3b4e63f968813f3b7ba3173ec329aab75a89.source: Once the quest is completed, the compass marker will point towards Captain Arne in Ascalon City, instead of Duke Barradin in Piken Square.
3a2c3b4e63f968813f3b7ba3173ec329aab75a89.text: 任务完成后，罗盘标记将指向阿斯卡隆城的阿恩船长，而不是皮肯广场的巴拉丁公爵。

0667796e536b27918dd84482be0d779c3fb958be.source: Wait for Healer Zenwa to finish his eulogy for Nehbawa Wahmeh
0667796e536b27918dd84482be0d779c3fb958be.text: 等待治愈者 Zenwa 完成他对 Nehbawa Wahmeh 的悼词

35f61c0fc01100bda457270d5bc08292a005fa61.source: Speak to Mutu Wahmeh to learn if he is worthy of his father's inheritance.
35f61c0fc01100bda457270d5bc08292a005fa61.text: 与穆图·瓦梅交谈，了解他是否值得继承他父亲的遗产。

cbb3efe2479fd308304d2815480195eacd0e85e6.source: Kill the Corsairs that stole the old fisherman's life savings.
cbb3efe2479fd308304d2815480195eacd0e85e6.text: 杀死偷走了老渔夫毕生积蓄的海盗。

b77f5c820ab3f04b14d95224802678ad6aff952c.source: Bring the fisherman back his life savings.
b77f5c820ab3f04b14d95224802678ad6aff952c.text: 把渔夫毕生的积蓄带回来。

60a10a6c1c423a5686721fbd301bd0b7d568e2a0.source: See Healer Zenwa for your reward.
60a10a6c1c423a5686721fbd301bd0b7d568e2a0.text: 请见治愈者 Zenwa 以获得奖励。

63bd8eb4df86584928679640808854432867d1ba.source: Talk to Mutu and then follow the compass point south to defeat a group of corsairs. Pick up the Chest of Coin, and carry it back to Horat (the fisherman).
63bd8eb4df86584928679640808854432867d1ba.text: 与穆图交谈，然后沿着指南针指向南方击败一群海盗。拿起金币箱，并将其带回给霍拉特（渔夫）。

82b9d14c51dae0346bcdb44716d8b1d5c569cf69.source: Mutu must survive to complete the quest.
82b9d14c51dae0346bcdb44716d8b1d5c569cf69.text: 穆图必须生存才能完成任务。

b34eb7abc4f6c6c523d4c12df95d7c498dcb3d56.source: A group of skale spawns close to the corsairs. It may be worth going ahead to take care of them before talking to Mutu, to reduce the risk of him dying if you aggro both the skale and the corsairs at once. The corsairs will not spawn until you've spoken to Mutu.
b34eb7abc4f6c6c523d4c12df95d7c498dcb3d56.text: 一群骷髅在海盗附近生成。在与穆图交谈之前先解决掉它们可能是值得的，这样可以减少当你同时攻击斯凯尔和海盗时他死亡的风险。在你与穆图交谈之前，海盗不会生成。

01b871bc08315597732e6a8344d9c73018cef3d1.text: 所需英雄：狡猾的玛格丽特

3c36bfdd0d792f4ab2e0a791070bbfe63be58a5d.source: Meet up with Jerob No-Spine in the Sunward Marches
3c36bfdd0d792f4ab2e0a791070bbfe63be58a5d.text: 在向阳行军中与杰罗布·无脊椎会面

ca2dd9658f9f828d54203eca466ac2a7d3be7a86.source: You've been tricked! Kill the Kournan soldiers before they kill you!
ca2dd9658f9f828d54203eca466ac2a7d3be7a86.text: 你被骗了！在库南士兵杀死你之前先杀死他们！

faccfef3c6066b6e86df73cf302367101e7386d6.source: Meet up with Jerob No-Spine in the Sunward Marches (just outside the Command Post), and follow his directions to the Kournan soldiers nearby. Unfortunately, Jerob's double-crossed the party and the soldiers are expected to capture you!
faccfef3c6066b6e86df73cf302367101e7386d6.text: 在向阳行军（就在指挥所外面）与杰罗布·诺·斯派恩会合，然后按照他的指示去找附近的库尔南士兵。不幸的是，杰罗布出卖了队伍，士兵们预计会抓住你！

15ae58265699a4327cc6fee00fe7bb10ffafea12.source: Fight them off! If you survive, return to the Sunspear Sanctuary and see Lonai for your reward.
15ae58265699a4327cc6fee00fe7bb10ffafea12.text: 击退他们！如果你幸存下来，请返回阳矛圣域并前往洛奈领取奖励。

d06a34c7b4edd10124621216469dd70efa8a3104.source: Clear the Flame Temple Corridor in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
d06a34c7b4edd10124621216469dd70efa8a3104.text: 在困难模式下清除阿斯卡隆火焰神殿走廊的所有敌人。

dbd99152454df5370d1b7620c3b1ca02ce443c71.source: To reach this explorable area, you must travel through the tar pit in the northeastern part of Diessa Lowlands. The nearest outpost is Grendich Courthouse.
dbd99152454df5370d1b7620c3b1ca02ce443c71.text: 要到达这个可探索的区域，您必须穿过迪萨低地东北部的焦油坑。最近的前哨站是格伦迪奇法院。

bf81519b403418a7af0393877e31bbe50c4098c9.source: The following quests may affect the spawns in this area:
bf81519b403418a7af0393877e31bbe50c4098c9.text: 以下任务可能会影响该区域的生成：

4f86261c063b2513067b021558ea3af6d5d74a21.source: The Titan Source (You will encounter one of the Charr bosses listed under the quest data, guarding the Altar)
4f86261c063b2513067b021558ea3af6d5d74a21.text: 泰坦之源（你将遇到任务数据下列出的查尔 Boss 之一，守卫祭坛）

806d41677ac18a67e08977f8d52a25617e842b49.source: The charr and hydra in the southeast corner are hostile to each other.
806d41677ac18a67e08977f8d52a25617e842b49.text: 东南角的夏尔和九头蛇彼此敌对。

e4daabc787502ac2fac80951a8c1ac1d43536bd9.source: A squad of four Ascalon soldiers will start heading towards the temple (specifically, the Charr Altar) in a slow walk. They usually die rather quickly if left alone, especially in hard mode. If they manage to reach the altar, they will simply wander around it.
e4daabc787502ac2fac80951a8c1ac1d43536bd9.text: 一队由四名阿斯卡隆士兵组成的小队将开始缓慢步行前往神庙（具体来说，查尔祭坛）。如果独自一人，他们通常会死得相当快，尤其是在困难模式下。如果他们成功到达祭坛，他们只会在祭坛周围徘徊。

43feba8e65fed84e5475da1dfb9b5c27821111c0.source: Mid-level groups arriving here for quests should find the isolated Charr groups around the temple complex to be manageable. Be careful when moving in towards the altar though, aggroing two or three groups may easily wipe a party. Pick the groups off one-by-one by pulling them.
43feba8e65fed84e5475da1dfb9b5c27821111c0.text: 到达这里执行任务的中级团体应该会发现寺庙建筑群周围孤立的夏尔团体是可以管理的。不过，在走向祭坛时要小心，两三个团体的攻击可能会轻易消灭一个队伍。通过拉动将组逐一挑选出来。

8bbb0db3a3ff9916f957023a7fc7116a2c550967.text: {{征服者|计数 = 100|最低 = 96|最高 = 122|注释=隐藏有吞噬者。}}

cc8ca2156195460ac6bf82ef7d56d836d6597ba2.source: Consider taking advantage of the four Ascalon soldiers against the first few groups. But given that the foes near the temple complex should be pulled carefully, it may be better to use them as bait or as additional corpses.
cc8ca2156195460ac6bf82ef7d56d836d6597ba2.text: 考虑利用四名阿斯卡隆士兵来对抗前几组。但考虑到寺庙建筑群附近的敌人应该被小心地拉走，最好将它们用作诱饵或作为额外的尸体。

703f33c28ce3ac2d0387e8751daa28a761afea37.source: Also consider starting from Yak's Bend to benefit from a party size of 6.
703f33c28ce3ac2d0387e8751daa28a761afea37.text: 还可以考虑从 Yak's Bend 出发，以享受 6 人聚会的好处。

a79d652cc022953e8b08d8951fd96f0d7994f430.source: During Special Ops: Flame Temple Corridor, you will be transported to an alternative version of the area.
a79d652cc022953e8b08d8951fd96f0d7994f430.text: 在“特别行动：火焰神殿走廊”期间，您将被传送到该区域的另一个版本。

17a16934b1aaaed160b4aaf5bd6538dd26056c73.source: Shoo the troublesome flamingos out of Kanyama's south field.
17a16934b1aaaed160b4aaf5bd6538dd26056c73.text: 将麻烦的火烈鸟赶出 Kanyama 的南田。

f49bc3e685753f6924994b559afe6c1a61a0cf44.text: 前往 Kanyama 领取奖励

c470e8da9df40e4a23a96506202167b9f260773c.source: Use the command /shoo to shoo out flamingos in south field. You only need to shoo each flamingo once, after which it will keep running from you and you can simply run after it to chase it away. Try to herd them into groups to save time, and be aware that they can wander back into the field after you shoo them out.
c470e8da9df40e4a23a96506202167b9f260773c.text: 使用命令 /shoo 赶走南田的火烈鸟。你只需要对每只火烈鸟进行一次射击，之后它就会继续逃离你，你可以简单地追着它把它赶走。尝试将它们分成几组以节省时间，并注意在您将它们赶走后它们可能会重新回到田野中。

87a91f9eddb9e2d0e9f31282bb19f8d16475a7e9.source: The quest will update once there are no flamingos left in the field, and you can claim your reward from Kanyama.
87a91f9eddb9e2d0e9f31282bb19f8d16475a7e9.text: 一旦现场没有火烈鸟，任务就会更新，你可以从 Kanyama 那里领取奖励。

9d2171c1976a937691cfafdca40b184140ab3131.source: Despite what Kanyama says, the worst the flamingos will do is body block you.
9d2171c1976a937691cfafdca40b184140ab3131.text: 不管 Kanyama 怎么说，火烈鸟最糟糕的做法就是用身体挡住你。

034af05fe09ad7cdc4b635f8238a483f34ff109b.source: It is possible to charm the flamingos.

d3a5e8a7551fcd7a0b2a16631fb2316847a42764.source: Having multiple human players helps to save time on this quest.
d3a5e8a7551fcd7a0b2a16631fb2316847a42764.text: 拥有多名人类玩家有助于节省此任务的时间。

ca37c18a449f52f629fc20c46f55a9c5dac41b81.source: It may help to come directly from Beknur Harbor, giving the flamingos as little time as possible to spread out before you arrive.
ca37c18a449f52f629fc20c46f55a9c5dac41b81.text: 直接从贝克努尔港出发可能会有所帮助，这样可以在您抵达之前让火烈鸟有尽可能少的时间分散开来。

cb3f1a20d3b2bb6f9301a94dd22db5a8700484df.source: While you are nearby, you should open the Buried Treasure on the edge of the field if you have not done so recently.
cb3f1a20d3b2bb6f9301a94dd22db5a8700484df.text: 当你在附近时，如果你最近没有这样做，你应该打开场地边缘的埋藏宝藏。

b62b1376d484f3fb6997fd19fa1b0d2437ab3825.source: Find Sergeant Bokkun in Sebelkeh Basilica. He'll know where the heket are.
b62b1376d484f3fb6997fd19fa1b0d2437ab3825.text: 在塞贝尔克大教堂找到博昆中士。他会知道heket在哪里。

d6ad8d556f730b605792ac8d49b3851b755d8920.source: Eavesdrop on the heket warrior's conversations. Glean information about the upcoming heket attacks.
d6ad8d556f730b605792ac8d49b3851b755d8920.text: 偷听赫克特战士的谈话。收集有关即将发生的 heket 攻击的信息。

1c0126f191c5e4a0719fc18a1ae4c4076b8ddb30.source: Gather more details about the arriving shipment.
1c0126f191c5e4a0719fc18a1ae4c4076b8ddb30.text: 收集有关到达货物的更多详细信息。

2ca143061872b81d5c0bac8baaa9650f7dba6fa8.source: See Commander Tanmod for your reward.
2ca143061872b81d5c0bac8baaa9650f7dba6fa8.text: 请见指挥官坦莫德以获得奖励。

8993110578821676b0d64441d63890a19dd22910.source: Start at Dzagonur Bastion. At point one, you will find Sergeant Bokkun, who will know where the Heket are. He will send Scout Dehra to take you to point two, where you will wait and eavesdrop on two Heket. Do not get into aggro range. Once the two Heket are finished talking, Scout Dehra will lead you to point three, where you will eavesdrop on two more Heket. Once this is finished, go to point four, which is Dzagonur Bastion. You can map there. Collect your quest reward, and you're done.
8993110578821676b0d64441d63890a19dd22910.text: 从扎古努尔堡垒开始。在第一点，你会找到博昆中士，他会知道赫克特人在哪里。他会派侦察兵德赫拉带你到第二点，在那里你会等待并窃听两个赫克特。不要进入仇恨范围。一旦两个赫克特谈话完毕，侦察兵德赫拉就会带你到第三点，在那里你会偷听另外两个赫克特的谈话。完成后，前往第四点，即扎贡努尔堡垒。你可以在那里绘制地图。收集你的任务奖励，你就完成了。

bfdda180d441597c243ca1acf881a2f02a509bff.source: After talking to Sergeant Bokkun, an additional NPC, Scout Dehra, will join your party and follow you, but doesn't appear under the party ally list.
bfdda180d441597c243ca1acf881a2f02a509bff.text: 与 Bokkun 中士交谈后，额外的 NPC Scout Dehra 将加入你的队伍并跟随你，但不会出现在队伍盟友列表中。

7dd075b5e60f8d49da87f1fd21d63c12d770bfd6.source: It may be possible to combine this quest with The Search for Survivors, for an enlarged party with extra allies.
7dd075b5e60f8d49da87f1fd21d63c12d770bfd6.text: 也许可以将此任务与寻找幸存者结合起来，以扩大队伍并增加盟友。

b81262ed5058875b98d15dc0c4585d17c2759b07.source: The quest states to find Sergeant Bokkun in Sebelkeh Basilica, although he actually stands just outside Dzagonur Bastion.
b81262ed5058875b98d15dc0c4585d17c2759b07.text: 任务要求在 Sebelkeh Basilica 找到 Bokkun 中士，尽管他实际上就站在 Dzagonur Bastion 外面。

5e6268cd702aa9a5c8ce0159f4beedd5efc337c7.source: Meet Vael in Sacnoth Valley to begin your mission.
5e6268cd702aa9a5c8ce0159f4beedd5efc337c7.text: 在萨克诺斯谷与瓦尔会面，开始你的任务。

7bd7f6a0f9230700eeb89b6e780885a961f40dd4.source: Follow Vael to the hierophant's stronghold.
7bd7f6a0f9230700eeb89b6e780885a961f40dd4.text: 跟随维尔前往圣职者的据点。

9f688a175e0560c5e43e52c72812dff168b1ac25.source: You have three minutes to sneak in and out of the stronghold.
9f688a175e0560c5e43e52c72812dff168b1ac25.text: 你有三分钟的时间潜入和潜出要塞。

1c1b5922604abea64533da981ec6f803634c1ec2.source: Your mission has been compromised! Kill Gharaz the Glutton at all costs!
1c1b5922604abea64533da981ec6f803634c1ec2.text: 你的任务已经受到损害！不惜一切代价杀死暴食者加拉兹！

f31e381a9fbaaca4f9c8d2710e8b9f953de9c8db.source: After accepting this quest, head through the Grothmar Wardowns and take the portal in the southeast corner into Sacnoth Valley. Vael is just inside, across from the shrine (shrine blessings are not necessary; no kills are required for this quest). After speaking to Vael he will run to the stronghold and ask if you're ready, agree that you are. Vael will disappear and a three minute timer will appear. During this time all of the Charr inside of the stronghold are incapacitated. There are no enemies to fight during the three minutes.
f31e381a9fbaaca4f9c8d2710e8b9f953de9c8db.text: 接受此任务后，穿过格罗斯玛战区并通过东南角的传送门进入萨克诺斯山谷。瓦尔就在里面，神殿对面（不需要神殿祝福；这个任务不需要杀戮）。与瓦尔交谈后，他会跑到要塞并询问你是否准备好，同意你准备好了。瓦尔将会消失，并且会出现一个三分钟的计时器。在此期间，要塞内的所有夏尔人都丧失了行动能力。三分钟内没有敌人可以战斗。

631c0af3d6945586bc051f4158cf393130d68baa.source: You have three minutes to poison all five stacks of food supplies. Just follow the green quest marker to the two locations where food supplies are kept (marked 1 and 2 on the map, above). Make sure to click on each food supply. Failing to click on all five will result in the mission being compromised - requiring you to kill Gharaz the Glutton.
631c0af3d6945586bc051f4158cf393130d68baa.text: 你有三分钟的时间给所有五堆食物下毒。只需沿着绿色任务标记到达存放食物供应的两个位置（在上面的地图上标记为 1 和 2）。确保点击每个食物供应。未能点击所有五个将导致任务受到损害 - 要求你杀死暴食者加拉兹。

e645229f0ade707ab6f8996931c6997478e1cf08.source: After you've poisoned all five food supplies, run outside of the stronghold, back to Vael. If done correctly, Vael should have the exclamation mark over his head. If Vael does not, you've missed something and the mission will be compromised.
e645229f0ade707ab6f8996931c6997478e1cf08.text: 当你对所有五种食物投毒后，跑出要塞，回到瓦尔。如果做得正确，瓦尔的头上应该有感叹号。如果瓦尔不这样做，你就错过了一些东西，任务就会受到影响。

2f39f0a77e66000fbb3c3a2459851b33ac51a7cb.source: Because the gas bombs technically kill and then resurrect the Charr (including Gharaz the Glutton) in the fort, they will not yield any experience, reputation points or drops after the bombs have been set off. Gharaz the Glutton will be resurrected with the other Charr in the fort even if you poisoned the food, which means that he will still be alive during the following quest if you remain in the zone.
2f39f0a77e66000fbb3c3a2459851b33ac51a7cb.text: 因为从技术上讲，毒气炸弹会杀死并复活要塞中的夏尔（包括暴食者加拉兹），因此在炸弹引爆后，他们不会产生任何经验、声望点或掉落物。即使你在食物中下了毒，暴食者加拉兹也会与堡垒中的其他夏尔一起复活，这意味着如果你留在该区域，他在接下来的任务中仍然活着。

4253dbc1fc5ecb4cee78cc514e6a99d6f2ba88a5.source: Heroes can be flagged outside of the stronghold, near Vael's starting location, for smoother running animations since they are not needed.
4253dbc1fc5ecb4cee78cc514e6a99d6f2ba88a5.text: 可以在要塞外靠近瓦尔起始位置的地方标记英雄，因为不需要英雄，因此可以使运行动画更流畅。

126ada8e287b870303cf94fb8e98ec5fcae8d36a.source: Compromised your mission? Instead of fighting Gharaz the Glutton, consider stepping through the nearby portal into the Grothmar Wardowns and then back into the Sacnoth Valley. This will reset the quest, giving you the opportunity to play without having to fight this boss.
126ada8e287b870303cf94fb8e98ec5fcae8d36a.text: 损害了你的使命？与其与暴食者加拉兹战斗，不如考虑通过附近的传送门进入格罗斯玛战区，然后返回萨克诺斯山谷。这将重置任务，让你有机会玩而不必与这个老板战斗。

abeef6c7b08dfc2fabbb36d25cb512fa37f37b76.source: If you have not yet captured Eviscerate, it can be easily captured from Gharaz the Glutton even without fighting him, since the "dozing" Charr are technically dead. There is plenty of time to poison all of the supplies and still capture the skill.
abeef6c7b08dfc2fabbb36d25cb512fa37f37b76.text: 如果你还没有捕获剔骨，即使不与暴食者加拉兹战斗，也可以轻松地从他那里捕获它，因为“打瞌睡”的夏尔从技术上来说已经死了。有足够的时间来毒害所有物资并仍然获得技能。

e08b4cf72f4f14c418b7aa225554950986ded68a.text: 杀死奴隶流亡者中的福吉威特。

78ac16577ee7289e27eab8cc21dc2706c6e48747.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Forgewight。

85645f038628826356c2ed84adbdf7c308e8ebc9.source: Locate the cave where the captives are being held in the Dalada Uplands.
85645f038628826356c2ed84adbdf7c308e8ebc9.text: 找到达拉达高地关押俘虏的洞穴。

54ded39e4c7c7600c1986e79b0ed78f1f73c9c64.source: Bushwhack the Charr guarding the prisoners.

f5145e72a47c9ff47faa8cef5f7b49d4f5009408.source: Check on the Flaming Scepter Mages.

22e26cec7106fb70c4d2fd952310136049e90025.source: See Sergeant Weststar for your reward.
22e26cec7106fb70c4d2fd952310136049e90025.text: 去找维斯塔中士领取奖励。

1d71798c2631ceebf1a15925e4bcbe04cdfe7f5d.source: After completing this quest, the Flaming Scepter Mages will be replaced with Hodat the Tumbler and a group of Stone Furies.
1d71798c2631ceebf1a15925e4bcbe04cdfe7f5d.text: 完成此任务后，火焰权杖法师将被不倒翁霍达和一群石之复仇所取代。

7e6042136ad5d4f4ebb0e642178eff58060d94fd.source: Obtain the quest from Sergeant Weststar just outside of Doomlore Shrine and follow the object marker southeast. Heading to the south first will provide a Siege Devourer, making the journey faster and easier.
7e6042136ad5d4f4ebb0e642178eff58060d94fd.text: 从末日神殿外的韦斯特星中士那里获得任务，然后沿着东南方的物体标记前进。首先向南前进会提供攻城吞噬者，使旅程更快更容易。

965a872c670fabe3c3cf3e53639d4e8c38aba6a2.source: The Flaming Scepter Mages can be found in the cave near the southeast corner of Dalada Uplands. Defeat the group of Charr guarding the entrance to the cave and head in. If the party leader has completed the Nolani Academy mission, the mages will become hostile. Once you have defeated them, they will once again become friendly.
965a872c670fabe3c3cf3e53639d4e8c38aba6a2.text: 火焰节杖法师可以在达拉达高地东南角附近的洞穴中找到。击败守卫洞穴入口的夏尔小队并进入。如果队长完成了诺拉尼学院的任务，法师们就会变得敌对。一旦你打败了他们，他们就会再次变得友好。

dc6337c09b1808b555df53a6c593b7220e0bbd52.source: Once their dialogue is completed, the quest will update and you may return to Sergeant Weststar to collect the reward.
dc6337c09b1808b555df53a6c593b7220e0bbd52.text: 一旦他们的对话完成，任务就会更新，你可以返回维斯塔中士那里领取奖励。

28c2976d4f193ffd6d9abc1ba9c27690b2968a24.source: This quest reunites you with the Flaming Scepter Mages.
28c2976d4f193ffd6d9abc1ba9c27690b2968a24.text: 这个任务让你与火焰权杖法师重聚。

58399881b2f6c5dcc33844f70b143762a027b283.source: The dialogue by the Flaming Scepter Mages refers to their use in the Prophecies campaign of standing in obelisks and attacking any nearby foes, usually Charr. They were last seen prior to the final battle of the Nolani Academy mission on Horn Hill, where they were apparently captured by retreating Charr.
58399881b2f6c5dcc33844f70b143762a027b283.text: 火焰权杖法师的对话指的是他们在预言战役中站在方尖碑上攻击任何附近的敌人（通常是夏尔）的用法。他们最后一次出现是在霍恩山诺拉尼学院任务的最后一场战斗之前，他们显然被撤退的查尔俘虏了。

406ff27bc3e72105eb9e57e04a7180f14d304ba9.source: Sergeant Weststar appears just outside Doomlore Shrine to give out the quest. However, when zoning into the area again while Falling Out is active, he will not appear in his initial location. Doing Falling Out to the end will lead you into Sacnoth Valley where Sergeant Weststar will be right outside Rragar's Menagerie to give you the reward for that quest, as well as the quest The Hunting of the Charr. He will not give you the reward for Forgotten Relics. This appears to be some sort of bug, as the quest marker will point back to the Dalada Uplands. He will spawn here again only if at least one member of your party has completed Falling Out and no member of your party has Falling Out active.
406ff27bc3e72105eb9e57e04a7180f14d304ba9.text: 韦斯特星中士出现在末日神殿外并发出任务。然而，当“闹翻”处于活动状态时再次进入该区域时，他将不会出现在最初的位置。打倒到底会带你进入萨克诺斯山谷，韦斯特星中士将在拉格动物园外为你提供该任务的奖励，以及狩猎夏尔任务的奖励。他不会给你被遗忘圣物的奖励。这似乎是某种错误，因为任务标记将指向达拉达高地。仅当你的队伍中至少有一名成员完成了“闹翻”并且你的队伍中没有任何成员处于“闹翻”状态时，他才会再次出现在此处。

5228d28fbe81a50ff2da6ccb5c043115be01ca84.source: If you cannot find Sergeant Weststar, make sure you complete the Falling Out quest.
5228d28fbe81a50ff2da6ccb5c043115be01ca84.text: 如果你找不到韦斯特星中士，请务必完成“闹翻”任务。

ed43e39d3f0e689f8082ea8491a64ef8cace623d.source: Kill 40 Margonites. You have destroyed [0...40] Margonites.
ed43e39d3f0e689f8082ea8491a64ef8cace623d.text: 杀死 40 名玛贡尼特。你已经摧毁了 [0...40] 玛贡尼特。

f9c875e57b458f0781a86446fc34f37ab66f0bee.source: See Vissh Rakissh for your reward.
f9c875e57b458f0781a86446fc34f37ab66f0bee.text: 前往 Vissh Rakissh 领取奖励。

60349d78ac88f54189a7c768db3ac0fbe534e7ed.source: Find and kill 40 Margonites, then return to Vissh for your reward. The Margonites can be from any area, they do not have to be found in The Desolation; however, killing Margonites in the Domain of Anguish do not count towards the 40 Margonites killed.
60349d78ac88f54189a7c768db3ac0fbe534e7ed.text: 找到并杀死 40 个玛贡尼特，然后返回维什领取奖励。玛贡尼特可以来自任何地区，不一定要在荒凉之地才能找到；不过，在痛苦领域杀死玛贡尼特并不计入被杀的 40 名玛贡尼特。

9f7a448f024be8181fc629f428222449d92fe2d6.source: Vissh's master difficulty quest The Cold Touch of the Past and its followup provide enough Margonites to complete this quest. This quest can also be completed at the same time as Getting Even.
9f7a448f024be8181fc629f428222449d92fe2d6.text: 维什的主难度任务“过去的冷触”及其后续任务提供了足够的玛贡尼特来完成此任务。该任务也可以与报仇同时完成。

b0f71021dccc29c7fdaf6f1169b28781b29ca697.source: Plenty of Margonites can also be found in Vabbi and the Realm of Torment to fulfill the requirements of this quest. Most likely, players will complete it by simply playing through the storyline if they pick it up before arriving in the Realm of Torment.
b0f71021dccc29c7fdaf6f1169b28781b29ca697.text: 在瓦比和折磨领域也可以找到大量玛贡尼特来满足该任务的要求。如果玩家在到达折磨领域之前拿起它，很可能会通过简单地玩故事情节来完成它。

48d8ab389fab4f89858ae3d3f8623026c09e0a52.source: This quest is very similar to Wicked Wardens in the Factions campaign.
48d8ab389fab4f89858ae3d3f8623026c09e0a52.text: 这个任务与派系战役中的邪恶守望者非常相似。

90000d8f919714d714aae40550c4c7bac82b9bd9.source: Seek out Siliss Yassith in the Arid Sea.
90000d8f919714d714aae40550c4c7bac82b9bd9.text: 在干旱海中寻找希利斯·亚西斯。

86e06c73afd0443a04d542b5c8830ed60d0e2917.source: After accepting the quest, head directly south to The Arid Sea exit from Skyward Reach. To find Siliss Yassith you must go to the platform East of where the indicator points and cross the bridge of rocks. Though the quest marker looks to be fairly obvious and easy to reach, Siliss Yassith's location is trickier to access than it may seem. Approaching the quest marker the player should notice a statue of a female warrior in the distance. This will collapse as the player draws nearer.
86e06c73afd0443a04d542b5c8830ed60d0e2917.text: 接受任务后，直接向南前往天空之境的干旱海出口。要找到希利斯·亚西斯，你必须前往指示器所指东边的平台并穿过岩石桥。尽管任务标记看起来相当明显并且很容易到达，但西利斯·亚西斯的位置比看起来更难访问。接近任务标记时，玩家应该注意到远处有一尊女战士的雕像。当玩家靠近时，它会崩溃。

e046b5cc7183f727369eb6858f35f488098f61db.source: Upon reaching the mesa that Siliss is standing upon, head further south, around the mesa and up a small trail. From there the ruins of the statue actually form a bridge that can be used to reach Siliss. Then speak with him to receive the reward for the quest.
e046b5cc7183f727369eb6858f35f488098f61db.text: 到达西利斯所站立的平顶山后，继续向南行驶，绕过平顶山，沿着一条小路向上走。从那里，雕像的废墟实际上形成了一座可以到达西利斯的桥。然后与他交谈以获得任务奖励。

f26fadc94ac2a95b2dab8952e22ec10821237c73.source: The statue of a female warrior falls and forms the bridge to get to the mesa. You do not actually see it crumble, but instead it will sway from right to left and as you come within a certain distance from it, it will be standing up at one moment and the next suddenly lie collapsed with only the feet still standing.
f26fadc94ac2a95b2dab8952e22ec10821237c73.text: 一位女战士的雕像落下，形成了通往台地的桥梁。你实际上并没有看到它崩溃，而是它会从右向左摇晃，当你离它一定距离时，它一会儿会站起来，一会儿会突然倒塌，只剩下脚还站着。

8c852ceee08f75349fe52ed450a27f0979bd6a41.source: Invite a henchman into your party, then speak to Ludo in Sunqua Vale.
8c852ceee08f75349fe52ed450a27f0979bd6a41.text: 邀请一名追随者加入你的队伍，然后与桑夸谷的卢多交谈。

5cb2f3818dcee04bb35467533098e85d8f3a899b.source: Add at least one henchman to your party. They are standing right next to Ludo. Either click on one and add them to your party through the Party Window or use the Party Search panel. Ludo will be waiting right outside the monastery in Sunqua Vale. Speak to him for your reward.
5cb2f3818dcee04bb35467533098e85d8f3a899b.text: 至少在你的队伍中添加一名追随者。他们就站在卢多旁边。单击其中一个并通过派对窗口将其添加到您的派对或使用派对搜索面板。卢多将在桑夸谷的修道院外等候。与他交谈以获得奖励。

2b236199f23d9ada13a036ef2c16bdd6d37dbc42.source: While the initial quest Long Thought Forgotten takes you to the entrance to the east of the Northlands, completing that quest opens up the west entrance, just north-east of Piken Square behind the charr encampment.
2b236199f23d9ada13a036ef2c16bdd6d37dbc42.text: 虽然最初的任务“长期的思想被遗忘”会带你到北地东部的入口，但完成该任务会打开西入口，位于夏尔营地后面皮肯广场的东北部。

51f7ef74c594fd7b3f3954c0eede830f27010d65.source: Because this area is mechanically part of the Depths of Tyria, the Vanguard Initiate and Reforged Mode effects are not applied.
51f7ef74c594fd7b3f3954c0eede830f27010d65.text: 由于该区域在机械上是泰瑞亚深渊的一部分，因此不会应用先锋启动和重铸模式效果。

4c89aa83c1aed35faace116718dea369ecb2b143.source: Like in pre-Searing Ascalon, however, party members do not suffer Death Penalty, and enemies have reduced health in Reforged Mode.
4c89aa83c1aed35faace116718dea369ecb2b143.text: 然而，就像在灼热阿斯卡隆之前一样，队伍成员不会受到死刑，并且敌人在重铸模式下的生命值会降低。

cbfe1dc367f04bd3f048ec28f6d287fb649a638e.source: Progress through this dungeon depends on multiple quests:
cbfe1dc367f04bd3f048ec28f6d287fb649a638e.text: 这个地牢的进展取决于多个任务：

a2f0373069ff1690ea1792ae98597d9d9c844cd7.source: The dungeon cannot be entered if any party members have Across the Wall or A Bastion In the North active in their quest log.
a2f0373069ff1690ea1792ae98597d9d9c844cd7.text: 如果任何队伍成员的任务日志中激活了“跨越长城”或“北方堡垒”，则无法进入地牢。

b3cc21940e660be7109699920e21e2ef81e1e05c.source: If no party members have Charr in the Tunnels or The Scourge Beneath, or if any party member has Long Thought Forgotten, the party cannot advance to the second level.
b3cc21940e660be7109699920e21e2ef81e1e05c.text: 如果隧道或下方天灾中没有队伍成员拥有夏尔，或者任何队伍成员拥有长期被遗忘的思想，则队伍无法晋级到第二级。

7209662901dd64d92d9123fe381b861b04d69728.source: If no party members have The Scourge Beneath, or if any party member has Charr in the Tunnels, the party cannot advance to the third level.
7209662901dd64d92d9123fe381b861b04d69728.text: 如果没有队伍成员拥有下方天灾，或者任何队伍成员在隧道中拥有夏尔，则队伍无法晋级第三级。

dd051e529e9d52f3324784bef718fa475075793e.source: Quest spawns will not appear if any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode. This prevents access to levels two and three, since Wyle Brimscourge will not spawn.
dd051e529e9d52f3324784bef718fa475075793e.text: 如果队伍中的任何成员未处于重铸模式，则不会出现任务生成。这会阻止进入第二级和第三级，因为怀尔·布里姆斯鞭不会生成。

5ae92a8e79c81fd6da53704c5195262e84ed7c78.source: If every member of the party who has The Scourge Beneath leaves after reaching level 2 of the dungeon, remaining players can still fight Maz Scourgeheart and spawn the reward chest.
5ae92a8e79c81fd6da53704c5195262e84ed7c78.text: 如果拥有 The Scourge Beneath 的队伍中的每个成员在到达地牢 2 级后都离开，则剩余玩家仍然可以与 Maz Scourgeheart 战斗并生成奖励宝箱。

a6a7626f32aadba42a5a2875403b43367f2da6a6.source: The presence, level, and skills of some Charr foes in the dungeon scale with that of the lowest-leveled player in the party:
a6a7626f32aadba42a5a2875403b43367f2da6a6.text: 地下城中一些夏尔敌人的存在、等级和技能与队伍中等级最低的玩家的存在、等级和技能相当：

0f8adc5f6b15bf7d85bbe2a9f487343a652a4031.source: If any party member has Long Thought Forgotten, Charr in the Tunnels, or the first-time version of The Scourge Beneath in their quest log, or if any party member is not in Reforged Mode, the party level is set to 1-9.
0f8adc5f6b15bf7d85bbe2a9f487343a652a4031.text: 如果任何队伍成员的任务日志中有长期思想遗忘、隧道中的夏尔或天灾军团的首次版本，或者任何队伍成员未处于重铸模式，则队伍等级将设置为 1-9。

9597abc51e0a9bed22fdac37efcdda37ebeac136.source: If Devona is present in the party as a hero, her level does not influence the party level.
9597abc51e0a9bed22fdac37efcdda37ebeac136.text: 如果德沃娜作为英雄出现在队伍中，她的等级不会影响队伍等级。

ffc44dfcb1554bfa2fcd982e7c74f65ccc6d515c.source: Similar to Vanguard quest foes, these Charr do not drop any loot, except for Maz Scourgeheart.
ffc44dfcb1554bfa2fcd982e7c74f65ccc6d515c.text: 与先锋任务敌人类似，这些夏尔不会掉落任何战利品，除了马兹·天灾之心。

9e0683c371a99fdf5ac3c508de596bb7c363da1e.source: The rewards dropped by Maz's Chest are improved when higher-level foes are present.
9e0683c371a99fdf5ac3c508de596bb7c363da1e.text: 当存在更高级别的敌人时，玛兹宝箱掉落的奖励会提高。

498624b0cc2494f3491d56998bb047084942798e.source: Similarly, the size of the chest also increases.
498624b0cc2494f3491d56998bb047084942798e.text: 同样，胸部的尺寸也会增大。

2190f008428f0051df149df4f1ef2a224c0b7c18.source: Walking over the patches of blue, crystalline ground will inflict the Crippled condition for 15 seconds and the Dazed condition for 20 seconds. This environment effect affects all allies, including pets and owned minions, but does not affect any foes.
2190f008428f0051df149df4f1ef2a224c0b7c18.text: 走过蓝色水晶地面会造成 15 秒的瘫痪状态和 20 秒的茫然状态。这种环境效果会影响所有盟友，包括宠物和拥有的小兵，但不会影响任何敌人。

2dc39141fd334b873ee1808994cca14d63fd6ed5.source: The plants and bandits are hostile towards all other creature types, including each other.
2dc39141fd334b873ee1808994cca14d63fd6ed5.text: 植物和强盗对所有其他生物类型都怀有敌意，包括彼此之间。

a6fb2aa064ba98814c99d92d52df8ddeb7a40265.source: No Locked Chests or Hidden Stashes spawn inside the dungeon.
a6fb2aa064ba98814c99d92d52df8ddeb7a40265.text: 地牢内不会生成上锁的箱子或隐藏的藏品。

55706180032434486fe86a17df1ff8c269b4cb16.source: The dungeon's icon on the map does not change when a character completes the dungeon.
55706180032434486fe86a17df1ff8c269b4cb16.text: 当角色完成地下城时，地图上的地下城图标不会改变。

d9ef9060565236ddf1759abdee544476b44a610a.source: The map in the Northlands points you towards the eastern entrance, but the western entrance is actually closer to Piken Square. Moreover, Artificer Mullenix is immediately present after going through the western entrance, making it likely the intended one.
d9ef9060565236ddf1759abdee544476b44a610a.text: 北地的地图将你指向东入口，但西入口实际上更靠近皮肯广场。而且，从西边的入口进去后，技师穆莱尼克斯就出现了，看来这就是预定的入口。

277b94d69ab58b2c3eaea7a4af7609065f463d1d.source: Exit Piken Square through the northern exit and head north to locate the tunnel entrance (see map). If a player has not completed Long Thought Forgotten, this entrance will be closed, forcing you to go to the eastern entrance.
277b94d69ab58b2c3eaea7a4af7609065f463d1d.text: 从北出口离开皮肯广场，向北行驶即可找到隧道入口（参见地图）。如果玩家没有完成“长思遗忘”，这个入口将会关闭，迫使你去东边的入口。

62f93042fd3dece281034303965b23dbd9904761.source: If any member of the party is doing the quest for the first time, Devona will join you as a level 5 ally, and the enemies you face will be similar to those found during Long Thought Forgotten and Charr in the Tunnels. Devona has a high damage output for her level, but she is not very durable against the enemies in the dungeon. Fortunately, if she is killed, she will resurrect herself as soon as no foes are within earshot.
62f93042fd3dece281034303965b23dbd9904761.text: 如果队伍中的任何成员第一次执行任务，德沃娜将作为 5 级盟友加入你，你面对的敌人将类似于长思遗忘和隧道中的夏尔中发现的敌人。德芙娜在她的等级中拥有很高的伤害输出，但她在对抗地牢中的敌人时并不是很耐用。幸运的是，如果她被杀，一旦周围没有敌人，她就会复活。

f5db8237264a7b7f5f6c70b26645042bc51564a1.source: On repeated visits to the tunnels, you will have to deal with additional Charr foes whose levels scale with that of the lowest-leveled member of the party, up to a maximum of level 18. It is advisable to bring Devona as a hero so that you can make use of skills unlocked outside Pre-Searing Ascalon.
f5db8237264a7b7f5f6c70b26645042bc51564a1.text: 在多次访问隧道时，你将不得不对付额外的夏尔敌人，他们的等级与队伍中最低等级成员的等级相同，最高可达 18 级。建议将德沃娜作为英雄，这样你就可以使用预灼热阿斯卡隆之外解锁的技能。

0411d4da276ddcd6228a3f6d72103409c6d7e7ad.source: This part of the quest is the same as Charr in the Tunnels, except that the inhabitants of Wyle Brimscourge's chamber may be slightly more numerous, and you will have to deal with the more powerful Charr on repeat visits. Fight your way down to the south end of the dungeon as usual, pull Wyle Brimscourge and kill him for the Dungeon Key, then run or fight your way to the Dungeon Lock and the portal to level 2.
0411d4da276ddcd6228a3f6d72103409c6d7e7ad.text: 这部分任务与隧道中的夏尔相同，只是怀尔·布里姆斯科奇房间的居民可能稍微多一些，而且你将不得不在重复访问时对付更强大的夏尔。像往常一样一路杀到地牢的南端，拉出怀尔·布里姆斯科奇并杀死他以获得地牢钥匙，然后跑或战斗到达地牢锁和通往 2 级的传送门。

c3d50f42e9090c6e9e11d75815f9a9359f48f49c.source: Once again, you need to make your way from the south side of this floor to the north side. Sneak or fight your way through the large atrium to the stairs and northern tunnels; it may be easiest to keep close to the eastern side. Your quest marker will be pointing you to the crystal gate where the northern patrol was found during Charr in the Tunnels, but you actually need to go to where you found the northeastern patrol first (at the exclamation point on the map to the right). In the far northeastern tunnel, you will need to kill some Shard Elementals, unless the nearby Ironheart has already taken care of them for you. Pick up the Elemental Crystal bundle they drop, and carry it west to the crystal gate. When you approach the gate, the crystal will disappear, and the gate will open to reveal the entrance to level 3.
c3d50f42e9090c6e9e11d75815f9a9359f48f49c.text: 再次，您需要从该层的南侧走到北侧。潜行或战斗穿过大中庭到达楼梯和北部隧道；靠近东侧可能是最容易的。你的任务标记将指向你在隧道查尔期间发现北方巡逻队的水晶门，但你实际上需要先去找到东北巡逻队的地方（在右侧地图上的感叹号处）。在最东北的隧道中，你需要杀死一些碎片元素，除非附近的铁心已经帮你解决了。捡起他们掉落的元素水晶包，然后将其向西带到水晶门。当你接近大门时，水晶会消失，大门会打开，露出第三层的入口。

dae72e16e7b24c32b09092881da2e13d4ab459c6.source: You start at the middle of the south side of this floor, and will need to follow the purple path on the map to the right. Head northeast until you reach a large chamber filled with ruins and Charr, then hug the left wall heading north until you can start heading west again. Pass under the bridge, being careful of any Charr above. Just after the bridge, you may want to take a short detour south to clear out the Charr atop another bridge you will be passing under later. Continue west and you will reach a large foundry area, where your goal is to reach one of the stairways leading up to the higher walkways to the southwest. There is a resurrection shrine nearby, and from there you should be able to see the Boss Key lying on the overlook further south. After picking up the key, return to the red path on the map to the right, and fight your way around to the Boss Lock, then to the large open area to the southwest where Maz Scourgeheart and his elementals await you.
dae72e16e7b24c32b09092881da2e13d4ab459c6.text: 你从这一层南侧的中间开始，需要沿着地图上的紫色路径向右走。向东北方向前进，直到到达一个充满废墟和夏尔的大房间，然后沿着左墙向北走，直到你可以再次向西走。从桥下穿过，小心上面的夏尔。过了桥后，您可能需要向南绕一小段路，以清除稍后将要经过的另一座桥上的查尔河。继续向西，您将到达一个大型铸造区，您的目标是到达通往西南方向较高走道的楼梯之一。附近有一个复活神殿，从那里你应该可以看到位于更南边的观景台上的 Boss 钥匙。拿起钥匙后，返回地图右侧的红色路径，一路杀到 Boss Lock，然后到达西南方向的大片空地，马兹·天灾之心和他的元素生物在那里等待着你。

ab642fb650c0625358e296b6105685fc26e29052.source: The elementalist boss is fought three times. The first two times he reaches 10% health, he will turn friendly, taunt the party, summon a large group of Shard Elementals and teleport to a side of the arena. His new location will be locked behind a crystal gate. To open it, you must kill the Shards elementals, pick up the Elemental Keystone one of them is carrying, and carry it to the crystal gate.
ab642fb650c0625358e296b6105685fc26e29052.text: 元素系 Boss 战斗了 3 次。前两次他的生命值达到 10% 时，他会变得友好、嘲讽队伍、召唤一大群碎片元素并传送到竞技场的一侧。他的新位置将被锁在水晶门后面。要打开它，你必须杀死碎片元素，拿起其中一个携带的元素钥匙石，并将其带到水晶门。

d38497a1e650bae5223ed0b1dec0b8535cdb8f41.source: Maz will start with Fire Magic, including Mark of Rodgort, Fireball and Lava Font. After teleporting once, he will switch to Air Magic, with Lightning Javelin and Whirlwind to interrupt attackers and Lightning Strike to hit without line of sight. For the last confrontation he will use Water Magic, snaring his enemies with Deep Freeze and Shard Storm while protecting himself with Blurred Vision and Swirling Aura. In all three fights, he will also use Earthquake for AoE knockdown and Kinetic Armor to increase his armor rating.
d38497a1e650bae5223ed0b1dec0b8535cdb8f41.text: 马兹将从火魔法开始，包括罗德戈特印记、火球术和熔岩字体。传送一次后，他会切换到气系魔法，用闪电标枪和旋风斩打断攻击，用雷击进行视线外攻击。在最后的对抗中，他将使用水魔法，用深度冰冻和碎片风暴诱捕敌人，同时用模糊视觉和旋转光环保护自己。在所有三场战斗中，他还将使用地震进行 AoE 击倒，并使用动能装甲来提高他的护甲等级。

42e85021db41a811d9f9da4b350b705965345d3c.source: His elementals are identical to the other elementals in the dungeon, and behave as a group. While they can deal significant melee damage at low levels, sufficient AoE damage should dispatch them quickly.
42e85021db41a811d9f9da4b350b705965345d3c.text: 他的元素与地牢中的其他元素相同，并且表现得像一个群体。虽然它们可以在低等级时造成大量近战伤害，但足够的 AoE 伤害应该可以快速消灭它们。

2a101405ad912da35e0c4d8f97504d4bb967ce77.source: Maz and his minions shouldn't pose too much of a threat compared to the other mobs in the dungeon, especially if you are a spellcaster with high firepower. His spells are also slow to cast, giving you a generous window to spike him down before he becomes a problem. Armor-ignoring damage in particular bypasses Kinetic Armor, and Backfire will shut him down completely. Should you still face difficulties, equipping Devona with interrupts and/or enchantment removal can counter most of Maz's tactics.
2a101405ad912da35e0c4d8f97504d4bb967ce77.text: 与地牢中的其他怪物相比，马兹和他的爪牙不应该构成太大的威胁，特别是如果你是一个拥有高火力的施法者。他的法术施放速度也很慢，这给了你一个宽裕的时间来在他成为问题之前把他击倒。无视护甲的伤害尤其会绕过动能护甲，而逆火将完全关闭他。如果你仍然面临困难，为德沃娜配备中断和/或结界移除功能可以对抗马兹的大部分战术。

5dfdc3151ece0e6b6b1dd007ee0c6decd1c432f1.source: Upon his death, Maz's Chest will spawn. After every player in the party has opened the chest, a countdown will start and the party will be returned to Piken Square.
5dfdc3151ece0e6b6b1dd007ee0c6decd1c432f1.text: 当他死后，玛兹的宝箱将会生成。当队伍中的每个玩家都打开宝箱后，倒计时将开始，队伍将返回皮肯广场。

59ccaa5dc679b039acfa3aa4b44b5dadecce8ce7.source: Talk to Devona to finish the quest.
59ccaa5dc679b039acfa3aa4b44b5dadecce8ce7.text: 与德沃娜交谈以完成任务。

a9dabab86288bf07790784c9f84143ae95f9b1e6.source: Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies from spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it slightly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
a9dabab86288bf07790784c9f84143ae95f9b1e6.text: 将没有重铸模式的玩家添加到队伍中将阻止敌人在北地北部生成，从而更容易到达被遗忘的隧道。如果所有没有重铸模式的玩家在进入地牢之前退出或离开地图，任务仍然可以完成。

83b06b56c58ddb6e85cecf9f1f17a0b0292f1433.source: When repeating the quest, there will be additional Charr groups throughout the dungeon with no loot and levels that scale with the weakest member of the party. Players interested in speed clears and safer runs may therefore prefer to abandon the quest after opening the reward chest, though this means never unlocking Devona as a hero.
83b06b56c58ddb6e85cecf9f1f17a0b0292f1433.text: 重复任务时，整个地牢中将会出现额外的夏尔团体，没有战利品，并且等级会随着队伍中最弱的成员而变化。因此，对速度清除和更安全的运行感兴趣的玩家可能更愿意在打开奖励箱后放弃任务，尽管这意味着永远不会将德沃娜解锁为英雄。

0883cd962deadb810315debbfaf7af5c13fdcfef.source: An alternative is to join a party with another player who is doing the first-time version of the quest, or with a player whose level is lower than 10.
0883cd962deadb810315debbfaf7af5c13fdcfef.text: 另一种方法是与正在执行第一次版本任务的其他玩家或等级低于 10 的玩家一起加入队伍。

653358ba455e00bd7f9c6ca02eb57b98155c2170.source: The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge and the Elemental Crystal on level 2, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten or Charr in the Tunnels active in their quest log.
653358ba455e00bd7f9c6ca02eb57b98155c2170.text: 如果任何队伍成员的任务日志中激活了长思被遗忘或隧道中的夏尔，则任务生成（包括第 2 级的怀尔·布里姆斯灾和元素水晶）将被覆盖。

f28fa74ae4a4c680b862eabc654b1b4059f412be.source: If another player in the party has Charr in the Tunnels active, the party can complete that quest by killing all of the Charr Patrol Stalkers, then use the portal back to level 1 to reset the map, enabling access to level 3 without returning to the surface. This makes the run slightly longer, but allows the party to kill three additional charr bosses along the way.
f28fa74ae4a4c680b862eabc654b1b4059f412be.text: 如果队伍中的另一名玩家在隧道中激活了夏尔，则该队伍可以通过杀死所有夏尔巡逻跟踪者来完成该任务，然后使用传送门返回 1 级以重置地图，从而无需返回地表即可进入 3 级。这使得运行时间稍微长一些，但允许队伍沿途杀死三个额外的夏尔老板。

5db092bd81684460e815cf4e37b20d0709fa49db.source: It is possible to kill Maz Scourgeheart by dealing damage at range (typically with spells such as Fire Storm or Symbol of Wrath or a bow with long enough range) without opening any crystal gate.
5db092bd81684460e815cf4e37b20d0709fa49db.text: 可以在不打开任何水晶门的情况下，通过造成远程伤害（通常使用诸如火焰风暴或愤怒象征之类的法术或射程足够长的弓）来杀死马兹·天灾之心。

9c68514125dc756c1efd6a19b02218c78a88a4af.source: Once Maz is killed, the remaining Shard Elementals of the second wave (with the exception of the one carrying the Elemental Keystone) will have a special animation and stop attacking the players. They won't retaliate even when attacked.
9c68514125dc756c1efd6a19b02218c78a88a4af.text: 一旦马兹被杀死，第二波剩余的碎片元素（携带元素钥石的除外）将会有一个特殊的动画并停止攻击玩家。即使受到攻击，他们也不会反击。

83909e9f3751c88f22c61adfe386d8869b9d9271.source: Travel to Fort Aspenwood and speak to the Luxon Commander.
83909e9f3751c88f22c61adfe386d8869b9d9271.text: 前往阿斯彭伍德堡并与卢克森指挥官交谈。

5616a34b29c956eb57c14aebc707f38938a0f172.source: Leaving from Zos Shivros Channel, head west through Boreas Seabed (explorable area) and Mount Qinkai. Alternatively, you can leave from Cavalon into Archipelagos and through Breaker Hollow.
5616a34b29c956eb57c14aebc707f38938a0f172.text: 从佐斯希夫罗斯海峡出发，向西穿过北风之神海底（可探索区域）和秦凯山。或者，您也可以从卡瓦隆出发前往群岛并穿过 Breaker Hollow。

3b512ea531d78bbda9f109f96ef8c2eb08d6f044.source: The Kurzick equivalent of this quest is Defend Fort Aspenwood.
3b512ea531d78bbda9f109f96ef8c2eb08d6f044.text: 库尔兹克相当于这个任务是保卫阿斯彭伍德堡。

3fba9d316fef554c55742d04ed2b6c8f480b760a.source: Push the invading Charr forces back to the Great Northern Wall.
3fba9d316fef554c55742d04ed2b6c8f480b760a.text: 将入侵的夏尔军队击退到北方长城。

d9d57d72aa117db650b2b19285da2bd0784da622.source: *BONUS* Rescue Deeter Saberlin from the Charr.
