a11dcb1b6f20117ac75a306e233348a24f787b39.text: 卡布乌斯被 3 名奥菲尔斯小队以及他自己的 2 名阿米尼保镖包围。如果想最后与卡布斯战斗，小心拉动是有效的——但要小心奥菲尔·纳瓦利治疗被引诱的敌人，然后引起另一群蛙人的仇恨。杀死卡布斯后，会出现博格鲁特宝箱，任务完成。如果您在计时器耗尽之前没有与吉里夫交谈以领取奖励，那么您可以在返回火花飞沼泽后获得奖励，因为他就在附近。

77eb5814b5b723d2bc4ed95cff4cf7183ddb386b.source: There are plenty of corpses here for a minion master.
77eb5814b5b723d2bc4ed95cff4cf7183ddb386b.text: 对于小兵大师来说，这里有很多尸体。

18597e6b44f67e2febd31be971a3e2d61a2691ae.source: Consider bringing hex removal to counter the Ophil Tlamatini and Fanged Ayahuascas, who also interrupt.
18597e6b44f67e2febd31be971a3e2d61a2691ae.text: 考虑使用妖术移除来对抗 Ophil Tlamatini 和 Fanged Ayahuascas，他们也会打断。

296820d600d8d2accee1fa7e3fef838b2cf68626.source: Bring something to help counter the spike inflicted by Stormcloud Incubi, such as "I Am Unstoppable!".
296820d600d8d2accee1fa7e3fef838b2cf68626.text: 带一些东西来帮助对抗 Stormcloud Incubi 造成的尖峰，例如“我势不可挡！”。

18dd45011618c0b66fafe8fabfa22e1d393bf573.source: Upon activating this quest by speaking to Giriff, the quest Tekks's War will be reset. The same will count the other way around.
18dd45011618c0b66fafe8fabfa22e1d393bf573.text: 通过与吉里夫交谈激活此任务后，任务“特克斯的战争”将被重置。反之亦然。

880a940b234a14950d4834b35a16897f1f10c3e3.source: The two amphibians fighting at the very beginning of the dungeon might not die. In order to continue with the dungeon, you may need to rezone.
880a940b234a14950d4834b35a16897f1f10c3e3.text: 在地牢一开始战斗的两只两栖动物可能不会死。为了继续探索地牢，您可能需要重新分区。

f0244b242ad7733c30b0733c8cb5a1bc3e2db637.source: On the first level, you might have to rezone numerous times because all of the amphibians are dead, thus you can't progress because the door doesn't open. Every time you rezone you MUST re-talk to the quest-giving NPC (Giriff/Tekk) to follow you into the dungeon.
f0244b242ad7733c30b0733c8cb5a1bc3e2db637.text: 在第一层，你可能需要多次重新分区，因为所有两栖动物都死了，因此你无法前进，因为门打不开。每次你重新分区时，你都必须重新与提供任务的 NPC（Giriff/Tekk）交谈，以跟随你进入地牢。

7bed9d18de2ddefcd4dec3fc55ccc5da4bf5f52c.text: 在火花飞沼泽遇见海达。

12e0d59fe1480a3eb9f05280f7b2c030b0a02568.source: Assemble with the White Mantle for their peace talks.
12e0d59fe1480a3eb9f05280f7b2c030b0a02568.text: 与白斗篷集会进行和平谈判。

161e655ec65709cf382acf5498862ae67016fe19.source: Defeat the White Mantle. You currently have [5...0] of 5 groups remaining.
161e655ec65709cf382acf5498862ae67016fe19.text: 击败白斗篷。您目前还剩下 [5...0] 个组，共 5 个组。

2ef52b31f904838f124c4433bf55814d1a3585ce.source: Hayda is just north of the portal you enter Sparkfly Swamp. Fight your way with Hayda to the location with the White Mantle, but do not approach Ambassador Kharnige yet. Kill any enemies on periphery of the White Mantle group to ensure that you don't have any nasty surprises while occupied with the Mantle.
2ef52b31f904838f124c4433bf55814d1a3585ce.text: 海达 (Hayda) 位于进入 Sparkfly 沼泽的门户以北。与海达一起杀出一条血路，到达白斗篷所在地，但先不要接近卡尼格大使。杀死白斗篷集团外围的所有敌人，以确保您在占领白斗篷时不会遇到任何令人讨厌的意外。

1b090d80ebf2a6466480443224f146e2d2cc2bcb.source: Now approach the Ambassador, while Hayda is talking to him, position your group on the eastern edge. Once the Mantle turn hostile you can take out the Ambassador's group first and then deal with each group as it approaches. The foes this quest spawns should not pose too great a threat to a party of 8.
1b090d80ebf2a6466480443224f146e2d2cc2bcb.text: 现在接近大使，当海达与他交谈时，将你的团队安置在东部边缘。一旦地幔变得敌对，你可以先干掉大使的队伍，然后在每个队伍接近时处理它们。此任务产生的敌人不会对 8 人队伍造成太大威胁。

eb15da69e10b66233f27bf89bfbe325c1a9b6a53.source: Note: If Hayda dies, she will resurrect automatically once there are no enemies in her vicinity, like all Eye of the North allies.
eb15da69e10b66233f27bf89bfbe325c1a9b6a53.text: 注意：如果海达死亡，当她附近没有敌人时，她会像所有北方之眼盟友一样自动复活。

622927762909bc2f08c5bc55151f816af6624356.source: When you first see her, she will be close to a group of Angorodons. There is a good chance you will fight them if you aren't careful. If you end up fighting them, a group of wandering Raptors will come upon you if you don't kill the prior group fast. Lure the Angorodons away before doing anything with her, and fight them there.
622927762909bc2f08c5bc55151f816af6624356.text: 当你第一次看到她时，她会靠近一群安哥洛恐龙。如果你不小心的话，你很有可能会与他们战斗。如果你最终与他们战斗，如果你不快速杀死前面的一群猛禽，一群游荡的猛禽就会袭击你。在对她做任何事之前先把安戈洛顿人引开，然后在那里与他们战斗。

b9c13e4397eb5ece06dc701ca312ee1650e6906e.source: NPCs Giriff and Tekks are just north of the White Mantle groups, so you can recruit one of them as an ally before engaging the White Mantle.
b9c13e4397eb5ece06dc701ca312ee1650e6906e.text: NPC 吉里夫和泰克斯位于白斗篷组织的北部，因此您可以在与白斗篷交战之前招募其中一位作为盟友。

8b5ff3b215b78893a6ae395d31f8f53dba633721.source: Sometimes Hayda will get stuck on the resurrection shrine and you will have to restart the quest. It's possible that enemies may get trapped in terrain or otherwise be missing (including having run to the other side of the map, which also requires a restart.
8b5ff3b215b78893a6ae395d31f8f53dba633721.text: 有时海达会卡在复活神殿上，你将不得不重新开始任务。敌人可能会被困在地形中或失踪（包括跑到地图的另一边，这也需要重新启动。

367fe7bd85a95de4d00b15d6ba8c50489a0ddb0b.source: Protect the Baby Dragon at all costs.
367fe7bd85a95de4d00b15d6ba8c50489a0ddb0b.text: 不惜一切代价保护小龙。

b5c2decb29fdf0d685d3befd8a1be9711f48a8d4.source: Survive all six waves of destroyers.
b5c2decb29fdf0d685d3befd8a1be9711f48a8d4.text: 在全部六波驱逐舰中幸存。

f540e8fbc04751109899de92968de3a0b4521058.source: Destroy enemy waves quickly to earn points; the faster you kill the more points you earn.
f540e8fbc04751109899de92968de3a0b4521058.text: 快速摧毁敌人的浪潮以获得积分；杀得越快，获得的积分就越多。

965f7d63f5e7207dc8e29424bf60d9cde6b46222.source: Earn bonus points for each Dwarf defender who survives the assault.
965f7d63f5e7207dc8e29424bf60d9cde6b46222.text: 每个在袭击中幸存下来的矮人防御者都可以获得奖励积分。

856ca2b6b5d28ce558b7adb35345d6cbb52ef79b.source: After the party defeats the final wave, a Chest of the Brotherhood will spawn, which drops a Cloth of the Brotherhood and a Destroyer Core (in Hard Mode one Cloth of the Brotherhood and 5 Destroyer Cores) for each member.
856ca2b6b5d28ce558b7adb35345d6cbb52ef79b.text: 队伍击败最后一波后，将会生成一个兄弟会宝箱，为每个成员掉落一件兄弟会圣衣和一个毁灭者核心（在困难模式下为一个兄弟会圣衣和 5 个毁灭者核心）。

cf44554657b32dd5b1b27c97656d441179091105.source: 25 Dwarf reputation points per wave defeated, awarded immediately after each wave ends (End round 1 -- 25 points, End round 3 -- 75 points).
cf44554657b32dd5b1b27c97656d441179091105.text: 每波击败 25 点矮人声望点，在每波结束后立即奖励（第 1 轮结束 - 25 点，第 3 轮结束 - 75 点）。

657b09012d24f31e751c75f57aded755584e2887.source: Updated scores appear on Consular Rahburt's record board, shortly after the old ones are broken.
657b09012d24f31e751c75f57aded755584e2887.text: 旧分数被打破后不久，更新的分数就会出现在拉伯特领事的记录板上。

691cf7badd10169552e35af9bfde6e18e9c0431d.source: Each party member will be awarded 1500 Delver Reputation points should they break the daily record.
691cf7badd10169552e35af9bfde6e18e9c0431d.text: 如果每位队员打破每日记录，他们将获得 1500 点 Delver 声望点。

8ff4928a39a678efc7b1f8a9408e0e185b53fc54.source: Each party member will be awarded 3000 Delver Reputation points should they break the monthly record.
8ff4928a39a678efc7b1f8a9408e0e185b53fc54.text: 如果每位队员打破每月记录，他们将获得 3000 点 Delver 声望点。

af62f2a47e7db8af52180ef41da32ca62b4e54de.source: Each party member will be awarded 6000 Delver Reputation points should they break the quarterly record (3 months).
af62f2a47e7db8af52180ef41da32ca62b4e54de.text: 如果每位党员打破季度记录（3 个月），他们将获得 6000 Delver 声望点。

41de9bdedf85c1bee5b6630c7f1834bc3fd1aad7.source: The main mission area contains three entrances to a room with the Baby Dragon. The rear entrance connects to an elevated loop that encircles the arena. There are two side gates which lead to pathways and monster spawn points. In the center, the baby dragon rests on an elevated platform.
41de9bdedf85c1bee5b6630c7f1834bc3fd1aad7.text: 主要任务区域包含通往小龙房间的三个入口。后门连接到环绕竞技场的高架环路。有两个侧门通向路径和怪物生成点。在中心，小龙休息在一个高架平台上。

8d8f35ea1ef369de0b6ec20472e30e02ef4dc014.source: You will be attacked by six waves consisting of different types of Destroyers. A new wave starts immediately after the last destroyer of the previous wave has been killed. The party gains a morale boost every time a new wave starts.
8d8f35ea1ef369de0b6ec20472e30e02ef4dc014.text: 您将受到由不同类型的驱逐舰组成的六波攻击。在前一波的最后一艘驱逐舰被杀死后，新一波立即开始。每当新一波浪潮开始时，党的士气就会得到鼓舞。

79cb2649a24c9c3bbef98bb280b2494dd9419ddb.source: The first wave consists of a constant swarm of weak level 10 and 15 Destroyers of Souls and Destroyers of Hordes, along with some level 20 Destroyers of Thoughts for about two minutes and thirty seconds (last spawn at 2:25). Splitting into two groups along the two paths and killing the monsters at their spawn points is effective. Alternatively, you can let the Destroyers pile up one side and spam heavy AoE skills to clear them all at once.
79cb2649a24c9c3bbef98bb280b2494dd9419ddb.text: 第一波持续约两分三十秒，由一群弱小的 10 级和 15 级灵魂毁灭者和部落毁灭者组成，同时还有一些 20 级思想毁灭者（最后出现时间为 2:25）。沿着两条路径分成两组并在怪物重生点杀死它们是有效的。或者，你可以让毁灭者堆积一侧并发送大量 AoE 技能来一次性清除它们。

89c29d8f886a70a52c1ae495149373303117590c.source: The second wave consists of Destroyers of Compassion and Destroyers of Deeds. The Destroyers of Deeds block most attacks with Lightning Reflexes, making this the hardest wave for groups consisting mainly of physical damage dealers. They also use Debilitating Shot and Savage Shot, which can incapacitate your casters. Meanwhile, the Destroyers of Compassion will try to wreck your backline. This is one of the more difficult waves. Focus on killing the Destroyers of Compassion first as they deal catastrophic amounts of damage.
89c29d8f886a70a52c1ae495149373303117590c.text: 第二波由慈悲破坏者和行为破坏者组成。行为毁灭者可以用闪电反射阻挡大部分攻击，这对于主要由物理伤害造成的群体来说是最难的一波。他们还使用衰弱射击和野蛮射击，这可以使你的施法者丧失能力。与此同时，慈悲毁灭者将试图破坏你的后线。这是难度较大的一波。首先集中精力消灭慈悲毁灭者，因为它们会造成灾难性的伤害。

01c5dfc2be9a35cd6a7fe9fa4bf567ff0ef470ab.source: In the third wave, Destroyers of Hope and Destroyers of Thoughts dig out of the ground throughout the entire arena. If not aggroed, they will circle around the area and attack the Baby Dragon from behind. It is advisable to spread out your party in order to defeat the wave as quickly as possible, being sure to have at least one party member targeting the destroyers on each bridge.
01c5dfc2be9a35cd6a7fe9fa4bf567ff0ef470ab.text: 在第三波中，希望的破坏者和思想的破坏者在整个竞技场中从地下挖出。如果没有被激怒，它们会绕着该区域转圈，从后面攻击小龙。建议分散你的队伍，以便尽快击败这波浪潮，并确保至少有一名队伍成员瞄准每座桥上的驱逐舰。

19d613e07376b19a108aea7f6a9be3a06a3bbe71.source: The fourth wave consists of Destroyers of Compassion, Destroyers of Flesh, Destroyers of Sinew, Destroyers of Bones, and a few Destroyers of Souls coming down both side exits.
19d613e07376b19a108aea7f6a9be3a06a3bbe71.text: 第四波由慈悲毁灭者、血肉毁灭者、筋力毁灭者、骨头毁灭者和一些灵魂毁灭者组成，从两侧出口而来。

5634beb69956aa2780018f19425eb618c641caa7.source: The fifth wave consists of Destroyers of Hope and Destroyers of Thoughts coming through all three exits, while Destroyers of Lives pop up within range of the Baby Dragon. Interrupt the Destroyers of Lives and dispatch them quickly, as they do massive fire damage, and inevitably target the baby dragon if left alive for too long.
5634beb69956aa2780018f19425eb618c641caa7.text: 第五波由来自所有三个出口的希望毁灭者和思想毁灭者组成，而生命毁灭者则出现在小龙的射程内。打断生命毁灭者并迅速消灭它们，因为它们会造成巨大的火焰伤害，并且如果存活时间太长，不可避免地会瞄准小龙。

9034f781e38ae615acc6463c79b187883fba5b9f.source: The sixth and final wave consists of four Bosses: the Hand of Destruction and the Heart of Destruction from the left spawn, and the Mind of Destruction and the Flesh of Destruction from the right.
9034f781e38ae615acc6463c79b187883fba5b9f.text: 第六波也是最后一波由四个 Boss 组成：左侧生成的毁灭之手和毁灭之心，右侧生成的毁灭之心和毁灭之肉。

d116c69f716b75e7ef1b3f3c2700fab6df5b6401.source: Destroyers are immune to burning and have (at least) +20 armor against fire damage; they have a -20 penalty against cold damage.
d116c69f716b75e7ef1b3f3c2700fab6df5b6401.text: 驱逐舰免疫燃烧并且（至少）+20 防御火焰伤害的护甲；他们对寒冷伤害的惩罚为-20。

5894e822b1e64d05c13d8a5d2023c7438da83d92.source: There are enough corpses for at least 2 Minion Masters. Several Death Magic skills deal cold damage.
5894e822b1e64d05c13d8a5d2023c7438da83d92.text: 尸体数量至少足够 2 个仆从大师使用。一些死亡魔法技能会造成冰冷伤害。

7d080c5fb2d08c46f1cbe3e27615818ff5b4ce09.source: Some Deldrimor skills have extra impact against destroyers, especially Alkar's Alchemical Acid.
7d080c5fb2d08c46f1cbe3e27615818ff5b4ce09.text: 一些德尔德里莫技能对驱逐舰有额外的影响，尤其是阿尔卡的炼金酸。

7e91b21843424b8ed73fcf401d1de3134896f62f.source: Display the Stout-Hearted title effect, which increases skill damage against the destroyers (while healing skill users).
7e91b21843424b8ed73fcf401d1de3134896f62f.text: 显示“坚强的心”标题效果，增加对驱逐舰的技能伤害（同时治疗技能使用者）。

2d33ca2314b50fc841fd0e3a82a28cb392875879.source: Certain hero team comps can successfully complete the challenge without any player input.
2d33ca2314b50fc841fd0e3a82a28cb392875879.text: 某些英雄团队组合可以在没有任何玩家输入的情况下成功完成挑战。

fad7ee6d2bcc5171fb82b11f732c1ea7537b966e.source: Find a ship willing to carry a passenger to Ascalon.
fad7ee6d2bcc5171fb82b11f732c1ea7537b966e.text: 找到一艘愿意载客前往阿斯卡隆的船。

d119906d1beec65f0563ac979fc5465ff88cc0ab.source: Seek out Captain Joran in Wajjun Bazaar.
d119906d1beec65f0563ac979fc5465ff88cc0ab.text: 在 Wajjun Bazaar 寻找乔兰船长。

5502c09079b7acfd37c5f08fd467172f4ae0fb9d.source: From Kaineng Center, go to Bejunkan Pier and speak to Armian. He will tell you to see Captain Joran in Wajjun Bazaar. Speak to Captain Joran, who will agree to take Bryan along. Return to Bryan in Bukdek Byway to collect your reward.
5502c09079b7acfd37c5f08fd467172f4ae0fb9d.text: 从凯能中心出发，前往 Bejunkan 码头并与 Armian 交谈。他会告诉你到 Wajjun Bazaar 去见 Joran 队长。与乔兰队长交谈，他会同意带布莱恩一起去。返回 Bukdek Byway 的 Bryan 处领取奖励。

6955fd333f5ae6037fef544e914421f1ee75cd7f.source: It is recommended that you not have Chasing Zenmai active when accepting or completing this quest. Bryan is hostile to enemies so when you approach him, Am Fah will spawn near him and attack. Either complete Chasing Zenmai first or abandon it before accepting or completing Going Home.
6955fd333f5ae6037fef544e914421f1ee75cd7f.text: 建议您在接受或完成此任务时不要激活“追逐善舞”。布莱恩对敌人充满敌意，因此当您接近他时，Am Fah 会在他附近生成并进行攻击。要么先完成“追寻善麦”，要么在接受或完成“回家”之前放弃它。

3e2c2773eaef3000acd1b47127c5dd367ff9d404.source: Seek out the Great Zehtuka in Nightfallen Jahai.
3e2c2773eaef3000acd1b47127c5dd367ff9d404.text: 在堕夜者贾海寻找伟大的泽图卡。

94aebdf4f31d3c00e8709d8eaa71beca5d883398.source: Slay the demon pestering the Great Zehtuka.
94aebdf4f31d3c00e8709d8eaa71beca5d883398.text: 消灭困扰伟大泽图卡的恶魔。

1385765dcd0dd0f2e75501db1ecf2a5a673aab7a.source: Kill Zealous Amarantha and her minions.
1385765dcd0dd0f2e75501db1ecf2a5a673aab7a.text: 杀死热心苋菜和她的爪牙。

20518dc940338039d700ee409521faaad7e34242.text: 去找 Churrazek 领取奖励。

fe28ba6a14a9da025f94ebbd5b387e1c1b9a0f87.source: Complete this quest while performing others taken at Gate of Torment to save time. Assist Zehtuka to defeat the nearby Awakened Defiler, then follow him to kill a group of Margonites with the Zealous Amarantha boss.
fe28ba6a14a9da025f94ebbd5b387e1c1b9a0f87.text: 完成此任务的同时执行在折磨之门采取的其他任务以节省时间。协助泽图卡击败附近的觉醒污染者，然后跟随他与热心苋菜 Boss 一起杀死一群玛贡尼特。

70c85f52d3ac67f7d4aa1538f88474ff3965333f.source: This quest is automatically accepted upon encountering the Great Zehtuka in Nightfallen Jahai (no need to talk to Churrazek).
70c85f52d3ac67f7d4aa1538f88474ff3965333f.text: 当在堕夜者贾海遇到伟大的泽图卡时，该任务会自动接受（无需与 Churrazek 交谈）。

6235947a90dc056a35527c273755831914f6dfa9.source: Having chosen Norgu to accompany Midauha in Istan in the quest Brains or Brawn.
6235947a90dc056a35527c273755831914f6dfa9.text: 选择诺尔古陪伴伊斯坦的米多哈执行“大脑或体力”任务。

fa5a6cbe3a4f32d60e049da7d6a30067b27d9904.source: * Gain Goren neither active nor completed
fa5a6cbe3a4f32d60e049da7d6a30067b27d9904.text: * 获得鬣蜥人既不活跃也不完成

494e40c1b3c28e405fb1e2636f8caa4de0c42437.source: Accompany Goren while he finds his weapon.

40ed5337a5604ba234ee9fbdd793de27650fdc59.source: Accompany Goren while he finds his armor.
40ed5337a5604ba234ee9fbdd793de27650fdc59.text: 陪伴戈伦寻找他的盔甲。

c6dfd85572fcf71823c76c391b8af59fae378273.source: Accompany Goren while he finds his most prized possession: a sparkling rock.
c6dfd85572fcf71823c76c391b8af59fae378273.text: 陪伴戈伦找到他最珍贵的财产：一块闪闪发光的岩石。

4a46e504dd94f9c5dd34f36cd9608f618e472bf9.source: See Xunlai Agent Momo for your reward.
4a46e504dd94f9c5dd34f36cd9608f618e472bf9.text: 找迅来特工莫莫领取奖励。

1f124aaa91995a5e3c0fe7ecbebe3893c76703b4.source: This quest involves protecting Goren, a level 18 hammer warrior while he collects his belongings through Resplendent Makuun, surrounding the Bokka Amphitheatre.
1f124aaa91995a5e3c0fe7ecbebe3893c76703b4.text: 该任务涉及保护 18 级锤子战士 Goren，同时他通过 Bokka 露天剧场周围的 Resplendent Makuun 收集他的物品。

088570bacd17860b3509c84cb1a943c71c65d8ed.source: His AI has two behaviors: He will follow your lead while walking through the area. But will start to rush in by himself when approaching any of the three quest marker spots. Everytime he runs alone by himself, he risks quest failure since his survival is one of the objectives. If your team set-up is not suited and need to retry, consider taking bonding skills like Life Bond to ease the job.
088570bacd17860b3509c84cb1a943c71c65d8ed.text: 他的人工智能有两种行为：他会在穿过该区域时跟随你的引导。但当接近三个任务标记点中的任何一个时，他会开始自己冲进去。每次他独自奔跑时，他都会面临任务失败的风险，因为他的生存是目标之一。如果您的团队设置不适合并且需要重试，请考虑采用诸如 Life Bond 之类的粘合技能来缓解工作压力。

889a11f2e3c146cccbde83eeeea47434f3a0231c.source: Escort and protect this ally while searching 3 items (his weapon, armor and a sparkling rock) to complete the quest.
889a11f2e3c146cccbde83eeeea47434f3a0231c.text: 护送并保护这位盟友，同时搜索 3 件物品（他的武器、盔甲和一块闪闪发光的岩石）来完成任务。

7abe82488955bf477ef24d34da8424b19c5bd6f5.source: If you are not in a hurry to acquire Goren, it is easier to complete Gain Goren than this quest, since that quest only requires you to speak to Prince Bokka the Magnificent in Resplendent Makuun. The Gain Goren quest also awards 500 more experience than this quest.
7abe82488955bf477ef24d34da8424b19c5bd6f5.text: 如果你不急于获得戈伦，那么完成获得戈伦比这个任务更容易，因为该任务只需要你与辉煌马库恩的伟大的博卡王子交谈。 Gain Goren 任务还比该任务奖励多 500 点经验。

aabdc1fe265d19556c26ecf8c23512e633ab1dea.source: Although unlocking Goren is a prerequisite for Goren's Stuff: Part 2, this quest itself is not.
aabdc1fe265d19556c26ecf8c23512e633ab1dea.text: 尽管解锁巨人是《巨人之物：第 2 部分》的先决条件，但此任务本身却不是。

dcfd76275212818c063c38117d4ebd7f2e443027.source: Take Goren and his Sparkling Rock to the Hidden City of Ahdashim to hide the rock.
dcfd76275212818c063c38117d4ebd7f2e443027.text: 将戈伦和他的闪闪发光的岩石带到阿达西姆隐藏之城隐藏岩石。

d8eeead6e92d29b7261368ec1ba6c0a5037febec.source: Map to Dasha Vestibule and speak to the Key of Ahdashim to enter the hidden city. Once inside, pickup Goren's Sparkling Rock. A hostile baby Saltspray Dragon will hatch out of it and attack the party. Once defeated the dragon will turn into a friendly NPC, that you should chat with and complete the quest.
d8eeead6e92d29b7261368ec1ba6c0a5037febec.text: 地图到 Dasha Vestibule 并与 Ahdashim 钥匙交谈以进入隐藏的城市。进去后，拿起鬣蜥人的闪闪发光的岩石。一条充满敌意的盐雾龙宝宝会从中孵化出来并攻击队伍。一旦被击败，龙就会变成一个友好的 NPC，你应该与之聊天并完成任务。

90f142d27cfd2a2b1afd96fd8ace45459fa41ad6.source: The baby dragon resides inside the Hidden City, after the completion of the quest.
90f142d27cfd2a2b1afd96fd8ace45459fa41ad6.text: 任务完成后，幼龙居住在隐藏之城内。

e29a4e1e76e45c6b133311c71d88af6362ef0863.source: This quest is explicitly titled as Part 2 and its story element follows directly from Part 1; however, Part 1 is only available to characters who chose to keep Goren in Brains or Brawn, while Part 2 is available regardless.
e29a4e1e76e45c6b133311c71d88af6362ef0863.text: 该任务的明确标题为第 2 部分，其故事元素直接源自第 1 部分；然而，第 1 部分仅适用于选择将 Goren 保留在 Brains 或 Brawn 中的角色，而第 2 部分则无论如何都可用。

719d058704600fc476ef089d089ef5365c4d90e7.source: Take Tahlkora and close the torment rifts in the Sebelkeh Basilica.
719d058704600fc476ef089d089ef5365c4d90e7.text: 占领塔尔科拉并关闭塞贝尔克大教堂中的折磨裂缝。

ee6fade87e560fbd4cfec7bc1cfd4c6b38e6cc17.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 6 minutes (12 minutes in Hard Mode).
ee6fade87e560fbd4cfec7bc1cfd4c6b38e6cc17.text: *奖励* 在 6 分钟内完成任务（困难模式下为 12 分钟）。

941f6d30e61c0808f2e9f9f147d64956cfdd5ee4.source: As per the Grand Court of Sebelkeh mission.
941f6d30e61c0808f2e9f9f147d64956cfdd5ee4.text: 根据塞贝尔克大法庭的使命。

e9617a0e594fdb489a175f395adbc5dc6b09add0.source: Protect Archivist Ithimar from the Nightmares.
e9617a0e594fdb489a175f395adbc5dc6b09add0.text: 保护档案管理员伊蒂玛免受噩梦的侵害。

0b4600f5120425ce648936883db2dd99a066a645.source: Return to Archivist Ithimar for your reward.
0b4600f5120425ce648936883db2dd99a066a645.text: 返回档案管理员伊蒂玛那里领取奖励。

4607310558124157439686f61bfd89ed83538a78.source: Take the path heading directly East outside of Lion's Arch and follow it North until you reach Archivist Ithimar. As soon as you accept the quest, groups of Nightmares will begin spawning around the foot of Ithimar's pedestal, one group at a time. There will be two groups of 2, one group of 3, and finally a group of 4, with each group only appearing once all of the Nightmares in the previous group have been killed. The Nightmares are fairly weak, especially in small numbers, relying on Touch of Agony combined with Dark Aura for moderate AoE spike damage. However, be careful about casting spells on yourself or your allies, since you may be hexed with Mark of Subversion.
4607310558124157439686f61bfd89ed83538a78.text: 沿着狮子拱门外的正东方向行驶，然后向北行驶，直到到达档案管理员伊蒂玛。一旦你接受了任务，成群的梦魇就会开始在伊西玛的基座脚下生成，一次一组。将会有两组 2 人、一组 3 人、最后一组 4 人，每组只有在前一组中的所有噩梦都被杀死后才会出现。梦魇相当弱，尤其是数量较少，依靠痛苦之触与黑暗光环相结合来造成中等范围的尖峰伤害。然而，在对自己或盟友施法时要小心，因为你可能会被颠覆印记所诅咒。

e0e3b2dfa9ac1d97c3c9d7728ba59909a81453dc.source: After clearing all the groups, talk to Ithimar again for your reward.
e0e3b2dfa9ac1d97c3c9d7728ba59909a81453dc.text: 清除所有小组后，再次与伊蒂玛交谈以获得奖励。

f76e778bb825fc81aba9ddb69aea76bb3d0a399a.source: The Nightmares will not actually attack Archivist Ithimar, and cannot damage him even with Dark Aura.
f76e778bb825fc81aba9ddb69aea76bb3d0a399a.text: 梦魇实际上不会攻击档案管理员伊蒂玛，即使有黑暗光环也无法伤害他。

d16ee6fe835300531c8044ccfbd0c949630f987c.source: During the quest, Archivist Ithimar will be animated as if he is activating a skill, but no skill is actually being used.
d16ee6fe835300531c8044ccfbd0c949630f987c.text: 在任务过程中，档案管理员伊蒂玛会被动画化，就好像他正在激活一项技能一样，但实际上并没有使用任何技能。

edc3b9442ea0dac2dc645584a30d565c1d69e687.source: If you rezone before all the Nightmares have been killed, you will need to speak to Ithimar and ask him about the quest to cause the Nightmares to spawn again.
edc3b9442ea0dac2dc645584a30d565c1d69e687.text: 如果你在所有噩梦被杀死之前重新分区，你将需要与伊西玛交谈并询问他有关导致噩梦再次生成的任务。

00388bca767250e1a6887261c13cdb67e9b0f885.source: If you keep the quest active, the Nightmares can be farmed for Piles of Glittering Dust and Shadowy Remnants. In Normal Mode, the Nightmares are level 15, making them a good source of experience.
00388bca767250e1a6887261c13cdb67e9b0f885.text: 如果你保持任务活跃，可以通过梦魇来获得成堆的闪闪发光的灰尘和阴暗的遗迹。在普通模式下，噩梦等级为 15，这使得它们成为良好的经验来源。

b117eaccc375a9bb052ed08c6346e6354a2d3038.source: If you intend to farm the quest, consider also keeping The Ascalon Settlement active for the allies it provides.
b117eaccc375a9bb052ed08c6346e6354a2d3038.text: 如果您打算进行任务，请考虑让阿斯卡隆定居点为其提供的盟友保持活跃状态。

27c18a4730ac803919103241abd3a26c90a22e4b.source: On some occasions a Krytan/Locked Chest will spawn as soon as a group of Nightmares appears.
27c18a4730ac803919103241abd3a26c90a22e4b.text: 在某些情况下，一旦出现一组梦魇，就会生成科瑞塔/锁定宝箱。

9ec58b00f5b34cf3c183be1c3108c0db172a7d5b.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: warrior
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
9ec58b00f5b34cf3c183be1c3108c0db172a7d5b.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：战士
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

5258cde387fd2d9068c6c5b939b371dd88462fed.source: Look for Grawl invaders along the road. Eliminate them.
5258cde387fd2d9068c6c5b939b371dd88462fed.text: 沿路寻找穴居人入侵者。消灭他们。

4ec4876afc337e734e87e4c65c1e4f01fba60aa7.source: Upon accepting the quest, Warmaster Grast will provide you with a Starter Sword and give you the following skills:
4ec4876afc337e734e87e4c65c1e4f01fba60aa7.text: 接受任务后，战帅格拉斯特将为你提供一把入门剑并赋予你以下技能：

82ea2d25cb781f21fb6143024239da145afb0a14.source: Two of your newly acquired skills, Sever Artery and Gash require a sword to function. Equip the Starter Sword provided by Warmaster Grast and head southwest down the road. Along the way, you will encounter several non-hostile Stone Elementals. You may try out your sword skills on them to learn that these creatures of earth are immune to Bleeding, rendering your new condition-based combo ineffective.
82ea2d25cb781f21fb6143024239da145afb0a14.text: 你新获得的两项技能“切断动脉”和“割伤”需要一把剑才能发挥作用。装备战帅格拉斯特提供的入门剑，沿着道路向西南方向前进。一路上，你会遇到一些没有敌意的石元素。你可以在他们身上尝试一下你的剑技，发现这些地球生物免疫流血，从而使你的新的基于条件的组合无效。

7cff3dd5a1f8dbf73fac63e08ccb2cfc515fd342.source: Continue past the elementals to find a a patrol of three Grawl Invaders close by. Being flesh and blood, they are susceptible to your blade. Use your basic attack to build up your Adrenaline. Once you have amassed 3 strikes of Adrenaline, use Sever Artery to inflict the Bleeding condition. When you reach 5 strikes of Adrenaline, follow up with Gash to inflict a Deep Wound on the bleeding target. Notice that each adrenal skill has its own independent Adrenaline pool.
7cff3dd5a1f8dbf73fac63e08ccb2cfc515fd342.text: 继续经过元素生物，发现附近有一支由三名穴居人入侵者组成的巡逻队。他们是有血有肉的人，很容易受到你的刀刃的伤害。使用你的基本攻击来增强你的肾上腺素。一旦你积累了 3 次肾上腺素攻击，就可以使用切断动脉来造成出血状态。当你的肾上腺素达到 5 次时，继续使用割伤对流血的目标造成深度伤口。请注意，每个肾上腺技能都有自己独立的肾上腺素池。

509224b9d0f0fc4d34502d11e2bc88928ee84b4d.source: Once the Grawl threat has been eliminated, return to Grast to claim your reward.
509224b9d0f0fc4d34502d11e2bc88928ee84b4d.text: 一旦 Grawl 的威胁被消除，就返回 Grast 领取你的奖励。

65996a9108e326202b1232148e9cbce69a971285.source: Clear Grenth's Footprint in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
65996a9108e326202b1232148e9cbce69a971285.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉中所有敌人的古兰斯足迹。

475dfc5177a2b3484829284345156ba08d7e247b.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
475dfc5177a2b3484829284345156ba08d7e247b.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 1%。

5f0b23478768eb9627a68b8b26e80da91dad710d.source: When vanquishing, there is a group of two ice imps and a golem that wanders a long route passing through the SE area of the map.
5f0b23478768eb9627a68b8b26e80da91dad710d.text: 征服时，有一群两个冰小鬼和一个傀儡，在地图的东南部区域徘徊了很长一段路。

fb67b638ade0bdf0f074cce751d8cbb892a6bc09.source: Stone Summit and Pinesoul groups are hostile to each other.
fb67b638ade0bdf0f074cce751d8cbb892a6bc09.text: 石顶派和松魂派彼此敌对。

62397d10452b54e58e0eb5fa463c81a5f3b870a8.source: Clear the Griffon's Mouth in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
62397d10452b54e58e0eb5fa463c81a5f3b870a8.text: 在困难模式下清除北席瓦山脉狮鹫之口的所有敌人。

8db60c076f646012f3f8f0d6c222ad3371433d39.source: The To Kryta: The Ice Cave primary quest will lead Prophecies characters through this map.
8db60c076f646012f3f8f0d6c222ad3371433d39.text: 前往科瑞塔：冰洞的主线任务将引导预言角色穿越这张地图。

904726f804ec1c1d6564b8bc69c1feb9c8a4c3e7.source: It can also be accessed from Beacon's Perch via Deldrimor Bowl.
904726f804ec1c1d6564b8bc69c1feb9c8a4c3e7.text: 也可以通过德尔德里莫碗从灯塔栖息地进入。

e062ad7674acb2c33ac08587a5041114cacd8d3a.source: Characters from other campaigns must travel from Lion's Arch through North Kryta Province and Scoundrel's Rise.
e062ad7674acb2c33ac08587a5041114cacd8d3a.text: 其他战役中的角色必须从狮子拱门出发，穿过北科瑞塔省和恶棍高地。

b52121d78833d8ecd18b0bf25e6dc102c53c25f8.source: Often people running through this area experience rubber-banding as they are trying to pass by groups of ettins, which can prove troubling for those without shadow steps.
b52121d78833d8ecd18b0bf25e6dc102c53c25f8.text: 人们在穿过这个区域时，在试图经过成群的埃廷人时，常常会遇到橡皮筋的情况，这对于那些没有影子步的人来说可能会很麻烦。

ce1a158596d30124094fabc15cf450436f908153.source: Heroes and henchmen often remain stuck at some several places in the ice cave, there is currently no known reason for this.
ce1a158596d30124094fabc15cf450436f908153.text: 英雄和追随者经常被困在冰洞的某些地方，目前尚不清楚原因。

4a9f443d31d0e13d0a652ec96542e2176cb5b7c4.source: On the southern part of this area, where ice paths can be found, you actually walk through the ice instead of walking on it.
4a9f443d31d0e13d0a652ec96542e2176cb5b7c4.text: 在该地区的南部，可以找到冰路，您实际上是在冰上行走，而不是在冰上行走。

6c5ff0fb5382cdc1de592efe3006509b623ae87c.source: There is an invisible wall between the exit from the cave into the forest area, north of the southern resurrection shrine and west across the wall from Whiskar Featherstorm.}}
6c5ff0fb5382cdc1de592efe3006509b623ae87c.text: 洞穴出口进入森林区域之间有一堵看不见的墙，位于南部复活神殿以北，西面与威斯卡·羽风暴隔墙相望。}}

ce568f7208ccbcd61f02a200ffdc8b0018546c8f.source: Clear the Grothmar Wardowns in the Charr Homelands of all enemies in hard mode.
ce568f7208ccbcd61f02a200ffdc8b0018546c8f.text: 在困难模式下清除查尔故乡的格罗斯玛战事中的所有敌人。

bee1dde289070cb4459bf9b4ca8ec7b1c5ee67eb.source: The first time you appear with Rebel Yell activated, Weststar's squad will appear once, talk for a bit, and then leave for the outpost. Wait for them to finish so that you can do the Vanguard-side skill quests later.
bee1dde289070cb4459bf9b4ca8ec7b1c5ee67eb.text: 当你第一次出现并激活叛军呐喊时，西星的小队会出现一次，交谈一会儿，然后前往前哨站。等他们完成之后再做先锋侧的技能任务。

cfbc1db483eef7310d49a9528c5add57952c6af7.source: The Black Wolves in this area cannot be attacked.
cfbc1db483eef7310d49a9528c5add57952c6af7.text: 这个区域的黑狼是无法被攻击的。

080b04fe0a6275043a644e0bf1935d9766108bb5.source: Chaelse Flameshielder, the boss in the Charr camp, can be hard to kill due to multiple healers or simply due to the amount of resurrect skills. Bring the appropriate skills to interrupt or counter resurrection if your party does not have sufficient fire power. You can use the cliff to provide some protection and hold aggro.
080b04fe0a6275043a644e0bf1935d9766108bb5.text: Chaelse Flameshielder，Charr阵营的boss，由于多个治疗者或仅仅由于复活技能的数量而很难被杀死。如果你的队伍没有足够的火力，请带上适当的技能来打断或反复活。你可以利用悬崖来提供一些保护并保持仇恨。

6ebc8458e2f5480b2c1f518294c8d3397e294157.source: Alternatively, you can avoid this group entirely by completing Against the Charr first; you will spawn in the middle of the camp and Chaelse does not spawn. However, if Plan A is active, then the camp will be filled with hordes of charr and your team will likely wipe.
6ebc8458e2f5480b2c1f518294c8d3397e294157.text: 或者，你可以通过先完成“对抗夏尔”来完全避开这个群体；你会在营地中间生成，而 Chaelse 不会生成。然而，如果 A 计划生效，那么营地将充满成群的夏尔，你的队伍可能会被消灭。

8ca36be6986336f4efaf3d3c293efa80d6865c64.source: Only Charr Dominators, Charr Avengers, Charr Blademasters, and Charr Axemasters can resurrect; the monks (Charr Menders, Charr Prophets, and Chaelse Flameshielder) cannot.
8ca36be6986336f4efaf3d3c293efa80d6865c64.text: 只有夏尔支配者、夏尔复仇者、夏尔剑圣和夏尔斧王可以复活；僧侣（夏尔治愈者、夏尔先知和查尔丝·火盾者）则不能。

b425565d52f9b5bbbf7e484f1532c9bc3a109d72.source: As with any area in the Charr Homelands, if at least two player characters are in the party, several Siege Devourers can be mounted which can make vanquishing much easier.
b425565d52f9b5bbbf7e484f1532c9bc3a109d72.text: 与夏尔家园的任何区域一样，如果队伍中至少有两名玩家角色，则可以安装多个攻城吞噬者，这可以使征服变得更加容易。

af70b911ebcd97e950eaa92251a8c910de6a2862.source: Travel to the eastern side of Resplendent Makuun. Explore the last known position of the raiding party.
af70b911ebcd97e950eaa92251a8c910de6a2862.text: 前往辉煌马库恩的东侧。探索突袭队最后已知的位置。

bf6bd153f6490e528de7117677545a42f5717771.source: Find the captured guard captain and assess the situation.
bf6bd153f6490e528de7117677545a42f5717771.text: 找到被俘的守卫队长并评估局势。

b30b4c2a5bd4fa298bbb70c5753e77b139f6f24e.source: Escort the freed guards from the heket lair.
b30b4c2a5bd4fa298bbb70c5753e77b139f6f24e.text: 护送被释放的守卫离开赫克特巢穴。

9005fb24cda7a140307d7c1cca9b4eb8b3a95a7e.source: Hand over the freed guards to the rescue party.
9005fb24cda7a140307d7c1cca9b4eb8b3a95a7e.text: 将获释的守卫交给救援队。

91a5241b5c1176fd83e312769b641d7eea2e2949.source: See Prince Ahmtur the Mighty for your reward.
91a5241b5c1176fd83e312769b641d7eea2e2949.text: 去见强大的阿姆图尔王子以获得奖励。

3358c3143f26a8ff71a0f3187822926d31d65908.source: If you do this quest immediately after Population Control, it's probably easiest to walk straight back across the Wilderness to Resplendent Makuun, since the route will be clear after doing the previous quest.
3358c3143f26a8ff71a0f3187822926d31d65908.text: 如果你在人口控制后立即执行此任务，那么直接穿过荒野回到灿烂的马库恩可能是最简单的，因为在完成上一个任务后路线将变得清晰。

8111f2f490fce7e30947b20c0a7dbec28f62867f.source: If you do this quest later, it's best to start from the Honur Hill outpost, and take your party along the northern edge of Resplendent Makuun to the first objective.
8111f2f490fce7e30947b20c0a7dbec28f62867f.text: 如果你以后做这个任务，最好从荣誉山前哨站开始，带着你的队伍沿着辉煌马库恩的北部边缘到达第一个目标。

8aa3eb5bd88f5f349b96058dfc53e52c7f6559bc.source: In either case, follow the quest pointer and make your way towards the missing patrol's last known position. Unfortunately, few members of the patrol remain; they have no doubt been slain by the heket in the area. However, the captain and 2 guards are still alive and being held prisoner, so the party must make haste to the next point and rescue them from the roaming creatures!
8aa3eb5bd88f5f349b96058dfc53e52c7f6559bc.text: 无论哪种情况，请按照任务指针前往失踪巡逻队最后已知的位置。不幸的是，巡逻队成员所剩无几。毫无疑问，他们是被该地区的赫克特杀死的。然而，队长和两名守卫仍然活着并被囚禁，所以队伍必须赶紧前往下一个地点，从漫游的生物手中救出他们！

9f162aee7a3a78874a5f036b7b09b769724b91a8.source: Having rescued the still living members of the patrol, escort them to Captain Portir and his rescue team on the eastern side of Resplendent Makuun, where you can hand over the freed guards and their captain.
9f162aee7a3a78874a5f036b7b09b769724b91a8.text: 救出还活着的巡逻队成员后，护送他们到辉煌马库恩东侧的波提尔队长和他的救援队，在那里你可以交出被释放的守卫和他们的队长。

2a64bd47db54e66a5247f3544c5cb5670f2a2829.source: To collect your reward from Prince Ahmtur, map back to Dzagonur Bastion and walk back to the Citadel in the Wilderness of Bahdza.
2a64bd47db54e66a5247f3544c5cb5670f2a2829.text: 要从阿姆图尔王子那里领取奖励，请返回扎古努尔堡垒，然后步行回到巴德扎荒野中的城堡。

9a59e7c7f7b0587f34920d1103a20fd9b5622dd2.source: Combines well with The Show Must Go On.
9a59e7c7f7b0587f34920d1103a20fd9b5622dd2.text: 与《演出必须继续》完美结合。

4d9378568fa39c8d058669a604bf27afa4903a38.source: Gwen does not already have a Flute. (Monk Monk characters see notes, below, as the quest is slightly different.)
4d9378568fa39c8d058669a604bf27afa4903a38.text: 格温还没有长笛。 （僧侣角色请参阅下面的注释，因为任务略有不同。）

d2ea98f1b82ef13b428d04aa09341e1b59207809.source: Guide to meeting Gwen Once you get the quest from Gwen, follow the southwest road until you come to the river. Go across it and you should find the Broken Flute on the beach. Return to Gwen for the reward.
d2ea98f1b82ef13b428d04aa09341e1b59207809.text: 格温见面指南 一旦你接到格温的任务，沿着西南路一直走到河边。穿过它，你应该在海滩上找到断笛。返回格温那里领取奖励。

a7ea2aaf47fc768abdc20dd2551b6b115f3c7cb0.source: This quest is mechanically unusual. Rather than having a normal quest window, it is accepted through "normal" dialogue, and the quest reward will be accepted automatically after returning the flute to Gwen.
a7ea2aaf47fc768abdc20dd2551b6b115f3c7cb0.text: 这个任务在机制上是不寻常的。它没有一个正常的任务窗口，而是通过“正常”对话接受，并且在将笛子归还给格温后，任务奖励将自动接受。

857e1f47261d38d656edadda75f6466f636cd909.source: If you form a party with anyone who has already started or completed this quest, or has given her the new flute or new cape, then Gwen will not give you the Tapestry Shred. Afterwards, everyone that will form a party with you and enter this area will have the same situation. This quest is not necessary for monks to obtain the Tapestry Shred. If you give her the new flute, new cape and flowers, she will give you the Tapestry Shred. If you are in a party with some one doing this quest (giving her the broken flute) after your party member gives her the broken flute and you need to speak to her she will give you the 250 experience points. She will say "Your friend found my flute. Thank You." If you abandon this quest, Gwen will not give it again.
857e1f47261d38d656edadda75f6466f636cd909.text: 如果你和任何已经开始或完成这个任务的人组队，或者给了她新的笛子或新的斗篷，那么格温不会给你挂毯碎片。之后，所有和你组队进入这个区域的人都会遇到同样的情况。僧侣无需完成此任务即可获得挂毯碎片。如果你给她新的笛子、新的斗篷和鲜花，她会给你挂毯碎片。如果你在一个队伍中，有人在你的队伍成员给了她破碎的笛子之后有人做这个任务（给她破碎的笛子），并且你需要和她说话，她会给你 250 点经验值。她会说“你的朋友找到了我的笛子。谢谢你。”如果你放弃这个任务，格温不会再给它。

552336cd7ce4d8aa525fd5030fc69c6cd01e733d.source: Guard the turtle caravan from the Gyala Hatchery.
552336cd7ce4d8aa525fd5030fc69c6cd01e733d.text: 守卫甲拉孵化场的海龟商队。

98c558d9acc88d9712b697166ea0faab45eb3c72.source: *BONUS* Keep all five young turtles alive.
98c558d9acc88d9712b697166ea0faab45eb3c72.text: *奖励*让所有五只小海龟都活着。

ec4b90789874247bf27e11036eb5f8530bc63950.source: As per the Gyala Hatchery mission.
ec4b90789874247bf27e11036eb5f8530bc63950.text: 根据嘉拉孵化场的任务。

5308f73842be248e8846114ee5713cf98c73c656.source: Clear the Gyala Hatchery in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
5308f73842be248e8846114ee5713cf98c73c656.text: 在困难模式下清除玉海甲拉孵化场的所有敌人。

ea1db290ceff0c90acfd72f91857c43be6f11681.source: Clear the Haiju Lagoon on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
ea1db290ceff0c90acfd72f91857c43be6f11681.text: 在困难模式下清除 Shing Jea 岛上海珠泻湖的所有敌人。

e27f75d513f4fb941e7ef43cde2e458f9cc640d2.source: Exit from Zen Daijun or travel northeast from Seitung Harbor through Jaya Bluffs.
e27f75d513f4fb941e7ef43cde2e458f9cc640d2.text: 从 Zen Daijun 出口或从 Seitung 港向东北行驶穿过 Jaya Bluffs。

c147711f64d3a53a0b73769aaf13b0ffb5451081.source: The primary quest To the Rescue will lead Factions characters here.
c147711f64d3a53a0b73769aaf13b0ffb5451081.text: 主要任务“救援”将带领派系角色来到这里。

3f8b90a65c15bb7a6d0732c1157e3e8acc9cc685.source: These quests will affect the spawns in this area: An Unwelcome Guest, Sentimental Treasures, Skin the Snake, The Bog Beast of Bokku, The Captured Son, The Naga Source, The Thieving Nanny, To the Rescue and To Zen Daijun.
3f8b90a65c15bb7a6d0732c1157e3e8acc9cc685.text: 这些任务将影响该区域的生成点：不速之客、感伤宝藏、剥蛇皮、博库沼泽野兽、被俘虏的儿子、娜迦之源、盗贼保姆、救援和禅大君。

49bba771fb8af6b25778d6498ec17dfc24068c6f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.17% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
49bba771fb8af6b25778d6498ec17dfc24068c6f.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Canthan 制图师头衔贡献了约 3.17%。

869656d806ab8c5b72eed280378341ad09d0a1ab.source: You can reduce to as little as 61 if Cleansing Haiju Lagoon is active or completed. Note that finishing this quest will remove all of the enemies, including the bosses, and replace them with scavengers.
869656d806ab8c5b72eed280378341ad09d0a1ab.text: 如果净化海珠泻湖已激活或完成，您可以减少至 61。请注意，完成此任务将消除所有敌人，包括 Boss，并用拾荒者取而代之。

bb3069cdc85da21adb3f88d85d943bbcfa5fb8ac.source: There are hidden groups of Naga mobs near the small cave at Daochu Village.
bb3069cdc85da21adb3f88d85d943bbcfa5fb8ac.text: 道处村的小山洞附近隐藏着成群的娜迦暴徒。

29c60a0e8901086a169fb6ea4d176adbb747b038.source: Tin Dao Kaineng can be dangerous due to the boss' Spirit Rift. Try to pull the two nearby groups apart. Daze the Naga boss to make it easier to interrupt. Keep spread out. Be prepared to flag heroes and henchmen away to avoid the rifts or to retreat.
29c60a0e8901086a169fb6ea4d176adbb747b038.text: 由于 Boss 的灵魂裂缝，天道凯能可能会很危险。尝试将附近的两组拉开。迷惑纳迦老大，以便更容易打断。保持分散。准备好标记英雄和追随者，以避免分裂或撤退。

4ac1ab74d2a1d5c56bd45620d8293a695a122e1c.source: Ambush the Charr in the tar pits south of Piken Square. Strike down Grimm Sharpfang.
4ac1ab74d2a1d5c56bd45620d8293a695a122e1c.text: 在皮肯广场南边的焦油坑里伏击夏尔。击倒格林锐牙。

7abd60c76bfb7b7fc1c34406e3d1c2bbdc7f21bd.source: Exit Piken Square and move south to the tar pits, kill Grimm Sharpfang and the Charr around him. Some Ascalon Militia will be attacking from the south as you arrive at the tar pits which can provide a useful distraction. Once Grimm Sharpfang is dead, return to the Duke in Piken Square for your reward.
7abd60c76bfb7b7fc1c34406e3d1c2bbdc7f21bd.text: 退出皮肯广场并向南移动到焦油坑，杀死格林·锐牙和他周围的夏尔。当你到达焦油坑时，一些阿斯卡隆民兵将从南面进攻，这可以提供有用的分散注意力。格林尖牙死后，返回皮肯广场的公爵那里领取奖励。

a25d86e69b9ff8b65c5d5863bc758f25b0dbd538.source: Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in Perdition Rock.
a25d86e69b9ff8b65c5d5863bc758f25b0dbd538.text: 杀死毁灭岩中的哈恩或玛克辛·科尔斯通。

e81c9b5f9e74f24ec42188f01cdef783ad663f21.source: *BONUS* Kill either Harn or Maxine Coldstone in Hard Mode.
e81c9b5f9e74f24ec42188f01cdef783ad663f21.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Harn 或 Maxine Coldstone。

383ff7e4d51a86e977944e0aaa0523a7c54f6b80.source: Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.
383ff7e4d51a86e977944e0aaa0523a7c54f6b80.text: 一旦玩家进入重生点位置的雷达范围，哈恩或玛克辛就会重生并开始在岛屿周围巡逻。 Boss 会在其巡逻路径上逆时针行走，因此最好顺时针行走其巡逻路径，因为 Boss 在生成时会向您移动，并且您无需在众多小怪中追逐 Boss。如果你沿着它的巡逻路径顺时针走，就会有血肉傀儡和玛戈九头蛇的小怪在灰烬之光营地外巡逻一圈。你的队伍可以呆在复活神殿附近并拉动每个怪物。

8dfad6c583a6dafba61d96b6d2885c24d15d872a.source: If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
8dfad6c583a6dafba61d96b6d2885c24d15d872a.text: 如果你顺时针穿过它的巡逻路径：

e4d4c959a20a223dc767c73154670a1d7a87475d.source: You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
e4d4c959a20a223dc767c73154670a1d7a87475d.text: 你只会遇到施法者小怪（暗焰干燥者、龙、肉傀儡、玛戈九头蛇和幻影），因此请考虑携带反施法者技能和/或各种游侠自然仪式，这些仪式可以使你的队伍受益，但不能使敌方施法者受益（例如顺风、真热、毒性，因为暗焰干燥者使用冻疮和风选）。

8d6a02ff90a211dfbbba140ac9ff02864cfd1fc5.source: The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
8d6a02ff90a211dfbbba140ac9ff02864cfd1fc5.text: 唯一的物理攻击者将是血肉傀儡通过动画骨小兵创造的骨小兵，因此阻挡、造成失误或造成失明状态的技能在这里效果较差。

327b774648640920c21cefaec256c946ee49405b.source: This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
327b774648640920c21cefaec256c946ee49405b.text: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 4 月 25 日。

04190dd724551eace891bbf6d0f78e7715846094.source: If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
04190dd724551eace891bbf6d0f78e7715846094.text: 如果你顺时针穿过boss的巡逻路径，你可以借此机会获得火山岩。

66ae43d549b4d89562b04b883b73c95c45e6100e.source: It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path
66ae43d549b4d89562b04b883b73c95c45e6100e.text: 哈恩或玛克辛有可能在其路径北部的海滩上生成

f8667d33aa4b03d3a05b86521810af31aa166ca3.source: Investigate the spirit sighting areas. You have 3..0 areas left to explore.
f8667d33aa4b03d3a05b86521810af31aa166ca3.text: 调查灵体观测区域。您还有 3..0 个区域可供探索。

e0bda5c4367afdfa0706f7dc7bc69d2aea4b3640.source: Exorcise the spirit of Tanto the Grim.
e0bda5c4367afdfa0706f7dc7bc69d2aea4b3640.text: 驱除冷酷者坦托的灵魂。

ffc951a296eaa3151d5ba7841d779f33282558e5.source: Exit Olafstead and follow the first quest marker, located on a small island to the northwest. As the party approaches, Xandra's dialogue will begin and Tanto the Grim will appear with a mob of Regrets. You will have the environmental effect Haunted Ground on you and your party. Be wary of the Ice Imps that populate the island—consider pulling them away from the marker so you do not have to fight both groups at once.
ffc951a296eaa3151d5ba7841d779f33282558e5.text: 退出奥拉夫斯特德并跟随第一个任务标记，该标记位于西北的一个小岛上。随着队伍临近，桑德拉的对话将开始，冷酷者坦托将带着一群后悔者出现。你和你的队伍将会受到闹鬼之地的环境影响。小心岛上的冰小鬼——考虑将它们从标记处拉开，这样你就不必同时与两个群体战斗。

ea0d65be802089755957ff614a9ad2bce50058c8.source: After defeating the Regrets, travel east to the next quest marker. Tanto will appear again, this time with a mob of Sorrows accompanying him. Once the Sorrows are killed, the quest marker will update.
ea0d65be802089755957ff614a9ad2bce50058c8.text: 击败后悔者后，向东前往下一个任务标记。坦托将再次出现，这次伴随着一群悲伤。一旦悲伤被杀死，任务标记就会更新。

c09110c5682a94b5eab54349efb27235dc7b1d0e.source: Tanto waits at the final marker. Approach him carefully—several Shock Phantoms are hidden in the area. After a short dialogue, Tanto will turn hostile and several Anguishes will spawn.
c09110c5682a94b5eab54349efb27235dc7b1d0e.text: 坦托在最后的标记处等待。小心地接近他——该地区隐藏着几架电击幻影。简短的对话后，Tanto 会变得敌对，并且会产生一些痛苦。

d50a0aa7b8c1d13e7319a8f230674f83f8850ce5.source: Killing Tanto and all the Anguishes will complete the quest.
d50a0aa7b8c1d13e7319a8f230674f83f8850ce5.text: 杀死 Tanto 和所有痛苦将完成任务。

a61f922a02cdc5b8abfe8d6e048ca903818f5a74.source: Tanto actually spawns the moment the party enters Varajar Fells, and does not respond until they have reached the appropriate quest trigger. Consider clearing spawn points 2 and 3 before investigating the first quest marker to avoid being overwhelmed by more than one mob at a time.
a61f922a02cdc5b8abfe8d6e048ca903818f5a74.text: 实际上，Tanto 在队伍进入瓦拉贾荒原时就会生成，并且直到他们到达适当的任务触发器后才会做出反应。在调查第一个任务标记之前，请考虑清除重生点 2 和 3，以避免一次被多个生物淹没。

fd32fcb4ddaaf86d2a91ecbde142d35f3eaff5a7.source: The required spawns for this quest will not appear if A Good Deed is active.
fd32fcb4ddaaf86d2a91ecbde142d35f3eaff5a7.text: 如果“善行”处于活动状态，则此任务所需的生成点将不会出现。

1cb8a5dab259a07081da06f486920caac6777e97.source: Despite the description, you can fulfill this quest without Xandra in your party.
1cb8a5dab259a07081da06f486920caac6777e97.text: 尽管有这样的描述，你也可以在没有桑德拉在你的队伍中的情况下完成这个任务。

929b0499986ed41a6913e54bfbc4ca966e22124d.source: Kill Havok Soulwail in Darkrime Delves.
929b0499986ed41a6913e54bfbc4ca966e22124d.text: 在暗黑深渊杀死哈沃克·灵魂哀嚎。

55ac3a2084eafd67d5c4c3b637edb1f891b7bf10.source: *BONUS* Kill Havok Soulwail in Hard Mode.
55ac3a2084eafd67d5c4c3b637edb1f891b7bf10.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死哈沃克·灵魂哀嚎。

295b5312792f0ddb24fe25842a0bdc3157fa0d5b.source: The walkthrough is the same for the quest The Misanthropic Jotun Principle given by Einarr Frostcleft in Bjora Marches just west of the entrance to the Darkrime Delves. If you enter without the quest, the door inside will be shut. Einarr and another Norn will follow you during the quest but don't help.
295b5312792f0ddb24fe25842a0bdc3157fa0d5b.text: 任务流程与埃纳尔·霜裂在暗黑深渊入口以西的比约拉边境所给出的任务“厌世的佐敦法则”相同。如果你没有任务就进入，里面的门就会关闭。艾纳尔和另一个诺恩会在任务期间跟随你，但不会提供帮助。

09ae41b7b6a7155020d30eb766ce97cc39a877d2.source: A Warrior 24 Dwarven Ghost at or near every Resurrection Shrine
09ae41b7b6a7155020d30eb766ce97cc39a877d2.text: 每个复活神殿或附近都有一个战士 24 矮人幽灵

b343c6f4dafefc7ce28ee21854fceea7152a283e.source: 3 Hidden Treasures by the Area Map/Jacado the Putrid
b343c6f4dafefc7ce28ee21854fceea7152a283e.text: 区域地图上的 3 个隐藏宝藏/Jacado the Putrid

512fbcb6cfe910e329f567b2509d040fd71afbf2.source: 2 Hidden Treasures under Ice Jet north of Cracked Wall
512fbcb6cfe910e329f567b2509d040fd71afbf2.text: 2 裂墙以北冰流下的隐藏宝藏

9de28394f9e7073e0fc62ea75027d2b8eb88a33a.source: 2 Hidden Treasures under Ice Jet on path to Erasklion the Prolific
9de28394f9e7073e0fc62ea75027d2b8eb88a33a.text: 2 通往多产者伊拉斯克利昂途中冰喷射下的隐藏宝藏

a364b65d9acd6774beac72fd5a46fb2c7a53bd04.source: 2 Hidden Treasures by Resurrection Shrine at end of level
a364b65d9acd6774beac72fd5a46fb2c7a53bd04.text: 关卡结束时复活神殿有 2 个隐藏宝藏

2e7d22df49397d443f907917201c12c4aafcad88.source: 1 Hidden Treasure to the north of said end-level shrine, by an (inaccessible) area with what appears like scaffolding amongst swamp/jungle shrubbery
2e7d22df49397d443f907917201c12c4aafcad88.text: 1 个隐藏宝藏位于所述终层神殿以北，位于一个（无法进入的）区域，在沼泽/丛林灌木丛中看起来像脚手架

f44686f4f5d3484d5051714b5c476dbdc9e19a60.source: 1 Hidden Treasure just north of the above and some stairs
f44686f4f5d3484d5051714b5c476dbdc9e19a60.text: 1 个隐藏宝藏就在上面和一些楼梯的北边

30878eebda3a6f42b7b56824366d46d524bc1bf5.source: 2 Dwarven Ghosts in second chamber (with exit)
30878eebda3a6f42b7b56824366d46d524bc1bf5.text: 第二个房间有 2 个矮人幽灵（有出口）

024eec51a6a8c47ca0f2424f492fd74abdf61b03.source: If you do not yet have the quest Heart of the Shiverpeaks, Budger Blackpowder does not appear, so the Cracked Wall on the first level cannot be passed. You can still navigate between the Battledepths and Bogroot Growths.
024eec51a6a8c47ca0f2424f492fd74abdf61b03.text: 如果你还没有任务席瓦峰之心，巴吉黑粉不会出现，所以第一层的裂墙无法通过。您仍然可以在 Battledeeps 和 Bogroot Growths 之间导航。

9888a5f9456b911d4434da418d59fe5034d6ed85.source: For tips on how to defeat Cyndr, see the boss' page here.
9888a5f9456b911d4434da418d59fe5034d6ed85.text: 有关如何击败 Cyndr 的提示，请参阅这里的 Boss 页面。

9572ce0967937ec9480d1990bd0cca1fe5e34e4f.source: If you have killed Cyndr the Mountain Heart before (either in Normal mode or Hard mode), you don't need a quest to complete this dungeon. Simply enter the dungeon and complete it. The final boss will be Magmus instead of Cyndr, who breaks into Jellies when killed. All of those Magma Blisters must be killed before the Mountain Heart Chest will spawn.
9572ce0967937ec9480d1990bd0cca1fe5e34e4f.text: 如果你之前已经杀死了山之心辛德尔（无论是在普通模式还是困难模式），你不需要任务来完成这个地下城。只需进入地牢并完成即可。最终的老板将是马格穆斯而不是辛德尔，辛德尔被杀后会闯入果冻。必须在山心宝箱生成之前杀死所有这些岩浆水泡。

276145ebc1bd867cc00d4bfe00741163c8c43c11.source: If you do not have the Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest, Budger Blackpowder is available to provide powder kegs for your party. He is located prior to the Cracked Walls on each level.
276145ebc1bd867cc00d4bfe00741163c8c43c11.text: 如果您没有席瓦峰之心任务，巴吉黑火药可以为您的队伍提供火药桶。他位于每一层的裂墙之前。

0d4b51fed505b8dd5757d1410bee8cd120eb4943.source: 1,500 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon for the first time in Normal Mode, and 750 points are awarded for subsequent completions. 2,250 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon in hard mode for the first time, and 1,125 points are awarded for subsequent completions.
0d4b51fed505b8dd5757d1410bee8cd120eb4943.text: 在普通模式下首次完成该地下城可获得 1,500 点 Deldrimor 声望点，后续完成则可获得 750 点声望点。首次在困难模式下完成该地下城可获得 2,250 点 Deldrimor 声望点，后续完成则可获得 1,125 点声望点。

0b0dbcd6f781653cfea34f88b3be1416f850d3d4.source: Entrance from Bogroot Growths is far to the southwest of the entrance from the Battledepths, and the Bogroot path is much longer.
0b0dbcd6f781653cfea34f88b3be1416f850d3d4.text: 博格鲁特生长区的入口距离战场深处入口的西南方向很远，而且博格鲁特的路径也更长。

dd3c66f315c0db634e27870a7b3bb3d05442fb55.source: On level 2 there are a total of five Dwarven Ghosts, even though the level has fewer than 30 enemies.
dd3c66f315c0db634e27870a7b3bb3d05442fb55.text: 在第 2 层，尽管该层的敌人数量少于 30 个，但总共有 5 个矮人幽灵。

30676ca8dc573712b4ea3dff684885f488713570.source: On level 3, there are no fleshy foes and there are several foes with Burning Immunity.
30676ca8dc573712b4ea3dff684885f488713570.text: 在第 3 级，没有肉身敌人，但有几个具有燃烧免疫的敌人。

b1bfb35d4d10daf94994cdab704381dc481780fc.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #18 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
b1bfb35d4d10daf94994cdab704381dc481780fc.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书第 18 页。

fa2b6d5d78312b82bc7d508f353ef28cbe2c1fe2.source: Defeat the great evil at Hell's Precipice.
fa2b6d5d78312b82bc7d508f353ef28cbe2c1fe2.text: 击败地狱悬崖的大恶魔。

72f43fbc8ff92a70ea4bf784babea2998f32ca2f.source: As per the Hell's Precipice mission.

a17d857e9f4534b16a7339b29707ef2911dae056.source: Find Rangil Ironbow in Traveler's Vale.
a17d857e9f4534b16a7339b29707ef2911dae056.text: 在旅行者谷找到兰吉尔·铁弓。

80b5ccf7f0773e2401f6afe7c1f6c64019704b4e.source: Go out from Yak's Bend and start down the path toward Borlis Pass. When you come to the split in the road, go either west or north; you can avoid more enemies on the west path. Both paths re-join near an iron bridge. Cross the bridge and turn west, stopping just before the entrance to Iron Horse Mine to talk to Rangil and receive the reward.
80b5ccf7f0773e2401f6afe7c1f6c64019704b4e.text: 从牦牛弯 (Yak's Bend) 出去，沿着小路前往博利斯山口 (Borlis Pass)。当你到达道路的岔路口时，要么向西走，要么向北走；你可以在西边的道路上躲避更多的敌人。两条路在一座铁桥附近重新汇合。过桥向西转，在铁马矿洞入口处停下来与兰吉尔交谈并获得奖励。

5eae9d4af718ec09e88b7f7365a8c512aef09af4.source: This quest leads into a long quest arc, beginning with Minaar's Trouble. Because the quest giver for those is some distance from the nearest town, it will save some time to do the arc in one trip.
5eae9d4af718ec09e88b7f7365a8c512aef09af4.text: 这个任务会导致一个漫长的任务弧，从米纳尔的麻烦开始。因为这些任务的提供者距离最近的城镇有一段距离，所以一趟完成弧线会节省一些时间。

521ac49a456f2afa0d8ef3cebcb80d1b80d6b2fe.source: Rangers and monks can further save time by doing the quests Stone Summit Beastmasters and The Wayward Monk alongside this quest arc.
521ac49a456f2afa0d8ef3cebcb80d1b80d6b2fe.text: 游骑兵和武僧可以通过在这个任务弧旁边完成任务石峰驯兽师和任性武僧来进一步节省时间。

f4af20fcc1dd912107f8001042b173a4124cc413.source: Although this quest serves to lead players to Rangil Ironbow, it is not a prerequisite to Rangil's quests.
f4af20fcc1dd912107f8001042b173a4124cc413.text: 虽然这个任务可以引导玩家找到兰吉尔铁弓，但它并不是兰吉尔任务的先决条件。

71410ab04f878868690a0083041730c853d97606.source: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can learn all six skills by waiting until you can change your secondary profession, then taking and abandoning the quest once with each secondary profession.
71410ab04f878868690a0083041730c853d97606.text: 由于技能是在接受此任务时给出的，因此您可以通过等到可以更改第二职业，然后为每个第二职业接受和放弃一次任务来学习所有六种技能。

1232f0ef5d9ebd0a204a18bb9ee8ec3527a14925.source: Deliver the supplies to Ellie Rigby in Ascalon City.
1232f0ef5d9ebd0a204a18bb9ee8ec3527a14925.text: 将补给品运送给阿斯卡隆市的埃莉·里格比。

4f025df62072511463b54ef90c4bc672b2cf0c0c.source: Return to Ascalon City, where you'll find Ellie Rigby standing to the east of Warmaster Tydus. Hand over the supplies, then head back out into Old Ascalon. As you exit the city, you'll witness a heated standoff between the king and Prince Rurik, which ultimately ends with both returning to the city. Speak with the Ambassador and get your quest reward.
4f025df62072511463b54ef90c4bc672b2cf0c0c.text: 返回阿斯卡隆城，你会发现埃莉·里格比站在战帅泰杜斯的东边。交出补给品，然后返回旧阿斯卡隆。当你离开城市时，你会目睹国王和鲁里克王子之间的激烈对峙，最终以两人返回城市而告终。与大使交谈并获得任务奖励。

8e451aaf2f5abd393a6d3361f87202b8d2875ef7.source: Seek out Herdsman Mehnosi on the Marga Coast.
8e451aaf2f5abd393a6d3361f87202b8d2875ef7.text: 在马尔加海岸寻找牧民梅诺西。

6f7fd1097ca5a480416c5ca3b1d8831a07ee653b.source: Protect the cattle while Herdsman Mehnosi moves them to a safer location. At least 3 cows must survive.
6f7fd1097ca5a480416c5ca3b1d8831a07ee653b.text: 保护牛群，牧民梅诺西将它们转移到更安全的地方。至少有 3 头牛必须生存。

793a1930c841f05bede66e13de36e2d80f29f3f8.source: See Herdsman Zekanu for your reward.
793a1930c841f05bede66e13de36e2d80f29f3f8.text: 去找牧人泽卡努领取奖励。

fb540bb9c21b791dbbb0e3f5f9ffe88a9fe33733.source: The herd must be escorted from southeast of the garrison to the entrance of Nundu Bay. First clear the path between the locations of any enemies that normally spawn there. Then talk to Herdsman Mehnosi, at point M on the quest map, to start the herd moving. Two groups of Kournan military, at points K on the quest map, will spawn and attack the herd. The first group attacks just southwest of the garrison and the second group attacks along the path between the garrison and Nundu Bay. Intercept and destroy these groups before they come in range of the cows. Then just wait until the herd reaches its final destination. Go to Herdsman Zekanu at point Z on the quest map for your reward.
fb540bb9c21b791dbbb0e3f5f9ffe88a9fe33733.text: 牛群必须从驻地东南方护送到南杜湾入口处。首先清理通常在那里生成的任何敌人的位置之间的路径。然后与任务地图上 M 点的牧人 Mehnosi 交谈，开始牧群移动。任务地图上 K 点的两支库尔南军队将生成并攻击牛群。第一组攻击驻军西南方向，第二组沿着驻军和南杜湾之间的路径攻击。在这些群体进入奶牛的射程之前拦截并消灭它们。然后等待牛群到达最终目的地。前往任务地图 Z 点的牧人泽卡努处获取奖励。

df4bae028ee4c1e80cb00d86dc9a84aca45dafd3.source: The dialogue to start this quest plays when you first come to the village during Hunted!, but you cannot start it until after that quest.
df4bae028ee4c1e80cb00d86dc9a84aca45dafd3.text: 当您在“狩猎”期间第一次来到村庄时，会播放启动此任务的对话，但直到完成该任务后才能启动它。

04918cfe9d617e4dffafa1c0d057f896fd4ff1e9.source: If you clear the way to Nundu Bay, then immediately run to the first spawn location after talking to Herdsman Mehnosi. When the cows are out of compass, they stop follow the Herdsman making this a simple quest to complete.
04918cfe9d617e4dffafa1c0d057f896fd4ff1e9.text: 如果你清理了通往南杜湾的道路，那么在与牧民梅赫诺西交谈后立即跑到第一个重生位置。当奶牛离开指南针时，它们就会停止跟随牧民，这使得这个任务很容易完成。

5343ecee6646b20eae809c420b4df5e538544e03.source: Speak to Burol Ironfist while you have a Hero in your party to begin the Hero tutorial.
5343ecee6646b20eae809c420b4df5e538544e03.text: 当你的队伍中有英雄时，与布罗尔·铁拳交谈以开始英雄教程。

c4a7e559c0c7aacf62c03fd78bacb019c4fe9fa3.source: Use your Hero to capture areas two and three.
c4a7e559c0c7aacf62c03fd78bacb019c4fe9fa3.text: 使用你的英雄占领第二和第三区域。

df49639c61c539cb4a2935d1dfa1f213bdd81237.source: See Burol Ironfist [Hero Tutorial] for your reward.
df49639c61c539cb4a2935d1dfa1f213bdd81237.text: 请参阅 Burol Ironfist [英雄教程] 以获得奖励。

b0d277542090874af720a3d659741d85ffbeea46.source: Take this to Arkor Leadfoot in Boreal Station to receive a weapon of your choosing.
b0d277542090874af720a3d659741d85ffbeea46.text: 将其带到北方空间站的 Arkor Leadfoot 处，即可获得您选择的武器。

5755df90006895de22bf3d12bbbc5d5ed2392e71.source: The quest takes place at a small instanced area. You will on top of a small platform with no way down. Your heroes will be at the foot of the platform. Any henchmen in your party will be removed.
5755df90006895de22bf3d12bbbc5d5ed2392e71.text: 任务发生在一个小实例区域。你将站在一个小平台上，没有办法下来。你的英雄将在平台的脚下。你党内的任何追随者都将被除掉。

f7b8c4155ade9233cf201db7c7b7c5af0316e1a7.source: Burol's monologue will start but you can go ahead and use the flag to direct your heroes to the first pillar marked "Area One". When they are near it, the progress bar on your screen will slowly turn blue. It is captured when it is completely blue. Eventually Burol will tell you to move your heroes to "Area One" and then to "Area Two" and "Area Three". When that part of the quest dialogue appears, three level 5 Snow Wolves will appear at the base of each of the latter two areas. Your heroes will make short work of them. Once all three areas are captured and the enemies dispatched, move them back to "Area One" to complete to quest. Claim your reward when you return to Boreal Station.
f7b8c4155ade9233cf201db7c7b7c5af0316e1a7.text: 布罗尔的独白将开始，但你可以继续使用旗帜将你的英雄引导到标有“区域一”的第一个柱子。当他们靠近时，屏幕上的进度条会慢慢变成蓝色。当它完全变成蓝色时就被捕获。最终布罗尔会告诉你将你的英雄移动到“区域一”，然后移动到“区域二”和“区域三”。当这部分任务对话出现时，后两个区域的底部会出现三只5级雪狼。你的英雄很快就能消灭他们。一旦所有三个区域都被占领并消灭了敌人，将他们移回“区域一”以完成任务。返回北方空间站后即可领取奖励。

fe6bb32759e4b409dcc6a2437a824f8761c0df00.source: On completion of the quest, you will be returned to Boreal Station after 30 seconds.
fe6bb32759e4b409dcc6a2437a824f8761c0df00.text: 完成任务后，你将在 30 秒后返回北方空间站。

99d100c991788ad2df9bfbebf1fd94db12d0d6e4.source: Even though it's destroyed the Asuran Gate is still shown active.
99d100c991788ad2df9bfbebf1fd94db12d0d6e4.text: 尽管阿苏兰之门已被摧毁，但它仍然处于活动状态。

ba47e6f7c802e6f6053e3ecf48cbb37391e57a0a.source: Obtaining a drop from the wolves (ie. festive drops) will open the Unclaimed Items interface when you're warped back to the Boreal Station.
ba47e6f7c802e6f6053e3ecf48cbb37391e57a0a.text: 当你被传送回北方空间站时，从狼那里获得掉落物（即节日掉落物）将打开无人认领的物品界面。

10ac8319f14af78a3bac2634b9418538fb63dc15.source: Players must listen to the whole conversation between Chitundu, Beastmaster Yapono, and Nehdukah, before the quest becomes available.
10ac8319f14af78a3bac2634b9418538fb63dc15.text: 在任务可用之前，玩家必须聆听奇通杜、兽王亚波诺和尼杜卡之间的整个对话。

915b94d165d745bd2b6a007f5efed77e0e117a35.source: Help Nehdukah find an impressive warthog
915b94d165d745bd2b6a007f5efed77e0e117a35.text: 帮助尼杜卡找到一只令人印象深刻的疣猪

541b613b51b34ba981f649b3aeef20c1bdc60f1f.source: Keep Nehdukah safe while he tames the impressive warthog.
541b613b51b34ba981f649b3aeef20c1bdc60f1f.text: 在尼杜卡驯服令人印象深刻的疣猪的同时，保证他的安全。

4119cf2f89cad6d42c8ffc304136ff2f1e33e760.source: Take Nehdukah and the tamed warthog to Yapono and Chitundu.
4119cf2f89cad6d42c8ffc304136ff2f1e33e760.text: 带着尼杜卡和驯服的疣猪前往亚波诺和奇通杜。

d6cf752d0852366451fb46e1b72891c34eca26e9.source: A fairly straightforward quest. With Nehdukah following, head up to the water front northwest of the Sunspear Great Hall. On a piece of land jutting out into the water is an Impressive Warthog. Nehdukah will begin to tame the beast. During this time, a group of about five or six Mandragor Slither will attack. Keep Nehdukah's health up and keep fighting. After the last monster has fallen, take Nehdukah back to Yapono and Chitundu, where they'll fawn over the piggy. After the dialogue, talk to Nehdukah for the reward.
d6cf752d0852366451fb46e1b72891c34eca26e9.text: 一个相当简单的任务。跟随 Nehdukah，前往阳矛大厅西北的海滨。在一块伸入水中的陆地上有一只令人印象深刻的疣猪。尼杜卡将开始驯服这头野兽。在此期间，大约有五六只曼德拉戈滑行者会发起攻击。保持内杜卡的健康并继续战斗。最后一个怪物倒下后，将尼杜卡带回亚波诺和奇通杜，在那里他们会讨好小猪。对话结束后，与尼杜卡对话以获得奖励。

d453bd9f8deb5766d0d147437575ac25d808d712.source: Non-Elonian characters will encounter Nehdukah with the warthog already tamed.
d453bd9f8deb5766d0d147437575ac25d808d712.text: 非伊隆尼亚角色将会遇到已经驯服疣猪的尼杜卡。

5070040db7753437f524d9f85c50942ad729bb5e.source: Despite what the dialogue implies, defeating the spawned mandragor is what advances the quest, not Nehdukah taming the warthog. If you rush Nehdukah past the warthog and into combat with the Juvenile Bladed Termites and Irontooth Drake in the water, he will still say his lines while fighting, but the quest will not advance until you go back and kill the mandragor.
5070040db7753437f524d9f85c50942ad729bb5e.text: 不管对话暗示什么，击败生成的曼陀罗才是推进任务的原因，而不是尼杜卡驯服疣猪。如果你让尼杜卡冲过疣猪，并在水中与幼年刃白蚁和铁牙幼龙战斗，他仍然会在战斗时说出他的台词，但任务不会推进，直到你回去杀死曼陀罗。

fbf38d5212b8e66df0a82624597ded80f1f1c7c1.source: It can be advisable to complete or at least take this quest as soon as possible. Otherwise, Nehdukah's conversation with his friends will play every time you exit the Sunspear Great Hall, which you are likely to do multiple times while progressing through the Nightfall storyline.
fbf38d5212b8e66df0a82624597ded80f1f1c7c1.text: 建议尽快完成或至少接受此任务。否则，每次你退出烈阳之矛大厅时，都会播放尼杜卡与他的朋友们的对话，在完成《夜幕降临》故事情节的过程中，你可能会多次这样做。

89862b6721e91950686e5961cf1f79674924e4db.source: This quest will be registered as completed if the player is in a party with another player that has already completed this quest. If doing this quest with a non-Elonian character in party, Nehdukah will not follow the party.
89862b6721e91950686e5961cf1f79674924e4db.text: 如果玩家与已完成此任务的另一名玩家处于同一队伍中，则此任务将被注册为已完成。如果在队伍中与非伊隆尼亚角色一起执行此任务，尼杜卡将不会跟随队伍。

b17b9272e146aba0fb2ed26d84438949bb664a27.source: Aid the Keepers as they defend their position from Margonite forces.
b17b9272e146aba0fb2ed26d84438949bb664a27.text: 帮助守护者保卫自己的阵地，抵御玛贡尼特军队的攻击。

121d5d0d0305195a935c211e0b50e8daa81fd1db.source: Assist the Keepers as they fend off additional Margonite forces.
121d5d0d0305195a935c211e0b50e8daa81fd1db.text: 协助守护者抵御额外的玛贡尼特部队。

e45a9e63b734b586004e89c44e5506df18a7c509.source: The initial group of Forgotten are just to the northeast of the Gate of Secrets in the Domain of Fear (marked point 1 on the map) and will probably be under attack from torment creatures as you approach. Despite the need to save them, the party needs to be careful to avoid aggroing additional patrolling creatures as the team reaches the Forgotten.
e45a9e63b734b586004e89c44e5506df18a7c509.text: 第一批被遗忘者就位于恐惧领域的秘密之门的东北部（地图上标记为点 1），当你接近时，他们可能会受到折磨生物的攻击。尽管需要拯救它们，但当团队到达被遗忘者时，队伍需要小心避免骚扰其他巡逻生物。

fb497facddfaef58452677bc0d8195d56d5b5897.source: The party will be attacked by several waves of creatures. The early waves will be made up of Earth Born Titans, Rotting Titans, Wild Growths, Wind Born Titans and Water Born Titans. Later waves will be made up of Margonites, and the final waves will be made up of three Shiro'ken Assassins. You do not need to defeat the Shiro'ken in order to move on to the next step of the quest.
fb497facddfaef58452677bc0d8195d56d5b5897.text: 队伍将受到几波生物的攻击。早期的波浪将由土生泰坦、腐烂泰坦、野生生长、风生泰坦和水生泰坦组成。后面的几波将由玛贡尼特组成，最后几波将由三名白肯刺客组成。您无需击败白剑即可继续任务的下一步。

28a6c5beee092d9f124940990f9ee73622601d5e.source: After these waves have been defeated, the quest pointer will move to indicate another group of Forgotten over the bridge southeast of the Gate of Secrets (marked point 2 on the map), and the process is much the same: defend and defeat the several waves of creatures.
28a6c5beee092d9f124940990f9ee73622601d5e.text: 当这些波次被击败后，任务指针会移动，指示秘密之门东南方桥上的另一群被遗忘者（地图上标记为2点），过程大致相同：防御并击败几波生物。

23caae6779533126b2ef98c10466cd49db50c6a3.source: The surviving Forgotten from the initial group will follow the team to the second site and combine with the second group of Forgotten to provide some aid in the defense.
23caae6779533126b2ef98c10466cd49db50c6a3.text: 第一组中幸存的被遗忘者会跟随队伍前往第二地点，并与第二组被遗忘者会合，提供一些防御援助。

24767cf7b929adaf65cabaa5f1e49399669607a5.source: While the composition of attackers remains the same, the waves for this second group spawn faster and come from two different locations. Additionally, a small mob of Terrorweb Dryders can prove to be a troublesome menace, as they (usually) appear at the worst possible times.
24767cf7b929adaf65cabaa5f1e49399669607a5.text: 虽然攻击者的组成保持不变，但第二组的攻击波产生速度更快并且来自两个不同的位置。此外，一小群恐怖网干燥者可能会成为一种麻烦的威胁，因为它们（通常）出现在最糟糕的时刻。

abc2717fe61ab5ed8c865931b020a0df822b67ab.source: The final wave consists of Shiro'ken Assassins, and, once again, you do not need to defeat them.
abc2717fe61ab5ed8c865931b020a0df822b67ab.text: 最后一波由白肯刺客组成，同样，你不需要击败他们。

fd458117185480b3c24d172cba2f2a695e898b14.source: Combines well with The Last Patrol for some extra allies.
fd458117185480b3c24d172cba2f2a695e898b14.text: 与最后的巡逻队完美结合，获得一些额外的盟友。

f4974016267e8dd06240d9d2ed1053437f4b5007.source: Chests near Tyrian Titans may contain Magmas Shields.
f4974016267e8dd06240d9d2ed1053437f4b5007.text: 泰瑞安泰坦附近的箱子可能含有岩浆护盾。

cd0f8e06f6e04e1400696b6480c056eb5ae71a83.source: Initially heading to the second quest point and defeating all the enemies there will cause the quest to be marked as completed. Enemies will still spawn at the first point if one then proceeds there, although the quest will still be considered complete.
cd0f8e06f6e04e1400696b6480c056eb5ae71a83.text: 最初前往第二个任务点并击败那里的所有敌人将使任务标记为已完成。如果随后继续前进，敌人仍会在第一个点生成，尽管任务仍将被视为完成。

78f2c84b00c0e0927fe34544cc74465a537168c6.source: {{Research needed | Do the surviving Cursebearers, Illusionists and Arcanists follow the party after the first location is completed? the Sages follow to heal minions but that might be due to healing nature of AI and not quest npc movement. }}
78f2c84b00c0e0927fe34544cc74465a537168c6.text: {{需要研究|第一个地点完成后，幸存的咒使者、幻术师和奥术师会跟随队伍吗？贤者会跟随来治疗小兵，但这可能是由于 AI 的治疗性质而不是任务 NPC 移动。 }}

61f3be955eb21b40db82a3cc81637a28485d8d53.source: Clear the Holdings of Chokhin in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
61f3be955eb21b40db82a3cc81637a28485d8d53.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比乔欣领地中的所有敌人。

a61d5e7d37ea87ac0a802b36f31f1c63b2e51fa6.source: This area lies beyond Mihanu Township, which is found on the northwestern corner of the Mirror of Lyss.
a61d5e7d37ea87ac0a802b36f31f1c63b2e51fa6.text: 该区域位于米哈努镇之外，位于里斯之镜的西北角。

8cd3cf46909a163edf9bbbc565a214a63da38666.source: If your character goes with Margrid the Sly instead of the Master of Whispers, then the primary quest Greed and Regret will lead your character here.
8cd3cf46909a163edf9bbbc565a214a63da38666.text: 如果你的角色与狡猾的玛格丽特一起而不是低语大师，那么主要任务贪婪和遗憾将引导你的角色来到这里。

0198c776f8e2779018166271136e0bc6a7972628.source: The structure in the northeastern corner is the Halls of Chokhin, a library maintained by Prince Mehtu the Wise.
0198c776f8e2779018166271136e0bc6a7972628.text: 东北角的建筑是乔欣大厅 (Halls of Chokhin)，这是一座由智者梅赫图亲王维护的图书馆。

3a5c68f01dce9cdc1a9afb9e4fae9df02d160003.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.6% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
3a5c68f01dce9cdc1a9afb9e4fae9df02d160003.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.6%。

20ce17d347883f85914c86c262906bfc473b5a55.source: There are no enemies inside the Halls of Chokhin.

1c3e3b925fb79e8e40aa49afef2623a99f8b8e64.source: The plant groups outside the Halls of Chokhin patrol very close to each other. Engaging a group without pulling will very likely draw in another one or two groups.
1c3e3b925fb79e8e40aa49afef2623a99f8b8e64.text: 乔欣大厅外的植物群彼此非常接近地巡逻。让一个群体参与而不拉动很可能会吸引另外一两个群体。

44b2ce8c21c2e8a6a5dc4e95963258aa5e246255.source: The Madness of Prophecy quest in particular significantly reduces the number of insect spawns.
44b2ce8c21c2e8a6a5dc4e95963258aa5e246255.text: 疯狂预言任务尤其显着减少了昆虫产卵的数量。

791435e5264d20e09ce3e26ba98a36206edab03a.source:
* Guild Wars Eye of the North on the account
* Neither What Lies Beneath nor I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet completed
* Level 10 or higher
791435e5264d20e09ce3e26ba98a36206edab03a.text:
* 帐户上的激战北方之眼
*《What Lies Beneath》和《I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet》均未完成
* 10级或以上

a9683ad70f06689468cc9e03f01045ac0ba8b753.source: Investigate the fissure on the Plains of Jarin near Kamadan.
a9683ad70f06689468cc9e03f01045ac0ba8b753.text: 调查卡马丹附近贾林平原上的裂缝。

17bcff3b89fec68d0aa90d9e12a5a340c88beb8a.source: Enter the fissure in the Plains of Jarin.

b08c7377a35f3611d2845fec3496fcdd0ae969f9.text: 调查伊斯坦地下的深处。

5e3a7f6a5e6cc57cd99dd920a2ec1e6d08f2be07.source: Once this quest, I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet or What Lies Beneath has been completed, the fissure, chasm and crevasse become permanent interactive objects of their respective explorable areas.
5e3a7f6a5e6cc57cd99dd920a2ec1e6d08f2be07.text: 一旦这个任务“我感觉地球在 Cantha 的脚下移动”或“什么在下面”完成，裂缝、裂口和裂缝将成为其各自可探索区域的永久互动对象。

569a1e934ac7c3f703d19100945bd5ed529008eb.source: Go out into the Plains of Jarin and head south. Once you reach the fissure, click on it to be taken to the Caverns Below Kamadan. Inside you will face a circle of Corsairs. They are all level 7, and so shouldn't pose much of a threat. If you follow the path, you will eventually run into a level 11 Corsair Lookout. He will be accompanied by a level 8, a level 7, and a level 3 Corsair. When you continue along the path, you will come to a large room, where 5 Corsairs of various levels (none over level 10) will run toward you. Turn north and run to the end of the hallway. Then turn east, where you will soon see two dwarves. Pass them and continue, and you will soon hit a cinematic. The Beginning of the End is the follow-up primary quest that is automatically added to your quest log.
569a1e934ac7c3f703d19100945bd5ed529008eb.text: 进入贾林平原并向南行驶。到达裂缝后，单击它即可前往卡马丹下方的洞穴。在里面你将面对一圈海盗。他们都是7级，所以不会构成太大的威胁。如果你沿着这条路走，你最终会遇到 11 级的 Corsair Lookout。陪伴他的将有一架 8 级海盗船、一架 7 级海盗船和一架 3 级海盗船。继续沿着路走，你会来到一个大房间，里面有5个不同等级的海盗（没有10级以上）会向你跑来。转向北并跑到走廊的尽头。然后转向东，很快你就会看到两个矮人。通过它们并继续，你很快就会看到电影般的画面。终结的开始是后续主要任务，会自动添加到您的任务日志中。

b6f406219f01c9894463274c5a6c8430bb6bc778.source: This quest concludes automatically at the end of the cinematic; the follow-up quest, The Beginning of the End, is automatically accepted.
b6f406219f01c9894463274c5a6c8430bb6bc778.text: 这个任务在电影结束时自动结束；后续任务“终结的开始”将自动接受。

f50dcf9007b4bc15de6d14f4cd3bdda4804a7d63.source: If you are below level 20 you will be buffed by Journey to the North within the Eye of the North expansion.
f50dcf9007b4bc15de6d14f4cd3bdda4804a7d63.text: 如果您的等级低于 20 级，您将在“北方之眼”扩展包中获得“北游”的增益。

f662fcba746c8e71cf9558b4626b2670be9b0bf1.source: If you have any of the other Eye of the North access quests in your Quest Log, finishing one will remove them from your Quest Log.
f662fcba746c8e71cf9558b4626b2670be9b0bf1.text: 如果您的任务日志中有任何其他“北方之眼”访问任务，完成其中一个会将它们从您的任务日志中删除。

782bf58feb445ecca6d123c598a6f1633d6434c6.source: Find the refugees in Shenzun Tunnels.
782bf58feb445ecca6d123c598a6f1633d6434c6.text: 在神尊隧道中寻找难民。

a42c6b06f05e5d17ec2da975836e1c23fe45e756.source: The hardest part of this quest is finding Imperial Guardsman Yang to get it. While he isn't far from the entrance to Zin Ku Corridor, he is on a different level which requires going to the northern end of the area, climbing up, then heading back south, with several large groups of Jade Brotherhood along the way.
a42c6b06f05e5d17ec2da975836e1c23fe45e756.text: 这个任务最难的部分是找到禁卫杨来获得它。虽然距离津库走廊的入口不远，但他所处的层次不同，需要到该地区的北端，爬上去，然后再向南返回，沿途有几大群翡翠兄弟会。

737f27edc5e0d8aaf140f2b0297317bb809140a8.source: Once you have the quest, simply enter Shenzun Tunnels from Tahnnakai Temple and follow the quest marker. There are few foes along the way. Talk to all three refugees in the order indicated by the quest marker, then go to Raisu Pavilion to claim your reward.
737f27edc5e0d8aaf140f2b0297317bb809140a8.text: 完成任务后，只需从塔纳凯神庙进入神尊隧道，然后按照任务标记走即可。一路上敌人很少。按照任务标记指示的顺序与所有三名难民交谈，然后前往 Raisu Pavilion 领取奖励。

372571e81dde5981237197e31252aa013d2a0fdc.source: Speak with Old Mac in Deldrimor Bowl.
372571e81dde5981237197e31252aa013d2a0fdc.text: 与德尔德里莫碗中的老麦克交谈。

012689735ac494cbf6eec38428dc0d40a512254c.source: Feed Joe [10...0] more Succulent Juniper Meats.
012689735ac494cbf6eec38428dc0d40a512254c.text: 给乔喂 [10...0] 更多多汁的杜松肉。

1ff6b74e636194f04ae778b63c5e3b6489a02fac.source: Return to Master Saberlin for your reward.
1ff6b74e636194f04ae778b63c5e3b6489a02fac.text: 返回萨柏林大师那里领取奖励。

6be91a3fda4c1eed03dfee0781b98a9132fa9cc7.source: Head out from the outpost, talk to Old Mac, and then follow the path to where the plants are. There are some Centaur patrols to clear out first, but once that's done, the Succulent Junipers are easy kills. Then just feed Joe and go speak to Old Mac again.
6be91a3fda4c1eed03dfee0781b98a9132fa9cc7.text: 从前哨站出去，与老麦克交谈，然后沿着小路前往植物所在的地方。首先需要清除一些半人马巡逻队，但一旦完成，肉质杜松就很容易被杀死。然后喂乔，然后再去和老麦克说话。

8fd00f203be448c8705ce2c5448a1b97b381dad1.source: You have to keep Joe alive to feed him; if he dies, you will need to re-zone to finish the quest. However, you can continue to collect Succulent Juniper Meat after he dies. If you collect all 10 before returning to Beacon's Perch, you can feed Joe immediately after leaving the outpost. You can also collect the Succulent Juniper Meat before speaking to Old Mac so that Joe does not follow you into danger. Since you'll need to talk to Old Mac to continue the quest anyway, leaving Joe with him won't cost you any time.
8fd00f203be448c8705ce2c5448a1b97b381dad1.text: 你必须让乔活着才能养活他；如果他死了，你将需要重新区域才能完成任务。然而，在他死后你可以继续收集多汁杜松肉。如果您在返回灯塔栖息处之前收集了全部 10 个，则可以在离开前哨站后立即喂乔。您还可以在与老麦克说话之前收集多汁的杜松肉，这样乔就不会跟着您陷入危险。因为无论如何你都需要与老麦克交谈才能继续任务，所以把乔留在他身边不会花费你任何时间。

92dcb80d4f332e12380ecd7067fcdea79e843e9a.source: There are two spawn locations for the Junipers, noted on the map. Typically you need only one in order to complete the quest and if Joe gets stuck on a tree you won't see the second location until you find him and feed him.
92dcb80d4f332e12380ecd7067fcdea79e843e9a.text: 地图上标出了杜松子有两个生成位置。通常，您只需要一个位置即可完成任务，如果乔被困在一棵树上，您将看不到第二个位置，直到您找到他并喂他。

ff660fe0c20f03d8304a8670d4e74094ae4814a3.source: There will be fewer centaurs after To Kryta: Refugees.
ff660fe0c20f03d8304a8670d4e74094ae4814a3.text: 《科瑞塔：难民》之后半人马数量将会减少。

e030645d031706420ef25baf358f87232396ed38.source: This quest is useful for farming Alpine Seeds. After initiating the first time, avoid speaking to Joe or Old Mac when you rezone.
e030645d031706420ef25baf358f87232396ed38.text: 这个任务对于种植高山种子很有用。第一次启动后，重新分区时避免与 Joe 或 Old Mac 交谈。

8e21e6310ad9b5322a1cd757f12897b8e52fedde.source: Joe sometimes becomes stuck between two small trees If you have more then 10 pieces of meat in your inventory, and then feed Joe, he will take all of the pieces of meat from your inventory. After feeding Joe the 10 pieces of meat, if you leave the instance before talking to Old Mac he will not continue with his dialogue. However the quest will update allowing you to talk to Master Saberlin to collect your reward.
8e21e6310ad9b5322a1cd757f12897b8e52fedde.text: 乔有时会被困在两棵小树之间如果你的库存中有超过 10 块肉，然后喂乔，他会从你的库存中拿走所有的肉。给乔喂了 10 块肉后，如果你在与老麦克交谈之前离开实例，他将不会继续对话。然而，任务将会更新，让你可以与萨伯林大师交谈来领取你的奖励。

fe9b7bc96b86fbe889637175891a6e0b14a0fedb.source:
* Guild Wars Eye of the North on the account
* Neither What Lies Beneath nor Hole of Istan completed
* Level 10 or higher
fe9b7bc96b86fbe889637175891a6e0b14a0fedb.text:
* 帐户上的激战北方之眼
* What Lies Beneath 和 Hole of Istan 均未完成
* 10级或以上

7e6dcedcab2028db91671e059b46584c17baeae1.source: Investigate the collapsed street in Bukdek Byway.
7e6dcedcab2028db91671e059b46584c17baeae1.text: 调查 Bukdek Byway 倒塌的街道。

2c0b59664ac5038491b856b4882b8e0385ba3921.source: Once this quest, Hole of Istan or What Lies Beneath has been completed, the chasm, fissure and crevasse become permanent interactive objects of their respective explorable areas.
2c0b59664ac5038491b856b4882b8e0385ba3921.text: 一旦这个任务“伊斯坦之洞”或“隐藏在下面的东西”完成，裂缝、裂缝和裂口将成为各自可探索区域的永久互动对象。

f6132cf900944d071570312ae78dce91baa0634e.source: Enter Bukdek Byway from Kaineng Center and follow the quest marker. You will reach the chasm - just click it to enter and proceed to the Tunnels Below Cantha. Now fight your way through the groups of Am Fah; the entire area will have a graphical effect similar to Cathedral Collapse, but without any side effects. Because Am Fah Assassins can block and inflict blind, you should consider bringing spellcasters instead of physical attackers. Follow the enemy spawns and you will reach some dwarves. Vekk and Ogden Stonehealer will also be there. A cinematic will start after which you will automatically get the quest The Beginning of the End.
f6132cf900944d071570312ae78dce91baa0634e.text: 从凯能中心进入 Bukdek Byway，然后按照任务标记前进。您将到达裂缝 - 只需单击它即可进入并前往 Cantha 下面的隧道。现在，在 Am Fah 的队伍中杀出一条血路；整个区域将具有类似于大教堂倒塌的图形效果，但没有任何副作用。因为阿姆法赫刺客可以阻挡并造成盲人，所以你应该考虑带施法者而不是物理攻击者。跟随敌人的出现，你会遇到一些矮人。维克和奥格登·石疗者也将出席。电影将开始，之后您将自动获得任务“结束的开始”。

889075c90b4653015c197a36b2d08c43289a2ce2.source: Sometimes this quest will not end until The Beginning of the End does; however, this has no impact on the game.
889075c90b4653015c197a36b2d08c43289a2ce2.text: 有时这个任务直到结束的开始才会结束；不过，这对游戏没有影响。

9339825eec190e315f161f8bc00af602c259b257.source: Free the rebel leaders imprisoned in the Ice Caves of Sorrow.
9339825eec190e315f161f8bc00af602c259b257.text: 释放被囚禁在悲伤冰洞中的叛军领袖。

7957d8625a149293c50ccd6972ac968b3cde0dea.source: *BONUS* Relay news of Deldrimor's spy to the dwarves.
7957d8625a149293c50ccd6972ac968b3cde0dea.text: *奖励* 将德尔德里莫间谍的消息传递给矮人。

d29730af64593022f6d40b98c821d76289ab3a55.source: As per the Ice Caves of Sorrow mission.

73962480c4af92970c95d6fcedfebe0876221489.source: Clear the Ice Cliff Chasms in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
73962480c4af92970c95d6fcedfebe0876221489.text: 在困难模式下清除远席瓦山脉中所有敌人的冰崖裂缝。

5087155fec927f707dac4fac75f178047bf2d510.source: This area can initially be entered from Boreal Station after doing the requisite quest to enter Guild Wars Eye of the North.
5087155fec927f707dac4fac75f178047bf2d510.text: 在完成进入激战北方之眼的必要任务后，最初可以从北方站进入该区域。

88e63e9ba68e4fb64974b0c3d6f534b2cb192ff9.source: The area outside Boreal Station is a popular place for chest runs or to farm experience (for pets, heroes, your character, or the Survivor title).
88e63e9ba68e4fb64974b0c3d6f534b2cb192ff9.text: 北方站外的区域是进行宝箱奔跑或农场体验（宠物、英雄、你的角色或幸存者称号）的热门场所。

a52f2a86b22e42f622480d765b81a6931967ad8a.source: It is almost completely safe: the Snow Wurms spawn in fixed locations, they do little damage (even in Hard Mode), and they do not attack unless you attack them first.
a52f2a86b22e42f622480d765b81a6931967ad8a.text: 它几乎是完全安全的：雪龙在固定位置生成，它们造成的伤害很小（即使在困难模式下），并且除非您先攻击它们，否则它们不会攻击。

a01ff276b1781401466f0b6e6baae174edb78a84.source: On average, a runner can reach two locked chests in less than two minutes.
a01ff276b1781401466f0b6e6baae174edb78a84.text: 平均而言，跑步者可以在不到两分钟的时间内到达两个上锁的箱子。

b7e16029612e3858a9be5b4220f361e6d7396b94.source: The portals to the Battledepths and Norrhart Domains are closed until your character uses the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments to view the First Vision cinematic.
b7e16029612e3858a9be5b4220f361e6d7396b94.text: 通往战场深处和诺拉特领域的传送门将关闭，直到您的角色使用纪念碑大厅中的占卜池观看第一视觉动画。

dc08f4c39061751aa907c4d9358ba71d07062cdb.source: This area is easier to map if either Service: In Defense of the Eye or Snowball Dominance are active.
dc08f4c39061751aa907c4d9358ba71d07062cdb.text: 如果服务：保卫眼睛或雪球统治处于活动状态，则该区域更容易绘制地图。

6edad6309b604a46b0eb361a090a40e6d37d7b27.source: The Ice Imps and Stonewolves are hostile to each other.
6edad6309b604a46b0eb361a090a40e6d37d7b27.text: 冰小鬼和石狼彼此敌对。

91a7bdd73271dab08be9119f21afc4a98c2e1a42.source: The first time you visit this zone, a dialogue occurs between Jora and Sif Shadowhunter, which prevents Tjorvi Throstson from spawning. If you want to get Norn blessing right away, rezone through Boreal Station before continuing.
91a7bdd73271dab08be9119f21afc4a98c2e1a42.text: 当你第一次访问这个区域时，乔拉和希芙·暗影猎人之间会发生对话，这会阻止托尔维·索罗森生成。如果你想立即获得诺恩的祝福，请在继续之前通过北方空间站重新划分区域。

79f2093e359f3704d96e6b5793cc081242a93735.source: There are hidden Mountain Aloes in the southern areas, mostly near the Mountain Pinesouls.
79f2093e359f3704d96e6b5793cc081242a93735.text: 南部地区有隐藏的山沉香，大多靠近山松魂。

a707eea2d695fc86fe8efc27970eae3c5a3cfff2.source: In normal mode only a single group of Chilling Wisps spawn on the central frozen lake, while in hard mode an additional group of Chilling Wisps and multiple groups of Ice Imps spawn there too.
a707eea2d695fc86fe8efc27970eae3c5a3cfff2.text: 在正常模式下，只有一组冰冷小精灵会在中央结冰的湖面上生成，而在困难模式下，还会有一组额外的冰冷小精灵和多组冰小鬼在那里生成。

c6763e19a14e47bd15146bc40f8447cd0554a370.source: Clear the Ice Floe in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
c6763e19a14e47bd15146bc40f8447cd0554a370.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉浮冰上的所有敌人。

0a93b7cf98eb23d10df9c89b4206e43bb8c0b9f7.source: This area is mostly optional. Getting to Marhan's Grotto is usually the reason to traverse this area.
0a93b7cf98eb23d10df9c89b4206e43bb8c0b9f7.text: 该区域大部分是可选的。前往马汉石窟通常是穿越该地区的原因。

0c9727490717d493fea4307ff713ffb36a53a07b.source: This area is easily reached by exiting Thunderhead Keep to the southwest.
