0c9727490717d493fea4307ff713ffb36a53a07b.text: 从雷头城堡西南方向退出即可轻松到达该区域。

3d571a83d0d4675f38cda3fdc83e8511709086dd.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.7% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
3d571a83d0d4675f38cda3fdc83e8511709086dd.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.7%。

358d400571d8bb9fdb02e9c52a7a43c07762acac.source: When approaching the possible spawn point of Frostbite, if it does spawn, there will be a hidden group of Azure Shadows.
358d400571d8bb9fdb02e9c52a7a43c07762acac.text: 当接近霜冻可能的产卵点时，如果它真的产卵，将会有一群隐藏的蔚蓝暗影。

0c0104d37f9393a735d66d0d5772119f73f9cf16.source: Some Mursaat groups have long patrol paths, so to find them you might need to backtrack to places you've already cleared.
0c0104d37f9393a735d66d0d5772119f73f9cf16.text: 一些穆萨特组织有很长的巡逻路线，因此要找到它们，您可能需要原路返回到您已经清理过的地方。

fd7ea5871f9cd3b6713d6f2c210ee905ac2bd2d0.source: There are Mursaat patrols in this area which are made up of 2 groups. When they stop patrolling they sometimes become one group. So when vanquishing it is advised to lure a group of Mursaat away while they are still patrolling.
fd7ea5871f9cd3b6713d6f2c210ee905ac2bd2d0.text: 该地区有 Mursaat 巡逻队，由 2 个小组组成。当他们停止巡逻时，有时会变成一群。因此，在击败时，建议趁一群穆萨特仍在巡逻时引诱他们离开。

572681f1843de3d375a31211c4c77881b459ba71.source: It is not advised to attempt this vanquish if your armour is not infused. You will die from Spectral Agony.
572681f1843de3d375a31211c4c77881b459ba71.text: 如果你的护甲没有被注入，不建议尝试这种征服。你会死于幽灵痛苦。

cdc51a8f1d0097fe1d5f1b160e59593c58feec6e.source: Ice Imps have very high DPS, careful flagging (and if using spirits, precasting) is essential.
cdc51a8f1d0097fe1d5f1b160e59593c58feec6e.text: 冰小鬼有非常高的 DPS，小心标记（如果使用烈酒，则需要预制）。

bdf6c5b2c9942948e4426cb837fea9e9a7441c26.source: Sometimes two groups spawn right next to the Marhan's Grotto resurrection shrine. If you start from that outpost and wipe on them, it's possible to get in an endless wipe loop with the two imp groups camping the shrine. In this case it's best to restart from the outpost.
bdf6c5b2c9942948e4426cb837fea9e9a7441c26.text: 有时，两群人会在马汉石窟复活神社旁边生成。如果你从那个前哨站开始消灭它们，就有可能与在神殿扎营的两个小鬼团体陷入无限的消灭循环。在这种情况下，最好从前哨站重新启动。

065224412d052207abf515dce578d20935d4949a.source: Clear Icedome in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
065224412d052207abf515dce578d20935d4949a.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉冰穹中的所有敌人。

64ab343afa7944c6d1e6ad254b596b00e9fcdad9.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.44% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
64ab343afa7944c6d1e6ad254b596b00e9fcdad9.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 0.44%。

09748477dc0debbae12ec168fa975df2f888a9ba.source: Many enemy groups are close together, so pull carefully to avoid taking on more than one mob at the same time.
09748477dc0debbae12ec168fa975df2f888a9ba.text: 许多敌人群体靠得很近，所以要小心拉动，避免同时对付多个怪物。

411eea2d5e6cdd358bae8a751ad9ea9e481434d8.source: Some players find it better to enter from Talus Chute, because your party will get aggroed immediately when arriving from the Frozen Forest.
411eea2d5e6cdd358bae8a751ad9ea9e481434d8.text: 有些玩家发现从塔鲁斯滑道进入更好，因为当你的队伍从冰冻森林到达时会立即受到攻击。

fece2e72485de2c38ffec7a987b012cf7f21fc01.source: There is a group of two Stone Summit that roam around the eastern portion of the map counter-clockwise that can be missed if not encountered with other foes, which may require you to trace your path.
fece2e72485de2c38ffec7a987b012cf7f21fc01.text: 有一组两个石峰在地图东部逆时针漫游，如果没有遇到其他敌人，可能会错过它们，这可能需要你追踪你的路径。

167eb672cc5281ccaa3ef5ea08f520148463f627.source: The Mission Map will sometime fail to capture and track the player's location within Icedome, causing it's position to not be centered.
167eb672cc5281ccaa3ef5ea08f520148463f627.text: 任务地图有时会无法捕获和跟踪玩家在冰穹内的位置，导致其位置不居中。

7c02222073577be183029f31ec0a78207b67f83f.source: The map beyond the portal to Talus Chute doesn't extend far enough. When looking in the distance, a sea can be seen. After crossing the portal, that sea is replaced with mountains.
7c02222073577be183029f31ec0a78207b67f83f.text: 距骨滑道传送门之外的地图延伸得不够远。远远望去，可以看到一片大海。穿过传送门后，那片海就被山取代了。

4af5fc380adb2990340bc28ed335100a0871ef96.source: Get information about the shipment of identification kits from Kupekanu at Champion's Dawn.
4af5fc380adb2990340bc28ed335100a0871ef96.text: 获取有关冠军黎明库佩卡努运送识别套件的信息。

70906229fc7dd52159ee029e2e1833e9a410d487.source: Recover the lost shipment crate from the band of corsairs at the Cliffs of Dohjok.
70906229fc7dd52159ee029e2e1833e9a410d487.text: 从多霍克悬崖的海盗手中找回丢失的货物箱。

1ad24ef5d64a626aaf3af9cf0afdc2336d3c2703.source: Sometimes, the spirits will not spawn at all, obliging the players to get back to the outpost. Sometimes, a Locked Chest will spawn blocking the pathway of the Tortured Spirits which will also oblige the players to return to the outpost.
1ad24ef5d64a626aaf3af9cf0afdc2336d3c2703.text: 有时，灵魂根本不会出现，迫使玩家返回前哨站。有时，会生成一个上锁的宝箱，阻挡受折磨的灵魂的路径，这也将迫使玩家返回前哨站。

d4200ef4e9b75acdfde819247ec23500e84a1bb8.source: Travel to Resplendent Makuun and protect the theatre against the besieging demons.
d4200ef4e9b75acdfde819247ec23500e84a1bb8.text: 前往辉煌的马库恩，保护剧院免受恶魔的围攻。

a492f2a9ae51fbb46f09fe9082b71cbfb38e8a05.source: See Prince Bokka the Magnificent for your reward.
a492f2a9ae51fbb46f09fe9082b71cbfb38e8a05.text: 去见伟大的博卡王子以获得奖励。

eefca54dc178c2b3be5cb971848019f87565852a.source: For this quest, Prince Bokka will spawn in the northeastern plaza, in the vicinity of the resurrection shrine, rather than his usual location in the throne room. This is also where the enemies are headed.
eefca54dc178c2b3be5cb971848019f87565852a.text: 对于此任务，博卡王子将在复活神殿附近的东北广场生成，而不是他通常在王座室的位置。这也是敌人的前进方向。

c95701d9f3bffd915ec5570ea704793b21d68098.source: When you arrive at the quest marker, four Margonite groups will spawn outside and split up and approach from both sides of the central stairway. Confront the groups on one side to avoid letting them join up; even if the other groups slip past you, there is a delay before they will attack Bokka, so you have plenty of time.
c95701d9f3bffd915ec5570ea704793b21d68098.text: 当你到达任务标记时，四个玛贡尼特群体将在外面生成，并从中央楼梯的两侧分开并接近。与一侧的群体对抗，避免让他们加入；即使其他队伍从你身边溜走，他们攻击博卡之前也会有一段延迟，所以你有足够的时间。

fdb89c8baf626cab943aae2e633fb5abee6b0d3b.source: You also have time to set traps or spirits on the stairs before the party triggers the quest start. Take advantage of the natural choke-points (such as narrow archways & stairs) that the party can retreat to and block/hold off the Margonites.
fdb89c8baf626cab943aae2e633fb5abee6b0d3b.text: 在队伍触发任务开始之前，你还有时间在楼梯上设置陷阱或灵魂。利用天然的咽喉要道（例如狭窄的拱门和楼梯），队伍可以撤退并阻挡/抵挡玛贡尼特。

df7f97abb950cee4f9b177b880c3e8ed6067c03a.source: If you have some difficulties and wipe, there is a resurrection shrine near Bokka, so you should still be able to complete the quest.
df7f97abb950cee4f9b177b880c3e8ed6067c03a.text: 如果你遇到一些困难并消灭，博卡附近有一个复活神社，所以你应该仍然能够完成任务。

14366a16263f854a2f2561e27c623b4751b2e255.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: monk
14366a16263f854a2f2561e27c623b4751b2e255.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：僧侣

ccabbee187f040d66ab6e8510ecbbcab2f967e2d.source: Find Melka Blanston, outside of Ascalon City, and tell her that Gurn loves her.Objective for Deliver a Message to My Wife
ccabbee187f040d66ab6e8510ecbbcab2f967e2d.text: 找到阿斯卡隆城外的梅尔卡·布兰斯顿，并告诉她古恩爱她。 给我妻子传递消息的目标

d3070fd8790e901c131491f4fba269cf9de5efe0.source: Find Melka Blanston, just outside of Ascalon City, and inform her of the death of Paulus.
d3070fd8790e901c131491f4fba269cf9de5efe0.text: 找到阿斯卡隆城外的梅尔卡·布兰斯顿，告诉她保卢斯的死讯。

2eb55c461c81a348b7879760eca0befd047c8ac7.source: Map travel to Ascalon City and then exit into Old Ascalon. Melka will be to the left, at the top of the slope.
2eb55c461c81a348b7879760eca0befd047c8ac7.text: 地图旅行到阿斯卡隆市，然后退出旧阿斯卡隆。梅尔卡将在左边，在斜坡的顶部。

58bbae539bfc8db3ebc3930006b986fcbf2bb195.source: The wrong objective in the quest log for this quest is displayed. It is the objective for the quest Deliver a Message to My Wife, another quest involving Melka.
58bbae539bfc8db3ebc3930006b986fcbf2bb195.text: 该任务的任务日志中显示了错误的目标。这是任务“向我的妻子传递消息”的目标，这是另一个涉及梅尔卡的任务。

42e87a0e9d6c3d5a3a7cecbe4bd2ab4bad2ebd85.source: Find and enlist four recruits into the Luxon army. [4...0] recruits remaining.
42e87a0e9d6c3d5a3a7cecbe4bd2ab4bad2ebd85.text: 找到四名新兵并招募他们加入卢克森军队。剩余 [4...0] 名新兵。

7e47ee4ce2cf8843d8ca7395b4b530b8bfcf8864.source: The recruits are scattered around the area. The map shows the location of 8 recruits, but you only need 4. To get one to follow you (and join your group as an ally), speak to them once and click on the dialogue option. You can lead them back to the recruiter or caravan up to four recruits together. If one dies after joining, they cannot be resurrected, so you have to find a replacement.
7e47ee4ce2cf8843d8ca7395b4b530b8bfcf8864.text: 新兵分散在该地区各处。地图显示了 8 个新兵的位置，但你只需要 4 个。要让其中一个跟随你（并作为盟友加入你的队伍），请与他们交谈一次，然后单击对话选项。您可以将他们带回招募人员或商队处，最多可容纳四名新兵。如果加入后死亡，则无法复活，因此必须寻找替代者。

7efb8eb76490a8e32d3df7cee5a0a3a335e932cd.source: Although they do try to keep out of harm's way, they walk slowly and can fall far behind; keep an eye out to make sure that they follow you (otherwise you have to go back for them). To start over, you need to map back to Bai Paasu Reach (which automatically abandons this quest), then re-enter Maishang Hills and get the quest again from Recruiter Lysandra.
7efb8eb76490a8e32d3df7cee5a0a3a335e932cd.text: 尽管他们确实尽力避免受到伤害，但他们走得很慢，而且可能会远远落在后面；请留意以确保他们跟随您（否则您必须回去寻找他们）。要重新开始，您需要映射回白帕苏河段（会自动放弃此任务），然后重新进入麦尚山并从招募员莱桑德拉那里再次获得任务。

f0b61edfd9b43abb45ceea53ed485f864bff38d4.source: When you accept this quest, additional Kurzick enemies will popup at specific locations in the area. (Like other popups, these can also spawn additional chests.)
f0b61edfd9b43abb45ceea53ed485f864bff38d4.text: 当你接受这个任务时，额外的库尔兹克敌人将会出现在该地区的特定位置。 （与其他弹出窗口一样，它们也可以产生额外的箱子。）

ff34c97b469466867d5a3f7ac6a7b82e21204a4d.source: All of the recruits are monks, use swords, and do not activate any skills, regardless of their named profession.
ff34c97b469466867d5a3f7ac6a7b82e21204a4d.text: 所有新兵都是僧侣，使用剑，并且不激活任何技能，无论他们的职业是什么。

927f26d89917ec7184d89507d52f292b4bb3fc05.source: Find and enlist four recruits into the Kurzick army. [4...0] recruits remaining.
927f26d89917ec7184d89507d52f292b4bb3fc05.text: 找到并招募四名新兵加入库尔齐克军队。剩余 [4...0] 名新兵。

2a16128b26b11dd16ae0cfe4a0995e9654629537.source: Escort the recruits to Recruiter Sigmund.
2a16128b26b11dd16ae0cfe4a0995e9654629537.text: 护送新兵去见征募员西格蒙德。

c2584164c16bd0f9798e1e52655b17231c4804a0.source: See Recruiter Sigmund for your reward.
c2584164c16bd0f9798e1e52655b17231c4804a0.text: 请向招聘人员西格蒙德寻求奖励。

c179c0ccffb3f6747953eec97c0556ccda8c05a1.source: The goal is to bring four recruits back to Recruiter Sigmund. You can bring recruits to him singly or in groups of up to four at a time. There are eight candidates available, but you may not recruit more than four at one time. If a recruit dies, you can use a replacement recruit from those remaining.
c179c0ccffb3f6747953eec97c0556ccda8c05a1.text: 目标是将四名新兵带回招聘人员西格蒙德身边。你可以将新兵单独带到他面前，也可以一次最多四人为一组。有八名候选人可供选择，但您一次不得招募超过四名候选人。如果新兵死亡，你可以从剩余的新兵中使用替代新兵。

fd399403b158a3761f9d081d462c98e459982d12.source: The first part of this quest is merely meant to get you to the outpost Champion's Dawn. It should not be hard to get there, though you should watch out for several Mandragor emerging from the soil while you travel there. In the outpost, talk to Kupekanu, and he'll tell you that his last shipment was stolen by corsairs. Head out to the Cliffs of Dohjok and use your compass to get where you need to be. There are three groups of two corsairs here, with one group having the aid of Suubay the Greedy. Once Suubay is defeated, the Shipment Crate will drop. Pick it up and take it to Shatam for your reward.
fd399403b158a3761f9d081d462c98e459982d12.text: 这个任务的第一部分只是为了让你到达前哨站冠军的黎明。到达那里应该不难，不过您在前往那里时应该留意从土壤中冒出来的几只曼陀罗兽。在前哨站，与库佩卡努交谈，他会告诉你他的最后一批货物被海盗偷走了。前往 Dohjok 悬崖，使用指南针到达您需要去的地方。这里有三组海盗，每组两名海盗，其中一组得到了贪婪者苏拜的帮助。一旦苏拜被击败，运输箱就会掉落。捡起它并把它带到沙塔姆以获得奖励。

aff932756cad3d8294ed994b23097cc75e2a23dd.source: This quest can be performed at the same time as Scholarly Affairs and Leaving a Legacy.
aff932756cad3d8294ed994b23097cc75e2a23dd.text: 该任务可以与学术事务和留下遗产同时执行。

4d159a5f836b0ba43945936bd5edea9eefb209b7.source: Although the leader of the corsair robbers has a name of his own (Suubay the Greedy), he is not a boss.
4d159a5f836b0ba43945936bd5edea9eefb209b7.text: 虽然海盗头子有自己的名字（贪婪者苏拜），但他并不是老板。

55919d44e827bd27395af204783c212bac3d4149.source: Find the saltspray dragon Albax and return his scale.
55919d44e827bd27395af204783c212bac3d4149.text: 找到盐雾龙阿尔巴克斯并归还他的鳞片。

6ad2e477eee91b8ded7489a8ac9c961215f9c021.source: See Infortunatos Maxeles for your reward.
6ad2e477eee91b8ded7489a8ac9c961215f9c021.text: 前往 Infortunatos Maxeles 领取奖励。

6336960ba9b73e3326f000fa0acb597d473f243e.source: Completing this quest is quicker if coming from Seafarer's Rest instead of Leviathan Pits outpost. There are about 3 groups to fight before reaching Albax by himself.
6336960ba9b73e3326f000fa0acb597d473f243e.text: 如果来自海员之眠而不是利维坦坑前哨站，完成此任务会更快。在他独自到达阿尔巴克斯之前，大约还有 3 个小组需要战斗。

9826902410e7ff6dc6c404ab13590b0adcb08520.source: Kill Ilsundur, Lord of Fire in the Catacombs of Kathandrax.
9826902410e7ff6dc6c404ab13590b0adcb08520.text: 杀死卡坦德拉克斯地下墓穴中的火之王伊尔桑杜尔。

bc8af5fb16d2b00de86ae6a667c638c7a7cd84f7.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死伊尔桑杜。

54a9f2d48d8b7e6e36763ed17a1288221085840e.text: 根据卡坦德拉克斯的破碎机。

a4cb3704e2dfbe3a8624dd224bc1618e2afe0eac.source: Speak with Imperial Guard Rantoh about medical supplies.
a4cb3704e2dfbe3a8624dd224bc1618e2afe0eac.text: 与兰托帝国卫队讨论医疗用品事宜。

97a43f70de5b904e37ce4dd9fa536bdcac8a9cee.source: Take the medical supplies to Guardsman Pah.
97a43f70de5b904e37ce4dd9fa536bdcac8a9cee.text: 将医疗用品交给卫兵帕。

b624edb7fa5376d419c2ec0c5c1eddf8c666445b.source: Head to the southern portion of Wajjun Bazaar, just outside Nahpui Quarter, to find Imperial Guard Rantoh, then head a bit north of him to find Guardsman Pah. If you have Seek out Brother Tosai active or the Chalice of Corruption, there should be no fights involved.
b624edb7fa5376d419c2ec0c5c1eddf8c666445b.text: 前往 Wajjun Bazaar 的南部，就在 Nahpui Quarter 外，找到帝国卫兵 Rantoh，然后向他偏北一点的地方找到卫兵 Pah。如果你主动寻找东斋兄弟或腐败圣杯，就不应该发生战斗。

5d4511af9649a22e31070d590e8ea4be00e14328.source: This quest appears to be mutually exclusive with the Red Tape quest.
5d4511af9649a22e31070d590e8ea4be00e14328.text: 该任务似乎与繁文缛节任务相互排斥。

2756fa4e17875ad69a261fa56261b54f2b3e4a84.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 2.5 minutes (3 minutes in Hard Mode).
2756fa4e17875ad69a261fa56261b54f2b3e4a84.text: *奖励* 在 2.5 分钟内完成任务（困难模式为 3 分钟）。

56a37b455f9b32247e79d930a638819a15d26246.source: As per the Imperial Sanctum mission.

b41ca0b4bf593f33e5b083fa994e5c04deeaecc3.source: Defend the Released Spirits while they escape from the Pit.
b41ca0b4bf593f33e5b083fa994e5c04deeaecc3.text: 在被释放的灵魂逃离深渊时保护他们。

de93efeaa5eeff8c53a91c5d95977fb23281ab57.source: Protect the Released Spirits while they travel to the Reaper.
de93efeaa5eeff8c53a91c5d95977fb23281ab57.text: 在被释放的灵魂前往死神时保护他们。

26b64eaf9a6225b89cbb76b1771de20a98884353.source: Return to the Reaper of the Bone Pits for your reward.
26b64eaf9a6225b89cbb76b1771de20a98884353.text: 返回骨坑收割者处领取奖励。

196a75cb69f8c208ade2c12251405b5f23e35786.source: It is highly advisable to have only one player take the quest while the rest of the party waits near the Bone Pit, where a group of four Tortured Spirits will spawn one by one as soon as the quest is taken. If any of these spirits are killed, you will be forced to go back to the outpost, so make sure that your team protects them. These spirits will attack foes, and actively run to enemies if they come within aggro range.
196a75cb69f8c208ade2c12251405b5f23e35786.text: 强烈建议只有一名玩家接受任务，而队伍的其他成员则在骨坑附近等待，一旦接受任务，就会一一生成一组四个受折磨的灵魂。如果这些灵魂中的任何一个被杀死，你将被迫返回前哨站，所以请确保你的团队保护他们。这些灵魂会攻击敌人，如果敌人进入仇恨范围，它们会主动跑向敌人。

d1adff4c00f1f6d47432c550eeeb71058658595b.source: Almost immediately upon taking the quest, three Skeletons of Dhuum will spawn, one at each spawn point. Shortly after, a group of Terrorweb Dryders (both standard and silver) will spawn to the south (near the bridge), followed by another smaller group spawning to the northeast (by the small hooked pathway). It is important to position your party more or less on the spawns, so that the dryders do not more forward and aggro the Spirits. A third group of three Terrorweb Dryders will spawn near the bridge, further south than the first, about a minute after the quest begins. If your group is fast enough with DPS, both other groups will be dead by the time they spawn. If the Tortured Spirits hadn't taken any aggro, they will have already begun moving towards the Reaper.
d1adff4c00f1f6d47432c550eeeb71058658595b.text: 几乎在接受任务后，三个德姆骷髅就会生成，每个生成点各有一个。不久之后，一群恐网干燥者（标准和银色）将在南边（靠近桥梁）产卵，随后另一小群恐网干燥者将在东北部（小钩状通道旁）产卵。将你的队伍或多或少地定位在重生点上很重要，这样干燥者就不会更向前并激怒灵魂。任务开始后大约一分钟，第三组三只恐网烘干机将在桥附近产卵，比第一组更南。如果你的队伍的 DPS 足够快，那么其他队伍在生成时就会死亡。如果折磨之灵没有受到任何仇恨，他们早就开始向死神移动了。

6ccc4d13838a3c364521128b2a21e3f556732505.source: Once you've killed the dryders and skeletons the spirits will walk to the Reaper and the quest will be completed.
6ccc4d13838a3c364521128b2a21e3f556732505.text: 一旦你杀死了干燥者和骷髅，灵魂就会走向收割者，任务就会完成。

aefd94f5446784de998fcdb39da1bc971c5d7961.source: Chained Souls keep spawning in the area. They will draw the aggro of the spirits and slow you down, but they do not pose a threat. There is not much you can do about this.
aefd94f5446784de998fcdb39da1bc971c5d7961.text: 被束缚的灵魂不断在该地区生成。它们会吸引灵魂的仇恨并减慢你的速度，但它们不会构成威胁。对此你无能为力。

6d84ba102a0286a1c8091a956d20b32ccc6b81dd.source: The candidates are scattered across the map. Although there is no map indicator for them, they are in the same locations every time. While recruits are following you, you can trigger Luxon pop-ups in various locations on the map.
6d84ba102a0286a1c8091a956d20b32ccc6b81dd.text: 候选人分散在地图上。尽管没有地图指示符，但它们每次都位于相同的位置。当新兵跟随你时，你可以在地图上的不同位置触发 Luxon 弹出窗口。

1478edc4e11231c7468d37004e2a13fe516c0b2a.source: The two biggest obstacles to completing the quest are the recruits themselves: they can get stuck on corners or objects. They also move very slowly and can get caught by patrols that your party has managed to otherwise avoid.
1478edc4e11231c7468d37004e2a13fe516c0b2a.text: 完成任务的两个最大障碍是新兵本身：他们可能会被困在角落或物体上。他们的移动速度也非常缓慢，可能会被你的队伍设法避开的巡逻队抓住。

168424f1c1cae348078a877993093290e5221f2a.source: You must complete the quest before leaving the map to receive your reward.
168424f1c1cae348078a877993093290e5221f2a.text: 您必须在离开地图之前完成任务才能获得奖励。

a5b2e3f03e4bf565a36d6be19f919b57f2510905.source: The recruits can be used during vanquishes or quests as non-renewable fodder.
a5b2e3f03e4bf565a36d6be19f919b57f2510905.text: 新兵可以在征服或任务中用作不可再生的饲料。

69a3a2206337705b72ac09afba66a2355f63cb0a.source: The Luxon equivalent is In the Army (Luxon).
69a3a2206337705b72ac09afba66a2355f63cb0a.text: Luxon 的等效项是 In the Army (Luxon)。

20e1e5b5b65256acee88196fc09ee2929d2f4513.source: The quest can sometimes fail after a recruit dies, if the journal fails to update properly to acknowledge the loss — this prevents you from replacing them with one of the alternatives. There is no known work-around.
20e1e5b5b65256acee88196fc09ee2929d2f4513.text: 如果期刊未能正确更新以承认新兵死亡，任务有时可能会在新兵死亡后失败——这会阻止你用其中一种替代方案来取代他们。没有已知的解决方法。

b4b130fd896f45b65a8059ff7ef499c22cae837e.source: Despite the profession suggested by their names (e.g. Kurzick Elementalist Recruit), all the recruits are monks and carry swords. The recruits have dialogue that appears to be in response to an encounter with Luxons. However, it can be triggered any time after they join your party.
b4b130fd896f45b65a8059ff7ef499c22cae837e.text: 尽管他们的名字暗示了他们的职业（例如库兹克元素师新兵），但所有新兵都是僧侣并携带剑。新兵的对话似乎是为了回应与卢克森的遭遇。然而，它可以在他们加入你的队伍后随时触发。

5e684362075631ddaeea7a8d586d8d1b8acd9ca9.source: Find the Stone Summit camp concealed in Drakkar Lake.
5e684362075631ddaeea7a8d586d8d1b8acd9ca9.text: 找到隐藏在德拉卡湖中的石峰营地。

7e33c26083dc0247f985dbfff2395468a88ede6e.source: Eradicate all Stone Summit in the camp.

fdb3a4718e9b5e41c34ff032b6b50bcee73a8683.source: Dvalinn Stonebreaker will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.
fdb3a4718e9b5e41c34ff032b6b50bcee73a8683.text: 此任务完成后，Dvalinn Stonebreaker 将不再生成。

8c4f506f1167d90c55b225d7674a856d6b7144ea.source: Go to the western side of the mountains and you'll start to come across plenty of Stone Summit. Follow the path to their camp, and pull groups away from the others, as they tend to be quite close together. At the end of the camp, you'll come across Dvalinn Stonebreaker amongst other Stone Summit. You have to kill everyone in the camp.
8c4f506f1167d90c55b225d7674a856d6b7144ea.text: 走到山的西侧，你会开始看到大量的石峰。沿着小路前往他们的营地，并将小组从其他小组中拉开，因为他们往往距离很近。在营地结束时，您会在其他石峰中遇到 Dvalinn Stonebreaker。你必须杀死营地里的所有人。

fc84909ec592f52ea8a3464b08d1fae24a54e445.source: Occasionally the quest will be completed without killing Dvalinn Stonebreaker and his group.
fc84909ec592f52ea8a3464b08d1fae24a54e445.text: 有时，任务会在不杀死德瓦林碎石者和他的团队的情况下完成。

106602d0027ec53eb4da27abdf6d80980e2a1ff7.source: Feed Toma as many enemies as possible in 3 minutes.
106602d0027ec53eb4da27abdf6d80980e2a1ff7.text: 在 3 分钟内尽可能多地喂养托马的敌人。

240fa002d93171ce2a2ac38c57aa803842d5b83d.source: 1 Branch of Juni Berries for every 5 enemies eaten
240fa002d93171ce2a2ac38c57aa803842d5b83d.text: 每吃掉 5 个敌人即可获得 1 枝朱尼浆果

b3a20914da45f1253b54f232de447cca6b0b864d.source: Take Toma and attack enemies until they are injured enough for him to eat. While this quest is active, some Mandragors will spawn outside the village along the dry waterway.
b3a20914da45f1253b54f232de447cca6b0b864d.text: 带着托玛攻击敌人，直到他们受伤到足以让他吃掉为止。当此任务处于活动状态时，一些曼德拉角兽会沿着干涸的水道在村庄外生成。

664cf0f16af95425c80c08bf91cde53d8f073cc8.source: In order to get credit for a kill, Toma has to eat the foe using Feeding Frenzy (any foe deaths for other reasons do not count). Toma will only use the skill when the target is at 20% health or lower, which makes the timing tricky. There are several ways to increase the number of available snacks:
664cf0f16af95425c80c08bf91cde53d8f073cc8.text: 为了获得击杀奖励，托马必须使用疯狂进食来吃掉敌人（任何因其他原因死亡的敌人都不计算在内）。 Toma只会在目标生命值低于20%时使用该技能，这使得时机变得棘手。有几种方法可以增加可用零食的数量：

1d78399bffcdf8a49ce3a05385d479207ab4eea3.source: Take only healing heroes or henchmen, then weaken the enemies enough for Toma to kill them. This usually provides 10 kills (2 berry branches) each round.
1d78399bffcdf8a49ce3a05385d479207ab4eea3.text: 只带上治疗英雄或追随者，然后削弱敌人，让托马杀死他们。这通常每轮可杀死 10 个人（2 个浆果树枝）。

96d73b12898b2f974c2962e4ec6d1c6d406fe42e.source: This method can also be approximated by running one's usual setup but setting all heroes to Avoid Combat as it won't prevent the healers and protectors from doing their job but still keep offensive skills available to be called. This will also prevent them from doing unnecessary damage by autoattacking.
96d73b12898b2f974c2962e4ec6d1c6d406fe42e.text: 这种方法也可以通过运行通常的设置来近似，但将所有英雄设置为避免战斗，因为它不会阻止治疗者和保护者完成他们的工作，但仍然可以调用进攻技能。这也将防止他们通过自动攻击造成不必要的伤害。

530bb7880ff378b344f7139085d35d05de91f0cf.source: Use the quest Undead Defenders to generate foes.
530bb7880ff378b344f7139085d35d05de91f0cf.text: 使用任务不死防御者来生成敌人。

d31fd10bbc2ca29f1cb32881193d2580dc13822a.source: After the Kournan Commander finishes speaking, speak to Chuno to activate Toma, who should have plenty to eat while you attack the incoming foes. Collect the reward from Chuno, but not from Elder Jonah. You can abandon and restart the quest repeatedly this way in order to easily collect many branches of juni berries.
d31fd10bbc2ca29f1cb32881193d2580dc13822a.text: 库尔南指挥官结束讲话后，与丘诺交谈以激活托马，在你攻击即将到来的敌人时，他应该有足够的食物。从丘诺那里领取奖励，但不能从乔纳长老那里领取。您可以通过这种方式反复放弃并重新开始任务，以便轻松收集许多杜松子树枝。

a26543ba13fbd764177e669ef5000abfb8a63e48.source: To ensure Toma spawns, wait until Elder Jonah is done speaking, accept the quest, then rezone via Sunspear Sanctuary; Toma will spawn when you return.
a26543ba13fbd764177e669ef5000abfb8a63e48.text: 为了确保托马生成，请等待乔纳长老说完，接受任务，然后通过烈阳之矛庇护所重新分配区域；当你返回时，托马将会生成。

cc27bb7be285b25db5e72bc78b18901a7f13fee8.source: Create masterless minions to provide food for Toma without leaving the village; at maximum efficiency, this can produce four or more branches per run.
cc27bb7be285b25db5e72bc78b18901a7f13fee8.text: 创建无主人的爪牙，无需离开村庄即可为托马提供食物；在最高效率下，每次运行可以产生四个或更多分支。

8c537cce00a46df097227f163a91427c6a2ac6f8.source: One efficient method uses two minion masters and a Mesmer/Monk to resurrect them quickly. Sacrifice the first necro to provide a corpse for the second to use for minions. Sac the second necro to make the minions masterless (after which Toma will begin munching them quickly). Repeat this until the time limit is reached.
8c537cce00a46df097227f163a91427c6a2ac6f8.text: 一种有效的方法是使用两个随从大师和一个幻术师/武僧来快速复活他们。牺牲第一个死灵，为第二个死灵提供尸体，以供小兵使用。萨克第二个死灵，使小兵失去主人（之后托马将开始快速咀嚼它们）。重复此操作，直到达到时间限制。

edcf381357936dd8f2055c423e20d954e466f54c.source: Call targets and flag heroes a short distance away from an enemy when it reaches 20% health.
edcf381357936dd8f2055c423e20d954e466f54c.text: 当敌人生命值达到 20% 时，在距离敌人不远的地方召唤目标并标记英雄。

04efe3977052ab3e7f3a121bd2ee5b50d80f484b.source: After the time limit runs out, Toma will return to Chuno on his own.
04efe3977052ab3e7f3a121bd2ee5b50d80f484b.text: 期限结束后，托马将独自返回丘诺。

d5ed8fececdfa7786707e9bba62d74390e0d110f.source: This quest will not appear in the quest log. Toma will not spawn if Undead Defenders is active; if needed, complete that quest and rezone to finish Insatiable Appetite. (After the initial dialogue for Undead Defenders between Elder Jonah, Tuma, and the herdsmen, Chuno disappears.) After 10 feedings, 20 seconds are added to the count-down clock. However, the total duration of the feeding time does not change, so that it appears that 20 seconds remain when Toma stops accruing additional kills. Make sure you have room to accept the quest reward: if your inventory is full when speaking to Chuno, you will not be able to receive any branches, despite Chuno's offer to "speak to [him] again, once you have made space."
d5ed8fececdfa7786707e9bba62d74390e0d110f.text: 该任务不会出现在任务日志中。如果不死防御者处于活动状态，托马将不会生成；如果需要，完成该任务并重新分配以完成贪得无厌的食欲。 （在乔纳长老、图玛和牧民之间进行《不死防御者》的最初对话后，丘诺就消失了。）喂食 10 次后，倒计时会增加 20 秒。然而，喂食时间的总持续时间并没有改变，因此看起来还剩 20 秒，Toma 就停止了额外的杀戮。确保你有空间接受任务奖励：如果在与 Chuno 交谈时你的库存已满，你将无法收到任何分支，尽管 Chuno 提出“一旦你腾出了空间，就再次与[他]交谈”。

39037b08e140a408a4828e4da95cb56744aebeeb.source: See Justiciar Naveed for your reward.
39037b08e140a408a4828e4da95cb56744aebeeb.text: 向法官纳维德寻求奖励。

ac33f9a6353d4b48aae0f17d6e5107bbab76342c.source: Talk to Glayvin and you will be taken into the Insidious Remnants zone, a quest-specific version of Tarnished Haven. After some dialogue, you will fight the Aspect of Lazarus, a level 28 Elementalist boss.
ac33f9a6353d4b48aae0f17d6e5107bbab76342c.text: 与格雷文交谈，你将被带入阴险遗迹区域，这是玷污避难所的任务特定版本。经过一些对话后，你将与 28 级元素师 Boss 拉撒路守护者战斗。

adc550957bf4efaa9d6f3944c033dc998594720a.source: During this quest the outpost portals have no effect. This allows a player to completely explore Alcazia Tangle without any foes for Master of the North.
adc550957bf4efaa9d6f3944c033dc998594720a.text: 在此任务期间，前哨传送门不起作用。这使得玩家可以在没有北方大师的任何敌人的情况下完全探索阿尔卡齐亚缠结。

26d8becf475386e148e3b828218bed5af6f0d99c.source: Unlike most Mursaat, the Aspect of Lazarus does not use Spectral Agony.
26d8becf475386e148e3b828218bed5af6f0d99c.text: 与大多数穆萨特不同，拉撒路守护者不使用幽灵痛苦。

9bb19705f71953bc06d337281b6a869a46fa13b4.source: When the Aspect of Lazarus has no health left, it will vanish - it will not actually "die" and leave a corpse. As a result, players cannot capture Blinding Surge or any other skills from it.
9bb19705f71953bc06d337281b6a869a46fa13b4.text: 当拉撒路守护者的生命值耗尽时，它就会消失——它实际上不会“死亡”并留下尸体。因此，玩家无法从中捕获致盲涌动或任何其他技能。

04b6bcb88fcbb0dbae930a6941c70ae7bc9a9a58.source: If you warp out of the area before the fight is over and the quest log is updated, you won't be able to return, because the quest NPCs do not offer the relevant dialogues; in this case, the only way to do the quest is by abandoning and retaking it.
04b6bcb88fcbb0dbae930a6941c70ae7bc9a9a58.text: 如果你在战斗结束且任务日志更新之前离开该区域，你将无法返回，因为任务NPC不提供相关对话；在这种情况下，完成任务的唯一方法是放弃并重新接受它。

9e9738ea4c8ea528c0b46c5fab07d5d628826f17.text: 阻止 Am Fah 快递员

9c7a0d2958849b793d0f15f3004f9e0b2174b394.source: Meet with Scout Dehra outside Dzagonur Bastion and head south with her to intercept and destroy the Kournan caravan. Be aware of the groups of creatures and Margonites along the way. Once the Kournans have been dealt with, return to Dzagonur Bastion for your reward.
9c7a0d2958849b793d0f15f3004f9e0b2174b394.text: 在扎古努尔堡垒外与侦察兵德拉会合，并与她一起向南拦截并摧毁库尔南商队。注意沿途的生物群和玛贡尼特。解决掉库南人后，返回扎古努尔堡垒领取奖励。

1a5a2193eccea232620965026985d4cf67331ed1.source: Combines well with The Search for Survivors to give some useful warrior allies.
1a5a2193eccea232620965026985d4cf67331ed1.text: 与寻找幸存者完美结合，提供一些有用的战士盟友。

60f058cda39e70c9892a1e21c59ed91a3ab0569e.source: Leaving from Honur Hill and killing the Shipment Guard Captain without meeting Scout Dehra first does not mark the quest as complete. You must meet with Scout Dehra just outside the Bastion to get credit first.
60f058cda39e70c9892a1e21c59ed91a3ab0569e.text: 在没有先见到侦察兵德拉的情况下离开荣誉山并杀死货运警卫队长并不意味着任务已完成。你必须在堡垒外与侦察兵德赫拉会面才能首先获得荣誉。

6d9c14b48b5732ac8aeeedba74dc61f464ac81f8.source: Head to The Breach and repel the Charr attacks.
6d9c14b48b5732ac8aeeedba74dc61f464ac81f8.text: 前往突破口并击退夏尔的攻击。

0c3ec0563be3916fc800d72502b4eade68eefdba.source: The allies that are spawned by this quest will continue to remain in The Breach after this quest is completed.
0c3ec0563be3916fc800d72502b4eade68eefdba.text: 该任务完成后，由该任务产生的盟友将继续留在突破口。

5326269babe39e19733e3ab0029cd340d284e570.source: Talk to Warmaster Grast and head west until you reach the Hammer Gate where Gate Guard Hollis is posted. Enter The Breach and head towards the quest marker to find Captain West's group, help them fend off three waves of incoming Charr groups. Once all three waves are defeated, return to Warmaster Grast to claim your reward.
5326269babe39e19733e3ab0029cd340d284e570.text: 与战帅格拉斯特交谈，然后向西行进，直到到达门卫霍利斯驻守的锤门。进入The Breach并前往任务标记寻找韦斯特队长的队伍，帮助他们抵御三波来袭的夏尔队伍。一旦所有三波都被击败，返回战帅格拉斯特领取你的奖励。

396c37bb36bbc2f406c0122f2df0cea4c7c75352.source: Uncover the fate of The Oddbodies.

60699c8e9b7bf9745386c22ec8c4328e13ce1b2c.source: See Captain Yithlis for your reward.
60699c8e9b7bf9745386c22ec8c4328e13ce1b2c.text: 去找伊斯利斯船长领取奖励。

d70108bddca2c1dcac073b8a70703cbeb667b0b1.source: Start from Gate of Fear, which is the only entrance to the Domain of Pain. Thenemi is waiting just outside. From there, follow the quest pointer to the other Oddbodies; you must find each of them before Captain Yithlis will be ready to speak with you. Each Oddbody will follow you as an ally, making the fights easier as you proceed; they do not need to survive to complete the quest.
d70108bddca2c1dcac073b8a70703cbeb667b0b1.text: 从恐惧之门开始，这是通往痛苦领域的唯一入口。 Thenemi is waiting just outside. From there, follow the quest pointer to the other Oddbodies; you must find each of them before Captain Yithlis will be ready to speak with you. Each Oddbody will follow you as an ally, making the fights easier as you proceed; they do not need to survive to complete the quest.

bafd29c6337f89c2306a11646dd62f704a25b0b8.source: Although there is no visible bridge between Scout Ahktum and The Lost, the river of souls can still be crossed just like in the mission. Eventually, you will reach the captain; speak to him to receive the reward.
bafd29c6337f89c2306a11646dd62f704a25b0b8.text: Although there is no visible bridge between Scout Ahktum and The Lost, the river of souls can still be crossed just like in the mission.最终，你会到达船长身边；与他交谈以获得奖励。

6219240e4b3cdb944a0f50fc8c69e1ce91e2c5c3.source: You can talk to Captain Yithlis at any time, however you still need to talk to each Oddbody NPC to get the reward dialogue from Yithlis. If you talk to Yithlis before the last, the Oddbodies will not join you as allies, but instead stay still after being talked to.
6219240e4b3cdb944a0f50fc8c69e1ce91e2c5c3.text: 你可以随时与 Yithlis 队长交谈，但你仍然需要与每个 Oddbody NPC 交谈才能从 Yithlis 那里获得奖励对话。 If you talk to Yithlis before the last, the Oddbodies will not join you as allies, but instead stay still after being talked to.

bfbea11391f84338b008789bd01a6d96a3647b63.source: There is a Treasure Chest near Igraine.
bfbea11391f84338b008789bd01a6d96a3647b63.text: 伊格莱恩附近有一个宝箱。

e863397cc62d2c626d60e3e4855737ce3bf1153e.source: There are two other quests inside the Domain of Pain (given by the Wandering Soul in the Leech Tunnels), namely a Faded Memory and the follow-up A Fleshy Operation. You can use the Oddbodies to help complete these quests. After picking up Igraine, instead of heading to Captain Yithlis, proceed to perform these quest first and then return to Captain Yithlis to finish "Into the Fire".
e863397cc62d2c626d60e3e4855737ce3bf1153e.text: 痛苦领域内还有另外两个任务（由水蛭隧道中的游魂给出），即“褪色的记忆”和后续的“肉身行动”。您可以使用 Oddbodies 来帮助完成这些任务。接起伊格莱因后，不要前往伊斯利斯船长处，而是先执行这些任务，然后返回伊斯利斯船长处完成“进入火海”。

611e67fa6920c90eea028bb4a8639812936db22c.source: Meet your friends in Skyward Reach.
611e67fa6920c90eea028bb4a8639812936db22c.text: Meet your friends in Skyward Reach.

9ed0856a65cc2366dacaa8cc1a0ea3dbc7c533ed.source: Find Aidan and get a good look at the mesa.
9ed0856a65cc2366dacaa8cc1a0ea3dbc7c533ed.text: 找到艾丹并仔细观察台面。

9bc88e44f599e3cf73e9665d2d093ac2631e4c88.source: Return to Jorn Kudebeh for your reward.
9bc88e44f599e3cf73e9665d2d093ac2631e4c88.text: 返回乔恩·库德贝那里领取奖励。

f4926cc089708f4bac64348e00bdcc57c3bb9184.source: Exit Augury Rock to meet Cynn, Devona, and Mhenlo. Follow them on a short walk through Skyward Reach until you reach Aidan at the quest marker, and map travel back to Augury Rock after the quest updates to see Jorn Kudebeh.
f4926cc089708f4bac64348e00bdcc57c3bb9184.text: 退出占卜岩，与辛恩、德沃娜和门洛会面。跟随他们穿过 Skyward Reach 步行一小段，直到到达任务标记处的 Aidan，并在任务更新后返回占卜岩以查看 Jorn Kudebeh。

c347e4b9f1f851de74937d564698108faa4eb612.source: It is possible to complete the quest just by visiting the target location, without waiting for your allies to reach it.
c347e4b9f1f851de74937d564698108faa4eb612.text: 只需访问目标位置即可完成任务，而无需等待您的盟友到达。

cfb2f96814184249fe4c10c1d5a70ef1aa66e4b4.source: This quest can be done with no fighting.
cfb2f96814184249fe4c10c1d5a70ef1aa66e4b4.text: This quest can be done with no fighting.

0b9a45674d50ac143e8396733666d966bacb9253.source: It is very easy for Mhenlo, Cynn and Devona to be killed due to the sheer amount of area of effect damage hydras put out. However, their deaths will not cause the quest to fail and it can still be completed.
0b9a45674d50ac143e8396733666d966bacb9253.text: It is very easy for Mhenlo, Cynn and Devona to be killed due to the sheer amount of area of effect damage hydras put out. However, their deaths will not cause the quest to fail and it can still be completed.

6011b8785c1e47620e0e2b59b0b05db7686ff5ae.source: Sometimes Mhenlo will continue to follow you and heal your party after you reach the mesa. Aidan's second line, "Impressive. I assume that completing these trials will open the way for us?", should be spoken by Devona.
6011b8785c1e47620e0e2b59b0b05db7686ff5ae.text: 有时，在你到达平顶山后，曼洛会继续跟随你并治愈你的队伍。艾丹的第二句台词“令人印象深刻。我认为完成这些考验将为我们开辟道路？”，应该由德沃娜说。

55ed58e10709a51d6929959b73c91abd9b7795d3.source: Seek out Rukkassa in Nightfallen Jahai.
55ed58e10709a51d6929959b73c91abd9b7795d3.text: Seek out Rukkassa in Nightfallen Jahai.

ebb9c3097db86361609265d099d33be50b2d2e53.source: Rukkassa spawns a short distance away from the Gate of Pain in Nightfallen Jahai, guarded by two Terrorweb Dryders. Consider exiting from the Gate of Pain in order to kill the Terrorwebs before triggering the quest marker. After the dryders are defeated, walk past Rukkassa to the quest point. After a short dialogue, he will become possessed and attack, but as a lone monk, poses little threat. Defeating him completes the quest.
ebb9c3097db86361609265d099d33be50b2d2e53.text: 卢卡萨在堕夜者贾海的痛苦之门附近生成，由两个恐网烘干机守卫。 Consider exiting from the Gate of Pain in order to kill the Terrorwebs before triggering the quest marker.打败干燥者后，经过鲁卡萨到达任务点。短暂的对话后，他会附体并发起攻击，但作为一个孤独的僧人，威胁不大。 Defeating him completes the quest.

87d1bb2df91bc9b377cb846526ee0b26e15c942a.source: Invoke Saint Anjeka of House Vasburg.
87d1bb2df91bc9b377cb846526ee0b26e15c942a.text: 召唤瓦斯堡家族的圣安杰卡。

3f74dc34099aaa7a9b2babe8ae4eedee7b36a30a.source: Invoke Saint Melodie of House Lutgardis.
3f74dc34099aaa7a9b2babe8ae4eedee7b36a30a.text: Invoke Saint Melodie of House Lutgardis.

e6da9b3178d6d90d6353f803d80ec8dd9e639323.source: Invoke Saint Perahta of House Brauer.
e6da9b3178d6d90d6353f803d80ec8dd9e639323.text: 召唤布劳尔家族的圣佩拉赫塔。

1dafbce4493a6aafb0ad84723d41568c0b638c76.source: Invoke Saint Ehren of House Durheim.
1dafbce4493a6aafb0ad84723d41568c0b638c76.text: 召唤德海姆家族的圣埃伦。

48e350cb9cb3da7351f4cae77442b9c93051ba18.source: This is a very simple quest: map (or walk) to each of the Kurzick family outposts and speak to the relevant NPC there, then return to House zu Heltzer for your reward.
48e350cb9cb3da7351f4cae77442b9c93051ba18.text: 这是一个非常简单的任务：绘制（或步行）到每个 Kurzick 家族前哨基地并与那里的相关 NPC 交谈，然后返回 House zu Heltzer 获取奖励。

2cf50c6854bc16957de803a6e07680f396c04398.source: The saints are invoked as follows:
2cf50c6854bc16957de803a6e07680f396c04398.text: The saints are invoked as follows:

fb40832546b3afc8ebe8c452cd8f58aa0d2447c4.source: Saint Anjeka, speak to Baroness Attia Vasburg at Vasburg Armory.
fb40832546b3afc8ebe8c452cd8f58aa0d2447c4.text: 圣安杰卡，与瓦斯堡军械库的阿蒂亚·瓦斯堡男爵夫人交谈。

b7b55864d6de9b6e89539257376642ff183ee88e.source: Saint Melodie, speak to Duke Holtz Lutgardis at Lutgardis Conservatory.
b7b55864d6de9b6e89539257376642ff183ee88e.text: 圣梅洛迪，与卢特加迪斯音乐学院的霍尔茨·卢特加迪斯公爵交谈。

b6da24ae18c3e57903b806ba25d464a34007add2.source: Saint Perahta, speak to Count Archek Brauer at Brauer Academy.
b6da24ae18c3e57903b806ba25d464a34007add2.text: 圣佩拉赫塔，与布劳尔学院的阿尔切克·布劳尔伯爵交谈。

1c9018f58e223a0176d05cce3ed644743ee883e2.source: Saint Ehren, speak to Countess Sandra Durheim at Durheim Archives.
1c9018f58e223a0176d05cce3ed644743ee883e2.text: 圣埃伦，与德海姆档案馆的桑德拉·德海姆伯爵夫人交谈。

254f5bce4ac45a2e868029054241eafd29db455e.source: In the dialogue used by Count Archeck Brauer, he refers to Saint Perahta, the patron saint of House Brauer, as "the most revered ancestor of House Lutgardis".
254f5bce4ac45a2e868029054241eafd29db455e.text: 在阿切克·布劳尔伯爵的对话中，他将布劳尔家族的守护神圣佩拉赫塔称为“卢特加迪斯家族最受尊敬的祖先”。

c046c163a8011ad9fd67cb27d3c1ee0d88cdb0ea.source: Clear the Iron Horse Mine in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
c046c163a8011ad9fd67cb27d3c1ee0d88cdb0ea.text: 在困难模式下清除北席瓦山脉铁马矿井中的所有敌人。

0f1fc2a2097eda519e09186d19c90caaf86010a5.source: Travel northwest from Yak's Bend through Traveler's Vale. Alternatively, travel the northeast from Ice Tooth Cave via Anvil Rock.
0f1fc2a2097eda519e09186d19c90caaf86010a5.text: 从牦牛弯向西北行驶，穿过旅行者谷。或者，从冰牙洞向东北方向行驶，途经铁砧岩。

fa5734a1c4c487c565f212b504176c023d014678.source: The Minaar's Trouble, Minaar's Worry, Stone Summit Beastmasters, and The Wayward Monk quests affect the spawns in this area.
fa5734a1c4c487c565f212b504176c023d014678.text: 米纳尔的麻烦、米纳尔的忧虑、石峰驯兽师和任性的僧侣任务会影响该区域的生成。

47a6b0b58fc9bd4ff3db58b9dac3743fc90b676b.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
47a6b0b58fc9bd4ff3db58b9dac3743fc90b676b.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 1.4%。

c333faca62c17cd0dd8006ec6405f4052621ae5c.source: The Dolyak Riders may prove difficult to kill with their use of Mark of Protection. Consider bringing enchantment removal or interrupts; although, it will also work by getting the Dolyak Rider to use Mark of Protection on another foe before focusing on killing the Dolyak Rider.
c333faca62c17cd0dd8006ec6405f4052621ae5c.text: 事实证明，使用保护印记的多利亚克骑士很难被杀死。考虑移除结界或打断结界；不过，它也可以通过让多利亚克骑士在专注于杀死多利亚克骑士之前对另一个敌人使用保护印记来发挥作用。

9149f6bb9cdf5c6815962650bbcd73c08c906e84.source: Consider coming from Ice Tooth Cave rather than Yak's Bend. Traveler's Vale contains large numbers of Stone Summit, whereas in Anvil Rock you will face only Minotaurs and a few Frostfire Dryders.
9149f6bb9cdf5c6815962650bbcd73c08c906e84.text: 考虑从冰牙洞而不是牦牛弯来。旅行者之谷拥有大量的石峰，而在铁砧岩中你只会面对牛头怪和一些霜火干燥者。

309968d7406b842b7467fb0e32ee8ef631009e56.source: Some Stone Summit groups have long patrol paths, so to find them you might need to revisit places you've already cleared.
309968d7406b842b7467fb0e32ee8ef631009e56.text: 一些石峰小组有很长的巡逻路径，因此要找到它们，您可能需要重新访问已经清理过的地方。

011f4834456193ad78d28f0991a4ffaeab73ef17.source: Go to the Iron Horse Mine. Sabotage the control levers around the equipment used by the Stone Summit.
011f4834456193ad78d28f0991a4ffaeab73ef17.text: 前往铁马矿。破坏石峰使用的设备周围的控制杆。

398c34eca932091d7b515df6af484ef4b82d7d2e.text: 破坏 9...0 个以上控制杆。

62f3979414a4f0660fcca8385cda8da8070ee166.source: Return to Rangil Ironbow for your reward.
62f3979414a4f0660fcca8385cda8da8070ee166.text: 返回兰吉尔铁弓处领取奖励。

23a72b40d291c4a3bb8857c319773f7727109095.text: 残酷法杖（使用乌鸦法杖皮肤）

02fb3269271a62d776857592b9ad9a06ff1a9325.source: After obtaining the quest, go through the portal into the Iron Horse Mine. Once there, follow the map marker to a Dwarven Powder Keg Station, obtain a keg and drop near a lever. While you are doing this watch out for patrols. Drop a keg on each of the 3 clusters of levers to finish the quest, and return to Rangil Ironbow for your reward. Try to drop the keg in the centre of the lever clusters, otherwise it might not destroy all three levers with one keg.
02fb3269271a62d776857592b9ad9a06ff1a9325.text: 获得任务后，通过传送门进入铁马矿。到达那里后，按照地图标记到达矮人火药桶站，获得一个小桶并放在杠杆附近。 While you are doing this watch out for patrols. Drop a keg on each of the 3 clusters of levers to finish the quest, and return to Rangil Ironbow for your reward. Try to drop the keg in the centre of the lever clusters, otherwise it might not destroy all three levers with one keg.

21a464279c37048defec609c3e7ff2e949149078.source: If you are not planning on doing any other quests after this or do not mind the death penalty, a quick way back to Rangil is to allow your party to die and respawn at the entrance to Traveler's Vale.
21a464279c37048defec609c3e7ff2e949149078.text: 如果您不打算在此之后执行任何其他任务或者不介意死刑，那么返回兰吉尔的快速方法是让您的队伍死亡并在旅行者谷的入口处重生。

3c88a41342260b06e77f2aeaa7555b2aab88af1d.source: The reward staff possess an inherent +5 armor vs physical damage (and is not due to a staff wrapping). In addition, it can be dyed, unlike other weapons sharing its skin.
3c88a41342260b06e77f2aeaa7555b2aab88af1d.text: 奖励法杖拥有固有的+5护甲对抗物理伤害（并且不是由于法杖包裹）。 In addition, it can be dyed, unlike other weapons sharing its skin.

0b7d45f7ba2cb0fc693060bafa3f69695ea3078b.source: Find the traitor in the Iron Mines of Moladune. Defeat him and his guards.
0b7d45f7ba2cb0fc693060bafa3f69695ea3078b.text: 在莫拉杜恩铁矿找到叛徒。击败他和他的守卫。

e6701b08766a219bbfba26db9cf1e04004cf523c.source: As per the Iron Mines of Moladune mission.
e6701b08766a219bbfba26db9cf1e04004cf523c.text: 根据莫拉杜恩铁矿任务。

e4bfdf1e0e4642826dc598d5f653b33bb86cca0c.source: Clear the Issnur Isles in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
e4bfdf1e0e4642826dc598d5f653b33bb86cca0c.text: Clear the Issnur Isles in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.

26cce2162b190133be0d6202234b09574fe1c0b3.source: This area lies between the outposts of Beknur Harbor and Kodlonu Hamlet. The only way to arrive here for the first time is exiting from Beknur Harbor. The primary quest Isle of the Dead leads through this location.
26cce2162b190133be0d6202234b09574fe1c0b3.text: 该地区位于贝克努尔港和科德洛努哈姆雷特前哨之间。第一次到达这里的唯一方法是从贝克努尔港离开。主要任务“死亡之岛”会穿过这个地点。

8c78c6f452b87843a78b8e3e798a1363b16e3fdf.source: This area contains the first boss in the Nightfall campaign that has an elite skill.
8c78c6f452b87843a78b8e3e798a1363b16e3fdf.text: 该区域包含夜幕降临战役中第一个拥有精英技能的 Boss。

b9069ded2d797a4d68c0b0cdf0c3f66e0b6adf0b.source: Is it possible to explore this area without any foes by entering the quest Assault on Beknur Harbor, and running through the gates from the Beknur Harbor outpost.
b9069ded2d797a4d68c0b0cdf0c3f66e0b6adf0b.text: 是否可以通过进入任务“突击贝克努尔港”并从贝克努尔港前哨穿过大门来探索该区域，而没有任何敌人。

d56b6062bc29a02032ececeae127f00d9acabfc7.source: Vanquishing this area up to 10 times on an Elonian Support weekly bonus will allow any character to achieve Legendary Spearmarshal.
d56b6062bc29a02032ececeae127f00d9acabfc7.text: 通过埃洛尼安支援每周奖励征服该区域最多 10 次，任何角色都将获得传奇矛元帅的称号。

0b8bc71938dbce61ada1724d176bab8df45f24f8.source: The Skale Blighters will spread disease so condition removal skills will come in handy.
0b8bc71938dbce61ada1724d176bab8df45f24f8.text: Skale Blighters 会传播疾病，因此消除疾病的技能会派上用场。

4f3040d6c471996f4b5a04be3105550fd74cdb2c.source: {{bug|For non-Nightfall characters (only), there are several quest-related spawns or triggers that are incorrect. These quests cannot be done by non-Nightfall characters yet they affect the instance.
4f3040d6c471996f4b5a04be3105550fd74cdb2c.text: {{bug|（仅）对于非夜幕角色，有几个与任务相关的生成或触发器不正确。这些任务不能由非黄昏角色完成，但它们会影响实例。

c867e29e42bed6edea35960319d2c55c76768a00.source: Healer Zenwa will always initiate his speech for the First Born quest chain and the many Mourning Villagers will always spawn.
c867e29e42bed6edea35960319d2c55c76768a00.text: 治疗者 Zenwa 将始终为“初生”任务链发起演讲，并且许多哀悼村民将始终出现。

9eacf0fc042e0b15a4ce21727da9aa4007688382.source: Troublesome Flamingos for the quest Flamingo-ing... going... gone. always spawn.}}
9eacf0fc042e0b15a4ce21727da9aa4007688382.text: 麻烦火烈鸟的任务火烈鸟-ing...去...消失了。总是产卵。}}

d1e9f47fe25440428bc367abfb545e91f6141678.source: Destroy the fire golems. You have [5...0] fire golems remaining.
d1e9f47fe25440428bc367abfb545e91f6141678.text: 摧毁火傀儡。你还剩下 [5...0] 个火傀儡。

e699d57205578187c36ecc1b61e6a41d3fbc1075.source: See the Emperor's Hand for your reward.
e699d57205578187c36ecc1b61e6a41d3fbc1075.text: 前往帝皇之手领取奖励。

a0fb08c39b9310b07031afe350a699b9197faf92.source: Exit from Nahpui Quarter into Wajjun Bazaar and head to the Undercity portal, killing any Am Fah groups you happen to run into. (This is a lot quicker if you have Seek out Brother Tosai active, since there are no foes in Wajjun Bazaar.)
a0fb08c39b9310b07031afe350a699b9197faf92.text: 从 Nahpui 区退出进入 Wajjun Bazaar，前往幽暗城传送门，杀死你碰巧遇到的任何 Am Fah 团体。 （如果你激活了“寻找东斋兄弟”，这会快得多，因为 Wajjun Bazaar 中没有敌人。）

7120d45d368bed1982ba63eae4dfec10a6da4f9c.source: Simply head southeast once inside the Undercity and kill the Fire Golems.
7120d45d368bed1982ba63eae4dfec10a6da4f9c.text: 进入幽暗城后，只需向东南方向前进并杀死火傀儡即可。

31ac1031d75178027949ff5f03cd9f18f53c4ec2.source: The so-called "fire" golems are the same as Flesh Golems from the Ring of Fire Islands.
31ac1031d75178027949ff5f03cd9f18f53c4ec2.text: 所谓的“火”傀儡与来自火环群岛的血肉傀儡是一样的。

6c9a47b1705a6b97b1dbe67cdca3a49f451b2ff9.source: Clear the Jaga Moraine in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
6c9a47b1705a6b97b1dbe67cdca3a49f451b2ff9.text: 在困难模式下清除远席瓦山脉中的贾加冰碛中的所有敌人。

df8abf189e0402ace648bfda96f48f2458426eb0.source: Jaga Moraine is directly accessible from the outpost of Sifhalla. An alternative access route is to head north from Gunnar's Hold into Bjora Marches, then walk up the west side of that area to the portal with Jaga Moraine.
df8abf189e0402ace648bfda96f48f2458426eb0.text: 从 Sifhalla 前哨站可直接到达 Jaga Moraine。另一种进入路线是从古纳尔的要塞向北进入比约拉边境，然后沿着该区域的西侧步行到贾加莫瑞恩的传送门。

dcd2dce6c0ec41cbcca2a2b4318cd2ae286e76b9.source: This area contributes approximately 6.88 exploration points towards the Master of the North title track.
dcd2dce6c0ec41cbcca2a2b4318cd2ae286e76b9.text: 该区域为《北方大师》主打歌贡献了大约 6.88 个探索点。

e876516960a24815beccc09c4da27d52c202ed78.source: On rare occasions, you can see a group of Snowmen fighting off Grentches at the entrance of the abandoned village in the southeastern corner. If your party kills the Grentches, they will yield Norn Hunting Party points.
e876516960a24815beccc09c4da27d52c202ed78.text: 在极少数情况下，你可以在东南角废弃村庄的入口处看到一群雪人与格伦特奇人战斗。如果你的队伍杀死了格兰特人，他们将获得诺恩狩猎队积分。

8fd322f88200489e08bbfa96ea680cb1aaf75929.source: Watch out for ice boulders in the northern parts.

6c9ae3750e1bc42832e0bf1d1bfa6b3b08cb45fc.source: There are 4 Jars of Healing Salve at Egil's Perch.
6c9ae3750e1bc42832e0bf1d1bfa6b3b08cb45fc.text: 埃吉尔栖息处有 4 罐治疗药膏。

8c6c914ab09ae0af3005f56f93e600f56881ab1e.source: There are more Vaettir in hard mode; some groups find it more efficient to bring a vaettir farmer to deal with them.
8c6c914ab09ae0af3005f56f93e600f56881ab1e.text: 困难模式下有更多瓦蒂尔；一些团体发现让瓦蒂尔农民来对付他们更有效。

0e9b92376b094f5468f510a7f83e5ff134300167.source: Pairs of hidden Frost Wurms can spawn in six different spots in the northeastern quarter. If you wait to vanquish that section last, you might not have to kill any of them. The Mountain Pinesouls are hostile to these Frost Wurms.
0e9b92376b094f5468f510a7f83e5ff134300167.text: 成对的隐藏冰霜亚龙可以在东北区的六个不同地点生成。如果你等到最后才征服那部分，你可能不需要杀死他们中的任何一个。山松之魂对这些冰霜亚龙怀有敌意。

1e0a5941f010bdfe849435e3442afc6baa1683ed.source: The patrol paths of Mandragors and Minotaurs overlap in certain areas.
1e0a5941f010bdfe849435e3442afc6baa1683ed.text: 曼陀罗和牛头怪的巡逻路径在某些区域重叠。

400e19d4eb5facd943caccf567e6beffddd94c1e.source: There are hidden Mountain Aloes in the southwestern section.

5969f5aba96fcbec6a244dde84f2d645c776cac3.source: If Kilroy Stonekin spawns and you accept his challenge, there will be additional Stone Summit troops.
5969f5aba96fcbec6a244dde84f2d645c776cac3.text: 如果基尔罗伊·斯通金出现并且你接受他的挑战，将会有额外的石峰部队。

c8ffc7ec361ddc16fde6d5f41cdf585bc045c1d7.source: Clear the Jahai Bluffs in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
c8ffc7ec361ddc16fde6d5f41cdf585bc045c1d7.text: 在困难模式下清除库尔纳贾海悬崖上的所有敌人。

a581e749f24dd9487e36ba8d4d9add7456eb00ac.source: Exiting via the east exit of the Command Post will bring characters here, most likely while following the primary quest Centaur Blackmail.
a581e749f24dd9487e36ba8d4d9add7456eb00ac.text: 从指挥所东出口退出会将角色带到这里，很可能是在完成主要任务半人马勒索时。

43677cc36645d7d94365b2a31268c80f041e0378.source: Despite having hidden Mandragors spread out in the open areas of this location, Mandragor Hunt is not available here.
43677cc36645d7d94365b2a31268c80f041e0378.text: 尽管在该地点的空旷区域散布着隐藏的曼陀罗，但此处无法进行曼陀罗狩猎。

2bc31c63d0295c0dc731e1505f2caf80347f17f0.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.3% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
2bc31c63d0295c0dc731e1505f2caf80347f17f0.text: 对这一领域的完整探索为 Elonian Cartographer 主打歌贡献了约 3.3%。

e6c4bb852ad8a8f8b6f684a964e276658c4e67c2.source: Be aware that the fortress ramps to the northeast contains several large groups of elite Kournan military. Careful pulling is critical. Anti-melee skills and physical damage mitigation is helpful.
e6c4bb852ad8a8f8b6f684a964e276658c4e67c2.text: 请注意，东北方的要塞坡道上驻扎着几大群精锐的库尔南军队。小心拉动至关重要。反近战技能和物理伤害缓解很有帮助。

a49434ec620d190bc0a5e38dafa85af98d71bf42.source: A huge mountain can be seen when looking west-northwest, it is clear when entering from Kodonur Crossroads. It is probably the mountain seen on the map southwest of The Sulfurous Wastes.
a49434ec620d190bc0a5e38dafa85af98d71bf42.text: 向西北偏西方向望去，可以看到一座巨大的山峰，从科多努尔十字路口进入时清晰可见。它可能就是地图上硫磺荒原西南方向的那座山。

ce712e6b593a35308554ca5e059abe6243e3df3d.source: Kill Jarimiya the Unmerciful in the Vehtendi Valley.
ce712e6b593a35308554ca5e059abe6243e3df3d.text: 在维赫滕迪山谷杀死无情者加里米亚。

0cd19b18baabb07dfb0bc0f62c7f1fde103f014e.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Jarimiya。

88d5889321bba8c46b5defc6a93b4f71dbaf25d6.source: Proceed west from Yahnur Market, down the hills, across several bridges and into the plains area near the center of Vehtendi Valley. Note that this boss is near several patrols of other Heket, including other bosses. It is possible to get to this boss while avoiding the other groups.
88d5889321bba8c46b5defc6a93b4f71dbaf25d6.text: 从 Yahnur 市场向西行驶，下山，穿过几座桥梁，进入 Vehtendi 山谷中心附近的平原地区。请注意，这个 Boss 靠近其他 Heket 的几个巡逻队，包括其他 Boss。可以在避开其他队伍的同时到达这个boss。

765b628008aaeb16f8c60612870684f0a3bceb1c.source: Alternately take the easier route, heading south into Forum Highlands from the Kodash Bazaar and hugging the eastern-most wall, where you will only have to fight 1 to 3 mobs of heket. Continue south through the portal into Vehtendi Valley. Head south, around the slope and Jarimiya is directly ahead of you.
765b628008aaeb16f8c60612870684f0a3bceb1c.text: 或者选择更简单的路线，从 Kodash Bazaar 向南进入 Forum Highlands，紧靠最东边的墙，在那里你只需要与 1 到 3 个 heket 怪物战斗。继续向南穿过入口进入 Vehtendi 山谷。向南行驶，绕过斜坡，贾里米亚就在您的正前方。

068ed36cdd9b6c60fc0e54acea742f09528d1984.source: Clear the Jaya Bluffs on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
068ed36cdd9b6c60fc0e54acea742f09528d1984.text: 在困难模式下清除 Shing Jea 岛上的 Jaya Bluffs 上的所有敌人。

e323bb8217f1dd3a507eba850f5d7d6fa338c085.source: Exit from Seitung Harbor located North in the Outpost or travel west through Haiju Lagoon from Zen Daijun.
e323bb8217f1dd3a507eba850f5d7d6fa338c085.text: 从位于前哨站北部的 Seitung 港出口或从 Zen Daijun 向西穿过海州泻湖 (Haiju Lagoon)。

8a621f8faa01433692be25cf45f6cbe930384fa7.source: The primary quest Looking For Trouble will lead Factions characters here.
8a621f8faa01433692be25cf45f6cbe930384fa7.text: 主要任务“寻找麻烦”将引导派系角色来到这里。

ad6e546ff4e46cd33946c619d241a034043886a6.source: Death with Honor, Looking For Trouble and The Rite of Valor.
ad6e546ff4e46cd33946c619d241a034043886a6.text: 《荣誉而死》、《寻找麻烦》和《英勇仪式》。

4b63a9033983a3da3dad3b98b4fae9e55c49b923.source: This area is a popular choice for Feather farming.
4b63a9033983a3da3dad3b98b4fae9e55c49b923.text: 该地区是羽毛养殖的热门选择。

e8d8108384baa54338a408363d69d65897ac254c.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.4% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
e8d8108384baa54338a408363d69d65897ac254c.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Canthan 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.4%。

3063c2a1a893beedb8ddb8d125521fd592648f17.source: When mapping, there is a small path in the top NW area, where one of the main Factions quests leads to, that may be missed.
3063c2a1a893beedb8ddb8d125521fd592648f17.text: 绘制地图时，西北顶部区域有一条小路，主要派系任务之一通向该路，但可能会被错过。

79b89a002753345fbf9e2a9ea4281ac2dc451017.source: The Yeti and the Sensali Tengus are hostile to each other. The Yeti bosses might get killed before your arrival, particularly Ahvha Sankii. Letting them fight each other will ease clearing this place.
79b89a002753345fbf9e2a9ea4281ac2dc451017.text: 雪人与森萨利天狗彼此敌对。雪人首领可能会在您到达之前被杀死，尤其是 Ahvha Sankii。让他们互相争斗就能轻松清理这个地方。

9de11d5bc4a9377ae33d9f19304b4342d97968f2.source: There are pigs in this area that have strange animations- it can be seen here.
9de11d5bc4a9377ae33d9f19304b4342d97968f2.text: 这个区域有一些猪，它们有奇怪的动画——可以在这里看到。

218827635f6672a3bd7791bd1277ac5aa9a5fbdc.source: Gull Hookbeak and Yorrt Strongjaw will always spawn for non-Factions characters, despite the fact that non-Factions characters cannot acquire either of the quests that these two NPCs can offer.
218827635f6672a3bd7791bd1277ac5aa9a5fbdc.text: 海鸥钩喙和约尔特·强颚总是会为非派系角色生成，尽管事实上非派系角色无法获得这两个 NPC 可以提供的任何一个任务。

09f921b3bf09748416d68b278e8ee93218d056b0.source: Kill Jedeh the Mighty in Crystal Overlook.
09f921b3bf09748416d68b278e8ee93218d056b0.text: 杀死水晶瞭望台中的强大者杰德。

992acc7d2f39a1ad06c19bdf2c6b2641af1b5ee1.source: *BONUS* Kill Jedeh the Mighty in Hard Mode.
992acc7d2f39a1ad06c19bdf2c6b2641af1b5ee1.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死强大的杰德。

bcf674271eb806d6ec613c1c5efbfe617d7910be.source: The recommended way to reach Jedeh is to start from the Mouth of Torment. Take the western exit to the Ruptured Heart and make your way to the portal to Crystal Overlook. There will be a few mobs of Graven Monoliths, Margonites and Giants to defeat or avoid. Once you reach the Overlook, the most direct route to Jedeh is indicated by the blue line on the map. However, this will take you through several groups of Djinn, who can be tough to fight especially in Hard Mode. An alternative that is more time-consuming but less lethal is to turn left after entering the map, and board a Junundu. Go through the sulfurous area in the middle of the map and approach Jedeh from the east rather than the northeast. All the mobs you meet along the way should be small and easily disposed of.
bcf674271eb806d6ec613c1c5efbfe617d7910be.text: 到达杰德的推荐路线是从折磨之口出发。从破碎之心的西面出口出发，前往水晶眺望台的传送门。将会有一些坟墓巨石、玛贡尼特和巨人等怪物需要击败或躲避。到达观景台后，地图上的蓝线指示了前往吉德的最直接路线。然而，这将带你穿过几组巨灵，他们很难对付，尤其是在困难模式下。另一种更耗时但杀伤力较小的选择是进入地图后左转，登上朱南杜。穿过地图中间的硫磺区域，从东部而不是东北方向接近吉德。你沿途遇到的所有怪物都应该很小并且很容易处理掉。

75fa54f3a1c6df393a1e5326f66f8b9cc433082c.source: Mutu, the Oldest Child quest not active
75fa54f3a1c6df393a1e5326f66f8b9cc433082c.text: 穆图，最大的孩子任务未激活

2c889fabdd6c49b647113eea870fd51eff804ce1.source: Misela, the Middle Child quest not active
2c889fabdd6c49b647113eea870fd51eff804ce1.text: 米塞拉，中间的孩子任务未激活

f51609ce62b531b1284c73a394be8c42cceba6e7.source: Search the ruins of Fahranur to find where Nehbawa Wahmeh has hidden the family inheritance.
f51609ce62b531b1284c73a394be8c42cceba6e7.text: 搜索法赫拉努尔废墟，找到尼巴瓦·瓦梅 (Nehbawa Wahmeh) 隐藏家族遗产的地方。

132c9138a32195a2ec1a9226768d7a43cd26995a.source: Jedur Wahmeh must survive to recover his inheritance.
132c9138a32195a2ec1a9226768d7a43cd26995a.text: 杰杜尔·瓦梅 (Jedur Wahmeh) 必须生存下来才能收回他的遗产。

bb1f7f801d13e12383cc99513d3238ab9e237db1.source: After accepting the quest, accept Zenwa's offer to transport you to the ruins of Fahranur. Once you are there, fight your way through the undead hordes to Nehbawa Wahmeh's inheritance, which is marked by the compass point.
bb1f7f801d13e12383cc99513d3238ab9e237db1.text: 接受任务后，接受 Zenwa 的提议，将你传送到 Fahranur 废墟。到达那里后，穿过不死族群，到达尼巴瓦·瓦梅 (Nehbawa Wahmeh) 的继承地，那里有罗盘点标记。

522a93981df5f8fffa4f1f51620598a44c38a02e.source: Be careful walking around corners. Giant bells drop from above to crush the unwary.
522a93981df5f8fffa4f1f51620598a44c38a02e.text: 在拐角处行走时要小心。巨大的钟声从高处落下，碾碎粗心的人。

e83ed46137155c5d1156ba5be0108eb5e99d01a2.source: If using a survivor character, beware the boss right before the end - he can hit in excess of 150 before protection on an AL 40 target.
e83ed46137155c5d1156ba5be0108eb5e99d01a2.text: 如果使用幸存者角色，请在结束前提防 Boss - 在保护 AL 40 目标之前，他可以击中超过 150 次。

a09b7c642e234557d32f5c6b1d829b89c6e8544e.source: Once you make it to the inheritance, Jedur will retrieve it, and you will be transported back to Issnur Isles.
a09b7c642e234557d32f5c6b1d829b89c6e8544e.text: 一旦你到达了继承地，杰杜尔就会取回它，而你将被传送回伊斯努尔群岛。

ebd07cc87a0f417dd51b46a624dd8b1dc05ac765.source: If you are finding this quest difficult, start in Kodlonu Hamlet, which allows up to 8 party members and provides access to level 15 henchmen.
ebd07cc87a0f417dd51b46a624dd8b1dc05ac765.text: 如果您发现此任务很困难，请从科德洛努哈姆雷特开始，该村庄最多允许 8 名党员，并提供对 15 级追随者的访问权限。

57148ef46c09cd087d4f3cd8156e5b0fe421bcec.source: Take Koss and defend the Garden of Seborhin against the demon horde.
57148ef46c09cd087d4f3cd8156e5b0fe421bcec.text: 带领科斯，保卫塞伯林花园，对抗恶魔大军。

8baafbd13d4f6e1b83211d356cbd19530f8ff0cc.source: *BONUS* Defeat two additional Harbingers and accompanying foes.
8baafbd13d4f6e1b83211d356cbd19530f8ff0cc.text: *奖励* 击败另外两名先驱者和伴随的敌人。

f6c279885b5f9eb9d965fcefc4938a50205dce63.source: As per the Jennur's Horde mission.
f6c279885b5f9eb9d965fcefc4938a50205dce63.text: 根据詹努尔的部落任务。

fdff75b4f213c292eb16dc91cea7b1a411c21d2b.source: Kill Joffs the Mitigator in Riven Earth.
fdff75b4f213c292eb16dc91cea7b1a411c21d2b.text: 杀死裂痕大地的缓和者乔夫斯。

d15ff27541826bd3c3b850b4fa1a9b60fa5267f1.source: *BONUS* Kill Joffs the Mitigator in Hard Mode.
d15ff27541826bd3c3b850b4fa1a9b60fa5267f1.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死缓解者乔夫斯。

13bf5d7c1d9d34da6d42e4a0f895ea8c4ba97dde.source: It is highly recommended to bring enchantment removal skills as this boss will use Stoneflesh Aura and Armor of Earth, potentially reducing any damage dealt to him to 0. Also, make sure to space everyone out accordingly as this boss can wipe out your entire party with just one Shockwave if you're balled up. On the other hand, Pain Inverter can cause massive damage to him when he uses Shockwave, so consider bringing a minion master. Bringing a source of the Dazed condition (such as Broad Head Arrow) is also useful.
13bf5d7c1d9d34da6d42e4a0f895ea8c4ba97dde.text: 强烈建议带上结界移除技能，因为这个 Boss 将使用石肉光环和大地之甲，有可能将对他造成的伤害降至 0。此外，请确保将每个人都分开，因为如果你被困住了，这个 Boss 可以用一个冲击波消灭你的整个队伍。另一方面，当他使用冲击波时，疼痛反转器会对他造成巨大伤害，所以考虑带一个随从大师。携带茫然状态的来源（例如宽头箭）也很有用。

175f60d5556796a95e9d3669a28be8b2fa77c480.source: Consider bringing two minion masters. After a couple groups of Raptors you will have plenty of minions, thus making this quite easy to accomplish with the Pain Inverter strategy.
175f60d5556796a95e9d3669a28be8b2fa77c480.text: 考虑带两个随从大师。在几组猛龙队之后，你将拥有大量的小兵，因此使用痛苦反转器策略很容易实现这一点。

b5098d1c0e7ea45717bf9451833ec7d2aa21c060.source: Take Melonni to investigate the deaths of workers at the Jokanur Diggings in the ruins of Fahranur, the First City.
b5098d1c0e7ea45717bf9451833ec7d2aa21c060.text: 带着梅洛尼去调查第一城法赫拉努尔废墟中乔卡努尔矿区工人的死亡事件。

9e4e898ca9cd9ebba41f23a9047005e4318f42f2.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission with two Sunspear Ghosts left alive.
9e4e898ca9cd9ebba41f23a9047005e4318f42f2.text: *奖励* 在两名阳矛幽灵还活着的情况下完成任务。

3b536de1a6fe223eb78811e5e2c6c5811a9c16d8.source: As per the Jokanur Diggings mission.
3b536de1a6fe223eb78811e5e2c6c5811a9c16d8.text: 根据乔卡努尔矿区任务。

77ddd98e53f9694cc100513776418379bd3050e4.source: Kahdash is considered a Sunspear Ghost, so the first bonus objective is not completed if he dies. The bonus objective text should instead be Complete the mission with three Sunspear Ghosts left alive.
77ddd98e53f9694cc100513776418379bd3050e4.text: 卡达什被认为是阳矛幽灵，所以如果他死了，第一个奖励目标就不会完成。奖励目标文本应该是在三名阳矛幽灵还活着的情况下完成任务。

2577de07ed7f82e4a690a3a8fe6aea0c72e0ce95.source: Clear Joko's Domain in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
2577de07ed7f82e4a690a3a8fe6aea0c72e0ce95.text: 在困难模式下，在所有敌人的荒凉中清除乔科的领地。

7ee9bae074dd0fea22f950578107f6a5c8a7083b.source: The primary quest A Deal's a Deal is the first quest that will lead characters into this area.
7ee9bae074dd0fea22f950578107f6a5c8a7083b.text: 主要任务“一桩交易”是第一个引导角色进入该区域的任务。

d4a92395254a9a8970e8e2ceb3f29a4f5df5c397.source: This area is accessible via Basalt Grotto before completing Gate of Desolation, which introduces you to Junundu. You can reach the exits to the Remains of Sahlahja and the Shattered Ravines from here by hugging the walls and so avoiding the sulfurous sands, but this is very difficult.
d4a92395254a9a8970e8e2ceb3f29a4f5df5c397.text: 在完成荒凉之门之前，可以通过玄武岩洞进入该区域，这将向您介绍朱南杜。从这里你可以通过紧贴墙壁到达萨赫拉贾遗迹和破碎峡谷的出口，从而避开硫磺沙子，但这非常困难。

181107e8597e0c32c014970ef0d848f788043358.source: Despite the availability of the Margonite Battle bounty, there are only a handful of Margonite groups here (although you can find more depending on which quests are active).
181107e8597e0c32c014970ef0d848f788043358.text: 尽管可以获得玛贡尼特战斗赏金，但这里只有少数玛贡尼特团体（尽管你可以根据活跃的任务找到更多）。

b54d70e48c844bed5808f41427c71980e4a2f5f4.source: This area can take more time to vanquish than others, in part due to the large number of foes, but also because of their resurrection skills. Consider bringing Frozen Soil to counter this.
b54d70e48c844bed5808f41427c71980e4a2f5f4.text: 这个区域可能比其他区域需要更多的时间来征服，部分原因是敌人数量众多，但也因为他们的复活技能。考虑使用冻土来解决这个问题。

e900269e03bea14643e3c0f0abcd93085ac9ce1f.source: Arneh the Vigorous will spam Signet of Return; try to pull him within range of Junundu, after which you can kill his group faster than they can be resurrected.
e900269e03bea14643e3c0f0abcd93085ac9ce1f.text: 活力四射的阿纳会向回归徽记发送垃圾邮件；尝试将他拉到朱南杜的射程内，之后你可以比他们复活的速度更快地杀死他的团队。

311425156aee0418c7903c906940fbbf46f91e16.source: Shekoss the Stony is a lethal earth elementalist grouped with several undead, including Dune Carvers and Acolytes; spread out before engaging to avoid his Aftershock. You can pull the group apart, but you won't be able to bring them within range of Junundu.
311425156aee0418c7903c906940fbbf46f91e16.text: 石质谢科斯是一位致命的土元素师，与数名不死生物组成，其中包括沙丘雕刻师和侍僧；在交战前分散开，以避免他的余震。你可以将队伍拉开，但你无法将他们带入朱南杜的范围内。

3b0afdd78536cf4f38bc4989476a6480ad5ae748.source: Consider going for the above two bosses first and restarting if you fail to kill them without too much Death Penalty.
3b0afdd78536cf4f38bc4989476a6480ad5ae748.text: 考虑先去打上面两个boss，如果你没能在没有太多死亡惩罚的情况下杀死他们，就重新开始。

0a0b5618e542419a5740e1ee5d7bea9621538549.source: Elementals are often found in groups of five or six foes, which is more than sufficient to take out Junundu in hard mode; be prepared to retreat when necessary.
0a0b5618e542419a5740e1ee5d7bea9621538549.text: 元素生物通常以五到六个敌人为一组，这足以在困难模式下消灭朱南杜；必要时做好撤退的准备。

81d3d0c0f62975fb52eb70d6f96ae25b3834c1ba.source: Death Penalty removers can be helpful; while inside the wurms, it is easy to accumulate 30%-50% DP without noticing.
81d3d0c0f62975fb52eb70d6f96ae25b3834c1ba.text: 废除死刑可能会有所帮助；而在亚龙体内，很容易在不知不觉中积累30%-50%的DP。

2c8baf29a94d81354850d942a9345197988cc990.source: You can easily miss a group of Mandragors on a rocky island towards the east; you can reach them by heading southeast from the area below three bridges that are patrolled by insect groups and then crossing a bridge.
2c8baf29a94d81354850d942a9345197988cc990.text: 您很容易就会错过东部一座岩石岛上的一群曼陀罗鸟。你可以从三座有昆虫群巡逻的桥梁下方的区域向东南方向走，然后过一座桥就可以到达它们。

0c32b1ce5b5043b72119cfd002b8e0560937c75c.source: Undead and Margonites have potent anti-shout abilities with Vocal Minority and Well of Silence respectively, hindering shout-based builds.
0c32b1ce5b5043b72119cfd002b8e0560937c75c.text: Undead 和 Margonites 分别对 Vocal Minority 和 Well of Silence 具有强大的反喊叫能力，阻碍了基于喊叫的构建。

7629278983dc329c0f5190d4923e9dc9f1558334.source: Holy damage can be very helpful against the undead, especially from skills such as Light of Deldrimor, Heart of Holy Flame or Ray of Judgment.
7629278983dc329c0f5190d4923e9dc9f1558334.text: 神圣伤害对不死生物非常有帮助，尤其是德尔德里莫之光、神圣火焰之心或审判射线等技能。

389e2732cdfaa45cc125fd9a15ddcdbd00803ea2.source: Hex based teams will encounter Hex Eater Vortex from the Awakened Thought Leeches.
389e2732cdfaa45cc125fd9a15ddcdbd00803ea2.text: 基于妖术的队伍将遭遇来自觉醒思想水蛭的妖术吞噬者漩涡。

a80fadb7d3a2ffbd05c1ace1b1709f75bd477796.source: During the Halloween quest Open the Flood Gates of Death, you receive six Mad King's Guards as allies and the vanquish is decreased by up to 100 foes (excluding the quest foes).
a80fadb7d3a2ffbd05c1ace1b1709f75bd477796.text: 在万圣节任务打开死亡洪水之门期间，您将获得六名疯狂国王的守卫作为盟友，并且击败的敌人最多会减少 100 个（不包括任务敌人）。

66d71c98527de15bddfa8e6b17ee0a7e01248540.source: This area can still be vanquished even if you have abandoned A Deal's a Deal. However, you can not leave from Bone Palace, as the gate will remain closed.
66d71c98527de15bddfa8e6b17ee0a7e01248540.text: 即使你已经放弃了协议就协议，这个区域仍然可以被征服。但是，您无法离开骨宫，因为大门将保持关闭状态。

2b185e35fa5bb1b0b8c75d45683e1d3e95374fed.source: The Wurm Spoor outside the Bone Palace is located very close to rocky ground. Because of this, henchmen/heroes in your back row may inadvertently be ejected from their Junundu right after entering. Check that everyone is in a Junundu before moving out.
2b185e35fa5bb1b0b8c75d45683e1d3e95374fed.text: 骨宫外的亚龙足迹距离岩石地面非常近。因此，后排的追随者/英雄可能会在进入后无意中被从他们的 Junundu 中弹出。搬出前请检查是否每个人都在 Junundu 中。

f6f6e014dfe10e3c0ea81eee9692be52135e384f.source: If A Deal's a Deal is active, you may not receive credit for vanquishing even if the party defeats the last foe before triggering the cinematic.
f6f6e014dfe10e3c0ea81eee9692be52135e384f.text: 如果“一桩桩交易”处于活动状态，即使队伍在触发过场动画之前击败了最后一个敌人，您也可能不会获得征服的功劳。

bef40a35f8546bc7b967315cbd7f2c0a9e12459b.source: Kill Justiciar Thommis and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile.
bef40a35f8546bc7b967315cbd7f2c0a9e12459b.text: 杀死奴隶贩子流放地的审判官托米斯和随行的敌人。

38c6e6f24c948414f672f81b1f9b61b4755ee276.source: *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Thommis and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
38c6e6f24c948414f672f81b1f9b61b4755ee276.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死审判官托米斯和随行的敌人。

9b05d2e0c22353f9c14ad302e847bca5d54b26fb.source: Justiciar Thommis is the left most boss on the map. The Stone Summit Warders should be the first target as they have protective wards and can deal massive area of effect damage. The other main target should be Stone Summit Defenders because they have Power Drain and Waste Not, Want Not allowing them to spam protection spells as well as interrupt
9b05d2e0c22353f9c14ad302e847bca5d54b26fb.text: 审判官汤米斯是地图上最左边的 Boss。石峰守护者应该是第一个目标，因为他们有防护守卫并且可以造成大范围的效果伤害。另一个主要目标应该是石峰防御者，因为他们有能量消耗和不浪费，不想让他们发送垃圾邮件保护咒语以及打断

d7bfe0b5106d3ea89b438ebbe83373ad0b9c1404.source: Frozen Soil, as most of the Stone Summit have a resurrection skill.
d7bfe0b5106d3ea89b438ebbe83373ad0b9c1404.text: 冻土，因为大部分石峰都有复活技能。

4bf7641cfdfb039cf31ef844ccfba0d8c8712535.source: Anti-knock down, there are large mobs of Modniir on the path to Justiciar Thommis.
4bf7641cfdfb039cf31ef844ccfba0d8c8712535.text: 反击倒后，前往审判官托米斯的路上有大群莫尼尔暴徒。

1ae9a2f276c7ac7948064e3bf2d680cc05fef3d8.text: 杀死深渊中的卡纳赛伊。

757cea01749e45ff2457940641267e6bea2a78a3.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Kanaxai。

990fc732b708d369c418558e948859fbe7d8e161.source: Completing this quest requires completion of the Deep, an elite mission. See that mission's article for details.
990fc732b708d369c418558e948859fbe7d8e161.text: 完成此任务需要完成“深渊”，这是一项精英任务。有关详细信息，请参阅该任务的文章。

4dd6c6f4ab080b22026b856e6767c6cd4a49c6d1.text: 找回卡坦德拉克斯的破碎机。

2ed15598b9a0d715235812ccf316b78820cf9e41.source: Return Kathandrax's Crusher to Swithin Nye in Sacnoth Valley Missing period
2ed15598b9a0d715235812ccf316b78820cf9e41.text: 将 Kathandrax 的破碎机归还给 Sacnoth Valley 的 Swithin Nye 失踪时期

df30d7f7593313ed043617b797adb540cadc79ae.source: Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path.
df30d7f7593313ed043617b797adb540cadc79ae.text: 杀死先知之路上的凯普赫特骨髓盛宴。

d328122f527fa606d38b00e05f91911b78902c11.source: *BONUS* Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Hard Mode.
d328122f527fa606d38b00e05f91911b78902c11.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Kepkhet Marrowfeast。

ed58275d508cdf360ee9f5ff02dcc26207b4c92e.source: If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Marrow Scarabs, Minotaurs, Rockshot Devourers, and Scarab Nest Builders on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. Hex removal skills are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.
ed58275d508cdf360ee9f5ff02dcc26207b4c92e.text: 如果您沿着右侧地图中的路径前进，在前往凯普赫特骨髓盛宴的途中，您只会遇到骨髓圣甲虫、牛头怪、岩弹吞噬者和圣甲虫筑巢者。去除妖术的技能是不必要的，因为上述敌人不会施放妖术。

6d5670293789a345c6be265c05f254de946dd80d.source: Avoid using condition-inflicting skills on Marrow Scarabs, as they will use Plague Touch and then Virulence. Marrow Scarabs use Well of the Profane, so either interrupt its activation, avoid bringing enchantments with long recharge times, and/or move away from corpses before they are exploited to create a Well of the Profane.
6d5670293789a345c6be265c05f254de946dd80d.text: 避免对骨髓圣甲虫使用造成状态的技能，因为它们会使用瘟疫之触，然后使用毒力。骨髓圣甲虫使用亵渎之井，因此要么中断其激活，避免带来长时间充电的结界，和/或在尸体被利用以创建亵渎之井之前远离尸体。

ab696285e8824b85c9a99e203f2636eb91a83dd5.source: Rockshot Devourers and Scarab Nest Builders use Distracting Shot, so skills that block, inflict the blind condition, cause misses, or prevent interruption can be helpful. They also use numerous traps, so it may be a good idea to have one party member walk ahead of the party to trigger the traps and prevent the entire party from taking damage.
ab696285e8824b85c9a99e203f2636eb91a83dd5.text: 岩弹吞噬者和圣甲虫筑巢者使用分散射击，因此格挡、造成失明、造成失误或防止中断的技能会有所帮助。他们还使用许多陷阱，因此最好让一名队伍成员走在队伍前面来触发陷阱并防止整个队伍受到伤害。

2b701566e2c34b2ca32e415e971b7771f7cbd084.source: Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't popup until a party member approaches her spawn point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her energy by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity and remove Mark of Protection.
2b701566e2c34b2ca32e415e971b7771f7cbd084.text: 有时，Kepkhet Marrowfeast 一开始是隐藏的，直到队伍成员接近她的重生点后才会弹出。如果从平弓或长弓射程攻击，凯普凯特骨髓盛宴周围的圣甲虫巢穴建造者将不会移动，因此您可以在你的队伍与凯普凯特骨髓盛宴交战之前，通过治疗和保护圣甲虫巢穴建造者来导致凯普凯特骨髓盛宴耗尽她的能量。当你靠近凯普赫特骨髓盛宴时，会弹出几只骨髓圣甲虫。如果 Kepkhet Marrowfeast 对自己施放了保护印记，应用条件或咒语将导致她使用纯洁沉思并移除保护印记。

930501b3f7db0726593e1fb90e5cdbdbba0150d3.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Family Soul quest, since it also requires you to kill her.
930501b3f7db0726593e1fb90e5cdbdbba0150d3.text: 考虑与家庭灵魂任务同时完成这个任务，因为它也需要你杀死她。

7f99f97fecd93cd18bb967dcc2fe69817af53ffa.source: Clear Kessex Peak in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
7f99f97fecd93cd18bb967dcc2fe69817af53ffa.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔凯塞克斯峰上的所有敌人。

f862a677cf7969a231861ae9c1197f119cddb6e8.source: This area is harder if War in Kryta is active.
f862a677cf7969a231861ae9c1197f119cddb6e8.text: 如果科瑞塔战争正在进行，这个区域会变得更加困难。

fe3ebc1e1eb9e520670f7830e0928047a064a1e2.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Verata, Destor the Truth Seeker, Justiciar Amilyn, and/or Justiciar Marron bounties.
fe3ebc1e1eb9e520670f7830e0928047a064a1e2.text: 考虑与维拉塔、真相探索者德斯特、正义者阿米林和/或正义者马龙赏金同时完成此任务。

7b24eeb8937e6731aed15504e0c2d2fbe7c2ca4b.source: From Temple of the Ages, head south through the Black Curtain.
7b24eeb8937e6731aed15504e0c2d2fbe7c2ca4b.text: 从世纪神殿出发，向南穿过黑幕。

9cb2561de592674403fe0e3948c04f5565c68b00.source: The only resurrection shrine is at the beginning of the area.
9cb2561de592674403fe0e3948c04f5565c68b00.text: 唯一的复活神社位于该地区的开头。

d9296d765a204bbd5425843fc8541a19eac24ba3.source: Apprentices of Verata will steal party members' minions using Verata's Gaze.
d9296d765a204bbd5425843fc8541a19eac24ba3.text: 维拉塔的学徒将使用维拉塔的凝视窃取队伍成员的爪牙。

2e0028c3f5f9922ff63de2587b09852f6dcd30fb.source: The Villainy of Galrath (reduces foes by about 20)
2e0028c3f5f9922ff63de2587b09852f6dcd30fb.text: 加拉斯的恶行（减少大约 20 名敌人）

ed6087599daf0b0c487efae6fd9f7a2999323690.source: Heirlooms of the Mad King (Halloween quest)
ed6087599daf0b0c487efae6fd9f7a2999323690.text: 疯狂国王的传家宝（万圣节任务）

9cd1eb9ead738d34059c180c3667659b1d3e649c.text: {{Vanquisher|计数 = 190|低 = 156|高 = 205|笔记=有隐藏的敌人。}}

1eb30c766121cee923b8f8af894985564fd767b7.source: Many consider this area more difficult than others due to the Cult of Verata presence.
1eb30c766121cee923b8f8af894985564fd767b7.text: 由于维拉塔邪教的存在，许多人认为这个区域比其他区域更困难。

1bdbb38b25a55c4439c02ac8ab59c3e0e90ff1cd.source: Bring party members that are not dependent on line of sight; this allows for killing many of the Cult of Verata in relative safety by standing at the foot of their cliff, out of compass range from the access slope. (EVAS is great for luring enemies from even further away into to the party's range.)
1bdbb38b25a55c4439c02ac8ab59c3e0e90ff1cd.text: 携带不依赖视线的党员；这样一来，维拉塔教的许多成员就可以站在悬崖脚下，在进入斜坡的指南针范围之外，相对安全地杀死他们。 （EVAS 非常适合将敌人从更远的地方引诱到队伍的射程内。）

3438fd7a71c4f1bbb923708b1f95877982be2b98.source: With The Villainy of Galrath (not the hard mode version) active, many of the groups are converted to weaker groups of bandits, making vanquishing easier.
3438fd7a71c4f1bbb923708b1f95877982be2b98.text: 随着《加尔拉斯的恶行》（非困难模式版本）的激活，许多团体会转变为较弱的强盗团体，从而使征服变得更容易。

0680b02a5ec485f361cb9878a873d6c05d445336.source: If the War in Kryta is active, the area will also include Peacekeepers and White Mantle.
0680b02a5ec485f361cb9878a873d6c05d445336.text: 如果科瑞塔战争正在进行，该地区还将包括和平卫士和白斗篷。

a9d5a99f57651dd93d77d1d7ca193122825ecfc7.text: 杀死博格鲁特生长区的卡布斯。

978e17bdaec18e71ba6b939d21fe9f1bfdf34948.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死卡布斯。

7731971d002c1003c9a5b2f44d7315a6e5c363fb.source: The Bogroot Chest will not appear, and this quest will not update, until Khabuus and the two Ophil allies with him are defeated.
7731971d002c1003c9a5b2f44d7315a6e5c363fb.text: 博格鲁特宝箱不会出现，这个任务也不会更新，直到卡布斯和他的两个奥菲尔盟友被击败。

b3d92330085b5f98dbcb168a312586c8a653b593.source: See the Eternal Forgemaster for your reward
b3d92330085b5f98dbcb168a312586c8a653b593.text: 见永恒锻造师以获得奖励

eb43b3f2bcfe39cf6b25819334d778854f74317b.source: Follow the starburst to the Lake of Fire southeast of the Eternal Forgemaster. In the Lake of Fire area, you will run across groups of Obsidian Furnace Drakes, Smoke Walker monks, and a few Infernal Wurms. Khobay's group itself isn't hard to dispose of, but it is next to an Infernal Wurm that can be a problem due to its siege attacks. Pulling Khobay away from it, into a chasm that your team passes through, is a recommended tactic as it blocks the siege attack's line of sight.
eb43b3f2bcfe39cf6b25819334d778854f74317b.text: 跟随星爆到达永恒锻造大师东南部的火湖。在火湖区域，你会遇到成群的黑曜石熔炉龙、烟行僧和一些地狱亚龙。科贝伊的队伍本身并不难消灭，但它毗邻地狱亚龙，由于其围攻攻击可能会成为一个问题。将霍拜拉离它，进入你的团队穿过的裂缝中是推荐的策略，因为它阻挡了围攻攻击的视线。

8aaf15d03d8cc6b61851be71a5e82c48f2af6f12.text: 帮助基尔罗伊击败古尔纳尔·铁趾

3a154c0e7cf9cd1d2cf25bdbd38680a2909d0c28.source: See Kilroy Stonekin for your reward
3a154c0e7cf9cd1d2cf25bdbd38680a2909d0c28.text: 前往基尔罗伊·斯通金领取奖励

bb9914c06be58cbe65cc9856252f1cd3bd457e58.source: Find Kilroy Stonekin in Grenth's Footprint, just south west of exit from Deldrimor War Camp, and escort him to Sorrow's Furnace. Along the way you'll face a number of Stone Summit bosses, but nothing difficult. Kilroy will stay in the rear, and neither attack nor be attacked.
bb9914c06be58cbe65cc9856252f1cd3bd457e58.text: 在德尔德里莫战争营地出口西南方向的古兰斯足迹中找到基尔罗伊·斯通金，并护送他前往悲伤熔炉。一路上你会面对许多石峰首领，但没什么困难的。基尔罗伊将留在后方，既不攻击也不被攻击。

32772a533a6f73bb96c8f69fe9a1706393ce932c.source: After you enter Sorrow's Furnace and speak to Kilroy, he will begin to run ahead of you through the caverns. Your objective now is to keep him alive. If Kilroy Stonekin dies, you lose the mission and will be teleported back to Deldrimor War Camp. If you exit the Furnace without completing the quest, Kilroy gets teleported to where you first found him in Grenth's Footprint, and you'll have to start again.
32772a533a6f73bb96c8f69fe9a1706393ce932c.text: 当你进入悲伤熔炉并与基尔罗伊交谈后，他将开始在你前面穿过洞穴。你现在的目标是让他活下去。如果基尔罗伊·斯通金死亡，你就会失去任务并被传送回德尔德里莫战争营地。如果你在没有完成任务的情况下退出熔炉，基尔罗伊会被传送到你在格伦斯的足迹中第一次发现他的地方，你将不得不重新开始。

07264861476bcac97da84ec2361e3a7e9a7c9cba.source: The mobs in the Furnace are fairly easy. Just watch that the Priests of Sorrows don't resurrect the dead Stone Summit.
07264861476bcac97da84ec2361e3a7e9a7c9cba.text: 熔炉里的小怪相当容易。只要注意悲伤牧师不会复活死去的石峰即可。

0d4ed99e5972ce7c83d1e86f5c1b5c038df9c214.source: A couple of times Kilroy will start fighting without you, but mostly he'll run to the next checkpoint and wait for you to catch up to him. You normally have time to pick up loot, and, as you draw near to the next checkpoint, to check out the composition of the mob ahead and to cast enchantments before you walk up to Kilroy and start the fight. If you want to stay on the safe side, pick up loot during each battle and keep following Kilroy, who will begin to run to the next checkpoint as soon as all foes around him are dead.
0d4ed99e5972ce7c83d1e86f5c1b5c038df9c214.text: 有几次基尔罗伊会在没有你的情况下开始战斗，但大多数时候他会跑到下一个检查站并等待你追上他。你通常有时间拾取战利品，并且当你接近下一个检查站时，检查前方暴民的构成并在走到基尔罗伊并开始战斗之前施放结界。如果你想保持安全，请在每场战斗中拾取战利品并继续跟随基尔罗伊，一旦他周围的所有敌人都死了，他就会开始跑到下一个检查站。

e9b27c095b2e6ff71cb0f5f4b943e9a3d924843e.source: Selecting his name and pressing spacebar to follow comes in handy.
e9b27c095b2e6ff71cb0f5f4b943e9a3d924843e.text: 选择他的名字并按空格键进行关注很方便。

26ff5f6fa68d5670f447d97f4b5b454283d5c3ba.source: In the final part of this quest, there will be three mobs facing you. Stay with Kilroy — he'll run for the monk boss, Gulnar Irontoe.
26ff5f6fa68d5670f447d97f4b5b454283d5c3ba.text: 在这个任务的最后部分，你将面对三个小怪。留在基尔罗伊身边——他将竞选僧侣老大古尔纳尔·艾恩托。

255efad5c61d46aa2dfc51c50809dd036cfd10e7.source: When Kilroy stops at his "checkpoints" and waits for you to catch up, it is possible to sneak past him, thus allowing your party to eliminate remaining enemies (including Irontoe) without him engaging.
255efad5c61d46aa2dfc51c50809dd036cfd10e7.text: 当基尔罗伊停在他的“检查站”并等待你追上时，你可以偷偷溜过他，从而让你的队伍在没有他参与的情况下消灭剩余的敌人（包括铁趾）。

6bfdd41a4dac4ae98d95a38a1dd9bdaad5f91f5c.source: At three times during this quest, an unlocked chest will spawn. Opening it will reveal one to three purple items assigned to random party members within compass range.
6bfdd41a4dac4ae98d95a38a1dd9bdaad5f91f5c.text: 在此任务期间，会出现三次解锁的箱子。打开它会显示一到三个紫色物品，分配给罗盘范围内的随机队伍成员。

ee72641346b1524f3db781b0c4b5d40f5f6b3a6d.source: This is a fairly easy repeatable quest with a 3,000 experience reward. Characters farming the Survivor title without other players may use this quest for cheap, easy experience. Note that sometime the hardest part of this quest can be getting from Kilroy in Grenth's Footprint into Sorrow's Furnace. Having good running and survival skills can be critical during this part.
ee72641346b1524f3db781b0c4b5d40f5f6b3a6d.text: 这是一个相当简单的可重复任务，有 3,000 经验奖励。在没有其他玩家的情况下获得幸存者头衔的角色可以使用此任务来获得廉价、简单的体验。请注意，有时此任务最困难的部分可能是从古兰斯足迹中的基尔罗伊进入悲伤熔炉。在这一部分中，拥有良好的跑步和生存技能至关重要。

a116026fe08371b2238b5d61322cc9e784969015.source: Speak to Kilroy when you are ready to hunt for Fronis Irontoe.
a116026fe08371b2238b5d61322cc9e784969015.text: 当你准备好寻找弗罗尼斯·艾恩托时，与基尔罗伊交谈。

2894ace3718b1a1276ba665713a066a23edfc38c.source: Accompany Kilroy. Find and defeat Fronis Irontoe using nothing but brass knuckles.
2894ace3718b1a1276ba665713a066a23edfc38c.text: 陪伴基尔罗伊。仅使用指节铜套即可找到并击败弗罗尼斯·铁趾。

ceb3eb22911c56ff1ea876d6104c312fe18850aa.source: See Kilroy Stonekin for your reward.
ceb3eb22911c56ff1ea876d6104c312fe18850aa.text: 去找基尔罗伊·斯通金领取奖励。
