5569a3ff131320d99d3b5f3c75f96e1d3f181874.text: 这些 Shing Jea 岛任务将影响该区域的生成：

43d31fbab73cfbe01d9b87988a232189efe7856d.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 3.3% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
43d31fbab73cfbe01d9b87988a232189efe7856d.text: 对该区域的完整探索将为 Canthan Cartographer 主打歌带来约 3.3% 的收益。

53715655870e937b5bc4e0cd3cc7742ed9c859d2.source: Kappa and Crimson Skull are hostile to each other, though their patrols only overlap in a small area.
53715655870e937b5bc4e0cd3cc7742ed9c859d2.text: 河童和红骷髅彼此敌对，尽管它们的巡逻范围只在一小部分区域重叠。

3ac5d50822da642e7d1d4e701fbf75a98a165948.source: Skills like Shelter, Union, Shield of Absorption, and Protective Spirit are highly recommended as this area is populated by numerous Elementalists and damage-dealing Ritualists.
3ac5d50822da642e7d1d4e701fbf75a98a165948.text: 强烈推荐庇护所、联盟、吸收之盾和保护精神等技能，因为该区域居住着众多元素师和造成伤害的仪式师。

d95e1f107119913afb57734a6656092fb20dfd40.source: The vast majority of damage dealt by foes in this area comes from projectile attacks and/or projectile spells. Conveniently, the area's naturally hilly/mountainous terrain makes it very easy to break line of sight.
d95e1f107119913afb57734a6656092fb20dfd40.text: 该区域的敌人造成的绝大多数伤害来自投射物攻击和/或投射物法术。该地区自然的丘陵/山区地形非常方便，很容易破坏视线。

1b1055a16bbe435e53a8d19b1d961c543b83e7d1.source: Mantra of Frost and Mantra of Lightning are also very effective in this area due to the prevalence of cold and lightning damage.
1b1055a16bbe435e53a8d19b1d961c543b83e7d1.text: 由于寒冷和雷电伤害的普遍存在，冰霜真言和雷电真言在该地区也非常有效。

85ddc7d79551162e4b1c22b88fab7465bb57bf69.source: Without active quests the area east of the Tsumei Village entrance doesn't have any enemies.
85ddc7d79551162e4b1c22b88fab7465bb57bf69.text: 如果没有主动任务，津名村入口以东的区域没有任何敌人。

bf7ea8d77962c8399816403b45692b35df21690b.source: A hidden Naga group in Raiyan Cave will spawn if one ventures close to the waterline at the southern edge of the cave.
bf7ea8d77962c8399816403b45692b35df21690b.text: 如果有人冒险靠近洞穴南缘的水线，就会在莱岩洞中生成隐藏的纳迦族群。

cacd781a30e7ae95b9457ac187c5b617e77324c0.source: A hidden pair of Kappa will appear if one ventures along the beach immediately north of Pei the Skull Blade's ship. There's another hidden Kappa group south of Kaitan Village, on the sandy beach.
cacd781a30e7ae95b9457ac187c5b617e77324c0.text: 如果沿着骷髅刀佩伊船北边的海滩冒险，就会出现一对隐藏的河童。在凯坦村以南的沙滩上还有另一个隐藏的河童群。

21a8695aee592088f2150367c68208469bec8688.source: Naga groups will also appear if one traverses the water along the western edge.
21a8695aee592088f2150367c68208469bec8688.text: 如果沿着西边穿过水域，纳迦族群也会出现。

56f7faf7478653ccc025c450e4ccedb78d1b2630.source: Starting from the resurrection shrine along the southern edge west of Raiyan Cave, and at several points along the path towards and around Port Kaimu, are many hidden groups of Crimson Skull. At least one of the hidden groups at Port Kaimu may be required to be killed in order for the vanquish to complete.
56f7faf7478653ccc025c450e4ccedb78d1b2630.text: 从雷岩洞以西南缘的复活神殿开始，在通往凯姆港及其周围的道路上的几个地点，有许多隐藏的猩红骷髅群。为了完成征服，可能需要至少杀死凯姆港的一个隐藏组织。

4a664393e8eac8e8c0126c282f01a52876c7b9a4.source: There are two hidden Lesser Oni in this area:
4a664393e8eac8e8c0126c282f01a52876c7b9a4.text: 该区域有两个隐藏的小鬼：

b71eeed76fa1ec705d90563c874b870e892f7334.source: Along the curving mountain path west of Losai Hapatu, the Kappa Shell collector.
b71eeed76fa1ec705d90563c874b870e892f7334.text: 沿着卡帕贝壳收藏家洛赛·哈帕图 (Losai Hapatu) 以西的弯曲山路前进。

9d078d7b6ed22b5ccc1519eda039857d86ee8c2b.source: The Lesser Oni that spawns west of Losai Hapatu has to be killed to complete the vanquish even when it is still hidden.
9d078d7b6ed22b5ccc1519eda039857d86ee8c2b.text: 必须杀死在洛赛哈帕图以西生成的小鬼才能完成征服，即使它仍然处于隐藏状态。

32f30b82dc8ef99ec97a5510fdfe7bfb3ca6d4c2.source: Vanquishing during Darkness at Kaitan (during the Dragon Festival) produces some spawn changes.
32f30b82dc8ef99ec97a5510fdfe7bfb3ca6d4c2.text: 在黑暗中击败凯坦（龙节期间）会产生一些生成变化。

c76e3bd5466eef4e03ca4f74e00556e93123544a.source: Naga groups spawn in the village, in groups of five.
c76e3bd5466eef4e03ca4f74e00556e93123544a.text: 纳迦族群在村庄中生成，每五个一组。

1aedb151063f9e420bfb8b099ea2f84178211b9e.source: Raiyan Cave is filled with groups of 1-2 Lesser Grasps.
1aedb151063f9e420bfb8b099ea2f84178211b9e.text: Raiyan Cave 充满了 1-2 个小型抓握者组。

552a3b55fdb8a19a32b70f9abe693d392319a1b5.source: The "s"-shaped area east of the bridge on the southern edge of the map is empty - this eliminates several closely packed groups of Crimson Skull.
552a3b55fdb8a19a32b70f9abe693d392319a1b5.text: 地图南缘桥以东的“s”形区域是空的——这消除了几组紧密排列的猩红骷髅。

d010d567c2984583eea3152eabbea818f385b514.source: Overall, the result is a slight reduction in the total number of foes.
d010d567c2984583eea3152eabbea818f385b514.text: 总体而言，结果是敌人总数略有减少。

efc65d806bcf2c6d804fc239afa52a91221b0805.source: Vanquishing during Togo's Ultimatum will affect the spawns in this area.
efc65d806bcf2c6d804fc239afa52a91221b0805.text: 在多哥最后通牒期间的胜利将会影响该区域的生成。

4bf91a6e1b2f4bf072649c3c44e699a815719830.source: The Crimson Skull at the harbor will not turn hostile and Cho Wei the Skull Axe does not spawn.
4bf91a6e1b2f4bf072649c3c44e699a815719830.text: 港口的猩红骷髅不会变得敌对，骷髅斧 Cho Wei 也不会生成。

0d2df786eca5b8521fae5873d281e8061d4c7a4a.source: The bridge after the "s"-like mountain will not have Crimson Skull popup.
0d2df786eca5b8521fae5873d281e8061d4c7a4a.text: “s”状山后面的桥不会弹出猩红骷髅。

e38f52c6fad42923b7b9c511d84be355d590b6d4.source: Leaving from Kaineng City, head directly southeast through Bukdek Byway and cross the bridge to receive the quest from Minister Tahlen, then talk to Minister Khannai who is nearby. Map travel to The Marketplace, exit south into Wajjun Bazaar and talk to Minister Baasong who is just outside the portal. Head back through the marketplace to the northeast over the bridge to talk to Minister Onghsang. Map travel to Nahpui Quarter (outpost) and exit north into Wajjun Bazaar, following the last quest marker to talk to Guardsman Pah to receive the quest reward.
e38f52c6fad42923b7b9c511d84be355d590b6d4.text: 从凯能城出发，直接向东南方向穿过Bukdek Byway，过桥即可接到塔伦部长的任务，然后与附近的卡奈部长交谈。地图前往市场，向南出口进入 Wajjun Bazaar，并与门户外的巴松部长交谈。穿过市场向东北方向走，过桥与 Onghsang 部长交谈。地图旅行到Nahpui Quarter（前哨站），然后向北进入Wajjun Bazaar，沿着最后一个任务标记与Guardsman Pah交谈以获得任务奖励。

7ee29a7bc24342e1e2835f1a016efc8063d7cdfd.source: Clear Perdition Rock in the Ring of Fire Islands of all enemies in hard mode.
7ee29a7bc24342e1e2835f1a016efc8063d7cdfd.text: 在困难模式下清除火环群岛中所有敌人的毁灭岩。

74a35a9522c90e514aafdd84e43821e73c59f0ee.source: The Final Blow primary quest will take characters through this area on their way to the next mission outpost.
74a35a9522c90e514aafdd84e43821e73c59f0ee.text: “最后一击”的主要任务将带领角色穿过这个区域，前往下一个任务前哨站。

69bd774bc654640c6d73d5c7cba35edfe7f6c422.source: You can get the Volcanic Rock for the Black Moa Chick from the northeast part of this area.
69bd774bc654640c6d73d5c7cba35edfe7f6c422.text: 您可以从该地区的东北部为黑恐鸟雏鸡获取火山岩。

d542b73a1617e09f70941d7c0e2c9c8fc0bc7e7b.source: Watch out for Mahgo Hydras with their Meteor Shower. They can also do massive damage through other fire skills.
d542b73a1617e09f70941d7c0e2c9c8fc0bc7e7b.text: 留意玛戈九头蛇的流星雨。他们还可以通过其他火焰技能造成巨大伤害。

58915f3f676dae996e2b100dae385ec0e3a90dbf.source: Martial Professions will want to bring a way to deal with Blind as Phantoms pop up throughout the zone.
58915f3f676dae996e2b100dae385ec0e3a90dbf.text: 当幻影在整个区域中突然出现时，武术职业将希望找到一种方法来对付盲人。

2f121b8fc0aa9ad3a35469eeecbf498c51386840.source: Caster Professions will also want to bring a way to deal with Interrupts as Phantoms carry 3 with one of them being Cry of Frustration which is an area of effect interrupt.
2f121b8fc0aa9ad3a35469eeecbf498c51386840.text: 施法者职业也希望带来一种处理中断的方法，因为幻影有 3 个中断，其中一个是挫败之声，这是一个效果中断区域。

db004da77f6926a4d017adb83bc7b29c705d9374.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.2% to the Tyrian Cartographer title track.
db004da77f6926a4d017adb83bc7b29c705d9374.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Tyrian Cartographer 主打歌贡献了约 1.2%。

dc311f7e0d98275b9a6b9a5405a35df931a043a2.source: There are less foes after accepting the quest reward for Final Blow.
dc311f7e0d98275b9a6b9a5405a35df931a043a2.text: 接受“最后一击”的任务奖励后，敌人会减少。

97717e0e7a729b072012ecc01e6192d74cdf8dd9.source: Having Proof of Triumph in the inventory will make a further group with Abaddon's Cursed spawn.
97717e0e7a729b072012ecc01e6192d74cdf8dd9.text: 在库存中拥有胜利证明将与阿巴顿的诅咒生成进一步组成一组。

278d012baa12752babdff026bde6d0255632abde.source: Not all of the elite skills are available for capture in any one instance of the map.
278d012baa12752babdff026bde6d0255632abde.text: 并非所有精英技能都可以在地图的任何一个实例中捕获。

e87a80f315924fc661d7e10a6efc61f4f89493d3.source: Not all bosses listed above will spawn in the same map instance. Generally, only one boss will spawn at each spawn point.
e87a80f315924fc661d7e10a6efc61f4f89493d3.text: 并非上面列出的所有 Boss 都会在同一个地图实例中生成。一般来说，每个生成点只会生成一个 Boss。

8821a4bb0b2da1e4c8172283f043563cc07f64fe.source: Any spawn point may spawn more than one boss.
8821a4bb0b2da1e4c8172283f043563cc07f64fe.text: 任何生成点都可能生成多个 Boss。

84814ada5c7bd2ef5de2dfd3ffae46f79592c061.source: Occasionally no boss spawns at a spawn point for Abomination or Ghost bosses.
84814ada5c7bd2ef5de2dfd3ffae46f79592c061.text: 有时，憎恶或幽灵 Boss 的生成点不会生成 Boss。

de61a2976e3295684528f1da845700c176e7fce8.source: Sometimes, not all of the Phantom bosses will spawn.
de61a2976e3295684528f1da845700c176e7fce8.text: 有时，并非所有幻影 Boss 都会生成。

c12405eea2ae2cad33406165ff89864a112869c6.source: Harn and Maxine Coldstone will not spawn in the same instance.
c12405eea2ae2cad33406165ff89864a112869c6.text: 哈恩和玛克辛·科尔斯通不会在同一实例中生成。

66013d2fc56230fb8bb4a0f1263a63121419b853.source: Since there are four spawn points shared by the Ettin boss and two Hydra bosses, one of the spawn points will be empty.
66013d2fc56230fb8bb4a0f1263a63121419b853.text: 由于埃丁 Boss 和两个九头蛇 Boss 共享四个重生点，因此其中一个重生点将为空。

b9c09d9ef345f75f99580d52ed0dee093139c5ee.source: An easy way to capture the elite skills of the Ghost and Abomination bosses is to exit from Ember Light Camp and then run to the first boss location to the east (one or two bosses will spawn there). If the boss you are looking for is not there then rezone. This could take many tries since there are 5 Abominations and 3 Phantom bosses and their spawn is random.
b9c09d9ef345f75f99580d52ed0dee093139c5ee.text: 捕获幽灵和憎恶 Boss 精英技能的一个简单方法是从 Ember Light Camp 退出，然后跑到东边的第一个 Boss 位置（那里会生成一个或两个 Boss）。如果你要找的老板不在，那就重新分区。这可能需要多次尝试，因为有 5 个憎恶和 3 个幻影 Boss，而且它们的生成是随机的。

cc6a27e5b6dcd2f592876d057620eb3315e4c57b.source: Travel to Shing Jea Monastery and get a kappa trap for Farmer Zinhao.
cc6a27e5b6dcd2f592876d057620eb3315e4c57b.text: 前往Shing Jea寺并为农民Zinhao获取河童陷阱。

9de49f3e3088ce9c3bda4d5f274a59b97ad4dbf7.source: See Farmer Zinhao for your reward.

206b51237196958a7ff9699f312798910169e2bf.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Suhkaro. Return to Farmer Zinhao in Panjiang Peninsula for your reward. He may not be present, if you have already got an active quest in the area.
206b51237196958a7ff9699f312798910169e2bf.text: 地图前往Shing Jea 寺并与Suhkaro 交谈。返回盘江半岛的农民子豪那里领取奖励。如果你已经在该地区有一个活跃的任务，他可能不在场。

473421a99226999681e54af3bca80df07b5a1d31.source: Escort the ghost Ganji to the spot Krahm fell.
473421a99226999681e54af3bca80df07b5a1d31.text: 护送幽灵甘吉到克拉姆坠落的地方。

0f5d003e7286aa04464c4d5814d833ec4f177369.source: Guide the wandering spirits to Allura's last resting place.
0f5d003e7286aa04464c4d5814d833ec4f177369.text: 引导流浪的灵魂前往阿鲁拉最后的安息之地。

9a26f273a7345cf50edd0d0683a3a1f4df3d5e3a.source: Walk to the spot where Shandara and her daughter were lost.
9a26f273a7345cf50edd0d0683a3a1f4df3d5e3a.text: 走到珊达拉和她女儿失踪的地方。

06e48b46f11c8adf7486d90fcf3bd106ce337acf.source: Reunite the spirits with Shahin to complete the pilgrimage.
06e48b46f11c8adf7486d90fcf3bd106ce337acf.text: 让灵魂与沙欣重聚，完成朝圣之旅。

1822cd03bbd8ee0f34c47b78447ea6975238d032.source: Upon completing this quest, Allura, Ganji, Krahm, Shahin, and Shandara will be placed outside Augury Rock, finally completing their Pilgrimage.
1822cd03bbd8ee0f34c47b78447ea6975238d032.text: 完成此任务后，Allura、Ganji、Krahm、Shahin 和 Shandara 将被放置在占卜岩外，最终完成他们的朝圣之旅。

12bdae4865952ec6f7dda3c7ed2d7133a3638ead.source: Ganji is in The Ruptured Heart near the southwestern exit into the Alkali Pan. After you accepted the quest, just follow the quest markers. To complete the last objective and reach Shahin you need a Junundu. There is a Wurm Spoor southeast from the quest marker (right of the writing "The Ruptured Heart"). Alternatively just follow the path on the map.
12bdae4865952ec6f7dda3c7ed2d7133a3638ead.text: 甘吉位于破碎之心，靠近碱锅西南出口。接受任务后，只需按照任务标记进行即可。要完成最后一个目标并到达沙欣，您需要朱南杜。在任务标记的东南方向（写着“破碎的心”的右侧）有一个亚龙足迹。或者，只需沿着地图上的路径行驶即可。

81155803081023243df95e70fd5221e3c46d9761.source:
* Elonian (Nightfall) character
* Guild Wars factions on the account
* Mhenlo's Request neither active nor completed You must also have completed and accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh
81155803081023243df95e70fd5221e3c46d9761.text:
* Elonian（夜幕降临）角色
* 帐户上的激战派系
* Mhenlo 的请求既未激活也未完成 您还必须已完成并接受《时机已到》的奖励

064ce4136e5597e0b87bf12c8613e4f958ae3247.source: Speak to Funwa Shento in Kamadan, Jewel of Istan to be directed to Mhenlo.
064ce4136e5597e0b87bf12c8613e4f958ae3247.text: 与伊斯坦之珠卡马丹的芬瓦·神托交谈，即可前往门洛。

1333d681585d4e127707e996aa379397d74d7050.source: Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn about what is occurring in Cantha.
1333d681585d4e127707e996aa379397d74d7050.text: 与领事馆码头的 Mhenlo 交谈，了解 Cantha 正在发生的事情。

818b6779b3b34f4122efd7bb92593eaa0a263c58.source: Tell Mhenlo when you are ready to leave for Cantha.
818b6779b3b34f4122efd7bb92593eaa0a263c58.text: 当您准备好前往 Cantha 时，告诉 Mhenlo。

6987b118968f1ad50d2f48bfbf2c0744f27532ec.source: Find Dockhand Quangnai to learn more about the situation in Cantha.
6987b118968f1ad50d2f48bfbf2c0744f27532ec.text: 找到Dockhand Quangnai，了解更多关于Cantha的情况。

a403d5bf6ba2c7bc36b35d0a4deaaadfdf9ca79a.source: Just follow the radar indicators. There will be no fights in this quest. Although this can be done solo, players may want to bring lower level heroes to make the most of the experience received.
a403d5bf6ba2c7bc36b35d0a4deaaadfdf9ca79a.text: 只需遵循雷达指示器即可。这个任务中不会有战斗。虽然这可以单独完成，但玩家可能希望带上较低级别的英雄来充分利用获得的经验。

18abfeab58fc05ef9069cb721d5a2baaf03738b6.source: This quest unlocks Kaineng City port (once you have arrived at Bejunkan Pier).
18abfeab58fc05ef9069cb721d5a2baaf03738b6.text: 此任务解锁凯能城港口（一旦您到达贝琼坎码头）。

95af3cb133323f5e29c51dbcc74cc813b79feb53.text: 与 Mhenlo 的请求相互排斥。

3e0be1cf3edc3d2eff6a40c139607a1e9f1d45ce.source: A Nightfall character with this quest can ferry characters of any level (from any Campaign) to Cantha, provided that they have the Consulate Docks unlocked (i.e. by either having completed The Time is Nigh themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).
3e0be1cf3edc3d2eff6a40c139607a1e9f1d45ce.text: 执行此任务的夜幕角色可以将任何级别的角色（来自任何战役）运送到 Cantha，前提是他们已解锁领事馆码头（即，自己完成了“时日将至”，或者之前通过该任务从卡马丹收到了前往码头的渡轮）。

609498be0129c8398efc763ecf8670f8da39b8d3.source: You can be taken to Benjunkan Pier by Mhenlo multiple times without restarting the quest and even after accepting the reward. There is no reason to keep this quest in your log.
609498be0129c8398efc763ecf8670f8da39b8d3.text: 即使在接受奖励后，您也可以被 Mhenlo 多次带到 Benjunkan 码头，而无需重新启动任务。没有理由将此任务保留在您的日志中。

293cb7bff64bd5df89d3d0143ddd3fcf49489d89.source: Ferried characters can map travel to Kaineng Center right away and do not have to walk there.
293cb7bff64bd5df89d3d0143ddd3fcf49489d89.text: 乘坐渡轮的角色可以立即绘制前往凯能中心的旅行地图，而不必步行前往那里。

f44814415e4ba8af233324e339a8678e03417d45.source: In order to take the follow-up quest, Welcome to Cantha, you must either accept the reward for this quest or abandon it. You can also skip Welcome to Cantha if you are ferried into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) by another character with that quest.
f44814415e4ba8af233324e339a8678e03417d45.text: 为了接受后续任务“欢迎来到凯珊”，您必须接受此任务的奖励或放弃它。如果你被另一个执行该任务的角色带到维祖纳广场（外国区），你也可以跳过欢迎来到凯珊。

77636dc19a79c522d51986e077da6139bd30cdfc.source: Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in Raven's Point.
77636dc19a79c522d51986e077da6139bd30cdfc.text: 杀死乌鸦角的毁灭瘟疫和伴随的敌人。

ff365da808ea5647ada9f0af2f384b89d169e5af.source: *BONUS* Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
ff365da808ea5647ada9f0af2f384b89d169e5af.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死毁灭瘟疫和伴随的敌人。

bdeb553cf58a65123adb2213d3b9a626b5939f87.source: As per Defending the Breach. Note that unlike that quest, you have to defeat all the Destroyers in the final room to finish this (as with spawning the chest).
bdeb553cf58a65123adb2213d3b9a626b5939f87.text: 根据捍卫违规行为。请注意，与该任务不同的是，您必须击败最后一个房间中的所有毁灭者才能完成此任务（与生成箱子一样）。

3ef70cbb4786a4f86d558c5503b5e3caae8cb087.source: Kill the heket in the Garden of Seborhin. You have X of 10 groups remaining.
3ef70cbb4786a4f86d558c5503b5e3caae8cb087.text: 杀死塞伯林花园中的赫克特。您还剩下 X 个组，共 10 个组。

393809625ea740e23a1b60264c60fcfe080e4bc8.source: See Horticulturist Hinon for your reward.
393809625ea740e23a1b60264c60fcfe080e4bc8.text: 向园艺师 Hinon 寻求奖励。

447bc6eb56de093ea4ceef60d4e14f3bf49a7d5c.source: This quest is a simple process of following the pointer to each group of heket, and eliminating them. These heket groups are in addition to those that normally spawn in this area. These new groups are located around or inside the garden compound. The plague cannot be done when the garden is under nightfall so do it before you trigger that or after you have completed the campaign.
447bc6eb56de093ea4ceef60d4e14f3bf49a7d5c.text: 这个任务是一个简单的过程，沿着指针找到每组heket，然后消除它们。这些 heket 群体不属于通常在该区域生成的群体。这些新的群体位于花园大院周围或内部。当花园在夜幕降临时，瘟疫无法发生，所以在触发瘟疫之前或完成战役之后进行。

1a4166e7d37e8d4c60fd0471576857b30de86779.source: After receiving the quest, it's a good idea to speak to the Vabbian Scout nearby, since he has a Heket Hunt blessing which will earn sunspear promotion points for any player taking it.
1a4166e7d37e8d4c60fd0471576857b30de86779.text: 收到任务后，最好与附近的瓦比安侦察兵交谈，因为他有赫克特狩猎祝福，任何接受它的玩家都会获得阳矛晋升积分。

c17ae886e12e170cb2e9401b50e9c874da780b26.source: This quest cannot be completed in Nightfallen Jahai. If Nightfall has occurred, you must complete the campaign before completing this quest.
c17ae886e12e170cb2e9401b50e9c874da780b26.text: 该任务无法在堕夜者贾海完成。如果夜幕降临，您必须在完成此任务之前完成战役。

a092b847bc4cf41085c892623446ddcb9cd24410.source: Clear the Plains of Jarin in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
a092b847bc4cf41085c892623446ddcb9cd24410.text: 在困难模式下清除伊斯坦贾林平原上的所有敌人。

f7b82e0b1ce4532480f1374cc958b40f1daff751.source: The Plains of Jarin connects Kamadan and three other outposts. Leaving Kamadan for the first time using the northwestern exit will bring players here. A variety of quests available in Kamadan and the Sunspear Great Hall lead to and take place here.
f7b82e0b1ce4532480f1374cc958b40f1daff751.text: 贾林平原连接卡马丹和其他三个前哨基地。第一次从西北出口离开卡马丹会将玩家带到这里。卡马丹和阳矛大厅中的各种任务都会通向并发生在这里。

613785bb545c3bd8edb997f450296787409cfeb8.source: The Juvenile Bladed Termites are passive. There's a large group of them in the western waters. Watch out for the lone hostile Irontooth Drake in their midst.
613785bb545c3bd8edb997f450296787409cfeb8.text: 幼年叶片白蚁是被动的。西部海域有一大群。小心他们中间孤独的敌对铁牙幼龙。

b4c33032003e851718ebf3b7d40b74281a95f56f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.7% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
b4c33032003e851718ebf3b7d40b74281a95f56f.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.7%。

e25f9e617ed095783d39b76be0e2fb0d52c80233.source: Be careful with the hidden mandragor groups near Tarom Rockbreaker; the boss itself is part of a hidden group.
e25f9e617ed095783d39b76be0e2fb0d52c80233.text: 小心Tarom Rockbreaker附近隐藏的曼德拉草群；老板本身就是一个隐藏团体的一部分。

fdd67b426b8167b5ca513af238d3fe0536edc335.source: This area will yield about 1,800 Sunspear Promotion Points with all bounties. When vanquishing with non-Elonian characters this area will offer Istani bounties as long as you are below Sunspear rank 6. A Land of Heroes is the easier method for non-Elonian characters to reach rank 6.
fdd67b426b8167b5ca513af238d3fe0536edc335.text: 该区域将产生约 1,800 个阳矛晋升点以及所有赏金。当击败非 Elonian 角色时，只要您低于 Sunspear 等级 6，该区域就会提供 Istani 赏金。英雄之地是非 Elonian 角色达到等级 6 的更简单方法。

7242f0b64c2a3e9db2f9f753e08eb82a5371a44e.source: If the quest Zaishen Elite is active, you must defeat the two Acolytes to successfully vanquish the area.
7242f0b64c2a3e9db2f9f753e08eb82a5371a44e.text: 如果“再神精英”任务处于活动状态，您必须击败两名侍僧才能成功征服该地区。

8dd40d22268d3a8d225782b9b48e8d90b7866b2e.source: The festival quest White Mist adds three allied Humbugs to your team.
8dd40d22268d3a8d225782b9b48e8d90b7866b2e.text: 节日任务“白雾”为您的团队添加了三名骗子盟友。

3642909f5d938d2f81c1d20422977245d8e58153.source: It is possible to vanquish this area with a party of eight members. See Kamadan, Jewel of Istan notes for details.
3642909f5d938d2f81c1d20422977245d8e58153.text: 八人小队就有可能征服这个地区。有关详细信息，请参阅卡马丹，伊斯坦宝石注释。

5bc939e12cccce17a7288d19a0cb19d57ee79269.source: It is also possible to get a party of eight members from the Sunspear Great Hall under the same conditions after completing Blacktide Den mission.
5bc939e12cccce17a7288d19a0cb19d57ee79269.text: 完成黑潮巢穴任务后，同样条件下也可以从阳矛大厅获得八人小队。

ba38c2bb0a1fd9af6cb44d3574d252ffe3c173ec.source: Meet Vael at the rendezvous point in Grothmar Wardowns.
ba38c2bb0a1fd9af6cb44d3574d252ffe3c173ec.text: 在格罗斯玛战争的集合点与瓦尔会面。

ab47e72a5559b18393db20e7e1a53591d90b5253.source: Get into position and wait for Vael to create a diversion. Do not alert the Charr in the camp to your presence.
ab47e72a5559b18393db20e7e1a53591d90b5253.text: 就位并等待瓦尔制造牵制。不要提醒营地里的夏尔你的存在。

fd6dd02f8db558c021ba2b1af65d2d7b3a4e8e89.source: Run in and steal the plans while Vael keeps the Charr busy.
fd6dd02f8db558c021ba2b1af65d2d7b3a4e8e89.text: 瓦尔让夏尔忙得不可开交，跑进去窃取计划。

2d19c3f34ac6e9568f867045f541c923b3aa76d3.source: Take the plans back to Captain Langmar.
2d19c3f34ac6e9568f867045f541c923b3aa76d3.text: 将计划带回给朗玛船长。

8d25b53cdfaf9f4a5120b10c50abbf3d81167f44.source: Don't forget the plans! (If the plans are dropped.)
8d25b53cdfaf9f4a5120b10c50abbf3d81167f44.text: 不要忘记计划！ （如果计划被放弃。）

a4c90a885766d969727b35b291dccf4318a29f18.source: If zoning in with a party member who has never spoken to Vael:
a4c90a885766d969727b35b291dccf4318a29f18.text: 如果与从未与瓦尔交谈过的党员进行分区：

fe0f0ca63d2bf57b8e6f4537c1eb8e87bdbff844.source: Vael is not ready to undertake the covert mission. He has still not made himself known to one of your party members.
fe0f0ca63d2bf57b8e6f4537c1eb8e87bdbff844.text: 瓦尔还没有准备好执行秘密任务。他还没有让你们的一名党员知道他的身份。

026f899d81a86fd7d6e123bd97521468e7a62f4b.source: If zoning in with a party member who has spoken to Vael but has not completed Be Very, Very Quiet...:
026f899d81a86fd7d6e123bd97521468e7a62f4b.text: 如果与已与瓦尔交谈过但尚未完成“非常非常安静”的党员划入分区...：

4d9f4ddadcfcaa22192ace50a779d8be56136e13.source: Vael is not ready to undertake the covert mission. He is busy following a suspicious looking Charr. Help your party member discover what that Charr is up to, and then Vael will be ready to raid the Charr camp for plans.
4d9f4ddadcfcaa22192ace50a779d8be56136e13.text: 瓦尔还没有准备好执行秘密任务。他正忙着跟踪可疑的夏尔。帮助你的队员发现夏尔在做什么，然后瓦尔将准备好突袭夏尔营地以寻求计划。

9d2fa347aa4ab524cad3a3373a103e5915457681.source: After speaking with Vael, the party waits on a bluff close by while he runs to the Charr camp and lures them away. A large group will follow Vael once he challenges them, wait a few seconds and a lingering group of four or more Charr will run out after them. Once the Charr have left, the Battle Plans are easily attainable. Return them to Captain Langmar for the reward.
9d2fa347aa4ab524cad3a3373a103e5915457681.text: 与瓦尔交谈后，队伍在附近的悬崖上等待，而他则跑到夏尔营地并引诱他们离开。一旦维尔挑战他们，一大群人就会跟随他，等几秒钟，四人或更多的夏尔就会追上他们。一旦夏尔离开，作战计划就很容易实现。将它们归还给朗玛船长以获得奖励。

a26c762073ccaa5d8bf2dd257c53aec0b31b496e.source: Note that the Battle Plans are a bundle item, and that you will not be able to map travel back to Longeye's Ledge without losing it. Also, don't wait too long, because those Charr do come back.
a26c762073ccaa5d8bf2dd257c53aec0b31b496e.text: 请注意，作战计划是捆绑物品，如果不丢失它，您将无法在地图上返回长眼壁架。另外，不要等太久，因为那些夏尔确实会回来。

20709ab371330aec01b7ccaee8f80911aa983786.source: Avoid lingering in the camp too long as the Charr will return shortly.
20709ab371330aec01b7ccaee8f80911aa983786.text: 避免在营地逗留太久，因为夏尔很快就会回来。

644d752c4c2e1d40f77661730544b1257c99c8b7.source: There is usually a Locked Chest in the camp near the plans.
644d752c4c2e1d40f77661730544b1257c99c8b7.text: 营地中靠近计划的地方通常有一个上锁的箱子。

d158f62236c238777a2b8e4b80133926c5767ef4.source: The Battle Plans can be carried while in Siege Devourer form, but the Devourer's standard ranged spacebar attack cannot be used.
d158f62236c238777a2b8e4b80133926c5767ef4.text: 攻城吞噬者形态下可以携带战斗计划，但吞噬者的标准远程空格键攻击无法使用。

606523ffed4a77e5daaf1c128a9e78a3943f1c3a.source: Vael will sometimes get stuck, and not lure the Charr as the quest suggests. If this occurs, simply zone in and out of nearby Sacnoth Valley and try talking to him again. You may receive a "QUEST FAILED" message upon retrieving the plans. The quest reward can still be collected upon returning them to Captain Langmar
606523ffed4a77e5daaf1c128a9e78a3943f1c3a.text: 瓦尔有时会陷入困境，并不能像任务所建议的那样引诱夏尔。如果发生这种情况，只需在附近的萨克诺斯谷进出区域并尝试再次与他交谈即可。检索计划后，您可能会收到“任务失败”消息。任务奖励仍可在归还给朗玛船长后领取

851fc62f32cda7f96c472a1afd3cb7b013b0e053.source: Clear the Pockmark Flats in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
851fc62f32cda7f96c472a1afd3cb7b013b0e053.text: 在困难模式下清除阿斯卡隆麻子平地上的所有敌人。

46556446dad610cbbd272835b66834bf733386ff.source: Several secondary quests of the Ascalon region lead here. This area is located south of the Eastern Frontier and due east of Serenity Temple.
46556446dad610cbbd272835b66834bf733386ff.text: 阿斯卡隆地区的几个次要任务都通向这里。该区域位于东部边境以南、宁静寺正东。

4605119f3f4eb1480b7cce755984ccf1e5491576.source: There is a resurrection point just inside the small walled area near the Serenity Temple portal, but no visible shrine.
4605119f3f4eb1480b7cce755984ccf1e5491576.text: 在宁静神殿入口附近的小围墙区域内有一个复活点，但没有可见的神殿。

9ff42c00451e07bc1bc81bfc886812ffaeddd167.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 170|low = 135|high = 234|notes =There are numerous Devourer pop-ups throughout the zone, with a large number in the northern valley surrounding the Searing Crystal.}}
9ff42c00451e07bc1bc81bfc886812ffaeddd167.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 170|low = 135|high = 234|notes =整个区域有大量吞噬者弹出窗口，其中大量出现在灼热水晶周围的北部山谷中。}}

5db04f19abd453e8afe0cdb5433a4af315910634.source: The Geomancer's Test will significantly increase the number of foes, and Replacement Healers will add Devona as an ally.
5db04f19abd453e8afe0cdb5433a4af315910634.text: 风水师的测试将显着增加敌人的数量，而替代治疗师将添加德沃娜作为盟友。

0f48af9f7de73d5d0dfe2e73626539ee5e151823.source: There appear to be three variations of spawns in the crater valley; you should be able to tell which shortly after exiting Serenity Temple:
0f48af9f7de73d5d0dfe2e73626539ee5e151823.text: 火山口山谷中似乎存在三种不同的生成点：退出宁静寺后不久，您应该能够分辨出：

180ba1c0d165958c37c62cc2fb01a502a48b3a1d.source: Riders: Patrols of Storm Riders swirl around crevices, and then circle the valley counter-clockwise around the crystal; there is a separate group that stays near the center. When vanquishing, move clockwise to avoid missing any. (Rough estimate: 80% of visits.)
180ba1c0d165958c37c62cc2fb01a502a48b3a1d.text: 骑士：风暴骑士的巡逻队绕着裂缝旋转，然后绕着水晶逆时针绕山谷一圈；有一个单独的小组住在中心附近。击败时顺时针移动，以免错过任何机会。 （粗略估计：80% 的访问量。）

352be386f1fbf671411491caa3597ceb0150f93a.source: Elementals: The crater contains patrols of Stone Elementals instead. (Roughly 10% of visits.)
352be386f1fbf671411491caa3597ceb0150f93a.text: 元素：火山口内有石元素的巡逻队。 （大约占访问量的 10%。）

9797e6f067358c014736006efc4ca1baa6914bae.source: Gargoyles: The spawns are gargoyles and there appear to be fewer devourer pop-ups. (Roughly 10% of visits.)
9797e6f067358c014736006efc4ca1baa6914bae.text: 石像鬼：生成的是石像鬼，并且吞噬者的弹出窗口似乎较少。 （大约占访问量的 10%。）

8bbe1ba920f773495a2cb23732e62c92d55e257a.source: The collector Nicanor Gannel does not always appear; his presence might be tied to the type of spawns in the crystal valley.
8bbe1ba920f773495a2cb23732e62c92d55e257a.text: 收藏家尼卡诺·甘内尔 (Nicanor Gannel) 并不总是出现；他的存在可能与水晶谷中的生成点类型有关。

5e70b2362daaa3fe64d68460e4c7b26fa9c604e3.source: As per the Pogahn Passage mission.

03062e954b5f76025943153b1e9138819bfa2d2b.source: The quest reward is greater than that of other Zaishen quests from the region.
03062e954b5f76025943153b1e9138819bfa2d2b.text: 该任务奖励高于该地区的其他再神任务。

abd699aa5e43dac9ef9a5ea6f08a793c0f5b7f29.source: Clear the Poisoned Outcrops in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
abd699aa5e43dac9ef9a5ea6f08a793c0f5b7f29.text: 在困难模式下清除所有敌人荒凉之地的有毒露头。

763f729fba3843976b0524ee543643880d086176.source: Head out the northeastern exit of either the Lair of the Forgotten or the Ruptured Heart.
763f729fba3843976b0524ee543643880d086176.text: 从被遗忘者巢穴或破碎之心的东北出口出发。

d58fdcd6ef3eab95f7eb19da189b92b4347522db.source: This is the only area in the Desolation where Junundu are not available.
d58fdcd6ef3eab95f7eb19da189b92b4347522db.text: 这是荒凉之地唯一无法使用朱南杜的区域。

a3aedf1a910e6a517e066cc65561c991d883d363.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.4% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
a3aedf1a910e6a517e066cc65561c991d883d363.text: 对这一领域的完整探索为 Elonian Cartographer 主打歌贡献了约 2.4%。

5979384eda825e71529407e40eca6c0253703461.source: There's a small group of hidden insects at the end of the northern path just out of the Lair of the Forgotten. They can be avoided simply by not using that short central path.
5979384eda825e71529407e40eca6c0253703461.text: 在被遗忘者巢穴外的北边小路的尽头有一小群隐藏的昆虫。只需不使用那条短的中心路径就可以避免它们。

bcfac3f2f3b05035c8118853966baf93c6e079fd.source: The boss group of Droajam, Mage of the Sands is, by far, the most difficult group to take down. It consists of the boss itself plus 4 other elementals (Sandstorm Crag and Shambling Mesa, usually more of the former). The sheer damage that they can dish out at once can wipe even a well-prepared party several times. Focusing on one at a time and spreading out wide is essential to taking them down. Alternatively, a well-timed Pain Inverter will also usually kill the boss and Sandstorm Crags in one Sandstorm, especially if using spirits/minions/pets (which can also act as a decoy).
bcfac3f2f3b05035c8118853966baf93c6e079fd.text: 迄今为止，德罗亚姆的 Boss 团“沙之法师”是最难打倒的。它由 Boss 本身和 4 个其他元素组成（沙暴峭壁和蹒跚台地，通常前者较多）。他们一次性造成的巨大伤害甚至可以将准备充分的队伍消灭数次。一次集中精力并广泛传播对于消灭他们至关重要。另外，适时的疼痛反转器通常也会在一场沙暴中杀死 Boss 和沙暴峭壁，特别是在使用精魂/小兵/宠物（也可以充当诱饵）的情况下。

88b76d9f10dd9323990f80b8e4bae6fa4ec3387b.source: Just west of the Lair of the Forgotten are several very closely placed groups of undead, possibly overlapping with a Margonite group as well. Carefully pull each group into the narrow path before fully engaging them. The boss group containing Nehjab the Parched may be difficult to take down; it depends on the number of Awakened Acolytes and Awakened Cavaliers there are. Consider skills like Frozen Soil.
88b76d9f10dd9323990f80b8e4bae6fa4ec3387b.text: 被遗忘者巢穴的西边有几个距离非常近的不死族群，可能也与玛贡尼特族群重叠。小心地将每个小组拉入狭窄的路径，然后再让他们完全参与。包含“干渴者内贾布”的 Boss 队伍可能很难被消灭；取决于觉醒侍僧和觉醒骑士的数量。考虑像冻土这样的技能。

cf9eefddfbc15669aca09f9c707219b3ef66a3ae.source: Both the Hallowed Point and the Growing Threat quests will significantly increase the number of Margonite spawns, although the latter also provides some allies.
cf9eefddfbc15669aca09f9c707219b3ef66a3ae.text: 神圣点和日益增长的威胁任务都会显着增加玛贡尼特的生成数量，尽管后者也提供了一些盟友。

14bd05b086d464307e6062a32e9e044234ab2c9e.source: Enter Sorrow's Furnace without To Sorrow's Furnace sub quests.
14bd05b086d464307e6062a32e9e044234ab2c9e.text: 进入“悲伤熔炉”，无需执行“悲伤熔炉”子任务。

cf73a2b1c9bf5796545adec580e1fbd3338d8eda.source: Find and slay 6 more Stone Summit leaders.
cf73a2b1c9bf5796545adec580e1fbd3338d8eda.text: 找到并杀死另外 6 位石峰领袖。

ec139a513e8d7636caa173f9e14454b05655ccb2.source: See Tharn Stonerift for your reward.
ec139a513e8d7636caa173f9e14454b05655ccb2.text: 去找萨恩·斯通里夫特领取奖励。

24bd7f7c220698467d6c62c6a7f2af180eeec106.source: Find and kill six bosses within Sorrow's Furnace. The quickest way to complete the quest is to kill the two bosses in the same chamber as Tharn Stonerift (Sorrow's Belly), take the southwestern path to the Stone Basilica and kill the two bosses there, and then return to Sorrow's Belly, take the east path, and turn south at the fork to clear out the Iron Arch and its two bosses.
24bd7f7c220698467d6c62c6a7f2af180eeec106.text: 找到并杀死悲伤熔炉内的六个 Boss。完成任务最快的方法是杀死与萨恩·斯通裂谷（悲伤之腹）同一个房间的两个boss，走西南方向的石大教堂并杀死那里的两个boss，然后返回悲伤之腹，走东边的路，在岔路口向南清除铁拱门及其两个boss。

dc7edbc19fb0a1c34df63d75ef0700a1355081da.source: Turning north at the fork and following the sparsely-populated crescent passage (the Gap) leads to another two bosses, which may be a preferable alternative to clearing the more enemy-dense Basilica.
dc7edbc19fb0a1c34df63d75ef0700a1355081da.text: 在岔路口向北转向，沿着人烟稀少的新月形通道（缺口）通向另外两个 Boss，这可能是清除敌人更密集的大教堂的更好选择。

6d190e1c78b36382ad2c5d7b1023e7a14cb62d38.source: This quest requires killing exactly half of the bosses in Sorrow's Furnace.
6d190e1c78b36382ad2c5d7b1023e7a14cb62d38.text: 该任务需要杀死悲伤熔炉中一半的 Boss。

e93f1688426fbad1aec26ab7679990717b29ea71.source: Any bosses killed before you accept the quest are retroactively counted towards the objective, potentially allowing the reward to be claimed immediately.
e93f1688426fbad1aec26ab7679990717b29ea71.text: 在您接受任务之前杀死的任何 Boss 都会被追溯计入目标，从而有可能立即领取奖励。

68afee9c45b87a20e0c79817cb4fef5d38328d09.source: If a boss is resurrected (e.g. by a Priest of Sorrows), killing him again will not affect the counter.
68afee9c45b87a20e0c79817cb4fef5d38328d09.text: 如果头目被复活（例如被悲伤牧师复活），再次杀死他不会影响计数器。

6827fd69fbfdb7b6267b0fcd75891370b7147a59.source: The northwestern boss can sometimes wander into the crushers, providing a free kill.
6827fd69fbfdb7b6267b0fcd75891370b7147a59.text: 西北首领有时会溜进粉碎机，提供免费杀戮。

82c3c6d38089b96b3ba8c18dcf22fe965190378a.source: Like many monk NPCs, Tharn can sometimes travel long distances with the party to provide healing, particularly if there is a minion master present. However, this may do more harm than good, since Tharn will also heal and cleanse conditions on enemies, including his supposed rivals.
82c3c6d38089b96b3ba8c18dcf22fe965190378a.text: 与许多僧侣 NPC 一样，萨恩有时可以与队伍一起长途跋涉来提供治疗，特别是在有小兵大师在场的情况下。然而，这可能弊大于利，因为 Tharn 也会治愈和净化敌人的状况，包括他所谓的对手。

bb6f21f9afdb7761e684d76259388f495baf4f0e.source: This quest can easily be completed alongside Tasca's Reprise or Subversive Ideas, since both require exploring most of the dungeon.
bb6f21f9afdb7761e684d76259388f495baf4f0e.text: 这个任务可以很容易地与塔斯卡的重演或颠覆性想法一起完成，因为两者都需要探索大部分地牢。

749b1258e896390a68e132d5fec68498c2ab497a.source: As with other quests offered inside Sorrow's Furnace, this quest is automatically abandoned if you leave the zone.
749b1258e896390a68e132d5fec68498c2ab497a.text: 与悲伤熔炉内提供的其他任务一样，如果您离开该区域，此任务将自动放弃。

487cf2b7e7de1b124a4d585bb098a2cb94e8475a.source: Defeat Blarp in a game of Polymock at Gadd's Encampment.
487cf2b7e7de1b124a4d585bb098a2cb94e8475a.text: 在加德营地的波利莫克游戏中击败布拉普。

4f53f7ac172c2cf4cc78e384d0983a6fc2908823.source: See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward.
4f53f7ac172c2cf4cc78e384d0983a6fc2908823.text: 请参阅 Hoff [Polymock Master] 获取奖励。

8dfea048ff2a054975083aebf9bc94fc2e24ce1f.source: Blarp's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
8dfea048ff2a054975083aebf9bc94fc2e24ce1f.text: 布拉普的棋子及其独特技能如下：

3b85cd85b39e9c20a2b0a28dffa54960ce3ee189.source: Earth Elemental: Polymock Stone Daggers, Polymock Obsidian Flame, Polymock Earthquake
3b85cd85b39e9c20a2b0a28dffa54960ce3ee189.text: 土元素: 波莫克石匕首, 波莫克黑曜石火焰, 波莫克地震

7a0b9537f4a156037fa687e9b854aec3ed94052e.source: Ice Elemental: Polymock Ice Spear, Polymock Frozen Armor, Polymock Glyph Freeze
7a0b9537f4a156037fa687e9b854aec3ed94052e.text: 冰元素: 多莫克冰矛, 多莫克冰冻护甲, 多莫克雕文冻结

aaf4025ae854eab2b79b2686beda244475597de0.source: Fire Elemental: Polymock Flare, Polymock Fireball, Polymock Rodgort's Invocation
aaf4025ae854eab2b79b2686beda244475597de0.text: 火元素: 波莫克耀斑, 波莫克火球, 波莫克罗格特的召唤

4500d5142f93b2717c577bf35dfda08296ca4f9c.source: The following pieces are good counters:
4500d5142f93b2717c577bf35dfda08296ca4f9c.text: 以下棋子是很好的计数器：

27a91f8bbdeb257b83cfead5cfa416cef681b3dd.source: Kappa Polymock piece vs. Earth Elemental Polymock piece
27a91f8bbdeb257b83cfead5cfa416cef681b3dd.text: Kappa Polymock 件 vs. Earth Elemental Polymock 件

b10ef6e778589503b77a4ee81a6441b6640922b3.source: Fire Imp Polymock piece vs. Ice Elemental Polymock piece
b10ef6e778589503b77a4ee81a6441b6640922b3.text: 火小鬼 Polymock 件 vs. 冰元素 Polymock 件

4b7553066de5d40af5ef3c3ce4266252b2fd4dab.source: Skale Polymock piece vs. Fire Elemental Polymock piece
4b7553066de5d40af5ef3c3ce4266252b2fd4dab.text: Skale Polymock 件 vs. Fire Elemental Polymock 件

50f8b1f93f3acb40ed560be349cba9aa081fce09.source: Skale Polymock piece vs. Earth Elemental Polymock piece
50f8b1f93f3acb40ed560be349cba9aa081fce09.text: Skale Polymock 件 vs. Earth Elemental Polymock 件

38f902461870c90ef4b8bb1983704b6b1a1b1d8d.source: Gargoyle Polymock piece vs. Ice Elemental Polymock piece
38f902461870c90ef4b8bb1983704b6b1a1b1d8d.text: 石像鬼 Polymock 件 vs. 冰元素 Polymock 件

7a3ad6a33a246933afb514da664af5171b1b9f19.source: Kappa Polymock piece vs. Fire Elemental Polymock piece
7a3ad6a33a246933afb514da664af5171b1b9f19.text: Kappa Polymock 件与火元素 Polymock 件

dd19992ae69373437c4a38533a7ebffd21619c93.source: Blarp can be quite difficult to defeat as he uses three Uncommon pieces (and you're likely to only have one, the Kappa). Be sure to Block/Drain the two most important skills of each piece. The latter is more powerful.
dd19992ae69373437c4a38533a7ebffd21619c93.text: 布拉普很难击败，因为他使用三件罕见棋子（而你很可能只有一件，河童）。确保阻止/耗尽每件作品中两个最重要的技能。后者更强大。

12c6bf8f944c26c6bc46f0c4f189d246be3ec408.source: These are the skills to watch out for:
12c6bf8f944c26c6bc46f0c4f189d246be3ec408.text: 这些是需要注意的技能：

3301ebcc301a1340bbf1129ea1bdecdf96872043.source: Earth Elemental: Earthquake (650 damage, 6 energy, 1 activation, 20 recharge), Obsidian flame (800 damage, 6 energy, 1 activation, 20 recharge)
3301ebcc301a1340bbf1129ea1bdecdf96872043.text: 土元素：地震（650 伤害，6 能量，1 次激活，20 充能），黑曜石火焰（800 伤害，6 能量，1 次激活，20 充能）

9d57994c59277326d5a31b8e94db4af749625dd4.source: Ice Elemental: Frozen Armor (+1000 Health for 30 seconds, 2 energy, 2 activation, 20 recharge), Glyph Freeze (600 damage, 6 energy, 1 activation, 20 recharge
9d57994c59277326d5a31b8e94db4af749625dd4.text: 冰元素：冰冻护甲（+1000 生命值，持续 30 秒，2 点能量，2 次激活，20 次充能），雕文冻结（600 点伤害，6 点能量，1 次激活，20 次充能）

7353ed9f55d27c70c7c3deb39c87e74e319e1329.source: Fire Elemental: Fireball (800 damage, 6energy, 1activation, 20recharge), Rodgort's Invocation (200 damage, 10 degeneration for 15 seconds, 2energy, 2activation, 20recharge)
7353ed9f55d27c70c7c3deb39c87e74e319e1329.text: 火元素：火球（800伤害，6能量，1次激活，20次充能），罗德戈特的召唤（200点伤害，10点退化，持续15秒，2能量，2次激活，20次充能）

626e3f9d9b51da24027c00678bce9660b4441e35.source: Keep in mind that by strafing (walking from side to side) you can avoid getting hit by projectiles such as Polymock Stone Daggers, Ice Spear, Flare and Fireball.
626e3f9d9b51da24027c00678bce9660b4441e35.text: 请记住，通过扫射（从一侧走到另一侧），您可以避免被 Polymock 石匕首、冰矛、照明弹和火球等射弹击中。

29656732c3d08ce676a2561111feec7d52a68769.source: Defeat Dune Teardrinker in a game of Polymock at Doomlore Shrine.
29656732c3d08ce676a2561111feec7d52a68769.text: 在末日神殿的 Polymock 游戏中击败沙丘饮泪者。

22000c9aa4eb0d7cbad7eddffa160e0c162abd8a.source: Dune Teardrinker's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
22000c9aa4eb0d7cbad7eddffa160e0c162abd8a.text: 沙丘饮泪者的棋子及其独特技能如下：

256648f646659c2041eda726be9480d0e208afb2.source: Charr Shaman: Polymock Smite, Polymock Piercing Light Spear, Polymock Signet of Smiting
256648f646659c2041eda726be9480d0e208afb2.text: 夏尔萨满: 多莫克重击, 多莫克穿刺光矛, 多莫克重击徽记

d3a3075b5953eb61ab062832cbdd8d6856780149.source: Charr Flamecaller: Polymock Flare, Polymock Fireball, Polymock Mind Blast
d3a3075b5953eb61ab062832cbdd8d6856780149.text: 夏尔·唤火者： 波莫克耀斑、波莫克火球、波莫克心灵冲击

5c9fdcaed55ce6204cff6818a1e5c727593d0e52.source: Titan: Polymock Flare, Polymock Savannah Heat, Polymock Rodgort's Invocation
5c9fdcaed55ce6204cff6818a1e5c727593d0e52.text: 泰坦：波利莫克耀斑、波利莫克萨凡纳热火、波利莫克罗德戈特的召唤

b70654494237d6324614e9a12f1b56f63b2bcc7e.source: Use the Earth Elemental against the Charr Shaman.
b70654494237d6324614e9a12f1b56f63b2bcc7e.text: 使用土元素对抗夏尔萨满。

441119d376a11adaf94f9224a1151adbacb15345.source: Use the Fire Elemental or Fire Imp against the Charr Flamecaller.
441119d376a11adaf94f9224a1151adbacb15345.text: 使用火元素或火小鬼对抗夏尔唤火者。

7b0e87cc1d9d53c1c569248b114483fa93997a52.source: Use the Kappa against the Titan.

f4e307c74a4e0215d68e52d6c0ea49ebe46bb264.source: Be careful. Sometimes the Titan Polymock piece uses Polymock Savannah Heat as a last attack just before you hit him with the final attack that will make you win. The result of this is, you defeat him, but then die because of the Polymock Savannah Heat and you must go back to the outpost. You also then have to defeat him again.
f4e307c74a4e0215d68e52d6c0ea49ebe46bb264.text: 小心点。有时，泰坦波利莫克作品会在你用最后一次攻击击中他之前，使用波利莫克萨凡纳热火作为最后一次攻击，这将使你获胜。结果是，你打败了他，但随后因为波利莫克萨凡纳热火而死，你必须回到前哨站。然后你还必须再次击败他。

db991ee18dc03c8ab45a907b90fb8d82bb6921db.source: Defeat Fonk in a game of Polymock at Gunnar's Hold.
db991ee18dc03c8ab45a907b90fb8d82bb6921db.text: 在古纳城堡的一场 Polymock 游戏中击败 Fonk。

3a2eca0e6fc97a0b969f4e3116775b3703647661.source: Fonk's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:

b1049138892d95ab0995c9233b95a6c3662fe8ab.source: Kappa: Polymock Ice Spear, Polymock Ice Shard Storm, Polymock Frozen Trident
b1049138892d95ab0995c9233b95a6c3662fe8ab.text: 河童： 波莫克冰矛、波莫克冰碎片风暴、波莫克冰冻三叉戟

276d42fea6e18773ad274e0c9a95105aa2bb776b.source: Aloe Seed: Polymock Smite, Polymock Smite Hex, Polymock Bane Signet
276d42fea6e18773ad274e0c9a95105aa2bb776b.text: 芦荟种子: Polymock Smite, Polymock Smite Hex, Polymock Bane Signet

f7c48ded633a0f9a205c3ce65718e9d7c2504f1f.source: Wind Rider: Polymock Overload, Polymock Backfire, Polymock Guilt
f7c48ded633a0f9a205c3ce65718e9d7c2504f1f.text: 驭风者：Polymock 过载、Polymock 逆火、Polymock 内疚

da23f5698cf198357b5c6d0fc61073a810e318f0.text: 使用 Kappa 对抗芦荟种子

115a1869201d9573098f5cb7ecb4e9880abbccd1.source: Use Fire Imp or Ice Imp against Wind Rider Polymock piece
115a1869201d9573098f5cb7ecb4e9880abbccd1.text: 使用火小鬼或冰小鬼对抗驭风者聚合物模型

aa6abd952dc598d71b04ce09493e22084aa96087.source: Defeat Grulhammer Silverfist in a game of Polymock at Umbral Grotto.
aa6abd952dc598d71b04ce09493e22084aa96087.text: 在暗影石窟的 Polymock 游戏中击败格鲁哈默·银拳。

ddca2051041ffc4cc1175d886df1bcebcf3e1909.source: Grulhammer's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
ddca2051041ffc4cc1175d886df1bcebcf3e1909.text: 格鲁哈默的棋子及其独特技能如下：

9ac3d9ebabf01032cad5a6e748b9dd84c6757815.source: Dredge: Polymock Ice Spear, Polymock Icy Bonds, Polymock Mind Freeze
9ac3d9ebabf01032cad5a6e748b9dd84c6757815.text: 疏浚： 波莫克冰矛、波莫克冰冷纽带、波莫克心灵冻结

89919bd3c3686807b5fce147e9e875c85e89c820.source: Dolyak Rider: Polymock Smite, Polymock Banish, Polymock Bane Signet
89919bd3c3686807b5fce147e9e875c85e89c820.text: 多利亚克骑士: 波莫克重击, 波莫克放逐, 波莫克祸根徽记

ab66331a4807caadbe7d512960315120a0118107.source: Dwarven Arcanist: Polymock Stone Daggers, Polymock Sandstorm, Polymock Earthquake
ab66331a4807caadbe7d512960315120a0118107.text: 矮人奥术师：波利莫克石匕首、波利莫克沙尘暴、波利莫克地震

1171dcef3724c91b5b2aa1dbc02e558da2dd2b8d.source: Use the Kappa Polymock Piece or Aloe Seed Polymock Piece against Dredge Form
1171dcef3724c91b5b2aa1dbc02e558da2dd2b8d.text: 使用 Kappa Polymock 片或芦荟种子 Polymock 片对抗疏浚形态

c3e52fdf73e35a75c3d1dc6639573223f1877bd4.source: Start casting Polymock Smite Hex when you see him using Polymock Icy Bonds. This will remove his hex just in time.
c3e52fdf73e35a75c3d1dc6639573223f1877bd4.text: 当你看到 Polymock 使用 Polymock Icy Bonds 时，开始施放 Polymock Smite Hex。这将及时消除他的咒语。

9d618e5d136c1c3f5289aa554d467baf80abd0bb.source: Use the Earth Elemental Polymock Piece against Dolyak Rider Form
9d618e5d136c1c3f5289aa554d467baf80abd0bb.text: 使用土元素聚合物碎片对抗多利亚克骑士形态

0edb70b4cc71cc80a168e6bf69a1b5251211fe89.source: Use the Ice Elemental Polymock Piece (or Ice Imp Polymock Piece if you haven't got the Ice Elemental piece yet) against Dwarven Arcanist Form
0edb70b4cc71cc80a168e6bf69a1b5251211fe89.text: 使用冰元素多模碎片（如果你还没有冰元素碎片，则使用冰小鬼多模型碎片）对抗矮人奥术师形态

09167967d3599139c2aea2773a5a8722f349d1e0.source: Against the Dwarven Arcanist Form it is best to stand close to him at first, and when he casts sandstorm you have just enough space to walk backwards out of the AoE.
09167967d3599139c2aea2773a5a8722f349d1e0.text: 对抗矮人奥术师形态时，最好一开始就站在他附近，当他施放沙尘暴时，你有足够的空间向后走出 AoE。

850378a2b8a026e73020108d57167ef820c4a4cf.source: Defeat Master Hoff in a game of Polymock at Rata Sum.
850378a2b8a026e73020108d57167ef820c4a4cf.text: 在 Rata Sum 的 Polymock 游戏中击败 Hoff 大师。

e2c6c601e035f144d35dccb331d4ef7dddb49b08.source: Defeat Necromancer Volumandus in a game of Polymock at Tarnished Haven.
e2c6c601e035f144d35dccb331d4ef7dddb49b08.text: 在玷污避难所的波利莫克游戏中击败死灵法师沃卢曼杜斯。

a532e34360964e13da3f0a91cd7772a9658b6e47.source: Volumandus' pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
a532e34360964e13da3f0a91cd7772a9658b6e47.text: 沃鲁曼多斯的棋子及其独特技能如下：

d783b1e13fe2249a3ae09906f29a01b09135b0ac.source: Skeletal Mage: Polymock Overload, Polymock Backfire, Polymock Diversion
d783b1e13fe2249a3ae09906f29a01b09135b0ac.text: 骷髅法师：Polymock 过载、Polymock 逆火、Polymock 转移

4579bfdb2b1085306fc9a4c257b7846a3cdc1ecb.source: Smoke Wraith: Polymock Lightning Strike, Polymock Mind Shock, Polymock Lightning Blast
4579bfdb2b1085306fc9a4c257b7846a3cdc1ecb.text: 烟雾幽灵: 波莫克闪电打击, 波莫克心灵震击, 波莫克闪电爆炸

a1c5f1f1a23f3b3e40c4588d7bea9b05da76b66d.source: Bone Dragon: Polymock Deathly Chill, Polymock Rising Bile, Polymock Poisoned Ground
a1c5f1f1a23f3b3e40c4588d7bea9b05da76b66d.text: 骨龙: 波莫克死亡之寒, 波莫克升腾胆汁, 波莫克毒土

a883cc06b861f0e55eed71706f1ff9c7b1037ba4.source: Use Earth Elemental Polymock piece against Skeleton Polymock piece
a883cc06b861f0e55eed71706f1ff9c7b1037ba4.text: 使用土元素 Polymock 碎片对抗骷髅 Polymock 碎片

9fb12ff4b83447a54bb712317ea071e1f8f93670.source: Use Polymock Ether Signet to remove his Polymock Diversion
9fb12ff4b83447a54bb712317ea071e1f8f93670.text: 使用 Polymock Ether Signet 移除他的 Polymock Diversion

5030eb0b1e47fb221dff4b853635b3bc4889de08.source: Use Fire Imp Polymock piece or if you have it Fire Elemental Polymock piece against Smoke Wraith Form
5030eb0b1e47fb221dff4b853635b3bc4889de08.text: 使用火小鬼 Polymock 部件，或者如果您有火元素 Polymock 部件来对抗烟雾幽灵形态

909b1987a064da44405165950b71e637b39444fd.source: Use Kappa Polymock piece or if you have it Aloe Seed Polymock piece against Bone Dragon Form
909b1987a064da44405165950b71e637b39444fd.text: 使用 Kappa Polymock 部件或者如果您有芦荟种子 Polymock 部件来对抗骨龙形态

609bb0fab65fa363ebb650dae7981d8710f136cf.source: Defeat Plurgg in a game of Polymock at Vlox's Falls.
609bb0fab65fa363ebb650dae7981d8710f136cf.text: 在弗洛克斯瀑布的波利莫克游戏中击败普鲁格。

cb47fdd9efcf0f02d52fc0974bbc524e5d034009.source: Plurgg's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
cb47fdd9efcf0f02d52fc0974bbc524e5d034009.text: 普鲁格的棋子及其独特技能如下：

134a0be6c624229980dcb8f7af9eb4277b24ce59.source: Fire Imp: Polymock Flare, Polymock Immolate, Polymock Meteor
134a0be6c624229980dcb8f7af9eb4277b24ce59.text: 火焰小鬼：Polymock Flare、Polymock Immolate、Polymock Meteor

5667207f1ce6bde745c0acc8bdf7f26bbf2e6100.source: Ice Imp: Polymock Ice Spear, Polymock Icy Prison, Polymock Mind Freeze
5667207f1ce6bde745c0acc8bdf7f26bbf2e6100.text: 冰小鬼: 波莫克冰矛, 波莫克冰冷监狱, 波莫克心灵冻结

82d98fc9f9a79143863989dfb41d37fc154f9170.source: Skale Polymock piece vs. Fire Imp Polymock piece
82d98fc9f9a79143863989dfb41d37fc154f9170.text: Skale Polymock 件与 Fire Imp Polymock 件

18af17cc720c10835db96e2281e0a49aa1e9d904.source: Fire Imp Polymock piece vs. Ice Imp Polymock piece
18af17cc720c10835db96e2281e0a49aa1e9d904.text: 火小鬼 Polymock 件与冰小鬼 Polymock 件对比

6e90a49c2164ceb539085558b4144f7fdbf1f6f3.source: Gargoyle Polymock piece vs. Kappa Polymock piece
6e90a49c2164ceb539085558b4144f7fdbf1f6f3.text: Gargoyle Polymock 件与 Kappa Polymock 件

c3edf88c69646bed8b992c37f84d2d7bb7302ff1.source: Polymock Immolate and Polymock Ice Shard Storm deal considerable damage, however they are slow casting, making them easy to block or interrupt. As long as you interrupt them and prevent your own damage skills from being interrupted with Polymock Block, Polymock Glyph of Concentration and timing, you should have no problem. If you hit them first with a high damage dealing throw then block, then do a concentration block then a long term affliction, you should win.
c3edf88c69646bed8b992c37f84d2d7bb7302ff1.text: 多莫克献祭和多莫克冰碎片风暴会造成相当大的伤害，但它们的施法速度很慢，很容易被格挡或打断。只要你用Polymock Block、Polymock集中雕文和时机来打断它们并防止你自己的伤害技能被打断，你应该没有问题。如果你先用高伤害造成的投掷击中他们，然后进行格挡，然后进行集中格挡，然后进行长期痛苦，你应该获胜。

7eed82bcb34ec3cb90a9ac9c38388e7adf9f3fc8.source: Register three Polymock pieces for play with Denn [Polymock Unlocks] at Rata Sum.
7eed82bcb34ec3cb90a9ac9c38388e7adf9f3fc8.text: 在 Rata Sum 注册三个 Polymock 部件，与 Denn [Polymock Unlocks] 一起玩。

15db8bae7837aeaf1afb5ae082f77b46ff2ffef2.source: Talk to Yulma [Polymock] to start the game.
15db8bae7837aeaf1afb5ae082f77b46ff2ffef2.text: 与 Yulma [Polymock] 交谈以开始游戏。

b8758b50c1ad40acbf5685a5163dfea14e82d4cc.source: Defeat Yulma in a game of Polymock at Rata Sum.
b8758b50c1ad40acbf5685a5163dfea14e82d4cc.text: 在拉塔苏姆的 Polymock 游戏中击败尤尔玛。

48d0dc8d5b45e4ce3a4abdd2a09717c11d02f0c8.source: Hoff will give you your three starter Polymock pieces: Gargoyle, Mergoyle, and Skale. With them in your inventory, talk to Denn to register them one by one. A registered Polymock piece will be removed from your inventory and your character (and only that character) will be able to use this piece in any Polymock game. Once you have three pieces registered (if you don't have additional pieces from dungeon rewards), talk to Yulma to challenge her.
48d0dc8d5b45e4ce3a4abdd2a09717c11d02f0c8.text: Hoff 将为您提供三款 Polymock 入门作品：Gargoyle、Mergoyle 和 Skale。将它们放入您的库存中后，与 Denn 交谈以将它们一一注册。已注册的 Polymock 部件将从您的库存中删除，您的角色（并且只有该角色）将能够在任何 Polymock 游戏中使用该部件。一旦您注册了三件作品（如果您没有来自地牢奖励的额外作品），请与尤尔玛交谈以挑战她。

14b8070701f2bd7e92ddbf6b332d83dbeac34700.source: Yulma's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
14b8070701f2bd7e92ddbf6b332d83dbeac34700.text: 尤尔玛的棋子及其独特技能如下：

918c98858ca23e26802020e8dc95f1c677a96dec.source: Gargoyle: Polymock Lightning Strike, Polymock Lightning Orb, Polymock Lightning Djinn's Haste
918c98858ca23e26802020e8dc95f1c677a96dec.text: 石像鬼: 波莫克雷击, 波莫克闪电球, 波莫克闪电巨灵的急速

013d3b8621fb755ca9817e914d80779779b70d16.source: Skale: Polymock Deathly Chill, Polymock Rising Bile, Polymock Rotting Flesh
013d3b8621fb755ca9817e914d80779779b70d16.text: Skale：波莫克死亡之寒、波莫克胆汁上升、波莫克腐肉

603361bdaa47a43750b4faa73538188cc86809bc.source: Mergoyle: Polymock Overload, Polymock Glyph Destabilization, Polymock Mind Wreck
603361bdaa47a43750b4faa73538188cc86809bc.text: Mergoyle：Polymock 过载、Polymock 字形不稳定、Polymock 精神崩溃

2f6e108cbd61a0e3bc5593a673b1da66fc5231c4.source: Yulma is fairly easy to beat. You can freely use any of the pieces you have against her in any order, although leaving the Gargoyle piece for last might be a good idea as it's your most damaging piece and you can use it to regain ground if you've lost your first two pieces.
2f6e108cbd61a0e3bc5593a673b1da66fc5231c4.text: 尤尔玛相当容易被击败。你可以以任何顺序自由地使用你拥有的任何棋子来对抗她，尽管把石像鬼棋子留在最后可能是一个好主意，因为它是你最具破坏性的棋子，如果你失去了前两个棋子，你可以用它来收复失地。

aa9694ee5eefd1e1bfbf7336512f4f60a28fa29c.source: Yulma can be a bit disconcerting to fight because she sometimes uses skills in odd combinations (such as using Glyph of Concentration and then Blocking, for example), and has frequent pauses in between using skills. This can make her somewhat difficult to predict (and therefore interrupt/block). In general, a good offense is the best way to deal with Yulma; it is possible to simply spam your offensive skills at her until she loses.
aa9694ee5eefd1e1bfbf7336512f4f60a28fa29c.text: 尤尔玛在战斗中可能会有点令人不安，因为她有时会以奇怪的组合使用技能（例如使用集中雕文然后使用格挡），并且在使用技能之间经常停顿。这可能会使她有点难以预测（因此会中断/阻止）。一般来说，良好的进攻是对付尤尔玛的最好方法；您可以简单地向她发送进攻技巧，直到她输掉。

5575b50b52af349991cb9ede5e3e744e3bd00bb8.source: Clear Pongmei Valley near Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
5575b50b52af349991cb9ede5e3e744e3bd00bb8.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能城附近的庞美山谷中的所有敌人。

fc4bf7fc97d4abc9298caa5bc06a04dfdaff47e9.source: The Count's Daughter quest will lead characters through here. The first time characters enter here will be from Maatu Keep or Sunjiang District.
fc4bf7fc97d4abc9298caa5bc06a04dfdaff47e9.text: 伯爵的女儿任务将引导角色穿过这里。第一次进入这里的角色将来自马图堡或孙江区。

ba1947d04d78356a6848b41c4f1f4d7b07e234b3.source: The Convocation (Both Master Togo and Headmaster Greico will travel with you, but only the former will fight, while the latter won't and will body block allies.)
ba1947d04d78356a6848b41c4f1f4d7b07e234b3.text: 集会（Togo大师和Greico校长都会和你一起旅行，但只有前者会战斗，而后者不会，并且会用身体阻挡盟友。）

473bb3df9f629a3c4678728c7b5d50f1f65137f6.source: The Yeti in this area charm the elder pets when you get into compass range. If you stay out of compass range and let heroes and henchmen kill the Yeti, you can tame an Elder Crane or Tiger.
473bb3df9f629a3c4678728c7b5d50f1f65137f6.text: 当您进入指南针范围时，该区域的雪人会吸引年长的宠物。如果你远离指南针范围并让英雄和追随者杀死雪人，你可以驯服老鹤或老虎。

e16713c0b53217b5505921d13ee27e8a299835ea.source: As you approach Xuekao, the Deceptive, use caution to avoid getting surrounded. Groups of Am Fah and Jade Brotherhood will spawn and fight each other; you can either join the brawl or let them fight it out and dispose of what remains.
e16713c0b53217b5505921d13ee27e8a299835ea.text: 当你接近欺骗者雪考时，要小心避免被包围。 Am Fah 和 Jade Brotherhood 会生成并互相战斗；你可以加入争吵，也可以让他们决一死战并处理掉剩下的东西。

75247a1d0caa74ff482f9616182aecfba33ca4b0.source: Foes that only appear in Echovald Forest (e.g. Stone Scale Kirins) or the Jade Sea (e.g. Yeti) with the exception of Pongmei Valley will drop:
75247a1d0caa74ff482f9616182aecfba33ca4b0.text: 仅出现在埃科瓦尔德森林（例如石鳞麒麟）或玉海（例如雪人）（庞美谷除外）的敌人将会掉落：

203f07ef13978de82809a175f735da90c1eb0907.source: Kurzick Keys or Luxon Keys in normal mode, respectively, even though only Canthan Chests spawn in this area.
203f07ef13978de82809a175f735da90c1eb0907.text: 分别在正常模式下使用库兹克钥匙或卢克森钥匙，即使该区域仅生成凯森宝箱。

f2b45b7430f7974bebd248ed4e8afc9d52a55fde.source: Weapons that typically only drop in Echovald Forest (e.g. Amber weapons) or the Jade Sea (e.g. Jade weapons), respectively.
f2b45b7430f7974bebd248ed4e8afc9d52a55fde.text: 通常仅分别在 Echovald 森林（例如琥珀武器）或翡翠海（例如翡翠武器）中掉落的武器。

495a7b3f7eca1a2088296874e65c7cb2960df552.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.58% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
495a7b3f7eca1a2088296874e65c7cb2960df552.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Canthan 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.58%。

c2784931d55980fdaf9d7e77cd3087b2ca187d41.source: You will not gain a faction bonus for vanquishing this area. However, you can acquire blessings to gain points while killing foes from the Luxon Priest near Boreas Seabed or the Luxon/Kurzick Priest near Tanglewood Copse.
c2784931d55980fdaf9d7e77cd3087b2ca187d41.text: 征服该地区不会获得派系奖励。然而，您可以在杀死北风之神海底附近的卢克森牧师或坦格伍德树林附近的卢克森/库兹克牧师的敌人时获得祝福来获得积分。

dcfa755ee9dcb119a5e11fc05aad8b3ecdfd7a5b.source: You can skip fighting Meynsang the Sadistic by avoiding his spawn point.
dcfa755ee9dcb119a5e11fc05aad8b3ecdfd7a5b.text: 你可以通过避开施虐狂梅恩桑的重生点来跳过与他的战斗。

9c00f59e944f4ae2d535affd18a23754a5757cf8.source: If you trigger the Jade Brotherhood and Am Fah groups near Xuekao, the Deceptive, but leave the area without fighting them, it can save ~14 kills. This is easiest done by flagging a hero while most of the party stays near compass range.
9c00f59e944f4ae2d535affd18a23754a5757cf8.text: 如果你在欺骗者雪考附近触发翡翠兄弟会和阿姆法赫团体，但离开该地区而不与他们战斗，它可以节省约 14 人的死亡。最简单的方法是在大部分队伍都在指南针范围内时标记英雄。

a2be210e48091a40d988ccb28c480a67f3288547.source: Some Canthan Guards will fight the enemies on the map, and get killed by them.
a2be210e48091a40d988ccb28c480a67f3288547.text: 一些凯珊守卫会与地图上的敌人战斗，并被他们杀死。

b6cc64b9a4833405ad3ae78220ac0d85947b8591.source: Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Find Miller Upton and ask him to help Namar.
b6cc64b9a4833405ad3ae78220ac0d85947b8591.text: 沿着从城镇向西南方向行驶的道路前往阿什福德。找到米勒·厄普顿并请他帮助纳马尔。

3cd3d0ff351606870699a61d8e7481351cdb9515.source: Use the honeycomb to lure the three bee swarms across the bridge.
3cd3d0ff351606870699a61d8e7481351cdb9515.text: 使用蜂巢引诱三群蜂群过桥。

7c52cd979c08fbeaced6f29416a76ace90b890a2.source: Return to Miller Upton for your reward.
7c52cd979c08fbeaced6f29416a76ace90b890a2.text: 返回米勒厄普顿处领取奖励。

d82a61c0f906eb9dd94007a66b7f70ab7240a3ff.text: 护甲 +10（生命值低于 33% 时）

bc724242e8b1a35bb6bcdd7546a8ef13d3c3c530.source: Head down the southwest road from Ascalon City to Ashford and speak with Miller Upton. Before he can help Namar, you'll need to handle a bee problem for him. Pick up the Massive Honeycomb and approach the three bee swarms to grab their attention. Lead the swarms across the bridge until the quest updates, drop the honeycomb, and return to Upton for your reward.
bc724242e8b1a35bb6bcdd7546a8ef13d3c3c530.text: 沿着西南路从阿斯卡隆市前往阿什福德并与米勒·厄普顿交谈。在他帮助纳马尔之前，你需要帮他解决蜜蜂问题。拿起巨大的蜂窝并接近三群蜂群以吸引他们的注意力。带领蜂群过桥，直到任务更新，放下蜂巢，然后返回厄普顿领取奖励。

26b4c3f645deb1f3a86589f803eae87f9ff4f3a8.source: This quest introduces players to Bundle items.
26b4c3f645deb1f3a86589f803eae87f9ff4f3a8.text: 该任务向玩家介绍捆绑物品。

15f2cf5259d3bf177cfc3d07114e5c21a506575b.source: The path you take to bring the Massive Honeycomb across the bridge affects the quest getting updated.
15f2cf5259d3bf177cfc3d07114e5c21a506575b.text: 您将巨型蜂窝带过桥的路径会影响任务的更新。

3173376dc6c120b7ffa784d476dc699f7afc53dc.source: The bee swarms might get stuck during the quest and stop moving. The easiest way to get around this issue is to lead the bees underneath the bridge just within range of the quest marker to achieve quest completion.
3173376dc6c120b7ffa784d476dc699f7afc53dc.text: 蜂群可能会在任务过程中被卡住并停止移动。解决这个问题的最简单方法是引导蜜蜂到桥下任务标记的范围内以完成任务。

d3dd2bd25f810bf5d6247e74699f5d4523dde4ff.source: Glean information about the harpies from Captain Jafahni.
d3dd2bd25f810bf5d6247e74699f5d4523dde4ff.text: 从贾法尼船长那里收集有关鹰身女妖的信息。

b766aa0466b540c8eaa306f699beabc4ff298315.source: Scavenge the wilderness for Screecher and Scratcher. Kill them to reduce harpy morale.
b766aa0466b540c8eaa306f699beabc4ff298315.text: 在荒野中搜寻尖叫者和尖叫者。杀死他们可以降低鹰身女妖的士气。

c5251279a0022b34021af66e1aa10c6a51cb04d8.source: Captain Jafahni and the "Elder Skree" harpies in Wilderness of Bahdza (Elder Skree Griffins, Elder Skree Raiders, Elder Skree Singers, and Elder Skree Trackers) will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.
c5251279a0022b34021af66e1aa10c6a51cb04d8.text: 此任务完成后，贾法尼队长和巴德扎荒野中的“长者斯克里”鹰身女妖（长者斯克里狮鹫、长者斯克里袭击者、长者斯克里歌手和长者斯克里追踪者）将不再生成。

8e62b8d4f761510c7efa929a853f98f958902588.source: Start out from Dzagonur Bastion, and meet Captain Jafahni in the Wilderness of Bahdza (just to the east of the outpost). From here, follow your quest pointer deep into the wilderness to hunt down and slay the two harpy leaders: Screecher and Scratcher.
8e62b8d4f761510c7efa929a853f98f958902588.text: 从扎古努尔堡垒出发，在巴德扎荒野（就在前哨站的东边）与贾法尼队长会面。从这里开始，跟随你的任务指针深入荒野，追捕并杀死两个鹰身女妖首领：尖叫者和尖叫者。

c9007ec903b4f6daaf4875095f34145c0e65c1ee.source: Each leader will be accompanied by 3 other skree harpies, usually Trackers and Raiders. After defeating each leader's group, a 2nd group of skree will pop up and attempt to run away, towards the portal with Resplendent Makuun (without attacking the party); chasing them down or letting them run away does not affect the quest.
c9007ec903b4f6daaf4875095f34145c0e65c1ee.text: 每个领导者都会有 3 个其他斯克雷鹰身女妖陪同，通常是追踪者和掠夺者。击败每个首领的队伍后，第二组斯克雷会突然出现并试图逃跑，与辉煌的马库恩一起逃向传送门（不攻击队伍）；追赶他们或让他们逃跑并不影响任务。

c47907e29c67094dacb2592bb7c264afd10d2ec5.source: Alternately, one can zone into the Wilderness of Bahdza from the Resplendent Makuun entrance. Screecher and Scratcher are both relatively near the portal, and once they have been slain, you will receive credit for completion.
c47907e29c67094dacb2592bb7c264afd10d2ec5.text: 或者，您可以从辉煌的马库恩入口进入巴德扎荒野。尖叫者和尖叫者都相对靠近传送门，一旦他们被杀死，你将获得完成的积分。

0b7a9ba7131b2bd7d717c5eb38f2db6d353c184e.source: Once the two skree leaders have been killed, return to Prince Ahmtur in the north-west corner of the Wilderness (or map back to Dzagonur Bastion and take a short walk into the Citadel).
0b7a9ba7131b2bd7d717c5eb38f2db6d353c184e.text: 杀死两名斯克雷首领后，返回荒野西北角的阿姆图尔王子处（或返回扎古努尔堡垒并步行一小段距离进入城堡）。

df044826ad4db78d6c149e67c857ae02c1b9e103.source: The additional Skree popup group at the second leader, Scratcher, sometimes gets stuck on the shrine nearby when they try to run away.
df044826ad4db78d6c149e67c857ae02c1b9e103.text: 第二个领导者 Scratcher 的额外 Skree 弹出小组有时在试图逃跑时被困在附近的神殿上。

598e09dc75af691b2cf704ca1db2b0c3e1592b97.source: The group of Skrees near Scratcher will attack you when you begin to fight with him, but occasionally if you inflict enough damage they will run away through the portal into Resplendent Makuun.
598e09dc75af691b2cf704ca1db2b0c3e1592b97.text: 当你开始与 Scratcher 战斗时，Scratcher 附近的 Skrees 群会攻击你，但偶尔如果你造成足够的伤害，他们会通过传送门逃到 Resplendent Makuun。

cd1e774baff8dcbccf2d3ebad37d6415ce826d06.source: See Headmaster Quin for your reward.
cd1e774baff8dcbccf2d3ebad37d6415ce826d06.text: 去找奎恩校长领取奖励。

bdb4bd4dc3bb45332e6b8318a3176ce59c7dfba5.source: Leave from Tsumei Village and head south to talk to Jaikmo, then head south again and kill the Unbound Spirit.
bdb4bd4dc3bb45332e6b8318a3176ce59c7dfba5.text: 从Tsumei村出发，向南走与Jaikmo对话，然后再次向南走，杀死Unbound Spirit。

f9d832cb7aa4f30683bd5ac5182c96dfe73500cd.source: Travel to Jaga Moraine and find the bottomless pit.
f9d832cb7aa4f30683bd5ac5182c96dfe73500cd.text: 前往贾加冰碛并找到无底洞。

1613308f5587d0e2e1283e3e34bd1923faf1fdac.source: Travel to the northeastern corner of Jaga Moraine to find the bottomless pit, and defeat Ssissth the Leviathan.
1613308f5587d0e2e1283e3e34bd1923faf1fdac.text: 前往贾加冰碛的东北角找到无底洞，并击败利维坦西斯。

bac5b0cb22a8d2f956f58bda87010aad4f1cf969.source: You can save time by combining this quest with A Hunter's Pride, Krak's Cavalry, and Anything You Can Do.
bac5b0cb22a8d2f956f58bda87010aad4f1cf969.text: 你可以通过将此任务与猎人的骄傲、克拉克的骑兵和任何你能做的事情结合起来来节省时间。

2728cdafdc4d05da250acd4ccdb0acca27790987.source: This quest cannot be repeated after an Extreme Makeover Credit (sex change) because the boss will not be there.
2728cdafdc4d05da250acd4ccdb0acca27790987.text: 在获得极限改造积分（性别改变）后无法重复此任务，因为老板不会在那里。

ad1594604ba95425ebe36587d76a42e78cd9a751.source: Kill the Priest of Menzies in the Fissure of Woe.
ad1594604ba95425ebe36587d76a42e78cd9a751.text: 杀死悲伤裂缝中的孟席斯牧师。

12137440d6e941f05f3106a4f49090530cf36a84.source: *BONUS* Kill the Priest of Menzies in Hard Mode.
12137440d6e941f05f3106a4f49090530cf36a84.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死孟席斯牧师。

9ac66b759c256d2b95eae3a4be5a308718c23277.source: As per Army of Darkness walkthrough.

3435c90610ba6eb12b535fd507d0c2779628ad51.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Dragon Lich Zaishen quest, since that quest is available from the Zaishen Bounty signpost on the eighth day after this quest (based on the Zaishen Bounty cycle) and both targets are found in the same location at the Great Battle Field.
3435c90610ba6eb12b535fd507d0c2779628ad51.text: 考虑与龙巫妖再神任务同时完成此任务，因为该任务可在该任务后的第八天从再神赏金路标处获得（基于再神赏金周期），并且两个目标都在大战场的同一位置找到。

4d6a0b655ecf3cefcd5a4787ff9769bbc1a75bec.source: Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in the Depths of Tyria. Lists the region instead of the dungeon name
4d6a0b655ecf3cefcd5a4787ff9769bbc1a75bec.text: 在泰瑞亚深处杀死 3 只棱柱软泥怪。列出区域而不是地下城名称

c0033918ee6c69a2041fd5b29b81aefa3d439a44.source: *BONUS* Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in Hard Mode.
c0033918ee6c69a2041fd5b29b81aefa3d439a44.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 3 个棱柱软泥怪。

d12311fd1826e6f7794a491b6ae57405db83e5e1.source: As per the Watch it Jiggle quest. At least one party member must have the quest in order to get past the locked gate in the dungeon.
d12311fd1826e6f7794a491b6ae57405db83e5e1.text: 根据“Watch it Jiggle”任务。至少一名党员必须完成任务才能穿过地牢上锁的大门。

03e23735899fadda81fb586ada576b959e535517.source: This quest takes place entirely in Wajjun Bazaar and requires little (if any) fighting. Due to the sequence of events, it does require a significant amount of "backtracking" to complete, since Guardsman Pah is located between Paomu and Officer Chitaro, and Budo is located beyond both of them (along the path to The Marketplace). Once you have spoken to Paomu, Officer Chitaro and Guardsman Pah (in that order), you can map travel to The Marketplace to meet Budo, before returning to Paomu for the reward. If you have access to Nahpui Quarter then map traveling there after meeting Budo shortens the amount of time to complete this quest.
03e23735899fadda81fb586ada576b959e535517.text: 这个任务完全发生在Wajjun Bazaar，几乎不需要（如果有的话）战斗。由于事件的顺序，它确实需要大量的“回溯”才能完成，因为卫兵 Pah 位于 Paomu 和军官 Chitaro 之间，而 Budo 位于他们两人之外（沿着通往市场的路径）。与 Paomu、Chitaro 警官和 Pah 卫士（按顺序）交谈后，您可以在地图上前往市场与 Budo 会面，然后返回 Paomu 获取奖励。如果你有权进入纳普伊区，那么在遇见布多后前往那里的地图会缩短完成此任务的时间。

525f940f58870894c0b33acbb576549a5dee0b7f.source: Meet Poturi on the Plains of Jarin.
525f940f58870894c0b33acbb576549a5dee0b7f.text: 在贾林平原遇见波图里。

96bc80c284631ca1860b2a44353e65a1c1abaa4a.source: Retrieve the sword from the injured Corsair.
96bc80c284631ca1860b2a44353e65a1c1abaa4a.text: 从受伤的海盗身上取回剑。

4ec31c58ee9a8621b715db7a33246bdd5616e901.source: Speak to Poturi for your reward.
4ec31c58ee9a8621b715db7a33246bdd5616e901.text: 与波图里交谈以获得奖励。

843be8cd31f31670e548bf6a326b94c53b9025b3.source: [Incomplete source section] Exit the Sunspear Great Hall into the Plains of Jarin with Poturi and travel to where the Wounded Corsair is. There's a surprisingly large group of corsairs around him, so if you're still a low level you may wish to try pulling the groups of four, one by one. Defeat the Wounded Corsair and then interact with the Corsair Chest to receive the Notched Sword. No key is required. Speak with Poturi afterward for your reward.
843be8cd31f31670e548bf6a326b94c53b9025b3.text: [不完整的来源部分] 与 Poturi 一起离开阳矛大厅进入贾林平原，前往受伤海盗所在的地方。他周围有一大群海盗，如果你等级还低的话，不妨尝试一下四人一组，一一拉。击败受伤的海盗，然后与海盗宝箱互动以获得缺口剑。不需要钥匙。之后与波图里交谈以获得奖励。

cbe27f885b8ff8b092e9b388f3f1a8ddbeaf9374.source: Clear Prophet's Path in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
cbe27f885b8ff8b092e9b388f3f1a8ddbeaf9374.text: 在困难模式下清除水晶沙漠中所有敌人的先知之路。

50b3591e88840b98bf75f776221654bc4d669bbe.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.72% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
50b3591e88840b98bf75f776221654bc4d669bbe.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.72%。

7abec3cb0d8b7efe0ad7038b94266cd12814f742.source: There are lots of hidden scarabs and devourers, with several Sand Wurms and Salving Cactuses. The Salving Cactuses may burrow similar to wurms for a short time.
7abec3cb0d8b7efe0ad7038b94266cd12814f742.text: 这里有很多隐藏的圣甲虫和吞噬者，还有一些沙龙和救援仙人掌。救援仙人掌可能会像亚龙一样在短时间内挖洞。

9036f60c1839fdf63da78e38bdec2efd86919291.source: The area around Kepkhet Marrowfeast is likely the most difficult, as there are several Scarab Nest Builders that cannot be pulled away (but you can pull the boss). Ranged damage is best because the Scarab Nest Builders litter the area with traps. Consider clearing out the patrols around the boss before engaging. The patrols are hostile to non-scarab foes.
9036f60c1839fdf63da78e38bdec2efd86919291.text: Kepkhet Marrowfeast 周围的区域可能是最困难的，因为有几个圣甲虫筑巢者无法被拉走（但你可以拉 Boss）。远程伤害是最好的，因为圣甲虫筑巢者会在该区域布满陷阱。在交战之前考虑清除 Boss 周围的巡逻队。巡逻队对非圣甲虫敌人充满敌意。

e9f43779e78bc2370fb6f2365385a04bb0295166.source: The foes here use conditions liberally. Condition removal skills can be brought, but since they are reapplied very quickly, it is best to bring skills to counter health degeneration.
e9f43779e78bc2370fb6f2365385a04bb0295166.text: 这里的敌人可以随意利用条件。可以携带消除状况的技能，但由于它们重新应用的速度非常快，因此最好携带对抗生命退化的技能。

bac36e24be4d240434389139acb9bd02c9fc9308.source: The hydra boss (random profession) patrols a long route west of Augury Rock and might be missed.
bac36e24be4d240434389139acb9bd02c9fc9308.text: 九头蛇头目（随机职业）在占卜岩以西的一条漫长路线上巡逻，可能会被错过。

75379617dc1f935bec8b1bd8d485759f9e567948.source: Even if the player waits on the hydra boss route, the hydra may not approach the player on its own. Various groups of patrolling minotaurs are hostile to all foes, including other minotaurs. If you start from Augury Rock, Heroes' Audience, or Vulture Drifts and kill all the foes south of the green oasis belt, sometimes the area is considered vanquished, even if there are still foes north of the line of greenery (the area outside of the Amnoon Oasis).
75379617dc1f935bec8b1bd8d485759f9e567948.text: 即使玩家在九头蛇头目路线上等待，九头蛇也可能不会自行接近玩家。各种巡逻的牛头怪群体对所有敌人都怀有敌意，包括其他牛头怪。如果你从占卜岩、英雄观众或秃鹫漂流开始，杀死绿洲带以南的所有敌人，有时该地区被认为已被征服，即使在绿化线以北（安努绿洲以外的区域）仍然有敌人。

45514d4478561f52b753ec751a6a203e8f6b8fb5.source: Protect the Halcyon from Outcast raiders. You have 7..0 groups remaining.
45514d4478561f52b753ec751a6a203e8f6b8fb5.text: 保护翡翠鸟免受流放者的袭击。您还剩下 7..0 个组。

6d294b7d722517cef2bd04ccde577b2b85a0bfc3.source: See Captain Lexis for your reward.
6d294b7d722517cef2bd04ccde577b2b85a0bfc3.text: 去找莱克西斯船长领取奖励。

5e66a6211f8b7f8d91d998b902bcc52a71d36d07.source: This quest simply requires you to fight off several waves of attacking Outcasts. This is most easily accomplished with ranged attacks or spells. A warrior (or minion master) can tank the Outcasts as they head inside and move upwards to your position.
5e66a6211f8b7f8d91d998b902bcc52a71d36d07.text: 这个任务只需要你击退几波攻击的流放者。通过远程攻击或法术最容易实现这一点。当流放者进入并向上移动到你的位置时，战士（或随从大师）可以坦克他们。

98ca10ba9517cf0ebf3dc14c1ed6952ff0a58b90.source: After obtaining the quest, travel to Zos Shivros Channel and head out the northern gate into the Boreas Seabed. The Halcyon is the large ship just to the north of your starting location.
98ca10ba9517cf0ebf3dc14c1ed6952ff0a58b90.text: 获得任务后，前往佐斯希夫罗斯海峡，从北门前往北风之神海底。 Halcyon 是一艘位于您起始位置以北的大型船。

8237128a95f64e08457c68e74f8b0624838bf394.source: The ship is hollow with several levels of walkways inside. Rion is located up the first ramp, on the tiny first level. Talking to him immediately starts the waves of attackers. Head up the ramp to the second level and attack from here. This level is within casting range of the NPCs in the area (who have Word of Healing) and attacking range of the Outcasts on the ground.
8237128a95f64e08457c68e74f8b0624838bf394.text: 船是中空的，里面有几层走道。 Rion 位于第一个坡道上，位于狭小的第一层。与他交谈立即引发一波又一波的攻击。沿着坡道前往第二层，然后从这里攻击。该等级处于该地区 NPC（拥有治愈之言）的施法范围和地面上的流亡者的攻击范围内。

dc383c99c0025c1924e9715cbd0ad43b5eebf547.source: Targeting opponents requires moving along the walkways rather than moving to ground level. Be careful of this when targeting the next opponent. Whether using the keyboard or the mouse to target opponents, game mechanics will move you downward rather than along the walkway to a viable shooting location.
dc383c99c0025c1924e9715cbd0ad43b5eebf547.text: 瞄准对手需要沿着走道移动而不是移动到地面。当瞄准下一个对手时要小心这一点。无论是使用键盘还是鼠标来瞄准对手，游戏机制都会让你向下移动，而不是沿着走道到达可行的射击位置。

3d96947dfdd0e9e1dabf907d57b0ba0450f0717e.source: If somebody in your group has the Quest "The Halcyon Job" active, the assault will not start and your quest log states that you have 7 groups remaining.
3d96947dfdd0e9e1dabf907d57b0ba0450f0717e.text: 如果你的队伍中有人激活了任务“The Halcyon Job”，攻击将不会开始，并且你的任务日志显示你还剩下 7 个队伍。

9c7b5f952d6c370b9e791e06c427ccf699873f00.source: Alert the scholars about the assault on the Halls of Chokhin. You have spoken to 0...8 of 8 scholars.
9c7b5f952d6c370b9e791e06c427ccf699873f00.text: 向学者们通报乔欣大厅遭到的袭击。您已与 8 位学者中的 0...8 位进行过交谈。

b88dc1704386c314e3021682145539268ec51ab8.source: Protect the scholars from the advancing Margonite forces. At least 4 scholars must survive. 8...0 of 8 scholars are still alive.
b88dc1704386c314e3021682145539268ec51ab8.text: 保护学者们免受玛贡尼特势力的侵害。至少有 4 名学者必须幸存。 8 名学者中有 8...0 人还活着。

ace165820f2547d9c6ffc107bbdd3632275bc207.source: Eliminate the groups of Margonites attacking Chokhin. 12...0 of 12 groups remain.
ace165820f2547d9c6ffc107bbdd3632275bc207.text: 消灭攻击乔欣的玛贡派团体。 12 组中的 12...0 剩余。

2fcd134fba1e97eaacb233f8555c953553d87c15.source: When this quest is active, there appear to be "hidden" triggers in the Halls of Chokhin which set off each wave of Margonite groups, however, these triggers only become active after the party has spoken to all 8 scholars. When the scholars are spoken to, they will run to the shrine of Lyssa at the north-west side of the halls. For this reason, it is best to start talking to the scholars furthest from the shrine, then work your way in to speak to the closest scholars last.
2fcd134fba1e97eaacb233f8555c953553d87c15.text: 当这个任务激活时，乔欣大厅里似乎有“隐藏”的触发器，它会引发每一波玛贡尼特团体，然而，这些触发器只有在该队伍与所有 8 位学者交谈后才会激活。当与学者们交谈时，他们会跑到大厅西北侧的莱莎神殿。因此，最好先与距离神社最远的学者交谈，然后最后与最近的学者交谈。

bece2d335c005af9dc6b2ebc7e0963bd9a013b02.source: Once all the scholars have been spoken to and have congregated at the shrine, the party can start to trigger the Margonite groups. This is best done by carefully moving forward on one side while holding the Show Targets key (Left Ctrl by default) until you can see a Margonite group, and then moving enough to trigger make them head towards the scholars. At this point, hold your position to head them off, or retreat to a suitable ambush/blocking point.
bece2d335c005af9dc6b2ebc7e0963bd9a013b02.text: 一旦与所有学者交谈并聚集在神社后，该队伍就可以开始触发玛贡尼特团体。最好的方法是在按住“显示目标”键（默认情况下为左Ctrl）的同时小心地向一侧前进，直到您可以看到玛贡尼特群体，然后移动足够的距离以触发他们朝学者走去。此时，坚守阵地阻止他们，或者撤退到合适的伏击/阻挡点。

27720a444e679da40a1f189f624d43620ee703a6.source: Even with this careful approach, you will likely find that the Margonites attack in waves of 3 groups (so 2 waves on each of the north and south sides to make the total 12 groups). Do note that there are 4 different kinds of groups. The first group at the east are mostly rangers. The 2nd at the east side are melee. The 2 groups on the west side are both casters and melee.
27720a444e679da40a1f189f624d43620ee703a6.text: 即使采用这种谨慎的方法，您也可能会发现玛贡尼特人会以 3 组为一组进行攻击（因此南北两侧各各 2 波，总共 12 组）。请注意，有 4 种不同类型的组。东部的第一组主要是护林员。东侧第二场是混战。西侧2组都是法师和近战。

09da48138d4c487ebb759c5c57ad08206b54ed3c.source: When you have cleared the 6 groups on one side in this fashion, switch to the other and repeat.
09da48138d4c487ebb759c5c57ad08206b54ed3c.text: 当您以这种方式清除一侧的 6 个组时，切换到另一侧并重复。

eee3339260bd0b0cd3ca6c435f264fe0c5b250d6.source: The terrain here benefits a smart party: make use of height advantage by standing at the top of stairs and use ranged attacks to increase damage; use body blocking at corners to hold groups and nuke them together; wells and wards can help the party or hinder foes (minion masters or other corpse users will have plenty of material); since the Margonites will have to cross bridges or climb narrow stairways, placing traps in their path before you trigger each wave can be of great help too. Casting Death Nova on minions to spread poison is also useful.
eee3339260bd0b0cd3ca6c435f264fe0c5b250d6.text: 这里的地形有利于聪明的一方：利用高度优势，站在楼梯顶部，使用远程攻击来增加伤害；在角落使用身体阻挡来控制群体并将他们集中在一起；水井和守卫可以帮助队伍或阻碍敌人（小兵大师或其他尸体使用者将拥有大量材料）；由于玛贡尼特人必须过桥或爬狭窄的楼梯，因此在触发每一波浪潮之前在他们的路径上放置陷阱也会有很大帮助。对小兵施放死亡新星来传播毒药也很有用。

71c4561b7d27051c3c8af8eeb0c887b6f684607f.source: For more tips and tactics for this mission, see this article's Talk page
71c4561b7d27051c3c8af8eeb0c887b6f684607f.text: 有关此任务的更多提示和策略，请参阅本文的讨论页面

be506ee1de61982b8b0f43c4919c072eeb02a30f.source: Find Paulus the Monk in Regent Valley
be506ee1de61982b8b0f43c4919c072eeb02a30f.text: 在摄政谷找到僧侣保卢斯

cd382d14e5e504db5f489322c51979a0e2c2e89d.source: Search Paulus's body for any personal effects.
cd382d14e5e504db5f489322c51979a0e2c2e89d.text: 搜查保卢斯的尸体，寻找任何个人物品。

66ca3d8d162e8f8cce99863f245622c34e92121e.source: Return the holy symbol to Grazden the Protector.
66ca3d8d162e8f8cce99863f245622c34e92121e.text: 将圣徽归还给保护者格拉兹登。

2fb808d506c32312e66996fae4cfad86d4a76899.source: Go into Regent Valley to look for Paulus. If you're having trouble finding the path to the portal, follow the creek bed in the direction of Ascalon City a short distance until you can climb a hill on your right. Once through the portal it's a fairly straight path; just follow the quest arrow. Alternatively start from Fort Ranik and walk alongside the aqueduct. This not only is extremely easy to find but also much shorter.
2fb808d506c32312e66996fae4cfad86d4a76899.text: 进入摄政谷寻找保卢斯。如果您找不到通往传送门的路径，请沿着河床向阿斯卡隆城方向走一小段距离，直到您可以爬上右侧的一座小山。一旦通过传送门，就会出现一条相当笔直的路径；只需跟随任务箭头即可。或者从拉尼克堡出发，沿着渡槽行走。这不仅非常容易找到，而且也短得多。

26ccfd4d06e6d7c23f1f6cb72c7345d27492c5f7.source: You'll find that you are too late to save him. You'll need to click on his body to obtain his holy symbol to take back to Grazden. Beware, though. Party members will become poisoned by the spot. Return the symbol to Grazden.
26ccfd4d06e6d7c23f1f6cb72c7345d27492c5f7.text: 你会发现你已经来不及拯救他了。你需要点击他的身体以获得他的圣徽并带回格拉兹登。不过要小心。党员会当场中毒。将符号返回给格拉兹登。

327b127d69843cf267ec39c3c3ea23a7d457ba97.source: The poison inflicted by interacting with Paulus's body suggests that he fell to a similar environment effect to the one monk players had to protect him from in pre-Searing.
327b127d69843cf267ec39c3c3ea23a7d457ba97.text: 与保卢斯身体相互作用而产生的毒素表明，他陷入了与僧侣玩家在灼热前必须保护他免受伤害的环境影响类似的环境影响。

447d98aa2775ff7b09b2260010244f030d3dd17a.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: monk
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
447d98aa2775ff7b09b2260010244f030d3dd17a.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：僧侣
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

f9e2ad4a2bc3f2960289cf7ecb66dcc232f7a299.source: Meet Farrah Cappo in Lakeside County.
f9e2ad4a2bc3f2960289cf7ecb66dcc232f7a299.text: 在湖滨县与法拉·卡波 (Farrah Cappo) 见面。

d8de0024005c4f57f750305f76c4a7d0fd7c8bf8.source: Keep Farrah alive while she hunts down the infamous Alain.
d8de0024005c4f57f750305f76c4a7d0fd7c8bf8.text: 保护法拉的生命，同时她追捕臭名昭著的阿兰。

b7994fb2e12b56e52a315865b27a35d419038b40.source: Return to Grazden the Protector for your reward.
b7994fb2e12b56e52a315865b27a35d419038b40.text: 返回保护者格拉兹登那里领取奖励。

e9f7dd182bc246dc3571f10616e34969981ce4b1.source: Grazden will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
e9f7dd182bc246dc3571f10616e34969981ce4b1.text: 接受任务后，格拉兹登会给你以下技能：

0ba6a122ac20ff4557963ef8ac3ad2dc48626d7a.source: After accepting the quest from Grazden the Protector, leave Green Hills County to Lakeside County. There you will find Farrah Cappo waiting for you. She will start running to fight the groups of bandits. Follow her and make sure she doesn't die. You can help her fight if you want but the main objective of the quest is to keep her alive. Once she fights off four groups she will run into Alain. Keep Farrah alive at all costs. Once he is dead run back to Green Hills County to talk to Grazden the Protector for your reward.
0ba6a122ac20ff4557963ef8ac3ad2dc48626d7a.text: 接受守护者格拉兹登的任务后，离开青山郡前往湖滨郡。在那里您会发现法拉·卡波 (Farrah Cappo) 正在等您。她将开始奔跑与强盗团伙作战。跟着她，确保她不会死。如果你愿意，你可以帮助她战斗，但任务的主要目标是让她活下去。一旦她击退了四支队伍，她就会遇到阿兰。不惜一切代价保住法拉的生命。一旦他死了，就跑回绿山县与保护者格拉兹登交谈以获得奖励。

3ed855792a1a3962891e3ac0e0ccc11404f41a14.source: If Alain kills you but Farrah still manages to kill him, you will get credit for completing the quest
3ed855792a1a3962891e3ac0e0ccc11404f41a14.text: 如果阿兰杀了你，但法拉仍然设法杀了他，你将获得完成任务的荣誉

58789bdeabe8c6c69df5e7fc99a528129923dd7d.source: Alternatively, if you kill Alain before the escort (which only starts when you approach Farrah at the Green Hills County zone portal), the quest will be marked complete once Farrah reaches Alain's location safely.
58789bdeabe8c6c69df5e7fc99a528129923dd7d.text: 或者，如果你在护送之前杀死阿兰（只有当你在青山县区域门户接近法拉时才会开始），一旦法拉安全到达阿兰的位置，任务将被标记为完成。

76076062761aa37cca5efe288985f448f978d755.source: Speak to Kilroy to start your brawling training.
76076062761aa37cca5efe288985f448f978d755.text: 与基尔罗伊交谈以开始你的争吵训练。

e9341183965a7f087e776d10f0e9a627464ba4f0.source: Defeat the Norn brawlers using your new skills.
e9341183965a7f087e776d10f0e9a627464ba4f0.text: 使用你的新技能击败诺恩乱斗者。

e02a844952d4bd3f68ba4b5fb2d6b94dfca913a9.source: Accepting Kilroy's quest offer will not place the Brass Knuckles in your inventory yet, but you will have it once you enter the arena and will need to equip it in your weapon slot. Your skills will be replaced with the Brawling build. The Norn Brawlers will become hostile in order. First, two single brawlers will face you, then a pair and finally the last three. Your health is partially refilled any time you defeat a brawler, and the next set does not turn hostile until you have defeated all the previous group.
e02a844952d4bd3f68ba4b5fb2d6b94dfca913a9.text: 接受基尔罗伊的任务不会将指节铜套放入你的库存中，但是一旦你进入竞技场，你就会拥有它，并且需要将它装备到你的武器槽中。你的技能将被斗殴技能所取代。诺恩乱斗者将按顺序变得敌对。首先，两个单独的斗士将面对你，然后是一对，最后是最后三个。每当你击败一个争吵者时，你的生命值都会得到部分恢复，并且在你击败前一组之前，下一组不会变得敌对。

8d4f6f7088cc492eea97d2fa214aad2bdd137bb5.source: Although the pair and trio of Norn Brawlers move to the center of the arena as if they were a group, they actually are not together as a team and using a longbow/flatbow or slowly moving towards them from the side can help you pull just one at a time.
8d4f6f7088cc492eea97d2fa214aad2bdd137bb5.text: 虽然一对或三人诺恩斗殴者像一群人一样移动到竞技场中央，但他们实际上并不是一个团队，使用长弓/扁弓或从侧面慢慢向他们移动可以帮助你一次只拉一个。

2819fb91060c0cde116a6205c16dd00eb4e130a4.source: Seek the meaning of the ancient parchment.
2819fb91060c0cde116a6205c16dd00eb4e130a4.text: 寻找古代羊皮纸的含义。
