8b1a6c2c9d9652157c8e06b87cf3279275b98e27.source: Map travel to Tihark Orchard, then head out into the western Forum Highlands, and speak to Seborhin Protector Zuor to gain entrance to the Garden of Seborhin. Once in the garden, make your way to Hedge Wizard Mabai located in the middle area of the east side. Speak to Mabai and show him the ancient parchment to complete the quest.
8b1a6c2c9d9652157c8e06b87cf3279275b98e27.text: 地图旅行到蒂哈克果园，然后前往西部论坛高地，与塞博欣保护者祖尔交谈，获得进入塞博欣花园的入口。进入花园后，前往位于东侧中部区域的树篱向导马白。与马白交谈并向他展示古老的羊皮纸以完成任务。

e915ce1e1e87f80f575918a5017d41b49c085dce.source: You can only complete this quest if you have completed the Nightfall campaign, or if you have Tahlkora in your party (before the garden becomes Nightfallen).
e915ce1e1e87f80f575918a5017d41b49c085dce.text: 只有当你完成了夜幕降临战役，或者你的队伍中有塔尔科拉（在花园变成夜幕降临之前）时，你才能完成这个任务。

9df8a5c2ec174a9d07bbaa89a1485c294ec77ac6.source: The garden is not always accessible. See Garden of Seborhin for details.
9df8a5c2ec174a9d07bbaa89a1485c294ec77ac6.text: 花园并不总是可以进入。详情请参阅塞博欣花园。

cf2eee1705855a65ceb82342b7606cd0b9030238.source: Kill Pywatt the Swift in Alcazia Tangle.
cf2eee1705855a65ceb82342b7606cd0b9030238.text: 杀死阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区的迅捷者皮瓦特。

c7998f62def3bf81a7ac080d22f07ae9cc2e036e.source: *BONUS* Kill Pywatt the Swift in Hard Mode.
c7998f62def3bf81a7ac080d22f07ae9cc2e036e.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死迅捷的皮瓦特。

7d2d3644bbd5c25aa1dd965a0f77ba48fdd1bef7.source: The simplest way to reach Pywatt is to leave from Rata Sum via Magus Stones. Use the southeast portal to travel to Alcazia Tangle; Pywatt is just south of the portal in Alcazia Tangle.
7d2d3644bbd5c25aa1dd965a0f77ba48fdd1bef7.text: 到达皮瓦特的最简单方法是从拉塔苏姆经魔法石离开。使用东南传送门前往阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔；皮瓦特位于阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔传送门的南边。

e1d568fa9d8e75b1701024cb5fcb6e6f09ec0ae8.source: Goes well with the quest Turning the Page.

d55d1bc8f447bd59acd1b77d80439f2f8d37d644.source: Deliver the custom sword to Castellan Puuba at the Sunspear Great Hall.
d55d1bc8f447bd59acd1b77d80439f2f8d37d644.text: 将定制剑交给阳矛大厅的城堡主普乌巴。

09bd7e0235c2b71b1bcdec8487110c2c9bca131c.source: Meet up with Castellan Puuba on the Plains of Jarin.
09bd7e0235c2b71b1bcdec8487110c2c9bca131c.text: 在贾林平原与普巴堡主会面。

28dffa3252df9476014a1e91203c62581e393e0f.source: Fight beside Castellan Puuba as he tries out his new, customized sword. You have slain x of 10 creatures.
28dffa3252df9476014a1e91203c62581e393e0f.text: 当普巴堡主尝试他的新定制剑时，与他并肩作战。你已经杀死了 10 个生物中的 x。

008dd4d84690773529f4f096dcee1d19c6a7b2d3.text: 请参阅 Chorben [武器] 以获得奖励。

311fd650be17f5b9648aaf012c5ceb5be8dd7a5a.source: If you don't have the Sunspear Great Hall on your map yet you can combine this quest with Armored Transport, which will take you there. If you haven't entered the Sunpspear Great Hall after that quest you have to go there now and enter the outpost. Once in the Sunspear Great Hall, find Castellan Puuba (you can use the "Alt" key to find NPCs inside a town/outpost). When you talk to him he will ask you to go outside into Plains of Jarin to test his new blade.
311fd650be17f5b9648aaf012c5ceb5be8dd7a5a.text: 如果你的地图上没有阳矛大厅，你可以将此任务与装甲运输车结合起来，它将带你去那里。如果在该任务之后你还没有进入阳矛大厅，你现在就必须去那里并进入前哨站。进入阳矛大厅后，找到 Castellan Puuba（您可以使用“Alt”键查找城镇/前哨站内的 NPC）。当你和他交谈时，他会要求你去贾林平原测试他的新剑。

67af019dfefa30382e42764933de2cee05ded152.source: Enter the area and after taking the Insect Hunt Bounty at the resurrection shrine, approach Castellan Puuba. He will now be added to your party as a ally. Straight ahead from the entrance there is a colony of Stalking Nephila. Lead the Castellan there and he will start to attack them; and, as a good ally, he will even change his target to whatever target you are attacking. After slaying the required 10 creatures, the Castellan will thank you for your help and you can return to Kamadan to collect your reward.
67af019dfefa30382e42764933de2cee05ded152.text: 进入该区域，在复活神殿获得昆虫狩猎赏金后，接近城主普乌巴。他现在将作为盟友添加到您的队伍中。入口正前方有一群潜行新蜘蛛。将城主带到那里，他就会开始攻击他们；而且，作为一个好的盟友，他甚至会改变他的目标，无论你攻击什么目标。杀死所需的 10 个生物后，城主会感谢你的帮助，你可以返回卡马丹领取奖励。

3cd64f53790c2a2af12f345aad0d8fe35d8f9c68.source: Puuba doesn't personally have to slay a beast to make it count.
3cd64f53790c2a2af12f345aad0d8fe35d8f9c68.text: 普巴并不需要亲自杀死一头野兽才算有价值。

d7a875b4792207772708ffd89a1ef1cec2de5989.source: Combines well with Armored Transport, Proof of Courage, and Map-Travel Inventor.
d7a875b4792207772708ffd89a1ef1cec2de5989.text: 与装甲运输、勇气证明和地图旅行发明者完美结合。

693685810d341c7af3def28a0a8e5b284a8a1b21.source: The word Castellan is a Title, not part of the NPC's Name.
693685810d341c7af3def28a0a8e5b284a8a1b21.text: Castellan 这个词是一个头衔，而不是 NPC 名字的一部分。

26a23ca8d6c015fcaab8321332794cfb31e9d595.source: Unlike most other quests when you give an item to an NPC, there doesn't appear to be a text notification that Puuba takes his sword.
26a23ca8d6c015fcaab8321332794cfb31e9d595.text: 与大多数其他任务不同的是，当你将物品交给 NPC 时，似乎不会出现 Puuba 拿走他的剑的文字通知。

21f7223d86db26ea44180fcc601eb04b998f9bee.source: Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in Tahnnakai Temple.
21f7223d86db26ea44180fcc601eb04b998f9bee.text: 在塔纳凯神庙杀死拳松灵语。

4b893a75d58f6bee94e887234dcc35030272a6b6.source: *BONUS* Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in Hard Mode.
4b893a75d58f6bee94e887234dcc35030272a6b6.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死拳松灵语。

5174d4b6075f73a1d34f49bc842009e76e81a48b.source: Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from Zin Ku Corridor. Be prepared for area of effect fire damage from the Temple Guardians around him. If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak.
5174d4b6075f73a1d34f49bc842009e76e81a48b.text: 从 Zin Ku 走廊向北穿过 Tahnnakai 神庙探索区。做好应对周围圣殿守护者造成的区域火焰伤害的准备。如果你沿着右边地图上的路径走，你只会在前往拳松灵语的路上遇到神殿守护者。

1e9166a271f94f76ad32344ad279f228c3d8c7ad.source: You will not encounter any physical attackers, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here; however, Temple Guardians have Stun on Critical Hit.
1e9166a271f94f76ad32344ad279f228c3d8c7ad.text: 你不会遇到任何物理攻击者，所以格挡、失手、致盲的技能在这里效果较差；然而，圣殿守护者在暴击时会晕眩。

5141e021bca77222a3894b38da56605221b32680.source: Quansong Spiritspeak and Temple Guardians are not fleshy creatures, so skills that exploit corpses and inflict bleeding, disease, or poison are ineffective against them.
5141e021bca77222a3894b38da56605221b32680.text: 拳松灵语和圣殿守护者都不是肉质生物，因此利用尸体并造成流血、疾病或中毒的技能对他们无效。

ec4ef189a6c6a99c42be4559508dbb1a5564ba92.source: You will only encounter spellcaster mobs, so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the Temple Guardians (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, and Winnowing).
ec4ef189a6c6a99c42be4559508dbb1a5564ba92.text: 你只会遇到施法者小怪，所以考虑带上反施法者技能和/或各种游侠自然仪式，这些仪式可以使你的队伍受益，但不能使圣殿守护者受益（例如顺风、真热和风选）。

e946a57f5acfcbd0fe47623b511b57fca9f87c75.source: Temple Guardians have less armor rating against cold damage, so consider bringing Winter or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing Water Magic hex spells that snare and deal cold damage (i.e. Deep Freeze, Ice Spikes, Mind Freeze, and Shard Storm), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your midline/backline and dealing point blank area of effect damage from Temple Guardians' Double Dragon and Quansong Spiritspeak's Ancestors' Rage.
e946a57f5acfcbd0fe47623b511b57fca9f87c75.text: 圣殿守护者对寒冷伤害的护甲等级较低，因此请考虑使用冬季或造成寒冷伤害的技能。考虑使用水魔法六角咒语，这些咒语会诱捕并造成寒冷伤害（即深度冻结、冰刺、心灵冻结和碎片风暴），这将减慢他们的移动速度，并有助于防止他们到达你的中线/后线，并从圣殿守护者的双龙和拳松灵语的祖先之怒中造成空白区域的效果伤害。

c3d06df2194df9e28d0bf48c1e753bf3a99378a7.source: Temple Guardians have less armor rating against blunt damage, so consider using a weapon that deals blunt damage.
c3d06df2194df9e28d0bf48c1e753bf3a99378a7.text: 圣殿守卫针对钝器伤害的护甲等级较低，因此请考虑使用造成钝器伤害的武器。

05f2befbca377024413d56cb97731c3c1ba31ad9.source: Speak to Miner Tonabanza at the Cliffs of Dohjok and tell him you will stand guard while he continues mining.
05f2befbca377024413d56cb97731c3c1ba31ad9.text: 与多赫约克悬崖的矿工托纳班扎交谈，告诉他在他继续采矿时你会站岗。

ddf0795c9fc183b495a6bf19c026143805fc9354.source: Protect the miner if he gets attacked.
ddf0795c9fc183b495a6bf19c026143805fc9354.text: 如果矿工受到攻击，请保护他。

113e28c1fddb82d8beec3c5c717fee4ac7449b66.source: Speak with Miner Tonabanza to start him walking towards the cliff wall. When he starts to work, a group of three mandragors will spawn near him. Kill the mandragors and keep them off the miner. Once the mandragors are dead, talk to the Tonabanza again and then return to Quarrymaster Bohanna for the reward.
113e28c1fddb82d8beec3c5c717fee4ac7449b66.text: 与矿工托纳班扎交谈，让他走向悬崖壁。当他开始工作时，一群三只曼陀罗会在他附近生成。杀死曼陀罗并让他们远离矿工。曼德拉草死后，再次与托纳班扎交谈，然后返回采石场大师博哈纳处获取奖励。

582b1eb587581b8eb758a0240527fb469b939039.source: Meet the Sunspear squad at the Cliffs of Dohjok
582b1eb587581b8eb758a0240527fb469b939039.text: 在多赫约克悬崖与烈阳之矛小队会面

3f798b0dae078f9adef7091544948c45da0f75b6.source: Kill all the mandragor in the quarry
3f798b0dae078f9adef7091544948c45da0f75b6.text: 杀死采石场里所有的曼德拉草

e4076e7ff346270ac03b64cc0cea4c9316481977.source: See Quarrymaster Bohanna for your reward
e4076e7ff346270ac03b64cc0cea4c9316481977.text: 见采石场大师 Bohanna 领取奖励

2ef6a8838709c3a45e47762eb413260430eb110c.source: After talking to Quarrymaster Bohanna, exit the outpost onto the Cliffs of Dohjok. Talk to Captain Vahndah to have the Sunspear squad follow you to the quarry. At its west end, you will find a group of stoneflesh, slitherers, and imp mandragor guarding the Queen. After killing all of them, return to the Quarrymaster for your reward.
2ef6a8838709c3a45e47762eb413260430eb110c.text: 与采石场大师博哈纳交谈后，退出前哨站，前往多赫约克悬崖。与瓦恩达队长交谈，让烈阳之矛小队跟随你前往采石场。在它的西端，你会发现一群石肉人、滑行者和小恶魔曼陀罗守卫着女王。杀死所有人后，返回采石场老板那里领取奖励。

058cd132d14f5a4902afc105e07f7c4f67523cff.source: As an alternative (if you've already been there), Map travel to Blacktide Den. This will give you a shorter route with fewer monsters, and a party of 8, at the cost of not gaining the level 10 allies from outside Champion's Dawn.
058cd132d14f5a4902afc105e07f7c4f67523cff.text: 作为替代方案（如果您已经去过那里），可以通过地图前往黑潮巢穴。这将为你提供一条更短的路线、更少的怪物和 8 人的队伍，但代价是无法从冠军黎明之外获得 10 级盟友。

2309662609a1bde214316e1bafff2d49168556d8.source: Assault the Crimson Skull Guild Hall and defeat Captain Quimang. Find reinforcements along the way
2309662609a1bde214316e1bafff2d49168556d8.text: 袭击红骷髅公会大厅并击败奎芒队长。沿途寻找援军

5d121c0e4c8d4ac5c97419ed8ed9cd93e1919ac2.source: See The Emperor's Blade for your reward.
5d121c0e4c8d4ac5c97419ed8ed9cd93e1919ac2.text: 请参阅帝皇之刃以获得奖励。

1dfb7c39925caf7b538340e66b2aaf458633ab1b.source: You have to find recruits who are guards and go to Captain Quimang. The guards are necessary as Quimang has a lot of Crimson Skull protecting him in all directions.
1dfb7c39925caf7b538340e66b2aaf458633ab1b.text: 你必须找到担任守卫的新兵，然后去找奎芒队长。守卫是必要的，因为奎芒有很多猩红骷髅从各个方向保护着他。

58e3190bcfaeeb5c076e7e0c2160fa73d62d88a5.source: Best if using Henchmen to start in Ran Musu Gardens, that way your henchmen will be level 10 where as starting in Tsumei Village your Henchmen will be level 6. Start in Ran Musu Gardens, go down through Kinya Province to Panjiang Peninsula to keep henchmen at level 10. Kill Tahkayun Tsi to give your party a morale boost, as he is right outside of the exit from Ran Musu Gardens. Head down towards Port Kaimu where Captain Quimang is, killing the groups on both sides of where the Captain is, but staying away from contact with him. Then head to the farming village (Kaitan Village) just outside Tsumei Village starting from as far south as you can go working north and you'll end up with 9 level 10 guards to help you with the final group and Captain Quimang.
58e3190bcfaeeb5c076e7e0c2160fa73d62d88a5.text: 最好使用随从从冉木宿花园开始，这样你的随从将达到10级，而从Tsumei村开始，你的随从将达到6级。从燃木宿花园开始，向下穿过金亚省到达盘江半岛，使随从保持在10级。杀死塔卡云齐可以鼓舞你的队伍士气，因为他就在冉木宿花园的出口外面。前往奎芒船长所在的凯姆港，杀死船长所在两侧的队伍，但不要与他接触。然后前往津名村外的农庄（凯坦村），从最南边向北走，你会遇到 9 名 10 级守卫来帮助你对付最后的小组和奎芒队长。

1c8e61c498229f87978fecfaad989cc8263508f9.source: If one of the partymembers has the quest Togo's Ultimatum, you cannot do this quest as Captain Quimang will not be hostile.
1c8e61c498229f87978fecfaad989cc8263508f9.text: 如果其中一名队员有任务“多哥的最后通牒”，你就不能做这个任务，因为奎芒队长不会有敌意。

4cd483166a0c4760964e7b9f108469aaba80addf.source: There are groups of Crimson Skull all over the area. The best way to collect the help described above is to take on and kill these groups.
4cd483166a0c4760964e7b9f108469aaba80addf.text: 整个地区都有成群的猩红骷髅。获得上述帮助的最佳方法就是对抗并消灭这些团体。

14d7d276df54dd8bb97b800584e46f53c61e8492.source: The gathered reinforcements will be useless if playing a ranged character. This is is because their aggro range is quite short and being under attack (or attacking) will not cause them to engage the enemy.
14d7d276df54dd8bb97b800584e46f53c61e8492.text: 如果扮演远程角色，聚集的援军将毫无用处。这是因为他们的仇恨范围很短，受到攻击（或攻击）不会导致他们与敌人交战。

fe4b158a5b2ce8685b822cb9b3395487ef89f1df.source: Speak to the first Sunspear Recruit.
fe4b158a5b2ce8685b822cb9b3395487ef89f1df.text: 与第一位烈阳之矛新兵交谈。

5f7107f21d4aab4e98ada3d3e4a7e623b2559418.source: Speak to the second Sunspear Recruit.
5f7107f21d4aab4e98ada3d3e4a7e623b2559418.text: 与第二名烈阳之矛新兵交谈。

00a3b814d7b542f4aafc30ccf8e89c2826c0231c.source: Speak to the third Sunspear Recruit.
00a3b814d7b542f4aafc30ccf8e89c2826c0231c.text: 与第三名烈阳之矛新兵交谈。

0e5789822110f9c4f81c7f50a4279164b01b4f25.source: Speak to the three Sunspear Recruits and return to First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.
0e5789822110f9c4f81c7f50a4279164b01b4f25.text: 与三名烈阳之矛新兵交谈并返回首席矛者贾杜加尔处领取奖励。

b22d794c783b02e2957eaf527fcb1d3d4d0138e2.source: This is marked as a Primary Quest but is not required to proceed.
b22d794c783b02e2957eaf527fcb1d3d4d0138e2.text: 这被标记为主要任务，但不需要继续。

6895beb31da96f1c8ab5a92ab99da9b223807e56.source: Escort Hareh to the ancient graveyard in the Sulfurous Wastes.
6895beb31da96f1c8ab5a92ab99da9b223807e56.text: 护送哈雷前往硫磺荒原的古老墓地。

b918f3a4bf42520f6863549a793cdc7803780338.source: Visit gravesites and help Hareh summon the undead. You have visited 0 of 5 gravesites.
b918f3a4bf42520f6863549a793cdc7803780338.text: 参观墓地并帮助 Hareh 召唤亡灵。您已参观过 5 个墓地中的 0 个。

4fe1c1f6a12ab2f7cf0c6148f8a0f4d61c88849e.source: Protect Hareh while he performs the ritual to raise the undead.
4fe1c1f6a12ab2f7cf0c6148f8a0f4d61c88849e.text: 在哈雷执行复活亡灵仪式时保护他。

5e7b70cea6061fa2ce024584dbdf5e1b99ebaca1.source: See Infantryman Hareh for your reward.
5e7b70cea6061fa2ce024584dbdf5e1b99ebaca1.text: 请见步兵哈雷以获得奖励。

902c5a3cb6827263a2c57f1474a635d4f15ef3d3.source: Follow the quest marker to come to a spot with five gravesites located near each other. Infantryman Hareh will follow you (he is undead, so don't worry about him not being inside a Junundu). The quest marker will point you successively to all five of the gravesites. At each gravesite, Infantryman Hareh will use the skill Rise From Your Grave! to animate two level 18 Undead Soldiers (they look like Flesh Golems). You do not need to click on the gravesites. Just get Hareh to follow you close enough to trigger his use of that skill.
902c5a3cb6827263a2c57f1474a635d4f15ef3d3.text: 按照任务标记来到一个有五个彼此相邻的墓地的地方。步兵 Hareh 会跟着你（他是不死生物，所以不用担心他不在 Junundu 里面）。任务标记将依次将您指向所有五个墓地。在每个墓地，步兵 Hareh 都会使用技能“从坟墓中崛起！”激活两个 18 级不死士兵（他们看起来像血肉傀儡）。您不需要点击墓地。只要让 Hareh 跟随你足够近，以触发他使用该技能即可。

d943d67efdc643e33b50d24f3b2f02ffa0183930.source: After Hareh animates each pair of his minions (unlike normal minions, these will not have inherent health degeneration), a group of about 6 Margonites will attack your position. Being inside Junundu will make the fight easy, but note this will prevent you from using healing skills on Infantryman Hareh, so consider having a monk outside of the wurm if you have trouble keeping him alive. Don't worry about the Undead Soldiers dying. Once Hareh has activated his skill for the fifth time, the quest is considered complete and you can claim the quest from him before the fifth group of Margonites arrives.
d943d67efdc643e33b50d24f3b2f02ffa0183930.text: 当 Hareh 激活他的每对小兵后（与普通小兵不同，这些小兵不会有固有的健康退化），一群大约 6 个玛贡尼特人将攻击你的位置。在朱南杜内部会让战斗变得容易，但请注意，这会阻止你对步兵哈雷使用治疗技能，所以如果你很难让他活着，请考虑在亚龙外面安排一个和尚。不用担心不死士兵的死亡。一旦哈雷第五次激活了他的技能，任务就被认为完成了，你可以在第五组玛贡尼特到达之前向他领取任务。

825b1e9992897866898c376ab8b2218eb87c0e47.text: 保护基苏皇帝免受白剑的侵害。

0c6b8eafbba65d3eeda8ff753a9d3c81b32b3598.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes (26 minutes in Hard Mode).
0c6b8eafbba65d3eeda8ff753a9d3c81b32b3598.text: *奖励* 在 20 分钟内完成任务（困难模式为 26 分钟）。

056e954f13e30967b59bf700269936be4cb816c2.source: As per the Raisu Palace mission.

8e4f3ce6f0b4d1e7caad638e6ac313c75784064e.source: This quest was first offered on April 26, 2009.
8e4f3ce6f0b4d1e7caad638e6ac313c75784064e.text: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 4 月 26 日。

2f04a8e46518bcb1de6c120f0f1936eb4476c657.source: Clear Raisu Palace in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
2f04a8e46518bcb1de6c120f0f1936eb4476c657.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能城的莱苏宫殿中的所有敌人。

ea336a1b0eeebe196e0e5bdb59f90b89c089439f.source: Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile.
ea336a1b0eeebe196e0e5bdb59f90b89c089439f.text: 在奴隶流放地杀死兰德·暴风织者和随行的敌人。

32d7a692728a3d0e3714430e13a8973824f2c108.source: *BONUS* Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
32d7a692728a3d0e3714430e13a8973824f2c108.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死兰德·风暴编织者和伴随的敌人。

fd8bb0ad4986f1e7132c7b41424148a69fcf9970.source: As per Justiciar Thommis' level. Both Rand Stormweaver and the small group directly around him must be killed.
fd8bb0ad4986f1e7132c7b41424148a69fcf9970.text: 按照汤米斯法官的级别。兰德·暴风织者和他周围的小队都必须被杀死。

f7e8607ffc3092570866c105487ed882310234ae.source: Take Rastin's request to Artisan Daved in Old Ascalon.
f7e8607ffc3092570866c105487ed882310234ae.text: 将拉斯廷的请求交给旧阿斯卡隆的工匠戴维德。

afc96da8c5d60c2f379f25624dde2ea7f7f81857.source: Deliver the Scribe's supplies to Witness Rastin in Old Ascalon.
afc96da8c5d60c2f379f25624dde2ea7f7f81857.text: 将抄写员的补给品交给旧阿斯卡隆的拉斯廷见证人。

1af91de93c50aebabfdf36accabfdc4fffda2876.source: Head south from Witness Rastin along the main road. You'll encounter some Gargoyles, a Hulking Stone Elemental or two, some Devourers, and a couple Grawl. After you crest the top of the hill, turn southwest and speak with Artisan Daved to get the necessary items. Head back to Rastin and give him the supplies to get your reward.
1af91de93c50aebabfdf36accabfdc4fffda2876.text: 从见证人拉斯廷 (Witness Rastin) 出发，沿着主干道向南行驶。你会遇到一些石像鬼、一两个巨大的石元素、一些吞噬者和几个穴居人。登上山顶后，转向西南并与工匠戴维德交谈以获得必要的物品。返回拉斯廷并给他补给品以获得奖励。

fd59f7624fb28ff3e34d24e6a9abdc220baf8cdc.source: This quest can be completed in conjunction with Gargoyle Trouble and Counting the Fallen, as they take place in roughly the same area.
fd59f7624fb28ff3e34d24e6a9abdc220baf8cdc.text: 该任务可以与石像鬼麻烦和清点阵亡者一起完成，因为它们发生在大致相同的区域。

ef50208a6155d37441647bbb3b00b11c063f0268.source: You may have to speak with Artisan Daved twice. If you speak with him and the green arrow over his head is still present, speak with him again to get the supplies.
ef50208a6155d37441647bbb3b00b11c063f0268.text: 您可能需要与 Artisan Daved 交谈两次。如果你与他交谈并且他头上的绿色箭头仍然存在，请再次与他交谈以获得补给。

e38fb93aca0ec0cd593e4624c3d4ca5438242da9.source: If you do not have the required quest, the closed door by the Inscribed Stone will not let you leave the first room.
e38fb93aca0ec0cd593e4624c3d4ca5438242da9.text: 如果你没有完成所需的任务，铭刻石关闭的门将不会让你离开第一个房间。

f5b3c6841468d238ad18a9276798ce4d753c584e.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #8 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
f5b3c6841468d238ad18a9276798ce4d753c584e.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 8 页。

229e837d63ba38b290572f8ba4fdf9a7b1717c30.source: Be careful of the ice traps.

dfad90c96574ab3e62e379ea436481ae8c2c9460.source: East from the Dungeon Key, a lone Ancient Vaettir roams at the end of the corridor. When approached, it will "push" three ice boulders that roll down and kill any creature in their path.
dfad90c96574ab3e62e379ea436481ae8c2c9460.text: 在地牢钥匙的东边，一个孤独的远古瓦蒂尔在走廊的尽头徘徊。当接近时，它会“推”三块冰块滚下来并杀死路径上的任何生物。

ee86962df96055bad1948b8014d5528293843091.source: Allies such as minions and Dwarven Heroes will attempt to attack these boulders and may die as a result.
ee86962df96055bad1948b8014d5528293843091.text: 小兵和矮人英雄等盟友将尝试攻击这些巨石，并可能因此而死亡。

4a68367ff2543e80a4822419942667adb7a09f28.source: The Vaettir may also die to these boulders.
4a68367ff2543e80a4822419942667adb7a09f28.text: 维提尔也可能死于这些巨石。

0f2294956617355275c5e0172e40443451e6e719.source: Light the braziers near the north bridge to lower the bridges.
0f2294956617355275c5e0172e40443451e6e719.text: 点燃北桥附近的火盆以降低桥梁。

3b7322b06b0d3620a719c573307b1bc51c7d1d5a.source: To get the dungeon key to drop, you must kill the Reaper of Destruction and the group of hidden destroyers at the Reaper's initial location.
3b7322b06b0d3620a719c573307b1bc51c7d1d5a.text: 要掉落地牢钥匙，您必须杀死毁灭收割者和收割者初始位置的隐藏驱逐舰群。

52481f91c58e6ebe4b51ee45cb49771e48080eb5.source: Near the portal to Level 3, the Chromatic Drakes and the Destroyers will fight against each other.
52481f91c58e6ebe4b51ee45cb49771e48080eb5.text: 在通往第 3 层的传送门附近，彩色龙和毁灭者将互相战斗。

2eab67afbda9514581f597f04a2a2e8d3875a1fd.source: There is an area beyond the traps that is not shown on the map. There is nothing of value.
2eab67afbda9514581f597f04a2a2e8d3875a1fd.text: 陷阱之外还有一个区域未在地图上显示。没有什么有价值的东西。

450f6f13015ee8226c10106b06cdce536bcdecd5.source: There appears to be an unreachable area beyond the south west corner of level 2 which does not appear on the minimap, within which a Whirling Wisp may occasionally be seen. The final Destroyers may be friendly, making the dungeon impossible to complete.
450f6f13015ee8226c10106b06cdce536bcdecd5.text: 在第 2 层西南角之外似乎有一个无法到达的区域，该区域没有出现在小地图上，在该区域内偶尔可能会看到旋转的小精灵。最后的毁灭者可能会很友好，使地下城无法完成。

c0a574d0e740df67f27867932194bd4545998377.source: Find Junior Minister Jejiang. Convince him to call off the destruction of "The Roost."
c0a574d0e740df67f27867932194bd4545998377.text: 找到杰江少部长。说服他取消对“栖息地”的破坏。

731274bc0ab31a9d08bd1afc783abbc49c96bdc7.source: Collect 2 platinum to bribe Junior Minister Jejiang.
731274bc0ab31a9d08bd1afc783abbc49c96bdc7.text: 收集2白金贿赂杰江少臣。

091ec5975297c1dcd00946ade1b80478eb478147.source: See Quill Songfeather for your reward.
091ec5975297c1dcd00946ade1b80478eb478147.text: 请参阅羽毛笔歌羽以获得奖励。

cadff8ccb4e7b5fd2a3fc51b75928ffa861806e3.source: The quest itself is straight forward, simply travel between the quest giver and the Minister, and then back.
cadff8ccb4e7b5fd2a3fc51b75928ffa861806e3.text: 任务本身很简单，只需在任务提供者和部长之间移动，然后再返回即可。

e04de3411043f5decf5350d29ced8c9792ba47a4.source: You can complete the quest without spending any money: with at least 2 platinum in your inventory, speak to Junior Minister Jejiang and follow the dialogue until the "Accept" and "Decline" options appear. Drop all your money and Accept the reward. (Remember to pick up your cash before zoning out.)
e04de3411043f5decf5350d29ced8c9792ba47a4.text: 您无需花费任何金钱即可完成任务：库存中至少有2白金，与杰江次官交谈并按照对话进行，直到出现“接受”和“拒绝”选项。放下你所有的钱并接受奖励。 （记得在走神前领取现金。）

ca68002810517a98cbaa0356bd215686054c10b2.source: Find Rojis on Issnur Isles and convince him to rejoin the Sunspears.
ca68002810517a98cbaa0356bd215686054c10b2.text: 在伊斯努尔群岛找到罗吉斯并说服他重新加入烈阳之矛队。

3fdd8e3e548f5aac9219e5a4e46720cffb6381cf.source: Find the nest of mandragor destroying Rojis' field and eliminate them.
3fdd8e3e548f5aac9219e5a4e46720cffb6381cf.text: 找到摧毁罗吉斯领域的曼德拉草巢穴并消灭它们。

67c4ed7a2322b0da18f1d5991fa8ccc4be7b443f.source: Tell Rojis the Mandragor are dead.
67c4ed7a2322b0da18f1d5991fa8ccc4be7b443f.text: 告诉罗吉斯曼德拉戈尔已经死了。

c70a8a07f0787fb53902792028285f1ae4989f42.source: Enter Issnur Isles from Kodlonu Hamlet and follow the quest marker to find Rojis. He will ask you to kill five level 11 Mandragors located to the south-west of Rojis' position, in the midst of several groups of skale. When you have killed all five mandragors, speak to Rojis again, and then return to Castellan Puuba.
c70a8a07f0787fb53902792028285f1ae4989f42.text: 从科德洛努哈姆雷特进入伊斯努尔群岛，然后按照任务标记找到罗吉斯。他会要求你杀死位于罗吉斯阵地西南方向、几组斯卡莱中间的 5 只 11 级曼德拉角兽。当你杀死所有五个曼德拉草后，再次与罗吉斯交谈，然后返回卡斯特兰普乌巴。

85cbc7ac36419dc52ebd9dd1f5f3b81cdb92d73c.source: Rojis will appear outside Kamadan with the group of Sunspears during the quest War Preparations (Recruit Training) even if this quest is not completed.
85cbc7ac36419dc52ebd9dd1f5f3b81cdb92d73c.text: 在任务战争准备（新兵训练）期间，即使该任务尚未完成，罗吉斯也会与烈阳之矛队一起出现在卡马丹外。

620e0b3aeea21d964a940fe4f854b0cf099c7d8d.source: Completing this quest requires completing the first step in Isle of the Dead; curiously, however, Rojis is part of the Sunspear squad met during that quest in Cliffs of Dohjok, despite being recruited back into the Sunspears in this quest.
620e0b3aeea21d964a940fe4f854b0cf099c7d8d.text: 完成此任务需要完成死亡之岛的第一步；然而，奇怪的是，罗吉斯是在多赫约克悬崖的任务中遇到的烈阳之矛小队的一员，尽管他在这次任务中被重新招募到了烈阳之矛小队中。

4a62bfac15fc75ee2d22f45318e260f0f2d6176b.source: Meet Lieutenant Murunda and her soldiers in the Mirror of Lyss.
4a62bfac15fc75ee2d22f45318e260f0f2d6176b.text: 在里斯之镜中遇见穆伦达中尉和她的士兵。

85d65a40bd1089bdce780cd36629c3fee6f28069.source: Kill the demons infesting the Sebelkeh Basilica. 7...0 of 7 groups remain.
85d65a40bd1089bdce780cd36629c3fee6f28069.text: 消灭侵扰塞贝尔克大教堂的恶魔。 7 组中的 7...0 组剩余。

e15017f595e5c63f804c390761a60efd76e5b92e.source: Start from Dzagonur Bastion, and meet Lieutenant Murunda just outside in the Mirror of Lyss. After speaking to Murunda, a Vabbi Guard Captain and 4 Vabbi Guards will join your party as allies.
e15017f595e5c63f804c390761a60efd76e5b92e.text: 从扎贡努尔堡垒出发，在里斯之镜外面与穆伦达中尉会面。与穆伦达交谈后，一名瓦比守卫队长和 4 名瓦比守卫将作为盟友加入你的队伍。

1eceece163c9eb7f7a0a31111dc382e691b39f9e.source: From here, it's a simple search and destroy type quest, as you follow the quest pointer to each group of Margonites and defeat them. Be aware that the usual spawns for The Mirror of Lyss will also be present along the way.
1eceece163c9eb7f7a0a31111dc382e691b39f9e.text: 从这里开始，这是一个简单的搜索和摧毁类型的任务，当你跟随任务指针找到每组玛贡尼特并击败他们时。请注意，里斯之镜的常见生成点也会沿途出现。

03cfcfa0d27423c4c655301f37b6c2a8b7e483ce.source: If the Margonite groups are killed out of order, the Vabbi Guard's dialogue appear in a different order as well. Each quote is tied to a specific group.
03cfcfa0d27423c4c655301f37b6c2a8b7e483ce.text: 如果玛贡尼特群体被乱杀，瓦比守卫的对话也会以不同的顺序出现。每个报价都与一个特定的组相关联。

b46e95ced7a7378487c4616ff9a9315fed8989ed.source: The Guards will follow you until the quest is finished, which makes Vanquishing this area much easier. While the quest does add the Margonite groups, it also removes most of the Kournan spawns, for only a small overall increase in foes to be vanquished.
b46e95ced7a7378487c4616ff9a9315fed8989ed.text: 守卫会跟随你直到任务完成，这使得征服这个区域变得更加容易。虽然该任务确实添加了玛贡尼特群体，但它也删除了大部分库南生成物，因此被击败的敌人总体上只增加了一小部分。

ac3896e611e5fce99a8d0107c110c7c1937460e6.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* The Great Northern Wall mission completed
ac3896e611e5fce99a8d0107c110c7c1937460e6.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 北长城任务完成

3470fb0690a16621dcf576c41bf969f55ee34dd1.source: Go from town to Old Ascalon and find the Army Recruits.
3470fb0690a16621dcf576c41bf969f55ee34dd1.text: 从城镇前往旧阿斯卡隆并找到新兵。

cd9408775560960437dfb5e813ff66c7b5afe8a1.source: Lead all three recruits west along the wall to the far gate and present them to Gate Guard Hollis.
cd9408775560960437dfb5e813ff66c7b5afe8a1.text: 带领所有三名新兵沿着城墙向西到达远处的大门，并将他们交给门卫霍利斯。

344bccbacdc692b80695668b01b914bbf2dc0593.source: Speak to Gate Guard Hollis for your reward.
344bccbacdc692b80695668b01b914bbf2dc0593.text: 与门卫霍利斯交谈以获得奖励。

e6a2344065d4f3464a99f1a9ebcec454ba987f50.text: 能量 +6（需要 5 次治疗祈祷）

1614c3401bb3ebedcd880fa7f164c591b3aafd03.source: Start from Ascalon City. Outside you will meet three Army Recruits, who will follow you automatically. The recruits tend to lag behind the party, and all three must survive to complete the quest, so take care while escorting them. Head to the entrance to The Breach, where Gate Guard Hollis stands, but do not go through. The quest will be updated when the three recruits have arrived.
1614c3401bb3ebedcd880fa7f164c591b3aafd03.text: 从阿斯卡隆市出发。在外面你会遇到三名陆军新兵，他们会自动跟随你。新兵往往落后于队伍，三人都必须生存才能完成任务，所以护送他们时要小心。前往 The Breach 的入口，门卫霍利斯就站在那里，但不要穿过去。当三名新兵到达时，任务将会更新。

12f192044112a7dceefb804c86de842d390363c3.source: The recruits will stop moving during combat and do not fight back if attacked.
12f192044112a7dceefb804c86de842d390363c3.text: 新兵在战斗中会停止移动，如果受到攻击也不会反击。

c1ba5c38acf1c0a2b7a46cf4fe10ca059724b2a8.source: Speak to Guardsman Pah about filling out the ministry's scrollwork.
c1ba5c38acf1c0a2b7a46cf4fe10ca059724b2a8.text: 与卫兵帕交谈，了解如何填写该部的卷轴。

ed917ec8636affe664003cc4d9a5a5a6e8eb77c7.source: This quest is quite easy, all it requires is for you to retrace your path taken in the previous quest back to Guardsman Pah.
ed917ec8636affe664003cc4d9a5a5a6e8eb77c7.text: 这个任务很简单，只需要你沿着上一个任务中的路径回到卫兵帕。

bd657399dbe104a0cc574af106268ccecac3a27d.source: Alternatively, map travel to Nahpui Quarter and return into Wajjun Bazaar to Guardsman Pah.
bd657399dbe104a0cc574af106268ccecac3a27d.text: 或者，也可以在地图上前往 Nahpui 区，然后返回 Wajjun Bazaar 找到 Guardsman Pah。

6ccff4861c426256f644826710b8bf66c5774cfb.source: This quest appears to be mutually exclusive with the Imperial Assistance quest.
6ccff4861c426256f644826710b8bf66c5774cfb.text: 该任务似乎与帝国援助任务相互排斥。

950463ec20d36abe21a45b3d1d3fffb0f36da8e4.source: Talk to Yayoi of the Orders.

60c2781b7ed1ec4e9c77024e4225c5ec9c91b932.source: Talk to Chow Zhong the Inferno.

03563c432538cf980d2ba01a04e10e97e3e9d378.source: Talk to Gao Han of the Rings.

444e8f09cfad231100a8d8752b20fa78f3be60f2.source: Talk to Disciple of Shadow Feung Zhu.

a400d8fe34927be01abc36867f35e6611ce13a0e.source: Talk to Min the Dragon's Claw.

96fd1cc2398c2e0c7492817911a451cf207fad0e.source: While this quest is active, the Shiro'ken bosses in Sunjiang District do not spawn.
96fd1cc2398c2e0c7492817911a451cf207fad0e.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，孙江区的白肯 Boss 不会生成。

1721778f83beff84a6cee81bc5a7f67a81d31410.source: Start from Zin Ku Corridor and head out a short distance to meet up with Zenmai, who is having a conversation with Daisuke Crimson Edge. The Ministry of Purity will approach soon; kill them and Zenmai will join as an ally.
1721778f83beff84a6cee81bc5a7f67a81d31410.text: 从真库走廊出发，走出一小段距离，就会遇到正在与红刃大辅对话的善舞。纯洁部即将到来；杀死他们，善迈就会作为盟友加入。

0e09a1c6d34d5dbb6c8f6d135a536827d9e64447.source: Your task now is to lead Zenmai to find her friends in the Am Fah. Keep an eye on her as she has a tendency to get stuck on chests and be left behind. The Ministry of Purity are hostile to Am Fah groups, so try to take advantage of this. The mobs are spaced out enough that you mostly do not need to worry about over-aggro.
0e09a1c6d34d5dbb6c8f6d135a536827d9e64447.text: 你现在的任务是带领 Zenmai 去 Am Fah 寻找她的朋友。密切关注她，因为她很容易被卡在箱子上而被抛在后面。纯洁部对 Am Fah 团体怀有敌意，因此请尝试利用这一点。怪物之间的距离足够远，你基本上不需要担心过度仇恨。

fb59cc714197743dbeb5c185d5eee4317632aeab.source: Refer to the map for the shortest path to reach all of Zenmai's friends. She must get within range before the quest update will trigger. Each of her friends will turn hostile at end of a dialogue. Four of them, when defeated, will turn into allies. Of particular note is Chow Zhong the Inferno - spread out your group before his dialogue ends because he uses PBAoE skills.
fb59cc714197743dbeb5c185d5eee4317632aeab.text: 请参阅地图，了解到达 Zenmai 所有朋友的最短路径。她必须进入射程内，任务更新才会触发。她的每个朋友在对话结束后都会变得充满敌意。其中四个被击败后将成为盟友。特别值得注意的是地狱周忠 - 在他的对话结束之前分散你的团队，因为他使用 PBAoE 技能。

f3f8485a2f14123891a8dc572281631a9e60375e.source: After Chow Zhong, you will run into two groups of Ministry, led by the ranger and assassin bosses.
f3f8485a2f14123891a8dc572281631a9e60375e.text: 在周忠之后，你将遇到由游侠和刺客头目领导的两组部门。

d10fb0b958d9dcc41bf7942eead8fa1b35829f0b.source: At the last point on the map, where Min the Dragon's Claw is located, the dialogue will trigger the spawning of two large groups of Ministry, led by the remaining two bosses. Right before they turn hostile, friendly Am Fah will show up. You can either let the Am Fah weaken the Ministry for you first, or just join in the fray. Once all hostiles are dead, the quest is complete.
d10fb0b958d9dcc41bf7942eead8fa1b35829f0b.text: 在地图上的最后一个点，即龙爪敏所在的地方，对话将触发由剩下的两个 Boss 领导的两大部族的生成。就在他们变得敌对之前，友好的 Am Fah 会出现。你可以让Am Fah先为你削弱该部，或者直接加入战斗。一旦所有敌人都死了，任务就完成了。

1231e152aec80646133dc4da116fe9420a69c673.source: For players without Guild Wars Nightfall, the Sunspear that Zenmai mentions in her opening dialogue refers to a prominent NPC in the Nightfall campaign.
1231e152aec80646133dc4da116fe9420a69c673.text: 对于没有《激战 夜幕降临》的玩家来说，善迈在开场对话中提到的阳矛指的是夜幕战役中的一个著名 NPC。

2d13bbe7a8b63f3b54815335d0e414c182cfaeae.source: If any of the Am Fah allies recruited in this quest die in combat, their "death" will count as a morale boost, and you will be able to capture their skills. They will still self-resurrect after a period of time.
2d13bbe7a8b63f3b54815335d0e414c182cfaeae.text: 如果在此任务中招募的任何 Am Fah 盟友在战斗中死亡，他们的“死亡”将算作士气提升，你将能够获得他们的技能。一段时间后它们仍然会自我复活。

93b39152827cbc8fe9f78ce64d1ff68bb133b61d.source: As per the normal mode version, refer to the map for the locations of the quest NPCs. Take note that their locations are different compared to normal mode.
93b39152827cbc8fe9f78ce64d1ff68bb133b61d.text: 和普通模式版本一样，任务NPC的位置请参考地图。请注意，它们的位置与正常模式不同。

e98a69f82a9d2e82b3aec3e52a3ca350e0822fb4.source: Another difference is that as Zenmai approaches each quest NPC, the moment the dialog triggers, a group of Am Fah will spawn near the boss. They turn hostile the moment the boss turns hostile. Consider placing spirits and flagging heroes apart before letting Zenmai trigger the dialogue.
e98a69f82a9d2e82b3aec3e52a3ca350e0822fb4.text: 另一个区别是，当 Zenmai 接近每个任务 NPC 时，对话触发的那一刻，一群 Am Fah 会在 Boss 附近生成。当老板变得敌对时，他们就会变得敌对。在让善迈触发对话之前，请考虑将灵魂和标记英雄分开。

2f0c8f6f59036230f8f6fe70ee02654c9f4d6f85.source: The ambush at the end of the quest, although in a different location, is the same. It is best to quickly move away from the Min's location, where the Ministry will converge. Let Daisuke's Am Fah take the brunt of the attack before joining in.
2f0c8f6f59036230f8f6fe70ee02654c9f4d6f85.text: 任务最后的伏击虽然地点不同，但都是一样的。最好赶紧离开敏所在的位置，那里是部会汇聚的地方。让 Daisuke 的 Am Fah 在加入之前首当其冲。

9fd5657dafb19dac28090176b109fd1982ae5440.source: The locations of the quest NPCs are different compared to the normal mode version.
9fd5657dafb19dac28090176b109fd1982ae5440.text: 与普通模式版本相比，任务 NPC 的位置有所不同。

83610c246ff5c3839b0d3ea352462f42efcf7740.source: The first time each boss ally dies, the party gains a morale boost.
83610c246ff5c3839b0d3ea352462f42efcf7740.text: 每个首领盟友第一次死亡时，队伍的士气都会得到提升。

34a963e61c469d34f379dd747481f1b2f2b27e97.source: Including enemies defeated during the quest, there are 223-227 enemies to vanquish in this area while the quest is active.
34a963e61c469d34f379dd747481f1b2f2b27e97.text: 包括在任务中击败的敌人在内，任务进行期间该区域有 223-227 个敌人需要消灭。

05464b406f7878294ab55d59fed48d839dcc9323.source: Clear Reed Bog in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
05464b406f7878294ab55d59fed48d839dcc9323.text: 在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林中的芦苇沼泽中的所有敌人。

155ad2e31fb8c8414a781e6d4d67a99e1898c284.source: Start from Ventari's Refuge and travel south through Ettin's Back. The secondary quest Dropping Eaves given outside Ventari's Refuge will lead here.
155ad2e31fb8c8414a781e6d4d67a99e1898c284.text: 从文塔里避难所出发，向南穿过埃丁之背。在文塔里避难所外给出的次要任务“落下的屋檐”将通向这里。

6c9b3b58dd1bc5591c4a4a73e0243dab1d156a53.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.6% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
6c9b3b58dd1bc5591c4a4a73e0243dab1d156a53.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 0.6%。

4785b9fc815d2d83ac19e3962b3a8a808e1ed120.source: Minion masters should be aware that the Moss Scarabs will steal minions using Verata's Gaze.
4785b9fc815d2d83ac19e3962b3a8a808e1ed120.text: 小兵大师应该意识到苔藓圣甲虫会使用维拉塔的凝视偷走小兵。

05972f3c0c36487385c8fab9b2c090c9a40bcde4.source: Most foes in the area are hidden.
05972f3c0c36487385c8fab9b2c090c9a40bcde4.text: 该地区的大多数敌人都是隐藏的。

23fca5fe9a833aa47fe03589c717c526942a6613.source: The northern path has many hidden Moss Scarabs.
23fca5fe9a833aa47fe03589c717c526942a6613.text: 北边的小路有许多隐藏的苔藓圣甲虫。

e50c9546290cf16750b7e910fcdeaffa64dab1ce.source: The southern path has many hidden Maguuma Spiders and Life Pods.
e50c9546290cf16750b7e910fcdeaffa64dab1ce.text: 南边的小路有许多隐藏的迈古玛蜘蛛和生命豆荚。

8e1b615201c664d735e5fe3ab672f5f1ad89c5cd.source: Defeat Primeval King Jahnus and his royal guards.
8e1b615201c664d735e5fe3ab672f5f1ad89c5cd.text: 击败原始国王贾努斯和他的皇家卫队。

7bb349b34240f3f7faffeacd3e993291adfbbb6e.source: Find Myrish, the leader of the slave spirits, and tell him of King Jahnus' demise.
7bb349b34240f3f7faffeacd3e993291adfbbb6e.text: 找到奴隶灵魂的首领密里什，并告诉他雅努斯国王的灭亡。

4c0022ce5b0a0898ff841f4bc70e9cd2580e7ba2.source: Right after taking the quest, King Jahnus and his guards will turn hostile. You just need to kill the king to get the first objective. It's a relatively easy fight.
4c0022ce5b0a0898ff841f4bc70e9cd2580e7ba2.text: 接受任务后，雅努斯国王和他的卫兵就会变得敌对。你只需要杀死国王即可获得第一个目标。这是一场相对容易的战斗。

c60f524b65d068ab68418c58abc5e51ef2a6dd75.source: Both this quest and its sister quest, Destroy the Ungrateful Slaves, give the same rewards.
c60f524b65d068ab68418c58abc5e51ef2a6dd75.text: 这个任务和它的姊妹任务“消灭忘恩负义的奴隶”都提供相同的奖励。

63645ed519a72ac2aa31a1fddaa676660054e022.source: Immediately after accepting this quest, the king and his guards will become hostile.
63645ed519a72ac2aa31a1fddaa676660054e022.text: 接受这个任务后，国王和他的卫兵就会立即变得敌对。

ac9c9735b79ed9ee767f6e33a73931976a1a0240.source: Bring the Chalice of Corruption to the Imperial Agent Hanjo.
ac9c9735b79ed9ee767f6e33a73931976a1a0240.text: 将腐败圣杯交给帝国特工半条。

858dff6cd25987b5ae1e2404beb8ae42907860a7.source: Just speak with Imperial Agent Hanjo in Kaineng Center.
858dff6cd25987b5ae1e2404beb8ae42907860a7.text: 只需与凯能中心的帝国特工 Hanjo 交谈即可。

08be9c271f9140e406a235e7e52cec2534dd5530.source: Accepting this quest will turn all the surrounding Am Fah hostile.
08be9c271f9140e406a235e7e52cec2534dd5530.text: 接受这个任务将使周围的所有 Am Fah 都充满敌意。

bbde51aa0daebc0e424f1826ddf3edcdc90ed1c3.source: When the Am Fah become hostile, you can just map travel to Kaineng Center to see Imperial Agent Hanjo for your reward.
bbde51aa0daebc0e424f1826ddf3edcdc90ed1c3.text: 当 Am Fah 变得敌对时，你可以在地图上前往凯能中心去见帝国特工 Hanjo 以获得奖励。

689b60114dc39e2dfc033ac13a46c6ba1fc87c13.source: Once this quest is completed, your character can no longer complete the Drink from the Chalice of Corruption quest.
689b60114dc39e2dfc033ac13a46c6ba1fc87c13.text: 一旦完成此任务，你的角色就无法再完成“腐化圣杯的饮料”任务。

59ecb063ae326cf8c46c1c50af587ccdd29051cb.source: Upon turning hostile, many of the Am Fah, especially the Marksmen will fall victim to the numerous traps they set while friendly.
59ecb063ae326cf8c46c1c50af587ccdd29051cb.text: 当变得敌对时，许多 Am Fah，尤其是神射手，会成为他们在友善时设置的众多陷阱的受害者。

a004113a88a540421e7cb8b1efb621c4dae35d93.source: Clear the Regent Valley in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
a004113a88a540421e7cb8b1efb621c4dae35d93.text: 在困难模式下清除阿斯卡隆摄政谷的所有敌人。

4ba3761a275b8e7021f1802a0bb166b13305fbe2.source: There are many secondary quests that will lead to this area. It lies to the southeast of Old Ascalon and leads to Fort Ranik in its northeastern corner.
4ba3761a275b8e7021f1802a0bb166b13305fbe2.text: 有许多次要任务会通往这个区域。它位于旧阿斯卡隆的东南部，通向其东北角的拉尼克堡。

3af6ba5e1e22522674ad2d22efbe05873815e3d5.source: If entering from Fort Ranik, a small group of soldiers can be seen engaging either the renegades or a group of Charr.
3af6ba5e1e22522674ad2d22efbe05873815e3d5.text: 如果从拉尼克堡进入，可以看到一小群士兵正在与叛徒或一群夏尔交战。

7733ca5a09d6d2432a6e1a0772b7e834c6740dad.source: You can obtain a Moa Egg (required to hatch a Black Moa Chick) in the southeastern section, near a large number of Moas.
7733ca5a09d6d2432a6e1a0772b7e834c6740dad.text: 您可以在东南部靠近大量恐鸟的地方获得恐鸟蛋（孵化黑色恐鸟雏鸟所需）。

d98314e2dcb56ba503796b448d8cac6576f8a804.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 150|low = 129|high = 178|notes=There are many hidden Devourers in this area.}}
d98314e2dcb56ba503796b448d8cac6576f8a804.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 150|low = 129|high = 178|notes=这个区域有很多隐藏的吞噬者。}}

596208edd99b91b8933703a7145e4cf6fe1f9cac.source: The Renegade Elementalists have Mind Burn in hard mode, a powerful area of effect spell.
596208edd99b91b8933703a7145e4cf6fe1f9cac.text: 叛徒元素师在困难模式下拥有心灵灼烧，这是一个强大的区域效果法术。

00de76a8ed58cbc7c4284c7e696380cc00fb6b7e.source: The fog in the northwest corner of the map does not uncover for an unknown reason, so it will not look like it is explored on the map; exploring this part will still add to your Cartographer title.
00de76a8ed58cbc7c4284c7e696380cc00fb6b7e.text: 地图西北角的迷雾不知为何没有被揭开，所以在地图上看起来不会像是被探索过；探索这部分仍然会增加你的制图师头衔。

c6bd9205dfba9f6e28cf951a42ee820e4ed25697.source: At the exit to Pockmark Flats the shrine on the other side looks destroyed with both arches incomplete but when changing the area the shrine is complete and working.
c6bd9205dfba9f6e28cf951a42ee820e4ed25697.text: 在波马克平原的出口处，另一侧的神殿看起来被毁坏了，两个拱门都不完整，但当改变区域时，神殿是完整的并且可以工作。

6d851e90761999d8e13eb224513dbd99e7f421c1.text: 搜索国王守望台寻找夏尔。

f3e305f1a98baa7d232e58b03f237c3a0c9563e0.source: See Lord Darrin for your reward.
f3e305f1a98baa7d232e58b03f237c3a0c9563e0.text: 去见达林勋爵以获得奖励。

fc6b7d2bba49066a08d08fa4ab65137a1ea21409.source: After obtaining the quest from Sergeant Brannen just outside Fort Ranik, head to King's Watch in Regent Valley. A group of four Charr will be waiting at the marked location, but they do not need to be killed. The quest will update upon reaching the quest marker, and you can map travel back to Fort Ranik for the reward.
fc6b7d2bba49066a08d08fa4ab65137a1ea21409.text: 从拉尼克堡外的布兰宁中士那里获得任务后，前往摄政谷的国王哨所。四名夏尔将在标记的位置等待，但不需要杀死他们。任务将在到达任务标记后更新，您可以在地图上返回拉尼克堡以获得奖励。

bc584dfedec6c54e307f82fcf0aaee915e867705.source: This quest combines well with Cities of Ascalon and The Red-Cloaked Deserter as all three require traveling to King's Watch.
bc584dfedec6c54e307f82fcf0aaee915e867705.text: 该任务与《阿斯卡隆之城》和《红袍逃兵》很好地结合在一起，因为这三个任务都需要前往国王守望台。

fbba1a4b391ec0d3e2b8920981d847f07f24babc.source: Start from Lost Soul [Challenge Mission Starter] located in Remains of Sahlahja.
fbba1a4b391ec0d3e2b8920981d847f07f24babc.text: 从位于 Sahlahja 遗迹的失落灵魂 [挑战任务启动器] 开始。

111880d39df1b664567b250e1e515157f9aeb0c0.source: Evade angry ghosts and cleanse the tombs by killing the insects that have infested the area.
111880d39df1b664567b250e1e515157f9aeb0c0.text: 通过杀死出没该地区的昆虫来躲避愤怒的鬼魂并清理坟墓。

f526de747cf2c81adc94ed0bc81831e6cbf57d65.source: Evade the ghosts of the primeval kings.

d8d1b3919fff96b4c49f49b9b5f1587920a26bda.text: 杀死感染者以获得积分。

b673033da58beb846be3c0848e497b3f5192c040.source: Kill greater infestations to earn points and gain the temporary ability to harm ghosts.
b673033da58beb846be3c0848e497b3f5192c040.text: 杀死更大的感染者以获得积分并获得伤害鬼魂的临时能力。

5d42c70a9eae5e8ae01bff804096464bbd0ea3a7.source: Destroy lost souls to free their spirits and earn points.
5d42c70a9eae5e8ae01bff804096464bbd0ea3a7.text: 摧毁迷失的灵魂以释放他们的灵魂并赚取积分。

27cca2b89ddfe22ae3cb418937589db51dce0d9b.source: Earn 15 points to unlock access to each section of the tombs.
27cca2b89ddfe22ae3cb418937589db51dce0d9b.text: 获得 15 点即可解锁进入古墓各个部分的权限。

1b919b0ee0838f6d932adf41e358d62e5b0df93d.source: For every Maddened Spirit that you kill, you have a chance of acquiring an Ancient Armor Remnant (each of these allows you to upgrade the visual appearance of hero armor; you can add statues of heroes with upgraded armor to the Hall of Monuments).
1b919b0ee0838f6d932adf41e358d62e5b0df93d.text: 对于你杀死的每一个疯狂的灵魂，你都有机会获得远古盔甲遗迹（每一个都可以让你升级英雄盔甲的视觉外观；你可以将具有升级盔甲的英雄雕像添加到纪念碑大厅）。

0de85d53ca01e4dd7500a2aa60952b4ceee155a0.source: During the mission, you will suffer from Corrupted Lands, which causes a constant Health degeneration of 1 pip. This can be hard to mitigate because your ability to heal is limited by spending most of the mission riding a Junundu. There are 5 different areas in this challenge. You start out in the center and have 4 locked doors to the other areas at the beginning. For every 15 points you earn you unlock a new section. You earn points by defeating various enemies during the mission
0de85d53ca01e4dd7500a2aa60952b4ceee155a0.text: 在任务期间，您将遭受腐化土地的影响，这会导致健康状况持续恶化 1 点。这可能很难缓解，因为你的治疗能力因大部分任务都骑在朱南杜上而受到限制。这项挑战有 5 个不同的领域。你从中心开始，一开始有 4 扇锁着的门通往其他区域。每获得 15 分，您就可以解锁一个新部分。您可以通过在任务期间击败各种敌人来获得积分

5f8db5aa7c9f082b7db41f9b7df7352731be1118.text: 感染（1 点，1 光明使者点）

bd884884572d4f7ebbd1e87e1a942c56e9674755.text: 更大的感染（3点，3点光明使者点）

155e660c9a6498099ad7b7ec5ce91ae8a5dea5ab.text: 疯狂之灵（4 点，4 光明使者点）

1184c51c39a2beeb786d4821822dc41d55ba7fcc.text: 失落的灵魂（8点，8点光明使者点）

fe6907a224ffd6b132443ade873ade2b86ee86a6.source: The Maddened Spirits deal 700 damage and are invincible unless you are enchanted with Spirit Form, which lasts for a short period after killing a Greater Infestation while within a Junundu. You get the most points for defeating Lost Souls, which spawn at random locations on the map.
fe6907a224ffd6b132443ade873ade2b86ee86a6.text: 疯狂的灵魂会造成 700 点伤害，并且是无敌的，除非你被灵魂形态附魔，灵魂形态在朱南杜杀死一只大感染后会持续很短一段时间。击败失落的灵魂会获得最多的积分，失落的灵魂会在地图上的随机位置生成。

ed97c58567fa7cfe5a60ad68c7ebdb5d051ee72d.source: The Paragon skill, "Can't Touch This!", will protect you from the Maddened Spirit's Maddened Strike (but you can only kill a Maddened Spirit while inside a wurm — and you can enter a wurm while being attacked by Maddened Spirit, unlike with any other creature).
ed97c58567fa7cfe5a60ad68c7ebdb5d051ee72d.text: 典范技能“不能碰这个！”将保护你免受疯狂之灵的疯狂打击（但你只能在亚龙体内杀死疯狂之灵——并且你可以在被疯狂之灵攻击时进入亚龙，这与任何其他生物不同）。

386c0a6d6824a9492fad089a77c13020f15f8330.source: The best method to get Armor Remnants is to camp near a Greater Infestation and keep it near death as you kill Infestations. Keep an eye on your radar and watch for a moving red dot, then as the Maddened Spirit gets near you kill the Greater Infestation. You should then be able to kill the spirit and move on to camp the next Greater Infestation.
386c0a6d6824a9492fad089a77c13020f15f8330.text: 获得护甲残余物的最佳方法是在大型感染者附近扎营，并在杀死感染者时使其接近死亡。密切注意你的雷达并注意移动的红点，然后当疯狂的灵魂接近你时杀死更大的感染。然后你应该能够杀死灵魂并继续前往下一次大感染的营地。

39b3706f67fee86e221ccb3927fc34d6f06d190a.source: The best method for gaining points is seeking and killing Lost Souls. Kill the first few Maddened Spirits until you have unlocked two areas. Then, start running in your wurm through the areas. There are three spawn points in the northwestern corner (one on rocky ground), three in the northeastern corner, one in the southeastern corner (on rocky ground) and two in the southwestern corner. When you start running, go through each area methodically, scanning for lost souls. Do not fight the Spirits. Let them chase you and use your tunnel skill to keep ahead of them. When you find a lost soul, make sure you have some space between you and the spirits before you kill it. Then, tunnel quickly away. This will take a while, but done effectively you can rack up many points.
39b3706f67fee86e221ccb3927fc34d6f06d190a.text: 获得积分的最佳方法是寻找并杀死失落的灵魂。杀死前几个疯狂的灵魂，直到你解锁两个区域。然后，开始在你的亚龙中奔跑穿过这些区域。西北角有 3 个生成点（1 个在岩石地面上），东北角有 3 个，东南角有 1 个（岩石地面），西南角有 2 个。当你开始跑步时，有条不紊地穿过每个区域，寻找迷失的灵魂。不要与灵魂对抗。让他们追你，并利用你的隧道技巧保持领先。当你发现一个迷失的灵魂时，在杀死它之前确保你和灵魂之间有一些距离。然后，快速地隧道离开。这将需要一段时间，但如果做得有效，您可以获得很多积分。

5a0437cf67e7ef7164a49f203a602917bfbd44bd.source: For souls on rocky ground, have at least 2 aggro circles' distance between you and the spirits before having the wurm spit you out. You will need a running skill (perhaps two) and enough damage to kill the soul quickly.
5a0437cf67e7ef7164a49f203a602917bfbd44bd.text: 对于岩石地面上的灵魂，在让亚龙把你吐出来之前，你和灵魂之间至少有 2 个仇恨圈的距离。你需要一个奔跑技能（也许两个）和足够的伤害来快速杀死灵魂。

79079f317339504b9f641495dd4fbec21fad152d.source: To heal you can either build up your adrenaline and use Junundu Smash to KD a mob then use Junundu Bite (given that the first attack doesn't kill your target) to heal for 500 hp. You can also use Junundu Tunnel then use Junundu Bite to knock down and heal for 500 hp. You can also use Junundu Wail to heal for 500 hp if there are no enemies near you. The best way to heal is to exit your wurm and get a new wurm, but you are very vulnerable while doing this so make sure you have at least two aggro circles' distance between you and the spirits before you try this.
79079f317339504b9f641495dd4fbec21fad152d.text: 为了治疗，你可以增强你的肾上腺素并使用朱南杜粉碎来KD一个小怪，然后使用朱南杜咬伤（假设第一次攻击不会杀死你的目标）来治疗500点生命值。您还可以使用 Junundu 隧道，然后使用 Junundu 咬击击倒并治疗 500 hp。如果你附近没有敌人，你还可以使用朱南杜哀嚎来治疗 500 点生命值。最好的治疗方法是退出你的亚龙并获得一个新的亚龙，但这样做时你非常脆弱，所以在你尝试这个之前，请确保你和灵魂之间至少有两个仇恨圈的距离。

9faf23c695d4923470d3506121181bbb9e1d3fc6.source: To offset the effects of health degeneration you can use Bowl of Skalefin Soup or War Supplies, which will cancel the effects of the health degeneration and allow the Junundu's natural regeneration to take over.
9faf23c695d4923470d3506121181bbb9e1d3fc6.text: 为了抵消健康退化的影响，你可以使用一碗 Skalefin 汤或战争补给品，这将消除健康退化的影响并让朱南杜的自然再生接管。

7b409d45fd4f90ec35e41c6bb3ea9f2a3ec17cdf.source: You may want to equip a few speed stances, because Lost Souls may spawn on rocky terrain where your wurm cannot go to. In these cases you'll have to build sufficient distance between you and the Maddened Spirits to get out your wurm without being caught. Once you are out of the wurm use your speed boosts to stay ahead of the Spirits and run to the nearest wurm spoor after killing the Lost Soul.
7b409d45fd4f90ec35e41c6bb3ea9f2a3ec17cdf.text: 你可能需要装备一些速度姿态，因为失落的灵魂可能会在你的亚龙无法到达的岩石地形上生成。在这些情况下，你必须在你和疯狂的灵魂之间建立足够的距离，才能在不被抓住的情况下摆脱你的亚龙。一旦你离开了亚龙，使用你的速度提升来保持在灵魂的前面，并在杀死失落的灵魂后跑到最近的亚龙足迹。

3ee7cb9bf52fc5812d240db767c99797095f4a45.source: During this mission you will be under the effects of Corrupted Lands.
3ee7cb9bf52fc5812d240db767c99797095f4a45.text: 在此任务期间，您将受到腐化之地的影响。

cecf65b9c7c248370361027d6dc377dce69d6c57.source: As with most other challenge missions, foes do not drop loot.
cecf65b9c7c248370361027d6dc377dce69d6c57.text: 与大多数其他挑战任务一样，敌人不会掉落战利品。

de630750bdb2cebe2b43ebd524f0af4965d51a76.source: The Dynastic Tombs, in which this mission takes place, contributes approximately 1.87% towards the Elonian Cartographer title.
de630750bdb2cebe2b43ebd524f0af4965d51a76.text: 该任务发生的王朝陵墓为埃隆制图师头衔贡献了约 1.87%。

a9dd19673d14d15a08e1f53e929623b2d1dde7e2.source: The section at the start contributes about 0.5%.

c8a3f640d1e671c8919f75626f9d0cd8ec46af97.source: After unlocking a single gate, you can uncover just under 0.4% more.
c8a3f640d1e671c8919f75626f9d0cd8ec46af97.text: 解锁一个门后，您可以多发现不到 0.4%。

6e4129b49b19262ecd8394e6adbc393eccae575c.source: You can indefinitely avoid the maddened spirits (while still killing infestations) by using a consumable providing a speed boost (e.g. using Rock Candy, Cupcake or Empowering Feast)
6e4129b49b19262ecd8394e6adbc393eccae575c.text: 您可以通过使用提供速度提升的消耗品（例如使用冰糖、纸杯蛋糕或赋能盛宴）无限期地避免疯狂的灵魂（同时仍然杀死感染）

b817b5cf28c6eb1a5501eb40b3d401b9cf5f4b90.source: You can recover health with either a health regeneration buff (e.g. Bowl of Skalefin Soup, War Supplies or Empowering Feast) or using your junundus skills (in particular the Junundu Tunnel>Junundu Bite combo)
b817b5cf28c6eb1a5501eb40b3d401b9cf5f4b90.text: 你可以通过生命再生增益（例如一碗 Skalefin 汤、战争物资或赋能盛宴）或使用你的 junundus 技能（特别是 Junundu 隧道 > Junundu 咬合组合）来恢复生命值

37eabe4d1a0cc096022521ebf8535ab36d99d54d.source: A video guide for the mission can be found here.
37eabe4d1a0cc096022521ebf8535ab36d99d54d.text: 您可以在此处找到该任务的视频指南。

654bd1fe54da84ca80cafbccf15807a673ef5726.source: Kill the Remnant of Antiquities and accompanying foes in the Sepulchre of Dragrimmar.
654bd1fe54da84ca80cafbccf15807a673ef5726.text: 杀死德拉格里玛墓穴中的古物遗迹和随行的敌人。

d0c1af1cfb30c9b059612cfdb287c0476794b827.source: *BONUS* Kill the Remnant of Antiquities and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
d0c1af1cfb30c9b059612cfdb287c0476794b827.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死古物遗迹和伴随的敌人。

1625383d4237993199d20b92bee1ef376f86ddd0.source: As per The Anvil of Dragrimmar quest.
1625383d4237993199d20b92bee1ef376f86ddd0.text: 根据德拉格里玛铁砧任务。

0f8d13199138824dd46952afae5b4b473c1547bf.source: Find Verata in Traveler's Vale and put an end to his experiments.
0f8d13199138824dd46952afae5b4b473c1547bf.text: 在旅行者谷找到维拉塔并结束他的实验。

2292dfd2f7b29a6cef42a2f5b16af4d0ebd5db33.source: Return to Necromancer Morgan for your reward.
2292dfd2f7b29a6cef42a2f5b16af4d0ebd5db33.text: 返回死灵法师摩根处领取奖励。

6e1e56984e7a9b59a81e92930114f185a364d304.source: Verata is found surrounded by corpses of Ascalonian Rangers near the portal to Ascalon Foothills. You can fight or run past the Verata's Fiends and Verata's Horrors to get to him. When you see him, he will use Animate Bone Fiend on a corpse of an Ascalonian Ranger. When you go near him, his dialogue occurs and he will go through the Ascalon Foothills portal. Return to Yak's Bend to get your reward.
6e1e56984e7a9b59a81e92930114f185a364d304.text: 维拉塔被发现被阿斯卡隆游骑兵的尸体包围在阿斯卡隆山麓的入口附近。你可以通过战斗或跑过维拉塔的恶魔和维拉塔的恐怖来找到他。当你看到他时，他会对阿斯卡隆游侠的尸体使用动画骨魔。当你靠近他时，他的对话就会发生，他将穿过阿斯卡隆山麓的传送门。返回牦牛湾以获得奖励。

9bda7614673da5f16866476488bc258c67a9bece.source: This quest can be completed by running to Verata, since it does not require you to kill any foes.
9bda7614673da5f16866476488bc258c67a9bece.text: 这个任务可以通过跑到维拉塔来完成，因为它不需要你杀死任何敌人。

f9eff45f12484fadbc5dfedada27bc3b2394997b.source: This quest can be completed at the same time as Shiverpeak Stragglers or Oswalt's Epitaph.
f9eff45f12484fadbc5dfedada27bc3b2394997b.text: 该任务可以与席瓦峰散兵游勇或奥斯瓦尔特的墓志铭同时完成。

78df3df90f7cad38a2daa3a022fec93e9619409b.source: For Shiverpeak Stragglers, you simply go a bit to the east, and can easily lead them back along the path you cleared.
78df3df90f7cad38a2daa3a022fec93e9619409b.text: 对于席瓦峰散兵游勇来说，你只需向东走一点，就可以轻松地将他们沿着你清理出的路径带回来。

eac4b9f55ab54dcb010c792c7d58c4dd9ad7a584.source: For Oswalt's Epitaph, travel to the Ascalon Foothills where his headstone is located.
eac4b9f55ab54dcb010c792c7d58c4dd9ad7a584.text: 要查看奥斯瓦尔特的墓志铭，请前往他的墓碑所在的阿斯卡隆山麓。

ac70b1a1236923ff2dc9fc1691920300bd9d1581.source: If you are a combination of Necromancer and Warrior, do this quest at the same time as Securing the Vale. Both will lead you to the area with Verata.
ac70b1a1236923ff2dc9fc1691920300bd9d1581.text: 如果你是死灵法师和战士的组合，请在保卫山谷的同时完成此任务。两者都会带您前往 Verata 所在的区域。

1d48a64a30007d2f4cb3c067e1b9e86ef0e78987.source: Once Verata has entered Ascalon Foothills, the Bone Fiends he created will remain in Traveler's Vale and become hostile.
1d48a64a30007d2f4cb3c067e1b9e86ef0e78987.text: 一旦维拉塔进入阿斯卡隆丘陵，他创造的骨魔将留在旅行者谷并变得敌对。

75668238259850ee314ced2de8eb7a1c6f03f3f0.text: 在麻子平地与德沃娜见面。

9b0d1e5b561893ee79568f8754a5712c8f026336.source: Escort Devona to the Eastern Frontier.
9b0d1e5b561893ee79568f8754a5712c8f026336.text: 护送德沃娜前往东部边境。

ca54bf3650b994c8c0debb5abb2e1662c077869d.source: Help Devona defeat the Charr warband.
ca54bf3650b994c8c0debb5abb2e1662c077869d.text: 帮助德沃娜击败夏尔战帮。

217c4e58ed209953d843f903b580646217329967.source: Return to Priestess Rashenna for your reward.
217c4e58ed209953d843f903b580646217329967.text: 返回女祭司拉什娜那里领取奖励。

31bae416149f83ef60773a9d14f17e0294ab7c09.source: Talk to Devona just outside the Temple's exit and she will follow you to the portal into the Eastern Frontier. Once in the Frontier, Devona will take the lead; you will have to follow her to the warband. There will be a few devourer popups along the way. Keep Devona alive and kill the Charr.
31bae416149f83ef60773a9d14f17e0294ab7c09.text: 在神殿出口外与德沃娜交谈，她会跟随你前往东部边境的传送门。一旦进入边境，德沃娜将带头；你必须跟随她加入战队。一路上会出现一些吞噬者弹出窗口。让德沃娜活着并杀死夏尔。

f4b0cf85568d6bdd0e340a65416d672ac97a81d0.source: Devona can become stuck on terrain, requiring re-zoning to continue.
f4b0cf85568d6bdd0e340a65416d672ac97a81d0.text: 德沃纳可能会被困在地形上，需要重新分区才能继续。

3c77059566361079341cb0b5a761d684be2c8104.source: While this quest is active, Devona will follow you wherever you go in Pockmark Flats, and can be used as a 4th henchman in the area.
3c77059566361079341cb0b5a761d684be2c8104.text: 当这个任务活跃时，无论你去波克马克平原，德沃娜都会跟着你，并且可以作为该地区的第四个追随者。

18f888deddcd21d0709f1b01c9b249833dbe5188.source: Devona can die and you can still finish the quest and claim the reward.
18f888deddcd21d0709f1b01c9b249833dbe5188.text: 德沃娜可以死，但你仍然可以完成任务并领取奖励。

f28dd7dc922b4fc7d867d7b559079f6905cb27cd.source: Travel to the ancient temple in the Sulfurous Wastes.
f28dd7dc922b4fc7d867d7b559079f6905cb27cd.text: 前往硫磺荒原的古老寺庙。

520ae8155e25dad1570f216069a1a0d3b95f4964.source: Retrieve the ancient tome of knowledge.

59057ceb350161211233310fea4a2a7a4818f745.source: Return to Infantryman Hareh with the ancient tome.
59057ceb350161211233310fea4a2a7a4818f745.text: 带着古书回到步兵哈雷那里。

8caf7e663414c66704451440db9a4659ef03a01c.source: After you have accepted the quest, make your way to the monolith temple in the southwestern part of the map. There you have to fight a few Margonite groups and you can claim the Ancient Tome of Knowledge. The tome itself is actually lying on the ground at the temple entrance. On your way back, along the path leading out of the southwestern corner, two more Margonite groups will spawn in an attempt to stop you from leaving; but since your party is inside Junundu, they should pose little threat.
8caf7e663414c66704451440db9a4659ef03a01c.text: 接受任务后，前往地图西南部的巨石神庙。在那里你必须与一些玛贡尼特团体战斗，然后你就可以获得远古知识之书。这本书本身实际上就躺在寺庙入口处的地上。在你回来的路上，沿着从西南角出来的小路，将会出现另外两个玛贡尼特群体，试图阻止你离开；但由于你的队伍在朱南杜境内，他们应该不会构成什么威胁。

eb4723f4e42a3ab4c737664248987633c4085209.source: Infrantryman Hareh is in a blocked area to the north, which requires you to smash a pillar with Junundu Smash to gain access (see the notes section of the Sulfurous Wastes).
eb4723f4e42a3ab4c737664248987633c4085209.text: 步兵哈雷 (Hareh) 位于北部的封锁区域，需要您使用朱南杜粉碎 (Junundu Smash) 粉碎一根柱子才能进入（参见硫磺废土的注释部分）。

04089204a4fe3f8fbf656e3dc6a2877bb1380ee2.source: This quest is popularly used in conjunction with A Show of Force to farm points for both the Sunspear rank and the Lightbringer rank (see Guide to farming Lightbringer promotion points for details).
04089204a4fe3f8fbf656e3dc6a2877bb1380ee2.text: 此任务通常与武力展示结合使用，以获取阳矛等级和光明使者等级的点数（有关详细信息，请参阅获取光明使者升级点数指南）。

827744d42c72d52200da66626d864893f8ade244.source: The quests Temple of the Monoliths‎ and A Show of Force conclude in the same area; consider doing one of them at the same time as this quest.
827744d42c72d52200da66626d864893f8ade244.text: 任务“巨石神庙”和“武力展示”在同一区域结束；考虑在这个任务的同时做其中一个。

8556c41edec69adbae0b0e3c097386d2224888ee.source: There is a Treasure Chest inside the temple.

eab810a3ec659a5cf0b47d386a38d0db31b44513.source: Clear the Resplendent Makuun in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
eab810a3ec659a5cf0b47d386a38d0db31b44513.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比辉煌马库恩的所有敌人。

9c91f4efa994686830942d850dfb787fd967a256.source: This area lies to the southeast of the Mirror of Lyss, past Honur Hill. Characters are most likely to venture here for the first time as part of the primary quest All's Well That Ends Well.
9c91f4efa994686830942d850dfb787fd967a256.text: 该区域位于里斯之镜的东南方，经过荣誉山。角色最有可能作为主线任务“一切都好，结局好”的一部分首次在这里冒险。

94c490d6f6d03f5809098764f992ffe6925446b5.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.98% to the Elonian Cartographer title; you can clear an additional 0.03% after exploring Bokka Amphitheatre. (Source: Guild Wiki)
94c490d6f6d03f5809098764f992ffe6925446b5.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.98%；探索博卡露天剧场后，您可以额外清除 0.03%。 （来源：公会维基）

3117907ef9544bd213e6f92e250b761cc4d4fe3a.source: The exit portal marker for Wilderness of Bahdza is placed too far west on the map.
3117907ef9544bd213e6f92e250b761cc4d4fe3a.text: 巴哈扎荒野的出口标记在地图上放置得太西。

797b382e2d3474cad0f96a0a3f30ce7d00eabfff.source: Destroy the Seeds of Corruption. 5..0 Seeds of Corruption remain.
797b382e2d3474cad0f96a0a3f30ce7d00eabfff.text: 消灭腐败的种子。 5..0 腐败的种子依然存在。

cd72e04586588529c1377e1508cdba40a40c5f51.source: The Seeds of Corruption all spawn in a cave to the south known as the Spider Cave. Each of the Seeds spawn next to one of the Doubter's Dryders and its associated pop-ups of Armored Cave Spiders that are normally in the cave. The quest is complete when the last Seed is dead. Parties with bonders should beware as both the Dryders are heavy on enchantment removal.
cd72e04586588529c1377e1508cdba40a40c5f51.text: 腐化种子全部生成于南边一个被称为蜘蛛洞的洞穴中。每个种子都会在其中一个怀疑者烘干机及其相关的通常位于洞穴中的装甲洞穴蜘蛛弹出窗口旁边生成。当最后一个种子死亡时，任务就完成了。拥有绑定器的各方应该小心，因为两个干燥器都非常注重去除结界。

c79d78e38cc0fc8949faf4d930234991cdd6205e.source: It is possible to clear the cave of dryders and spiders before taking the quest.
c79d78e38cc0fc8949faf4d930234991cdd6205e.text: 在接受任务之前可以清除洞穴中的烘干机和蜘蛛。

5f74d7573988b02db7895324488260d4f6fb4d01.source: This is the final quest required for players to craft Obsidian armor
5f74d7573988b02db7895324488260d4f6fb4d01.text: 这是玩家制作黑曜石盔甲所需的最终任务

dd5bcd4e89de6e7d2ae81d1c16e34588d9622df6.source: Completing this quest also allows you to sell items to the Eternal Forgemaster.
dd5bcd4e89de6e7d2ae81d1c16e34588d9622df6.text: 完成此任务还可以让你将物品出售给永恒锻造师。

b265f4186ccb8e1e647d5059de29d26b88f048ad.source: Summon the Reaper of the Chaos Planes.
b265f4186ccb8e1e647d5059de29d26b88f048ad.text: 召唤混沌位面的收割者。

c91e3db4229d9e4df1269ea2121bfe6b72fdcb2b.source: Summon the Reaper of the Ice Wastes.

a8864646ccc84727425bb6ed7ee0dfc8af75c2f3.source: Summon the Reaper of the Bone Pits.

4e07d78464c4c367432a6403f8555776b216b6a0.source: Summon the Reaper of the Spawning Pools.

0c995a1cc3c01eec9cce8742b304cd6e8e2f8deb.source: Summon the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale.

0439fd84a360627bbcdd182c541d78750977a537.source: Summon the Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains.

45872d6aa178203c451ffd375f48bc5175fe50f9.source: Return to Reaper of the Labyrinth for your reward.
45872d6aa178203c451ffd375f48bc5175fe50f9.text: 返回迷宫收割者那里领取奖励。

d4c5d182ea0b971479ebb656ea2ce6b9fc1586d6.source: Completing this quest will require you to travel the whole Underworld, killing groups of three Terrorweb Dryders at the six other monuments of Grenth. Upon accepting the quest one group of Terrorwebs will spawn next to each of the monuments. When your party kills one of the groups the corresponding Reaper is spawned next to the monument.
d4c5d182ea0b971479ebb656ea2ce6b9fc1586d6.text: 完成这个任务需要你走遍整个地狱，在古兰斯的另外六座纪念碑处杀死三名恐怖网干燥者。接受任务后，每个纪念碑旁边都会生成一组恐怖网。当你的队伍杀死其中一组时，相应的收割者就会在纪念碑旁边生成。

78af305403e423c24a0534af9dc9856a9bd16889.source: Pay extra caution at the monuments of Forgotten Vale, Twin Serpent Mountains and Spawning Pools. Kill the surrounding monsters before the Terrorweb Dryders, because otherwise they might attack the Reaper and cause your party to be taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld.
78af305403e423c24a0534af9dc9856a9bd16889.text: 在遗忘谷、双蛇山和产卵池的纪念碑处要格外小心。在恐怖网烘干机之前杀死周围的怪物，否则它们可能会攻击收割者并导致你的队伍被带回你进入地狱的前哨站。

b93d33b6828b4215b64ec45448a4dfc82c10fd25.source: As the quest suggests, once a Reaper is freed, you will be able to speak to him and he can teleport you to any other Reaper that you have freed. The Reapers also have quests to offer, but be aware that taking any quests without consulting the party is unwise as they tend to spawn dangerous groups and might cause a party wipe if the party isn't prepared.
b93d33b6828b4215b64ec45448a4dfc82c10fd25.text: 正如任务所示，一旦收割者被释放，你就可以与他交谈，他可以将你传送到你释放的任何其他收割者处。收割者也有任务要提供，但要注意，在没有咨询队伍的情况下接受任何任务是不明智的，因为它们往往会产生危险的群体，如果队伍没有做好准备，可能会导致队伍被消灭。

a6f0917d8af0af658986b12322ac5cfc873155fb.source: Note: Although it is very tempting to take the quest immediately after completing the preceding quest or soon after clearing one or two nearby areas due to the offered teleportation possibility, it might be wise to clear the furthermost problematic monuments before accepting the quest to avoid having to fight against the Terrorwebs and the other enemies surrounding the monuments at the same time.
a6f0917d8af0af658986b12322ac5cfc873155fb.text: 注意：尽管由于提供了传送的可能性，在完成前面的任务后或在清理一两个附近区域后不久就很容易接受任务，但在接受任务之前清理最远的有问题的纪念碑可能是明智的，以避免同时与恐怖网和纪念碑周围的其他敌人作战。

bcf63946afe2a02611fd5320797ca5e9c82057a2.source: Stop the rampaging undead in Joko's Domain. 6...0 groups of undead remain.
bcf63946afe2a02611fd5320797ca5e9c82057a2.text: 阻止约科领地里狂暴的亡灵。还剩下 6...0 群不死生物。

a0d2407e22c05b9b2a47ed0f98b6ad5e0d566b62.source: Follow the quest pointer to each of the six groups in turn. All 6 are found on rocky ground to the south east of the Bone Palace, which wurms cannot tunnel through. The party will however have to use wurms to leave the Bone Palace and reach the initial rocky area.
a0d2407e22c05b9b2a47ed0f98b6ad5e0d566b62.text: 按照任务指针依次到达六组中的每一组。所有 6 个都位于白骨宫殿东南部的岩石地面上，亚龙无法通过该地面。然而，队伍必须使用亚龙离开骨宫并到达最初的岩石区域。

4babe5202b0e3f042def9cb699b1648ac743ad59.source: Bringing disruption skills or even better Frozen Soil can severely speed up this quest because of the number of resurrection skills the undead groups have.
4babe5202b0e3f042def9cb699b1648ac743ad59.text: 由于不死族拥有大量的复活技能，因此带来破坏技能甚至更好的冻土可以大大加快这个任务的速度。

7eb0e803a8f759d82839a6b935613600f866f2a1.source: Find and defeat Arrahhsh Mountainclub and retrieve the Golden Lantern.
7eb0e803a8f759d82839a6b935613600f866f2a1.text: 找到并击败Arrahhsh Mountainclub并取回金灯笼。

bb1ccde307d6e178b02a5b7ece26f18140e0f1a1.source: See Magistrate Kin for your reward.
bb1ccde307d6e178b02a5b7ece26f18140e0f1a1.text: 请见金县长以领取奖励。

34da1eb5dea44607a2fca35c850a49aea8bc163e.source: After accepting the quest head north from Magistrate Kin to a cave full of yeti. Arrahhsh Mountainclub is in a large group of yeti right next to the monk boss Hukhrah Earthslove. Eliminate Arrahhsh Mountainclub and retrieve the golden lantern to complete the quest.
34da1eb5dea44607a2fca35c850a49aea8bc163e.text: 接受任务后，从金裁判官处向北前往一个充满雪人的洞穴。 Arrahhsh Mountainclub 位于一大群雪人中，紧邻僧侣头目 Hukhrah Earthslove。消灭Arrahhsh Mountainclub并取回金灯笼即可完成任务。

1ce0e0fe6e97bb09a8286ddbfdffe8624ceb9e3a.source: Keiran will not appear unless Gwen is included in your party as a hero.
1ce0e0fe6e97bb09a8286ddbfdffe8624ceb9e3a.text: 除非格温作为英雄加入你的队伍，否则凯兰不会出现。

4b5ff7cf787d9437d18fd1cebeda44dbeb57a853.source: If Gwen died along the way, upon initiation of the dialogue she will automatically be resurrected.
4b5ff7cf787d9437d18fd1cebeda44dbeb57a853.text: 如果格温在途中死亡，在对话开始时她会自动复活。

5528aa6db44936f3c1304c7c6221c716f42a78bd.source: You must return to your Hall of Monuments to receive the quest reward; you cannot speak with party-member Gwen.
5528aa6db44936f3c1304c7c6221c716f42a78bd.text: 您必须返回纪念碑大厅才能获得任务奖励；你不能和党员格温说话。

76d774e190d60e52e2a40d0f0d4f66ee7ef7314b.source: After this quest, Keiran will propose to Gwen (see: Keiran's proposal). After you accept the quest reward, you must exit your Hall of Monuments and re-enter a couple of times to trigger Kieran's next appearances.
76d774e190d60e52e2a40d0f0d4f66ee7ef7314b.text: 完成此任务后，凯兰将向格温求婚（参见：凯兰的求婚）。接受任务奖励后，您必须退出纪念碑大厅并重新进入几次才能触发基兰的下一次出现。

15ad731cd877105cf36c65443af64e87ca6fd428.source: During the Proposal dialogue, Keiran appears to alternate between carrying a shield and then not carrying a shield between multiple rezonings. What's even more interesting is that the shields appear to be of different types.
15ad731cd877105cf36c65443af64e87ca6fd428.text: 在提案对话期间，凯兰似乎在多次重新分区之间交替携带盾牌和不携带盾牌。更有趣的是，盾牌的类型似乎不同。

b248a32e0e3eaa536225495521411bd8b5e8a717.source: Weaken Wulk Cragfist and talk with him to get the quest.
b248a32e0e3eaa536225495521411bd8b5e8a717.text: 削弱沃克·峭拳并与他交谈以完成任务。

e62ff20d26fa452fcf176a470bed51f3af628218.source: Follow Wulk Cragfist to the Sensali Tengu camp and avenge his fallen companions.
e62ff20d26fa452fcf176a470bed51f3af628218.text: 跟随沃克·峭拳前往森萨里天狗营地，为他阵亡的同伴报仇。

b3312b88a5abd729e7d504eb23eed9684558984b.source: See Wulk Cragfist for your reward.
b3312b88a5abd729e7d504eb23eed9684558984b.text: 前往沃克·峭拳获取奖励。

a58ce27f3e9ebdce1adb5856dbf0724b4ea1fe2d.source: After acquiring the quest, head northwest from Wulk Cragfist. As a large group of Tengu becomes visible, Wulk Cragfist will cry out and charge towards them. Help with defeat this group of 6 to 8 Tengu (quest-specific spawn). Although Wulk Cragfist is of a much higher level, if you do not help him, the combined damage from all the Tengu is sufficient to take him down. Once this group of Tengu has been slain, claim your reward from Wulk Cragfist.
a58ce27f3e9ebdce1adb5856dbf0724b4ea1fe2d.text: 完成任务后，从乌尔克·克拉格菲斯特向西北走。当一大群天狗出现时，沃克·峭拳会大喊并向他们冲锋。帮助击败这群 6 到 8 只天狗（任务特定生成）。虽然沃克·岩拳的等级要高得多，但如果你不帮助他，所有天狗的伤害加起来就足以把他打倒了。一旦这群天狗被杀死，就可以从沃克·峭拳那里领取奖励。

c56c32653a6a98e068b841e4b06cf98554a1842d.source: Since he is a tall creature, the quest markers will not be visible
c56c32653a6a98e068b841e4b06cf98554a1842d.text: 由于他是一个高大的生物，任务标记将不可见

f5c2125b53734be502b7a606acc3ffaa58d6d8d4.source: If Wulk Cragfist dies, you have to rezone, defeat him again, and talk to him about the quest to make the quest active again. If he dies, the quest will fail.
f5c2125b53734be502b7a606acc3ffaa58d6d8d4.text: 如果沃克·克拉格拳死了，你必须重新分区，再次击败他，并与他谈论任务以使任务再次激活。如果他死了，任务就会失败。

8097a5720d3dbc2692b2513aca62940dc5e7e299.source: You can make this quest a little easier by taking Yijo Tahn (Study Buddy quest) along with you.
8097a5720d3dbc2692b2513aca62940dc5e7e299.text: 你可以通过带着 Yijo Tahn（学习伙伴任务）来使这个任务变得更容易一些。

b02e2d68f11cdefe28d617d595071de4aeaf480b.source: If you stay where you are after getting the quest from him, Wulk will be invincible (as long as his name is grey in the party list from being out of your range) but he will still be able to kill the Tengu making this quest virtually unfailable.
b02e2d68f11cdefe28d617d595071de4aeaf480b.text: 如果你在接到他的任务后留在原地，乌尔克将是无敌的（只要他的名字在队伍列表中显示为灰色，超出你的范围），但他仍然能够杀死天狗，使这个任务几乎不会失败。

77d1a27a155a2aab91776d795dec0e945f057fc6.source: When the quest is completed, Wulk Cragfist is not removed from the party list. Instead he remains in his location as an ally member until you are out of Sunqua Vale.
77d1a27a155a2aab91776d795dec0e945f057fc6.text: 任务完成后，沃克·峭拳不会从队伍列表中删除。相反，他会作为盟友保留在原来的位置，直到你离开桑夸谷。

bcdfa4231ae7b2d2a440757b6fe7a8ec1650e504.source: Head to Scoundrel's Rise east of North Kryta Province. Find the cause of the undead's westward movement.
bcdfa4231ae7b2d2a440757b6fe7a8ec1650e504.text: 前往北科瑞塔省东部的流氓高地。找出亡灵西迁的原因。

17e78229857654c5c079e3f6fde7f977e05a580b.source: Lord Timot is the source of the undead movement. Destroy him.
17e78229857654c5c079e3f6fde7f977e05a580b.text: 蒂莫特领主是不死族运动的源头。毁了他。

c62e20bfe6765635b5920c74f9f8fdb6c2c01325.source: Return to Captain Greywind [Skills] for your reward.
c62e20bfe6765635b5920c74f9f8fdb6c2c01325.text: 返回格雷风队长[技能]处领取奖励。

47836166f032a63d2f86156c21811eb22c55dfd3.text: 土系伤害：7-13（需要 6 土系魔法）

5f1bb336baaa91a0622a9ca40a1cd8b441ba2fae.source: Head east along the beach of North Kryta Province and enter Scoundrel's Rise. Just as you enter you will see Settlement Scout Drew (if he dies you cannot complete the quest until you zone somewhere, luckily he stands right next to a portal). He will point you in the direction of Lord Timot, a zombie boss who you must kill to complete the quest. Proceed east until you can travel south into a dead-end swamp where the boss will be located. The route is guarded by 4 Executioners who may prove difficult to take down if faced all at once. Timot himself can be found at the bottom of the path together with some Smoke Phantoms.
5f1bb336baaa91a0622a9ca40a1cd8b441ba2fae.text: 沿着北科瑞塔省的海滩向东行驶，进入 Scoundrel's Rise。当你进入时，你会看到定居点侦察兵德鲁（如果他死了，你就无法完成任务，直到你在某个地方区域，幸运的是他就站在传送门旁边）。他会为你指明蒂莫特领主的方向，你必须杀死他才能完成任务。向东前进，直到你可以向南进入一个死胡同沼泽，老板将在那里。这条路线由 4 名刽子手守卫，如果同时面对他们可能很难击倒。蒂莫特本人和一些烟雾幻影就在道路的底部。

2abc07f71175d7322ed415bf063a10a01791549b.source: When you enter the dead-end swamp, Lord Timot and the Executioners will begin moving out towards you, leaving the rest of the undead behind. The Executioners move much more slowly than their Lord, passing them at the swamp's entrance, so you can wait for them to separate in order to kill Timot without his guardsmen. Once outside, Lord Timot will turn southeast and march towards the Gates of Kryta, eventually becoming unreachable when he moves beyond the portal. Consider pre-clearing the large clump of enemies just east of the swamp entrance to make sure you can safely catch up with Lord Timot if you intend to let him move away from the Executioners before engaging him.
2abc07f71175d7322ed415bf063a10a01791549b.text: 当你进入死胡同的沼泽时，蒂莫特领主和刽子手们将开始向你移动，将其余的不死族抛在身后。刽子手的移动速度比他们的领主慢得多，在沼泽入口处经过他们，所以你可以等待他们分开，以便在没有卫兵的情况下杀死蒂莫特。一旦出了门，蒂莫特领主就会转向东南，向科瑞塔之门进军，最终当他越过传送门时，就变得无法到达。考虑预先清除沼泽入口东边的一大群敌人，以确保你可以安全地追上蒂莫特领主，如果你想让他在与刽子手交战之前离开刽子手的话。

0cd682c5639d1577fadc04dbc74826ee40046c9d.source: Once he is defeated, return to Captain Greywind for your reward.
0cd682c5639d1577fadc04dbc74826ee40046c9d.text: 一旦他被打败，就回到格雷温德船长那里领取奖励。

ed3771359246910e7a31969bae64d3019943c274.source: If you have War in Kryta content active, Lord Timot will spawn close to Joh the Hostile and his group, who will fight and kill Lord Timot if he comes too close, rendering you unable to complete the quest until you zone. You are advised to move to the area quickly to prevent this from happening.
ed3771359246910e7a31969bae64d3019943c274.text: 如果你激活了《科瑞塔之战》内容，蒂莫特勋爵将在敌对者乔和他的团队附近生成，如果蒂莫特勋爵靠得太近，他们会战斗并杀死蒂莫特勋爵，使你无法完成任务，直到你进入区域。建议您尽快前往该地区，以防止这种情况发生。

bbb7fc9f45cb5e8cfcaca3d92a3778719eca0183.source: The reward focus item has the Stone Chakram skin, not Jeweled Chalice.
bbb7fc9f45cb5e8cfcaca3d92a3778719eca0183.text: 奖励焦点物品有石环轮皮肤，而不是宝石圣杯。

6dfbef093b28089dd66ab22b3b3a6ada67d9a94e.source: This is the earliest opportunity to obtain the skills Desecrate Enchantments, Animate Bone Fiend and Barbs in the Prophecies campaign, so consider bringing three Signets of Capture if you are a Necromancer.
6dfbef093b28089dd66ab22b3b3a6ada67d9a94e.text: 这是在预言战役中获得“亵渎结界”、“活化骨魔”和“倒钩”技能的最早机会，因此如果您是死灵法师，请考虑带上三个捕获徽记。

1fd9357060e4b5930520f8bc87698dd8ead27e7f.source: Eventually, Timot will leave Scoundrel's Rise into Gates of Kryta, making the quest impossible to finish in the current instance.
1fd9357060e4b5930520f8bc87698dd8ead27e7f.text: 最终，蒂莫特将离开流氓高地进入科瑞塔之门，使得任务在当前实例中无法完成。

76845574bb8ee035ec77e5ed89f1391c8facd809.source: Kill Maximole and his followers to quell the revolt.
76845574bb8ee035ec77e5ed89f1391c8facd809.text: 杀死马克西莫勒和他的追随者以平息叛乱。

78aaebcfd5322f92fc9b10e10b9d1a7ae5b8c74e.source: Maximole and his group can be found patrolling in Ferndale a little way west of Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick); however, beware of the other patrolling groups of Dredge in the area that you should deal with first before moving to Maximole's group. Maximole will typically be found with 3-4 other Dredge.
78aaebcfd5322f92fc9b10e10b9d1a7ae5b8c74e.text: 马克西莫勒和他的团队在阿斯彭伍德门（库尔齐克）以西不远的芬代尔巡逻；然而，要提防该地区的其他巡逻队，在前往马克西莫尔的队伍之前，你应该先解决这些问题。 Maximole 通常会与 3-4 个其他挖泥机一起被发现。

5ca2e32440fe0b097885ad3bba82e0149e20e523.source: Clear Rhea's Crater in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
5ca2e32440fe0b097885ad3bba82e0149e20e523.text: 在困难模式下清除玉海瑞亚火山口的所有敌人。

bfa35906173af3c9fc0ecb1debdc8e9714648e31.source: Rhea's Crater can be reached via the eastern exit of Seafarer's Rest, or through the Gyala Hatchery explorable area from the Leviathan Pits.
bfa35906173af3c9fc0ecb1debdc8e9714648e31.text: 瑞亚火山口可以通过海员休息站的东出口到达，或者从利维坦坑穿过加拉孵化场探索区。

d4cde57d02183f616127e2ddd8ae1825a328d81c.source: There are 7 hidden Oni groups (each consisting of 3 to 5 of them):
d4cde57d02183f616127e2ddd8ae1825a328d81c.text: 共有 7 个隐藏的鬼组（每个组由 3 到 5 个组成）：

147936e1d52f8d04c48aef9d95e04f7c47912a5a.source: Southwest of Grenth's shrine, at the southern end of the curving path at the western edge.
147936e1d52f8d04c48aef9d95e04f7c47912a5a.text: 古兰斯神殿的西南方，西边弯曲小路的南端。

8900f66fc5913f676bcfa4a589042a87dce5335d.source: In the inlet bordering the landmass west of Grenth's shrine.
8900f66fc5913f676bcfa4a589042a87dce5335d.text: 位于与古兰斯神殿以西陆地接壤的入口处。

3af9d89b8556f772b46c528d9fbbfae8af9ff08a.source: Short distance from the Gyala Hatchery exit, near the shrine.
3af9d89b8556f772b46c528d9fbbfae8af9ff08a.text: 距离甲拉孵化场出口不远，靠近神社。

47c594f58317946cbcf554655dc73efcf34d48d1.source: In a nook at the northeastern corner.

9f9421c189fe08ece30e3a2d5a44ab2ddae11a7e.source: At the end of the eastern path that leads away from the Aurios Mines.
9f9421c189fe08ece30e3a2d5a44ab2ddae11a7e.text: 在远离奥里奥斯矿场的东边小路的尽头。

f5293af7d0439ea541e82be23b5b5e98642dd08b.source: At both ends of the bridge just north of the petrified leviathan marked on the area map as a dark green square (see map), these ones have a chance to drop Ungues of the Oni.
f5293af7d0439ea541e82be23b5b5e98642dd08b.text: 在区域地图上标记为深绿色方块（参见地图）的石化利维坦以北的桥梁两端，这些人有机会掉落鬼之爪。

abddd7a0956fea38882299016788e3f373b76164.source: Outcasts are hostile to other enemies - you can save ~22 kills if you let them fight it out.
abddd7a0956fea38882299016788e3f373b76164.text: 流放者对其他敌人怀有敌意 - 如果你让他们决一死战，你可以节省大约 22 次杀戮。

1d084e9d456b1cfbebe385505215282068113319.source: Arius, Dark Apostle - depending on how fast you can reach her location - may already have been killed by other mobs.
1d084e9d456b1cfbebe385505215282068113319.text: 黑暗使徒阿里乌斯 - 取决于你到达她所在位置的速度 - 可能已经被其他生物杀死了。

e571fab8d8fedfa5c3008962ba85df1e8e29dd92.source: Talous the Mad may also get in a fight with the sea life of the area, but will most likely emerge victorious. She and Wavecrest Stonebreak will fight each other when their patrol paths intersect.
e571fab8d8fedfa5c3008962ba85df1e8e29dd92.text: 疯狂的塔洛斯也可能会与该地区的海洋生物发生战斗，但很可能会取得胜利。当她和 Wavecrest Stonebreak 的巡逻路径交叉时，他们会互相争斗。

20786c2503d73baa60218ac3c712b0b22db3a73a.source: The eastern side of the central area contains actual water - a rarely seen thing in the Jade Sea region.
20786c2503d73baa60218ac3c712b0b22db3a73a.text: 中心区的东侧竟然有水，这在玉海地区是很少见的。

61d79cd363971b4bfd9d1094ce10ddfd4ddc14b9.source: This area has one boss of each profession available in Guild Wars Factions.
61d79cd363971b4bfd9d1094ce10ddfd4ddc14b9.text: 该区域在激战派系中每个职业都有一个 Boss。

29a542e187bf3302d02e168eda81e8fc6d4e1eb9.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 2.4% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
29a542e187bf3302d02e168eda81e8fc6d4e1eb9.text: 对该区域的完整探索将为 Canthan Cartographer 主打歌带来约 2.4% 的收益。

175d7194a586397aaf716ec8cad794d1c3916976.source: Take note of the small Outcast groups that run quickly along their patrol paths.
175d7194a586397aaf716ec8cad794d1c3916976.text: 注意沿着巡逻路径快速奔跑的小型流放者群体。

0ad1b6cb14b023663394dfcf660bdbc34b3526c9.source: Hunt down and kill the rhythm drinker. Retrieve its rhythm wing, and return to Vasili Lutgardis.
0ad1b6cb14b023663394dfcf660bdbc34b3526c9.text: 追捕并杀死节奏饮酒者。取回它的节奏翼，然后返回瓦西里·卢特加迪斯身边。

c08055a67fa35289967030b17a1eb3e5e18e753a.source: The rhythm drinker can be found in Melandru's Hope a little way east of Lutgardis Conservatory on the other side of the river.
c08055a67fa35289967030b17a1eb3e5e18e753a.text: 节奏饮水器位于梅兰德鲁之希望 (Melandru's Hope)，位于河对岸卢特加迪斯音乐学院 (Lutgardis Conservatory) 以东不远的地方。

a0e2b6b2c20f2112b9b1cf71995218632a3c5880.source: Take the Master of Whispers to Rilohn Refuge in Kourna and defeat the demon in Mahnkelon Waterworks.
a0e2b6b2c20f2112b9b1cf71995218632a3c5880.text: 将低语大师带到库尔纳的里洛恩避难所，并击败曼科隆自来水厂的恶魔。

d2cbcafc412fa0e311443c3441eae7ed0d8ff53e.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission without shutting down the water pumps.
d2cbcafc412fa0e311443c3441eae7ed0d8ff53e.text: *奖励* 在不关闭水泵的情况下完成任务。

e86359e265d95236dd612743408b870106c1a379.source: As per the Rilohn Refuge mission.
e86359e265d95236dd612743408b870106c1a379.text: 根据里洛恩避难所任务。

ee9afc94aeb22d64332dd98d3b95a2f6866dd17a.source: Clear the way on the Ring of Fire islands.

d7410b4ee04832b5228604330546cd479e9db995.source: *BONUS* Return the Spectral Essence from the Eidolon to the Ancient Seer.
d7410b4ee04832b5228604330546cd479e9db995.text: *奖励* 将夜灵中的幽灵精华返还给远古先知。

bd41c04f2925b255b5ff8de46c143824107da6ae.source: As per the Ring of Fire mission.

f9f291654d5a8d8f30ec3287869e7a3877a9b75a.source: Contrary to the quest objective text and the mission bonus, killing the Eidolon is counted as completion, rather than returning the Spectral Essence.
f9f291654d5a8d8f30ec3287869e7a3877a9b75a.text: 与任务目标文本和任务奖励相反，杀死幻灵被视为完成，而不是归还幽灵精华。

f6b72f52cf7880e9c4280c4ab36d978f9207c0cb.source: When the mission begins, you will be in the town of Beetletun. White Mantle soldiers will threaten villagers on the east side of the mission map. Position Miku close to them during their speech and when they become hostile, kill them as quickly as possible. Keep using Nature's Blessing to heal the villagers; all survivors will assist you in the battles that follow. Following the initial fight, Keiran will receive an additional shout, "There's Nothing to Fear!"; use it often on both sides of the village to increase the durability of your allies.
f6b72f52cf7880e9c4280c4ab36d978f9207c0cb.text: 当任务开始时，你将到达 Beetletun 镇。白斗篷士兵将威胁任务地图东侧的村民。在他们讲话时让 Miku 靠近他们，当他们变得有敌意时，尽快杀死他们。继续使用自然的祝福来治愈村民；所有幸存者都会在接下来的战斗中协助你。在最初的战斗之后，凯兰将额外听到一声喊叫：“没什么好害怕的！”；经常在村庄两侧使用它来增加盟友的耐用性。

8fa510440aa5f137de557e8e6ecc3b43fc76f142.source: Six waves of enemies will then attack alternating sides of the village: waves 1 and 3 come from the Nebo side; waves 2 and 4 come from the Watchtower side; and waves 5 and 6 come nearly simultaneously from both sides. Avoid the front lines, so that you can cover as many villagers as possible with Keiran's shout and stance. Use interrupts frequently, and watch out for minion-producing necromancers that hide outside the village.
8fa510440aa5f137de557e8e6ecc3b43fc76f142.text: 然后，六波敌人将交替攻击村庄的两侧：第一波和第三波来自尼波一侧；第2波和第4波来自了望塔一侧；第5波和第6波几乎同时从两侧袭来。避开前线，这样你就可以用凯兰的喊声和姿态覆盖尽可能多的村民。经常使用打断，并提防隐藏在村外的生产小兵的死灵法师。
