d85e389724dfeb7f82fd19431de96ce3b12f4ce6.source: Just before the final wave, Miku will announce, "looks like the big one".
d85e389724dfeb7f82fd19431de96ce3b12f4ce6.text: 就在最后一波之前，Miku 将宣布，“看起来像是大一波”。

4d20e768b26bf7ef761e0f901c17d7b6710c7f66.source: "There's Nothing to Fear!" is added to Thackeray's skillbar after he shouts "There's nothing to fear!" (shortly after the Initial Confrontation).
4d20e768b26bf7ef761e0f901c17d7b6710c7f66.text: “没什么好害怕的！”在萨克雷大喊“没有什么好害怕的！”后，他的技能栏上就添加了“没有什么好害怕的”。 （初次对抗后不久）。

2e11a9dbbf2b3ed5d60045e20d8513971872b8ab.source: "Find Their Weakness!" and "There's Nothing to Fear!" benefit from his high Expertise, reducing their energy costs.
2e11a9dbbf2b3ed5d60045e20d8513971872b8ab.text: “找出他们的弱点！”和“没什么好害怕的！”受益于他的高专业知识，降低他们的能源成本。

df5df226a36bec2e9fee51752b26a15adf664894.source: You must equip Keiran's Bow to start this mission. However, you can switch it out for another weapon, including a long- or flatbow for pulling and especially one that has weapon upgrades appropriate to Keiran's skills. However, you cannot increase his maximum health, energy, or total attributes using weapon or armor upgrades.
df5df226a36bec2e9fee51752b26a15adf664894.text: 您必须装备凯兰的弓才能开始此任务。然而，你可以将其换成另一种武器，包括用于拉动的长弓或扁弓，尤其是具有适合凯兰技能的武器升级的武器。但是，您无法使用武器或护甲升级来增加他的最大生命值、能量或总属性。

020f3653c86445279e9f73f697d3c9291fb7f89f.source: As with other missions, you can still receive credit for completing Rise even after you die, as long as all enemies are killed. To get your rewards, wait for the quest to update before mapping out.
020f3653c86445279e9f73f697d3c9291fb7f89f.text: 与其他任务一样，即使你死了，只要杀死所有敌人，你仍然可以获得完成崛起的功劳。要获得奖励，请等待任务更新后再进行规划。

252bcbafccdb626de7ba3841ee55678bbba21f1c.source: Crossing the portals will teleport you to the middle of the village; you can take advantage of this to jump quickly from one battlefront to the other.
252bcbafccdb626de7ba3841ee55678bbba21f1c.text: 穿过传送门会将你传送到村庄的中心；你可以利用这一点从一个战场快速跳转到另一个战场。

8e17ce0220094549ab6889836e106be7b7844a9f.source: Some consider this a good farming option for Ebon Vanguard reputation points, War Supplies, or sweet points because it can be completed in under 8 minutes, i.e. in an hour, approximately 37,000 experience, 38 supplies/sweet points, and 9,400 EV points.
8e17ce0220094549ab6889836e106be7b7844a9f.text: 有些人认为这是获得 Ebon Vanguard 声望点、战争补给品或甜蜜点的良好农业选择，因为它可以在 8 分钟内完成，即一小时内，获得大约 37,000 经验、38 个补给/甜蜜点和 9,400 EV 点。

e0172b3d3089f2a101674244b175e99f4c15f19f.source: Gain the rank of First Spear.

71e83a64dba37f9e8a1d16a40ce03b57feb102d0.source: Complete quests or help Sunspear scouts with conscription orders to earn Sunspear promotion points.
71e83a64dba37f9e8a1d16a40ce03b57feb102d0.text: 完成任务或帮助烈阳之矛侦察兵执行征兵命令，以获得阳戟之城晋升积分。

b2b24db565676479aff1616bb33bbe5579b8490e.source: See Runduk [Sunspear Rank Officer] for your reward.
b2b24db565676479aff1616bb33bbe5579b8490e.text: 请见伦杜克 [烈阳之矛军阶军官] 以获得奖励。

4632a14396a418269c13309a541ca3df346f8b03.source: Basically the same as with Rising in the Ranks: Master Sergeant. Go out and do quests and slay monsters for which you have a bounty. As soon as you reach the rank of First Spear in your title track your quest log will update and you can go back to Runduk to collect your reward.
4632a14396a418269c13309a541ca3df346f8b03.text: 与《军衔崛起：军士长》基本相同。出去做任务并杀死你有赏金的怪物。一旦您在标题曲目中达到第一矛的排名，您的任务日志就会更新，您可以返回伦杜克领取奖励。

0da85386095eb2f6aee9e09bbfe70f20934bd755.source: Gain the rank of Master Sergeant.

c13a6cc414b2487e54b7e390edec89fc496e5e36.source: This quest only requires you to obtain Sunspear promotion points.
c13a6cc414b2487e54b7e390edec89fc496e5e36.text: 该任务只需要你获得阳矛升级点即可。

ebb323889c80db741f8fcd45eb8ad47b7514ecc7.source: Throughout the campaign there are resurrection shrines. An NPC can be found at each shrine who can grant a bounty for hunting certain creatures. The bounty normally provides extra experience and, more importantly for this quest, it includes Sunspear promotion points. Gather 100 points to achieve the Master Sergeant level. You can see your progress in your Hero panel; press H to open it, and select the "Titles" tab. As soon as you reach the rank of Master Sergeant your quest log will update and you can go to Runduk to collect your reward.
ebb323889c80db741f8fcd45eb8ad47b7514ecc7.text: 整个战役中都有复活神殿。每个神社都可以找到一名 NPC，他可以为狩猎某些生物提供赏金。赏金通常会提供额外的经验，更重要的是对于这个任务，它包括阳矛升级点。收集 100 点即可达到军士长级别。您可以在英雄面板中查看您的进度；按 H 将其打开，然后选择“标题”选项卡。一旦您达到军士长军衔，您的任务日志就会更新，您可以前往伦杜克领取奖励。

dd4c2b10544ce3923fb7e76c43fbcf0ca50c92a9.source: Accessible secondary quests that provide Sunspear Points
dd4c2b10544ce3923fb7e76c43fbcf0ca50c92a9.text: 可提供阳矛点数的辅助任务

f745c9b1b3ba37e62913690941c88ceb59704f5d.text: 斯克雷幼体季节 (10 分)

8d2285c83de79e0b7f12eaeedab306a875df5ca5.source: Talk to three potential recruits in Zehlon Reach and convince them to join the Sunspears.
8d2285c83de79e0b7f12eaeedab306a875df5ca5.text: 与泽隆河段的三名潜在新兵交谈并说服他们加入烈阳之矛队。

48ab63777d288e9d60e66ab5a9e09fac121182e0.source: Talk to Morik in Zehlon Reach and ask him to join the Sunspears.
48ab63777d288e9d60e66ab5a9e09fac121182e0.text: 与泽隆河段的莫里克交谈并邀请他加入烈阳之矛队。

903b0d091af63560459de05b81557a65121e0f51.source: Talk to Dahni about Morik's dilemma.
903b0d091af63560459de05b81557a65121e0f51.text: 与达尼谈论莫里克的困境。

171251d7e32633a8e12950fa585b53408564c700.source: Tell Morik that Dahni is leaving to join the Sunspears.
171251d7e32633a8e12950fa585b53408564c700.text: 告诉莫里克达尼要离开并加入烈阳之矛队。

de08055947364aeff4c561e203a7003219f1e9e8.source: Talk to Ando and ask him to join the Sunspears.
de08055947364aeff4c561e203a7003219f1e9e8.text: 与安藤交谈并邀请他加入阳矛队。

bb5a63f8690e50c7c032481a79d5b07cf7231f14.source: Kill the beast threatening Ando's family.
bb5a63f8690e50c7c032481a79d5b07cf7231f14.text: 杀死威胁安藤家人的野兽。

d95a318de2bf6e21b2172da93451b9df16e23b25.source: Tell Ando that the threat is gone.
d95a318de2bf6e21b2172da93451b9df16e23b25.text: 告诉安藤威胁已经消失。

a2aec769f980bbb1a5f0386a9c8c5f691c4d14d5.source: See Castellan Puuba for your reward
a2aec769f980bbb1a5f0386a9c8c5f691c4d14d5.text: 前往 Castellan Puuba 领取奖励

176f873064bde294a04d311a4f68eeeee5132722.source: The first potential recruit, Morik, can be found on a pier in the center of the north coast in Zehlon Reach. Speak to him to find out he doesn't have confidence in himself and would rather stay with Dahni. Speak to Dahni, who can be found a little south on the same pier. She is the second recruit and has already decided to join the Sunspears. She asks you to tell Morik that she is leaving. Talk to Morik and he will join the Sunspears. The third recruit, Ando, can be found southwest in a small village. Speak to him to find out he can't leave the village until he is certain that it will be safe without him protecting it. Head a little south and kill the group of five Irontooth Drakes that is threatening his village. Tell Ando that the threat is gone and he will join. Return to the Sunspear Great Hall and speak to Castellan Puuba to collect your reward.
176f873064bde294a04d311a4f68eeeee5132722.text: 第一个潜在的新兵莫里克可以在泽隆河段北海岸中心的一个码头上找到。与他交谈，发现他对自己没有信心，宁愿留在达尼身边。与达尼交谈，他位于同一个码头南边不远的地方。她是第二位新兵，已经决定加入阳矛队。她要求你告诉莫里克她要离开。与莫里克交谈，他将加入烈阳之矛队。第三名新兵安藤位于西南方向的一个小村庄里。与他交谈，了解他不能离开村庄，除非他确信没有他的保护村庄会安全。向南走一点，杀死威胁他村庄的五只铁牙幼龙。告诉安藤威胁已经消失，他会加入。返回阳矛大厅并与城主普乌巴交谈以领取奖励。

ecc1c0f1286848eb1d4503e02170a7b47b5c033e.source: This quest appears to have been added after the November 30th, 2006 update.
ecc1c0f1286848eb1d4503e02170a7b47b5c033e.text: 该任务似乎是在 2006 年 11 月 30 日更新后添加的。

60c179da05455e4dbf1145a5ff7a09166fdafc0f.source: To significantly decrease the quest time, use Charge or a similar team running skill and set your heroes to avoid combat. Leave from Jokanur Diggings and run North past all enemies.
60c179da05455e4dbf1145a5ff7a09166fdafc0f.text: 要显着减少任务时间，请使用冲锋或类似的团队奔跑技能并设置你的英雄避免战斗。从 Jokanur 矿区出发，向北跑过所有敌人。

a029bc86b63342cad45db8c10646f85b65cf1fcc.source: Light candles on all four braziers in the catacombs to appease the angry spirits.
a029bc86b63342cad45db8c10646f85b65cf1fcc.text: 在地下墓穴中的所有四个火盆上点燃蜡烛，以安抚愤怒的灵魂。

b6c157114e413b73a67ad562736e07ba55b9bdee.source: Return to Necromancer Munne for your reward.
b6c157114e413b73a67ad562736e07ba55b9bdee.text: 返回死灵法师穆尼那里领取奖励。

849061cabe49fe5821b4bad81eb18f751865caea.source: Upon completing the quest, the braziers will no longer spawn. Neither will the Restless Spirits, resulting in a higher presence of Restless Corpses in the swamp water, as they will no longer be thinned out by the spirits.
849061cabe49fe5821b4bad81eb18f751865caea.text: 完成任务后，火盆将不再生成。不安的灵魂也不会，导致沼泽水中的不安尸体的数量更高，因为它们将不再被灵魂稀释。

0aebb64c515364995a29829e1dfb59b146c78f58.source: Talk to Necromancer Munne and take the 4 Votive Candles. Proceed through the Catacombs and place a candle on each of the four Remembrance Braziers in the order shown on the mission map.
0aebb64c515364995a29829e1dfb59b146c78f58.text: 与死灵法师穆尼交谈并获得 4 根许愿蜡烛。继续穿过地下墓穴，按照任务地图上显示的顺序在四个纪念火盆上各放一根蜡烛。

a9fd57053fb4fd18a22ed5e19001961a70385d04.source: Since some of the braziers are located in Swamp Water, which causes constant health degeneration, you need to monitor your health drop. Be careful about drawing aggro from nearby foes at the same time.
a9fd57053fb4fd18a22ed5e19001961a70385d04.text: 由于一些火盆位于沼泽水中，这会导致健康状况不断恶化，因此您需要监控您的健康状况下降情况。同时要小心吸引附近敌人的仇恨。

c5c0121ed771e6442157599f35768de1fcf46e71.source: Any healing skill, such as Orison of Healing or Troll Unguent, to counter with the swamp water effects.
c5c0121ed771e6442157599f35768de1fcf46e71.text: 任何治疗技能，例如奥里森治疗或巨魔药膏，可以对抗沼泽水效果。

ffa4befe070d5b2afcf9a33c0b6124fa855e964d.source: Life stealing skills like Vampiric Touch can be useful too, though there are few foes to use them against in the swamp water.
ffa4befe070d5b2afcf9a33c0b6124fa855e964d.text: 像吸血鬼之触这样的生命窃取技能也很有用，尽管在沼泽水中很少有敌人可以使用它们。

ded4cd77abb2fe9857ac6c87bf524479b8d6e12b.source: If you die, you will lose the candles. Just go back to Necromancer Munne for more candles. She will take any extra back when you go to get your reward.
ded4cd77abb2fe9857ac6c87bf524479b8d6e12b.text: 如果你死了，你就会失去蜡烛。返回死灵法师穆尼那里获取更多蜡烛即可。当你去领取奖励时，她会收回多余的钱。

a08e7193b7e44b689da267db0b3bd48255e90b4f.source: Completing the Condition Removal quest should be relatively easy. Before entering the dojo, set all of your attribute points in Restoration Magic. Before you start the course, use Generous Was Tsungrai to increase your maximum health, and be ready to drop the ashes when you need a quick burst of healing or just before the spell ends. Keep Resilient Weapon up as soon as you're first hit with a condition; it should deal with any damage you take as long as you're not bleeding. You can also train Soothing Memories if you want to be extra sure of survival. As the warrior attacking you uses self-knockdown skills, kiting can be very effective too.
a08e7193b7e44b689da267db0b3bd48255e90b4f.text: 完成条件移除任务应该相对容易。进入道场之前，先在恢复魔法中设置好自己的所有属性点。在开始课程之前，使用慷慨的宗格莱来增加你的最大生命值，并准备好在你需要快速爆发治疗时或在法术结束之前掉落灰烬。当你第一次受到攻击时，请立即保持弹性武器；只要你不流血，它就可以处理你受到的任何伤害。如果你想更加确定生存，你还可以训练舒缓记忆。由于攻击你的战士使用自我击倒技能，风筝也非常有效。

9b5546c2dd4d5f441a0ae4772772b5db2376c871.source: You should use the same tactics as the ones for Condition Removal, however you should train Soothing Memories if you didn't already as you will be losing health much faster.
9b5546c2dd4d5f441a0ae4772772b5db2376c871.text: 你应该使用与条件消除相同的策略，但是如果你还没有训练舒缓记忆，你应该训练它们，因为你会更快地失去生命值。

138c40ea84a29e3d4f3d913cfa513c244ea0beb6.source: You can also create spirits and back up. They will focus their attack the spirits. Just remember to keep creating spirits when the current ones are about to die. You can then choose to wait it out or try to deplete their health.
138c40ea84a29e3d4f3d913cfa513c244ea0beb6.text: 您还可以创建精神并备份。他们将集中攻击灵魂。只要记住在当前的灵魂即将死去时继续创造灵魂即可。然后你可以选择等待或尝试耗尽他们的生命值。

040829709acf15201cbf0a367eba9ef99c089c03.source: The Disruption quest is slightly harder; you should mix your attributes between Communing and Spawning Power for this quest. It also helps to have taken a secondary profession with strong interrupts. You should bring Pain as well as Dissonance, and any secondary profession skills that can interrupt. Essentially your goal here is to reduce the instructor to 50% health, while they try to use skills against you with very long casting times. If you have any interrupts that cast quickly, save them to counter Meteor.
040829709acf15201cbf0a367eba9ef99c089c03.text: 破坏任务稍微困难一些；你应该在这个任务中混合你的交流和产卵能力属性。选择一个有强烈干扰的第二职业也有帮助。你应该带上痛苦和不和谐，以及任何可以打断的辅助职业技能。本质上，你的目标是将教练的生命值降低到 50%，而他们会尝试使用技能来对抗你，并且施法时间很长。如果你有任何快速施法的打断，请将它们保存下来以对抗流星。

4683e2a29e15ab9725857893e5b1621984b5778e.source: Skill Chaining is the hard part of this quest and you may want to level up before attempting it. It should be very easy by the time you reach level 10. Simply put all of your attribute points into Channeling Magic and bring Cruel Was Daoshen, Channeled Strike, Spirit Rift, and Spirit Boon Strike. Before they start attacking use Cruel Was Daoshen. When they start attacking use Channeled Strike then drop Cruel. Next use Spirit Rift and Spirit Boon Strike. Repeat if necessary.
4683e2a29e15ab9725857893e5b1621984b5778e.text: 技能链是此任务的困难部分，您可能需要在尝试之前升级。到10级的时候应该很容易了，只要把所有的属性点都放到引导魔法上，带上残酷道神、引导打击、灵裂、灵恩打击就可以了。在他们开始攻击之前使用残忍被道神。当他们开始攻击时，使用引导打击，然后掉落残酷。接下来使用精神裂缝和精神恩惠打击。如有必要，请重复。

778c0ee53fcca4cc99468b4463f4a6efbbf97f64.source: Clear Riven Earth in the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
778c0ee53fcca4cc99468b4463f4a6efbbf97f64.text: 在困难模式下清除黯淡海岸中的裂痕大地中的所有敌人。

432e81c4be6ad835d8da5e59d8ac5d26356be3e5.source: This area is to the east of Rata Sum. To get here for the first time, start from Vlox's Falls and head west across Arbor Bay.
432e81c4be6ad835d8da5e59d8ac5d26356be3e5.text: 该区域位于拉塔苏姆 (Rata Sum) 以东。第一次到达这里，可以从 Vlox's Falls 出发，向西穿过 Arbor Bay。

9615d41eabbce7d16f239ffb9cf75d04cd6fd857.source: After completing Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation, speak with Sokka to obtain an Asuran Beacon, which can be dropped to create a G.O.L.E.M. 1.0 to aid your party.
9615d41eabbce7d16f239ffb9cf75d04cd6fd857.text: 完成天才操作的生命魔法显现后，与索卡交谈以获得阿苏兰信标，将其掉落以创建 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0 来帮助你的派对。

c77989108db7253a9180ab15f7c81151125f385e.source: This is a popular spot for farming Asura reputation due to the large concentration of Raptor Nestlings in a cave close to the entrance.
c77989108db7253a9180ab15f7c81151125f385e.text: 由于靠近入口的洞穴中大量集中了猛禽雏鸟，因此这里是获得阿修罗声望的热门地点。

dd51464467ef06f7771472ed1eca5b793e957392.source: Discounting quest influences, it has been reported to range from 260 to 299.
dd51464467ef06f7771472ed1eca5b793e957392.text: 扣除任务影响后，据报道范围在 260 到 299 之间。

8a90a932807a152d571b8b27ebcf3034a0db14f4.source: These Quests influence the spawns in this area: The Asura Trap, The Cipher of Dwayna
8a90a932807a152d571b8b27ebcf3034a0db14f4.text: 这些任务影响该区域的生成：阿苏拉陷阱、德薇娜密码

b178e4f9ff84050268da39b636d3bd42980fdfb2.source: Keep spread out when engaging dinosaurs (especially Ceratadons); their area damage can easily kill bunched up heroes and henchmen.
b178e4f9ff84050268da39b636d3bd42980fdfb2.text: 与恐龙（尤其是角齿龙）交战时保持分散；他们的区域伤害可以轻松杀死聚集的英雄和追随者。

4f0ba0cba1dac0a8b2f28a7164b49ec75fb6ed88.source: Keep away from the forested area west of the Golem Foundry, to avoid triggering the hidden spider groups there (but do find the Simians in the clearing north of it).
4f0ba0cba1dac0a8b2f28a7164b49ec75fb6ed88.text: 远离魔像铸造厂以西的森林区域，以避免触发那里隐藏的蜘蛛群（但一定要在其北部的空地上找到猿猴）。

0b598d704f6c073da9c7b28c27ddf5c5a5b9f2f3.source: There are also hidden spider groups right before reaching Gallow Nooseknitter.
0b598d704f6c073da9c7b28c27ddf5c5a5b9f2f3.text: 在到达绞索编织者之前还有隐藏的蜘蛛群。

ce246d0ca3f4fce18c0790e3ee433d24ca258e35.source: After completion of the Eye of the North storyline, the small number of Destroyers in the north are actually separated into two hostile groups that will fight each other.
ce246d0ca3f4fce18c0790e3ee433d24ca258e35.text: 北方之眼故事情节完成后，北方的少量毁灭者实际上分成了两个敌对群体，互相争斗。

762e9943dd3023c53bd187b012c3a204a3d7ff35.source: This area comprises approximately 6% of the mappable area in Eye of the North; you can uncover most of it during the G.O.L.E.M. mission by killing the originally spawning Destroyers and before activating the kilns.
762e9943dd3023c53bd187b012c3a204a3d7ff35.text: 该区域约占北方之眼可绘制地图区域的 6%；你可以在 G.O.L.E.M. 期间揭开其中的大部分内容。任务是在激活窑炉之前杀死最初生成的驱逐舰。

4d077f685108382221f08b7284e1297bf748741d.text: *奖励* 摧毁所有九座瞭望塔。

d0927cef7a5879ae4df2beca987fb64f8b6575cf.source: As per the Riverside Province mission.

0a06059749abbef06aef9f96155510b83d0dccf7.source: It is significantly easier and faster to complete the mission in hard mode and then do the first bonus in normal mode (assuming you don't need the hard mode bonus for the Guardian of Tyria title).
0a06059749abbef06aef9f96155510b83d0dccf7.text: 在困难模式下完成任务然后在正常模式下完成第一个奖励会更加容易和快捷（假设您不需要泰瑞亚守护者头衔的困难模式奖励）。

b71a8a0de9296db8f12fb622f836199aba177016.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死腐鳞。

7fd7ba22c4e3a21de1771b1422d5484625778de6.source: Killing Rotscale during A Vengeance of Blades does not complete this quest.
7fd7ba22c4e3a21de1771b1422d5484625778de6.text: 在《刀锋复仇》中杀死腐鳞并不能完成此任务。

2d920abb1c52bc26a1f9275a9b488ae58a859df3.source: Enter the tournament and defeat your first round opponent.
2d920abb1c52bc26a1f9275a9b488ae58a859df3.text: 参加锦标赛并击败第一轮对手。

a2a02b719055fcf0b1ade2ea0f6eae168b40b052.source: You gain 5 Norn reputation points for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
a2a02b719055fcf0b1ade2ea0f6eae168b40b052.text: 杀死敌人后你获得 5 诺恩声望点（除非诺恩等级 8 或以上）

89a71a727537081e15a9f056e2e6dc1efb29a799.source: You gain a quest reward after beating all 6 rounds, see Final Round: Fight! (first time completion) or Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight! (for repeated victories)
89a71a727537081e15a9f056e2e6dc1efb29a799.text: 通关全部 6 轮后您将获得任务奖励，请参阅最终轮：战斗！ （首次完成）或决赛，冠军版：战斗！ （为了屡战屡胜）

20d5ae9c36aff8e7bf20df2715d0e9b055c66708.source: Talk to Gellir Frostshield to start the tournament. A fee of 100gold is automatically deducted from your character upon confirmation.
20d5ae9c36aff8e7bf20df2715d0e9b055c66708.text: 与盖里尔·霜盾交谈以开始锦标赛。确认后，系统会自动从您的角色中扣除 100gold 的费用。

5e1cf79bd68f9ab5ecf27f1a2330ef7e180b4c47.source: Round one opponents may be Kilroy, Kisai, Little Thom, Lo Sha, Sogolon, or the Great Zehtuka. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
5e1cf79bd68f9ab5ecf27f1a2330ef7e180b4c47.text: 第一轮的对手可能是基尔罗伊、基赛、小汤姆、洛沙、索戈隆或大泽图卡。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

7a608ff8629c0c7688fb5bae695b5aa7bf87c74f.source: This quest is automatically completed upon defeating the round 1 opponent. The follow-up quest Round 2: Fight! is automatically accepted (that is, if you win round 1.)
7a608ff8629c0c7688fb5bae695b5aa7bf87c74f.text: 该任务在击败第一轮对手后自动完成。后续任务第二轮：战斗！自动接受（即，如果您赢得第一轮。）

673ef7e145074ee24ad73cd64e799f7b604ae470.source: As your character progresses through the quest chain (i.e. tournament rounds), should your character lose, your quest log will again show this quest as not completed, allowing you to talk to Gellir Frostshield to start again without needing to re-acquire this quest from Magni the Bison.
673ef7e145074ee24ad73cd64e799f7b604ae470.text: 当你的角色在任务链中前进（即锦标赛回合）时，如果你的角色输了，你的任务日志将再次显示此任务未完成，允许你与盖里尔·霜盾交谈以重新开始，而无需从野牛麦格尼重新获取此任务。

d5824ec4da58b6eb6ec1de31782e7708da8fd7d8.source: For the detail of spectators' quotes, see talk page.
d5824ec4da58b6eb6ec1de31782e7708da8fd7d8.text: 观众言论详情请见讨论页。

3cf7a081d38a9ee423c7c6f39a2ad7c10542de08.source: You can use Heart of the Norn to gain extra health depending on the title rank for an extra boost.
3cf7a081d38a9ee423c7c6f39a2ad7c10542de08.text: 您可以使用诺恩之心来获得额外的生命值，具体取决于头衔等级以获得额外的提升。

5477e0f86cdb63515cde5df0dd59a0661d43db63.source: Defeat your second round opponent in Magni the Bison's tournament.
5477e0f86cdb63515cde5df0dd59a0661d43db63.text: 在野牛麦格尼的锦标赛中击败第二轮对手。

4fdc6aa6a9b257d44aea36595787d7a4fe7e2fbf.source: You gain 10 Norn Reputation Points for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
4fdc6aa6a9b257d44aea36595787d7a4fe7e2fbf.text: 杀死敌人后你获得 10 诺恩声望点（除非诺恩等级 8 或以上）

e8861c6ab2688ec02670a0a01070426c37f16b2c.source: Round two opponents may be Alesia, Melonni, Norgu, Old Mac with Joe, Orion, Vekk, or Xandra. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
e8861c6ab2688ec02670a0a01070426c37f16b2c.text: 第二轮的对手可能是 Alesia、Melonni、Norgu、Old Mac 和 Joe、Orion、Vekk 或 Xandra。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

f449eb7de89707a2838fa957719925af9017884b.source: This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 1 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 2 opponent and the follow-up quest Round 3: Fight! is automatically accepted.
f449eb7de89707a2838fa957719925af9017884b.text: 完成前一个任务（即赢得锦标赛第一轮）后，该任务将自动接受。击败第二轮对手和后续任务第三轮：战斗后也会自动完成。会自动接受。

782026fe532c4582d91768e0ae556ca7666edbff.source: Defeat your third round opponent in Magni the Bison's tournament.
782026fe532c4582d91768e0ae556ca7666edbff.text: 在野牛麦格尼的锦标赛中击败第三轮对手。

8ac70e2bda79ca025ddac006c465f30db0eee024.source: You gain 15 Norn Reputation Points for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
8ac70e2bda79ca025ddac006c465f30db0eee024.text: 杀死敌人后你获得 15 点诺恩声望点（除非诺恩等级 8 或以上）

cf4d2bfabfd2ab513222baae454a2067b1621989.source: Round three opponents may be Cynn, Danika (with Brutus and Sheena), Lukas, Panaku, Warmaster Tydus, or Zho with Onyx. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
cf4d2bfabfd2ab513222baae454a2067b1621989.text: 第三轮对手可能是 Cynn、Danika（与 Brutus 和 Sheena）、Lukas、Panaku、战帅 Tydus 或与 Onyx 的 Zho。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

446e1fc90f845b80290263d8840ddb4dce56ff9e.source: This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 2 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 3 opponent and the follow-up quest Round 4: Fight! is automatically accepted.
446e1fc90f845b80290263d8840ddb4dce56ff9e.text: 完成前面的任务（即赢得锦标赛第 2 轮）后，该任务将自动接受。击败第三轮对手和后续任务第四轮：战斗后也会自动完成。会自动接受。

039989661df02fd07e5f106b64b1d364ad8f2e22.source: Win the fourth round of the Norn fighting tournament.
039989661df02fd07e5f106b64b1d364ad8f2e22.text: 赢得诺恩格斗锦标赛第四轮。

c21a368ad470a1fc111b7c5215f2a2593f305c99.source: You gain 20 Norn Reputation Points for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
c21a368ad470a1fc111b7c5215f2a2593f305c99.text: 杀死敌人后你获得 20 诺恩声望点（除非诺恩等级 8 或以上）

9e6b976545f0e7b9739dd238581a0ab2942dce75.source: Round four opponents may be Eve, the Ghostly Hero, Headmaster Vhang, Kahmu, Koss, Morgahn, or Razah. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
9e6b976545f0e7b9739dd238581a0ab2942dce75.text: 第四轮的对手可能是伊芙、幽灵英雄、校长 Vhang、Kahmu、Koss、Morgahn 或 Razah。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

72644511a2eded1e63ad9a8911ca4a8b96b337c5.source: This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 3 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 4 opponent and the follow-up quest Round 5: Fight! is automatically accepted.
72644511a2eded1e63ad9a8911ca4a8b96b337c5.text: 完成前面的任务（即赢得锦标赛第三轮）后，该任务将自动接受。击败第 4 轮对手和后续任务第 5 轮：战斗后也会自动完成。会自动接受。

035fdee9d6ece81faeec067268c7bb8564838984.source: Win the fifth round of the Norn fighting tournament.
035fdee9d6ece81faeec067268c7bb8564838984.text: 赢得诺恩格斗锦标赛第五轮。

f91031736fdd29280364d7479659006408a55eff.source: You gain 25 Norn Reputation Points for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
f91031736fdd29280364d7479659006408a55eff.text: 杀死敌人后你获得 25 点诺恩声望点（除非诺恩等级 8 或以上）

99eca354dcec2d4dea06a0eb81dbc47b6de0ccb8.source: Round five opponents may be Argo, Devona, Gwen, Mhenlo, Nika, or Talon Silverwing. Please refer to the Norn Fighting Tournament article for details on their skill sets.
99eca354dcec2d4dea06a0eb81dbc47b6de0ccb8.text: 第五轮的对手可能是阿尔戈、德沃娜、格温、门洛、尼卡或利爪银翼。请参阅诺恩格斗锦标赛文章，了解有关他们技能组合的详细信息。

b444cc39e11a8ed37bdb94c050ea9c4f6e3bc4b1.source: This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 4 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 5 opponent.
b444cc39e11a8ed37bdb94c050ea9c4f6e3bc4b1.text: 完成前面的任务（即赢得锦标赛第 4 轮）后，该任务将自动接受。击败第 5 轮对手后也会自动完成。

2d3a220803bd5542603f079ab024bddf0fa5b0e7.source: The follow-up quest will be Final Round: Fight! if your character has not won the Norn Fighting tournament before. On subsequent victories, the follow-up quest will be Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight! instead.
2d3a220803bd5542603f079ab024bddf0fa5b0e7.text: 后续任务将是最终回合：战斗！如果您的角色之前没有赢得过诺恩格斗锦标赛。在随后的胜利中，后续任务将是决赛回合，冠军版：战斗！反而。

545844ab980787f99e516208e52d351dea1ffd34.source: Kill Royen Beastkeeper in Nahpui Quarter of Kaineng City.
545844ab980787f99e516208e52d351dea1ffd34.text: 杀死凯能城纳普伊区的罗伊恩兽卫。

58eed0e027b4c183a55f5046c7642ab3f2f6cedb.source: *BONUS* Kill Royen Beastkeeper in Hard Mode.
58eed0e027b4c183a55f5046c7642ab3f2f6cedb.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Royen Beastkeeper。

a9202fa65aae4793fd6f9b454c93bb056f54c9d1.source: From Senji's Corner, walk out the southern exit into Nahpui Quarter (explorable area). Follow the path as indicated on the map. (Directly under the Q in "Nahpui Quarter" on the map, be careful for an over-aggro of Jade Brotherhood, especially if using heroes and henchmen.) When fighting Royen, you may want to move up on the hill above him to remove his damage bonus due to his elevation, but, his skills are all pet based so the elevation bonus only applies to his auto-attacks.
a9202fa65aae4793fd6f9b454c93bb056f54c9d1.text: 从 Senji's Corner 出发，走出南口进入 Nahpui Quarter（可探索区域）。按照地图上指示的路径行驶。 （在地图上“Nahpui Quarter”的 Q 正下方，要小心翡翠兄弟会的过度仇恨，特别是在使用英雄和追随者时。）在与 Royen 战斗时，你可能需要移动到他上方的山上，以消除他因海拔而造成的伤害加成，但是，他的技能都是基于宠物的，因此海拔加成仅适用于他的自动攻击。

32d629441059a491f26d4adb0d2cbdec8eeb4710.source: Kill Rragar Maneater in the Depths of Tyria. Lists the region instead of the dungeon name
32d629441059a491f26d4adb0d2cbdec8eeb4710.text: 在泰瑞亚深处杀死拉加食人者。列出区域而不是地下城名称

ba7883cca67dcfd7fd53aa84e1182153863f5d53.source: *BONUS* Kill Rragar Maneater in Hard Mode.
ba7883cca67dcfd7fd53aa84e1182153863f5d53.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死拉加食人者。

39eaf1876236579737cf2ecf0e87ad970940655c.source: As per the Veiled Threat quest. At least one party member must have the quest.
39eaf1876236579737cf2ecf0e87ad970940655c.text: 根据隐藏的威胁任务。至少一名党员必须有该任务。

55eeb5f5249133d4c504eacbc7fb656fddac1bfa.source: You need to have the quest Veiled Threat (from Gron Fierceclaw in Doomlore Shrine) to advance through level 1 of this dungeon. Otherwise, the door beside the Scrawled Hide in the first room will not open.
55eeb5f5249133d4c504eacbc7fb656fddac1bfa.text: 你需要完成任务“隐秘的威胁”（来自末日神殿的格隆·猛爪）才能进入这个地下城的第 1 级。否则，第一个房间的潦草兽皮旁边的门将打不开。

c29a0ed18fa05486075c83552d62f03dc5738a69.source: You will earn 3,000 Ebon Vanguard reputation points upon your first completion of this dungeon on normal mode, and 1,500 for subsequent completions. 4,500 Vanguard reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon for the first time in hard mode, and 2,250 for subsequent completions in hard mode.
c29a0ed18fa05486075c83552d62f03dc5738a69.text: 在正常模式下首次完成此地下城时，您将获得 3,000 点黑锋先锋声望点，后续完成则可获得 1,500 点声望点。在困难模式下首次完成该地下城可获得 4,500 点先锋声誉点，随后在困难模式下完成该地下城可获得 2,250 点先锋声誉点。

a0565a5d72e673a9ba39f4a90fbf61121e1fd513.source: Feeding a "Blobby" will cause it to join your party as an ally.
a0565a5d72e673a9ba39f4a90fbf61121e1fd513.text: 喂食“Blobby”会使其作为盟友加入你的队伍。

0b94882cd8928f718edfd2adb6eecf2d3aaa6f45.source: Rragar and Hidesplitter do not regenerate their health.
0b94882cd8928f718edfd2adb6eecf2d3aaa6f45.text: 拉加和裂皮者不会恢复生命值。

d3060802d02d893e037a7f4a59011435c7abd0b8.source: When fighting Rragar and Hidesplitter, it is useful to kill Rragar first, because he carries Resurrection Chant.
d3060802d02d893e037a7f4a59011435c7abd0b8.text: 当与拉加和劈皮者战斗时，先杀死拉加是有用的，因为他携带复活颂歌。

d53d266f4fe8071fcdd54ab843aca03dc5a9b4ab.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #2 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
d53d266f4fe8071fcdd54ab843aca03dc5a9b4ab.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 2 页。

322e9ea923d6b09595238a00c81e5a6e440ecddd.source: Sometimes the door at first level, is closed. Re-zone to continue the dungeon.
322e9ea923d6b09595238a00c81e5a6e440ecddd.text: 有时第一层的门是关着的。重新区域以继续地牢。

14fcd04fd4d23906decb5fd90cc9082e633f5641.source: Leave from Doomlore Shrine and go southwest through Dalada Uplands, to Grothmar Wardowns, and then southeast into Sacnoth Valley. Head south to the southwest corner, as this is where the entrance to Rragar's Menagerie is found.
14fcd04fd4d23906decb5fd90cc9082e633f5641.text: 从杜姆洛神殿出发，向西南穿过达拉达高地，到达格罗斯玛沃顿，然后向东南进入萨克诺斯山谷。向南前往西南角，因为这里是拉加动物园的入口。

85b5c0f98ba377c3bd0e9d694291af39e08b9e56.source: Talk to the Beacon of Droknar to gain Dwarven Raider. Head north past Blobby (a neutral Ooze). Just after, some Fleshreavers will appear. Save any Fleshreaver Morsels that they might drop; you can use them to tame Blobby and have him follow you. Throughout the first level, the Charr and Fleshreavers are hostile; you can leave them to kill each other off and mop up the remains.
85b5c0f98ba377c3bd0e9d694291af39e08b9e56.text: 与卓克纳尔信标交谈以获得矮人袭击者。向北行驶，经过布洛比（Blobby）（一个中立的软泥怪）。紧接着，一些食肉者就会出现。保存好它们可能掉落的食肉者碎片；你可以用它们来驯服布洛比并让他跟随你。在整个第一关中，夏尔和食肉者都是敌对的；你可以让他们互相残杀并清理尸体。

e947766580bcf5e48541d12a8efca6431bcd5848.source: To get the optional dungeon map, take the north-east passage. Proceed carefully to avoid aggroing too many of the Charr patrols along the way.
e947766580bcf5e48541d12a8efca6431bcd5848.text: 要获得可选的地下城地图，请走东北通道。小心前进，避​​免沿途激怒太多夏尔巡逻队。

83f2686dfa8b165604e9db7f0e86683e4dc6b337.source: On your way back to the western passage, pick up a Dwarven Powder Keg (bundle) or clear out the group of Charr near the weakened wall and then return for it. Your next goal is to acquire the dungeon key to advance to the next level. Crack the wall to your right and ignore the cracked wall in the chamber you enter. Take the right passageway that will lead to a group of Charr (led by a boss). After finishing them off, continue down the passage to meet Rragar Maneater and still more Charr. You can pull about half of them without aggroing Rragar. As you kill off the group, Rragar will take off leaving behind the key. Return back to the wall you've cracked open. Head north-west. Magma Blisters will appear in the piles of magma, which can cause Burning when stepped on. After killing the blisters, turn left (west) and go down the ramp (the first ramp is a dead end the second is a tunnel; can be easy to miss if your screen is dark.
83f2686dfa8b165604e9db7f0e86683e4dc6b337.text: 在返回西部通道的路上，拿起矮人火药桶（捆绑包）或清除弱化墙壁附近的夏尔群，然后返回。您的下一个目标是获得地牢钥匙以进入下一个级别。打破你右边的墙壁，并忽略你进入的房间里破裂的墙壁。走右边的通道，会看到一群夏尔（由老板领导）。解决掉他们后，继续沿着通道去见拉加·食人者和更多的夏尔。你可以拉出大约一半的怪物而不惹恼拉加。当你消灭这群人时，拉加会离开并留下钥匙。回到你已经裂开的墙边。向西北方向行驶。岩浆堆中会出现岩浆水泡，踩到会引起燃烧。杀死水泡后，左转（向西）并走下坡道（第一个坡道是死胡同，第二个坡道是隧道；如果屏幕很暗，很容易错过。

4419dad4581b8a8edeb333f7fbe5e9317b543bc9.source: As you enter the next chamber, Fleshreavers will pop up; an Ooze group will pop-up right at the shrine - be careful not to aggro the charr and ooze at the same time. After finishing these foes, you will notice a Keg Station near a Beacon of Droknar. Grab a keg and head north to find more Charr and Blisters. Blow up the cracked wall you find. Do not enter immediately to allow the Fleshreavers and Charr to fight; move in and finish them off. Avoid any remaining Charr on your way to Level 2.
4419dad4581b8a8edeb333f7fbe5e9317b543bc9.text: 当你进入下一个房间时，食肉者会弹出；软泥怪队伍会在神社附近突然出现——小心不要同时攻击夏尔和软泥怪。消灭这些敌人后，你会注意到卓克纳尔信标附近有一个小桶站。拿起一个小桶，向北走去寻找更多的夏尔和水泡。炸毁你发现的有裂缝的墙。不要立即进入让食肉者和夏尔战斗；进去解决掉他们。在通往 2 级的路上避开任何剩余的夏尔。

a8e5e047f3d124b775694e2832a614e721893642.source: As you enter and head left, a group of Charr will run away, unleashing two Boulders and closing a large gate. You have three options: run quickly to the right and follow them out the gate (so it does not lock you in); snare them (so that you can kill them before they exit); or allow them to lock the gate. The fight is easier using the first two options, but you end up in the same place regardless.
a8e5e047f3d124b775694e2832a614e721893642.text: 当你进入并向左走时，一群夏尔会逃跑，释放出两块巨石并关闭一扇大门。你有三个选择：快速向右跑，跟着他们走出大门（这样它就不会把你锁在里面）；诱捕他们（这样你就可以在他们离开之前杀死他们）；或允许他们锁门。使用前两个选项，战斗会更容易，但无论如何你最终都会在同一个地方。

91cefb42da0b4ed91ed42674ee10d4d81255da19.source: This hallway has several spots where there are rockslides. You will eventually encounter a sizable group of Charr. You can easily pick up the dungeon map for this level if you head into the left chamber from where you encountered the Charr group. After handling these, you will enter an area with a body of water you will have to walk through, Ooze pop-ups will occur. Turn right after handling the pop-ups and head north through the entrance. Turn left after going through this entrance. Keep heading south-west, killing a group of Fleshreavers a few Charr groups.
91cefb42da0b4ed91ed42674ee10d4d81255da19.text: 这条走廊有多处发生岩石滑坡的地方。你最终会遇到一大群夏尔。如果你从遇到夏尔小组的地方进入左边的房间，你可以轻松地拿起这个级别的地下城地图。处理完这些之后，你将进入一个有水体的区域，你必须步行穿过，软泥弹出窗口将会出现。处理完弹出窗口后右转，然后通过入口向北行驶。穿过这个入口后左转。继续向西南方向前进，杀死一群食肉者和几个夏尔小队。

2986ac1bd1779c59cccaca678eccecc430a1b867.source: It is easy to miss the boss key on this floor. You will reach a Beacon of Droknar. West of this beacon is Rragar Maneater, again, with Charr around him. You can pull the Charr without Rragar to make the battle easier. Get the Key.
2986ac1bd1779c59cccaca678eccecc430a1b867.text: 这层楼很容易错过老板钥匙。你将到达卓克纳尔信标。这座灯塔的西边又是拉加食人者，夏尔在他身边。你可以在没有拉加的情况下拉夏尔，让战斗变得更容易。拿到钥匙。

d0b7f685184f9f8897c2b17785027b23bb042b97.source: Start heading south-east to reach the entrance to the last level. You will fight through Fleshreavers, Charr, and Ooze to get there.
d0b7f685184f9f8897c2b17785027b23bb042b97.text: 开始向东南方向行驶，到达最后一层的入口。你将与​​食肉者、夏尔和软泥怪战斗才能到达那里。

d3a46991c95ee41220455ba4e6b60d8671f2f665.source: If you kill the Charr group at the beginning of the level before they close the gate on you and pick up the key they drop, then use the Dungeon Lock, the gate will close.
d3a46991c95ee41220455ba4e6b60d8671f2f665.text: 如果你在关卡开始时杀死夏尔小队，然后在他们关上你的门之前，捡起他们掉落的钥匙，然后使用地牢锁，门就会关闭。

eef7c15be0dad3add3b404747f1288f6b21a6781.source: Head to the south passage. After you kill the Fleshreavers blocking the way, head west. Charr and Fleshreavers will start appearing in hybrid groups. Head south-west when possible. You will reach a chamber with a Beacon of Droknar and another Keg Station; as you approach, the wall nearby will be blown up by an incoming Charr group. Head directly south down this now-opened passage and retrieve the boss key, after killing a sizable group of Fleshreavers with a boss type amongst them.
eef7c15be0dad3add3b404747f1288f6b21a6781.text: 前往南边的通道。杀死挡路的食肉者后，向西前进。夏尔和食肉者将开始以混合群体的形式出现。如果可能的话，向西南方向行驶。你将到达一个带有 Droknar 信标和另一个 Keg Station 的房间；当你接近时，附近的墙壁将被即将到来的夏尔小队炸毁。杀死一大群带有 Boss 类型的食肉者后，沿着这条现已打开的通道直接向南走，取回 Boss 钥匙。

6a5be893899cde151d6dbd6f4c48e50de96fd06b.source: Start heading north-west when possible now. You may fight through several Fleshreaver groups. However, if you are careful and watch the patrols, you can avoid all but one or two. Use the Boss Key to open the gate.
6a5be893899cde151d6dbd6f4c48e50de96fd06b.text: 如果可能的话，现在就开始向西北行驶。你可能会与几个食肉者组织战斗。然而，如果你小心并观察巡逻者，你可以避开除了一两个之外的所有。使用老板钥匙打开大门。

ec98c8919891b6d12094d9c85db3eece9cf4a69d.source: Most players concentrate on killing Rragar first; if Hidesplitter dies first, Rragar will resurrect him. Hidesplitter, on the other hand, goes into a rage when Rragar dies, but if you got this far, you should not have any trouble surviving anything he tries to throw at you.
ec98c8919891b6d12094d9c85db3eece9cf4a69d.text: 大多数玩家首先集中精力杀死拉加；如果劈皮者先死，拉加会复活他。另一方面，劈皮者在拉加死后会勃然大怒，但如果你已经走到这一步，无论他向你扔什么东西，你都不会有任何困难。

f498f4fc5553f3d047c7068f488ef91cd4e4d319.source: There are plenty of exploitable corpses for minion masters; however, Fleshreaver Hounds deal holy damage, Ominous Oozes have Verata's Aura, and Shimmering Oozes have Spiritual Pain.
f498f4fc5553f3d047c7068f488ef91cd4e4d319.text: 有大量可供小兵大师利用的尸体；然而，食肉猎犬会造成神圣伤害，不祥软泥怪具有维拉塔光环，微光软泥怪具有精神痛苦。

09a3652d6f65c0aee05d3ba2766355ec0f06c2ec.source: Shadow Form is a poor skill for tanking; Fleshreaver Hounds can cause substantial melee-range damage through it.
09a3652d6f65c0aee05d3ba2766355ec0f06c2ec.text: 暗影形态是一个很差的坦克技能；食肉猎犬可以通过它造成大量的近战伤害。

8ee91b7d3abf7088b5fb6656fd876bcce60e81f6.source: On the first level, Charr and Fleshreavers are hostile to each other; however, they are allied with each other on the second and third levels.
8ee91b7d3abf7088b5fb6656fd876bcce60e81f6.text: 在第一层，夏尔和食肉者彼此敌对；然而，它们在第二层和第三层上彼此结盟。

52a21d5203d077c9184405b9965beb1dc47c4626.source: The key to an easy victory is by bringing down the health of one boss to a minimum and then attack the other boss. If Rragar Maneater is killed first, then Hidesplitter will enter an aggressive stance and deals more damage. If Hidesplitter gets killed, Rragar Maneater will try to resurrect his companion using Resurrection Chant.
52a21d5203d077c9184405b9965beb1dc47c4626.text: 轻松获胜的关键是将一个 Boss 的生命值降至最低，然后攻击另一个 Boss。如果拉加食人者先被杀死，那么劈皮者就会进入攻击姿态并造成更多伤害。如果劈皮者被杀，拉加食人者会尝试使用复活圣歌来复活他的同伴。

a5cbfcaad7feaed4071c09b46b0adec3d0799c67.source: On the first level, near the door to Level 2, beware of the popup Ooze group. Try to pull the Charr away from that spot to avoid being overwhelmed.
a5cbfcaad7feaed4071c09b46b0adec3d0799c67.text: 在第一层，靠近第二层的门处，小心弹出的软泥怪组。尝试将夏尔拉离该位置，以免被淹没。

6fe31ad47a757d76f5e5d7e966694e0c06f995d1.source: On the first level, in the far southwest corner there is hidden treasure. There are also 2 other hidden treasures in the same chamber to the north. On the first level, to the southeast of the northern Dwarven Powder Keg Station there is a secret switch which opens a secret tunnel. There is a hidden treasure and a Dwarven Ghost down that secret tunnel. There are 2 hidden treasures by the exit from the first level.
6fe31ad47a757d76f5e5d7e966694e0c06f995d1.text: 在第一层的西南角，隐藏着宝藏。北面的同一个房间里还有另外 2 个隐藏的宝藏。在第一层，矮人火药桶站北部的东南部有一个秘密开关，可以打开一条秘密隧道。在那条秘密隧道里有一个隐藏的宝藏和一个矮人幽灵。第一层出口处有 2 个隐藏的宝藏。

9a85e49ca12454bb3658caac9b88e4039c515622.source: On the second level there is a Dwarven Ghost next to the Beacon near the Boss Key and there is a hidden treasure next to the Boss Key. There is a hidden chest to the northeast of the boss door.
9a85e49ca12454bb3658caac9b88e4039c515622.text: 在第二层，Boss 钥匙附近的灯塔旁边有一个矮人幽灵，Boss 钥匙旁边有一个隐藏的宝藏。 Boss 门的东北方有一个隐藏的箱子。

04c786816a92a0c17454c0913d8050d4ac533b29.source: On the third level, south of the entrance there is a secret switch for a secret chamber. In the secret chamber there are five hidden treasures and one Dwarven Ghost. In the four alcoves near where the boss key is obtained there is a hidden treasure in each alcove.
04c786816a92a0c17454c0913d8050d4ac533b29.text: 在第三层，入口南面有一个秘密房间的秘密开关。密室中有五件隐藏宝藏和一件矮人鬼魂。在获得 Boss 钥匙的附近的四个凹室中，每个凹室中都有一个隐藏的宝藏。

6892e2fb3281d9284095cc0fd928981eb6eeeb8e.source: Kill Abaddon's prophet in the Ruins of Morah.
6892e2fb3281d9284095cc0fd928981eb6eeeb8e.text: 在莫拉废墟杀死阿巴顿的先知。

fee396c54ee1b126a41bc5beba9b24fd0c6af074.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in less than 8 minutes (10 in Hard Mode).
fee396c54ee1b126a41bc5beba9b24fd0c6af074.text: *奖励* 在 8 分钟内完成任务（困难模式为 10 分钟）。

276c264d738ba4cd68f6bdb028015f9cc09dbd7d.source: As per the Ruins of Morah mission.

18a39e2a394b5c4ee3e5134d6c92a5d31a82e358.source: Assist and protect Prince Rurik as he frees Ascalonians from the Charr in the Ruins of Surmia.
18a39e2a394b5c4ee3e5134d6c92a5d31a82e358.text: 协助并保护鲁里克王子将阿斯卡隆人从苏米亚废墟的夏尔手中解救出来。

0baeefa3f4acae864b19e42776ebc4d5a4c886ac.text: *奖励* 扑灭夏尔神庙的火焰。

e8ff5ffbdfd1e671f915e7e2912b4eb5207fd554.source: Clear Sacnoth Valley in the Charr Homelands of all enemies in hard mode.
e8ff5ffbdfd1e671f915e7e2912b4eb5207fd554.text: 在困难模式下清除查尔故乡的萨克诺斯山谷中的所有敌人。

9a5102ed000018ccd35f811025f22fc0e50fa2b4.source: This is the only location where players can tame a Raven.
9a5102ed000018ccd35f811025f22fc0e50fa2b4.text: 这是玩家可以驯服乌鸦的唯一地点。

58ffa1d0762c7f735106bffbd20b100892e726e3.source: The charr stronghold is inaccessible if any party member has not completed Assault on the Stronghold. It is possible to have completed Assault on the Stronghold without having completed the other charr missions in the same mode (by alternating Normal and Hard mode), in which case the stronghold will also be inaccessible.
58ffa1d0762c7f735106bffbd20b100892e726e3.text: 如果任何队员未完成突袭夏尔要塞，则无法进入夏尔要塞。有可能在未完成相同模式下的其他夏尔任务的情况下完成对要塞的突袭（通过交替正常和困难模式），在这种情况下，要塞也将无法进入。

20903a9a99412abc60283818ea6374da15489ec1.source: If any party member has Forbidden Fruit active, the western back entrance will be open.
20903a9a99412abc60283818ea6374da15489ec1.text: 如果任何队员激活了禁果，西后门就会打开。

30f14aaa04a5440db6cd230026e4369f2f0fa848.source: If any party member has Single Ugly Grawl Seeks Same for Mindless Destruction in Ascalon active, the southern path leading into the stronghold will be accessible.
30f14aaa04a5440db6cd230026e4369f2f0fa848.text: 如果任何队伍成员在阿斯卡隆激活了“单一丑陋的穴居人寻找相同的无意识毁灭”，那么通往要塞的南部道路将是可用的。

98ff372af27b594926754bfdee1b0807b0cec423.source: Players can still enter the stronghold by exploiting Dismount Siege Devourer right at the front gate, facing away from it.
98ff372af27b594926754bfdee1b0807b0cec423.text: 玩家仍然可以通过在前门背对着大门利用下马攻城吞噬者来进入要塞。

9d2e671402a95f34f6721b3caf7cca9bae876529.source: The southeastern area is teeming with Burning Spirits and Flowstone Elementals, making it arguably the most dangerous part due to the high number of spells dealing AoE fire damage.
9d2e671402a95f34f6721b3caf7cca9bae876529.text: 东南部地区充满了燃烧之灵和流石元素，由于大量法术会造成范围火焰伤害，因此可以说是最危险的地区。

0177d66d34aee2b9a904e1fd0e6653be186236a1.source: Keep an eye out for patrolling groups of Burning Spirits, especially the one including Borrguus Blisterbark; they move quickly along a circular route and can quickly overwhelm your party.
0177d66d34aee2b9a904e1fd0e6653be186236a1.text: 留意巡逻的燃烧之灵群体，尤其是包括博尔格斯·泡树皮在内的那群；他们沿着环形路线快速移动，可以很快压倒你的队伍。

554e1fc4670dfde7e0b1cc3c2b6e89a42eeea397.source: Bring skills for party-wide damage mitigation and/or elemental resistance such as Ward Against Harm. Party-wide caster shutdown tactics, especially Daze (e.g. using Technobabble) and interrupt (e.g. using Complicate) are also advised to counter Searing Flames, Fire Storm and Savannah Heat.
554e1fc4670dfde7e0b1cc3c2b6e89a42eeea397.text: 带来全队伤害减轻和/或元素抵抗的技能，例如防御伤害。还建议全党范围内的施法者关闭策略，特别是发呆（例如使用科技语言）和打断（例如使用复杂）来对抗灼热火焰、火焰风暴和萨凡纳热气。

f7550d83bdafff5e5ae3dd0ed3039adfa081ebdc.source: A single well-placed Pain Inverter there is usually a guaranteed kill.
f7550d83bdafff5e5ae3dd0ed3039adfa081ebdc.text: 一个放置在适当位置的疼痛反转器通常可以保证杀死。

7f298f6c9cd8fdf095c12c09900d1d6e0d28263f.source: There are four bosses in the Charr stronghold (after completion of Assault on the Stronghold), which makes it worth saving until you have a Boss Bounty. Approach from the west or south, to avoid the well-defended eastern entrance (Charr Seekers stand atop the ridge, making it hard to get close without taking significant damage).
7f298f6c9cd8fdf095c12c09900d1d6e0d28263f.text: 查尔要塞中有四个 Boss（完成突袭要塞后），这使得在获得 Boss 赏金之前值得保存。从西边或南边接近，避开防守严密的东边入口（夏尔探索者站在山脊上，很难在不受到重大伤害的情况下接近）。

ecd8f358ba168399ae3b6510ae0a6b790cc016cc.source: Fozzy Yeoryios is in a group with a lot of potent healing; it can be difficult to kill them without the proper counters.
ecd8f358ba168399ae3b6510ae0a6b790cc016cc.text: Fozzy Yeoryios 属于具有强大治疗效果的一组；如果没有适当的计数器，很难杀死它们。

328a4b881da5b20f3651bce42d605ff4b326b9f1.source: For a complete Vanquish all worms in the southwest corner have to be killed.
328a4b881da5b20f3651bce42d605ff4b326b9f1.text: 为了彻底征服，必须杀死西南角的所有蠕虫。

f8ff007c24cba310871cfe0794b55902e9cab0ea.source: The flaming spirits surrounding Borrguus Blisterbark will shout phrases normally attributed to the Charr, e.g. "For the warband!". After extended periods of time, the animation of the fire in the burning forest will freeze and will not resume until you have exited and restarted the game. At certain times, the Stronghold will be closed to all players. This requires a full reset from a outpost.
f8ff007c24cba310871cfe0794b55902e9cab0ea.text: 博尔古斯水泡树周围的火灵会喊出通常归因于夏尔的短语，例如： “为了战队！”。经过很长一段时间后，燃烧的森林中的火焰动画将冻结，直到您退出并重新启动游戏后才会恢复。在某些时候，要塞将对所有玩家关闭。这需要从前哨站完全重置。

2e06c61ebb51cbeba2d1edcacb743801823efd18.source: Clear the Sage Lands in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
2e06c61ebb51cbeba2d1edcacb743801823efd18.text: 在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林中圣人之地的所有敌人。

60edadb64bbaa1e8c1c3265c836c0b5636b8c911.source: There is a resurrection shrine close to the Druid's Overlook portal, which can lead to accidental zoning.
60edadb64bbaa1e8c1c3265c836c0b5636b8c911.text: 德鲁伊俯瞰门附近有一个复活神殿，这可能会导致意外分区。

38f716e4edb2aed4ee97f4600cb443692bc296ae.source: Wind Riders chain Cry of Frustration interrupting initial skill usage efficiently. Use the Fount Of Maguuma environmental effect to gain an advantage.
38f716e4edb2aed4ee97f4600cb443692bc296ae.text: 风行者连锁挫败之呼有效地中断了初始技能的使用。使用迈古玛喷泉环境效果来获得优势。

bc80f5ba4f2dbaca74b58478080142d6df2f9c18.source: There's a large number of hidden foes, more than the visible ones.
bc80f5ba4f2dbaca74b58478080142d6df2f9c18.text: 隐藏的敌人比可见的敌人还要多。

124358192e0540db782fb5fc335e4906293b37be.source: Devourers hide by the dry paths, especially in the south.
124358192e0540db782fb5fc335e4906293b37be.text: 吞噬者躲在干燥的小路上，尤其是在南方。

c6cea24d019bea9fc7c82b3f3bef7fc79c855a68.source: Maguuma Spiders spawn near the bamboo-like growths.
c6cea24d019bea9fc7c82b3f3bef7fc79c855a68.text: 迈古玛蜘蛛在竹子状生长物附近产卵。

a6a25da5f9fd06efaa388582fdf1a142f10bc322.source: Moss Scarabs sometimes spawn with spiders but mostly along verdant paths, especially in the north. They use Verata's Gaze to steal minions and Vampiric Touch can be deadly if too many spike a single ally.
a6a25da5f9fd06efaa388582fdf1a142f10bc322.text: 苔藓圣甲虫有时会与蜘蛛一起生成，但大多沿着青翠的小路生成，尤其是在北方。他们使用维拉塔的凝视来偷走小兵，如果太多的吸血鬼之触刺伤了一个盟友，那么吸血鬼之触可能会致命。

242cc83c43633b8b11cd7465f128f3ab0dc1090a.source: Some of the popup groups may stagger their appearance, spawning some after you've already engaged the first enemies. Be aware of this and be sure to check in case any didn't aggro.
242cc83c43633b8b11cd7465f128f3ab0dc1090a.text: 一些弹出组可能会错开它们的外观，在您与第一个敌人交战后会产生一些弹出组。请注意这一点，并确保检查是否有任何问题。

8f1767b822fd24396ee408258b83c854510187b1.source: Clear the Salt Flats in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
8f1767b822fd24396ee408258b83c854510187b1.text: 在困难模式下清除水晶沙漠盐滩中的所有敌人。

f67df1ee193bc7a8a0ded98d36e2fb0712922f9a.source: There are a lot of hidden foes littering the entire area, with hidden scarabs concentrated in the north, and hidden devourers in the south. (Occasionally foes will spawn on the southern path to Skyward Reach, forcing you to trigger the southern popups.)
f67df1ee193bc7a8a0ded98d36e2fb0712922f9a.text: 整个区域散布着大量隐藏的敌人，隐藏的圣甲虫集中在北部，隐藏的吞噬者集中在南部。 （偶尔会有敌人出现在通往 Skyward Reach 的南部路径上，迫使你触发南部的弹出窗口。）

ef00817aeda6174706c5a1a956ddae88a8b64ddc.source: It is sometimes possible to vanquish this area without killing all of the non-popup scarabs and devourers along the path to/from Skyward Reach.
ef00817aeda6174706c5a1a956ddae88a8b64ddc.text: 有时可以在不杀死往返 Skyward Reach 的道路上所有非弹出圣甲虫和吞噬者的情况下征服该区域。

8b51a225ac42c34ce52a86980a566961e6402010.source: Many of the foes in this area, particularly the Storm Kin and Hydra, travel quickly along long routes, making them easy to miss. Placing numerous spirits will help to slow or kill many of these patrolling foes.
8b51a225ac42c34ce52a86980a566961e6402010.text: 该地区的许多敌人，尤其是风暴近亲和九头蛇，都沿着漫长的路线快速行进，因此很容易被错过。放置大量的灵魂将有助于减缓或杀死许多巡逻的敌人。

0744856d48a2e6fd265c16b248f43ca766c7bb4a.source: The northernmost Teleporter set is useless, due to you being able to walk on a narrow path up or down the cliff next to the left teleporter.
0744856d48a2e6fd265c16b248f43ca766c7bb4a.text: 最北端的传送装置毫无用处，因为你可以在左边传送装置旁边的悬崖上走上或走下一条狭窄的小路。

c32b0a7273e96b286c187c27c63cde12f6079e5d.source: Safely deliver the Scepter of Orr to Vizier Khilbron.
c32b0a7273e96b286c187c27c63cde12f6079e5d.text: 将奥尔权杖安全地交给维齐尔基尔布朗。

e3fc3a2c72fcd44b50cdb8989e959de7456d0d64.source: As per the Sanctum Cay mission.

f1a134c88cc852ee3c157031a3371f5282ba668e.source: Clear Saoshang Trail on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
f1a134c88cc852ee3c157031a3371f5282ba668e.text: 在困难模式下清除盛杰岛扫上小道上的所有敌人。

4ac336c914d4112bd073c6203cb014caefb286b2.source: Factions characters will be directed to take this trail to Seitung Harbor as part of the primary quest the Road Less Traveled.
4ac336c914d4112bd073c6203cb014caefb286b2.text: 作为主线任务“少有人走的路”的一部分，派系角色将被引导沿着这条小路前往塞通港。

78f0440c707cde124042247002978726d47c754a.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 0.5% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
78f0440c707cde124042247002978726d47c754a.text: 对该区域的完整探索将为 Canthan Cartographer 主打歌带来约 0.5% 的收益。

347feccc73c2a9e87e7d7a8a32064a22d056cfe5.source: You can have six in your party if you enter from Seitung Harbor.
347feccc73c2a9e87e7d7a8a32064a22d056cfe5.text: 如果您从 Seitung 港进入，您的队伍中可以有六人。

3a6b4920dbd03e11f826ca3e8a4be21b4f893518.source: You can avoid up to 3 popup groups of three each:
3a6b4920dbd03e11f826ca3e8a4be21b4f893518.text: 您最多可以避免 3 个弹出窗口组，每个组三个：

6d39ab7a970904ecb6fc30679f3a5346f358ac58.source: Skip two groups by pulling the Mantid Monitor Hatchling near Seitung Harbor, if you start from Shing Jea Monastery.
6d39ab7a970904ecb6fc30679f3a5346f358ac58.text: 如果您从 Shing Jea 寺出发，可以在 Seitung 港附近拉起螳螂巨蜥幼体，跳过两组。

be8d926a8aa331e49fc5be8fdf1c3c97bd9d19ac.source: Avoid the third group by staying on the path.
be8d926a8aa331e49fc5be8fdf1c3c97bd9d19ac.text: 留在路上以避免第三组。

ee0875f8bfb63511e913ffad435799d4be169c8e.source: The remaining popups can be deadly: avoid area of effect spike cold damage by spreading out (or bring Elemental Resistance/Mantra of Frost) and consider bringing enchantment removal skills for Shield of Regeneration cast by the monk mantids.
ee0875f8bfb63511e913ffad435799d4be169c8e.text: 剩下的弹出窗口可能是致命的：通过分散（或带来元素抗性/冰霜咒语）来避免效果范围尖峰寒冷伤害，并考虑为僧侣螳螂施放的再生之盾带来结界去除技能。

ff2f3255fea298b0a35b5bde729fb02b2f4998d9.source: Skills that remove conditions or hexes are unnecessary, since none of the foes can inflict conditions and the only hex your party will encounter is Parasitic Bond.
ff2f3255fea298b0a35b5bde729fb02b2f4998d9.text: 消除条件或妖术的技能是不必要的，因为没有任何敌人可以造成条件，并且你的队伍将遇到的唯一妖术是寄生债券。

1681e5299e0e6150277e5400bb707078ee916405.source: Shing Jea Chests/Locked Chests never spawn here.
1681e5299e0e6150277e5400bb707078ee916405.text: Shing Jea 宝箱/锁定宝箱永远不会在这里生成。

d4f82cadc4bdf78d8ad7a0ae884d8dde524a0883.source: Go to the ruins in Old Ascalon. Clear out any scavengers.
d4f82cadc4bdf78d8ad7a0ae884d8dde524a0883.text: 前往旧阿斯卡隆的废墟。清除所有拾荒者。

d73cf99f04bf46e4b5328e2c8eb39f970728785b.source: Return to Warmaster Tydus for your reward,
d73cf99f04bf46e4b5328e2c8eb39f970728785b.text: 返回战帅泰杜斯那里领取奖励，

f8a2fe46de1cf17af918239deae4900e22e8c172.text: 切割伤害：6-16（需要精通 3 个斧头）

10b6cb2420361d656c14ff7f7b1fc42f1e374238.text: +15% 伤害（相对于夏尔）固有模组

30d10690825b574f3137dd31bd7d519fc564477f.source: Walk out of Sardelac Sanitarium and take the way at your right. Talk to Thaddiel and click the following answers to fulfil the quest:
30d10690825b574f3137dd31bd7d519fc564477f.text: 走出沙德拉疗养院，走右边的路。与萨迪尔交谈并点击以下答案来完成任务：

96a24225dd2e5f85196058a37748f4559cc2b8f9.source: "I have order to clear the area of scavengers."
96a24225dd2e5f85196058a37748f4559cc2b8f9.text: “我奉命清除该地区的拾荒者。”

91e2da934bbe1833d254e94a9b4990838c213240.source: The quest will be updated and you can map to Ascalon City for the reward.
91e2da934bbe1833d254e94a9b4990838c213240.text: 任务将更新，您可以映射到阿斯卡隆城以获得奖励。

8352640de97df92d3e410ce10a8e6871ad497556.source: Originally, the Battle Axe (hatchet) that is given as reward in this mission, had different upgrades, allowing to put two grips at the same time. Doing this, for example, combinations of two Axe Grips of Enchanting were possible, providing a permanent +40% longevity in enchantments. This was modified in the December 20, 2005 game update and all the axes inside the game were forcibly changed to the current one (including the ones inside the inventory backpack).
8352640de97df92d3e410ce10a8e6871ad497556.text: 最初，在这个任务中作为奖励给出的战斧（斧头）有不同的升级，允许同时放置两个握把。例如，这样做可以组合两个附魔斧握，提供永久+40%的附魔寿命。这在2005年12月20日的游戏更新中进行了修改，游戏内的所有轴都被强制更改为当前的轴（包括库存背包内的轴）。

79b5e7eb86ea65e5c82df1498f051cdcadd6c4e2.source: Meet Zerai the Learner on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
79b5e7eb86ea65e5c82df1498f051cdcadd6c4e2.text: 在多赫约克悬崖上与学习者泽莱见面。

c5fd5f2f6354f9d149d4ba957843255bc90b352e.source: Collect 12 Iboga blossoms by slaying Beautiful Iboga. You have collected [0...12] of 12 Iboga blossoms.
c5fd5f2f6354f9d149d4ba957843255bc90b352e.text: 杀死美丽的伊博加，收集 12 朵伊博加花。您已收集了 [0...12] 朵伊博加花，共 12 朵。

7c531d1e99708bf9083074bfe98dca6d6c65bc06.source: Escort Zerai the Learner to Jokanur Diggings.
7c531d1e99708bf9083074bfe98dca6d6c65bc06.text: 护送学习者泽莱前往乔卡努矿坑。

c4a3853fd610ed4a6464d071e58738c4c9b40f4f.text: 前往 Midauha 领取奖励。

22e2f93e5b298351fb32da82e566e5d7a56acf0f.source: After entering the area go to Zerai and talk to him, he will now start following you. You don't have to worry much about him since he will not be attacked. Now follow the road westwards. you will find the Beautiful Iboga along the path.
22e2f93e5b298351fb32da82e566e5d7a56acf0f.text: 进入该区域后，去找泽莱并与他交谈，他现在将开始跟随你。你不必太担心他，因为他不会受到攻击。现在沿着路向西走。沿着小路你会发现美丽的伊博加。

df96e1598629e7cd803075d7688c370806c2e944.source: The Beautiful Iboga are level 10 and are in groups of 3 each. Make sure you can kill them fast since they are of the Mesmer profession. More healing does not work too well against Mesmers, faster killing is most of the time the key in beating them. A skill to remove Hexes is a good thing to have in your skillbar while doing this quest.
df96e1598629e7cd803075d7688c370806c2e944.text: 美丽的伊博加 (Beautiful Iboga) 等级为 10，每组 3 只。确保你能快速杀死他们，因为他们是催眠师职业。更多的治疗效果并不能很好地对抗幻术师，更快的杀戮大多数时候是击败他们的关键。在执行此任务时，技能栏中拥有移除六角形的技能是一件好事。

b25e62d29b0327b0b858cfc1a0664d361ed9a697.source: Make sure to take the most Northern path westwards.
b25e62d29b0327b0b858cfc1a0664d361ed9a697.text: 确保走最北的路径向西。

bee92a538bd08f2f3c0ebbf389ac159cb385a566.source: If Zerai gets stuck along the way, just go back and move around him for a bit he will get unstuck again and follow once more. When you arrive at the portal of Jokanur Diggings, make sure to wait for the Quest log to update before going through the portal (the game is prone to not registering this part, make sure you res any dead party members before walking up to the gate of the diggings!). Last but not least, collect your reward from Midauha.
bee92a538bd08f2f3c0ebbf389ac159cb385a566.text: 如果泽莱一路上被卡住了，只要回去绕着他走一会儿，他就会再次摆脱卡住并再次跟随。当你到达Jokanur Diggings的门户时，请务必等待任务日志更新后再通过门户（游戏很容易没有注册这部分，请确保在走到矿区门口之前找到任何死去的队友！）。最后但并非最不重要的一点是，从 Midauha 领取奖励。

ca781fb22a5ee15b86680e473a33d32d79ffd74e.source: If you get to the entrance to Jokanur Diggings and you don't have all 12 blossoms, you can still take Zerai there and then enter Jokanur Diggings. The quest will update that you have escorted him. Now all you need are the other blossoms and you can simply re-enter the Cliffs of Dohjok, find enough blossoms, then map to Jokanur Diggings for the reward.
ca781fb22a5ee15b86680e473a33d32d79ffd74e.text: 如果你到达了乔卡努尔矿区的入口，并且你没有拥有全部 12 朵花，你仍然可以带泽莱到那里，然后进入乔卡努尔矿区。该任务将更新您已护送他。现在你所需要的只是其他花朵，你可以简单地重新进入多赫约克悬崖，找到足够的花朵，然后映射到乔卡努尔挖掘场以获得奖励。

21ce210f803416d25026b7ce19372c3ee796a3ce.source: You can easily complete this quest while working on Leaving a Legacy and Identity Theft in the Cliffs of Dohjok.
21ce210f803416d25026b7ce19372c3ee796a3ce.text: 你可以在处理“在多赫乔克悬崖中留下遗产”和“身份盗窃”时轻松完成此任务。

c138b742424930ee9c4f90a707d51d3030d7e2ce.source: If you keep the quest active, the 4 groups of Beautiful Iboga can be farmed for Iboga Petals and Sentient Seeds. At low levels, they can also be farmed for experience with the Fire Imp and Dunkoro as an ally from the quest Leaving a Legacy.
c138b742424930ee9c4f90a707d51d3030d7e2ce.text: 如果你保持任务活跃，可以种植 4 组美丽的伊博加以获得伊博加花瓣和有情种子。在低等级时，还可以通过培养它们来获得与火焰小鬼和邓科洛一起作为任务“留下遗产”的盟友的经验。

4da339fb1c848ea4041dfe8ec0527e4ef3618aec.source: If Zerai the Learner is left too far behind, it will cause him to stop moving. The only way to make him follow you again is to get within range of where he stopped.
4da339fb1c848ea4041dfe8ec0527e4ef3618aec.text: 如果学习者泽莱落后得太远，就会导致他停止移动。让他再次跟随你的唯一方法就是进入他停下的地方的范围内。

8e262a4c0a458bb22acc47a9afd5115e495fb68b.source: Speak with Diji and find out what is happening in Vehtendi Valley.
8e262a4c0a458bb22acc47a9afd5115e495fb68b.text: 与 Diji 交谈，了解 Vehtendi 山谷中发生的事情。

880b83dfa5ed4b78a88d851507b428414e113cc4.source: Investigate the area around the disturbance and eliminate any hostiles.
880b83dfa5ed4b78a88d851507b428414e113cc4.text: 调查骚乱周围的区域并消灭任何敌对分子。

b8318db51805762d7bc9e6cab1d20e9c3fbffe76.source: Tell Diji the hostile creatures have been destroyed.
b8318db51805762d7bc9e6cab1d20e9c3fbffe76.text: 告诉迪吉敌对生物已被消灭。

15cef32a92fcd7f01a4210ce0969d031442aea96.source: Start from Yahnur Market and follow the quest pointer to meet Diji standing nearby. After receiving Diji's confused report, investigate the nearby rift and eliminate the margonites around it. Be aware that the usual mobs for the area will also be present, so try not to aggro too much at once. Afterwards, return to Diji and speak with him before leaving the valley, otherwise the quest will not be completed.
15cef32a92fcd7f01a4210ce0969d031442aea96.text: 从亚努尔市场出发，按照任务指针与站在附近的迪吉见面。收到迪吉的混乱报告后，调查附近的裂缝并消灭周围的玛龙石。请注意，该地区常见的小怪也会出现，所以尽量不要一次聚集太多。之后，返回迪吉并在离开山谷前与他交谈，否则任务将无法完成。

9f3c433bccbff88729fbd6159eb0b5b0009c50e8.source: Return to Elementalist Aziure for your reward.
9f3c433bccbff88729fbd6159eb0b5b0009c50e8.text: 返回元素师阿兹乌尔那里领取奖励。

dfca5dd60a7e234ec4535854470131e03bef8b87.source: After accepting this quest, simply wander around Old Ascalon and you will find plenty of Hulking Stone Elementals to kill to complete this quest. They are particularly concentrated in areas to the west of Elementalist Aziure.
dfca5dd60a7e234ec4535854470131e03bef8b87.text: 接受这个任务后，只需在旧阿斯卡隆周围闲逛，你就会发现大量巨大的石元素需要杀死来完成这个任务。他们特别集中在元素师阿兹乌尔以西的地区。

35d5e2d70663926b41475fc1b608a39720a93e6d.source: The counter will increase if other creatures, such as patrolling grawl, kill elementals.
35d5e2d70663926b41475fc1b608a39720a93e6d.text: 如果其他生物（例如巡逻穴居人）杀死元素生物，计数器将会增加。

9175811cc0b5ad40b43a92ce652126196ee329fa.source: Other types of stone elemental, including bosses such as Flint Touchstone and Cobble Poundstone, do not increase the counter.
9175811cc0b5ad40b43a92ce652126196ee329fa.text: 其他类型的石元素，包括燧石试金石和鹅卵石磅石等 Boss，不会增加计数器。

3f7821cdf733ddb3d3262489687bbe39006d5fa8.source: Plenty of Hulking Stone Elementals can be found along the way to Shalev the Hermit's cave while completing Elemental Knowledge.
3f7821cdf733ddb3d3262489687bbe39006d5fa8.text: 在完成元素知识的同时，前往隐士沙莱夫洞穴的途中可以找到大量巨大的石元素。

03ae4e7aa3eedb293cb8b19f33b36c75566ae1ab.source: The counter for x/5 Hulking Stone Elementals sometimes goes up even if you kill foes that aren't Hulking Stone Elementals.
03ae4e7aa3eedb293cb8b19f33b36c75566ae1ab.text: 即使您杀死非巨石元素的敌人，x/5 巨石元素的计数器有时也会上升。

ca3b40090fca076058fbf7e4a9a5d9a51aaf51c9.source: Clear Scoundrel's Rise in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
ca3b40090fca076058fbf7e4a9a5d9a51aaf51c9.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔恶棍崛起中的所有敌人。

752641909f12dcc9e235c939bb3e17e923a4662c.source: Characters must pass through this area to complete the primary quest, To Kryta: Journey's End. It is the first explorable area in Kryta that Tyrian-born characters can reach.
752641909f12dcc9e235c939bb3e17e923a4662c.text: 角色必须穿过这个区域才能完成主要任务“前往科瑞塔：旅程的终点”。这是泰瑞亚出生的角色可以到达的科瑞塔第一个可探索区域。

055ec3c043b9c4bfc8a8a22c72ab9b59f3806037.source: To Kryta: Journey's End — many Mergoyles and Skales are replaced by Skeleton Mesmers and Zombie Warlocks with Grasping Ghoul popups
055ec3c043b9c4bfc8a8a22c72ab9b59f3806037.text: 前往科瑞塔：旅程的终点 — 许多 Mergoyles 和 Skale 被骷髅催眠师和僵尸术士取代，并带有抓取食尸鬼弹出窗口

b5ba67e58ea695ca4473d339da1a7170127a8803.source: Without active quests, your party will only encounter Gargoyles and Skales:
b5ba67e58ea695ca4473d339da1a7170127a8803.text: 如果没有主动任务，你的队伍只会遇到石像鬼和斯卡莱斯：

6d87ebe3fff51e36eae2e47fe5b242632131e8d9.source: None of them can inflict conditions on your party, so condition removal skills are unnecessary.
6d87ebe3fff51e36eae2e47fe5b242632131e8d9.text: 它们都不会对你的队伍造成条件，因此条件消除技能是不必要的。

35a79a6fd25c197f94e37910b0dfd8c2b6e99cc8.source: They do not rely on attacks to deal damage, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
35a79a6fd25c197f94e37910b0dfd8c2b6e99cc8.text: 它们不依赖攻击来造成伤害，因此格挡、失手或造成失明状态的技能在这里效果较差。

e1bb7892dc37881a7b089e7182c4531d2babd7a5.source: Each of them use at least two hexes, so consider bringing additional hex removal skills.
e1bb7892dc37881a7b089e7182c4531d2babd7a5.text: 他们每个人都至少使用两个六角形，因此请考虑携带额外的六角形去除技能。

b4e4ac3789cd5eb9da01282c5f004176a1cc2c7a.source: They have additional armor rating against cold damage and Mergoyles use Mantra of Lightning, so consider not bringing skills nor equip weapons that deal cold nor lightning damage.
b4e4ac3789cd5eb9da01282c5f004176a1cc2c7a.text: 他们有额外的防御寒冷伤害的护甲等级，并且默戈伊尔斯使用闪电咒语，所以考虑不要携带技能或装备造成寒冷或闪电伤害的武器。

d9a0497f05d2ca622f099b2f6dc1e28a7354e5d5.source: They are all spellcasters, so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit them (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Bog Skale Blighters use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
d9a0497f05d2ca622f099b2f6dc1e28a7354e5d5.text: 他们都是施法者，因此请考虑携带反施法者技能和/或各种游侠自然仪式，这些仪式可以使你的队伍受益，但不能使他们受益（例如顺风、真热、毒性，因为沼泽斯卡莱枯萎者使用冻疮和风选）。

2409d8a8e7266badd6cb7127cb351aaa5ed5b8d2.source: Go to the first checkpoint and search for Kurzicks in the vicinity. Kill any Kurzick invaders you find.
2409d8a8e7266badd6cb7127cb351aaa5ed5b8d2.text: 前往第一个检查站并在附近搜索库兹克。杀死你发现的所有库兹克入侵者。

f9133535785c43ddb229075a7cfa40e3418920aa.source: Go to the second checkpoint and search for Kurzicks in the vicinity. Kill any Kurzick invaders you find.
f9133535785c43ddb229075a7cfa40e3418920aa.text: 前往第二个检查站并在附近搜索库兹克。杀死你发现的所有库兹克入侵者。

5ec38b576b03d02deec288aed63b8db40ae35976.source: Go to the third checkpoint and search for Kurzicks in the vicinity. Kill any Kurzick invaders you find.
5ec38b576b03d02deec288aed63b8db40ae35976.text: 前往第三个检查站并在附近搜索库兹克。杀死你发现的所有库兹克入侵者。

91a17bc1041ff85bd684173727ab2ee22106af82.source: Go to the fourth checkpoint and search for Kurzicks in the vicinity. Kill any Kurzick invaders you find.
91a17bc1041ff85bd684173727ab2ee22106af82.text: 前往第四个检查站并在附近搜索库兹克。杀死你发现的所有库兹克入侵者。

a57b5ee8f005be8f369ee7447cd5e25900ab66c0.source: See Scoutmaster Aerios for your reward.
a57b5ee8f005be8f369ee7447cd5e25900ab66c0.text: 向童子军领队艾里奥斯寻求奖励。

4db5df70e765b76a888aa0ae6aa0a1e0395140fa.source: Obtain the quest from Scoutmaster Aerios standing just outside Breaker Hollow. Follow the path on the mission map to points 1 through 4. At each point a group of Kurzicks will appear. They often appear around your party so as soon as this happens, take several steps back so that you are not surrounded. Defeat them and move on to the next destination. Along the way, you will encounter a couple groups of Oni. Continue until you clear out all four locations. Return to Scoutmaster Aerios for your reward.
4db5df70e765b76a888aa0ae6aa0a1e0395140fa.text: 从站在破坏者山谷外的侦察队长艾利奥斯那里获得任务。沿着任务地图上的路径到达点 1 到 4。在每个点都会出现一群库兹克人。他们经常出现在你的队伍周围，所以一旦发生这种情况，请后退几步，以免被包围。击败他们并前往下一个目的地。一路上，你会遇到几群鬼。继续，直到清除所有四个位置。返回侦察兵队长艾利奥斯那里领取奖励。

29fa800905094a9ae121b2207d93d86331dc00db.source: See the Notes below for combining this quest with Return of the Yeti.
29fa800905094a9ae121b2207d93d86331dc00db.text: 请参阅下面的注释，了解将此任务与雪人回归结合起来。

ea0dcec44995e831ada7bf4f08951f6b018aa311.source: Kurzick equivalent is Securing Echovald Forest
ea0dcec44995e831ada7bf4f08951f6b018aa311.text: Kurzick 的等效项是保护 Echovald 森林

5b7f70bdd2b7c58b2c0c20677b9e1b13ef5e20db.source: This quest is a repeatable quest
5b7f70bdd2b7c58b2c0c20677b9e1b13ef5e20db.text: 该任务是一个可重复的任务

300699bedf70a9411bef3d84affd311923a46f1c.source: This quest was used often for FFF prior to the November 13th 2008 update
300699bedf70a9411bef3d84affd311923a46f1c.text: 在 2008 年 11 月 13 日更新之前，此任务经常用于 FFF

cb6e9bf5d5effa14bb12156942196f6f9333ce29.source: If you leave the area before collecting your reward, you will have to restart the quest from the beginning. After scouting, you must return to Scoutmaster Aerios on foot to complete the quest
cb6e9bf5d5effa14bb12156942196f6f9333ce29.text: 如果您在领取奖励之前离开该区域，则必须从头开始任务。侦察结束后，你必须步行回到侦察兵队长艾利奥斯那里才能完成任务

4c941455338ee4c7bb3c9a511987532bb315b3a8.source: This quest can be easily combined with Return of the Yeti. As you approach point 1 on the mission map, you will pass by Magistrate Kin. Speak to him to obtain the Return of the Yeti quest. Make Scout the Coast your current quest and continue with the quest by going to point 2 and then to point 3. At point 3, in addition to the group of Kurzicks, you will also find several groups of Yeti. Arrahhsh Mountainclub is among one of the groups. Defeat him and you can pick up the Golden Lantern to complete Return of the Yeti. You can then either go back to Magistrate Kin immediately for your reward or finish Scout the Coast and then go back to Magistrate Kin later.
4c941455338ee4c7bb3c9a511987532bb315b3a8.text: 这个任务可以很容易地与雪人归来结合起来。当您接近任务地图上的点 1 时，您将经过法官 Kin。与他交谈以获得雪人归来任务。将“侦察海岸”作为当前任务，然后前往第 2 点，然后前往第 3 点继续该任务。在第 3 点，除了库兹克群之外，您还会发现几群雪人。 Arrahhsh Mountainclub 就是其中之一。击败他，你就可以拿起金灯笼来完成雪人归来。然后，您可以立即返回金裁判官那里领取奖励，或者完成海岸侦察，然后稍后再返回金裁判官处。

2b2d5d3fccda6380e4676f840791c2cabc01b9d4.source: A Locked Chest usually spawns with one of the mobs.
2b2d5d3fccda6380e4676f840791c2cabc01b9d4.text: 上锁的箱子通常会与其中一个小怪一起生成。

6d9d0d63522dd1079e6025ccbd79d832241e9004.source: Search Ferndale for Luxon scout]] groups and destroy them. [4...0] Luxon scout groups remaining.
6d9d0d63522dd1079e6025ccbd79d832241e9004.text: 搜索芬代尔寻找卢克森侦察兵]]小组并消灭他们。 [4...0] 剩余的卢克森侦察小组。

594f3058ce948b869fe476a54cf8dd4b3c74efdf.source: See Forestmaster Vasha for your reward.
594f3058ce948b869fe476a54cf8dd4b3c74efdf.text: 去找森林管理员瓦莎领取奖励。

5ce644a18574c7f4da48746d1ac1e95aad7fe01a.source: You must return to Forestermaster Vasha without exiting the map; leaving Ferndale resets the quest even when marked as completed.
5ce644a18574c7f4da48746d1ac1e95aad7fe01a.text: 你必须在不退出地图的情况下返回森林大师瓦莎；即使标记为已完成，离开芬代尔也会重置任务。

924c554d42d9b83fe283c3d878888ab2ff8a8a18.source: This quest works well with the other Ferndale repeatable quest Kurzick Supply Lines. The beginning of that quest is not far from the last group for this one, and the rewards are next to each other just outside Lutgardis Conservatory. Therefore start from Lutgardis, do this quest and finish with Kurzick Supply Lines.
924c554d42d9b83fe283c3d878888ab2ff8a8a18.text: 该任务与其他芬代尔可重复任务库尔齐克补给线配合得很好。该任务的起点距离本次任务的最后一组不远，奖励就在卢特加迪斯音乐学院外，彼此相邻。因此，从卢特加迪斯开始，完成这个任务并以库尔齐克补给线结束。

e65ada253057e01c88304ad159d26d261bb5df55.source: Search Maishang Hills for Kurzick scout groups and destroy them. 4...0 Kurzick scout groups remaining.
e65ada253057e01c88304ad159d26d261bb5df55.text: 在麦尚山搜寻库兹克侦察团并消灭他们。剩余 4...0 库尔齐克侦察小组。

4a0ae8b151236e57f4fca43e717e73cc558966b2.source: See Scoutmaster Theron for your reward.
4a0ae8b151236e57f4fca43e717e73cc558966b2.text: 去找童子军队长塞隆领取奖励。

3b5ee61826d4f6b16e2d6e75712374782c2201f8.source: Obtain the quest from Scoutmaster Theron just outside of Eredon Terrace. You will need to defeat four Kurzick scout groups. There are seven possible locations where these groups will appear (marked with an "X" on the quest map). Follow the quest marker to each location in the Maishang Hills. A Kurzick Scout and a random group of Kurzicks will spawn at each location. Only killing the Kurzick Scout is necessary to update the quest log, so pulling and killing the Kurzick Scout and not killing the rest of the group can save time.
3b5ee61826d4f6b16e2d6e75712374782c2201f8.text: 从埃瑞顿台外的童子军队长塞隆那里获得任务。您需要击败四个库尔兹克侦察小组。这些团体可能会出现在七个位置（在任务地图上用“X”标记）。跟随任务标记到达麦尚丘陵的每个位置。每个地点都会生成一个库兹克侦察兵和一组随机的库兹克人。只需杀死库兹克侦察兵即可更新任务日志，因此拉动并杀死库兹克侦察兵而不杀死队伍的其他成员可以节省时间。

fa447627ec6abd7d71e0d48afc9ae7db881ea787.source: After defeating the Kurzicks at each of the four locations, return to Scoutmaster Theron to collect your reward. Remember that you should not map travel to Eredon Terrace before collecting your reward, since leaving Maishang Hills area will automatically abandon this quest.
fa447627ec6abd7d71e0d48afc9ae7db881ea787.text: 在四个地点击败库兹克人后，返回童子军队长塞隆处领取奖励。请记住，在领取奖励之前，您不应该将旅行映射到埃瑞顿台，因为离开麦尚丘陵区域将自动放弃此任务。

6222cb6fbf4b722e4b4eff90354cb10ec41c3c92.source: This is a repeatable quest but note that the specific locations you need to visit may differ each time you perform the quest.
6222cb6fbf4b722e4b4eff90354cb10ec41c3c92.text: 这是一个可重复的任务，但请注意，每次执行任务时您需要访问的具体位置可能会有所不同。

66bfc0b6b6a0f1cca6c1a985b102241f108d06b4.source: Help Hixx and his troops secure the Arachni's Haunt.
66bfc0b6b6a0f1cca6c1a985b102241f108d06b4.text: 帮助希克斯和他的部队保卫阿拉克尼鬼屋。

5d7dfb6e79858513347eded54d8ea87117e6a861.text: 消灭 3 个蜘蛛女族长。

17f67afb604ea871c1d6da97a442bb93236b2bf3.source: Use the Asura flame staff to burn through the web gates.
17f67afb604ea871c1d6da97a442bb93236b2bf3.text: 使用阿修罗火焰法杖烧穿网门。

83ac126f5ad453bbf8dfdc4b5a9b83eb5c26966c.source: Use the Asura flame staff to set ablaze the egg sacs.
83ac126f5ad453bbf8dfdc4b5a9b83eb5c26966c.text: 使用阿修罗火焰杖点燃卵囊。

f6064021a66ec9750ca9dd54755145e850ab1d18.source: Speak with Misela Wahmeh to learn if she is worthy of her father's inheritance.
f6064021a66ec9750ca9dd54755145e850ab1d18.text: 与米塞拉·瓦梅交谈，了解她是否值得继承她父亲的遗产。

4a3ef1f8931424cffe15ae9e7d2d498f11aa2fdf.source: Escort Misela Wahme while she gathers Mosu Reeds to make a cure for the swamp fever.
4a3ef1f8931424cffe15ae9e7d2d498f11aa2fdf.text: 护送米塞拉·瓦姆收集摩苏芦苇来治疗沼泽热病。

9e4fc63cf15c5b3ad0fafa7acc1e6041e283987f.source: Talk to Misela and then follow the compass point to find the mosu reeds. Kill the skale that are there and walk past the mosu reeds to get Misela to find them.
9e4fc63cf15c5b3ad0fafa7acc1e6041e283987f.text: 与米塞拉交谈，然后按照罗盘指向找到摩苏芦苇。杀死那里的斯凯尔，然后走过摩苏芦苇丛，让米塞拉找到他们。

cbf2f2f659bbfc69cf10394abb89676de7ec0dce.source: To get to the Secret Lair of the Snowmen, get the quest Lost Treasure of King Hundar from Koris Deeprunner in Umbral Grotto. You must have already given him all of the map pieces first. Subsequent runs do not need additional map pieces.
cbf2f2f659bbfc69cf10394abb89676de7ec0dce.text: 要前往雪人的秘密巢穴，请从暗影石窟的科里斯·深行者那里接取亨达尔国王失落的宝藏任务。你肯定已经先把所有的地图碎片都交给他了。后续运行不需要额外的地图片段。

a110be2ca875f9f97451afb7c8887bf5feee61ae.source: You do not gain experience for defeating the 165-180 foes in this dungeon; however you can gain reputation points if you take the bounty from the Beacon of Droknar when you enter. This typically results in earning approximately 1,500 points per run (2,000 in hard mode).
a110be2ca875f9f97451afb7c8887bf5feee61ae.text: 在这个地下城中击败 165-180 名敌人并不会获得经验；但是，如果您在进入时从卓克纳尔信标处获得赏金，您就可以获得声望点。这通常会导致每次运行获得大约 1,500 点（困难模式下为 2,000 点）。

7fcf5c17cda391a94746addaa633886efbd93680.source: These snowmen have no apparent weakness to fire or resistance to cold. All but the Angry Snowman are fleshy.
7fcf5c17cda391a94746addaa633886efbd93680.text: 这些雪人对火和寒冷没有明显的弱点。除了愤怒的雪人之外，其他雪人都是肉质的。

631efd0e74024b310dc00ed4928d4dea2232842c.source: Killing the Angry Snowman disables the 4 ice dart towers and the ice geysers in front of his spawn.
631efd0e74024b310dc00ed4928d4dea2232842c.text: 杀死愤怒的雪人会禁用他出生点前面的 4 个冰镖塔和冰间歇泉。

e9918d884d2d680b662723e9771d1d024cc0c978.source: The snowmen in this dungeon deal cold damage with their normal attacks.
e9918d884d2d680b662723e9771d1d024cc0c978.text: 这个地牢中的雪人的普通攻击会造成寒冷伤害。

f7f9b6e376611e8e0bbd4cf1ed8c849e07dbad1a.source: Consider bringing Shield of Absorption on a monk, as the damage can not be mitigated by block or Protective Spirit as you will most likely not take enough damage in a single shot for it to matter.
f7f9b6e376611e8e0bbd4cf1ed8c849e07dbad1a.text: 考虑对僧侣使用吸收之盾，因为伤害无法通过格挡或防护精神来减轻，因为你很可能在一次射击中无法承受足够的伤害，因此它很重要。

9292365bb373d6b9dfa3414f2a12cd39ac41e266.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #17 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
9292365bb373d6b9dfa3414f2a12cd39ac41e266.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书第 17 页。

595d159da2ecd78022aaad38d7df5bb7427af572.source: If Koris Deeprunner dies at Freezie and does not self-resurrect, the dungeon chest might not spawn. Similarly, if he gets stuck (e.g. on a bridge or locked chest), he will not reach the final room and you will not be able to complete the dungeon. If that happens, flag any heroes or henchmen out of the way and then maneuver around the NPC to guide him around the obstruction and back to the final room.
595d159da2ecd78022aaad38d7df5bb7427af572.text: 如果 Koris Deeprunner 在 Freezie 死亡并且没有自我复活，则地牢宝箱可能不会生成。同样，如果他被卡住（例如在桥上或上锁的箱子上），他将无法到达最后一个房间，并且您将无法完成地牢。如果发生这种情况，请标记任何英雄或追随者让开，然后在 NPC 周围移动，引导他绕过障碍物并返回最后的房间。

5a045e982f8f631432c9a90b79f3cd64d9a8ddc8.source: The Snowmen near the second shrine sometimes spawn inside a wall; they can be ignored or killed using ranged, non-projectile attacks.
5a045e982f8f631432c9a90b79f3cd64d9a8ddc8.text: 第二个神社附近的雪人有时会在墙内生成；他们可以被忽视或被远程非投射攻击杀死。

da41cb78a1359b7f9f0250b66e291023d1fd3e23.source: Koris Deeprunner can spawn without his bow. However, he will still attack as if he has it, and hit enemies but does 0 damage.
da41cb78a1359b7f9f0250b66e291023d1fd3e23.text: 科里斯·深行者可以在没有弓的情况下生成。然而，他仍然会像拥有它一样进行攻击，并击中敌人，但造成 0 伤害。

6bcc428cc9f2ba622e3c7b10c8b0d14be11587e6.source: Help Hatuk kill the Great Fire Flower and pass his rite of passage into manhood.
6bcc428cc9f2ba622e3c7b10c8b0d14be11587e6.text: 帮助哈图克杀死大火花并通过他的成年仪式。

d301fa0e81b5df0524b3a523b995a57e3069c473.source: Once this quest is completed, Hatuk will no longer spawn in Zehlon Reach.
d301fa0e81b5df0524b3a523b995a57e3069c473.text: 一旦完成此任务，哈图克将不再在泽隆河段生成。

2ded29fc10ad9734517f557e67f35e164858a5fc.source: Obtain the quest by entering Zehlon Reach from The Astralarium and heading west along the northern path. Once obtained, head further west across the swamp. The Great Fire Flower is not a boss, and should not pose a problem even for solo players of the same level as the foe. The foe is not in the same group as any of the surrounding plants, so you may wish to kill those separately first.
2ded29fc10ad9734517f557e67f35e164858a5fc.text: 从星体馆进入泽隆河段并沿着北部道路向西走即可获得任务。获得后，继续向西穿过沼泽。大火花并不是boss，即使对于与敌人同等级的单人玩家来说也不会有什么问题。敌人与周围的植物不属于同一群体，因此您可能希望先单独杀死它们。

2124ba1222c84fcc1b07b08ba2955bab6af5d5e2.source: If you come from Champion's Dawn when obtaining this quest, you might want to head south first, to swing by the Resurrection Shrine near the entrance to the Cliffs of Dohjok to obtain the plants bounty.
2124ba1222c84fcc1b07b08ba2955bab6af5d5e2.text: 如果你来自冠军黎明，在获得这个任务时，你可能会想先向南走，到多霍克悬崖入口附近的复活神殿去获得植物赏金。

c17a0b49734726088e920491c3d44ba0cb94c4b5.source: The pre-quest offer dialogue will always get initiated for non-Nightfall characters despite the fact that non-Nightfall characters will not be offered this quest.
c17a0b49734726088e920491c3d44ba0cb94c4b5.text: 尽管非夜幕降临角色不会被提供此任务，但任务前的任务对话始终会为非夜幕降临角色启动。

ab76408af96a0d388cd60f9bd714a799e0af264e.source: Go to the first checkpoint and make certain that it is secure. Kill any Luxon invaders you find.
ab76408af96a0d388cd60f9bd714a799e0af264e.text: 前往第一个检查站并确保其安全。杀死你发现的所有卢克森入侵者。

7a64787fb29b85eec7495776f6a173f8912c28b9.source: Go to the second checkpoint and make certain that it is secure. Kill any Luxon invaders you find.
7a64787fb29b85eec7495776f6a173f8912c28b9.text: 前往第二个检查站并确保其安全。杀死你发现的所有卢克森入侵者。

eeb34ea4b49bd362164c544c448607c55d97e009.source: Go to the third checkpoint and make certain that it is secure. Kill any Luxon invaders you find.
eeb34ea4b49bd362164c544c448607c55d97e009.text: 前往第三个检查站并确保其安全。杀死你发现的所有卢克森入侵者。

1647d194317289007856a929d4aceb88c4ec86c0.source: Go to the fourth checkpoint and make certain that it is secure. Kill any Luxon invaders you find.
1647d194317289007856a929d4aceb88c4ec86c0.text: 前往第四个检查站并确保其安全。杀死你发现的所有卢克森入侵者。

63c3e20159ab959b53858ac5ca9578055086a0de.source: See Scoutmaster Arne for your reward.
63c3e20159ab959b53858ac5ca9578055086a0de.text: 去找童子军队长阿恩领取奖励。

6d68951146efd14a3415a50d470ae2036a64e67c.source: Simply visit each of the four checkpoints. A Luxon raiding party will spawn at all four locations, which you must kill in order to progress. Each Luxon raiding party spawns in two groups, each consisting of three to five Luxons. After the first group is eliminated, the second group immediately spawns. Once your party has cleared all four checkpoints, return to Scoutmaster Arne for your reward.
6d68951146efd14a3415a50d470ae2036a64e67c.text: 只需访问四个检查站即可。卢克森袭击小队将在所有四个地点产卵，你必须杀死它们才能前进。每个卢克森袭击小队都会分成两组，每组由三到五个卢克森组成。第一组被消灭后，第二组立即产生。一旦你的队伍清除了所有四个检查站，就返回童子军队长阿恩那里领取奖励。

3ab0ff4fc573eff4ef31d98d17e28f49f807ee92.source: Unlike previously, the checkpoints are now random, with the possible options indicated in the maps on the right.
3ab0ff4fc573eff4ef31d98d17e28f49f807ee92.text: 与以前不同的是，检查点现在是随机的，右侧地图中指示了可能的选项。

e94bb396b090e45de5515576a53d288ba92a4f72.source: This quest was used for Kurzick fast faction farming prior to the November 13th 2008 update, which added the requirement of killing the Luxon spawns (and moved the 4 spawn locations), significantly increasing the time required to complete the quest.
e94bb396b090e45de5515576a53d288ba92a4f72.text: 此任务在 2008 年 11 月 13 日更新之前用于库尔兹克快速派系耕作，更新增加了杀死 Luxon 生成点的要求（并移动了 4 个生成位置），显着增加了完成任务所需的时间。

331d8edab4ce181bdf8fb9066714baa9dff42a07.source: Like all Factions repeatable quests, if you leave the instance in the middle of the quest, even before accepting the reward, the quest will automatically be abandoned.
331d8edab4ce181bdf8fb9066714baa9dff42a07.text: 与所有派系可重复任务一样，如果您在任务中途离开实例，甚至在接受奖励之前，任务就会自动放弃。

197f103ddcd0c8ffc7c65401df6011fb410d9e67.source: This quest is listed under the "Melandru's Hope" heading in the quest log.
197f103ddcd0c8ffc7c65401df6011fb410d9e67.text: 该任务列在任务日志的“梅兰德鲁的希望”标题下。

0e62cabe812cd17fccb8fe2f4e41950f03b6b9a0.source: You can combine this quest with Charting the Forests since one of the objectives is to get to 5 points in Melandru's Hope.
0e62cabe812cd17fccb8fe2f4e41950f03b6b9a0.text: 您可以将此任务与绘制森林图结合起来，因为目标之一是在梅兰德鲁的希望中获得 5 点。

9294264f67dfce09cf5bda20755c8ab912359387.source: Proceed to the first patrol point in Traveler's Vale.
9294264f67dfce09cf5bda20755c8ab912359387.text: 前往旅行者谷的第一个巡逻点。

31b269f9f7bca1d6babc8d976773ebfe97b0d917.source: Proceed to the second patrol point in Traveler's Vale.
31b269f9f7bca1d6babc8d976773ebfe97b0d917.text: 前往旅行者谷的第二个巡逻点。

ea981646b804c7c630e9c74330a05d0d52801dad.source: Proceed to the third patrol point in Traveler's Vale.
ea981646b804c7c630e9c74330a05d0d52801dad.text: 前往旅行者谷的第三个巡逻点。

51c73086d724a6796618e7973a96558c79a18f26.source: Proceed to each patrol point, potentially clearing enemies along the way to avoid overaggro. Once all three points have been visited, return to Van the Warrior.
51c73086d724a6796618e7973a96558c79a18f26.text: 前往每个巡逻点，可能会清除沿途的敌人，以避免过度仇恨。访问完所有三个点后，返回战士范那里。

31256bb73235482129163c592f3650620f627af1.source: Despite the warning of enemy encounters, there is no need to fight any targets during this quest, and no additional enemies are spawned.
31256bb73235482129163c592f3650620f627af1.text: 尽管有遭遇敌人的警告，但在此任务期间无需与任何目标战斗，也不会产生额外的敌人。

79d235b1def2e8f73f5b85b16498f57fc7c0bbf7.source: Because of this, the quest combines well with other quests in Traveler's Vale, particularly Shiverpeak Stragglers, The Way is Blocked, and The Road to Borlis Pass.
79d235b1def2e8f73f5b85b16498f57fc7c0bbf7.text: 正因为如此，该任务与旅行者谷中的其他任务很好地结合在一起，特别是席瓦峰流浪者、道路被封锁和通往博利斯通道的道路。

d6ba27ae00510410df88aee37ff0e41d6ca00716.source: It is possible to start from Borlis Pass and complete the objective for the second patrol point before the first.
d6ba27ae00510410df88aee37ff0e41d6ca00716.text: 可以从博利斯山口出发，在第一个巡逻点之前完成第二个巡逻点的目标。

0ad4340cc4c162815c8ef18e8394f0943f0204b1.source: It is impossible to complete the third patrol point objective prior to the other two.
0ad4340cc4c162815c8ef18e8394f0943f0204b1.text: 在另外两个巡逻点之前完成第三个巡逻点目标是不可能的。

76229b89ef8fdff398e59264a24201b2f798cc56.source: It is possible to encounter Devona near the third patrol point. She will be running into the Vale from the Ascalon Foothills and engage in combat throughout the area. There is no need to keep her alive or assist her during this quest.
76229b89ef8fdff398e59264a24201b2f798cc56.text: 在第三个巡逻点附近有可能遇到德沃娜。她将从阿斯卡隆山麓跑进谷地，并在整个地区参与战斗。在这个任务中没有必要让她活下去或帮助她。

1f76eae19bb84cbcbdd495cda2af2e9b78df89a3.source: While this quest is active, all the Am Fah in Wajjun Bazaar will be allies. This also means that they will not ambush parties out near the areas closer to Nahpui Quarter.
