Because of this, it may be advantageous to hold off on completing this until you finish your quests in The Undercity and/or vanquish Wajjun Bazaar. The exceptions to this are the quests Captured, The Xunlai Agent, Deactivating P.O.X., and Street Justice. The Am Fah in the immediate area will still be hostile.
1f76eae19bb84cbcbdd495cda2af2e9b78df89a3.text: 当此任务激活时，Wajjun Bazaar 中的所有 Am Fah 都将成为盟友。这也意味着他们不会在靠近纳普伊区的地区伏击部队。因此，推迟完成此任务直到完成幽暗城的任务和/或征服 Wajjun Bazaar 可能是有利的。任务“捕获”、“寻来特工”、“停用 P.O.X.”和“街头正义”是例外。附近地区的 Am Fah 仍然充满敌意。

489ee2aeaf21ea0d6c94eb726221f364ec26bbf0.source: After completing this quest, all the Am Fah will be allies until you take either Refuse to Drink or Drink from the Chalice of Corruption. You can use this advantage and keep the Chalice of Corruption in the inventory for some time, while doing other quests in Wajjun Bazaar and nearby areas.
489ee2aeaf21ea0d6c94eb726221f364ec26bbf0.text: 完成此任务后，所有 Am Fah 都将成为盟友，直到您获得“拒绝饮酒”或“从腐败圣杯中饮酒”。您可以利用这一优势，将腐败圣杯保留在库存中一段时间​​，同时在 Wajjun Bazaar 和附近地区执行其他任务。

173575c6c8258f5354a62802d5ae0d99a3c5830f.source: Just speak with Brother Tosai. You can find him near the entrance to The Undercity surrounded by legions of Am Fah.
173575c6c8258f5354a62802d5ae0d99a3c5830f.text: 就跟东斋哥哥说吧。你可以在幽暗城入口附近找到他，周围环绕着阿姆·法赫军团。

2a9897101b38bb402df72c3b8e0ef9888a015f67.source: If you take the Refuse to Drink quest that follows, you will immediately be attacked by the Am Fah there, and Brother Tosai.
2a9897101b38bb402df72c3b8e0ef9888a015f67.text: 如果你接受接下来的“拒绝饮酒”任务，你将立即受到那里的阿姆法赫和托西兄弟的攻击。

db18248c6471e78299d743ef7db006988a00c1c9.source: As mentioned above, leaving this quest in the Quest Log without finishing it, allows to do other quests in the zone without enemies, since the Am Fah foes are allies. This is a good way to grind experience to level up since there are many quests in that zone that give 3,000 XP rewards. It also makes vanquishing easier.
db18248c6471e78299d743ef7db006988a00c1c9.text: 如上所述，将此任务留在任务日志中而不完成它，可以在没有敌人的情况下在该区域执行其他任务，因为 Am Fah 的敌人是盟友。这是磨练经验以升级的好方法，因为该区域中有许多任务可以提供 3,000 XP 奖励。这也让征服变得更加容易。

470061cbfc723908dea90a7462ce5e9877e0752b.source: Sometimes this quest does not show in the quest log.
470061cbfc723908dea90a7462ce5e9877e0752b.text: 有时该任务不会显示在任务日志中。

41a5ba25727467ddc9a68a61329981cf76cd07df.source: Speak to Guardsman Pongtu in Xaquang Skyway.
41a5ba25727467ddc9a68a61329981cf76cd07df.text: 与 Xaquang Skyway 的守卫蓬图交谈。

75814ac13ea1dd2b76da277c0aea1ab975b2632d.source: Locate Imperial Guardsman Tingjo in the Shenzun Tunnels. Obtain a shelter pass from him.
75814ac13ea1dd2b76da277c0aea1ab975b2632d.text: 在神尊隧道中找到帝国卫士汀卓。从他那里获得庇护所通行证。

f68ddb25dcfad33df71edc2c0ac7a2ba152243f6.source: After obtaining the quest, speak to Camp Guard/Guardsman Pongtu who is a few steps away from Yikaro. Imperial Guardsman Tingjo can be found outside of Maatu Keep in Shenzun Tunnels. When you go near Tingjo, several groups of Afflicted will approach Tingjo and attack; however, the quest doesn't require you to defend Tingjo from the Afflicted, so you can speak to him before the Afflicted arrive to receive the shelter pass and map travel to Senji's Corner to collect your reward.
f68ddb25dcfad33df71edc2c0ac7a2ba152243f6.text: 获得任务后，与距离伊卡罗几步之遥的营地守卫/守卫蓬图交谈。帝国禁卫军廷卓位于神尊隧道马图城堡外。当你靠近Tingjo时，几群苦难者会靠近Tingjo并攻击；然而，该任务并不要求你保护Tingjo免受受苦者的侵害，因此你可以在受苦者到达之前与他交谈以获取避难所通行证并在地图上前往森吉之角领取奖励。

544f30777073aaf6501c2980ec6030213250b2c7.source: The shelter pass is not an actual quest item as it doesn't appear in your inventory when you receive it from Tingjo.
544f30777073aaf6501c2980ec6030213250b2c7.text: 庇护所通行证不是实际的任务物品，因为当您从 Tingjo 收到它时，它不会出现在您的库存中。

38d5e6e33f601399dfc5c720b4ee75cbb2826f26.source: Camp Guard Pongtu is incorrectly identified as Guardsman Pongtu in the quest log.
38d5e6e33f601399dfc5c720b4ee75cbb2826f26.text: 营地守卫庞图在任务日志中被错误地识别为卫兵庞图。

51aaac58e100a07318d2f75fb32f4716237bec6a.source: Kill Selvetarm and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile.
51aaac58e100a07318d2f75fb32f4716237bec6a.text: 在奴隶流放地杀死席维塔姆和随行的敌人。

d80afd8ac16d569996f1050b43eaffbdd8743a3d.source: *BONUS* Kill Selvetarm and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
d80afd8ac16d569996f1050b43eaffbdd8743a3d.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Selvetarm 和伴随的敌人。

2a34a39cfa010dde5ee639ee774a3824b2bd084e.source: As per the Selvetarm portion of The Last Hierophant quest.
2a34a39cfa010dde5ee639ee774a3824b2bd084e.text: 根据最后的圣职者任务的 Selvetarm 部分。

cf5bbd0f97ef2aae5d29b1cf538f78d72fd89a09.source: Miller Quang, a resident of the area, has been keeping a treasure chest of his on a near-by small island. Since the increase of the local Naga population, he has been chased off of the island, and has grown increasingly uncomfortable with leaving his chest there.
cf5bbd0f97ef2aae5d29b1cf538f78d72fd89a09.text: 该地区的居民米勒·广(Miller Quang)一直在附近的一个小岛上保存着他的一个宝箱。由于当地娜迦人口的增加，他被赶出了岛上，并且越来越不舒服将自己的箱子留在那里。

36e282c083e9e01212b63aa39755733ab9c2c4f1.source: Find Miller Quang's chest on Yuroso Island.
36e282c083e9e01212b63aa39755733ab9c2c4f1.text: 在尤罗索岛找到米勒·光的箱子。

d7ab964d13a2da686056c69503d896e404db1538.source: Return the chest to Miller Quang.
d7ab964d13a2da686056c69503d896e404db1538.text: 将箱子归还给 Miller Quang。

9a2966f6b5cd1e2f31b4839672ec7afb5f3a3155.source: See Miller Quang for your reward.
9a2966f6b5cd1e2f31b4839672ec7afb5f3a3155.text: 请见 Miller Quang 领取奖励。

72e99504bd241917bb033dce45f241641567f192.source: Head to the beach north of Zen Daijun and you will see a small island surrounded by Naga. The chest is on this island, at the top of a small ledge. Grab the chest, and kill the Naga if you want; killing the Naga is not required, but is recommended, as they will be attacking you. Return to Miller Quang to get your reward.
72e99504bd241917bb033dce45f241641567f192.text: 前往禅代君以北的海滩，您会看到一个被那伽包围的小岛。箱子就在这个岛上，在一个小壁架的顶部。抓住箱子，如果你愿意的话，就可以杀死娜迦；杀死纳迦不是必需的，但建议这样做，因为他们会攻击你。返回米勒·光处领取奖励。

59b42886c0043ef38ca8ef23d0442bcd37a1e0a4.source: On your attempt to retrieve the chest you will probably run into the Naga boss Tin Dao Kaineng, so go prepared for a challenge.
59b42886c0043ef38ca8ef23d0442bcd37a1e0a4.text: 当你尝试取回宝箱时，你可能会遇到娜迦老大 Tin Dao Kaineng，所以准备好迎接挑战吧。

db348eed07380c815eebde656d5d6593c457f433.source: If you have completed Winds of Change, no Naga will spawn. However, many groups of stronger enemies (level 24 scavengers) will be present.
db348eed07380c815eebde656d5d6593c457f433.text: 如果您完成了变革之风，则不会生成纳迦。然而，将会出现许多更强大的敌人（24 级拾荒者）群体。

f45d6789c7a7f6ee59a7f72f42c1ebfe86165ce5.source: If you do not have the required quest, you cannot leave the first room due to the closed Gates of Strength.
f45d6789c7a7f6ee59a7f72f42c1ebfe86165ce5.text: 如果您没有完成所需的任务，由于力量之门关闭，您无法离开第一个房间。

aa2a9bd2f1d9212f8358a6ef1e99a66aaefa5a14.source: For the Anything You Can Do quest, you must kill the Fragment of Antiquities on Level 1. However, there is a bug where killing the Remnants of Antiquity will sometimes also fulfill the quest requirement.
aa2a9bd2f1d9212f8358a6ef1e99a66aaefa5a14.text: 对于“无所不能”任务，您必须杀死 1 级的古代遗迹碎片。但是，有一个错误，杀死古代遗迹有时也能满足任务要求。

b580823efbb7ad6f1bad7239b2f82a76bfcf7a3a.text: 一张“证明”可以打开所有相应的大门。

e03b214a90659eb1afe661762b2fbea80569860d.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #7 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
e03b214a90659eb1afe661762b2fbea80569860d.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 7 页。

c45c6986aa8011d6a4fdc62f1a4b678908b3174a.source: The first floor consists of several gates which indirectly lead to the second floor, which contains the boss. To open each gate, you need to step on a proof within the dungeon, of the same name. For example, stepping on Proof of Strength will open the Gates of Strength, and so on. The dungeon includes rooms with several posts which fire Ice Darts and Ice Jets. The streams are easy to avoid; however, the darts can be very annoying and potentially deadly. A party entering a room full of dart posts and foes should be wary. It is usually safer to pull enemies out of the rooms to avoid being hit by the darts.
c45c6986aa8011d6a4fdc62f1a4b678908b3174a.text: 第一层由几扇门组成，这些门间接通向第二层，第二层包含老板。要打开每个门，您需要踩到地牢内同名的证据。比如踩到力量证明就会打开力量之门等等。地牢的房间里有几个可以发射冰镖和冰射流的柱子。溪流很容易避开；然而，飞镖可能非常烦人，甚至可能致命。进入充满飞镖和敌人的房间的队伍应该保持警惕。将敌人拉出房间以避免被飞镖击中通常会更安全。

d47b1f72afac162f460bd69f795bf6827b529fbf.source: In general, players should avoid fighting large mobs of monsters and getting trapped in places where they are constantly taking damage. This strategy will make for a relatively straightforward run. When players arrive at the boss area, they will see Remnant of Antiquities and two other ice elementalist creatures. It is recommended to dispatch the non-boss creatures first, as they cast dangerous AoE spells.
d47b1f72afac162f460bd69f795bf6827b529fbf.text: 一般来说，玩家应该避免与大群怪物战斗并被困在不断受到伤害的地方。这一策略将使运行相对简单。当玩家到达boss区域时，他们会看到古物遗迹和另外两个冰元素生物。建议先消灭非 Boss 生物，因为它们会施放危险的 AoE 法术。

ffa844a113bfe64f1635cf19b9a21c911da3343c.source: Defeating the Remnant of Antiquities can be a very difficult and grueling experience, especially if the party has no reliable interrupts or dazing. The boss casts the monster-only AoE spell Diamondshard Mist, a type of ward which causes bleeding and heavy damage to those within its boundaries at its expiration.
ffa844a113bfe64f1635cf19b9a21c911da3343c.text: 击败古物遗迹可能是一次非常困难和艰苦的经历，特别是如果队伍没有可靠的打断或眩晕的情况下。 Boss 会施放仅限怪物的 AoE 法术“钻石碎片之雾”，这是一种结界类型，在结界到期时会对其范围内的人员造成流血和严重伤害。

892343c3f01434ca8610b449c8658531233a79b1.source: If you are unable to prevent the spell, it is essential to keep moving in order to stay out of the Diamondshard Mist. The party should spread out so that multiple party members avoid taking heavy damage simultaneously. If the entire party dies, there is a nearby resurrection shrine, so you can return to the assault before the boss can recover completely. A persistent party can defeat the Remnant regardless of Death Penalty.
892343c3f01434ca8610b449c8658531233a79b1.text: 如果您无法阻止该法术，则必须继续移动才能远离钻石碎片迷雾。队伍应该分散开来，以避免多名队员同时受到严重伤害。如果整个队伍都死了，附近有一个复活神殿，所以你可以在boss完全恢复之前返回攻击。无论死刑如何，坚持不懈的一方都可以击败残党。

09d46f20739afdcb86a93a03d216a2e3deb21cb8.source: Bring hex removal as the dryders and elementals in this dungeon use a lot of hexes.
09d46f20739afdcb86a93a03d216a2e3deb21cb8.text: 由于这个地牢中的干燥者和元素使用了大量的六角形，因此需要去除六角形。

f6bcbb8af3213e2e79289cef2a8e5a649f4adcf4.source: Careful pulling and avoiding bunching up will make this dungeon a relatively easy run. Also, because the traps can deal a lot of damage, it's advised to lure the enemies to a location where the traps can't hit you.
f6bcbb8af3213e2e79289cef2a8e5a649f4adcf4.text: 小心拉动并避免聚集将使这个地牢变得相对容易运行。另外，由于陷阱会造成大量伤害，因此建议将敌人引诱到陷阱无法击中您的位置。

3f155de0b8c7899fb2df1be97c6cde35fbc09cba.source: Bringing the following skills will make this dungeon much easier: Ward Against Elements, Mantra of Frost, Light of Deliverance, Extinguish (for the final boss), and interrupts such as Savage Shot, Distracting Shot, or anything causing Daze.
3f155de0b8c7899fb2df1be97c6cde35fbc09cba.text: 携带以下技能将使这个地下城变得更加容易：元素防御、冰霜咒语、拯救之光、熄灭（对于最终老板）以及诸如野蛮射击、分散射击或任何导致眩晕的中断。

84b908c7f3cb6e99f76ee7ce35f5523ff1d0aa96.source: There are not many fleshy creatures, so skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here. Plus, the Whirling Wisps carry Banishing Strike, destroying minions quickly.
84b908c7f3cb6e99f76ee7ce35f5523ff1d0aa96.text: 肉质生物并不多，所以造成流血、疾病、中毒或者需要尸体的技能在这里效果较差。另外，旋转小精灵还带有驱逐打击，可以快速消灭小兵。

5f2d4dcd9cd8d0220b5f1650c4fc93f1d243ba2d.source: Cold damage is less effective here, since several foes have additional armor rating against cold damage.
5f2d4dcd9cd8d0220b5f1650c4fc93f1d243ba2d.text: 寒冷伤害在这里效果较差，因为一些敌人具有针对寒冷伤害的额外护甲等级。

b756fef8ef13d402fd4337449cee9adeeb37d92e.source: The henchwoman Zho uses Broad Head Arrow, making her the henchman of choice for this dungeon if you don't have a hero with a daze skill yourself.
b756fef8ef13d402fd4337449cee9adeeb37d92e.text: 女追随者佐使用宽头箭，如果你自己没有具有迷惑技能的英雄，她将成为这个地下城的首选追随者。

264b2ecd2bf1ffc22b2dadf71ccd9a021e3c91d6.source: When facing the boss, spreading your party so his Deep Freeze won't hit all of them at the same time is very helpful.
264b2ecd2bf1ffc22b2dadf71ccd9a021e3c91d6.text: 当面对老板时，分散你的队伍，这样他的深度冻结就不会同时攻击所有人，这是非常有帮助的。

0a67802bdcfe15cc8367af620e1c891e63a65489.source: Or you can bring Pain Inverter and a party with spirits and minions so the boss kills itself.
0a67802bdcfe15cc8367af620e1c891e63a65489.text: 或者你可以带上止痛剂和一支由灵魂和仆从组成的队伍，这样老板就会自杀。

9ebdc53d7c5db89c30e60e459fb945292a52fc1c.source: Defend King Frozenwind while he summons new Ice Elementals.
9ebdc53d7c5db89c30e60e459fb945292a52fc1c.text: 在冰风国王召唤新的冰元素时保卫他。

314cdfe1fa5a3f8da2cb8504bb9f4e30f8f9de26.source: Return to the Reaper of the Ice Wastes for your reward.
314cdfe1fa5a3f8da2cb8504bb9f4e30f8f9de26.text: 返回冰荒收割者处获取奖励。

f920e3186074f0c745a4825bde02fde567820054.source: Once this quest is activated, groups of enemies will start spawning northeast. Each wave consists of separate groups of two yellow Terrorweb Dryders, one or two silver Terrorweb Dryders, and one Skeleton of Dhuum. One group will head towards King Frozenwind, while the other heads toward the Reaper of the Ice Wastes (see the map). A total of three waves will spawn within a short span of time. King Frozenwind has four level 28 Ice Elementals to assist him, but they will fall quickly to the fire spells of the dryders. You must protect both King Frozenwind and the Reaper. If either of them dies, your party is taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld. You can either split your team into two groups which take one group of foes at a time or you can take all foes as a whole group if you aggro them at their spawn-point. Note that the following waves spawn quickly, so you will need to take them down quickly.
f920e3186074f0c745a4825bde02fde567820054.text: 一旦激活此任务，成群的敌人将开始在东北方生成。每波由两个独立的黄色恐怖网干燥器、一到两个银色恐怖网干燥器和一个德姆骷髅组成。一组将前往冰风国王，而另一组将前往冰荒收割者（参见地图）。短时间内总共会产生三波。冰风之王有四个28级的冰元素来协助他，但他们很快就会被干燥者的火焰法术击倒。你必须保护冰风国王和死神。如果他们中的任何一个死亡，你的队伍就会被带回你进入地狱的前哨站。你可以将你的团队分成两组，一次带走一组敌人，或者如果你在他们的重生点聚集他们，你也可以将所有敌人作为一个整体。请注意，后续波浪会快速产生，因此您需要快速将其击落。

d6aa748686b0ae31757fdbd0036f7a61cc8ef062.source: King Frozenwind and his allies can take down a group of 4 Terrorweb Dryders, thanks to his Ward Against Harm. This can lighten the load on your team if you position yourselves to primarily defend the Reaper, who is practically defenseless.
d6aa748686b0ae31757fdbd0036f7a61cc8ef062.text: 借助他的防伤害结界，冰风国王和他的盟友可以击败 4 个恐网烘干机。如果你把自己定位为主要防守几乎毫无防御能力的收割者，这可以减轻你团队的负担。

8929a3b506e4512aac1430e89e88ace015df03b7.source: Consider bringing Winter to convert the Dryder's fire damage to cold damage, against which the Ice Elementals have a higher resistance.
8929a3b506e4512aac1430e89e88ace015df03b7.text: 考虑引入冬天，将烘干机的火焰伤害转化为寒冷伤害，而冰元素对此有更高的抵抗力。

6b3f8bf1e32c85e04928ab5b7745223471eb3ab9.source: If capturing a spider from this location, it should be noted that the spider spawns and the quest is completed after the first wave is destroyed, even though more waves will continue to come.
6b3f8bf1e32c85e04928ab5b7745223471eb3ab9.text: 如果从这个位置捕获蜘蛛，应该注意的是，蜘蛛会在第一波被摧毁后产卵并且任务完成，即使更多的波会继续到来。

34ec5d91f8a118c4d9ef6f1800545081e2b1e0f2.source: Due to the rapid spawn times of the Dryders, the fact that they are spawned in separate places, and they spawn with Skeletons of Dhuum this quest is now considered the hardest of The Underworld.
34ec5d91f8a118c4d9ef6f1800545081e2b1e0f2.text: 由于干燥者的生成时间很快，事实上它们是在不同的地方生成的，而且它们与德姆骷髅一起生成，这个任务现在被认为是地狱中最难的任务。

1b8afa8c0979ed8113b5bfb59695a1bd3734d881.source: Speak to Artificer Mullenix when you are ready to defend the Eye of the North.
1b8afa8c0979ed8113b5bfb59695a1bd3734d881.text: 当你准备好保卫北方之眼时，与技师穆勒尼克斯交谈。

fdf7959864e0e2625a96d4c4a3e53dc3349c74c1.source: Fight alongside the Eye's support personnel. Defend the Eye of the North from the attacking Shiverpeak Centaurs.
fdf7959864e0e2625a96d4c4a3e53dc3349c74c1.text: 与眼睛的支援人员并肩作战。保卫北方之眼免受席瓦峰半人马的攻击。

346b48d2803ed7ba5eea9183ee5e236c5f3eb22f.source: After talking to Artificer Mullenix, you will be taken just outside the entrance of Eye of the North to the Service: In Defense of the Eye zone, which shares a map with Ice Cliff Chasms. There, you will be attacked by several waves of Shiverpeak and Modniir Centaurs.
346b48d2803ed7ba5eea9183ee5e236c5f3eb22f.text: 与技师 Mullenix 交谈后，您将被带到北方之眼入口处的服务：保卫之眼区域，该区域与冰崖峡谷共享地图。在那里，你会受到几波席瓦峰和莫尼尔半人马的攻击。

c203a800c5b1636fb5ff982381319e82ceafdb7c.source: The easiest way to complete this quest is to retreat up the ramp. Rangers and spirit spammers then have plenty of time to lay/summon their spirits/traps without the attacking centaurs being aggroed (beware spirits too far down attacking the centaurs). Players can then aggro the centaurs causing them to move up the ramp to attack. Once your enemies are grouped together on the ramp unleash a barrage of area of effect damage, this will quickly destroy the level 8 Shiverpeaks Centaurs leaving only the level 20 Modniir Centaurs. Take notice of the Modniir Centaur's skill Trample as it can cause havoc if you're not prepared.
c203a800c5b1636fb5ff982381319e82ceafdb7c.text: 完成这个任务最简单的方法就是撤退到坡道上。然后游骑兵和灵魂垃圾邮件发送者有足够的时间放置/召唤他们的灵魂/陷阱，而不会攻击半人马（小心太远的灵魂攻击半人马）。然后玩家可以攻击半人马，使他们爬上坡道进行攻击。一旦你的敌人在坡道上聚集在一起，就会释放出一连串的区域伤害，这将迅速摧毁 8 级的席瓦峰半人马，只留下 20 级的莫德尼尔半人马。请注意莫德尼尔半人马的技能践踏，因为如果您没有做好准备，它可能会造成严重破坏。

cbb425ee24969d6f0c7ad4ef4f8e5b4f2e2967cb.source: An alternate strategy calls for running directly to the left at the beginning of the mission. Simply allow the centaurs to reach the front of the Eye, then pull them into smaller groups. This tactic allows players to avoid the mobs of Centaurs (which ultimately requires less firepower), but requires more time in return.
cbb425ee24969d6f0c7ad4ef4f8e5b4f2e2967cb.text: 另一种策略是在任务开始时直接向左跑。只需让半人马到达眼睛的前方，然后将它们拉成更小的群体即可。这种策略可以让玩家避开半人马的小怪（最终需要更少的火力），但需要更多的时间来回报。

16b437536c6b443a8c944cdc5c621415e2ab1f94.source: Another strategy is to retreat far back on the ramp and stay there, pull one group of foes at a time on the ramp by using a ranged attack such as a longbow. This strategy puts fewer demands on group composition, though inclusion of two elementalists, two healers and two warriors is recommended (not counting the three allies that join you on this mission).
16b437536c6b443a8c944cdc5c621415e2ab1f94.text: 另一种策略是在坡道上撤退到很远的地方并留在那里，使用长弓等远程攻击一次将一组敌人拉到坡道上。此策略对团队组成的要求较低，但建议包含两名元素师、两名治疗师和两名战士（不包括与您一起执行此任务的三个盟友）。

a21f273ed2d4a1c115319f6f0e799ee70c99af35.source: Consider bringing along Disease as it will spread between the centaurs but your party will remain safe from it (provided you do not bring Zhed Shadowhoof). This tactic is much better when combined with Toxicity.
a21f273ed2d4a1c115319f6f0e799ee70c99af35.text: 考虑携带疾病，因为它会在半人马之间传播，但你的队伍不会受到它的影响（前提是你不带哲德·影蹄）。这种策略与毒性结合起来效果会更好。

46bdab3d6e2091aa1b932e38d960b6b829be7a2b.source: There are enough centaur bodies to support two minion masters which will greatly help.
46bdab3d6e2091aa1b932e38d960b6b829be7a2b.text: 有足够的半人马尸体来支持两个小兵大师，这将有很大帮助。

5981c0524a85a3b94dcd60b4386dd96455a6f484.source: The centaurs arrive in 3 waves which will attack whether or not the previous wave has been defeated. The first wave consists solely of warriors. The second is solely rangers so the newly acquired spirit Winds is useful against this wave. The third and final wave contains warriors, rangers, monks, and a boss. Beware of the Ice Boulders that roll across the frozen lake, as they will kill anyone they roll over, including the Centaurs themselves.
5981c0524a85a3b94dcd60b4386dd96455a6f484.text: 半人马会分 3 波到达，无论前一波是否被击败，它们都会发起攻击。第一波仅由战士组成。第二个是纯粹的游侠，所以新获得的精神之风在对抗这一波时很有用。第三波也是最后一波包含战士、游侠、僧侣和 Boss。小心滚过冰冻湖面的冰巨石，因为它们会杀死任何被滚过的人，包括半人马本身。

577b7c6846434284e1f5fcb000d1b7380946bb3c.source: Edge of Extinction is also very useful here, again provided that you do not bring Zhed Shadowhoof.
577b7c6846434284e1f5fcb000d1b7380946bb3c.text: 灭绝边缘在这里也非常有用，前提是你不带哲德·影蹄。

a0b412a73846038ad7c856592c326d623d3f3054.source: This quest provides an opportunity to map Ice Cliff Chasms for Master of the North: equip your heroes with speed boosts (especially "Charge!", "Fall Back!", and "Incoming!") and move away from the portal to the EotN outpost. The remainder of the area will be free of foes, giving you plenty of time to scrape.
a0b412a73846038ad7c856592c326d623d3f3054.text: 此任务提供了为北方大师绘制冰崖裂缝的机会：为你的英雄装备速度提升（特别是“冲锋！”、“撤退！”和“来袭！”）并从传送门移至 EotN 前哨站。该区域的其余部分将没有敌人，给你足够的时间来搜寻。

c6400f3e8ccd3b527ad2761fd2f1cd29cc20804c.source: Several exits are blocked by closed doors. Those that are open (the portals to Boreal Station and Norrhart Domains) lead back to the EotN outpost. This is also true for the exit to The Battledepths, even though it appears blocked (you can walk through the doors).
c6400f3e8ccd3b527ad2761fd2f1cd29cc20804c.text: 几个出口被紧闭的门挡住。那些开放的（通往北方空间站和诺拉特域的传送门）会带回 EotN 前哨站。对于通往 The Battledeeps 的出口也是如此，尽管它看起来被封锁了（你可以穿过门）。

b8eb570f8ae4cb28182b9fc357e724cb6cbfd830.source: When you resign, you get the usual, message that "Your party was defeated". However, you remain alive and centaurs continue to attack you until you're returned to the outpost.
b8eb570f8ae4cb28182b9fc357e724cb6cbfd830.text: 当你辞职时，你会收到通常的消息“你的政党被击败了”。然而，你仍然活着，半人马会继续攻击你，直到你返回前哨站。

fd5dfc92bd049b2ba89d94d61b14fee47e77a068.source: If you kill the boss too far from the main battle (the base of the stairs), your three allies will start celebrating at the location where the boss died; they will not return with you to the stairs to kill any remaining foes.
fd5dfc92bd049b2ba89d94d61b14fee47e77a068.text: 如果你杀死的boss距离主战（楼梯底部）太远，你的三个盟友将在boss死亡的地方开始庆祝；他们不会和你一起回到楼梯去杀死任何剩余的敌人。

13507a0b89198806ea76ed10026661d2d7967f3b.source: Tell Artificer Mullenix when you are ready to start the training session.
13507a0b89198806ea76ed10026661d2d7967f3b.text: 当您准备好开始训练时，告诉 Artificer Mullenix。

5c394ba9e5e27c86f5bac43190122b0fca665589.source: Help train the service staff by leading them into combat. Destroy 20 practice dummies in 3 minutes.
5c394ba9e5e27c86f5bac43190122b0fca665589.text: 通过引导服务人员参加战斗来帮助培训他们。在 3 分钟内摧毁 20 个练习假人。

104b1b38cb789b2d98a5336a7c6a608b4afcc27d.source: When you start the quest, you are brought to an instance of the Eye of the North outpost along with the three service staff. After the twenty training dummies pop up, you must help the NPCs destroy them. The NPCs will attack the closest dummy and continue around the circle until all twenty are destroyed. The dummies don't attack or use skills, so healing skills and interrupts are not needed.
104b1b38cb789b2d98a5336a7c6a608b4afcc27d.text: 当您开始任务时，您将与三名服务人员一起被带到北方之眼前哨站的一个实例。当二十个训练假人出现后，你必须帮助 NPC 摧毁它们。 NPC 将攻击最近的假人并继续绕圈，直到所有二十个都被摧毁。假人不会攻击或使用技能，因此不需要治疗技能和打断。

3e9830abac2b7c50cae49fa83160d34d136c97d0.source: As the dummies leave exploitable corpses, a minion master with damage skills.
3e9830abac2b7c50cae49fa83160d34d136c97d0.text: 当假人留下可利用的尸体时，一个具有伤害技能的小兵大师。

fcd396f269820e3e7dc9501c94c1af0750612c64.source: Signet of Spirits build and Great Dwarf Weapon works exceptionally well.
fcd396f269820e3e7dc9501c94c1af0750612c64.text: 精神徽记的建造和伟大的矮人武器效果非常好。

4e82b16283e4ca2767264c505cab4e9eeecd5ef4.source: To complete the quest as quickly as possible, resign when you first arrive at the site, before the timer begins. Type the /resign command before entering the mission, and simply hit enter as soon as possible after the loading screen disappears. The log will say you have failed, but it will also say you killed all twenty dummies. In about five seconds, you will be returned to the Eye of the North, and you can claim your reward.
4e82b16283e4ca2767264c505cab4e9eeecd5ef4.text: 为了尽快完成任务，请在计时器开始之前第一次到达站点时退出。在进入任务之前输入 /resign 命令，并在加载屏幕消失后尽快按下 Enter 键。日志会说你失败了，但它也会说你杀死了所有二十个假人。大约五秒钟后，你将返回北方之眼，你就可以领取奖励了。

8b41e7f29ccd1596513027cb3d69712285150ec1.source: Even if you miss this opportunity, the quest itself should be easy.
8b41e7f29ccd1596513027cb3d69712285150ec1.text: 即使你错过了这个机会，任务本身也应该很容易。

c5ee16b2b4c083790b8195c0b90b240cc36fcb7f.source: The dummies actually count as Charr according to the title Rebel Yell so when you kill/destroy one you will gain 2 energy.
c5ee16b2b4c083790b8195c0b90b240cc36fcb7f.text: 根据《Rebel Yell》标题，这些假人实际上算作 Charr，因此当你杀死/摧毁一个假人时，你将获得 2 点能量。

e8292027683a900a87b944de1d543303c27f1014.source: The instance inside the Eye of the North outpost used for this quest is labeled Mano a Norn-o.
e8292027683a900a87b944de1d543303c27f1014.text: 用于此任务的北方之眼前哨站内的实例被标记为“Mano a Norn-o”。

9caf7a86c47170c58e6ee64679a52eb5daadbc49.source: Resigning while the timer is up will mark the quest as completed.
9caf7a86c47170c58e6ee64679a52eb5daadbc49.text: 在计时器到时退出将把任务标记为已完成。

eead0257f455235bbdf34ce575f0eb9cc9f09018.source: Clear Shadow's Passage in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
eead0257f455235bbdf34ce575f0eb9cc9f09018.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能城所有敌人的暗影通道。

3d307ba0664547bc51674b942322d363dd244771.source: Exit from Dragon's Throat, or travel through Bukdek Byway
3d307ba0664547bc51674b942322d363dd244771.text: 从龙喉出口出来，或通过 Bukdek Byway 行驶

b77e8ac81b7cd57b8f63a1c684056e5fa3319862.source: This area always contains one chest. When entering the area from Bukdek Byway, the chest most often spawns near Afflicted, otherwise you'll find it near Jade Brotherhood.
b77e8ac81b7cd57b8f63a1c684056e5fa3319862.text: 该区域始终包含一个箱子。当从 Bukdek Byway 进入该区域时，宝箱最常出现在受折磨附近，否则你会在翡翠兄弟会附近找到它。

9f1dbe74948f5da95ac33493bbd4732d2873e1a8.source: If starting from Dragon's Throat it is possible to vanquish only the Afflicted groups, The Afflicted Ako and one small spawn before him, by pulling them closer so you are never within range for the Jade Brotherhood to spawn. This will decrease the number of foes to vanquish to approximately 8.
9f1dbe74948f5da95ac33493bbd4732d2873e1a8.text: 如果从龙之喉咙开始，可以仅击败受折磨的群体、受折磨的阿科和他之前的一个小生成，方法是将它们拉近，这样你就永远不会在翡翠兄弟会生成的范围内。这会将需要消灭的敌人数量减少到大约 8 个。

362a7a13a4a951eae7a09a632711a3e67a1bbd32.source: Find information about the White Mantle's plans.
362a7a13a4a951eae7a09a632711a3e67a1bbd32.text: 查找有关白斗篷计划的信息。

54bc572ca43a0692f0a06a142588fdc4a1977e49.source: Follow the main path from Aurora Glade until you reach the area with the Henge Portal, killing foes along the way. Find and read the White Mantle Missive deep in the camp to finish the quest.
54bc572ca43a0692f0a06a142588fdc4a1977e49.text: 沿着奥罗拉林地 (Aurora Glade) 的主路前进，直到到达巨石阵传送门 (Henge Portal) 的区域，杀死沿途的敌人。在营地深处找到并阅读白斗篷信函来完成任务。

2ca22881b53f802420eb53ac4c2629d96455902d.source: If she dies, Miku will self-resurrect after a short period of time.
2ca22881b53f802420eb53ac4c2629d96455902d.text: 如果她死了，Miku会在短时间内复活。

4b137eddcd1a00ddbc8dd88409e1a066b8f18e34.source: "Find Their Weakness!" is added to Thackeray's skillbar after he shouts "Find Their Weakness".
4b137eddcd1a00ddbc8dd88409e1a066b8f18e34.text: “找出他们的弱点！”在萨克雷喊出“找到他们的弱点”后，他的技能栏就会被添加。

ac289c6ce8669e54d185e05ea5d130afbd8c6a0b.source: The skill benefits from his high Expertise, reducing its energy costs.
ac289c6ce8669e54d185e05ea5d130afbd8c6a0b.text: 该技能受益于他的高专业知识，降低了其能量成本。

b9c404875794b3f68fb40b4e55ac358ddb7eb987.source: If you have rearranged your skills so that your 7th skill slot is taken, "Find Their Weakness!" will replace the skill on this slot.
b9c404875794b3f68fb40b4e55ac358ddb7eb987.text: 如果你重新安排了你的技能，以便你的第七个技能槽被占用，“找到他们的弱点！”将取代该槽位上的技能。

da5bb8e92f379f099fbc8447e616a6153a737825.source: Travel to Raven's Point to begin the hunt.

e653bf8f2b494b9317f626474457ede0ceadf6a3.source: Start from Olafstead and head north-west to the entrance of Raven's Point dungeon. Head inside, where you will find the Shadow Spawn surrounded by mobs of Shadow Vaettir, Mist Vaettir and Stormcloud Incubus.
e653bf8f2b494b9317f626474457ede0ceadf6a3.text: 从奥拉夫斯特德出发，向西北方向前往乌鸦角地牢的入口。走进去，你会发现暗影之卵被暗影维提尔、迷雾维提尔和暴风云梦魇所包围。

44395cd2dee796e0c30f334130e5a7bf828b324b.source: The Vaettir and Incubus can easily be pulled away from the Shadow Spawn and defeated before taking it on. Once the creature is defeated, return to Hogni Truthseeker.
44395cd2dee796e0c30f334130e5a7bf828b324b.text: 维蒂尔和梦魇可以很容易地从暗影之卵身边拉开并在攻击之前将其击败。击败该生物后，返回霍格尼真理探索者身边。

3008669c4543d505a35d321c4537235fc19b93f4.source: Do not talk to Olaf (at Olafstead), since he will redirect your party to a different primary quest in the same dungeon. Olrun Olafdottir, at the entrance to this dungeon, offers an additional secondary quest, which does not interfere with this quest.
3008669c4543d505a35d321c4537235fc19b93f4.text: 不要与奥拉夫（在奥拉夫斯特德）交谈，因为他会将你的队伍重定向到同一地下城中的不同主要任务。奥尔伦·奥拉夫多蒂尔（Olrun Olafdottir）位于该地下城的入口处，提供了一个额外的次要任务，该任务不会干扰该任务。

7026a62adc3e097da1b43d5ba14ab59988af4f90.source: Go to the Breach and kill Charr Fire Callers to obtain a bottle of fiery unguent.
7026a62adc3e097da1b43d5ba14ab59988af4f90.text: 前往突破口并杀死夏尔召唤火者，获得一瓶炽热的药膏。

67f61cc897a04dbd8bd75fd51b91495b6a1bcda1.source: Return to Shalev the Hermit for your reward.
67f61cc897a04dbd8bd75fd51b91495b6a1bcda1.text: 返回隐士沙莱夫那里领取奖励。

97aa7ed05a2894b49dfb385d2a11951e201d46eb.source: Find Shalev in a cave on the western border of Old Ascalon, west-northwest of Sardelac Sanitarium. Map travel or navigate to Piken Square. Cross the small valley to the west and climb the path to the right (watching for Charr patrols) to find up to three Charr Fire Callers. When defeated, one will drop a bottle of fiery unguent. Bring it back to Shalev for the reward.
97aa7ed05a2894b49dfb385d2a11951e201d46eb.text: 在旧阿斯卡隆西部边界、沙德拉疗养院西北偏西的一个洞穴中找到沙莱夫。绘制旅行地图或导航至皮肯广场。穿过西边的小山谷，爬上右边的小路（注意查尔巡逻队），最多可以找到三个查尔火召唤者。被击败后，会掉落一瓶炽热的药膏。把它带回给沙莱夫以获得奖励。

0efe2211783a592908674dfa492f47eda21ff580.source: From Vlox's Falls head south. You will also pass through this dungeon as part of Finding Gadd. If you have access, you can start directly from Gadd's Encampment (however, if your goal is completing Lost Souls, you will need to visit the other entrance to find Crewmember Shandra; only she can open the door required for the quest).
0efe2211783a592908674dfa492f47eda21ff580.text: 从弗洛克斯瀑布出发，向南行驶。作为寻找加德的一部分，你还将穿过这个地牢。如果你有权限，你可以直接从加德的营地开始（但是，如果你的目标是完成迷失的灵魂，你将需要访问另一个入口才能找到船员珊德拉；只有她可以打开任务所需的门）。

2c19521cf21b5e18cd37291e01f38f45c5c47818.source: If you do not have the required quest, you cannot pass the door to the southeast by the Scrap of Parchment. It is still possible to navigate between the exits to Arbor Bay and Gadd's Encampment.
2c19521cf21b5e18cd37291e01f38f45c5c47818.text: 如果你没有完成所需的任务，你就无法通过羊皮纸碎片进入东南方的门。仍然可以在阿伯湾和加德营地的出口之间导航。

c0d7f83bcac9c0262782fb488ea7cb9aec9710ea.source: Completion of this dungeon rewards 1,500 Asuran points in normal mode and 2,250 in hard mode. Completing the dungeon for the first time in each mode rewards twice that.
c0d7f83bcac9c0262782fb488ea7cb9aec9710ea.text: 完成这个地下城会在普通模式下奖励 1,500 阿苏兰点，在困难模式下奖励 2,250 点。在每种模式中首次完成地下城的奖励是该模式的两倍。

70d694270ae5a72d542168fa4e9770f661d07c57.source: To complete the dungeon, you must destroy the Soul of Fendi Nin.
70d694270ae5a72d542168fa4e9770f661d07c57.text: 要完成地牢，你必须摧毁芬迪宁的灵魂。

f5e6add75d16a896a39901004b28c44468eeaf24.source: Although Shandra cannot be killed, she does not attack or use skills in the dungeon. On the contrary, she often body blocks allies trying to maneuver.
f5e6add75d16a896a39901004b28c44468eeaf24.text: 虽然珊德拉无法被杀死，但她在地牢中不会攻击或使用技能。相反，她经常用身体阻挡试图行动的盟友。

a9c1ea6ef3939550c602ec56261a228324fe2b13.source: On the second floor, the Northernmost room with three interlinking traps allows an entire party to walk behind the traps against the wall, bypassing them entirely.
a9c1ea6ef3939550c602ec56261a228324fe2b13.text: 在二楼，最北端的房间有三个相互连接的陷阱，允许整个队伍在陷阱后面靠墙行走，完全绕过它们。

639faac541a0b7505a6fea29d4ec44e6543bc9ad.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #12 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
639faac541a0b7505a6fea29d4ec44e6543bc9ad.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 12 页。

780981ae06b3e17b90f80f4bbd81c749f2404dfa.source: If Fendi Nin is killed by a flame jet without any interaction from your party, the Soul of Fendi Nin will not appear. Instead, as you approach the jet, Fendi Nin will respawn with full health.
780981ae06b3e17b90f80f4bbd81c749f2404dfa.text: 如果芬迪宁在没有与你的队伍进行任何互动的情况下被火焰喷射杀死，芬迪宁的灵魂将不会出现。相反，当你接近喷气式飞机时，芬迪宁将以完全生命值重生。

bf8d19b051d1e785478471d8796bf4b97034a5a9.source: On very rare occasions, Fendi Nin will not spawn. Unfortunately, there is no work-around; you must restart the dungeon. This happens if you have quests for other dungeons. There is an interval of approximately 2 seconds during which Fendi respawns and the soul disappears (these two events do not occur simultaneously - Fendi respawns first). If the soul has been killed before its disappearance and after Fendi's respawn, its death will trigger the chest but will not unspawn Fendi and the archers.
bf8d19b051d1e785478471d8796bf4b97034a5a9.text: 在极少数情况下，芬迪宁不会生成。不幸的是，没有解决方法；你必须重新启动地牢。如果您有其他地下城的任务，就会发生这种情况。芬迪重生和灵魂消失之间有大约 2 秒的间隔（这两个事件不会同时发生 - 芬迪首先重生）。如果灵魂在消失之前和芬迪重生之后被杀死，它的死亡将触发宝箱，但不会使芬迪和弓箭手消失。

1c72889148b92d04dd714162d4f1856918e77d3c.source: Collect heket legs to sate Rokel's unending hunger. You have collected [0...10] of 10 heket legs.
1c72889148b92d04dd714162d4f1856918e77d3c.text: 收集heket腿来满足Rokel无尽的饥饿。您已收集了 [0...10] 条 10 条 heket 腿。

e8b557593dbf0dea08817ecf885f0627667a7fef.source: See Bonesmith Rokel for your reward.
e8b557593dbf0dea08817ecf885f0627667a7fef.text: 去骨匠罗克尔那里领取奖励。

f7d257e21934d6ffb14eb43c43172874e4d25374.source: While a character has this quest active, all Heket killed will drop a Juicy Heket Leg each until your character holds 10 of it in their inventory. This means that if those collected legs are dropped or moved into storage, the Juicy Heket Legs will start dropping off any Heket again.
f7d257e21934d6ffb14eb43c43172874e4d25374.text: 当角色激活此任务时，所有被杀死的赫克特都会掉落一条多汁的赫克特腿，直到你的角色在其库存中拥有 10 条。这意味着，如果这些收集到的腿被丢弃或移入仓库，Juicy Heket 腿将再次开始掉落任何 Heket。

6d3e7d7ea7a9f5d81014d682a50c7a747093c647.source: Places where a lot of Heket can be found include (but not limited to) northern portion of Barbarous Shore, southern half of Dejarin Estate, the watery areas of the Floodplain of Mahnkelon, and the northwestern corner of Vehjin Mines.
6d3e7d7ea7a9f5d81014d682a50c7a747093c647.text: 可以找到大量 Heket 的地方包括（但不限于）Barbarous Shore 的北部、Dejarin Estate 的南半部、Mahnkelon 洪泛区的水域以及 Vehjin Mines 的西北角。

c1daafaf7e0175fa3bd9295d1d127ff5b1abc97d.source: Heket killed in the Tarnished Coast locations (Guild Wars Eye of the North) also drop these legs while this quest is active. If available consider combining with the quest Frogstomp.
c1daafaf7e0175fa3bd9295d1d127ff5b1abc97d.text: 在任务激活期间，在黯淡海岸地点（激战北方之眼）杀死的赫克特也会掉落这些腿。如果可以的话，考虑与任务青蛙践踏结合起来。

60b57d595cd7a67fb1e4e8ac3bbbb4f883ae5329.source: This quest is easily done with Desperate Measures active. The Skree and the Heket kill each other, leaving the player only needing to pick them up.
60b57d595cd7a67fb1e4e8ac3bbbb4f883ae5329.text: 在绝望措施激活的情况下，这个任务很容易完成。斯克雷人和赫克特人互相残杀，玩家只需要捡起他们即可。

8a4f6f3297d0e2bd201b46b47b32023af490699f.source: This quest doesn't change status to "completed" when you gather all required items.
8a4f6f3297d0e2bd201b46b47b32023af490699f.text: 当您收集所有必需的物品时，此任务不会将状态更改为“已完成”。

e7c0552113629ef3d5661d44ff147dba899fc262.source: Clear the Shenzun Tunnels in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
e7c0552113629ef3d5661d44ff147dba899fc262.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能城神尊隧道中的所有敌人。

b8f52ff56114aa66528d9c312fc44953361b3551.source: The To Tahnnakai Temple primary quest will lead characters through this area for the first time.
b8f52ff56114aa66528d9c312fc44953361b3551.text: 前往塔纳凯神庙的主线任务将带领角色第一次穿过这个区域。

1055298ad5112c90824631a25a90e1d83661d84f.source: Travel from Senji's Corner via the Nahpui Quarter explorable area or Xaquang Skyway. Alternatively, when available leave directly from Tahnnakai Temple or Sunjiang District.
1055298ad5112c90824631a25a90e1d83661d84f.text: 从 Senji's Corner 出发，途经 Nahpui Quarter 探索区或 Xaquang Skyway。或者，如果有的话，可以直接从塔纳凯寺或孙江区出发。

43fb0d581c03af7f39c314349955030d2b1d90cf.source: 4 additional Afflicted popup when approaching The Afflicted Kam (besides those already visible).
43fb0d581c03af7f39c314349955030d2b1d90cf.text: 当接近受苦的 Kam 时，会有 4 个额外的受苦弹出窗口（除了那些已经可见的）。

dd18516dab70b345f2d3969ca25c7d7b8c8a125e.source: Similarly, only 4 foes are visible as you approach The Afflicted Li Yun, after which he and several Afflicted popup (see map).
dd18516dab70b345f2d3969ca25c7d7b8c8a125e.text: 同样，当您接近受折磨的李云时，只有 4 个敌人可见，之后他和几个受折磨的人会弹出（参见地图）。

8559bf9854e3eb09ef0297050a32bb43ceacba71.source: There is an Am Fah group that patrols a long route along the western side and might be missed.
8559bf9854e3eb09ef0297050a32bb43ceacba71.text: 有一个 Am Fah 小组沿着西侧很长的路线巡逻，可能会被错过。

ff6b9f09ed3151c1d14e70f6a0a27aa1b5482a56.source: 10 Royal Guard allies spawn near Maatu Keep during the quest Battle in the Sewers. However, they are not as intelligent in battle as heroes or henchmen.
ff6b9f09ed3151c1d14e70f6a0a27aa1b5482a56.text: 在任务“下水道之战”期间，10 名皇家卫队盟友会在马阿图要塞附近生成。然而，他们在战斗中并不像英雄或追随者那样聪明。

295becb567ebc9ca856047aa648be249c0e184ef.source: Sometimes the vanquish won't be complete even after you kill everything in the area. In this case, run to all the portals. Occasionally a group of foes walks through it to disappear and you can get the reward as you approach the portal.
295becb567ebc9ca856047aa648be249c0e184ef.text: 有时，即使你杀死了该地区的一切，征服也不会完成。在这种情况下，请运行到所有门户。偶尔会有一群敌人穿过它消失，当你接近传送门时你可以获得奖励。

291c593000725abe2f6e0c1bb57043af4bf6a209.source: Search the road to Ascalon for refugees.
291c593000725abe2f6e0c1bb57043af4bf6a209.text: 在通往阿斯卡隆的路上寻找难民。

1b62ac27902b0f2e3c8fdab072d8ea7f1201f03c.source: Lead the refugees to Yak's Bend.

46792ddba49d577459049639b6e69b82b162ef38.source: Return to Captain Osric [Skills] for your reward.
46792ddba49d577459049639b6e69b82b162ef38.text: 返回奥斯里克队长[技能]处领取奖励。

91890daffda357e43d7c1b37270a6debc3476ad8.text: 火焰伤害：5-10（需要 5 神圣恩惠）

5e71264e5e9a458fabbefe29906b3099760e6eeb.text: 钝器伤害：14-23（需要 5 锤子掌握）

bcc14ef22609b6e19730dda820d7929295561660.text: 生命值+25（处于站立状态时）

bf3b8744748bc8ecbc8fd91f1cd1a3251b0bc5c2.source: Make your way to the quest marker on the south side of Traveler's Vale. It is quickest to reach from Borlis Pass, but starting at Yak's Bend allows you to clear foes along the way, making it easier to protect the refugees on the way back.
bf3b8744748bc8ecbc8fd91f1cd1a3251b0bc5c2.text: 前往旅行者谷南侧的任务标记。从博利斯山口到达速度最快，但从牦牛弯开始可以让你清除沿途的敌人，从而更容易保护返程的难民。

83d5d4219e5c4277f8effe6e3e9022f7602303df.source: A short way north of the refugees, on the path from Yak's Bend, you will find about a dozen Stone Summit warriors and mesmers, in four groups of 2-4 dwarves each, gathered close together. Either pull them and kill them there, being wary of overlapping patrols, or bypass them by traveling along the east side of the map.
83d5d4219e5c4277f8effe6e3e9022f7602303df.text: 在难民以北不远的地方，在从牦牛湾出发的路上，你会发现大约十几个石峰战士和幻术师，他们分成四组，每组 2-4 个矮人，紧密地聚集在一起。要么把他们拉到那里杀死他们，警惕重叠的巡逻队，要么沿着地图的东侧绕过他们。

9f20b388d663a769159ca023517ced638bc3b963.source: At the quest marker, you will find Elsa Alston and a handful of Ascalon Refugees. Speak to Elsa and the group will begin following you. If the Stone Summit dwarves spawned by the quest are still alive when a player approaches Elsa, they will run south and spread themselves out over the road, but there is ample time to evade them and return to Yak's Bend along the eastern path. Lead the refugees to Yak's Bend and make sure the quest has updated before entering the outpost and claiming the reward from Captain Osric.
9f20b388d663a769159ca023517ced638bc3b963.text: 在任务标记处，你会找到艾尔莎·阿尔斯顿和一些阿斯卡隆难民。与艾尔莎交谈，小队就会开始跟踪你。如果当玩家接近艾莎时，任务中产生的石峰矮人还活着，他们会向南跑，分散在道路上，但有足够的时间躲避他们，并沿着东边的小路返回牦牛弯。带领难民前往牦牛湾并确保任务已更新，然后再进入前哨站并从奥斯里克队长那里领取奖励。

66eb6bfa3a6f354c93ec80a3472218aa6c279d49.source: Elsa Alston is the only refugee who is required to survive to complete the quest.
66eb6bfa3a6f354c93ec80a3472218aa6c279d49.text: 艾尔莎·奥尔斯顿是唯一需要生存才能完成任务的难民。

84e2f012e99917d0d20c1534210613fcfbc8674d.source: While it is tempting to take Captain Osric's other quests, The Way is Blocked and The Road to Borlis Pass, at the same time, the enemies spawned by these three quests overlap substantially, making them significantly easier to complete separately.
84e2f012e99917d0d20c1534210613fcfbc8674d.text: 虽然接受奥斯里克船长的其他任务“道路被封锁”和“通往博利斯山口的道路”很诱人，但同时，这三个任务产生的敌人大量重叠，使它们更容易单独完成。

75261f3e56dede42abd7293cfdaca39c0ad90aba.source: If attempting to complete one or both of these quests at the same time, most of the Stone Summit spawned by Shiverpeak Stragglers will move out of the way if you bypass them and speak to Elsa Alston first.
75261f3e56dede42abd7293cfdaca39c0ad90aba.text: 如果试图同时完成其中一个或两个任务，如果你绕过它们并先与艾尔莎·阿尔斯通交谈，则由席瓦峰散兵产生的大部分石峰都会移开。

95c49cc6b8d4a86b46e31dcdddae160dabf782af.source: The Ascalon Refugees will shout "Look out! It's the Dwarves!" when you engage any mob, even if they aren't Dwarves. They will also attack, despite Elsa's claim not to be fighters.
95c49cc6b8d4a86b46e31dcdddae160dabf782af.text: 阿斯卡隆难民会大喊“小心！这是矮人！”当你与任何生物交战时，即使他们不是矮人。尽管艾尔莎声称自己不是战士，但他们也会发动攻击。

63d18d6edc76ea596ca7e3bc465b0c4474ef8e54.source: The refugees will continue to follow you and fight after leading them to Yak's Bend.
63d18d6edc76ea596ca7e3bc465b0c4474ef8e54.text: 难民们将在带领他们到达牦牛湾后继续跟随你并战斗。

ba5c14372558b413c85b035c02ad50ab0cef1ea5.source: The refugees may be dead by the time you arrive, forcing you to restart the trip to them again.
ba5c14372558b413c85b035c02ad50ab0cef1ea5.text: 当你到达时，难民可能已经死了，迫使你重新开始前往他们的旅程。

27036eb5a42cbb4f83a4f237fa1002ea4ad3cc7f.source: Clear the Silent Surf in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
27036eb5a42cbb4f83a4f237fa1002ea4ad3cc7f.text: 在困难模式下清除玉海无声浪中的所有敌人。

66c33033be89df351d7f0b78ce09b99b1bb654ea.source: The Journey to the Whirlpool primary quest will lead characters from the Leviathan Pits through this area on their way to Unwaking Waters (Luxon).
66c33033be89df351d7f0b78ce09b99b1bb654ea.text: 漩涡之旅的主要任务将带领来自利维坦坑的角色穿过这个区域，前往不醒水域（卢克森）。

74d2e3f902c20ffeb6e1bfccde43e8d5f0eddbd5.source: Several secondary quests that can be obtained in Leviathan Pits also take place here.
74d2e3f902c20ffeb6e1bfccde43e8d5f0eddbd5.text: 在利维坦坑中可以获得的几个次要任务也发生在这里。

7dfb756d76bdb8d75103a8fccd16dd7ffadbef36.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 2.8% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
7dfb756d76bdb8d75103a8fccd16dd7ffadbef36.text: 对该区域的完整探索将为 Canthan Cartographer 主打歌带来约 2.8% 的收益。

daae8f6f8638c4a801cb1e9dd037ba4410fb41da.source: Be wary of groups that move along long overlapping patrol paths, especially the Outcast groups, as some of them move very fast.
daae8f6f8638c4a801cb1e9dd037ba4410fb41da.text: 警惕沿着长而重叠的巡逻路径移动的团体，尤其是被驱逐者团体，因为其中一些移动速度非常快。

085dad38c44973a1758b81df2d3d9b893dc40d1e.source: Around the southern bend from the Seafarer's Rest exit.
085dad38c44973a1758b81df2d3d9b893dc40d1e.text: 从海员休息处出口绕南转弯。

f7b31121bc76fa75317d81731614a83e183c41b3.source: In a corner at the end of the western path heading south away from Leviathan Pits.
f7b31121bc76fa75317d81731614a83e183c41b3.text: 在远离利维坦坑向南的西边小路尽头的一个角落里。

8a33f78294028a35b4fbddecbe311057613f5ac5.source: In the small nook east of the bridge that connects the eastern island to the larger landmass.
8a33f78294028a35b4fbddecbe311057613f5ac5.text: 在连接东岛和更大陆地的桥东边的小角落里。

22c1b33f9c7ed31662d1cb36bb9ea023b3f0b55d.source: South of Kenrii Sea Sorrow's location, along the cliff face.
22c1b33f9c7ed31662d1cb36bb9ea023b3f0b55d.text: Kenrii Sea Sorrow 位置以南，沿着悬崖面。

67763b6aec36d45b5005a73011e93648c578a839.source: On the southernmost island (the path above the pier).
67763b6aec36d45b5005a73011e93648c578a839.text: 在最南端的岛屿上（码头上方的小路）。

a6b8ec352183a8eb4a1125ffc3f4ac01e6bd982b.source: The Afflicted, the Outcasts, and the Jade Sea wildlife are all hostile to one another and will fight each other if two different groups come within aggro range. If you take your time before moving to the more densely-patrolled areas, many of the groups may have already killed each other.
a6b8ec352183a8eb4a1125ffc3f4ac01e6bd982b.text: 受折磨者、流放者和玉海野生动物都互相敌对，如果两个不同的群体进入仇恨范围，就会互相争斗。如果你在转移到巡逻更密集的地区之前花点时间，许多团体可能已经互相残杀了。

6f72e16f4adadeaffe6726088e6e6a1296cc68ec.source: Because so many groups kill each other, it is possible to complete the vanquish by killing only around 175 enemies, despite there being over 240.
6f72e16f4adadeaffe6726088e6e6a1296cc68ec.text: 由于如此多的团体互相残杀，尽管敌人数量超过 240 人，但只需杀死约 175 人就可以完成征服。

846eac7c755e90967a9b67555b3dfeaaf8178f25.source: Clear Silverwood in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
846eac7c755e90967a9b67555b3dfeaaf8178f25.text: 在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林中银林的所有敌人。

f82922c5248706b45f762f2842d2ab4fb3fbeda1.source: Exit from Quarrel Falls or Bloodstone Fen. Alternatively, the quest Mysterious Message will lead you here from Druid's Overlook.
f82922c5248706b45f762f2842d2ab4fb3fbeda1.text: 从夸雷尔瀑布或血石沼泽退出。或者，任务神秘消息将引导你从德鲁伊眺望台来到这里。

bd60b867681f6bb5cd201c7d0228de26cebc5e07.source: It is possible to walk through the portal leading to Ettin's Back without zoning into that area. Note that this does not yield otherwise non-explorable parts of the map.
bd60b867681f6bb5cd201c7d0228de26cebc5e07.text: 可以步行穿过通往埃丁之背的传送门，而无需划分到该区域。请注意，这不会产生地图的其他不可探索部分。

def6f746ef8913d5a2600c2dc49062a65c79dab9.source: There are hidden groups of Moss Scarabs.There are no Life Pods.
def6f746ef8913d5a2600c2dc49062a65c79dab9.text: 有隐藏的苔藓圣甲虫群。没有生命豆荚。

b30a2c82ea240df9c3d3800111cef94ce8d9db28.source: There are two groups of three Maguuma Hunters that are easily missed. One group patrols a long route in the northwestern corner of the map, south of Bloodstone Fen. The other patrols in the south.
b30a2c82ea240df9c3d3800111cef94ce8d9db28.text: 有两组三名迈古玛猎人很容易被错过。一组人在地图西北角、血石沼泽以南的一条长路线上巡逻。其他人则在南边巡逻。

2b26d72a11063932034e3a2bb739413827d9a15c.source: Mind also the lone Wind Rider that patrols the fountain area in the northeast.
2b26d72a11063932034e3a2bb739413827d9a15c.text: 还要注意在东北方喷泉区巡逻的孤独驭风者。

f60196dffe1dfca24aa1523721c42b4ba20ac391.source: Just outside the entrance to Bloodstone Fen, there is an area that appears to keep "foggy" as if unexplored.
f60196dffe1dfca24aa1523721c42b4ba20ac391.text: 就在血石沼泽入口外，有一片区域似乎一直“雾蒙蒙”，仿佛未经探索。

886661d0bf270e67b1bf4f16e5db31e4956c3fa4.source: Wait by the entrance to the hierophant's stronghold for Vael to create a diversion.
886661d0bf270e67b1bf4f16e5db31e4956c3fa4.text: 在圣职者要塞的入口处等待维尔来制造牵制。

06d18adf7ac233fe22e5d64744c97ac486eb79ae.source: Rush in while the Charr are distracted and kill Vyrrgis the Pestilent.
06d18adf7ac233fe22e5d64744c97ac486eb79ae.text: 趁夏尔分心时冲进去，杀死瘟疫者维尔吉斯。

b7c201671ea8da5666798c07a414713399441d57.source: Walk to the quest marker on your radar and wait for Vael to run past carrying 'Grawl Pheromones'. He will be followed by a very large group of Grawl. Once the quest log updates, follow Vael's lead into the camp. Once inside, head straight to Vyrrgis and kill him. You shouldn't be attacked while the Charr and Grawl are occupied with each other. Once the foe is dead, you can simply zone back to Longeye's Ledge.
b7c201671ea8da5666798c07a414713399441d57.text: 走到雷达上的任务标记处，等待瓦尔带着“穴居人信息素”跑过去。他身后将跟着一大群Grawl。任务日志更新后，跟随瓦尔的带领进入营地。进去后，直奔维尔吉斯并杀死他。当夏尔和格罗尔互相忙碌时，你不应该受到攻击。一旦敌人死亡，你就可以简单地回到长眼壁架。

36b49217e7c5e49f5b0a4130571a6948c5eaa88e.source: The Grawl will be hostile to both the Charr and to you.
36b49217e7c5e49f5b0a4130571a6948c5eaa88e.text: 穴居人会对夏尔和你都怀有敌意。

2c212728d3e3571d57d92052eb2d2f2832e5ba94.source: You can pick up the Grawl Pheromones afterwards, but it will no longer have any effect.
2c212728d3e3571d57d92052eb2d2f2832e5ba94.text: 之后你可以拾取穴居人信息素，但它不再有任何效果。

863231eb3d85ac7d602b2dfec63e1f709b58f7a0.source: Seek out Master Engineer Jakumba in Zehlon Reach.
863231eb3d85ac7d602b2dfec63e1f709b58f7a0.text: 在泽隆河段寻找首席工程师贾库姆巴。

c8c0570fab014df5f45385549f8de551803850a5.source: Lure the fierce skale by attacking his brethren by the fishing docks. x of 4 groups remain.
c8c0570fab014df5f45385549f8de551803850a5.text: 通过在渔码头攻击凶猛的骷髅同胞来引诱凶猛的骷髅。剩下 4 组中的 x。

2e5820564d1c619ca4d13543dadab4f64da8a71c.source: Recover Jakumba's magical compass from the fierce skale.
2e5820564d1c619ca4d13543dadab4f64da8a71c.text: 从凶猛的斯凯尔手中夺回贾昆巴的魔法指南针。

cd1b73c15160524f6036334f1d1ca4da24108651.source: Return the magical compass to Jakumba.
cd1b73c15160524f6036334f1d1ca4da24108651.text: 将魔法罗盘归还给贾昆巴。

45b535a263a5f86d18f6365e629bb3f3c46fc2ea.source: Once this quest is completed, Hungry Skale will no longer spawn in Zehlon Reach.
45b535a263a5f86d18f6365e629bb3f3c46fc2ea.text: 一旦完成此任务，饥饿的斯凯尔将不再在泽隆河段生成。

02812b4dd69f353c2f5392373dc62feae355a988.source: Start from Jokanur Diggings. Head North to find Lieutenant Murunda. She is located next to the resurrection shrine along side some stone pillars and columns.
02812b4dd69f353c2f5392373dc62feae355a988.text: 从 Jokanur 矿区开始。向北寻找穆伦达中尉。她位于复活神殿旁边，旁边有一些石柱和石柱。

ebf1df2d58df6b8ddc444ea9a1e7a14c4fdb6053.source: After taking the quest, you need to talk to Master Engineer Jakumba, who is just outside of compass range to the East along the northern bank of the water. He will send you to the North to hunt down the skale who took his compass. Kill the small groups of Hungry Skale until you find the Fierce Skale who will drop the compass.
ebf1df2d58df6b8ddc444ea9a1e7a14c4fdb6053.text: 接受任务后，你需要与总工程师贾库姆巴交谈，他就在北岸东部罗盘范围之外。他会派你去北方追捕夺走他指南针的斯卡勒。杀死小群饥饿的斯卡勒，直到找到会掉落指南针的凶猛斯卡勒。

8572e8769c821c6a94b14db0e31c917a86ec55f2.source: Once the compass is retrieved, simply return it to Master Engineer Jakumba, then return to Lieutenant Murunda to turn in the quest.
8572e8769c821c6a94b14db0e31c917a86ec55f2.text: 取回指南针后，只需将其归还给总工程师贾昆巴，然后返回给穆伦达中尉即可完成任务。

eae459f618943d161b31812fd1b77e6491861e3b.source: Lieutenant Murunda and the Hungry Skale spawn by default, including for non-Nightfall characters who will not be offered this quest.
eae459f618943d161b31812fd1b77e6491861e3b.text: 默认情况下会生成穆伦达中尉和饥饿的斯凯尔，包括不会提供此任务的非黄昏角色。

5fc1020e35214e31b47b4dc49b3416c8ed9e41b4.source: Speak with Sujun again to begin the test.

842473a1f24faf6893b475a9cbdf61c3074b20ab.source: You will be provided with two skills. Carefully read their descriptions to see how they can interact. Then use them in the right order to gain the synergetic effect. This will make defeating your trainers easy. You may also defeat them using other skills.
842473a1f24faf6893b475a9cbdf61c3074b20ab.text: 您将获得两项技能。仔细阅读他们的描述，看看他们如何互动。然后按照正确的顺序使用它们以获得协同效应。这将使击败你的训练师变得容易。您也可以使用其他技能击败他们。

5c7ec69a97c6c8058f34b5edeb8c5423258cae85.source: Go to the north shore and kill the Naga boss Xsshsss Zsss
5c7ec69a97c6c8058f34b5edeb8c5423258cae85.text: 去北岸杀死娜迦boss Xsshsss Zsss

efe46fd719b3fb400f205f9596e67379ef451851.source: The destination (as the crow flies) is North-Northwest from Miller Quang. The best route to take is through Linkei Township and across the map to the North of Teipao Island, then up and around the outcropping of rock. This will help you avoid the extremely large encampment of Crimson Skull located to the North of Hanzing Pier.
efe46fd719b3fb400f205f9596e67379ef451851.text: 目的地（直线飞行）是从 Miller Quang 出发的西北方向。最佳路线是穿过临溪镇，穿过地图到达帝堡岛北部，然后向上绕过露出地面的岩石。这将帮助您避开位于汉津码头以北的巨大的猩红骷髅营地。

77998fee93261396773ac5af683895ee01b745f1.source: The Naga 'boss' is accompanied by 6 other Naga, varying from levels 6 to 10.
77998fee93261396773ac5af683895ee01b745f1.text: 娜迦“老大”伴随着另外 6 名娜迦，等级从 6 级到 10 级不等。

6a9cb6c12045174b5f025b1496cacc694b60058c.source: After completing the Zen Daijun mission, this map area is crawling with Crimson Skull groups.
6a9cb6c12045174b5f025b1496cacc694b60058c.text: 完成禅大君任务后，这个地图区域就布满了猩红骷髅群。

433482e88d64b58ae62694323abea2e4e0a9a570.source: Find the skree harpy nests on the Cliffs of Dohjok and destroy the skree hatchlings. You have destroyed [0...26] of 26 hatchlings so far.
433482e88d64b58ae62694323abea2e4e0a9a570.text: 找到多赫约克悬崖上的斯克雷鹰身女妖巢穴并消灭斯克雷幼体。到目前为止，您已消灭了 26 只幼体中的 [0...26] 只。

06c7062eb54939ed57dd4b991685030f983a1cd7.text: 请前往 Mofuun 领取奖励。

b183741773a22eabd6af028c46bc7bcc25c2da00.source: Simply head southwest from Champion's Dawn towards the shrine outside Beknur Harbor. Before you get to the shrine, you will encounter 26 hatchlings to kill. For every 6 or so hatchlings that you kill, a higher level Harpy Mother will spawn, so be careful not to be overrun by harpies.
b183741773a22eabd6af028c46bc7bcc25c2da00.text: 只需从冠军黎明向西南方向前往贝克努尔港外的神社即可。在你到达神社之前，你会遇到 26 只幼体需要杀死。每杀死 6 个左右的幼体，就会生成一个更高级别的鹰身女妖母亲，所以要小心，不要被鹰身女妖占领。

8b2ea834c14b97b8b39efb6d9a3cb523f6409953.source: While a Skree Battle bounty would be handy considering the number of Skree encountered during this quest, the Sunspear Scouts that provide this bounty are located on the far side of the quarry.
8b2ea834c14b97b8b39efb6d9a3cb523f6409953.text: 虽然考虑到在此任务中遇到的斯克雷人数量，斯克雷人战斗赏金会很方便，但提供此赏金的阳矛侦察兵位于采石场的远端。

5217757d3b7e58b4aa64101038a1a28a72ca429b.source: Clear Skyward Reach in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
5217757d3b7e58b4aa64101038a1a28a72ca429b.text: 在困难模式下清除水晶沙漠中的所有敌人。

080a587199391d680570ca3a27edfa86ec33390c.source: Consider acquiring the quests for The Arid Sea (two days earlier) and The Scar (the next quest in cycle), since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.
080a587199391d680570ca3a27edfa86ec33390c.text: 考虑获取干旱之海（两天前）和疤痕（循环中的下一个任务）的任务，因为你可以通过被遗忘的守护者带领一支八人队伍连续征服所有三个区域。

fe043e06594c9d1a127c3ea7a93201a1950521c0.source: Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 1.33% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
fe043e06594c9d1a127c3ea7a93201a1950521c0.text: 完成对该区域的探索后，泰尔制图师头衔将增加约 1.33%。

39f2b74eb0b09ff55f56d7c871ed47bd5fae9243.source: Hydra are found more frequently here than anywhere else in the Crystal Desert so skills like Protective Spirit, Shelter, Spirit Bond, and Mantra of Flame are highly recommended.
39f2b74eb0b09ff55f56d7c871ed47bd5fae9243.text: 九头蛇在这里的出现频率比水晶沙漠中的其他地方都要高，因此强烈推荐诸如保护精神、庇护所、精神纽带和火焰咒语等技能。

d2c82009c192b3711a297726d5b10ff6a43cab65.source: There are a dozen Desert Griffons in the fingertip of land south of Augury Rock.
d2c82009c192b3711a297726d5b10ff6a43cab65.text: 在占卜岩以南的指尖上的土地上，有十几头沙漠狮鹫。

58fc1bd7ba6d6476fc775a4c9741d2d4b81f1114.source: Near Diviner's Ascent, there are a couple of spots with hidden Rockshot Devourers.
58fc1bd7ba6d6476fc775a4c9741d2d4b81f1114.text: 在占卜者上升点附近，有几个隐藏着岩弹吞噬者的地点。

a2cf0c9f56cbd03a522e158ca175f104a01bfc0e.source: There is also a short patrol of Enchanted near the Vulture Drifts portal.
a2cf0c9f56cbd03a522e158ca175f104a01bfc0e.text: 在秃鹫漂流传送门附近还有一个魔法小队巡逻。

04adfe7c71641805efe09752ce1adbe9ea240119.source: The zone includes two landmarks with no known function:
04adfe7c71641805efe09752ce1adbe9ea240119.text: 该区域包括两个功能未知的地标：

f4bb2c0c4754d2e46beb25d2164e80c36d91a168.source: A large skeleton (of an unknown creature) rests near Mourn Drakespur.
f4bb2c0c4754d2e46beb25d2164e80c36d91a168.text: 一具（未知生物的）大型骷髅躺在哀悼龙马附近。

54049c7ab4142bbfe12c52a24d50402a002f29f0.source: Just outside Destiny's Gorge is a spot with four pedestals, each with a ramp leading up to it.
54049c7ab4142bbfe12c52a24d50402a002f29f0.text: 命运峡谷外面有一个地方，有四个基座，每个基座都有一个通向它的坡道。

2fc766039195774f73c6b7be5bb3a4b37016a4cf.text: 重复次数：2,500（困难模式下为 3,750）

f4749c51ec1a94a8208e7cf619383896beaa755a.source: See The Last Hierophant for a walkthrough of that quest. This quest is gained automatically when entering the dungeon.
f4749c51ec1a94a8208e7cf619383896beaa755a.text: 请参阅最后的圣职者以了解该任务的演练。进入地下城时会自动获得该任务。

1e377e3f103ecde4d1110a996590b6f063b3661c.source: At least one party member must have completed EotN, otherwise Frida Unmoven will block the entrance.
1e377e3f103ecde4d1110a996590b6f063b3661c.text: 至少一名党员必须完成 EotN，否则 Frida Unmoven 将堵塞入口。

bfe456db4167f551e8ef13a52baedd0a531ee0f3.source: This dungeon has five named levels: an entrance level, three intermediate levels (can be completed in any order or mode), and a final level. The intermediate and final levels are connected to the initial level.
bfe456db4167f551e8ef13a52baedd0a531ee0f3.text: 该地下城有五个指定级别：一个入口级别、三个中间级别（可以以任何顺序或模式完成）和一个最终级别。中间层和最终层与初始层相连。

8b1b7a088b355fb9b187a70ec07682300e6e30a8.source: You may complete the dungeon in multiple trips, since you can leave after defeating any of the boss-like foes on the quest list without losing your progress in The Last Hierophant.
8b1b7a088b355fb9b187a70ec07682300e6e30a8.text: 您可以多次完成地牢，因为您可以在击败任务列表中任何类似 Boss 的敌人后离开，而不会丢失在《最后的圣职者》中的进度。

70af8ebc2aa45cf92eb1f96b993681053035758a.source: You cannot enter Duncan's level until every party member has killed his henchmen (the other four boss-like foes) in the three intermediate levels.
70af8ebc2aa45cf92eb1f96b993681053035758a.text: 在三个中间关卡中，每个党员都杀死了他的追随者（其他四个像老板一样的敌人）之前，你不能进入邓肯的关卡。

d23791c87bbc255c7a5a49c2aaf813a2a8e23885.source: You get Hard mode credit for this dungeon by killing Duncan at that difficulty level; the sub-bosses may still be killed in normal mode. This makes it easier to get credit for your Master of the North title and/or Master Dungeon Guide book.
d23791c87bbc255c7a5a49c2aaf813a2a8e23885.text: 通过在该难度级别杀死邓肯，您可以获得该地下城的困难模式积分；正常模式下小boss还是有可能被杀的。这使得您更容易获得北方大师头衔和/或地下城大师指南书籍的积分。

2a5ebef4b02bfbfc0acd5db85ea3941be22b5316.source: If you failed to claim the reward from the Hierophant's Chest (either by exiting or wiping), you must start over.
2a5ebef4b02bfbfc0acd5db85ea3941be22b5316.text: 如果您未能从圣职者宝箱中领取奖励（通过退出或清除），您必须重新开始。

af733d16dd8fe1ef5c61afbf3156128964b3c63e.source: The Spirits of Disenchantment, Pain and Shadowsong have 15 Communing in Normal Mode.
af733d16dd8fe1ef5c61afbf3156128964b3c63e.text: 幻灭之魂、痛苦之魂和影歌之魂在正常模式下有 15 次交流。

6a95ec2ee233eeb77e96147686751053c2c1791a.source: Bring Frozen Soil to counter the resurrection skills of the Stone Summit Dwarves.
6a95ec2ee233eeb77e96147686751053c2c1791a.text: 带上冰冻土来对抗石峰矮人的复活技能。

918003b9c7f37ab7fb0aa44fe1ef66c5ddbaed39.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #15 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
918003b9c7f37ab7fb0aa44fe1ef66c5ddbaed39.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书第 15 页。

97e8d53c2ba74859426974608edc9dcd4da121a9.source: This quest automatically appears in your quest log when entering the dungeon.
97e8d53c2ba74859426974608edc9dcd4da121a9.text: 进入地牢时，该任务会自动出现在您的任务日志中。

8cda5622aa93f0827327aeaa4dfbbf4adeb92ba5.source: Quest progress is saved even when exiting the dungeon. This allows you to modify your party's build(s) for each boss, if required.
8cda5622aa93f0827327aeaa4dfbbf4adeb92ba5.text: 即使退出地牢，任务进度也会保存。如果需要，这允许您修改每个 Boss 的队伍构建。

14b1f099252190048ec4c769ea9f9b4f0ee6f179.source: Unlike most dungeons, Slavers' Exile is not linear, and you can kill the first four bosses in any order. The initial room leads directly to each sub-level, with Duncan's room opening once the others are complete.
14b1f099252190048ec4c769ea9f9b4f0ee6f179.text: 与大多数地下城不同，奴隶放逐不是线性的，你可以按任意顺序杀死前四个 Boss。最初的房间直接通向每个地下层，一旦其他房间完成，邓肯的房间就会打开。

b9ffcf3551874fba108f61437f4c1a89c9f9c11d.source: You don't need to defeat all of the bosses in Hard Mode to get the Hard Mode page for the dungeon book, only Duncan.
b9ffcf3551874fba108f61437f4c1a89c9f9c11d.text: 你不需要击败困难模式中的所有 Boss 来获得地下城书的困难模式页面，只需击败邓肯即可。

634181b76e909f44b5edcf26ba9da9a59f7ee409.source: If striving to complete all the sub-quests in one go, consider bringing a few Identification Kits. There is a Weaponsmith in the main area to whom you can sell your items.
634181b76e909f44b5edcf26ba9da9a59f7ee409.text: 如果努力一次性完成所有子任务，请考虑带一些识别工具包。主区域有一个武器匠，你可以向他出售你的物品。

411f1d3d26a28fb3004481b466df353d24a7a750.source: Most of the Stone Summit have some type of resurrection skill, consider bringing Frozen Soil.
411f1d3d26a28fb3004481b466df353d24a7a750.text: 大多数石峰都有某种复活技能，可以考虑带上冻土。

0978f262775fd3832a183ce18cfa514421ce2d5b.source: There are two bosses on this level, Justiciar Thommis, and Rand Stormweaver. It is recommended to do both during the same run, otherwise the exit will be blocked. The main difficulty is the large number of Dwarves that tend to aggro at the same time. Be prepared to do hit and run, or to manage large groups.
0978f262775fd3832a183ce18cfa514421ce2d5b.text: 这一层有两个 Boss，正义者汤米斯和兰德·斯托姆韦弗。建议在同一运行期间执行这两项操作，否则出口将被阻塞。主要的困难是大量的矮人往往会同时仇恨。做好肇事逃逸或管理大型团体的准备。

d9109f0e00f3ef87f428f68131dcf6b1819a1d40.source: Aside from large groups of Dwarves (see above), there are three additional difficulties here. (1) Some places have chained clerics and reavers popups, which may overwhelm groups already engaged in a fight. Pulling is recommended, as well as tactical retreats. (2) At the door right before the boss, there are popups. Each time you kill them, a larger groups spawns. There are a limited number of groups, but unprepared groups may suffer a wipe. Pulling is recommended to avoid the new group appearing on top of you. Also, these use life-stealing skills. Focus fire and general caster-shutdown is recommended against them. (3) Selvetarm and his group use Jagged Bones and Death Nova to produce a self-renewing supply of undead bombs. Using Verata skills to steal his minions will help, or some form of spike AoE damage such as splinter barrage.
d9109f0e00f3ef87f428f68131dcf6b1819a1d40.text: 除了一大群矮人（见上文）之外，这里还存在三个额外的困难。 (1) 有些地方有锁链牧师和掠夺者弹出窗口，这可能会压垮已经参与战斗的团体。建议撤退，以及战术撤退。 (2) 在boss前面的门口，有弹出窗口。每次你杀死它们，就会产生更大的群体。团体数量有限，但毫无准备的团体可能会遭到抹杀。建议拉动以避免新的组出现在您的上方。此外，它们还使用生命窃取技能。建议集中火力和一般施法者关闭来对付他们。 (3) Selvetarm 和他的团队使用锯齿骨头和死亡新星来生产自我更新的不死炸弹。使用维拉塔技能偷走他的小兵会有所帮助，或者某种形式的尖峰 AoE 伤害，例如碎片弹幕。

7e3b8f98e80cd69b496b36e9fdf94aba57152c14.source: Enemies primarily consist of large groups of fire elementals and large groups of Stone Summit.
7e3b8f98e80cd69b496b36e9fdf94aba57152c14.text: 敌人主要由大群火元素和大群石峰组成。

d180179ee6df13872496fd6490af18f49a38ef5c.source: A general strategy against this is to have a dedicated Tank/Aggro manager, a Protection or bonder monk, and a few AoE damagers. Cast protective spells on tank, have them hold the aggro, then do as much AoE damage as possible to thin out the group. A ranger with Frozen Soil is highly recommended against Stone Summit to prevent resurrection, and Gaze of Fury to remove spirits when needed.
d180179ee6df13872496fd6490af18f49a38ef5c.text: 应对这种情况的一般策略是拥有一名专门的坦克/仇恨经理、一名保护或束缚僧侣以及一些 AoE 伤害者。对坦克施放保护法术，让他们控制仇恨，然后尽可能多地造成 AoE 伤害，以削弱队伍的实力。强烈建议使用冰冻土壤的游侠对抗石峰以防止复活，并在需要时使用愤怒凝视来移除灵魂。

8a71f481984a128f60e87c0ba208b1346b7df329.source: The mobs in this area are composed entirely of Stone Summit and Restless Dead popups. The Restless Dead use Vampiric Touch and Vampiric Bite quite a bit, which can be countered with "Can't Touch This!". Refer to the other sections for skills and tactics to counter Summit dwarves.
8a71f481984a128f60e87c0ba208b1346b7df329.text: 该区域的怪物完全由 Stone Summit 和 Restless Dead 弹出窗口组成。不安的死者大量使用吸血鬼之触和吸血鬼咬伤，可以用“不能碰这个！”来反击。请参阅其他部分来了解对抗顶峰矮人的技能和战术。

98b193fa93cec894a22a712af9efd7e57f5337d7.source: Duncan the Black awaits in a large room full of Restless Dead popups. Sweeping the room to popup and killing all foes makes the following fight easier.
98b193fa93cec894a22a712af9efd7e57f5337d7.text: 黑人邓肯在一个充满“不安死者”弹出窗口的大房间里等待着。扫荡房间弹出并杀死所有敌人使接下来的战斗变得更容易。

588b1f412b08cc3a8d5bba806e806a0b45d7bf3e.source: When approaching Duncan, several groups of Spirits will appear. Not only will these spirits damage, blind and disenchant you, several of Duncan's skills profit from having a spirit within earshot as well. These spirits will respawn when killed, but it is possible to move them away using Swap before engaging Duncan.
588b1f412b08cc3a8d5bba806e806a0b45d7bf3e.text: 当接近邓肯的时候，就会出现几群魂灵。这些灵魂不仅会伤害、致盲和驱散你的迷惑，而且邓肯的一些技能也会因在听力范围内的灵魂而受益。这些灵魂在被杀死后会重生，但在与邓肯交战之前可以使用交换将它们移开。

b25226bd6963771627fe98d608ae2b43d9be9789.source: Duncan himself uses Duncan's Defense, which deals twice the damage he takes back to you. Don't damage him too quickly, or your healers will struggle to keep you alive. This can be circumvented by using life stealing or health loss instead of damage. Due to his large amount of health, Spoil Victor works great.
b25226bd6963771627fe98d608ae2b43d9be9789.text: 邓肯本人使用邓肯防御，造成的伤害是他对你造成的伤害的两倍。不要太快地伤害他，否则你的治疗师将很难让你活下去。这可以通过使用生命窃取或健康损失而不是伤害来规避。由于他的生命值很高，Spoil Victor 的表现非常出色。

f8aa317b84f4b696d4aeb9853b2cd7505e06c9f9.source: Once Duncan is dead, the spirits will disappear.
f8aa317b84f4b696d4aeb9853b2cd7505e06c9f9.text: 一旦邓肯死了，灵魂就会消失。

a092e89f326e6a522eb37b940a6c3deb03688209.source: You can leave the dungeon at any time between completing the rooms of the bosses. The game records any killed bosses as killed in the quest log. The log will not be reset.
a092e89f326e6a522eb37b940a6c3deb03688209.text: 您可以在完成 Boss 房间之间的任何时间离开地牢。游戏会在任务日志中记录所有被杀死的 Boss。日志不会被重置。

a8ee84dd70f9adf2c0c4b9a0fcf38a163e6c0886.source: This quest also rewards 5000 Norn reputation points for first time completion. 2500 Norn reputation are awarded upon repeat.
a8ee84dd70f9adf2c0c4b9a0fcf38a163e6c0886.text: 首次完成此任务还会奖励 5000 诺恩声望点。重复获得 2500 诺恩声望。

ed3907c2c4a544c1a366ab85055db3a7b0f510e1.source: To gain access to Duncan's dungeon, all party members must kill the preceding four bosses Justiciar Thommis, Rand Stormweaver, Selvetarm and Forgewight as shown in The Last Hierophant quest. The 4 "defeat" lines must be crossed off leaving only "Destroy Duncan the Black" left undone. This situation is frequently abbreviated "4/5". Once you have completed the quest, you will need to retake it and kill the other bosses before you can face Duncan again.
ed3907c2c4a544c1a366ab85055db3a7b0f510e1.text: 要进入邓肯的地牢，所有队伍成员都必须杀死前面的四个头目正义者汤米斯、兰德·斯托姆韦弗、席尔维塔姆和福吉威特，如《最后的圣职者》任务中所示。 4 条“失败”线必须划掉，只留下“消灭黑邓肯”未完成。这种情况通常缩写为“4/5”。完成任务后，您需要重新接受任务并杀死其他 Boss，然后才能再次面对邓肯。

93587988b81627dc9f137fbd62df9e5f808e6a30.source: Destroy the Shadow Overlords. You have [4...0] Shadow Overlords left.
93587988b81627dc9f137fbd62df9e5f808e6a30.text: 消灭暗影霸主。你还剩下 [4...0] 个暗影霸主。

19d233e31311f3264e914757efa15d67b855045b.source: Return to Miko the Unchained for your reward.
19d233e31311f3264e914757efa15d67b855045b.text: 返回到不受束缚的米科那里领取奖励。

d1461ccfac850414de699634b3050356ed4d8cd5.source: Clear the Burning Forest before accepting this quest, otherwise you will have to deal with the original mobs while you tackle those spawned by the quest. As long as you can control how many mobs you confront at once, the area is easy. However, it is often difficult to do this because they have overlapping patrol routes. If you start to get overwhelmed, get as far away as quickly as you can; the groups will sometimes follow you almost all the way back to Miko.
d1461ccfac850414de699634b3050356ed4d8cd5.text: 在接受这个任务之前清理燃烧的森林，否则你将不得不在处理任务产生的怪物时处理原来的怪物。只要你能控制一次面对的小怪数量，这个区域就很容易。然而，这样做往往很困难，因为它们的巡逻路线重叠。如果您开始不知所措，请尽快远离；有时，这些团体会跟着你几乎一路回到 Miko。

4925f5beb69300e0033de7c2cfdb2024e144dc83.source: The quest itself spawns four additional groups, each consisting of a Shadow Overlord and three allies. Killing these groups is all that's required to complete the quest.
4925f5beb69300e0033de7c2cfdb2024e144dc83.text: 任务本身会产生四个额外的小组，每个小组由一名暗影霸主和三名盟友组成。只需杀死这些团体即可完成任务。

50a24f14bf9249102ac948e1945bf6aae40ca4ca.source: The Enslaved Hero you save makes a slow, safe walk back to the Forest of the Wailing Lord.
50a24f14bf9249102ac948e1945bf6aae40ca4ca.text: 你拯救的被奴役英雄缓慢而安全地走回哀嚎之主森林。

0486a5fd0cc7be0b09322664a1514edcff9706d6.source: Unlike every other quest (except A Strange Request), the objectives include words highlighted in green.
0486a5fd0cc7be0b09322664a1514edcff9706d6.text: 与其他任务不同（除了“奇怪的请求”），目标包括以绿色突出显示的单词。

b7a2105171153f5ed17d2bab5a8987d7e4172e61.source: Clear Snake Dance in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
b7a2105171153f5ed17d2bab5a8987d7e4172e61.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉所有敌人的蛇舞。

3d478011d131a6eecc5735c608a89bc80bcb2045.source: The easiest way to reach this area is to first get to Camp Rankor and head out its northwestern exit. Camp Rankor is usually reached only towards the end of the Prophecies campaign.
3d478011d131a6eecc5735c608a89bc80bcb2045.text: 到达该地区最简单的方法是首先到达兰科尔营地并从其西北出口出发。通常只有在预言战役结束时才能到达兰克营地。

db0f875ef0dc04fc3389ed074e62875cc18a43d0.source: To reach here from the Northern Shiverpeaks, head south out of Beacon's Perch and through both Lornar's Pass and Dreadnought's Drift; the journey is dangerous for a party of 6 out of Beacon's Perch as the areas are filled with high-level foes. This area lets characters reach Droknar's Forge, and there is a Beacon's Perch - Droknar's Forge run to allow early access to late-game areas and prestige armors.
db0f875ef0dc04fc3389ed074e62875cc18a43d0.text: 要从北席瓦山脉到达这里，请从灯塔栖息地向南行驶，穿过洛纳通道和无畏舰漂流；对于来自灯塔栖息地的 6 人小队来说，这段旅程很危险，因为该地区充满了高级敌人。这个区域可以让角色到达卓克纳尔的熔炉，并且有一个灯塔栖息处 - 卓克纳尔的熔炉路线，可以让角色尽早进入游戏后期区域和声望盔甲。

449628c5a22b6194efbe99c7c19b35c95c96cdc0.source: There are many spots with about five or more Stone Summit corpses that do not vanish like regular corpses, exploited or not. The northern ones sometimes have a Tundra Giant corpse among them or a single hidden Nightmare. This is perhaps indicative that the Stone Summit are having difficulty gaining a foothold in this hostile area.
449628c5a22b6194efbe99c7c19b35c95c96cdc0.text: 有许多地方有大约五具或更多的石峰尸体，无论是否被剥削，它们都不会像普通尸体一样消失。北方的有时会有一具苔原巨人的尸体或者一个隐藏的梦魇。这或许表明石峰很难在这个充满敌意的地区立足。

3c35df0cc2a3333f98034443f94229332f89782a.source: There are many hidden Nightmare groups in this area, concentrated mostly around the center and towards the south.
3c35df0cc2a3333f98034443f94229332f89782a.text: 这片区域隐藏着许多梦魇集团，主要集中在中心和南边。

85ae998491562c8c6249911133e19c4e6de32003.source: Many of the foes in this area possess skills that cause knock down. Skills like Ward of Stability and "I Am Unstoppable!" will be useful.
85ae998491562c8c6249911133e19c4e6de32003.text: 该区域的许多敌人都拥有导致击倒的技能。稳定结界和“我势不可挡！”等技能会有用的。

5a8d49e2da1bcbecc77204fb9ff9c1287db811c0.source: The Tundra Giants are aggressive to Azure Shadows, and will knock them down with Giant Stomp if they are in the area.
5a8d49e2da1bcbecc77204fb9ff9c1287db811c0.text: 苔原巨人对蔚蓝暗影具有攻击性，如果它们在该区域，就会用巨人践踏将它们击倒。

db3cf37d125542c37737df929ffebeb745c21de0.source: Although this area's two Giant bosses share three spawn points, they are not guaranteed to spawn; sometimes neither will spawn, other times only one will spawn.
db3cf37d125542c37737df929ffebeb745c21de0.text: 虽然该区域的两个巨人 Boss 共享三个生成点，但并不保证它们会生成；有时两者都不会生成，有时只有一个会生成。

c1b9bb04fb182dfbc2bd9ef9c7b988dfcf48c270.source: The northernmost spawn point for them is very close to the portal to Dreadnought's Drift, making it possible to rezone there to try and make a certain boss appear there if trying to Capture either's elite skill.
c1b9bb04fb182dfbc2bd9ef9c7b988dfcf48c270.text: 他们最北端的重生点非常靠近无畏舰漂流的传送门，如果试图捕获其中任何一个的精英技能，就可以在那里重新划分区域，尝试让某个 Boss 出现在那里。

3d3c5829cb6a08163558900f6a1e9b335053ce4f.source: A few Blessed Griffon groups can sometimes be seen fighting other groups.
3d3c5829cb6a08163558900f6a1e9b335053ce4f.text: 有时可以看到一些祝福狮鹫群体与其他群体战斗。

aca67942c5c381aeb9bbd41c3c603e51e8053239.source: The hidden Nightmare groups can be deadly if they are triggered while engaging another large group. Some of the hidden groups are up to 6 strong.
aca67942c5c381aeb9bbd41c3c603e51e8053239.text: 隐藏的噩梦团体如果在与另一大团体交战时被触发，可能会致命。有些隐藏团体的人数最多可达 6 人。

daa01dcacac56554a23184591465a0d828094c4e.source: The Tundra Giants are concentrated in the center and the north. With their knock-downs, it can be relatively easy for them to score a kill if unprepared.
daa01dcacac56554a23184591465a0d828094c4e.text: 苔原巨人集中在中部和北部。通过他们的击倒，如果他们毫无准备，他们可以相对容易地击杀对手。

6b532d066876ed9ce64674d13ad4068a38808444.source: Blessed Griffons employ Spell Breaker, which can be annoying to parties that rely heavily on targeted spells.
6b532d066876ed9ce64674d13ad4068a38808444.text: 祝福狮鹫会使用法术破坏者，这对于严重依赖目标法术的队伍来说可能会很烦人。

df37fbff34111ddf39b19dde9eea356f06ce33c2.source: In the north, along the high mountain path, there are several large overlapping patrols of Mountain Trolls and Tundra Giants. Take care to note their path before engaging.
df37fbff34111ddf39b19dde9eea356f06ce33c2.text: 北方，沿着高山小道，有几支山地巨魔和苔原巨人重叠巡逻的大部队。在参与之前请注意记下他们的路径。

04d2ecc0aa6ccf381398498cf084d3717ae94dc2.source: For the quickest multiple profession skill capture running, it is best to start from Deldrimor War Camp and head west through Grenth's Footprint. This will bring you directly to the center of Snake Dance within a couple of minutes, thus closer to most of the bosses, which are in the north side of Snake Dance.
04d2ecc0aa6ccf381398498cf084d3717ae94dc2.text: 为了以最快的速度获取多职业技能，最好从德尔德里莫战争营地出发，通过格伦斯的足迹向西行进。这将在几分钟内将您直接带到蛇舞的中心，从而更接近大多数位于蛇舞北侧的 Boss。

faba6efbc1107c8755e7e4ba1252fe0d4af0f4e2.source: You must have Warrior, Ranger, Elementalist or Assassin as your primary or secondary profession.
faba6efbc1107c8755e7e4ba1252fe0d4af0f4e2.text: 你必须将战士、游侠、元素师或刺客作为你的主要或次要职业。

af4c604c0992a0421ccd9b358dd4fa54e1d5064e.source: Speak with Kai Ying again to begin your test.
af4c604c0992a0421ccd9b358dd4fa54e1d5064e.text: 再次与凯英交谈以开始测试。

495b3b779275253f1c25f36c1120904c20e654c3.source: Use snaring and kiting to force Zho into submission.
495b3b779275253f1c25f36c1120904c20e654c3.text: 使用圈套和风筝迫使卓屈服。

e956542ac54899f375176dc58d402a6f1d21a806.source: See Instructor Ng for your reward

5d18e61af1ff90ca5b51b0164141a7f32a4ca19d.source: You will have been provided with skill that allows you to slow down an enemy (Warriors will receive a skill to run faster). Use these to hunt down and defeat Zho.
5d18e61af1ff90ca5b51b0164141a7f32a4ca19d.text: 您将获得可以减慢敌人速度的技能（战士将获得跑得更快的技能）。用它们追捕并击败Zho。

0cc16df20b516b7e38a6f343295e7755211e1e4a.source: A Ritualist or Ranger can body block the center of the gate with 2 spirits to prevent Zho from leaving. This allows one to defeat Zho with ease.
0cc16df20b516b7e38a6f343295e7755211e1e4a.text: 仪式师或游侠可以用2个灵魂挡住大门的中心，以阻止Zho离开。这样一来，就能轻松击败赵。

0c866b523227a2580562723469bded533558f460.source: Patrol the area and protect the Stone Singers from the raiding Luxon forces. 5 Stone Singers must survive. You have [8...0] out of 8 remaining.
0c866b523227a2580562723469bded533558f460.text: 巡逻该地区并保护石歌者免受卢克森军队的袭击。 5 名石头歌手必须生存。您还剩 [8...0] 个，共 8 个。

dd48e67166bdd98040e2f8d921ff10cb982a7e5e.source: Start from Altrumm Ruins. Follow the quest markers to the stone singers then protect them. The quest markers will lead you on a specific path (due to the complex nature of Arborstone's landscape), if you already know the locations of the singers you can find your own (possibly quicker path), or keep following the marker.
dd48e67166bdd98040e2f8d921ff10cb982a7e5e.text: 从阿尔特鲁姆废墟开始。跟随任务标记找到石歌手，然后保护他们。任务标记将引导您走上一条特定的路径（由于阿伯斯通景观的复杂性），如果您已经知道歌手的位置，您可以找到自己的位置（可能更快的路径），或者继续跟随标记。

908684d64f2f9042545cd4e7159776a7351b6319.source: When you get to the places where Stone Singers are, as soon as you get close, they will plead for their lives and two or three groups of Luxons will spawn nearby within a few seconds and rush towards them. Each group of Luxons usually have about three units.
908684d64f2f9042545cd4e7159776a7351b6319.text: 当你到达石歌者所在的地方时，只要你靠近，他们就会求饶，几秒钟之内就会有两三群卢克森人在附近生成，并向他们冲去。每组 Luxons 通常有大约三个单位。

212312afc55ca87f7ebb91fab62471bb36665542.source: If there is only one Stone Singer, make sure your party quickly surrounds him in order to act as a shield. The Luxons will aggro your party and engage the soft targets, ignoring the singer. If you have one or more Ritualists in your party, setting up spirits around the singer will also help distract the attackers, therefore allowing you to easily attack without the worry of having to protect the Stone Singers.
212312afc55ca87f7ebb91fab62471bb36665542.text: 如果只有一名石歌者，请确保你的队伍迅速包围他，以充当盾牌。 Luxons 会激怒你的队伍并与软目标交战，而忽略歌手。如果你的队伍中有一名或多名仪式者，在歌手周围设置灵魂也将有助于分散攻击者的注意力，因此让你可以轻松攻击，而不必担心必须保护石歌手。

8c1fc5c585ced6cd5f359b15c3a3b8c04813f073.source: The one location where it might be problematic is point 3 in the map above. There are three singers there and it could be hard to cover all of them since the Luxons approach from three directions, and there is usually a group of Stone Scale Kirin and Dragon Moss nearby that is hard to avoid. If you are playing with other players, spread out further and take on the individual groups. If you're playing this with henchmen, try to stand near the middle and move about as the Luxons approach to take the aggro. Please note that henchmen do not heal the Stone Singers. If this is difficult, then try to protect just one of them, since the quest can still be completed even if you lose a couple singers.
8c1fc5c585ced6cd5f359b15c3a3b8c04813f073.text: 可能出现问题的一个位置是上图中的第 3 点。那里有三个歌手，很难将他们全部覆盖，因为卢克森人从三个方向接近，而且附近通常有一群石鳞麒麟和龙苔，很难避开。如果您正在与其他玩家一起玩，请进一步分散并与各个小组进行对抗。如果你和追随者一起玩这个游戏，请尝试站在中间附近，并在卢克森人接近时四处走动以承受仇恨。请注意，追随者不会治愈石歌者。如果这很困难，那么尝试只保护其中一个，因为即使你失去了几个歌手，任务仍然可以完成。

572fae18077a0b1db84a1c19c0a0d4629c0ba6e4.source: If you have the quest Wardens On the March active in your Quest Log and follow the path put forth by the quest markers, getting to the last marker will require you to go through the large mob of Wardens from that quest. They will be waiting on the stairs between points 7 and 8 (refer to the quest map), but of course you can either avoid this mob, or save time and do both quests at the same time.
572fae18077a0b1db84a1c19c0a0d4629c0ba6e4.text: 如果您的任务日志中激活了“行军中的守望者”任务，并按照任务标记所提供的路径进行操作，则要到达最后一个标记，您将需要穿过该任务中的大量守望者。他们会在第 7 点和第 8 点之间的楼梯上等待（请参阅任务地图），但当然你可以避开这个怪物，或者节省时间并同时完成两个任务。

5a26ad418a6304c915859fde7b9eb934b041b9b4.source: If you find it too difficult to get past the mobs of the wardens in order to get to point 8, you can purposely die to get to the Resurrection Shrine. From there, backtrack all the way to the Altrumm Ruins exit and then use the back door to the cathedral. While it is a long way, there are no enemies along this route, so it easily lets you complete the quest.
5a26ad418a6304c915859fde7b9eb934b041b9b4.text: 如果你发现很难通过守卫的小怪来到达第 8 点，你可以故意死亡来到达复活神殿。从那里一路原路返回阿尔特鲁姆遗址出口，然后从后门到达大教堂。虽然路途遥远，但沿途没有敌人，所以很容易就能完成任务。

f7ccd7e4fa7355ca79f8688a0898bcf50a434cf3.source: Having the quest Charting the Forests at the same time is a also good idea as you will be easily able to complete the charting of the area with only minimal extra effort.
f7ccd7e4fa7355ca79f8688a0898bcf50a434cf3.text: 同时进行绘制森林图任务也是一个好主意，因为您只需付出最少的额外努力即可轻松完成该区域的绘制。

5a1a472b182fd19e2638f31d7f9e7da80e4745c4.source: A Restoration Ritualist should drop healing / protection spirits near the Singers. If possible, prioritize keeping the singers alive over your party.
5a1a472b182fd19e2638f31d7f9e7da80e4745c4.text: 恢复仪式师应该在歌手附近掉落治疗/保护灵魂。如果可能的话，优先考虑让歌手活下去而不是你的派对。

bcf485ba128c4757edd5a2a992e64fc6dc51b14a.source: A Necromancer hero (Master of Whispers, Olias, or Livia) set up as a minion master is very helpful to divert Luxon attacks away from the Stone Singers which you are supposed to protect in order to complete the quest.
bcf485ba128c4757edd5a2a992e64fc6dc51b14a.text: 将死灵法师英雄（低语大师、奥利亚斯或利维亚）设置为随从大师非常有助于将卢克森的攻击从你应该保护的石歌者身上转移开，以完成任务。

edf8339d3c565cbd12935772cf8748e962967788.source: If you are doing this quest with just heroes and/or henchmen, sometimes your healer NPCs will completely ignore the Stone Singers. Follow the direction of the above map, doing this quest in reverse the last 3 singers will not appear as objectives on the map and you won't be able to complete all 8 requirements.
edf8339d3c565cbd12935772cf8748e962967788.text: 如果你只用英雄和/或追随者来完成这个任务，有时你的治疗 NPC 会完全忽略石歌者。按照上面地图的方向，反向执行此任务，最后 3 个歌手将不会作为目标出现在地图上，并且您将无法完成所有 8 个要求。

8582d8d5cd2fd176790234bebe885f52f10a70d7.source: Pathing tip: After saving the trio, continue following the stream to the next point (which will be empty). After saving Treff, you will need to backtrack a bit; stay in the water until the wood ramp.
8582d8d5cd2fd176790234bebe885f52f10a70d7.text: 路径提示：保存三重奏后，继续跟随流到达下一个点（该点将为空）。保存Treff后，你需要回溯一下；留在水中直到木坡道。

4d38c5cbe9e9b33e69c9d724d34cd064d3c97ff2.source: Escort Farmer Hamnet to Ascalon City
4d38c5cbe9e9b33e69c9d724d34cd064d3c97ff2.text: 护送农民哈姆内特前往阿斯卡隆市

e6b4dcc07e25d31f44208f9660d5cdfcb1b8a4dc.source: If you came from Ascalon City by the path on the hill, you've already cleared the path out and the quest is quite easy. There will be one extra spawn of devourers near the city. Even if you don't clear the path first, just try to keep the monsters off Farmer Hamnet.
e6b4dcc07e25d31f44208f9660d5cdfcb1b8a4dc.text: 如果你从阿斯卡隆市沿着山上的小路过来，那么你已经清理出了道路，任务也很容易。城市附近将会额外出现一处吞噬者。即使你不先清理道路，也要尽量让怪物远离农夫哈姆内特。

eb28e780dd398dcf5d271f3ced415282e72c464c.source: Hamnet doesn't become an ally in the party window, but keeps himself alive with Heal Area. This could be annoying because it will heal adjacent monsters as well.
eb28e780dd398dcf5d271f3ced415282e72c464c.text: 哈姆内特并没有成为队伍窗口中的盟友，而是通过治疗区域让自己保持活力。这可能很烦人，因为它也会治疗相邻的怪物。

c80327175cc135574ccf83593a0553401f7969d4.source: Remember, as with all other "escort NPCs to town" quests, to come close to the portal but not enter it. Wait for Hamnet to come near and the quest to update. Then return to Grazden and tell him Hamnet made it to town safely.
c80327175cc135574ccf83593a0553401f7969d4.text: 请记住，与所有其他“护送 NPC 进城”任务一样，要靠近传送门但不要进入其中。等待哈姆内特靠近并更新任务。然后返回格拉兹登并告诉他哈姆内特已安全抵达城镇。
