7d97befce3d820fa6bb2ed4205753a9f524e695b.source: Farmer Hamnet often gets stuck along the path and the quest has to be restarted to continue.
7d97befce3d820fa6bb2ed4205753a9f524e695b.text: 农夫哈姆内特经常被困在路上，必须重新开始任务才能继续。

034b823e7273e2d8e53c512368916f9b11aa6cb3.source: When Farmer Hamnet gets to the portal at Ascalon City, he can be seen walking beyond the portal. You can Shadow Step into Ascalon City without triggering the portal
034b823e7273e2d8e53c512368916f9b11aa6cb3.text: 当农夫哈姆内特到达阿斯卡隆城的传送门时，可以看到他正走出传送门。你可以暗影步进入阿斯卡隆城而不触发传送门

40a851a4631d7e5ceccc158870bae95802bc924e.source: Clear Sparkfly Swamp in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
40a851a4631d7e5ceccc158870bae95802bc924e.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉的闪光沼泽中的所有敌人。

7df7126085269e7de9c8712b0da7c7b6ea59b4c6.source: The quest dialogue indicates that Sparkfly Swamp is part of the Southern Shiverpeaks when it is actually part of Tarnished Coast.
7df7126085269e7de9c8712b0da7c7b6ea59b4c6.text: 任务对话表明，闪光沼泽是南部席瓦山脉的一部分，而实际上它是玷污海岸的一部分。

189d151b149297353d56d04c3f86ff9ad31871ee.source: Saidra's Ashes can be found in the northwest corner of this area.
189d151b149297353d56d04c3f86ff9ad31871ee.text: 赛德拉的骨灰位于该区域的西北角。

be98a35c8a0160e501a3bdea26cf4e7da31cc894.source: Including quest influences, it has been reported to range from 310 to 353.
be98a35c8a0160e501a3bdea26cf4e7da31cc894.text: 据报道，包括任务影响在内，范围在 310 到 353 之间。

68ab1dee327e527adf6ece5ed0a85e82014a201b.source: Some Arachnid groups have additional hidden Arachnids that popup when you engage them. Approaching from the North is highly recommended.
68ab1dee327e527adf6ece5ed0a85e82014a201b.text: 一些蛛形纲动物群体有额外的隐藏蛛形纲动物，当你与它们交战时会弹出。强烈建议从北方接近。

440e8ca33e919b9f8fe0a37353528ca655b2b463.source: Beware of overlapping patrols among the dinosaurs and the Heket.
440e8ca33e919b9f8fe0a37353528ca655b2b463.text: 小心恐龙和赫克特之间的重叠巡逻。

922bc9e86943fb91d691742cd069bfa3ece5e24f.source: If you accept either Giriff's War or Tekks's War, the associated NPC will follow you as an ally and help with the vanquish.
922bc9e86943fb91d691742cd069bfa3ece5e24f.text: 如果您接受吉里夫之战或泰克斯之战，相关的 NPC 将作为盟友跟随您并帮助您战胜敌人。

56b816d9d0ca9e245790cd11917ee7f9200abe89.source: If you have not yet obtained Hayda as a hero, she will join as an ally for the vanquish if you have one of the associated quests and approach her location.
56b816d9d0ca9e245790cd11917ee7f9200abe89.text: 如果你还没有获得海达作为英雄，如果你有相关任务之一并接近她的位置，她将作为征服者的盟友加入。

cf8f854a63b431c5de5532bf601c1253757aba16.source: The quest Finding Gadd will spawn 3 Inscribed Ettin bosses, providing bonus reputation points for defeating them.
cf8f854a63b431c5de5532bf601c1253757aba16.text: 任务“寻找加德”将产生 3 个铭文埃丁 Boss，为击败它们提供额外的声望点。

08347f350a17e64adc358a8b514bb891427d57eb.source: In the northwest area approaching the water is a view of a head carved from a mountain, with a waterfall flowing from its mouth.
08347f350a17e64adc358a8b514bb891427d57eb.text: 西北临水处有一山雕头像，嘴中有瀑布流淌。

c120fd4c5d4957cfbafd515de67babf6251f25a4.source: The Zaishen Vanquish quest indicates that the Sparkfly Swamp is part of the Southern Shiverpeaks.
c120fd4c5d4957cfbafd515de67babf6251f25a4.text: Zaishen Vanquish 任务表明 Sparkfly 沼泽是南部席瓦山脉的一部分。

419465d84f21c8806ea7729d20e974dacc581a0c.source: Clear Spearhead Peak in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
419465d84f21c8806ea7729d20e974dacc581a0c.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉中的矛头峰所有敌人。

73a46520082eee56a7bcf693db04a8bd532349cd.source: The Elder Wolf will be charmed by an enemy ranger. He won't start charming it until you're close enough. One option is to flag your heroes close, and hope they can interrupt his Charm Animal skill.
73a46520082eee56a7bcf693db04a8bd532349cd.text: 老狼会被敌方游侠迷住。在你们足够接近之前，他不会开始迷恋它。一种选择是将你的英雄标记为接近，并希望他们能够打断他的魅惑动物技能。

d2cf74099d81a7f02dcd02e0aea6a30b3aa8dbe9.source: Consider Mantra of Frost and some points in Inspiration Magic to counter the cold damage from Ice Imps and Siege Ice Golems. Spread out to minimize the effects of Maelstrom and Deep Freeze.
d2cf74099d81a7f02dcd02e0aea6a30b3aa8dbe9.text: 考虑冰霜咒语和灵感魔法中的一些点来对抗冰小鬼和攻城冰傀儡的寒冷伤害。展开以尽量减少漩涡和深度冻结的影响。

1a639cbbe8a2f3715549e509bdc3258e0751c2c9.source: Sometimes, a mob spawns beyond the portal to Grenth's Footprint.
1a639cbbe8a2f3715549e509bdc3258e0751c2c9.text: 有时，怪物会在通往古兰斯足迹的传送门之外生成。

bce223921f8e2b3b14f3cd96236c5fd7dd9a93ee.source: The appropriate copy of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans.
bce223921f8e2b3b14f3cd96236c5fd7dd9a93ee.text: 加密夏尔作战计划的相应副本。

618c25329a2fa1f27fab23ea51bc42587ffe05bc.source: A Charr Battle Plan Decoder from Captain Langmar.
618c25329a2fa1f27fab23ea51bc42587ffe05bc.text: 兰玛船长的夏尔作战计划解码器。

d2a346061ec4bb05f1c6e3eb9b7dc4f18285b5dc.source: Find and annihilate all three Charr companies in Dragon's Gullet.
d2a346061ec4bb05f1c6e3eb9b7dc4f18285b5dc.text: 找到并消灭龙之咽喉中的全部三个夏尔连队。

6092f3cf69f99647e1aee745765b0f4e2a6f1e39.text: 100 名夏尔中的 X 名被杀死。

faa2d3d1ef54b66063dfab28051da61ca46a57ac.source: 1,000 Vanguard reputation points [with Ebon Vanguard rank 7 or less]
faa2d3d1ef54b66063dfab28051da61ca46a57ac.text: 1,000 先锋队声望点 [黑檀先锋队等级 7 或以下]

b9e056a354362a79efc6c14b86d37c4347cb6dc4.source: You start in a random location in Dragon's Gullet. Charr patrols travel around the southernmost tar lake. There is a single Siege Devourer to the north, 2 more to the east, a large group of low-level Charr to the southwest and a group containing a single Charr Lord is to the north. After killing all 100 Charr, your party will be transported to Longeye's Ledge.
b9e056a354362a79efc6c14b86d37c4347cb6dc4.text: 你从龙之食道的随机位置开始。夏尔巡逻队在最南端的焦油湖周围巡逻。北边有一个攻城吞噬者，东边还有两个，西南方向有一大群低级夏尔，北边有一个包含一个夏尔领主的群体。杀死全部 100 名夏尔后，你的队伍将被传送至长眼壁架。

af8da2e0d67f036c2314457d00e4700c7678f3a9.source: To activate the mission, double-click on the decoder and drag and drop the associated Encrypted Charr Battle Plans into it. With the decoded plans still inside the decoder, talk to Captain Langmar, who will now have a dialogue option to enter the mission.
af8da2e0d67f036c2314457d00e4700c7678f3a9.text: 要激活任务，请双击解码器并将相关的加密 Charr 战斗计划拖放到其中。解码后的计划仍在解码器内，与朗玛队长交谈，他现在将有一个对话选项来进入任务。

a1e98e18904a4d67a52a270ccaabce84f079354a.source: When you accept this mission, Captain Langmar takes both your decoder and the battle plans that were inside it, so make sure your party is ready to go beforehand.
a1e98e18904a4d67a52a270ccaabce84f079354a.text: 当你接受这个任务时，朗玛队长会拿走你的解码器和里面的战斗计划，所以请确保你的队伍提前做好出发的准备。

f931b155276b9426ea746f76a0fddb1067dcd395.source: The reward for this quest is received automatically after completing the objectives.
f931b155276b9426ea746f76a0fddb1067dcd395.text: 完成目标后会自动收到此任务的奖励。

34d0b08cd31e2ab9899a9a2183faee89ec9bdefd.source: There is no reward if your Ebon Vanguard rank is 8 or higher.
34d0b08cd31e2ab9899a9a2183faee89ec9bdefd.text: 如果您的黑锋先锋等级达到 8 或更高，则不会获得任何奖励。

e25a74700c6bc1137f48d4d22ac62995ef76a29d.source: If your party is defeated, you will need to acquire a new set of Encrypted Charr Battle Plans to restart it.
e25a74700c6bc1137f48d4d22ac62995ef76a29d.text: 如果你的队伍被击败，你将需要获得一套新的加密夏尔战斗计划来重新启动它。

816fb78be8eba0888aa9e7897c34df14f0d79da3.source: Walking through the tar lakes will not cause the Tar environment effect.
816fb78be8eba0888aa9e7897c34df14f0d79da3.text: 穿过焦油湖不会造成焦油环境影响。

588783ba4f744a151f46b69825b54aee9d993258.source: Capturing the Siege Devourer can make your task much easier.
588783ba4f744a151f46b69825b54aee9d993258.text: 捕获攻城吞噬者可以使你的任务变得更加容易。

506d243acd631b926c85df81878c7ff5d2453a57.source: The quest does not mention that the reward can depend on your rank and you will receive the success message even if you are ineligible to receive the reputation reward.
506d243acd631b926c85df81878c7ff5d2453a57.text: 任务没有提到奖励取决于你的等级，即使你没有资格获得声望奖励，你也会收到成功消息。

135e46f2c61e51838bdb438cc367be799cd19717.source: Find and kill [Charr Boss Name], Charr legion leader.
135e46f2c61e51838bdb438cc367be799cd19717.text: 找到并杀死[夏尔老大名字]，夏尔军团领袖。

68636960cea3dda85c6a515dd95d220e8c22a703.source: You have 15 minutes to find and kill the legion leader before he escapes.
68636960cea3dda85c6a515dd95d220e8c22a703.text: 你有 15 分钟的时间找到并杀死军团首领，然后再让他逃跑。

7318d108e9da83ebdbe791e8193cd6bc56eacfc0.source: This mission is fairly short. Because the target of this mission is randomly assigned, and the bosses have different spawn locations, there will be no quest objective on your compass or minimap. You have 15 minutes to hunt your target through Flame Temple Corridor. As with other Special Ops missions, you will face a mix of high and low level Charr.
7318d108e9da83ebdbe791e8193cd6bc56eacfc0.text: 这次任务的时间相当短。由于此任务的目标是随机分配的，并且 Boss 的生成位置不同，因此您的指南针或小地图上不会有任务目标。你有 15 分钟的时间通过火焰神殿走廊追捕目标。与其他特别行动任务一样，你将面对高等级和低等级的夏尔。

6591b89d1882cb02e91f618d124aaf8d6c563ea4.source: The area will include Ascalonian Chests.
6591b89d1882cb02e91f618d124aaf8d6c563ea4.text: 该区域将包括阿斯卡隆宝箱。

fd3329666e9e8af08374ca59d35bd6223a9d8acf.source: Defend Grendich Courthouse from the Charr attackers.
fd3329666e9e8af08374ca59d35bd6223a9d8acf.text: 保卫格伦迪奇法院免受查尔袭击者的袭击。

bdc98e902604411a653f47df87e095371a315259.source: At least one Ascalonian soldier must survive. [8..0] of 8 soldiers still living.
bdc98e902604411a653f47df87e095371a315259.text: 至少一名阿斯卡隆士兵必须活下来。 [8..0] 8 名士兵仍然活着。

c1b1380a064d7aaf210de037136bcd862dc68b08.source: The 8 Ascalonian soldiers are positioned with four soldiers inside the courthouse, two at the top of the steps to the courthouse, and two at the bottom of the steps.
c1b1380a064d7aaf210de037136bcd862dc68b08.text: 8 名阿斯卡隆士兵被安置在法院大楼内，其中 4 名士兵位于法院大楼的台阶顶部，另外两名位于台阶底部。

a4518fc79c17c45591aa2b8788414cf9ec9e32ee.source: The Charr will attack in waves, alternating from the left and the right. Each wave contains a mix of level 8 and level 20 Charr, but as the mission progresses there are less level 8 and more level 20 Charr per wave. You will encounter Charr Hunters, Charr Flame Wielders, Charr Seekers, and Charr Flameshielders.
a4518fc79c17c45591aa2b8788414cf9ec9e32ee.text: 夏尔人会从左到右交替进行一波又一波的攻击。每波都包含 8 级和 20 级 Charr 的混合，但随着任务的进展，每波 8 级 Charr 会减少，20 级 Charr 会增加。你将遇到夏尔猎人、夏尔火焰挥舞者、夏尔探索者和夏尔火焰盾者。

f9ed053ff90d40d15877da3ebeeea589306aabdc.source: There will be a lot of exploitable bodies, but not a lot of time for making minions. Have skills that exploit corpses like Putrid Explosion or bring a minion master utilizing Aura of the Lich.
f9ed053ff90d40d15877da3ebeeea589306aabdc.text: 将会有很多可利用的尸体，但没有很多时间来制造小兵。拥有利用尸体的技能，例如腐烂爆炸，或者使用巫妖光环来召唤一个随从大师。

717c4241e9192c8f4f8a3919b05680b07a99c39b.source: The Charr will tend to ball up when they run in and group toward the bottom of the steps. Having spells or attacks that are AoE will help a lot.
717c4241e9192c8f4f8a3919b05680b07a99c39b.text: 当夏尔人跑向台阶底部时，他们往往会聚集成团。拥有 AoE 范围内的法术或攻击会有很大帮助。

23c4000543fc20b70893530195b7f94498c14094.source: A lot of the damage dealt by the Charr is fire damage, the Charr Flameshielders will drop both Meteor Shower and Fire Storm while the Charr Seekers will use ignite arrows. Spread out to avoid too much damage, bring party heals, and prepare for fire damage.
23c4000543fc20b70893530195b7f94498c14094.text: 夏尔造成的大部分伤害都是火焰伤害，夏尔火焰护盾者会掉落流星雨和火焰风暴，而夏尔探索者将使用点燃箭。分散开来避免造成太大伤害，为队伍提供治疗，并为火焰伤害做好准备。

c7e821020808dfa5b23c597b356057dbed0134b1.source: Rebel Yell and Mantra of Flame can greatly cut down incoming damage and give you quite a bit of energy at the same time.
c7e821020808dfa5b23c597b356057dbed0134b1.text: 叛逆呐喊和火焰咒语可以极大地减少传入的伤害，同时给你相当多的能量。

151228c3264045d052fc03d6dad8e91d743fc25e.source: Kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna in the Archipelagos.
151228c3264045d052fc03d6dad8e91d743fc25e.text: 杀死群岛上德薇娜的祝福者苏恩斯。

2d1854cbb51ff7df9f36b80087679aba70047641.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Ssuns。

6a33f78eade094f97a7cdd6c8fab77daa8887bcf.source: The route from Cavalon doesn't require you to fight Ssyn Coiled Grasp. Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south. Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss. Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty.
6a33f78eade094f97a7cdd6c8fab77daa8887bcf.text: 从卡瓦隆出发的路线不需要你与Ssyn Coiled Grasp战斗。进入群岛并向东前进，消灭你遇到的第一批鱼，然后继续前进，直到到达地图边缘并向南行驶。现在前往老板，杀死巡逻的娜迦和老板面前的两个静止的娜迦小怪。与 Dwayna 的祝福 Ssun 交战并杀死 Ssun，以完成赏金。

3b0318e863848d5432097ef61560bf4d11545b95.source: If taking the route from Jade Flats (Luxon), your party will only encounter Naga Warriors, Naga Archers, Naga Ritualists, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, and a few Kappa. Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party does not contain any allies that require attacks and attack skills to deal damage, since your party will only encounter a total of two Kappas who use Blurred Vision and Shatterstone (whose end effect triggers even if the hex is removed). Consider not bringing blocking skills, since they can be bypassed by Naga Warriors and Archers. Naga Warriors and Archers can also interrupt with Distracting Blow and Concussion Shot, so consider skills that can prevent interrupts, inflict blind or cause misses. Consider Signet of Binding for Destruction spirits created by Naga Ritualists and Ssyn Coiled Grasp.
3b0318e863848d5432097ef61560bf4d11545b95.text: 如果从翡翠平原（卢克森）出发，你的队伍只会遇到娜迦战士、娜迦弓箭手、娜迦仪式者、Ssyn盘握和一些河童。如果你的队伍不包含任何需要攻击和攻击技能来造成伤害的盟友，则不需要妖术去除技能，因为你的队伍只会遇到总共两个使用模糊视觉和碎石的卡帕（即使妖术被去除，其最终效果也会触发）。考虑不要带格挡技能，因为娜迦战士和弓箭手可以绕过它们。纳迦战士和弓箭手也可以用分散打击和震荡射击来打断，因此请考虑可以防止打断、造成失明或导致失误的技能。考虑由 Naga Ritualists 和 Ssyn Coiled Grasp 创造的毁灭束缚徽记。

4ef77702c6b8397a055db30ed52d9e85db65c964.source: Convince 5 Canthan Refugees to return to Kaineng City. You have convinced [0...5] of 5 refugees.
4ef77702c6b8397a055db30ed52d9e85db65c964.text: 说服 5 名 Canthan 难民返回凯能市。您已说服 [0...5] 5 名难民。

3073e4fa926b83c1075c4eb68aadf9c963f11fe1.source: See Attendant Yoko for your reward.
3073e4fa926b83c1075c4eb68aadf9c963f11fe1.text: 去找侍从洋子领取奖励。

8d237895ae4107e589a3dadf58da7525335e58fe.source: After accepting the quest in Maatu Keep head south through the exit to Pongmei Valley. At the bottom of the ramp there are 3 refugees. As you approach them they will wave to each other and begin walking in separate directions. There's no need to rush since they are only walking and you can easily get to all three of them pretty easily before they've gone very far. Next head a little farther south where there will be 5 more refugees who will again wave to each other and begin walking their separate ways as soon as you approach them. Just like before these are pretty easy to get to as well.
8d237895ae4107e589a3dadf58da7525335e58fe.text: 在马图城堡接受任务后，通过出口向南前往庞美谷。坡道底部有 3 名难民。当你接近它们时，它们会互相挥手并开始朝不同的方向行走。无需着急，因为他们只是步行，您可以在他们走很远之前轻松到达他们三个。接下来再向南走一点，那里还会有 5 名难民，当你接近他们时，他们会再次互相挥手，并开始分道扬镳。就像以前一样，这些也很容易到达。

a035acf1313492dc49b23310491b2b2f1da7efb2.source: The number of asked refugees does not reset itself if you re-zone, meaning you can do the quest through multiple visits of the same area.
a035acf1313492dc49b23310491b2b2f1da7efb2.text: 如果您重新分区，被请求的难民数量不会自行重置，这意味着您可以通过多次访问同一区域来完成任务。

29ae3f36c84f90559e5db63470065b738945514c.source: Creatures in the area do not attack the refugees.
29ae3f36c84f90559e5db63470065b738945514c.text: 该地区的生物不会攻击难民。

ce2e0eb141ecd36f66465a2a96b279eeed112437.source: There are a total of 8 refugees, but only 5 of them will agree to come back.
ce2e0eb141ecd36f66465a2a96b279eeed112437.text: 共有8名难民，但只有5人同意回来。

864d2e0ba22bd16d6817ae218e7f9156ab50f7f0.source: Destroy the graven monoliths and harvest their shards. Collect 10 more to complete your sample.
864d2e0ba22bd16d6817ae218e7f9156ab50f7f0.text: 摧毁雕刻的巨石并收获它们的碎片。再收集 10 个来完成您的样本。

b3bd20b21ca2b0316e26f0922f1ba3a95d486690.source: Continue to kill Graven Monoliths until they have dropped 10 Inscribed Shards then return to Awata for your reward. The Inscribed Shards are not quest items, make sure to not salvage or sell them.
b3bd20b21ca2b0316e26f0922f1ba3a95d486690.text: 继续杀死墓碑直到它们掉落 10 个铭刻碎片，然后返回阿瓦塔领取奖励。铭刻碎片不是任务物品，请确保不要抢救或出售它们。

729e7d321269407211545e533b9ab8f5cf2648b9.source: Unlike the other quests that are given in the Bone Palace, this is the only one that does not precede A Deal's a Deal, since one can acquire Sticks and Stones before turning in A Deal's a Deal.
729e7d321269407211545e533b9ab8f5cf2648b9.text: 与白骨宫殿中给出的其他任务不同，这是唯一一个不先于“一桩交易”的任务，因为人们可以在交出“一桩交易”之前获得棍棒和石头。

b8d08b5a6a4b291e2311bccf399918fea6f7dd0a.source: You have to collect ordinary Inscribed Shards, even though the quest dialogue refers to glowing shards.
b8d08b5a6a4b291e2311bccf399918fea6f7dd0a.text: 你必须收集普通的铭刻碎片，即使任务对话提到的是发光碎片。

6d0a7447757bdac53a3c5ac3a2fad2a365619a8a.source: As with other quests, if you do not have room when you accept the reward, Awata will take the 10 shards but will not give you the Ancient Artifact.
6d0a7447757bdac53a3c5ac3a2fad2a365619a8a.text: 与其他任务一样，如果您在接受奖励时没有足够的空间，阿瓦塔将拿走 10 个碎片，但不会给您远古神器。

78b5e5f81af30c1e93dfc804c2ed72aee3845b07.source: Clear Stingray Strand in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
78b5e5f81af30c1e93dfc804c2ed72aee3845b07.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔黄貂鱼海滩上的所有敌人。

a2e0fba9631ce64b4312c17404de68f19c8c51d2.source: Exit from the Sanctum Cay or Fisherman's Haven.
a2e0fba9631ce64b4312c17404de68f19c8c51d2.text: 从 Sanctum Cay 或 Fisherman's Haven 出口。

0208079fd4dec670da2f8c165d3cb0077c72e9de.source: The Royal Papers quest will affect the spawns in this area.
0208079fd4dec670da2f8c165d3cb0077c72e9de.text: 皇家文件任务将影响该区域的生成。

0b4883a4e7779ef4c989356d1c94a8be6add19e7.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.94% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
0b4883a4e7779ef4c989356d1c94a8be6add19e7.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 0.94%。

5009acbba9c9c4e29cc0fd923c99271e3fba4ff5.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 150|low = 150|high = 170|notes=Has hidden Large Spined Aloes throughout the area.}}
5009acbba9c9c4e29cc0fd923c99271e3fba4ff5.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 150|low = 150|high = 170|notes=在整个区域隐藏了大刺芦荟。}}

c0d0c8fd3ed6de88dce1d58ceb1dd1e92208a9b9.source: The Inferno Imps deal AoE fire damage and cause Burning; they can be countered by keeping spread out and by using general anti-caster techniques and/or party healing.
c0d0c8fd3ed6de88dce1d58ceb1dd1e92208a9b9.text: 地狱小鬼造成范围火焰伤害并造成燃烧；可以通过保持分散以及使用一般的反施法者技术和/或团队治疗来对抗它们。

435f4f0a79de9d85e410928834d1eb9a05350f4c.source: The Caromi Tengu include warriors, rangers, and mesmers; bring melee counters for the first two and be careful of the AoE interrupts of the Caromi Wilds.
435f4f0a79de9d85e410928834d1eb9a05350f4c.text: 卡罗米天狗包括战士、游侠和催眠师；为前两个带来近战计数器，并小心卡罗米荒野的 AoE 中断。

47fd4fdd0d3228bdf4aa58cfb93a63b7b242db8f.source: The Bog Skales use health degeneration and corpse exploitation. Consider bringing Interrupts and hex removal to use against them. A minion master can help reduce the available corpses for exploitation.
47fd4fdd0d3228bdf4aa58cfb93a63b7b242db8f.text: 沼泽斯卡莱斯使用健康退化和尸体剥削。考虑使用中断和十六进制删除来对付它们。仆从大师可以帮助减少可利用的尸体。

0b672a11cc8b21ec61c04e41003b64267c9e4169.source: Track down and destroy Thorgrim Beastlasher in Iron Horse Mine.
0b672a11cc8b21ec61c04e41003b64267c9e4169.text: 追踪并摧毁铁马矿井中的索格瑞姆·屠兽者。

ae243743eff015effe84db911817e3e43e1f0b41.source: Make your way through Traveler's Vale towards Iron Horse Mine and you will find Artemis the Ranger by the metal bridge close to the portal.
ae243743eff015effe84db911817e3e43e1f0b41.text: 穿过旅行者谷前往铁马矿，你会在靠近传送门的金属桥旁找到游侠阿耳忒弥斯。

75764eb5b50e847a71a7bb45d48d6f38dcd462cf.source: After accepting the quest, enter Iron Horse Mine and head north. You will soon find Thorgrim Beastlasher and a group of three Summit Beastmasters. It is possible to pull Thorgrim alone, but if you aggro the whole group, be careful of their knockdown skills, Bull's Strike and Giant Stomp. Once Thorgrim is dead, return to Artemis to receive the reward.
75764eb5b50e847a71a7bb45d48d6f38dcd462cf.text: 接受任务后，进入铁马矿并向北走。你很快就会找到索格瑞姆·屠兽者和一群三名巅峰驯兽师。单独拉索格瑞姆是可能的，但如果你攻击整个队伍，要小心他们的击倒技能，公牛之击和巨人践踏。索格瑞姆死后，返回阿尔忒弥斯领取奖励。

18d45da265518dff5c187603f78e1185dab284d7.source: Because of her low level, Artemis can easily be killed by nearby Stone Summit. If this happens, use the Iron Horse Mine portal to reset.
18d45da265518dff5c187603f78e1185dab284d7.text: 由于阿尔忒弥斯等级较低，很容易被附近的石峰杀死。如果发生这种情况，请使用铁马矿山传送门进行重置。

215b9c13aa12a3c8ce35e2ea70515c70b7fc250a.source: Combines well with the Helping the Dwarves quest arc since it leads you past Artemis to get to Rangil Ironbow and the mine where Minaar Stonesledge is being held is just a bit further down the path.
215b9c13aa12a3c8ce35e2ea70515c70b7fc250a.text: 与帮助矮人任务线结合得很好，因为它会带你经过阿耳忒弥斯到达兰吉尔铁弓，而米纳尔石狮所在的矿井就在这条路上稍远的地方。

dedc1fb928bc0a427092fd3429876c24845dcb3a.source: The monk quest The Wayward Monk also leads to the same area.
dedc1fb928bc0a427092fd3429876c24845dcb3a.text: 僧侣任务任性的僧侣也通往同一区域。

e2a41d1e50a83f2f7f634d2dd65d9d4143824d8f.source: Speak with Miresh about your task.
e2a41d1e50a83f2f7f634d2dd65d9d4143824d8f.text: 与 Miresh 讨论您的任务。

d4897cd6910576734fa97ebd9eaee0f126d0edf7.source: Meet Miresh on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
d4897cd6910576734fa97ebd9eaee0f126d0edf7.text: 在多赫约克悬崖上与米雷什会面。

c9f47d43cc963f7f6ea5c24184be50c2e8ecb51a.source: Fight your way to the center of the skree harpy nest and retrieve a harpy egg. Miresh must survive.
c9f47d43cc963f7f6ea5c24184be50c2e8ecb51a.text: 杀出一条血路，到达斯克里鹰身女妖巢穴的中心，并取回一枚鹰身女妖蛋。米雷什必须生存。

4d9286450fe7f235f577fea2779a45cc221fd052.source: Once you speak with Miresh, you'll find him again just inside the entrance to the Cliffs of Dohjok from the Zehlon Reach entrance.
4d9286450fe7f235f577fea2779a45cc221fd052.text: 一旦你与米雷什交谈，你就会在泽隆河段入口处的多赫约克悬崖入口处再次找到他。

ede7f59a791c7c8201c20699b2486e952fdd2dae.source: The quest to retrieve the egg is straightforward; the main thing to be contended with is the fact that Miresh dies entirely too easily, voiding the quest. A good strategy for getting around this is to stand back a ways from the quest target, then send your heroes in just past the nest. Once they've distracted the harpies, run in and grab the egg, then run away before you attract the attention of the Skree. Once you get a bit away, you can talk to Miresh to finish the quest, then head back to clean up the rest of the Skree (and resurrect any heroes which may have died during the initial assault).
ede7f59a791c7c8201c20699b2486e952fdd2dae.text: 取回蛋的任务很简单；需要解决的主要问题是米雷什太容易死了，导致任务无效。解决这个问题的一个好策略是远离任务目标，然后将你的英雄派到巢穴附近。一旦他们分散了鹰身女妖的注意力，就跑过去抢鸡蛋，然后在引起斯克里人的注意之前逃跑。一旦你离开了一点，你就可以与米雷什交谈来完成任务，然后回去清理其余的斯克里人（并复活在最初攻击中可能死亡的任何英雄）。

ddcc651c604cd61aaf0db820a46f6074f08b388f.source: Starting from The Marketplace follow along the northern edge until you reach the bridge closest to the northwestern end. Getting to Quufu will be difficult; the small island has a number of enemies and a large group of them constantly patrols around it. Pulling one group of enemies will spawn another which may end up pulling another nearby group, leading to you quickly being swarmed and wiped. Quufu will initially be alone, but if you step in the immediate vicinity of the asterisk on your minimap, a mob will spawn with him. You can pull Quufu away using ranged attacks, and aggro him separately, preventing the additional spawns. Killing him ends the quest.
ddcc651c604cd61aaf0db820a46f6074f08b388f.text: 从市场出发，沿着北边缘行驶，直到到达最靠近西北端的桥梁。去曲阜会很困难；这个小岛有很多敌人，并且有一大群敌人不断在它周围巡逻。拉动一组敌人会产生另一组敌人，最终可能会拉动附近的另一组敌人，导致您很快被包围并消灭。曲夫一开始是孤独的，但如果你踏入小地图上星号的附近，就会有一群生物和他一起生成。你可以使用远程攻击将 Quufu 拉开，然后单独攻击他，防止额外出现。杀了他就结束了任务。

4504360c152012ea4c78f3a05ebad669c9db3f33.source: Though Quufu has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns.
4504360c152012ea4c78f3a05ebad669c9db3f33.text: 虽然曲夫有女性的外表，但他被用男性代词指称。

9be07189651aa6436ec54d9f74b937f775262534.source: Travel to the Alkali Pan and request an audience with the undead warlord.
9be07189651aa6436ec54d9f74b937f775262534.text: 前往碱锅并请求会见不死军阀。

5b935657f9a4a714f4caf50bf0a1ae46c84f4b63.source: Defeat Kareh Ossa and his undead guards.
5b935657f9a4a714f4caf50bf0a1ae46c84f4b63.text: 击败卡雷·奥萨和他的不死守卫。

cef2d4632466988d6a58baf12b3b14a4051e9d7f.source: See General Farrund for your reward.
cef2d4632466988d6a58baf12b3b14a4051e9d7f.text: 去找法伦德将军领取奖励。

bc10a6330d2733a85e916db211cc1f21f97ca0b0.source: Head west into the Alkali Pan and meet with General Farrund just outside the Bone Palace. Activate the Wurm Spoor and head North West following the quest marker on your compass.The wurms will deposit your party on land just before the warlord, Kareh Ossa, and a small group of Royal Guards, just south of the Ruins of Morah. After a short speech, Kareh and his guards will turn hostile and attack the party, but their small number can be easily defeated. When they are dispatched, talk with General Farrund for your reward.
bc10a6330d2733a85e916db211cc1f21f97ca0b0.text: 向西进入碱锅，在白骨宫殿外与法伦德将军会面。激活亚龙足迹并按照指南针上的任务标记向西北方向前进。亚龙会将您的队伍安置在军阀卡雷·奥萨和一小群皇家卫队前面的陆地上，就在莫拉废墟的南边。简短的讲话后，卡雷和他的卫兵会转而攻击该党，但他们的人数很少，很容易被击败。当他们被派遣时，与法伦德将军交谈以获得奖励。

65c3dd75b8a10caf8bea15fa06f50c288dd75de4.source: Can easily be completed at the same time as the primary quest that follows the same route: Horde of Darkness.
65c3dd75b8a10caf8bea15fa06f50c288dd75de4.text: 可以轻松地与遵循相同路线的主要任务同时完成：黑暗部落。

3fc5bcb80d870dd73a273c5e6e59414e571dfeee.source: Bring justice to all the unscrupulous peddlers.

5f14fb07c99050b824bef7605a60fd3c750296d0.source: You have eliminated [0...5] of the 5 peddlers.
5f14fb07c99050b824bef7605a60fd3c750296d0.text: 您已经消灭了 5 个小贩中的 [0...5] 个。

3ddfd1b654d35e3731c90a3828b2dff3187c2f5d.source: Enter Wajjun Bazaar from the Marketplace and head west along the waterfront, dispensing the small groups of Jade Brotherhood you meet along the way. When approaching a peddler, four Am Fah Assassins will spawn. The peddlers themselves will not attack. Defeat Rai Kazu, then turn south and defeat Doctor Jung immediately afterward. Follow the quest marker southeast to Xang, and south again to Pe Ling. Follow the path to the west, which will then lead you southeast to Naiju.
3ddfd1b654d35e3731c90a3828b2dff3187c2f5d.text: 从市场进入 Wajjun Bazaar，然后沿着海滨向西行驶，分发沿途遇到的一小群翡翠兄弟会。当接近小贩时，会出现四名 Am Fah 刺客。小贩本身不会攻击。击败雷和，然后转向南方并立即击败郑博士。沿着任务标记向东南方向前往Xang，然后再次向南到达Pe Ling。沿着小路向西走，然后向东南方向到达内州。

7b4b638fc18667dec841fe9ecf4b58061a91aa6a.source: Once all five peddlers and their summoned assassins are defeated, return to Emperor's Hand for your reward.
7b4b638fc18667dec841fe9ecf4b58061a91aa6a.text: 击败所有五个小贩和他们召唤的刺客后，返回皇帝之手领取奖励。

a5b61d2f0108ecb563f4297405397c8ed26fe398.source: The Am Fah are level 26 in hard mode, while the peddlers are level 20 as usual since they are allied before approaching them.
a5b61d2f0108ecb563f4297405397c8ed26fe398.text: Am Fah 在困难模式下为 26 级，而小贩则像往常一样为 20 级，因为他们在接近他们之前已经结盟了。

100e6424458c92858ea28971ef29ed29bbf15e4d.source: This quest goes well with Closer to the Stars as the last peddler is close to Loud Kou, the NPC needed to finish that quest.
100e6424458c92858ea28971ef29ed29bbf15e4d.text: 这个任务与靠近星星很相配，因为最后一个小贩靠近大声寇，这是完成该任务所需的 NPC。

0f31a22d7f94cb738265d47d8d65467a3b28e2a6.source: Leaving the area restarts the quest.
0f31a22d7f94cb738265d47d8d65467a3b28e2a6.text: 离开该区域将重新开始任务。

c92f7ac5f74e5b912c8d4eef777cd7a1c6f4bf61.source: * Student Sousuke neither active nor completed
c92f7ac5f74e5b912c8d4eef777cd7a1c6f4bf61.text: *学生宗介既不活跃也不完成

5ecd54da0275ffff15fa4e7249127e42a9274e79.source: Travel to Zehlon Reach and bond with Acolyte Jin through battle against one of Balthazar's Eternals.
5ecd54da0275ffff15fa4e7249127e42a9274e79.text: 前往泽隆河段，通过与巴尔萨泽的一位永恒者的战斗，与侍僧金结下不解之缘。

a3db03dbae4f312fd8bc17374d2f083963d607cc.source: See Field General Hayao for your reward.
a3db03dbae4f312fd8bc17374d2f083963d607cc.text: 去找隼雄陆军将军领取奖励。

00f007e8fe6485cb14eeb874e688ffa2e1e5e75c.source: After talking with Field General Hayao after Zaishen Elite in the Plains of Jarin make your way to The Astralarium. Enter Zehlon Reach and proceed south to find Acolyte Jin, Balthazar's Eternal, and two Ghostly Griffons. Defeat the Eternals and report back to Field General Hayao at the Sun Docks.
00f007e8fe6485cb14eeb874e688ffa2e1e5e75c.text: 与哈姚将军交谈后，在贾林平原的再神精英之后，前往星辰馆。进入泽隆河段并继续向南找到侍僧金、巴尔萨泽的永恒者和两只幽灵狮鹫。击败永恒族并向太阳码头的隼雄将军报告。

ac412d87278cf6cc2f11a2dc2c50eb4afde6a095.source: * Student Jin neither active nor completed
ac412d87278cf6cc2f11a2dc2c50eb4afde6a095.text: * 金同学既不活跃也不完成

8de58718479543f6c3ba7f6448b19abb6e58d86b.source: Travel to Zehlon Reach and bond with Acolyte Sousuke through battle against one of Balthazar's Eternals.
8de58718479543f6c3ba7f6448b19abb6e58d86b.text: 前往泽隆河段，与侍僧宗介一起对抗巴尔萨泽的永生者之一。

905d09767d8462f651c823b6f94e20c6f7800d28.source: Follow the quest marker to the location in Zehlon Reach (west of Astralarium). At the marker you will find Acolyte Sousuke near Balthazar's Eternal and two Ghostly Griffons. Defeat them to complete the quest.
905d09767d8462f651c823b6f94e20c6f7800d28.text: 跟随任务标记到达泽隆河段（星界以西）的位置。在标记处，你会在巴尔萨扎的永恒者附近找到侍僧宗介和两只幽灵狮鹫。击败他们即可完成任务。

2f564ba0c26c67078331f4ee2540a93f48a405e6.source: Meet Yijo Tahn outside of Shing Jea Monastery.
2f564ba0c26c67078331f4ee2540a93f48a405e6.text: 在 Shing Jea 寺外与 Yijo Tahn 见面。

735dc3ffe78f799598502e279c499e985ec2f3ad.source: Escort Yijo Tahn to Tsumei Village.

7ba010a6fcfdbe1592aa0b7bbf537299a97b01b3.source: Talk to Sister Choi Ju in Tsumei Village.
7ba010a6fcfdbe1592aa0b7bbf537299a97b01b3.text: 与津名村的崔珠姐妹交谈。

5f4d03a7abf69eb39c7042857a3ee9edf92948eb.text: 请参阅 Yazoying 以获得奖励。

14c726d45f8501b740398f1c2aa1fd27b5a42cd3.source: Meet Yijo Tahn in Sunqua Vale just outside Shing Jea Monastery. It is an easy but time-consuming task, because Yijo attacks non-aggressive mantids and kappa along the way, however, if you run all the way to Tsumei Village without stopping to wait for Yijo, he won't attack anything on the way because he'll be preoccupied with catching up to you. When you get to Tsumei Village, talk to Sister Choi Ju. She tells you to return to Yazoying for your reward.
14c726d45f8501b740398f1c2aa1fd27b5a42cd3.text: 在 Shing Jea 寺外的 Sunqua Vale 与 Yijo Tahn 见面。这是一项简单但耗时的任务，因为一城一路上会攻击非攻击性的螳螂和河童，但是，如果你一路跑到津名村而没​​有停下来等待一城，他就不会攻击路上的任何东西，因为他会全神贯注地追赶你。到达津名村后，与崔珠姐姐交谈。她让你返回亚佐营领取奖励。

90050014e31db79dceab4138c01b5508e6c8d3e6.source: Similar to Cash Crops, if you completed the Zen Daijun mission with this quest in your Quest Log, you can go accept the reward even though the quest objectives do not display as being completed.
90050014e31db79dceab4138c01b5508e6c8d3e6.text: 与现金作物类似，如果您在任务日志中完成了禅大君任务，即使任务目标没有显示为已完成，您也可以去接受奖励。

71e3d42912649a8850c72766d360fb799df3531b.source: Yijo will not spawn if The Shrine of Maat or A Strange Request is active.
71e3d42912649a8850c72766d360fb799df3531b.text: 如果“玛特神殿”或“奇怪的请求”处于活动状态，Yijo 将不会生成。

23d1b7385059fe386d408775c82f7d9aad43bc8f.source: If Yijo accidentally damages an Ox during this quest, he will be able to attack and kill it
23d1b7385059fe386d408775c82f7d9aad43bc8f.text: 如果 Yijo 在这个任务中意外伤害了一头牛，他将能够攻击并杀死它

39ebb96bc6a84b9883b5ebc4f10e86a840896059.source: Enter Sorrow's Furnace without To Sorrow's Furnace subquests.
39ebb96bc6a84b9883b5ebc4f10e86a840896059.text: 进入“悲伤熔炉”，但没有“悲伤熔炉”子任务。

8ce268589e918f6d08e7d9da0b4b14cbf8006ff5.source: Deliver 5 Scrolls of Rebellious Rhetoric to the Dredge Slaves.
8ce268589e918f6d08e7d9da0b4b14cbf8006ff5.text: 将 5 个叛逆言论卷轴交付给挖泥奴隶。

2ded47740b353e53488f44b1d31b419eac5487c4.text: 去找莫拉切夫领取奖励。

6a1fd774882598dfc37b0b132069ac8b8fa11b81.source: This quest does not guide you with any quest marker. As you wander around Sorrow's Furnace, you will come across many Dredge Slaves scattered about singly. Simply talk to the first five that you come across to complete the quest.
6a1fd774882598dfc37b0b132069ac8b8fa11b81.text: 该任务不会通过任何任务标记来指导您。当你在悲伤熔炉周围闲逛时，你会遇到许多分散的挖掘奴隶。只需与你遇到的前五个人交谈即可完成任务。

8c25db9e46cac87df9809d62b5c01e5bb5537edc.source: It's useful to perform this quest while doing Tasca's Reprise and Political Ramifications, the other two quests that require that the main Sorrows Furnace quests not be active.
8c25db9e46cac87df9809d62b5c01e5bb5537edc.text: 在执行塔斯卡的重演和政治后果时执行此任务很有用，这两个任务要求主悲伤熔炉任务不处于活动状态。

40a468ab3d7695760761b2d6bd665da008634b52.source: Find Ola the Fantastical in the Mirror of Lyss and convince him to perform in the new play.
40a468ab3d7695760761b2d6bd665da008634b52.text: 在里斯之镜中找到神奇奥拉并说服他在新剧中表演。

38d96756c46b1573936dc5dfe5651c61a06416a7.source: Find Amadi and free her from the Kournans.
38d96756c46b1573936dc5dfe5651c61a06416a7.text: 找到阿玛迪并将她从库南家族手中解救出来。

c7b8b609e685a9f4d1b593dd737b53f05f903af4.source: Convince Amadi she must appear in the new play.
c7b8b609e685a9f4d1b593dd737b53f05f903af4.text: 说服阿玛迪她必须出现在新剧中。

0f4e7684750d1ab3b35487b86f3ee2087c33450e.source: See Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.
0f4e7684750d1ab3b35487b86f3ee2087c33450e.text: 去找剧院经理达迪领取奖励。

f7974eeb9e134b98adb39455a697f570d7807128.source: Ola can be found very close to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh; head out of the east exit to reach him.
f7974eeb9e134b98adb39455a697f570d7807128.text: Ola 位于 Sebelkeh 大法院附近；从东出口出去去找他。

02a962f4e2fdb0ed473125600b7930c753242497.source: Ola has a lot of potential dialogue routes to go through before he'll accept the offer to act in the play (see below). One route however will end up with the player paying over 500 gold pieces to bribe Ola to appear in the play, so watch what buttons you click on! The easiest way to avoid this is to choose the second option everytime.
02a962f4e2fdb0ed473125600b7930c753242497.text: 奥拉在接受剧中表演之前，有很多潜在的对话路线需要经历（见下文）。然而，其中一种路线最终会是玩家支付超过 500 枚金币来贿赂奥拉，让其出现在剧中，所以请注意您点击了哪些按钮！避免这种情况的最简单方法是每次都选择第二个选项。

5a2729f991b3e1b4d70288163f87042673f9212c.source: Amadi is being held prisoner in the south-western corner of Resplendent Makuun, so map-travel to Yahnur Market as the closest outpost, otherwise you will have to travel south from Honur Hill. There is a single group of Kournans guarding Amadi, and usually a small, separate, group of harpies patrolling nearby.
5a2729f991b3e1b4d70288163f87042673f9212c.text: 阿马迪被关押在辉煌马库恩的西南角，因此请根据地图前往最近的前哨站亚努尔市场，否则您将不得不从荣誉山向南行驶。有一群库尔南守卫着阿马迪，通常还有一小群独立的鹰身女妖在附近巡逻。

60849dee732d8e13a7888f7299e305dc2ca53f6f.source: Once you've defeated the Kournans, chat with Amadi to complete the quest and head back to Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.
60849dee732d8e13a7888f7299e305dc2ca53f6f.text: 击败库尔南一家后，与阿马迪聊天以完成任务，然后回到剧院经理达迪那里领取奖励。

a6af508493001019fae2ce821836b3855b147cd8.source: Alternative: You can go straight to Amadi from where you get the quest, and it will skip the part with Ola, and you can just go back to Theatre Manager Daudi for your reward.
a6af508493001019fae2ce821836b3855b147cd8.text: 替代方案：你可以从接到任务的地方直接去阿马迪，它会跳过与奥拉的部分，你可以直接回到剧院经理达迪那里领取奖励。

08dde04364c94f97acc7aac784bf98d3ef7d5343.source: Despite what Ola says, Amadi is in southern Resplendent Makuun. If you do not pay Ola, he incorrectly refers to the play as "Springtime for Varesh" in his second last dialog. Speaking to Amadi will complete the quest even if you haven't recruited Ola.
08dde04364c94f97acc7aac784bf98d3ef7d5343.text: 不管奥拉怎么说，阿马迪位于辉煌马库恩南部。如果你不付钱给奥拉，他会在倒数第二个对话中错误地将这部剧称为“瓦雷什的春天”。即使你没有招募奥拉，与阿马迪交谈也会完成任务。

7449b3b39a04ead0248460f9bfc8b65830d0c40c.source: See Galen Trask for your reward.
7449b3b39a04ead0248460f9bfc8b65830d0c40c.text: 请见盖伦·特拉斯克以获得奖励。

b7f4aabe8ebf150b8edbcf58d76ecb0c78486205.source: Find Galen Trask in Grenth's Footprint, and lead him to Sorrow's Furnace. Once inside, speak to him to receive this quest. He wants you to pretend to be a slave, and to scout out five locations. He will cast Chains of Enslavement on you, which will render most Stone Summit friendly. The main enemies you'll fight will be rebellious Dredge, and nearby Stone Summit will help you. It is not possible to remove the Chains of Enslavement condition while inside Sorrow's Furnace during this quest, so don't worry about betraying your identity.
b7f4aabe8ebf150b8edbcf58d76ecb0c78486205.text: 在古兰斯的足迹中找到盖伦·特拉斯克，并带领他前往悲伤熔炉。进去后与他交谈即可接受此任务。他希望你假装是奴隶，并侦察五个地点。他会对你施放奴役之链，这将使大多数石峰变得友好。你要对抗的主要敌人是叛逆的德雷奇，附近的石峰会帮助你。在此任务期间，在悲伤熔炉内无法解除奴役之链的状态，所以不用担心泄露你的身份。

55a983f2c9c76bf228d3b8c0fd12d9baf8f18108.source: Galen Trask will sell you to Taskmaster Ironboot, who will lead you to Krak Flamewhip, who will offer five optional subquests that can be done whilst scouting the locations for Trask. These quests will take you to places close to the spots you'll have to scout for Galen. For more information on these subquests, see the entries: Cold One, Fire in the Hole, Gathering Resources, Unruly Slaves, and Wrenches In The Gears. If you don't want to bother with the subquests, simply follow your direction arrows to scout out locations. If you wish to do the subquests, have a look at Gathering Resources first and speak to Tharn Stonerift, as he will ask you to gather iron ore that can be found in the course of completing the other subquests.
55a983f2c9c76bf228d3b8c0fd12d9baf8f18108.text: 盖伦·特拉斯克会把你卖给模仿大师铁靴，他会带你去克拉克·火鞭，后者会提供五个可选的子任务，可以在侦察特拉斯克的位置时完成。这些任务将带你前往寻找盖伦的地点附近的地方。有关这些子任务的更多信息，请参阅条目：Cold One、Fire in the Hole、Gathering Resources、Unruly Slaves 和 Wrenches In The Gears。如果您不想打扰子任务，只需按照方向箭头侦察位置即可。如果你想完成子任务，请先查看收集资源并与 Tharn Stonerift 交谈，因为他会要求你收集在完成其他子任务过程中可以找到的铁矿石。

c76af716b54f41e2f55603f9a78075ad315b3c0f.source: Accepting a subquest from Krak Flamewhip will spawn a number of foes. The main Summit Slaves quest is a lot easier to complete without accepting any of these subquests. Alternatively, it's possible (though it'll take a long time) to complete the main Summit Slaves quest and then go to Krak Flamewhip to accept his subquests. These will be less difficult seeing that you'll already have killed most of the foes.
c76af716b54f41e2f55603f9a78075ad315b3c0f.text: 接受克拉克火鞭的子任务将会产生许多敌人。在不接受任何这些子任务的情况下，主峰会奴隶任务更容易完成。或者，也可以（尽管需要很长时间）完成主峰奴隶任务，然后前往克拉克火鞭接受他的子任务。因为你已经杀死了大部分敌人，所以这些都会变得不那么困难。

fb432555b0aeb817f816baefd44e5272d392d5f6.source: While journeying through the caves, carrying a Master Gear is unnecessary as these slow your movement rate and there is always one nearby in a working gearbox. Since the main quest (and all 5 subquests, should the player choose to do them) mostly consists of running, consider having at least one party member bring a party-wide speed boost skill.
fb432555b0aeb817f816baefd44e5272d392d5f6.text: 在洞穴中旅行时，没有必要携带主齿轮，因为它们会减慢你的移动速度，而且附近总是有一个正在工作的齿轮箱。由于主要任务（以及所有 5 个子任务，如果玩家选择执行它们）主要由跑步组成，因此请考虑让至少一名队伍成员携带全队速度提升技能。

8a382d6284efc5017eca18d2e6864865089550b9.source: When you have found a location the message "Quest Updated: Summit slaves" is displayed. Select the Summit Slaves quest in your quest log to see which locations you have visited. (Following the quest arrows in the order they appear results in a bit of backtracking, following the numbers on the wiki map would be quicker.)
8a382d6284efc5017eca18d2e6864865089550b9.text: 当您找到位置时，会显示消息“任务已更新：峰会奴隶”。在任务日志中选择峰会奴隶任务，查看您访问过的地点。 （按照任务箭头出现的顺序进行操作会导致一些回溯，按照维基地图上的数字进行操作会更快。）

7560c3e8d8e358da3ec4c0de6e62227017ac2ffd.source: Locate and destroy the source of the spirit army in the Sunjiang District of Kaineng City.
7560c3e8d8e358da3ec4c0de6e62227017ac2ffd.text: 在凯能市孙江区找到并消灭灵族大军的源头。

860eeaef559afd064b839ebfff83d0d68a886055.source: As per the Sunjiang District mission.

143a4e0f1c625d22abe9bf348b0154c6d412e666.source: Similar to its Master's Reward, the mission can be completed in under 25 minutes in hard mode for this quest's first bonus objective.
143a4e0f1c625d22abe9bf348b0154c6d412e666.text: 与大师的奖励类似，在困难模式下，该任务可以在 25 分钟内完成，以实现该任务的第一个奖励目标。

2e35f9ac3a24e33040ccdb31b5ae644aea713cf0.source: Clear the Sunjiang District in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
2e35f9ac3a24e33040ccdb31b5ae644aea713cf0.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能市孙江区的所有敌人。

505dcee7220b98a2e9280a9a29dfc7d93fb5d1a0.source: Clear Sunqua Vale on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
505dcee7220b98a2e9280a9a29dfc7d93fb5d1a0.text: 在困难模式下清除 Shing Jea 岛上 Sunqua Vale 的所有敌人。

fe8a4e3649814585136391d693eb07fe70ae2210.source: Exit from either Shing Jea Monastery, Minister Cho's Estate, or Tsumei Village. Quite a few quests from the monastery will lead you out here.
fe8a4e3649814585136391d693eb07fe70ae2210.text: 从成吉寺、曹部长庄园或津名村出口。修道院里的很多任务都会带你到这里。

81c998621631d488b1d93adb3120961afb9a9d05.source: Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 3.3% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
81c998621631d488b1d93adb3120961afb9a9d05.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Canthan Cartographer 的主打歌增加了约 3.3%。

ae7cb2169c99daefac5db8cdc220183db341d848.source: The fewest number of foes spawn during A Strange Request, which is part of the Dragon Festival.
ae7cb2169c99daefac5db8cdc220183db341d848.text: 在“奇怪的请求”期间生成的敌人数量最少，这是龙节的一部分。

6895e365ffd414ea5d6625e21d1da5774b754acc.source: A group of Kappa will jump out of the water if you approach too close the southeastern waterfront.
6895e365ffd414ea5d6625e21d1da5774b754acc.text: 如果您距离东南滨水区太近，一群河童会跳出水面。

4327b3def82fdace3ace16dfb2dba312bb70c6cc.source: Similarly, a group of Naga will show up at the eastern end of the bridge over Lake Puang.
4327b3def82fdace3ace16dfb2dba312bb70c6cc.text: 同样，一群纳迦将出现在普昂湖桥的东端。

1096c5302b0e07ac64d162ac8d7f0bb8e5bd9a3a.source: A single, hidden Lesser Oni can be found a short distance northwest from the Tsumei Village portal.
1096c5302b0e07ac64d162ac8d7f0bb8e5bd9a3a.text: 在津名村门户西北方向不远的地方可以找到一个隐藏的小鬼。

d0d4a07bc68b2aff3978b06835521e60674b88a4.source: Around 3 groups of Crimson Skull drop from trees on the northern edge of the snowy area.
d0d4a07bc68b2aff3978b06835521e60674b88a4.text: 大约有 3 组猩红骷髅从雪地北缘的树上掉落。

ce9ebde3d0affcbed83b5414af728bd955bed329.source: Zhengjo Temple has hidden single Mantids everywhere that spawn one at a time after you kill the visible Mantid Monitor next to their spawn spot. In total 2-3 hidden ones spawn for each visible enemy.
ce9ebde3d0affcbed83b5414af728bd955bed329.text: 正祖寺到处都隐藏着单个螳螂，当你杀死它们产卵点旁边可见的螳螂监视器后，它们一次产卵一个。每个可见敌人总共会生成 2-3 个隐藏敌人。

f7b42c541aefcd564b1f672fce7ca31d2b4f8b92.source: The Kappa and Mantids are hostile to each other, though they will only fight in Hard mode. The Red Yeti and a nearby Sensali are hostile to each other, and may both die fighting.
f7b42c541aefcd564b1f672fce7ca31d2b4f8b92.text: 河童和螳螂彼此敌对，尽管他们只会在困难模式下战斗。红色雪人与附近的森萨利人彼此敌对，并且可能都会在战斗中死去。

5e648131c5a1d19e5cc4cf1138d4c3cf5eb1697e.source: Wulk Cragfist spawns as a hostile for all characters and turns into an ally after being defeated, despite the fact that only Factions characters can take his quest, Revenge of the Yeti. Sometimes, a Water Buffalo (near the second rabbit cage) will spawn in the middle of two trees and be unable to move. Inside Zhengjo Temple, two Mantid Hatchlings will attack the Mantid Monitor near to where they spawn.
5e648131c5a1d19e5cc4cf1138d4c3cf5eb1697e.text: 尽管事实上只有派系角色可以接受他的任务“雪人的复仇”，但沃克·峭拳作为所有角色的敌对者出现，并在被击败后变成盟友。有时，水牛（靠近第二个兔子笼）会在两棵树中间产卵并且无法移动。在正祖寺内，两只螳螂幼崽会攻击它们产卵地点附近的螳螂巨蜥。

0ea5fada7a7b5c66d3d3d1d047c8d6c25e7374f0.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) or Canthan (Factions) character
* Guild Wars Nightfall on the account
* Sunspears in Kryta neither active nor completed
0ea5fada7a7b5c66d3d3d1d047c8d6c25e7374f0.text:
* Tyrian（预言）或Canthan（派系）角色
* 激战黄昏在帐户上
* 科瑞塔的烈阳之矛既不活跃也不完整

8ac0bf3e23f8c905aa93fe846995a0071c2e62ae.source: Speak with Kormir at Bejunkan Pier.
8ac0bf3e23f8c905aa93fe846995a0071c2e62ae.text: 与贝琼坎码头的科米尔交谈。

be185ee75e1e8585dd683d3ad63977858ae4b548.source: Defend Kaineng Center from the evil that threatens to destroy it.
be185ee75e1e8585dd683d3ad63977858ae4b548.text: 保卫凯能中心免受威胁摧毁它的邪恶势力的侵害。

7c631aa62c272a8b980ce1986a87f171566ceebc.source: Speak with Kormir at Bejunkan Pier to arrange to travel to Elona.
7c631aa62c272a8b980ce1986a87f171566ceebc.text: 与 Bejunkan 码头的科米尔交谈，安排前往伊洛纳的行程。

67b28018ab8ccc249b5071376162a3ffb5116889.source: See Seamarshal Bendro for your reward.
67b28018ab8ccc249b5071376162a3ffb5116889.text: 去找本德罗元帅领取奖励。

68dcfd5629f70ab6912c3cae5148deed1271b0c8.source: Travel to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan unlocked.
68dcfd5629f70ab6912c3cae5148deed1271b0c8.text: 前往卡马丹，解锁伊斯坦宝石。

eb3393df099b7f8123f9d0f2640d1d0938d37d70.source: This quest is an easier way to gain access to Nightfall than Sunspears in Kryta, the equivalent quest from Prophecies: the party size is eight (instead of six); henchmen are level 20 (instead of 10); your other allies will be more durable; and it can be easier to take advantage of the geography to bunch up opponents or avoid them.
eb3393df099b7f8123f9d0f2640d1d0938d37d70.text: 这个任务是比科瑞塔的烈阳之矛更容易进入夜幕的方法，相当于预言中的任务：队伍规模是八人（而不是六人）；追随者等级为 20（而不是 10）；你的其他盟友会更加持久；而且可以更容易地利用地理位置来聚集对手或避开他们。

fab9d036e09af16cbcd7c390aa5c2ba2c508c9dd.source: After setting up your party, enter Bejunkan Pier and speak to Kormir who will transport you to a mission-instance of Kaineng Center. You will be confronted by Torment Claws and various other Chaos creatures (Grasps of Insanity, Scythes of Chaos, and Wrathful Storms). Your goal is to destroy the four Chaos Rifts (large purple bubbles) without succumbing to the foes.
fab9d036e09af16cbcd7c390aa5c2ba2c508c9dd.text: 组建好队伍后，进入 Bejunkan 码头并与 Kormir 交谈，他将带你前往 Kaineng 中心的任务实例。你将面对折磨利爪和各种其他混沌生物（疯狂之握、混沌镰刀和愤怒风暴）。你的目标是摧毁四个混沌裂隙（紫色大气泡）而不屈服于敌人。

95a54a11a07c099a1ae836cc5150d3860890135b.source: Each time you stand near one of the rifts, a red progress bar will appear; it takes about 10 seconds to take down the rift and once removed, it cannot reappear. After you have banished the fourth rift, a countdown timer will appear (giving you some time to pick up any drops), after which you will be returned to the pier. Speak to Kormir again to take you to Elona. After a short cinematic, you will transported to the Sun Docks. Speak to Seamarshall Bendro to get credit for the quest.
95a54a11a07c099a1ae836cc5150d3860890135b.text: 每次你站在其中一个裂缝附近时，都会出现一个红色进度条；消除裂缝需要大约10秒的时间，并且一旦消除，它就不会再出现。当你消除第四个裂缝后，将会出现一个倒计时器（给你一些时间来拾取任何掉落物），之后你将返回码头。再次与科米尔交谈，带你前往伊洛娜。观看简短的电影后，您将前往太阳码头。与海军元帅本德罗交谈以获得任务奖励。

c63772c1fdad1f17e7a4968c72358ac889e1fe3e.source: There is no time limit for the quest so proceed slowly and avoid aggroing too many foes at once: mobs are close together and will easily cause a wipe if you move too quickly. Pull foes away from the Torment Claws so you can confront those individually; if you do get swarmed, focus on the claws first or at least interrupt their Torment Slash. A cautious team of one player and seven henchmen can easily succeed while even a well-balanced party of eight players can fail if they over-aggro.
c63772c1fdad1f17e7a4968c72358ac889e1fe3e.text: 任务没有时间限制，所以要慢慢进行，避免同时攻击太多敌人：怪物距离很近，如果你移动得太快，很容易造成消灭。将敌人从折磨之爪处拉开，这样你就可以单独对抗他们；如果你确实被包围，请首先关注利爪，或者至少打断他们的折磨斩。一支由一名玩家和七名追随者组成的谨慎团队很容易成功，而即使是由八名玩家组成的平衡良好的队伍如果过度仇恨也可能会失败。

02de35b075a11e00ea26a3f58d39fef3d6efcfca.source: Skills that mitigate damage to other allies are helpful, e.g. Shelter.
02de35b075a11e00ea26a3f58d39fef3d6efcfca.text: 减轻对其他盟友造成的伤害的技能很有帮助，例如庇护所。

a12cb684b37a198f5806a8fb20e2eac1c3b614e1.source: Interrupts to prevent the Torment Claws from using their skills.
a12cb684b37a198f5806a8fb20e2eac1c3b614e1.text: 打断以防止折磨之爪使用他们的技能。

d7be2a2c8c99787d6cd938b8b753a3ee73f4c1ce.source: This quest unlocks Kamadan, Jewel of Istan (once you have walked through the portal from Sun Docks).
d7be2a2c8c99787d6cd938b8b753a3ee73f4c1ce.text: 此任务解锁卡马丹，伊斯坦的宝石（一旦您从太阳码头穿过传送门）。

7bcea8f70952eb1522a89c17c00e343c4c6c8fb9.source: Do not leave the party immediately after the Chaos Rifts are destroyed; everyone must speak with Kormir a second time in Bejunkan Pier. If anyone is missing, you will not be able to travel to the Sun Docks in Elona.
7bcea8f70952eb1522a89c17c00e343c4c6c8fb9.text: 混沌裂隙被摧毁后不要立即离开队伍；每个人都必须在 Bejunkan 码头与 Kormir 再次交谈。如果有人失踪，您将无法前往伊洛纳的太阳码头。

7675c925de3b0fcd7e59c1534d70329510cce68c.source: You will get credit for completing the quest as long as the countdown timer begins and you wait it out, even if you are defeated.
7675c925de3b0fcd7e59c1534d70329510cce68c.text: 只要倒计时开始并等待结束，即使您被击败，您也会因完成任务而获得积分。

d90324c88f5627208c3bfeab6aeff177663876a6.source: Kormir will refer to any character as if they were a Canthan native and has no alternate dialogue.
d90324c88f5627208c3bfeab6aeff177663876a6.text: 科米尔将任何角色视为凯珊人，并且没有替代对话。

c2b52fec47fd539c999d324c965d822cf9e080f6.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) or Canthan (Factions) character
* Guild Wars Nightfall on the account
c2b52fec47fd539c999d324c965d822cf9e080f6.text:
* Tyrian（预言）或Canthan（派系）角色
* 激战黄昏在帐户上

53e1cceb83365430d9ce3df43a95185c55a87ced.source: Sunspears in Cantha neither active nor completed
53e1cceb83365430d9ce3df43a95185c55a87ced.text: 凯萨的烈阳之矛既不活跃也不完整

214046e155e042a6fb35b7bb59b97178a84206f7.source: Speak to Lionguard Bedo to gain entrance to Lion's Gate.
214046e155e042a6fb35b7bb59b97178a84206f7.text: 与狮子卫士贝多交谈以进入狮子之门。

b926ae5cd867d4b75e4c79bce6fd0d65d02ffbbb.source: Speak with Kormir in Lion's Gate.

464d23164ffecd5c87ddc90c35c46d687f31e05f.source: Defend Lion's Arch from the evil that threatens to destroy it.
464d23164ffecd5c87ddc90c35c46d687f31e05f.text: 保卫狮子拱门免受威胁摧毁它的邪恶力量的侵害。

b1ce504620112f0c3da944bb98ab0f2d3117cc95.source: Speak with Kormir in Lion's Gate to arrange travel to Elona (see Notes below).
b1ce504620112f0c3da944bb98ab0f2d3117cc95.text: 与狮门的科米尔交谈，安排前往伊洛纳的旅行（见下面的注释）。

80c16393bf1db82247feb0eab65eca1d5863f7ab.source: Travel to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan port unlocked.
80c16393bf1db82247feb0eab65eca1d5863f7ab.text: 前往卡马丹，伊斯坦宝石港口已解锁。

7aa88e6bcf9f428fdfd05f8c5f9505eadcd74ebd.source: Talk to Kormir in Lion's Gate. She will ask you if you are ready to face the danger that has come to Lion's Arch. When you respond "yes", you will be taken to the mission. Your party will be in a mission instance of Lion's Arch, with mission rules. If your party is wiped out, the quest is failed.
7aa88e6bcf9f428fdfd05f8c5f9505eadcd74ebd.text: 与狮门的科米尔交谈。她会问你是否准备好面对狮子拱门的危险。当您回答“是”时，您将被带到任务。你的队伍将进入狮子拱门的任务实例，并有任务规则。如果你的队伍被消灭，任务就会失败。

40e1f52286e06b83f6184576ada278e71bfb13d2.source: There will be some fights with high level enemies, so it's strongly advised not to go alone. It may also be difficult to complete this quest using only the level 10 henchmen from Lion's Arch. You will, however, have four very hardy Lionguard Sentries following you.
40e1f52286e06b83f6184576ada278e71bfb13d2.text: 会有一些与高等级敌人的战斗，所以强烈建议不要单独前往。仅使用狮子拱门的 10 级追随者也可能很难完成此任务。然而，您将有四个非常顽强的狮子卫士哨兵跟随您。

0c03823c13560b96a21da10a1728e553327f7546.source: You need to close four Chaos Rifts to defend Lion's Arch while fighting or avoiding groups of Wrathful Storms (level 24 elementalists), Scythes of Chaos (level 18 mesmers), Grasps of Insanity (level 22 warriors), and Torment Claws (stationary level 22 warriors) in the area. To close a rift, stand under it and wait to capture it. A red bar on the left side of your screen will indicate how far the rift has to go to close and how quickly it is closing. When the bar turns blue, the rift has closed.
0c03823c13560b96a21da10a1728e553327f7546.text: 你需要关闭四个混沌裂缝来保卫狮子拱门，同时与该地区的愤怒风暴（24级元素师）、混沌之镰（18级催眠师）、疯狂之握（22级战士）和折磨利爪（22级静止战士）战斗或躲避。要闭合裂缝，请站在裂缝下方等待捕获它。屏幕左侧的红色条将指示裂缝需要多远才能关闭以及关闭的速度。当条变成蓝色时，裂缝已经关闭。

a8f8cd9e73a8afed317a0df1254d719b478807e0.source: Each rift is guarded by a Grasp of Insanity and either a Wrathful Storm or a Scythe of Chaos, sometimes with a Torment Claw as well. You may avoid killing them while you capture the rift, but they can capture the rifts back. Be wary of other groups that may be patrolling nearby. Once all four rifts are closed, a 30 second timer counts down. You must hold all four rifts during this time.
a8f8cd9e73a8afed317a0df1254d719b478807e0.text: 每个裂缝都由疯狂之握和愤怒风暴或混沌镰刀守卫，有时还带有折磨爪。当你占领裂痕时，你可能会避免杀死他们，但他们可以夺回裂痕。警惕可能在附近巡逻的其他团体。一旦四个裂缝全部闭合，30 秒计时器就会倒计时。在此期间，你必须守住所有四个裂缝。

862e651f599b9290aee39bb4de2ae3c64e60d9c1.source: Once your party is ready, head to Lion's Gate and talk to Kormir. Travel to Elona and get your reward.
862e651f599b9290aee39bb4de2ae3c64e60d9c1.text: 当你的队伍准备好后，前往狮门并与科米尔交谈。前往伊洛纳并获得奖励。

51d4b6d1e635517fdf2328e183b058badb08afa1.source: This quest unlocks the Kamadan, Jewel of Istan port in Elona (once you have arrived at the Sun Docks).
51d4b6d1e635517fdf2328e183b058badb08afa1.text: 此任务将解锁伊罗纳的伊斯坦宝石卡马丹港口（一旦您到达太阳码头）。

fabc7a37387f08d960c534bf30bc9fa6c7733481.source: Make sure no party members leave after the Chaos Rifts are all destroyed, as you need to talk with Kormir (a second time) in Lion's Gate in order to travel to the Sun Docks in Elona. If all party members are not present, you will not be able to travel.
fabc7a37387f08d960c534bf30bc9fa6c7733481.text: 确保混沌裂隙全部被摧毁后没有队伍成员离开，因为你需要与狮门的科米尔（第二次）交谈才能前往伊洛纳的太阳码头。如果所有党员均未到场，您将无法出行。

ec0291e5fcb97665e5b175fe8046491f054d7caf.source: Consider completing Mhenlo's Request and Sunspears in Cantha rather than this quest. You fight the same enemies in both versions of this quest, but entering from Kaineng Center gives you a full party size of 8, level 20 henchmen with stronger builds, and more and higher-level NPC allies.
ec0291e5fcb97665e5b175fe8046491f054d7caf.text: 考虑完成Mhenlo的请求和Cantha的烈阳之矛而不是这个任务。在这个任务的两个版本中，你要对抗相同的敌人，但从凯能中心进入，你的队伍规模为 8 人，拥有更强体型的 20 级追随者，以及更多更高级别的 NPC 盟友。

8e535cd2edea103d0e76f6e8ec3331570ad15c9c.source: Whenever a character who has not visited Elona enters Lion's Arch, unless this quest or Sunspears in Cantha is in their log, the message "To unlock travel to Elona, take the "Sunspears in Kryta" quest from Lionguard Figo." will appear.
8e535cd2edea103d0e76f6e8ec3331570ad15c9c.text: 每当未访问过伊罗娜的角色进入狮子拱门时，除非该任务或凯萨的烈阳之矛在他们的日志中，否则会显示消息“要解锁前往伊罗娜的旅行，请接受雄狮卫士菲戈的“科瑞塔的烈阳之矛”任务。”将会出现。

d084a888f3e45b43ffc87d9aa417f2d6bc5f8555.source: Clear the Sunward Marches in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
d084a888f3e45b43ffc87d9aa417f2d6bc5f8555.text: 在困难模式下清除库尔纳向阳行军中的所有敌人。

04a8269ce414f2f8e8c9b57243a5602d20e116e4.source: Upon arrival at the Command Post for the first time, Dunkoro will offer a series of quests that will lead you here to build up the set of NPCs that will ultimately settle in the Command Post.
04a8269ce414f2f8e8c9b57243a5602d20e116e4.text: 首次抵达指挥所后，敦科罗将提供一系列任务，引导您在此建立最终定居在指挥所的 NPC 组。

2b0a505be7e519088ead4076d18e7a4dbb36dd2a.source: There is a group of Rampaging Ntouka in the northwestern corner which is much larger than the average group size for this zone. It has a patrol route that heads south.
2b0a505be7e519088ead4076d18e7a4dbb36dd2a.text: 西北角有一群狂暴恩图卡，其规模远大于该区域的平均规模。它有一条向南的巡逻路线。

7653110b61b24b34585e2e49e461ff4d2a384427.source: Kournan military outside of the garrison are level 16. Those inside the garrison itself are level 20.
7653110b61b24b34585e2e49e461ff4d2a384427.text: 库尔南驻地外的军队等级为16级。驻地内的军队等级为20级。

cc39a9731e1470ad6846ad195481e14f91284722.source: Additional allies (6) and foes during And a Hero Shall Lead Them.
cc39a9731e1470ad6846ad195481e14f91284722.text: 英雄将领导他们期间的额外盟友（6）和敌人。

16d9701206c1162fa3dfcd59369d49092cc40af6.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.0% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
16d9701206c1162fa3dfcd59369d49092cc40af6.text: 对这一领域的完整探索为 Elonian Cartographer 主打歌贡献了大约 3.0%。

8147efe637ea9fbae7b74c3b387ab2ccb10347f0.source: The large group of Rampaging Ntouka, referred to above, is deadly if a party is not prepared for the damage spike.
8147efe637ea9fbae7b74c3b387ab2ccb10347f0.text: 如果一方没有做好应对伤害高峰的准备，上面提到的大群狂暴恩图卡将是致命的。

848fc65aaaec4d768d318aedad9391f0ecb44c5b.source: To collect bounties, it is recommended to leave from Command Post going in a clockwise direction.
848fc65aaaec4d768d318aedad9391f0ecb44c5b.text: 为了收集赏金，建议从指挥所出发，按顺时针方向离开。

310f8854277dc760bae9a89d6636bce846f5f43c.source: Escort the supply column to Piken Square.
310f8854277dc760bae9a89d6636bce846f5f43c.text: 护送补给纵队前往皮肯广场。

b921527fc8fb875c05b0bdb82d64b7ffb97c2587.source: See Quartermaster Aada for your reward.
b921527fc8fb875c05b0bdb82d64b7ffb97c2587.text: 向军需官阿达寻求奖励。

e1f65c94d25e017aaf92918d978c74da5b877c21.source: After accepting the quest, enter the The Breach. Once there a Hunter will whisper to you by the entrance. Head to Piken Square by following that hunter.
e1f65c94d25e017aaf92918d978c74da5b877c21.text: 接受任务后，进入The Breach。一旦到达那里，猎人就会在入口处对你低声说话。跟随那个猎人前往皮肯广场。

1b23d17c7c77a63a85c146f265e546dce2ebd8a6.source: If you are starting from Piken Square, it is useful to combine this quest with "The Siege of Piken Square", "Fallen Soldiers" and / or "Army Life". If you do, you will automatically take the easiest way to find the Supply Bearers.
1b23d17c7c77a63a85c146f265e546dce2ebd8a6.text: 如果你从皮肯广场出发，将此任务与“皮肯广场围攻”、“阵亡士兵”和/或“军队生活”结合起来会很有用。如果这样做，您将自动采取最简单的方法来寻找补给承载者。

508f1f5117d7078a44f9cdc71081fdf9bd62b571.source: After talking to the Bearers you have to escort them back to Piken Square. Note that the Bearers are completely passive and provide no support along your way. To complete the quest, at least one of the Supply Bearers has to survive. The easiest way to ensure their survival is to head back the way you came (ahead of them) and destroy the Charr forces at the bridge before the Bearers get there. Do not enter Piken Square until the Supply Bearers catch up and you receive acknowledgement that the quest has been completed.
508f1f5117d7078a44f9cdc71081fdf9bd62b571.text: 与承载者交谈后，你必须护送他们返回皮肯广场。请注意，承载者完全是被动的，不会为你提供任何支持。为了完成任务，至少有一名补给员必须生存。确保他们生存的最简单方法就是沿你来时的方向返回（在他们前面），并在承载者到达那里之前摧毁桥上的夏尔部队。在补给员赶上并且您收到任务已完成的确认消息之前，不要进入皮肯广场。

ac84bf6ae73e566d8da91479eb8f1a23befea25a.source: Speak with Warmaster Tydus to accept his aid.
ac84bf6ae73e566d8da91479eb8f1a23befea25a.text: 与战帅泰达斯交谈以接受他的援助。

9692547eedb3b767dc7732b9f971a063ab61c07e.source: This quest is marked as completed upon accepting it. Speak to Warmaster Tydus again to accept the rewards.
9692547eedb3b767dc7732b9f971a063ab61c07e.text: 该任务在接受后被标记为已完成。再次与战帅泰杜斯交谈以接受奖励。

898e89534c1d4cda7af3b3d9309eb2a63c3d5b49.source: The Superior Identification Kit and Superior Salvage Kit are usually not available this early in Prophecies, being only offered by merchants from the Crystal Desert or later regions.
898e89534c1d4cda7af3b3d9309eb2a63c3d5b49.text: 高级鉴定工具包和高级打捞工具包通常在预言早期是无法获得的，只有来自水晶沙漠或后来地区的商人才能提供。

1e0dfd1c7c9916e243606bfa8a524df7c61c6a9a.source: Find and defeat the corsair raiding group that took Suwash. You have defeated x of 4 possible groups.
1e0dfd1c7c9916e243606bfa8a524df7c61c6a9a.text: 找到并击败夺取苏瓦什的海盗袭击组织。您已经击败了 4 个可能的小组中的 x 个。

476b5a024f52ddfd92c0a327059cbaf134b19307.source: Head south from the Sunspear Great Hall. Engage groups at points A, B, C, and D. Be careful at each point as you may draw aggro from Stormseed Jacarandas, Preying Lances, Skale, Fanged Iboga, and Irontooth Drakes.
476b5a024f52ddfd92c0a327059cbaf134b19307.text: 从阳矛大厅向南走。在 A、B、C 和 D 点与队伍交战。在每个点都要小心，因为你可能会从 Stormseed Jacarandas、Preying Lances、Skale、Fanged Iboga 和 Irontooth Drakes 中吸引仇恨。

2f4c2e69ba24e51eabfc0cfa9c4a699f0f6b112a.source: When you reach point D, the group will be slightly larger than the previous three groups, including a level 7 Corsair Bosun. Defeat them, and speak with Suwash. Travel back to the Sunspear Great Hall and speak with Sehti to get your reward.
2f4c2e69ba24e51eabfc0cfa9c4a699f0f6b112a.text: 当你到达D点时，队伍会比之前的三组稍大一些，其中包括一个7级的海盗船水手长。击败他们，并与 Suwash 交谈。返回阳矛大厅并与塞赫蒂交谈以获得奖励。

00c1afcf506b0473833f87833eaef27f491cfbaa.source: Go to Ascalon City and talk to Symon about getting a copy of his book.
00c1afcf506b0473833f87833eaef27f491cfbaa.text: 前往阿斯卡隆市并与西蒙谈谈以获得他的书的副本。

5bc06284529ff43fa130e1b4b27e3282bd215b7f.source: Find Artisan Daved in southeastern Old Ascalon and acquire 5 rolls of parchment.
5bc06284529ff43fa130e1b4b27e3282bd215b7f.text: 在旧阿斯卡隆东南部找到工匠戴维德并获得 5 卷羊皮纸。

037f0b2a2dc5b4735a4c6f8a1d498091b7eea20b.source: Take the parchment to Symon the Scribe.
037f0b2a2dc5b4735a4c6f8a1d498091b7eea20b.text: 将羊皮纸交给抄写员西蒙。

3e3b1527609f6a5e76479e96ca5c5c143dac55e0.source: Deliver Symon's "History of Ascalon" to Witness Rastin.
3e3b1527609f6a5e76479e96ca5c5c143dac55e0.text: 将西蒙的《阿斯卡隆历史》交给证人拉斯廷。

f2ba176cf20d557ca6d2bcc052d58f4ed84b446e.source: This is a fairly easy quest, particularly for the amount of experience it gives. You can even have the 5 rolls of parchment in your inventory ahead of time to speed up the quest. You also don't have to go to Artisan Daved to craft it, merely obtain it by any means, but crafting it is far cheaper than buying it from the rare material trader. To craft, you need 25 Wood Planks in your inventory and 100 gold.
f2ba176cf20d557ca6d2bcc052d58f4ed84b446e.text: 这是一个相当简单的任务，特别是它所提供的经验量。您甚至可以提前将 5 卷羊皮纸放入库存中，以加快任务速度。你也不必去工匠戴德那里制作它，只需通过任何方式获得它，但制作它比从稀有材料商人那里购买要便宜得多。要制作，您的库存中需要 25 块木板和 100 金币。

689981ed8e61144132cddb115b9c150ac4568d09.source: After talking to Symon and receiving the book you can talk to him again and receive another book if you have the required amount of rolls of parchment even if you still have the first book in your inventory.
689981ed8e61144132cddb115b9c150ac4568d09.text: 与西蒙交谈并收到这本书后，如果你有所需数量的羊皮纸，即使你的库存中仍然有第一本书，你也可以再次与他交谈并收到另一本书。

1297416c729bd6fb1de2a9007cb0c1d1fa288c62.source: Take Mhenlo and free the eight bound spirits in Tahnnakai Temple.
1297416c729bd6fb1de2a9007cb0c1d1fa288c62.text: 带着 Mhenlo 并释放塔纳凯神庙中被束缚的八个灵魂。

89a5bb2a2e449d98c2d8e11cdbdaf94f749346be.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes (30 in Hard Mode).
89a5bb2a2e449d98c2d8e11cdbdaf94f749346be.text: *奖励* 在 20 分钟内完成任务（困难模式为 30 分钟）。

a0ac81e776bcdcb6ab39e39252130cdc9c1d9384.source: As per the Tahnnakai Temple mission.

e4df4e87fcd18f15e0a842ae6a4480e431a13665.source: Clear Tahnnakai Temple in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
e4df4e87fcd18f15e0a842ae6a4480e431a13665.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能城的塔纳凯神庙中的所有敌人。

b7b04d0962916003563e42e0c88a2c57176db069.source: Clear the Talmark Wilderness in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
b7b04d0962916003563e42e0c88a2c57176db069.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔塔尔马克荒野中的所有敌人。

af4ccdb2337ce3f34af98eed9bab4e24c2b9a76a.source: You can get to this explorable area by heading north from Fisherman's Haven (with up to six in your party) or west from Temple of the Ages (with up to eight).
af4ccdb2337ce3f34af98eed9bab4e24c2b9a76a.text: 您可以从渔人港向北（您的队伍最多六人）或从世纪神殿向西（最多八人）到达这个可探索的区域。

f5d8057c43a29c7483fa05ca9e268a432b634f8a.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.43% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
f5d8057c43a29c7483fa05ca9e268a432b634f8a.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.43%。

aa01f8fdd1265dec96f646d8a0d3073250586328.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 225|low = 185|high = 244|notes=There are hidden Fog Nightmares throughout the area, encountered either alone or in pairs.}}
aa01f8fdd1265dec96f646d8a0d3073250586328.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 225|low = 185|high = 244|notes=整个区域都有隐藏的雾梦魇，单独或成对遇到。}}

36a16ca290ddcebffbb6883b7effb31c0b20dede.source: The northern path have several Inferno Imps close to each other, instead of taking their full fire power, send a tank to lure them all and ball for attack.
36a16ca290ddcebffbb6883b7effb31c0b20dede.text: 北边的道路上有几个彼此靠近的地狱小鬼，不要用他们的全部火力，而是派一辆坦克来引诱他们，然后用球进行攻击。

a29a7e7d7b7fadca47035ae683631e077404c877.source: If you start at Temple of the Ages for this vanquish, consider caravan vanquishing additional areas to the west since there are no outposts to the west that allow a party of eight.
a29a7e7d7b7fadca47035ae683631e077404c877.text: 如果你从世纪神殿开始进行这次征服，请考虑商队征服西边的其他区域，因为西边没有允许八人队伍的前哨站。

6b8fa0f3619f9817858b549e1cca8fb158815654.source: This area is replaced by its War in Kryta equivalent and the level design changes after your character has completed either Prophecies or Eye of the North. If War in Kryta is completed and your character holds no Wanted by the Shining Blade bounty, you'll enter the War in Kryta version of the map without the War in Kryta spawns.
6b8fa0f3619f9817858b549e1cca8fb158815654.text: 该区域被科瑞塔之战的同等区域所取代，并且在您的角色完成预言或北方之眼后，关卡设计也会发生变化。如果科瑞塔之战已完成，并且您的角色没有获得光刃通缉赏金，您将进入科瑞塔之战版本的地图，而不会出现科瑞塔之战。

b0f632b34f22e906762f6a67ad3a0c270d710323.source: You can only return to the pre-WiK level design version by teaming up with someone which has not completed Eye of the North or Prophecies. This is relevant for cartography, as there's a sliver of map to the north-east that can only be uncovered when exploring the original map.
b0f632b34f22e906762f6a67ad3a0c270d710323.text: 你只能通过与未完成北方之眼或预言的人合作才能返回到 WiK 之前的关卡设计版本。这与制图相关，因为东北方有一小片地图只能在探索原始地图时才能发现。

5b14814b7b5bcf76756672dd6c894fa7d9071ce7.source: It has been reported that due to War in Kryta update content, both explorable area icons conflict with each other when vanquished, the World Map will sometimes display it red and others orange. Re-logging resolves this issue.
5b14814b7b5bcf76756672dd6c894fa7d9071ce7.text: 据报道，由于科瑞塔之战更新内容，两个可探索区域的图标在被征服时会相互冲突，世界地图有时会显示为红色，其他则显示为橙色。重新登录可以解决此问题。

90870a59c67600024361c40aa5d1785d72fd869a.source: Clear Talus Chute in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
90870a59c67600024361c40aa5d1785d72fd869a.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉中所有敌人的距骨滑道。

0763a26ad62a43f027b8006329ca00321371d62b.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
0763a26ad62a43f027b8006329ca00321371d62b.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 2%。

fa22691d6e3ea973c80320436ad38f311946836b.source: There are hidden Azure Shadows in the northwestern corner of the map.
fa22691d6e3ea973c80320436ad38f311946836b.text: 地图的西北角有隐藏的蔚蓝阴影。

1b786fd945e1f50cd404585d1058423a0d93b4da.source: Two groups of Tundra Giants are easy to miss. Both patrol a long route using the mountain top path on the westernmost side of the map - one patrols clockwise, the other counter-clockwise.
1b786fd945e1f50cd404585d1058423a0d93b4da.text: 两群苔原巨人很容易被错过。两者都使用地图最西侧的山顶小路巡逻很长的路线 - 一个顺时针巡逻，另一个逆时针巡逻。

5af23b4bffb18c636e624accd7a31f8658398b6c.source: There are many forms of knock down in this area, between Giant Stomp and Water Trident. Bringing anti-knockdown skills can be a huge help.
5af23b4bffb18c636e624accd7a31f8658398b6c.text: 这个区域有多种击倒方式，包括巨人践踏和水三叉戟。携带抗击倒技能可以提供巨大的帮助。

bfef5f0d021e67e2404658ff33f42cc1d7c8f416.source: A roaming group of Avicara may also lengthen your vanquish, they range over an area south and east of the nametag on the map.
bfef5f0d021e67e2404658ff33f42cc1d7c8f416.text: 一群漫游的阿维卡拉也可能会延长你的征服时间，它们的范围覆盖地图上名牌以南和以东的区域。

f955a1d901936a296ab5bcdde28339f2f6cadcbe.source: Low-level creatures usually encountered in the Northern Shiverpeaks can be found wandering about various places in solitude. They have no special abilities that distinguish them from other low-level monsters, and do not appear to have any purpose or relation to any quest. In hard mode, their levels and skills are adjusted to a degree appropriate for the area, but they are still alone.
f955a1d901936a296ab5bcdde28339f2f6cadcbe.text: 通常在北席瓦山脉遇到的低级生物会在各个地方孤独地游荡。它们没有与其他低级怪物区分开来的特殊能力，并且似乎与任何任务没有任何目的或关系。在困难模式下，他们的等级和技能会调整到适合该地区的程度，但他们仍然是孤独的。

1bfa1218700e71753956f4fa48ca85b43f847274.source: The "troll cave" can be found to the west of Droknar's Forge, which contains many Mountain Trolls and two Troll bosses. It was once a popular spot for farming.
1bfa1218700e71753956f4fa48ca85b43f847274.text: “巨魔洞穴”位于卓克纳尔熔炉的西边，里面有许多山地巨魔和两个巨魔 Boss。它曾经是一个受欢迎的农业地点。

aab179829afd267fdc9c61ec45a6fb744a0eeaa6.source: It is possible to reach the edge of the map in the eastern Talus Chute. The terrain abruptly ends, with the sky and ocean visible beyond it. This "edge of the world" bug is an artifact of the way DirectX renders the world. It exists in all areas, but most have obstructions to prevent players from seeing it.
aab179829afd267fdc9c61ec45a6fb744a0eeaa6.text: 可以到达东部距骨滑道的地图边缘。地形突然结束，远处可见天空和海洋。这个“世界边缘”错误是 DirectX 渲染世界方式的产物。它存在于所有区域，但大多数都有障碍物阻止玩家看到它。

9167b18b7aa029218c270a3b9903cfe8469a22e5.source: There is a group which can patrol through the Icedome portal and get stuck there, making vanquishing impossible.
9167b18b7aa029218c270a3b9903cfe8469a22e5.text: 有一个小组可以在冰穹传送门中巡逻并被困在那里，从而使征服变得不可能。

dacfe032c15e4c5f9c62484b37bcb93176a9f773.source: Clear Tangle Root in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
dacfe032c15e4c5f9c62484b37bcb93176a9f773.text: 在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林中所有敌人的缠结根。

b9303eeacae9c4fe8d4f91ac270c657b3b810020.source: Exit from Henge of Denravi or travel through Ettin's Back and Dry Top from Ventari's Refuge. The primary quest Passage Through The Dark River will lead you through here.
b9303eeacae9c4fe8d4f91ac270c657b3b810020.text: 从丹拉维巨石阵退出，或者从文塔里避难所穿过埃丁背脊和干顶。主线任务“穿越黑暗之河”将引导你穿过这里。

9816b197e1bc85c3e616104b56d5c25a04ba38ac.source: Lone Jungle Trolls may be accompanied by a pair of hidden Life Pods and, rarely, a few Moss Scarabs.
9816b197e1bc85c3e616104b56d5c25a04ba38ac.text: 孤独的丛林巨魔可能会伴随着一对隐藏的生命豆，很少有一些苔藓圣甲虫。

a8194b52b197e1f3b5fee598e01aac66712b7611.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.71% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
a8194b52b197e1f3b5fee598e01aac66712b7611.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.71%。

b341c24581c9acae5f3f468fd870558d30a09c9e.source: There are (at least) three ways to reach the upper pathways of Tangle Root:
b341c24581c9acae5f3f468fd870558d30a09c9e.text: 有（至少）三种方法可以到达缠结根的上部路径：

876a0306f1f284d9e7176358c5e95f61a117eff9.source: Turn at your first left uphill after leaving Henge of Denravi.
876a0306f1f284d9e7176358c5e95f61a117eff9.text: 离开 Denravi 的 Henge 后，在第一个路口左转上坡。

1a2ec0a49f6df6ebd8591a25185c7e4a7c534441.source: Turn right after leaving Maguuma Stade.
1a2ec0a49f6df6ebd8591a25185c7e4a7c534441.text: 离开迈古玛体育场后右转。

203d9a330d75b854578e0c9dd381f44c1affa1a3.source: Turn north uphill by Old Joness and the Statue of Melandru.
203d9a330d75b854578e0c9dd381f44c1affa1a3.text: Turn north uphill by Old Joness and the Statue of Melandru.

c4a8b66bd14b68c85d0d8f6c5e9023a692facf5c.source: There a lot of hidden Moss Scarabs and Life Pods.
c4a8b66bd14b68c85d0d8f6c5e9023a692facf5c.text: 有很多隐藏的苔藓圣甲虫和生命豆荚。

72fd1720588e22c019f802b9908e16edab7c95e7.source: The count increases slightly during Defend Denravi. However, since you must kill many of these foes during the quest, some players find it simple to continue to clear the zone. If you choose to vanquish titans, be prepared for Wild Growth popups (only some of which can be avoided) and Rotting Titans.
72fd1720588e22c019f802b9908e16edab7c95e7.text: The count increases slightly during Defend Denravi. However, since you must kill many of these foes during the quest, some players find it simple to continue to clear the zone. If you choose to vanquish titans, be prepared for Wild Growth popups (only some of which can be avoided) and Rotting Titans.

82d5ee80ca4ae289b6f82517e112bf31c68a0c51.source: In the southeastern section, foes are located close by on different levels; watch your aggro range.
82d5ee80ca4ae289b6f82517e112bf31c68a0c51.text: In the southeastern section, foes are located close by on different levels;注意你的仇恨范围。

2a04065dad28c37f48721c0178fec8384d112b83.source: Clear Tasca's Demise in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
2a04065dad28c37f48721c0178fec8384d112b83.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉中所有敌人的塔斯卡灭亡。

ce723fd0959a4dc3c2e164094af75edac76c5d07.source: While Defend Droknar's Forge is active, there will be more foes to vanquish. However, you will not get vanquishing credit for the Titans that spawn from other Titans, whom you must also kill.
ce723fd0959a4dc3c2e164094af75edac76c5d07.text: While Defend Droknar's Forge is active, there will be more foes to vanquish. However, you will not get vanquishing credit for the Titans that spawn from other Titans, whom you must also kill.

733af8aa051986704b997cbcdaa90e8aba3b509a.source: The Avicara near Mineral Springs are hostile to the Stone Summit.
733af8aa051986704b997cbcdaa90e8aba3b509a.text: The Avicara near Mineral Springs are hostile to the Stone Summit.

7d3d6f9ef55d157393fb6f94b6efa0165c1201e0.source: Watch out for patrols before engaging the Stone Summit in the camp at the center of the zone.
7d3d6f9ef55d157393fb6f94b6efa0165c1201e0.text: Watch out for patrols before engaging the Stone Summit in the camp at the center of the zone.

0f852a5f545488f705a9351e1dc07bf9e257fb28.source: An Avicara near Mineral Springs may spawn behind portal requiring to rezone.
0f852a5f545488f705a9351e1dc07bf9e257fb28.text: An Avicara near Mineral Springs may spawn behind portal requiring to rezone.

425eff814e59f2f98aa943432715987a7030767e.source: A Shiverpeak Chest (or Locked Chest in hard mode) may sometimes spawn behind the portal to Mineral Springs.
425eff814e59f2f98aa943432715987a7030767e.text: A Shiverpeak Chest (or Locked Chest in hard mode) may sometimes spawn behind the portal to Mineral Springs.

8a98638e8d5203220b4a99ae5a7b27168933b7c5.source: See Marshall Whitman for your reward.
8a98638e8d5203220b4a99ae5a7b27168933b7c5.text: See Marshall Whitman for your reward.

26bde3c9d00f9ab22d1c73d5b5acdb3f30e62ffc.source: The items are easily located by simply following the quest marker, although you can probably save time by knowing where to go to minimize the distance traveled. Each item is found in a plain Chest that appears only after defeating an enemy group that "guards" it (it's the group that's targeted by the quest marker). Each enemy group consists of the same set of Stone Summit, as noted in the NPCs section below. These groups are relatively easy to defeat, just be careful of not getting entangled with more than one or two enemy groups, since their locations are usually filled with closely packed enemies. After retrieving the five items, head back to Marshall Whitman for your reward.
26bde3c9d00f9ab22d1c73d5b5acdb3f30e62ffc.text: The items are easily located by simply following the quest marker, although you can probably save time by knowing where to go to minimize the distance traveled. Each item is found in a plain Chest that appears only after defeating an enemy group that "guards" it (it's the group that's targeted by the quest marker). Each enemy group consists of the same set of Stone Summit, as noted in the NPCs section below. These groups are relatively easy to defeat, just be careful of not getting entangled with more than one or two enemy groups, since their locations are usually filled with closely packed enemies. After retrieving the five items, head back to Marshall Whitman for your reward.

84facbbab221af03658982efb878b410f604ceb9.source: Tasca's Axe - the platform overlooking the Stone Basilica.
84facbbab221af03658982efb878b410f604ceb9.text: 塔斯卡之斧 - 俯瞰石大教堂的平台。

4f198fdffe69ddc56acd08e77f37bf7a338e4f87.source: Tasca's Compass - near the southwestern corner, in Darkhaven.
4f198fdffe69ddc56acd08e77f37bf7a338e4f87.text: 塔斯卡的指南针 - 靠近西南角，在黑暗港。

f0c3a784a8bae8c861fcf9cb7392e24332126609.source: Tasca's Map - near a group of three Furnace Guardians guarding the entrance into the forge.
f0c3a784a8bae8c861fcf9cb7392e24332126609.text: 塔斯卡的地图 - 靠近守卫熔炉入口的三名熔炉守护者。

77369253ecb16344a7bc9ead6db365545707289b.source: Tasca's Boots - a bit east from Molachev, on the northeastern outskirts of Darkhaven.
77369253ecb16344a7bc9ead6db365545707289b.text: 塔斯卡的靴子 - 位于莫拉切夫以东一点，位于达克黑文的东北郊。

15bcf208a014a88d4fd492114ed9efe5b6ba8355.source: Tasca's Pack - at the bridge past Molenin, the bridge where Orozar Highstone runs to in Noble Intentions Plan B.
15bcf208a014a88d4fd492114ed9efe5b6ba8355.text: 塔斯卡的背包 - 在经过莫列宁的桥上，奥罗扎尔·海斯通在高尚意图 B 计划中跑到的桥上。

af3f78d4cd09ef5c4d9dc293b13d8bededd6241d.source: Clear Tears of the Fallen in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
af3f78d4cd09ef5c4d9dc293b13d8bededd6241d.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔所有敌人的堕落者之泪。

611fe6a6e11072b44859aaf7828b3fa2e5e032b8.source: Travel north from Fishermen's Haven or Sanctum Cay through Stingray Strand, or from Riverside Province through Twin Serpent Lakes.
611fe6a6e11072b44859aaf7828b3fa2e5e032b8.text: 从渔民港或圣岛向北穿过黄貂鱼海滩，或者从河滨省穿过双蛇湖。

8091ee8a03098944648dba76e2354b2139807529.source: A group of Bog Skale Icetooths may be difficult to spot in the southwestern corner, across a gap from Arris Weston. }}
8091ee8a03098944648dba76e2354b2139807529.text: 在西南角，与阿里斯·韦斯顿隔着一条缝隙，可能很难发现一群沼泽斯卡勒冰齿兽。 }}

bdc6dc9a6cd58d8e6e07d0b03dd6d39f1d613312.source: Talk to Tekks about helping the yellow Ophil tribe.
bdc6dc9a6cd58d8e6e07d0b03dd6d39f1d613312.text: 与泰克斯讨论如何帮助黄色奥菲尔部落。

2abb53b19205a2b61f98501c20b9480786f9f07a.source: Locate and defeat the leader of the undead in the temple.
2abb53b19205a2b61f98501c20b9480786f9f07a.text: 找到并击败神庙中不死族的首领。

b8a2e04212988cf7b4e01017984b0d86e26050c0.source: Find a sacked relic and return it to Gron Fierceclaw.
b8a2e04212988cf7b4e01017984b0d86e26050c0.text: 找到一件被洗劫一空的圣物并将其归还给戈隆·烈爪。

464342b8926c4a74f09bd5e2607b8c0eab13f6bf.source: Eliminate the wardens that threaten the Temple of the Dredge.
464342b8926c4a74f09bd5e2607b8c0eab13f6bf.text: 消灭威胁挖泥神殿的守卫。

dd6d544da6194a89200cd2c6af33eeb149fb9743.source: Once this quest is completed, Warden of Saprophytes will no longer spawn in Ferndale.
dd6d544da6194a89200cd2c6af33eeb149fb9743.text: 一旦完成此任务，腐生守望者将不再在芬代尔生成。

5533e6d697fb7a1942fc5e4df737436d78c60b57.source: Go to the Temple of the Dredge and destroy the group of wardens there. When finished, return to speak with Moleneaux. Only the boss Warden of Saprophytes need be killed to complete the quest.
5533e6d697fb7a1942fc5e4df737436d78c60b57.text: 前往挖泥神殿并消灭那里的守卫群。 When finished, return to speak with Moleneaux.只需杀死 Boss 腐生守望者即可完成任务。

cedbd809c5da323754b16cd4336ba750e3e55495.source: It is closer to begin this quest from House zu Heltzer or Saint Anjeka's Shrine than from Moleneaux's location.
cedbd809c5da323754b16cd4336ba750e3e55495.text: 从 House zu Heltzer 或 Saint Anjeka's Shrine 开始这个任务比从 Moleneaux 的位置更接近。

2f59559f084a688c3d4c15802a1a60b691cc8766.source: The temple is also a key location in other quests, so it is possible to simultaneously finish or move along Melodic Gaki Flute, Charting the Forests, The Experimental Weaponsmith and The Beak of Darkness.
2f59559f084a688c3d4c15802a1a60b691cc8766.text: 寺庙也是其他任务的关键地点，因此可以同时完成或沿着旋律长笛、绘制森林图、实验武器匠和黑暗之喙移动。

518c435dd588b9ec682fa573b25bf99adcd68e5f.source: Investigate the area plagued by graven monolith attacks.
518c435dd588b9ec682fa573b25bf99adcd68e5f.text: 调查遭受巨石袭击的地区。

174567328c9c5631c2d99b57d91162cc2e299231.source: See Officer Lohru for your reward.
174567328c9c5631c2d99b57d91162cc2e299231.text: See Officer Lohru for your reward.

1f03e8bebd63544691c5336c7a38e44bfaff7771.source: The temple is located in the southwestern corner of the Sulfurous Wastes and can only be reached via Junundu. Be careful of hidden Mandragors along the way, but otherwise you should be able to reach it without fighting. Once you near the quest marker, the quest is complete and you can map back for your reward; you do not have to clear out the temple.
1f03e8bebd63544691c5336c7a38e44bfaff7771.text: 该寺庙位于硫磺荒原的西南角，只能通过朱南杜到达。 Be careful of hidden Mandragors along the way, but otherwise you should be able to reach it without fighting.一旦你接近任务标记，任务就完成了，你可以返回地图以获得奖励； you do not have to clear out the temple.

638a18d1dbd7552e7b8132b1e00d5df0df4f2af3.source: The quest Requiem for a Brain takes you to the same temple, so you may want to do both at the same time.
638a18d1dbd7552e7b8132b1e00d5df0df4f2af3.text: 大脑安魂曲任务会将您带到同一座寺庙，因此您可能想同时完成这两个任务。

58e6933dd47ab2927c3c5a08b012a3fedc38e0ee.source: Since there's a good number of monoliths inside the temple, it's a good place to try to get Inscribed Shards needed for the Sticks and Stones quest. Otherwise you may have great difficulty farming for the shards later.
58e6933dd47ab2927c3c5a08b012a3fedc38e0ee.text: 由于寺庙内有大量的巨石，因此这是尝试获取棍棒和石头任务所需的铭刻碎片的好地方。否则以后你可能很难耕种碎片。

d0f62efe431301ddc9b31bc80b4f3966c47515fa.source: The three Margonite Clerics that spawn inside the temple while this quest is active are not allied to the monoliths; they will not heal the monoliths and they are in their own aggro group.
d0f62efe431301ddc9b31bc80b4f3966c47515fa.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，在神庙内生成的三名玛贡尼特牧师并不与巨石结盟；他们不会治愈巨石，而且他们在自己的仇恨团体中。

693bb9be94d97defb339568fcc52220c45851893.source: There is a Treasure Chest inside the temple area.
693bb9be94d97defb339568fcc52220c45851893.text: 寺庙区域内有一个宝箱。

3e409ed89fa2dd38d3e9b4debb2a5518e5a8bb7c.source: Negotiate a deal with Caretaker Palmor to buy back Zudash Dejarin's property.
3e409ed89fa2dd38d3e9b4debb2a5518e5a8bb7c.text: 与看守帕尔莫协商一项协议，回购祖达什·德贾林的财产。

f0bdfa3106a93377be538c3c4aa71b46c344c765.source: "Evict" the Kournan soldiers from Dejarin land.
f0bdfa3106a93377be538c3c4aa71b46c344c765.text: "Evict" the Kournan soldiers from Dejarin land.

67e39a8ab3cceeeea0ca61b37ef363d4fe052d3c.source: See Zudash Dejarin for your reward.
67e39a8ab3cceeeea0ca61b37ef363d4fe052d3c.text: See Zudash Dejarin for your reward.

4fe963ca925743f7d93f110cf5c4841e1eb2bbdc.source: After accepting the quest, talk to Vadah who is also in Pogahn Passage. Next pay a visit to Caretaker Palmor in the Dejarin Estate. She will initially be hostile, so kill off the other soldiers and attack her until she is willing to talk. Backtrack to the location of the squatting soldiers and kill them.
4fe963ca925743f7d93f110cf5c4841e1eb2bbdc.text: 接受任务后，与也在波甘通道的瓦达交谈。 Next pay a visit to Caretaker Palmor in the Dejarin Estate.她一开始会怀有敌意，所以杀死其他士兵并攻击她，直到她愿意说话为止。 Backtrack to the location of the squatting soldiers and kill them.
