657a1a974a3f7bb44ff186726f6bec9bbbcc2dc1.source: The quest can be completed without having Koss in the party by simply defeating both Caretaker Palmor's group and the group that needs to be "evicted" from the estate. The quest log will continue demanding for Koss' attendance and not update until both groups are dealt with (thus not showing the location of the latter), at which point it will complete.
657a1a974a3f7bb44ff186726f6bec9bbbcc2dc1.text: 只需击败看门人帕尔莫的团队和需要从庄园“驱逐”的团队，即可在没有科斯参与的情况下完成任务。任务日志将继续要求科斯出席，并且不会更新，直到两个小组都得到处理（因此不会显示后者的位置），此时它将完成。

4ecc87b6756e0c480d89d15027eae1866f8db84a.source:
* Elonian (Nightfall) character
* Guild Wars Prophecies on the account You must also have completed and accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh
4ecc87b6756e0c480d89d15027eae1866f8db84a.text:
* Elonian（夜幕降临）角色
* 帐户上的《激战预言》您还必须完成并接受“时机已到”的奖励

d649a22ce2de846fda12c1d898bbcb55dba28c71.source: Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn more about the situation in Tyria.
d649a22ce2de846fda12c1d898bbcb55dba28c71.text: Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn more about the situation in Tyria.

1dc2d4c518cbf151277d6d556eb720121184b64d.source: Tell Mhenlo when you are ready to leave for Tyria.
1dc2d4c518cbf151277d6d556eb720121184b64d.text: 当你准备好前往泰瑞亚时告诉门洛。

fd6925f401a38bea271ed8e33c0bdd9cd7d41b0f.source: Report to Lionguard Neiro in the foreign administration center and gain entrance to Lion's Arch and the lands of Kryta.
fd6925f401a38bea271ed8e33c0bdd9cd7d41b0f.text: 向外国管理中心的狮子卫士内罗报到并进入狮子拱门和科瑞塔土地。

05e293f4effc07cacd9897cc8397b8d57acc5191.source: Inform Firstwatch Sergio, captain of the Lionguard, that you have arrived in Lion's Arch.
05e293f4effc07cacd9897cc8397b8d57acc5191.text: Inform Firstwatch Sergio, captain of the Lionguard, that you have arrived in Lion's Arch.

bd429845bb9b057f9891ca870f66172e15982073.source: Map travel to the Consulate Docks. Walking there is impossible due to a closed gate. Talk to Mhenlo once, then talk to him again to set off for Tyria. When you get to Lion's Gate talk to Lionguard Neiro to open the gate into Lion's Arch.
bd429845bb9b057f9891ca870f66172e15982073.text: Map travel to the Consulate Docks. Walking there is impossible due to a closed gate. Talk to Mhenlo once, then talk to him again to set off for Tyria. When you get to Lion's Gate talk to Lionguard Neiro to open the gate into Lion's Arch.

b4273c8363191d96fc42651940fd39e14877e5d2.source: This quest unlocks the Lions Arch port (once you have walked through the portal from Lion's Gate).
b4273c8363191d96fc42651940fd39e14877e5d2.text: This quest unlocks the Lions Arch port (once you have walked through the portal from Lion's Gate).

a93276593acf5d01bd02a33eddbc13746dfe5968.source: A Nightfall character with this quest can ferry characters of any level (from any Campaign) to Tyria, provided that they have Consulate Docks unlocked (i.e. by either having completed The Time is Nigh themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).
a93276593acf5d01bd02a33eddbc13746dfe5968.text: A Nightfall character with this quest can ferry characters of any level (from any Campaign) to Tyria, provided that they have Consulate Docks unlocked (i.e. by either having completed The Time is Nigh themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).

324881642199b75814c948ee6e5d28943f911efc.source: Although you can be taken to Lion's Gate by Mhenlo multiple times, Lionguard Neiro will only open the gates to Lion's Arch for you once, so you will need to abandon the quest and retake it for subsequent ferries.
324881642199b75814c948ee6e5d28943f911efc.text: Although you can be taken to Lion's Gate by Mhenlo multiple times, Lionguard Neiro will only open the gates to Lion's Arch for you once, so you will need to abandon the quest and retake it for subsequent ferries.

c2fa5e47dedd901b9c1eba25c6effafe1e3d8e38.source: Should your whole party die in the Lion's Gate area (e.g. via Vampiric weapon, etc), you will receive a "your party has been defeated" dialog and then be returned to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan.
c2fa5e47dedd901b9c1eba25c6effafe1e3d8e38.text: Should your whole party die in the Lion's Gate area (e.g. via Vampiric weapon, etc), you will receive a "your party has been defeated" dialog and then be returned to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan.

6bb8624ac16393a2d21b5695162b6f6dcae48961.source: If a Guild Wars Nightfall character has used a ferry to get to the Consulate Docks early, they will still be able to obtain and use this quest later, after having completed The Time is Nigh.
6bb8624ac16393a2d21b5695162b6f6dcae48961.text: If a Guild Wars Nightfall character has used a ferry to get to the Consulate Docks early, they will still be able to obtain and use this quest later, after having completed The Time is Nigh.

24ed9e1fb85a2e58f1aa108dbf04f4dc15b5aaab.source: Return to Reaper of the Spawning Pools for your reward.
24ed9e1fb85a2e58f1aa108dbf04f4dc15b5aaab.text: 返回产卵池收割者处领取奖励。

965916df75e7e18dd8e48de0955ae61b853b1c7b.source: The Terrorweb Queen spawns in a small passageway accompanied by four Obsidian Guardians. Four Obsidian Guardians, three Skeletons of Dhuum, and four Terrorweb Dryders also spawn on each side of her room, so make sure to take caution when attacking these enemies. The Obsidian Guardians' regular attacks can sometimes knock down foes and they will use wards to defend themselves and the Terrorweb Queen. It is possible to first kill the enemies on one side, then to teleport to a Reaper on the other side of by talking to the Reaper so that it would be easier to defeat the queen when all of her guardians are dead.
965916df75e7e18dd8e48de0955ae61b853b1c7b.text: 恐怖网女王在四名黑曜石守护者的陪伴下在一条小通道中生成。 Four Obsidian Guardians, three Skeletons of Dhuum, and four Terrorweb Dryders also spawn on each side of her room, so make sure to take caution when attacking these enemies.黑曜石守护者的定期攻击有时可以击倒敌人，他们会使用守卫来保护自己和恐怖网女王。 It is possible to first kill the enemies on one side, then to teleport to a Reaper on the other side of by talking to the Reaper so that it would be easier to defeat the queen when all of her guardians are dead.

c2f6304771146d79ef43df3cd161b4ff33afae7b.source: It is also possible to simply pull the queen away from the guardians and to complete the quest from one side. She can attack from a long distance so the puller may need to back up further than usual to get her out of the defensive wards.
c2f6304771146d79ef43df3cd161b4ff33afae7b.text: 也可以简单地将女王从守护者身边拉开并从一侧完成任务。她可以从很远的距离攻击，因此拉车者可能需要比平常更远的距离才能让她脱离防御区。

8dee5643c66c30d94aaa46849fc36904ca09b002.source: Consider using spells that do not require a line of sight, and kill the Obsidian Guardians one by one from behind a wall. Note that if you can't interrupt Obsidian Flesh you need to wait until it expires.
8dee5643c66c30d94aaa46849fc36904ca09b002.text: 考虑使用不需要视线的法术，从墙后一一杀死黑曜石守护者。 Note that if you can't interrupt Obsidian Flesh you need to wait until it expires.

40786cddb7cb562d7b27787dc8f180a4a8164c1c.source: You can also fill the spawning area with traps before taking the quest. By concentrating the traps in one or two corners of this area, you should be able to take out one or two Guardians without any trouble. The queen will most likely survive any such attempts.
40786cddb7cb562d7b27787dc8f180a4a8164c1c.text: 您还可以在接受任务之前在产卵区域布满陷阱。通过将陷阱集中在该区域的一两个角落，你应该能够毫无困难地干掉一两个守护者。女王很可能会在任何此类尝试中幸存下来。

9f0ee6ea77b87bdc30be84f7f0f0ff17c976234d.source: Groups of Charged Blackness pop up in the a broad area around where the Queen spawns if you didn't kill them before accepting the quest.
9f0ee6ea77b87bdc30be84f7f0f0ff17c976234d.text: Groups of Charged Blackness pop up in the a broad area around where the Queen spawns if you didn't kill them before accepting the quest.

d1e295011f13bb681818e03d228184aea89422eb.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: necromancer
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
d1e295011f13bb681818e03d228184aea89422eb.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：死灵法师
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

a12e399c6682d479599aad92122b83aea6de5d9f.source: Go south and destroy all the crypt fiends there.
a12e399c6682d479599aad92122b83aea6de5d9f.text: Go south and destroy all the crypt fiends there.

3f3d901174046d6b05b119942226c96997d8b5f4.source: Return to Oberan the Reviled for your reward.
3f3d901174046d6b05b119942226c96997d8b5f4.text: Return to Oberan the Reviled for your reward.

434ac3e9267435291887f28812cfc34fea34cf59.source: Oberan the Reviled will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
434ac3e9267435291887f28812cfc34fea34cf59.text: 接受任务后，被辱骂的奥贝兰会给你以下技能：

bc934456a631ac6b4b753f4c5897ec3f78abbfaa.source: Oberan can be hard to find for new players; however, the quest Charr in the Catacombs from Prince Rurik will lead the player straight to Oberan.
bc934456a631ac6b4b753f4c5897ec3f78abbfaa.text: Oberan can be hard to find for new players;然而，鲁里克王子的地下墓穴中的查尔任务将引导玩家直接前往奥伯兰。

64c401165b076e3ff2f2e4bc8b96659776771fbe.source: Upon accepting the quest, the Crypt Fiends will start spawning one at a time and approach through the long southern hallway. The crypt fiends have no skills and attack at melee range with low damage output, so they are not difficult to defeat. Just kill all 5 and collect your reward.
64c401165b076e3ff2f2e4bc8b96659776771fbe.text: 接受任务后，地穴恶魔将开始一次生成一个，并穿过漫长的南部走廊。地穴恶魔没有技能，攻击范围为近战，伤害输出较低，所以击败它们并不困难。 Just kill all 5 and collect your reward.

3e1cbe4e9abf0a18e81b9efd5b7ee93b67091bc4.source: Faintedheartedness is a very weak hex, and its main use is to trigger Soul Barbs' damage. Soul Barbs, on the other hand, is quite strong and works with all hexes, including Siphon Strength and mesmer hexes such as Conjure Phantasm and Imagined Burden.
3e1cbe4e9abf0a18e81b9efd5b7ee93b67091bc4.text: 昏心是一个非常弱的咒语，它的主要用途是触发灵魂倒刺的伤害。 Soul Barbs, on the other hand, is quite strong and works with all hexes, including Siphon Strength and mesmer hexes such as Conjure Phantasm and Imagined Burden.

b0c36460b770f1f6056d6ce5027818bfd6608a51.source: An easy way to finish this quest is to hide behind the wall behind Oberan so that the Crypt Fiends will get stuck trying to reach you as they will be bodyblocked by him. You will then be able to slowly kill them with ranged spells.
b0c36460b770f1f6056d6ce5027818bfd6608a51.text: 完成这个任务的一个简单方法是躲在奥伯兰后面的墙后面，这样地穴恶魔就会被困在试图接近你的过程中，因为他们会被他身体挡住。 You will then be able to slowly kill them with ranged spells.

ccf353cf1b968cfb3ab3ceeec1d2c1f87c99438b.source: Karleen, the universal collector for foot armor pieces in pre-Searing (collecting Gargoyle Skulls), can be found a short way to the north of Oberan.
ccf353cf1b968cfb3ab3ceeec1d2c1f87c99438b.text: 卡琳 (Karleen) 是灼热前阶段足甲碎片的通用收集者（收集石像鬼头骨），位于奥伯兰以北不远的地方。

de9cc681f0c6e67dd62aeabc839800e1c3439a6f.source: Find the afflicted creature that was once Imperial Guardsman Chun and destroy it.
de9cc681f0c6e67dd62aeabc839800e1c3439a6f.text: Find the afflicted creature that was once Imperial Guardsman Chun and destroy it.

6429aeeeb13862afbbd2a039b7c1d56c88a15a20.source: Heading east from Kaineng Center, you will head up a ramp and across a bridge. Chun is in the middle of a mob of afflicted creatures. Once you kill Chun, the quest is over.
6429aeeeb13862afbbd2a039b7c1d56c88a15a20.text: 从凯能中心向东行驶，您将走上坡道并穿过一座桥。 Chun is in the middle of a mob of afflicted creatures.一旦你杀死了Chun，任务就结束了。

51d0ef5438d1c8484cd9bfe80133f346c95c3171.source: Because the guardsman uses Frenzy, has no self heal, often spawns alone and is attacked by some Canthan Guards, this quest sometimes "completes itself".
51d0ef5438d1c8484cd9bfe80133f346c95c3171.text: 因为守卫使用狂乱，没有自我治疗，经常单独生成并受到一些凯珊守卫的攻击，所以这个任务有时会“自行完成”。

e8239bb239d790e81946a3005c72522318a8b533.source: With Winds of Change, the Ministry of Purity members or the Am Fah can also attack the guard and complete the quest.
e8239bb239d790e81946a3005c72522318a8b533.text: With Winds of Change, the Ministry of Purity members or the Am Fah can also attack the guard and complete the quest.

2c7d8aacd5cc8b43bc8a745f62e144cb6d320f6f.source: See Tahbo Paa for your reward.
2c7d8aacd5cc8b43bc8a745f62e144cb6d320f6f.text: 请前往 Tahbo Paa 领取奖励。

bc8db849c628b9cd14e9ac9e9dbc8c1656376e44.source: You can find Tahbo Paa at the resurrection shrine in the Southwestern corner of Kinya Province, near the portal to Panjiang Peninsula. To reach the Aerie, simply follow the Western coast North.
bc8db849c628b9cd14e9ac9e9dbc8c1656376e44.text: 你可以在金亚省西南角的复活神殿找到塔博帕，靠近盘江半岛的门户。 To reach the Aerie, simply follow the Western coast North.

e256020bb96350ba25609377931d7d3ce9f7fc52.source: If you accept this quest then leave the area, the quest marker will be in the wrong place when you return. The marker will still be in Aerie, though you must collect Tahbo Paa again.
e256020bb96350ba25609377931d7d3ce9f7fc52.text: If you accept this quest then leave the area, the quest marker will be in the wrong place when you return. The marker will still be in Aerie, though you must collect Tahbo Paa again.

eed2608be32bae32219541eceb68d1b5bc9cf31d.source: Clear the Alkali Pan in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
eed2608be32bae32219541eceb68d1b5bc9cf31d.text: Clear the Alkali Pan in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.

54bff412f8db4be1eda6f1dc2d5a6ff570ae6275.source: The primary quest that will lead your party here from the Bone Palace is Horde of Darkness. The secondary quest Strange Bedfellows also takes place here.
54bff412f8db4be1eda6f1dc2d5a6ff570ae6275.text: The primary quest that will lead your party here from the Bone Palace is Horde of Darkness.次要任务“奇怪的同床者”也发生在这里。

172aa5a36b137609c6939732f3ecd76b8a92fb15.source: Complete exploration of the area contributes approximately 3.02% towards the Elonian Cartographer Title.
172aa5a36b137609c6939732f3ecd76b8a92fb15.text: 对该地区的完整探索为埃洛尼安制图师头衔贡献了约 3.02%。

4db60635e3684dcc5b84762a777ee708c13fb242.source: A pillar near Fumeai can be knocked down using Junundu Smash, which opens an alternate route from the Bone Palace to the Shattered Ravines.
4db60635e3684dcc5b84762a777ee708c13fb242.text: 可以使用 Junundu Smash 击倒 Fumeai 附近的一根柱子，这会打开一条从白骨宫殿到破碎峡谷的替代路线。

fa69aa4d5793f93801bed20a2dd0a21382e20a93.source: Before acquiring the Horde of Darkness quest, the passage in front of the Ruins of Morah exit will be closed; making it more difficult to get to the other side of the map.
fa69aa4d5793f93801bed20a2dd0a21382e20a93.text: 在完成黑暗部落任务之前，莫拉废墟出口前的通道将被关闭； making it more difficult to get to the other side of the map.

ff054c7b8d177461344030d8c7dd6f1129191da9.source: This area can be cleared while inside the relative safety of a Junundu, with the exception of the rocky ground outside the two outposts and the boss group of Shelkeh the Hungry.
ff054c7b8d177461344030d8c7dd6f1129191da9.text: 除了两个前哨站外的岩石地面和饥饿者谢尔克的 Boss 群之外，可以在朱南杜相对安全的范围内清除该区域。

32c1ac49f12bdff55ce11fe2b77b4fd003695efd.source: Shelkeh the Hungry is a mesmer boss and its group might have several Awakened Cavaliers. Skills that prevent resurrection (such as Frozen Soil) are useful to overcoming them.
32c1ac49f12bdff55ce11fe2b77b4fd003695efd.text: Shelkeh the Hungry is a mesmer boss and its group might have several Awakened Cavaliers.阻止复活的技能（例如冻土）对于克服它们很有用。

ad10e6e6c7e6fcec12b8d5567b7cd60cdae1e76f.source: For large awakened groups (the larger ones are on the sulfurous wastes), be sure to take down all Awakened Acolytes and Awakened Cavaliers first. These groups can be difficult to take on, even while inside a Junundu. The Cavaliers have both Signet of Return and "We Shall Return!" so it is essential to keep killing them, or else they will maintain an infinite resurrection chain.
ad10e6e6c7e6fcec12b8d5567b7cd60cdae1e76f.text: 对于大型觉醒团体（较大的觉醒团体在硫磺荒原上），请务必先击倒所有觉醒侍僧和觉醒骑士。即使在朱南杜内部，这些团体也很难对付。骑士队拥有回归徽记和“我们将回归！” so it is essential to keep killing them, or else they will maintain an infinite resurrection chain.

53f60645ab1d5520eebe0ee25dd325e6e563352c.source: There are about a dozen spots in the sulfurous wastes where Desert Wurms are hidden, with some having two of them appear at once. Make sure you sweep the area and proceed carefully before engaging undead or elemental groups.
53f60645ab1d5520eebe0ee25dd325e6e563352c.text: 硫磺荒原中大约有十几个地方隐藏着沙漠亚龙，有些地方同时出现了两只。在与不死族或元素团体交战之前，请务必清扫该区域并小心行事。

f01ff17bd96bf8636815eefc4f964215a8cca9bd.source: Hidden mandragor groups can be found on the western rocky ground, the eastern sandy area, and the rocky northeastern corner. Proceed slowly to avoid engaging multiple groups.
f01ff17bd96bf8636815eefc4f964215a8cca9bd.text: 隐藏的曼德拉草群分布在西部岩石地面、东部沙地和岩石东北角。缓慢进行以避免多个小组参与。

af4194c7c851ecfe7cbc5eb65aecea32da3f2aad.source: Go to Regent Valley. Hunt down the bandit Torin.
af4194c7c851ecfe7cbc5eb65aecea32da3f2aad.text: 前往摄政谷。追捕强盗托林。

48e303a907c162bbae8a803a6e9c54fe82a2e2e0.text: 双倍肾上腺素增益（几率：10%）1

b4de7d06ab61a32b46767a9b641729bc258a2e2e.source: The easiest way to complete this quest is to wait until you get to Fort Ranik (after finishing the The Great Northern Wall).
b4de7d06ab61a32b46767a9b641729bc258a2e2e.text: The easiest way to complete this quest is to wait until you get to Fort Ranik (after finishing the The Great Northern Wall).

924b7ea1af89e62fd86f902dccf2613240822729.source: Head south from Fort Ranik. A group of Charr may come running from the arches to ambush you, so take them out. Head west, following the arches. Along the way, you'll engage scattered groups of Renegades and Renegade Elementalists. Turn north at the next fork, watching your step for burrowing Devourers, which may pop up from the ground. Cross the bridge and take out the first group of Renegades after the bridge. Then, head west to a dead end where Torin and two Renegade Elementalists are standing. Eliminate the bandit leader and return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.
924b7ea1af89e62fd86f902dccf2613240822729.text: Head south from Fort Ranik. A group of Charr may come running from the arches to ambush you, so take them out. Head west, following the arches. Along the way, you'll engage scattered groups of Renegades and Renegade Elementalists. Turn north at the next fork, watching your step for burrowing Devourers, which may pop up from the ground. Cross the bridge and take out the first group of Renegades after the bridge.然后，向西前往一个死胡同，托林和两名叛徒元素师站在那里。 Eliminate the bandit leader and return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.

c843d5ea186f41b5169feeb45c64871cffcf11b4.source: The staff has the same appearance as The Yakslapper and Sacred Staff.
c843d5ea186f41b5169feeb45c64871cffcf11b4.text: 法杖的外观与打牦牛者和圣杖相同。

8878b71e5b6d9cee7523e14bf02ef344dc547811.source: Kill 3 different forest creatures and return to Scholar Andrej.
8878b71e5b6d9cee7523e14bf02ef344dc547811.text: Kill 3 different forest creatures and return to Scholar Andrej.

847604b28c41fd9a555d4a42b6e6a1b2d048ae9e.source: See Scholar Andrej for your reward.
847604b28c41fd9a555d4a42b6e6a1b2d048ae9e.text: See Scholar Andrej for your reward.

30cc21ad984f09d07acf6782347f770051e81c63.source: A very simple quest seeing as you should have both Maatu Keep and Tanglewood Copse on your World Map, map travel to either of these locations and leave for Pongmei Valley, all three of the creatures specified reside within this explorable area, the Stone Scale Kirin towards the crossroads where you encounter Danika and Master Togo in previous quests, and the Dragon Moss and Wardens patrol close to Tanglewood Copse.
30cc21ad984f09d07acf6782347f770051e81c63.text: 这是一个非常简单的任务，因为你应该在你的世界地图上同时拥有Maatu Keep和Tanglewood Copse，地图旅行到这些位置中的任何一个并前往Pongmei Valley，指定的所有三种生物都居住在这个可探索的区域内，石鳞麒麟朝向你在之前的任务中遇到Danika和Master Togo的十字路口，以及Dragon Moss和Wardens在Tanglewood Copse附近巡逻。

0548c90d16eb3c1a7b968fd65625e2dc7fa6803d.source: Escort Outrunner Remlok to the Anvil of Dragrimmar within the depths of the sepulchre.
0548c90d16eb3c1a7b968fd65625e2dc7fa6803d.text: Escort Outrunner Remlok to the Anvil of Dragrimmar within the depths of the sepulchre.

4b69179415b40c0f544e66c0e3a97947016504dc.source: Defeat the Remnant of Antiquities guarding the Anvil of Dragrimmar.
4b69179415b40c0f544e66c0e3a97947016504dc.text: Defeat the Remnant of Antiquities guarding the Anvil of Dragrimmar.

1eeca9998c3cbccd147a0c62b997dadddc349082.source: See Outrunner Remlok for your reward.
1eeca9998c3cbccd147a0c62b997dadddc349082.text: See Outrunner Remlok for your reward.

744f80995fe2de4d5eae9a62fbcdbc09bb4e4ca6.source: Escort the Apostate while he retrieves his writings.
744f80995fe2de4d5eae9a62fbcdbc09bb4e4ca6.text: Escort the Apostate while he retrieves his writings.

cf3079a422729661499b9d401d115e86d46e0327.source: Protect the Apostate from the Margonite Stalker!
cf3079a422729661499b9d401d115e86d46e0327.text: Protect the Apostate from the Margonite Stalker!

12ef20c7913240216b54c2e33684c186c3fd8592.source: Carefully follow the Apostate in the Domain of Fear and avoid over-aggro. He sometimes stops and waits for you (he runs quicker as he isn't affected by Cower in Fear). Also, he is not targeted by foes, so you do not have to worry about his safety. Moving near him should make him start running again. Expect a fight when you reach your destination. There will be a Margonite Stalker and 5 Margonite Bowmasters to deal with. The fight should be fairly simple.
12ef20c7913240216b54c2e33684c186c3fd8592.text: Carefully follow the Apostate in the Domain of Fear and avoid over-aggro. He sometimes stops and waits for you (he runs quicker as he isn't affected by Cower in Fear). Also, he is not targeted by foes, so you do not have to worry about his safety. Moving near him should make him start running again. Expect a fight when you reach your destination.将会有一名玛贡奈特追猎者和 5 名玛贡奈特弓箭手需要对付。 The fight should be fairly simple.

888f334f4d9c88408265cfe997a10a5c1d8a753d.source: If you want to play it safe, start this quest from the Gate of Secrets and clear the pathway to the Apostate, then you can just follow him back to the end point and not worry about accidental aggro. This method will only add a couple of extra minutes to the quest.
888f334f4d9c88408265cfe997a10a5c1d8a753d.text: 如果你想保险起见，从秘密之门开始这个任务，清理通往叛教者的道路，然后你就可以跟着他回到终点，而不用担心意外仇恨。 This method will only add a couple of extra minutes to the quest.

1127da02dc7248f515d1ade2213b0eb947908efa.source: If he completely stops moving, simply continue running to the endpoint near the entrance to Gate of Secrets to get him to move as well.
1127da02dc7248f515d1ade2213b0eb947908efa.text: 如果他完全停止移动，只需继续跑到秘密之门入口附近的端点即可让他也移动。

37329ce93b0ebc95c54c138e795a20849caa1868.source: The Apostate will sometimes heal you and your enemies using Divine Intervention, and remove your and your enemies' conditions with Dismiss Condition.
37329ce93b0ebc95c54c138e795a20849caa1868.text: 叛教者有时会使用神圣干预治愈你和你的敌人，并使用解散条件消除你和你的敌人的条件。

ba5ecd9ae0516fd58845ca240b92686ee27050e8.source: This quest has good synergy with the primary quest Kormir's Crusade.
ba5ecd9ae0516fd58845ca240b92686ee27050e8.text: 该任务与主线任务科米尔的远征有良好的协同作用。

8fbc82348a44ebc7ad8c72a6a5aa7be1fc726286.source: Clear the Arid Sea in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
8fbc82348a44ebc7ad8c72a6a5aa7be1fc726286.text: Clear the Arid Sea in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.

2f00cbc9b0097eca452eda5c7ba8c832648a88f9.source: Consider waiting for two and three more days to acquire the quests for Skyward Reach and The Scar, respectively, since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.
2f00cbc9b0097eca452eda5c7ba8c832648a88f9.text: 考虑再等待两天和三天来分别获得“天空之境”和“疤痕”的任务，因为您可以通过“被遗忘的守护者”带领八人队伍连续征服所有三个区域。

d5eae469937ac0714f8cbed88f57194ca9686a9f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.3% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
d5eae469937ac0714f8cbed88f57194ca9686a9f.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了约 1.3%。

57f63a6468e5c1a1b64e4ab268ff1bc28af96b15.source: There are several small hidden groups of scarabs scattered throughout the area. A Dune Burrower tends to have a pair of hidden scarabs nearby.
57f63a6468e5c1a1b64e4ab268ff1bc28af96b15.text: 整个地区散布着几小群隐藏的圣甲虫。沙丘穴居者附近往往有一对隐藏的圣甲虫。

40935fd1417d25b1cf0bdf3dd97e3327bc2997f5.source: There's also a chance of encountering hidden Sand Wurms and Salving Cacti. Make sure you kill them before moving on; if they burrow and hide, they still count against your vanquisher kills.
40935fd1417d25b1cf0bdf3dd97e3327bc2997f5.text: 还有机会遇到隐藏的沙龙和拯救仙人掌。确保在继续前进之前杀死他们；如果它们挖洞并隐藏起来，它们仍然会计算在征服者的杀戮中。

b576b7e72bea4c3cbd399941f81d5e34108280f3.source: There might be a hydra group (sometimes a boss group) that patrols clockwise around the edge of the map. If you're having troubles finding the last group, try running counter-clockwise to intercept them.
b576b7e72bea4c3cbd399941f81d5e34108280f3.text: 可能会有一个九头蛇小组（有时是头目小组）沿着地图边缘顺时针巡逻。如果您在找到最后一组时遇到困难，请尝试逆时针奔跑以拦截它们。

c1c9d28fae2e165dbb82039da29aacaad4be451a.source: The south-western section contains only hidden foes.
c1c9d28fae2e165dbb82039da29aacaad4be451a.text: 西南部分只包含隐藏的敌人。

d55765a00df00730ae1831fafd1cdbba78c23399.source: A large group of Enchanted armors in the ruins in the northwestern part of the map have an unusual patrol path that makes them easy to miss.
d55765a00df00730ae1831fafd1cdbba78c23399.text: 地图西北部废墟中的一大群魔法铠甲有一条不寻常的巡逻路径，很容易被错过。

d851a70a8c1853d779220c62588db3af9607c1c3.source: If a player has both Prophecies and Nightfall on the same account, there is a transfer point in this region to the far south via Forgotten Guardian. Characters must have already completed the Gate of Desolation mission to use this exit. By using the portal from Crystal Overlook, players can bring in a party of eight instead of the normal six, to help with vanquishing (although the relatively small enemy groups tend to make this unnecessary). When taking this teleporter in either direction, party members who do not meet the requirements will be left behind.
d851a70a8c1853d779220c62588db3af9607c1c3.text: 如果玩家在同一个帐户上同时拥有预言和夜幕，则该地区有一个通过被遗忘的守护者到遥远南方的传送点。角色必须已经完成荒凉之门任务才能使用此出口。通过使用水晶俯瞰的传送门，玩家可以带上八人小队而不是通常的六人，以帮助征服（尽管相对较小的敌人群体往往使这变得不必要）。当使用此传送器向任一方向移动时，不符合要求的队伍成员将被抛在后面。

5a601c0aa999c15f3b45012dc747608821388df7.source: Return to Saerin for your reward.
5a601c0aa999c15f3b45012dc747608821388df7.text: 返回萨林那里领取奖励。

bb31941f9a1ae10ea57cd1acde4fb6d3fb1cb971.source: Go east through southern Sparkfly Swamp and enter the Bloodstone Caves by walking through the portal; do not use the Inscription Stone. In the dungeon, get the dungeon key to go to the second floor. There, head south east until you're in a large, open room with many marble-like pillars. Pull the groups of Skeletons, and kill the Crystal Ettin. Go to Saerin to get your reward.
bb31941f9a1ae10ea57cd1acde4fb6d3fb1cb971.text: 向东穿过闪光沼泽南部，穿过传送门进入血石洞穴；不要使用铭文石。在地牢中，获得地牢钥匙即可前往二楼。在那里，向东南方向行驶，直到进入一个宽敞的开放房间，里面有许多大理石状的柱子。拉动骷髅群，杀死水晶埃丁。前往萨林领取奖励。

e4532d5cefc30c260752f86a7bd58592484bdf28.source: It is possible, but not required, to complete the dungeon with this quest.
e4532d5cefc30c260752f86a7bd58592484bdf28.text: 通过此任务完成地牢是可能的，但不是必需的。

317989845481afb3bfe433dc6b968a51d452db83.source: Can be completed at the same time as The Blade's Essence
317989845481afb3bfe433dc6b968a51d452db83.text: 可以与刀锋精华同时完成

fa199dee46df0d3971060c2dac0ab5c237d55729.source: You must have completed The Battle for Lion's Arch and have seen the reporting of Keiran Thackeray's disappearance, which happens in the Hall of Monuments.
fa199dee46df0d3971060c2dac0ab5c237d55729.text: 您一定已经完成了狮子拱门之战，并且看过关于凯兰·萨克雷失踪的报道，这起事件发生在纪念碑大厅。

47ef4913e881bc219e6b4dfa151868d27adf8b39.source: The Ebon Vanguard Scout, who appears in Ice Cliff Chasms after The Battle for Lion's Arch and the "Gwen's Unintended Promotion" dialogue, hints at the location of the Embedded Arrowhead. Find the Embedded Arrowhead in Watchtower Coast to acquire this quest.
47ef4913e881bc219e6b4dfa151868d27adf8b39.text: 在狮子拱门之战和“格温的意外晋升”对话之后出现在冰崖裂缝中的黑锋先锋侦察兵暗示了嵌入箭头的位置。在了望塔海岸找到嵌入的箭头来完成此任务。

9849a0cdeb94de16583b0058bcdfe23bf1b86877.source: Investigate the arrowhead at the scrying pool.

3568053fb998206f79c44a68a41a03aaa8a848d9.source: Lead your party north to the Ascalon Settlement.
3568053fb998206f79c44a68a41a03aaa8a848d9.text: 带领你的队伍向北前往阿斯卡隆定居点。

6c3e168d9b6f41f85ddb715451b9386a99a7da0b.source: See Captain Greywind [Skills] for your reward.
6c3e168d9b6f41f85ddb715451b9386a99a7da0b.text: 请见灰风船长[技能]以获得奖励。

462ee7c36a34999d6de22b1152cf0bb2f5a28db8.source: Immediately after entering North Kryta Province, a dialogue starts between Damaris and the four ascalonian NPCs. Wait until the end, then talk to Damaris then Devona.
462ee7c36a34999d6de22b1152cf0bb2f5a28db8.text: 进入北科瑞塔省后，达马里斯和四个阿斯卡隆 NPC 之间立即开始对话。等到最后，然后与达马里斯交谈，然后与德沃娜交谈。

a3ca495b6608807dc59e5504f31d6a8f205d5eb2.source: With Aidan, Cynn, Devona, and Mhenlo following you, walk to the settlement marked on your map (at the northwest corner of the explorable area) and talk to Captain Greywind. Devona must survive to obtain the rewards.
a3ca495b6608807dc59e5504f31d6a8f205d5eb2.text: 艾丹、辛恩、德沃娜和门洛跟着你，步行到地图上标记的定居点（位于可探索区域的西北角）并与格雷温德船长交谈。德沃娜必须生存才能获得奖励。

118171697a43f8e743f29628605dc4091197c247.source: Several routes are possible: the route displayed in red on the picture has a few Bog Skales and no War in Kryta spawns (should War in Kryta be active), while the purple route has War in Kryta spawns and many Tengu.
118171697a43f8e743f29628605dc4091197c247.text: 有几条路线是可能的：图片上显示为红色的路线有一些沼泽斯卡尔斯，并且没有科里塔之战生成（如果科里塔之战活跃），而紫色路线有科里塔之战生成和许多天狗。

8e4c437e1d31dda18949c08d5ebd465d3720b993.source: Captain Greywind will not spawn if you have the Wintersday quest A Very Grentchie Wintersday task "Travel to the Ascalon Settlement with the Grentch and destroy all the Wintersday gifts from Dwayna. 0 of 7 Wintersday gifts remaining." active.
8e4c437e1d31dda18949c08d5ebd465d3720b993.text: 如果你有冬日任务 一个非常格伦奇的冬日任务“与格伦奇一起前往阿斯卡隆定居点并销毁来自德薇娜的所有冬日礼物。剩余 7 个冬日礼物中的 0 个”，灰风船长将不会生成。积极的。

76baaab88f255254c066e7cb7f361cb56f3526ed.source: This quest combines well with Merchant's Plea and The Last Hog.
76baaab88f255254c066e7cb7f361cb56f3526ed.text: 该任务与商人的恳求和最后的野猪完美结合。

01bf295af5d65147c08c896974e45d9281a4a661.source: Consider also taking The Weaver of Nebo, especially if you plan on taking Blankets for the Settlers from Captain Greywind, as it is not much further to Nebo Terrace.
01bf295af5d65147c08c896974e45d9281a4a661.text: 也可以考虑拿走尼波编织者，特别是如果你打算从格雷温德船长那里拿走定居者毯子，因为它离尼波台不远。

611ccd0fed74a4c439a8eb46a6faf8a38ba79f00.source: Players can use this quest for farming experience/drops quickly thanks to the help of the several fairly good allies it provides.
611ccd0fed74a4c439a8eb46a6faf8a38ba79f00.text: 得益于它提供的几个相当不错的盟友的帮助，玩家可以使用这个任务快速获得农业经验/掉落物。

f7921280738cf8ec67883196fd90d7d220baf620.text: 在萨克诺斯谷与安东见面。

17f232c50875c161180933b8ccc066e31bca646d.text: 找到并击败雷德·暴虐者

76797304ed37d8e90016b50c01100fb1f9ecb278.source: Defeat Rend Ragemauler's guards. You have killed [0..9] of 9 guards.
76797304ed37d8e90016b50c01100fb1f9ecb278.text: 击败雷德·暴虐者的守卫。你已经杀死了 9 名守卫中的 [0..9] 名。

538e649e66727aed0acb4f90d108a7dc96a27e3c.source: Enter Sacnoth through the Dalada Uplands zone. Anton will meet you close to the entrance. Follow the quest marker west a short way, and you will find Rend Ragemauler surrounded by his guards. After a talk between the two, Ragemauler sets his guards on you. Defeat them, talk a little more, and Ragemauler himself will attack. Defeat him to complete the quest. The quest is very easy if you come in as a Siege Devourer from the Uplands.
538e649e66727aed0acb4f90d108a7dc96a27e3c.text: 穿过达拉达高地区域进入萨克诺斯。安东将在入口附近与您会面。沿着任务标记向西走一小段路，你会发现雷德·暴虐者被他的守卫包围着。两人交谈后，狂暴者对你设置了戒备。打败他们，多说话，狂暴者就会亲自攻击。击败他即可完成任务。如果你是来自高地的攻城吞噬者，这个任务就很容易。

c31b64d81be3403e8ea44a31abb17ea8feb953a5.source: If you choose to fight on foot, be very wary of the Charr Seeker backline, as they can quickly annihilate your own backline.
c31b64d81be3403e8ea44a31abb17ea8feb953a5.text: 如果你选择徒步战斗，要非常警惕夏尔探索者的后线，因为他们可以迅速消灭你自己的后线。

3d16da9ddb409f7abada488e8a3b4a0876e53c93.source: It is possible to get to Sacnoth Valley without fighting anything. If you follow the path from Grothmar to the east and follow it south, you can use the ridges to either side of this path to avoid the Charr patrols.
3d16da9ddb409f7abada488e8a3b4a0876e53c93.text: 不进行任何战斗就可以到达萨克诺斯谷。如果你沿着格罗斯玛的路径向东并向南走，你可以使用这条路径两侧的山脊来避开夏尔巡逻队。

b89c512ac57597c851e3c7ca44450e79efa544e4.source: Meet Justiciar Naveed in Riven Earth.
b89c512ac57597c851e3c7ca44450e79efa544e4.text: 在裂痕大地遇见审判官纳维德。

9aa5da9ac451403584862aa107721fd765570c51.source: Escort Justiciar Naveed to the meeting place.
9aa5da9ac451403584862aa107721fd765570c51.text: 护送法官纳维德前往集合地点。

f6fa7c0251432bc6bda4ceab9c535d47f0e06a95.source: Leave the Grimoire at the meeting place as bait.
f6fa7c0251432bc6bda4ceab9c535d47f0e06a95.text: 将魔典留在集合地点作为诱饵。

2c0a07946bd88898017c900c2782618c99763f4d.source: Take cover until Glayvin gets caught.
2c0a07946bd88898017c900c2782618c99763f4d.text: 寻找掩护，直到格雷文被抓住。

9f1108d8f87cc8c94375302e6fc6c387dd71499b.source: Travel from Rata Sum through Riven Earth towards Justiciar Naveed (Marked 1 on the map), who is near the exit to Alcazia Tangle in the south. Clear the path of Raptors and Angorodons along the way. Once you meet him, backtrack the way you came and head to the meeting place (Marked 2 on the map) from just outside Rata Sum. Justiciar Naveed leaves the Grimoire as bait, follow him to the hiding place. Once Glayvin agrees to help, accept your reward from Justiciar Neveed.
9f1108d8f87cc8c94375302e6fc6c387dd71499b.text: 从拉塔苏姆出发，穿过裂痕大地，前往正义者纳维德（地图上标记为 1），他位于南部阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔的出口附近。清除沿途的猛禽和安戈洛顿。遇见他后，原路返回，从 Rata Sum 外前往集合地点（地图上标记为 2）。审判官纳维德留下魔典作为诱饵，跟随他到藏身之处。一旦格雷文同意提供帮助，请接受法官尼维德的奖励。

41b4f1d01ae96e5d7760ab9d68c5e7dcdcd41c5f.source: Do not attempt to pick up the Grimoire, as doing so causes the quest to fail.
41b4f1d01ae96e5d7760ab9d68c5e7dcdcd41c5f.text: 不要尝试拿起魔典，因为这样做会导致任务失败。

78c5323266eddbf10a7e29fb91d2c49810beb755.source: Kill the enemy guards at the quarry sites.
78c5323266eddbf10a7e29fb91d2c49810beb755.text: 杀死采石场的敌方守卫。

47f1e1c3da5f971f5b65fd651bdc94dbe0e09f57.source: At the start, there are nine quarry sites controlled by the nightmare horde. Each site is guarded by a Shadow of Kanaxai. Defeating a Shadow of Kanaxai changes control of that site to your side and a Luxon Enchanter will spawn at that site. There are patrols that move to quarry sites that you control and attack the Luxon Enchanters there. When a Luxon Enchanter is defeated, the site changes control to the nightmare horde and a Shadow of Kanaxai spawns. The frequency and size of these patrols increases over time, but there can only be 4 groups present at any one time. Every 10 seconds, the nightmare horde's score and your score increases by the number of quarry sites that are controlled, which is indicated by the flags next to the scores. This mission does not have a time limit, however, once the nightmare horde has a score of 500 the challenge ends.
47f1e1c3da5f971f5b65fd651bdc94dbe0e09f57.text: 一开始，噩梦部落控制着九个采石场。每个地点都由 Kanaxai 之影守卫。击败卡纳克斯之影后，该地点的控制权就会转移到你这边，并且卢克森附魔师将在该地点生成。有巡逻队移动到你控制的采石场并攻击那里的卢克森附魔师。当卢克森附魔师被击败时，该地点的控制权将转移给噩梦部落，并且卡纳赛之影会生成。这些巡逻的频率和规模随着时间的推移而增加，但每次只能有 4 个小组在场。每 10 秒，噩梦部落的分数和你的分数就会增加所控制的采石场的数量，这由分数旁边的旗帜表示。该任务没有时间限制，但是，一旦噩梦部落得分达到 500 分，挑战就会结束。

8fccec69d786671c3aa05cc9b0df388dc4343660.source: To obtain a score of at least 100, you will need to control at least two shrines until the game ends. One possible way is to run to each quarry site and kill the Shadow of Kanaxai there while avoiding patrols. Consider bringing party wide speed boosts such as "Charge!" or "Fall Back!" to reduce the time spent between each site. Alternatively, you could have a few party members split off and solo each Shadow of Kanaxai, while the rest of the party defend the sites that are already controlled. In both strategies, Luxon Enchanters provide party wide defenses and healing that stall patrols and assist the party when defending.
8fccec69d786671c3aa05cc9b0df388dc4343660.text: 为了获得至少 100 分，你需要控制至少两个神社直到游戏结束。一种可能的方法是跑到每个采石场并杀死那里的卡纳赛之影，同时避开巡逻。考虑在全队范围内提供速度提升，例如“冲锋！”或“撤退！”以减少每个站点之间花费的时间。或者，你可以让一些队伍成员分开并单独每个 Kanaxai 之影，而队伍的其余成员则保卫已经控制的地点。在这两种策略中，卢克森附魔师都提供全队防御和治疗，阻止巡逻并在防守时协助队伍。

f1bdbad599a9864acb31c38e100fe8feb129275d.source: Like most challenge missions, the foes in this mission do not drop items when killed.
f1bdbad599a9864acb31c38e100fe8feb129275d.text: 与大多数挑战任务一样，此任务中的敌人被杀死时不会掉落物品。

a40258634c8737bfa6e7989768bb8b39272cd7ae.source: Obtaining a score of 100 or above here will increase your Luxon faction cap by 1000.
a40258634c8737bfa6e7989768bb8b39272cd7ae.text: 在这里获得 100 分或以上的分数将使您的 Luxon 派系上限增加 1000 点。

faba66095c214ffc8c2d9168363e97be9e5bc6ec.source: Exploring in this mission gives you 1.2% towards the explorer title. If your alliance owns The Aurios Mines (outpost), you may explore the mission by talking to the Luxon Sentry there.
faba66095c214ffc8c2d9168363e97be9e5bc6ec.text: 在此任务中进行探索可让您获得 1.2% 的探险家头衔。如果你的联盟拥有奥里奥斯矿井（前哨站），你可以通过与那里的卢克森哨兵交谈来探索任务。

25ea997067264f01ac139fb3247ae3a153f0a9d0.source: Find Johann zu Heltzer in Ferndale and speak with him about the elusive Black Moa.
25ea997067264f01ac139fb3247ae3a153f0a9d0.text: 在芬代尔找到约翰·祖·赫尔策 (Johann zu Heltzer)，并与他谈论难以捉摸的黑恐鸟。

e7dd0c6f0fa93e566bb3d760b76fd804c1a74eca.source: Find Erik Lutgardis in Melandru's Hope and talk to him about the mysterious Black Moa.
e7dd0c6f0fa93e566bb3d760b76fd804c1a74eca.text: 在梅兰德鲁的希望中找到埃里克·卢特加迪斯，并与他谈论神秘的黑恐鸟。

dfeb0430611ba6b1e855bbaedf385f8e4a49dfd1.source: Find Konrad Vasburg in Ferndale and chat with him about the cunning Black Moa.
dfeb0430611ba6b1e855bbaedf385f8e4a49dfd1.text: 在芬代尔找到康拉德·瓦斯伯格并与他谈论狡猾的黑恐鸟。

5cd82f4593348eb1140cd8a93cb4af4a587322dd.source: Find Ruprecht Brauer in Drazach Thicket and learn the whereabouts of the devious Black Moa.
5cd82f4593348eb1140cd8a93cb4af4a587322dd.text: 在德拉扎克丛林中找到鲁普雷希特·布劳尔，了解狡猾的黑恐鸟的下落。

26c682e18c14eb642b98330342177de31b73c667.source: Travel to Ferndale and slay the despicable Black Moa.
26c682e18c14eb642b98330342177de31b73c667.text: 前往芬代尔并杀死卑鄙的黑恐鸟。

915e5888b075cbaa96d0dd8133f8ce401b4de6ad.source: See Rutger zu Heltzer for your reward.
915e5888b075cbaa96d0dd8133f8ce401b4de6ad.text: 请参阅 Rutger zu Heltzer 以获得奖励。

edd6651702120650f748c72578cff65a4c42e472.source: Once this quest is completed, the Black Moa becomes a permanent spawn in Ferndale.
edd6651702120650f748c72578cff65a4c42e472.text: 一旦完成这个任务，黑色恐鸟就会成为芬代尔的永久生成点。

896b1f410f82ee5039dbc93d67b69854d86f2333.source: Start out from House zu Heltzer and follow the quest pointer to each of the witnesses of the Black Moa's attack and hear their statements. Once all have been visited, head out into Ferndale to finally put an end to the dreaded beast.
896b1f410f82ee5039dbc93d67b69854d86f2333.text: 从 House zu Heltzer 出发，跟随任务指针找到黑恐鸟袭击的每个目击者并听取他们的陈述。当所有的人都参观完毕后，前往芬代尔，最终消灭这头可怕的野兽。

e1659abbeb1671a0a5bba573285a2aeed11bc42a.source: This quest will take the party over several areas of Echovald Forest in search of the witnesses. If you don't already have outposts unlocked there, it may take some time to do as you wander round from point to point.
e1659abbeb1671a0a5bba573285a2aeed11bc42a.text: 该任务将带领队伍穿越埃科瓦尔德森林的几个区域寻找目击者。如果你还没有在那里解锁前哨站，那么当你从一个点徘徊到另一个点时，可能需要一些时间才能完成。

6eee496238a3f980085ef01c2b9757573e313601.source: The final step in finding and slaying the Black Moa is probably the most difficult part, due to the number of criss-crossing dredge patrols where the bird is located. Tread carefully and deal with the patrols before trying to kill the Black Moa.
6eee496238a3f980085ef01c2b9757573e313601.text: 寻找并杀死黑恐鸟的最后一步可能是最困难的部分，因为黑恐鸟所在的地方有大量的挖泥船巡逻队。在尝试杀死黑恐鸟之前，请小心行事并对付巡逻队。

ef4819cc15ea13238fd4765d2d1211854c1f7885.source: With the previous point, the monk boss in the patrol uses fast cast spells only. Bringing Broad Head Arrow, or another dazing skill, reduces the time it takes to get to the moa considerably.
ef4819cc15ea13238fd4765d2d1211854c1f7885.text: 与前一点一样，巡逻队中的僧侣老大只使用快速施法法术。携带宽头箭或其他令人眼花缭乱的技能，可以大大减少到达恐鸟所需的时间。

9d4df20fe59645d7f4e71751687a6c2a49822541.source: If you wish to Charm the Black Moa (see note at end of this page), it is useful to defeat all foes nearby, and if you have henchmen or heroes, flag them away. This is because when charming the Black Moa, he will become hostile, and your henchmen and heroes will attack. Also, not killing the nearby foes will cause them to also attack the Black Moa.
9d4df20fe59645d7f4e71751687a6c2a49822541.text: 如果你想迷惑黑色恐鸟（请参阅本页末尾的注释），击败附近的所有敌人会很有用，如果你有追随者或英雄，请将他们标记走。这是因为当迷惑黑恐鸟时，他会变得充满敌意，你的追随者和英雄会攻击。此外，不杀死附近的敌人也会导致他们攻击黑恐鸟。

662ed9932a8d96d35fa8d39aeccaedde667bfe3e.source: It is possible to complete the quest if you are with a friend who has already done this. After a friend has completed this, the Black Moa will spawn for him and from there, you can tame/kill the Black Moa to easily complete the quest without going through all the steps.
662ed9932a8d96d35fa8d39aeccaedde667bfe3e.text: 如果您和已经完成此任务的朋友一起完成该任务，则可以完成该任务。朋友完成此操作后，黑色恐鸟将为他生成，从那里，您可以驯服/杀死黑色恐鸟，轻松完成任务，而无需执行所有步骤。

0195e6c0c22481f4573805396e76186ab7d01a5f.source: Doing some of the steps before joining someone else that has done this may affect the spawning of the Black Moa. See the next note.
0195e6c0c22481f4573805396e76186ab7d01a5f.text: 在加入其他已完成此操作的人之前执行某些步骤可能会影响黑色恐鸟的生成。请参阅下一个注释。

cf9b777b998de2a4e97e5c6361b78a264f0f5bed.source: The Black Moa will not spawn in Ferndale until you have gone through each of the quest steps, and you will need to speak to each man in the order of the quest objectives.
cf9b777b998de2a4e97e5c6361b78a264f0f5bed.text: 在您完成每个任务步骤之前，黑色恐鸟不会在芬代尔生成，并且您需要按照任务目标的顺序与每个人交谈。

4c926a711909f4b78537bfe94ef7296abbb9f0ba.source: The Black Moa starts out as a friendly creature, and like other friendly creatures, it can be tamed. Taming the bird instead of killing it also completes the quest.
4c926a711909f4b78537bfe94ef7296abbb9f0ba.text: 黑恐鸟一开始是一种友好的生物，和其他友好的生物一样，它可以被驯服。驯服这只鸟而不是杀死它也完成了任务。

ec2ada79a2f6b9b2baac4fe6c2603d9735b1a61f.source: A Luxon ambush might appear and attack the Black Moa.
ec2ada79a2f6b9b2baac4fe6c2603d9735b1a61f.text: 卢克森伏击可能会出现并攻击黑恐鸟。

1d4bab5fdb3ad70bb5a5f3d653eacba7f7762b92.source: Johann zu Heltzer is closest to House zu Heltzer
1d4bab5fdb3ad70bb5a5f3d653eacba7f7762b92.text: Johann zu Heltzer 距离 House zu Heltzer 最近

fad91c6547bdf4162eaedef9e8adf6c79d639c9c.source: Erik Lutgardis is closest to Brauer Academy
fad91c6547bdf4162eaedef9e8adf6c79d639c9c.text: Erik Lutgardis 距离布劳尔学院最近

8965b680b7915d1e929405157a8f9e106d62caf0.source: Konrad Vasburg is closest to Lutgardis Conservatory
8965b680b7915d1e929405157a8f9e106d62caf0.text: Konrad Vasburg 距离 Lutgardis Conservatory 最近

9844f943168627a00969b284c55943ae505643c6.source: Ruprecht Brauer is closest to Brauer Academy
9844f943168627a00969b284c55943ae505643c6.text: 鲁普雷希特·布劳尔 (Ruprecht Brauer) 距离布劳尔学院最近

84c57b6b5dbed5a6f78ab98bd91050749d6cd238.source: The Black Moa is closest to Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick)
84c57b6b5dbed5a6f78ab98bd91050749d6cd238.text: 黑恐鸟距离阿斯彭伍德门 (Kurzick) 最近

46bb878f667e55d660f0dfe7f0438da70f1581ab.source: For the last person you have to talk to, depending on where the Kurzick-Luxon border is, you can walk just outside of Saint Anjeka's Shrine and get killed by the Wardens there, this will then send you to the resurrection shrine right next to him.
46bb878f667e55d660f0dfe7f0438da70f1581ab.text: 对于你必须与之交谈的最后一个人，根据库尔兹克-卢克森边界的位置，你可以走到圣安杰卡神社外面并被那里的守望者杀死，然后这会将你送到他旁边的复活神社。

cebf8e53d8e4ea2b673d5f9adeedc7596567a652.source: Find and kill Chieftain Ulgrimar Gnash in Drakkar Lake.
cebf8e53d8e4ea2b673d5f9adeedc7596567a652.text: 在达卡湖找到并杀死酋长乌格玛·纳什。

f0dbadbbeda9feed0777447cca9c8bf45a997c2c.source: Leave Sifhalla and go south. You will come across two Jotun Skullsmashers standing still to each side and will already be able to sight Chieftain Ulgrimar Gnash. There will be an incoming group of 4-5 Jotun nearby, wait for them before facing the boss and its allies to prevent over-aggro. The Chieftain's allies can be carefully pulled to face the boss alone.
f0dbadbbeda9feed0777447cca9c8bf45a997c2c.text: 离开西夫哈拉，向南走。你会遇到两名左右站着的佐顿碎颅者，并且已经能够看到酋长乌格玛·纳什。附近会有一群4-5只巨人来袭，等待他们再面对boss及其盟友，以防止过度仇恨。可以小心地拉着酋长的盟友单独面对boss。

c1c83f6f0b0748d07af02ad84f62472365e1b918.source: "You're proving to be quite a handy human to have around! Budger'll be thrilled to hear the news. It means more powder kegs for him! I'll get my mining team back up there as soon as possible."
c1c83f6f0b0748d07af02ad84f62472365e1b918.text: “事实证明，你是一个非常方便的人！巴吉听到这个消息会很兴奋。这对他来说意味着更多的火药桶！我会尽快让我的采矿队回到那里。”

965351535ca210733fdab46c77769d4c0900a161.source: Kill the Black Beast of Arrgh in the Foundry of Failed Creations
965351535ca210733fdab46c77769d4c0900a161.text: 在失败造物铸造厂杀死阿格的黑色野兽

a859169736c134810c8fb999ed10bf301aead525.source: *BONUS* Kill the Black Beast of Arrgh in Hard Mode.
a859169736c134810c8fb999ed10bf301aead525.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Arrgh 的黑色野兽。

e2d647d0c41cef88ff7cfbad35420d219a671d82.source: As per the Foundry Breakout quest.

b173c53e159905ef26bb401585c7b1b5af2af9a3.source: Clear the Black Curtain in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
b173c53e159905ef26bb401585c7b1b5af2af9a3.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔黑幕中的所有敌人。

662035197a409b0d35b7250f63d5d78360a6b87b.source: There are many ship burial sites that have never taken sail.
662035197a409b0d35b7250f63d5d78360a6b87b.text: 有许多从未航行过的船只埋葬地。

40d5ac42ca70c64e175fef14d02b62fd4eb15fe1.text: {{Vanquisher|计数 = 230|低 = 207|高 = 306|笔记=有很多隐藏的敌人。}}

b4c2de4f254303e34c9c1c0010680a3dcef62657.source: Even though the appearance is the same, certain areas of the bog will inflict a Poison condition, while others will not. Even though your party is allowed eight spots, you lose your henchmen when map traveling to Temple of the Ages from the Black Curtain with only heroes and henchmen in your party. A Locked Chest may spawn behind the portal to Talmark Wilderness, making it reachable only by shadow stepping. Be careful of popup spawns behind the portal to avoid unintended zoning.
b4c2de4f254303e34c9c1c0010680a3dcef62657.text: 尽管外观相同，但沼泽的某些区域会造成中毒状态，而其他区域则不会。尽管你的队伍有八个名额，但当你的队伍中只有英雄和追随者从黑幕前往世纪神殿时，你会失去你的追随者。上锁的宝箱可能会在通往塔尔马克荒野的传送门后面生成，使其只能通过暗影步到达。请小心门户后面出现的弹出窗口，以避免意外分区。

0dfeded994ef29ebf07802f2533a4507cc63a93c.source: Return the shimmering essence to Saerin for a reward.
0dfeded994ef29ebf07802f2533a4507cc63a93c.text: 将闪闪发光的精华归还给萨林以获得奖励。

9d9ba9bb199f316a709ae197e3e070560ea8df59.source: Go across the southern part of Sparkfly Swamp to the Bloodstone Caves entrance. Do not click on the Inscribed Stone. Instead, you can walk through the door and then the portal into the Bloodstone Caves as it normally is. In the caves, head east then south, and in the center of a small basin you'll find the Paranoia Ettin with a few Incubuses around it. Kill the ettin, grab the essence, and return to Saerin for your reward.
9d9ba9bb199f316a709ae197e3e070560ea8df59.text: 穿过火花沼泽的南部到达血石洞穴入口。不要点击铭刻石。相反，您可以像往常一样穿过门，然后通过门户进入血石洞穴。在洞穴中，向东然后向南走，在一个小盆地的中心，你会发现偏执狂埃丁，周围有一些梦魇。杀死埃丁，获取精华，然后返回萨林领取奖励。

1443e115572f083763d4d6d8fe804f2bf35b2df9.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: monk
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
1443e115572f083763d4d6d8fe804f2bf35b2df9.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：僧侣
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

1b5504319d68ff0a7c31cac22e317fd564ae8be6.source: Travel to the fields north of Ashford and dispatch the skeletons there.
1b5504319d68ff0a7c31cac22e317fd564ae8be6.text: 前往阿什福德北部的田野并在那里派遣骷髅。

79279928a6b10d9f5b89cbed0d9fd487392ea53c.source: Exit Ashford Abbey into Lakeside County. Head north until you reach a group of Raging Cadavers and Skeleton Raiders attacking Ascalonian Farmers. You may choose to join the fight or hold back and heal the farmers until they kill the enemies. Since the Undead take double damage from Holy Damage, skills such as Bane Signet, Retribution and Banish are of great help here.
79279928a6b10d9f5b89cbed0d9fd487392ea53c.text: 离开阿什福德修道院进入湖滨县。向北行驶，直到遇到一群正在攻击阿斯卡隆农民的愤怒尸体和骷髅袭击者。你可以选择加入战斗，也可以阻止并治疗农民，直到他们杀死敌人。由于亡灵会受到神圣伤害的双倍伤害，因此诸如祸根印章、惩戒和放逐之类的技能在这里有很大帮助。

bb676fc1fce98045da3c66d8d3cd04330852889c.source: Once all the undead enemies are killed, return to Ashford Abbey and speak with Brother Mhenlo for your reward.
bb676fc1fce98045da3c66d8d3cd04330852889c.text: 杀死所有不死敌人后，返回阿什福德修道院并与曼洛修士交谈以获取奖励。

3be06a0ed534d56325b1a9a8384e1ade4bb25628.source: Listen to Baasong tell his ghost story to the kids.
3be06a0ed534d56325b1a9a8384e1ade4bb25628.text: 听巴松给孩子们讲他的鬼故事。

08c8e21b764b5b327b20f0733a1f71bbbcd8a5b3.source: Find and defeat the legendary Bog Beast of Bokku.
08c8e21b764b5b327b20f0733a1f71bbbcd8a5b3.text: 找到并击败传说中的博库沼泽野兽。

4a9a098a9a3415988e495686ecc22e88c45d5831.source: The Bog Beast can be found over Teipao Island, in the middle of Haiju Lagoon, north from Baasong and the children. It is wise to clear out all the Dragon Lillies and Grasping Roots around the island including the mesmer boss Baozo Evilbranch before taking the quest.
4a9a098a9a3415988e495686ecc22e88c45d5831.text: 沼泽兽可以在海州泻湖中部的帝堡岛上找到，位于巴松和孩子们的北边。在接受任务之前，明智的做法是清除岛上所有的龙百合和抓根，包括幻术师 Boss 巴佐·邪枝。

da0aebe86f8c0137a391fcc4af8c644449f97db7.source: This quest can be done by characters from any campaign.
da0aebe86f8c0137a391fcc4af8c644449f97db7.text: 此任务可以由任何战役中的角色完成。

1455066e242713947cb4ee6e575afe9703568c96.source: This may be unintended, as it is the only pre-Winds of Change quest that can be done by non-Canthan characters on Shing Jea Island.
1455066e242713947cb4ee6e575afe9703568c96.text: 这可能是无意的，因为这是 Shing Jea 岛上非 Canthan 角色可以完成的唯一一个变风之前的任务。

5389b2c3e573c4f64f9ee8776dfbe487962d9d4c.source: This quest can easily be done in conjunction with The Thieving Nanny.
5389b2c3e573c4f64f9ee8776dfbe487962d9d4c.text: 这个任务可以很容易地与小偷保姆一起完成。

ac31811b2ea84441054d131499a2b2ad749d9846.source: Meet Lo Sha in Panjiang Peninsula.

4cc50fbb1c66c69764a94bc2964d584761702fd1.source: Find out where the Crimson Skull are keeping Mei Ling.
4cc50fbb1c66c69764a94bc2964d584761702fd1.text: 找出猩红骷髅将梅铃关押在哪里。

04d082218e8d351e17b274e3a24236ecd574f4fd.source: Protect Lo Sha and help him rescue Mei Ling.
04d082218e8d351e17b274e3a24236ecd574f4fd.text: 保护罗莎并帮助他救出美铃。

8382cad330eafddab13b629c21572590a5fa16b4.source: Return to Headmaster Kaa for your reward.
8382cad330eafddab13b629c21572590a5fa16b4.text: 返回卡阿校长处领取奖励。

6d7595c8c8f48105564ec5d4098db102ad756579.text: 法术技能回复减半（几率：10%）

f94462e161188e9a4aa7e558d371af6b086849bf.source: [Incomplete source section] Head South into Panjiang Peninsula from Tsumei Village and follow the quest marker to Lo Sha. After talking to him follow the marker into the Crimson Skull camp and kill them. Talk to Lo Sha again once you have rescued Mei Ling. Map travel back to Shing Jea Monastery for the quest reward.
f94462e161188e9a4aa7e558d371af6b086849bf.text: [不完整来源部分] 从茑名村向南进入盘江半岛，按照任务标记到达螺沙。与他交谈后，跟随标记进入猩红骷髅营地并杀死他们。救出美玲后，再次与洛莎交谈。地图返回Shing Jea寺以获得任务奖励。

354fa72439fbad06988d25e4406a19f1e554e17f.source: Although rescuing Mei Ling after Lo Sha dies will produce the message "Quest failed", after returning to the area the quest will update to the next "Talk to Lo Sha" step. After talking to him again you may return to Headmaster Kaa for the reward.
354fa72439fbad06988d25e4406a19f1e554e17f.text: 虽然在洛煞死亡后营救美玲会产生“任务失败”的信息，但返回该区域后任务将更新到下一个“与洛煞对话”步骤。再次与他交谈后，你可以回到卡阿校长那里领取奖励。

f91061a9e03bfe78e51a4058083fb9282c1708a4.source: Clear the Breach in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
f91061a9e03bfe78e51a4058083fb9282c1708a4.text: 在困难模式下清除阿斯卡隆突破口的所有敌人。

0945991a6275a6397c3a92d8fa81ff04f7c42a6c.source: Characters will most likely venture into this area following the secondary quest Supplies for the Duke. It is reached by traveling due west from Ascalon City to the northwest corner of Old Ascalon, then passing through the Hammer Gate to the north.
0945991a6275a6397c3a92d8fa81ff04f7c42a6c.text: 角色很可能会在完成次要任务“公爵补给品”后冒险进入该区域。从阿斯卡隆城向西行至旧阿斯卡隆的西北角，然后穿过锤门向北即可到达。

08eba079903d974a63137557f9f0a31bc0ef0220.source: If any member of the party has started or completed Into the Breach, a squad of soldiers including an Academy Monk will spawn near the exit to Old Ascalon. If a minion master is in the party, the Academy Monk can be coaxed into following the party, as she will try to heal the minions.
08eba079903d974a63137557f9f0a31bc0ef0220.text: 如果队伍中的任何成员已经开始或完成了进入突破口，包括一名学院僧侣在内的一队士兵将在老阿斯卡隆的出口附近产卵。如果小兵大师在队伍中，则可以哄骗学院武僧跟随队伍，因为她会尝试治愈小兵。

d673381b8892b83cc4db5ee7a4e3041691008814.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 130|low = 100|high = 134|notes=Has hidden Devourers and Crown of Thorns.}}
d673381b8892b83cc4db5ee7a4e3041691008814.text: {{征服者|计数 = 130|低 = 100|高 = 134|注释=隐藏了吞噬者和荆棘王冠。}}

5b7cd8ed7428386dd5121bc32454be59aa500cf2.source: There are several hidden Devourer groups concentrated near the Old Ascalon exit.
5b7cd8ed7428386dd5121bc32454be59aa500cf2.text: 在旧阿斯卡隆出口附近有几个隐藏的吞噬者组织。

240c4bbf5c82fbbc245bf5c492b009ea1027b4f5.source: A few hidden Crowns of Thorns can be triggered in the southwestern area, in the slightly greener terrain.
240c4bbf5c82fbbc245bf5c492b009ea1027b4f5.text: 一些隐藏的荆棘王冠可以在西南地区稍绿的地形中触发。

c4425e6dbe75d17c86b2fdeec5839e941a47aa20.source: Investigate the broken sword at the scrying pool.

fcb65051aff7ecaa0b9a197efc284164d6f99d42.source: You must watch all of Gwen's dialogue after completing A Vengeance of Blades for the broken sword to appear.
fcb65051aff7ecaa0b9a197efc284164d6f99d42.text: 完成《刀锋复仇》后，你必须观看格温的所有对话，断剑才会出现。

4569f87d10e2bc8b5e71073952086ef02c5a96e4.source: Defeat the Crimson Skull and free Jatoro Musagi.
4569f87d10e2bc8b5e71073952086ef02c5a96e4.text: 击败深红骷髅并释放杰托罗·穆萨吉。

50579d2230ba2ee5f24224fd7628573be59b732c.source: Return the letter for Jatoro's Mother to Lady Mukei Musagi.
50579d2230ba2ee5f24224fd7628573be59b732c.text: 将贾托罗母亲的信返还给穆吉·穆萨吉夫人。

f41366575776dc188853da9444ea8c819a0cc5a5.source: Make your way north-east from Seitung Harbor towards Haiju Lagoon or start from Zen Daijun if you already have it, and follow the quest marker. The Crimson Skull camp has several members which can easily overwhelm your team. Instead of fighting them all together, pull them apart from each other so that you can fight only a few of them at a time. Use ground features to obstruct their projectiles or to create choke points. Additionaly you can obtain blessings from Melandru's shrine by kneeling at her statue.
f41366575776dc188853da9444ea8c819a0cc5a5.text: 从 Seitung 港向东北方向前往 Haiju Lagoon，或者从 Zen Daijun 出发（如果您已经拥有它），然后按照任务标记进行操作。猩红骷髅阵营拥有多名成员，可以轻松压垮您的团队​​。不要将他们全部打在一起，而是将他们分开，这样你一次只能与其中的几个人战斗。使用地面特征来阻挡他们的射弹或创建阻塞点。此外，您还可以通过跪在梅兰德鲁的雕像前获得她神殿的祝福。

360ee3556b356fa12010847cae1352babc6f71d2.source: Once you defeat all of the Crimson Skull, the quest will update and you can speak to Jatoro for your reward.
360ee3556b356fa12010847cae1352babc6f71d2.text: 一旦你击败了所有的猩红骷髅，任务就会更新，你可以与杰托罗交谈以获得奖励。

fb4ed7360d2c9e5c0d6c944067dc5ded4f09205b.source: Since this is a secondary quest, players having difficulties (due to level difference) can leave it for later until the player is stronger and better armored.
fb4ed7360d2c9e5c0d6c944067dc5ded4f09205b.text: 由于这是次要任务，因此遇到困难（由于等级差异）的玩家可以稍后再进行，直到玩家变得更强且装甲更好。

85df949088b8bed9a387813cb28a93602d242a5f.source: If you choose to do this quest along with To Zen Daijun and Su dies, you will not be able to enter Zen Daijun and will have to zone back into Jaya Bluffs and speak with her group again. You will not have to fight the waves of enemies again, however.
85df949088b8bed9a387813cb28a93602d242a5f.text: 如果你选择在To Zen Daijun和Su死亡的情况下完成这个任务，你将无法进入Zen Daijun并且必须回到Jaya Bluffs并再次与她的团队交谈。然而，你不必再次与一波又一波的敌人战斗。

e845ea2f8576cd0a9383ed670793ae295b915b8a.source: If you already unlocked Zen Daijun, use the level 16 henchmen available in that outpost to benefit from stronger allies.
e845ea2f8576cd0a9383ed670793ae295b915b8a.text: 如果您已经解锁了 Zen Daijun，请使用该前哨站中可用的 16 级追随者，从更强大的盟友那里获益。

399361fcad5d24d2ab2103f2ba6333b891a90963.source: This quest can be used to farm: Copper, Silver, and Gold Crimson Skull Coins. Keep the quest active in your log; do not claim your rewards from Jatoro.
399361fcad5d24d2ab2103f2ba6333b891a90963.text: 该任务可用于耕种：铜、银和金深红骷髅币。在你的日志中保持任务活跃；不要从 Jatoro 那里领取奖励。

ad5efea31984236a34513de314edbb8ef46b2c4f.source: Find Bakghu and his gang in the Undercity.
ad5efea31984236a34513de314edbb8ef46b2c4f.text: 在幽暗城找到巴克胡和他的帮派。

82d9ef19e1553cbd8d54f6fdf9fd5e86a10fd04f.text: 击败 Chong Poi 的帮派。

a437805c78be621ad6e65d724ebb4b54e689e1fb.source: See Senjo Wah for your reward.
a437805c78be621ad6e65d724ebb4b54e689e1fb.text: 请前往 Senjo Wah 领取奖励。

de04cf8dd80395d493cfcff77524f29ae98c41a0.source: If you are able, enter the Undercity from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) and head slightly west. Otherwise, start at The Marketplace and enter the underground area from Wajjun Bazaar, heading north and then east.
de04cf8dd80395d493cfcff77524f29ae98c41a0.text: 如果可以的话，从维祖纳广场（当地街区）进入幽暗城，然后稍微向西走。否则，从市场开始，从 Wajjun Bazaar 进入地下区域，向北然后向东行驶。

83f4335708d0d2f781c7c4d123f6ab3a1ccc9c1e.source: When you arrive at his location, Bakghu will not be hostile. As he begins speaking, the other gangs will arrive; take this opportunity to move out of range (there is a good spot to the north, though be wary if you have The Shadow Blades active, as there will be a cluster of aggressive Shadow Blade Assassins nearby). Once the last gang member arrives, the groups will become hostile and attack each other. You can either join in or wait to defeat the weakened victors.
83f4335708d0d2f781c7c4d123f6ab3a1ccc9c1e.text: 当你到达他的位置时，Bakghu不会有敌意。当他开始讲话时，其他帮派就会到达；借此机会移出射程（北边有一个好地方，但如果你有暗影之刃，请小心，因为附近会有一群侵略性的暗影之刃刺客）。一旦最后一个帮派成员到达，各帮派就会变得敌对并互相攻击。你可以加入，也可以等待击败实力较弱的胜利者。

53d3859fcecd726b30c23225837d491ca35d9b63.source: Be cautious of The Afflicted Miju and the Afflicted that spawn nearby; they can be aggroed by the gangsters, causing trouble for your party.
53d3859fcecd726b30c23225837d491ca35d9b63.text: 小心受折磨的 Miju 和附近生成的受折磨的生物；他们可能会受到歹徒的骚扰，给你的队伍带来麻烦。

3c45cd59228d345bc4c28b77e3e44c35b4d9d8d2.source: None of the named foes involved in this quest are bosses. This means that you cannot capture any skills from them.
3c45cd59228d345bc4c28b77e3e44c35b4d9d8d2.text: 参与此任务的指定敌人都不是 Boss。这意味着你无法从他们身上获得任何技能。

3b77cb28b66c0736b86b13fa7ba8d35761e73933.source: If Bakghu's or Chong Poi's gang dies before they turn aggressive (e.g. during Cleansing the Undercity or The Shadow Blades), the quest cannot continue; you will have to return to the outpost and retry.
3b77cb28b66c0736b86b13fa7ba8d35761e73933.text: 如果 Bakghu 或 Chong Poi 的帮派在变得具有侵略性之前死亡（例如在净化幽暗城或暗影之刃期间），则任务无法继续；您必须返回前哨站并重试。

63fa8b21efb1c4c7bf9892dac98a1bd013afb41b.source: Hunt down and destroy the Charr patrol.
63fa8b21efb1c4c7bf9892dac98a1bd013afb41b.text: 追捕并摧毁夏尔巡逻队。

b0863161631ff1c9a51071f213fa97408c70fe85.source: Nente will immediately start to run, heading south. While he is passing several points on the map fighting against the creatures on that way, the quest will be updated at each point. At the final quest marker you will reach a little wooden bridge where 5 Charr Stalkers are standing. After you have killed them, you can immediately talk to Master Ranger Nente for your reward.
b0863161631ff1c9a51071f213fa97408c70fe85.text: 南特立即开始奔跑，向南而去。当他经过地图上的几个点并与沿途的生物战斗时，每个点的任务都会更新。在最后的任务标记处，您将到达一座小木桥，那里站着 5 个夏尔追猎者。杀死他们后，你可以立即与游侠大师 Nente 交谈以获得奖励。

b8e8a86314710d2fbb19e3576ced017b8ef52d7f.source: You do need to follow Nente to the quest markers, as he will stop moving if you follow a path far enough away from the one he is taking.
b8e8a86314710d2fbb19e3576ced017b8ef52d7f.text: 你确实需要跟随南特到达任务标记，因为如果你沿着一条距离他所走的路足够远的路径走，他就会停止移动。

90c4331c8de23740fef2581bb322496212f9b07d.source: If Nente dies or is stuck on some certain point, you may have to start the quest again. (Sometimes, if Nente is stuck, clicking on him will cause him to continue.) Even if you kill the Charr patrol and the quest is updated in your quest log, you won't be able to gain the reward from Nente.
90c4331c8de23740fef2581bb322496212f9b07d.text: 如果 Nente 死亡或卡在某个特定点上，你可能必须重新开始任务。 （有时，如果Nente被卡住，点击他会让他继续。）即使你杀死了Charr巡逻队并且任务在你的任务日志中更新，你也无法从Nente获得奖励。

a8e2ddba363b5754d8d72d0c47ed4fa408eb00a2.source: Make sure your party is able to make enough damage and to heal enough, if possible also Master Ranger Nente. Every time he kneels it is better to wait for him to ensure that the quest will be updated and Nente will head forward on his way.
a8e2ddba363b5754d8d72d0c47ed4fa408eb00a2.text: 确保你的队伍能够造成足够的伤害和足够的治疗，如果可能的话，还有游侠大师南特。每次跪下最好等他，以确保任务更新，Nente会继续前进。

1d38baa8babd86ba4386e621595ba43475785fbd.source: The Charr Stalkers also spawn before accepting or completing the quest. If they are killed beforehand, Nente still has to reach their location for the quest to be completed.
1d38baa8babd86ba4386e621595ba43475785fbd.text: 夏尔追猎者也会在接受或完成任务之前生成。如果他们被提前杀死，南特仍然必须到达他们的位置才能完成任务。

6e01f45fb81fd3e1254a44f1b3531c6743fc4884.source: Head to the Breach and kill Gorgaan Hatemonger.
6e01f45fb81fd3e1254a44f1b3531c6743fc4884.text: 前往裂口并杀死戈尔冈仇恨者。

036c81d686fc83248820116706a2d2c9794b33dd.source: After accepting the quest, travel to the gate west of Nente's original position at the Balthazar statue and enter The Breach, then travel a short distance northeast to the stone bridge where you will find the Warrior boss Gorgaan Hatemonger on the far side, replacing the usual boss spawn there. He is accompanied by a group of three Charr including a Charr Martyr and a Charr Overseer; however, he can be pulled away to engage him alone.
036c81d686fc83248820116706a2d2c9794b33dd.text: 接受任务后，前往南特在巴尔萨扎雕像的原始位置以西的大门，进入裂口，然后向东北移动一小段距离到达石桥，在那里你会在远处找到战士老板戈尔冈·哈特蒙格，取代那里通常的老板产卵。陪伴他的是三名夏尔，其中包括一名夏尔殉道者和一名夏尔督军。然而，他可以被拉开，单独与他交战。

6577c9e5ac973b61a272a84d85948adb4218d851.source: Once Gorgaan has been killed, return to Master Ranger Nente at the Balthazar statue in Old Ascalon for your reward.
6577c9e5ac973b61a272a84d85948adb4218d851.text: 一旦戈尔甘被杀死，就回到旧阿斯卡隆的巴尔萨扎雕像处去找游侠大师南特以获得奖励。

18d06f4e413d92062d912e9db4f9f6bab32ce3bb.source: A duplicate Gorgaan Hatemonger may spawn at any of the other boss locations in The Breach, including one within compass range west of the entrance from Old Ascalon. Killing either version of Gorgaan will complete the quest.
18d06f4e413d92062d912e9db4f9f6bab32ce3bb.text: 重复的高尔冈憎恨者可能会在裂口中的任何其他 Boss 位置生成，包括位于旧阿斯卡隆入口以西的罗盘范围内的位置。杀死任一版本的戈尔甘都会完成任务。

ab7a4a9a18e54474cc255d8b3481359945162f1c.source: Use the Divination to locate the Facet of Destruction.
ab7a4a9a18e54474cc255d8b3481359945162f1c.text: 使用占卜来定位毁灭面。

6570a72088bb259bdbdcfaee929f3c9af1c121b6.source: You are currently carrying the Divination.

deaf639f017cf6d84420c92279a056b99c326b28.source: Defeat the Facet of Destruction to obtain its cipher.
deaf639f017cf6d84420c92279a056b99c326b28.text: 击败毁灭之面以获得其密码。

661888f9a6b97948847be2fb71947d71fc63ba16.text: 请见克尔什以获得奖励。

7b3de37f3d79cb5d575782726b1d6db3776f061c.source: It is possible to complete this quest with little effort - keep zoning into Verdant Cascades from Umbral Grotto until the bar is slightly filled - then head east and then south. As with the other Facets, the location in the zone is randomized. Divination refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the Facet's location. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the Facet is coming out of hiding.
7b3de37f3d79cb5d575782726b1d6db3776f061c.text: 可以轻松完成此任务 - 继续从 Umbral Grotto 进入 Verdant Cascades，直到酒吧稍微填满 - 然后向东，然后向南。与其他 Facet 一样，该区域中的位置是随机的。占卜是指标有“与目标的接近度”的栏，当您接近 Facet 的位置时，该栏就会填充。一旦找到接近条已填满的位置，请等待并环顾四周，看到一圈光，这表明 Facet 正在从隐藏中显现出来。

34c133a5ac3795dcbf3ff26f7289b96352bed4e2.source: The spawn location of the Facet of Destruction is random. Known spawn locations:
34c133a5ac3795dcbf3ff26f7289b96352bed4e2.text: 毁灭面的生成位置是随机的。已知的产卵地点：

459a7950d905a281a9fda86a33bebd7a62db73dd.source: At the eastern edge of the southwestern forest.

89cc9718347519fe12a9e98dd34b5b81c30fe3d7.source: Southwest of the river bend, south of the hill, east of Kaykitt Hidemender's spawn point.
89cc9718347519fe12a9e98dd34b5b81c30fe3d7.text: 河湾西南部，山丘以南，凯基特·希德蒙德的出生点以东。

a302072567089a370f48a53441f17224e5090368.source: Defeat the Facet to complete the quest. The patrolling Quetzal in the area are hostile to the Facet of Destruction and will attack and kill it once it has become visible. The quest will be complete regardless of who killed it.
a302072567089a370f48a53441f17224e5090368.text: 击败分面即可完成任务。该地区巡逻的绿咬鹃对毁灭面怀有敌意，一旦它出现，就会攻击并杀死它。无论是谁杀了它，任务都会完成。

4ff400ef2e07babf64015a8f77bd899ca084bfe5.source: Use the Divination to locate the Facet of Existence.
4ff400ef2e07babf64015a8f77bd899ca084bfe5.text: 使用占卜来定位存在的侧面。

108567f358b807863b9ba2b1c79d19d8743eab75.source: Defeat the Facet of Existence to obtain its cipher.
108567f358b807863b9ba2b1c79d19d8743eab75.text: 击败存在之面以获得其密码。

3b5a635aa8602d411b5874e00bf98b5ad5333467.source: It is possible to complete this quest with little effort - keep zoning into Riven Earth from Rata Sum until the bar is over a 1/3 full but a bit less than 1/2 full (it will be blue) - then head northeast until you reach the first mentioned spot below.
3b5a635aa8602d411b5874e00bf98b5ad5333467.text: 可以毫不费力地完成这个任务 - 继续从拉塔苏姆划入裂痕大地，直到进度条超过 1/3 满但略小于 1/2 满（它将是蓝色的） - 然后向东北走，直到到达下面第一个提到的地点。

7b5aa47ce24bccbd7e9adcf7dd2b3df8352cd8cb.source: Each time you enter Riven Earth while this quest is active, the spawning location will be reset to one of the following randomly chosen locations:
7b5aa47ce24bccbd7e9adcf7dd2b3df8352cd8cb.text: 每次您在该任务处于活动状态时进入裂痕大地，生成位置都会重置为以下随机选择的位置之一：

7ab8299e665f610853157f36a22ed9cda21727c1.source: Northwest corner of the zone. Slightly northwest of the G.O.L.E.M. mission location, among the trees south of the river. This location can be identified through rezoning (see the first wiki-map)
7ab8299e665f610853157f36a22ed9cda21727c1.text: 开发区西北角。位于 G.O.L.E.M. 稍西北处任务地点，河以南的树林中。这个位置可以通过重新分区来识别（参见第一个维基地图）

0391b1b6d0a77718c2ed2ed87dac70bf8fc0640c.source: Northeast corner of the zone. Just southwest of the Arbor Bay zone gate, on the northern bank of the river, near the bridge by the waterfall.
0391b1b6d0a77718c2ed2ed87dac70bf8fc0640c.text: 开发区东北角。就在阿伯湾区大门西南侧，河北岸，瀑布旁的桥附近。

329580eafdb3254bddf90db5db01dcd7cd2cf29a.source: Northern, middle of the zone. From the Destroyer hive at the end of G.O.L.E.M., head east past the shrine.
329580eafdb3254bddf90db5db01dcd7cd2cf29a.text: 北部、中部地区。从 G.O.L.E.M. 尽头的毁灭者巢穴出发，向东经过神殿。

f0fd44011486ed5d5cc7c41c22cfecbb26df6eed.source: Center of the zone, south of the river. This location can only be described as being at a point almost due north of the zone gate to Alcazia Tangle, but slightly southwest of a shrine. Joffs the Mitigator is located nearby.
f0fd44011486ed5d5cc7c41c22cfecbb26df6eed.text: 区域中心，河以南。这个位置只能被描述为位于阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔区域大门正北的某个点，但在一座神殿的西南方向。缓和者乔夫斯就位于附近。

3527f25ec0bdc340eb6fbe53862e981a50ebe27d.source: Divination refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the Facet's location. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the Facet is coming out of hiding. Defeat the Facet to complete the quest.
3527f25ec0bdc340eb6fbe53862e981a50ebe27d.text: 占卜是指标记为“接近目标”的栏，当您接近 Facet 的位置时，该栏就会填充。一旦找到接近条已填满的位置，请等待并环顾四周，看到一圈光，这表明 Facet 正在从隐藏中显现出来。击败分面即可完成任务。

ea476eedc620a221063138d3a4c3865e068d6b2f.source: If you have completed G.O.L.E.M. Sokka at the nearby resurrection shrine will give you an Asuran Beacon to summon a golem ally.
ea476eedc620a221063138d3a4c3865e068d6b2f.text: 如果您已完成 G.O.L.E.M.附近复活神殿的索卡会给你一个阿苏兰信标来召唤魔像盟友。

ac5795fc33ef51a85520988d5543a2a9ef57add5.source: Use the Divination to locate the Facet of Death.
ac5795fc33ef51a85520988d5543a2a9ef57add5.text: 使用占卜来定位死亡之面。

b5df8358e7e84f63365ad4ba3dfd1d350c1a66d3.source: Defeat the Facet of Death to obtain its cipher.
b5df8358e7e84f63365ad4ba3dfd1d350c1a66d3.text: 击败死亡之面以获得它的密码。

e75885dbba9aa2a3cc7f485281d37d6920976b35.source: You can complete this quest with little effort as follows: enter Sparkfly Swamp from Gadd's Encampment, and head east along the path towards the nearby wooden cart; check the proximity bar — if it starts to fill, continue northeast to the Facet of Death and defeat it. Otherwise, rezone and repeat. Be cautious of the two Raptor groups, whose patrol routes converge nearby.
e75885dbba9aa2a3cc7f485281d37d6920976b35.text: 你可以毫不费力地完成这个任务，如下：从加德的营地进入火花蝇沼泽，沿着小路向东前往附近的木车；检查邻近条——如果它开始填满，继续向东北方向到达死亡面并击败它。否则，重新分区并重复。小心两个猛禽组，它们的巡逻路线在附近交汇。

674fbd7ed91cae333f89dd9dd9d2b07091b56e02.source: Each time you enter Sparkfly Swamp while this quest is active, the spawning location will be reset to one of the following randomly chosen locations:
674fbd7ed91cae333f89dd9dd9d2b07091b56e02.text: 每次您在该任务处于活动状态时进入火花蝇沼泽，生成位置将重置为以下随机选择的位置之一：

cdef5616ca53f32b28bc2d52860ec4f35a3c0c88.source: In the middle of the swampy area dominated by Heket, who will kill the facet as soon as you trigger its appearance.
cdef5616ca53f32b28bc2d52860ec4f35a3c0c88.text: 在赫克特统治的沼泽区域中央，只要你触发它的出现，他就会杀死小面。

8e8a87fc1e4607284238540567b5b5eb2674b945.source: North of the Bloodstone Caves there is a shrine. The facet appears north of the shrine.
8e8a87fc1e4607284238540567b5b5eb2674b945.text: 血石洞北面有一座神殿。该刻面出现在神殿的北面。

1847ff4dc265be5019d458eabcff0a5de1c03ae0.source: North and a bit west of the spawn above is another shrine. The facet appears south of this shrine.
1847ff4dc265be5019d458eabcff0a5de1c03ae0.text: 上面出生点的北边和西边是另一个神殿。该刻面出现在这座神殿的南边。

a98cb4ea1291a0d2c76804a2d42faf34fe8320dc.source: East of the shrine mentioned above.

3803253c270a3f1bf0cc9b2b0942d8ff40d93df0.source: Divination refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the facet's location. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the facet is coming out of hiding. Defeat the facet to complete the quest.
3803253c270a3f1bf0cc9b2b0942d8ff40d93df0.text: 占卜是指标有“与目标的接近度”的栏，当您接近刻面的位置时，该栏就会填充。一旦找到邻近条已填满的位置，请等待并环顾四周，看到一圈光，这表明该面正在从隐藏中显现出来。击败方面以完成任务。

7f9bc1735f0d39a1546f56aa77e49c56198c6a84.source: Facets generally appear near shrines. Always make sure to look around nearby shrines after setting them as your resurrection point.
7f9bc1735f0d39a1546f56aa77e49c56198c6a84.text: 刻面通常出现在神社附近。将附近的神社设置为复活点后，请务必环顾四周。

62b30696578454cbc08171ef46ef90902359a93d.source: Because of the large number of patrolling creatures in this zone, the only suggestion that can be made is to master their movement. Rezoning is of almost no help in this situation.
62b30696578454cbc08171ef46ef90902359a93d.text: 由于这个区域里有大量的巡逻生物，唯一能提出的建议就是掌握它们的行动。在这种情况下，重新分区几乎没有帮助。

10abf1238b59dc1ef4b17daa0d26fa2be14fa886.source: Must have completed all previous Cipher quests
10abf1238b59dc1ef4b17daa0d26fa2be14fa886.text: 必须完成所有之前的密码任务

ab752952b4380e032576111e86bb544ac478f6a0.source: Use the Divination to locate the Facet of Spirit.
ab752952b4380e032576111e86bb544ac478f6a0.text: 使用占卜来定位精神面。

7e08ad96c921b8ba8d01667ee16ab742d7fd5eb5.source: Defeat the Facet of Spirit to obtain its cipher.
7e08ad96c921b8ba8d01667ee16ab742d7fd5eb5.text: 击败精神面以获得其密码。

9b876dd4393b3a811c3048d23ae13ab518efb736.source: It is possible to complete this quest with little effort - keep zoning into Arbor Bay from Vlox's Falls until the bar is red and over 75% full - then head to the closest location mentioned in the maps. As with the other Facets, the Facet of Spirit spawns randomly in one of several predetermined locations. Divination refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the Facet's location. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the Facet is coming out of hiding.
9b876dd4393b3a811c3048d23ae13ab518efb736.text: 可以毫不费力地完成此任务 - 继续从 Vlox's Falls 划分到 Arbor Bay，直到条变成红色且已满 75% 以上 - 然后前往地图中提到的最近位置。与其他方面一样，精神方面会在几个预定位置之一随机生成。占卜是指标记为“接近目标”的栏，当您接近 Facet 的位置时，该栏就会填充。一旦找到接近条已填满的位置，请等待并环顾四周，看到一圈光，这表明 Facet 正在从隐藏中显现出来。

0e1e1f3ffadc615db4e576926013d5817dcd6b99.source: The Facet of Spirit spawns randomly in Arbor Bay at one of several predetermined locations. Known spawn locations:
0e1e1f3ffadc615db4e576926013d5817dcd6b99.text: 精神面在乔木湾的几个预定位置之一随机生成。已知的产卵地点：

92213f6a55c175bf797905974c531746991fa3e5.source: In the waters directly south of Vlox's Falls.
92213f6a55c175bf797905974c531746991fa3e5.text: 在弗洛克斯瀑布正南的水域中。

3eed428a2fb8b1c6712ae2c307dcb62ed8b96532.source: Northeast of center, at the top of the hill northwest of the the northeastern lagoon
3eed428a2fb8b1c6712ae2c307dcb62ed8b96532.text: 中心东北部，东北泻湖西北的山顶

2de2384be186cb1deb6d8f79abcc2064134207ed.source: In the waters southwest of Ventari's sanctuary.

b95e76709f04490ccfda0347406a4ff307b23494.source: In the waters directly east of Ventari's sanctuary.
b95e76709f04490ccfda0347406a4ff307b23494.text: 位于文塔里圣域正东的水域。

45e6ccf941fe4d0bf6dc382ccf67b94be3a1ba2f.source: Defeat the Facet to complete the quest.
45e6ccf941fe4d0bf6dc382ccf67b94be3a1ba2f.text: 击败分面即可完成任务。

16f26bea01656aedb7d45117a1665e6dedcd170c.source: It is possible to obtain this quest without turning in the pre-requisites, however you must have them completed to do so.
16f26bea01656aedb7d45117a1665e6dedcd170c.text: 可以在不提交先决条件的情况下获得此任务，但您必须完成这些任务才能这样做。

9abd9a83e5203ed7cab911f310df7be1893c4d1e.source: Use the Divination to locate the Facet of Illusions.
9abd9a83e5203ed7cab911f310df7be1893c4d1e.text: 使用占卜来定位幻象方面。

75597b68ec6ac483a3357157935daf32fcc43969.source: Defeat the Facet of Illusions to obtain its cipher.
75597b68ec6ac483a3357157935daf32fcc43969.text: 击败幻象面以获得其密码。

3746ba8e828925218acdd3d6308bb12f4b8db095.source: It is possible to complete this quest with little effort - keep zoning into Magus Stones until the bar is 75% filled - then head to the closest location mentioned in the maps. Each time you enter Magus Stones while this quest is active, the spawning location will be reset to one of the following randomly chosen locations:
3746ba8e828925218acdd3d6308bb12f4b8db095.text: 可以轻松完成此任务 - 继续划分到魔法石中，直到栏填满 75% - 然后前往地图中提到的最近位置。每次您在该任务处于活动状态时进入魔法石，生成位置都会重置为以下随机选择的位置之一：

2943691974f066a33cf2e58ed39709de4ec4ae95.source: Northern, middle of zone, and due west of Rata Sum; in the middle of a small lake. The proximity bar will be around three quarters of the way filled when you leave Rata Sum.
2943691974f066a33cf2e58ed39709de4ec4ae95.text: 区域北部、中部以及拉塔苏姆 (Rata Sum) 正西；在一个小湖的中央。当您离开拉塔苏姆时，邻近栏将填满大约四分之三的距离。

7d0ac1e140dfd10ef67425ae29c6009b524b989b.source: This is the location closest to Rata. You can simply rezone until you obtain this location to make quest completion easier.
7d0ac1e140dfd10ef67425ae29c6009b524b989b.text: 这是距离拉塔最近的位置。您可以简单地重新分配区域，直到获得此位置，以便更轻松地完成任务。

f1b87955212ae4f92bd340c3224790041ffe859b.source: West. Due west of the zone's name on the world map, near a shrine.
f1b87955212ae4f92bd340c3224790041ffe859b.text: 西。世界地图上该地区名称的正西，靠近一座神社。

91ad0b84c771c122badd62e388f93faddf6c408b.source: Southwest. Almost due west of the zone gate to Alcazia Tangle, in the middle of the zone. Between two rock outcroppings (these appear below the zone name on the World Map).
91ad0b84c771c122badd62e388f93faddf6c408b.text: 西南。几乎位于阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔 (Alcazia Tangle) 区域大门的正西侧，位于该区域的中部。在两个岩石露头之间（这些岩石出现在世界地图上的区域名称下方）。

0c1860d8850d16b173fc8444108be708db7d16e0.source: Northwest. Near the entrance to Oola's Lab. Go north beneath the vine bridge created during the Elusive Golemancer quest into the enclosed area, the Cipher is beyond the pool.
0c1860d8850d16b173fc8444108be708db7d16e0.text: 西北。靠近 Oola 实验室的入口。在难以捉摸的傀儡师任务中创建的藤桥下向北走，进入封闭区域，密码就在水池之外。

3d52b148d7b20afb9422a4edb802216ca132d909.source: Use the Divination to locate the Facet of Creation
3d52b148d7b20afb9422a4edb802216ca132d909.text: 使用占卜来定位创造的侧面

422b30f9ae5dd667ec422ba9ffe695b3acbd96e8.source: Defeat the Facet of Creation to obtain its cipher.
422b30f9ae5dd667ec422ba9ffe695b3acbd96e8.text: 击败创造之面以获得其密码。

f6124bfb70aac927b4ae581a6c6e07d8910a8023.source: Each time you enter Alcazia Tangle while this quest is active, the spawning location will be reset to one of the following randomly chosen locations:
f6124bfb70aac927b4ae581a6c6e07d8910a8023.text: 每次您在该任务处于活动状态时进入阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区，生成位置都会重置为以下随机选择的位置之一：

76e9152096211442e576ff4d314695959b4e1173.source: From the Riven Earth zone gate entering with the Cipher filled at 75% indicates the position is to the South of the zone gate, right below the bluff in a clearing free of any mobs. Clear the area around the bluff of an Angorodon patrol if you wish, although this is not necessary (a Redhand Simian group will be to the east of your position on the bluff). This is the easiest of the locations.
76e9152096211442e576ff4d314695959b4e1173.text: 从 Riven Earth 区域大门进入，密码填满 75% 表示该位置位于区域大门的南边，在悬崖正下方，没有任何小怪的空地上。如果你愿意的话，可以清理安戈罗顿巡逻队的悬崖周围的区域，尽管这不是必要的（红手猿猴群将在你悬崖上位置的东边）。这是最简单的位置。

118d222a012f35c774a7dd2539c921c54d49dc11.source: Northeast corner of the zone. West of the zone gate to Arbor Bay, past the river.
118d222a012f35c774a7dd2539c921c54d49dc11.text: 开发区东北角。区域大门以西，经过河流，通往阿伯湾。

00fd3265894be91a521f50a535cdd02543c7b033.source: This is identifiable by the bar starting to fill just down the hill north of the first simian group.
00fd3265894be91a521f50a535cdd02543c7b033.text: 这可以通过在第一个猿猴群以北的山下开始填充的条形来识别。

13996d351372b9562122ef28bb936460f884972a.source: You can quickly rezone from Arbor Bay, if the bar appears ~2/3 filled and red you will know the spawn is closest to you, if not simply rezone.
13996d351372b9562122ef28bb936460f884972a.text: 你可以从 Arbor Bay 快速重新分区，如果栏显示 ~2/3 填充并呈红色，你就会知道出生点离你最近，如果不是简单地重新分区。

68df499b98323d3bef6958cecb997d04e78d5fb8.source: Northwest corner of the zone. Just northeast of the zone gate to Magus Stones.
68df499b98323d3bef6958cecb997d04e78d5fb8.text: 开发区西北角。就在魔法石区域大门的东北方。

d5b241f5c292cbdd532702a27eacaa4728d4af36.source: If you want to take this one go into the zone gate to Riven Earth.Once you went through the zone gate, go back to Alcazia Tangle. Check the divination. If it is filled 25% immediately after gating the Cipher will be nearby east of your position. If it it isn't go back to Riven Earth and repeat this. This way it will be a lot easier.
d5b241f5c292cbdd532702a27eacaa4728d4af36.text: 如果你想拿这个，请进入裂痕地球的区域大门。穿过区域大门后，返回阿尔卡齐亚·坦格尔。检查占卜。如果在门控后立即填充 25%，密码将位于您位置的东边附近。如果不是，请返回裂痕地球并重复此操作。这样就会容易很多。

adbc7aff189159534f34d3dbabb889dcc4a40e6d.source: Southwest, slightly southwest of a Ceratadon patrol.
adbc7aff189159534f34d3dbabb889dcc4a40e6d.text: 西南方向，稍稍位于角齿龙巡逻队的西南方向。

12edd48a26994ad265aac64afff12e0a67da107c.source: South/South-West, on an open field near a Resurrection Shrine.
12edd48a26994ad265aac64afff12e0a67da107c.text: 南/西南，复活神殿附近的一片空地上。

4f3375e5f25a35dcf51a2406c6dd5c314cc536dd.source: Divination refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the Facet's location. Initially the bar fills as blue, even though your character is moving towards the target - an increasing, blue bar means your character is going in the right direction. At 50% proximity to target the bar turns red. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the Facet is coming out of hiding. Defeat the Facet to complete the quest.
4f3375e5f25a35dcf51a2406c6dd5c314cc536dd.text: 占卜是指标记为“接近目标”的栏，当您接近 Facet 的位置时，该栏就会填充。最初，即使您的角色正在向目标移动，该条仍填充为蓝色 - 不断增加的蓝色条意味着您的角色正在朝正确的方向前进。距离目标 50% 时，条形图会变成红色。一旦找到接近条已填满的位置，请等待并环顾四周，看到一圈光，这表明 Facet 正在从隐藏中显现出来。击败分面即可完成任务。

6969b5a12fc83f66c343b2539515a8b04100a78c.source: Turning off the mission progress bar in the interface menu will hide the Divination bar.
6969b5a12fc83f66c343b2539515a8b04100a78c.text: 关闭界面菜单中的任务进度条将隐藏占卜栏。

ff4d81a84ce44e3f75bb55024ccb005bbe749dc9.source: This quest has good synergy with the quest Turning the Page. Start from Rata Sum, taking the southern exit into Magus Stones. Select the Turning the Page quest and follow the quest marker south to the exit into Alcazia Tangle. Zone in and out of Alcazia Tangle, until the Divination bar is filled about 10-15%. Walk south following the quest marker again. Defeat the White mantle and take the tome out of the chest, then walk further south (and defeating, or skipping Pywatt the Swift) until the divination bar is full. Defeat the Cipher of Melandru, and zone to Tarnished Haven. Exit Tarnished Haven to get the quest reward for Turning the Page.
ff4d81a84ce44e3f75bb55024ccb005bbe749dc9.text: 该任务与翻页任务具有良好的协同作用。从 Rata Sum 出发，从南面出口进入 Magus Stones。选择翻页任务，然后沿着任务标记向南到达阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区的出口。进出阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区的区域，直到占卜栏填满约 10-15%。再次沿着任务标记向南走。击败白斗篷并从箱子中取出书本，然后继续向南走（击败或跳过迅捷者皮瓦特），直到占卜栏满了。击败梅兰德鲁密码，前往玷污避风港。退出失去光泽的避难所以获得翻开新页的任务奖励。
