f3d82fb42a257660dcd8e173dbca0deef66a3a2c.source: Some characters who have never been to Tarnished Haven have this quest in their logs, but the reason is currently unknown.
f3d82fb42a257660dcd8e173dbca0deef66a3a2c.text: 一些从未去过玷污避难所的角色的日志中有此任务，但目前原因未知。

663a7736c0512e04c6052e05e6c31d0d57924d02.source: Destroy all residents of the Margonite City.
663a7736c0512e04c6052e05e6c31d0d57924d02.text: 消灭玛贡尼特城的所有居民。

56f5e716bc2d8701f9c056fba03a8db0c0bcd122.source: This quest may be divided in different parts. The players begin outside of the Margonite City itself, where many Margonite groups stand in long patrol patterns - it's important to pull each group individually, making sure that the players do not stand on the patrol route of other enemies. It's wise to kill the Margonites standing on the City's walls - they are out of range from melee characters, but they are able to hit players thanks to being elementalists and rangers, and so ranged sources of damage are capable of destroying them.
56f5e716bc2d8701f9c056fba03a8db0c0bcd122.text: 这个任务可以分为不同的部分。玩家从玛贡尼特城外开始，那里有许多玛贡尼特团体以长长的巡逻模式站立 - 单独拉动每个小组很重要，以确保玩家不会站在其他敌人的巡逻路线上。杀死站在城墙上的玛贡尼特是明智之举 - 他们超出了近战角色的范围，但由于他们是元素主义者和游侠，他们能够击中玩家，因此远程伤害源能够摧毁他们。

4e607879232e400fcd7f1c6986ce89f10027a28e.source: After all enemies outside have been killed, Captain Sulahresh will move foward and the gates for the city itself will open. Inside, there are more Margonite groups, similar to those outside - the same strategies work here, with the advantage that it's possible to use the terrain for the players' benefit (such as when attacking enemies through walls).
4e607879232e400fcd7f1c6986ce89f10027a28e.text: 当外面的所有敌人都被杀死后，苏拉赫雷什队长将继续前进，城市本身的大门将会打开。内部有更多的玛贡尼特群体，与外部类似 - 在这里使用相同的策略，其优点是可以利用地形为玩家谋取利益（例如穿过墙壁攻击敌人时）。

f5f57a7fe8499ab8326585d194f6f7dc44da2422.source: Once all enemies have been killed, the quest itself will be over, and it becomes possible to accept the quest reward from Captain Sulahresh (a good way of removing Death Penalty for the group). Once the quest reward has been accepted, Lord Jadoth and his army of Margonites will arrive through the gate leading to the Stygian Veil, allowing you to spawn a Torc'qua Chest and progress the quest Mallyx the Unyielding. See there for strategies.
f5f57a7fe8499ab8326585d194f6f7dc44da2422.text: 一旦所有敌人都被杀死，任务本身就会结束，并且可以接受苏拉赫什队长的任务奖励（这是消除团队死刑的好方法）。一旦接受了任务奖励，贾多斯勋爵和他的玛贡尼特大军将穿过通往斯泰吉亚面纱的大门到达，让你生成一个托克夸宝箱并继续任务“不屈的马里克斯”。请参阅那里的策略。

8bbbf8255d2787c9d3f9b3bace65e1b29b8b3095.source: Travel to the Poisoned Outcrops and find the resting place of the Staff of the Mists before Battlelord Turgar discovers it.
8bbbf8255d2787c9d3f9b3bace65e1b29b8b3095.text: 前往有毒露头并在战将图尔加发现之前找到迷雾之杖的安息之地。

4a596acf6554b2f5d43af797a18b41df87fcb39b.source: Defeat Battlelord Turgar before he completes the ritual to activate the Staff of the Mists.
4a596acf6554b2f5d43af797a18b41df87fcb39b.text: 在战争领主图尔加完成激活迷雾之杖的仪式之前击败他。

7a10bd2667182d95950ed27f658a42cb684ac287.source: Recover the Staff of the Mists.

6f25897e5d055c8a2656134963313214e84f33fa.source: Enter the Poisoned Outcrops and follow the quest pointer towards the north-west. There is a wide area with several patrols after the left corridor which can easy over-aggro, pull them back to the corridor to dispatch them one by one. The quest log will update by first time once you reach the resting place of the Staff of the Mist, you will see two enemy types Mummies and Margonite patrols, always keep watch of your radar so that foes won`t overwhelm your party.
6f25897e5d055c8a2656134963313214e84f33fa.text: 进入有毒露头并按照任务指针向西北方向前进。左边走廊后面有一片广阔的区域，有几个巡逻队，很容易产生仇恨，把他们拉回走廊一一消灭。一旦你到达迷雾之杖的安息地，任务日志就会第一时间更新，你会看到两种敌人类型木乃伊和玛贡尼特巡逻队，时刻注意你的雷达，这样敌人就不会压倒你的队伍。

d6243f64953d8d1b6fd5162c3aaf4b0786b567c5.source: Battlelord Turgar will be behind 3 separate groups of Margonites, each group can be lured away and dispatched before killing the boss alone. Once defeated, it will drop the Staff of the Mists and the spirit of Buuran will be released for your reward.
d6243f64953d8d1b6fd5162c3aaf4b0786b567c5.text: 战将图尔加将在 3 组独立的玛贡尼特身后，每组都可以在单独杀死 Boss 之前引诱并派遣出去。一旦被击败，它将掉落迷雾之杖，并且布乌兰的灵魂将被释放以获得奖励。

b2f26453dd2e366a9ab210a4df6a27b3c1e7c8bf.source: This can be a good time to work on Forgotten Retribution, since there are about 20 Margonites at the endpoint, and a few groups along the way.
b2f26453dd2e366a9ab210a4df6a27b3c1e7c8bf.text: 这可能是处理“被遗忘的报应”的好时机，因为终点处大约有 20 个玛贡尼特，沿途还有一些小组。

81f57279c9421da54d851744049456ebde33a6fb.source: Establish a stable base of operations in Kourna.
81f57279c9421da54d851744049456ebde33a6fb.text: 在库尔纳建立稳定的运营基地。

dd2892f6aa6d1f3087c7567408e9422d5d07a67d.source: Complete "Building the Base: Prisoners of War."

e89993f8a513ba60f15be0666408620dfdff3a78.source: Deliver the supplies to Ghost of Althea.
e89993f8a513ba60f15be0666408620dfdff3a78.text: 将补给品交给阿尔西娅之魂。

cb110130a3fe52602453cdbe20ac15ca2652fac3.source: Find a way to the next floor.

3fe160b05869e74ec4a1f213b38b292f8dcc3422.source: Track down Duke Willgrove and recover the stolen goods.
3fe160b05869e74ec4a1f213b38b292f8dcc3422.text: 追踪威尔格罗夫公爵并追回赃物。

f9776d4484508fc0e21bb29737bdf43e0aed8a57.source: Return the stolen supplies to Ghost of Althea.
f9776d4484508fc0e21bb29737bdf43e0aed8a57.text: 将偷来的物资归还给阿尔西娅之魂。

b8b07249292833183b8b1d7c88d359a8beda322c.text: 与阿尔西娅的幽灵交谈

92a2d3da05fe19286d6cbff71105ebdbe0a8e783.source: Players familiar with the walkthrough of Forsaken Tunnels will find this quest to proceed in a similar way, with the Duke at the same location as Maz Scourgeheart, without boss key or boss lock, and an elemental keystone located on the other side when facing the crystal gate, forcing you to go a bit further.
92a2d3da05fe19286d6cbff71105ebdbe0a8e783.text: 熟悉被遗忘隧道流程的玩家会发现这个任务以类似的方式进行，公爵与马兹·天灾之心位于同一位置，没有老板钥匙或老板锁，并且在面对水晶门时在另一侧有一个元素梯形石，迫使你走得更远。

2c185aff18bfc67528bc3225b9ffa2033b152648.source: Enter the Tunnels of the Forsaken and be careful of occasional Wind Riders patrols. Head towards the objective marker and talk to Ghost of Althea. From there, head straight north, up the hill, and kill the bandits at the camp until you get a Elemental Keystone. Pick it up, and bring it to the crystal gate in the north. The gate opens, enter the second level.
2c185aff18bfc67528bc3225b9ffa2033b152648.text: 进入被遗忘者隧道并小心偶尔巡逻的乘风者。前往目标标记并与 Althea 的幽灵交谈。从那里，一直向北走，上山，杀死营地里的强盗，直到获得元素钥石。捡起来，带到北边的水晶门。门打开，进入第二层。

632677e553cf560cd2b9bd3337f27e0f3db6acd3.source: On the second level, head forward and take the left side wherever possible, left around the tree, left of the crystal, left around the rock, left around the cauldron and go under the overpass. Take left again after the glowing altar, and after you'll start getting dialogue from Duke Willgrove, head straight to find him. Talk to Duke to retrieve the stolen supplies.
632677e553cf560cd2b9bd3337f27e0f3db6acd3.text: 在第二层，向前走，尽可能走左边，在树周围左边，在水晶左边，在岩石周围左边，在大锅周围左边，然后到立交桥下。经过发光祭坛后再次左转，在你开始收到威尔格罗夫公爵的对话后，径直去找他。与杜克交谈以取回被盗的物资。

c599ef986404711af0c5cbe3d778b7bcf4a30524.source: To return the supplies to Althea on the first level of the dungeon, it can be faster to map travel to Piken Square. Talk to Althea to return the stolen supplies, and again to accept the reward for the quest.
c599ef986404711af0c5cbe3d778b7bcf4a30524.text: 要将补给品返还给地牢第一层的阿尔西娅，可以更快地绘制前往皮肯广场的地图。与 Althea 交谈以归还被盗的物资，并再次接受任务奖励。

9127e4f97cddb8d5f771c4763df58c50e578b5d9.source: The quest marker for Duke Willgrove will appear to point to the exit when entering level two of the Tunnels of the Forsaken
9127e4f97cddb8d5f771c4763df58c50e578b5d9.text: 当进入被遗忘者隧道第二层时，威尔格罗夫公爵的任务标记将显示为指向出口

ffcfe9a4fcc989c2f1f2af41ad8a801036e47416.source: If you travel outside of the dungeon after recovering the stolen goods, the quest objectives will reset; but if you re-enter the dungeon they will return to where they should be, allowing you to complete the quest without redoing any steps.
ffcfe9a4fcc989c2f1f2af41ad8a801036e47416.text: 如果你在找回赃物后离开地牢，任务目标将会重置；但如果你重新进入地牢，它们会回到它们应该在的地方，让你无需重做任何步骤即可完成任务。

9b15c73218f9db02e778627965aec18743066831.source: You can do this quest faster with a running build, since only some bandits on the first level have to be defeated, for the Elemental Keystone. Just make sure you bring something that can kill them (e.g.: a party, a summoning stone or even skills near your running ones, especially on normal mode).
9b15c73218f9db02e778627965aec18743066831.text: 您可以通过运行构建更快地完成此任务，因为只有第一级的一些强盗必须被击败才能获得元素钥石。只要确保你带了一些可以杀死他们的东西（例如：一个队伍，一块召唤石，甚至是你正在奔跑的人附近的技能，尤其是在正常模式下）。

279163f7854f0c2d05471524e82791d82e245bc2.source: Speak with Tahon and attempt to join the cult of the Stone Face.
279163f7854f0c2d05471524e82791d82e245bc2.text: 与塔洪交谈并尝试加入石面教。

60987c3d54d4866f381f885bed2075d0381520e1.source: Prove your might by defeating the crew of corsairs in southern Zehlon Reach
60987c3d54d4866f381f885bed2075d0381520e1.text: 击败泽隆河段南部的海盗船员，证明你的力量

c5ab96799ae44e69583cc9f67a3616cedc7c5971.source: Prove your resilience by withstanding an assault from an army of skales
c5ab96799ae44e69583cc9f67a3616cedc7c5971.text: 抵挡住骷髅大军的攻击，证明你的韧性

601305d15df7f23eede8a9df4170380c05246f28.text: 前往 Tahon 领取奖励

1ea8592b2d93e2fde09ac0a4827bbc7cd2a94fcd.source: The cultists can be found on the drier grounds near the center, west out of the Astralarium. They are gathered around a fallen stone head, the object of their cult worship.
1ea8592b2d93e2fde09ac0a4827bbc7cd2a94fcd.text: 信徒们可以在中心附近干燥的地面上找到，星辰馆以西。他们聚集在一个倒下的石头周围，这是他们崇拜的对象。

15e6f92d3ba9949ad8e7489dbbfb48483d0297eb.source: Tahon, the cult leader, will test your party by first instructing you to defeat a group of 6 corsairs a bit to the southwest. If the party is victorious, Tahon will test them again by asking them to defeat a group of 6 skales, which spawns to the north and will charge towards the party's location. The cultists will not get attacked. For low-level parties, be careful of the AoE damage spikes from the skales.
15e6f92d3ba9949ad8e7489dbbfb48483d0297eb.text: 邪教领袖 Tahon 将测试你的队伍，首先指示你击败西南方向的 6 艘海盗船。如果队伍获胜，塔洪将再次测试他们，要求他们击败一组 6 个斯卡勒斯，这些斯卡勒斯在北方生成，并向队伍所在地冲锋。邪教徒不会受到攻击。对于低等级队伍，要小心来自骷髅的 AoE 伤害峰值。

8d965d9af388b842570090f12301ff86a29ec3c4.source: Once the skales are defeated, Tahon will accept the characters into the cult.
8d965d9af388b842570090f12301ff86a29ec3c4.text: 一旦斯卡莱斯被击败，塔洪就会接受这些角色加入邪教。

23a9ab02facda018e86588992030e4236823af95.source: If you leave the area before completing this quest, you will have to begin anew.
23a9ab02facda018e86588992030e4236823af95.text: 如果您在完成此任务之前离开该区域，则必须重新开始。

8ea1feadbe47e21a22e605fbce1c4100099bc3c6.source: Find and defeat the Skale Lord Jurpa.
8ea1feadbe47e21a22e605fbce1c4100099bc3c6.text: 找到并击败斯卡勒领主朱尔帕。

894b90ef06124effd3e842f03d7b563ee1e6b593.source: After the Assault on Beknur Harbor, talk to Elder Jurdu to get this quest. Travel to Mehtani Keys and head to the Cyclone Palace in the southeastern corner. Pull the numerous level 13 Skale Blighters and level 4 Ridgeback Skale group by group. Finally, attack and kill the Skale Lord, who is grouped with Skale Lashers and Frigid Skale. Be careful of possible spike damage from the combined Ice Spear of all the Frigid Skale.
894b90ef06124effd3e842f03d7b563ee1e6b593.text: 袭击贝克努尔港后，与长老朱尔杜交谈即可完成此任务。前往Mehtani Keys，前往东南角的旋风宫。一组一组地拉动大量 13 级 Skale Blighters 和 4 级 Ridgeback Skale。最后，攻击并杀死斯凯尔领主，他与斯凯尔鞭打者和冰冷斯凯尔同组。小心所有冰冻斯凯尔的冰矛组合可能造成的尖刺伤害。

275a6735f5377169f5dd5703dee91046c13a1d5b.source: Kill the 3 Darknesses in the Hall of Heroes.
275a6735f5377169f5dd5703dee91046c13a1d5b.text: 杀死英雄大厅中的 3 个黑暗。

d3314f34fbef53284fb8864fbabb630cf62f41b9.source: *BONUS* Kill the 3 Darknesses in Hard Mode.
d3314f34fbef53284fb8864fbabb630cf62f41b9.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 3 个黑暗。

19c7c40ed9031f7276514065746ac68d46450751.source: Find and destroy the source of the Luxon outcasts and Oni
19c7c40ed9031f7276514065746ac68d46450751.text: 找到并摧毁卢克森流亡者和鬼的根源

ef871f2f2ca95631b35acb7be49654065b8fe191.source: Killing Kanaxai spawns Kanaxai's Chest, which will reward:
ef871f2f2ca95631b35acb7be49654065b8fe191.text: 杀死卡纳赛会生成卡纳赛的宝箱，它将奖励：

7f72e51b57dcfe4ec63cc6d641be6184eec8c043.source: Three Jadeite Shards (6 Jadeite Shards in Hard mode)
7f72e51b57dcfe4ec63cc6d641be6184eec8c043.text: 三个翡翠碎片（困难模式下为 6 个翡翠碎片）

fd169bf1b8039b361b1dbfa9531055014ee2dfac.source: One Passage Scroll to the Deep (Hard Mode only)
fd169bf1b8039b361b1dbfa9531055014ee2dfac.text: 一篇卷轴深入（仅限困难模式）

39ebfb2ea25869e9e4d83aa326519b4811afa510.source: One of the following (two in Hard mode):
39ebfb2ea25869e9e4d83aa326519b4811afa510.text: 以下之一（困难模式下为两个）：

48d7e2869916e5332aa16839885a38da0345da8a.source: A rare inscribable item, which may be one of the following items that are only available from this chest or Urgoz's Chest:
48d7e2869916e5332aa16839885a38da0345da8a.text: 一件稀有的铭文物品，可能是以下只能从该宝箱或乌尔戈兹宝箱中获得的物品之一：

8d54c4f6d94edfc2bb683ab267b45354331302f5.source: A unique item unique to this chest:
8d54c4f6d94edfc2bb683ab267b45354331302f5.text: 该箱子独有的独特物品：

05dced07abdc65fef360bd07e62bd0cf6f9cfe2a.source: The Deep is also one of only two places in which the following non-inscribable weapons can drop (either from a foe or through one of the chests):
05dced07abdc65fef360bd07e62bd0cf6f9cfe2a.text: 深渊也是仅有的两个可以掉落以下不可书写武器的地方之一（无论是从敌人身上还是通过其中一个箱子）：

cafdbae398181dadd73ed7cdd80bca1310d0b45d.source: The entire mission area is divided into fifteen sections, each with its own environment effect. The environment effect for each section persists until the Aspect of Kanaxai in that section is defeated. While killing the Aspect quickly will help in some rooms, it is not necessary to kill the Aspects to continue through the mission to the next section. The effects in the initial and final sections are permanent.
cafdbae398181dadd73ed7cdd80bca1310d0b45d.text: 整个任务区分为十五个区域，每个区域都有自己的环境效果。每个部分的环境效果一直持续到该部分的 Kanaxai 守护者被击败为止。虽然快速杀死守护者在某些房间会有所帮助，但没有必要杀死守护者才能继续执行下一部分的任务。最初和最后部分的效果是永久性的。

3fa67e74ea2903bf3aafba8c40eb5e4804ad30d0.source: Bear in mind that this mission can take around 1 to 2 hours, depending on how experienced the team is. If you have not been there before, it is wise to proceed slowly and carefully, due to Oni pops and Aspect effects. It is a bad idea to try to rush through this mission without knowing the spawns.
3fa67e74ea2903bf3aafba8c40eb5e4804ad30d0.text: 请记住，此任务可能需要大约 1 到 2 小时，具体取决于团队的经验。如果您以前没有去过那里，那么明智的做法是缓慢而小心地进行，因为有鬼流行和方面效果。在不知道生成点的情况下尝试匆忙完成此任务是一个坏主意。

9979c6251739d839f1548d366408b98cd3d1af7b.source: In The Deep, a tank and wall method is often used. One tank pulls foes into a wall made of either other tank, spirits and/or minions who bodyblock. The skill level of your tank/s often define how effective your team will be. Before attempting The Deep, its highly suggested to find an experienced tank or someone who knows the Deep reasonably well. Stance warriors are recommended for the tanking role, as enchant removal and area effects can get through skills such as Shadow Form and Spell Breaker.
9979c6251739d839f1548d366408b98cd3d1af7b.text: 在《深海》中，经常使用水池和墙的方法。一辆坦克将敌人拉入由其他坦克、灵魂和/或身体阻挡的小兵组成的墙中。你的坦克的技能水平通常决定了你的团队的效率。在尝试深海之前，强烈建议找一位经验丰富的坦克或对深海相当了解的人。建议使用姿态战士担任坦克角色，因为附魔移除和区域效果可以通过暗影形态和法术破坏者等技能来实现。

f9b7d06bf90c7bc34397e14db311dfb34c4183d4.source: Enchantment removals or interrupts are required to stop Kanaxai's Nightmare Refuge (Revealed Enchantment is particularly good since it recharges instantly vs Monster enchantments, and can also be used on other Oni and Aspects). Knock down skills are a must to kill Kanaxai and his aspects. "You Move Like a Dwarf!" is a good shout for this, as it is available to all classes and activates instantly, making it an efficient interrupt as well.
f9b7d06bf90c7bc34397e14db311dfb34c4183d4.text: 需要移除结界或中断结界来阻止 Kanaxai 的噩梦避难所（显露结界特别好，因为它会立即对怪物结界进行充电，并且也可以用于其他 Oni 和 Aspects）。击倒技能是杀死 Kanaxai 及其方面的必备技能。 “你像个侏儒一样移动！”这是一个很好的说法，因为它可供所有类使用并立即激活，这也使其成为一个有效的中断。

c7a92b4137dfe7d9dbcc769c7d869ab245a3a213.source: Aspect of Exhaustion : While under this aspect, you suffer from overcast every 30 seconds.
c7a92b4137dfe7d9dbcc769c7d869ab245a3a213.text: 疲惫相位：在此相位下，你每30秒就会遭受阴沉的折磨。

9e306304716119d4e3ffed877d32e14304fa9a4f.source: This is the arrival room. The party must split into four groups of three. Each group needs to enter through one of four different portals, which will activate from the far right to the far left one at a time. Ideally each group of 3 should possess a knockdown. The team should have decided upon the group split prior to entering the mission - do not linger in this section, characters will quickly be overcast. When organizing groups ensure to assign characters equally e.g.: two damage dealers and one monk. As long as one of the four teams breaks out into the 5th section and kills the Aspect of Pain, they can then rescue the whole team through the now open gates. It is not necessary to kill any of the first four Aspects as killing the fish in each room will open the gates regardless of the status of the Aspects.
9e306304716119d4e3ffed877d32e14304fa9a4f.text: 这是到达房间。该党必须分成四组，每组三人。每个小组需要通过四个不同的门户之一进入，这些门户将从最右到最左一次激活。理想情况下，每组 3 人都应具有击倒能力。团队应该在进入任务之前就决定好分组——不要在这个部分徘徊，角色很快就会阴沉的。组织团体时，确保平等分配角色，例如：两名伤害经销商和一名僧侣。只要四支队伍中的一支突入第五区，击杀痛苦之象，就可以通过现在打开的大门营救全队。没有必要杀死前四个守护者中的任何一个，因为无论守护者的状态如何，杀死每个房间中的鱼都会打开大门。

7def39f8b802959e774582c38d0f16566540c051.source: It is possible to have 10 heroes in a single room. With two players, one flags their first three heroes to gate one (far right) and flag the rest of the heroes back at the wooden gate. Once all two/three players are inside Room Two, unflagging the heroes will cause them all to rejoin the players after a short delay.
7def39f8b802959e774582c38d0f16566540c051.text: 一个房间里可以有10个英雄。对于两名玩家，一名玩家将他们的前三名英雄标记为一号门（最右侧），并将其余英雄标记为木门。一旦所有两/三名玩家都进入二号房间，取消英雄标记将使他们在短暂的延迟后重新加入玩家。

dae6c4a19f2c8bc1b6c677582c949a143840e524.source: The Aspects of Kanaxai are fast moving and attacking melee foes. At 75%, 50%, and 25% health, they will stop taking damage until knocked down. It is not necessary to kill them, as the gates open once mobs are killed.
dae6c4a19f2c8bc1b6c677582c949a143840e524.text: 卡纳赛的守护者移动速度快，攻击近战敌人。当生命值为 75%、50% 和 25% 时，它们将不再受到伤害，直到被击倒。没有必要杀死他们，因为一旦怪物被杀死，大门就会打开。

cdcfe8859b3944435cc6f804219eab7ba5d268df.source: While under this aspect, you cannot "block" attacks.
cdcfe8859b3944435cc6f804219eab7ba5d268df.text: 在这个方面，你无法“阻止”攻击。

09d3524b5b86ba8a548b59d99f9d0bfa8e704c37.source: Take advantage of kiting and anti-melee skills. (Such as the cripple inflicted by "You Move Like a Dwarf!")
09d3524b5b86ba8a548b59d99f9d0bfa8e704c37.text: 利用风筝和反近战技能。 （例如“你像个侏儒一样移动！”造成的跛行）

250f25624948ae08a19fdf729f361d7cda8690e3.source: When under this aspect, whenever you are struck by an attack, you are knocked down.
250f25624948ae08a19fdf729f361d7cda8690e3.text: 在这个相位下，只要受到攻击，就会被击倒。

ee3bbb92213ff876c019d741cb83e601f5283c6d.source: Considered the toughest of the first four rooms, take advantage of anti-melee skills (e.g. Spiteful Spirit) - which deal damage even if team members are knocked down, and spirits - to bodyblock and absorb the hits.
ee3bbb92213ff876c019d741cb83e601f5283c6d.text: 被认为是前四个房间中最难的一个，利用反近战技能（例如恶意精神） - 即使团队成员被击倒也会造成伤害，而精神 - 可以进行身体格挡并吸收击中。

80af1f54b4b5303dc3e3a153483e6fbc9bc473fc.source: While under this aspect, you receive 20% less benefit from healing.
80af1f54b4b5303dc3e3a153483e6fbc9bc473fc.text: 在这个相位下，你从治疗中获得的好处会减少 20%。

e3686a9bede4bdc6eebf95409da7bc06f43af576.source: Considered the easiest of the first four rooms. Any balanced team should make it through.
e3686a9bede4bdc6eebf95409da7bc06f43af576.text: 被认为是前四个房间中最简单的一个。任何平衡的团队都应该能够成功。

4fac220931f15646ae86764c1cc44a1d106ec8d4.source: While under this aspect, it takes you twice as long to gain adrenaline.
4fac220931f15646ae86764c1cc44a1d106ec8d4.text: 在这个相位下，你需要两倍的时间才能获得肾上腺素。

a961f840dc692540c75b088c1ad58346a7acff8b.source: Take advantage of casters damage and anti-melee.
a961f840dc692540c75b088c1ad58346a7acff8b.text: 利用脚轮伤害和反近战优势。

709b487279837d55759e8473dab9e79dc2ab48ae.source: Aspect of Pain : While under this aspect, you suffer -2 Health degeneration and suffer from the effects of Deep Wound.
709b487279837d55759e8473dab9e79dc2ab48ae.text: 痛苦方面：在这个方面，你会遭受-2健康退化并遭受深伤的影响。

9de3c3b73c5eb92052c931a1c2ddd18c00030df9.source: This Section is heavily patrolled by three large groups of Ripper Carps, Scourge Mantas, Blessed Mantas and Darkened Irukandjis. A bad pull will result in over-aggro, so watch patiently and pull them back inside either of the previous rooms to avoid aggroing more while in combat. The only difficulty here is the Irukandji's Restoration spirit, which resurrects every other foe that was killed in its area. Killing the spirit or stealing it with Signet of Binding will prompt the Irukandjis to cast a new one, but you can use Swap to move it away from corpses.
9de3c3b73c5eb92052c931a1c2ddd18c00030df9.text: 该区域由三大群开膛鲤鱼、天灾蝠鲼、祝福蝠鲼和黑暗伊鲁坎吉斯严密巡逻。拉不好会导致过度仇恨，因此请耐心观察并将它们拉回之前的房间内，以避免在战斗中出现更多仇恨。这里唯一的困难是伊鲁坎吉的复兴精神，它会复活在其区域内被杀死的所有其他敌人。杀死灵魂或用束缚徽记偷走它会促使伊鲁坎吉家族施放一个新的灵魂，但你可以使用交换将其从尸体上移开。

03e4acaaab0057456d09cde61edfbef57c773dc6.source: Killing all enemies except the Kanaxai Aspect of Pain will unlock all the gates, including the ones leading from the first four sections.
03e4acaaab0057456d09cde61edfbef57c773dc6.text: 杀死除卡纳赛痛苦之灵以外的所有敌人将解锁所有大门，包括从前四个部分通向的大门。

0b00afff91773455d9c01f9217c3e8e0b20d719c.source: Aspect of Lethargy : While under this aspect, you move 50% slower.
0b00afff91773455d9c01f9217c3e8e0b20d719c.text: 昏睡方面：在此方面下，你的移动速度减慢 50%。

e2fbd4c69a5cd8ba60a1204bda145a427a34ecc4.source: This room contains Leviathan Arms, Leviathan Minds and Leviathan Heads. Avoid rushing in to the middle as foes will close in from both sides. Instead, choose one side and clear to the other. Casters should be wary of Choking Gas from the Leviathan Heads. There is a Fire Flower nearby which throws fire projectiles that cause burning, touch once only to deactivate it. (A second touch will re-activate it.) The Aspect of Lethargy will be standing alone at the back of the room. When the Aspect is dead, kill the foes immediately behind the gate. In order to open the next gate, the team will have to temporarily sacrifice some of the players. It is important that crucial players do not stand on the pad (i.e. healers).
e2fbd4c69a5cd8ba60a1204bda145a427a34ecc4.text: 这个房间包含利维坦武器、利维坦思想和利维坦头。避免冲入中间，因为敌人会从两侧逼近。相反，选择一侧并清除另一侧。施法者应该警惕利维坦头部的窒息气体。附近有一朵火焰花，它会发射火焰弹，造成燃烧，触摸一次即可将其停用。 （第二次触摸将重新激活它。）昏睡的方面将独自站在房间的后面。当守护者死亡后，立即杀死门后的敌人。为了打开下一扇门，队伍将不得不暂时牺牲一些队员。重要的是关键玩家不要站在垫子上（即治疗者）。

4561c575796901482f888594f940be24815456a3.source: In the room that you have just cleared, there are a series of five wooden pads (square in shape with a round turtle shell in the center) which are activated when five players or heroes stands on them at once, one body per switch. If any of the five volunteers step off the pads, the gate will close after a short delay. While the five are standing on the pads, the other seven should cross through the temporarily open gate. The five volunteers should then move touch range to the now shut gate. Players with Recall, Shadow Meld or Dwarven Stability combined with Dash can manage to shadow step/rush through the gate before it closes (allowing them to avoid committing suicide).
4561c575796901482f888594f940be24815456a3.text: 在你刚刚清理的房间里，有一系列五个木垫（方形，中间有一个圆形龟壳），当五个玩家或英雄同时站在它们上时，每个开关一个身体，这些木垫就会被激活。如果五名志愿者中的任何一个离开垫子，大门将在短暂延迟后关闭。当五个人站在垫子上时，其他七个人应该穿过暂时打开的大门。然后，五名志愿者应将触摸范围移至现已关闭的大门。具有召回、暗影融合或矮人稳定性与冲刺相结合的玩家可以在大门关闭之前设法通过暗影步/冲过去（让他们避免自杀）。

c065da4cd171fdb52c25a4bb8c22852d9c384062.source: Normal mode only note: Sapping Nightmares will not cast Chaos Storm in normal mode on allies wielding martial weapons (i.e. no staves or scepters), regardless of profession. They will and do however use it in hard mode!
c065da4cd171fdb52c25a4bb8c22852d9c384062.text: 仅普通模式注意：在普通模式下，侵蚀梦魇不会对使用军用武器（即没有法杖或权杖）的盟友施放混沌风暴，无论其职业如何。然而他们会并且确实在困难模式下使用它！

8ebd9ec10488942f4e5775118af38b3cc7e1e2c5.source: In the seventh section, three groups of Outcast stand in an inverted U pattern. You will be able to see a small rock on the ground - anybody approaching nearby range of this stone will trigger a large spawn of Sappings and Freezing Nightmares behind the gate that head towards the five trapped in the sixth room.
8ebd9ec10488942f4e5775118af38b3cc7e1e2c5.text: 在第七部分中，三组被驱逐者站成倒U型。你将能够看到地面上的一块小石头 - 任何接近这块石头附近范围的人都会在门后触发大量的坑害和冰冻梦魇，这些恶梦会朝着被困在第六个房间的五个人飞去。

9f241c2c906fe4559c72b13043ba47614f0de8d8.source: Aspect of Depletion : While under this aspect, every 30 seconds, you lose 10 Energy and take 8 points of damage for every point of Energy lost this way.
9f241c2c906fe4559c72b13043ba47614f0de8d8.text: 消耗方面：在此方面下，每30秒，你会失去10点能量，并且每损失1点能量就会受到8点伤害。

ff8e0607608ae3efdf4ff964b25f36dab71648d8.source: The gate at the entrance to the room will re-open after defeating all of the Outcasts and the Aspect of Depletion.
ff8e0607608ae3efdf4ff964b25f36dab71648d8.text: 击败所有流放者和枯竭之灵后，房间入口处的大门将重新打开。

86feaef57b9d934b778fcef5943a608f82bdb35b.source: With a longbow, lure and kill the Aspect who patrols between the Outcast groups to remove the environmental effect. It is possible to pull the aspect without aggroing any of the Outcasts.
86feaef57b9d934b778fcef5943a608f82bdb35b.text: 用长弓引诱并杀死在流放者群体之间巡逻的守护者，以消除环境影响。可以在不激怒任何流放者的情况下拉动局面。

d2f29f2285d8b31501cbb55682980e2a5917a25e.source: If you choose to kill the Aspect before finishing off all of the Outcasts, then you can kill the Nightmares through the gate without them running amok (do bear in mind the potency of Chaos Storm). You won't be able to re-group your allies yet though. First, take out each group of Outcasts seperately. Watch out for Outcast Spellstorms casting Gust and Maelstrom, and Outcast Deathhands using Putrid Explosion. Once all foes are cleared, the back gates will re-open allowing you to resurrect and reunite the entire team again.
d2f29f2285d8b31501cbb55682980e2a5917a25e.text: 如果你选择在消灭所有流放者之前杀死守护者，那么你可以通过大门杀死梦魇，而不会让他们发疯（请记住混沌风暴的效力）。不过，你还无法重新组合你的盟友。首先，分别消灭每组流放者。留意施放狂风和漩涡的流放法术风暴，以及使用腐烂爆炸的流放死亡之手。一旦所有敌人被清除，后门将重新打开，让你复活并再次重新团结整个团队。

d86306be938cfcb1cbe696badb4077ea989d8d08.source: Aspect of Failure : While under this aspect, all of your spells fail.
d86306be938cfcb1cbe696badb4077ea989d8d08.text: 失败方面：在此方面下，你的所有法术都会失败。

8fd7d4efd45d7065f417fb8208a591c52461f44a.source: Casters are rendered useless here. To clear this section more easily, pull the patrolling Outcasts into the entrance. Teams can place tanks, spirits, minions across the gate to set up a body-blocking wall. Once the patrols are killed, only Outcast Raiders and the Aspect of Failure will remain in room at an elevated level.
8fd7d4efd45d7065f417fb8208a591c52461f44a.text: 脚轮在这里变得毫无用处。为了更容易地清除这个区域，请将巡逻的流放者拉到入口处。团队可以将坦克、灵魂、小兵放置在大门对面，以建立一堵身体阻挡墙。一旦巡逻队被杀死，只有被遗弃的掠夺者和失败之灵会以较高的水平留在房间里。

dbf8f634abda11f1e29678b4e6c9b5dc0c457514.source: Players can ignore these foes and move to the next section by keeping close to the wall opposite the Outcast Raiders. The platform just before section 9 does not have the environmental effect. If the party wishes to clear the top level, e.g. for a chest, a good strategy would be to first move to the exit of room 8, setup another wall near the steps, and then pull the Aspect down from the elevated level. With the removal of the environmental effect, the party should have no trouble clearing out the remaining Outcasts.
dbf8f634abda11f1e29678b4e6c9b5dc0c457514.text: 玩家可以忽略这些敌人，并靠近被驱逐者对面的墙壁移动到下一个部分。第 9 区之前的平台没有环境影响。如果一方希望清除顶层，例如对于箱子，一个好的策略是首先移动到房间 8 的出口，在台阶附近设置另一堵墙，然后将 Aspect 从高处拉下来。随着环境影响的消除，队伍应该可以毫无困难地清除剩余的流放者。

d5dbb563f8d516df68e80b45f874d94654390019.source: Aspect of Shadows : While under this aspect, you cannot use enchantments or be targeted by enchantments.
d5dbb563f8d516df68e80b45f874d94654390019.text: 阴影方面：在此方面下，您无法使用结界或成为结界的目标。

7d7c3dd49f2c33e41a271335413dd20182636680.source: This wide area has numerous Oni pop-ups and a massive wurm, The Leviathan at the center. It is apparently trapped in jade but it breaks free and attacks if the party walks too close. Ignore both the Leviathan and the Reborn Irukandjis (with Disenchantment) as they respawn indefinitely. It is recommended to pull the first few Oni groups out of the room into the gate into section 8 to reduce the number of oni faced at once. Following the left wall will lead to the Aspect, and beyond that, the exit.
7d7c3dd49f2c33e41a271335413dd20182636680.text: 这个广阔的区域有许多鬼弹出窗口和一个巨大的亚龙，利维坦位于中心。它显然被困在玉石中，但如果队伍走得太近，它就会挣脱并发起攻击。忽略利维坦和重生的伊鲁坎吉（带有祛魅），因为它们会无限重生。建议将房间内的前几组鬼拉到第8区的大门，以减少一次性面对的鬼数量。沿着左边的墙走就会到达看点，再往前走就是出口。

7f4f5ed6b1399208068265b080bfc51e69bd6a49.source: The Aspect of Shadows stands at the opposite end of the room to the entrance, kill it to use enchantments again. There are a few more oni popups before the gate into the 10th section.
7f4f5ed6b1399208068265b080bfc51e69bd6a49.text: 暗影守护者站在房间入口的另一端，杀死它以再次使用结界。在进入第 10 区的大门之前还有一些鬼弹出窗口。

ba01863a16acdf37b339d4d0a5a56ec107751224.source: Scorpion Aspect : While under this aspect, every 30 seconds, you are teleported to the nearest foe and knocked down.
ba01863a16acdf37b339d4d0a5a56ec107751224.text: 蝎子相位：在此相位下，每 30 秒，你会被传送到最近的敌人并被击倒。

e99e782ac2060459e148eda9c3d0b69707ff40e2.source: This section is considered by many the most difficult area in the Deep. A safe method is to have the full team wait atop the stairs (next to the Irukandji that keeps respawning) and have a player enter the 10th section and lure Oni patrols. Use the stairs to ball and nuke them with ease. Once several groups are killed, there may appear to be no more threats, but the room is not clear yet. Once the lure walks near to the Fire Flower, the Aspect of Scorpions will start to talk. At this point more Oni patrols will spawn (one to three groups), employ the same tactic of pulling them out of the room. Beware of further Oni popups.
e99e782ac2060459e148eda9c3d0b69707ff40e2.text: 此部分被许多人认为是深海中最困难的区域。一个安全的方法是让整个团队在楼梯顶上等待（在不断重生的伊鲁坎吉旁边），然后让一名玩家进入第 10 区并引诱 Oni 巡逻队。使用楼梯轻松地攻击和攻击他们。一旦几个群体被杀死，可能看起来不再有威胁，但房间还不清楚。一旦诱饵靠近火花，蝎子守护者就会开始说话。此时将会产生更多的鬼巡逻队（一到三组），采用相同的策略将它们拉出房间。当心更多的 Oni 弹出窗口。

deb17fd2d51498ebf88eedc86658c768697bda28.source: The remaining enemies are Outcast patrols which will have to be fought under the environmental effect. Since the environment effect is bugged, it is recommended to remove it by exiting into the ninth section to reset the frequency of teleports and knockdowns. The battle ahead will be very confusing as party members are ripped off into enemy mobs away from the team. Ensure to regroup as soon as possible. Players can time the effect to place themselves closer to the groups ahead and manipulate the effect to their advantage.
deb17fd2d51498ebf88eedc86658c768697bda28.text: 剩下的敌人是流亡者巡逻队，必须在环境影响下与他们战斗。由于环境效果有bug，建议通过退出第九部分重置传送和击倒频率来消除它。前方的战斗将会非常混乱，因为队伍成员会被诱骗到远离队伍的敌方暴徒中。确保尽快重新集结。玩家可以安排效果的时间，让自己更接近前方的队伍，并操纵效果对自己有利。

f2fc67f440869d18bb4a0414a97a2734e82e89a8.source: Aspect of Fear : While under this aspect, you move 10% faster. You take 25 damage each second you are moving.
f2fc67f440869d18bb4a0414a97a2734e82e89a8.text: 恐惧方面：在此方面下，你的移动速度加快 10%。你每移动一秒就会受到 25 点伤害。

676bc604970b1ee0f6a580c31f7561ca18a8f9f4.source: A snaking corridor awaits ahead, turning the first corner will trigger the charge of seven waves of Oni & Nightmares that spawn on the path behind. (Occasionally a chest will spawn with the foes.) The party will also be under fire from flowers that can be deactivated by touching them just like in the 6th section. There are two distinct methods to deal with the waves of foes:
676bc604970b1ee0f6a580c31f7561ca18a8f9f4.text: 前方有一条蜿蜒的走廊，转弯第一个拐角将触发后面道路上产生的七波鬼与梦魇的冲锋。 （有时敌人会生成一个箱子。）队伍也会受到花朵的攻击，就像第六部分一样，可以通过触摸花朵来关闭花朵。有两种不同的方法来应对敌人的浪潮：

b4843b7546d3456a6544ccb59b3fc4cd5aa8a93c.source: Fast but risky: The whole team rushes to the Aspect of Fear, quickly killing Oni popups that appear in the way, then turn around and defeat the incoming groups.
b4843b7546d3456a6544ccb59b3fc4cd5aa8a93c.text: 快速但危险：整个团队冲向恐惧之面，快速杀死出现在路上的鬼弹出窗口，然后转身击败来袭的队伍。

ea3d7268d81d1214779ff6ba97cb6f8040954eb0.source: Slow but safer: Stand your ground at the stairs before the first wooden bridge. Create a wall of spirits or party members, and have everybody else attack from behind. Await here for the incoming waves. A team composed mostly of heroes can use this place to take a break (afk) of five minutes as the AI can usually handle these small groups. After the waves have been defeated, make your way to the Aspect and dispose of any Oni popups.
ea3d7268d81d1214779ff6ba97cb6f8040954eb0.text: 缓慢但更安全：站在第一座木桥前的楼梯处。创建一道精神墙或党员墙，让其他人从后面攻击。在这里等待到来的波浪。主要由英雄组成的团队可以使用这个地方休息（afk）五分钟，因为AI通常可以处理这些小团体。击败海浪后，前往守护点并处理所有鬼弹出窗口。

d82a3d84c0c33ecb4635b64bf4c3253857cf5ffc.source: Note: It is possible to dodge the flowers' projectiles.
d82a3d84c0c33ecb4635b64bf4c3253857cf5ffc.text: 注意：可以躲避花朵的射弹。

54346b389c7c2019bb82651117a37b9f1fbc5be2.source: Aspect of Depletion : While under this aspect, whenever your Energy hits 0, you take 50 damage.
54346b389c7c2019bb82651117a37b9f1fbc5be2.text: 耗尽方面：在此方面下，每当你的能量达到0时，你就会受到50点伤害。

99d9b671ef926dd24e61b279d9de127431fb9cc2.source: From this point onwards, the scenery will change from the depths of the Jade Sea to the caverns deep beneath the sea itself.
99d9b671ef926dd24e61b279d9de127431fb9cc2.text: 从这里开始，景色将从玉海深处转变为海底深处的洞穴。

85f152caed2e554c0c12c7ba78f2c5a9e128bfed.source: The twelth precinct is round in shape, appearing to be empty at first, but contains many counter-clockwise Nightmare patrols. Chaos Storm is their most dangerous skill, and will deplete any energy very quickly. Create another bottle neck by creating a wall and sending the lure in to pull some foes. Depending on the tank's skill and the party's overall firepower, one single luring process can be more than enough to clear all foes at once.
85f152caed2e554c0c12c7ba78f2c5a9e128bfed.text: 第十二区域呈圆形，乍一看似乎空无一人，但里面有许多逆时针的梦魇巡逻队。混沌风暴是他们最危险的技能，会很快耗尽任何能量。通过创建一堵墙并发送诱饵来吸引一些敌人，从而创造另一个瓶颈。根据坦克的技能和队伍的整体火力，一次引诱过程足以一次性消灭所有敌人。

f96981052d5b94a96bf9b1428fcef6cffee08d33.source: The Aspect of Depletion stands at the center of this area and does not assist the Nightmares. You can choose to avoid it by hugging one of the walls.
f96981052d5b94a96bf9b1428fcef6cffee08d33.text: 枯竭巨像位于该区域的中心，不会对梦魇提供帮助。您可以选择通过拥抱其中一堵墙来避免它。

cec84ef5401999994f933cae088dd8bafb1bdac7.source: In normal mode, consider keeping caster weapons unequipped for the rest of the mission.
cec84ef5401999994f933cae088dd8bafb1bdac7.text: 在正常模式下，请考虑在任务的其余部分中保持未装备施法者武器。

12dcf940057fceb17db75167d743146093bfce66.source: Aspect of Decay : While under this aspect, if you are Poisoned or Bleeding, you suffer an additional -4 Health degeneration.
12dcf940057fceb17db75167d743146093bfce66.text: 腐烂方面：在此方面下，如果你中毒或流血，你会遭受额外的-4生命值退化。

838c92c73c080919eb0cf2061dfb9a5536ae4b6c.source: Another circular cavern, this time with a backpath circling up to the central mound where the Aspect of Decay stands atop.
838c92c73c080919eb0cf2061dfb9a5536ae4b6c.text: 另一个圆形洞穴，这次有一条小路盘旋至中央土丘，腐朽守护者就矗立在上面。

ecff2a7ad71edf59a50bcd6266feb16f409f97ce.source: Here the team can choose to either follow the left path or the right path. They both lead to the final section, so the choice makes little difference. Both paths have seven Blood Flowers in the outer ring, and four Venom Flowers on the inner ring. Like the Fire Flowers and the Thorn Flowers, these can also be turned off by touching them. There are two Oni spawn spots at the fork, one Outcast group and two other Oni pop-ups behind. If you happen to walk to the mound, the Onis from the other path will close in. Assign one or two players to turn off all the flowers to ease the healers' job.
ecff2a7ad71edf59a50bcd6266feb16f409f97ce.text: 在这里，团队可以选择走左路或右路。它们都通向最后一部分，因此选择几乎没有什么区别。两条道路的外环都有七朵血花，内环有四朵毒花。与火花和荆棘花一样，它们也可以通过触摸来关闭。岔路口有两个鬼怪重生点，一个被遗弃者群体和另外两个鬼怪弹出窗口。如果你碰巧走到土丘上，另一条路的奥尼斯就会靠近。指派一到两名玩家关闭所有花朵以减轻治疗师的工作。

1f6f61dbe07cee6f6982e65a01b7ac08ec93dfe3.text: 11号房间（除非使用技能否则会造成伤害）

32f77e21ba75c43fd1ddec93eef8d9da977f3ffd.source: Aspect of Torment : While under this aspect, you take 50 damage every 3 seconds if you don't use a skill.
32f77e21ba75c43fd1ddec93eef8d9da977f3ffd.text: 折磨方面：在此方面下，如果你不使用技能，你每3秒会受到50点伤害。

423bc2ec2913cd903e12a6ca541a9cb0aa080f40.source: The hidden foes that spawn will vary depending on which side you entered from; the south has Oni and the north has Nightmares. Finally, the Aspect of Torment stands with a group of Outcasts - you can pull the Aspect away from the Outcasts since they are not part of the same team.
423bc2ec2913cd903e12a6ca541a9cb0aa080f40.text: 产生的隐藏敌人会根据您从哪一边进入而有所不同；南方有鬼，北方有梦魇。最后，折磨方面与一群流放者站在一起 - 您可以将方面从流放者中拉开，因为他们不属于同一团队。

aa82b138effddf58ed607c43adb62739969f9670.source: Nightmare Aspect : While under this aspect, you suffer -8 Health degeneration.
aa82b138effddf58ed607c43adb62739969f9670.text: 噩梦相位：在此相位下，你会遭受-8健康退化。

e4d91849fb7773d5f1b9309d42199738d70328b8.source: This is the final chamber where Kanaxai resides, seemingly alone, at the back. The constant -8 health degeneration makes the use of party-wide healing (e.g. Heal Party) imperative. Note that this environmental effect does not go away even after Kanaxai has been defeated.
e4d91849fb7773d5f1b9309d42199738d70328b8.text: 这是 Kanaxai 居住的最后一个房间，看似孤独，位于后面。持续的-8生命值退化使得使用全队治疗（例如Heal Party）势在必行。请注意，即使在 Kanaxai 被击败后，这种环境影响也不会消失。

79ac6a13d4f899115e107750c6921b90cb855bf4.source: Kanaxai is a difficult foe, as he hits very hard and very fast. Each successful hit also knocks his target down. He uses an enchantment called Nightmare Refuge (1-second cast time, 10-second recharge), which makes all spells fail 50% of the time, and gives him a 50% chance to block attacks. In addition, that enchantment also heals him for 1,000 health if it is not removed within the 10 seconds it lasts. And finally, like all of the Aspects of Kanaxai, he stops taking damage at 80%, 60%, 40%, and 20% of his maximum health. To resume normal damage, a knockdown is necessary (although life stealing skills continue to function). The difference between Kanaxai and his aspects are that each of Kanaxai's knockdowns will spawn a mob of twelve creatures:
79ac6a13d4f899115e107750c6921b90cb855bf4.text: Kanaxai 是一个很难对付的敌人，因为他的打击非常猛烈且速度非常快。每一次成功的命中也会击倒他的目标。他使用了一种名为“噩梦避难所”的结界（1秒施法时间，10秒充能），这使得所有法术有50%的几率失败，并让他有50%的几率格挡攻击。此外，如果在持续 10 秒内没有将其移除，该结界还会治愈他 1,000 点生命值。最后，像所有 Kanaxai 守护者一样，他在最大生命值的 80%、60%、40% 和 20% 时不再受到伤害。要恢复正常伤害，需要击倒（尽管生命窃取技能仍然有效）。 Kanaxai 和他的方面之间的区别在于 Kanaxai 的每次击倒都会产生十二个生物的暴徒：

f05e73d67b1fcb4abe08bedf0f00f71022818d37.text: 削弱噩梦（超过最大生命值的 80%）

126dcba51983b30c8154d66d4ca049c1c7944cba.source: Freezing Nightmares (between 60% and 80% of maximum health)
126dcba51983b30c8154d66d4ca049c1c7944cba.text: 冰冻噩梦（最大生命值的 60% 到 80% 之间）

330fcf49a68e95f0e795020610580e9adfb89172.source: Oni of the Deep (between 40% and 60% of maximum health)
330fcf49a68e95f0e795020610580e9adfb89172.text: 深渊鬼（最大生命值的 40% 到 60% 之间）

6b3a12a0c0c85a57ef40132a8d6fe8c95b2dfa4d.source: Random mixture of the above (below 40% of maximum health)
6b3a12a0c0c85a57ef40132a8d6fe8c95b2dfa4d.text: 上述内容的随机混合（低于最大生命值的 40%）

367e43798a42b3255a21f723c2ce76290f51cd8c.source: The maximum number of Nightmare creatures that can be present at any one time is 24.
367e43798a42b3255a21f723c2ce76290f51cd8c.text: 任一时刻可出现的梦魇生物的最大数量为 24 个。

7b84950266d7b2b59173a4af72a9f7f167e820e0.source: The typical procedure to defeat him is as follows:
7b84950266d7b2b59173a4af72a9f7f167e820e0.text: 击败他的典型程序如下：

1ca3fa00f0c8acf870df54d7565deee787d049f2.source: Keep the team at the entrance, out of the degenerative environmental effect. Healer heroes must be flagged too or they will follow to heal.
1ca3fa00f0c8acf870df54d7565deee787d049f2.text: 让团队保持在入口处，远离退化的环境影响。治疗英雄也必须被标记，否则他们会跟随治疗。

b7bacb219be22025f3327e8e19fba1d769711f37.source: Send one character that has two knock downs, or two characters with one knock down skill each to lure Kanaxai to one side of the cavern. Avoid maintaining bonds on these characters since the Sapping Nightmares that spawn will remove their enchantments.
b7bacb219be22025f3327e8e19fba1d769711f37.text: 派出一名拥有两次击倒技能的角色，或两名各拥有一项击倒技能的角色，将 Kanaxai 引诱到洞穴的一侧。避免与这些角色保持联系，因为生成的侵蚀噩梦会消除他们的结界。

bded78e2b4fa3258b73eef1d025e7b639501ac7d.source: Once Kanaxai gets close to a wall, knock him down 2 times in succession to create the maximum amount of spawned creatures. Wait until Kanaxai stands up again before applying the second knock-down. Recall or Shadow Meld allow these characters to quickly escape from the spawned mob and rejoin the main team. (Either by dismissing the enchantment or the Nightmares removing it with Feedback.)
bded78e2b4fa3258b73eef1d025e7b639501ac7d.text: 一旦 Kanaxai 靠近墙壁，连续击倒他 2 次，以产生最大数量的生成生物。等到 Kanaxai 再次站起来后，再进行第二次击倒。召回或暗影融合可以让这些角色快速逃离生成的生物并重新加入主队。 （要么解除结界，要么噩梦通过反馈将其移除。）

125d9ecbc7087602e5a68904cbd783a95626220c.source: After these creatures have spawned, the whole party can run to the opposite side of the room and await Kanaxai. Since the boss has an extended aggro range, he will immediately run to the party, and his spawned Nightmares will stay where they appeared.
125d9ecbc7087602e5a68904cbd783a95626220c.text: 这些生物生成后，整个队伍可以跑到房间的另一边等待 Kanaxai。由于 Boss 的仇恨范围较远，他会立即跑向队伍，而他生成的噩梦会留在出现的地方。

3d480e900fb9cd682c681a878225f520214b413c.source: The whole party can now use everything they've got to take him down.
3d480e900fb9cd682c681a878225f520214b413c.text: 现在，全党可以使用一切手段来打倒他。

bbf6be16f928181cb0c0112ced707e4359642492.source: Do not forget that killing any of the spawned foes will cause more creatures to re-spawn (if Kanaxai is alive).
bbf6be16f928181cb0c0112ced707e4359642492.text: 不要忘记，杀死任何生成的敌人都会导致更多生物重新生成（如果 Kanaxai 还活着）。

8e412553511e2a87e826d9992a90dc0538c26fec.source: After defeating Kanaxai, Kanaxai's Chest will spawn in the center of the room. The game will ping its location on the compass with the red ping typical of players. Ensure that your team does not misjudge the ping as a sign to rush in, as sometimes the spawned Nightmare creatures may be wandering in range of the chest. Remember that the environmental effect will still persist even when Kanaxai has been defeated, if members of your party wish to backtrack through the mission for loot, then move out of the final room as soon as possible.
8e412553511e2a87e826d9992a90dc0538c26fec.text: 击败卡纳赛后，卡纳赛的宝箱会在房间中央出现。游戏将使用玩家典型的红色 ping 来显示指南针上的位置。确保你的团队不会将 ping 错误判断为冲入的信号，因为有时生成的噩梦生物可能会在宝箱范围内徘徊。请记住，即使 Kanaxai 被击败，环境影响仍然会持续存在，如果你的队伍成员希望返回任务以获取战利品，请尽快离开最后一个房间。

9c5edaa3af6b4c8413c1f0980c48736e33b6bc05.source: Each section in the Deep has an Aspect that causes an Environment effect, similar to player-usable skills (most of which are Assassin or Mesmer skills).
9c5edaa3af6b4c8413c1f0980c48736e33b6bc05.text: 深渊中的每个部分都有一个会导致环境效果的方面，类似于玩家可用的技能（其中大部分是刺客或幻术师技能）。

18f0cc25ce214e21784fc8a9e67340b829ca11e9.source: There are no henchmen available for this mission. Heroes are allowed, and are subject to the usual restriction of 7 heroes per player.
18f0cc25ce214e21784fc8a9e67340b829ca11e9.text: 没有可以执行此任务的追随者。允许使用英雄，但通常会受到每个玩家 7 个英雄的限制。

4d72e35d3e19ceb952eeb28aa41183f35ff88953.source: Skills that trigger health stealing (such as Insidious Parasite) bypass the requirement to knock down the aspects, so long as they are not receiving damage (such as as being attacked by a wand).
4d72e35d3e19ceb952eeb28aa41183f35ff88953.text: 触发生命值窃取的技能（例如阴险寄生虫）无需击倒各个方面，只要它们没有受到伤害（例如被魔杖攻击）即可。

f1cce6f312c24d137c95fc7962de0ed256c0ae2a.source: As with any underground area, exploration of this map does not count towards the Cartographer title track.
f1cce6f312c24d137c95fc7962de0ed256c0ae2a.text: 与任何地下区域一样，对该地图的探索不计入制图师标题曲目。

6ead99428595884c1c8d3cc0b4cb5ed4093ad675.source: Killing Kanaxai for the first time raises your account's Luxon faction cap by 10,000.
6ead99428595884c1c8d3cc0b4cb5ed4093ad675.text: 首次杀死 Kanaxai 会将您帐户的 Luxon 派系上限提高 10,000。

51d0f0f3f39733c46d079b919d3f6f1ff4fe862b.source: Be sure to obtain the quest for the Miniature Kanaxai from Merrise, Sworn to Seas, at embark beach if attempting to do this area in Hard Mode for the first time since the 2025 anniversary update.
51d0f0f3f39733c46d079b919d3f6f1ff4fe862b.text: 如果自 2025 周年更新以来第一次尝试在困难模式下完成此区域，请务必在登船海滩上从宣誓海洋的 Merrise 那里获得迷你 Kanaxai 的任务。

964dabedf514c253e1c06a8cd059873134b4f0c7.source: Help Zudash Dejarin regain his estate.
964dabedf514c253e1c06a8cd059873134b4f0c7.text: 帮助祖达什·德贾林夺回他的遗产。

14cd5a61061ed84aa0a797219e57bf22e739981f.source: Speak to Kahan in the northern section of Pogahn Passage in order to begin the series of four sub-quests needed to complete the main objective.
14cd5a61061ed84aa0a797219e57bf22e739981f.text: 与波甘通道北部的卡汉交谈，开始完成主要目标所需的一系列四个子任务。

db7ba4027d1c77c0bbdc67f9ce11b722d5d0b615.source: Find the deserters in Deldrimor Bowl.
db7ba4027d1c77c0bbdc67f9ce11b722d5d0b615.text: 在德尔德里莫碗中寻找逃兵。

55e18c11a5ad5a5bc921cd74e46d972a3cbb5bc0.source: Take word to Master Saberlin in Beacon's Perch that the supplies have been recovered.
55e18c11a5ad5a5bc921cd74e46d972a3cbb5bc0.text: 向灯塔栖息处的萨伯林大师通报补给品已被回收。

a6b7cc60491d5ab4d5607ba0e97eafb8953daaeb.text: 修道士巴尔萨泽的灵魂

8cf00ee46adf544e388a0fe06557904dc1e54db2.text: 催眠术启发的十六进制

e4680cdd57af9e40dfa553926fd65e7499b12057.source: Join with Devona and company outside Beacon's Perch. Journey straight north, eventually passing the exit to Anvil Rock. Turn west when you must, and you will find the deserters. There will be three warriors, two rangers, and two monks. As they are all level 7, and may have lost members fighting wildlife, it's an easy fight. Map back to Beacon's Perch for your reward.
e4680cdd57af9e40dfa553926fd65e7499b12057.text: 在灯塔栖息地外与德沃娜和同伴会合。一直向北行驶，最终经过铁砧岩的出口。当你必须向西转向时，你就会发现逃兵。将有三名战士、两名游侠和两名僧侣。由于他们都是 7 级，并且可能在与野生动物的战斗中失去了成员，所以这是一场轻松的战斗。映射回灯塔栖息地以获得奖励。

e5e7555ecad0f149cb85f5613ca73d8925987f5e.source: Players with Ice Tooth Cave unlocked may find the journey to be slightly shorter starting from this outpost.
e5e7555ecad0f149cb85f5613ca73d8925987f5e.text: 解锁了冰牙洞的玩家可能会发现从这个前哨站开始的旅程会稍微短一些。

44c61d7126c6dfb04f40c81af48d2f73e0dbeaec.source: The deserters' camp contains two chests that can be looted for free items.
44c61d7126c6dfb04f40c81af48d2f73e0dbeaec.text: 逃兵营地有两个箱子，可以抢劫以获得免费物品。

23f62ce07572019ecdd32ea10d21106b5251a561.source: Use Alkar's concoction against the Destroyers to test its effectiveness.
23f62ce07572019ecdd32ea10d21106b5251a561.text: 使用阿尔卡的混合物对抗毁灭者来测试其有效性。

011f5307bdaa4beea9f753314e0d52959add45b0.source: Find a Destroyer and activate the item given to you.
011f5307bdaa4beea9f753314e0d52959add45b0.text: 找到毁灭者并激活给你的物品。

d2c6bf308127b1b36af0245e7ab0687aed7306f5.source: Glint's Challenge, G.O.L.E.M., and A Time For Heroes all have an easily accessed abundance of Destroyers that can be used to complete this quest.
d2c6bf308127b1b36af0245e7ab0687aed7306f5.text: 《格林特的挑战》、《G.O.L.E.M.》和《英雄时刻》都拥有大量易于获取的毁灭者，可用于完成此任务。

e116e277c29d885cd572cec24ef13057326bc786.text: 在《寂静的冲浪》中遇见图里马科斯。

3ba292e3409530869f2c7b85bcb9d11f98ada7a1.source: Lead Turimachus to the clutch of Saltspray Dragon Eggs.
3ba292e3409530869f2c7b85bcb9d11f98ada7a1.text: 带领图里马科斯找到盐雾龙蛋。

2aa4e5a4ac6a5a3cdda9ea73274eb4c069971a2e.source: Protect Turimachus from the Saltspray Dragons.
2aa4e5a4ac6a5a3cdda9ea73274eb4c069971a2e.text: 保护图里马科斯免受盐雾龙的侵害。

7ba9bc1564741ba43b0e57bc6ee7702c5f075186.text: 前往图里马科斯领取奖励。

c314c6696cb579b64e42e8678233e3a66a629af2.source: Start from the Leviathan Pits and head into Silent Surf, where you will find Turimachus waiting just outside the outpost. As you walk near him, the quest will update and point to the location where you can find the dragon eggs. Turimachus will join your party as an ally. Should Turimachus die, you will need to map back to an outpost and restart the quest.
c314c6696cb579b64e42e8678233e3a66a629af2.text: 从利维坦坑出发，前往寂静冲浪，您会发现图里马科斯就在前哨站外等候。当你走近他时，任务将会更新并指向你可以找到龙蛋的位置。图里马科斯将作为盟友加入你的队伍。如果图里马科斯死了，你将需要映射回前哨站并重新开始任务。

afafb66829ce48de30c517a4057ce8120f45a811.source: Head south through Silent Surf to the location of the dragon eggs. As you approach, make sure that the area around the objective is clear of other creatures to avoid any aggro problems when the dragons spawn.
afafb66829ce48de30c517a4057ce8120f45a811.text: 向南穿过寂静海浪到达龙蛋的位置。当您接近时，请确保目标周围的区域没有其他生物，以避免龙生成时出现任何仇恨问题。

04df7ab83fd9d6ccaa8f75ebee19ffccd939a271.source: As you approach the quest marker, a group of 5 Saltspray Dragons will popup and 9-10 Saltspray Dragon Eggs will drop on the ground. Pay close attention to Turimachus here. When he has spoken his dialogue, he will rush into the dragon group to pick up an egg, and if successful, he'll run off north with his prize. However, he will be under attack from the dragons while doing this, so make sure he's well protected and healed.
04df7ab83fd9d6ccaa8f75ebee19ffccd939a271.text: 当您接近任务标记时，会弹出一组 5 条盐雾龙，并且 9-10 颗盐雾龙蛋会掉落在地上。密切关注这里的图里马科斯。当他说完对话后，他会冲进龙群去捡一个鸡蛋，如果成功，他就会带着他的奖品向北跑。然而，在这样做时他会受到龙的攻击，所以要确保他得到很好的保护和治疗。

109c67a84a23befbf78a6d6b1b350327016c1b03.source: If Turimachus gets away safely with an egg, the quest will update and become completed. At this point, map back to the Leviathan Pits to collect your reward.
109c67a84a23befbf78a6d6b1b350327016c1b03.text: 如果图里马科斯带着鸡蛋安全逃脱，任务就会更新并完成。此时，映射回利维坦坑以收集您的奖励。

f24c39bda71f7ccaac0081a0943843d941b56076.source: Another option for completing this quest is going to the nest (carefully avoiding Turimachus so the log will not trigger, or entering from Seafarer's Rest), clearing out all enemies along the way. Then, return to Turimachus and simply escort him to the nest, so he won't die. You'll only have to worry about the many dragons that spawn upon his arrival, but he should be okay.
f24c39bda71f7ccaac0081a0943843d941b56076.text: 完成此任务的另一个选择是前往巢穴（小心避开图里马科斯，以免日志触发，或从海员休息处进入），清除沿途的所有敌人。然后，返回图里马科斯并护送他到巢穴，这样他就不会死。你只需要担心他到来时会出现的许多龙，但他应该没事。

a9e610a6821618283c62fbf445ffaccab0096a94.source: It should be noted that Turimachus can be killed by other patrolling enemies as he attempts to escape with the Dragon Eggs, so clear out any nearby enemies. However, once your quest log has been updated with "See Turimachus for your reward", you should be able to map back to Leviathan Pits and meet him inside, whether or not he gets killed while escaping with the egg.
a9e610a6821618283c62fbf445ffaccab0096a94.text: 应该注意的是，当图里马科斯试图带着龙蛋逃跑时，他可能会被其他巡逻的敌人杀死，所以要清除附近的所有敌人。然而，一旦你的任务日志被更新为“查看图里马科斯以获得奖励”，你应该能够映射回利维坦坑并在里面见到他，无论他是否在带着蛋逃跑时被杀死。

bf43a2fdfd48731528b4bbe9497ee22e9577c6d7.source: Party members cannot pick up any of the Saltspray Dragon Eggs; you're only there to distract the dragons.
bf43a2fdfd48731528b4bbe9497ee22e9577c6d7.text: 队员无法拾取任何盐雾龙蛋；你只是在那里分散龙的注意力。

cdd937c94196b2d0cf693be66af2c12f7e7f507a.source: You can complete the quest by following Turimachus when he runs back towards Leviathan Pits. Talk to him when there are no monsters around to collect the reward without going to Leviathan Pits.
cdd937c94196b2d0cf693be66af2c12f7e7f507a.text: 当图里马科斯跑回利维坦坑时，你可以通过跟踪他来完成任务。当周围没有怪物时与他交谈即可领取奖励，而无需前往利维坦坑。

a55e1f40b2e23df686eadccf8d9be43143e5293b.source: If you encounter enemies on the way back to Leviathan Pits, Turimachus will drop his egg in order to fight. Despite not picking it back up, the quest still completes.
a55e1f40b2e23df686eadccf8d9be43143e5293b.text: 如果你在返回利维坦坑的路上遇到敌人，图里马科斯会掉落他的蛋以进行战斗。尽管没有捡起它，但任务仍然完成。

ba94e0f511a6dee7e9e83b0c4bab1d1522cdcac8.source: Talk to Glint in the Dragon's Lair.
ba94e0f511a6dee7e9e83b0c4bab1d1522cdcac8.text: 在龙穴中与格林特交谈。

411917f204392b8db770344a7e1520def282eb3e.source: Help Althea find a way deeper into the tunnels.
411917f204392b8db770344a7e1520def282eb3e.text: 帮助 Althea 找到更深入隧道的方法。

4bd6d9bf2d4b632982403c003567f711b59990c0.source: Reach the furthest depths of the Tunnels of the Forsaken.
4bd6d9bf2d4b632982403c003567f711b59990c0.text: 到达被遗忘者隧道的最深处。

a4a1b071a643ce66a12f60449769153488fdc172.text: 让受上帝感动的格罗尔平静下来。

1939e1e7643d03db6f3cff272023ddebd9a0f6fb.source: Ghost of Althea joins your party (first time only)
1939e1e7643d03db6f3cff272023ddebd9a0f6fb.text: 阿尔西娅之魂加入你的队伍（仅限第一次）

e96d3cc4c458e95ceace03a267870a2a410866f9.source: Note: Ghost of Althea will not accompany your group until you enter the second level.
e96d3cc4c458e95ceace03a267870a2a410866f9.text: 注意：进入第二层之前，Althea 的幽灵不会陪伴您的团队。

5bd6a0050406764f64a9573f250f63b2583197e9.source: Collect the Elemental Keystone bundle item from the bandits toward the north west.
5bd6a0050406764f64a9573f250f63b2583197e9.text: 从西北方向的强盗那里收集元素钥匙石捆绑包物品。

ec4a38f6fb5e67c6e70281ffe07fb2789b1f0337.source: Carry it back to the Crystal Gate to open it and proceed to the second level.
ec4a38f6fb5e67c6e70281ffe07fb2789b1f0337.text: 将其带回水晶门以打开它并前往第二层。

91ca171569c9d1b8479bc891d6bbe10c7cba531e.source: Continue through this level until you get to a closed rock doorway that the Ghost of Althea will open.
91ca171569c9d1b8479bc891d6bbe10c7cba531e.text: 继续穿过这个关卡，直到到达一个关闭的岩石门口，阿尔西娅的幽灵将打开该门口。

f0c4ca44c7ff55740be262932bd1b9ea9ba555b9.source: Push on and kill the Enraged Phantom boss that drops the Boss Key before proceeding to the end door with the Boss Lock.
f0c4ca44c7ff55740be262932bd1b9ea9ba555b9.text: 继续前进并杀死会掉落 Boss 钥匙的愤怒幻影 Boss，然后使用 Boss 锁前往最后的门。

4e149bcf6d6c6b31be11941b9efaddbd21e2bafa.source: Varny will summon a first wave of manipulated Grawl, then a second one among including the God-touched Grawl. That boss will turn friendly and help you once it reaches around 10-20% health.
4e149bcf6d6c6b31be11941b9efaddbd21e2bafa.text: 瓦尼将召唤第一波被操纵的穴居人，然后是第二波，其中包括神触穴居人。一旦生命值达到 10-20% 左右，那个老板就会变得友好并帮助你。

400b6d071d64961c34b7be0f3c71778efd5dedb1.source: Varny will then personally confront you with a last wave of Grawl.
400b6d071d64961c34b7be0f3c71778efd5dedb1.text: 然后，瓦尼将亲自用最后一波“Grawl”来对抗你。

938ac503a4c924828dc0396e89a22a9d00bf0c6e.source: This quest is actually coded as two quests, one for the first time and one for repeated runs.
938ac503a4c924828dc0396e89a22a9d00bf0c6e.text: 这个任务实际上被编码为两个任务，一个是第一次，一个是重复运行。

3b79e82f279592efb9857705eca3c69b2d3886a5.source: Doing this quest in hard mode can yield two maximum requirement gold weapon drops with inscription slots from the end chest, but the quest rewards are still the same as normal mode.
3b79e82f279592efb9857705eca3c69b2d3886a5.text: 在困难模式下完成此任务可以从末端宝箱中获得两个最大要求的带有铭文槽的黄金武器掉落，但任务奖励仍然与正常模式相同。

9079665fb82d63f4e992c214814bf420f039effb.source: Remember to cover your important enchantment spells. The foes here can easily strip them. Cast enchantments of lower importance on top of them, and monitor them closely. It will give you precious time to recast when the foes strip them.
9079665fb82d63f4e992c214814bf420f039effb.text: 记得遮盖你重要的附魔咒语。这里的敌人可以轻易剥夺他们。在它们上面施放不太重要的结界，并密切监视它们。当敌人剥夺它们时，它会给你宝贵的时间来重铸。

aa34b47923874df30b816c6e28aa13869ab0a61e.source: When repeating the quest, it is possible to pull the various Manipulated Grawls in the boss room into a fight with the Echos and Horsemen. It can thin their numbers significantly when finally facing the boss Varny, which is especially helpful in hard mode. This is not possible during a first run of the quest, because Echos and Horsemen will not spawn yet.
aa34b47923874df30b816c6e28aa13869ab0a61e.text: 重复任务时，可以将 Boss 房间中的各种操纵型穴居人拉入与回声和骑士的战斗中。当最终面对老板瓦尔尼时，它可以显着减少他们的数量，这在困难模式下特别有帮助。这在任务的第一次运行期间是不可能的，因为回声和骑士还不会生成。

1d6e435bc6e1bb630297f76e7a617277f26f34ca.source: You can trigger Varny's initial dialogue and the spawning of the manipulated grawl from the ledge above, near the 2nd resurrection shrine:
1d6e435bc6e1bb630297f76e7a617277f26f34ca.text: 你可以触发 Varny 的初始对话，并从上方靠近第二个复活神殿的壁架上生成受操纵的穴居人：

a8214fc6b4b09faac0149c739c1d2e2df0f4ef4e.source: See Barkeep Mehoro for your reward.
a8214fc6b4b09faac0149c739c1d2e2df0f4ef4e.text: 请前往酒吧老板 Mehoro 领取奖励。

5895f96ef4deba32d3cf9e38364c7ec7a78bdafb.source: To keep Afflicted from spawning in this area if you're of lower levels, keep this quest in your active log and stay away from Drinkmaster Tahnu until such time as you feel the need to complete it. Keeping him alive, untouched, and unharmed affects the spawns in his particular area of Bukdek Byway.
5895f96ef4deba32d3cf9e38364c7ec7a78bdafb.text: 如果你的等级较低，为了防止受苦者在该区域生成，请将此任务保留在你的活动日志中，并远离饮料大师塔努，直到你觉得需要完成它。让他活着、不受影响、不受伤会影响他在 Bukdek Byway 特定区域的生成。

556a106e50c8a2c77e669d28a4cbad200e4e8c6d.source: From Kaineng Center, head South, then South-West, until you get out into an open courtyard area. There will be none of the afflicted there that would usually be there, and he's standing off by himself off to the side. He'll start off neutral towards you, but as you approach him he'll turn red and attack. When you damage him until he has about 1/4 health, he'll turn neutral again and credit you with defeating him.
556a106e50c8a2c77e669d28a4cbad200e4e8c6d.text: 从凯能中心出发，向南行驶，然后向西南行驶，直到进入一个开放的庭院区域。那里不会有平常那样的受苦者，而他独自站在一边。他一开始会对你保持中立，但当你接近他时，他会变红并发起攻击。当你对他造成伤害直到他的生命值只剩下 1/4 左右时，他会再次转为中立并相信你击败了他。

01611965a67238587ad95ddd23bbad273d48ec8b.source: To capture Drinkmaster Tahnu's elite skill Enraged Smash, follow him to Kaineng Center after defeating him. He will die just before entering the town. If he gets stuck between a group of Canthan Peasants along the way, you will need to abandon the quest and start over. To prevent this, stand in front of him just before he approaches the group, forcing him to change course. Alternatively, you can use minions to kill the peasants or lure them away from Tahnu's path.
01611965a67238587ad95ddd23bbad273d48ec8b.text: 要捕获饮酒大师塔努的精英技能激怒粉碎，请在击败他后跟随他前往凯能中心。他将在进入城镇之前死去。如果他一路上被一群凯珊农民困住，你将需要放弃任务并重新开始。为了防止这种情况发生，请在他接近团队之前站在他面前，迫使他改变路线。或者，你可以使用爪牙杀死农民或引诱他们远离塔努的道路。

6eea1f5dc008ebb2aa09950a9e08ecc8120880b1.source: When approaching Drinkmaster Tahnu, you cannot use the usual approach of clicking on him, then pressing space bar. For some reason, the game will not let you use this method.
6eea1f5dc008ebb2aa09950a9e08ecc8120880b1.text: 当接近饮料大师塔努时，你不能使用通常的方法，即点击他，然后按空格键。由于某种原因，游戏不会让你使用这种方法。

0ff31e5a9eea4a6f53221805ae07b3f9d7e65f74.source: Search for signs of Duke Barradin's lost daughter, Althea.
0ff31e5a9eea4a6f53221805ae07b3f9d7e65f74.text: 寻找巴拉丁公爵失踪的女儿阿尔西娅的踪迹。

09ffd1836af9aa11199fbce77cb0ac80530e571d.source: Speak to Duke Barradin to claim your reward.
09ffd1836af9aa11199fbce77cb0ac80530e571d.text: 与巴拉丁公爵交谈以领取奖励。

0b25b52aab256233f624b1bfe308eeb44f7385ef.source: Althea is standing in one of the many possible locations in Diessa Lowlands, at the location of the quest marker. It is possible to keep rezoning from either Grendich Courthouse or Nolani Academy until she is relatively close by. It is not advised to travel to Diessa Lowlands from Piken Square for this quest. Regardless of the spawn point, she is often surrounded by various Charr. Despite this, the player only needs to talk to her to progress the quest. Once spoken to her, players can map travel back to Piken Square.
0b25b52aab256233f624b1bfe308eeb44f7385ef.text: 阿尔西娅正站在迪萨低地众多可能地点之一，任务标记所在的位置。可以继续从格伦迪奇法院或诺拉尼学院重新分区，直到她相对较近为止。不建议从皮肯广场前往迪萨低地执行此任务。无论重生点在哪里，她经常被各种夏尔包围。尽管如此，玩家只需要与她交谈即可完成任务。与她交谈后，玩家可以在地图上返回皮肯广场。

5940324ebfcc871fbc4eaedfecdd3c2a90f82c47.source: The Charr awaiting you can be very challenging if you are at a low level.
5940324ebfcc871fbc4eaedfecdd3c2a90f82c47.text: 如果你的等级较低，等待你的夏尔可能会非常具有挑战性。

d808fbac31701991748450d66c987d028b8fe31d.source: Her ghost may spawn inside solid objects, making it impossible to interact with her. Rezone to make her spawn in a different location.
d808fbac31701991748450d66c987d028b8fe31d.text: 她的鬼魂可能会在固体物体内生成，从而无法与她互动。重新分区以使她在不同的位置产卵。

566fd7fc91d2e92a2fd4076c4d0be08a091229d2.source: Defeat the four Lords of Anguish with Mallyx the Unyielding quest active, then speak with High Priest Zhellix.
566fd7fc91d2e92a2fd4076c4d0be08a091229d2.text: 激活不屈者马里克斯任务，击败四位苦痛领主，然后与高阶牧师热利克斯交谈。

f076c7f6fcce62617afd20fad48494861ed64f45.source: Protect High Priest Zhellix while he performs the opening ritual on the Ebony Citadel.
f076c7f6fcce62617afd20fad48494861ed64f45.text: 在大祭司热利克斯在乌木城堡举行开幕仪式时保护他。

82fdc03c77225ce205d03a076de1e7f121addc48.source: Chance of receiving Primeval Armor Remnants for party members.
82fdc03c77225ce205d03a076de1e7f121addc48.text: 队伍成员有机会获得原始护甲遗迹。

b9b60a07842c70e9817862433863e0af363e0c81.source: Citadel Chest which gives one of Mallyx's unique items to each party member.
b9b60a07842c70e9817862433863e0af363e0c81.text: 城堡宝箱为每位队员提供 Mallyx 的独特物品之一。

60aca4d849b0293445e2ba4da3cf195fab2c5ebf.source: Completion of Mallyx the Unyielding quest and taking its reward.
60aca4d849b0293445e2ba4da3cf195fab2c5ebf.text: 完成“不屈者马里克斯”任务并获得奖励。

9ad6f89ff2e87611d42d0b03e0db1933f741bb3e.source: The first step of the mission is to protect Zhellix while he performs the opening ritual. Nineteen (19) groups of monsters either spawn or arrive at the area of the priest:
9ad6f89ff2e87611d42d0b03e0db1933f741bb3e.text: 任务的第一步是在泽利克斯执行开幕仪式时保护他。十九 (19) 组怪物生成或到达牧师区域：

2dbd314bb799eee00eed851aaf840f8998a5d427.source: The waves come in the following order (pay close attention to when each group spawns as some groups will spawn on the death of certain foes and not others):
2dbd314bb799eee00eed851aaf840f8998a5d427.text: 波浪按以下顺序出现（密切注意每个组何时生成，因为某些组会在某些敌人死亡时生成，而不是其他敌人死亡时生成）：

8b282b7f5bb55902ceaae71f26f3bba06f5b74a2.source: From the south and west: 1 Margonite Anur Ki, 1 Margonite Anur Su, 1 Margonite Anur Kaya, 1 Margonite Anur Tuk, 1 Margonite Anur Vu and 1 Margonite Anur Rund.
8b282b7f5bb55902ceaae71f26f3bba06f5b74a2.text: 从南边和西边依次为：1 个 Margonite Anur Ki、1 个 Margonite Anur Su、1 个 Margonite Anur Kaya、1 个 Margonite Anur Tuk、1 个 Margonite Anur Vu 和 1 个 Margonite Anur Rund。

28d5dd59452bb8cf3e9165300bfda4190a7fb2bc.source: From the east: Shortly after (and regardless of whether any were killed) 1 Misery Titan, 2 Fury Titans, 1 Tortureweb Dryder and 1 Greater Dream Rider.
28d5dd59452bb8cf3e9165300bfda4190a7fb2bc.text: 来自东方：不久之后（无论是否有人被杀死）1 名苦难泰坦、2 名狂怒泰坦、1 名折磨网干燥者和 1 名伟大梦想骑士。

84282e1e997991fe618e52acec9b3c41f1f19940.source: From the west: As soon as all original members of group 2 die (Titan spawns do not count, group 1 does not matter). 2 Anguish Titans and 1 Tortureweb Dryder.
84282e1e997991fe618e52acec9b3c41f1f19940.text: 来自西方：一旦第 2 组的所有原始成员死亡（泰坦生成不计算在内，第 1 组并不重要）。 2 个苦痛泰坦和 1 个折磨网烘干机。

17a024589fec7a9145b06b4bc4437004339657c6.source: From the west: As soon as original members of group 3 die. 1 Heart Tormentor, 1 Mind Tormentor, 1 Water Tormentor, 1 Soul Tormentor and 1 Flesh Tormentor
17a024589fec7a9145b06b4bc4437004339657c6.text: 来自西方：一旦第3组的原始成员死亡。 1 心脏折磨者、1 精神折磨者、1 水折磨者、1 灵魂折磨者和 1 肉体折磨者

4abc6b9c47c9fff907530ee9cffa2171db975850.source: From the south: As soon as original members of group 4 die (spawns from Call to the Torment do not count). 1 Mind Tormentor, 1 Earth Tormentor, 1 Flesh Tormentor, 1 Sanity Tormentor and 1 Spirit Tormentor
4abc6b9c47c9fff907530ee9cffa2171db975850.text: 来自南方：一旦第 4 组的原始成员死亡（来自召唤折磨的生成不计算在内）。 1 个心灵折磨者、1 个大地折磨者、1 个肉体折磨者、1 个理智折磨者和 1 个精神折磨者

7d4b6155ce57653778fd6a5f9600a93a31aef79d.source: Center (just south of priest): As soon as original members of group 5 die. 1 Stygian Fiend, 1 Stygian Brute, 1 Stygian Horror, 1 Stygian Hunger, 1 Stygian Golem
7d4b6155ce57653778fd6a5f9600a93a31aef79d.text: 中心（牧师南边）：第 5 组的原始成员死亡后。 1 冥河恶魔, 1 冥河野兽, 1 冥河恐怖, 1 冥河饥饿, 1 冥河傀儡

b98a1d11b6116860e6e7f2a8bf3b83a847c16704.source: Center (just south of priest): As soon as group 6 dies. 1 Stygian Fiend, 1 Stygian Brute, 1 Stygian Golem, 1 Stygian Hunger, 1 Stygian Golem
b98a1d11b6116860e6e7f2a8bf3b83a847c16704.text: 中心（牧师南边）：第 6 组死亡后。 1 冥河恶魔, 1 冥河野兽, 1 冥河傀儡, 1 冥河饥饿, 1 冥河傀儡

bab93b6b1eb1b6e8484c5b06c41fe297534247e9.source: From the south: As soon as group 7 dies. 5 Greater Dream Riders.
bab93b6b1eb1b6e8484c5b06c41fe297534247e9.text: 从南方：第7组一死。 5 名更伟大的梦想骑士。

0aa6add6a711869cc532e8ba243a6c0755238376.source: From the west: As soon as group 7 dies (they spawn at the same time as group 8). 2 Tortureweb Dryders, 1 Rage Titan, 1 Despair Titan.
0aa6add6a711869cc532e8ba243a6c0755238376.text: 从西边：第 7 组死亡后（它们与第 8 组同时生成）。 2 个折磨网烘干机、1 个愤怒泰坦、1 个绝望泰坦。

7638d5fd8e539b7e8261a4dddacd87671ea67105.source: From the south: As soon as group 8 dies (even if group 9 did not). 1 Heart Tormentor, 1 Soul Tormentor, 1 Margonite Anur Vu, 1 Margonite Anur Tuk, 1 Flesh Tormentor
7638d5fd8e539b7e8261a4dddacd87671ea67105.text: 来自南方：第 8 组死亡后（即使第 9 组没有死亡）。 1 心脏折磨者, 1 灵魂折磨者, 1 玛格尼特·阿努尔·乌, 1 玛格尼特·阿努尔·图克, 1 肉体折磨者

7c936498e70de0c1cdde73db1aaebefdc3cb2080.source: Center: As soon as group 10 dies. 1 Heart Tormentor, 1 Water Tormentor, 1 Stygian Horror, 1 Stygian Brute, 1 Stygian Golem
7c936498e70de0c1cdde73db1aaebefdc3cb2080.text: 中：第 10 组一死亡。 1 心脏折磨者, 1 水折磨者, 1 斯泰吉亚恐怖物, 1 斯泰吉亚野兽, 1 斯泰吉亚傀儡

7c06e6582ef374c6ea4e93a8b6ef3be82c754e2f.source: Center (just south of priest): As soon as group 11 dies. 6 Dementia Titans.
7c06e6582ef374c6ea4e93a8b6ef3be82c754e2f.text: 中（牧师南边）：第 11 组死亡后。 6 痴呆泰坦。

ecdeaad8a715219bf9478db8414671e12b0cf02b.source: From the east: As soon as group 12 dies. 2 Misery Titans, 2 Anguish Titans.
ecdeaad8a715219bf9478db8414671e12b0cf02b.text: 来自东方：第12组一死亡。 2 个痛苦泰坦，2 个痛苦泰坦。

d4545128056d8d785c0e5ea5a7fabe3fe4049b07.source: From the South: As soon as original members of group 13 die. 1 Margonite Anur Ki, 1 Margonite Anur Ruk, 1 Margonite Anur Su, 1 Margonite Anur Tuk, 1 Margonite Anur Vu
d4545128056d8d785c0e5ea5a7fabe3fe4049b07.text: 来自南方：一旦13组的原始成员死亡。 1 玛格尼特阿努尔·基, 1 玛格尼特阿努尔鲁克, 1 玛格尼特阿努尔苏, 1 玛格尼特阿努尔图克, 1 玛格尼特阿努尔武

a9356b5a6c41b935e49c28dab3cb7a344bd8eeaa.source: Center (slightly west): As soon as group 14 dies. 2 Rage Titans, 2 Despair Titans, 2 Dementia Titans (these Titans do NOT spawn other Titans).
a9356b5a6c41b935e49c28dab3cb7a344bd8eeaa.text: 中（稍西）：第 14 组死亡后。 2 个愤怒泰坦、2 个绝望泰坦、2 个痴呆泰坦（这些泰坦不会生成其他泰坦）。

eb7f531b78e43b267fc188a45322840c69805510.source: Center (slightly east): As soon as group 15 dies. 5 Stygian Fiends.
eb7f531b78e43b267fc188a45322840c69805510.text: 中（稍偏东）：第 15 组死亡后。 5 冥河恶魔。

f2ee11b5386d3e513cdf05a12f316981467d8cdf.source: From the west: As soon as group 16 dies. 1 Heart Tormentor, 1 Mind Tormentor, 1 Flesh Tormentor, 1 Water Tormentor, 1 Soul Tormentor.
f2ee11b5386d3e513cdf05a12f316981467d8cdf.text: 来自西方：16组一死。 1 心灵折磨者、1 精神折磨者、1 肉体折磨者、1 水折磨者、1 灵魂折磨者。

f991ecedf63e604e1ef5c0a0b8ecd3e6b75eabab.source: and 19, final mobs after group 17 dies: From the east: Misery Titan, Greater Dream Rider, Tortureweb Dryder, Heart Tormentor, Water Tormentor and Spirit Tormentor. From the south: Margonite Anur Ki, Margonite Anur Ruk, Margonite Anur Rund, Margonite Anur Su, Margonite Anur Tuk and Margonite Anur Vu.
f991ecedf63e604e1ef5c0a0b8ecd3e6b75eabab.text: 19，第 17 组死亡后的最后小怪：来自东方：痛苦泰坦、伟大梦想骑士、折磨网干燥者、心脏折磨者、水折磨者和精神折磨者。从南部开始：Margonite Anur Ki、Margonite Anur Ruk、Margonite Anur Rund、Margonite Anur Su、Margonite Anur Tuk 和 Margonite Anur Vu。

ec8d1d2e2b62d7bc5575c046add7014b16bbb647.source: After the original members of groups 18 and 19 are killed, the door to Mallyx's citadel opens and the priest will be removed from the party list, where he was listed as an ally. As soon as any party member steps past the door, a short cut-scene is played, the whole party is transferred inside the Citadel and the door is closed behind them.
ec8d1d2e2b62d7bc5575c046add7014b16bbb647.text: 在第 18 组和第 19 组的原始成员被杀后，马里克斯城堡的大门打开，牧师将从队伍名单中删除，他被列为盟友。一旦任何小队成员走过门，就会播放一个简短的过场动画，整个小队都会被转移到城堡内，门在他们身后关上。

bb11bbc4fe0b893b39d3cf9768e95244429a725a.source: Mallyx will be standing on a pedestal and will not be hostile, as will be four spirits. As soon as any party member comes close enough to Mallyx (about 1.5 times the aggro radius), Mallyx will give a short speech then turn hostile and attack.
bb11bbc4fe0b893b39d3cf9768e95244429a725a.text: 马里克斯将站在一个基座上，并且不会像四个灵魂那样充满敌意。一旦任何党员距离 Mallyx 足够近（大约仇恨半径的 1.5 倍），Mallyx 就会发表简短的讲话，然后转为敌对并发起攻击。

fe4c50b777b44c0b68c1b0e767f545a7e27da43a.source: A technique that makes fending off the groups much easier is to pull the priest away from the spot where he is performing the ritual (which is the end point for all incoming waves). This can be achieved by having the priest chase a foe down to the gate of the citadel, and then killing that foe. The priest will remain in that spot and will not try to return to his original spot.
fe4c50b777b44c0b68c1b0e767f545a7e27da43a.text: 一种更容易抵御群体的技术是将牧师拉离他正在进行仪式的地点（这是所有传入波的终点）。这可以通过让牧师将敌人追到城堡门口，然后杀死该敌人来实现。牧师将留在那个位置，不会尝试返回到原来的位置。

d9e4d9e2f7a0fcfa9d793ebe01d8bf10999691ad.source: The best candidate for this action is one of the two Fury Titans that come as part of group 2. Since they are original members of the group, the following spawns will not trigger until they die. And because they are the smallest titans, they will not spawn any more after their death. Therefore, the party should leave one Fury Titan alive, bring him close to the priest so that the priest starts attacking him and then have his target slowly back up all the way to the Citadel door and wait for the priest to catch up. If done correctly, protecting the priest will not be a factor in defeating these monsters.
d9e4d9e2f7a0fcfa9d793ebe01d8bf10999691ad.text: 此操作的最佳候选者是第 2 组中的两个狂怒泰坦之一。由于它们是该组的原始成员，因此在它们死亡之前不会触发以下生成。而且因为它们是最小的泰坦，所以它们死后不会再生成。因此，队伍应该让一名愤怒泰坦活着，让他靠近牧师，以便牧师开始攻击他，然后让他的目标慢慢后退到城堡门口，等待牧师追上。如果做得正确，保护牧师将不会成为击败这些怪物的因素。

e0033d0a7b15f700e884aaed623c27eea35f02fa.source: Fighting away from the priest: Another tactic to facilitate defending the priest is, once the priest is moved, to actually pull groups up the hill (towards the southwest) and use the big rock at that spot for tanking and nuking. The one draw back of this approach is that there are two groups (group 9 and 17) that spawn at that position. However, the benefit (which strongly outweighs the disadvantage) is that the party can retreat at any time and disengage whenever they feel overwhelmed.
e0033d0a7b15f700e884aaed623c27eea35f02fa.text: 远离牧师的战斗：另一种有助于保护牧师的策略是，一旦牧师被移动，实际上将团队拉上山（朝向西南）并使用该地点的大岩石进行坦克和核武器攻击。这种方法的一个缺点是有两个组（第 9 组和第 17 组）在该位置生成。然而，好处（远远大于坏处）是，该方可以随时撤退，并在感到不知所措时脱离。

264b3c3a360826f7c93adbfe99aa861292698768.source: Four Anguished Soul spirits (6120 health in normal mode) reside behind Mallyx and are responsible for 4 environmental effects in the room (the same as seen across the Domain of Anguish):
264b3c3a360826f7c93adbfe99aa861292698768.text: 四个痛苦灵魂精魂（正常模式下有 6120 生命值）居住在 Mallyx 后面，负责房间内的 4 种环境影响（与痛苦领域中看到的相同）：

0edd2e2ef0a86530df060095f0117078954a1bb0.source: Listless Soul causes Repressive Energy: lose 2 energy for each attack or use of a skill
0edd2e2ef0a86530df060095f0117078954a1bb0.text: 无精打采的灵魂会导致压抑能量：每次攻击或使用技能都会损失 2 点能量

086fde5fdc0eb044eaa6068a586556adc0b6ef0b.source: Tormented Soul causes Enduring Torment: lose 10 health for every second of movement
086fde5fdc0eb044eaa6068a586556adc0b6ef0b.text: 受折磨的灵魂会造成持久折磨：每移动一秒就会损失 10 点生命值

fdc7f5ba973d4afb40ce8180643c700b06d5d548.source: Shrouded Soul causes Shroud of Darkness: all attacks have a 50% chance to miss
fdc7f5ba973d4afb40ce8180643c700b06d5d548.text: 被笼罩的灵魂造成黑暗笼罩：所有攻击有 50% 的几率失败

735d6bf064c76e5f7da30976b2ccb268767a76ee.source: Demonic Soul causes Demonic Miasma: take 50 damage for every block, or dodge
735d6bf064c76e5f7da30976b2ccb268767a76ee.text: 恶魔之魂造成恶魔瘴气：每格受到50点伤害，或闪避

466d32071652d18452a3e9c787e2acdd829d0e13.source: Mallyx can revive the nearest dead Anguished Soul by casting Unyielding Anguish.
466d32071652d18452a3e9c787e2acdd829d0e13.text: 马里克斯可以通过施放不屈痛苦来复活最近死去的痛苦灵魂。

ea17307009c86ae19e90275298be18db5db72d34.source: Mallyx himself uses particularly nasty monster skills:
ea17307009c86ae19e90275298be18db5db72d34.text: 马里克斯本人使用了特别令人讨厌的怪物技能：

b0ce7042c48c6ff726d8f6bac0005b9b01f7c0b9.source: Summoning Shadows: transports all his foes to him.
b0ce7042c48c6ff726d8f6bac0005b9b01f7c0b9.text: 召唤暗影：将所有敌人传送到他身边。

e8de9ae99bfbcb3584e681e6ed3d938bd0f767a5.source: Shadow Smash: heavy spike that pushes any surviving foes away from him.
e8de9ae99bfbcb3584e681e6ed3d938bd0f767a5.text: 暗影粉碎：重型尖刺，将任何幸存的敌人推离他。

d3ce82e3ef2939072887420e45d57c7c34e9c2fb.source: Consume Torment: purges all hexes and conditions and converts them into a strong source of healing.
d3ce82e3ef2939072887420e45d57c7c34e9c2fb.text: 消耗折磨：净化所有的咒语和状况，并将它们转化为强大的治疗源泉。

6a33e2143767b6a3cf2054a2b2994d10625b6c65.source: Banish Enchantment: strips all enchantments from a foe and disables one skill for every party member for every enchantment removed.
6a33e2143767b6a3cf2054a2b2994d10625b6c65.text: 消除结界：消除敌人的所有结界，并为每个移除结界的每个队员禁用一项技能。

c47e2f1606d0888996b674b752f55015ec7e0fc5.source: Wild Smash: ends stances and disables them.
c47e2f1606d0888996b674b752f55015ec7e0fc5.text: 狂野粉碎：结束姿态并使其失效。

f118ae87641b35aa1749a77051e62c3f64559737.source: Unyielding Anguish: revives the nearest environmental spirit.
f118ae87641b35aa1749a77051e62c3f64559737.text: 不屈的痛苦：复活最近的环境精神。

25ab2bd8158efa405db437a556f23d9fc38d3a97.source: Huge aggro range. He will start rushing creatures from far away.
25ab2bd8158efa405db437a556f23d9fc38d3a97.text: 巨大的仇恨范围。他将开始从远处冲向生物。

3bb98f919ce292ac9777c873bc018514ec212434.source: If Mallyx isn't hard enough to beat, reinforcements spawn whenever Mallyx's health drops below certain thresholds:
3bb98f919ce292ac9777c873bc018514ec212434.text: 如果 Mallyx 的难度不足以击败，每当 Mallyx 的生命值低于特定阈值时，就会产生增援：

d0c9d5534bff69560adbf09f5b6fefeaac786798.source: 80% Health: 2 groups at the portals on either side of the door, each group includes two random "Anur" Margonites
d0c9d5534bff69560adbf09f5b6fefeaac786798.text: 80% 生命值：门两侧的门户有 2 组，每组包括两个随机的“阿努尔”玛贡石

4897d706ca8a02e14ed1e1afd0d686e48c56ed4b.source: 50% Health: 2 groups of two random Torment Demons
4897d706ca8a02e14ed1e1afd0d686e48c56ed4b.text: 50% 生命值：2 组，每组两个随机折磨恶魔

136633de925ce0c11427b7509ac424af042bbe41.source: Ritualists are especially effective because they do not have to depend on hexes or enchantments. Mallyx has no special defenses against Spirits or Weapon Spells. In particular, Displacement and Shelter are very potent in containing Mallyx since his only actual damage comes from his melee attacks and environment effects.
136633de925ce0c11427b7509ac424af042bbe41.text: 仪式主义者特别有效，因为他们不必依赖巫术或结界。马里克斯对灵魂或武器法术没有特殊的防御能力。特别是，位移和庇护所对于遏制马里克斯非常有效，因为他唯一的实际伤害来自他的近战攻击和环境影响。

899b64fc8929084e97b55173e86337aca3a4840f.source: Anti-summon skills are useful: Holy Spear and Spiritual Pain do bonus damage to the Soul spirits; Gaze of Fury destroys them.
899b64fc8929084e97b55173e86337aca3a4840f.text: 反召唤技能很有用：圣枪和灵痛对魂灵造成额外伤害；愤怒凝视摧毁了他们。

5b7fb5238bf660dad840bc0a36dcf1860c660d1b.source: Never use enchantments unless you can shutdown his use of Banish Enchantment.
5b7fb5238bf660dad840bc0a36dcf1860c660d1b.text: 除非你能阻止他使用放逐结界，否则切勿使用结界。

c88e3f991b41ffc8a9c70cd92dd460e340b3be72.source: Bring alternatives to hexes, conditions, and enchantments: Wards, Wells, Shouts, Spirits, Weapon Spells, signets, and plain skills.
c88e3f991b41ffc8a9c70cd92dd460e340b3be72.text: 带来六角形、条件和结界的替代品：守卫、水井、喊叫、灵魂、武器法术、图章和普通技能。

f66ab05b1a5a5d057aa79f3fe5b643b5c093211f.source: Mallyx's skills cannot be disabled; skills such as Blackout and Diversion are of no use.
f66ab05b1a5a5d057aa79f3fe5b643b5c093211f.text: 马里克斯的技能无法被禁用；诸如停电和转移之类的技能没有用。

089a25029e601f2c32c540f0ad040a487c261efe.source: Mallyx's skills tend to prevent the use of the standard tactic of a frontline of tanks, a midline of ranged attackers/casters, and a backline of healers.
089a25029e601f2c32c540f0ad040a487c261efe.text: 马里克斯的技能往往会阻止使用前线坦克、中线远程攻击者/施法者和后线治疗者的标准战术。

9f61f546e50a884869b534d91d33a3f97263e31d.source: His Shadow Smash ability is always active and will often cause him to retarget different allies, making Tanking extremely difficult. Summoning Shadows similarly makes it difficult to keep out of his aggro range.
9f61f546e50a884869b534d91d33a3f97263e31d.text: 他的暗影粉碎能力始终处于激活状态，并且经常会导致他重新瞄准不同的盟友，使坦克变得极其困难。召唤暗影同样让人很难脱离他的仇恨范围。

a4b6a3ad00c0fb63ab31343225021e7a72430620.source: Kill the spirits to remove their environmental effects.
a4b6a3ad00c0fb63ab31343225021e7a72430620.text: 杀死灵魂以消除它们对环境的影响。

79344d56f7392ce614fe23d8d2095da66692c485.source: Examine Mallyx's movement, should he run off: aimless movement means he will return shortly; no movement means he has lost aggro.
79344d56f7392ce614fe23d8d2095da66692c485.text: 检查马里克斯的动作，看他是否逃跑：漫无目的的动作意味着他很快就会回来；没有任何动作意味着他已经失去了仇恨。

0a82c144918e4ea5f940b2ae8499661c8c7f0d33.source: Sometimes you need to distract him by leaving 2 or 3 people inside the gate to get him to stay, instead of running off after he kills the puller.
0a82c144918e4ea5f940b2ae8499661c8c7f0d33.text: 有时你需要在门内留下 2 或 3 个人来分散他的注意力，让他留下来，而不是在他杀死拉手后逃跑。

d900da502960e27439c7500d2fa64418917485d8.source: After Mallyx uses Shadow Smash, party members need to kite in order to force him to re-establish aggro on the tank, if using a tank.
d900da502960e27439c7500d2fa64418917485d8.text: 在马里克斯使用暗影粉碎后，队员需要放风筝才能迫使他在坦克上重新建立仇恨（如果使用坦克的话）。

0bc3b90eb3f609e2f5c43a0c7023874254aabf1f.source: Once Mallyx is defeated, a Citadel Chest and Spirit of Truth will spawn. If your party wipes after Mallyx has been killed (or while he is degenerating to death, ie through Well of Suffering), they will not be resurrected to claim the chest. The quest will be considered complete.
0bc3b90eb3f609e2f5c43a0c7023874254aabf1f.text: 一旦马里克斯被击败，城堡宝箱和真理之灵就会生成。如果你的队伍在马里克斯被杀后消灭（或者当他堕落至死时，即通过痛苦之井），他们将不会复活来夺取宝箱。任务将被视为完成。

f46397da64ac0851b01ff6a8e658ba28c437f2ec.source: Gaze of Fury may sometimes spawn the spirit but leave the Anguished Soul alive.
f46397da64ac0851b01ff6a8e658ba28c437f2ec.text: 愤怒凝视有时可能会生成灵魂，但会让痛苦的灵魂存活。

ea117ba5fc407381e5b0939f932b39d6093958e1.source: If a party member goes through the portal leading to Mallyx's room right after killing the last group of enemies and all 8 party members skip the cut scene quickly, then the entire party can stay in the original room. One person can pull Mallyx back to the original room and the entire fight can take place there to make it significantly easier due to the lack of spawns attacking you & negative spirit effects.
ea117ba5fc407381e5b0939f932b39d6093958e1.text: 如果一名队员在杀死最后一组敌人后立即通过通往 Mallyx 房间的传送门，并且所有 8 名队员都快速跳过过场动画，那么整个队伍都可以留在原来的房间里。一个人可以将 Mallyx 拉回原来的房间，整个战斗可以在那里进行，由于没有攻击你的生成物和负面精神效果，因此变得更加容易。

d0ed01caef98b5ca8b40e6d4d3ec98059f1f9b27.source: When planning to complete this mission in hard mode, it can be a good idea to first obtain the quest Miniature Companion: The Domain of Anguish from Merrise, Sworn to Seas in Embark Beach. This quest rewards 2025 experience, 2006 gold and the Miniature Greased Lightning.
d0ed01caef98b5ca8b40e6d4d3ec98059f1f9b27.text: 当计划在困难模式下完成此任务时，最好先从出发海滩的宣誓海洋梅里斯那里获得任务微型伴侣：痛苦领域。该任务奖励 2025 经验、2006 金币和微型油脂闪电。

2480108b22180b101054cbf8fdbee353604282e3.source: Escort Fadden Hathorn into the Devourer devourer cave and keep him safe while he gathers eggs.
2480108b22180b101054cbf8fdbee353604282e3.text: 护送法登·哈索恩进入吞噬者吞噬者洞穴，并在他收集鸡蛋时保证他的安全。

8be1100bc96a3c9b5d3d0c5cfa36df614af608ca.source: Escort Fadden Hathorn back to Duke Gaban.
8be1100bc96a3c9b5d3d0c5cfa36df614af608ca.text: 护送法登·哈索恩返回加班公爵。

d96fe694cb6d3429d8238dfd13766fb7d916ee3a.source: Return to Duke Gaban for your reward.
d96fe694cb6d3429d8238dfd13766fb7d916ee3a.text: 返回加班公爵那里领取奖励。

0265a4fe659f17fc55f7ed4778802a9d7879db45.source: Upon completing this quest, Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn will no longer spawn in Lakeside County. They can both be seen again post-Searing, Fadden in Sardelac Sanitarium and Duke Gaban in the Bonus Mission Pack.
0265a4fe659f17fc55f7ed4778802a9d7879db45.text: 完成此任务后，杜克·加班和法登·哈索恩将不再在湖滨县生成。他们都可以在《灼热》之后再次出现，法登在沙德拉疗养院，杜克·加班在奖励任务包中。

332428af3aec3ffaf312644a231f47c26ba70023.source: Upon completing this quest, the Devourer Nests will no longer be interactive.
332428af3aec3ffaf312644a231f47c26ba70023.text: 完成此任务后，吞噬者巢穴将不再具有互动性。

b05d24474bcbbfd7f53a308e52e5239c2e20f267.source: Exit Ascalon City, cross the river to the south, and head slightly uphill to locate Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn (hold Alt if you have trouble spotting them). Accept the quest and lead Fadden into the cave.
b05d24474bcbbfd7f53a308e52e5239c2e20f267.text: 离开阿斯卡隆城，向南过河，稍微上坡即可找到杜克·加班和法登·哈索恩（如果你很难找到他们，请按住 Alt）。接受任务并带领法登进入洞穴。

e5d5c426c940411e5c8f5eb133261e04527e47e9.source: Fadden will flee from any living devourer, even though most are not hostile. To keep him moving, you must systematically clear the cave. The eight level 1 Carrion and Lash Devourers inside shouldn't pose much of a threat, especially if you pull them one by one.
e5d5c426c940411e5c8f5eb133261e04527e47e9.text: 法登会逃离任何活着的吞噬者，即使大多数都没有敌意。为了让他继续前进，你必须系统地清理洞穴。里面的八只1级腐肉者和鞭子吞噬者应该不会造成太大的威胁，尤其是如果你把它们一一拉走的话。

a670715d8a434a574101b03c1363e3c8cb16e51e.source: One level 0 Diseased Devourer will unburrow at the second nest and attack you, and two more will strike at the third. This can trigger nearby devourers to attack as well. Focus down the level 0 ambushers first, as they drop after one or two basic attacks, which quickly brings down the incoming damage.
