a670715d8a434a574101b03c1363e3c8cb16e51e.text: 一只 0 级疾病吞噬者会在第二个巢穴中钻出并攻击你，另外两只会攻击第三个巢穴。这也会触发附近的吞噬者进行攻击。首先关注 0 级伏击者，因为它们会在一两次基本攻击后掉落，从而迅速降低传入的伤害。

0c42e8852f9180cab601f7c25239017a9200a05c.source: Once Fadden gathers all three eggs, escort him back to the Duke. Two Lash Devourers will spawn near the cave entrance while you are inside. If you haven't already, clear them out so Fadden can safely exit and you can claim your reward.
0c42e8852f9180cab601f7c25239017a9200a05c.text: 一旦法登集齐了所有三个蛋，就护送他回到公爵身边。当你在里面时，两只鞭子吞噬者会在洞穴入口附近生成。如果你还没有清理掉它们，那么法登就可以安全退出，然后你就可以领取奖励了。

a7563652436bfe079ef649c24410ff08f7c998d8.source: Upon completing the quest, Duke Gaban will give you two devourer eggs. One can be used in the quest The Worm Problem and the other in The Rogue's Replacement. You can also get eggs by giving Brownlow five skale fins or trading with another player.
a7563652436bfe079ef649c24410ff08f7c998d8.text: 完成任务后，加班公爵会给你两个吞噬者蛋。一个可用于任务“蠕虫问题”，另一个可用于任务“盗贼的替代品”。您还可以通过给布朗洛五个斯凯尔鳍或与其他玩家交易来获得鸡蛋。

8b6e98a5d2fedb5c58af8a2fe28cbc8370a6d406.source: Two Hidden Stashes also spawn in the cave. On rare occasions, this might block Fadden's path. To get him to move, try pulling some foes nearby, which should cause him to flee. If that does not work, you will have to rezone and try again.
8b6e98a5d2fedb5c58af8a2fe28cbc8370a6d406.text: 洞穴中还会生成两个隐藏的藏匿处。在极少数情况下，这可能会阻碍法登的道路。为了让他移动，尝试拉附近的一些敌人，这应该会导致他逃跑。如果这不起作用，您将不得不重新分区并重试。

a5d31162d5cab9de5a92577ebde58aac9e1ed824.source: When you attack a devourer that is trapped behind a rock or egg, your attacks can be obstructed. Reposition yourself so that you can attack from a different angle (or bring skills that can do damage without a line-of-sight).
a5d31162d5cab9de5a92577ebde58aac9e1ed824.text: 当你攻击被困在岩石或鸡蛋后面的吞噬者时，你的攻击可能会被阻碍。重新调整自己的位置，以便可以从不同的角度进行攻击（或使用可以在视线之外造成伤害的技能）。

d298f95ffec05b887a396bc19b082fd99b051828.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: elementalist
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
d298f95ffec05b887a396bc19b082fd99b051828.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：元素师
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

d002638a23866548d87a2168ef4d6d47b125d5a9.source: Use your Fire Storm spell to defeat the ice beasts that attack Aziure.
d002638a23866548d87a2168ef4d6d47b125d5a9.text: 使用你的火焰风暴法术击败攻击阿兹乌尔的冰兽。

637c3ff21e98774bbd80acbcb4372a31b27f29ed.source: Aziure will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
637c3ff21e98774bbd80acbcb4372a31b27f29ed.text: 接受任务后，Aziure 将为您提供以下技能：

51d017383bde3c78953eeb055d6e79e69d007013.source: Upon accepting the quest, simply wait for the Ice Elemental Shards to spawn. They come periodically in three waves. Since the Ice Elemental Shards take double damage from fire, a single, well-placed Fire Storm will easily kill them even with 0 Fire Magic. Wait until they cluster around you or Aziure, cast the spell once they stop moving, and watch them melt.
51d017383bde3c78953eeb055d6e79e69d007013.text: 接受任务后，只需等待冰元素碎片生成即可。它们周期性地分三波出现。由于冰元素碎片会受到双倍的火焰伤害，因此即使火系魔法为 0，一次恰到好处的火焰风暴也能轻松杀死它们。等到它们聚集在你或阿兹乌尔周围，一旦它们停止移动就施放咒语，然后看着它们融化。

7b958936aab5257399b5cc82e022975ef6bc78e0.source: Once the final wave is defeated, speak to Aziure to claim your reward.
7b958936aab5257399b5cc82e022975ef6bc78e0.text: 一旦最后一波被击败，与 Aziure 交谈以获得奖励。

63bc02db9db35e6efcc6398c001daa5ba31db3a9.source: If Aziure is killed you cannot accept the reward for this quest, so kill the Ice Elemental Shards before they can kill her.
63bc02db9db35e6efcc6398c001daa5ba31db3a9.text: 如果阿兹乌尔被杀，你就无法接受这个任务的奖励，所以在冰元素碎片杀死她之前杀死他们。

6282e8fa43ea0e18602bff297cd6cd0bf0d288c4.source: Some players may find it worthwhile to repeatedly do the quest for experience and drops, zoning back to Foible's Fair, abandoning the quest and going back to Aziure. However, the Ice Elemental Shards are level 1 (compared to the standard level 3 Ice Elementals) and do not drop Icy Lodestones.
6282e8fa43ea0e18602bff297cd6cd0bf0d288c4.text: 有些玩家可能会发现重复进行经验和掉落的任务是值得的，然后回到福布尔集市，放弃任务并返回阿兹乌尔。然而，冰元素碎片是 1 级（与标准 3 级冰元素相比）并且不会掉落冰冷磁石。

22d8e6ec083c22070be9914573f71b6fe3bf3828.source: Not being primary or secondary Elementalist.
22d8e6ec083c22070be9914573f71b6fe3bf3828.text: 不是初级或次级元素师。

f2cc9314ddb0fcf834e7d65b6a1262ca094f601f.source: Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Elementalist.
f2cc9314ddb0fcf834e7d65b6a1262ca094f601f.text: 没有作为二级元素师第一次完成占卜岩。

0161d5b4f91b902b3e3261b45fd2ab7416d35b74.source: Go to Prophet's Path and slay the kree minotaur.
0161d5b4f91b902b3e3261b45fd2ab7416d35b74.text: 前往先知之路并杀死克里牛头怪。

3dbd8600b8ba96bba84a47f346dd4b2e86296249.source: Take the kree minotaur hide to Cembrien in Heroes' Audience.
3dbd8600b8ba96bba84a47f346dd4b2e86296249.text: 将克里牛头怪皮带到英雄接见场的森布瑞恩。

475ad4351d0cad1140942fdb6c7dd5cc14eeea1b.source: Elementalist available as a secondary profession.
475ad4351d0cad1140942fdb6c7dd5cc14eeea1b.text: 元素师可以作为次要职业。

d445f1ff054cdf604f87441b7427dd20ede4017f.source: If you are a ranged character of some sort, this quest is easy. Go west from Augury Rock to the teleporter near the Kree Minotaur. If you attack the Kree Minotaur from the raised area, it will not be able to reach you, although it will frequently run out of range for a short time. Melee characters will have to make a small detour to the north to get to the lower area that the Kree Minotaur patrols, or use the teleporter to cross the valley and take a shorter detour south. Be sure to pick up the Kree Minotaur Hide before you map travel back to Heroes' Audience to get the reward.
d445f1ff054cdf604f87441b7427dd20ede4017f.text: 如果你是某种远程角色，这个任务很容易。从占卜岩向西前往克里牛头怪附近的传送器。如果你从凸起的区域攻击克里牛头怪，它将无法到达你，尽管它经常会在短时间内跑出攻击范围。近战角色必须向北绕一小段路才能到达克里牛头怪巡逻的较低区域，或者使用传送器穿过山谷并向南绕一小段路。在您返回英雄观众席以获得奖励之前，请务必拾取克里牛头怪皮。

c687a9229d4da829ace1be49020f67c2a2a7e901.source: This is the only secondary profession quest to require delivering an item instead of just killing a boss.
c687a9229d4da829ace1be49020f67c2a2a7e901.text: 这是唯一需要交付物品而不仅仅是杀死老板的次要职业任务。

b1b3dd4edcd72e916f6f3c56265a0a210b2de227.source: The Quest Log will update when the Kree Minotaur is killed, instead of when the hide is picked up like in most item delivery quests. Cembrien will not accept a Kree Minotaur Hide that is acquired without killing the Kree Minotaur, but the hide is required to complete the quest.
b1b3dd4edcd72e916f6f3c56265a0a210b2de227.text: 当克里牛头怪被杀死时，任务日志将会更新，而不是像大多数物品交付任务那样，当皮革被拾取时更新。森布里恩不会接受在没有杀死克里牛头怪的情况下获得的克里牛头怪皮，但需要该皮才能完成任务。

de1cbeaf79e830a47e3c64b7a70d720fd3e0bb9d.source: In the laboratory south west of Rata Sum, survive Oola's security measures while you locate her.
de1cbeaf79e830a47e3c64b7a70d720fd3e0bb9d.text: 在拉塔苏姆西南的实验室中，在乌拉的安全措施下幸存下来，同时找到她。

7db46fcf31981c9ec304a0b4fec61f172c1dfff1.source: As per The Elusive Golemancer quest.
7db46fcf31981c9ec304a0b4fec61f172c1dfff1.text: 根据《难以捉摸的傀儡师》任务。

4064a211ab92da1cb8f60c5c81b356eb85eeccea.source: Although the objectives states this as a mission, it is actually a primary quest.
4064a211ab92da1cb8f60c5c81b356eb85eeccea.text: 尽管目标将其表述为一项使命，但它实际上是一项主要任务。

625223943cbb98d8181fb19663db0adf7f24e2ab.source: The mission objectives say the laboratory is to the south of Rata Sum. It is actually to the west.
625223943cbb98d8181fb19663db0adf7f24e2ab.text: 任务目标称实验室位于拉塔苏姆以南。其实是在西边。

e8918c02cac609df111271a5a5a9e6fc222a9670.source: Informant Tahzen will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.
e8918c02cac609df111271a5a5a9e6fc222a9670.text: 此任务完成后，线人塔赞将不再生成。

985af2f5267c9187124560c0d0a9d7b23f75b878.source: Head east in Kaineng Center to the Raisu Pavilion portal. Talk to the Emperor's Hand, and then map travel to the Marketplace. Exit into Wajjun Bazaar and follow the quest marker to Informant Tahzen. After speaking to him, return to Kaineng Center and speak to Guildmaster Luan for your reward.
985af2f5267c9187124560c0d0a9d7b23f75b878.text: 在凯能中心向东前往 Raisu Pavilion 门户。与皇帝之手交谈，然后用地图前往市场。退出 Wajjun Bazaar，然后按照任务标记找到线人 Tahzen。与他交谈后，返回凯能中心并与栾会长交谈以获得奖励。

45a19699d7219c5962d969dd804ad724955959a2.source: Clear the Temple of War of enemies!

c5abd30e1c2f6b3d219cc85569e7153272707af8.source: Seek out the Forgemaster at the temple of War.
c5abd30e1c2f6b3d219cc85569e7153272707af8.text: 前往战争神殿寻找锻造大师。

7b94f752f19a744e930f299b2e6d010070045406.source: See Eternal Forgemaster for your reward.
7b94f752f19a744e930f299b2e6d010070045406.text: 前往永恒锻造大师处领取奖励。

66be2ee8bb195c2f918c684a768759910677cafc.source: To spawn the Eternal Weaponsmith to get this quest, clear out the camp on the west side of the Great Battle Field.
66be2ee8bb195c2f918c684a768759910677cafc.text: 要生成永恒武器匠来完成此任务，请清理大战场西侧的营地。

a2200e8acb6c95c90ee203722603836b07575b7d.source: The Temple sits atop the large hill in the center of the Fissure, and is guarded by some sizable groups of Shadow Army. It is possible to make them and nearby Skeleton Army groups aggro each other to weaken them. When the groups leading up to the Temple are dead, the gate will open. Inside are groups of Shadow Monks and Shadow Mesmers guarding the ramps to the central altar, with groups of Abyssals and Shadow Beasts patroling between them. Pull the first patrol to the door and away from the monks, then work your way around the Temple taking out one group at a time. Atop the central platform are Shadow Rangers and more Shadow Beasts. Clear these out and the Eternal Forgemaster will spawn with your reward.
a2200e8acb6c95c90ee203722603836b07575b7d.text: 圣殿坐落在裂隙中心的一座大山山顶上，由一些规模相当大的暗影军团守卫着。可以让他们和附近的骷髅军团互相攻击来削弱他们。当通往圣殿的队伍全部死亡时，大门就会打开。里面有成群的暗影僧侣和暗影催眠师守卫着通往中央祭坛的坡道，成群的深渊和暗影兽在它们之间巡逻。将第一支巡逻队拉到门口并远离僧侣，然后绕着寺庙前进，一次消灭一组。中央平台之上是暗影游侠和更多的暗影兽。清除这些，永恒锻造大师就会带着你的奖励出现。

d1e7c893bb1d7c488e4adab620a2532cba6258ef.source: Do not take the following quest until your party is ready.
d1e7c893bb1d7c488e4adab620a2532cba6258ef.text: 在你的队伍准备好之前不要接受以下任务。

239622aafe41b8551c34fd5649cd1c4bc0e33034.source: Despite the reward dialogue, you still need to do two more quests to craft Obsidian armor, Defend the Temple of War and Restore the Temple of War.
239622aafe41b8551c34fd5649cd1c4bc0e33034.text: 尽管有奖励对话，您仍然需要完成另外两个任务来制作黑曜石盔甲：保卫战争神殿和恢复战争神殿。

5458628db5774f6238d179792af7dcca9ec78a91.source: There are spots on the right side of each access ramp of the forge that allows non-tanking players to hide.
5458628db5774f6238d179792af7dcca9ec78a91.text: 熔炉每个通道坡道的右侧都有一些位置，可以让非坦克玩家隐藏。

21c1114a9e3fae1abfe7f650714c996c8641f322.source: Both the north and south ramps provide such narrow access that they are easily body-blocked should the foes attempt to go round the barriers.
21c1114a9e3fae1abfe7f650714c996c8641f322.text: 南北坡道的通道都很狭窄，如果敌人试图绕过障碍物，它们很容易被身体阻挡。

97d0e618161ebf2b437bc28b485150b58f25daf7.source: Clearing the Eternal Forge area before taking the quest, may sometimes result in the Forgemaster not spawning.
97d0e618161ebf2b437bc28b485150b58f25daf7.text: 在接受任务之前清理永恒熔炉区域有时可能会导致熔炉大师无法生成。

d924c161adc692f4dab850eda94ae18598dadcd4.source: Protect the Forever Trees in the Eternal Grove.
d924c161adc692f4dab850eda94ae18598dadcd4.text: 保护永恒丛林中的永恒之树。

8b836fd1e7ab2c7e9aba4f4b166d0aca52a06e9d.text: *奖励* 让所有 12 名树歌手都活着。

b5a21636ce30c4fed99f3933e8320ede0d42843f.source: As per The Eternal Grove mission.

6b7890cd5fb8be9dff8405d38ca1239879540e1d.source: Clear the Eternal Grove in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
6b7890cd5fb8be9dff8405d38ca1239879540e1d.text: 在困难模式下清除 Echovald 森林中的永恒丛林中的所有敌人。

0920df4c5ddef43f7411fa02861e1122a030577c.source: Bring the spirit essence to Mastersmith Rutger.
0920df4c5ddef43f7411fa02861e1122a030577c.text: 将精神精华带给铁匠鲁特格大师。

42afe58025cde6b09b3a7d566b599da194cb3137.source: On receiving the quest from Scholar Andrej, a quest item called Spirit Essence will be added to your inventory. The spirit essence must be taken to Mastersmith Rutger, who can be found in the south-west corner of Ferndale, near the Dredge temple. Chat with Rutger to pass along the Spirit Essence quest item and collect your reward.
42afe58025cde6b09b3a7d566b599da194cb3137.text: 收到学者安德烈的任务后，一个名为“精魂”的任务物品将被添加到您的库存中。精神精华必须被带到大师史密斯鲁特格那里，他位于芬代尔西南角，靠近德雷奇神庙。与鲁特格聊天，传递精髓任务物品并领取奖励。

8a61838dd193d4f50bdce2e80c8b4545873dfafa.source: You may wish to also have the quest Melodic Gaki Flute active while performing this quest since both quests take you to the same general area in Ferndale.
8a61838dd193d4f50bdce2e80c8b4545873dfafa.text: 在执行此任务时，您可能还希望激活旋律长笛任务，因为这两个任务都会带您前往芬代尔的同一区域。

d3bdec93cf63f978b3a631620f3b9c76f5f01fe2.source: Despite what the quest reward dialogue says, Rutger will never craft weapons.
d3bdec93cf63f978b3a631620f3b9c76f5f01fe2.text: 不管任务奖励对话怎么说，鲁特格永远不会制造武器。

c9a92bfad4f910aa8ff70a8b79b5c00d3a2fe667.source: Clear the Falls in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
c9a92bfad4f910aa8ff70a8b79b5c00d3a2fe667.text: 在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林瀑布中的所有敌人。

ec304308dcf6c28b1ed829f4633abb2cd7905050.source: Start from Ventari's Refuge and travel south through Ettin's Back and past Reed Bog. The secondary quest Blood And Smoke given outside Ventari's Refuge will lead here.
ec304308dcf6c28b1ed829f4633abb2cd7905050.text: 从文塔里避难所出发，向南穿过埃丁背脊，经过芦苇沼泽。文塔里避难所外的次要任务血与烟将通向这里。

94f56dfa503e5153e7041ba67e49e5653ef3d5a5.source: There are many hidden spiders in the southern half of the area.
94f56dfa503e5153e7041ba67e49e5653ef3d5a5.text: 该地区的南半部有许多隐藏的蜘蛛。

c2d1c14823ff14d08ea97bbc2f6da9911cac0de3.source: There are 2-3 hidden Life Pods around each Root Behemoth. Bring anti-caster or anti-healing skills to counter them; they can all pop up together if the Root Behemoths have spawned close to each other. Alternatively, you can creep up to a Root Behemoth by the edge of your aggro radius to spawn the Life Pods one or two at a time.
c2d1c14823ff14d08ea97bbc2f6da9911cac0de3.text: 每个根巨兽周围都有 2-3 个隐藏的生命豆荚。带上抗施法者或抗治疗技能来对抗它们；如果根部巨兽彼此靠近生成，它们就会一起弹出。或者，您可以爬到仇恨半径边缘的根部巨兽处，一次生成一两个生命豆荚。

9eba946011398df94a4514833468142c63446b49.source: There is a patrol of Jungle Skale on a counter-clockwise loop just after the 'main' bridge into the "Falls Area" (near Sewp the Darktooth.)
9eba946011398df94a4514833468142c63446b49.text: 在进入“瀑布区”（靠近黑牙塞普）的“主”桥之后，有一支丛林斯卡勒巡逻队沿逆时针方向循环。

eb3f8845d5bc3fcb76692b1d80826edf43f7a814.source: Minions and spirits are very useful when dealing with hordes of wind riders and life pods.
eb3f8845d5bc3fcb76692b1d80826edf43f7a814.text: 在对付成群的驭风者和救生舱时，小兵和精魂非常有用。

3ba0562435439d958c2a810dbb59bb4e8f19a107.source: Consider bringing Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support for a possible instant kill on life pods.
3ba0562435439d958c2a810dbb59bb4e8f19a107.text: 考虑带上黑檀先锋狙击手支援，可能会立即杀死救生舱。

59e1b848414353dc2f9a893df49d877e00c867d7.source: Remember to keep the party spread out when confronting Wind Riders: their area of effect interrupts and damage can easily wipe the unprepared.
59e1b848414353dc2f9a893df49d877e00c867d7.text: 记住，在面对御风者时，要让队伍分散开：他们的效果范围会中断，伤害很容易消灭毫无准备的人。

274b77de98b32b59562b5652e439624069fdce79.source: With great patience, it is possible to bring a party of 8 from the Temple of the Ages. Consider caravan vanquishing the region.
274b77de98b32b59562b5652e439624069fdce79.text: 只要有足够的耐心，就可以从千古神殿带出8人的队伍。考虑商队征服该地区。

8a8a81a1f871bed01f7cb553aaa0d153d64621d0.source: The Redwood Shepherds use Spirit of Primal Echoes, increasing the energy costs of using signets.
8a8a81a1f871bed01f7cb553aaa0d153d64621d0.text: 红木牧羊人使用原始回响之灵，增加了使用印章的能量消耗。

11665325aca51b1cdd44cc078ea1b01fd1549791.source: The water in the area imbues you (and allied creatures) with the Fount Of Maguuma.
11665325aca51b1cdd44cc078ea1b01fd1549791.text: 该地区的水为你（和盟友生物）注入迈古玛喷泉。

2478297c51f1ceba4b4fab422a6e7d6a4fe9f8d9.source: As with other bridges in the game, there are height issues with the vines that lead across valleys or chasms. In particular, you can attack or be attacked from the main vine (leading to The Falls area of the zone, southeast from Agrippa Stonehands). You can pickup dropped items that are supposedly below (or above) you. Also, creatures can body block each other, even if one is on the ground and the other is on the vine.
2478297c51f1ceba4b4fab422a6e7d6a4fe9f8d9.text: 与游戏中的其他桥梁一样，跨越山谷或裂缝的藤蔓也存在高度问题。特别是，你可以从主藤蔓（通往该区域的瀑布区域，阿格里帕石手东南部）进行攻击或被攻击。您可以拾取据称位于您下方（或上方）的掉落物品。此外，生物可以用身体互相阻挡，即使一个在地面上，另一个在藤蔓上。

da2eff3a51770af59d3f861906749e16908dd9ad.source: There's a graphic issue with the statue of Balthazar when favor is active; the sunrays behind the statue disappear where the fires are located.
da2eff3a51770af59d3f861906749e16908dd9ad.text: 当恩惠生效时，巴尔萨扎雕像存在图形问题；雕像后面的阳光在火焰所在的地方消失。

e23922b099bed72ab0f393ee9ded0625e116c571.source: Defeat Abbot Ramoth and retrieve the Litanies of the Unseen.
e23922b099bed72ab0f393ee9ded0625e116c571.text: 击败方丈拉莫斯并取回未见之祷文。

4a62acc362ff909918148f4aa92689d3e025839e.source: Return the Litanies of the Unseen to Brother Mizar.
4a62acc362ff909918148f4aa92689d3e025839e.text: 将看不见的连祷文归还给米扎修士。

0307d20139b49b2e1deb4a254c6a40037c91c494.source: Exit the Temple of the Ages and follow the quest marker west to Abbot Ramoth and his retinue of White Mantle Justiciars. You may encounter some Bog Skale Blighters and will likely find some hidden Spined Aloes on the road, which should not be too hard to dispatch by themselves.
0307d20139b49b2e1deb4a254c6a40037c91c494.text: 退出时代神殿，沿着任务标记向西到达拉莫斯院长和他的白斗篷审判官随从。你可能会遇到一些沼泽枯萎者，并且可能会在路上发现一些隐藏的刺芦荟，它们应该不难自行消灭。

33ec68b4e24a57de03dae228af8ee4fc4cd3f086.source: You must defeat Abbot Ramoth, whereupon he will drop the Litanies of the Unseen. Ramoth is a skilled protector monk, so engaging him together with his warrior guards may be challenging for an unprepared party, though the party size of 8 available from the Temple of the Ages is a boon. Fortunately, Ramoth can be separated from the Justiciars, and their wide wandering range should make it easy to pull them. If you do end up fighting all of them together, focus on the Abbot; the Justiciars are hardy even without his support, and they do not have to be killed to complete the quest.
33ec68b4e24a57de03dae228af8ee4fc4cd3f086.text: 你必须击败方丈拉莫斯，然后他就会掉落未见之祷文。拉莫斯是一位熟练的保护僧侣，因此让他和他的武士守卫一起战斗对于没有准备的队伍来说可能是一个挑战，尽管时代神殿提供的 8 人队伍规模是一个福音。幸运的是，拉莫斯可以与审判者分开，而且他们的游走范围很广，应该很容易拉动他们。如果你最终与他们所有人一起战斗，请专注于方丈；即使没有他的支持，正义者们也很坚强，而且不需要杀死他们来完成任务。

329fab5bca0a12292d95f652923290c9ee6c72bc.source: Once Ramoth is dead, retrieve the Litanies of the Unseen and return to Brother Mizar for your reward.
329fab5bca0a12292d95f652923290c9ee6c72bc.text: 拉莫斯死后，取回未见者的连祷文，然后返回米扎尔修士那里领取奖励。

77674797f20021cbb583683cb1d91214a7fb90d4.source: Abbot Ramoth and his Justiciars drop Leather Belts, which are otherwise unique to the much more challenging Cult of Verata and Galrath's Bandits, instead of the usual White Mantle Emblems and Badges.
77674797f20021cbb583683cb1d91214a7fb90d4.text: 院长拉莫斯和他的审判者会掉落皮带，这是更具挑战性的维拉塔教派和加尔拉斯强盗所独有的，而不是通常的白斗篷徽章和徽章。

9c18a0e6b09b0cadf7f670bfa741e52e259c8422.text: 找到恩尼斯·花岗岩陆行者。

a545e2765fca7c25a18e7858dc3b8dc7e82e9e3b.source: Help Ennis Granitestrider complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
a545e2765fca7c25a18e7858dc3b8dc7e82e9e3b.text: 帮助恩尼斯·花岗岩行者在悲伤熔炉中完成他的任务。

ed44d9e5b26a11733f323ec0956f7321a1b90678.source: This should be a walk in the park by now, since you had to travel to Sorrow's Furnace several times already for the preceding quest To Sorrow's Furnace. Talk to Ennis Granitestrider, who will be waiting patiently on the right when you exit Deldrimor War Camp in the Southern Shiverpeaks. Kill some patrols and just walk into the exit to Sorrow's Furnace.
ed44d9e5b26a11733f323ec0956f7321a1b90678.text: 现在这应该是在公园散步，因为你已经多次前往悲伤熔炉才能完成前面的任务“悲伤熔炉”。与恩尼斯·格兰尼斯特瑞德交谈，当你离开席瓦山脉南部的德尔德里莫战争营地时，他会在右侧耐心等待。杀死一些巡逻队，然后走进悲伤熔炉的出口。

3d97fa9484d4a0bd3394caa974e0c100a67b00c0.source: Here you will receive the quest The Forge Heart. To get past the gates, use the explosives given by Budger Blackpowder.
3d97fa9484d4a0bd3394caa974e0c100a67b00c0.text: 在这里您将收到任务锻造之心。要通过大门，请使用巴吉黑火药提供的炸药。

a09fa7c4426ebd1fb0a35dc6769db04a519936d6.source: After completing the quest, walk back to Ennis Granitestrider just inside the entrance gate if necessary to accept the reward. Do not leave the instance until after accepting the reward for The Forge Heart, since if you exit prematurely then The Forge Heart quest is removed from your quest log and you will have to repeat it.
a09fa7c4426ebd1fb0a35dc6769db04a519936d6.text: 完成任务后，如有必要，请走回入口处的恩尼斯·格兰尼斯特瑞德那里接受奖励。在接受锻造之心的奖励之前不要离开副本，因为如果您过早退出，那么锻造之心任务将从您的任务日志中删除，您将不得不重复它。

8f297b3768ae2830cab04393a4c8fab4cd0db487.source: Once The Forge Heart is complete, you can leave and turn in The Final Assault with the Dwarven Prospector.
8f297b3768ae2830cab04393a4c8fab4cd0db487.text: 一旦熔炉之心完成，你就可以离开并向矮人探矿者交出最后的突袭。

7b4a6dc7d28febd151c938dcada3ac87e69c4684.source: This quest sets up the spawns for The Forge Heart, including the Iron Forgeman, whose attack is required to hatch a Black Moa Chick once the player has acquired and filled an Incubator Kit.
7b4a6dc7d28febd151c938dcada3ac87e69c4684.text: 该任务为锻造之心设置了生成点，其中包括钢铁锻造师，一旦玩家获得并填充了孵化器套件，就需要他的攻击来孵化黑恐鸟雏鸡。

8ee616950413e481cc93592034d8bf9b05380e09.source: Completion of this quest unlocks the Eternal Conqueror of Sorrow's Furnace statue in the Hall of Monuments.
8ee616950413e481cc93592034d8bf9b05380e09.text: 完成此任务即可解锁纪念碑大厅中悲伤熔炉的永恒征服者雕像。

a0eecacd6a214df941ca75d6c0764dc1d4d512a5.source: Sometimes Ennis stops following you on the path to Sorrow's Furnace. Once inside, he will not appear and you have to come back to the starting point. To prevent this, click and talk to Ennis just before entering to ensure he is following.
a0eecacd6a214df941ca75d6c0764dc1d4d512a5.text: 有时，恩尼斯会在通往悲伤熔炉的路上停止跟随你。一旦进去，他就不会出现，你必须回到起点。为了防止这种情况，请在进入之前单击并与 Ennis 交谈，以确保他跟随。

6628c281844d261b69e562fd32abf3e1c6f00e3f.source: Initiate Zei Ri joins your party. 1
6628c281844d261b69e562fd32abf3e1c6f00e3f.text: 启动 Zei Ri 加入你的队伍。 1

77b874935f792feb7c10164367932bb5dfb62542.source: Clear the Floodplain of Mahnkelon in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
77b874935f792feb7c10164367932bb5dfb62542.text: 在困难模式下清除库尔纳曼科隆洪泛区的所有敌人。

a3f6768ea8e80dbd894e9dcc2a6e5c98f40f767c.source: This area lies to the northeast of the Kodonur Crossroads mission outpost. Your character's choice of either Margrid the Sly or the Master of Whispers determines whether this area is optional or not.
a3f6768ea8e80dbd894e9dcc2a6e5c98f40f767c.text: 该区域位于科多努尔十字路口任务前哨的东北部。你的角色对狡猾的玛格丽特或密语大师的选择决定了这个区域是否是可选的。

c6c87e8fcc88550432c0604018f3a5242618c862.source: Characters who chose to follow Margrid will not need to come here as completion of the Pogahn Passage mission will completely bypass this area. Those with Master of Whispers will end up here as part of the primary quest To Kill a Demon.
c6c87e8fcc88550432c0604018f3a5242618c862.text: 选择跟随玛格丽德的角色不需要来这里，因为波甘通道任务的完成将完全绕过这个区域。那些拥有低语大师的人将作为主要任务“杀死恶魔”的一部分最终来到这里。

abac5ad7365ca7c58800aa164346f0189525f2b2.source: There is a slim chance to charm the Elder Crocodile to the east of Pobehr before it gets charmed by the nearby Beast Sworn Heket.
abac5ad7365ca7c58800aa164346f0189525f2b2.text: 在波贝尔东边的鳄鱼老者被附近的野兽宣誓者赫克特迷惑之前，有很小的机会迷惑它。

f83bed45a0379be13e0d4a6f3e3847e849aee5fa.source: The eastern side of the area has several hidden groups of mandragor, a few very inconveniently placed near other mobs.
f83bed45a0379be13e0d4a6f3e3847e849aee5fa.text: 该地区的东侧有几个隐藏的曼陀罗群体，其中一些非常不方便地放置在其他生物附近。

f5b6462af8118cafa18eaaa6dd3490aa44767ee5.source: The two hidden boss groups, Zelnehlun Fastfoot and Jerneh Nightbringer, can be avoided by skirting their trigger points (refer to the map). For the former, it is near where the path splits into an upper and lower path. The latter is situated in the water before the stairs.
f5b6462af8118cafa18eaaa6dd3490aa44767ee5.text: 两个隐藏的 Boss 群体，Zelnehlun Fastfoot 和 Jerneh Nightbringer，可以通过避开它们的触发点来避开（参见地图）。对于前者，它靠近路径分成上路径和下路径的地方。后者位于楼梯前的水中。

d756e56b9dcb57759179ac05cd11f17c8779f58c.source: There is a Whispers Informant in the northeastern shrine offering Elemental Hunt despite the fact that there are no elementals in this area (aside from those that appear during the primary quest To Kill a Demon).
d756e56b9dcb57759179ac05cd11f17c8779f58c.text: 尽管该地区没有元素（除了在主要任务“杀死恶魔”中出现的元素），但东北神殿中有一个低语线人提供元素狩猎。

0833c90941611a9fa772b0c692447d6e28124437.source: All party members must have completed Pogahn Passage or Rilohn Refuge in order to vanquish this area, or the waterworks area will be unreachable due to all gates being closed.
0833c90941611a9fa772b0c692447d6e28124437.text: 所有队伍成员必须完成波加恩通道或瑞洛恩避难所才能征服该区域，否则水厂区域将因所有大门关闭而无法到达。

acfc3d1ce2881c7c4f1c52d696c14c38f3efcc0e.source: The NPCs related to the quest Drakes on the Plain (drakes and human NPCs) may spawn even if this quest has never been taken, the only condition is presence of Koss in the party.
acfc3d1ce2881c7c4f1c52d696c14c38f3efcc0e.text: 与平原上的龙族任务相关的 NPC（龙族和人类 NPC）可能会出现，即使从未完成过该任务，唯一的条件是队伍中存在科斯。

e8628c68ad1605f2a0d2ee3acea12069b33474eb.source: Settle Zudash's debt with the corsairs.
e8628c68ad1605f2a0d2ee3acea12069b33474eb.text: 解决祖达什与海盗的债务。

630a0ea90d697fcdff13c18f1c2dedb3119c6c7b.source: First talk to Zudash Dejarin in Yohlon Haven. Then make the long trek across the Arkjok Ward through Pogahn Passage across the Dejarin Estate to Camp Hojanu and then finally to the Barbarous Shore. Find Ruthless Sevad with a group of corsairs in the Barbarous Shore. After talking to him, the corsairs will become hostile. Defeat them, and return to Zudash to collect your reward.
630a0ea90d697fcdff13c18f1c2dedb3119c6c7b.text: 首先与 Yohlon Haven 的 Zudash Dejarin 交谈。然后长途跋涉，穿过阿克约克区，穿过波加恩通道，穿过德贾林庄园，到达霍贾努营地，最后到达野蛮海岸。在野蛮海岸找到无情的塞瓦德和一群海盗。与他交谈后，海盗们就会变得敌对。击败他们，然后返回祖达什领取奖励。

eed6b0c98319596136375afe198ff9de1c7e0bf2.source: It may be wise to speak with the Wandering Priest at the Resurrection Shrine just behind Sevad's group to obtain a bounty on Corsairs. Sevad's Boys count towards this bounty and will earn you additional Sunspear points.
eed6b0c98319596136375afe198ff9de1c7e0bf2.text: 明智的做法可能是与塞瓦德队伍后面的复活神殿的流浪牧师交谈，以获得海盗的赏金。塞瓦德的男孩计入此赏金，并将为您赢得额外的烈阳之矛积分。

5fa36cbe2d9c31a300b7f944b11a1f8988ae6b05.source: This quest fits right in with A Fool's Luck since both have you talk with Ruthless Sevad.
5fa36cbe2d9c31a300b7f944b11a1f8988ae6b05.text: 这个任务正好符合愚人节的运气，因为两者都让你与无情的塞瓦德交谈。

0f55195c78ec86abe92d78b29ae712883abe4226.source: Lieutenant Shagu will not appear while this quest is active.
0f55195c78ec86abe92d78b29ae712883abe4226.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，沙古中尉不会出现。

e3d564c08ed458fceb352c3017bde5c564830a5f.source: Destroy all three of the Rage Binders controlling the Iron Forgeman at the same time.
e3d564c08ed458fceb352c3017bde5c564830a5f.text: 同时消灭控制铁匠的所有三个愤怒束缚者。

38434be14716861956c520a5e8552de7bc222eea.text: 消灭 [3..0] 更多火焰巨灵。

b6227839204048705553a8ba9a038131fb85f39d.source: See Ennis Granitestrider for your reward.
b6227839204048705553a8ba9a038131fb85f39d.text: 去找恩尼斯·格兰尼斯特瑞德领取奖励。

4ead0ef046c225d21bede9add11bb5fb59a7c5a4.source: After talking to Ennis Granitestrider inside Sorrow's Furnace, Budger Blackpowder will accompany you. He will provide you with explosive Dwarven Powder Kegs, which will be used to blow up sealed doors inside this area (master gears won't work on the doors -- only on the bridge). Budger Blackpowder cannot die, and will not help out in battle. He does tend to stand in the middle of skirmishes, getting in your way, though. If you find he's gone missing, he may be stuck behind the crushing traps; run back and he should begin to follow you again when you're back within range.
4ead0ef046c225d21bede9add11bb5fb59a7c5a4.text: 在悲伤熔炉中与恩尼斯·花岗岩陆行鸟交谈后，巴吉·黑火药将陪伴您。他将为你提供爆炸性矮人火药桶，用于炸毁该区域内的密封门（主齿轮无法在门上工作——只能在桥上工作）。巴吉黑粉不会死，也不会在战斗中提供帮助。不过，他确实倾向于站在小冲突中间，妨碍你。如果你发现他失踪了，他可能被困在陷阱后面；跑回来，当你回到射程范围内时，他应该会再次开始跟随你。

9567fe056b3d65be6e8acdd20c68177a9707bcca.source: You start at the upper left corner of the map, and your objective is to reach the lower right-hand corner. Most of the enemies you encounter along the way are not difficult to kill. Towards the end of the journey, there will be a few groups of enemies together — pull small groups to avoid getting the attention of all of them at once.
9567fe056b3d65be6e8acdd20c68177a9707bcca.text: 您从地图的左上角开始，您的目标是到达右下角。沿途遇到的大多数敌人都不难杀死。在旅程的最后，将会有几组敌人聚集在一起——拉成小队以避免同时引起所有人的注意。

7a47298e23b0b00f7fd08e2e61cca42e96571fbf.source: You'll find The Iron Forgeman in a walled area surrounded by a number of guards. There are three Rage Binders accompanied by two Furnace Guardians, and one roaming Stone Summit patrol. In addition, while you are inside the walled area, The Iron Forgeman will dump lava on your group and hit you with a wrecking ball if you are stationary.
7a47298e23b0b00f7fd08e2e61cca42e96571fbf.text: 你会在一个被许多守卫包围的围墙区域找到铁匠。共有三名愤怒束缚者、两名熔炉守护者和一名漫游石峰巡逻队。此外，当你在围墙区域内时，钢铁锻造师会向你的团队倾倒熔岩，并在你静止不动时用破坏球击中你。

1302515b19f7f7b9e644b7d19e0cba5074b90a0e.source: The easiest method is to take your time, and eliminate each group of Furnace Guardians first, and then the patrol.
1302515b19f7f7b9e644b7d19e0cba5074b90a0e.text: 最简单的方法就是慢慢来，先消灭掉每一组守炉者，然后再消灭巡逻队。

84b1f44feb65c1122afaa7dd48f26f26260011df.source: There will be three Rage Binders left. When you kill one, it will respawn in about 30-45 seconds. You have to kill all three of them in a short amount of time. With a group of human players, this is fairly easy since you can split up into two teams. With heroes/henchmen only, it will be harder. You may have to race around the circle killing them as fast as you can. A speed boost can be handy, as can interrupt for the Life Siphon that the Rage Binders use.
84b1f44feb65c1122afaa7dd48f26f26260011df.text: 将会剩下三个愤怒束缚者。当你杀死一个时，它会在大约 30-45 秒内重生。你必须在短时间内杀死他们三个。对于一群人类玩家来说，这相当容易，因为你可以分成两队。只有英雄/追随者，事情会更困难。你可能必须绕圈跑，尽快杀死他们。速度提升可以很方便，也可以中断愤怒束缚者使用的生命虹吸管。

35b49b10a2ddfda19aeec8379aa6cc27f83b74d0.source: Don't kill the first one with slow-recharging skills, since there is no hurry killing the first. Your skills can better serve defeating the second.
35b49b10a2ddfda19aeec8379aa6cc27f83b74d0.text: 不要用慢充技能杀死第一个，因为没有急于杀死第一个的能力。你的技能可以更好地帮助击败第二个。

a17794907506b4213048a51c63300c8701c63707.source: It may be possible to damage one of the Rage Binders, and then move on to the second. In this way, the first will be killed faster when you come back to it.
a17794907506b4213048a51c63300c8701c63707.text: 有可能损坏其中一个愤怒束缚者，然后继续攻击第二个。这样一来，当你再回来的时候，第一个就会被杀得更快。

c51d6cfc51ce4326e5bc56d725f5de19dbd9cdce.source: Experienced players with heroes/henchmen can flag your heroes around one Rage Binder to keep it killed, while you and the henchmen kill the other 2 Rage Binders.
c51d6cfc51ce4326e5bc56d725f5de19dbd9cdce.text: 拥有英雄/追随者的经验丰富的玩家可以在一个愤怒束缚者周围标记你的英雄以使其被杀死，而你和追随者则杀死另外 2 个愤怒束缚者。

4fe0dddfa6491124fa1fbeed99a60bf3b5eb9eb9.source: Alternatively, if using a full party of heroes, you can kill the middle Rage Binder first then flag half of your heroes to one of the remaining Rage Binders and accompany half to the other, if your builds are good enough they should easily kill both in time.
4fe0dddfa6491124fa1fbeed99a60bf3b5eb9eb9.text: 或者，如果使用一整队英雄，你可以先杀死中间的愤怒束缚者，然后将一半的英雄标记为剩余的愤怒束缚者之一，并陪伴另一半英雄，如果你的构建足够好，他们应该很容易及时杀死两者。

e1c88dc596b334b948cf765865f9f9807a11dca3.source: When you have killed all three you will get to see a cut-scene.
e1c88dc596b334b948cf765865f9f9807a11dca3.text: 当你杀死三个人后，你会看到一个过场动画。

e7c0a411f344726844e5be370481b400946cd6b3.source: There will now be three Flame Djinn in the circle. You most certainly don't want to aggro all of them at the same time, so get back out of the circle quickly to regenerate. Pull one of them at a time outside the circle and interrupt the Consuming Flames skill to kill it faster. Even with a large Death Penalty it shouldn't be too big of a problem to kill one of them.
e7c0a411f344726844e5be370481b400946cd6b3.text: 现在圆圈中将出现三个火焰巨灵。你肯定不想同时攻击所有的人，所以要快速退出圈子来恢复。每次将其中一个拉到圈外并打断消耗火焰技能以更快地将其杀死。就算是重重的死刑，杀掉一个也不是什么太大的问题。

1f19184c8210fe57cbeb8c8ec61ea45d8cf4628b.source: Pain Inverter is highly effective if used when the Flame Djinn is using Consuming Flames resulting in it losing almost half of its health if 5 party members are next to it.
1f19184c8210fe57cbeb8c8ec61ea45d8cf4628b.text: 如果在火焰巨灵使用消耗火焰时使用疼痛反转器会非常有效，如果它旁边有 5 个小队成员，它会损失几乎一半的生命值。

6c2498e20966306bd75576cc2ab3784ae27eb5ef.source: If there are two Djinn stuck together, keep trying to pull one of them away from the other one. There's a resurrection shrine nearby, so you have all the time in the world. Some parties can probably kill two djinn at the same time, but with a large death penalty it will not work. But even with a full death penalty, a minion master can mitigate a large amount of damage from the djinns.
6c2498e20966306bd75576cc2ab3784ae27eb5ef.text: 如果有两个巨灵粘在一起，请继续尝试将其中一个与另一个分开。附近有一个复活神社，所以你有充足的时间。有些队伍可能可以同时杀死两个巨灵，但如果有大量的死亡惩罚，那就行不通了。但即使受到完全死亡的惩罚，小兵大师也可以减轻巨灵的大量伤害。

67372564f4f8ba580155b87b14120b1466b8852e.source: Now that you've killed all three djinn, talk to Ennis Granitestrider to complete the quest.
67372564f4f8ba580155b87b14120b1466b8852e.text: 现在你已经杀死了所有三个巨灵，与恩尼斯·格兰尼斯特瑞德交谈以完成任务。

297691ee0f6b03d69f5e7a16c00f3d534e517f21.source: This quest is only available if the party enters Sorrow's Furnace while accompanied by Budger Blackpowder and Ennis Granitestrider, who will only follow players who have completed To Sorrow's Furnace. This means that a party member who has completed To Sorrow's Furnace and The Final Assault at least once, can make this quest available for other party members who have not.
297691ee0f6b03d69f5e7a16c00f3d534e517f21.text: 仅当队伍在巴杰·黑火药和恩尼斯·格兰尼斯特莱德的陪同下进入“悲伤熔炉”时，此任务才可用，而后者只会跟随完成“悲伤熔炉”的玩家。这意味着至少完成过一次“悲伤熔炉”和“最终突袭”的队伍成员可以将该任务提供给其他尚未完成的队伍成员。

6f7c6e32a903d2046427aa34d24919e3024a05d2.source: As with other quests in elite areas, you must claim your quest reward before exiting Sorrow's Furnace.
6f7c6e32a903d2046427aa34d24919e3024a05d2.text: 与精英区域中的其他任务一样，您必须在退出悲伤熔炉之前领取任务奖励。

45966a41b6bdd3c3ac62885273dc9b38609b250d.source: Seek out Sariss Yassith in Skyward Reach.
45966a41b6bdd3c3ac62885273dc9b38609b250d.text: 在天空之境寻找萨里斯·亚西斯。

06f2c4c0ff3d55548df4164d9fae368d98f2d6dd.source: After obtaining the quest from Annelle Fipps in Destiny's Gorge, you can take one of two paths. You can take the northern exit at Destiny's Gorge and travel south through Skyward Reach. After a while, you will arrive at a teleporter which you will need to activate to continue south and then west where you will find Sariss Yassith. Alternatively you can map travel to Augury Rock, take the northern exit and travel south through Skyward Reach and then east to Sariss Yassith. The alternate route is a bit shorter, but takes you past a few groups of Hydra. Once you arrive at Sariss' location, simply speak to him to receive your reward.
06f2c4c0ff3d55548df4164d9fae368d98f2d6dd.text: 从命运峡谷的安妮尔·菲普斯那里获得任务后，你可以选择两条路之一。您可以从命运峡谷的北出口出发，然后通过 Skyward Reach 向南行驶。过了一会儿，你将到达一个传送器，你需要激活它才能继续向南，然后向西，在那里你会找到萨里斯·亚西斯。或者，您也可以在地图上前往占卜岩，从北出口出发，向南穿过 Skyward Reach，然后向东到达 Sariss Yassith。另一条路线稍微短一些，但会带你经过几组九头蛇。到达萨里斯的位置后，只需与他交谈即可获得奖励。

3879ff07586fe5d62d1cdf1cc4b2a86d1e8ff9ba.source: Fight your way through the entrance chambers to gain entry to the foundry.
3879ff07586fe5d62d1cdf1cc4b2a86d1e8ff9ba.text: 杀出一条血路，穿过入口室，进入铸造厂。

313190b17cbcc05567e606cae5d94dfbcedd07f2.source: Clear the first chamber of enemies.
313190b17cbcc05567e606cae5d94dfbcedd07f2.text: 清除第一个房间的敌人。

3afcc0e63fa804e787663baccb4d6a7aeac0f688.source: Clear the second chamber of enemies.
3afcc0e63fa804e787663baccb4d6a7aeac0f688.text: 清除第二个房间的敌人。

14b9a9a8ff3cb6764945bccf8dc9507ba59296d9.source: Clear the third chamber of enemies.
14b9a9a8ff3cb6764945bccf8dc9507ba59296d9.text: 清除第三个房间的敌人。

f85b9428b20dbfebdae6a7d81597666971438af2.source: Clear the fourth chamber of enemies.
f85b9428b20dbfebdae6a7d81597666971438af2.text: 清除第四个房间的敌人。

24000965b2a8a835bf54a3087df24cccef08e053.text: 请前往 Tekliss 领取奖励。

fb580043be0a7a8e8be47bf29219900f2d8e7b77.source: Clear the four chambers leading to the foundry. After all party members step past the tentacles to enter a chamber, the tentacles will close behind them and the party will be locked inside; this also triggers the initial spawn of foes. The tentacles will not open again until all the monsters in the chamber have been destroyed. In three of the four chambers, additional group(s) spawn after the first group is killed.
fb580043be0a7a8e8be47bf29219900f2d8e7b77.text: 清理通往铸造厂的四个房间。当所有小队成员跨过触手进入房间后，触手会在他们身后闭合，小队将被锁在里面；这也会触发敌人的初始生成。直到房间里的所有怪物都被消灭之前，触手才会再次张开。在四个房间中的三个中，第一组被杀死后会产生额外的组。

1870c951bf1e8e9d76e1731b8c9c7e79d6d8556d.source: Chamber 1: The first group are Margonites; when they are destroyed, they spawn a group of two Despair Titans and two Rage Titans.
1870c951bf1e8e9d76e1731b8c9c7e79d6d8556d.text: 第一室：第一组是玛贡派；当它们被摧毁时，它们会产生一组两个绝望泰坦和两个愤怒泰坦。

d2542c6d74608cc3ace345124f6269e782d1c7a0.source: Chamber 2: This chamber can be difficult to fight in because its size leaves no room to maneuver. The initial group consists of Margonite Anur mixed with Tortureweb Dryders. After these are destroyed, the new spawns include Tortureweb Dryders mixed with Greater Dream Riders.
d2542c6d74608cc3ace345124f6269e782d1c7a0.text: 房间 2：这个房间可能很难战斗，因为它的大小没有留下回旋的空间。第一组由 Margonite Anur 与 Tortureweb Dryders 混合组成。这些被摧毁后，新的生成物包括折磨网干燥者与伟大的梦想骑士的混合。

fc502363325cc4c44abb30f021d20b9b943a277f.source: Chamber 3: This room has only a single spawn, but it includes four patrols: four Anguish Titans; four Rage Titans; four Misery Titans; and three Tortureweb Dryders with a single Greater Dream Rider. When the titans die, they will spawn lesser titans (Anguish → Despair → Fury; Misery → Rage → Dementia). Each patrol covers the full perimeter of the room, so it is very difficult to pull just a single group unless you stand in the far corner and are very careful. Positioning is extremely important in this room, both to avoid over-aggro, and to minimize the harm from powerful AoE spells. Once the initial enemies are dead, the door to the next room will open.
fc502363325cc4c44abb30f021d20b9b943a277f.text: 房间 3：这个房间只有一个重生点，但它包括四个巡逻队：四个痛苦泰坦；四个愤怒泰坦；四个苦难泰坦；以及三个 Tortureweb Dryders 和一个 Great Dream Rider。当泰坦死亡时，他们会产生较小的泰坦（痛苦→绝望→愤怒；痛苦→愤怒→痴呆）。每个巡逻队都会覆盖房间的整个周边，因此很难只拉动一个小组，除非你站在远处的角落并且非常小心。在这个房间里，走位非常重要，既可以避免过度仇恨，又可以最大程度地减少强大 AoE 法术的伤害。一旦最初的敌人死亡，下一个房间的门就会打开。

9aab21316ef014743fc1a1b5a88e494058a26d9f.source: Chamber 4: This chamber has four successive spawns: Tortureweb Dryders mixed with a Margonite Anur Ki, followed by about 18 Dementia Titans, a mixed group of Despair, Rage, and Dementia Titans, and finally a group with a Greater Dream Rider, a Margonite Anur Ki, a Tortureweb Dryder, a Despair Titan, two regular Fury Titans, and one special Fury Titan (noticeably larger than the rest) which can drop a unique item. When the Despair Titan dies, it spawns two more regular Fury Titans which do not need to be killed to open the door to the Foundry.
9aab21316ef014743fc1a1b5a88e494058a26d9f.text: 房间 4：这个房间有四个连续的生成点：折磨网干燥者与玛贡尼特·阿努尔基混合，然后是大约 18 个痴呆泰坦，绝望、愤怒和痴呆泰坦的混合组，最后是一组包含一名伟大的梦想骑士、一个玛贡尼特·阿努尔基、一个折磨网干燥者、一个绝望泰坦、两个常规愤怒泰坦和一个特殊的愤怒泰坦（明显比其他泰坦大），可以掉落独特的物品。当绝望泰坦死亡时，它会再生成两个普通的愤怒泰坦，无需杀死它们即可打开铸造厂的大门。

1d5a590d95449c5de22c3b2bae6e2d18bdb955f1.source: After clearing the final chamber, players may advance to the Foundry; Tekliss will be just past the entrance.
1d5a590d95449c5de22c3b2bae6e2d18bdb955f1.text: 清理完最后一个房间后，玩家可以前往铸造厂； Tekliss 就在入口处。

6baf97237c99b054c77aa8b3abb5e83dd02961f0.source: If you clear the first room before taking the quest and then take the quest the wall will appear again and cannot be removed. This will trap whoever took the quest and anybody else still behind the wall.
6baf97237c99b054c77aa8b3abb5e83dd02961f0.text: 如果您在接受任务之前清理了第一个房间，然后接受任务，墙壁将再次出现并且无法移除。这将把接受任务的人和仍在墙后的其他人困住。

0921ce6f2d1fe28c4b9e720e9c080cbda34eb18c.source: Must have Restoring Grenth's Monuments quest active
0921ce6f2d1fe28c4b9e720e9c080cbda34eb18c.text: 必须激活恢复古兰斯纪念碑任务

3a21a2127efc6a4a68d243f575c732e44019e798.source: Return to Reaper of the Chaos Planes for your reward.
3a21a2127efc6a4a68d243f575c732e44019e798.text: 返回混沌位面收割者那里领取奖励。

091fe772e6c4de1a2e06a6a3ec532996226e10fa.source: After accepting this quest, the four horsemen begin their approach toward the Reaper from the middle section of the Chaos Planes. The horsemen, accompanied by several Terrorweb Dryders, split into two groups approaching from separate sides. The groups will attempt to eliminate the Reaper, returning the party to the outpost from which they entered the Underworld.
091fe772e6c4de1a2e06a6a3ec532996226e10fa.text: 接受这个任务后，四名骑士开始从混沌位面中部接近死神。骑兵在数名恐网干燥者的陪同下分成两队，从不同的方向逼近。这些团体将试图消灭收割者，将队伍送回他们进入地狱的前哨基地。

18cf8cfc1187fc4319858e25b265fe29483e30a0.source: This quest is arguably the most difficult in the underworld, requiring a good strategy to survive.
18cf8cfc1187fc4319858e25b265fe29483e30a0.text: 这个任务可以说是地下世界中最困难的任务，需要良好的策略才能生存。

55b800f6a05fb7b58517d0a9adf0f45cb68a2cfc.source: Spread out around the Reaper and make your stand there. Keep your distance to each other and to the Reaper to mitigate the Dryders' AoE spells - flag your heroes if you brought any.
55b800f6a05fb7b58517d0a9adf0f45cb68a2cfc.text: 分散到收割者周围并站在那里。保持彼此之间以及与收割者的距离，以减轻干燥者的 AoE 法术 - 如果你带了英雄，请标记你的英雄。

b45257b97b3310746e83bf388d22ad5a8101cff9.source: Your healers' priority should be to keep the Reaper alive. Everyone else must focus on dispatching or disabling the incoming foes. With a sufficiently strong party, you will outlast the waves, completing the quest.
b45257b97b3310746e83bf388d22ad5a8101cff9.text: 你的治疗者的首要任务应该是让收割者保持活力。其他人都必须集中精力消灭或消灭即将到来的敌人。有了足够强大的队伍，你就能战胜海浪，完成任务。

3db3d9a0138e48d2552e5fb764db4ffc11681bf6.source: This works well in normal mode and can be done with a 7-hero-team. In hard mode, more elaborate strategies are needed.
3db3d9a0138e48d2552e5fb764db4ffc11681bf6.text: 这在正常模式下效果很好，并且可以通过 7 名英雄团队来完成。在困难模式下，需要更精细的策略。

75fb19274a0a603364827a51520c3873f13b8b39.source: Use one or two party members to delay one side while everyone else kills the other.
75fb19274a0a603364827a51520c3873f13b8b39.text: 使用一到两名队员来拖延一方，而其他人则杀死另一方。

3306f9935c499df4301313840e95674d5afedf0d.source: This strategy needs a dedicated tank to draw aggro and block the foes on one side. A tank with permanent spell targeting prevention should be able to do it alone, otherwise help from a healer may be needed. The tank will last longer with knockdown prevention, Mantra of Flame and anything that boosts armor. The healer must be very careful not to draw aggro, keeping out of range, only approaching the tank when needed.
3306f9935c499df4301313840e95674d5afedf0d.text: 这种策略需要一个专门的坦克来吸引仇恨并阻挡一侧的敌人。具有永久法术目标预防功能的坦克应该能够单独完成，否则可能需要治疗师的帮助。通过防击倒、火焰咒语和任何增强护甲的东西，坦克的使用寿命会更长。治疗师必须非常小心，不要吸引仇恨，保持在范围之外，只在需要时才接近坦克。

dd7a83050d5ff3b7e8e1eef47d61b6d992c6a2b9.source: When the tank is ready, the other party members can accept the quest and intercept all spawns from the other side. Running as far as possible towards the spawns results in earlier kills, reducing the time your tank needs to hold out. On the other hand, staying closer to the reaper allows you to take measures should the tank fall.
dd7a83050d5ff3b7e8e1eef47d61b6d992c6a2b9.text: 当坦克准备好后，其他队员就可以接受任务并拦截来自另一方的所有生成。尽可能地跑向重生点会导致更早的杀戮，从而减少你的坦克需要坚持的时间。另一方面，靠近收割者可以让你在坦克掉落时采取措施。

8341437aa061293e4cdabb666f7f0c65644ced5d.source: Kill the four horsemen; Madruk Dhuum, Thul Za Dhuum, Ghozer Dhuum, Kazhad Dhuum in the Underworld.
8341437aa061293e4cdabb666f7f0c65644ced5d.text: 杀死四骑士；地狱中的马德鲁克·杜姆 (Madruk Dhuum)、图尔·扎·杜姆 (Thul Za Dhuum)、戈泽尔·杜姆 (Ghozer Dhuum)、卡扎德·杜姆 (Kazhad Dhuum)。

39127c365bb1324d1211f66b0313602fda7d87f7.source: *BONUS* Kill the four horsemen in Hard Mode.
39127c365bb1324d1211f66b0313602fda7d87f7.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死四名骑士。

beb09ef11ee79e25d46e9a66d46938331afe1c8a.source: As per the The Four Horsemen quest.

d27851681eda7cd23fe9b3602e9a07dcbb2e4455.source: Open the Frost Gate in the Northern Shiverpeaks.
d27851681eda7cd23fe9b3602e9a07dcbb2e4455.text: 打开北席瓦山脉的冰霜之门。

3d4591ecd8b5ae10c3acf7ad9e0bdb6e8e24245e.source: *BONUS* Secure the secret siege weapon plans.
3d4591ecd8b5ae10c3acf7ad9e0bdb6e8e24245e.text: *奖励* 确保秘密攻城武器计划的安全。

be109891a8e758095cfc22e419749baa5b32f05b.source: As per The Frost Gate mission.

4fce8ed4970ff80b7f3cf08faec19a4ec3073d0c.source: Activate all 3 earth shrines by placing Scorched Lodestones upon them.
4fce8ed4970ff80b7f3cf08faec19a4ec3073d0c.text: 将烧焦的磁石放置在所有 3 个大地神殿上即可激活它们。

4536bbfc60d7c5170df51999041ef53e2005c1bf.source: Return to Kendrick Redstaff for your reward.
4536bbfc60d7c5170df51999041ef53e2005c1bf.text: 返回肯德里克·雷德斯塔夫处领取奖励。

9f05333b2280993f935f12ca6ecfb50dd25c5a27.source: If you already have 3 Scorched Lodestones from The Way of the Geomancer or random encounters, skip this paragraph. The area outside of Serenity Temple is brimming with Stone Elementals and Hulking Stone Elementals. Spend some time in the area until you receive the necessary 3 Scorched Lodestones.
9f05333b2280993f935f12ca6ecfb50dd25c5a27.text: 如果您已经从《风水师之道》或随机遭遇中获得了 3 个烧焦磁石，请跳过本段。宁静神殿外的区域充满了石元素和巨大的石元素。在该地区花费一些时间，直到收到必要的 3 块烧焦磁石。

fd646877e0e42961adf0987471716081663c70cd.source: Now, travel through the Pockmark Flats to the earth shrines. Be careful of stone elemental patrols, there are a lot of patrols and they seem to converge at the earth shrines. Each earth shrine will look like a stone with an inscription and a bowl on the top. When a Scorched Lodestone is placed in each shrine a yellow sphere will glow above the shrine.
fd646877e0e42961adf0987471716081663c70cd.text: 现在，穿过波克马克平原前往大地神殿。小心石元素巡逻队，巡逻队很多，而且似乎都集中在大地神殿处。每个土神殿看起来都像一块石头，上面刻有铭文，顶部有一个碗。当将烧焦的磁石放置在每个神殿中时，神殿上方会出现一个黄色球体。

8d7d007d1cbaa00eacbd30f2c1f33cfd74269fd0.source: Each earth shrine can be found in relation to the massive crater in the northern part of the Pockmark Flats. The first earth shrine is north of the crater, the second shrine is to the west of the crater, and the third shrine is south of the crater.
8d7d007d1cbaa00eacbd30f2c1f33cfd74269fd0.text: 每个地球神殿都与波克马克平原北部的巨大火山口相关。第一大地神殿在火山口以北，第二大地神殿在火山口以西，第三大地神殿在火山口以南。

1a1ca3b5dcf16a17aa55198b37e6307545623d92.source: After all three shrines have a Scorched Lodestone placed within them the Stone Golem will appear to the southeast of the crater. The Stone Golem spawns by itself, but there are several earth elemental patrols around its position. Stone Golem can be seen from the southern earth shrine.
1a1ca3b5dcf16a17aa55198b37e6307545623d92.text: 在所有三个神殿内都放置了烧焦的磁石后，石傀儡将出现在火山口的东南部。石傀儡会自行生成，但其位置周围有几个土元素巡逻队。从南部的大地神殿可以看到石傀儡。

49157ca48a447779ebf3964bb6ad96c24b2b08a0.source: This quest removes a lot of non-elemental foes from the area (primarily the ones that would normally spawn north of the "Pockmark Flats" text label in the World Map), which may or may not make it easier to vanquish.
49157ca48a447779ebf3964bb6ad96c24b2b08a0.text: 该任务从该区域移除了许多非元素敌人（主要是通常在世界地图中“麻子平地”文本标签以北产生的敌人），这可能会或可能不会使征服变得更容易。

d5aec435e4483afa3ecea77c211e50c41da245c1.source: If you have activated the three shrines and leave the instance, the quest will reset and you will have to start again (and find three more Scorched Lodestones).
d5aec435e4483afa3ecea77c211e50c41da245c1.text: 如果您激活了三个神殿并离开了实例，任务将重置，您将必须重新开始（并找到另外三个烧焦的磁石）。

aefee82ccfa21f44313e58712850f280b63bb7b2.source: Drink from each of the two ale barrels to get drunk
aefee82ccfa21f44313e58712850f280b63bb7b2.text: 从两个啤酒桶中各喝一杯就醉了

38188bfcc3b63ce7fa41eacbe58ceb4ab043448e.source: Move three kegs of ale from the pile to the keg stand
38188bfcc3b63ce7fa41eacbe58ceb4ab043448e.text: 将三桶麦芽酒从堆中移至桶架上

2b0c717d6d4ae65c31700fe310b8fa519b240403.source: Drink from each of the two ale barrels
2b0c717d6d4ae65c31700fe310b8fa519b240403.text: 从两个啤酒桶中各喝一杯

8ecd62cc22c0b92dff26d040896ca477e240ec80.source: Run the slalom. You must pass each flag on the far side or you will be disqualified
8ecd62cc22c0b92dff26d040896ca477e240ec80.text: 跑回转。您必须通过远端的每面旗帜，否则您将被取消资格

b5caad19b621a27f3ab806788a040ce31b219b51.source: Herd three pigs into one of the pens
b5caad19b621a27f3ab806788a040ce31b219b51.text: 将三头猪关进其中一间猪栏

9874b6d6c56054b12783e7e27d0fd0224d3cb33c.source: See Olaf Olafson for your reward. (Female quest only)
9874b6d6c56054b12783e7e27d0fd0224d3cb33c.text: 前往奥拉夫·奥拉夫森领取奖励。 （仅限女性任务）

19f9dd3abf259d68894d7a636530f61e980725ce.source: See Olrun Olafdottir for your reward. (Male quest only)
19f9dd3abf259d68894d7a636530f61e980725ce.text: 前往奥尔伦·奥拉夫多蒂尔领取奖励。 （仅限男性任务）

0e6bc0d23172b625e908728f1c538837c3e8b64e.source: You will not have to fight anything, so concentrate your skillbar on moving quickly; aim for a permanent IMS of 33% or more. To start the quest, speak to Sif Shadowhunter who will start the timer. The quest indicator on your compass will help you find your next goal.
0e6bc0d23172b625e908728f1c538837c3e8b64e.text: 你不需要对抗任何东西，所以集中你的技能栏快速移动；目标是永久 IMS 达到 33% 或更高。要开始任务，请与 Sif Shadowhunter 交谈，他将启动计时器。指南针上的任务指示器将帮助您找到下一个目标。

15df288a8f128ed24b2a16732c08042dec94f759.source: Drink from both barrels next to Sif.
15df288a8f128ed24b2a16732c08042dec94f759.text: 从 Sif 旁边的两个桶里喝水。

28140c780d401b082a427348e093361f8359409b.source: Run to the Keg of Ale stack, pick up one, and carry it to the Keg Stand.
28140c780d401b082a427348e093361f8359409b.text: 跑到啤酒桶堆，拿起一桶，然后把它带到啤酒桶摊位。

1df62d08cce64ac2af8c888b1051bba36aa1b8dc.source: Return to the barrels; drink from both again.

ad381dc468a2bfe90419f18eed0ccc427d647a38.source: Run the slalom by following a zigzag path around the outside of the markers.
ad381dc468a2bfe90419f18eed0ccc427d647a38.text: 沿着标记外侧的锯齿形路径进行回转。

f973745d84445f17bccaf6a1206f09c6855d1465.source: Make sure the quest updates as you pass each marker.
f973745d84445f17bccaf6a1206f09c6855d1465.text: 确保任务在您通过每个标记时更新。

a1c6efcd25cab1d3cedfc9096a2a2d979d661a76.source: Avoid the inner side of the flags; you can get disqualified even if you had passed them earlier from the far side.
a1c6efcd25cab1d3cedfc9096a2a2d979d661a76.text: 避开旗帜的内侧；即使您较早从远端超越了它们，您也可能会被取消资格。

479a96860181c621aca694481bdd5cff90f31363.source: Return to the barrels and drink from both one last time.
479a96860181c621aca694481bdd5cff90f31363.text: 返回到酒桶处，最后一次喝完这两个酒。

44d6a4ddfa129d0dedd696935059c59b71ae59db.source: Follow the quest markers to the pen and push 3 piggies into the pen by bodyblocking them from the opposite direction.
44d6a4ddfa129d0dedd696935059c59b71ae59db.text: 跟随任务标记到达围栏，并从相反方向用身体阻挡 3 只小猪，将它们推入围栏。

a29b9d3bad1efc5a6259c71f04801a414e14ac69.source: You can speed things up by moving some pigs closer to the pen before starting the challenge.
a29b9d3bad1efc5a6259c71f04801a414e14ac69.text: 在开始挑战之前，您可以通过将一些猪移近猪栏来加快速度。

2f6f2c25eac540d11554c1abf943147eb6f35fbc.source: If you are lucky, you can even herd three pigs into the stable and collect the reward without talking to Sif, allowing you to collect the reward without triggering the timer. However, the pigs are not at all cooperative.
2f6f2c25eac540d11554c1abf943147eb6f35fbc.text: 如果你幸运的话，你甚至可以在不与Sif交谈的情况下将三头猪赶进马厩并收集奖励，这样你就可以在不触发计时器的情况下收集奖励。然而，猪们一点也不合作。

e8daa6d227253ef6ec6786a4a87cb2747282c6b9.source: You can bring spirits to help guide the pigs, but that is not guaranteed to work.
e8daa6d227253ef6ec6786a4a87cb2747282c6b9.text: 你可以带烈酒来帮助引导猪，但这并不能保证一定有效。

0f686b62fa28e494adfeaa38eff9c6478d08fbb8.source: Some players have had success by repeatedly rezoning until the pigs are either in or very close to the stable before attempting to herd them.
0f686b62fa28e494adfeaa38eff9c6478d08fbb8.text: 一些玩家通过反复重新分区，直到猪进入或非常接近马厩，然后再尝试放牧它们，从而取得了成功。

d0899b10d84f025b57169a20dee4f6ea19061a15.source: You do not need to touch the Keg Stand; once you bring the keg bundles close enough; they will drop automatically.
d0899b10d84f025b57169a20dee4f6ea19061a15.text: 您无需触摸桶架；一旦你把小桶捆放得足够近；它们会自动掉落。

4ac3b8aab0286b9122d4df0c26f6f908faaf51cd.source: The slalom zig-zag path is unforgiving, so give each flag a wide berth (around 5 to 10 steps) as you pass around its far side. Start at the bottom of the hill and head towards the stable.
4ac3b8aab0286b9122d4df0c26f6f908faaf51cd.text: 回转曲折的路径是无情的，因此当您绕过每个旗帜的远端时，请与每个旗帜保持一定的距离（大约 5 到 10 步）。从山脚开始，朝马厩走去。

b873eceb9c976686fcdfb27bfd98ed843759f575.source: You must run exactly between the flags, otherwise you fail the quest.
b873eceb9c976686fcdfb27bfd98ed843759f575.text: 你必须准确地跑到旗帜之间，否则任务就会失败。

9b7d15c1bb3406ba1046885fe9612d41341254ab.source: Drunkenness from these kegs does not count towards drunkard title.
9b7d15c1bb3406ba1046885fe9612d41341254ab.text: 从这些小桶中喝醉的人不会计入酒鬼头衔。

85e121b8eb1009952c14d10bffe7be9969c7c8ab.source: Disabling post-process effects makes it easier to navigate, since the display will not wobble.
85e121b8eb1009952c14d10bffe7be9969c7c8ab.text: 禁用后处理效果可以更轻松地导航，因为显示不会晃动。

6b24a1d98d6157770c8c8eff9fa56972853242d9.source: You can explore past the closed doorways at the various map exits and reveal otherwise unreachable areas. However, you will encounter the usual foes outside the alemoot; bring running skills and/or spirits to use as decoys.
6b24a1d98d6157770c8c8eff9fa56972853242d9.text: 您可以探索各个地图出口处关闭的门口，并揭示其他无法到达的区域。然而，你会在阿穆特之外遇到常见的敌人；携带跑步技巧和/或精神作为诱饵。

ce6e0b7652d67fd8bb1cd9e536b21858d7b1dbee.source: There is a locked chest to the south, in the area where Nulfastu Earthbound normally spawns.
ce6e0b7652d67fd8bb1cd9e536b21858d7b1dbee.text: 南边有一个上锁的箱子，位于努法斯塔通常生成的区域。

f623fca0aff724260009ecae7edd0ea3d9916dce.source: You may postpone the quest reward by map travel from this solo instance to one of outposts and then receive it from corresponding NPC in their usual location. This allows to add to the party other heroes (in particular, below level 20) who will get experience as well.
f623fca0aff724260009ecae7edd0ea3d9916dce.text: 您可以通过从该单人副本到前哨站之一的地图旅行来推迟任务奖励，然后从相应的 NPC 在其通常的位置接收它。这允许将其他英雄（特别是20级以下）添加到队伍中，他们也将获得经验。

f8eb24e0fdfde33be0a0649e6c74ea491701fcaa.source: {{Bug|For various reasons, the quest can be completed without finishing all the activities:
f8eb24e0fdfde33be0a0649e6c74ea491701fcaa.text: {{Bug|由于各种原因，任务可以在未完成所有活动的情况下完成：

916b0447f965669f729ebee6b01800a2fa9945ea.source: You automatically succeed once three pigs enter the stables. You can use this to your advantage, by body-blocking the pigs into the pen before starting the timer. It takes longer, as the hogs are harder to control, but you have all the time you need this way. Also:
916b0447f965669f729ebee6b01800a2fa9945ea.text: 一旦三头猪进入马厩，您就自动成功。您可以利用这一点，在启动计时器之前用身体将猪挡在猪栏内。这需要更长的时间，因为猪更难控制，但你有足够的时间以这种方式。另外：

3688afdd2f409169fe9c8d167ad0bbe3b8048bd0.source: Sometimes three will reach the corral on their own.
3688afdd2f409169fe9c8d167ad0bbe3b8048bd0.text: 有时三个人会自己到达畜栏。

fe9cc94b935cbfa5f128bb6e88c5ce69ee077d09.source: Sometimes the game server registers three pigs entering, although you see something different on-screen.
fe9cc94b935cbfa5f128bb6e88c5ce69ee077d09.text: 有时游戏服务器会注册三只猪进入，尽管您在屏幕上看到的内容有所不同。

c02157737ff72f050cc23d934d8b127d6bc4c500.source: If you have completed up to the slalom, you can retake the challenge and succeed by heading straight for the pigs, who will now be easier to herd.}}
c02157737ff72f050cc23d934d8b127d6bc4c500.text: 如果您完成了回转，您可以重新接受挑战并直接向猪走去并获得成功，现在猪会更容易放牧。}}

8912d05e4994e5d52099b9e195be8ef7f2f17785.source: If you apply an Extreme Makeover Credit to change gender after taking the quest, but before completion, you will have to finish it an extra time before you can proceed to the subsequent quests.
8912d05e4994e5d52099b9e195be8ef7f2f17785.text: 如果您在接受任务后但在完成之前应用极端改头换面信用来改变性别，则您必须额外完成一次才能继续后续任务。

e6ea688e7faccb4fa78b71f073d6c63b66147890.source: You can see the edge of the world by running into the next zone.
e6ea688e7faccb4fa78b71f073d6c63b66147890.text: 你可以通过跑进下一个区域来看到世界的边缘。

4e7e01dbbee021ea915e439e1e5e575995406e59.source: As with any time-dependent tasks, you can fail this quest due to lag. Consider waiting until your ping is low.
4e7e01dbbee021ea915e439e1e5e575995406e59.text: 与任何依赖时间的任务一样，您可能会因延迟而失败此任务。考虑等到您的 ping 值较低。

641ff56e80fb65e6afd28b220b80aa7deef7bef3.source: Scout the enemy territory north of the Great Northern Wall and assess the strength of the Charr army.
641ff56e80fb65e6afd28b220b80aa7deef7bef3.text: 侦察北长城以北的敌方领土，评估夏尔军队的实力。

50b8895da06b6ce249be7e473527a683aed7aae4.source: *BONUS* Find and return the four pieces of Kilnn Testibrie's armor to his tomb.
50b8895da06b6ce249be7e473527a683aed7aae4.text: *奖励*找到 Kilnn Testibrie 的四件盔甲并将其放回他的坟墓。

644fe1199069e9a05762abd5e1e0302d032b286b.source: As per The Great Northern Wall mission.

554e1fe6dccab76c68a3acd36d74141bab067240.source: The Great Zehtuka will only offer this quest after all the Aggressive Lions and Lionesses surrounding him are dead (although you can charm one to become a pet).
554e1fe6dccab76c68a3acd36d74141bab067240.text: 伟大的泽图卡只会在他周围的所有好斗的狮子和母狮都死后才会提供这个任务（尽管你可以迷惑一只狮子使其成为宠物）。

810ccde25578160647963dcc72c5da6a7bfa61f8.source: Travel around Jahai Bluffs and visit landmarks commemorating the valiant deeds of the Great Zehtuka.
810ccde25578160647963dcc72c5da6a7bfa61f8.text: 游览贾海悬崖 (Jahai Bluffs)，参观纪念伟大泽图卡 (Great Zehtuka) 英勇事迹的地标建筑。

e2736028285709e26321dff64d8e8a184c4e5dd4.source: See the Great Zehtuka for your reward.
e2736028285709e26321dff64d8e8a184c4e5dd4.text: 去见伟大的泽图卡以获得奖励。

7ce38491f128501a6a28d0da780f1292be8d5b46.source: This is basically a tour following Zehtuka around to various points in Jahai Bluffs listening to him blow his own horn about how great a hunter he is. The only possible trouble is the wandering groups of wildlife. You can time your party's movement to avoid many of them.
7ce38491f128501a6a28d0da780f1292be8d5b46.text: 这基本上是一次跟随 Zehtuka 到 Jahai Bluffs 各个地点的旅行，听他吹响自己的号角，讲述他是多么伟大的猎人。唯一可能的麻烦是流浪的野生动物群。您可以安排队伍的行动时间来避免其中的许多情况。

9619e27e31b6dc0c5dee5b447b420256a47af117.source: Zehtuka will not wait for your group to keep up, and will travel past the edge of the small square map (at standard size). The best way to catch up with him is keeping this quest active, and follow the stars and/or arrows.
9619e27e31b6dc0c5dee5b447b420256a47af117.text: Zehtuka 不会等待您的队伍跟上，并且会经过小方形地图（标准尺寸）的边缘。追上他的最好方法是保持这个任务活跃，并跟随星星和/或箭头。

c6eea848ef5553a772f0d246e12ab39cb87686b4.source: Kill the Greater Darkness in Ravenheart Gloom.
c6eea848ef5553a772f0d246e12ab39cb87686b4.text: 杀死鸦心幽暗中的大黑暗。

3ec950a2097f0d65d5f841a2a7264f566740266f.source: *BONUS* Kill The Unlike the previous objective, 'The' is capitalized here Greater Darkness in Hard Mode.
3ec950a2097f0d65d5f841a2a7264f566740266f.text: *奖励*杀死 The 与之前的目标不同，“The”在困难模式下的大黑暗中是大写的。

bf28ec2dec6519f3571e7845301c59edb8083ad5.source: After completing the repeatable quests To the Rescue!, The Rifts Between Us and Deathbringer Company in Ravenheart Gloom, the Greater Darkness will spawn along with two of the Darknesses. They're easy to kill, but will spawn additional foes on death.
bf28ec2dec6519f3571e7845301c59edb8083ad5.text: 在完成 Ravenheart Gloom 的可重复任务“救援！”、“我们之间的裂痕”和“死亡使者连”之后，“大黑暗”将与其中两个“黑暗”一起生成。它们很容易被杀死，但死亡后会产生更多的敌人。

2caa0a0eef4ebf0e97a5d43f64d0c4ee93161911.source: Killing or even surviving the additional foes is not required for this quest, but will progress the quest Mallyx the Unyielding and spawn a reward chest.
2caa0a0eef4ebf0e97a5d43f64d0c4ee93161911.text: 此任务不需要杀死甚至幸存额外的敌人，但会推进任务“不屈的马里克斯”并产生奖励箱。

fdebe199a20c810d68208decda989c15d04fb2eb.source: Meet Jehner in the Poisoned Outcrops.

feccc96598f28cb18105237871cad8528e234c05.source: Destroy the soul-eating Margonites. You have X of 5 groups remaining.
feccc96598f28cb18105237871cad8528e234c05.text: 消灭噬魂玛贡尼特。您还剩下 X 个组，共 5 个组。

0563ccc4bef0b2c9c74a7e80a4dba7fa6f89ac94.source: Just follow the markers and kill the Margonite groups. Some groups might be killed for you by the roaming Djinns and Awakened.
0563ccc4bef0b2c9c74a7e80a4dba7fa6f89ac94.text: 只需跟随标记并杀死玛贡尼特群体即可。有些团体可能会被漫游的神灵和觉醒者杀死。

bced555f21b0fc01afc3ee74c58e73eb9aa83343.source: Jehner and several Freed Souls will join you as allies on this quest. Although quest completion does not require their survival, if you keep Jehner alive, you can avoid the need to return to The Ruptured Heart to claim the reward.
bced555f21b0fc01afc3ee74c58e73eb9aa83343.text: 耶纳和几个被释放的灵魂将作为盟友与你一起完成这个任务。虽然完成任务并不要求他们生存，但如果你让耶纳活着，你就可以避免返回破碎之心领取奖励。

478ecf970714571f4b7c005253eed4c7f8c94aef.source: Jehner and the Freed Souls will stop following your party when the quest is completed. If you are using them as meat shields or general allies in a vanquish, it may be advantageous to save one group of Margonite Souleaters for last.
478ecf970714571f4b7c005253eed4c7f8c94aef.text: 任务完成后，耶纳和自由灵魂将停止跟随你的队伍。如果你在征服中使用它们作为肉盾或一般盟友，那么将一组玛贡尼特食魂者留到最后可能会更有利。

bf01a9ac10dafb37258ce42dcb6c0de5df800472.source: The Margonite Souleaters are hostile to both normal Margonites and the Awakened.
bf01a9ac10dafb37258ce42dcb6c0de5df800472.text: 玛贡尼特噬魂者对普通玛贡尼特和觉醒者都怀有敌意。

a31a14c4387d558ec7529e335d063ebbb121f9e6.source: As the Souleaters spawn when you zone into the instance, it is possible to start from Lair of the Forgotten and backtrack to kill the groups without talking to Jehner, effectively making the quest shorter as you don't need to walk from the quest start location to Poisoned Outcrops as well as guaranteeing his survival making claiming the reward easier.
a31a14c4387d558ec7529e335d063ebbb121f9e6.text: 当你进入实例时，食魂者会生成，因此可以从被遗忘者的巢穴开始，然后原路返回杀死小组，而无需与耶纳交谈，从而有效地缩短任务时间，因为你不需要从任务开始位置步行到有毒露头，并保证他的生存，从而更容易获得奖励。

3abb5267f2d9015220871cee63020b66f456a9a4.source: Speak to Captain Rion of the Halcyon.
3abb5267f2d9015220871cee63020b66f456a9a4.text: 与翡翠号的瑞恩船长交谈。

1a56610fdb6d8d48ce72522c7af591e5e642f777.source: [Incomplete source section] Enter Boreas Seabed from Zos Shivros Channel. Go north after speaking to Rion. Most mobs can be avoided. There are popup Oni in a few places. Then head east over the bridge. On the way to Lord Senkai, you will encounter hostile level 10 Canthan Peasants and Canthan Nobles who will turn friendly when reached. Near them you will encounter level 20 Luxon Assassin popups. Head towards Lord Senkai and kill him. This will cause a wave of level 20 Kurzick and Luxon including War Captain Womack and multiple Monks. Killing War Captain Womack completes the quest.
1a56610fdb6d8d48ce72522c7af591e5e642f777.text: [不完整的来源部分] 从 Zos Shivros 海峡进入 Boreas 海底。与里昂交谈后向北走。大多数小怪是可以避免的。在一些地方有弹出式鬼。然后过桥向东走。在前往战海领主的路上，你会遇到敌对的 10 级凯珊农民和凯珊贵族，他们在到达后会转为友好。在他们附近你会遇到 20 级 Luxon 刺客弹出窗口。前往战海领主并杀死他。这将引发一波20级的库兹克和卢克森，包括战队长沃马克和多名武僧。杀死沃马克上尉即可完成任务。

5d9644b77ab34662b8c9d2439d4e47a75b4efaf6.source: Despite his unique name, War Captain Womack is not a boss; however, his death will give a morale boost.
5d9644b77ab34662b8c9d2439d4e47a75b4efaf6.text: 尽管沃马克上尉的名字很独特，但他并不是一个 Boss；而是一个 Boss。然而，他的死将鼓舞士气。

731510ef94e7a6cf36c25ab26ae8e1946f91f156.source: Despite their ongoing conflict, the Luxon and Kurzick will not attack each other.
731510ef94e7a6cf36c25ab26ae8e1946f91f156.text: 尽管冲突持续不断，卢克森人和库兹克人不会互相攻击。

7a5ff24e8a7a7c3b504fac14c20c19da556290eb.source: This quest can be used for farming Bo Staves, Dragon Staves, and many other rare items. Players may choose not to complete this quest in order to use it for farming instead.
7a5ff24e8a7a7c3b504fac14c20c19da556290eb.text: 该任务可用于种植博杖、龙杖和许多其他稀有物品。玩家可以选择不完成此任务，而是将其用于耕种。

c2c3ec40017ac78b7103517ad3db64d65f44625b.source: Carry the Staff of the Mists to the Hallowed Point.
c2c3ec40017ac78b7103517ad3db64d65f44625b.text: 将迷雾之杖带到神圣地点。

3b9b86cc453f7b2f1a2b63f96ddb91e911cfa677.source: Throw the Staff of the Mists into the Hallowed Point.
3b9b86cc453f7b2f1a2b63f96ddb91e911cfa677.text: 将迷雾法杖扔进神圣点。

254d2bd1f336d60391716b741db2f8ffc2aea8c2.source: Carry the Staff of the Mists northwest to the Hallowed Point. You will encounter additional spawns of Margonites along the way. When the quest log asks the player to "throw" the staff, click on the Hallowed Point. Return to Buuran for your reward.
254d2bd1f336d60391716b741db2f8ffc2aea8c2.text: 将迷雾法杖带到西北方向的神圣点。沿途你会遇到额外的玛贡尼特生成物。当任务日志要求玩家“扔掉”法杖时，点击神圣点。返回布乌兰领取奖励。

a5856284d40c1f6879b24c655803d31f5867548e.source: Be sure to accept the quest before taking the Staff of the Mists to the Hallowed Point, since clicking on the Hallowed Point will make the staff disappear - requiring you to rezone to start the quest again.
a5856284d40c1f6879b24c655803d31f5867548e.text: 请务必在将迷雾法杖带到神圣点之前接受任务，因为点击神圣点将使法杖消失 - 需要您重新分配区域才能再次开始任务。

dd7e4ea3fa30335a44ac0be126d94df25a3d3942.source: Combines well with Forgotten Retribution, since there are plenty of Margonites along the quest route.
dd7e4ea3fa30335a44ac0be126d94df25a3d3942.text: 与被遗忘的报应结合得很好，因为任务路线上有很多玛贡尼特。

68fa6c0dcebea1ebcd50af2a86468810ab88d56d.source: Lead Gardener Pohsin safely to the Hanging Gardens of Jahin.
68fa6c0dcebea1ebcd50af2a86468810ab88d56d.text: 带领园丁 Pohsin 安全到达贾欣空中花园。

b0a38be87c926912f0ba2e29c9bbc9141b86d7b1.source: See Gardener Pohsin for your reward.
b0a38be87c926912f0ba2e29c9bbc9141b86d7b1.text: 去找园丁 Pohsin 领取奖励。

dc81756e973843de95ef16b18724aa762fc3d3b6.source: Once this quest is completed, Gardener Pohsin will no longer spawn in Vehtendi Valley.
dc81756e973843de95ef16b18724aa762fc3d3b6.text: 一旦完成此任务，园丁波辛将不再在维赫滕迪山谷中生成。

872016a0fd90d2438641df5c06f1c9cd447e2c35.source: This is a routine escort type quest, simply ensure that the NPC Pohsin stays alive while you take her across Ventendi Valley (point 1 to point 2 on the map). Creatures you're likely to encounter are Kournan soldiers (usually with a margonite), heket and some plant type mobs. The initial quest objective can be approached from either Yahnur Market or the Kodash Bazaar.
872016a0fd90d2438641df5c06f1c9cd447e2c35.text: 这是一个例行护送类型任务，只需确保 NPC Pohsin 在带她穿越 Ventendi 山谷（地图上的点 1 到点 2）时保持活力即可。你可能会遇到的生物有库尔南士兵（通常带着玛岗石）、赫克特和一些植物类型的怪物。最初的任务目标可以从 Yahnur 市场或 Kodash 集市到达。

97972493c9098be5fa6b211979d72a1d4eab363a.source: This quest can easily be picked up while performing The Role of a Lifetime quest for Norgu, and completed afterwards before leaving Vehtendi Valley.
97972493c9098be5fa6b211979d72a1d4eab363a.text: 这个任务可以在为 Norgu 执行“终生角色”任务时轻松完成，并在离开 Vehtendi 山谷之前完成。

94da5d68fd164f94e4282e221e69fe1c4028b3c6.source: If Pohsin dies, then the quest fails. You will have to return to an outpost, then return back to the starting point to accompany Pohsin again.
94da5d68fd164f94e4282e221e69fe1c4028b3c6.text: 如果波辛死了，任务就会失败。您将必须返回前哨站，然后返回起点再次陪伴波辛。

ee59d8213aa4ef527bf9b19c3c012d5eef48f017.source: There are many NPCs for Pohsin to get caught on.
ee59d8213aa4ef527bf9b19c3c012d5eef48f017.text: 有很多 NPC 可供 Pohsin 抓捕。

dd45b8b696d292f5d4b170ca85e5e4331220a9c4.source: Speak with Devona in Lion's Arch to receive the quest, then again to complete it.
dd45b8b696d292f5d4b170ca85e5e4331220a9c4.text: 与狮子拱门的德沃娜交谈以接受任务，然后再次完成它。

03544ad5e9b907e5a790c386a83385b496102b93.source: This quest is available even to characters that have already unlocked Devona as a hero through completion of The Scourge Beneath in pre-Searing Ascalon.
03544ad5e9b907e5a790c386a83385b496102b93.text: 这个任务甚至适用于那些已经通过完成灼热阿斯卡隆前期的天灾之下而将德沃娜解锁为英雄的角色。

8e21a79366ffb37021a90eddcb3f2c6c7814dedf.source: Must have changed secondary profession at least once to another profession (see Notes), either
8e21a79366ffb37021a90eddcb3f2c6c7814dedf.text: 必须至少曾将次要职业更改为其他职业（见注释），或者

12ecc5e505cd4e4d5e9fb34893377e49d30cb99c.source: via a profession changer and a manual change via the Skills and Attributes Panel to first the original secondary profession and then the newly acquired one again, or
12ecc5e505cd4e4d5e9fb34893377e49d30cb99c.text: 通过职业变更者并通过技能和属性面板手动更改，首先选择原来的第二职业，然后再次选择新获得的职业，或者

30625a7895a496f7a7f1e42020f5968c7e407b70.source: by completing one of the following "'s Path" quests:
30625a7895a496f7a7f1e42020f5968c7e407b70.text: 完成以下“路径”任务之一：

0a9cdf92c43b3c87be4b7578fa9904deeaec45f6.source: Enter the Frozen Forest from Iron Mines of Moladune.1
0a9cdf92c43b3c87be4b7578fa9904deeaec45f6.text: 从莫拉杜恩铁矿进入冰冻森林1

544ef5c5e4f9e0d3386451c468275c583b5bdb07.source: Return to Vanyi for your reward.
544ef5c5e4f9e0d3386451c468275c583b5bdb07.text: 返回瓦尼那里领取奖励。

c10d45a517831c6c0ddb2904a108970444f57bc0.source: Enter the Frozen Forest either from Iron Mines of Moladune or Copperhammer Mines and meet Sanyi who will be standing in front of Copperhammer Mines outpost. Follow her while killing Mragga Spawns and finally defeat her. Return to Vanyi.
c10d45a517831c6c0ddb2904a108970444f57bc0.text: 从莫拉杜恩的铁矿或铜锤矿进入冰冻森林，并与站在铜锤矿前哨站前的桑伊会面。跟随她杀死姆拉加生成者并最终击败她。返回凡尼。

73f2b3d484a71d5968f3588deb77b18f98a0d8df.source: Despite the initial dialogue and the quest objective, it is possible to complete the quest by starting from Copperhammer Mines, which is closer to Sanyi.
73f2b3d484a71d5968f3588deb77b18f98a0d8df.text: 尽管有最初的对话和任务目标，但可以从距离三义更近的铜锤矿山开始完成任务。

326366dcf8461ec87dfa0cd909b12690ce036e1b.source: It is not necessary to change secondary profession as long as any of the "'s Path" quests have been completed.
326366dcf8461ec87dfa0cd909b12690ce036e1b.text: 只要完成任何“路径”任务，就没有必要改变第二职业。

ff3e28672ba28134578923b296ac38085bbdb3ed.source: If you haven't completed any of the "'s Path" quests, you will need to change from your initial secondary profession to another one once via the Skills and Attributes Panel. Change of secondary from profession changers do not seem to count.
ff3e28672ba28134578923b296ac38085bbdb3ed.text: 如果您还没有完成任何“路径”任务，您将需要通过技能和属性面板从最初的第二职业更改为另一个职业。从职业改变者转为中专似乎不算数。

382fed7e7f262a24605ec10c8a6ab6bb9d7ef525.source: Sometimes Sanyi will get stuck behind the tree stump right before the Stone Summit after crossing the bridge. Talk to her and she will move.
382fed7e7f262a24605ec10c8a6ab6bb9d7ef525.text: 有时三义过桥后会被卡在石峰前的树桩后面。和她说话她就会移动。

9453bc5b9a4d081964fc453a249f559e890a3438.source: Map travel back to each of the three outposts in the Crystal Desert, or run to them from Augury Rock if necessary. Once all three have been visited, return to Droknar's Forge and claim the reward from Vanyi.
9453bc5b9a4d081964fc453a249f559e890a3438.text: 地图返回水晶沙漠中的三个前哨站，或者在必要时从占卜岩跑到它们那里。拜访完这三个人后，返回卓克纳尔熔炉并从瓦尼那里领取奖励。

62d7952d254e469ba048fc59181e282d4aa412ad.source: The quest is intended to lead players to the new quests available in the three listed outposts, which unlock the ability to change your secondary profession. Completing those quests is not required to claim the reward for this quest, but will unlock Vanyi's attribute point quest, The Hero's Challenge.
62d7952d254e469ba048fc59181e282d4aa412ad.text: 该任务旨在引导玩家完成所列三个前哨站中的新任务，从而解锁改变第二职业的能力。完成这些任务不需要领取该任务的奖励，但会解锁Vanyi的属性点任务，英雄的挑战。

120d889315872e4291e1d6790a129dabb1c14f93.source: If a character has already visited the outposts and changed professions before talking to Vanyi, it is possible to acquire both quests at the same time.
120d889315872e4291e1d6790a129dabb1c14f93.text: 如果角色在与Vanyi交谈之前已经访问过前哨站并改变了职业，则可以同时获得这两个任务。

7cbb997601a37d0238cdb4beb82adf6ed8157e2b.source: Having visited those locations previously will not fulfill the objectives, but allows you to do so by simple map travel.
7cbb997601a37d0238cdb4beb82adf6ed8157e2b.text: 之前访问过这些地点并不能实现目标，但可以让您通过简单的地图旅行来实现。

bf5981b4f942036ddff7b400544536af1129b02e.source: The reward dialogue is the same even if you have completed one of the profession quests and learned how to change your secondary profession.
bf5981b4f942036ddff7b400544536af1129b02e.text: 即使你完成了其中一项职业任务并学会了如何改变你的第二职业，奖励对话也是一样的。

709497617d99ec9f2df184a3f69f499f638b4fa2.source: Clear the Hidden City of Ahdashim in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
709497617d99ec9f2df184a3f69f499f638b4fa2.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比艾哈达希姆隐藏之城的所有敌人。

26feb8badeb0bcf64ddb82d8a4b6f6a670a452f1.source: Even though this is a Vabbian area, and thus rewards Lightbringer points for vanquishing the area, this quest rewards Sunspear promotion points.
26feb8badeb0bcf64ddb82d8a4b6f6a670a452f1.text: 尽管这是瓦比亚地区，因此征服该地区会奖励光明使者点数，但此任务会奖励阳矛升级点数。

5bed1574325d46a248f72ee3c58714a2e1d7b043.source: This area is only accessible via the Dasha Vestibule mission outpost by speaking to the Key of Ahdashim. The character must have completed either the Dasha Vestibule mission or the Dzagonur Bastion mission.
5bed1574325d46a248f72ee3c58714a2e1d7b043.text: 该区域只能通过 Dasha Vestibule 任务前哨与 Ahdashim 钥匙交谈来进入。该角色必须完成 Dasha Vestibule 任务或 Dzagonur Bastion 任务。

ccc1d88e98ed7d0504da19f6c90d6d57b1f63786.source: Beyond the first chamber (which has hidden djinn on both sides) where the party starts, this area is divided into three paths:
ccc1d88e98ed7d0504da19f6c90d6d57b1f63786.text: 除了队伍开始的第一个房间（两边都隐藏着巨灵）之外，这个区域分为三个路径：

dfae884a0ddc9b3edfe632ec2f716ea1df99547e.source: The central path runs all the way to the northern edge of the map. There are numerous elementals along the way, including several hidden groups.
dfae884a0ddc9b3edfe632ec2f716ea1df99547e.text: 中央路径一直延伸到地图的北边缘。沿途有许多元素，包括几个隐藏的团体。

b3e2d11aa217f290afbad7f4a8d24cdce017ba8d.source: The western path starts off with some Cobalt groups in the first chamber. The rest of it is also filled with hidden and patrolling groups of elementals.
b3e2d11aa217f290afbad7f4a8d24cdce017ba8d.text: 西边的路径从第一个房间中的一些钴基团开始。其余部分也充满了隐藏和巡逻的元素群。

b9fbdeafd3bc298cb11601b74e937e8f0bdf8d6a.source: The eastern path is actually outside the city proper. As such, it is instead populated by hostile plants, beasts, hekets, and beetles. Hidden groups of beetles are found in the paths towards the north.
b9fbdeafd3bc298cb11601b74e937e8f0bdf8d6a.text: 东边的小路实际上是在城外。因此，这里充满了敌对的植物、野兽、赫克特和甲虫。在向北的小路上可以发现隐藏的甲虫群。

4cf08824cec01b9d937e75673e86e0649bc02ba0.source: This area is underground (i.e. does not show up on the World Map) and so does not contribute to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
4cf08824cec01b9d937e75673e86e0649bc02ba0.text: 该区域位于地下（即不会出现在世界地图上），因此不会对 Elonian Cartographer 的主打歌做出贡献。

47fde8bd0969bcdbf349e161edc26e5d2f062a32.source: The elementals in this area (especially the boss groups) are capable of dealing a very large amount of area damage. Always try to spread out before engaging.
47fde8bd0969bcdbf349e161edc26e5d2f062a32.text: 该区域的元素（尤其是 Boss 群体）能够造成大量区域伤害。在参与之前一定要尝试分散注意力。

458387a5f6242e1946accd77ca5e56438618122a.source: Damage reduction skills (or increasing one's health), especially those that affect the whole party, together with health degeneration counters will ease the difficulty of this area greatly.
458387a5f6242e1946accd77ca5e56438618122a.text: 减少伤害的技能（或增加生命值），尤其是那些影响整个队伍的技能，再加上生命值退化计数器将大大缓解该领域的难度。

298f695a655dd0ca16ef3ddace942316c8baad7b.source: Interrupts, especially AoE ones such as Cry of Frustration and Panic will make defeating the Roaring Ethers much easier preventing the use of their Resurrection Signets and large AoE Spikes from Energy Surge.
298f695a655dd0ca16ef3ddace942316c8baad7b.text: 中断，尤其是 AoE 中断，例如“沮丧呐喊”和“恐慌”，将使击败咆哮以太变得更加容易，从而防止使用它们的复活印章和来自能量激增的大型 AoE 尖峰。

fccfa5470e08ae9b41e2fa6c4e29778359c6101b.source: The Gift of the Djinn quest will reduce the total number of creatures that spawn. But do not activate the altars, because this will trigger a lot of Djinn.
fccfa5470e08ae9b41e2fa6c4e29778359c6101b.text: 巨灵的礼物任务将减少生成的生物总数。但不要激活祭坛，因为这会触发大量巨灵。

de9a3bf4014ffede6f6479dc973ce94b3d70aa48.source: Having the quest Gift of the Djinn in your quest log prevents Nicholas the Traveler from spawning in the Hidden City of Ahdashim. As per most quests, you must be in an outpost to abandon it and get Nicholas to spawn as normal.
de9a3bf4014ffede6f6479dc973ce94b3d70aa48.text: 在你的任务日志中加入任务“巨灵的礼物”可以防止旅行者尼古拉斯在艾哈达希姆的隐藏之城中生成。根据大多数任务，您必须在前哨站中放弃它并让尼古拉斯正常产卵。

afaa6d4ae47e137abe7c1dbccd5c19f30ae30dc8.source: Go to Bergen Hot Springs and obtain a written testimony from Andar D'Leod.
afaa6d4ae47e137abe7c1dbccd5c19f30ae30dc8.text: 前往卑尔根温泉并获得安达尔·德·莱奥德的书面证词。

449c2b1788a726ab0e806ed89f86ae427a7a2746.source: Go to Bergen Hot Springs and obtain a written testimony from Dannel Smythe.
449c2b1788a726ab0e806ed89f86ae427a7a2746.text: 前往卑尔根温泉并获得丹内尔·斯迈思的书面证词。

f4491d2ecc2070223e2071d06d08715962175d29.source: Go to Bergen Hot Springs and obtain a written testimony from Penelope Randell.
f4491d2ecc2070223e2071d06d08715962175d29.text: 前往卑尔根温泉并获得佩内洛普·兰德尔的书面证词。

3d32ae1ab9a9425ec89e2d2a3fa8b92994dd80af.source: Go to Bergen Hot Springs and obtain a written testimony from Layman Josef.
3d32ae1ab9a9425ec89e2d2a3fa8b92994dd80af.text: 前往卑尔根温泉并获得约瑟夫外行的书面证词。

0de5b189bbe8f517693beaa3f4455d748b80452d.source: Return the written testimonies to Inspector Caleb in Nebo Village.
0de5b189bbe8f517693beaa3f4455d748b80452d.text: 将书面证词返还给尼波村的督察迦勒。

eb60eb7a6c5b9f47fa5f1374a4c7f67476fe514a.source: To complete the quest, simply follow the quest marker to the outpost Bergen Hot Springs and speak with each witness. Return the testimonies to Inspector Caleb in Nebo Village, then speak with Inquisitor Gilead to receive the reward.
eb60eb7a6c5b9f47fa5f1374a4c7f67476fe514a.text: 要完成任务，只需按照任务标记前往前哨卑尔根温泉并与每个目击者交谈即可。将证词交给尼波村的督察迦勒，然后与审判官基列交谈以获得奖励。

ec4b73ff9cdbe8fa37d1c4e80b6172aa621860fb.source: Following the quest Mustering a Response, Nebo Village will be cleared of its residents, causing the player to be unable to complete the quest until The War in Kryta is further completed.
ec4b73ff9cdbe8fa37d1c4e80b6172aa621860fb.text: 在任务“召集响应”之后，尼波村的居民将被清除，导致玩家无法完成任务，直到科瑞塔之战进一步完成。

9356005cb4d9b3ed8caa177f9593700897163231.source: Destroy the Shard Wolves. 7..0 Shard Wolves remain.
9356005cb4d9b3ed8caa177f9593700897163231.text: 消灭碎片狼。 7..0 碎片狼依然存在。

5a52eef30c2adb764e69af82148b46686ee71796.source: Return to Nimros the Hunter for your reward.
5a52eef30c2adb764e69af82148b46686ee71796.text: 返回猎人尼姆罗斯那里领取奖励。

e0d9f5d7529939e3546e28745b0409f9411c9797.source: When the quest is taken, the seven Shard Wolves will spawn scattered about the Fissure. There will be a Shard Wolf in each of the major areas surrounding the Temple, with the exception of the Lake of Fire. The Shard Wolves can be killed in conjunction with exploring or doing other quests in the Fissure. When the last Shard Wolf is dead, return to Nimros the Hunter for your reward.
e0d9f5d7529939e3546e28745b0409f9411c9797.text: 完成任务后，七只碎片狼会分散在裂缝周围生成。除了火湖之外，神殿周围的每个主要区域都会有一只碎片狼。碎片狼可以在探索裂缝或执行其他任务时被杀死。当最后一只碎片狼死后，回到猎人尼姆罗斯那里领取奖励。

a3386e82c5f7b8262ba1557dc2d3e79fceb18406.source: Ensure that all players take the quest before killing the first wolf, or else they can lose the 10,000 xp quest reward (however, they will still get credit for completing The Hunt as one of the eleven mission objectives).
a3386e82c5f7b8262ba1557dc2d3e79fceb18406.text: 确保所有玩家在杀死第一只狼之前接受任务，否则他们可能会失去 10,000 xp 任务奖励（但是，他们仍然会因完成十一个任务目标之一的狩猎而获得积分）。

b7f2936bd87e50068fb30694a7699e2f8d123241.source: Some players find it easier to start and complete the quest after the area is cleared of foes.
b7f2936bd87e50068fb30694a7699e2f8d123241.text: 有些玩家发现在清除该区域的敌人后开始和完成任务会更容易。

261432898ee6465a2519b1c3fcf2102bfd3b7af2.source: When six wolves have been killed, the quest log reads, "Destroy the Shard Wolves. 1 Shard Wolve remain".
261432898ee6465a2519b1c3fcf2102bfd3b7af2.text: 当六只狼被杀死后，任务日志上会写着：“消灭碎片狼。剩下 1 只碎片狼”。

772a108c37d9d9cbc66d4c8512d73941397d1ffa.source: Purify the hunter's horn in the healing spring in Regent Valley.
772a108c37d9d9cbc66d4c8512d73941397d1ffa.text: 在摄政谷的疗愈泉水中净化猎人的号角。

909b1bba0f5d022ebe7705be7b9dca0f2e9965b3.source: Go to the fishing village south of the tower in Wizard's Folly and deliver the purified horn to Aidan.
909b1bba0f5d022ebe7705be7b9dca0f2e9965b3.text: 前往巫师之愚中塔南边的渔村，将净化后的号角交给艾丹。

5085c1a991159c50bf071f2cc70c3255ac8cd6ca.source: After receiving the quest from Chantalle head southeast towards Regent Valley. Once you travel through the portal into Regent Valley start heading south towards the healing spring. This quest has a lot of running across long distances, so make sure your character will survive the journey. At the Healing Spring there are River Skale, Black Bears, Wolves, and all around are Grawl, so when doing the quest make sure you take your time and kill everybody on the way.
5085c1a991159c50bf071f2cc70c3255ac8cd6ca.text: 收到尚塔勒的任务后，向东南方向前往摄政谷。一旦您穿过摄政谷的入口，就开始向南前往治愈泉。这个任务需要大量的长途奔跑，所以要确保你的角色能够在旅途中幸存下来。在治愈之泉，有斯卡勒河、黑熊、狼，周围都是穴居人，所以在做任务时一定要花点时间，杀死路上的所有人。

832709069fcc79611bf6209fe8a99e3f8c245016.source: Once the area is safe, interact with the Healing Spring with the Hunter's Horn in your inventory. The item icon will brighten, signaling it has become purified.
832709069fcc79611bf6209fe8a99e3f8c245016.text: 一旦该区域安全，请使用库存中的猎人号角与治疗泉互动。物品图标会变亮，表明它已被净化。

bab898a8449a2dd4db7721852faa1791409efd7d.source: Follow your updated quest marker west to the entrance to Wizard's Folly. There, travel west along the river until you come to a fishing village, then go south and loop east, where you will find Aidan. Talk to him and get your reward.
bab898a8449a2dd4db7721852faa1791409efd7d.text: 沿着更新后的任务标记向西到达巫师愚蠢的入口。在那里，沿着河流向西行驶，直到到达一个渔村，然后向南向东绕行，在那里你会找到艾丹。与他交谈并获得奖励。

7615612dc2b479a6103ce7f211104cb650d31c2c.source: The spot you purify the horn is close to the area where you are asked to charm an animal during the quest The Ranger's Companion from Master Ranger Nente.
7615612dc2b479a6103ce7f211104cb650d31c2c.text: 净化号角的地点靠近游侠大师 Nente 的游侠同伴任务中要求你迷惑动物的区域。
