9e81f34ad40d4bb67a0e96d5b038d1b51208d72c.source: If your character is either a primary or secondary Ranger, you might consider going on to Ivor Trueshot and completing his quest before purifying the horn. You can then go to Aidan with the purified horn, and complete his Ranger quest as well while you are there.
9e81f34ad40d4bb67a0e96d5b038d1b51208d72c.text: 如果你的角色是主要或次要游侠，你可能会考虑在净化号角之前继续寻找艾弗·真射手并完成他的任务。然后你可以带着净化的号角去找艾丹，并在那里完成他的游侠任务。

0ff02f296392713026d9f58b14c21a0f137ee8ee.source: Enter through the nearby portal into Rragar's Menagerie located in Sacnoth Valley South-West corner. You do not need the quest Veiled Threat that is otherwise needed for the dungeon, as the foes are found in the first room. Pick up the blessing from the Beacon of Droknar and go straight ahead to the mob that you can clearly see with the two melee bosses in. It is a good idea to take out the Flameshielders first as they deal the most damage here. After you have killed the small mob, map travel to Longeye's Ledge and exit into Grothmar Wardowns and speak to Captain Langmar for your reward.
0ff02f296392713026d9f58b14c21a0f137ee8ee.text: 通过附近的传送门进入位于萨克诺斯谷西南角的拉加动物园。您不需要地牢中需要的任务“隐藏的威胁”，因为敌人是在第一个房间中找到的。接受卓克纳尔信标的祝福，然后径直走到怪物那里，你可以清楚地看到里面有两个近战 Boss。最好先干掉火焰护盾者，因为他们在这里造成的伤害最大。杀死小怪后，在地图上前往长眼壁架，然后进入格罗斯玛战区并与兰玛船长交谈以获得奖励。

92c672ca020cf2c3a2acad9fe780bb6d8bd40780.text: 在达拉达高地遇见安东。

ec0c0bec924ab883febc6039793555d9375919c1.source: Defeat the Charr warbands and discover the location of Rend Ragemauler.
ec0c0bec924ab883febc6039793555d9375919c1.text: 击败夏尔战帮并发现雷德·暴虐者的位置。

4d3f12d4a0e797eca7a103ac7475bc916f4efa90.source: Exit from Doomlore Shrine and head south to find Anton (The first marker on the quest map).
4d3f12d4a0e797eca7a103ac7475bc916f4efa90.text: 从末日神殿退出，向南寻找安东（任务地图上的第一个标记）。

679a09e7ffec8a25916da28afe3567f9121eb0cf.source: The quest updates points that will lead you into the big open field near Molotov Rocktail -- stay on the edge of the clearing if you want to avoid an encounter. Keep in mind that you can activate the resurrection shrines along the way.
679a09e7ffec8a25916da28afe3567f9121eb0cf.text: 该任务更新了一些点，这些点将引导你进入 Molotov Rocktail 附近的大片空地——如果你想避免遭遇，请留在空地的边缘。请记住，您可以沿途激活复活神殿。

defac5a4c6611216297565e980c342df2bdfe20d.source: In each Charr group there is a Prophet and a Charr Flameshielder. Thus, the easiest way to do this quest, with heroes and henchmen only, is to start from Doomlore Shrine and get control of the Siege Devourer stationed outside the outpost.
defac5a4c6611216297565e980c342df2bdfe20d.text: 每个夏尔群体中都有一名先知和一名夏尔火盾者。因此，完成这个任务最简单的方法是从末日神殿开始，控制驻扎在前哨站外的攻城吞噬者，只需要英雄和追随者。

1d6b18311495de7528d042e63c1bdef209f49c69.source: After finishing off the fourth group of Charr, map travel to Longeye's Ledge and head outside to speak with Captain Langmar for your reward!
1d6b18311495de7528d042e63c1bdef209f49c69.text: 消灭第四组夏尔后，在地图上前往长眼壁架，然后前往外面与朗玛船长交谈以获得奖励！

96fe68b6e3b23396ad0ec8c5c482457bc6f9660a.source: Killing the four Charr mobs will complete this quest. You do not need to meet Anton.
96fe68b6e3b23396ad0ec8c5c482457bc6f9660a.text: 杀死四个夏尔小怪即可完成此任务。你不需要见安东。

de195bcaeff8e5de0734cc764d7161d97d79855d.source: Meet Zenos and the rest of the crew in Gyala Hatchery.
de195bcaeff8e5de0734cc764d7161d97d79855d.text: 在嘉拉孵化场与芝诺斯和其他船员见面。

a74b30f6b0f62672eacb76e5f375223fce392453.source: See Po Fang for your reward.

9331064b7f99236f054ac893c6c8e2486dabf1b5.source: Start from the Leviathan Pits and head north into Gyala Hatchery where Zenos and the crew and waiting just outside. Unfortunately, Zenos can't fulfil any of the crew's requests or requirements before they'll join him, so it's just Zenos and the party going on the monster hunt!
9331064b7f99236f054ac893c6c8e2486dabf1b5.text: 从利维坦坑出发，向北进入加拉孵化场，芝诺斯和船员们就在外面等候。不幸的是，在船员们加入他之前，芝诺斯无法满足他们的任何要求或要求，所以只有芝诺斯和他的队伍正在进行怪物狩猎！

ea6e5a7eec676fd1b0825a027f115ad0cc79b8c6.source: From here, follow your quest pointer to the far north of Gyala Hatchery to find and slay the Impossible Sea Monster.
ea6e5a7eec676fd1b0825a027f115ad0cc79b8c6.text: 从这里开始，按照任务指针前往加拉孵化场的最北端，找到并杀死不可能的海怪。

b6335b2933a6ebf91d88d1e3ba099dfcf3a261a5.source: After slaying the monster, map to Kaineng Center and see Po Fang for your reward.
b6335b2933a6ebf91d88d1e3ba099dfcf3a261a5.text: 杀死怪物后，前往凯能中心，见破方领取奖励。

15e5323db2ccb1ad1e4abed8f6d80be26085b438.source: It does not matter if Zenos dies before you get to the Impossible Sea Monster, since once you kill it the quest will finish anyway and you will be able to get your reward from Po Fang.
15e5323db2ccb1ad1e4abed8f6d80be26085b438.text: 如果芝诺斯在你到达不可能的海怪之前死了也没关系，因为一旦你杀死了它，任务就会完成，你将能够从破方那里得到奖励。

2e1498d9346bf1b56fc12f8fdd8952bbbc27af09.source: There is no accept/decline dialogue, since this quest is automatically added to your quest log when you receive the preceding quest reward.
2e1498d9346bf1b56fc12f8fdd8952bbbc27af09.text: 没有接受/拒绝对话，因为当您收到前面的任务奖励时，该任务会自动添加到您的任务日志中。

2c4d545e8bf37ad0f997c02093509434f511dc97.source: This also applies if you abandon this quest after receiving it; it is immediately re-added to your quest log without any dialogue if you talk to Delphinus.
2c4d545e8bf37ad0f997c02093509434f511dc97.text: 如果您在收到任务后放弃该任务，这也适用；如果您与海豚交谈，它会立即重新添加到您的任务日志中，无需任何对话。

6eacd94c16813564615475c7c8585b35b28f4ec8.source: If Zenos dies before the initial dialogue finishes, the quest freezes and you have to rezone to continue.
6eacd94c16813564615475c7c8585b35b28f4ec8.text: 如果芝诺斯在初始对话结束之前死亡，任务就会冻结，你必须重新分配区域才能继续。

44b7018c858829426ff3c53fad6b330701cf2979.source: There is an intermediate dialogue that most players miss, after you have killed the monster with Zenos still alive. The problem is that, as a low level NPC, Zenos almost always dies before you get even close to the monster. One way around this, literally, is to enter Gyala Hatchery from Rhea's Crater and then kill all the enemies between Zenos and the The Impossible Sea Monster, being careful to not kill the monster itself or getting too close to Zenos so he won't follow you. Once everyone is dead, go get Zenos and bring him to the monster - after killing it, you'll see the last intermediate dialogue.
44b7018c858829426ff3c53fad6b330701cf2979.text: 在芝诺斯还活着的情况下杀死怪物后，大多数玩家都会错过中间对话。问题是，作为一个低等级的 NPC，芝诺斯几乎总是在你接近怪物之前就死了。从字面上看，解决这个问题的一种方法是从瑞亚陨石坑进入加拉孵化场，然后杀死芝诺斯和不可能海怪之间的所有敌人，小心不要杀死怪物本身或离芝诺斯太近，这样他就不会跟着你。一旦所有人都死了，去找芝诺斯并把他带到怪物那里 - 杀死怪物后，你会看到最后的中间对话。

fa94a0923b30dc9ea68fc101d2c50722f9d70cfc.source: You may also keep Zenos alive by using Heroes/Henchmen and just have them flagged to fight enemies while you stay back with Zenos.
fa94a0923b30dc9ea68fc101d2c50722f9d70cfc.text: 你也可以通过使用英雄/追随者来保持芝诺斯的生命，并在你留在芝诺斯身边时标记他们与敌人作战。

bf4ab7248bb3bba873dee311eb9f1c8b3d9709e1.source: Kill the Iron Forgeman in the Forge Heart.
bf4ab7248bb3bba873dee311eb9f1c8b3d9709e1.text: 杀死锻造之心的钢铁锻造师。

37cf7c3d9b66803332f6a6838e25f33f3edcf884.source: *BONUS* Kill The Unlike the previous objective, 'The' is capitalized here Iron Forgeman in Hard Mode.
37cf7c3d9b66803332f6a6838e25f33f3edcf884.text: *奖励* Kill The 与之前的目标不同，“The”在这里大写为困难模式下的 Iron Forgeman。

96d23cf49dd3874d7d75c59329bc5728ae6942e6.source: Enter the arena and defeat all of the other combatants.
96d23cf49dd3874d7d75c59329bc5728ae6942e6.text: 进入竞技场并击败所有其他战斗人员。

7f5855a02d90eb3353c46fbf711ae35bf63ecc5c.source: See Arena Master Portus for your reward.
7f5855a02d90eb3353c46fbf711ae35bf63ecc5c.text: 前往竞技场大师波图斯领取奖励。

227a6971e3c986d3e8e37015825b6a70d8affc7a.source: Starting from Breaker Hollow, walk south along the west wall onto a small hill and locate Arena Master Portus (point P on the map). There is usually a wandering group near the small hill consisting of one to two Creeping Carps, an Irukandji, and Scuttle Fish as well as a group of three to four Oni that will spawn at the top of the small hill just before meeting with Portus.
227a6971e3c986d3e8e37015825b6a70d8affc7a.text: 从 Breaker Hollow 出发，沿着西墙向南走到一座小山上，找到 Arena Master Portus（地图上的 P 点）。小山附近通常有一群游荡的小山，其中包括一到两条爬行鲤鱼、一条伊鲁坎吉鱼和墨鱼，以及三到四只鬼，它们会在与波图斯会面之前在小山顶上产卵。

7b68841aef9d2f98d0d5acd9770c3fa1ce72b600.source: 2 Warriors, 2 Monks, 1 Necromancer, 2 Assassins, 1 Ritualist, no monsters.
7b68841aef9d2f98d0d5acd9770c3fa1ce72b600.text: 2个战士，2个武僧，1个死灵法师，2个刺客，1个仪式师，没有怪物。

710d4b07235da32ad5061fc13b0e43d2329bf784.text: 3个游侠，2个武僧，3个元素使，没有怪物。

4bb8f60ab0bd09fc4d029023a86dab977d470e68.source: 1 Irukandji, 1 Warrior, 1 Ranger, 2 Monks, 1 Necromancer, 1 Mesmer, 1 Elementalist.
4bb8f60ab0bd09fc4d029023a86dab977d470e68.text: 1伊鲁坎吉、1战士、1游侠、2武僧、1死灵法师、1幻术师、1元素师。

3084a3db377b7255bf8d4c7d352352015203893d.text: 1 伊鲁坎吉、3 游侠、2 武僧、2 元素使。

d075bc2f77165b26f60b3a5bb926d27356153a23.source: 1 Jade Torn Kirin, 2 Rangers, 2 Monks, 2 Mesmers, 1 Elementalist.
d075bc2f77165b26f60b3a5bb926d27356153a23.text: 1 玉撕裂麒麟，2 游侠，2 武僧，2 幻术师，1 元素师。

24056798e44b139ae980a592672034595af2cc12.source: The professions of the criminals can be identified by their appearance.
24056798e44b139ae980a592672034595af2cc12.text: 犯罪分子的职业可以通过外貌来判断。

e470976667019805e6cb5c952c289a99ba09dce6.source: The combatants turn hostile when they enter your aggro circle or when Portus reaches them.
e470976667019805e6cb5c952c289a99ba09dce6.text: 当战斗人员进入你的仇恨圈或波图斯到达他们时，他们就会变得敌对。

24932b9fb3caf0cbac3bd5938a798acf7f9c0b8f.source: The Criminals carry resurrection signets. Bringing a skill such as Frozen Soil will help.
24932b9fb3caf0cbac3bd5938a798acf7f9c0b8f.text: 罪犯们携带着复活印章。带上诸如冻土之类的技能会有帮助。

8a34b080b4620cbad76d060ecc95fe36b8125005.source: This quest can be used to farm Luxon faction, cash, and experience for Survivor.
8a34b080b4620cbad76d060ecc95fe36b8125005.text: 此任务可用于为幸存者获取卢克森派系、现金和经验。

16e9346b6c866b1b0d45872260970148b24e7b8a.source: It works better if the alliance's battles map favor Kurzicks.
16e9346b6c866b1b0d45872260970148b24e7b8a.text: 如果联盟的战斗地图有利于库尔兹克，效果会更好。

48b4e00304cd4c86a3dd7d18e942e3d40d7ec6d3.source: This run can be completed in 3-4 minutes with a meta hero team.
48b4e00304cd4c86a3dd7d18e942e3d40d7ec6d3.text: 使用元英雄团队可以在 3-4 分钟内完成此任务。

b43639bbf62f54355f71595182a0e160beb6a421.source: An efficient team can complete the quest in under three minutes (including travel time). With the Blessing of the Luxons active, you can earn 140-160 points, in addition to the 400 point reward for completing the quest. This translates to roughly 11,000 points per hour.
b43639bbf62f54355f71595182a0e160beb6a421.text: 一个高效的团队可以在三分钟内完成任务（包括行程时间）。激活卢克森祝福后，除了完成任务的 400 点奖励之外，您还可以获得 140-160 点。这相当于每小时大约 11,000 点。

0d053ed3274c81a4ac1303ea1b82898f17a1f60d.source: The quest can be completed in 2 minutes if all party members cast Recall on a single runner starting from Jade Flats. Since the enemies along the route to the arena do not possess snares, this allows the runner to shave a minute of time.
0d053ed3274c81a4ac1303ea1b82898f17a1f60d.text: 如果所有小队成员对从翡翠公寓开始的单个跑步者施放召回，则该任务可以在 2 分钟内完成。由于通往竞技场沿途的敌人没有陷阱，这可以让奔跑者节省一分钟的时间。

b88055609cc60805b670647283df5fba1a06d80b.source: Sometimes the enemy party will not turn hostile at all or it may take a substantial amount of time.
b88055609cc60805b670647283df5fba1a06d80b.text: 有时敌方根本不会转为敌对，或者可能需要相当长的时间。

04ba5a988a0ccf703d5cd7de112083960381e58c.source: If you are killed and returned to the resurrection shrine, the enemies sometimes will not attack, using only healing skills. The monks will still attempt to heal their teammates.
04ba5a988a0ccf703d5cd7de112083960381e58c.text: 如果你被杀并返回复活神殿，敌人有时不会攻击，只使用治疗技能。僧侣们仍然会尝试治愈他们的队友。

5254a12a11c70bc8017d51aa315354aecebd731b.source: Travel to the Jade Quarry and speak to Kommandant Durheim.
5254a12a11c70bc8017d51aa315354aecebd731b.text: 前往玉矿场并与指挥官杜尔海姆交谈。

3f137f9a173b6076a542d289ebf5cf41981a1c76.source: Starting from House zu Heltzer, head southeast through Ferndale to reach Lutgardis Conservatory. Then proceed northeast through Melandru's Hope, and eventually you will reach your destination. Talk to Kommandant Durheim for your reward.
3f137f9a173b6076a542d289ebf5cf41981a1c76.text: 从 House zu Heltzer 出发，向东南方向穿过芬代尔 (Ferndale)，到达卢特加迪斯温室 (Lutgardis Conservatory)。然后向东北方向穿过梅兰朵之望，最终到达目的地。与杜尔海姆指挥官交谈以获得奖励。

ced3e4d905a80d49c30cd58eb22483dbe467c7e0.source: Travel to the Jade Quarry and speak to Erek.
ced3e4d905a80d49c30cd58eb22483dbe467c7e0.text: 前往玉矿场并与埃里克交谈。

e2972ab73444b3e8912a8930b8ee45d142ca93d5.source: Leaving from Cavalon, travel south by southwest through Archipelagos until you reach the Jade Flats (Luxon), then head into the next outpost.
e2972ab73444b3e8912a8930b8ee45d142ca93d5.text: 从卡瓦隆出发，向南偏西南方向穿过群岛，直到到达翡翠平原（卢克森），然后前往下一个前哨基地。

16b70d6c216ef0206f8d178456d5325a77b9636c.source: Speak to Justiciar Naveed when you are ready to face the White Mantle.
16b70d6c216ef0206f8d178456d5325a77b9636c.text: 当你准备好面对白斗篷时，与审判官纳维德交谈。

5cbf1cf867fa715129ec898e8ee1658a45af1460.text: 请前往格莱文领取奖励。

6519a9e5305d5f233559eb62ed96bf7250235cdc.source: You will be in an explorable version of Tarnished Haven with Justiciar Naveed.
6519a9e5305d5f233559eb62ed96bf7250235cdc.text: 您将与Justiciar Naveed 一起进入可探索的Turnished Haven 版本。

9b44b0e908994ea146e1ee1d6db054e9ae1ba416.source: Fairly large groups of White Mantle will come from the southern portal. A second group will come as soon as you finish off the first group, and so on. There are 7 waves. Don't be discouraged, as these Mantle will be fairly easy to kill. Focus your fire on the White Mantle Priests and stay clear of the Searing Heat cast by White Mantle Savants. When all the groups are dead, Lazarus the Dire will come forth. You do not need to fight him, just watch the confrontation between him and the justiciar.
9b44b0e908994ea146e1ee1d6db054e9ae1ba416.text: 相当大的白斗篷群体将从南部传送门涌来。当你完成第一组后，第二组就会来，以此类推。有7波。不要灰心，因为这些地幔很容易被杀死。将你的火力集中在白斗篷牧师身上，并远离白斗篷学者施放的灼热热力。当所有群体都死后，可怕的拉撒路就会出现。你不需要和他战斗，只要看他和审判官的对抗就可以了。

9d88f265a2812f14b2ee7a8c1326e24058559b60.source: It is possible to go through the portal to Alcazia Tangle and explore the whole area without interference from the regular foes.
9d88f265a2812f14b2ee7a8c1326e24058559b60.text: 可以穿过阿尔卡齐亚坦格的传送门并探索整个区域，而不会受到常规敌人的干扰。

ae4097089d9ef578bd81240cc8040731026e45fd.source: Find and kill the Kaguchi brothers.

e4c9da4ba7fb86850d030994279e41b5ed6c8885.source: See Headmaster Zhan for your reward.
e4c9da4ba7fb86850d030994279e41b5ed6c8885.text: 去见詹校长领取奖励吧。

86f8e26eaf43c2e232fa26adbaf38a28d5b516a3.source: Journeying from Tsumei Village, head to the western side of Panjiang Peninsula. The Kaguchi brothers can be found just north of Pei the Skull Blade's ship.
86f8e26eaf43c2e232fa26adbaf38a28d5b516a3.text: 从津梅村出发，前往盘江半岛西侧。卡口兄弟位于骷髅刀裴的船北边。

7ad7baa28866d6a025175a74a162127b073c3c03.source: Gather a party in Ascalon City. Sir Tydus recommends bringing Alesia to heal you.
7ad7baa28866d6a025175a74a162127b073c3c03.text: 在阿斯卡隆市举办派对。泰达斯爵士建议带阿莱西亚来治疗你。

6c732afe66ff14d2f55a6c94c482da0b051805e1.source: Go to Old Ascalon. Deliver the royal message to Ambassador Zain.
6c732afe66ff14d2f55a6c94c482da0b051805e1.text: 前往老阿斯卡隆。向扎因大使传达皇室信息。

ca63c0c148e45fecd8e17b7cf644ab63c8754740.source: War Hammer (has the skin of a Foehammer)

d8157fecafd9ad7430bac2f597d0aeaab279045a.text: 钝器伤害：13-20（需要 3 锤子掌握）

a149902a57ab8b4c21cbbc36d370f58810281004.source: Invite at least one player or henchman to your party before stepping through the portal into Old Ascalon. Head straight east toward a small Krytan camp ahead. Beware of the two Devourers that pop up from the ground next to the bridge if you get too close to them. If you're a warrior, you can easily pick up quests from Warmaster Grast who is on the route of this quest (just past the bridge).
a149902a57ab8b4c21cbbc36d370f58810281004.text: 在穿过传送门进入旧阿斯卡隆之前，至少邀请一名玩家或追随者加入你的队伍。径直向东前往前方的一个小型科瑞塔营地。如果你离桥太近，请小心从桥旁边的地面上突然出现的两只吞噬者。如果你是一名战士，你可以轻松地从战帅格拉斯特那里接取任务，他就在这个任务的路线上（刚刚过了桥）。

4b296c80942fc4bc80cecba94b611394c9786794.source: Forming any group anywhere in the game completes the first objective, despite what the the quest suggests.
4b296c80942fc4bc80cecba94b611394c9786794.text: 无论任务有何建议，在游戏中的任何位置组建任何团队即可完成第一个目标。

66fd155ae425bfc234b8f5a9655b377ef39bac23.source: This objective becomes active again if you leave your group at any point in the future. You must face Ambassador Zain in a group if you wish to proceed with the quest.
66fd155ae425bfc234b8f5a9655b377ef39bac23.text: 如果您在未来的任何时候离开您的团队，此目标将再次激活。如果你想继续任务，你必须在团队中面对扎因大使。

552d9c53e2d66c86afc567008c8483558eef5c82.source: Prince Rurik will not appear for his dialogue with Ambassador Zain if any member of the party is a non-Prophecies character or has already completed the quest.
552d9c53e2d66c86afc567008c8483558eef5c82.text: 如果队伍中的任何成员是非预言角色或已经完成任务，鲁里克王子将不会出现在与扎因大使的对话中。

a07309ab934bb10f575f23e69cd1b8c852ae4361.source: Travel to Frontier Gate and speak with Warmaster Riga.
a07309ab934bb10f575f23e69cd1b8c852ae4361.text: 前往边境之门并与战帅里加交谈。

fd354abf4cf29e853a140f78c1fe9235906c29dc.source: Travel to the Eastern Frontier to aid King Adelbern against the Titans.
fd354abf4cf29e853a140f78c1fe9235906c29dc.text: 前往东部边境，帮助阿德尔伯恩国王对抗泰坦。

573f4a954c1be0400a5e7130d6c126823f447599.source: Because of the high level charr and low level henchmen, it is best to either go with other players or with heroes. Also, due to the small party size, the party must be well balanced.
573f4a954c1be0400a5e7130d6c126823f447599.text: 由于夏尔等级高，追随者等级低，所以最好要么与其他玩家一起走，要么与英雄一起走。此外，由于政党规模较小，政党必须保持良好的平衡。

465984fbc86c77c03c50bd24982bbebbb30c6849.source: The quest itself is straightforward. Walk out the gate and a short distance (through a few Charr groups) to find King Adelbern, one Adelbern's Priest and two Adelbern's Guards rushing towards a group of Charr. They are low level Charr and no threat, but after the elimination of that group the Armageddon Lords will start to arrive, one at a time. Each one will be accompanied with some regular Charr and some Charr lords. The groups increase in difficulty; at first there will be only one Charr lord, then two, then two including a healer and then three Charr lords. The final group will have two Armageddon Lords together.
465984fbc86c77c03c50bd24982bbebbb30c6849.text: 任务本身很简单。走出大门，走了一小段距离（穿过几个夏尔队伍），发现阿德伯恩国王、一名阿德伯恩牧师和两名阿德伯恩守卫正在冲向一群夏尔。他们是低等级夏尔，没有威胁，但在消灭那群人后，末日领主将开始到来，一次一个。每一位都会有一些普通夏尔和一些夏尔领主陪同。各组难度增加；一开始只有一名夏尔领主，然后是两名，然后是两名，包括一名治疗师，然后是三名夏尔领主。最后一组将有两个世界末日领主在一起。

4790a868300fd32dfb5b2ab3767378f551039722.source: In general, you need to watch the composition of the incoming enemies. If there are any Spark of the Titans, take them down as fast as you can; they have the potential to deal a large amount of damage to the party. Next on the list are the Charr Lord casters — Charr Shaman Lord, Charr Flame Lord, Charr Mind Lord, and Charr Ashen Lord. Turn your attention to any Charr Axe Lords and Charr Stalker Lords before tackling the Armageddon Lord. You can pretty much ignore the regular level 8 or 9 Charr, as they usually die to any AoE damage when you're attacking the Charr Lords.
4790a868300fd32dfb5b2ab3767378f551039722.text: 一般来说，你需要观察来袭敌人的构成。如果有任何泰坦火花，请尽快将其击落；他们有可能对政党造成大量损害。接下来是夏尔领主施法者——夏尔萨满领主、夏尔火焰领主、夏尔心灵领主和夏尔灰烬领主。在对付哈米吉多顿领主之前，请将注意力转向夏尔斧王和夏尔追猎者领主。你几乎可以忽略常规的 8 级或 9 级夏尔，因为当你攻击夏尔领主时，他们通常会因任何 AoE 伤害而死亡。

220459f2517963b09b5ed47fa8e7ec0314d05f57.source: Another strategy is to kill the Sparks, the Armageddon and their spawns, avoiding killing one or two Charr casters, who do considerably less damage. Since the next enemy wave won't approach until all the charr in the previous group are dead, by keeping them alive you can buy some time to heal and regenerate energy with little pressure before facing a new wave.
220459f2517963b09b5ed47fa8e7ec0314d05f57.text: 另一种策略是杀死火花、哈米吉多顿及其后代，避免杀死一两个夏尔施法者，因为他们造成的伤害要小得多。由于只有前一组中的所有夏尔都死了，下一波敌人才会接近，通过让他们活着，你可以在面对新一波之前以较小的压力赢得一些时间来治疗和再生能量。

5d3b44000ec62d85c56ef9377dea4376c02b1f02.source: Always attempt to intercept the incoming groups well ahead of King Adelbern and always protect Adelbern's Priest. Losing the priest ally will most assuredly put too much pressure on the single monk in the party.
5d3b44000ec62d85c56ef9377dea4376c02b1f02.text: 始终尝试在阿德尔伯恩国王之前拦截即将到来的部队，并始终保护阿德尔伯恩的牧师。失去牧师盟友肯定会给队伍中的单个僧侣带来太大的压力。

260e24b02351c152b7770642062c0ea8be6cbfa4.source: If possible, bring cold damage. Cold damage deals heavy damage against the Titans.
260e24b02351c152b7770642062c0ea8be6cbfa4.text: 如果可能的话，带来寒冷伤害。寒冷伤害会对泰坦造成严重伤害。

025eb1ca1a597fdce29915c536fca9ca6230d8d9.source: Bringing Winter is a better alternative as Adelbern and his guards use Fiery Dragon Swords.
025eb1ca1a597fdce29915c536fca9ca6230d8d9.text: 带来冬天是一个更好的选择，因为阿德尔伯恩和他的守卫使用火龙剑。

ca95d0760d38aefa31b655e095d0d18c4f0ade5a.source: Likewise, Area of Effect skills like traps are helpful as the groups are often close together and come from the same direction.
ca95d0760d38aefa31b655e095d0d18c4f0ade5a.text: 同样，陷阱等效果区域技能也很有帮助，因为队伍通常距离很近并且来自同一方向。

171151f7ed3105c9eb62e66f19d20305d80922b5.source: Elementalist equiped with Water spells are also extremely useful. Ice Spikes and Maelstrom can do cold damage and slow down the enemy advance while Mist Form and Swirling Aura can give your party additional healing, taking some pressure off of the primary healer
171151f7ed3105c9eb62e66f19d20305d80922b5.text: 配备水系法术的元素师也非常有用。冰刺和漩涡可以造成寒冷伤害并减缓敌人的前进速度，而迷雾形态和漩涡光环可以为你的队伍提供额外的治疗，减轻主治疗师的一些压力

ae53d952efbb5c6ad988f29fcccf414a733ea3bd.source: Both Ward Against Harm and Mantra of Flame are helpful in reducing damage.
ae53d952efbb5c6ad988f29fcccf414a733ea3bd.text: 伤害防御和火焰咒都有助于减少伤害。

c6df1d7df6285d9f120d0d635b37fb29b954e05a.source: Try to keep the NPCs alive as long as possible, as they greatly help.
c6df1d7df6285d9f120d0d635b37fb29b954e05a.text: 尽量让 NPC 活得尽可能久，因为他们有很大帮助。

72fee737dd08722e90f955b445788a01f7d847cc.source: Morale Boosts and Holy Blessing can be acquired from the statue of Lyssa west of Adelbern's group.
72fee737dd08722e90f955b445788a01f7d847cc.text: 士气提升和神圣祝福可以从阿德尔伯恩队伍西边的莱莎雕像中获得。

62e5ccf4f04b1e391fdcb85c25d56ef759c4ff16.source: If you fail this quest, your entire party, no matter its size, will be sent to Frontier Gate intact as long as you did not bring henchmen that are not available in said outpost.
62e5ccf4f04b1e391fdcb85c25d56ef759c4ff16.text: 如果你失败了这个任务，你的整个队伍，无论规模大小，只要你没有带上该前哨站中没有的追随者，就会被完好无损地送到边境之门。

804bce52acd80349a76f379f5729f766e5a61ccd.source: Rebel Yell helps with the Charr encountered during this quest.
804bce52acd80349a76f379f5729f766e5a61ccd.text: 叛军呐喊帮助解决在此任务中遇到的夏尔。

a6305209fd16ea77f1c52b39f6085956787e1a59.source: It is possible to kill three of the Armageddon Lord groups without spawning King Adelbern's group by approaching the Titans from the south on the eastern side.
a6305209fd16ea77f1c52b39f6085956787e1a59.text: 从东侧的南部接近泰坦，可以杀死三个末日领主群体，而不产生阿德尔伯恩国王的群体。

9b8ab12e445efafd675fed6158e6845d1d7fca5c.source: By flagging heroes, it is possible to kill all five Armageddon Lord groups without spawning King Adelbern's group. See the talk page for a map.
9b8ab12e445efafd675fed6158e6845d1d7fca5c.text: 通过标记英雄，可以杀死所有五个末日领主队伍，而不会产生阿德尔伯恩国王的队伍。请参阅讨论页面以获取地图。

a14cddc06b11fb687dd8e09a51e3620ad5afd5de.source: Because the Armageddon Lords are melee casters, it is advisable to bring a tank with good fire or elemental protection.
a14cddc06b11fb687dd8e09a51e3620ad5afd5de.text: 由于末日领主是近战施法者，因此建议携带具有良好火力或元素防护的坦克。

2c02d07eeb6ef3d23aac24c5dede9081867b6ba7.source: If you do not have any heroes and cannot find players to help you, it is possible to leave in hard mode so that you have level 20 henchmen and, except for the low level Charr, the enemies are not boosted very much.
2c02d07eeb6ef3d23aac24c5dede9081867b6ba7.text: 如果你没有任何英雄并且找不到玩家来帮助你，你可以在困难模式下离开，这样你就有20级的追随者，除了低等级的夏尔之外，敌人的提升并不多。

f73e600df30c9ed91fdc8d91850cb3f94f958348.source: Running from Yak's Bend for a party of 6, or from Temple of the Ages for a party of 8 is possible.
f73e600df30c9ed91fdc8d91850cb3f94f958348.text: 6 人小队可以从牦牛弯跑，8 人小队可以从千古寺跑。

1fa2c8e6ebeccb60e9f7c20751c1b576cba2d032.source: Each group after the first starts to approach once all the original members of the previous group are killed, regardless of whether or not Risen Ashen Hulks, Fists of the Titans or Hands of the Titans are still alive.
1fa2c8e6ebeccb60e9f7c20751c1b576cba2d032.text: 一旦前一组的所有原始成员被杀死，第一组之后的每一组都会开始接近，无论灰烬绿巨人、泰坦之拳或泰坦之手是否还活着。

c8de839cc5e07dbf079909c2d0d243f46c3c82a8.source: If you kill all the titan groups (which will be updated if you kill the last Armageddon Lord) and King Adelbern dies, you will be sent back to Frontier Gate, but you'll only have to reach Adelbern again and speak with him, then you will be able to take the reward at Glint's Vision.
c8de839cc5e07dbf079909c2d0d243f46c3c82a8.text: 如果你杀死了所有的泰坦团体（如果你杀死了最后一个末日领主，则会更新）并且阿德尔伯恩国王死亡，你将被送回边境之门，但你只需要再次到达阿德尔伯恩并与他交谈，然后你就可以在格林特幻象处获得奖励。

adf11d2e9c5d725c2f644fb8e80972cc9586e788.source: Even if one person hasn't talked to Warmaster Riga yet, as long as someone in your party did so, everyone who has the quest in their log can complete it.
adf11d2e9c5d725c2f644fb8e80972cc9586e788.text: 即使有人还没有与战帅里加交谈过，只要你的队伍中有人这样做了，日志里有该任务的每个人都可以完成它。

f53afd4f264c4c81a33e715f00ea1548f610a967.source: If you approach the king from the north or west, he will run to the blue dot as soon as he spawns.
f53afd4f264c4c81a33e715f00ea1548f610a967.text: 如果你从北边或西边接近国王，他一出生就会跑向蓝点。

9e8e03d0b1c078e98c7d2edabcf5ae38bcf2ac58.source: With this quest, a Charr lord or two might spawn inside one of the cliffs. Such a spawn obstructs weapons, but can still be killed with ranged skills.
9e8e03d0b1c078e98c7d2edabcf5ae38bcf2ac58.text: 通过此任务，一两个夏尔领主可能会在其中一个悬崖内生成。这样的生成物会阻碍武器，但仍然可以用远程技能杀死。

6bce994f8c91dbe2b56685fefcf037a761bac854.source: Warning: In contrast to most other quests that require you to protect an NPC, Adelbern's death will lead to you immediately travelling back to your last visited outpost. Especially groups arriving from Yak's Bend or Temple of the Ages should be very careful with regards to Adelbern's survival.
6bce994f8c91dbe2b56685fefcf037a761bac854.text: 警告：与大多数其他需要你保护 NPC 的任务不同，阿德尔伯恩的死亡会导致你立即返回上次访问过的前哨站。特别是从牦牛弯或世纪神殿抵达的团体应该非常小心阿德尔伯恩的生存。

c3f78b1f97de06b684578871fcd5cd78d2cc2bf6.source: Ideally, come from the south, keeping east of Adelbern's trigger circle. Kill the eastern-most group first. Work your way counter-clockwise for groups 2 and 3. For the last of the northern groups, use only one hero to pull them closer to you by carefully flagging the hero, while keeping the rest of your party back with you. As soon as the hero gets attacked, pull them back to you. If the hero should die, use another hero to ressurect them. Finally, backtrack towards the 5th and last group to the crossroad. Careful pulling should also be used for enemies between you and the last group.
c3f78b1f97de06b684578871fcd5cd78d2cc2bf6.text: 理想情况下，从南边过来，保持在阿德尔伯恩触发圈的东边。先杀掉最东边的那群。第 2 组和第 3 组按逆时针方向进行。对于最后一组北方组，仅使用一名英雄，通过小心地标记该英雄来将他们拉近您的距离，同时让您的队伍的其他成员留在您身边。一旦英雄受到攻击，就将他们拉回到你身边。如果英雄死了，请使用另一个英雄来复活他们。最后，原路返回第五组，也是最后一组，到达十字路口。对于你和最后一组之间的敌人也应该小心拉动。

fd41c4fb4d795d7a4065547fa2e43bbbfe39cd1a.source: If possible, bring cold damage as it deals better damage against the Titans.
fd41c4fb4d795d7a4065547fa2e43bbbfe39cd1a.text: 如果可能的话，带来寒冷伤害，因为它对泰坦造成更好的伤害。

b942387b209c38a376a7e3c22df9834bf2afac84.source: Bringing Winter is highly recommended as Adelbern and his guards use Fiery Dragon Swords.
b942387b209c38a376a7e3c22df9834bf2afac84.text: 强烈推荐“带来冬天”，因为阿德尔伯恩和他的守卫使用火龙剑。

180b9e8aa607bdedaa2686aea75333638d67c2dc.source: It is possible to kill three of the five Armageddon Lord groups before King Adelbern spawns by coming from the south and attacking the easternmost groups first. Using heroes for pulling, all five groups can be killed.
180b9e8aa607bdedaa2686aea75333638d67c2dc.text: 在阿德尔伯恩国王出现之前，可以通过从南方首先攻击最东边的群体来杀死五个世界末日领主群体中的三个。用英雄拉扯，五组都可以杀。

ea312820d58999ed80cd0265823f84b1cd9ff819.source: A Soul Twisting Ritualist with protective spirits or a Protection Prayers Monk are necessary because of the Armageddon Lords' high damage output.
ea312820d58999ed80cd0265823f84b1cd9ff819.text: 由于末日领主的高伤害输出，需要具有保护精神的灵魂扭曲仪式师或保护祈祷僧。

7958a3d5095cbbe3a6a24b5b9fc3d166a0c792f6.source: Buffs that mitigate elemental or fire damage, such as Ward Against Harm and Mantra of Flame, are recommended.
7958a3d5095cbbe3a6a24b5b9fc3d166a0c792f6.text: 建议使用减轻元素或火焰伤害的增益，例如防御伤害和火焰咒语。

ea5d990c37fcb5b36090323a29fe14f19faf8866.source: Avoid melee distance with Armageddon Lords if possible. If not, be sure to bring good defense against elemental or fire damage.
ea5d990c37fcb5b36090323a29fe14f19faf8866.text: 如果可能的话，避免与末日领主近战。如果没有，请务必做好对元素或火焰伤害的防御。

597551c9adcfeba8d831be76aef37f7ff809aff3.source: Avoid using builds that rely on long recharging enchantments.
597551c9adcfeba8d831be76aef37f7ff809aff3.text: 避免使用依赖长时间充电附魔的构建。

d3c587908d09facfc29e6a8838ed9427211043cd.source: Adelbern is great at soaking up damage, so using him to tank can be helpful.
d3c587908d09facfc29e6a8838ed9427211043cd.text: 阿德尔伯恩非常擅长吸收伤害，所以用他来坦克会很有帮助。

3cc70aed2ae946d4d8984daf901e3bfb006c134f.source: Rebel Yell helps with fighting the Charr in this quest.
3cc70aed2ae946d4d8984daf901e3bfb006c134f.text: 叛军大喊在这个任务中帮助对抗夏尔。

0467313f094d358c98f9802321af594065df8c20.source: Each group after the first starts to approach once all the original members of the previous group are killed, regardless of whether or not Risen Ashen Hulks, Fists of the Titans or Arms of the Titans are still alive.
0467313f094d358c98f9802321af594065df8c20.text: 一旦前一组的所有原始成员被杀死，第一组之后的每一组都会开始接近，无论灰烬绿巨人、泰坦之拳或泰坦之臂是否还活着。

41202f93a887a071b52e75ab3142b9320b600d24.source: See Veth the Storyteller for your reward.
41202f93a887a071b52e75ab3142b9320b600d24.text: 去找讲故事的维斯领取奖励。

00d86af8ca60f2067e94c256e0f9ac4740f01b20.source: Find Farmer Dirk's last remaining Prize-Winning Hog and chase it back to him.
00d86af8ca60f2067e94c256e0f9ac4740f01b20.text: 找到农夫德克最后剩下的获奖猪并将其追回给他。

23740a033d933d23fac6925c271016373154f3a8.source: Return to Farmer Dirk for your reward.
23740a033d933d23fac6925c271016373154f3a8.text: 返回农夫德克那里领取奖励。

c25c2557f58efbdaf53ed6c418560bc8a220f195.source: From Farmer Dirk, you have to travel South. The prize winning hog is a bit South of the entrance to Nebo Terrace. At the junction to the Nebo Terrace entrance, four groups of two level 15 Gypsie Ettins will appear. Once these are killed, you need to chase the hog back to Farmer Dirk, approaching it from the south so that it runs north. If it gets stuck along the sides of the path, back off a bit and wait for it to move out enough that you can redirect it. You don't have to get the hog into the pen, just as far as Farmer Dirk. When the path splits into two with the big tree in the middle, try to avoid letting the hog near the tree where it can get stuck when it moves through the tree. If this happens you have to rezone and start over again.
c25c2557f58efbdaf53ed6c418560bc8a220f195.text: 从农夫德克出发，您必须向南行驶。获奖猪位于尼波露台入口南边。在 Nebo Terrace 入口的交界处，将会出现四组，每组两名 15 级吉普赛埃丁人。一旦它们被杀死，你需要把猪追回农夫德克，从南边接近它，让它向北跑。如果它卡在路径两侧，请后退一点，等待它移出足够的距离，以便您可以重新引导它。你不必把猪放进猪栏里，只要到农夫德克那里就可以了。当路径分成两部分并且中间有大树时，尽量避免让猪靠近树，因为它在穿过树时可能会被卡住。如果发生这种情况，您必须重新分区并重新开始。

a6b5395603e7d11babeb57e2eec1f18a7710ce9e.source: If you cannot beat the 8 Ettins (coming in pairs), you can still finish the quest. When you "meet" the hog (at the blue dot), push it as fast as possible towards the south so the incoming Ettins stop before detecting you. Then push him around the east-side hill following the red dots. At the yellow dot, you'll meet a random enemy group, which you can either kill or run through. Walk through the village once more, reach the farmer, and you're done.
a6b5395603e7d11babeb57e2eec1f18a7710ce9e.text: 如果你无法击败 8 个埃廷斯（成对出现），你仍然可以完成任务。当你“遇到”野猪时（在蓝点处），尽可能快地将它推向南方，这样即将到来的埃廷斯就会在发现你之前停下来。然后沿着红点把他推到东边的山上。在黄点处，你会遇到一个随机的敌人群体，你可以杀死他们，也可以跑过去。再次穿过村庄，到达农民那里，你就完成了。

515a0720d29546fb901b564b7801afe70bd7dc4f.source: This quest combines well with The Ascalon Settlement, which provides 4 NPC allies.
515a0720d29546fb901b564b7801afe70bd7dc4f.text: 该任务与阿斯卡隆定居点完美结合，提供 4 名 NPC 盟友。

44fa0fcc39d887295b49ce44b527e4386cb93bd3.source: During the War in Kryta, if Farmer Dirk is interrogated by Inquisitor Bauer, he will not offer this quest until you rezone.
44fa0fcc39d887295b49ce44b527e4386cb93bd3.text: 在科瑞塔战争期间，如果农夫德克被审判官鲍尔审问，他不会提供此任务，直到你重新分区。

be6cc26c13870a8229e08802abf6320e392a3ff9.source: Find Captain Yithlis in the Domain of Fear.
be6cc26c13870a8229e08802abf6320e392a3ff9.text: 在恐惧领域找到伊斯利斯船长。

09bceef2e29194716c22716656c7f2f99c80665a.source: Find and defeat the demons surrounding The Unseen.
09bceef2e29194716c22716656c7f2f99c80665a.text: 找到并击败“看不见的”周围的恶魔。

227aec529e756142d9ea2e956cd33e564fb23715.source: Return to Commander Thurnis in the Gate of Torment for your reward.
227aec529e756142d9ea2e956cd33e564fb23715.text: 返回折磨之门去找指挥官图尼斯领取奖励。

d1c7dac4f582d77529f19eab6848463fbddecd40.source: Enter the Domain of Fear and talk to Captain Yithlis. Head south into the swamp.
d1c7dac4f582d77529f19eab6848463fbddecd40.text: 进入恐惧领域并与伊斯利斯队长交谈。向南进入沼泽。

84f882e02e7a8d65485c992479c99eb0464b5481.source: The goal of this quest is to kill three Portal Wraiths performing a ritual near The Mouth of Torment. There are many foes nearby: Torment creatures, Torment Claws, Terrorweb Dryders, Grasp of Insanities and Scythe of Chaos. Avoid over-aggro and proceed with caution (pulls, watch minions).
84f882e02e7a8d65485c992479c99eb0464b5481.text: 该任务的目标是杀死三名正在折磨之口附近举行仪式的传送门幽灵。附近有很多敌人：折磨生物、折磨爪、恐网烘干机、疯狂之握和混沌镰刀。避免过度仇恨并谨慎行事（拉动，观察小兵）。

3f32ff7b8b21b6f8628801689fc29a7166432fce.source: The Oddbodies do not have to survive to complete this quest.
3f32ff7b8b21b6f8628801689fc29a7166432fce.text: 奇怪的人不需要生存来完成这个任务。

fe0759d2c9eb70986c4d6109a4335dc7f412744d.source: This quest combines well with: Holding the Line, A History of Violence, and Bad Fortune since it provides extra allies. Leave The Last Patrol undone to complete these quests first.
fe0759d2c9eb70986c4d6109a4335dc7f412744d.text: 该任务与：坚守阵线、暴力史和厄运结合得很好，因为它提供了额外的盟友。保留“最后的巡逻”未完成，以首先完成这些任务。

5c5dc7e78597cf0c5af8ffa17e44eb131a0fbe5f.source: The extra allies are also useful for farming Lightbringer points in the Domain of Fear.
5c5dc7e78597cf0c5af8ffa17e44eb131a0fbe5f.text: 额外的盟友对于在恐惧领域种植光明使者点也很有用。

b1389886c12cf9e29227a41c534a7d84e9b51cf7.source: Meet Rahlon and the village men in Mehtani Keys.
b1389886c12cf9e29227a41c534a7d84e9b51cf7.text: 在梅塔尼礁岛认识拉隆和村民。

d339b3dc33ae38185218ab3a2afb77094b8a8534.source: Chase down the corsair and stop him before he makes it back to his friends.
d339b3dc33ae38185218ab3a2afb77094b8a8534.text: 追捕海盗并在他回到朋友身边之前阻止他。

ab1f77b4544c12d0067cb07c20a3b7176b166485.source: [Incomplete source section] After accepting the quest, head out into Mehtani Keys and talk to Rahlon. The objective is to kill the Sneaky Corsair waiting on the small island nearby. However, when you approach, he will run away, and if he runs too far the quest will fail. It is difficult to catch the corsair, even with speed boosts and snares, mainly because you will be slowed down by other foes along the way. One of the easiest ways to complete the quest is to cut a wide path around him as shown in the map above and approach from the other side. He will start running towards you, giving you plenty of time to use a snare and kill him. Bringing ranged attackers can help to finish the runner if he slips through your initial attack.
ab1f77b4544c12d0067cb07c20a3b7176b166485.text: [不完整的源代码部分]接受任务后，前往梅塔尼群岛并与拉隆交谈。目标是杀死在附近小岛上等待的狡猾的海盗。然而，当你靠近时，他就会逃跑，如果他跑得太远，任务就会失败。即使有速度提升和陷阱，也很难抓住海盗船，主要是因为沿途的其他敌人会减慢你的速度。完成任务的最简单方法之一是在他周围开辟一条宽阔的路径，如上图所示，然后从另一侧接近。他会开始跑向你，给你足够的时间使用陷阱并杀死他。如果跑动者躲过了你最初的攻击，带上远程攻击者可以帮助他完成任务。

beba15dd467ea7a0028e86293b89e3501db471ce.source: See the Notes section for additional methods.
beba15dd467ea7a0028e86293b89e3501db471ce.text: 有关其他方法，请参阅注释部分。

887254098e83cfc031e13dd97a9a5f3f5445fd21.source: Rahlon must survive to complete the quest. The rest of his group is immaterial for this quest.
887254098e83cfc031e13dd97a9a5f3f5445fd21.text: 拉隆必须生存才能完成任务。他的团队的其他成员对于这个任务来说并不重要。

12a0d2bfb98f789bd3b88420400d969d6109184a.source: If you don't have a sprint skill, you'll never catch the "Sneaky Corsair". Even if you do, you'll end up fighting the Mandragor that are hidden in the sand, along with other nuisances.
12a0d2bfb98f789bd3b88420400d969d6109184a.text: 如果你没有冲刺技能，你永远也抓不到“偷偷摸摸的海盗”。即使你这样做了，你最终也会与隐藏在沙子里的曼德拉戈尔以及其他讨厌的东西战斗。

a36cc0d76b07e9826ec63f1c9576edbce18e2730.source: You can simply kill the corsair after he reaches his destination if you haven't talked to Rahlon, and then talk to Rahlon (after killing the Sneaky Corsair) to get your reward.
a36cc0d76b07e9826ec63f1c9576edbce18e2730.text: 如果你还没有与拉隆交谈，你可以在海盗到达目的地后杀死他，然后与拉隆交谈（杀死偷偷摸摸的海盗后）以获得奖励。

7684cde06ec9f929a533ddfee2d5b2b3bd185e34.source: Another possibility is to clear the island as mentioned and then station your heroes and henchmen (if any) on a pass which he takes, such as a bridge. The corsair will follow his route and run right to your heroes and henchmen.
7684cde06ec9f929a533ddfee2d5b2b3bd185e34.text: 另一种可能性是如上所述清理岛屿，然后将你的英雄和追随者（如果有的话）驻扎在他所采取的通道上，例如桥梁。海盗船将沿着他的路线直奔你的英雄和追随者。

57c822c7cd3d5fe1163e7a9e6fee6b8311607494.source: One last possibility is to again, clear the island as mentioned above, and then go talk to Rahlon (it doesn't really matter if you talk to him or not, really, because of how slow he and his group run). As you approach the Corsair, he'll begin running; just keep after him, and if you haven't equipped any sprint skills, don't worry- just cut as many corners as you can while doing this. You should finally be able to catch him about halfway through the explorable area, and kill him easily, before making your way back to Rahlon for your reward. If you should happen to run right by Rahlon's volunteer group at some point after killing the corsair, you'll notice that, even though they are all standing there, they're perfectly lined up with one another- giving the effect of there being just one man standing there.
57c822c7cd3d5fe1163e7a9e6fee6b8311607494.text: 最后一种可能性是再次按照上面提到的方式清理岛屿，然后去与拉隆交谈（你是否与他交谈并不重要，真的，因为他和他的团队跑得有多慢）。当你接近海盗船时，他会开始奔跑；只要跟在他后面，如果你没有配备任何冲刺技能，别担心——在这样做的时候尽可能多地走捷径。你最终应该能够在可探索区域的一半左右抓住他，并轻松杀死他，然后返回拉隆以获得奖励。如果你在杀死海盗后的某个时刻碰巧跑到拉隆的志愿者队伍旁边，你会注意到，尽管他们都站在那里，但他们彼此完美地排成一排——给人一种只有一个人站在那里的效果。

9768f14ddc49acc67acc671489023b276751df7d.source: If Isle of the Dead is active, be careful. A group of undead is near a hidden spawn of enemies on the path the corsair runs.
9768f14ddc49acc67acc671489023b276751df7d.text: 如果死亡之岛处于活动状态，请小心。在海盗船运行的路径上，一群不死生物靠近隐藏的敌人生成点。

46363cde8476ecd89a602b08a7388ae993123136.source: Find and speak to Salma in the Temple of the Ages.
46363cde8476ecd89a602b08a7388ae993123136.text: 在万古神殿中找到萨尔玛并与其交谈。

caea972a1d103dc76288554c6c0edd18ec48d020.source: Return to Watchman Arad for your reward.
caea972a1d103dc76288554c6c0edd18ec48d020.text: 返回守望者阿拉德那里领取奖励。

a582f9ce34476c124a709d06504c18d1f952c7b2.source: If you have unlocked Temple of the Ages already, map there and speak with Princess Salma. Otherwise, the outpost is a long walk from either Lion's Arch or Fisherman's Haven, where you picked up the quest.
a582f9ce34476c124a709d06504c18d1f952c7b2.text: 如果您已经解锁了世纪神殿，请绘制那里的地图并与萨尔玛公主交谈。否则，前哨站距离您接任务的狮子拱门或渔人港有很长的步行路程。

93fd758989d78e3279c7bef2aa5af9b958cc9c25.source: File:The_Lost_Princess_Stingray_Strand.jpg|1. Stingray Strand File:The_Lost_Princess_Tears_of_the_Fallen.jpg|2. Tears of the Fallen File:The_Lost_Princess_Talmark_Wilderness.jpg|3. Talmark Wilderness File:The_Lost_Princess_The_Black_Curtain.jpg|4. The Black Curtain
93fd758989d78e3279c7bef2aa5af9b958cc9c25.text: 文件：The_Lost_Princess_Stingray_Strand.jpg|1。黄貂鱼线文件：The_Lost_Princess_Tears_of_the_Fallen.jpg|2。堕落者之泪档案：The_Lost_Princess_Talmark_Wilderness.jpg|3。塔尔马克荒野文件：The_Lost_Princess_The_Black_Curtain.jpg|4。黑幕

a9cbd912de6029552d06230879b97520a70b00b8.source: The travel from Fisherman's Haven to Temple of the Ages requires crossing four explorable areas. The starting outpost provides level 15 henchmen and a party size of six. The whole journey may seem to be a long trip, but it is actually quite quick as there are only a few foes in the way in each area. The only instances that need careful engagement are where there are different types of creatures standing close together, and skale groups with a Grand Drake. Consider hex removal since the Bog Skales use numerous hexes.
a9cbd912de6029552d06230879b97520a70b00b8.text: 从渔人港到世纪神殿的旅程需要穿越四个可探索的区域。起始前哨站提供 15 级追随者和六人队伍。整个旅程看似漫长，但其实很快，因为每个区域的敌人都只有几个。唯一需要仔细交战的情况是，有不同类型的生物并排站在一起，以及有大龙的骷髅群体。考虑去除六角形，因为沼泽斯卡莱斯使用大量六角形。

1d60a68577dae73c88573151bd697e27b321b0fc.source: File:Temple-of-the-ages from-bergen-hot-springs.jpg|Route from Bergen Hot Springs
1d60a68577dae73c88573151bd697e27b321b0fc.text: 文件:古老的寺庙 from-bergen-hot-springs.jpg|从卑尔根温泉出发的路线

71cf3dae06e1d06e506beaacbc2d4038997cb992.source: This route also crosses four explorable areas: North Kryta Province, Nebo Terrace, the Cursed Lands, and the Black Curtain. However, the henchmen are only level 10, and there is significantly more fighting along the way. It is advisable to unlock Bergen Hot Springs on the way and gain level 12 henchmen; if you have already been to that outpost, you can start there to skip North Kryta Province and half of Nebo Terrace. Be careful crossing the Cursed Lands, since many of the undead groups are close together, and head northwest to the northern portal leading to the Black Curtain. Be prepared for frequent applications of poison and crippled.
71cf3dae06e1d06e506beaacbc2d4038997cb992.text: 这条路线还穿过四个可探索的区域：北科瑞塔省、尼波台地、诅咒之地和黑幕。然而，追随者只有10级，而且一路上的战斗明显更多。建议途中解锁卑尔根温泉并获得12级追随者；如果你已经去过那个前哨站，你可以从那里开始跳过北科瑞塔省和尼波台的一半。穿越诅咒之地时要小心，因为许多不死族群都靠得很近，并向西北方向前往通往黑幕的北部传送门。做好频繁使用毒药和致残的准备。

bb0286be470b2f7036e23eb1c594ce69283b618a.source: The dialogue implies that this quest takes place after The Royal Papers, despite both quests being available from Watchman Arad simultaneously. The quest marker will not appear on the radar while in explorable areas, except at The Black Curtain.
bb0286be470b2f7036e23eb1c594ce69283b618a.text: 对话暗示这个任务发生在《皇家文件》之后，尽管守望者阿拉德可以同时完成这两个任务。在可探索区域（黑幕除外）中，任务标记不会出现在雷达上。

5743b3af9a9aa0885c85342fe0b3dee73c9bc2cf.source: Find Hanbahd the Anchorite in the Mirror of Lyss.
5743b3af9a9aa0885c85342fe0b3dee73c9bc2cf.text: 在利斯镜子中找到隐士汉巴德。

ee0492e88e0082e2f14255760226cc5153bc9a43.source: Protect Hanbahd the Anchorite from the attacking Margonites.
ee0492e88e0082e2f14255760226cc5153bc9a43.text: 保护隐士汉巴德免受玛贡尼派的攻击。

bff5612f4ada33fd620440c4c7efccfe80513a4b.source: Hanbahd has fled to the Halls of Chokhin. Locate him, and find out what he knows about the ancient temple site.
bff5612f4ada33fd620440c4c7efccfe80513a4b.text: 汉巴德已逃至乔欣大厅。找到他，了解他对古庙遗址的了解。

256e73afb584b9789b05401b4e062a5c5d4bc73b.source: Hanbahd can be found in the Mirror of Lyss a little to the east of the Kodash Bazaar.
256e73afb584b9789b05401b4e062a5c5d4bc73b.text: 汉巴德位于科达什集市以东不远的里斯之镜中。

4e7f27e69a2ea2a6fe09887c71d87d3ea4c4fdfe.source: The party's arrival at Hanbahd will trigger several waves of Margonite attacks, consisting of 2 or 4 creatures, that will try to kill Hanbahd. The party must keep Hanbahd alive to continue the quest. Once saved, Hanbahd will run off towards Mihanu Township, telling the players to follow and find him in the Halls of Chokhin. At this point, it's probably quickest to map to Mihanu Township and continue on into the Holdings of Chokhin.
4e7f27e69a2ea2a6fe09887c71d87d3ea4c4fdfe.text: 该队伍到达汉巴德将触发几波由 2 或 4 个生物组成的玛贡尼特攻击，这些攻击将试图杀死汉巴德。队伍必须让汉巴德活着才能继续任务。一旦获救，汉巴德就会跑向米哈努镇，告诉玩家跟随并在乔欣大厅找到他。此时，最快的方法可能是映射到米哈努镇并继续前往乔欣领地。

22e26546dd2ed8144c114b87c97914c6d3d20139.source: Outside, follow the narrow passage on the south edge of the Holdings of Chokhin, to find Hanbahd at the end with your quest reward.
22e26546dd2ed8144c114b87c97914c6d3d20139.text: 在外面，沿着 Chokhin 领地南边的狭窄通道走，在尽头找到 Hanbahd，并获得任务奖励。

d26ce7c2eb72c956f60309a138f222b93b886cf3.source: Do this quest with The Search for Survivors or Reclaiming the Temple to use the 4 Vabbian Guards and the Vabbian Guard Captain to help protect Hanbahd the Anchorite.
d26ce7c2eb72c956f60309a138f222b93b886cf3.text: 通过搜索幸存者或收复圣殿来完成此任务，使用 4 名瓦比安守卫和瓦比安守卫队长来帮助保护隐士汉巴德。

1c028de10538c1ff67eab31f44a941efbef9c13b.source: Investigate the Shining Blade cloak at the Scrying Pool.
1c028de10538c1ff67eab31f44a941efbef9c13b.text: 调查占卜池的光刃斗篷。

e03bc0f08f48ff3f6f5f0242dcc723264a7765e3.source: Enter Watchtower Coast from Divinity Coast (outpost). The Shining Blade Cloak will be on a sunken path, shortly below the first W in "Watchtower Coast" on the map. (The cloak is also close to Beetletun, but the path is swarmed with Tengu.)
e03bc0f08f48ff3f6f5f0242dcc723264a7765e3.text: 从神性海岸（前哨站）进入了望塔海岸。光刃斗篷将位于一条凹陷的路径上，位于地图“瞭望塔海岸”第一个 W 下方不久。 （斗篷也靠近甲壳虫，但路上挤满了天狗。）

6963f614bf63c0306edc2b69a384f432f2416fc7.source: Not being primary or secondary Mesmer.
6963f614bf63c0306edc2b69a384f432f2416fc7.text: 不是主要或次要的幻术师。

e1ecbd526cded26b56315d856ead4072e61c4bc3.source: Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Mesmer.
e1ecbd526cded26b56315d856ead4072e61c4bc3.text: 第一次没有以二级幻术师的身份完成占卜石。

7e0867d6c82114203bfd4a1b6bd87d22e9e0f56d.source: Go through Skyward Reach to Diviner's Ascent.
7e0867d6c82114203bfd4a1b6bd87d22e9e0f56d.text: 穿过 Skyward Reach 到达占卜者的上升。

ed9e3eb49f27d408175143678dc97ea45bf02a12.source: Slay all three tempest drakes in a single battle.
ed9e3eb49f27d408175143678dc97ea45bf02a12.text: 在一场战斗中杀死全部三只暴风龙。

2b26af4cd89f3d33b38c7b0536a197ba994d61f9.source: Return to Eulenias for your reward.
2b26af4cd89f3d33b38c7b0536a197ba994d61f9.text: 返回尤里尼亚斯那里领取奖励。

27618498aafd5fa5f7d05f9939f9fb6d0bfef329.text: 幻术师可用于第二职业

27d23787ff0758dc72327f6e0ede317dcf18a7ad.source: This is easiest to accomplish leaving Elona Reach. Hug the south wall, moving to the teleporters, and continue eastward, hugging the north wall to where it makes a sharp northward turn, then straight out to the end of the area. The Tempest Drakes are immediately north of this position, and will not separate from their mob. Area of effect skills and some hit and run tactics will easily defeat all three very quickly. After the going through teleporter, if you do not hug the north wall, there is a good chance that you will aggro the Sand Wurm which dwells in the middle of this explorable area.
27d23787ff0758dc72327f6e0ede317dcf18a7ad.text: 离开 Elona Reach 是最容易实现的。拥抱南墙，移动到传送器，然后继续向东，拥抱北墙，直到它急剧向北转向，然后径直到达该区域的尽头。暴风龙龙就在这个位置的北面，不会与他们的暴徒分开。区域技能和一些打了就跑的战术将很容易很快地击败这三个人。通过传送器后，如果你不紧贴北墙，你很有可能会攻击居住在这个探索区域中间的沙龙。

ee3b34c27eb4e67927b5b0c2d1663f0587d7e38a.source: Clear the Mirror of Lyss in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
ee3b34c27eb4e67927b5b0c2d1663f0587d7e38a.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比利斯之镜中的所有敌人。

5cc246f3a047c8b6d7af9adaed24ce38eb4e126b.source: Characters will arrive in this area for the first time as part of the primary quest All's Well That Ends Well. Several other follow-up primary quests, as well as quite a few secondary quests, will give reason for characters to revisit this area.
5cc246f3a047c8b6d7af9adaed24ce38eb4e126b.text: 作为主线任务 All's Well That Ends Well 的一部分，角色将首次抵达该区域。其他几个后续主要任务以及相当多的次要任务将为角色提供重新访问该区域的理由。

63132d900720a405926b2531e12f2ebd660395c0.source: Without any active quests, the Kournan Bounty available applies only to Briahn the Chosen's group of soldiers.
63132d900720a405926b2531e12f2ebd660395c0.text: 如果没有任何活跃的任务，库南赏金仅适用于天选者布里恩的士兵。

28d29b4ec0084997fa6f2111eda946c0e92c5ccd.source: Despite the presence of many beasts, there is no Monster Hunt available.
28d29b4ec0084997fa6f2111eda946c0e92c5ccd.text: 尽管存在许多野兽，但没有怪物狩猎可用。

8832ecfcfe40ca80bdb164ca2e7e9b93b516acf5.source: The area east of the lake is a good place for Lightbringer rank farming. Start from Dzagonur Bastion to get Elemental Hunt and go southwards - this yields about 50 Lightbringer points. Consider using Frozen Soil on a ranger hero against Roaring Ethers.
8832ecfcfe40ca80bdb164ca2e7e9b93b516acf5.text: 湖东地区是光明使者等级耕种的好地方。从 Dzagonur Bastion 开始进行元素狩猎并向南前进 - 这会产生大约 50 个光明使者点数。考虑对游侠英雄使用冰冻土壤来对抗咆哮以太。

aba9249d91c7fb1e9e18fdddf555f3676f806510.source: Briahn the Chosen's group will begin its east-west patrol only after your party reaches a point near the southeastern bank of the river. See the boss article for more information.
aba9249d91c7fb1e9e18fdddf555f3676f806510.text: 只有当你的队伍到达靠近河流东南岸的地点后，天选者布里恩的队伍才会开始东西向巡逻。更多信息请参阅老板文章。

3b75cc5bb4bd721236d0bc86d62f64d18a7f53fe.source: There is a group of beetles that are easily missed because they are on a path that is not clearly visible on the map. This path is reached from the small patch of land that borders the southern edge of the lake and western bank of the river and is slightly north of the Buried Treasure.
3b75cc5bb4bd721236d0bc86d62f64d18a7f53fe.text: 有一群甲虫很容易被错过，因为它们所在的路径在地图上不清晰可见。这条路是从与湖泊南缘和河流西岸接壤、位于埋藏宝藏稍北处的一小块土地到达的。

9f95aabc36d05d9c35d23a8a697d564beea20da1.source: Both the Madness of Prophecy and the Search for Survivors quests will significantly increase the number of creature spawns (mostly Margonites) in the area, although the latter will also provide you with warrior allies.
9f95aabc36d05d9c35d23a8a697d564beea20da1.text: 疯狂预言和寻找幸存者任务都会显着增加该地区生物生成的数量（主要是玛贡尼特），尽管后者也会为你提供战士盟友。

6a58becff0ab7d557db9f2316dbd6e6046eae65b.source: This area always contains 5 Vabbi Chests (or Locked Chests in Hard mode).
6a58becff0ab7d557db9f2316dbd6e6046eae65b.text: 该区域始终包含 5 个瓦比宝箱（或困难模式下的锁定宝箱）。

0cb9484824827b6911293217f82c18847e5aa587.source: The three patrolling groups of Vabbian Guards around Ahjii do not attack foes and vice-versa, and area of effect damage from foes do not affect the Vabbian Guards.
0cb9484824827b6911293217f82c18847e5aa587.text: 阿吉周围的三个瓦比安卫队巡逻队不会攻击敌人，反之亦然，敌人造成的伤害范围不会影响瓦比安卫队。

b330d39f2931b62d000f2614a16e2b9bd9c42d64.source: Seek the great jotun living within Darkrime Delves.
b330d39f2931b62d000f2614a16e2b9bd9c42d64.text: 寻找居住在暗黑深渊的伟大角顿人。

b72af83614f87b9a3fcda3c2b792f1dfaa043432.source: Find the source of the roar heard from below.
b72af83614f87b9a3fcda3c2b792f1dfaa043432.text: 找到下面传来的咆哮声的来源。

1ad71fedd60a54882de2402bf0db8a7d5cc3fd4f.source: Find a way to kill the giant jotun.
1ad71fedd60a54882de2402bf0db8a7d5cc3fd4f.text: 找到杀死巨人佐顿的方法。

c84985bdbba72fb1499040a81641256a7464ee45.source: See Einarr Frostcleft for your reward.
c84985bdbba72fb1499040a81641256a7464ee45.text: 前往艾纳尔·霜裂以获得奖励。

1175fd65a03f3a3355ce955f0e27db0a8491f57a.source: Find Yort the Bronze's ceremonial family sword.
1175fd65a03f3a3355ce955f0e27db0a8491f57a.text: 找到青铜约特的家庭礼仪剑。

6fe3d40fd2df14fbb702d9c00f7381dce4cbdd6b.source: Return the ceremonial family sword to Yort the Bronze.
6fe3d40fd2df14fbb702d9c00f7381dce4cbdd6b.text: 将礼仪家族剑归还给青铜约特。

3f6fa580b53ca9361bbc2fc4d7105c1108103c38.source: The shortest route is to map to Augury Rock and then go north-west from there to enter the ditch. Follow the ditch until you find the Ancient Remains; once you click on the yellow text you will receive the sword. Then just map back for your reward.
3f6fa580b53ca9361bbc2fc4d7105c1108103c38.text: 最短的路线是地图到占卜岩，然后从那里向西北进入沟渠。沿着沟渠前进，直到找到远古遗迹；一旦你点击黄色文字，你就会收到剑。然后只需映射回来即可获得奖励。

e199d583d7bffc5e120485a05f2d681685229b2e.source: An alternative (though slightly longer) route is to start from Heroes' Audience and walk north up the western side of Prophet's Path until you reach the grassy area the river flows through, then walk north-east along the river/grass until you find the Ceremonial Family Sword.
e199d583d7bffc5e120485a05f2d681685229b2e.text: 另一种（虽然稍长）路线是从英雄观众席开始，沿着先知之路的西侧向北走，直到到达河流流经的草地区域，然后沿着河流/草地向东北走，直到找到仪式家族剑。

5a36bdaec55bcb023ae2a29df0d7d13d084132a3.source: Although the Amnoon Oasis looks to be the closest outpost, if you leave from there, you will have to take a much longer route to be able to enter the ditch.
5a36bdaec55bcb023ae2a29df0d7d13d084132a3.text: 虽然安努绿洲看起来是最近的哨所，但如果从那里离开，就需要走更长的路才能进入沟渠。

ec48f2c587ba72bf04b490d3921c3a7ffbe971b7.source: Follow the road through Traveler's Vale to the Ascalon Foothills.
ec48f2c587ba72bf04b490d3921c3a7ffbe971b7.text: 沿着路穿过旅行者谷到达阿斯卡隆山麓。

caa3a8b30b6570568987e0e6c5462513b89ef90d.source: Follow the quest marker into Ascalon Foothills. Once you arrive, keep an eye out for various Hydras who use Meteor and Stone Fury who can blind you with Eruption. Once you get to Artisan Rudger, talk to him complete the quest.
caa3a8b30b6570568987e0e6c5462513b89ef90d.text: 跟随任务标记进入阿斯卡隆丘陵。到达后，请留意使用流星和石之怒的各种九头蛇，它们可以用爆发使你失明。到达工匠鲁杰后，与他交谈即可完成任务。

bd1ce582e43e4421d304ec1b49e4ecbf13abc79e.source: Go to Bukdek Byway and burn the diseased corpses.
bd1ce582e43e4421d304ec1b49e4ecbf13abc79e.text: 前往 Bukdek Byway 烧毁患病尸体。

eeb0b386ac00722b1b9c0fad33deb87416dbf2de.source: Investigate the corpse thefts and find out where the bodies are being taken.
eeb0b386ac00722b1b9c0fad33deb87416dbf2de.text: 调查尸体盗窃案并查明尸体被运往何处。

23fdfd4695c64bb7ce2872eba4116e473024b630.source: See Guardsman Kinri for your reward.
23fdfd4695c64bb7ce2872eba4116e473024b630.text: 去找卫兵金里领取奖励。

3bb63f2b1550b280875111e7c039dfdbce0c3092.source: Leave for Bukdek Byway by way of Kaineng Center. The compass will lead you towards catching Corpse Thief Mang in the act of moving some corpses. Confront him and the quest will be complete.
3bb63f2b1550b280875111e7c039dfdbce0c3092.text: 经凯能中心前往 Bukdek Byway。指南针将引导你抓住正在移动尸体的盗尸者芒。面对他，任务就会完成。

081b6bab443dc6a23b4f7c1f55e5b038325c65bc.source: Find Ke Feng's boss, Shae Wong, in Kaineng Center.
081b6bab443dc6a23b4f7c1f55e5b038325c65bc.text: 在凯能中心找到柯峰的老板 Shae Wong。

5cd760076da9b5b155f7cf38be8afd56cd6b3f71.source: Find Ke Feng in the Undercity and inform him that his cover is blown.
5cd760076da9b5b155f7cf38be8afd56cd6b3f71.text: 在幽暗城找到柯枫，并告诉他他的身份已经暴露。

9ce84875f2a8a798d9aa4978307f69623636cb15.source: Kill the Jade Brotherhood thug Noqui.
9ce84875f2a8a798d9aa4978307f69623636cb15.text: 杀死翡翠兄弟会暴徒诺基。

01fc812c47e199eb84432d3692fd9c244cfcd439.source: Return to Shae Wong and tell him what has transpired.
01fc812c47e199eb84432d3692fd9c244cfcd439.text: 返回 Shae Wong 身边，告诉他发生了什么事。

19106ea473b507d8d632cd8d3d56eaa248c9ae5d.source: Once this quest is accepted, Baosen will no longer spawn in the Undercity.
19106ea473b507d8d632cd8d3d56eaa248c9ae5d.text: 一旦接受此任务，宝森将不再在幽暗城中生成。

605d5dd042d02ca3eaaa592c69eaae6285987df9.source: This quest is triggered by talking to Baosen. Ke Feng and several Jade Brotherhood members will spawn. When Ke Feng's health is low he will turn friendly and the actual quest can be accepted from him. Travel to Kaineng Center and talk to Shae Wong. Return to the Undercity and go to Ke Feng's location. As you approach him Noqui will pop up in front of him and kill him. Kill Noqui.
605d5dd042d02ca3eaaa592c69eaae6285987df9.text: 该任务是通过与宝森对话触发的。柯峰和几名翡翠兄弟会成员将会出现。当柯峰的生命值较低时，他会变得友好，并且可以从他那里接受实际的任务。前往凯能中心并与 Shae Wong 交谈。返回幽暗城，前往柯锋所在地。当你接近他时，诺基会突然出现在他面前并杀死他。杀死诺基。

6ed359c5af1d47ea15a2475a9c76ef22ac364da2.source: After Noqui is dead, return to Shae Wong and accept the reward.
6ed359c5af1d47ea15a2475a9c76ef22ac364da2.text: Noqui死后，返回Shae Wong并接受奖励。

90d2513b91331d3b8da23b181a7bdcd1898e5288.source: You cannot save Ke Feng, no matter how quick your character or party is.
90d2513b91331d3b8da23b181a7bdcd1898e5288.text: 无论你的角色或队伍有多快，你都无法拯救柯峰。

af4a8704bd6b32ed5e55a540545d7d89e21b3869.source: Senjo Wah can be asked about this quest, although he does not play any role in it.
af4a8704bd6b32ed5e55a540545d7d89e21b3869.text: Senjo Wah 可以被问到这个任务，尽管他在其中没有扮演任何角色。

668c3d516b89a72bb6a5a50f1605017e7779021c.source: Investigate the fate of the patrol under Captain Yithlis.
668c3d516b89a72bb6a5a50f1605017e7779021c.text: 调查伊斯里斯队长领导下的巡逻队的命运。

b34c53e2c4c9d06bc81f0fd2e52ec48c4be68d60.source: Defeat the attacking demons. Captain Yithlis must survive.
b34c53e2c4c9d06bc81f0fd2e52ec48c4be68d60.text: 击败攻击的恶魔。伊斯利斯船长必须生存。

c02e9dc2da65fafe02bc57b22fb101d27b372618.source: Start from the Gate of Torment, pick up the Monolith bounty for the single monolith you'll encounter. Make your way directly to the quest marker, you will not encounter any groups apart from those surrounding Yithlis. Though appearing to be an easy quest, it can become complicated by the outnumbering spawns and nearby patrols. Try to clear the area of hostile groups (especially patrols) before approaching Captain Yithlis (entering aggro range will add his group to the party window and will spawn a group coming to attack you from the direction of the Gate of Torment). Do not talk to Captain Yithlis until all nearby attacking mobs have been defeated. After defeating the attacking groups, you can pick up the nearby Torment Bounty to the west.
c02e9dc2da65fafe02bc57b22fb101d27b372618.text: 从折磨之门开始，为你将遇到的单个巨石领取巨石赏金。直接前往任务标记，除了伊斯利斯周围的人之外，你不会遇到任何团体。虽然看起来是一个简单的任务，但由于数量过多和附近的巡逻，它可能会变得复杂。在接近 Yithlis 队长之前，尝试清除该区域的敌对团体（尤其是巡逻队）（进入仇恨范围会将他的队伍添加到队伍窗口中，并会产生一个团体从折磨之门的方向攻击你）。在附近所有攻击怪物被击败之前，不要与伊斯里斯队长交谈。击败攻击团后，你可以在西边附近拾取折磨赏金。

378ee42b9a640f5feb446251ed9bc29d131cc06a.source: Talking to Captain Yithlis will start the spawn of an additional 4 groups of tormented creatures (all approaching from the north). Protect the Captain from the torment creatures, his allies don't matter for the purpose of completing the quest, but will aid you against the tormented foes.
378ee42b9a640f5feb446251ed9bc29d131cc06a.text: 与 Yithlis 船长交谈将开始产生另外 4 组受折磨的生物（全部来自北方）。保护队长免受折磨生物的侵害，他的盟友对于完成任务的目的并不重要，但会帮助你对抗遭受折磨的敌人。

1317389f98c3fd0dfce4a16a38dfa7a7167ef759.source: After defeating the spawning enemies, talk to Captain Yithlis for the reward - he will also offer you the next quest, which happens in the same area.
1317389f98c3fd0dfce4a16a38dfa7a7167ef759.text: 击败生成的敌人后，与 Yithlis 队长交谈以获得奖励 - 他还会为您提供下一个任务，该任务发生在同一区域。

7274a0c39359e834a55254d170988f6cda92389f.source: Not being primary or secondary Monk.

9648e6a5ae2ae084ad99fed250fabe92d63eebf1.source: Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Monk.
9648e6a5ae2ae084ad99fed250fabe92d63eebf1.text: 第一次没有以二级武僧的身份完成占卜岩。

9c22d4959e17929b2f5c52b847bb9fd760d62d7b.source: Travel through the Salt Flats to Diviner's Ascent.
9c22d4959e17929b2f5c52b847bb9fd760d62d7b.text: 穿过盐滩前往占卜者上升点。

a95b14c27b670982a0bb12b072b4cada9a8c2949.source: Find the Eater of Souls and destroy it!

cdc132ae3c63e32f617316c2358f6e654ab45c9b.source: Return to Nausuan for your reward.

106ce408141b50471e6b72115d6d43e86d4548e5.source: Although the quest says you must go through the Salt Flats to get to Diviner's Ascent, it is easier and faster if you simply map travel to Elona Reach and then walk northeast to the quest marker. The Eater of Souls will appear in the distance. As the player approaches; however, it will soon disappear and a swarm of Jade Scarabs will take its place. After defeating a total of three waves of enemies, the Eater of Souls finally reappears to allow itself to be defeated.
106ce408141b50471e6b72115d6d43e86d4548e5.text: 虽然任务说你必须穿过盐滩才能到达占卜者的上升，但如果你简单地在地图上前往伊罗娜河段，然后向东北走到任务标记，那就更容易、更快。噬魂者将会出现在远处。当玩家接近时；然而，它很快就会消失，一大群翡翠圣甲虫将取代它。在击败了总共三波敌人后，噬魂者终于再次出现，让自己被击败。

675d16234ff920e3854aaa61eca928882d9453c0.source: There are enough foes to power one or even two minion masters.
675d16234ff920e3854aaa61eca928882d9453c0.text: 有足够的敌人来为一名甚至两名随从大师提供动力。

daf7e957f324fe8e5d37a09dd21c339c419b8bf8.source: If you keep this quest active, the groups of Jade Scarabs can be farmed for Jade Mandibles.
daf7e957f324fe8e5d37a09dd21c339c419b8bf8.text: 如果你保持这个任务活跃，可以通过养殖翡翠圣甲虫群来获得翡翠下颌骨。

173ca62af4dd9f5a3435701eb3255cd3a95878f3.source:
* Canthan (Factions) character
* The Road Less Traveled completed
173ca62af4dd9f5a3435701eb3255cd3a95878f3.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 少有人走的路已完成

ef83ec4e2607843f0426c4228be4de6c7609bc98.source: Travel to Haiju Lagoon and talk to Scout Shenfai.
ef83ec4e2607843f0426c4228be4de6c7609bc98.text: 前往海州泻湖并与侦察员申法交谈。

e573fc88f2a77c006a7c4edadf1f816473169bf5.source: Head North to the beach to look for Naga. Report your findings to Scout Shenfai.
e573fc88f2a77c006a7c4edadf1f816473169bf5.text: 向北前往海滩寻找娜迦。向侦察兵 Shenfai 报告你的发现。

aa6ade8e60a4235b1cc28b6319cf905ab69131db.source: See Scout Shenfai for your reward.
aa6ade8e60a4235b1cc28b6319cf905ab69131db.text: 去找侦察兵 Shenfai 领取奖励。

2bec043a2e363aec08831c80ddd0b317245b7c73.source: It's preferable to wait with this quest until you have unlocked Zen Daijun (outpost), as the route is shorter and the henchmen are of a higher level. Otherwise you have to travel from Seitung Harbor. In either case, make your way to Scout Shenfai, talk to him, and then travel north and then northeast. There are no extra foes on the route. Once near the beach, clear the normal nagas from the area, and then investigate the beach location indicated. A group of nagas will spawn, defeat them. This is repeated two more times. Take care to only trigger one group at a time. After that, you can go back and collect the reward.
2bec043a2e363aec08831c80ddd0b317245b7c73.text: 最好等到您解锁禅代军（前哨站）后再执行此任务，因为路线较短且追随者的等级较高。否则您必须从 Seitung 港出发。无论哪种情况，请前往侦察兵 Shenfai 处，与他交谈，然后向北行驶，然后向东北行驶。路线上没有额外的敌人。靠近海滩后，清除该地区的正常纳迦，然后调查指示的海滩位置。一群纳迦将会出现，击败他们。这又重复两次。注意一次只触发一组。之后就可以回去领取奖励了。

26dbddeb49d2a554803883879c7216ff12e1f12c.source: Speak with [3...0] more masters on the training grounds of the Isle of the Nameless.
26dbddeb49d2a554803883879c7216ff12e1f12c.text: 在无名岛的训练场上与 [3...0] 位大师交谈。

f47b6a5e2df96bda8da1ce201a25f2e88b257abd.source: Return to the Guide on the Isle of the Nameless.

6fe7b7a0daf72142b7fb784d119b5da2ae21ed85.source: Head to the main area of the isle. There, talk to three nameless masters other than Master of Winds; the closest ones are Master of Combat, Master of Magic and Master of Area Effects.
6fe7b7a0daf72142b7fb784d119b5da2ae21ed85.text: 前往岛上的主要区域。在那里，与除了风师之外的三位无名大师交谈；最接近的是战斗大师、魔法大师和区域效果大师。

63e78f4208d6c8e1cb44cc304dd22f38faf313c9.source: The quest marker will lead you to the Master of Combat, followed by Master of Magic and then Master of Conditions; however, you can speak any of the friendly masters in any order.
63e78f4208d6c8e1cb44cc304dd22f38faf313c9.text: 任务标记将引导您到达战斗大师，然后是魔法大师，然后是条件大师；但是，您可以按任何顺序与任何友好的大师交谈。

94b6ea43e942b2340eb654102469b379ca450c18.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: necromancer
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
94b6ea43e942b2340eb654102469b379ca450c18.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：死灵法师
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

a5d51002436cea6a6e2331f69e08f327da6d880b.source: Get past the fire traps in the burning section of the catacombs. (Use bone horrors to trigger the traps.)
a5d51002436cea6a6e2331f69e08f327da6d880b.text: 穿过地下墓穴燃烧部分的防火陷阱。 （使用骸骨恐怖物来触发陷阱。）

db6a88cc072b969ab30b9cc4e5a4492d386aff76.source: Munne will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
db6a88cc072b969ab30b9cc4e5a4492d386aff76.text: 接受任务后，穆恩会给你以下技能：

67b1f2f106e62c8e2e0028d333303f2a5f6641f9.source: Follow Necromancer Munne, fighting enemies as you go. Eventually she'll stop at the beginning of a long hallway with three consecutive Flame Geyser trap runes on the ground.
67b1f2f106e62c8e2e0028d333303f2a5f6641f9.text: 跟随死灵法师穆尼，边走边与敌人战斗。最终她会停在一条长长的走廊的入口处，地上有三个连续的火焰间歇泉陷阱符文。

a9ec3195b9be99c015d14bca7861b19743bfb6ef.source: These traps are especially deadly, dealing 500 elemental damage to unarmored targets, instantly killing most characters. Even rangers (which possess the highest armor against elemental damage among all professions) have to be at least level 6 with a good shield (e.g. the Serrated Shield) to survive. The game immediately demonstrates this destructive power by having a devourer spawn from the wall and run straight in the second trap, getting killed on the spot.
a9ec3195b9be99c015d14bca7861b19743bfb6ef.text: 这些陷阱尤其致命，会对无装甲目标造成 500 点元素伤害，立即杀死大多数角色。即使是游侠（在所有职业中拥有最高的抗元素伤害护甲）也必须至少达到 6 级并拥有良好的盾牌（例如锯齿盾）才能生存。游戏立即展示了这种破坏力，吞噬者从墙上产生并径直跑进第二个陷阱，当场被杀死。

c0c1c90050003fc825bc1e278f3aedb582f1cdbc.source: The idea is to use Animate Bone Horror; as the corpse is within the trap, the minion summoned from it will immediately trigger the trap, at the cost of it dying in the process.
c0c1c90050003fc825bc1e278f3aedb582f1cdbc.text: 这个想法是使用 Animate Bone Horror；当尸体在陷阱内时，从尸体中召唤的小兵将立即触发陷阱，但代价是它会在此过程中死亡。

301434a74158e0eec75cbb067a6de291a98a15f4.source: Once the traps are removed, the path to the Tomb Nightmare is clear. Despite being level 4, the Nightmare is very weak. It is especially susceptible to cold damage, making Deathly Swarm particularly effective.
301434a74158e0eec75cbb067a6de291a98a15f4.text: 一旦陷阱被移除，通向古墓噩梦的道路就畅通无阻了。尽管是4级，梦魇还是很弱。它特别容易受到寒冷伤害，这使得死亡群特别有效。

9eee05de63faccfd3e33bfdfa9574bba450e1296.source: Go back to Munne to collect the reward. You can also map travel to Ashford Abbey and re-enter the Catacombs as she will be back at her original location.
9eee05de63faccfd3e33bfdfa9574bba450e1296.text: 返回Munne领取奖励。您还可以在地图上前往阿什福德修道院并重新进入地下墓穴，因为她会回到原来的位置。

e0da04dabe14bffa33865ea37c2015f9294d9909.source: There are various ways to kill the Tomb Nightmare without confronting it directly:
e0da04dabe14bffa33865ea37c2015f9294d9909.text: 有多种方法可以在不直接面对古墓梦魇的情况下杀死它：

1ada09777748f0ab5162cc8043dbfd4966704658.source: If you have a flatbow or longbow, instead of triggering the last Flame Geyser, you can take advantage of the stairs' elevation to pull the Nightmare. It will try to get to you and run straight into the trap.
1ada09777748f0ab5162cc8043dbfd4966704658.text: 如果你有平弓或长弓，你可以利用楼梯的高度来拉梦魇，而不是触发最后一个火焰间歇泉。它会试图接近你并径直落入陷阱。

a82129827ab1e306d57b5d53c9dc016896cad69d.source: There's a ledge overlooking the Tomb Nightmare to the west of the last room, which can be more easily reached from the entrance in Green Hills County, north of The Barradin Estate, going then straight south then east. You can again pull the Nightmare with a bow and it will try to come straight to you, leaving you some time to kill it with ranged spells or attacks while it is still pondering how to reach you.
a82129827ab1e306d57b5d53c9dc016896cad69d.text: 最后一个房间的西边有一个壁架，可以俯瞰古墓噩梦，从巴拉丁庄园北部的格林希尔斯县的入口，然后一直向南再向东走，可以更容易地到达那里。你可以再次用弓拉梦魇，它会尝试直接向你靠近，让你有时间用远程法术或攻击杀死它，同时它仍在考虑如何接近你。

dc331f3eb35237a8fccf2fdcd561953f4afb9ae4.source: During the quest Vanguard Rescue: Save the Ascalonian Noble, two vanguard foes will spawn in the same spot than the Tomb Nightmare, and kill it in your stead.
dc331f3eb35237a8fccf2fdcd561953f4afb9ae4.text: 在任务“先锋营救：拯救阿斯卡隆贵族”期间，两个先锋敌人将在与古墓噩梦相同的位置生成，并代替你杀死它。

381cb8bc550d0f947446dfadb5741abf90b71b28.source: You can use Devona to trigger the first trap which will likely kill her unless she's level 8 or higher. You will need to resurrect her with a Resurrection Signet to sacrifice her again to trigger the second trap.
381cb8bc550d0f947446dfadb5741abf90b71b28.text: 你可以使用 Devona 触发第一个陷阱，这可能会杀死她，除非她等级达到 8 级或更高。你需要用复活徽记复活她，然后再次牺牲她来触发第二个陷阱。

70c6afc43cff842e2761207cd050acff75c0a3f2.source: Not being primary or secondary Necromancer.
70c6afc43cff842e2761207cd050acff75c0a3f2.text: 不是初级或次级死灵法师。

41fb11733083e175958931952e83c73b058dbb67.source: Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Necromancer.
41fb11733083e175958931952e83c73b058dbb67.text: 第一次没有以二级死灵法师的身份完成占卜岩。

81a4886f55fd2bb20501a1442fbcc43945ea10e1.source: Go to the Prophet's Path and slay the Sacred Griffon of Amnoon.
81a4886f55fd2bb20501a1442fbcc43945ea10e1.text: 前往先知之路并杀死安努的神圣狮鹫。

bc657347c6598167ac65affa35c54de3b28df98c.source: Return to Zratha Kor for your reward.
bc657347c6598167ac65affa35c54de3b28df98c.text: 返回泽拉萨·科尔领取奖励。

d1dd51141957e336ec045391e4bb46b63cec5c4a.text: 死灵法师可用于辅助职业。

6d2295a8e85051880f4f3aca43706c32c81f74fd.source: It is much quicker to leave from Augury Rock to complete this quest.
6d2295a8e85051880f4f3aca43706c32c81f74fd.text: 从占卜岩出发完成这个任务要快得多。

dc5ad69fafcb7138d76c04f070e613385a199e77.source: Head west from Augury Rock, veering south. You will encounter some Rockshot Devourers, some Scarabs, and a small handful of Minotaurs along the way. Take the groups one at a time, and you should not have too much trouble. The Devourers will probably lay a few traps down before you can engage them, so you should be prepared to deal with conditions like blindness and burning.
dc5ad69fafcb7138d76c04f070e613385a199e77.text: 从占卜岩向西行驶，转向南方。一路上你会遇到一些岩弹吞噬者、一些圣甲虫和一小部分牛头怪。一次一组地进行，你应该不会有太多麻烦。在你与吞噬者交战之前，吞噬者可能会布下一些陷阱，所以你应该做好应对失明和燃烧等情况的准备。

82995b2a2355925c9f5bfb409ed44b39c01a2cda.source: Continue heading southeast. You will encounter more Devourers and Scarabs. Kepkhet Marrowfeast will also be there, along with a rather large group of Scarabs. Avoid them and continue southeast. The Sacred Griffon of Amnoon will be surrounded by a small group of Desert Griffons. Kill the Sacred Griffon first as it is a Monk, followed by the Desert Griffons, or alternatively pull them separately as the Sacred Griffon is not part of the group. Return to Zratha Kor for your reward.
82995b2a2355925c9f5bfb409ed44b39c01a2cda.text: 继续向东南方向行驶。你会遇到更多的吞噬者和圣甲虫。 Kepkhet Marrowfeast 也会在那里，还有一大群圣甲虫。避开他们并继续向东南方向行驶。安努的神圣狮鹫将被一小群沙漠狮鹫包围。首先杀死神圣狮鹫，因为它是武僧，然后杀死沙漠狮鹫，或者单独拉它们，因为神圣狮鹫不属于该群体。返回泽拉萨·科尔领取奖励。

61ef5975d45191581d00e2afe167fa990886a4d9.source: You can kill some minotaurs on your way to the Sacred Griffon of Amnoon, which helps you complete the quest Ghostly Vengeance.
61ef5975d45191581d00e2afe167fa990886a4d9.text: 你可以在前往安努神圣狮鹫的途中杀死一些牛头怪，这可以帮助你完成幽灵复仇任务。

80c18158bd781c13c3133ff887338b1673a2e15c.source: Engage Dhuum in the Hall of Judgment. Your entire party must enter the hall.
80c18158bd781c13c3133ff887338b1673a2e15c.text: 在审判大厅与德姆交战。你们的整个队伍都必须进入大厅。

70624e53db6bf5640b8047abbb6f439eec5add6a.source: Protect the Reapers while they channel all their energy into Dhuum's Rest, a powerful enchantment developed to force Dhuum into dormancy. At least one Reaper must survive. There are 7..1 Reapers still standing.
70624e53db6bf5640b8047abbb6f439eec5add6a.text: 保护收割者，同时将他们所有的能量引导到德姆之眠，这是一种强大的结界，旨在迫使德姆进入休眠状态。至少一名收割者必须生存。还有 7..1 收割者还站着。

b7ece5465df81d7fc49945160f61ad8a0afd1faa.source: Lay Dhuum low so the Reapers' magic can force Dhuum into dormancy.
b7ece5465df81d7fc49945160f61ad8a0afd1faa.text: 将德姆放低，这样收割者的魔法就能迫使德姆进入休眠状态。

34816b11d22ab9b64abe039b758c4c043accefb6.source: See King Frozenwind for your reward.
34816b11d22ab9b64abe039b758c4c043accefb6.text: 去见冰风国王以获得奖励。

d167b1381788fa5ae4bc308ea2caf35fd43fb13a.source: While facing Dhuum, if you die or your death penalty hits 60%, you will be moved next to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale and turned into Spirit Form. Players must talk to the Mayor to return to the battle; heroes are returned automatically. Consumables that remove death penalty or grant a Morale Boost can prevent this.
d167b1381788fa5ae4bc308ea2caf35fd43fb13a.text: 在面对德姆时，如果你死亡或死亡惩罚达到60%，你将被移到遗忘谷的市长阿莱盖里旁边，并变成灵魂形态。玩家必须与市长对话才能重返战斗；英雄会自动返回。消除死刑或提高士气的消耗品可以防止这种情况发生。

ea636a4c11e38f7927facef0d817c855a9ebb217.source: Death in Spirit Form is supposed to be permanent, since the Curse of Dhuum prevents the use of resurrection skills during this battle. But resurrection scrolls and "By Ural's Hammer!" still work, as does pre-casting delayed resurrection skills like Unyielding Aura before entering the room.
ea636a4c11e38f7927facef0d817c855a9ebb217.text: 灵魂形态的死亡应该是永久性的，因为德姆的诅咒阻止了在这场战斗中使用复活技能。但是复活卷轴和“乌拉尔之锤！”仍然有效，就像进入房间之前预施延迟复活技能（例如不屈光环）一样。

4eedc33e628efd02c52582f50f6ae3f08b52eaeb.source: There are two goals in this battle. One is to fill the Dhuum's Rest bar, which is achieved gradually with the skill Dhuum's Rest used by the Reapers and by players in Spirit Form. The other is to damage Dhuum directly, bringing him below 25% health. When both goals are met, the fight is over and you can collect the reward from King Frozenwind.
4eedc33e628efd02c52582f50f6ae3f08b52eaeb.text: 这场战斗有两个目标。一是填充德姆之息栏，这是通过收割者和精神形态玩家使用的技能“德姆之息”逐渐实现的。另一种是直接对德姆造成伤害，使其生命值低于 25%。当两个目标都达到时，战斗就结束了，你可以从冰风国王那里领取奖励。

f3b5f9ffc741a216b159d17350e2ac03ca8e2f6a.source: Throughout the battle, make sure to kill all of the Minions of Dhuum and Champions of Dhuum that Dhuum periodically summons; if you don't kill them, they'll swarm your team. Because of the amount of skeletons and the easiness of killing them, Edge of Extinction is a good tool for keeping their numbers down. Avoid using the spirit form skill Encase Skeletal, since it prevents the target from taking damage; as more and more come it gets harder to keep them all in check and easier for them to swarm.
f3b5f9ffc741a216b159d17350e2ac03ca8e2f6a.text: 在整个战斗中，确保杀死德姆定期召唤的所有德姆小兵和德姆冠军；如果你不杀掉他们，他们就会蜂拥而至你的队伍。由于骷髅数量众多且易于杀死它们，“灭绝边缘”是减少骷髅数量的好工具。避免使用灵体技能“包裹骷髅”，因为它可以防止目标受到伤害；随着越来越多的人到来，控制它们变得越来越困难，而且它们更容易蜂拥而至。

009c50e8837bd5b41fa7ef50c6a5f8c7e4958eb5.source: Escort the Oddbodies to the Gate of Torment
009c50e8837bd5b41fa7ef50c6a5f8c7e4958eb5.text: 护送异类前往折磨之门

d6bd069cfe4618b052c9cd15528aae72fc361495.source: See Commander Thurnis for your reward.
d6bd069cfe4618b052c9cd15528aae72fc361495.text: 去找瑟尼斯指挥官领取奖励。

2b79bb76e28cbda3e991a9a5cb8a8d651005c429.source: Having survived the preceeding quest, escort Captain Yithlis and his patrol back to the Gate of Torment. You will be attacked by 3 mobs of torment creatures running at your escort on the way, so don't think you can take it easy!
2b79bb76e28cbda3e991a9a5cb8a8d651005c429.text: 在前面的任务中幸存下来后，护送伊斯利斯队长和他的巡逻队返回折磨之门。途中你会被护送你的 3 只折磨生物攻击，所以别以为你可以掉以轻心！

cc76726b92b98a0ffd4d0c4bcd9c3e3660be2276.source: Scythes of Chaos like to attack Yithlis and the spell casting party, running around the warriors so keep an eye on them. Consider killing Shadows of Fear first to ensure that you don't have to face exploding minions in addition to the other demons.
cc76726b92b98a0ffd4d0c4bcd9c3e3660be2276.text: 混沌之镰喜欢攻击伊斯利斯和施法队伍，在战士周围奔跑，所以要留意他们。考虑先杀死恐惧之影，以确保除了其他恶魔之外，你不必面对爆炸的小兵。

832c1a23d594db4293b1293b5310a4bcc1123dcb.source: The enemy groups spawn on the route back to the Gate of Torment even between handing in the previous quest and picking up this one — so if you want to make sure all the Oddbodies survive, you can fight the mobs before you accept this quest. If you killed all enemy groups around the NPCs during The Missing Patrol, they stay safe in that spot while you are off hunting the quest mobs.
832c1a23d594db4293b1293b5310a4bcc1123dcb.text: 即使在提交上一个任务和接受这个任务之间，敌人也会在返回折磨之门的路线上生成——所以如果你想确保所有奇怪的人都活下来，你可以在接受这个任务之前与小怪战斗。如果您在失踪巡逻期间杀死了 NPC 周围的所有敌方团体，那么当您外出狩猎任务小怪时，他们会安全地待在该地点。

a1d038ef01fb8c6e8935872b6aeddfffeebdb01d.source: You can use the Oddbodies to help farm Lightbringer points in this area. It may be worthwhile not to turn in the quest for this reason.
a1d038ef01fb8c6e8935872b6aeddfffeebdb01d.text: 您可以使用奇怪的人来帮助在该区域种植光明使者点。由于这个原因，不提交任务可能是值得的。

2f5834a3451fffa5b58d63c5fd6e27bfab322bff.source: It is possible to avoid all of the mobs unscathed, with the exception of a few henchman/heroes.
2f5834a3451fffa5b58d63c5fd6e27bfab322bff.text: 除了少数追随者/英雄之外，可以毫发无伤地避开所有怪物。

60c2cf2b1f82ed20f61e4af9c387cf08f8b11a46.source: The quest can be completed with just one member of the Oddbodies surviving.
60c2cf2b1f82ed20f61e4af9c387cf08f8b11a46.text: 只要一名 Oddbodies 成员幸存即可完成该任务。

a2ccf9409d0f45af8c7ef7d1d2f83ece783199ab.source: Find the Basket of Apples. Take it to Mary Malone.
a2ccf9409d0f45af8c7ef7d1d2f83ece783199ab.text: 找到一篮子苹果。把它交给玛丽·马龙。

6040a041fa75307de151bbc5e8e9c35b1086414d.source: Travel south from Fort Ranik, then turn east toward an area with stone arches. Giant Needle Spiders will popup at the entrance of the path leading to the area and around the ruins. Kill them and then pick up the basket lying underneath a nearby tree.
6040a041fa75307de151bbc5e8e9c35b1086414d.text: 从拉尼克堡向南行驶，然后向东转向有石拱门的区域。巨型针蜘蛛会出现在通往该地区的道路入口处和废墟周围。杀死他们，然后捡起附近树下的篮子。

e34cf737055b3cdec00faa36778cc32d5916c28d.source: Picking up the basket triggers an additional spider to spawn next to you immediately and others on the way back. In total, 6 additional level 2 spiders spawn while you carry the basket, 3 next to the arches, 3 others near the exit. Their spawn locations are about the same as the regular spawns.
e34cf737055b3cdec00faa36778cc32d5916c28d.text: 拿起篮子会立即触发一只额外的蜘蛛在您旁边生成，并在返回的路上触发其他蜘蛛。当您携带篮子时，总共会生成 6 个额外的 2 级蜘蛛，其中 3 个在拱门旁边，另外 3 个在出口附近。它们的生成位置与常规生成位置大致相同。

666ef7fd89c359cea3271a465df08bff1dff791e.source: As with most bundles, you cannot attack with your weapon and your movement speed is reduced while carrying the basket, though you can still cast most spells. Should you need to attack with your weapon, feel free to drop the bundle and pick it up again after the fight. Kill the spiders and return the basket to Mary to get your reward.
666ef7fd89c359cea3271a465df08bff1dff791e.text: 与大多数包裹一样，你无法使用武器进行攻击，并且携带篮子时你的移动速度会降低，但你仍然可以施展大多数法术。如果您需要使用武器进行攻击，请随意放下包裹并在战斗结束后再次捡起。杀死蜘蛛并将篮子还给玛丽即可获得奖励。

2a788e7cefc0926a694bdcc7921e68adfa690e70.source: Caution: Do not map travel to save time; doing so will cause you to lose the basket, forcing you to fetch it again, similar to the strongbox in the Bandit Raid quest.
2a788e7cefc0926a694bdcc7921e68adfa690e70.text: 注意：不要为了节省时间而绘制旅行地图；这样做会导致你丢失篮子，迫使你再次取回它，类似于强盗袭击任务中的保险箱。

c1617470cf163fd719ddf4f0580828777920628a.source: Higher level characters can farm this quest for Spider Legs.
c1617470cf163fd719ddf4f0580828777920628a.text: 更高级别的角色可以进行蜘蛛腿的任务。

be260786b5ee190871cb5ffa9345fa4a42b20de0.source: Sometimes a spider may spawn inside a tree.
be260786b5ee190871cb5ffa9345fa4a42b20de0.text: 有时蜘蛛可能会在树内生成。

b4b174bd27b5dc4854fa5eb73025a2012a294c97.source: Speak to the Guard of the Isles near the eastern gate to access the Forbidden Path.
b4b174bd27b5dc4854fa5eb73025a2012a294c97.text: 与东门附近的岛屿守卫交谈以进入禁道。

d0773cf5b519330682258e5b69e18eada83f1699.source: Speak to General Yurukaro in the Zaishen Elite refuge.
d0773cf5b519330682258e5b69e18eada83f1699.text: 与再神精英避难所的尤鲁卡罗将军交谈。

c465a2f2ff59b42c96513934004664112e137e84.source: Unlocks the Zaishen Elite outpost for the account.
c465a2f2ff59b42c96513934004664112e137e84.text: 解锁账户的再神精英前哨站。

a187162c036a747f0efe984492f3e6d31f86ee8d.source: Speak to the Guard of the Isles near the eastern gate (he will refuse to talk to you if do not have this quest active). You will be taken to the other side of the gate, then just follow the winding Forbidden Path. If finding the gap in the cliff proves difficult, refer to the instructions given by Rioka.
a187162c036a747f0efe984492f3e6d31f86ee8d.text: 与东门附近的群岛守卫交谈（如果没有激活此任务，他将拒绝与你交谈）。您将被带到大门的另一边，然后沿着蜿蜒的禁道走。如果发现悬崖上的缺口很困难，请参阅 Rioka 的说明。

d09f97651aac1f4879a6ea28d7b9994d8a78dfa4.source: Upon arrival in the Elite refuge, talk to Yurukaro and the quest will be completed.
d09f97651aac1f4879a6ea28d7b9994d8a78dfa4.text: 到达精英避难所后，与Yurukaro交谈即可完成任务。

bca09ca6b450e15daabaf9c5913727501c12a9df.source: Roleplaying characters on accounts created prior to the January 19, 2006 update do not need to complete the Zaishen Challenge to acquire this quest.
bca09ca6b450e15daabaf9c5913727501c12a9df.text: 在 2006 年 1 月 19 日更新之前创建的帐户上的角色扮演角色不需要完成 Zaishen 挑战来获得此任务。

8647e0311cee243592fcc733b5c8c568735c46e1.source: Outside of events, this quest is the only way to visit the Forbidden Path. If you want to enjoy the scenery, make sure not to collect the "reward".
8647e0311cee243592fcc733b5c8c568735c46e1.text: 除了活动之外，此任务是访问禁道的唯一途径。如果你想欣赏风景，请确保不要领取“奖励”。

e17a01546c6faaca2f5d2305a6739f06d3181f70.source: Though the reward quest seems to be account-wide, the quest can be taken and accomplished by different characters of the same account. However you'll still need to complete the two previous quests.
e17a01546c6faaca2f5d2305a6739f06d3181f70.text: 虽然奖励任务似乎是整个帐户范围内的，但该任务可以由同一帐户的不同角色进行和完成。但是您仍然需要完成之前的两个任务。

6360641d667a403e9299a2915df25667f9b6e65e.source: Travel to the deciphered location in Varajar Fells.
6360641d667a403e9299a2915df25667f9b6e65e.text: 前往瓦拉贾丘陵的破译地点。

a2a80681bdbb031fd49deef0f3385289ed375234.source: In eastern Varajar Fells where Nifling the Chained usually is, Kerrsh will be waiting for you. Upon approaching, the crater will spawn the various facets faced in the preceeding quests one after the other. Defeat them all to complete the quest.
a2a80681bdbb031fd49deef0f3385289ed375234.text: 在瓦拉贾荒原东部，链式尼夫林通常在的地方，克尔什会在那里等你。接近时，陨石坑将依次产生前面任务中面临的各个方面。击败他们所有人即可完成任务。

744ea819b8c5aa9767a1d54d59cbae779e15847b.source: You can reach the spawning site faster from the Central Transfer Chamber, if you have completed Destruction's Depths.
744ea819b8c5aa9767a1d54d59cbae779e15847b.text: 如果您已完成毁灭深渊，您可以从中央传送室更快地到达生成地点。

f4602560cd4ab705cf0b679fe3d24b7c6668e1f7.source: This quest is useful for farming Norn title points.
f4602560cd4ab705cf0b679fe3d24b7c6668e1f7.text: 这个任务对于耕种诺恩头衔点很有用。

d317535dfaf75611c17db410d167a8ae48a73972.source: Under the Norn Hunting Party blessing, each Facet counts for 50 points.
d317535dfaf75611c17db410d167a8ae48a73972.text: 在诺恩狩猎队的加持下，每个方面都有 50 分。

e490f99b5235887edf76d078c0683b2114f1aa5c.source: Under the maximum hunt rank (after 250 kills), you can receive 1.8k (300/boss in normal mode) or 2.7k (450/boss in hard mode).
e490f99b5235887edf76d078c0683b2114f1aa5c.text: 在最大狩猎等级下（250次击杀后），你可以获得1.8k（普通模式下300/boss）或2.7k（困难模式下450/boss）。
