9edc5a24650819b49ee0eca485ebe90323e3ef8f.source: You can improve this further by waiting until you are under the effects of a Boss Bounty
9edc5a24650819b49ee0eca485ebe90323e3ef8f.text: 等到你受到 Boss 赏金的影响后，你可以进一步改进这一点

1b232a0cb9608db5b1bd6c87e705eb765a35cb2e.source: You may map to Tarnished Haven and collect the reward from Kerrsh there, as well.
1b232a0cb9608db5b1bd6c87e705eb765a35cb2e.text: 您也可以映射到玷污避风港并从那里的克尔什那里收集奖励。

b1b0d0688eebdedad4eb8337eb95949c8149b99b.source: Kerrsh and the Facets will not spawn if A Good Deed and or Wintersday Cheer is active.
b1b0d0688eebdedad4eb8337eb95949c8149b99b.text: 如果“善行”和/或“冬日欢呼”处于活动状态，克尔什和小面将不会生成。

a9294eaf62d623c66477c10dbe523fc461f461d6.source: This quest takes place entirely in the Kaineng Docks. There are no enemies to fight, so you can do this solo if you please. First, speak with Deckhand Jakob at the end of the pier, then speak with Kevan at the base of the stairs, and finish off with Captain Ander at the top of the stairs.
a9294eaf62d623c66477c10dbe523fc461f461d6.text: 该任务完全发生在凯能码头。没有敌人可以战斗，所以如果你愿意的话，你可以单独进行。首先，与码头尽头的水手雅各布交谈，然后与楼梯底部的凯文交谈，最后与楼梯顶部的安德船长交谈。

5267ab28a42a388e7ffc9cd3ccf160878553839a.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
* Level 2 or higher
5267ab28a42a388e7ffc9cd3ccf160878553839a.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色
* 2级或以上

7d68a5a9e68cd456c40daffe7e0fa5b8569e3f42.source: Cross the river and destroy the plague devourer to get a poisonous stinger.
7d68a5a9e68cd456c40daffe7e0fa5b8569e3f42.text: 过河并消灭瘟疫吞噬者以获得毒刺。

32b9ec743094de829546ef4b1b920dcbac5f053f.source: Deliver the poisonous stinger to Brother Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey.
32b9ec743094de829546ef4b1b920dcbac5f053f.text: 将毒刺交给阿什福德修道院的曼洛修士。

61f9cdf4a3cb2a21c424d92ece4ba91f1225666c.source: Head south from Ascalon City and cross the river to reach the island cave (which appears grey on your map). Go around the western side until you reach the cave's entrance near Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn, and venture into the cave.
61f9cdf4a3cb2a21c424d92ece4ba91f1225666c.text: 从阿斯卡隆城向南，过河到达岛屿洞穴（在地图上显示为灰色）。绕过西侧，直到到达 Duke Gaban 和 Fadden Hathorn 附近的洞穴入口，然后冒险进入洞穴。

3ff9a85935e0ac12d2cdcf9643216497f0ff6ede.source: Although there are four more Carrion Devourers in the cave during this quest than usual, you can ignore most of them and the Lash Devourers, since they don't attack you unless a Diseased Devourer pops up. When this happens, focus on Diseased Devourers first, since they are level 0 and will die in one or two basic hits.
3ff9a85935e0ac12d2cdcf9643216497f0ff6ede.text: 虽然在这个任务中洞穴里的腐肉吞噬者比平时多了四个，但你可以忽略他们中的大多数和鞭打吞噬者，因为除非有病态吞噬者出现，否则它们不会攻击你。发生这种情况时，请首先关注疾病吞噬者，因为它们的等级为 0，并且会在一两次基本攻击中死亡。

7a32fb1490717c4b0053291fd1e12ad3bd72e654.source: The Plague Devourer is located near the end of the cave and will pop up and attack you once approached. Despite the dialogue, it cannot poison you. Once you have killed it, two poisonous stingers will drop. Collect one of them and map travel to Ashford Abbey to give it to Brother Mhenlo.
7a32fb1490717c4b0053291fd1e12ad3bd72e654.text: 瘟疫吞噬者位于洞穴尽头附近，一旦接近就会突然出现并攻击你。尽管有对话，但它不会毒害你。一旦你杀死它，就会掉落两根毒刺。收集其中一张，并在地图上前往阿什福德修道院，将其交给曼洛修士。

b0f7489d401c9cceea72bc2218f1fa28d4bc6fe0.source: Since a devourer has two tails, it will drop two stingers; however, only one of them is needed to complete the quest. The other one can be discarded or ignored.
b0f7489d401c9cceea72bc2218f1fa28d4bc6fe0.text: 由于吞噬者有两条尾巴，因此它会掉落两根毒刺；然而，只需要其中之一即可完成任务。另一种可以被丢弃或忽略。

d4b7f2e47e7bf4f2042ffdbf1c48b064f6cdae73.source: Enter the catacombs and destroy the Blood Fanatics.
d4b7f2e47e7bf4f2042ffdbf1c48b064f6cdae73.text: 进入地下墓穴并消灭血腥狂热者。

7309bf009198ca52795dcf77ae530d56ff3e601d.source: Kasha will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
7309bf009198ca52795dcf77ae530d56ff3e601d.text: 卡莎在接受任务后会给你以下技能：

44824722b191b781ad1769ce945b2ee7edb50391.source: Accepting this quest temporarily removes the Gargoyles and collector Karleen from the cavern near the Green Hills County exit. They will start spawning again once the Blood Fanatics are dealt with.
44824722b191b781ad1769ce945b2ee7edb50391.text: 接受此任务会暂时将石像鬼和收藏家卡琳从绿山县出口附近的洞穴中移走。一旦解决了血腥狂热分子，它们就会再次开始生成。

1614f276ef73ba67c8caee68d247e2ed59dd67da.source: The fastest route to the fanatics is from the Barradin Estate. From there, head north following the quest marker, and cross the second bridge near the Catacombs entrance. Inside, go straight east to find the fanatics (see the quest map for reference).
1614f276ef73ba67c8caee68d247e2ed59dd67da.text: 到达狂热分子的最快路线是从巴拉丁庄园出发。从那里，沿着任务标记向北走，穿过地下墓穴入口附近的第二座桥。在里面，一直向东走就能找到狂热分子（参考任务地图）。

37333d66da8971f0e7855a3d319945ce1b81a1c9.source: Alternatively, you may map travel to Ashford Abbey and enter the Catacombs there. There is a hidden passage to the right, just behind Necromancer Munne. At the end of the cavern, follow the long path straight ahead littered with gargoyles. When the path forks, follow the quest marker to the stairs which lead to a crypt on the right, where the fanatics are located.
37333d66da8971f0e7855a3d319945ce1b81a1c9.text: 或者，您可以在地图上前往阿什福德修道院并进入那里的地下墓穴。右边有一条隐藏通道，就在死灵法师穆尼的后面。在洞穴的尽头，沿着布满石像鬼的长路一直向前走。当路径分岔时，沿着任务标记到达通往右侧地下室的楼梯，那里是狂热者所在的地方。

c0c89f9f3f4db1bb39bc297ca28950fb7705d756.source: The fanatics themselves shouldn't pose any serious threat, dispose of them before returning to Kasha for your reward.
c0c89f9f3f4db1bb39bc297ca28950fb7705d756.text: 狂热分子本身不应该构成任何严重的威胁，在返回卡夏领取奖励之前先解决掉他们。

3e5624b809fad22c8a73b94d13b0023bf9c6c7cf.source: Although there are five fanatics, you only need to kill three of them. While Kasha tells you that the Blood Fanatics are fond of Dark Pact, they in fact use Vile Touch.
3e5624b809fad22c8a73b94d13b0023bf9c6c7cf.text: 虽然狂徒有五个，但你只需要杀掉三个就可以了。虽然卡莎告诉你血狂热者喜欢黑暗契约，但他们实际上使用邪恶之触。

40f74d6045857b205eed9cda63f9c9c4beb57469.source: Tell Gareth Quickblade about the lost White Mantle patrol.
40f74d6045857b205eed9cda63f9c9c4beb57469.text: 告诉加雷斯·快刃关于失踪的白斗篷巡逻队的事。

889254a866d53d276a7b29a085d2f4212bfad88b.source: Meet the Shining Blade scouts in Silverwood.

c3da6d5e80b2a3abc6fa89d0515028ab3458a802.source: Seek out and destroy the White Mantle patrol.
c3da6d5e80b2a3abc6fa89d0515028ab3458a802.text: 寻找并消灭白斗篷巡逻队。

6ecb1078919d6c61d25a6f5ab079b349f3521b24.source: Collect [5...0] more ruined White Mantle armors.
6ecb1078919d6c61d25a6f5ab079b349f3521b24.text: 收集 [5...0] 件更多被毁坏的白斗篷盔甲。

24ff6a299de0aed84bfb0fa2248f92bd9a13061c.source: Take the 5 ruined White Mantle armors back to Gareth Quickblade.
24ff6a299de0aed84bfb0fa2248f92bd9a13061c.text: 将 5 件毁坏的白斗篷盔甲带回给加雷斯·快刃。

8ddfa917e296734c49319e6969dc95a46396f58a.source: From Quarrel Falls, travel north to find Alari Doubleblade (see first map) and obtain the quest. Once you have the quest, map travel back to Quarrel Falls and talk to Gareth. It is suggested that first-time players not do this until you complete Bloodstone Fen, otherwise the actions you need to undertake in the quest will confuse you. Completing Bloodstone Fen will also put you right in Quarrel Falls.
8ddfa917e296734c49319e6969dc95a46396f58a.text: 从夸雷尔瀑布向北行驶找到阿拉里双刃（参见第一张地图）并获得任务。完成任务后，按地图返回夸雷尔瀑布并与加雷斯交谈。建议初次玩家在完成血石沼泽之前不要这样做，否则任务中需要采取的行动会让你感到困惑。完成血石沼泽也会让你进入争吵瀑布。

3b57bdeb2a4999564ed464c319180c61009eff57.source: Go outside and meet up with the Shining Blade Scout and two Shining Blade Rangers. They will head off to the north (see second map) for you to follow. They will aggro everything in their path and can die easily, but don't need to be kept alive for quest completion. Alternatively, you can head out of Bloodstone Fen (see third map). Kill the patrol, and pick up the Ruined Armors they drop. Map travel back to Quarrel Falls for your reward.
3b57bdeb2a4999564ed464c319180c61009eff57.text: 出去与光刃斥候和两名光刃游侠会合。他们将前往北方（见第二张地图）供您跟随。他们会吞噬路上的一切，并且很容易死亡，但不需要为了完成任务而保持活着。或者，您可以前往血石沼泽（参见第三张地图）。杀死巡逻队，捡起他们掉落的破损盔甲。地图返回夸雷尔瀑布以获得奖励。

0f7d3f80b9088c8a83e4706353cfc91ae19d479b.source: You can skip speaking to Gareth Quickblade by simply rezoning into Silverwood and killing the White Mantle patrol.
0f7d3f80b9088c8a83e4706353cfc91ae19d479b.text: 你可以跳过与加雷斯·快刃的对话，只需重新分区到银森林并杀死白斗篷巡逻队即可。

f03d650b383376f0157606e82f42263de609d86d.source: You can skip speaking to the Shining Blade Scouts by map traveling to Bloodstone Fen, then zoning into Silverwood, taking a left, and killing the patrol without them.
f03d650b383376f0157606e82f42263de609d86d.text: 你可以通过地图前往血石沼泽，然后分区进入银林，向左转，并在没有他们的情况下杀死巡逻队，从而跳过与光刃侦察兵的对话。

8e560dfbf64e94af0885e5727af2235787080416.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
* The Worm Problem completed
8e560dfbf64e94af0885e5727af2235787080416.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色
* 蠕虫问题已完成

023516ccbb0cfaac44d121b53b4134f7f7c69ed8.source: Head to the catacombs and find Pitney's prize bird.
023516ccbb0cfaac44d121b53b4134f7f7c69ed8.text: 前往地下墓穴并找到皮特尼的战利品鸟。

9facb326145bf63eb21f64c093fbba379e45e9dd.source: Return to Pitney for your reward.
9facb326145bf63eb21f64c093fbba379e45e9dd.text: 返回皮特尼以获得奖励。

b5c2c7c85e6ed7caa3aba8189d0172ed3ed605a0.source: For the duration of the quest, the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird will spawn in the ritual chamber of the catacombs.
b5c2c7c85e6ed7caa3aba8189d0172ed3ed605a0.text: 在任务期间，奖品恐鸟的尸体会在地下墓穴的仪式室中生成。

29fc94098391469af71f5f90f0bfd7cd7d5f0e46.source: After taking the quest, head to the Catacombs. You can enter from three locations, though Ashford Abbey is probably the quickest.
29fc94098391469af71f5f90f0bfd7cd7d5f0e46.text: 接受任务后前往地下墓穴。您可以从三个地点进入，但阿什福德修道院可能是最快的。

e2a576c5205076aa128399ae51578c679ead08af.source: From Ashford Abbey: Head south down one set of stairs, then west down another to a Y-intersection. Take the northwestern path across a bridge and down yet another set of stairs. There are two paths north from this room: a near one which leads to a Flame Geyser, and a less obvious one on the far side of the room. Take the far one, then turn southwest after the second pillar. Deadly Crypt Spiders pop up along this section. Continue along this path until just before the walls change over to stone blocks, and you'll find a passage south. This passage leads to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.
e2a576c5205076aa128399ae51578c679ead08af.text: 从阿什福德修道院 (Ashford Abbey) 出发：向南走下一组楼梯，然后向西走下另一组楼梯到达 Y 形交叉路口。沿着西北方向穿过一座桥，然后走下另一组楼梯。从这个房间向北有两条路：一条靠近的通向火焰间歇泉，另一条不太明显的位于房间的远端。走最远的一根，然后在第二根柱子后转向西南。致命的地穴蜘蛛会沿着这个区域弹出。继续沿着这条路走，直到墙壁变成石块之前，你会发现一条向南的通道。这条通道通向一个十字路口，走廊上有一群不死生物。继续向南走上一组楼梯，再走下另一组即可找到珍贵摩亚鸟的尸体。

47bf5a2bbf2414959b938417fa771c27e919aaff.source: From Green Hills County: Move past the Gargoyles and take the path south, turning west at the intersection. In the large circular room, head southwest and take the corridor south where Oberan the Reviled stands. After the corridor turns east, Deadly Crypt Spiders will start popping up. Where the stone wall on your right ends, take path south, and you'll come to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.
47bf5a2bbf2414959b938417fa771c27e919aaff.text: 从 Green Hills County 出发：经过 Gargoyles，沿路向南行驶，在十字路口向西转。在巨大的圆形房间里，向西南走，沿着被辱骂者奥贝兰所在的走廊向南走。走廊转向东后，致命地穴蜘蛛将开始出现。在你右边的石墙尽头，向南走，你会到达一个十字路口，那里有一条走廊，里面有一群不死族。继续向南走上一组楼梯，再走下另一组即可找到珍贵摩亚鸟的尸体。

fcbeb136efe080ba6c823b511752e6c8596ffce8.source: From Wizard's Folly: Simply follow the left wall to the northwest and you will enter a corridor with groups of undead. After two or three groups, you'll come to an intersection with corridors north, south, east (the way you came), and west. Turn south and head up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.
fcbeb136efe080ba6c823b511752e6c8596ffce8.text: 来自Wizard's Folly：只要沿着左墙向西北走，你就会进入一条有一群不死生物的走廊。经过两到三组后，您将到达一个与北、南、东（您来时的路）和西走廊的交叉点。向南转，上一组楼梯，再下另一组楼梯，找到珍贵摩亚鸟的尸体。

b6362718f40f14061df5b59814ffcc5802fe61f8.source: Approach the corpse to complete the quest. Be aware that two Crypt Fiends spawn when you get near the corpse. It is usually possible to complete the quest without spawning the Crypt Fiends. Return to Pitney for your reward.
b6362718f40f14061df5b59814ffcc5802fe61f8.text: 接近尸体即可完成任务。请注意，当您靠近尸体时，会生成两个地穴恶魔。通常可以在不产生地穴恶魔的情况下完成任务。返回皮特尼以获得奖励。

c25ca7078e86f5e5d45f38c41ed6173d31191258.source: Skills that deal Holy Damage, such as Bane Signet will help you get rid of the undead along the way quickly.
c25ca7078e86f5e5d45f38c41ed6173d31191258.text: 造成神圣伤害的技能，例如祸根徽记，将帮助你快速消灭沿途的不死生物。

fbd3d19213e63bc05a6229dcc84421ba3437dcb3.source: The Crypt Fiends are susceptible to Fire Damage, so even a low level character with a spell like Flare should have an easy time dealing with them.
fbd3d19213e63bc05a6229dcc84421ba3437dcb3.text: 地穴恶魔很容易受到火焰伤害，所以即使是拥有耀斑之类法术的低等级角色也应该能轻松对付它们。

3fc34948c5e0aede4a1cc545defdb85407971ed8.source: The Corpse of the Prize Moa Bird can be used to Animate Bone Horrors to assist against the fiends.
3fc34948c5e0aede4a1cc545defdb85407971ed8.text: 奖品恐鸟的尸体可以用来激活骸骨恐惧来协助对抗恶魔。

2ab5bdd1a16ad3fd326f60cf04e0645c156ec34c.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary profession: ranger
* Completed primary profession test
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
2ab5bdd1a16ad3fd326f60cf04e0645c156ec34c.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要职业：游侠
* 完成初级职业测试
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

cce32e4bcf3cfdaf9d79f075aed4d3dc70465578.source: Find the shrine of Melandru's statue along the path in the woods.
cce32e4bcf3cfdaf9d79f075aed4d3dc70465578.text: 沿着树林中的小路找到梅兰德鲁雕像的神殿。

a2e29b7d9a2ac9ff6e48a38a33449f7a16f5f8c6.source: Use your Charm Animal skill on one of Melandru's Stalkers when it appears.
a2e29b7d9a2ac9ff6e48a38a33449f7a16f5f8c6.text: 当梅兰德鲁的追猎者之一出现时，对它使用魅惑动物技能。

049003ef1b1834a27edf00ac77cc14d7cd10eec5.source: Master Ranger Nente will give you a Starter Bow and the following skills upon taking the quest:
049003ef1b1834a27edf00ac77cc14d7cd10eec5.text: 游侠大师 Nente 在接受任务后会给你一把入门弓和以下技能：

0cfb6550c4cbadf8f88fb22b3b739f69b4f12dbf.source: Head south until you reach a Statue of Melandru. Several Melandru's Stalkers can be found nearby. Target one of the beasts and use Charm Animal. The stalker will become hostile and attack while you are taming it. For safety, you may wish to use Troll Unguent beforehand, or you can stand close to the Statue of Melandru which provides health regeneration to any creature near it.
0cfb6550c4cbadf8f88fb22b3b739f69b4f12dbf.text: 向南行驶，直到到达梅兰德鲁雕像。附近可以找到几只梅兰德鲁追猎者。瞄准其中一只野兽并使用魅惑动物。当你驯服跟踪者时，它会变得充满敌意并发起攻击。为了安全起见，你可能希望事先使用巨魔软膏，或者你可以站在梅兰德鲁雕像附近，它可以为附近的任何生物提供生命恢复。

36c7c4fb370a1dfc85cd5c5487b6ef955bf7f6aa.source: Charming an animal other than a Melandru's Stalker stalls this quest. To finish it, you must relinquish your current pet to Jarrel the Tamer, pre-Searing Ascalon's only pet tamer, and try again.
36c7c4fb370a1dfc85cd5c5487b6ef955bf7f6aa.text: 迷惑梅兰德鲁追猎者以外的动物会阻碍该任务。要完成此任务，您必须将当前的宠物交给驯兽师贾瑞尔（灼热阿斯卡隆之前唯一的宠物驯兽师），然后重试。

e55cd36ce1bcbc5fd5ed451f3549cfc38ab08cc1.source: It is a good idea to keep the Melandru's Stalker as the post-searing quest Endangered Species requires you to tame one, although you may tame one in post-searing, too.
e55cd36ce1bcbc5fd5ed451f3549cfc38ab08cc1.text: 保留梅兰德鲁的追猎者是个好主意，因为灼热后的任务濒危物种要求你驯服一只，尽管你也可以在灼热后驯服一只。

52783204b5b11af52e202d657613d80475deb2d3.source: If you have the quest The Hunter's Horn active, the spot you have to purify the horn is near where you charm the Stalker.
52783204b5b11af52e202d657613d80475deb2d3.text: 如果你激活了猎人号角任务，那么你必须净化号角的地点就在你迷惑追猎者的地方附近。

38a34969f54590d27a3a70b74afdac55ee0095f1.source: Not being primary or secondary Ranger.
38a34969f54590d27a3a70b74afdac55ee0095f1.text: 不是主要或次要游骑兵。

01db415cadebb1f4cd1c03b852c14fbbf07aa2f0.source: Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Ranger.
01db415cadebb1f4cd1c03b852c14fbbf07aa2f0.text: 第一次没有以二级游侠身份完成占卜岩。

c677f69b5255cf47f47f679a149507d10b60ab4e.source: Go to the Salt Flats and slay the Yxthoshth.
c677f69b5255cf47f47f679a149507d10b60ab4e.text: 前往盐滩并杀死伊克斯托什。

e94b138a8b5e179f3116870558f774acfe6520b7.source: Return to Telius for your reward.
e94b138a8b5e179f3116870558f774acfe6520b7.text: 返回 Telius 处领取奖励。

7cce87a11efcae1dc5ca88e1da68bbf569010a74.source: For this quest it is best to bring some kind of interrupt, because of the Hydra that you will encounter on your path. You will encounter Storm Kin patrols on your way to Yxthoshth. Once Yxthoshth comes in to visual range, the Storm Kin near him will head right for you. Either kill the Storm Kin first then Yxthoshth or go straight for Yxthoshth.
7cce87a11efcae1dc5ca88e1da68bbf569010a74.text: 对于这个任务，最好带来某种中断，因为你会在路上遇到九头蛇。在前往伊克托什斯的途中你会遇到风暴亲族巡逻队。一旦伊克托什斯进入可视范围，他附近的风暴近亲就会朝你冲来。要么先杀风暴近亲，然后杀伊克托什，要么直接杀伊克托什。

771708cb211765230407a386680413ec6cd99131.source: This is the only secondary profession quest to provide access to an elite skill.
771708cb211765230407a386680413ec6cd99131.text: 这是唯一提供获得精英技能的次要职业任务。

01a833d03af9668bfa004fe410023f9d57ae47e4.source: Meet Zho and Sujun in Panjiang Peninsula.
01a833d03af9668bfa004fe410023f9d57ae47e4.text: 在盘江半岛与赵和苏君见面。

40ae218635112fd5db314ef4d5af95a2a6647ac4.source: Follow Ling Wong as she tracks the elusive red frog.
40ae218635112fd5db314ef4d5af95a2a6647ac4.text: 跟随 Ling Wong 追踪难以捉摸的红青蛙。

633c59d4276d3935dbf824ee53d87d0604e9620a.source: If Sujun dies, you must rezone to try again.
633c59d4276d3935dbf824ee53d87d0604e9620a.text: 如果Sujun死了，你必须重新分区再试一次。

339434510d11693a7ced2913ef9ef0fff5358773.source: Deliver Farrah's message to Little Thom.
339434510d11693a7ced2913ef9ef0fff5358773.text: 将法拉的消息传递给小汤姆。

ce93825c460e576d24ade5aeed46aa1d4af2d1f4.source: Tell Farrah of the death of Little Thom.
ce93825c460e576d24ade5aeed46aa1d4af2d1f4.text: 将小汤姆的死告诉法拉。

38b174d30420540679671735a1090de109c8ab94.source: Walk out of Fort Ranik and head to King's Watch in Regent Valley.
38b174d30420540679671735a1090de109c8ab94.text: 走出拉尼克堡，前往摄政谷的国王守望台。

50188d80140b4d045dbac4078212ba30dece6cc6.source: Walk out of Sardelac Sanitarium and head through Old Ascalon to King's Watch in Regent Valley
50188d80140b4d045dbac4078212ba30dece6cc6.text: 走出沙德拉疗养院，穿过旧阿斯卡隆前往摄政谷的国王守望台

e3d3fa1dd6e4ee0b8d6621fd5acf9897686b65b8.source: At the marked location on your map you will find the Corpse of Little Thom. Approach it until your character remarks on it, then return to Piken Square for the reward.
e3d3fa1dd6e4ee0b8d6621fd5acf9897686b65b8.text: 在地图上标记的位置，您会找到小汤姆的尸体。接近它，直到你的角色对它发表评论，然后返回皮肯广场以获得奖励。

7f98b810a21fd61111c51f9595fb349372f133bd.source: Obviously, this is not Little Thom. It is simply an Ascalon Guard, who was probably set up by Thom to get away.
7f98b810a21fd61111c51f9595fb349372f133bd.text: 显然，这不是小汤姆。这只是一个阿斯卡隆守卫，很可能是托姆为了逃跑而设下的。

2751feb3063729c386c6dfef1d25e6c12663811a.source: Sometimes, due to lag, when the player reaches Farrah Cappo after finding Little Thom, the quest does not finish. Instead, the quest reverts to finding him again.
2751feb3063729c386c6dfef1d25e6c12663811a.text: 有时，由于延迟，当玩家在找到小汤姆后到达法拉·卡波时，任务并未完成。相反，任务又回到了寻找他。

b445d73eaf0e6e3154aca67e4ec9424a08bc19ed.source: Capture the portal location to close the rift that provides the demons passage from the Realm of Torment.
b445d73eaf0e6e3154aca67e4ec9424a08bc19ed.text: 占领传送门位置以关闭为恶魔提供来自折磨领域的通道的裂缝。

3a5bdd6119da6aad6dc8bcb1d707c3ffc7581bc5.source: Head towards the rift, which is located north of the cave that you defended in the preceding quest. You will notice a list of stationary Torment creatures, with three groups of patrols around it. Two of the stationary foes are Torment Claws. It is advisable to clear off other mobs around the area before you engage the foes around the rift, to give you more space.
3a5bdd6119da6aad6dc8bcb1d707c3ffc7581bc5.text: 前往裂缝，它位于你在上一个任务中保卫的洞穴的北部。你会注意到一列静止的折磨生物，周围有三组巡逻队。其中两个静止的敌人是折磨之爪。建议您在与裂缝周围的敌人交战之前先清除该区域周围的其他生物，以便为您提供更多空间。

ee1c2b345001dfef6db8cca10d1979eacfcd36ca.source: Start by pulling the patrols and taking care of them one at a time. Once the patrols are cleared, pull the stationary foes, which are not all in the same group. Once you kill the Torment Claws, be ready to retreat. When the rift starts closing, five groups of Torment creatures will spawn and charge to the rift's location in waves. It's recommended to retreat to a safe location and intercept just one or two of the groups away from the rift. Then just return and pull the remaining groups before closing the rift.
ee1c2b345001dfef6db8cca10d1979eacfcd36ca.text: 首先拉动巡逻队并一次处理一个。一旦巡逻队被清除，拉动静止的敌人，这些敌人并不都在同一组中。一旦你杀死了折磨之爪，就准备撤退。当裂缝开始关闭时，五组折磨生物将会生成并一波又一波地冲向裂缝位置。建议撤退到安全位置并拦截远离裂缝的一两个小组。然后返回并拉动剩余的小组，然后再关闭裂缝。

5f99f0b6bcdea147d3f5e5658af20dfc05dbcafa.source: If you do not have any minions or spirits that automatically attack the Torment Claws, it is possible to close the rift before the reinforcements arrive. Once the rift is closed, the quest is complete, regardless of whether the reinforcements are still alive or not.
5f99f0b6bcdea147d3f5e5658af20dfc05dbcafa.text: 如果你没有任何小兵或灵魂自动攻击折磨之爪，则可以在援军到达之前关闭裂缝。一旦裂缝闭合，任务就完成了，无论援军是否还活着。

a26bb84c2e13c0d1819545da95b142a0568e30d1.source: Kill Yorrt Strongjaw and talk to Gull Hookbeak to get this quest.
a26bb84c2e13c0d1819545da95b142a0568e30d1.text: 杀死约尔特·强颚并与海鸥钩嘴交谈即可完成此任务。

6012fef1edfbd1966e2fdd1d0d234849a2084d1e.source: Locate a powerful Yeti that Gull Hookbeak can kill to complete the Rite of Valor.
6012fef1edfbd1966e2fdd1d0d234849a2084d1e.text: 找到海鸥钩嘴可以杀死的强大雪人来完成英勇仪式。

ee9efe14c57e8332e466762d6dba0be312d3077a.source: Eliminate the Yeti without killing Yrrg Snagtooth.
ee9efe14c57e8332e466762d6dba0be312d3077a.text: 在不杀死 Yrrg Snagtooth 的情况下消灭雪人。

b9a42bdb0747fbd6cf54fa04cadbfefbc3d309fd.source: See Gull Hookbeak for your reward
b9a42bdb0747fbd6cf54fa04cadbfefbc3d309fd.text: 查看海鸥钩嘴以获得奖励

fb3b2480d4097fa0d844f1f3cb9f71c28654a0d9.source: You will find Gull Hookbeak on a small plateau/hill between the Silver Crimson Skull Coin Collector and Stolen Supplies Collector in combat with Yorrt Strongjaw. Kill Strongjaw first then speak to Gull to begin the quest. Follow the quest marker to the yeti outlined in the quest, Yrrg Snagtooth. After you have done this, kill the yetis around the boss without killing the boss. Weaken him to allow Gull to deliver the killing blow. Speak to Gull once more to accept your reward.
fb3b2480d4097fa0d844f1f3cb9f71c28654a0d9.text: 你会在银红骷髅硬币收集器和被盗补给收集器之间的一个小高原/山丘上找到海鸥钩嘴，它正在与约特·强颚战斗。首先杀死强颚，然后与海鸥交谈以开始任务。跟随任务标记找到任务中概述的雪人，Yrrg Snagtooth。完成此操作后，在不杀死 Boss 的情况下杀死 Boss 周围的雪人。削弱他，让海鸥发出致命一击。再次与海鸥交谈以接受你的奖励。

9babeec8b306a932ccb16963c93fb681fc4b3380.source: This quest is useful to farm Stolen Supplies, since it causes additional groups of Yeti to spawn.
9babeec8b306a932ccb16963c93fb681fc4b3380.text: 这个任务对于农场被盗补给品很有用，因为它会导致额外的雪人群体产生。

5160986ce87dfa2777aa42ef704bc1a9ba7ea70c.source: Be careful with henchmen and/or heroes during this quest, lest you accidentally kill Yrrg Snagtooth with AoE damage.
5160986ce87dfa2777aa42ef704bc1a9ba7ea70c.text: 在此任务中要小心追随者和/或英雄，以免你意外杀死 Yrrg Snagtooth 造成 AoE 伤害。

98004e92a088937557483c32cd27fc0c4725be95.source: You will get credit for the quest if Snagtooth dies out of compass range of the other Yeti, regardless of how he dies.
98004e92a088937557483c32cd27fc0c4725be95.text: 如果粗牙死在另一个雪人的罗盘范围之外，无论他是如何死的，你都会获得该任务的功劳。

3afda13589f0f726adac1b4de2f2046e7130da02.source: Thus, some people choose to pull the boss away from the main battle.
3afda13589f0f726adac1b4de2f2046e7130da02.text: 于是，有人选择将boss拉离主战。

360f6a3adca0ad850ff7094d6e32035f229e4c15.source: This quest is (normally) mutually exclusive with Death with Honor, depending on which boss dies first.
360f6a3adca0ad850ff7094d6e32035f229e4c15.text: 这个任务（通常）与死亡荣誉是相互排斥的，具体取决于哪个老板先死。

b49cf0ee72149bc7d2d53b5cf33b68b3eb042fe3.source: Yorrt Strongjaw's death leads to this quest.
b49cf0ee72149bc7d2d53b5cf33b68b3eb042fe3.text: 约特·强颚的死导致了这个任务。

aa7e36038676e83788d70c775e10b0d573c4ffc5.source: Gull Hookbeak's death leads to the other.
aa7e36038676e83788d70c775e10b0d573c4ffc5.text: 海鸥钩嘴的死导致了另一个问题。

ec985e4fa0378160fdc2c1f5f9bfa79a1ba8498a.source: Follow the road from Yak's Bend to Borlis Pass. Defeat all Stone Summit raiders along the road.
ec985e4fa0378160fdc2c1f5f9bfa79a1ba8498a.text: 沿着牦牛弯 (Yak's Bend) 的道路前往博利斯山口 (Borlis Pass)。击败沿途所有石峰袭击者。

c8416d77ee0f3889fed8aaa481b6352df85159b1.source: Enter Traveler's Vale and follow the quest markers along the road to Borlis Pass. At each marker, there will be a group of two or three Stone Summit dwarves who must be killed to reveal the next marker. Advance carefully, especially if you have other quests active in the area, pulling foes if necessary to avoid over-aggro. Once all nine groups have been killed, you can return to Yak's Bend to claim the reward.
c8416d77ee0f3889fed8aaa481b6352df85159b1.text: 进入旅行者之谷，沿着任务标记前往博利斯山口。在每个标记处，都会有一群两到三个石峰矮人，必须杀死他们才能显示下一个标记。小心前进，尤其是当你在该地区有其他任务活跃时，必要时拉动敌人以避免过度仇恨。一旦所有九个小组都被杀死，你就可以返回牦牛湾领取奖励。

744ddd9f16d07b5bab89f7c4c855c21264c60f5a.source: The quest Shiverpeak Stragglers will spawn a clump of about a dozen Stone Summit dwarves in the middle of this quest's path. They can be engaged with careful pulling or a strong party, but it is easiest to circle around using the eastern path and complete Shiverpeak Stragglers first, causing most of these additional foes to move south and out of the way.
744ddd9f16d07b5bab89f7c4c855c21264c60f5a.text: 任务“席瓦峰散兵游勇”将在该任务路径的中间产生一群大约有十几个石峰矮人。他们可以通过谨慎的拉扯或强大的队伍进行交战，但最容易的是使用东部路径绕圈并首先完成席瓦峰散兵游勇，导致这些额外的敌人中的大多数向南移动并让开。

d7b95324e4fd22a4fb75b7596f5f097317430b33.source: The Way is Blocked takes place at the end of this quest's path, so it can be convenient to do both quests together if you can handle the additional Snow Ettins spawned by The Way is Blocked.
d7b95324e4fd22a4fb75b7596f5f097317430b33.text: 道路受阻发生在该任务路径的末尾，因此如果您可以处理道路受阻产生的额外雪埃丁，那么可以方便地同时完成这两个任务。

d5bd4f181579d9c0aae4cd1340a3fc1cc1f07903.source: Having killed the rogue bull during A Mesmer's Burden without abandoning said quest.
d5bd4f181579d9c0aae4cd1340a3fc1cc1f07903.text: 在催眠师的负担中杀死了流氓公牛，但没有放弃上述任务。

222c968ba41a07599d1a498ba96637d86559e67b.source: Search for a source of devourer eggs in Lakeside County. Collect one devourer egg.
222c968ba41a07599d1a498ba96637d86559e67b.text: 在湖滨县寻找吞噬者蛋的来源。收集一枚吞噬者蛋。

0c428eda7c54575fdf667b76b3c576385d303875.source: Return to Old Mac for your reward.
0c428eda7c54575fdf667b76b3c576385d303875.text: 返回旧麦克以获得奖励。

cdc2e7247aa01deb2879c27161a681b6f94f0385.source: Upon accepting the quest, Old Mac will no longer walk up to Althea's stage to have a short argument with her.
cdc2e7247aa01deb2879c27161a681b6f94f0385.text: 接受任务后，老麦克将不再走到阿尔西娅的舞台上与她短暂争论。

1bf5fe18bbe5f2388fbe8bd4607f8b3172a37351.source: This quest becomes available after killing the Rogue Bull as part of A Mesmer's Burden. It turns out that the bull (named 'Bill'), was owned by Old Mac. After rezoning and approaching the Ascalon City gate, Old Mac will appear near the resurrection shrine on the left. He will walk up to Lady Althea by her stage and have a short conversation with her. He will then walk back the way he came and stand just outside the entrance to Ascalon City; he will give the quest at any time after talking to Althea.
1bf5fe18bbe5f2388fbe8bd4607f8b3172a37351.text: 作为催眠师负担的一部分，杀死流氓公牛后即可完成该任务。事实证明，这头公牛（名叫“比尔”）的主人是老麦克。重新分区并接近阿斯卡隆城门后，老麦克会出现在左边的复活神殿附近。他将走到阿尔西娅女士的舞台旁，与她进行简短的交谈。然后他会沿着来时的路走回去，站在阿斯卡隆城的入口外；他会在与Althea交谈后随时给出任务。

c1a220ce57d12ffaabad20fd5049966716fcb710.source: The best source of eggs is Duke Gaban's quest, The Egg Hunter, across the river from Ascalon City, at the Devourer Cave. You can also trade 5 Skale Fins to Brownlow just outside the entrance to Ascalon City, or 3 Dull Carapaces to Rownan in Regent Valley for an egg.
c1a220ce57d12ffaabad20fd5049966716fcb710.text: 最好的鸡蛋来源是加班公爵的任务“鸡蛋猎人”，位于阿斯卡隆城河对岸的吞噬者洞穴。您还可以将 5 个 Skale Fins 交易到 Ascalon City 入口处的 Brownlow，或者将 3 个暗甲壳交易到摄政谷的 Rownan 来换取一枚鸡蛋。

fb11e45ca938395a7aa7ab8ba89c9ad521ab894b.source: Once you have acquired an egg, return it to Old Mac to get your reward.
fb11e45ca938395a7aa7ab8ba89c9ad521ab894b.text: 获得蛋后，将其归还给 Old Mac 即可获得奖励。

e70da3247a6fcf27967b238e77e982b7572ad5ef.source: If you have someone with you who is neither a primary nor a secondary Mesmer, Old Mac doesn't reappear. While Old Mac is talking to Lady Althea (before he gives the quest) he answers Althea a few moments before she says anything.
e70da3247a6fcf27967b238e77e982b7572ad5ef.text: 如果你身边有人既不是初级幻术师也不是次级幻术师，老麦克就不会再出现。当老麦克与阿尔西娅女士交谈时（在他给出任务之前），他在阿尔西娅说话前几分钟回答了她。

3cb04bfe9299cbf41accc15e2c0800b0b41e7ba5.source: Having chosen Goren to accompany Midauha in Istan in the quest Brains or Brawn.
3cb04bfe9299cbf41accc15e2c0800b0b41e7ba5.text: 选择Goren 陪伴Midauha 前往Istan 进行Brains or Brawn 任务。

e63d0c43238793b99bc10ca2b1984fb166b32ab7.source: * Gain Norgu neither active nor completed
e63d0c43238793b99bc10ca2b1984fb166b32ab7.text: * 获得 Norgu 既不活跃也不完成

3e96023b9ea1c81dc8a8657269009ef9d98e7fa7.text: 与 Norgu 在 Jahinur 一起表演。

c3aef47bfb8a992b1e6d777aae7c125f6d860382.source: Write a short script with Norgu.
c3aef47bfb8a992b1e6d777aae7c125f6d860382.text: 和 Norgu 一起写一个简短的剧本。

c05aab3db2cbfdac09d6628d14487977bdc5aad7.source: Perform with Norgu in Pojah Estates.
c05aab3db2cbfdac09d6628d14487977bdc5aad7.text: 与 Norgu 在 Pojah Estates 一起表演。

7919c08120c597193d598bc689875d15e3d830b5.source: Protect Norgu from the dangers of Vehtendi Valley.
7919c08120c597193d598bc689875d15e3d830b5.text: 保护诺古免受维赫滕迪山谷的危险。

aeffa58f456f7799b4349de309276e961ec6d7d9.source: Destroy the heket that have overrun the performance area.

c71bf1ae0953d66f9201500baadb3bfdadc1939d.source: Register Norgu's play rights with Records Keeper Palin at the Writing Guild of Vabbi.
c71bf1ae0953d66f9201500baadb3bfdadc1939d.text: 向瓦比写作协会的记录员佩林登记诺古的游戏权利。

8fbf895022ca200bf7592c68886c90cc87da7684.source: The initial quest objective can be approached from either Honur Hill or the Kodash Bazaar. Going from Honur Hill will take you through Yahnur Market, and while this isn't an often frequented outpost, it may be worth seeing on your way through for exploration purposes. Going from the Kodash Bazaar may be easier.
8fbf895022ca200bf7592c68886c90cc87da7684.text: 最初的任务目标可以从荣誉山或科达什集市到达。从荣誉山出发，您将穿过亚努尔市场，虽然这不是一个经常光顾的前哨站，但出于探索目的，在途中可能值得一看。从 Kodash Bazaar 出发可能会更方便。

b213306e830a857ac2333acc0a4650ce26bbb2c6.source: From Honur Hill, head due south along the west side of Resplendent Makuun to arrive at Yahnur Market, then on into Vehtendi Valley. Although the first objective is due west of Yahnur Market, it will be necessary to take a route that turns south, west over the fields, then north to meet with Norgu. This area mainly has Heket, Behemoths and Kournans. The Behemoth Gravebanes act as minion masters and also inflict degeneration using hexes on the party, so kill them first if possible.
b213306e830a857ac2333acc0a4650ce26bbb2c6.text: 从荣誉山出发，沿着 Resplendent Makuun 西侧向正南行驶，到达 Yahnur 市场，然后进入 Vehtendi 山谷。虽然第一个目标位于亚努尔市场的正西，但需要走一条向南、向西越过田野的路线，然后向北与诺尔古会合。该区域主要有Heket、Behemoths和Kournans。巨兽格雷夫班恩充当随从大师，也会使用巫术对队伍造成堕落，所以如果可能的话，先杀死他们。

9574d22cc2e6d158bfa4d4481c2daabbbf9de1f2.source: Very simply, head due south from the bazaar, you will most likely encounter Kournans and some plant mobs along the way.
9574d22cc2e6d158bfa4d4481c2daabbbf9de1f2.text: 很简单，从集市向南走，沿途你很可能会遇到库南人和一些植物怪。

7823070d26e2bb06338725d0050229805079151a.source: On meeting Norgu at Jahinur (point 1 on the map), you'll get the chance to create a script via some multiple choice dialogue, then watch the audience response to his "masterpiece". After the first performance at Jahinur, you must escort Norgu north to his next engagement (at point 2), making sure he doesn't die on the way. As a level 18 mesmer, Norgu provides some assistance, casting Clumsiness, Mantra of Persistence, and Conjure Phantasm as required.
7823070d26e2bb06338725d0050229805079151a.text: 在 Jahinur（地图上的第 1 点）与 Norgu 会面时，您将有机会通过一些多项选择对话创建脚本，然后观看观众对他的“杰作”的反应。在贾希努尔的第一次表演后，你必须护送诺尔古向北前往他的下一场战斗（第 2 点），确保他不会在途中死亡。作为 18 级催眠师，诺尔古提供一些帮助，根据需要施展笨拙、坚持咒语和召唤幻象。

627194dd84adcabc63535cc00aa71c82057c1ed9.source: Once the last objective is activated, it's an easy matter of map traveling to the Kodash Bazaar and collecting your reward and a new mesmer hero.
627194dd84adcabc63535cc00aa71c82057c1ed9.text: 一旦激活了最后一个目标，就可以轻松前往 Kodash Bazaar 地图并收集奖励和新的催眠英雄。

21905b2ccbf54df70226f5bd6f5b22b01ab38ccd.source: On your way from the first play to the next engagement with the heket, the quest The Hanging Gardener can be picked up and completed soon after this quest is finished (see point 3 on the maps above).
21905b2ccbf54df70226f5bd6f5b22b01ab38ccd.text: 在你从第一次玩到下一次与 heket 交战的过程中，任务“悬挂的园丁”可以在任务完成后很快被拾起并完成（参见上面地图上的第 3 点）。

8282c29482b694a48fd27cd82860562103bb03d5.source: If you are not in a hurry to acquire Norgu, it is easier to complete Gain Norgu than this quest, since that quest only requires you to speak to Korvus. The Gain Norgu quest also awards 500 more experience than this quest.
8282c29482b694a48fd27cd82860562103bb03d5.text: 如果你不急于获得诺尔古，那么完成获得诺尔古比这个任务更容易，因为该任务只需要你与科尔乌斯交谈。 Gain Norgu 任务还比该任务奖励多 500 点经验。

45e702f6057f5bcbfac367c38e08d000440b75ab.source: Retrieve the royal scribe's papers from the Tengu in Stingray Strand.
45e702f6057f5bcbfac367c38e08d000440b75ab.text: 从黄貂鱼海滩的天狗那里取回皇家抄写员的文件。

044e25dcc1425bffe7f9e58e67b22811aad94433.source: Return the royal scribe's papers to Watchman Arad in Fishermen's Haven.
044e25dcc1425bffe7f9e58e67b22811aad94433.text: 将皇家抄写员的文件归还给渔民港的守望者阿拉德。

2a6b0a96b019f2933f3d0ec4b470359e8b7a7436.source: Retrieve the royal scribe's papers by getting them out of a chest in Stingray Strand which is surrounded by a group of Tengu; you do not have to kill the guards. You can save some time by starting from Sanctum Cay, if you have unlocked that outpost. Be prepared for Skale, Inferno Imps, and the Tengu.
2a6b0a96b019f2933f3d0ec4b470359e8b7a7436.text: 从被一群天狗包围的黄貂鱼海滩的箱子里取出皇家抄写员的文件；你不必杀死守卫。如果您已经解锁了该前哨站，那么从圣殿岛出发可以节省一些时间。为斯卡勒、地狱小鬼和天狗做好准备。

d9cce075845b1794788232e653f8e23bbe316b7d.source: Clear the Ruptured Heart in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
d9cce075845b1794788232e653f8e23bbe316b7d.text: 在困难模式下清除所有敌人的荒凉中的破碎之心。

a471533ab4c5b4af72aa9fb6c2062ed083d6926e.source: Completion of the Ruins of Morah mission will have your party ending up in the Gate of Torment. From there, entering the Vortex will bring your party to the Mouth of Torment. Exit that outpost via one of its two exits to arrive in this area.
a471533ab4c5b4af72aa9fb6c2062ed083d6926e.text: 完成莫拉废墟任务后，你的队伍就会到达折磨之门。从那里进入漩涡会将你的队伍带到折磨之口。通过两个出口之一离开该前哨即可到达该区域。

f3260e25e4b2be57c0dac3354e21dc6b38889559.source: Alternatively, travel north from the Ruins of Morah outpost. Take note that you may not be able to fully explore this area (see next section).
f3260e25e4b2be57c0dac3354e21dc6b38889559.text: 或者，从莫拉废墟前哨站向北行驶。请注意，您可能无法完全探索该区域（请参阅下一节）。

58d3883a3d1940a1f6f09a68bb2634b95c7b9614.source: After completing the quest Pilgrimage, Allura still continues to spawn at the Bleached Bones. However, right after you trigger her spawn, she will die (or unspawn).
58d3883a3d1940a1f6f09a68bb2634b95c7b9614.text: 完成朝圣任务后，阿尤拉仍然继续在漂白骨头处生成。然而，在你触发她的重生后，她就会死亡（或不重生）。

b46c4448bb3ce9b17401a27eb2fbcbac26b60a84.source: The resurrection shrine with the statue of Lyssa in the middle of the northern sandy area does not have a bounty NPC.
b46c4448bb3ce9b17401a27eb2fbcbac26b60a84.text: 北部沙地中部有莱莎雕像的复活神社没有赏金NPC。

4b2f76515d86ca17849ca45c9330161c9f091ea4.source: If you are entering from the northeastern exit of the Mouth of Torment, there are two of either Shambling Mesas or Sandstorm Crags extremely close to where your party starts from. A fight could take place immediately after you load.
4b2f76515d86ca17849ca45c9330161c9f091ea4.text: 如果你从痛苦之口的东北出口进入，有两个蹒跚台地或沙暴峭壁离你的队伍出发地非常近。加载后可能会立即发生战斗。

002767df697774f05502ed8df99a98314900c238.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.4% to the Elonian Cartographer title track (with possibly another .1% from scraping the Mouth of Torment).
002767df697774f05502ed8df99a98314900c238.text: 对这一区域的完整探索为《Elonian Cartographer》主打歌贡献了约 2.4%（可能还有 0.1% 来自刮取折磨之口）。

7d702fb07afa108dfff3aacdc257f06c9611da49.source: The central circular area has several closely placed groups of Undead and Margonites. Watching their patrol routes and careful pulling is recommended.
7d702fb07afa108dfff3aacdc257f06c9611da49.text: 中央圆形区域有几组紧密排列的亡灵和玛贡尼特。建议观察他们的巡逻路线并小心拉动。

259f8a41378d102cef5c00cfbc54e7f924ec592c.source: The sandy area to the north can be cleared inside a Junundu wurm, although it is mostly sparsely populated.
259f8a41378d102cef5c00cfbc54e7f924ec592c.text: 北部的沙地可以在朱南杜亚龙内清理，尽管那里大多人烟稀少。

1e361255b772231a2393857ff127bc6927276c8d.source: Clear the Scar in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
1e361255b772231a2393857ff127bc6927276c8d.text: 在困难模式下清除水晶沙漠中所有敌人的伤痕。

d1bc22f81d9d1f5f1189efda750443cb5a099496.source: Consider acquiring the quests for The Arid Sea (three days earlier) and Skyward Reach (the prior quest in cycle), since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.
d1bc22f81d9d1f5f1189efda750443cb5a099496.text: 考虑获取干旱之海（三天前）和天空到达（循环中的先前任务）的任务，因为你可以通过被遗忘的守护者带领八人队伍连续征服所有三个区域。

4d99b086061e7e7452b7d35a1151a4b541621493.source: The southern half of the sandy dune area includes groups of hidden scarabs, mostly burrowed nearby the various Dune Burrowers.
4d99b086061e7e7452b7d35a1151a4b541621493.text: 沙丘地区的南半部有一群隐藏的圣甲虫，它们大多在各种沙丘洞穴附近挖洞。

7c83336fcc5a4c0a7268b133377d8d4d4a3d0f95.source: The northern half of the zone has a few hidden pairs of devourers.
7c83336fcc5a4c0a7268b133377d8d4d4a3d0f95.text: 该区域的北半部有几对隐藏的吞噬者。

d0bd6dbbe87140dfaa660b22754bfa0c34907670.source: There is a hidden Sand Wurm at a choke-point in the northeastern part of the area.
d0bd6dbbe87140dfaa660b22754bfa0c34907670.text: 在该地区东北部的一个咽喉要道处有一只隐藏的沙亚龙。

497963f0e86778b18fd4f9be74c72b491aaf6286.source: The hydras travel fast; watch for their patrols when fighting near them.
497963f0e86778b18fd4f9be74c72b491aaf6286.text: 九头蛇移动速度很快；在他们附近战斗时要注意他们的巡逻。

6a6fb894f7e3ef83d4ea4fb7ebbff8a71652a7af.source: If you have a caster or ranged team, you can snipe quite a few Losaru centaurs and Enchanted weapons from cliffs where melee enemies can't reach you.
6a6fb894f7e3ef83d4ea4fb7ebbff8a71652a7af.text: 如果你有一个施法者或远程团队，你可以从悬崖上狙击相当多的洛萨鲁半人马和魔法武器，而近战敌人无法到达你。

6883ea86c34ba37edadc2d5be016edb5e25c14ce.source: After the Hydra boss performs one circuit of the patrol loop, it becomes stationary by a cliff.
6883ea86c34ba37edadc2d5be016edb5e25c14ce.text: 九头蛇 Boss 执行完一圈巡逻后，就会在悬崖边静止不动。

42fb6a593f18faf006b42f4f9b7bb8ce9f53c423.source: Enter the tunnels and rendezvous with Devona. (first time only)
42fb6a593f18faf006b42f4f9b7bb8ce9f53c423.text: 进入隧道并与德沃娜会合。 （仅限第一次）

2bcd09e92d06feb12dcd749980afdf8b53244dd3.source: Enter the tunnels. (when repeating the quest)

d15f040873552dc02178fa972518907d823784be.source: Secure the key and and gain access to the lower level.
d15f040873552dc02178fa972518907d823784be.text: 确保钥匙安全并进入下层。

9fb2299e680645c7223ed1e96791195eb03afd51.source: Find a way through the crystal gate.
9fb2299e680645c7223ed1e96791195eb03afd51.text: 找到一条穿过水晶门的路。

abdd0a26240c125e5fb6339ac32208d6eebe74fd.source: Exit the tunnels and report to Devona in Piken Square.
abdd0a26240c125e5fb6339ac32208d6eebe74fd.text: 退出隧道并向皮肯广场的德沃娜报到。

f01e6fa62a5a06143b57a4f2bf83f285dd87cc6a.source: Devona joins your party (first time only)
f01e6fa62a5a06143b57a4f2bf83f285dd87cc6a.text: Devona 加入你的队伍（仅限第一次）

470bd78f6fd8bc5f1a2c5a8527a61a2b91087cae.source: Talk to Palawa Joko. Find out how he moved his forces into Vabbi so easily.
470bd78f6fd8bc5f1a2c5a8527a61a2b91087cae.text: 与帕拉瓦·乔科交谈。了解他如何如此轻松地将部队转移到瓦比。

29ccffc58ee43648bafba2551e2772d6daeb8bd2.text: 找到帕拉瓦·约科的权杖。

76b5a08fb14a64a564b30baf0c4434117f4790b1.source: Return the scepter to Palawa Joko.
76b5a08fb14a64a564b30baf0c4434117f4790b1.text: 将权杖归还给帕拉瓦·乔科。

bcf2c7f7dbc88d534d6675ab8e30328684735a1d.source: Find the hidden passage to Vabbi.
bcf2c7f7dbc88d534d6675ab8e30328684735a1d.text: 找到通往瓦比的隐藏通道。

1405e6a944f4c714232649dac5fbb3377d78d0bd.source: Travel to the Bone Palace and speak to Palawa, who requires you to complete a small task before he spills the beans: retrieve his scepter from a former general in the Alkali Pan.
1405e6a944f4c714232649dac5fbb3377d78d0bd.text: 前往骨宫并与帕拉瓦交谈，他要求你在他泄露秘密之前完成一项小任务：从碱锅的前将军那里取回他的权杖。

30e590d64775534ec5d1ef37612c380616525bae.source: After killing the general, return the scepter to Palawa, who will tell you about his secret passage, without providing its exact location in Joko's Domain: in a pass between Joko's Domain and Vehjin Mines. Once you approach the entrance to the Basalt Grotto, your quest log will update; alternatively, if you already have the outpost unlocked, you can map travel there and exit into Joko's Domain.
30e590d64775534ec5d1ef37612c380616525bae.text: 杀死将军后，将权杖归还给帕拉瓦，帕拉瓦会告诉你他的秘密通道，但不会提供其在约科领地的确切位置：在约科领地和维金矿之间的通道中。一旦您接近玄武岩洞的入口，您的任务日志就会更新；或者，如果您已经解锁了前哨站，您可以绘制那里的旅行地图并退出进入乔科的领地。

808a0453445f6b4b3cc4b701b73800bd54f868ee.source: The Rebellious General is just south of Ruins of Morah, starting there will make the run shorter but you will have to fight two groups before you can enter a Junundu.
808a0453445f6b4b3cc4b701b73800bd54f868ee.text: 叛逆将军就在莫拉废墟的南面，从那里出发会缩短行程，但你必须先与两个队伍战斗才能进入朱南杜。

6240666914c0ccb43e984264d4378f97d20c0c87.source: Collect [3...0] more Jade Brotherhood guild capes.
6240666914c0ccb43e984264d4378f97d20c0c87.text: 收集 [3...0] 更多翡翠兄弟会斗篷。

8c72979b14f9a483b2ddb7341654d6c89c5a1a1b.source: Return the 3 Jade Brotherhood guild capes to Bujo.
8c72979b14f9a483b2ddb7341654d6c89c5a1a1b.text: 将 3 件翡翠兄弟会斗篷归还给布乔。

ad3ece05cb497295c505a2b933942fad92d1b6ac.source: After accepting the quest reward, all the Am Fah in Wajjun Bazaar will be allies until you take either Refuse to Drink or Drink from the Chalice of Corruption. This also means that they will not ambush parties out near the areas closer to Nahpui Quarter. Because of this, it may be advantageous to hold off on completing this until you finish your quests in The Undercity and/or vanquish Wajjun Bazaar. The exceptions to this are the quests Captured, The Xunlai Agent, Deactivating P.O.X., and Street Justice. The Am Fah in the immediate area will still be hostile.
ad3ece05cb497295c505a2b933942fad92d1b6ac.text: 接受任务奖励后，Wajjun Bazaar 中的所有 Am Fah 都将成为盟友，直到您获得“拒绝饮酒”或“从腐败圣杯中饮酒”。这也意味着他们不会在靠近纳普伊区的地区伏击部队。因此，推迟完成此任务直到完成幽暗城的任务和/或征服 Wajjun Bazaar 可能是有利的。任务“捕获”、“寻来特工”、“停用 P.O.X.”和“街头正义”是例外。附近地区的 Am Fah 仍然充满敌意。

2b96d60f58fa167ec2aad65a20fe9fb51bf70a28.source: Simply map travel to The Marketplace and exit through the Wajjun Bazaar portal. Kill the 3 Jade Brotherhood Knights immediately outside and pick up the Jade Brotherhood Guild Capes. Map travel back to Kaineng Center to receive your reward.
2b96d60f58fa167ec2aad65a20fe9fb51bf70a28.text: 只需绘制前往 The Marketplace 的旅行地图，然后通过 Wajjun Bazaar 门户退出即可。立即杀死外面的 3 个翡翠兄弟会骑士并捡起翡翠兄弟会斗篷。地图返回凯能中心以获得奖励。

db813645961a0f2a3c8788319c3f01e5b5e7018a.source: The quest marker will point you to the island at Wajjun Bazaar.
db813645961a0f2a3c8788319c3f01e5b5e7018a.text: 任务标记将引导您前往 Wajjun Bazaar 的岛屿。

19babb8518e5be658feb65af56f36eb0dcb26926.source: Players who complete this quest will not be able to capture Quivering Blade until the rest of the quest chain is complete, since Sun, the Quivering won't spawn.
19babb8518e5be658feb65af56f36eb0dcb26926.text: 完成此任务的玩家将无法捕获颤抖之刃，直到任务链的其余部分完成，因为从太阳开始，颤抖之刃不会生成。

2a00ba97ddce20c2c1060cb9eb1d36a5a69cfccb.source: Follow Hanbahd the Anchorite to the place where he hid the Lost Scriptures.
2a00ba97ddce20c2c1060cb9eb1d36a5a69cfccb.text: 跟随隐士汉巴德前往他隐藏失落经文的地方。

84c43b3b87bd4588dc4cb1bb31bcbb65e867431e.source: Eliminate the Margonites trying to steal the Lost Scriptures. Hanbahd must survive.
84c43b3b87bd4588dc4cb1bb31bcbb65e867431e.text: 消灭试图窃取失落经文的玛贡派。汉巴德必须生存。

e94b01db736138ca051046d1029404556813b2d2.source: Bring the Lost Scriptures to Kachok.
e94b01db736138ca051046d1029404556813b2d2.text: 将失落的经文带给卡乔克。

e720e98c0a82cda6db6b50fd7fcd7adb85e4501f.source: Before accepting this quest it may be helpful to kill some of the wandering mobs nearby, since Hanbahd will move off very quickly when the quest is accepted and will not stand around waiting for the party.
e720e98c0a82cda6db6b50fd7fcd7adb85e4501f.text: 在接受这个任务之前，杀死附近的一些游荡的小怪可能会有所帮助，因为当任务被接受时，汉巴德会很快离开，并且不会站在那里等待队伍。

09b4eb965fd26aef44e1244045471d96eeb2439f.source: Hanbahd will run off to an enclosed area a little to the west of his starting point, where the Lost Scriptures bundle item will appear when he arrives. This is also the trigger for several waves of Margonites to launch an attack on the party and Hanbahd.
09b4eb965fd26aef44e1244045471d96eeb2439f.text: 汉巴德将跑到起点以西一点的封闭区域，当他到达时，失落的经文捆绑包物品将会出现。这也是数波玛贡派向本党和汉巴德发起攻击的触发因素。

b3ae2de2a7748c884039f78613aaa7edb5cf6c23.source: When all the Margonites have been killed, pick up the Lost Scriptures and carry them back to Kachok, who is waiting in the library in the Halls of Chokhin, to collect your reward. Hanbahd will return to his original spot and you no longer need to defend him.
b3ae2de2a7748c884039f78613aaa7edb5cf6c23.text: 当所有玛贡人都被杀死后，捡起失落的经文并将它们带回给在乔欣大厅图书馆里等待的卡乔克领取奖励。汉巴德将回到原来的位置，你不再需要防守他。

7183fd0baa3147b58f3deb784e51d23f3dd05c0e.source: Hanbahd is easy to protect, since he stands back in a corner away from the Margonites, the party simply has to ensure they stand forward of him to intercept the attacking creatures.
7183fd0baa3147b58f3deb784e51d23f3dd05c0e.text: 汉巴德很容易保护，因为他站在远离玛贡尼特的角落里，队伍只需确保他们站在他前面就能拦截攻击的生物。

e9adddc9db3b49aaef6fd6aef1804784e702fdb7.source: Find Ahmtur the Mighty and the other soldiers in the Mirror of Lyss.
e9adddc9db3b49aaef6fd6aef1804784e702fdb7.text: 在里斯之镜中找到强大的阿姆图尔和其他士兵。

e5d2b77f7f2b8043a1e98f3e07cb3a1306fce9e3.source: Search for and rescue Nightfall survivors in the ruins of the Mirror of Lyss and the surrounding area. [3...0] of 3 survivor groups remain.
e5d2b77f7f2b8043a1e98f3e07cb3a1306fce9e3.text: 在利斯之镜及周边地区的废墟中搜寻并营救夜幕降临的幸存者。 3 个幸存者群体中的 [3...0] 仍然存在。

96040a2674a20b32d98799bdae82233cedc2a483.source: Escort Priest Tuwahan to the safety of the Kodash Bazaar.
96040a2674a20b32d98799bdae82233cedc2a483.text: 护送图瓦汉牧师前往科达什集市的安全地带。

b5bb88e4055760fc1cb9c50bae088fe623703295.source: Shuttle the family to the protection of the Kodash Bazaar.
b5bb88e4055760fc1cb9c50bae088fe623703295.text: 将家人送往 Kodash Bazaar 的保护地。

5751ae3ffe222309922932abde059b5e7b9add22.source: Help the students reach the refuge of the Kodash Bazaar.
5751ae3ffe222309922932abde059b5e7b9add22.text: 帮助学生们到达科达什集市的避难所。

2f7af786e14a07950c310aa77ffbdee66cf0cfab.source: These do not spawn if this quest is active:
2f7af786e14a07950c310aa77ffbdee66cf0cfab.text: 如果此任务处于活动状态，则不会生成这些：

0dbc229a4b77c5a685e4ac519de8c68e80aca7a8.source: The bosses Shezel Slowreaper and Yammiron, Ether Lord
0dbc229a4b77c5a685e4ac519de8c68e80aca7a8.text: 首领谢泽尔·慢收割者和亚米隆，以太领主

a5fe82ed2d7f2796575421d90b3f5b28f9481f66.source: Roaring Ethers and Ruby Djinns, which makes vanquishing easier since they are difficult to kill.
a5fe82ed2d7f2796575421d90b3f5b28f9481f66.text: 咆哮以太和红宝石魔灵，这使得征服它们变得更容易，因为它们很难被杀死。

e103f24e410a16a4734e835b8c8176e0be753f9c.source: Start from Dzagonur Bastion, and meet Prince Ahmtur and his guards just outside in the Mirror of Lyss. After speaking to Prince Ahmtur, a Vabbi Guard Captain and 4 Vabbi Guards will join your party to assist in the search for survivors. Do not map travel to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh, if so, the quest will not complete properly.
e103f24e410a16a4734e835b8c8176e0be753f9c.text: 从扎古努尔堡垒出发，在里斯之镜外面与阿姆图尔王子和他的卫兵会面。与阿姆图尔王子交谈后，一名瓦比卫队队长和 4 名瓦比卫兵将加入你的队伍，协助寻找幸存者。不要将旅行映射到Sebelkeh 大庭院，如果是这样，任务将无法正确完成。

ecdf1177f28ab74b05dea6965a5b0740a4dc4a01.source: From here, it is a case of following the quest pointer to each of the 3 groups, and defeating any hostile groups encountered along the way. Note that the groups can be saved in any order, not necessarily the order listed in the objectives.
ecdf1177f28ab74b05dea6965a5b0740a4dc4a01.text: 从这里开始，就是跟随任务指针到达 3 个小组中的每一个，并击败沿途遇到的任何敌对小组。请注意，组可以按任何顺序保存，不一定是目标中列出的顺序。

d38e3c88361bcfcfcade0134232704fbb32d8319.source: Survivors can be blocked by NPCs such as spirits, so ensure the survivors continue to follow or you may need to backtrack to collect them.
d38e3c88361bcfcfcade0134232704fbb32d8319.text: 幸存者可能会被灵魂等 NPC 阻挡，因此请确保幸存者继续跟随，否则您可能需要原路返回才能收集他们。

433097e813512114b6a6533b86e673094e301811.source: At each survivor group, there will be 3-4 Margonite groups patrolling nearby, so careful pulling of each group is required.
433097e813512114b6a6533b86e673094e301811.text: 每个幸存者小组附近都会有3-4个玛贡尼特小组巡逻，因此需要小心地拉动每个小组。

77a020607e7904cd00c691be86659af7ec3fbde6.source: On arrival at the Kodash Bazaar, walk up to the entrance, but do not walk in (or leave the area) until the quest updates, otherwise the quest will not complete properly. The quest updates when Talgun, Priest Tuwahan, and Belanu reach the final quest pointer.
77a020607e7904cd00c691be86659af7ec3fbde6.text: 到达 Kodash Bazaar 后，走到入口处，但在任务更新之前不要走进（或离开该区域），否则任务将无法正常完成。当塔尔根、牧师图瓦汉和贝拉努到达最终任务指针时，任务就会更新。

52756cc476c5c8ea7f226bf0db8382bb3f258449.source: The final dialogue with the family (Belanu, Charmah, and Kimab) doesn't always trigger. Try to have them arrive at the location at the same time to make it trigger.
52756cc476c5c8ea7f226bf0db8382bb3f258449.text: 与家人（Belanu、Charmah 和 Kimab）的最后对话并不总是会触发。尝试让他们同时到达该位置以使其触发。

320f6a8a53ddba12a1c5d5c1a015a67c95551aa4.source: The amount of chests is reduced while this quest is active.
320f6a8a53ddba12a1c5d5c1a015a67c95551aa4.text: 当此任务处于活动状态时，箱子的数量会减少。

6b351a6777379e3cbde4cca13219938df084facf.source: The survivor groups follow the party around, but do not join as allies, so they are not attacked by hostile groups (except for any accidental AoE effects targeted on the party members).
6b351a6777379e3cbde4cca13219938df084facf.text: 幸存者团体跟随队伍，但不作为盟友加入，因此他们不会受到敌对团体的攻击（除了任何针对队伍成员的意外 AoE 效果）。

7b9b2c5abc4a48a059d9692394a6375ade60d09e.source: The survivor groups move slowly and so care should be taken that they do not get stuck on any objects - all of the survivors are required to complete the quest.
7b9b2c5abc4a48a059d9692394a6375ade60d09e.text: 幸存者群体移动缓慢，因此应注意不要卡在任何物体上 - 所有幸存者都需要完成任务。

4eece800a30669b82b2ee6f04699b05f2d1531cb.source: It isn't necessary to use the Vabbi Guards, so you may start from Kodash Bazaar if you wish (i.e. you could clear the quest path of foes before talking to Ahmtur the Mighty).
4eece800a30669b82b2ee6f04699b05f2d1531cb.text: 没有必要使用瓦比守卫，所以如果你愿意，你可以从科达什集市开始（即你可以在与强大的阿姆图尔交谈之前清除敌人的任务路径）。

fd2a2b8e3d9ae77d3d6f427a8598812075314fd2.source: Since the guards follow the party but not your commands, they may need to be led towards any hostile groups that you are attacking. This can be a problem for solo (with henchmen) players who use ranged attacks and skills, since you may have to move into close aggro range to ensure the guards start to attack.
fd2a2b8e3d9ae77d3d6f427a8598812075314fd2.text: 由于守卫听从队伍而不是你的命令，因此他们可能需要被引导去对付你正在攻击的任何敌对团体。对于使用远程攻击和技能的单人（与追随者）玩家来说，这可能是一个问题，因为你可能必须进入近距离仇恨范围以确保守卫开始攻击。

81d876d2d47fa1fb3fcd28b014c986d3b00cf91e.source: Priest Tuwahan from this quest is quite close to Hanbahd from The Madness of Prophecy quest, and since you will have 5 guard NPCs to assist you, that quest can also be completed very easily while doing this one.
81d876d2d47fa1fb3fcd28b014c986d3b00cf91e.text: 此任务中的牧师图瓦汉与疯狂预言任务中的汉巴德非常接近，并且由于你将有 5 个守卫 NPC 来协助你，因此在执行此任务时也可以轻松完成该任务。

0bd5b8526ef205ef77c1abdeb6fa9f98228d0040.source: If you die and resurrect via a shrine, the survivors you have gathered will rejoin your party by running towards you from your previous point of death.
0bd5b8526ef205ef77c1abdeb6fa9f98228d0040.text: 如果你死了并通过神殿复活，你聚集的幸存者将从你之前的死亡点跑向你，重新加入你的队伍。

1ca9f26cb845b9a6eceeee13f07a7dec812de9a9.source: Travel to the secret location of the Shadow Blades' meeting. Avoid being spotted.
1ca9f26cb845b9a6eceeee13f07a7dec812de9a9.text: 前往暗影之刃会议的秘密地点。避免被发现。

2270fae6e6a5b52bfce4fc302e9be8d5656d685d.source: Eavesdrop on the Shadow Blades' meeting. Remain hidden.
2270fae6e6a5b52bfce4fc302e9be8d5656d685d.text: 偷听暗影之刃的会议。保持隐藏。

5bedc846e31abe895c90f2e475881cad87da35e1.source: Start from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), enter The Undercity. Proceed across the bridge towards the quest marker, killing the single mob of afflicted in your path. Flag any heroes or henchmen at that spot, since any rogue spirits, minions or summons will cause the quest to fail.
5bedc846e31abe895c90f2e475881cad87da35e1.text: 从维祖纳广场（当地街区）出发，进入幽暗城。穿过桥前往任务标记，杀死路上的单个受折磨的暴民。在该地点标记任何英雄或追随者，因为任何盗贼灵魂、爪牙或召唤物都会导致任务失败。

5840224361a97a135b93966292752409e152b829.source: Walk slowly north up the corridor that links to the shadow blades' meeting spot. Keep going until the quest updates and remain there until you you see the line, "May your blades guide you to the hearts of your enemies". Wait until the quest log updates and then you can map out.
5840224361a97a135b93966292752409e152b829.text: 沿着连接暗影之刃交汇点的走廊慢慢向北走。继续前进，直到任务更新，并停留在那里，直到您看到一行“愿您的刀片引导您到达敌人的心脏”。等到任务日志更新后你就可以绘制地图了。

4594016246a7b32a64b0f669b404c6505dc3b95a.source: Alternatively, you can flag a hero to the corner just east of the meeting spot, after removing their ability to aggro foes (set their AI to avoid combat, disable any damage skills, and remove their weapon).
4594016246a7b32a64b0f669b404c6505dc3b95a.text: 或者，你可以在移除英雄仇恨敌人的能力后将其标记到集合地点东边的角落（将他们的AI设置为避免战斗，禁用任何伤害技能，并移除他们的武器）。

32b790d9a0eca56f05afa05d52995fe154a0d347.source: Non-Canthan characters can head north from The Marketplace, killing the Am Fah in the way while heading South West, eventually proceeding down a ramp into the Undercity.
32b790d9a0eca56f05afa05d52995fe154a0d347.text: 非凯珊角色可以从市场向北前进，在向西南方向前进时杀死途中的阿姆法赫，最终沿着坡道进入幽暗城。

e903983650b8f233666d6056469886c66ed8dd74.source: It is also possible to just do the The Challenge quest and get the quest completed by accident. Killing Tae Xang counts for both quests.
e903983650b8f233666d6056469886c66ed8dd74.text: 也有可能只做挑战任务并意外完成任务。杀死泰翔对于这两个任务都有效。

6d8c59161389927793b24b8f6a4f31ae3723d41f.source: Keep the Margonite Portal Mages from summoning enough demons and Margonites to overwhelm the area.
6d8c59161389927793b24b8f6a4f31ae3723d41f.text: 阻止玛贡尼特传送法师召唤足够多的恶魔和玛贡尼特来淹没该地区。

639c845291b90cb2008a196b67b39ddde224fa6f.source: Defeat the creatures guarding the Torment rifts to increase your score.
639c845291b90cb2008a196b67b39ddde224fa6f.text: 击败守卫折磨裂缝的生物来增加你的分数。

5d645c574f2ffe0ca363169e2252bea515dd328a.source: Defeat the Margonite Portal Mages to close the rift and earn a bonus score!
5d645c574f2ffe0ca363169e2252bea515dd328a.text: 击败玛贡尼特传送门法师以关闭裂痕并获得奖励分数！

ca789d32743741ed38d80908168beda3120ac5d4.source: Each party member has a random chance to obtain Mysterious Armor Pieces whenever a Margonite Portal Mage is killed. Like other armor pieces given in other Nightfall challenge missions, they do not drop on the ground; they are automatically placed in the player's inventory. These pieces can be used to upgrade the visual appearance of certain hero armor to Mysterious armor. This upgrade is available for Norgu, Goren, General Morgahn, Zenmai, and Olias. You also gain Lightbringer points if you achieve a daily, monthly or quarterly best score similar to the gold bonus.
ca789d32743741ed38d80908168beda3120ac5d4.text: 每当玛贡尼特传送门法师被杀死时，每个队伍成员都有随机机会获得神秘盔甲碎片。与其他黄昏挑战任务中提供的其他盔甲一样，它们不会掉落在地上；它们会自动放置在玩家的库存中。这些部件可用于将某些英雄盔甲的视觉外观升级为神秘盔甲。此升级适用于 Norgu、Goren、General Morgan、Zenmai 和 Olias。如果您达到每日、每月或每季度的最佳分数（类似于黄金奖励），您还将获得光明使者积分。

747e012be320068aab32a9c363348cb2eda75044.source: Use the Mission Map (default hotkey U) to see all of the rifts and their current states. Gray rifts are inactive and have no units there. Red rifts are active and contributing to the rift progress. Use this information to save as much time as possible when moving between rifts.
747e012be320068aab32a9c363348cb2eda75044.text: 使用任务地图（默认热键 U）查看所有裂痕及其当前状态。灰色裂隙处于非活动状态，并且那里没有单位。红色裂痕活跃并促进裂痕进展。在裂缝之间移动时，使用此信息可以节省尽可能多的时间。

fb8a57626beb502c07137779f1d0d70f2fb37924.source: Once the party zones in, there is a one minute countdown before the mission begins. Because not all the rifts are visible in the Mission Map to start, use this time to explore to the north and reveal the last three rifts.
fb8a57626beb502c07137779f1d0d70f2fb37924.text: 一旦队伍进入区域，任务开始前会有一分钟的倒计时。因为并不是所有的裂痕都在任务地图中可见，所以利用这段时间向北探索并揭示最后三个裂痕。

f0fa979596d94991cf7b60284010b90d94a37eb9.source: Bringing Fall Back to move between rifts can save precious time.
f0fa979596d94991cf7b60284010b90d94a37eb9.text: 让堕落者在裂缝之间移动可以节省宝贵的时间。

e77b4a5fd800a44a0956dcaca24fe3d5f64075ae.source: The portal mages are powerful air elementalists. Their Invoke Lightning can wreak havoc on unprepared groups. There are a few steps teams can take to prevent wipes:
e77b4a5fd800a44a0956dcaca24fe3d5f64075ae.text: 传送门法师是强大的空气元素师。他们的召唤闪电会对毫无准备的团体造成严重破坏。团队可以采取一些步骤来防止擦除：

19e5779623e116bc16987555af8b3cb0b103e447.source: Bring skills that increase armor against elemental or lightning damage (Mantra of Lightning, Ward Against Elements).
19e5779623e116bc16987555af8b3cb0b103e447.text: 带来可以增加防御元素或闪电伤害护甲的技能（闪电咒、元素防御）。

21296da862a2d6b7f98f84bf0cfa0e8cbbb8175e.source: It is highly recommended for monks to bring a form of damage mitigation, like Protective Spirit or Spirit Bond. Remember to preprot.
21296da862a2d6b7f98f84bf0cfa0e8cbbb8175e.text: 强烈建议僧侣携带一种减轻伤害的形式，例如保护精神或精神纽带。记住要预先保护。

13a0268db08979c82afa31ce61ad48258c9933bb.source: When engaging a portal mage, spread out so that the mage's Invoke Lightning will only damage one team member.
13a0268db08979c82afa31ce61ad48258c9933bb.text: 当与传送门法师交战时，分散开，以便法师的召唤闪电只会伤害一名团队成员。

908d5255f2acfc36c20f3a0b7fdee3fe043878e8.source: Rangers and Mesmers should bring interrupts. Interrupting Invoke Lightning is the best way to prevent damage.
908d5255f2acfc36c20f3a0b7fdee3fe043878e8.text: 游骑兵和催眠师应该带来干扰。中断调用闪电是防止损坏的最佳方法。

1ea486698da4b4f6c8618086a7f27b37cb1a7dda.source: While only the portal mage needs to be killed to close a rift, it is advisable to kill the surrounding creatures as well. This is because the monster would otherwise still be present should the rift reopen, leaving higher numbers of monsters near the next portal mage.
1ea486698da4b4f6c8618086a7f27b37cb1a7dda.text: 虽然只需要杀死传送门法师来关闭裂缝，但建议也杀死周围的生物。这是因为如果裂缝重新打开，怪物仍然会存在，从而在下一个传送门法师附近留下更多的怪物。

fffee815abb1689b88fa1a65a50a46a687005413.source: After clearing a rift, move away from it as quickly as possible. This is imperative because the rift may reopen while you are engaging a nearby rift, causing potential aggro problems from multiple monster groups.
fffee815abb1689b88fa1a65a50a46a687005413.text: 清除裂痕后，尽快离开裂痕。这是必要的，因为当你与附近的裂缝交战时，裂缝可能会重新打开，从而导致多个怪物群潜在的仇恨问题。

80c1e97655e106df021145f6a032c83325fe5cb9.source: The portal mage is not in the same group as the creatures guarding it, so if possible, pull the surrounding creatures before engaging the mage.
80c1e97655e106df021145f6a032c83325fe5cb9.text: 传送门法师与守卫它的生物不在同一组中，因此如果可能的话，在与法师交战之前拉动周围的生物。

a2246ba3365b9f2a8f9c7a3a98f876d7ce9f1e52.source: The portal mage is a boss giving a +2% morale boost when killed, so Resurrection Signets will be recharged frequently and provide a very effective resurrection skill. Skills that recharge slowly will also be ready for use after killing a portal mage due to the morale boost.
a2246ba3365b9f2a8f9c7a3a98f876d7ce9f1e52.text: 传送门法师是一个boss，被杀时士气提升+2%，因此复活徽记会经常充电，并提供非常有效的复活技能。由于士气提升，杀死传送门法师后，缓慢充能的技能也将可以使用。

dd3486318482e9dcdc7391766d77502df9a5f2b3.source: Like most other Challenge Missions, monsters in this mission do not drop loot.
dd3486318482e9dcdc7391766d77502df9a5f2b3.text: 与大多数其他挑战任务一样，此任务中的怪物不会掉落战利品。

8a8b69ec3c931a05c085c5558577423e29ded875.source: You can reach the Shadow Nexus through an east exit in Gate of Torment.
8a8b69ec3c931a05c085c5558577423e29ded875.text: 你可以通过折磨之门的东出口到达暗影枢纽。

320dcfa65b8609f7a2440f2f51ed2b4b1c83a6aa.source: Clear the Shattered Ravines in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
320dcfa65b8609f7a2440f2f51ed2b4b1c83a6aa.text: 在困难模式下清除所有敌人荒凉之地的破碎峡谷。

9607d7e2f9f96bff473bf2753f02ad8f31d5bc9f.source: While doing the quest Horde of Darkness, players will most likely enter from Joko's Domain to the south. Lair of the Forgotten (towards the north) provides the most convenient outpost for future travel to this area.
9607d7e2f9f96bff473bf2753f02ad8f31d5bc9f.text: 在进行黑暗部落任务时，玩家很可能会从约科的领地向南进入。被遗忘者的巢穴（朝北）为未来前往该地区的旅行提供了最方便的前哨基地。

e0b1562529dfcb1160195a53957168345a4d6356.source: There are three ranger bosses in this area, all of them can be attacked while inside a Junundu. It may be a good idea to bring three Signets of Capture and get them all. Take note to put those signets in skill slots that do not prevent the most important Junundu skills.
e0b1562529dfcb1160195a53957168345a4d6356.text: 该区域有 3 个游侠 Boss，他们都可以在 Junundu 内受到攻击。带上三个捕获徽记并全部获得可能是个好主意。请注意，将这些图章放在不会妨碍最重要的 Junundu 技能的技能槽中。

c8f19620ce5f0fc5adf7e257bc72ea9624498448.source: With quests you can reach just over 400 foes.
c8f19620ce5f0fc5adf7e257bc72ea9624498448.text: 通过任务，你可以接触到 400 多个敌人。

ba3c1c2fc8836fb94c81b6ee007e62e472edb609.source: With the exception of the rocky areas to the northwest and southeast, most of the area can be vanquished while inside a Junundu.
ba3c1c2fc8836fb94c81b6ee007e62e472edb609.text: 除了西北和东南部的岩石区域外，大部分区域都可以在朱南杜内被征服。

cc9071a825ce8d9d555cf76ea1e8ae81b27acb34.source: Watch out for hidden insect groups in the eastern portions and be careful of getting swarmed by two or more groups.
cc9071a825ce8d9d555cf76ea1e8ae81b27acb34.text: 留意东部隐藏的昆虫群，并小心被两个或更多的昆虫群包围。

fdf364fc79517850333b820607450276ef8893ce.source: Active quests in this area increases the number of Margonite groups.
fdf364fc79517850333b820607450276ef8893ce.text: 该区域的活跃任务会增加玛贡尼特群体的数量。

cd3dd9dd9ad9897a028e413c96156748ccb63082.source: Tell Theatre Manager Daudi that the prince wants another play to soothe his raging heart. And he wants one now!
cd3dd9dd9ad9897a028e413c96156748ccb63082.text: 告诉剧院经理达迪，王子想要另一场演出来安抚他汹涌的心。他现在就想要一个！

4e52815aa4e9ab13ef512a6bc1fa8da098622f23.source: Find a playwright to pen a new script for the prince to enjoy.
4e52815aa4e9ab13ef512a6bc1fa8da098622f23.text: 找一位剧作家写一个新剧本给王子欣赏。

381c4d4cea15772644fcc9ec168f0015c790b29c.source: Find Sijo and convince him to write a new play for the prince.
381c4d4cea15772644fcc9ec168f0015c790b29c.text: 找到Sijo并说服他为王子写一部新戏剧。

a429d4ab16943c1319090ed905234402e6942c07.source: All the objectives on this quest take place in the Resplendent Makuun area.
a429d4ab16943c1319090ed905234402e6942c07.text: 该任务的所有目标都发生在辉煌的马库恩地区。

5a0779cef33dd150956a8dd8990cd0ac402f30af.source: After picking up this quest from Prince Bokka (point 1), straight away go and speak to Theatre Manager Daudi nearby to trigger the second objective (point 2). The playwright you need to find is in fact Kenyatta in the Honur Hill outpost on the west side of Resplendent Makuun (point 3). Unfortunately, Kenyatta is having a bit of writer's block and suggests that you go and find Sijo in Resplendent Makuun, from the quest pointer Sijo appears to be getting in touch with his muse up in the north-east corner of the explorable area (point 4).
5a0779cef33dd150956a8dd8990cd0ac402f30af.text: 从博卡王子那里接到这个任务后（第1点），立即去与附近的剧院经理达迪交谈以触发第二个目标（第2点）。您需要找到的剧作家实际上是位于 Resplendent Makuun 西侧荣誉山前哨站的肯雅塔（第 3 点）。不幸的是，肯雅塔遇到了一些写作障碍，建议你去辉煌的马库恩找到西乔，从任务指针来看，西乔似乎正在探索区域的东北角（第 4 点）与他的缪斯取得联系。

f67e23910d42b866479651a703b67134c5f7fc2c.source: However, as you find on arrival, Sijo the Stagnant has been done in (probably by the Djinn wandering nearby), but fear not, the body has a freshly written script on it! (click on the body to pickup the "Springtime for Varesh" Script quest item).
f67e23910d42b866479651a703b67134c5f7fc2c.text: 然而，正如您抵达后发现的那样，静止的 Sijo 已经被消灭了（可能是由附近徘徊的巨灵造成的），但不用担心，尸体上有一个新写的脚本！ （点击尸体拾取“瓦雷什的春天”脚本任务项目）。

7720bac53e268e4b6eefe177a7781a7a225ae95d.source: Return to Daudi with your new treasure, just remember to wipe the bloodstains off first!
7720bac53e268e4b6eefe177a7781a7a225ae95d.text: 带着你的新宝藏返回达迪，记得先擦掉血迹！

201af497ecac081969f586a6f3d6c3246169838a.source: Find and cure 3 sickened villagers. You have 3 sickened villagers remaining.
201af497ecac081969f586a6f3d6c3246169838a.text: 找到并治愈 3 名患病的村民。您还剩下 3 名患病的村民。

2ebdd8e01c58565dae8a85cce4cb5ab772ef1aec.source: This is a straightforward quest. Head southeast out of Tsumei Village until you get to the quest marker. Use Mend Ailment on Fawn, Jia and Kin. Then map travel back to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Headmaster Amara for your reward.
2ebdd8e01c58565dae8a85cce4cb5ab772ef1aec.text: 这是一个简单的任务。从津名村向东南方向行驶，直到到达任务标记处。对小鹿、贾和金使用治愈疾病。然后按照地图返回Shing Jea 寺并与Amara 校长交谈以获得奖励。

29fbccac09cd3a79943e77340e6eb6e8c1c02039.source: Sometimes only Fawn and Jia have the green mist of sickness around them. Kin can still be "cured" though.
29fbccac09cd3a79943e77340e6eb6e8c1c02039.text: 有时只有小鹿和贾身边有绿色的病雾。尽管如此，Kin仍然可以被“治愈”。

12473783e496f1473288200036405dcc76f28f78.source: Although it is told that the villagers are sick they are actually poisoned.
12473783e496f1473288200036405dcc76f28f78.text: 虽然听说村民生病了，但他们实际上是中毒了。

584ecd3842dcb61cf162d7afcc4c610a87735af8.source: Head to Sunqua Vale and eradicate the approaching Crimson Skull forces. [9...0] groups of Crimson Skull cohorts remaining.
584ecd3842dcb61cf162d7afcc4c610a87735af8.text: 前往桑夸谷并消灭逼近的猩红骷髅军队。 [9...0] 组剩余的猩红骷髅大队。

149f48db992a6298b250251ea2b52f64c48b182b.source: Head to Panjiang Peninsula and eradicate the approaching Crimson Skull forces. [9...0] groups of Crimson Skull cohorts remaining.
149f48db992a6298b250251ea2b52f64c48b182b.text: 前往盘江半岛，消灭逼近的红骷髅势力。 [9...0] 组剩余的猩红骷髅大队。

a3d0d26cbc9987378ccaaeab92f0c57e261ea228.source: See the Emperor's Blade for your reward.
a3d0d26cbc9987378ccaaeab92f0c57e261ea228.text: 前往帝皇之剑领取奖励。

7e1838d4f402c45b8f3db756f4b10af4d45c861e.source: There is a two pronged attack of Crimson Skull, from both sides of Tsumei Village. Start by defending the Sunqua Vale side: spread out near the portal and hold your position; the attackers will come to you. Once you have cleared out most of them, tackle the remaining stragglers. As soon as the quest updates (giving you credit for removing all groups), head back into town.
7e1838d4f402c45b8f3db756f4b10af4d45c861e.text: 红骷髅从津名村的两侧发起了双管齐下的攻击。首先防守Sunqua Vale一侧：在传送门附近分散并坚守阵地；攻击者会来找你。一旦你清除了其中的大部分，就可以解决剩下的掉队者。一旦任务更新（给予你移除所有团体的功劳），就返回城镇。

12facbb7ad181c4407fd1f5159d561f77927102b.source: You can use the same tactics to defend the Panjiang Peninsula side, i.e. spread out and wait for the Skull to come to you. However, one of the groups will try to make an end run and attack you from behind. This can be an issue if you are using three henchmen; if you are, reposition your group closer to the resurrection shrine or otherwise backup so that the Canthan Guards can take some of the aggro while you regroup. Groups of Crimson Skull will also appear away from the main fighting area and head into the village to attack the villagers. Killing these groups do not count towards completing the quest.
12facbb7ad181c4407fd1f5159d561f77927102b.text: 防守盘江半岛一侧也可以用同样的战术，分散开来，等待骷髅来找你。然而，其中一组会试图进行最后的奔跑并从后面攻击你。如果你使用三个追随者，这可能是一个问题；如果你是这样，请将你的队伍重新定位到更靠近复活神殿的位置，或者以其他方式进行备份，以便凯珊守卫在你重新集结时可以承受一些仇恨。成群的猩红骷髅也会出现在远离主要战斗区域的地方，并进入村庄攻击村民。杀死这些群体并不算完成任务。

1d6adfdeb4a4835c4877c862018c4e72795b856b.source: Once you receive credit for defeating the last group, head back into town to collect your reward.
1d6adfdeb4a4835c4877c862018c4e72795b856b.text: 一旦您因击败最后一组而获得积分，请返回城镇领取奖励。

ac533f5187dfba2de9078f36e10dae9a764d0364.source: Note: You must complete the Sunqua Vale part of the quest first or else the final group in Panjiang Peninsula will not spawn.
ac533f5187dfba2de9078f36e10dae9a764d0364.text: 注意：您必须先完成任务的桑瓜谷部分，否则盘江半岛的最后一组将不会出现。

49de999c7fb90ebdd7f25867a35726a12e151a75.source: If you keep the quest active, the groups of Crimson Skulls can be farmed for Copper Crimson Skull Coins, Silver Crimson Skull Coins, and Gold Crimson Skull Coins.
49de999c7fb90ebdd7f25867a35726a12e151a75.text: 如果你保持任务活跃，可以通过种植猩红骷髅群来获得铜猩红骷髅币、银猩红骷髅币和金猩红骷髅币。

0d8ecc1562826dbfe6ee8b0f89fb139b31935d14.source: Destroy the Charr forces besieging Piken Square.
0d8ecc1562826dbfe6ee8b0f89fb139b31935d14.text: 消灭围困皮肯广场的夏尔军队。

1e938378e374240dc5099aee1d769c9e6b43ecef.text: 闪电伤害：4-7（需要 3 个空气魔法）

eb0439bb85bf8df414eb1ba932df400604a7205e.source: The Charr captain is just outside Piken Square, in an open area immediately southwest. Be aware that he has a lot of Charr with him, so it's probably wisest to kill them piecemeal, saving the Captain for last. After killing him, report back to Duke Barradin.
eb0439bb85bf8df414eb1ba932df400604a7205e.text: 查尔队长就在皮肯广场外，西南方向的一片空地上。请注意，他身边有很多夏尔，所以最明智的做法可能是零碎地杀死他们，把船长留到最后。杀死他后，向巴拉丁公爵报告。

8dd50fde8dc27cf38c47409eba18824d176d7632.source: Flush out the Titan in Sacnoth Valley
8dd50fde8dc27cf38c47409eba18824d176d7632.text: 冲掉萨克诺斯谷的泰坦

60d8fca0dc9b0d11f3dcbdfe8d7c4bbeea010ccb.source: The easiest way to complete this quest is to map travel to Doomlore Shrine and leave from there. Go directly south from the entrance until you find a hostile Siege Devourer. Kill it and its Charr rider, then mount it. Fight your way south-southeast through Dalada Uplands to get to Sacnoth Valley. After zoning you will still be riding the Devourer, which will make this quest much easier. Head south until you reach a burning forest. There you will find Ignus the Eternal. While approaching him watch out for Borrguus Blisterbark who patrols the area. Fighting both bosses at the same time will probably kill your team. Avoid the brightly burning trees, both upright and fallen, otherwise you will begin burning if you get too close. After you kill Ignus the Eternal head back to Captain Langmar for your reward.
60d8fca0dc9b0d11f3dcbdfe8d7c4bbeea010ccb.text: 完成此任务的最简单方法是绘制前往末日神殿的旅行地图并从那里离开。从入口直接向南走，直到找到敌方的攻城吞噬者。杀死它和它的夏尔骑手，然后骑上它。向东南偏南方向前进，穿过达拉达高地到达萨克诺斯谷。分区后，你仍然会骑着吞噬者，这将使这个任务变得更加容易。向南行驶，直到到达燃烧的森林。在那里你会找到永恒的伊格努斯。当接近他时，请留意在该地区巡逻的博尔格斯·泡树皮。同时与两个老板战斗可能会杀死你的团队。避开燃烧着的明亮树木，无论是直立的还是倒下的，否则如果离得太近就会开始燃烧。杀死永恒的伊格努斯后，回到朗玛船长那里领取奖励。

e624799e670fb4d53ea7b03a77f3b6f078d2a02f.source: As you will be fighting lots of fire Elementalists, skills such as interrupts, Mantra of Flame and Ward Against Elements are good choices.
e624799e670fb4d53ea7b03a77f3b6f078d2a02f.text: 由于你将与大量火元素师战斗，中断、火焰咒语和元素防御等技能是不错的选择。

a5c947c521886d2d929ce3e67dfd149cce2b20b4.source: While Pyre Fierceshot is in range of any of the creatures spawned by the quest, he will automatically resurrect after approximately 3 seconds with the cry of "A false god stands before us. We shall see if it can stand against the harsh realities of my wrath!" If there are a lot of enemies surrounding him when this occurs he is likely to be overwhelmed very quickly by their numbers. It may be necessary to flag him a sufficient distance away so that the enemies that trigger this move away, allowing the party to resurrect fully at the active shrine.
a5c947c521886d2d929ce3e67dfd149cce2b20b4.text: 当火葬烈火处于该任务所产生的任何生物的范围内时，他会在大约 3 秒后自动复活，并喊道“一个虚假的神站在我们面前。我们将看看它是否能抵抗我愤怒的严酷现实！”如果发生这种情况时他周围有很多敌人，他很可能很快就会被他们的数量淹没。可能有必要将他标记在足够远的距离，以便触发此事件的敌人移开，从而使队伍能够在活跃的神殿中完全复活。

96e29d49cdf287df0dd32f10bf1c9525e927ab4d.source: With the Quest Falling Out active, NPC Jenn Valefield will accompany you on the way towards the burning forest. She won't be targeted by the Elementalists and her Heal Area will help against the area damage.
96e29d49cdf287df0dd32f10bf1c9525e927ab4d.text: 当任务“Falling Out”激活时，NPC Jenn Valefield 将陪伴您前往燃烧的森林。她不会成为元素使的目标，她的治疗区域将有助于对抗区域伤害。

c6adfb6e4fafcbd92f25acbf8fde7af2d22daaa4.source: Find the Grawl that have stolen the relic. Look for them in the fields just north of the Sanitarium.
c6adfb6e4fafcbd92f25acbf8fde7af2d22daaa4.text: 找到偷走圣物的穴居人。在疗养院北面的田野里寻找它们。

e01b47d62dfaacae7a15c01074b03b347acf15ea.source: Escort Necromancer Munne and the relic back to the sanitarium. "sanitarium" is lowercase here
e01b47d62dfaacae7a15c01074b03b347acf15ea.text: 护送死灵法师穆尼和遗物返回疗养院。 “sanitarium”在这里是小写的

aac564d4bb732c13b8a2bec4819519b2746c7354.source: Meet Necromancer Munne outside the Sardelac Sanitarium and follow her north into the fields. Kill the three Grawl and pick up the Holy Relic they drop. Haul the artifact back to the Sanitarium's entrance and present it to Munne. You must be holding the quest item when you speak to her to get your reward.
aac564d4bb732c13b8a2bec4819519b2746c7354.text: 在沙德拉疗养院外与死灵法师穆尼会面，并跟随她向北进入田野。杀死三个穴居人并捡起他们掉落的圣物。将神器拖回疗养院入口并将其交给穆尼。当你与她交谈才能获得奖励时，你必须持有任务物品。

011a3a2b48496c44b696ed601b37f6ec64e19c61.source: The three Grawl that spawn as part of this quest will attack other Grawl that enter their aggro range.
011a3a2b48496c44b696ed601b37f6ec64e19c61.text: 作为此任务的一部分而生成的三只穴居人将攻击进入其仇恨范围的其他穴居人。

f280cfc25729268658bf47546a64a12a23aa2cea.source: Travel to Kupah Beach in Kinya Province.
f280cfc25729268658bf47546a64a12a23aa2cea.text: 前往基尼亚省的库帕海滩。

8f395ef6864a0d547bc734fe0c90a61169f6a889.source: Place the Stone of the Elements on the stone pedestal.
8f395ef6864a0d547bc734fe0c90a61169f6a889.text: 将元素之石放在石基座上。

8e70754b75b83a0251d1f3e3be748a95bb2866f3.source: Ronsu and Kai Ying can bug out when they appear, and instead of fighting will run towards the center of the map before vanishing when they get stuck.
8e70754b75b83a0251d1f3e3be748a95bb2866f3.text: Ronsu和Kai Ying出现时可能会逃跑，并且不会战斗，而是会跑向地图中心，然后在卡住时消失。

6c0bff2052eea6f8103c550066e910f5ccedd658.source: Defeat Ulrik the Undefeated in Traveler's Vale.
6c0bff2052eea6f8103c550066e910f5ccedd658.text: 在旅行者之谷击败不败者乌尔里克。

e7e32f361a039da481b0a22cb8be58be66b975d4.source: Ulrik is almost directly outside of Yak's Bend. He uses enchantment spells to boost his armor rating, so consider bringing enchantment removal skills. If these haven't been obtained yet, the henchman Dunham is equipped with Drain Enchantment. Ulrik's armor-boosting enchantments are Armor of Earth and Kinetic Armor, both of which apply bonus armor rating, and therefore do not stack. The largest bonus will be that of Kinetic Armor. As expected of a Mesmer quest, skills such as Backfire and armor-ignoring damage skills work wonders. Melee attack-oriented skill bars face not only Ulrik's armor bonus, but also Ward Against Melee. When Ulrik is defeated, return to Sebedoh in Yak's Bend.
e7e32f361a039da481b0a22cb8be58be66b975d4.text: 乌尔里克几乎就在牦牛湾的正外面。他使用结界法术来提高他的护甲等级，所以考虑带上结界移除技能。如果还没有获得这些，那么追随者邓纳姆就会装备排水结界。乌尔里克的护甲增强结界是大地护甲和动能护甲，两者都适用额外护甲等级，因此不会叠加。最大的奖励将是动能装甲。正如幻术师任务所期望的那样，逆火和无视护甲伤害等技能会产生奇迹。以近战攻击为导向的技能栏不仅面对乌尔里克的护甲加值，还面对近战防御。当乌尔里克被击败后，返回牦牛弯的塞贝多。

0ac401fec524da3468b7212ffb24117ff90f5ab5.source: Kill 4 Stygian Lords in the Stygian Veil.
0ac401fec524da3468b7212ffb24117ff90f5ab5.text: 在斯泰吉亚面纱中杀死 4 名斯泰吉亚领主。

ae291a6486d9ca703cdf6d52368e90ff6fec2fa5.source: *BONUS* Kill 4 Stygian Lords in Hard Mode.
ae291a6486d9ca703cdf6d52368e90ff6fec2fa5.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 4 名斯泰吉亚领主。

3a8ef45ac261142708a27debe652531d09cfd6a9.source: See Breaching the Stygian Veil and Brood Wars.
3a8ef45ac261142708a27debe652531d09cfd6a9.text: 请参阅《冲破冥河面纱》和《母巢之战》。

bc1c9dd9a205f6c9591a4b8aaf97435cc146eaf2.source: There is also a Zaishen quest for the Stygian Underlords.
bc1c9dd9a205f6c9591a4b8aaf97435cc146eaf2.text: 还有一个针对斯泰吉亚霸主的再神任务。

34ff3d2afdcaa2bb5f2bd933b81aefce3e57f2e0.source: Kill 2 Stygian Underlords in the Stygian Veil.
34ff3d2afdcaa2bb5f2bd933b81aefce3e57f2e0.text: 在斯泰吉亚面纱中杀死 2 名斯泰吉亚领主。

b2ffa2d5bf3908c3f25722de953c850383ab6e1d.source: *BONUS* Kill 2 Stygian Underlords in Hard Mode.
b2ffa2d5bf3908c3f25722de953c850383ab6e1d.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 2 名冥河霸主。

e7411b7433c8b0cd886380d604a3796940d6c6df.text: 请参阅《突破斯泰吉亚面纱》。

206a4eba8a8f0a969e2e581c218a46887902ae04.source: There is also a Zaishen quest for the Stygian Lords.
206a4eba8a8f0a969e2e581c218a46887902ae04.text: 还有一个针对斯泰吉亚领主的再神任务。

0b91e6ba268cb7af935f11816cf8d1232cae37f4.source: Clear the Sulfurous Wastes in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
0b91e6ba268cb7af935f11816cf8d1232cae37f4.text: 在困难模式下清除所有敌人荒凉之地的硫磺荒原。

87608cbf73d5a1684e81bfa33ff29f02dfa8092a.source: Head out the south exit of Remains of Sahlahja or the northwestern exit of the Gate of Desolation.
87608cbf73d5a1684e81bfa33ff29f02dfa8092a.text: 从萨赫拉贾遗迹的南出口或荒凉之门的西北出口出发。

e8d096288478549bf8a7bbb42af9a7558e24f4dc.source: Most of this explorable area is actually optional, as the required travel through this area is accomplished in the Gate of Desolation mission, however the primary quest Crossing the Desolation requires a short entrance into this area.
e8d096288478549bf8a7bbb42af9a7558e24f4dc.text: 这个可探索区域的大部分实际上是可选的，因为穿过该区域所需的旅行是在荒凉之门任务中完成的，但是主要任务穿越荒凉需要一个短暂的入口进入该区域。

5550a112eabae3c42af6b9645216d896ed7de6d3.source: To reach the small northern plateau on the map, you must destroy a pillar using Junundu Smash to create a bridge (see map above).
5550a112eabae3c42af6b9645216d896ed7de6d3.text: 要到达地图上的北部小高原，您必须使用 Junundu Smash 摧毁一根柱子以创建一座桥梁（参见上面的地图）。

0173baa8b2e09584e61b84aee331fd4e2e660cae.source: The pillar's base is on the southern side of the narrow east-west Sulfurous Haze path to the north.
0173baa8b2e09584e61b84aee331fd4e2e660cae.text: 石柱的底座位于北边狭窄的东西向硫磺烟雾小路的南侧。

b93f1720cbe4ef0edec1784a1771644115e549a5.source: Junundu Smash requires adrenaline, which you can build up by fighting the undead to the east or west or by attacking the Margonites on the north plateau from the path below. Either way, use Junundu Tunnel to quickly return to the pillar. The pillar can also be destroyed from the path below.
b93f1720cbe4ef0edec1784a1771644115e549a5.text: 朱南杜粉碎需要肾上腺素，你可以通过与东部或西部的不死族战斗或从下面的路径攻击北部高原的玛贡尼特来积累肾上腺素。无论哪种方式，都可以使用朱南杜隧道快速返回柱子。柱子也可以从下面的路径摧毁。

dd62e374cf72c3e2954dcc018a37f860d67a048f.source: Infantryman Hareh, who has two secondary quests, is on that northern plateau.
dd62e374cf72c3e2954dcc018a37f860d67a048f.text: 步兵哈雷（Hareh）有两个次要任务，就在那个北部高原上。

ae42fbb3e284594a7568f5c3ffd242c43e1ad954.source: There are three Margonite groups on a small northern plateau that can only be fought after smashing a pillar (see above). If you kill all available foes before knocking down the pillar, you will be unable to complete the vanquish unless you can find another way to generate the required adrenaline to power Junundu Smash.
ae42fbb3e284594a7568f5c3ffd242c43e1ad954.text: 在北部的一个小高原上有三个玛贡尼特团体，只有在击碎一根柱子后才能进行战斗（见上文）。如果你在击倒柱子之前杀死所有可用的敌人，你将无法完成征服，除非你能找到另一种方法来产生所需的肾上腺素来为朱南杜粉碎提供动力。

f2370d3b5023ed3b7f13140c5f5bce53a403ef7c.source: If you have vanquished everything nearby but have a minion master you can sacrifice party members or heroes on the sulphurous sands to generate corpses. Then sacrifice the minion master to make the minions hostile, letting you build up the adrenaline needed for Junundu Smash. Video.
f2370d3b5023ed3b7f13140c5f5bce53a403ef7c.text: 如果你已经征服了附近的一切，但有一个小兵大师，你可以在硫磺沙上牺牲党员或英雄来生成尸体。然后牺牲小兵大师让小兵变得敌对，让你积累朱南杜粉碎所需的肾上腺素。视频。

3e434f59927a03d14258a2419f5cfbbbce9dc4e4.source: Alternatively, if you have no minion master, you can equip a bow or spear and use the Junudu's ranged basic attack against the Margonite groups to build up the adrenaline needed to smash the pillar.
3e434f59927a03d14258a2419f5cfbbbce9dc4e4.text: 或者，如果你没有随从大师，你可以装备弓或矛，并使用朱努杜的远程基本攻击来对抗玛贡尼特群体，以积累粉碎柱子所需的肾上腺素。

186f9b76890dc2dc75485d3755a2c0c964a86086.source: Bohdabi the Destructive's undead mob in the northwest can be hard to handle on foot. You can make use of the wurm spoor in the extreme northwest and then aggro as many monsters as you can.
186f9b76890dc2dc75485d3755a2c0c964a86086.text: 毁灭者博赫达比在西北部的不死暴徒很难步行对付。你可以利用最西北的亚龙足迹，然后尽可能多地攻击怪物。

4180b09a149638ea7c39f70a0a65170f174bfd4b.source: There are hidden Mandragors towards the southwest.
4180b09a149638ea7c39f70a0a65170f174bfd4b.text: 西南方有隐藏的曼陀罗。

084bcabbd3f909cbd9c339dbac248f3740f82632.source: Activating Requiem for a Brain while vanquishing will spawn additional foes.
084bcabbd3f909cbd9c339dbac248f3740f82632.text: 征服时激活大脑安魂曲会产生更多敌人。

372a321cf94dfa1865e7aa5081583c54a14026ec.source: This area is a good place to farm Sunspear and Lightbringer points, especially if A Show of Force and Requiem for a Brain are active.
372a321cf94dfa1865e7aa5081583c54a14026ec.text: 这个区域是种植烈阳之矛和光明使者点数的好地方，特别是当“武力展示”和“大脑安魂曲”激活时。

2cea3bba6ae226a8a85511e781670c0875a8937b.source: During an Elonian Support weekly bonus, you can max your Lightbringer title by vanquishing the area around ten times.
2cea3bba6ae226a8a85511e781670c0875a8937b.text: 在 Elonian 支持每周奖励期间，您可以通过征服该区域大约十次来最大化您的光明使者头衔。

68af9756f26eca9528ba07964704424214a4c47c.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: elementalist
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
68af9756f26eca9528ba07964704424214a4c47c.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：元素师
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色
