0c8c1511356af4afe34826390625d62d7ba1b8cf.source: Follow the road up to the wizard's tower. Destroy the Tower Golem.
0c8c1511356af4afe34826390625d62d7ba1b8cf.text: 沿着路一直走到巫师塔。摧毁塔傀儡。

c79f8af7405b3f5f9ea96424f2893e933c32bd26.source: See Elementalist Aziure for your reward.
c79f8af7405b3f5f9ea96424f2893e933c32bd26.text: 请见元素师阿兹乌尔以获得奖励。

c6f200dfc261b7613bbdc86f7d12dc4bc991dd8d.source: Ralena will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
c6f200dfc261b7613bbdc86f7d12dc4bc991dd8d.text: 接受任务后，雷莱娜会给你以下技能：

58766f5ac44bcfda54913c6ef95e844a5563403a.source: Follow the southern path outside Foible's Fair until you reach a tall tower. The Tower Golem will be patrolling northwest of the tower. It is vulnerable to lightning damage, so use Lightning Javelin to kill it faster. Elementalist Aziure will be standing next to the tower for your reward.
58766f5ac44bcfda54913c6ef95e844a5563403a.text: 沿着福布尔集市外的南边小路行驶，直到到达一座高塔。塔傀儡将在塔的西北方向巡逻。它很容易受到闪电伤害，因此使用闪电标枪可以更快地杀死它。元素师阿兹乌尔将站在塔旁边领取奖励。

5322113fb8cc3968fc51c6d3f225bd24cd5b168c.source: Investigate the tarnished emblem at the scrying pool.
5322113fb8cc3968fc51c6d3f225bd24cd5b168c.text: 调查占卜池中失去光泽的徽章。

5c8c4f238d6c7636b83af4f541e9d0d468675881.source: The Tarnished Emblem is located at the resurrection shrine as you enter Majesty's Rest from Sage Lands.
5c8c4f238d6c7636b83af4f541e9d0d468675881.text: 当你从贤者之地进入陛下之眠时，黯淡徽章位于复活神殿处。

c290d1bb36d67f37e1b3d87f371edefec348babf.source: This quest is part of Hearts of the North, the second installment in Guild Wars Beyond.
c290d1bb36d67f37e1b3d87f371edefec348babf.text: 该任务是《激战3》第二部分《北方之心》的一部分。

a4d6d39341f0c330c45862e5bb06675ba4c6bc79.source: Speak to the Master of Paths on the Isle of the Nameless.
a4d6d39341f0c330c45862e5bb06675ba4c6bc79.text: 与无名岛上的道主交谈。

6c1c40e93e9a53b39393b2a229ed42b6cdfa9b14.source: Defeat all four arenas consecutively from outside the Great Temple of Balthazar.
6c1c40e93e9a53b39393b2a229ed42b6cdfa9b14.text: 从巴尔萨扎大神庙外连续击败所有四个竞技场。

350579545b27c8b2f437df249fc62cc600cded06.source: Report to Challenge Master Rioka in the Zaishen Challenge Outpost.
350579545b27c8b2f437df249fc62cc600cded06.text: 向在神挑战站的挑战大师里奥卡报到。

255fb678c4fb64df763aea7bf0a724d977c54594.source: Unlocks the Zaishen Challenge outpost for the account.
255fb678c4fb64df763aea7bf0a724d977c54594.text: 解锁该帐户的 Zaishen 挑战前哨站。

0dd094359d17b529988339fd83f380822fcc7cfb.source: Talk to the Master of Paths to get started; he will take you through the Training Arenas. If you fail any of the tests, you will need to try again from the start. Upon the successful completion of all four arenas, talk to Challenge Master, Rioka to complete the quest.
0dd094359d17b529988339fd83f380822fcc7cfb.text: 与路径大师交谈以开始；他将带您参观训练竞技场。如果您未通过任何测试，则需要从头开始重试。成功完成所有四个竞技场后，与挑战大师 Rioka 交谈以完成任务。

c8fdaf4c3e2c0784bf3a9a64c9eab20748f08d6e.source: Search Haiju Lagoon for Paomu's missing nanny and locate Paomu's missing coin purse.
c8fdaf4c3e2c0784bf3a9a64c9eab20748f08d6e.text: 在海州泻湖中寻找跑木失踪的保姆，并找到跑木失踪的零钱包。

d434f78c212d832a2438b9df75849c5ac67ed788.source: To acquire the quest, head northwest from Zen Daijun toward the green star shown on the map. Then head to Haiju Lagoon and go to its northwestern end. There you will find a Ravenous Drake. Kill it and use the Bleached Bones there to get the purse. Return the purse to Paomu.
d434f78c212d832a2438b9df75849c5ac67ed788.text: 要完成任务，请从禅代君向西北方向前往地图上显示的绿色星星。然后前往海珠泻湖并前往其西北端。在那里你会发现一只贪婪的幼龙。杀死它并使用那里的漂白骨头来获得钱包。将钱包还给泡木。

2c6739e08097a184ca0620d3d1f890de8dd59dd0.source: Speak to Kilroy when you are ready to fight Bjorn Thunderfist.
2c6739e08097a184ca0620d3d1f890de8dd59dd0.text: 当你准备好与比约恩·雷拳战斗时，与基尔罗伊交谈。

382c2c781c796612e9d9c7a5ee3532e6a65cc5f9.source: Defeat Bjorn Thunderfist in the championship brawling match.
382c2c781c796612e9d9c7a5ee3532e6a65cc5f9.text: 在冠军争夺战中击败比约恩雷拳。

a36480406d51014f05219b633da7e18d507f2465.text: 切割伤害：7-17（需要 9 匕首掌握）

6b66e36bec64535f919cd35b180e791e697eb03a.source: Once you enter a Norn style ring, the gates will open and Bjorn Thunderfist will turn hostile to start the single round. You only need to Knock him out once to win.
6b66e36bec64535f919cd35b180e791e697eb03a.text: 一旦你进入诺恩风格的擂台，大门就会打开，比约恩·雷拳将转为敌对，开始单轮比赛。你只需要击倒他一次即可获胜。

7c120447cb0b94f376ca7c10e606d2f7cbefa280.source: The easiest way to win is by only auto-attacking without using any skills to build up adrenaline. Keep the Block up whenever possible and interrupt when you can. Use the uppercut, knockdown and combination punch to do damage. You may get knocked out numerous times while slowly wearing him down. Or simply use the skills as in a real boxing fight. Brawling Jab to break his Brawling Block defense and then a powerful skill.
7c120447cb0b94f376ca7c10e606d2f7cbefa280.text: 最简单的获胜方法是仅自动攻击，而不使用任何技能来积累肾上腺素。尽可能保持阻塞状态，并尽可能打断。使用上勾拳、击倒拳和组合拳来造成伤害。你可能会被击倒无数次，同时慢慢地让他疲惫不堪。或者像在真正的拳击比赛中一样使用这些技能。斗殴刺破他的斗殴格挡防御，然后是一个强大的技能。

78b624ea2a1237ee7d8fd010ecb8931ec988bf51.source: Travel to Grendich Courthouse and speak with Warmaster Labofski to learn how you can help defend against the Titan threat.
78b624ea2a1237ee7d8fd010ecb8931ec988bf51.text: 前往格伦迪奇法院并与战帅拉波夫斯基交谈，了解如何帮助防御泰坦威胁。

fc21d07baa6e5b6c50799e06b639c9c97642766a.source: Travel to the northwest region of Dragon's Gullet and kill the 3 Titan bosses.
fc21d07baa6e5b6c50799e06b639c9c97642766a.text: 前往龙之咽喉的西北地区并杀死 3 个泰坦首领。

16e95522b3591e4f35be530e48fc82673d049efa.source: The best strategy is to start out at Grendich Courthouse and travel to Flame Temple Corridor, killing any bosses encountered along the way for extra morale. Alternatively, it is possible to start from Yak's Bend to have a party of 6 members, but this requires to make your way through Traveler's Vale, Ascalon Foothills and Diessa Lowlands. In Flame Temple, you will encounter the Charr Lords. Pull them away from the patrols and take them on one group at a time, then continue on to the Dragon's Gullet.
16e95522b3591e4f35be530e48fc82673d049efa.text: 最好的策略是从格伦迪奇法院出发，前往火焰神殿走廊，杀死沿途遇到的任何 Boss 以增加士气。或者，也可以从牦牛湾出发组建 6 名成员的队伍，但这需要穿过旅行者谷、阿斯卡隆山麓和迪萨低地。在火焰神殿，你会遇到夏尔领主。将他们从巡逻队中拉开，一次一组地对付他们，然后继续前往龙之咽喉。

29be0a9c25ec49b79e93e8dfd85130bb3e97639b.source: Consider maxing out your morale before venturing into the lake itself.
29be0a9c25ec49b79e93e8dfd85130bb3e97639b.text: 在冒险进入湖泊之前，请考虑最大化您的士气。

e97ecdb26f17c7c875f1fddba4d4b62f7f6aeb28.source: Enter the lake from the southeastern shore, northwest of the resurrection shrine that makes for a convenient restart spot should you wipe while fighting the Titan Lords. A pair of Hand and Fist of the Titans will pop out of the tar to greet you.
e97ecdb26f17c7c875f1fddba4d4b62f7f6aeb28.text: 从复活神殿西北部的东南岸进入湖泊，如果您在与泰坦领主战斗时擦拭，这里将是一个方便的重新启动点。一双泰坦之手和泰坦之拳会从焦油中弹出来迎接你。

459945d93dc2fbedcd584913031825f55fe58f5f.source: In the lake, you will have to deal with the constant 30% reduction in speed from the Tar environment effect.
459945d93dc2fbedcd584913031825f55fe58f5f.text: 在湖中，你将不得不应对因焦油环境影响而导致速度持续降低 30% 的情况。

aada8d09d836c841292b23d237573777e2d47253.source: After you deal with the popups, you need to take out a number of titan patrols that circle the bosses. The patrols are made up of more Hands and Fists, and also Sparks of the Titans and Risen Ashen Hulks; the sparks should be your priority target as they are capable of some extremely lethal Fire Magic. The Risen Hulks are the least dangerous, and should be left for last as they split into another pair of Hand and Fist when they die.
aada8d09d836c841292b23d237573777e2d47253.text: 处理完弹出窗口后，您需要消灭围绕 Boss 的大量泰坦巡逻队。巡逻队由更多的手和拳组成，还有泰坦火花和复活的灰烬浩克；火花应该是你的首要目标，因为它们能够使用一些极其致命的火焰魔法。复活的绿巨人是最不危险的，应该留在最后，因为他们死后会分裂成另一对手和拳头。

5af0d3259da249da01098005383649ec5358c89b.source: A second group of pop-up warrior titans will greet you in the southwest corner of the lake.
5af0d3259da249da01098005383649ec5358c89b.text: 第二组弹出的泰坦战士将在湖的西南角迎接您。

2bac44af37200285809b526283951c4da357a4d7.source: After the lake has been cleared of patrols, it is time to complete the main objective. In the center of the lake are three Titan bosses: the Titan Lords you were sent here to dispatch. Among their ranks is a small group of Charr Lords. A good tactic is to kill the Charr Lords first then go for the Titans.
2bac44af37200285809b526283951c4da357a4d7.text: 清除湖中的巡逻队后，就该完成主要目标了。湖的中心是三个泰坦首领：你被派到这里来派遣的泰坦领主。他们的队伍中有一小群夏尔领主。一个好的策略是先杀死夏尔领主，然后再去对付泰坦。

878062b353d364c7d5734bc0da592ea63c3d746d.source: A solid tank who can rush in and keep the bosses focused on him is an excellent complement to an Elementalist with Maelstrom who can render the Mesmer and Necromancer bosses useless for about 30 seconds (10 seconds of interruptions plus more time as their skills recharge).
878062b353d364c7d5734bc0da592ea63c3d746d.text: 一个可以冲进去并让 Boss 集中注意力的坚固坦克是对带有漩涡的元素师的完美补充，元素师可以使幻术师和死灵法师 Boss 在大约 30 秒内变得毫无用处（10 秒的中断加上他们的技能充电的更多时间）。

73ade679b1bf02d8eb00b0d45218584c7ce4026d.source: Titans are very resistant to physical damage, but less so to elemental damage - especially cold damage.
73ade679b1bf02d8eb00b0d45218584c7ce4026d.text: 泰坦对物理伤害有很强的抵抗力，但对元素伤害的抵抗力较差——尤其是寒冷伤害。

c8dfac3da49c5d95aafa966aca20c5b32d2ad6a4.source: This can be easily accomplished with Icy weapon mods.
c8dfac3da49c5d95aafa966aca20c5b32d2ad6a4.text: 这可以通过冰冷武器模组轻松实现。

07efc4210d6bf187ad3c69a68a257f3e181f827d.source: Alternatively, Winter will convert all elemental damage to cold damage. Because many mobs in the area use Greater Conflagration, physical damage will also often be converted to cold damage through Winter.
07efc4210d6bf187ad3c69a68a257f3e181f827d.text: 或者，冬天会将所有元素伤害转化为寒冷伤害。由于该地区的许多生物使用大火焰，物理伤害通常也会在冬季转化为寒冷伤害。

5ed75738ef805a47dc8a2288a8a6a2ea03a79bc4.source: An interrupt Mesmer can help here by shutting down the Necromancer boss and prevent him from casting Malaise.
5ed75738ef805a47dc8a2288a8a6a2ea03a79bc4.text: 中断幻术师可以通过关闭死灵法师 Boss 并阻止他施放不适来提供帮助。

5ab2c471cf08fd71041993d93d2ab5557494e835.source: A good way to break the anti-caster combination is to kill the Mesmer boss before the others.
5ab2c471cf08fd71041993d93d2ab5557494e835.text: 打破反施法者组合的一个好方法是在其他人之前杀死幻术师 Boss。

eb16252d671cde5ffc290c323256b69385c847eb.source: Consider equipping the Ebon Vanguard Title for access to Rebel Yell's Charr-mitigating effects.
eb16252d671cde5ffc290c323256b69385c847eb.text: 考虑装备黑檀先锋称号以获得叛逆呐喊的夏尔缓解效果。

57133656de4413d6dd547ac077c02a53596ece28.source: Due to the short distance, it's advised to leave from Yak's Bend for two additional party members. Be sure to first talk to Labofski though.
57133656de4413d6dd547ac077c02a53596ece28.text: 由于距离较短，建议多带两名队员从牦牛湾出发。不过，请务必先与 Labofski 交谈。

a44c273253efd46dbce86c2879397787055197f9.source: Rebel Yell helps in fighting the Charr during the quest.
a44c273253efd46dbce86c2879397787055197f9.text: 叛军呐喊在任务期间帮助对抗夏尔。

45ef5648d69593d43f29a32ae3a90a3a003d93bc.source: Bringing Winter or other forms of cold damage is advised as the Titans have lower armor rating vs cold damage; however, armor-ignoring damage, such as dealt by binding ritual spirits and chaos damage, works too.
45ef5648d69593d43f29a32ae3a90a3a003d93bc.text: 建议带来冬季或其他形式的寒冷伤害，因为泰坦的护甲等级低于寒冷伤害；然而，无视护甲的伤害，例如束缚仪式灵魂和混乱伤害造成的伤害，也有效。

cc469a6e9b238fe80eab75154d5a7817470b81ec.source: Kill the Kournan guards holding the Centaur weapon crafters captive.
cc469a6e9b238fe80eab75154d5a7817470b81ec.text: 杀死俘虏半人马武器工匠的库尔南守卫。

83b30e9468d507fe5d95107ece6cf23ead4e3d7f.source: Offer the Centaurs a place with the Sunspears.
83b30e9468d507fe5d95107ece6cf23ead4e3d7f.text: 为半人马提供与烈阳之矛队同在的位置。

9577795d3fe8aafb39d8a2f3a77a29b66006640d.source: Two weaponsmiths, Grif Ebonmane and Kol Swordshanks, will spawn in the Command Post after this quest is completed.
9577795d3fe8aafb39d8a2f3a77a29b66006640d.text: 任务完成后，两名武器工匠 Grif Ebonmane 和 Kol Swordshanks 将在指挥所中生成。

c4f3ed58b3c24be8e167139daafaaa1b4e208e5c.source: The easiest way to do this quest is to start from Kodonur Crossroads and head out into Dejarin Estate. This way you won't have any unnecessary encounters and will only have to fight two groups of Kournans guarding the Centaurs.
c4f3ed58b3c24be8e167139daafaaa1b4e208e5c.text: 完成这个任务最简单的方法是从科多努尔十字路口出发，前往德贾林庄园。这样你就不会发生任何不必要的遭遇，只需要与两群守卫半人马的库南人战斗。

3379a18ea051bc8bdb02f90f5033592ab6317838.source: Unlike other foes in hard mode, the foes spawned by this quest have the same level in normal and hard modes.
3379a18ea051bc8bdb02f90f5033592ab6317838.text: 与困难模式中的其他敌人不同，此任务产生的敌人在正常模式和困难模式下具有相同的等级。

f8a08bd1a1ccb2b0ce43e054183fd710e64b59f0.source: The Broken Toy acquired via the /special command or the quest Miniature Companion: Nightfall must be in your inventory.
f8a08bd1a1ccb2b0ce43e054183fd710e64b59f0.text: 通过 /special 命令或任务“微型伴侣：夜幕降临”获得的破损玩具必须在您的库存中。

ebab6db98f25a79e682511f6dae1aa12fd5e87db.source: Gather whimsical essence by defeating the whimsical djinn.
ebab6db98f25a79e682511f6dae1aa12fd5e87db.text: 击败异想天开的巨灵，收集异想天开的精华。

a0041821807112dda2701a2258e824774e6ac4f3.source: You have gathered the whimsical essence.
a0041821807112dda2701a2258e824774e6ac4f3.text: 你已经收集了异想天开的本质。

1da1c94f6f4bc7c1427def3361f7c75f539f087f.source: Tell Mahk to infuse the toy with the whimsical essence.
1da1c94f6f4bc7c1427def3361f7c75f539f087f.text: 告诉 Mahk 将异想天开的精髓注入到玩具中。

47a1a5f62a74fee2aa45ddca8ae687733ec7d689.source: Use Mahk's model toy to negotiate a contract with the Vabbian toy buyers.
47a1a5f62a74fee2aa45ddca8ae687733ec7d689.text: 使用 Mahk 的模型玩具与瓦比亚玩具买家谈判合同。

402c3e5b0ed99570ae5b78cb31ab97ba8e2fcdc0.text: 你收到了 Mahk 的合同。

ba48dec297856747a48dd4312b80bea6df6b78a6.text: 请见 Mahk 领取奖励。

341879c7a4da232939d33595aa8b3b03cbab6247.source: Speak to Keeper Jinyssa when all members of your party are ready to defend the Gate of Torment.
341879c7a4da232939d33595aa8b3b03cbab6247.text: 当你的队伍的所有成员都准备好保卫折磨之门时，与守护者吉妮萨交谈。

680ef3a21da0455a17baa27aad6fd36807fea151.source: Defend the Gate of Torment from the attacking demon army. # of 3 attack groups remain.
680ef3a21da0455a17baa27aad6fd36807fea151.text: 保卫痛苦之门，抵御恶魔大军的进攻。剩余 3 个攻击组。

7ec4059c6e915b6d31e3d405f4964f97294d3d75.source: Keeper Jinyssa must survive the battle.
7ec4059c6e915b6d31e3d405f4964f97294d3d75.text: 守护者吉妮萨必须在战斗中幸存。

c89dc9ae9905af9b6b79fe5764712e00dd59c1f2.source: Keeper Jinyssa transports you to the mission location. There is a one minute countdown timer before the first wave spawns. Your allies consist of one Forgotten Sage and three Forgotten Cursebearers to the northeast, one Forgotten Sage and three Forgotten Illusionists to the southwest and two Forgotten Sages, one Forgotten Arcanist and Keeper Jinyssa, a Mesmer, in the center. Waves attack from the northeast and southwest, with four groups in each wave and pauses between waves. Keeper Jinyssa dies easily if the player aggroes the attackers. Blades of Corruption, Rains of Terror, Scythes of Chaos and Margonite Sorcerers are particularly dangerous due to their high damage capacity.
c89dc9ae9905af9b6b79fe5764712e00dd59c1f2.text: 守护者吉妮莎将带您前往任务地点。在第一波出现之前有一个一分钟的倒计时器。你的盟友包括东北方的一名被遗忘的贤者和三名被遗忘的咒使者，西南方向的一名被遗忘的贤者和三名被遗忘的幻术师，以及位于中心的两名被遗忘的贤者、一名被遗忘的奥术师和守护者吉尼萨（幻术师）。波浪从东北和西南方向进攻，每波有四组，每波之间有停顿。如果玩家攻击攻击者，守门员吉尼萨很容易死亡。腐化之刃、恐怖之雨、混沌之镰和玛贡尼特巫师由于其高伤害能力而特别危险。

e2a0d724bcaa45a29f189cb697970f97a71acef8.source: The following is a chart of the waves' group makeup:
e2a0d724bcaa45a29f189cb697970f97a71acef8.text: 下图是波浪的分组构成图：

689f1d31ed38a80d1d6437e11ebee582df0d1a87.source: One way of completing the mission with heroes and henchmen is to use a tank on one side while the rest of the team defeats the group on the other side. Switch places after the enemies on one side are dead.
689f1d31ed38a80d1d6437e11ebee582df0d1a87.text: 与英雄和追随者一起完成任务的一种方法是在一侧使用坦克，而团队的其他成员则击败另一侧的团队。一侧敌人死亡后交换位置。

2610d824bd212ad628c12fcf69174966990a8a5a.source: Due to high amount of corpses available, a minion master can be helpful.
2610d824bd212ad628c12fcf69174966990a8a5a.text: 由于可用尸体数量较多，小兵大师会有所帮助。

9968449afbe2bb1d1ffd37f38272325c1f09c45a.source: Starting at the Frontier Gate, follow the road south through the Eastern Frontier and into Pockmark Flats.
9968449afbe2bb1d1ffd37f38272325c1f09c45a.text: 从边境门出发，沿着道路向南穿过东部边境，进入波马克平原。

9c8a6fdc7336c0cd88f06ea839cc0c100325e126.source: Return to Warmaster Tydus for your reward.
9c8a6fdc7336c0cd88f06ea839cc0c100325e126.text: 返回战帅泰达斯那里领取奖励。

e70ff3f6379e0402b22e97d897875174f3b9095b.source: Simply travel to Serenity Temple and talk to the priestess.
e70ff3f6379e0402b22e97d897875174f3b9095b.text: 只需前往宁静神庙并与女祭司交谈即可。

c23809bf4cbb5252ff3d096e67f9424ceb562568.source: There will be an inventory item given to you upon accepting the quest - make sure that you have enough space in your inventory for it. Be sure that you take it on your journey, or the quest will not update. If you lose it go back to Warmaster Tydus for a replacement.
c23809bf4cbb5252ff3d096e67f9424ceb562568.text: 接受任务后，您将获得一个库存物品 - 确保您的库存中有足够的空间。请确保在旅途中携带它，否则任务将不会更新。如果你丢失了它，请返回战帅泰杜斯处更换。

74050fe93679c5abb547c84e669b0a7ba09d4730.source: Travel east from the Barradin Estate to Lakeside County. Head south to Ashford. Take the southeast bridge to Regent Valley. Once in Regent Valley, follow the road to Fort Ranik.
74050fe93679c5abb547c84e669b0a7ba09d4730.text: 从巴拉丁庄园向东前往湖滨县。向南前往阿什福德。走东南桥到摄政谷。到达摄政谷后，沿着路前往拉尼克堡。

36caa2332e5878a64646db9ec31a340bcc24bee4.source: Deliver the message from Barradin to Lord Darrin.
36caa2332e5878a64646db9ec31a340bcc24bee4.text: 将巴拉丁的消息传递给达林勋爵。

2a5bbb6addf8316fe3ffd69bba4fab72e69855a5.source: If you have already unlocked Fort Ranik, simply map travel there to complete the delivery.
2a5bbb6addf8316fe3ffd69bba4fab72e69855a5.text: 如果您已经解锁了拉尼克堡，只需绘制前往那里的地图即可完成运送。

07204e47a10e224a23062a7c3038bf78d49ac180.source: Otherwise, make your way to Regent Valley via Lakeside County or Wizard's Folly. Refer to the quest map for guidance. Once there, follow the road signs to Fort Ranik and hand the letter to Lord Darrin to claim your reward.
07204e47a10e224a23062a7c3038bf78d49ac180.text: 否则，可经湖滨县 (Lakeside County) 或巫师愚蠢 (Wizard's Folly) 前往摄政谷 (Regent Valley)。请参阅任务地图以获得指导。到达那里后，按照路标前往拉尼克堡，并将信交给达林勋爵以领取奖励。

ef1bcbef4d2326425c368a52ce9833124cb562b6.source: Go to the Watchtower Coast and stop the undead from reaching Beetletun.
ef1bcbef4d2326425c368a52ce9833124cb562b6.text: 前往瞭望塔海岸并阻止不死生物到达甲特勒顿。

6ab2c820f7e63d33ee9d8d21147650757e808fdb.source: Return to Elder Hezron for your reward.
6ab2c820f7e63d33ee9d8d21147650757e808fdb.text: 返回赫兹伦长老那里领取奖励。

eb9cc12b034789a2c725ec0ae01eea4af66bee77.source: The undead come in small waves but grow successively, culminating in a Bone Dragon accompanying the last wave. Move very quickly and use holy damage. If you die, there is a resurrection shrine very close by.
eb9cc12b034789a2c725ec0ae01eea4af66bee77.text: 不死生物以小波的形式出现，但会不断增长，最终形成伴随最后一波的骨龙。快速移动并使用神圣伤害。如果你死了，附近有一个复活神殿。

59e10ed93917adc20c710776bda5042b781317ac.source: Waves 1, 2, and 3, have three groups of enemies each. Wave 4 has four groups. Wave 5 is the last wave, and has three groups, the last group being the Bone Dragon and a Damned Cleric.
59e10ed93917adc20c710776bda5042b781317ac.text: 第 1、2 和 3 波各有三组敌人。第 4 波有四组。第5波是最后一波，分为三组，最后一组是骨龙和诅咒牧师。

1f53c00528a8cea25a7ce45f5629615ea18fdb91.source: You only need to kill the last group of each wave to trigger the next wave to come. For the last wave, the final group is the Bone Dragon with a Cleric, and upon killing them, the quest will complete.
1f53c00528a8cea25a7ce45f5629615ea18fdb91.text: 你只需要杀死每一波的最后一组即可触发下一波的到来。对于最后一波，最后一组是骨龙和牧师，杀死他们后任务就会完成。

033896f7e6cbeacf505c3e5ad3481c6c8031c36e.source: Abandon the quest after completing it and take it again to farm items during times with special drops, such as Wintersday, Halloween, etc.
033896f7e6cbeacf505c3e5ad3481c6c8031c36e.text: 完成任务后放弃任务，并在有特殊掉落的时期再次使用它来农场物品，例如冬日、万圣节等。

1e7971c21a5e1d52f9f3e93a6023128e5512900a.source: On some of the groups, there are a large number of Level 1 and Level 3 enemies. It might be better to take them out quickly, to reduce the number of targets, and also to make it easier to concentrate your entire party's attack damage on the higher level monsters.
1e7971c21a5e1d52f9f3e93a6023128e5512900a.text: 在一些群体中，存在着大量的1级和3级敌人。最好尽快消灭它们，这样可以减少目标数量，也可以更容易地将全队的攻击力集中在更高等级的怪物身上。

801304e1fa7268cdb2bae3b78ed57d8a3b3ac974.source: In the War in Kryta environment you may not need to fight at all: wait a few minutes near a quest mark until 2 groups of Peacekeepers kill all quest foes, then go after the reward.
801304e1fa7268cdb2bae3b78ed57d8a3b3ac974.text: 在科瑞塔战争环境中，你可能根本不需要战斗：在任务标记附近等待几分钟，直到 2 组维和人员杀死所有任务敌人，然后去追求奖励。

4b4b78dedf59e3d46ace09e067fcf9f0b19b4b6f.source: If you don't succeed in stopping them you can just be resurrected nearby and return to finish the job, as the hordes will just wait at the Beetletun gates.
4b4b78dedf59e3d46ace09e067fcf9f0b19b4b6f.text: 如果你没有成功阻止他们，你可以在附近复活并返回完成任务，因为部落只会在甲壳虫洞门口等待。

1c161fb633413fd8b30778841eeb213137c78337.source: If you wait right in front of the gates, the large group of NPCs will engage the enemies as well and they do not need to survive for the quest to complete.
1c161fb633413fd8b30778841eeb213137c78337.text: 如果你在门前等待，一大群 NPC 也会与敌人交战，他们不需要生存就能完成任务。

4f968644e137e5ce27268884bec5368ac2432e95.source: Seek out Galrath at the wizard's tower in Kessex Peak. Put an end to his villainy.
4f968644e137e5ce27268884bec5368ac2432e95.text: 在凯塞克斯峰的法师塔中寻找加拉斯。制止他的恶行。

5844b78ce33cfd76d0b97a80d6030e1785ddbb09.source: Return to Firstwatch Sergio for your reward.
5844b78ce33cfd76d0b97a80d6030e1785ddbb09.text: 返回 Firstwatch Sergio 处领取奖励。

fdf48a0b1be712d733071afbc24674acd3233e07.text: 黑暗伤害：7-13（需要 6 血魔法）

54e7a6eb1e134c75b5de6d662ec535f582a10021.text: 肾上腺素增加双倍（几率：10%）

6f83008addd13bd69903436d53e2de9121dc3b8c.source: Starting from the Temple of the Ages (in order to have a maximum party size of 8) head south through The Black Curtain towards Kessex Peak. You will immediately encounter a group of Reed Stalkers. After defeating the Stalkers follow the path leading to the southeast, making sure to avoid the poisonous water whenever possible. You will soon come upon a Damned Cleric, who once aggroed will be accompanied by Smoke Phantoms and a Wraith. Be sure to dispatch these foes quickly or pull them to the west, because a group of Hellhounds and a Necrid Horseman will be patrolling the area.
6f83008addd13bd69903436d53e2de9121dc3b8c.text: 从万古神殿出发（队伍人数最多为 8 人），向南穿过黑幕，前往凯塞克斯峰。你会立即遇到一群芦苇追猎者。击败潜行者后，沿着通往东南方的道路前进，确保尽可能避开毒水。你很快就会遇到一名该死的牧师，一旦他被激怒，就会有烟雾幻影和幽灵陪伴。一定要迅速消灭这些敌人或将他们拉到西边，因为一群地狱犬和涅克里德骑士将在该地区巡逻。

a31f0d3a3092d92c447735abcbac30fb0f084b0b.source: Continue following the path to the southeast, making sure to watch for more Undead, until you come to a three-way intersection. Take the southern path where you will soon run out of land and be forced to head west to circle around the poisonous swamp. You will encounter a group of Ancient Oakheart, possibly including the Tree of Judgment, as well as some Bog Skale Blighters and the occasional Spined Aloe.
a31f0d3a3092d92c447735abcbac30fb0f084b0b.text: 继续沿着小路向东南方向走，一定要注意更多的亡灵，直到到达一个三路交叉口。走南边的小路，你很快就会耗尽土地，被迫向西绕过有毒的沼泽。你会遇到一群远古橡心树，可能包括审判之树，以及一些沼泽斯卡勒枯萎者和偶尔的刺芦荟。

4c8c2351a06f77f4ab5cc745e5ad9cb636430e8a.source: When you come upon a path follow it to the east, being sure to cross over the bridge to avoid the fetid water. You will come upon another group of Reed Stalkers as well as several Forest Minotaurs. Continue heading east until you reach the portal to Kessex Peak.
4c8c2351a06f77f4ab5cc745e5ad9cb636430e8a.text: 当你遇到一条小路时，沿着它向东走，一定要过桥，以避免恶臭的水。您将遇到另一群芦苇追猎者以及几只森林牛头怪。继续向东行驶，直到到达凯塞克斯峰的入口。

e356f688bf7591dcf74dc7b31f1713c86e750196.source: In Kessex Peak, continue south, passing over the next bridge where you will encounter some Fog Nightmares and more Reed Stalkers. After dispatching the monsters turn towards the southwest and follow the canyon towards the Krytan coast. Be sure to watch out for Nightmares and Aloes that will pop out of the ground while you fight the Reed Stalkers that patrol the canyon.
e356f688bf7591dcf74dc7b31f1713c86e750196.text: 在凯塞克斯峰，继续向南，穿过下一座桥，在那里你会遇到一些雾梦魇和更多的芦苇追猎者。消灭怪物后转向西南方向，沿着峡谷前往科瑞塔海岸。当你与在峡谷巡逻的芦苇追猎者战斗时，一定要小心从地下冒出来的梦魇和芦荟。

6bb528e8f62748eddf3c1438cf6da8a5db496275.source: Once you reach the end of the canyon turn south on the nearby path. Fen Trolls will be patrolling the path along with Ancient Oakhearts, and Forest Minotaurs. The Trolls and Minotaurs have very large patrol areas, so be especially careful not to find yourself stuck between two groups of enemies. When you come to the area where there are about 20 of them guarding the path, study their pattern of movement and aggro them from the north, one group at a time. Continue to follow the path to the southwest until you come to a floating castle overlooking a plateau. Head east until you come to a path leading up to where Galrath and his bandits are waiting.
6bb528e8f62748eddf3c1438cf6da8a5db496275.text: 到达峡谷尽头后，沿着附近的小路向南行驶。沼泽巨魔将与远古橡心树和森林牛头怪一起在道路上巡逻。巨魔和牛头怪的巡逻区域非常大，所以要特别小心，不要发现自己被困在两群敌人之间。当你来到大约有 20 只守卫道路的区域时，研究他们的行动模式并从北面攻击他们，一次一组。继续沿着小路向西南方向行驶，直到到达一座俯瞰高原的漂浮城堡。向东走，直到来到一条小路，通往加尔拉斯和他的强盗正在等待的地方。

345bad51416438d4cb1d303226c753862feea941.source: You will find large groups of Verata the Necromancer's cultists blocking your path. Be careful to only aggro one group at a time; dispatching Verata's army is not easy and aggroing more than one group means almost certain death for lower-level groups or henchmen. If players or henchmen have obtained a high death penalty it may be very difficult to kill even one group. If this happens, it is possible with the right timing to slip past the cult and engage Galrath and his bandits. The Apprentices of Verata will spawn Bone Fiends so a Necromancer with corpse exploitation skills of their own can be very useful. A minion master may not be the best however, as the Apprentices will use Verata's Gaze to steal your minions. After defeating the cultists, head west and kill the bandits before taking on Galrath himself.
345bad51416438d4cb1d303226c753862feea941.text: 你会发现一大群死灵法师维拉塔的信徒挡住了你的去路。小心一次只能攻击一组；消灭维拉塔的军队并不容易，而且攻击多个团体意味着低级别团体或追随者几乎肯定会死亡。如果玩家或追随者获得了很高的死刑，那么即使是杀死一群人也可能非常困难。如果发生这种情况，在正确的时机就有可能溜过邪教并与加拉斯和他的强盗交战。维拉塔的学徒会生成骨魔，因此拥有尸体剥削技能的死灵法师会非常有用。然而，随从大师可能不是最好的，因为学徒会使用维拉塔的凝视来偷走你的随从。击败邪教分子后，向西前进并杀死强盗，然后再与加尔拉斯本人较量。

6ba86e0e43c29b0dc7b6822df4fed7e703586c92.source: Once you have killed Galrath, simply map travel to Lion's Arch and see Sergio for your reward.
6ba86e0e43c29b0dc7b6822df4fed7e703586c92.text: 一旦你杀死了加拉斯，只需在地图上前往狮子拱门并找到塞尔吉奥即可获得奖励。

9efd033eeffe525f390b80e8217de3f8c1cd4c85.source: You may be able to find easier groups to fight through if, once you get to the main plateau area, you follow the northern edge from west to east, then south along the eastern edge along a path inhabited by a few Hill Giants. This path will also aid you if you are working on the cartographer title.
9efd033eeffe525f390b80e8217de3f8c1cd4c85.text: 如果你到达主要高原区域后，沿着北部边缘从西到东，然后沿着东部边缘向南，沿着一条居住着一些山丘巨人的小路，你可能会找到更容易战斗的队伍。如果您正在研究制图师头衔，此路径也会对您有所帮助。

c01808636fbd38100218b5679451c2410951a69d.source: Similarly, pulling some of the groups away from the plateau may make the task of reaching Galrath slightly easier.
c01808636fbd38100218b5679451c2410951a69d.text: 同样，将一些队伍拉离高原可能会使到达加拉斯的任务稍微容易一些。

5d5a561107ec1a869c0413baa485ffa1a4db3e8e.source: The Long Sword which is given as a reward has a 10% furious mod which can be salvaged.
5d5a561107ec1a869c0413baa485ffa1a4db3e8e.text: 作为奖励给出的长剑有 10% 的狂怒模式，可以回收。

13c3d8535b9acfcf4df6154705ac607f0b03ea1b.source: You do not need to kill every bandit to complete the quest, although it does make it easier to kill Galrath.
13c3d8535b9acfcf4df6154705ac607f0b03ea1b.text: 你不需要杀死每一个强盗来完成任务，尽管它确实让杀死加尔拉斯变得更容易。

ba1d1bebab2dcf669f0ad2a89799bc9083a2df94.source: Bringing Frozen Soil can help to suppress resurrection by White Mantle foes if the War in Kryta is active, as well as by Shepherds of Verata.
ba1d1bebab2dcf669f0ad2a89799bc9083a2df94.text: 如果科瑞塔战争正在进行，带来冰冻土壤可以帮助抑制白斗篷敌人以及维拉塔牧羊人的复活。

7e517bd74c16cf6b6f84689c3f1497560917df05.source: For the route to Galrath, see The Villainy of Galrath. He is surrounded by several groups of level 30 bandits. Careful pulling of these mobs is essential to avoid being overwhelmed. Be aware that the mobs tend to aggro simultaneously, so be prepared to conduct long pulls to string them out.
7e517bd74c16cf6b6f84689c3f1497560917df05.text: 关于前往加拉斯的路线，请参阅加拉斯的恶行。他被几群30级的强盗包围着。小心地拉动这些小怪对于避免被淹没至关重要。请注意，小怪往往会同时仇恨，因此请准备好进行长时间的拉力以将它们拉出去。

a2ecc3ece871f54330bf78f3e0170dc2921bede1.source: It is possible to engage the bandits from the foot of the cliff, where the path emerges from the northern valley. The main damage-dealers are melee assassins, so this can trim their numbers down with less risk to your party. You can also lure them into Verata's cultists, who are occupying the lower slopes of the hill; the ensuing fight will usually see the cultists quickly defeated, saving you some work in clearing the way to Galrath.
a2ecc3ece871f54330bf78f3e0170dc2921bede1.text: 可以从悬崖脚下与强盗交战，那里有一条小路从北部山谷延伸出来。主要的伤害造成者是近战刺客，因此这可以减少他们的数量，同时降低你的队伍的风险。你也可以将他们引诱到维拉塔的信徒那里，他们占据了山坡的较低处；接下来的战斗通常会看到邪教分子很快被击败，从而为你节省一些清理通往加拉斯的道路的工作。

7026483dafd4afd993e71f1c5c7a638695854d17.source: Bring Frozen Soil to counter the resurrection skills of the bandits.
7026483dafd4afd993e71f1c5c7a638695854d17.text: 带上冻土来对抗土匪的复活技能。

a086f18665f76e2997f33f1ccd3cf9a2f058e86b.source: Spiteful Spirit works well as the bandits tend to clump on the edge of the hill.
a086f18665f76e2997f33f1ccd3cf9a2f058e86b.text: 恶毒之魂效果很好，因为强盗往往会聚集在山边。

0793486d5bafe817f8d5d0f1a6686243497cb4b2.source: Galrath's Hundred Blades is vulnerable to Pain Inverter.
0793486d5bafe817f8d5d0f1a6686243497cb4b2.text: 加拉斯的百刃很容易受到疼痛反转器的攻击。

6b4facaa0c933c5cd61c23bb27c5de61f89088f4.source: Bring something to counter the powerful bandit healers, e.g. shutdown skills such as Panic, anti-healing such as Lingering Curse, or be able to spike.
6b4facaa0c933c5cd61c23bb27c5de61f89088f4.text: 带一些东西来对抗强大的强盗治疗师，例如关机技能比如Panic，反治疗比如缠绵咒，还是能够秒杀的。

526b1298cadd75b2f8013cc3e0ee01cf45d430f8.source: Mirror of Disenchantment will remove Healer's Boon from the monks.
526b1298cadd75b2f8013cc3e0ee01cf45d430f8.text: 祛魅之镜会移除武僧身上的治疗者恩惠。

6a96093d0286cfeba5870292f73994eca366da63.source: This quest is not available to certain characters.
6a96093d0286cfeba5870292f73994eca366da63.text: 该任务不适用于某些角色。

82b1a43f86290f0f14ddfe7d2b21f5b4b0979052.source: ArenaNet suggests that completing Hell's Precipice will enable those characters to receive the hard mode version. (Source.)
82b1a43f86290f0f14ddfe7d2b21f5b4b0979052.text: ArenaNet 建议完成地狱悬崖将使这些角色能够获得困难模式版本。 （来源。）

dde731502c94a2a79e487985367e969b728b53c6.source: However, some players have been able to obtain the quest without taking that step.
dde731502c94a2a79e487985367e969b728b53c6.text: 然而，有些玩家无需采取这一步就能获得任务。

1fe17e50e304df8d61b58bbae04ff39b4e89fbcb.source: Consets can help with making this quest easier.
1fe17e50e304df8d61b58bbae04ff39b4e89fbcb.text: 约束可以帮助使这个任务变得更容易。

33d6cd480309a37f6b19403108fedbf8f9ac914c.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Primary or secondary profession: warrior
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
33d6cd480309a37f6b19403108fedbf8f9ac914c.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 主要或次要职业：战士
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色

a267abfcd740fe654aa570f382d887aae385c0d7.source: Go to the duke's vineyard and kill all large aloe seeds.
a267abfcd740fe654aa570f382d887aae385c0d7.text: 前往公爵的葡萄园并杀死所有大芦荟种子。

76b72b1cf8d0aaeb7602c90546bedc92a25664e8.text: 杀死 4...0 个以上的大芦荟种子。

9f279b479ee61aa23fb7f8aa12697d8a9d001cde.source: Return to Little Thom for your reward.
9f279b479ee61aa23fb7f8aa12697d8a9d001cde.text: 返回小汤姆那里领取奖励。

1e2f1393ae59ecf64c205a150a9ca4b70ce8f1ac.source: Little Thom will give you a Starter Axe and the following skills upon taking the quest:
1e2f1393ae59ecf64c205a150a9ca4b70ce8f1ac.text: 小汤姆在接受任务后会给你一把入门斧和以下技能：

15b33177e5f7e945ae2a304f3d3543046511ab8e.source: Head Southeast of the The Barradin Estate, to the Vineyard near the Farm. Kill all Aloe Seeds, (just go stand in the middle of the ring they form, and use Cyclone Axe once, they all should die.) then return to Little Thom for your reward.
15b33177e5f7e945ae2a304f3d3543046511ab8e.text: 前往巴拉丁庄园东南方，前往农场附近的葡萄园。杀死所有芦荟种子，（只要站在它们形成的圆环中间，然后使用旋风斧一次，它们都会死。）然后返回小汤姆以获得奖励。

36a3b72a591a829a874628e8b75164cfcabd6e98.source: It is not required to kill the Aloe Seeds with an axe to complete this quest.
36a3b72a591a829a874628e8b75164cfcabd6e98.text: 完成此任务不需要用斧头杀死芦荟种子。

7eebfbdaca15b4471606a782e9a2e0f8e41669c3.source: This quest can be used to farm Unnatural Seeds
7eebfbdaca15b4471606a782e9a2e0f8e41669c3.text: 该任务可用于种植非自然种子

4b0b978428996318e484e9e0cafe99209b07276a.source: Destroy the forest banshees. 5..0 forest banshees remain.
4b0b978428996318e484e9e0cafe99209b07276a.text: 消灭森林女妖。 5..0 森林女妖依然存在。

9ead782302a50c27f2f2cbf2f4400d1fb857d567.source: Do not harm the Wailing Lord.

932c1ff079c240fe7581df10b80193a9fd6356a6.source: Return to Rastigan the Eternal for your reward.
932c1ff079c240fe7581df10b80193a9fd6356a6.text: 返回永恒者拉斯蒂根那里领取奖励。

0bd2113475122af1101b51ce4245782c8d50749d.source: The Wailing Lord resides in his forest in the northwest of the Fissure, though you will need to travel east then north through the Great Battle Field to get there. He and the Banshees are at the far end of the forest across a bridge. The bridge is guarded by a large number of Skeleton Army units, including pop-ups before, on, and after the bridge. Proceed with caution even if things look clear or you can be quickly overwhelmed.
0bd2113475122af1101b51ce4245782c8d50749d.text: 哀嚎领主居住在裂谷西北部的森林中，不过你需要先向东然后向北穿过伟大战场才能到达那里。他和女妖们穿过一座桥来到了森林的尽头。这座桥由大量骷髅军守卫，包括桥前、桥上和桥后的弹出窗口。即使事情看起来很清楚，也要谨慎行事，否则您很快就会不知所措。

a876527f331be3134772a7789ac39167e47bd636.source: Do not attack the Wailing Lord. You will be kicked out of the Fissure if he dies. Beware that because he's hostile he will take AoE damage and will be attacked by minions (if you have any). It is best to pull the Banshees, and any other enemy, across the bridge to ensure the Wailing Lord is unharmed.
a876527f331be3134772a7789ac39167e47bd636.text: 不要攻击哀嚎领主。如果他死了，你就会被踢出裂缝。请注意，因为他是敌对的，所以他会受到 AoE 伤害，并且会受到小兵的攻击（如果有的话）。最好将女妖和其他敌人拉过桥，以确保哀嚎领主不受伤害。

72672c9d59c8507c62fb2bb7f0324fefa27267a5.source: Do not take the quest offered by the Wailing Lord unless and until the party is ready, as it can make for a speedy exit from the Fissure for the unprepared. You don't need to talk to the Wailing Lord at all to complete the current quest. You can just go back to Rastigan to pick up the reward.
72672c9d59c8507c62fb2bb7f0324fefa27267a5.text: 除非队伍准备好，否则不要接受哀嚎领主提供的任务，因为这可以让没有准备的人迅速退出裂缝。你根本不需要与哀嚎领主交谈来完成当前的任务。你只需回到拉斯蒂根领取奖励即可。

f69273317b5be8bf26535c95da827891b30d5625.source: An unlocked Chest will spawn near the Wailing Lord when you complete the quest objectives.
f69273317b5be8bf26535c95da827891b30d5625.text: 当您完成任务目标时，一个解锁的宝箱将在哀嚎领主附近生成。

5341b397f701346497e6b904ae0c0d17e4a71d80.source: Not being primary or secondary Warrior.

49adea9db7efe3099d2ae98a3096bf8a3ba3417a.source: Did not complete Augury Rock for the first time as a secondary Warrior.
49adea9db7efe3099d2ae98a3096bf8a3ba3417a.text: 第一次没有以辅助战士的身份完成占卜岩。

ef4130851c7d640e07327829d0371ab540e66cf6.source: Go to the Scar and slay the Orshad Chieftain.
ef4130851c7d640e07327829d0371ab540e66cf6.text: 前往疤痕并杀死奥尔沙德酋长。

5be7b7b1545fdce407421e740787f825cfc12fa3.source: Return to Agastos the Brave for your reward.
5be7b7b1545fdce407421e740787f825cfc12fa3.text: 返回勇敢者阿加斯托斯那里领取奖励。

93de9450d8f7322b51f3872085662b008ba0946a.source: Head south from Destiny's Gorge into The Scar until you reach a teleporter where groups of hydras patrol. Use the teleporter to enter the gorge. Losaru groups will be patrolling the oasis with a boss in the center. To avoid being overwhelmed, pull each group away from the others before killing them. Continue southeast until you reach a small river, and then head east until you get to an open area. The Orshad Chieftain will be in the center surrounded by patrols. Again, pull the groups one by one. Defeat the chieftain and then return to Agastos the Brave for your reward.
93de9450d8f7322b51f3872085662b008ba0946a.text: 从命运峡谷向南进入疤痕，直到到达传送点，那里有成群的九头蛇巡逻。使用传送器进入峡谷。洛萨鲁小队将在绿洲巡逻，首领位于中心。为了避免被淹没，在杀死他们之前将每个小组从其他小组中拉开。继续向东南方向行驶，直到到达一条小河，然后向东行驶，直到到达一片开阔区域。奥尔沙德酋长将位于中心，周围有巡逻队。再次，将各组一一拉动。击败酋长，然后返回勇敢者阿加斯托斯那里领取奖励。

6ca57d6ec4253eea97fcadbe7bf52c3ddb8ed08c.source: For those who have difficulty with hydras, an easier route is from the Thirsty River. There is a hidden entrance into the gorge to the extreme west of where the path opens up. Hug the southern wall and you will turn northward passing under a rope bridge guarded by a Dune Burrower at each end. This route is somewhat shorter as well, and there are 3 Losaru bosses that are fairly easy to kill, providing a nice +6% to your morale. An image of this route can be found on the discussion page.
6ca57d6ec4253eea97fcadbe7bf52c3ddb8ed08c.text: 对于那些难以对付九头蛇的人来说，一条更简单的路线是从口渴河出发。在小路的最西端有一个通往峡谷的隐藏入口。紧靠南墙，您将转向北边，穿过绳索桥，绳桥的两端都有沙丘挖掘者把守。这条路线也较短，并且有 3 个洛萨鲁 Boss 相当容易杀死，为你的士气提供了不错的+6%。可以在讨论页面上找到该路线的图像。

59c0d80a574d39689fb5b64bd42721e33fa756af.text: 杀死十个巨大的石元素。

ad336c56fb81596279764f66de966339cf5a3cff.text: 返回肯德里克·雷德斯塔夫。

3e0ea7202507d74944cbecdde494953a644f7962.source: Leave Serenity Temple and walk around the Pockmark Flats, killing any Hulking Stone Elementals you find. Large numbers of elementals can be found in the entrances to the large crater to the east, and they can sometimes be found in the crater itself. Once you have killed 10, the quest is fullfilled and you can go for the reward. Alternatively, you can find large numbers of Hulking Stone Elementals in Old Ascalon without any Stone Elemental elementalists accompanying them.
3e0ea7202507d74944cbecdde494953a644f7962.text: 离开宁静神殿，绕着麻子平地走一圈，杀死你发现的任何巨石元素。在东部大陨石坑的入口处可以找到大量元素，有时也可以在陨石坑本身找到它们。一旦你杀死了10个，任务就完成了，你就可以去领取奖励了。或者，您可以在旧阿斯卡隆找到大量巨大的石元素，而没有任何石元素元素师伴随它们。

04e6971c5bd183378556070dd60c0cb5bbc63aec.source: Keep hold of any Scorched Lodestones you find, since 3 will be needed for the following quest, The Geomancer's Test.
04e6971c5bd183378556070dd60c0cb5bbc63aec.text: 保留你找到的所有烧焦的磁石，因为接下来的任务“风水师的测试”将需要 3 个。

2a15e1e5740e44c705ddd2da3d1cdbca22f55409.source: Although Kendrick tells you to kill elementals in Pockmark Flats, the quest will update when you kill a Hulking Stone Elemental anywhere.
2a15e1e5740e44c705ddd2da3d1cdbca22f55409.text: 尽管肯德里克告诉你要杀死麻子平地的元素，但当你在任何地方杀死巨石元素时，任务就会更新。

efe14653a36331fbcfcfb747ace7fe0300fcc00d.source: Talk to Cynn in Traveler's Vale.
efe14653a36331fbcfcfb747ace7fe0300fcc00d.text: 与旅行者谷的辛恩交谈。

6ff246afd1430418b764f81c6d83c2e811b166de.source: Help Cynn find Mhenlo in Iron Horse Mine.
6ff246afd1430418b764f81c6d83c2e811b166de.text: 帮助辛恩在铁马矿找到姆洛。

e91477d8ed13e81f5a18274786e323632b091c21.source: The quest is quite easy, just meet Cynn outside of Yak's Bend and fight a few groups northwest into Iron Horse Mine. In Iron Horse Mine, take the right fork and kill the first group of Stone Summit, then talk to Mhenlo to get your reward. This quest is also right on the path of Minaar's Trouble.
e91477d8ed13e81f5a18274786e323632b091c21.text: 任务很简单，只需在牦牛弯外与辛恩会合，然后与西北方向的几支队伍战斗进入铁马矿即可。在铁马矿井，走右边的叉子，杀死第一批石峰，然后与Mhenlo交谈以获得奖励。这个任务也正好在米纳尔的麻烦的路上。

41630b2249f8b4f9ba40e1ed597f75b13608c18d.source: Mhenlo's apology does not appear in Team Chat. If you leave the Iron Horse Mine before accepting the reward, Mhenlo will not be there when players return, and they will have to abandon the quest and start it again. If Mhenlo dies before the party rescues him, Cynn will still say "You're not dead!" and the quest will still update.
41630b2249f8b4f9ba40e1ed597f75b13608c18d.text: Mhenlo 的道歉并未出现在团队聊天中。如果在接受奖励之前离开铁马矿，当玩家返回时，门洛将不会在那里，他们将不得不放弃任务并重新开始。如果 Mhenlo 在队伍营救他之前死亡，Cynn 仍然会说“你没有死！”并且任务仍然会更新。

57ac018b740ef1fdfc6c2061db3baca43f8d6139.source: Talk to Ralena Stormbringer in Foible's Fair to learn Orion's whereabouts.
57ac018b740ef1fdfc6c2061db3baca43f8d6139.text: 与福布尔集市的雷琳娜·风暴使者交谈，了解猎户座的下落。

ad2328c59d4777012360fdfc008a87cde11b6c1a.source: Find Orion in Wizard's Folly and convince him to come home.
ad2328c59d4777012360fdfc008a87cde11b6c1a.text: 在《巫师愚蠢》中找到猎户座并说服他回家。

e34ad4d06afc65a8a875f71f7a7a7a7bdede909c.source: Return to Sandre Elek for your reward.
e34ad4d06afc65a8a875f71f7a7a7a7bdede909c.text: 返回桑德雷·埃莱克那里领取奖励。

194456f4ac0a6067b5650863f9bf50272d5dd420.source: Travel to Foible's Fair and talk to Ralena Stormbringer for a lead on Orion. To find him, exit the outpost, following the road northeast until you reach a house on your left. From there, head west through the trees toward the quest marker.
194456f4ac0a6067b5650863f9bf50272d5dd420.text: 前往福伊布尔集市并与雷莱娜·风暴使者交谈以获得猎户座的线索。要找到他，请退出前哨站，沿着东北方向的道路行驶，直到到达左侧的一栋房子。从那里向西穿过树林前往任务标记。

cc3085bf83178b980f5508f94dd8a9278f6110a1.source: There is a large number of level 3 Black Bears and Bandit Blood Sworn along the way; draw them out carefully to avoid being overwhelmed. Once you break the news to Orion about his romantic rival, travel back to Ascalon City and speak to Sandre Elek for the reward.
cc3085bf83178b980f5508f94dd8a9278f6110a1.text: 沿途有大量3级黑熊和盗血誓人；小心地把它们拉出来，以免被淹没。一旦你向猎户座透露了他的情敌的消息，就可以返回阿斯卡隆市并与桑德雷·埃莱克交谈以获得奖励。

c2bfb1d09d62d4d9223d4f9830edf514fab4f495.source: Talking to Orion before talking to Ralena Stormbringer will initiate a dialogue with him, but he will not be swayed.
c2bfb1d09d62d4d9223d4f9830edf514fab4f495.text: 在与雷莱娜·风暴使者交谈之前先与猎户座交谈将发起与他的对话，但他不会被动摇。

5d64226a3822655845c805979b7c44882baf7ef0.source: Orion starts walking as soon as you get done talking to him and, unless killed along the way, ultimately returns to Foible's Fair.
5d64226a3822655845c805979b7c44882baf7ef0.text:
猎户座在你与他交谈完后就开始行走，除非途中被杀，否则最终会返回福布尔集市。

MAPPINGOUT_f6cea476ad309b0_0
沿着公路穿过北科瑞塔省到达尼波台地。

c95bffa31efa6e2553b20053bf3593c9cf156c12.source: Having watched the dialogue between the couple and the norn in the Hall of Monuments.
c95bffa31efa6e2553b20053bf3593c9cf156c12.text: 在纪念碑大厅里观看了这对夫妇与诺恩的对话。

7209443a8b49024561f3ed5a79aa85996ae090cd.text: 参加格温和凯兰的婚礼。

1a77aec5df78c91338b8a38eab6d8ff0fd73f5b1.source: Keiran Thackeray joins your party as a Hero.
1a77aec5df78c91338b8a38eab6d8ff0fd73f5b1.text: 凯兰·萨克雷作为英雄加入你的队伍。

5efd2b69c0a6004a21447000312fb7e0ccebc361.source: Talk to Thackeray in the Hall of Monuments; he will eventually take you to the wedding site. During the wedding, speak to Olaf when he asks for someone to represent Gwen.
5efd2b69c0a6004a21447000312fb7e0ccebc361.text: 在纪念碑大厅与萨克雷交谈；他最终会带你去婚礼现场。婚礼期间，当奥拉夫要求有人代表格温时与他交谈。

882a640e2f864025b29e9edc09793945924091dc.source: It is possible to shadow step away from a Vanguard Warrior using a skill like Heart of Shadow or Viper's Defense to "portal jump" outside Olafstead and walk around Varajar Fells.
882a640e2f864025b29e9edc09793945924091dc.text: 可以使用“暗影之心”或“毒蛇防御”等技能从先锋战士身边躲开，在奥拉夫斯特德外进行“传送门跳跃”并绕着瓦拉贾荒原走动。

45bf8b34ab87e7db73da1497106d721de2db49b8.source: If you didn't complete Norn Catering there will be no food table, just the flower arrangements.
45bf8b34ab87e7db73da1497106d721de2db49b8.text: 如果您没有完成诺恩餐饮，则不会有餐桌，只有插花。

59be4ad73914816f0ba6b27626dd27d152b38811.source: The reward text reads, "You join Keiran Thackeray's party", an inversion of the usual text ("[Hero Name] joins your party"). Jora, Vekk, and Ogden retain their original names, whereas they usually switch to a generic name if their namesake is present in the area.
59be4ad73914816f0ba6b27626dd27d152b38811.text: 奖励文本写道：“你加入 Keiran Thackeray 的队伍”，这是通常文本的反转（“[英雄名字]加入你的队伍”）。乔拉、维克和奥格登保留他们原来的名字，但如果他们的同名者出现在该地区，他们通常会改用通用名称。

673656a725ee73bb2b54aa3c69bc7c3ef922a2ca.source: Rescue the Chosen hostages in the Wilds of the Maguuma Jungle.
673656a725ee73bb2b54aa3c69bc7c3ef922a2ca.text: 在迈古玛丛林的荒野中营救被选中的人质。

a082e4d09c8e94ce6b969889441697c810466ef3.source: Acquire a devourer egg from Fadden Hathorn in the devourer cave.
a082e4d09c8e94ce6b969889441697c810466ef3.text: 从吞噬者洞穴的法登·哈索恩那里获得一颗吞噬者蛋。

06a46726d7c957f47e9dfc895e778bc57b8ab5e1.source: Take the devourer egg to Pitney in Ashford.
06a46726d7c957f47e9dfc895e778bc57b8ab5e1.text: 将吞噬者蛋交给阿什福德的皮特尼。

6ef176467b573ef76f63ecfc13434fc446f45df1.source: Follow Pitney and kill the Queen Worm.
6ef176467b573ef76f63ecfc13434fc446f45df1.text: 跟随皮特尼并杀死女王蠕虫。

de08507003073ce9eebc27778797560489a56b57.source: Once you kill the Worm Queen, even before turning the quest in, slightly fewer Plague Worms will spawn in the area.
de08507003073ce9eebc27778797560489a56b57.text: 一旦你杀死了蠕虫女王，甚至在交任务之前，该地区生成的瘟疫蠕虫就会稍微少一些。

e073182a194a8aa54c938fb92e25553371dd4ff4.source: Your first task is getting a devourer egg to use as bait. You can earn two by completing The Egg Hunter quest involving Fadden Hathorn, to whom Pitney directs you at first. Alternatively, you can barter for one with local collectors: trade 5 skale fins to Brownlow or 3 dull carapaces to Rownan.
e073182a194a8aa54c938fb92e25553371dd4ff4.text: 你的第一个任务是获得一个吞噬者蛋作为诱饵。你可以通过完成涉及法登·哈索恩的鸡蛋猎人任务来获得两个，皮特尼首先指示你去找他。或者，您也可以与当地收藏家进行物物交换：将 5 个鳞鳍交易给 Brownlow，或者将 3 个钝甲壳交易给 Rownan。

c7a86495ea83321c5a45957aef584b860a74c110.source: Hand the egg over and follow Pitney to his field. He will use the bait to draw the Worm Queen out of the ground alongside several Plague Worms, who are hostile (in contrast to all the others in the area).
c7a86495ea83321c5a45957aef584b860a74c110.text: 把鸡蛋交给他，然后跟着皮特尼去他的田地。他将使用诱饵将蠕虫女王与几只敌对的瘟疫蠕虫一起从地面上引出来（与该地区的所有其他蠕虫形成鲜明对比）。

d1a9d82d4ec4ada0b0b9094d5cf60804ff401004.source: It is useful to clear out any roaming wolves nearby before engaging the queen to avoid getting overwhelmed, especially at lower levels.
d1a9d82d4ec4ada0b0b9094d5cf60804ff401004.text: 在与女王交战之前清除附近任何漫游的狼是很有用的，以避免被淹没，特别是在较低水平的情况下。

2e5b1e556150584184f079a9b703c1b627ac635d.source: Once the queen is slain, talk to Pitney (who should be standing nearby) for your reward.
2e5b1e556150584184f079a9b703c1b627ac635d.text: 女王被杀死后，与皮特尼（他应该站在附近）交谈以获得奖励。

4cdd2a9ce6c9a922842a63ddd18090694bcebba6.source: Sometimes Pitney will get caught on Devona, and you will have to leave the area and try again. If you leave the area during this quest, you will have to obtain another egg in order to finish it.
4cdd2a9ce6c9a922842a63ddd18090694bcebba6.text: 有时皮特尼会在德沃纳被抓住，你将不得不离开该地区并重试。如果您在此任务期间离开该区域，您将必须获得另一个鸡蛋才能完成它。

b9204f57bf787f159eb964e55fda58967affb1df.source: Find the stolen storage vault and return it to Xunlai Agent Honlo.
b9204f57bf787f159eb964e55fda58967affb1df.text: 找到被盗的存储库并将其归还给迅来特工 Honlo。

dbd70c95f34e14169b2f98293d276c263af0722d.source: See Xunlai Agent Honlo for your reward.
dbd70c95f34e14169b2f98293d276c263af0722d.text: 请前往迅来代理 Honlo 领取奖励。

f3d0dac97f315f9c0d20e0e153d3efcc1ce6b5af.source: After leaving from The Marketplace head east. You will encounter two groups of Am Fah after crossing the second of two bridges (1). Try to engage only one group at a time, but don't worry, if your party wipes you will be resurrected nearby. After defeating the two groups of Am Fah continue to head east. You will come into contact with two more manageably placed groups of Am Fah as well as a statue of Balthazar (2) that you can kneel in front of to give your team a boost. After killing the Am Fah enter a small alcove to the east. Once inside you will encounter a group of Am Fah guarding the Storage Chest (3). As soon as you attack the Am Fah more enemies will fall from the ceiling, so be ready for a fight.
f3d0dac97f315f9c0d20e0e153d3efcc1ce6b5af.text: 从市场离开后向东行驶。穿过两座桥中的第二座桥 (1) 后，您将遇到两组 Am Fah。尝试一次只与一组交战，但不用担心，如果你的队伍消灭了你，你会在附近复活。击败Am Fah的两支队伍后继续向东进发。您将接触到两个位置更易于管理的 Am Fah 团体以及巴尔萨扎雕像 (2)，您可以跪在雕像前为您的团队加油。杀死 Am Fah 后，进入东边的一个小壁龛。进入后你会遇到一群守卫储藏箱的 Am Fah (3)。一旦你攻击 Am Fah，就会有更多的敌人从天花板上掉下来，所以要做好战斗准备。

98cd614bcfec1b13070d05ff62f258b212ec3325.source: You do not need to kill the Am Fah that are guarding the chest, you can run to chest, pick it up and then map travel back to Kaineng Center.
98cd614bcfec1b13070d05ff62f258b212ec3325.text: 你不需要杀死守卫宝箱的Am Fah，你可以跑到宝箱处，捡起它，然后用地图旅行回到凯能中心。

e58aef7a8f665762e5cf0b14b98d024843241cd2.source: You can complete this quest, Eliminate the Am Fah, and A Monstrous Revelation simultaneously.
e58aef7a8f665762e5cf0b14b98d024843241cd2.text: 你可以同时完成这个任务、消灭阿姆法赫和巨大的启示。

f6cdea476ad309b0d6e4a2a152e421f16574bb2a.source: Follow the road through North Kryta Province to Nebo Terrace.
f6cdea476ad309b0d6e4a2a152e421f16574bb2a.text: 沿着公路穿过北科瑞塔省到达尼波台地。

a8ecd6513d29790fc2d8018f56125f4e120ea3d3.source: Talk to Etham the Artisan in Nebo Village.
a8ecd6513d29790fc2d8018f56125f4e120ea3d3.text: 与尼波村的工匠埃瑟姆交谈。

6b707133431ef4f2382dfaff0839b61e4e714140.source: Nebo Village is a small settlement in the northwestern part of Nebo Terrace. Leave from Lions Arch or D'Alessio Seaboard and follow the quest marker across North Kryta Province to Nebo Terrace. The village is a short walk northwest. Alternatively, players may map travel to Bergen Hot Springs or Beetletun and walk to Nebo Village from there (see map). Talk to Etham to complete the quest.
6b707133431ef4f2382dfaff0839b61e4e714140.text: 尼波村是尼波台地西北部的一个小聚居地。从狮子拱门或达莱西奥海滨出发，沿着任务标记穿过北科瑞塔省到达尼波台。该村位于西北方向一小段步行路程处。或者，玩家可以在地图上前往卑尔根温泉或 Beetletun，然后从那里步行到尼波村（参见地图）。与伊瑟姆交谈以完成任务。

dfdfb22706aff6be2ea867744adc08860081816c.source: Pair this quest with Blankets for the Settlers (from Captain Greywind in Ascalon Settlement); both quests require visiting the same person in Nebo Village.
dfdfb22706aff6be2ea867744adc08860081816c.text: 将这个任务与定居者的毯子配对（来自阿斯卡隆定居点的格雷温德船长）；这两个任务都需要拜访尼波村的同一个人。

f0a72147135051d4485caadb5c63ceefc59a246b.source: While this quest is to retrieve a specific item, the "result" isn't like any other, in that the item being retrieved doesn't actually appear in your inventory, and it isn't an item that needs to be carried to a certain person or place.
f0a72147135051d4485caadb5c63ceefc59a246b.text: 虽然此任务是检索特定物品，但“结果”与其他任务不同，因为被检索的物品实际上不会出现在您的库存中，并且它不是需要携带到特定人员或地点的物品。

f40bf1c3a678b75e13e735bd84636f787eaaf9c8.source: The quest dialogue states that you are to return with a Storage Vault but the item that you obtain is called a Storage Chest.
f40bf1c3a678b75e13e735bd84636f787eaaf9c8.text: 任务对话表明您将带着存储库返回，但您获得的物品称为存储箱。

38fe4a32b9597e262b0b45cf2aa126a82e9e879f.source: Help Hogun save his fiancee from corsair rivals.
38fe4a32b9597e262b0b45cf2aa126a82e9e879f.text: 帮助霍根从海盗竞争对手手中拯救他的未婚妻。

2097be531227c0b87ea2ffe1c31eddf0dbc78cff.source: Kill Hogun and his band of corsairs.
2097be531227c0b87ea2ffe1c31eddf0dbc78cff.text: 杀死霍根和他的海盗团。

722ba9e81a85cd53746ee408672168e431d38c3b.source: Speak with Ailonseh Dejarin and see if she is hurt.
722ba9e81a85cd53746ee408672168e431d38c3b.text: 与 Ailonseh Dejarin 交谈，看看她是否受伤。

8c32266a64ceef5d62f2f54de2dbf24585a33f87.source: Escort Ailonseh Dejarin to Camp Hojanu.
8c32266a64ceef5d62f2f54de2dbf24585a33f87.text: 护送 Ailonseh Dejarin 前往 Hojanu 营地。

de52e713a92a7a2ca8f4156acaa1f4d52331f566.source: After accepting the quest from Hogun (who is standing outside Pogahn Passage), escort him to where Ailonseh is being held. After some dialogue, the corsairs will turn hostile, so kill them. It's best that, before escorting Alionseh to Camp Hojanu, your party would kill all the monsters along the path to avoid her dying because she is only a level 10 monk. Be wary not to let her lag too far behind, as she has no regard for the aggro range of monsters, leading to her quick demise.
de52e713a92a7a2ca8f4156acaa1f4d52331f566.text: 接受霍根（站在波甘通道外）的任务后，护送他前往关押艾隆塞的地方。经过一番对话后，海盗们会变得敌对，所以杀死他们。最好在护送Alionseh前往Hojanu营地之前，你的队伍杀死沿途的所有怪物，以免她死亡，因为她只是10级武僧。小心不要让她落后太远，因为她不考虑怪物的仇恨范围，导致她很快死亡。

ad3928335fa7cf0e2af3a9c6c46760793351443a.source: Talk to Zenos and join his crew.
ad3928335fa7cf0e2af3a9c6c46760793351443a.text: 与芝诺斯交谈并加入他的团队。

293e19ce032d3a6f377069a69fb5b257e067d771.source: Obtain funding. Convince Po Fang in Kaineng Center to fund the expedition.
293e19ce032d3a6f377069a69fb5b257e067d771.text: 获得资金。说服凯能中心的坡方资助这次探险。

a3b3b114ebf00aa2826d71ae438ebc5b36d9c1fc.source: Make living history. Convince Jin Siyan with the Ministry of Earth to chronicle the expedition.
a3b3b114ebf00aa2826d71ae438ebc5b36d9c1fc.text: 创造活生生的历史。说服地球部的金丝燕记录这次探险。

48118d2c9ae11f566c22c13c2502b118ccb01da4.source: Hire a tracker. Convince Nendros to join the expedition.
48118d2c9ae11f566c22c13c2502b118ccb01da4.text: 雇用一名追踪员。说服南德罗斯加入探险队。

afe9d7ffe62fec181f858eaabd1840f8612fb456.source: Bring firepower. Convince Zenos' estranged wife Enelora to join the expedition.
afe9d7ffe62fec181f858eaabd1840f8612fb456.text: 带上火力。说服芝诺斯分居的妻子埃内洛拉加入探险队。

d848f66694f2148902b92066cc63ee29a3e0d142.source: Before you can embark on the monster hunting expedition, you'll need to rally some assistance and support from Zenos' crew in various locations around the Jade Sea and Kaineng, requiring some map travel.
d848f66694f2148902b92066cc63ee29a3e0d142.text: 在你开始怪物狩猎探险之前，你需要在玉海和凯能周围的不同地点获得芝诺斯船员的一些帮助和支持，这需要一些地图旅行。

8dfdf1b628589c4040ecbc7b61939c7a8a1d8cb3.source: Zenos himself can be found on the island in the middle of Silent Surf, and heading in from Seafarer's Rest provides the shortest and simplest route. Take a quick turn north when outside Seafarer's Rest, then cross over the bridge to the central island.
8dfdf1b628589c4040ecbc7b61939c7a8a1d8cb3.text: 芝诺斯本人就在寂静冲浪中心的岛上，从海员休息处前往是最短、最简单的路线。在海员休息站外快速向北转，然后穿过桥梁到达中央岛。

2717083254ba5e0f2bf49020062ad7b7c8a31119.source: Po Fang and Jin Siyan can both be found in Kaineng Center.
2717083254ba5e0f2bf49020062ad7b7c8a31119.text: 坡方和金丝燕都可以在凯能中心找到。

e7e9de0c16eae23df979e6293dafcf5069d071b3.source: Nendros is standing by the resurrection shrine in Silent Surf, just outside Seafarer's Rest.
e7e9de0c16eae23df979e6293dafcf5069d071b3.text: 南德罗斯站在寂静海浪的复活神殿旁，就在海员休息处外。

84d3c6902e5e2c39cc20f9f7c229d0a6876a8d79.source: Enelora is waiting in Silent Surf, just outside the Leviathan Pits.
84d3c6902e5e2c39cc20f9f7c229d0a6876a8d79.text: 埃内洛拉正在利维坦坑外的寂静冲浪中等待。

4de76352082915168753bcb65da846f61441e08c.source: After speaking to all the crew members, return to Zenos on the island and tell him about your progress. After that, go to the Leviathan Pits to collect your reward.
4de76352082915168753bcb65da846f61441e08c.text: 与所有船员交谈后，返回岛上的芝诺斯并告诉他你的进展。之后，前往利维坦坑领取奖励。

1ae66ac2325dc4d6f28da758e7ec0a1de333e487.source: When you receive this quest's reward, the followup quest is automatically added to your quest log.
1ae66ac2325dc4d6f28da758e7ec0a1de333e487.text: 当您收到此任务的奖励时，后续任务将自动添加到您的任务日志中。

003a1a2667e536194f53426eefd29cd89f36647a.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 所需英雄：格温

28b2909f3bf55f13db51008165dc446c2f0d5e1a.source: A Tapestry Shred or Tattered Girl's Cape in your inventory
28b2909f3bf55f13db51008165dc446c2f0d5e1a.text: 库存中的挂毯碎片或破烂的女孩斗篷

841c9748f5d319df834ae31708dccf2cfaaa399d.source: Travel to the ruins in Diessa Lowlands.

7ac0b24bc6dedcecd143d58720fd08f5d01cc5b4.source: Defeat the Charr guarding the ruins to free the prisoners. You have [4...0] groups remaining.
7ac0b24bc6dedcecd143d58720fd08f5d01cc5b4.text: 击败守卫废墟的夏尔以释放囚犯。您还剩下 [4...0] 个组。

93ea95a344cb7a1d3c359d9bcd974c715abad54f.source: Find Dahgar the Eye of Flame in Old Ascalon and destroy him.
93ea95a344cb7a1d3c359d9bcd974c715abad54f.text: 在旧阿斯卡隆找到火焰之眼达加尔并消灭他。

598fe722807e2f64733f613124cefd3a0e0b52b8.source: Find Gwen's hidden treasure in the ruins of Ashford.
598fe722807e2f64733f613124cefd3a0e0b52b8.text: 在阿什福德废墟中找到格温隐藏的宝藏。

8af6209b46987c8e9c308d706b0fabfe4a3a3fc1.source: Bring news of the Charr's defeat to Duke Barradin in Piken Square.
8af6209b46987c8e9c308d706b0fabfe4a3a3fc1.text: 将夏尔战败的消息带给皮肯广场的巴拉丁公爵。

0c0bc5aa2150eb495d48ab5128847565dcd80969.source: Gwen's Flute (unique) (obtained during the quest, not at the end)
0c0bc5aa2150eb495d48ab5128847565dcd80969.text: 格温的长笛（独特）（在任务期间获得，而不是在结束时获得）

c907db4d0f667086f6126a212b963146bb33a079.source: Starting from Nolani Academy, which is the closest outpost to the quest, go to Diessa Lowlands and make your way to quest marker. Once there, clear the temple and approach the prisoners.
c907db4d0f667086f6126a212b963146bb33a079.text: 从距离任务最近的前哨站诺拉尼学院出发，前往迪萨低地并前往任务标记。到达那里后，清理寺庙并接近囚犯。

4c9e8607a75ca512af796f8e694ade04d1e12dc7.source: Map travel to Sardelac Sanitarium, go outside to Old Ascalon and head to the cave in the south-east. Slay Dahgar the Eye of Flame.
4c9e8607a75ca512af796f8e694ade04d1e12dc7.text: 地图旅行到沙德拉疗养院，出去到旧阿斯卡隆，然后前往东南部的洞穴。杀死火焰之眼达加尔。

4e41aa5810ddac15611ca7a15d7a21feb197f256.source: Go to the former pig fencing (follow the quest marker) and kneel in the middle of it. You will receive Gwen's Flute.
4e41aa5810ddac15611ca7a15d7a21feb197f256.text: 前往以前的猪栅栏（按照任务标记）并跪在其中。您将收到格温的长笛。

0f06e16fc33175dc76e9412a7ced54b786fff96b.source: Claim your reward from Duke Barradin in Piken Square.
0f06e16fc33175dc76e9412a7ced54b786fff96b.text: 在皮肯广场向巴拉丁公爵领取奖励。

37bfa48e220c2abca514b2d4fb02c6c7b146a9c4.source: Accepting this quest will cost you the Tapestry Shred and/or Tattered Girl's Cape.
37bfa48e220c2abca514b2d4fb02c6c7b146a9c4.text: 接受此任务将花费你挂毯碎片和/或破烂女孩的斗篷。

efae07c97860e476ca4ab3e56bfa1435efb8537b.source: Gwen's treasure is actually her flute, which you receive during the quest.
efae07c97860e476ca4ab3e56bfa1435efb8537b.text: 格温的宝藏实际上是她的长笛，你在任务中收到。

2370b12204974cc3b26b7a72dcd5741ae68d3152.source: When the quest objective reads "Find Gwen's hidden treasure in the ruins of Ashford", go to the spot marked on the map, and then use the '/kneel' command. You will receive Gwen's Flute when doing so.
2370b12204974cc3b26b7a72dcd5741ae68d3152.text: 当任务目标显示“在阿什福德废墟中找到格温隐藏的宝藏”时，前往地图上标记的地点，然后使用“/跪”命令。这样做时你将收到格温的长笛。

ad77c32d0cd689fdd72b985a11c45054c49f2726.source: Gwen's Broken Flute found in Old Ascalon is not related to this quest.
ad77c32d0cd689fdd72b985a11c45054c49f2726.text: 在旧阿斯卡隆发现的格温的断笛与该任务无关。

8089e19769fddb5e65553ba701f479f772f71b33.source: As the flute is obtained during the quest, you can repeat the quest by abandoning it in an outpost. Therefore you are able to obtain multiple flutes.
8089e19769fddb5e65553ba701f479f772f71b33.text: 由于长笛是在任务中获得的，因此您可以通过将其丢弃在前哨站来重复任务。因此您可以获得多个凹槽。

45e4b634e6eb8b2f732f02a8c29f7c2c293acc88.source: Patrol Nightfallen Jahai for signs of the enemy. Dispatch any foes found along the way.
45e4b634e6eb8b2f732f02a8c29f7c2c293acc88.text: 巡逻夜魔贾海以寻找敌人的踪迹。消灭沿途发现的所有敌人。

46e00bce1ca7e82d7da3adcaaf88a8192821152c.source: Defeat Abaddon's Adjutant and the Emissary of Dhuum.
46e00bce1ca7e82d7da3adcaaf88a8192821152c.text: 击败阿巴顿的副官和德姆的使者。

955e798fa694324d95cce86036a850253f574372.text: 去找凯什塞克领取奖励。

eb995f36cc10adda0ca67fd90aa23cf5727fcc7c.source: Follow the quest pointer on a trip around Nightfallen Jahai, starting from the center and then turning in counter-clockwise direction. There is a total of 6 checkpoints that your party has to visit to complete the quest. At each checkpoint except the last, there is a group of 4 Torment creatures that your party must defeat to proceed to the next checkpoint. At the final checkpoint, it will initially be two NPCs having a conversation, before a quest trigger turns them hostile. Defeat the two bosses to complete this quest.
eb995f36cc10adda0ca67fd90aa23cf5727fcc7c.text: 跟随任务指针围绕堕夜者贾海旅行，从中心开始，然后逆时针方向转动。您的队伍必须访问总共 6 个检查站才能完成任务。在除最后一个检查点之外的每个检查点，都有一组 4 个折磨生物，您的队伍必须击败它们才能进入下一个检查点。在最后一个检查点，最初是两个 NPC 进行对话，然后任务触发使他们变得敌对。击败两个boss即可完成此任务。

42d4828e5e6a1d2f9bc203a8d846c40b51998b71.source: The torment creatures at the five checkpoints are as follows:
42d4828e5e6a1d2f9bc203a8d846c40b51998b71.text: 五个检查站的折磨生物如下：

15ff7d2c03f4ac7a506b153ccbbd645adb9d8677.source: Two Blades of Corruption, a Word of Madness, and a Spear of Torment.
15ff7d2c03f4ac7a506b153ccbbd645adb9d8677.text: 两把腐化之刃、一句疯狂之言和一把折磨之矛。

6d3eb37a9305d61101f76a0723a9a58bdb6ee3ca.source: Two Arms of Insanity, a Shadow of Fear, and a Herald of Nightmares.
6d3eb37a9305d61101f76a0723a9a58bdb6ee3ca.text: 两条疯狂之臂、一条恐惧之影和一只梦魇使者。

60de77838aac69d084268d02d4c256d78b828d27.source: An Arm of Insanity, a Rain of Terror, and two Scythes of Chaos.
60de77838aac69d084268d02d4c256d78b828d27.text: 一根疯狂之臂、一把恐怖之雨和两把混沌镰刀。

4fc245f03697069b4717f5c7baa095eb75010348.source: A Blade of Corruption, a Herald of Nightmares, and two Rain of Terror.
4fc245f03697069b4717f5c7baa095eb75010348.text: 一把腐化之刃，一把噩梦使者，以及两把恐怖之雨。

662b44112d82d6f225234ac5ae3d28d1973f76d5.source: Two Blades of Corruption, a Word of Madness, and a Scythe of Chaos.
662b44112d82d6f225234ac5ae3d28d1973f76d5.text: 两把腐化之刃、一句疯狂之语和一把混沌之镰。

4554e42948963abbdb980fc61b6bb53bdb7eb87c.source: When dispatching each group, watch out for nearby patrols. Remember to spike down each foe (as opposed to spreading out the damage) before moving on to the next, as their Call to the Torment triggers upon low health.
4554e42948963abbdb980fc61b6bb53bdb7eb87c.text: 派遣各组时，请留意附近的巡逻人员。请记住在继续攻击下一个敌人之前先击倒每个敌人（而不是分散伤害），因为他们的折磨召唤会在生命值较低时触发。

4f9c6a351e38100c03cc5629786e276ba8fa01b6.source: The two bosses at the end are not in the same group and can be pulled separately to make it easier. Be aware that there is a group of Torment creature patrol to the east of the two bosses. Either pull the bosses away from their initial position, or quickly pull that patrol group while the bosses are still talking.
4f9c6a351e38100c03cc5629786e276ba8fa01b6.text: 最后的两个boss不在同一组，可以分开拉，方便一些。请注意，在两个 Boss 的东边有一群折磨生物巡逻。要么把boss拉离他们原来的位置，要么趁boss还在说话的时候快速拉那个巡逻队。

4bf0c1d5aa3ab5e1926b1bae24255c5116a496c8.source: Leaving the area without killing the two bosses will reset this quest.
4bf0c1d5aa3ab5e1926b1bae24255c5116a496c8.text: 在不杀死两个 Boss 的情况下离开该区域将重置该任务。

66018ce08766ac5694f786cd3ad452866619ba32.source: It is recommended to also complete the quest Good Demon Hunting, since it takes place near the 2nd checkpoint.
66018ce08766ac5694f786cd3ad452866619ba32.text: 建议同时完成任务“良好的恶魔狩猎”，因为它发生在第二个检查站附近。

06329ffc846521aaa468cf99bb88915dd8da3e3e.source: Saving the Oddbodies first will gain your party additional allies.
06329ffc846521aaa468cf99bb88915dd8da3e3e.text: 首先拯救奇怪的人将为你的队伍赢得更多盟友。

135398c3d58c31d37bb434bab7187f176c544e54.source: Speak with Jedur Wahmeh to learn if he is worthy of his father's inheritance.
135398c3d58c31d37bb434bab7187f176c544e54.text: 与杰杜尔·瓦梅交谈，了解他是否值得继承父亲的遗产。

252f8827305290b4ee92be7c2fa75b88629f353f.source: Go with Jedur Wahmeh to recover the buried treasure.
252f8827305290b4ee92be7c2fa75b88629f353f.text: 与 Jedur Wahmeh 一起寻找埋藏的宝藏。

a49d6f10da14b9c96bbf180dde9bb68dbcdeb601.source: Talk to Jedur Wahmeh and then follow the compass point. Jedur will grab the treasure and cause an attack by a small group of corsairs.
a49d6f10da14b9c96bbf180dde9bb68dbcdeb601.text: 与 Jedur Wahmeh 交谈，然后按照指南针方向行驶。杰杜尔将夺取宝藏并引起一小群海盗的攻击。

3f275c14093b1e3538e3f35ae8e0071d464037ab.source: Annihilate the six opposing enemy teams.

c5b72ca1c54d8f71dadb3084635839f5ab180dab.source: *BONUS* Cleanse the area before King Khimaar's spirit leaves.
c5b72ca1c54d8f71dadb3084635839f5ab180dab.text: *奖励* 在希玛尔国王的灵魂离开之前净化该区域。

8f526993a7594b8f40fbaef3a034ca5817b90454.source: As per the Thirsty River mission.

19899e47ec3c24524e131f2a98c834168a07fd76.source: As per the Thunderhead Keep mission.

c825ba8932e9ba4e9f1aa0b13392daa69456aa7a.source: Talk to the three Vabbi Princes about joining your cause.
c825ba8932e9ba4e9f1aa0b13392daa69456aa7a.text: 与三位瓦比王子讨论加入你们的事业。

d24fe4c3a919914a2f5b8fc3de335a3389b4e3ad.text: *奖励* 参加五项节日活动。

e1eebc7983bb64b05211e03f6cdfce198449d781.source: As per the Tihark Orchard mission. This is a solo mission and you must be the only person in your party.
e1eebc7983bb64b05211e03f6cdfce198449d781.text: 根据提哈克果园任务。这是一个单人任务，您必须是队伍中唯一的人。

81b22635d35687669a9b2596124786814fbe64c2.source: Head due north from Ashford until you find the road to Green Hills County. Go to Green Hills County and talk to Grazden the Protector.
81b22635d35687669a9b2596124786814fbe64c2.text: 从阿什福德向北行驶，直到找到通往格林希尔斯县的道路。前往绿山县并与保护者格拉兹登交谈。

d2b51358e9480f053a5053e33be4861ef063969a.text: 将巴拉丁的什一税交给德沃娜。

fe86ce6f2db63b86fabbeb7328b29b067da0f20d.source: After talking to Devona, you can go straight to the north eastern limit of the map where the portal to Green Hills County is located. Map traveling to Ashford Abbey and starting from the entrance of the outpost can spare you a bit of time instead of starting from Devona's location.
fe86ce6f2db63b86fabbeb7328b29b067da0f20d.text: 与德沃娜对话后，可以直接前往地图的东北边界，那里是通往青山县的传送门所在。前往阿什福德修道院并从前哨站入口出发的地图可以节省您一些时间，而不是从德沃纳的位置出发。

d667d042efd117c7da3d0307652883640942bd11.source: Right after the portal there is a statue of Balthazar. Behind it, you will spot a Resurrection Shrine where Grazden the Protector can be found. Map travel to Ashford Abbey and return to Devona to deliver the tithe and claim your reward.
d667d042efd117c7da3d0307652883640942bd11.text: 大门后面有一座巴尔萨扎的雕像。在它后面，您会发现一座复活神殿，在那里可以找到保护者格拉兹登。地图前往阿什福德修道院，然后返回德沃纳交付什一税并领取奖励。

e170a788192a5f1de7ad83b25b7ed485e8a2481e.source: While the initial, intermediate, and reward dialogue all allude to an encounter with bandits, no bandits are encountered as part of this quest.
e170a788192a5f1de7ad83b25b7ed485e8a2481e.text: 虽然最初、中间和奖励对话都提到了与强盗的遭遇，但在此任务中没有遇到强盗。

0bce02f55c236b52f94769ec91943cbbfb3b9c17.source: Meet Nobleman Emrah and his fellow Vabbians in Lahtenda Bog.
0bce02f55c236b52f94769ec91943cbbfb3b9c17.text: 在拉滕达沼泽遇见贵族埃姆拉和他的瓦比族同胞。

72ce3bce04ac0ab59e1da0d3e15a3d91c1b06776.source: Escort the Vabbians on their hike to the Sunspear Crypt in Lahtenda Bog.
72ce3bce04ac0ab59e1da0d3e15a3d91c1b06776.text: 护送瓦比安人徒步前往拉滕达沼泽的阳矛墓穴。

e58ae35f7ab489404721d9b39c41807b2ffa11e3.source: See Nobleman Emrah for your reward.
e58ae35f7ab489404721d9b39c41807b2ffa11e3.text: 去见贵族埃姆拉以获得奖励。

8ea169c628b19e09996f45e09f4095a982576d38.source: Follow the map to the quest marker, killing any foes you encounter. Watch out for popup Mandragors and roving Insects.
8ea169c628b19e09996f45e09f4095a982576d38.text: 按照地图到达任务标记，杀死遇到的所有敌人。小心突然出现的曼德拉草和四处游荡的昆虫。

35263f4579a1fa8f2be2551ed1136a34ade858d8.source: This quest can be combined with the quest Crypt-ology as both lead to the same spot in Lahtenda bog.
35263f4579a1fa8f2be2551ed1136a34ade858d8.text: 这个任务可以与任务“密码学”结合起来，因为两者都会通往拉滕达沼泽的同一个地点。

58f1ce2ac4f6bbf44a95c9efa5952e3c2bde2746.source: You can also do the quests Down on the Bayou and Wandered Off Again while working on this quest.
58f1ce2ac4f6bbf44a95c9efa5952e3c2bde2746.text: 在做这个任务时，你也可以做任务“Down on the Bayou”和“Wandered Off Again”。

3d5df592374d26fd9a19cca6b2ca729d89edba03.source: Gather petals from a swamp flower plant.
3d5df592374d26fd9a19cca6b2ca729d89edba03.text: 从沼泽花卉植物中收集花瓣。

0a7c902d080f504116341f8c805b584664f789ea.source: See Barlom Dye Trader for your reward.
0a7c902d080f504116341f8c805b584664f789ea.text: 请前往 Barlom Dye Trader 获取奖励。

77f42180075504875667c5c70b49d60b525fa54a.source: Meet the Vabbian nobles in Zehlon Reach.
77f42180075504875667c5c70b49d60b525fa54a.text: 在泽隆河段遇见瓦比亚贵族。

751810b44ecef5ae361767016e6598cdae24b7db.source: Escort the Vabbian nobles on their tour of the Zehlon Reach.
751810b44ecef5ae361767016e6598cdae24b7db.text: 护送瓦比亚贵族游览泽隆河段。

08ce5f9ccb64cbbfbea1c9a2124a9878028a4efb.source: Help Galen Trask complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
08ce5f9ccb64cbbfbea1c9a2124a9878028a4efb.text: 帮助盖伦·特拉斯克完成他在悲伤熔炉内的任务。

ea12a3d64a73784070fc73a61ea353057d7f6801.source: Help Kilroy Stonekin complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
ea12a3d64a73784070fc73a61ea353057d7f6801.text: 帮助基尔罗伊·斯通金在悲伤熔炉中完成他的任务。

aeb7dbc0f54acbb786df7ce67071b4b0fa297afb.source: Help High Priest Alkar complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
aeb7dbc0f54acbb786df7ce67071b4b0fa297afb.text: 帮助大祭司阿尔卡完成他在悲伤熔炉内的任务。

db0e98640407167bbe49ccc0f70395d52441000b.source: Help Orozar Highstone complete his mission inside Sorrow's Furnace.
db0e98640407167bbe49ccc0f70395d52441000b.text: 帮助奥罗扎·海斯通在悲伤熔炉中完成他的任务。

2a05c3345333f04868a736e91d1cb5f9fc728b2a.source: Find Galen Trask somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
2a05c3345333f04868a736e91d1cb5f9fc728b2a.text: 在古兰斯足迹的某处找到盖伦·特拉斯克。

55537e6b65b4fe6727705f40122d2be507623acf.source: Lead Galen Trask into Sorrow's Furnace.
55537e6b65b4fe6727705f40122d2be507623acf.text: 带领盖伦·特拉斯克进入悲伤熔炉。

94fc62fe04142bb8c8199609c1072167dd370905.source: Find Kilroy Stonekin somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
94fc62fe04142bb8c8199609c1072167dd370905.text: 在古兰斯足迹的某个地方找到基尔罗伊·斯通金。

46c4a88e4977d2c58eb8f9062bfac0b1ba163a32.source: Lead Kilroy Stonekin into Sorrow's Furnace.
46c4a88e4977d2c58eb8f9062bfac0b1ba163a32.text: 带领基尔罗伊·斯通金进入悲伤熔炉。

dfa206924d6495b7cf8cf5f7a8b91e7866c3f6d3.source: Find High Priest Alkar somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
dfa206924d6495b7cf8cf5f7a8b91e7866c3f6d3.text: 在古兰斯足迹的某处找到高阶祭司阿尔卡。

4e0b24ab300d13be5de2b768b38802fea84adffd.source: Lead High Priest Alkar into Sorrow's Furnace.
4e0b24ab300d13be5de2b768b38802fea84adffd.text: 带领大祭司阿尔卡进入悲伤熔炉。

6844bb02df66a4933c0006b3947b7b24e08faa41.source: Find Orozar Highstone somewhere in Grenth's Footprint.
6844bb02df66a4933c0006b3947b7b24e08faa41.text: 在古兰斯足迹的某个地方找到奥罗扎·海斯通。

5c0429647070ab1839c6c49ce83b53611259985a.source: Lead Orozar Highstone into Sorrow's Furnace.
5c0429647070ab1839c6c49ce83b53611259985a.text: 带领奥罗扎·海斯通进入悲伤熔炉。

730b166e0ade7c60f1f4d62419f3f668f49c4042.source: This quest actually involves four subquests. There is no particular order in which these subquests must be completed; however, all the subquests cannot be acquired at the same time.
730b166e0ade7c60f1f4d62419f3f668f49c4042.text: 这个任务实际上涉及四个子任务。这些子任务的完成没有特定的顺序；但是，所有子任务不能同时获得。

45d335bb229508af05764d45acc82cb7d08f641d.source: Starting from the Deldrimor War Camp, for each of the four parts of the main "container" quest you'll have to:
45d335bb229508af05764d45acc82cb7d08f641d.text: 从德尔德里莫战争营地开始，对于主要“容器”任务的四个部分中的每一个部分，你都必须：

afd3340413cb86c778f67fbc2dd64c1f8d252240.source: Find a dwarf in Grenth's Footprint (and probably kill a couple of Stone Summit bosses along the way; this is not difficult, but when fighting the mobs here, take out the Stone Summit Gnashers as a priority, before they overwhelm the party with animated Bone Fiends);
afd3340413cb86c778f67fbc2dd64c1f8d252240.text: 在古兰斯的足迹中找到一个矮人（可能会一路杀死几个石峰首领；这并不困难，但是当在这里与小怪战斗时，优先消灭石峰咬人，以免他们用动画骨魔压垮队伍）；

7485b834b668abf0b0c673554c1ae73449292abc.source: Lead the dwarf to Sorrow's Furnace (and you can only lead one at a time);
7485b834b668abf0b0c673554c1ae73449292abc.text: 带领矮人前往悲伤熔炉（一次只能带领一名矮人）；

927e424a5ed2a3304eff2fb7f33c23c3c8205b6b.source: Speak to the dwarf within the door of Sorrow's Furnace;
927e424a5ed2a3304eff2fb7f33c23c3c8205b6b.text: 与悲伤熔炉门内的矮人交谈；

f7393525bb3f3c432c90272642de991066fe8c25.source: Complete the subquest that they in turn give you.
f7393525bb3f3c432c90272642de991066fe8c25.text: 完成他们依次给你的子任务。

97ebe37a2305c44b7f27f8c9c3419609aaf3a33d.source: Each of these subquests must be completed before exiting Sorrow's Furnace, or you will be required to locate the relevant NPC in Grenth's Footprint again.
97ebe37a2305c44b7f27f8c9c3419609aaf3a33d.text: 每个子任务都必须在退出悲伤熔炉之前完成，否则您将需要再次在古兰斯的足迹中找到相关的 NPC。

7186fc8f5c3933cb341d07672218f31024fc331a.source: Each of the subquests is a repeatable quest, and a good source of experience points.
7186fc8f5c3933cb341d07672218f31024fc331a.text: 每个子任务都是可重复的任务，也是经验值的良好来源。

98469c746107c4dcac3462a6345b232c845b2a4e.source: For more information, see the individual entries:
98469c746107c4dcac3462a6345b232c845b2a4e.text: 有关更多信息，请参阅各个条目：

2fabfe72951c4f472d2c331aea347e710ec7f6e3.source: Summit Slaves (given by Galen Trask, and this one involves sub-subquests)
2fabfe72951c4f472d2c331aea347e710ec7f6e3.text: 峰会奴隶（由 Galen Trask 提供，此任务涉及子任务）

374c5dbe5489738e64a5cff01fd7c2c4bfed6092.text: 基尔罗伊·斯通金（基尔罗伊·斯通金提供）

69f107fd4cc34b234c36f4b234530488aa3b3feb.source: Unspeakable, Unknowable (given by High Priest Alkar)
69f107fd4cc34b234c36f4b234530488aa3b3feb.text: 无法言说，不可知（由大祭司阿尔卡赐予）

4624b776d73650d3bfb2f5896477da34d30a8d19.source: Noble Intentions and Noble Intentions Plan B (given by Orozar Highstone)
4624b776d73650d3bfb2f5896477da34d30a8d19.text: 崇高意图和崇高意图 B 计划（由 Orozar Highstone 提供）

15513ecb4ce57c1bf5a644e95bd4242cc1fb861d.source: If you speak to any of the NPCs after completing their subquest, your quest log will update as if you need to complete the same subquest again. However, you can skip it and focus on the subquests that remain or proceed with The Final Assault, if you have completed each of the four tasks.
15513ecb4ce57c1bf5a644e95bd4242cc1fb861d.text: 如果您在完成子任务后与任何 NPC 交谈，您的任务日志将会更新，就好像您需要再次完成相同的子任务一样。但是，如果您已完成四个任务中的每一个，您可以跳过它并专注于剩余的子任务或继续“最终突击”。

98a36ed03e57412b184f9900cefcc6ce0489143a.source: Search the mines for Belgun's assistants.
98a36ed03e57412b184f9900cefcc6ce0489143a.text: 在矿井中寻找贝尔根的助手。

326a45a5db97ad72a8f23db59c495af1cb0fdce4.source: Defeat the Kournan and Margonite guards and free Assistant Lenahn.
326a45a5db97ad72a8f23db59c495af1cb0fdce4.text: 击败库尔南和玛贡尼特守卫并释放助理莱纳。

23ed643ff376e09e95ddfcd50666ddcbc44d7dd5.source: Survive the onslaught of Kournan and Margonite troops.
23ed643ff376e09e95ddfcd50666ddcbc44d7dd5.text: 在库尔南和玛贡尼特军队的猛攻中幸存下来。

6c2c11f0c7d24fd2632c3d212e9d4c111058b143.source: After receiving the quest from Belgun, head north-west to find Lenahn, who is being held captive by Kournans and a Margonite. After defeating the first Kournan group, further groups of Margonite reinforcements will approach the party from either side: 2 from the east, and 3 from the west (including the final boss group). After defeating all the groups, speak to Belgun for your reward and the followup quest.
6c2c11f0c7d24fd2632c3d212e9d4c111058b143.text: 接到贝尔根的任务后，向西北方向寻找被库南人和玛贡派俘虏的莱纳恩。击败第一支库尔南队伍后，更多的玛贡尼特援军将从两侧逼近队伍：2支来自东线，3支来自西线（包括最后的首领队伍）。击败所有团体后，与贝尔根交谈以获得奖励和后续任务。

a3fcd76dfd298ddcee2a479a63d82dd88b44f6b9.source: Nehpek the Remorseless does not spawn if this quest is active.
a3fcd76dfd298ddcee2a479a63d82dd88b44f6b9.text: 如果此任务处于活动状态，无情者内赫佩克不会生成。

b5c6876cb6d84c55c541b91ef9edcd19709be7d8.source: The foes' pincer movement can be avoided by retreating back along your arrival path as soon as the group at the quest marker has been eliminated, and fighting the spawns at that end alone. Once no more foes appear, head back to the marker to fight foes arriving from the other side.
b5c6876cb6d84c55c541b91ef9edcd19709be7d8.text: 一旦任务标记处的队伍被消灭，就可以沿着你的到达路径撤退，并单独与那一端的重生战斗，从而避免敌人的夹击运动。一旦不再有敌人出现，就回到标记处与来自另一边的敌人战斗。

38e6ae0f390911088f42a8c737363d73527ec299.source: The foes at the eastern end sometimes get stuck indefinitely on a Vabbi Chest which spawns in that narrow passage, so waiting at the quest marker can be fruitless. Simply travel out and tackle them at their sticking point.
38e6ae0f390911088f42a8c737363d73527ec299.text: 东端的敌人有时会无限期地卡在狭窄通道中生成的瓦比宝箱上，因此在任务标记处等待可能是徒劳的。只需出去并解决他们的症结即可。

b2e95764abd60445f3c76b16fb905616d9a7c9bb.source: Rescue the Order of Whispers company trapped behind enemy lines.
b2e95764abd60445f3c76b16fb905616d9a7c9bb.text: 营救被困在敌后的密语教团连。

3bfbb6f6d3a2724a9d71308a7778186338b9ee6f.text: 在恶魔大军的袭击中幸存下来。

4f1dbab13370449366cb56bd6cd4c45abbcbbf42.source: See Warden of Whispers for your reward.
4f1dbab13370449366cb56bd6cd4c45abbcbbf42.text: 前往密语典狱长处领取奖励。

de246562997ded19af1a6589ff65b77c5fcc6fe3.source: After accepting the quest, pick up the Shard of Brilliance if you want, it will give a little light, although it's not essential. As you leave the short passageway, notice a group of Order of Whispers standing out front. As you approach, four groups of three Torment creatures each will charge that position. Defend yourselves.
de246562997ded19af1a6589ff65b77c5fcc6fe3.text: 接受任务后，如果你愿意的话，可以捡起光辉碎片，它会发出一点光，尽管这不是必需的。当你离开短通道时，注意到一群低语教团站在前面。当你接近时，四组每组三个折磨生物将冲向该位置。保卫自己。

010f669e7553d1772fd5fcd4e8e0de6f0cee60fb.source: Follow the quest marker to the west, pulling and taking out patrols as necessary. There are groups of Order of Whispers and Torment creatures at several locations. At each one, they will begin fighting as you approach. Helping them is optional, since the survivors won't follow you anyway.
010f669e7553d1772fd5fcd4e8e0de6f0cee60fb.text: 沿着任务标记向西走，根据需要拉动和消灭巡逻队。在几个地点有成群的低语教团和折磨生物。在每一个地方，当你接近时，他们都会开始战斗。帮助他们是可选的，因为幸存者无论如何都不会跟随你。

bebbcbf3a4b07891b23210799f6b5cf01391cf43.source: Once you reach the quest marker where the Warden of Whispers and four Order of Whispers are, the waves will start coming. Each wave consists of 3 Torment creatures of the same profession. The waves come fast, and gets even faster towards the end. Your party must be able to dispatch each wave as quickly as possible before the numbers become overwhelming. The NPCs are of little help except as corpses, but take note that the Warden of Whispers inside the cave must survive.
bebbcbf3a4b07891b23210799f6b5cf01391cf43.text: 一旦你到达低语守望者和四个低语骑士团所在的任务标记，波浪就会开始到来。每波由 3 个相同职业的折磨生物组成。海浪来得很快，到最后会变得更快。你的队伍必须能够在人数变得压倒性之前尽快派遣每一波。除了尸体之外，NPC 几乎没有什么帮助，但请注意，洞穴内的低语守卫必须生存。

bfab312d28f7dcba7d348502683b2cf139bdd250.source: Depending on your style, it is also possible to intercept the Torment creatures outside the cave, in order to have a wider battlefield. This is quite risky as the NPCs inside that cave cannot survive even one group.
bfab312d28f7dcba7d348502683b2cf139bdd250.text: 根据你的风格，还可以拦截洞穴外的折磨生物，以便拥有更广阔的战场。这是相当危险的，那个洞穴里的NPC连一群都无法生存。

c6c1f4f17cc8b0c71e8327d993050e033a29e309.source: If you enter the cave where the Warden of Whispers is prior to starting the quest, the waves of torment creatures will attack before you can reach the Warden, making it next to impossible to succeed.
c6c1f4f17cc8b0c71e8327d993050e033a29e309.text: 如果你在开始任务之前进入低语守望者所在的洞穴，一波又一波的折磨生物会在你到达守望者之前发起攻击，这使得任务几乎不可能成功。

58f1d0e596ad78aaa86196f66eccfce5190f6b04.source: Deliver Master Togo's ultimatum to Captain Quimang.
58f1d0e596ad78aaa86196f66eccfce5190f6b04.text: 将多哥大师的最后通牒交给奎芒队长。

ea1ecd681eef39a3dff56d0a75568dbc1051a61e.source: This quest is relatively easy to complete. Basically, you have to walk to Port Kaimu, where Captain Quimang and his group are hanging out. Upon leaving Tsumei Village, Port Kaimu is to the Southwest (as the crow flies). You can follow the Southwest path, or go across Qi Falls near Ang the Ephemeral, and then turn South.
ea1ecd681eef39a3dff56d0a75568dbc1051a61e.text: 这个任务相对容易完成。基本上，你必须步行到凯姆港，奎芒船长和他的团队在那里闲逛。离开津名村后，向西南方（直线方向）即是开往港。你可以沿着西南方向走，或者穿过短命昂附近的气瀑布，然后向南转。

9a6d42ebf20e51f4616e559b58f66a23212745ed.source: You will probably encounter various groups of Kappa and the occasional hostile group of Crimson Skull along your travel. Once you get closer to the Port, the Crimson Skull pirates present will not be hostile, and will let you deliver the message and leave in peace.
9a6d42ebf20e51f4616e559b58f66a23212745ed.text: 在旅途中，您可能会遇到各种河童群体，偶尔还会遇到敌对的猩红骷髅群体。一旦你接近了港口，在场的红骷髅海盗就不会怀有敌意，会让你传递消息并安心离开。

08fff4b1a3576611066e9ff57c4aee4794ba0c50.source: Captain Quimang and his men do not become hostile when given the ultimatum. If you can get to him, this quest is Survivor-safe. The only potential problem is the groups of Crimson Skull you encounter before getting to Port Kaimu, where Captain Quimang is.
08fff4b1a3576611066e9ff57c4aee4794ba0c50.text: 当收到最后通牒时，基芒上尉和他的部下并没有变得敌对。如果你能找到他，这个任务对于幸存者来说是安全的。唯一的潜在问题是你在到达奎芒船长所在的凯姆港之前遇到的猩红骷髅群。

bcad939c1b91bd4d60ccd70c3eae6e686a7b77ec.source: Wait until the end of the dialog between Sunzu and Nakai.
bcad939c1b91bd4d60ccd70c3eae6e686a7b77ec.text: 等到孙祖和中井的对话结束。

5bebaafc282f23ad071d13c5819fc068429de39b.source: Speak to Nakai about the loan.
5bebaafc282f23ad071d13c5819fc068429de39b.text: 与 Nakai 谈谈贷款事宜。

626d616d04c3fa3314b338b69e1496e9a8b5badb.source: Speak to Sunzu about the loan.
626d616d04c3fa3314b338b69e1496e9a8b5badb.text: 与 Sunzu 谈谈贷款事宜。

e544035489037814b7a84192d3da92da0658d22d.source: Speak to Mitah about the loan.
e544035489037814b7a84192d3da92da0658d22d.text: 与 Mitah 谈谈贷款事宜。

0497bb3f4e3adbd3c9f8eea10479e38556102943.source: Return to Sunzu and discuss the loan.
0497bb3f4e3adbd3c9f8eea10479e38556102943.text: 返回孙祖，商议借贷事宜。

36aad4a563e81b9189bde60c200a5336b520c632.source: Nakai and Sunzu can initially be found in Bukdek Byway, east of The Marketplace: you will need to head east from the Marketplace over the bridge where the merchants and peasants are located, then double back over a shorter bridge south of this one.
36aad4a563e81b9189bde60c200a5336b520c632.text: Nakai 和 Sunzu 最初可以在市场以东的 Bukdek Byway 找到：你需要从市场向东走，越过商人和农民所在的桥，然后从该桥以南的一座较短的桥折回。

a9fb084be258caf50c16f5c14d9ebf1010799e9c.source: When your party approaches them, Nakai and Sunzu will have an argument about the debt Mitah owes, then Sunzu will run off back over the bridge towards Mitah. When Sunzu has gone far enough, Nakai will offer this quest.
a9fb084be258caf50c16f5c14d9ebf1010799e9c.text: 当你的队伍接近他们时，中井和孙祖会因为米塔所欠的债务发生争执，然后孙祖会从桥上跑回米塔。当孙祖走得足够远时，中井就会提供这个任务。

1fa3e27ab2c9052233eda17ac8f16cb10c4bf3c2.source: Head back to Mitah and Sunzu and speak to them in turn, and decide which of Sunzu's choices for the debt fix you prefer, either pay up 250 gold to help out Mitah, or refuse and kill Sunzu.
