If you refuse, and choose to kill Sunzu, a group of Jade Brotherhood members will appear (3 Mages and 1 Mesmer) and Sunzu himself will turn hostile and attack.
1fa3e27ab2c9052233eda17ac8f16cb10c4bf3c2.text: 返回Mitah和Sunzu并依次与他们交谈，并决定您更喜欢Sunzu的哪个债务修复选择，要么支付250金币来帮助Mitah，要么拒绝并杀死Sunzu。如果你拒绝并选择杀死孙祖，一群翡翠兄弟会成员将会出现（3名法师和1名幻术师），而孙祖本人也会转而敌对并发起攻击。

2dcef3fbc0ebb69bcb675cee82f7b371c906fda4.source: Finally, head back across the bridge to collect your reward from Nakai.
2dcef3fbc0ebb69bcb675cee82f7b371c906fda4.text: 最后，返回过桥，从 Nakai 那里领取奖励。

6ae5573a4af44002af54df76a0c2f9cc19733156.source: Sometimes Nakai won't offer the quest after Sunzu has run far enough to normally trigger the offer. Running back to Mitah, then back to Nakai can correct this. Sometimes Sunzu's helpers only spawn when you run through that area at a later time, even if you handed in the quest in the meanwhile.
6ae5573a4af44002af54df76a0c2f9cc19733156.text: 有时，在孙祖跑得足够远以正常触发任务后，中井不会提供任务。跑回 Mitah，然后跑回 Nakai 可以纠正这个问题。有时，孙祖的助手只会在你稍后跑过该区域时才会出现，即使你同时提交了任务。

334212166300f87ba4d0e3098ad2cab7a37a2edb.source: Defeat 5...0 more ancestral sprouts to cleanse the Ancestor Tree.
334212166300f87ba4d0e3098ad2cab7a37a2edb.text: 击败 5...0 个以上祖先芽苗以净化祖先树。

b6c82c21d0ce4fa8b7302e34af01996af76b23c6.source: Defeat the 5 ancestral sprouts near the Ancestor Tree. They spawn one at a time and once a group is defeated, the next will appear.
b6c82c21d0ce4fa8b7302e34af01996af76b23c6.text: 击败祖先树附近的 5 个祖先芽苗。它们一次生成一个，一旦一组被击败，下一组就会出现。

b78f191a61f17fb6d5b6e1f922bab60e57e363ed.source: Destroy the Shadow Army forces surrounding the Tower of Courage. You have 5...0 groups left.
b78f191a61f17fb6d5b6e1f922bab60e57e363ed.text: 摧毁勇气之塔周围的影子军团。您还剩下 5...0 个组。

c3bd843fc3369b42365a1fea430d2386591c1170.source: Destroy the Shadow Lord within the Tower of Courage.
c3bd843fc3369b42365a1fea430d2386591c1170.text: 摧毁勇气之塔内的暗影领主。

ccc624d933eb6bbf983241bdb9bb5f2c309fdbb5.source: The events of this quest will play out whether the quest is taken or not. You must be prepared for this if your party approaches the Tower of Courage because you will be thrown out of the Fissure of Woe if Rastigan the Eternal perishes. Each group of Shadow Army you need to kill for this quest consists of an Abyssal and two Shadow Rangers. Aggroing these groups will cause Rastigan to run forward, and he will certainly die if you haven't taken care of things.
ccc624d933eb6bbf983241bdb9bb5f2c309fdbb5.text: 无论任务是否被接受，该任务的事件都会发生。如果你的队伍接近勇气之塔，你必须为此做好准备，因为如果永恒的拉斯蒂根灭亡，你将被扔出痛苦裂缝。为了这个任务你需要杀死的每组暗影军团都由一个深渊和两个暗影游侠组成。仇恨这些群体会让拉斯蒂根向前奔跑，如果你不处理好他肯定会死。

86c2aa81bba38cd249601c9e31f1f9d075fde52f.source: First, clear out the area between you and the Tower without aggroing the Abyssal/Ranger groups. Most groups start with the left side first, and then the right. Be mindful of patrols and Shadow Beast popups. When the area is clear, take out the first group at the southwest of the Tower. Rastigan will run forward and stand where this group was. Take out the rest of the groups around the Tower. When they're dead, Rastigan will come up and open the tower gate. Shadow Lord Vogris will spawn inside with 2 Abyssals. One possible tactic to defeat this last group is to have one or more players body block them at the gate entrance. This will help focus their damage on fewer party members and bunch them up for AoE damage.
86c2aa81bba38cd249601c9e31f1f9d075fde52f.text: 首先，清理你和塔之间的区域，不要激怒深渊/游侠团体。大多数小组首先从左侧开始，然后是右侧。注意巡逻和暗影兽弹出窗口。当该区域清空后，干掉塔西南的第一组。拉斯蒂根将向前跑去，站在这群人所在的地方。干掉塔周围的其余队伍。当他们死后，拉斯蒂根会出现并打开塔门。暗影领主沃格里斯将在里面生成并携带 2 只深渊生物。击败最后这群人的一种可能策略是让一名或多名玩家在大门入口处挡住他们。这将有助于将他们的伤害集中在更少的党员身上，并将他们集中起来造成 AoE 伤害。

a3b8c791fff54a0a2dd8b8993931311713c84225.source: It is possible to prevent Rastigan from running forward after aggroing one of the Shadow Army groups if your party is well out of his range. The groups can then be defeated at your own pace. When you are ready for him to run forward, move within his range.
a3b8c791fff54a0a2dd8b8993931311713c84225.text: 如果你的队伍远远超出了拉斯蒂根的射程，那么在攻击影子军团之一后，可以阻止拉斯蒂根向前奔跑。然后可以按照你自己的节奏击败这些团体。当你准备好让他向前跑时，就在他的射程范围内移动。

3706f78b5a144e038f4ef278698e8ddfb1a8a0db.source: An unlocked Chest spawns inside the tower when this quest is completed.
3706f78b5a144e038f4ef278698e8ddfb1a8a0db.text: 完成此任务后，塔内会生成一个解锁的宝箱。

e8afa96349250817934d94a76983803a9c2f8dac.source: Clear the path to the Tower of Strength. You have 5...0 Shadow Patrols left.
e8afa96349250817934d94a76983803a9c2f8dac.text: 清理通往力量之塔的道路。您还剩 5...0 名暗影巡逻队。

571680897be42c20caa25d1b0e82ccb3acf50154.source: Enter the Tower of Strength and destroy the Shadow Lord.
571680897be42c20caa25d1b0e82ccb3acf50154.text: 进入力量之塔并消灭暗影领主。

7eadcc4139f532f3b7f81a1f133a93cd476dca8e.source: Return to Eternal Lord Taeres for your reward.
7eadcc4139f532f3b7f81a1f133a93cd476dca8e.text: 返回永恒之主泰雷斯那里领取奖励。

0132d4bdd786b43ae3e024694369aded10decbca.source: Exit the forge to the south and keep to the left. You will find several strong patrols of Shadow Army creatures and a lot of hidden Shadow Beasts on your way, so advance carefully. The Shadow Patrols that have to be killed are five single beasts similar to Abyssals, however, they are accompanied by large numbers of other nightmares and some Infernal Wurms.
0132d4bdd786b43ae3e024694369aded10decbca.text: 向南退出熔炉并保持左侧。途中你会发现几支强大的暗影军生物巡逻队和大量隐藏的暗影兽，所以要小心前进。需要击杀的暗影巡逻队是五头类似深渊兽的单体野兽，不过它们的身边还伴随着大量的其他噩梦和一些地狱亚龙。

4ed2daa56108d1870f15ce28b0fbabf9267793a2.source: When the Tower of Strength comes into sight, keep close to the right wall and always fight only one group at a time. With careful luring you can use the geography of this place to your advantage: There is a path leading down towards the tower with a ridge at its side. Spellcasters and Rangers should stay on that ridge and Warriors should lure the opponents to the place directly below the ridge. If done right this will keep the fragile party members out of harm's reach (at least from the powerful melee attacks of the Abyssals) but still enable them to participate in the fight.
4ed2daa56108d1870f15ce28b0fbabf9267793a2.text: 当力量之塔出现在视野中时，靠近右侧墙壁并始终一次只与一组作战。通过仔细的引诱，你可以利用这个地方的地理位置来发挥自己的优势：有一条小路通向塔楼，塔楼的一侧有山脊。施法者和游骑兵应该留在山脊上，而战士应该将对手引诱到山脊正下方的地方。如果做得好，这将使脆弱的党员远离伤害（至少免受深渊者强大的近战攻击），但仍然使他们能够参与战斗。

7ee39e93b44d7496ae3471bec737b48980af2fe6.source: After the way to the tower is cleared you will have to send one of your party members back to the forge to fetch the Tower Mage, he will not start moving until a player comes within radar range of him.
7ee39e93b44d7496ae3471bec737b48980af2fe6.text: 通向塔楼的道路被清除后，您必须派一名队员返回熔炉去接塔法师，直到有玩家进入他的雷达范围内后，他才会开始移动。

170acc476138f909d75ab4305edd8678806ef55e.source: When coming close to the gate, he will open it. The Shadow Lord will then spawn all alone inside the tower and shouldn't pose any threat whatsoever.
170acc476138f909d75ab4305edd8678806ef55e.text: 当他靠近大门时，他就会打开门。然后，暗影领主将独自在塔内生成，并且不会构成任何威胁。

ca62a69f6c641657e1b3b4043f0daa1659ce61be.source: Unlike other essential quest NPCs, the tower mage will not be attacked and thus does not need to be defended.
ca62a69f6c641657e1b3b4043f0daa1659ce61be.text: 与其他重要任务 NPC 不同，塔法师不会受到攻击，因此不需要防御。

f86c50b998728508667660a9e0c88ee0df212d39.source: Kill the TPS Regulator Golem in Oola's Lab.
f86c50b998728508667660a9e0c88ee0df212d39.text: 杀死 Oola 实验室中的 TPS 调节器傀儡。

b846ff202a41de5732466a2b717b524aa3398a2f.source: *BONUS* Kill the TPS Regulator Golem in Hard Mode.
b846ff202a41de5732466a2b717b524aa3398a2f.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 TPS 调节器傀儡。

7f40152d2095d320d34d2bf17adc9a9225c9ed5f.source: Quest involved: Little Workshop of Horrors.

d874ca37c1792d19589a672c15c8978440baf3e3.source: Gather 20 shells on the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You have gathered [0...20] of 20.
d874ca37c1792d19589a672c15c8978440baf3e3.text: 在 Mehtani Keys 的海滩上收集 20 个贝壳。您已收集了 20 个中的 [0...20] 个。

6de4b59a43495df6da697ed6ecc3624817ff5168.source: Give the shells to Elder Olunideh and collect your reward.
6de4b59a43495df6da697ed6ecc3624817ff5168.text: 将贝壳交给奥鲁尼德长老并领取奖励。

b4c6244bd1064eda2813a8a5d4443afbf8e2890f.source: There are approximately 78 shells in Mehtani Keys during this quest.
b4c6244bd1064eda2813a8a5d4443afbf8e2890f.text: 在此任务期间，Mehtani Keys 中大约有 78 颗炮弹。

9de2a825094ce3f61ec862a1f1f8e02abb492a89.source: Because you can collect the same shell more than once, you can repeatedly enter and exit Kodlonu Hamlet collecting the shells that are nearby, rather than running around the whole area.
9de2a825094ce3f61ec862a1f1f8e02abb492a89.text: 因为您可以多次收集相同的贝壳，所以您可以重复进出科德洛努村收集附近的贝壳，而不是绕着整个区域跑来跑去。

20826bc7664aa7df761759b9b89ff83f3b8a8b94.source: This quest can be completed at the same time as Isle of the Dead, by collecting the shells while killing the Ancient Undead in Mehtani Keys.
20826bc7664aa7df761759b9b89ff83f3b8a8b94.text: 该任务可以与死亡之岛同时完成，方法是在梅赫塔尼群岛杀死远古亡灵并收集贝壳。

93c59692152425b24100005c72756605cc2b1076.source: The chat window doesn't display Elder Olunideh taking the shells.
93c59692152425b24100005c72756605cc2b1076.text: 聊天窗口没有显示长老奥鲁尼德拿走贝壳。

f6f25393694ddabbe707e76eab9475da8248e5ec.source: Clear Traveler's Vale in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
f6f25393694ddabbe707e76eab9475da8248e5ec.text: 在困难模式下清除北席瓦山脉北部旅行者谷的所有敌人。

c67cb8ba4ccefb0ce4d7b30243498ecadfbac778.source: You can access the area via
c67cb8ba4ccefb0ce4d7b30243498ecadfbac778.text: 您可以通过以下方式访问该区域

c0e7020e7c17365a02d39381f1fe2924621eab6a.source: Yak's Bend, where you're teleported upon completion of the Nolani Academy mission
c0e7020e7c17365a02d39381f1fe2924621eab6a.text: 牦牛弯，诺拉尼学院任务完成后你会被传送到那里

91bfeec4b94bb86e771acc4dce6fbfe3fa181eb2.source: Ascalon Foothills if running from Ascalon
91bfeec4b94bb86e771acc4dce6fbfe3fa181eb2.text: 阿斯卡隆山麓（如果从阿斯卡隆跑）

b656928f2cf2edcab47c176c34848ad6196fbd06.source: Iron Horse Mine if running from Kryta
b656928f2cf2edcab47c176c34848ad6196fbd06.text: 铁马矿井（如果从科瑞塔逃跑）

5641c6fc0058f69c9356ab93e4c287312029df47.source: The Way is Blocked is the primary quest that takes the player through this area.
5641c6fc0058f69c9356ab93e4c287312029df47.text: 道路被封锁是带领玩家穿过该区域的主要任务。

0cf894d7bc5cc0e225623ffad1f06c1b0ce15784.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
0cf894d7bc5cc0e225623ffad1f06c1b0ce15784.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 1.0%。

599bdfbc368212c6cecbc03be1aa9177a09aed2c.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 196|low = 163|high = 191|notes=There are hidden Juniper Barks throughout the area.}}
599bdfbc368212c6cecbc03be1aa9177a09aed2c.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 196|low = 163|high = 191|notes=整个区域都有隐藏的杜松树皮。}}

f626cdc682dc9ea6f2230d818d76b374fcbd7428.source: Enchantment based builds are vulnerable to stripping from the large number of Stone Summit in the area.
f626cdc682dc9ea6f2230d818d76b374fcbd7428.text: 基于结界的建筑很容易被该地区大量的石峰剥离。

901bd88345eeb24ab17f2503d848b6ed2ee1f8d0.source: There are several walking groups of 2 Stone Summit each at the eastern part of the map below Yak's Bend which can be overlooked easily because they have a larger patrol circle/area.
901bd88345eeb24ab17f2503d848b6ed2ee1f8d0.text: 地图东部牦牛弯下方有几个步行组，每个步行组有 2 个石峰，很容易被忽视，因为它们有更大的巡逻圈/区域。

8837188b66e74faa83c5cd7ce68ff8b8a2318a0c.source: This is said to be where Nicholas found Professor Yakkington as a calf, before the Searing.
8837188b66e74faa83c5cd7ce68ff8b8a2318a0c.text: 据说，在灼热之前，尼古拉斯就是在这里发现了还是小牛的雅金顿教授。

9dc55a4d3a4a0c68136693d5fcb42f0618ad7895.source: The Centaurs and Dwarves are hostile to each other.
9dc55a4d3a4a0c68136693d5fcb42f0618ad7895.text: 半人马和矮人彼此敌对。

95cab69af63c9af949af49f194ae59e469b21c2c.source: Go to Lakeside County and follow the road to Ashford. Talk to Devona about the Grawl threat.
95cab69af63c9af949af49f194ae59e469b21c2c.text: 前往湖滨县并沿路前往阿什福德。与德沃娜谈论 Grawl 的威胁。

806fcbbdc78fd28761aeef98ff7fdba1f2e48bc1.source: Go with Devona and destroy the Grawl threatening Ashford.
806fcbbdc78fd28761aeef98ff7fdba1f2e48bc1.text: 与德沃娜一起消灭威胁阿什福德的穴居人。

1816c9bce5c03618919ce9f5fedb7a9e9fa432f1.source: From Ascalon City, follow the southwest road to Ashford. Talk to Devona, then follow her across the bridge to trigger the Grawl ambush. Watch out for Grawl Shamans who use Infuse Health and Heal Area; it may be worthwile to focus on them first. Since there are quite a few Grawl here, consider taking a healing spell to heal yourself and Devona if needed.
1816c9bce5c03618919ce9f5fedb7a9e9fa432f1.text: 从阿斯卡隆市出发，沿西南路前往阿什福德。与德沃娜交谈，然后跟随她过桥，触发格罗尔伏击。留意使用生命注入和治疗区域的穴居人萨满；首先关注它们可能是值得的。由于这里有相当多的穴居人，如果需要的话，可以考虑使用治疗咒来治疗你自己和德沃娜。

c6a99e2c8c7c4ef9cfc7698a22ef6049fd8bc35c.source: Keep your distance and let the Grawl waves come to you. Devona will often pull aggro from nearby skale, so a cautious approach prevents you from being overwhelmed.
c6a99e2c8c7c4ef9cfc7698a22ef6049fd8bc35c.text: 保持距离，让Grawl 波浪向您袭来。德沃娜经常会从附近的斯凯尔身上吸引仇恨，所以谨慎行事可以防止你被淹没。

ffce107a09fe6139f1157635372628c5b77b8e58.source: During the ambush, the Charr ranger Vatlaaw Doomtooth will spawn, cast Favorable Winds, and immediately flee through the portal to Regent Valley. Usually, he will escape before you can reach him. Once the Grawl are defeated, speak to Devona to claim your reward.
ffce107a09fe6139f1157635372628c5b77b8e58.text: 在伏击期间，夏尔游侠瓦特拉·末日之牙将会生成，施放顺风，并立即通过传送门逃往摄政谷。通常，他会在你找到他之前逃跑。击败穴居人后，与德沃娜交谈以领取奖励。

90288c4fe5dc27655c49c8020418428550e36b60.source: With some preparation it is actually possible kill Vatlaaw. To do so you will usually want high firepower, Imagined Burden to slow him down, and/or the use of minions or gwen to bodyblock him. When blocked, he will not fight back and can be easily killed. You will have to follow a method to stand in his path before he spawns:
90288c4fe5dc27655c49c8020418428550e36b60.text: 只要做好一些准备，实际上就有可能杀死 Vatlaaw。为此，你通常需要高火力、想象负担来减慢他的速度，和/或使用小兵或格温来身体阻挡他。当被阻挡时，他不会反击，很容易被杀死。在他出现之前，你必须遵循一种方法来挡住他的道路：

c9e50473b70c109d2c43c91b778098ee2761cdf5.source: Sneak around the devourer cave (after talking to Devona) to the east. This way, he will be forced to run into you while trying to flee into Regent Valley.
c9e50473b70c109d2c43c91b778098ee2761cdf5.text: 潜行到东边的吞噬者洞穴（与德沃娜交谈后）。这样，他将被迫在试图逃入摄政谷时遇到你。

32941804d2248057f1c086b65652a46e1ba5b2a8.source: Bring another player of significant level that will be waiting at Vatlaaw's spawn point up the road from Ashford.
32941804d2248057f1c086b65652a46e1ba5b2a8.text: 带来另一名具有重要水平的玩家，他将在阿什福德沿路的瓦特劳重生点等待。

50d3bc9ae0dcf964143f352410e32afc0f765b20.source: Using a cupcake may also work.
50d3bc9ae0dcf964143f352410e32afc0f765b20.text: 使用纸杯蛋糕也可能有效。

1918aca772b5feea5a3403430f3b5ea8f9877d99.source: Vatlaaw will occasionally become blocked or stuck, and not make his escape. Vatlaaw automatically casts Favorable Winds on spawn, however does two knockdown animations during the cast even though he is not being knocked down.
1918aca772b5feea5a3403430f3b5ea8f9877d99.text: 瓦特拉有时会被阻挡或卡住，而无法逃脱。 Vatlaaw 在生成时会自动施放顺风，但在施放期间会执行两次击倒动画，即使他没有被击倒。

01124e73928685c7db24b65ddb1706c52d1c2c1e.source: Seek the source of the corruption by defeating and purifying the tormented lands. You have [10...0] more tormented lands to defeat.
01124e73928685c7db24b65ddb1706c52d1c2c1e.text: 通过击败和净化受折磨的土地来寻找腐败的根源。你还有 [10...0] 个饱受折磨的土地需要打败。

76399c642be4a98ee2d49ef0c4162a73f1393217.source: Defeat and purify the Earthen Abomination.

e83653a602698cc89865002b696cc5847352d3de.source: Earthen Abomination and Tormented Lands will no longer spawn in Turai's Procession after this quest is completed.
e83653a602698cc89865002b696cc5847352d3de.text: 此任务完成后，大地憎恶和折磨之地将不再在图莱的队伍中生成。

33d3d437645cf8c1a89fbf349cdee471e747f626.source: After accepting the quest, Mirza will drop a Sacred Seed for a party member to carry.
33d3d437645cf8c1a89fbf349cdee471e747f626.text: 接受任务后，米尔扎会掉落一颗神圣种子，供队员携带。

a3819d73a0551ac42e3f6ab5a0d4609ff6b933ab.source: Take the seed and follow the quest pointer into the central area of Turai's Procession where you will see a Tormented Land, defeat the creature and drop the seed on its corpse. You will see a shimmering effect on the ground, and the creature's corpse will disappear as the corruption in it is purified. This process must be performed 10 times in total, once for each Tormented Land that appears.
a3819d73a0551ac42e3f6ab5a0d4609ff6b933ab.text: 拿着种子并按照任务指针进入图莱游行队伍的中心区域，在那里你会看到一片折磨之地，击败该生物并将种子扔在它的尸体上。你会在地面上看到闪烁的效果，并且该生物的尸体会随着其中的腐败被净化而消失。这个过程总共需要执行10次，每出现一个折磨之地就执行一次。

fea9da1bdebadebff94e959848b35a0ff9e7436f.source: After defeating 10 Tormented Lands, the final corrupted creature, the Earthen Abomination will appear, as above, slay this creature and drop the seed on its corpse to complete the purifying process.
fea9da1bdebadebff94e959848b35a0ff9e7436f.text: 击败 10 个折磨之地后，最后一个腐化生物大地憎恶将会出现，如上所述，杀死该生物并将种子撒在其尸体上以完成净化过程。

6e9375e03b33b5734572e9bf057245309d5006c1.source: Finally, return to Mirza and collect your reward.
6e9375e03b33b5734572e9bf057245309d5006c1.text: 最后，返回米尔扎并领取你的奖励。

42093d21832e1de4dd10c43aa41975d4ff203c3a.source: You can drop the seeds on the bodies in any order, including the boss.
42093d21832e1de4dd10c43aa41975d4ff203c3a.text: 你可以按任意顺序将种子扔到尸体上，包括 Boss。

c116c8e02774fad810de1c12b544de414472c558.source: Completion of this quest increases the number of foes required to Vanquish the area.
c116c8e02774fad810de1c12b544de414472c558.text: 完成此任务会增加征服该地区所需的敌人数量。

adf8c030d4b293be2b0463035b4447b4fd07a380.source: Tormented Lands will appear near the central area until the quest is completed. To complete the vanquish, each spawn only needs to be killed once.
adf8c030d4b293be2b0463035b4447b4fd07a380.text: 折磨之地将出现在中心区域附近，直到任务完成。要完成征服，每个生成只需要被杀死一次。

8a71c8a5ecf06d12c491ed942038c58ca3d043f7.source: After the quest is completed, the quest-related foes will be replaced by groups totaling more than 11 foes (including Heket, Stone Shard Crag/Cracked Mesa, and Tusked Hunter/Tusked Howler).
8a71c8a5ecf06d12c491ed942038c58ca3d043f7.text: 任务完成后，与任务相关的敌人将被总共超过11个敌人的群体所取代（包括赫克特、碎石峭壁/裂纹台地和獠牙猎人/獠牙咆哮者）。

1480544790c0efb18f56a3693271c2afd00db868.source: Find the home of Hogni Truthseeker in Drakkar Lake.
1480544790c0efb18f56a3693271c2afd00db868.text: 在德拉卡湖找到霍格尼真理探索者的家。

2002da0694d0bece84e55529ded356a56fee912c.text: 与霍格尼真相探索者交谈

69ad767fc72cce1b0c1727947ed1584cf2d86dcf.source: Note: The quest will only be available after completing "Tracking the Nornbear" quest.
69ad767fc72cce1b0c1727947ed1584cf2d86dcf.text: 注意：该任务仅在完成“追踪诺恩熊”任务后才可用。

14db5867a6f938f12742930a406b98ac56f92e4d.source: Start from either Olafstead or Sifhalla to get to Hogni Truthseeker. The route from Olafstead is shorter. It is entirely possible to run, as this quest requires no fighting.
14db5867a6f938f12742930a406b98ac56f92e4d.text: 从 Olafstead 或 Sifhalla 出发前往 Hogni Truthseeker。从奥拉夫斯特德出发的路线较短。逃跑是完全可能的，因为这个任务不需要战斗。

9a021b17af8164661467f905b95ae1f4eca15494.source: Hogni Truthseeker gives you three quests (A Hunter's Pride, Leader of the Pack and Shadows in the Night) to gain the elite form skills Ursan, Volfen and Raven blessings as well as Norn reputation points.
9a021b17af8164661467f905b95ae1f4eca15494.text: Hogni Truthseeker 为您提供了三个任务（猎人的骄傲、狼群领袖和暗夜之影）来获得精英形态技能乌桑、沃尔芬和乌鸦的祝福以及诺恩声望点。

b0a728a90d80a1f1c2a7c14e41436addf74d329a.source: The quests for each skill only become available after completing the primary quest in which you receive the corresponding temporary blessing: Blood Washes Blood (Ursan), Curse of the Nornbear (Volfen) and A Gate Too Far (Raven).
b0a728a90d80a1f1c2a7c14e41436addf74d329a.text: 每个技能的任务只有在完成主任务并获得相应的临时祝福后才可用：血洗血（乌尔桑）、诺恩熊的诅咒（沃尔芬）和遥远之门（乌鸦）。

9b7a3b849f7e8ef348c7e5b4313798fda54dccd0.source: Find and retrieve a mossy rock from the cave near the ruins of Ashford.
9b7a3b849f7e8ef348c7e5b4313798fda54dccd0.text: 从阿什福德废墟附近的洞穴中找到并取回一块长满青苔的岩石。

81bc6f7914cec8f5cc07b534270b039ad5477111.source: The cave is to the southeast of the Sanitarium. Follow the quest marker. There will be one or two Grawl boss groups in front of the cave entrance, as well as the elemental Grit Slingstone inside the cave; you do not have to kill any of them to complete the quest. Click on the mossy rock on the ground and you will obtain a Mossy Rock quest item. Take this back to Vassar.
81bc6f7914cec8f5cc07b534270b039ad5477111.text: 该洞穴位于疗养院的东南方。跟随任务标记。洞穴入口前会有一到两个穴居人 Boss 群，以及洞穴内的元素砂砾弹石；你不必杀死他们中的任何一个来完成任务。点击地面上的苔藓岩石，你将获得苔藓岩石任务物品。把这个带回给瓦萨。

8d3fe649454fbd3b4272a1458b75870a6cd0ad63.source: Combines well with Mesmerizing the Enemy as the target boss will be along the way.
8d3fe649454fbd3b4272a1458b75870a6cd0ad63.text: 与迷惑敌人完美结合，因为目标 Boss 会一路出现。

75864cb35e60c34d4fbeb2c9f920f805f7399f11.source: The portal on the first level claims it leads to the third level of Forsaken Tunnels. Multiple groups of singed oaks fail to fight back.
75864cb35e60c34d4fbeb2c9f920f805f7399f11.text: 第一层的传送门声称它通向被遗忘的隧道的第三层。多群烧焦的橡树未能反击。

80bcefd03e626d7ef29f13407dd28c0f93a18d2e.source: The dungeon can be entered with a party of 6 when starting from Yak's Bend or even 8 when starting from Temple of the Ages (very far away).
80bcefd03e626d7ef29f13407dd28c0f93a18d2e.text: 从牦牛弯出发时，可以 6 人进入地下城；从千古殿（很远）出发，甚至可以 8 人进入。

79f212ff9136183c09c5c70c81f503e7ad418825.source: If any party members have Elegy for Those Left Behind, the bandits that drop the Elemental Keystone don't spawn, so the party cannot advance to the second level.
79f212ff9136183c09c5c70c81f503e7ad418825.text: 如果任何队伍成员拥有《留守者挽歌》，则不会生成掉落元素钥石的强盗，因此队伍无法晋级到第二级。

c145fbb686c3d5d3f73119bd8cd6b34536d5a619.source: If no party members have The Dreamer and the Zealot active, the gate to the third level remains closed and none of the bosses on the third level spawn.
c145fbb686c3d5d3f73119bd8cd6b34536d5a619.text: 如果没有党员激活梦想家和狂热者，则第三层的大门将保持关闭，并且第三层上不会出现任何 Boss。

6271691be6f6df1a06528b32cd459a63fe0dcf41.source: First and second floor re-uses the second and third floor of Forsaken Tunnels with slight environmental differences.
6271691be6f6df1a06528b32cd459a63fe0dcf41.text: 一楼和二楼重复利用了被遗忘者隧道的二楼和三楼，但环境略有不同。

32280dbbec9573762fb01a204a9a22287a381c6c.source: Because this area is mechanically part of the Depths of Tyria, the Reforged Mode effect is not applied.
32280dbbec9573762fb01a204a9a22287a381c6c.text: 由于该区域在机械上是泰瑞亚深渊的一部分，因此不会应用重铸模式效果。

6dc4f4399bc8b11897fb7de8e1db8867f336da63.source: Clear Turai's Procession in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
6dc4f4399bc8b11897fb7de8e1db8867f336da63.text: 在困难模式下清除库尔纳图莱游行队伍中的所有敌人。

12b2e9163b3f97aba9d3996e641df8c292683bb4.source: Turai's Procession is the north exit in Command Post.
12b2e9163b3f97aba9d3996e641df8c292683bb4.text: 图莱的游行队伍位于指挥所的北出口。

0822f5c467164a46c5429d6f5d56c236cfeabb70.source: This area is named after Turai Ossa, but the "Procession" might refer to the march of his army towards the Battle of Jahai or him leading settlers to the Crystal Desert. Geographically, the latter is more likely.
0822f5c467164a46c5429d6f5d56c236cfeabb70.text: 该地区以图莱·奥萨的名字命名，但“游行”可能指的是他的军队向贾海战役行进，或者他带领定居者前往水晶沙漠。从地理上看，后者的可能性更大。

e8c6b96b6c3bd0e7517d30f82fcbc7d622125837.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.4% to the Elonian Cartographer title, the largest in Kourna.
e8c6b96b6c3bd0e7517d30f82fcbc7d622125837.text: 对该区域的完整探索为埃洛尼安制图师头衔贡献了约 3.4%，这是库尔纳最大的头衔。

b163f87f658ee7d2c6abc00cb8f26c2eeadf5a6a.source: This zone has a small section (on the eastern edge) with a permanent fog: it will remain covered even after your character explores it.
b163f87f658ee7d2c6abc00cb8f26c2eeadf5a6a.text: 该区域有一小部分（在东边）有永久的雾：即使在你的角色探索它之后，它仍然会被覆盖。

09aefeb43eda632517fd6a65894e0626cacf5f60.source: If triggered, Mirza's Last Stand greatly increases the number of foes in this area.
09aefeb43eda632517fd6a65894e0626cacf5f60.text: 如果触发，米尔扎的背水一战会大大增加该区域的敌人数量。

4c0927ade433fb768ef2d937a9dfbcd7bccee6f1.source: Until the quest Troubled Lands is completed, vanquishing requires killing the Tormented Lands. They spawn in a fixed order and might make vanquishing confusing - refer to the map in on the quest page if you're having difficulty finding the last few mobs.
4c0927ade433fb768ef2d937a9dfbcd7bccee6f1.text: 在任务“麻烦之地”完成之前，征服需要杀死“折磨之地”。它们以固定的顺序生成，可能会让征服变得混乱 - 如果您很难找到最后几个小怪，请参阅任务页面上的地图。

be765374d3f8aa8907b168f176168cbcbb83a31c.source: Kill each Tormented Land once - another will spawn nearby until the original ten are killed, at which point an Earthen Abomination spawns. Kill the Abomination and from this point on you can ignore these creatures. Two minutes later, the spawning process will begin again. The first 11 unique kills contribute to experience, leave drops, and count towards vanquishing; killing the re-spawned ones does not; the Earthen Abomination boss gives the morale boost only after first kill.
be765374d3f8aa8907b168f176168cbcbb83a31c.text: 杀死每个折磨之地一次 - 另一个会在附近生成，直到最初的十个被杀死，此时会生成土灵憎恶。杀死憎恶，从现在开始你就可以忽略这些生物了。两分钟后，产卵过程将再次开始。前 11 次独特的击杀有助于获得经验、留下掉落物并计入征服；杀死重生的则不会；大地憎恶 Boss 仅在首次击杀后才会提升士气。

a4e72086562272832253b890e5ba9dd5b3005b37.source: Completing Troubled Lands raises the kill count, as it replaces the Tormented Lands (10) and Earthen Abomination (1) with groups totaling more than the aforementioned 11 elementals required to complete the quest.
a4e72086562272832253b890e5ba9dd5b3005b37.text: 完成麻烦之地会提高击杀数，因为它取代了折磨之地 (10) 和大地憎恶 (1)，而队伍总数超过了完成任务所需的上述 11 个元素。

4b215e2d0fe34c50c6abca0e537d7f62ea9ac21a.source: Defeat the White Mantle who have taken the Grimoire Arcanum.
4b215e2d0fe34c50c6abca0e537d7f62ea9ac21a.text: 击败夺取魔典奥秘的白斗篷。

1f634311e3c61bc6b85517931593e7dcae558ffa.source: Return the Grimoire Arcanum to Justiciar Naveed.
1f634311e3c61bc6b85517931593e7dcae558ffa.text: 将魔典奥秘归还给法官纳维德。

5ff5171be81da2972601a5107337f2656fc92a72.source: Find Justiciar Naveed outside of Tarnished Haven. Travel to the west side of Alcazia Tangle near the exit to Magus Stones and defeat the group of White Mantle there. Pick up the Grimoire Arcanum and return it to Justiciar Naveed. To save time, once you have acquired the Grimoire Arcanum you can map back to Tarnished Haven and go to Justiciar Naveed from there.
5ff5171be81da2972601a5107337f2656fc92a72.text: 在玷污避难所外找到审判官纳维德。前往阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区西侧靠近魔法石出口的地方，击败那里的白斗篷队伍。拿起魔法书奥秘并将其归还给正义法官纳维德。为了节省时间，一旦你获得了《魔法书奥秘》，你就可以映射回玷污港并从那里前往正义者纳维德。

01304ee2bf8dbc8c869eb9a8dfc0ea5025b86954.source: A far easier route, than fighting through Alcazia Tangle to reach the West side, would be to travel South from Rata Sum through Magus Stones and then head through the portal into Alcazia Tangle. The White Mantle are just South of the portal.
01304ee2bf8dbc8c869eb9a8dfc0ea5025b86954.text: 一条比穿过阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔到达西侧更容易的路线是从拉塔苏姆向南穿过魔法石，然后通过传送门进入阿尔卡齐亚坦格尔。白斗篷就在传送门的南面。

a7a187a08a36264fe48a624e14ec7ac7066e51c0.source: Using the Chest (under the quest marker) after killing the White Mantle will acquire the Grimoire Arcanum.
a7a187a08a36264fe48a624e14ec7ac7066e51c0.text: 杀死白斗篷后使用宝箱（在任务标记下）将获得魔法书奥秘。

739fde17b68237271c9e9d8f7c83d33727082506.source: Justiciar Naveed will not accept the Grimoire Arcanum if you get it on one character and try to turn it in on another character, who has not completed the first objective (which is similar to Temple of the Damned and its quest item).
739fde17b68237271c9e9d8f7c83d33727082506.text: 如果您将魔法书奥秘放在一个角色上并尝试将其交给另一个尚未完成第一个目标的角色（类似于诅咒神庙及其任务物品），正义者纳维德将不会接受它。

3302a460b2381fa85737e0e97547444797c5e7f9.source: The assassin boss Pywatt the Swift is nearby.
3302a460b2381fa85737e0e97547444797c5e7f9.text: 刺客头目迅捷者皮瓦特就在附近。

c10f375f9a012ce56c8ee5d7544afb75dc16f11d.source: Clear Twin Serpent Lakes in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
c10f375f9a012ce56c8ee5d7544afb75dc16f11d.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔双蛇湖中的所有敌人。

d580d10038d70ffa51f492e90608087348f61a7c.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 185|low = 171|high = 194|notes=A Spined Aloe is often hidden between Ancient Oakhearts.}}
d580d10038d70ffa51f492e90608087348f61a7c.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 185|low = 171|high = 194|notes=刺芦荟经常隐藏在古代橡树心之间。}}

13734ba8b0a28cf1bf57455622ddc588e7252ebe.source: With War in Kryta active (during a Bounty), the foe count is approximately 137.
13734ba8b0a28cf1bf57455622ddc588e7252ebe.text: 随着科瑞塔之战活跃（赏金期间），敌人数量约为 137。

71f2339a2be06e0731d9488f3fd3a4ffd2269228.source: The Drakes, Gargoyles, and Skale often roam together. Use terrain features, such as walls, to obstruct their line of sight, and pull groups apart to avoid engaging multiple species at once.
71f2339a2be06e0731d9488f3fd3a4ffd2269228.text: 德雷克、石像鬼和斯凯尔经常一起漫游。利用地形特征（例如墙壁）来阻挡他们的视线，并将群体分开以避免同时与多个物种交战。

36e5131253a73623ee8eb58f562b05a0387365f2.source: The Caromi Tengu groups have long patrol routes and move quickly.
36e5131253a73623ee8eb58f562b05a0387365f2.text: 卡罗米天狗小组的巡逻路线很长，行动也很快。

7c2bab5d62c28c5d5ce8e9bd0f5499b3523af8b3.source: Rout the remaining Kournan forces. You have 0..3 groups to rout.
7c2bab5d62c28c5d5ce8e9bd0f5499b3523af8b3.text: 击溃剩余的库尔南部队。你有 0..3 个小组需要击溃。

d18b571905ce6c8a0df780f120831426ecd63e6d.source: Kournan soldiers will gather at the three entrances to the village. After some dialogue, the center group will attack, followed by the two outside groups. With the exception of the Kournan Commander, all the troops are level 16 and killing them should not be a problem for a full group.
d18b571905ce6c8a0df780f120831426ecd63e6d.text: 库尔南士兵将聚集在村庄的三个入口处。经过一番对话后，中心组将发起攻击，随后是外侧的两个组。除了库尔南指挥官之外，所有部队都是16级，杀掉他们对于一个完整的团队来说应该不成问题。

5ecb961de5080f3530f8313d67406e6c635849b3.source: If you kill the center group before they enter the village gates, the other two groups will not become hostile. Thus, the quest cannot be completed.
5ecb961de5080f3530f8313d67406e6c635849b3.text: 如果你在中间的队伍进入村门之前杀死他们，其他两组就不会变得敌对。因此，任务无法完成。

8a58cc8ad9e07929067b3e6a436b881a49f07771.source: There is a resurrection shrine near to the village, with a hunt blessing, so this quest can be used to farm Sunspear points.
8a58cc8ad9e07929067b3e6a436b881a49f07771.text: 村庄附近有一个复活神殿，有狩猎祝福，所以这个任务可以用来刷阳矛点。

81c5f4f2d113ab2db13cdd379a86cdb5f78e5c39.source: Convince Kareh Ossa's commanders to align with Joko by defeating them in combat. You have defeated [0...4] of 4 commanders.
81c5f4f2d113ab2db13cdd379a86cdb5f78e5c39.text: 在战斗中击败卡雷·奥萨的指挥官，说服他们与约科结盟。您已击败 4 位指挥官中的 [0...4] 位。

2c68c80811975678697acf71b116b6b87aacf78c.source: Follow the quest pointer to each of the commanders in turn and defeat them and their guards. Be careful, since the normal area spawns will also be present making for large mixed groups of enemies. Two commanders can be reached using Junundu, making them easy to defeat.
2c68c80811975678697acf71b116b6b87aacf78c.text: 依次跟随任务指针找到每位指挥官并击败他们和他们的守卫。请小心，因为正常区域也会出现，从而形成大量混合的敌人。使用 Junundu 可以接触到两名指挥官，这使得他们很容易被击败。

03052e3587bae064a52908a5c02cd55d92b997cb.source: On the map: W is Wurm Spoor locations. The numbers are the four commanders.
03052e3587bae064a52908a5c02cd55d92b997cb.text: 在地图上：W 是Wurm Spoor 的位置。数字是四位指挥官。

1dbd750d9d4d18bb5547f5c83030605301a35370.source: The four commanders are: Commander Mosek, Commander Yamji, Commander Lohgor and Commander Giturh. Note that while some of them have elite skills, they cannot be captured due to the fact that they automatically turn non-hostile if defeated (less than 20% health), preventing their deaths. Also since they do not, technically, die - you do not receive any morale boosts.
1dbd750d9d4d18bb5547f5c83030605301a35370.text: 这四名指挥官是：莫塞克指挥官、亚姆吉指挥官、洛戈尔指挥官和吉图尔指挥官。请注意，虽然其中一些拥有精英技能，但他们无法被捕获，因为如果被击败（生命值低于 20%），他们会自动转为非敌对状态，从而避免死亡。此外，从技术上讲，他们不会死亡——你不会获得任何士气提升。

5acb876cf39fcbf077cf9bcc90e5b41bbb840135.source: Should you map back to town to remove any death penalty, you will restart the quest.
5acb876cf39fcbf077cf9bcc90e5b41bbb840135.text: 如果你映射回城镇以取消任何死刑，你将重新开始任务。

ccef0b90c7758ea227fcdcc95abca2a91a7d61e3.source: The mob linked with each commander will become friendly when the commander is defeated, so if you want a fast run, target and take down each commander first.
ccef0b90c7758ea227fcdcc95abca2a91a7d61e3.text: 当指挥官被击败时，与每个指挥官相连的生物会变得友好，所以如果你想快速奔跑，首先瞄准并击倒每个指挥官。

ea02ca98195d70db05d613d5c3f5cd96864a547a.source: The boss group of Churkeh the Defiant might not spawn if this quest is active when entering the area.
ea02ca98195d70db05d613d5c3f5cd96864a547a.text: 如果在进入该区域时激活此任务，挑战者楚克的 Boss 团队可能不会生成。

9255c0d11fb0df020f0a4d1a94b431a1e177b94c.source: Return to Erudine for your reward.
9255c0d11fb0df020f0a4d1a94b431a1e177b94c.text: 返回埃鲁丁那里领取奖励。

b7e5489489b4a80e195d5f8106e7892cefb5ba81.source: Exit Serenity Temple and follow the quest marker to reach the giant crystal. The boss will spawn in the general area. Once you kill the boss, pick up the Storm Rider Tissue Sample and bring it back to Erudine for your reward.
b7e5489489b4a80e195d5f8106e7892cefb5ba81.text: 退出宁静神殿并按照任务标记到达巨型水晶。 Boss 将在一般区域生成。杀死 Boss 后，拿起风暴骑士组织样本并将其带回给 Erudine 以获得奖励。

9c82f97b6a67cb9d219b60adff6664c7bdb6a349.source: The quest will not be marked as completed after obtaining the Storm Rider Tissue Sample.
9c82f97b6a67cb9d219b60adff6664c7bdb6a349.text: 获得风暴骑士组织样本后，该任务不会被标记为已完成。

0d4ba57319bfd98c5570e7faf8d4ccb60f704340.source: Go to the falls to the west. Destroy the aloe husks until you find an aloe root.
0d4ba57319bfd98c5570e7faf8d4ccb60f704340.text: 前往西边的瀑布。摧毁芦荟外壳，直到找到芦荟根。

51d2221e527c0d6f37194cc65c48f1d6ee3156a1.source: Take the aloe root back to Aidan.

f18ac495b067d26b6ab8ffa317cafa69de80d997.source: Aidan will give you the following skills when accepting this quest:
f18ac495b067d26b6ab8ffa317cafa69de80d997.text: 接受此任务时，艾丹将给予你以下技能：

f70c7e2a353014eb63a839aec3f6570636f0bb6c.source: You can find Aidan south-east next to a small fishing village in the Wizard's Folly.
f70c7e2a353014eb63a839aec3f6570636f0bb6c.text: 你可以在巫师愚蠢区东南方的一个小渔村旁边找到艾丹。

5f071914eb75ba6e520c5bd3c577e79d82af4ae7.source: If you draw a line straight south from Ashford Abbey to the bottom of the map, the bottom of the line would cross the small fishing village. By foot that means go east from Foible's Fair until you come to the river. Then try to go south and you'll find the village. The village is in an area of the river shaped like a large "Y".
5f071914eb75ba6e520c5bd3c577e79d82af4ae7.text: 如果你从阿什福德修道院一直向南画一条线到地图的底部，线的底部会穿过那个小渔村。步行意味着从 Foible's Fair 向东走，直到到达河边。然后尝试向南走，你就会找到村庄。这个村庄位于河边，形状像一个大“Y”形。

40ab566eb9a931fd8f3f562a21f9ff12d199fa3b.source: When you're at the village, go south. You'll encounter some spiders. When you can't go south anymore, go east; you'll see a small house at a mountain. You can find Aidan at the foot of the hill, next to a part of the river which flows north to south.
40ab566eb9a931fd8f3f562a21f9ff12d199fa3b.text: 到了村子后，往南走。你会遇到一些蜘蛛。当你不能再向南走时，就向东走；你会看到山上有一座小房子。您可以在山脚下找到艾丹，靠近一条从北向南流淌的河流。

71a6b72d254ed8cbc3bf11904e1f4dfeea8e3c18.source: Equipping the two skills Aidan gives you will be a big help, as the Large Aloe Seeds you will encounter are susceptible to fire damage and come in clusters of three. This quest serves as an introduction to the concept of skill chaining, using skills in combination for greater effect. Using Dual Shot doubles the effect of Ignite Arrows.
71a6b72d254ed8cbc3bf11904e1f4dfeea8e3c18.text: 装备艾丹给你的两项技能将会有很大的帮助，因为你将遇到的大芦荟种子很容易受到火焰伤害，并且是三个一组的。此任务介绍了技能链的概念，组合使用技能以获得更大的效果。使用双重射击可以使点燃箭的效果加倍。

455759e42583bd2a78bb7de28aca99a37d423cd8.source: Follow the quest marker west until you encounter the river. Several Large Aloe Seeds will be hanging out here. Kill them, using your new skills if you wish. They will drop Aloe Roots when they die. Pick one up and take it back to Aidan.
455759e42583bd2a78bb7de28aca99a37d423cd8.text: 沿着任务标记向西走，直到遇到河流。几颗大芦荟种子将挂在这里。如果你愿意的话，可以使用你的新技能杀死他们。他们死后会掉落芦荟根。捡起一个并把它带回给艾丹。

4924a5c5a6ae7bec2064e3a48d85b1dc5449f36a.source: The Hunter's Horn quest leads to Aidan, who can be hard to find for new players.
4924a5c5a6ae7bec2064e3a48d85b1dc5449f36a.text: 猎人号角任务会找到艾丹，对于新玩家来说很难找到他。

96159916211811bdf4c5f55e97dbe295abac86cf.source: The Large Aloe Seeds spawn even without the quest active in the log, but they cease to spawn after completion of the quest.
96159916211811bdf4c5f55e97dbe295abac86cf.text: 即使日志中没有激活任务，大芦荟种子也会生成，但任务完成后它们会停止生成。

fde34d58ca858b73988764561339c2e5fb52ff25.source: The Stone Basilica can be scouted for Summit Slaves on the way to Molachev.
fde34d58ca858b73988764561339c2e5fb52ff25.text: 在前往莫拉乔夫的途中，可以在石质大教堂中寻找山顶奴隶。

faff6bc94665209ed7596dd7ef7be326d468141c.source: Darkhaven can be scouted for Summit Slaves while fighting Molachev.
faff6bc94665209ed7596dd7ef7be326d468141c.text: 在与莫拉切夫战斗时，可以在黑暗天堂搜寻峰会奴隶。

10f9cc31bfe6544b271d42d9485728ff8a645436.source: The ally and enemy Dredge in Darkhaven are hostile to each other.
10f9cc31bfe6544b271d42d9485728ff8a645436.text: 黑暗港的盟友和敌人德雷奇彼此敌对。

c923c6005e45a700f785e12567fcd2525a6dc09e.source: Return to the ancient ruins of the Great Destroyer.
c923c6005e45a700f785e12567fcd2525a6dc09e.text: 返回伟大毁灭者的古代遗迹。

b16ff3b747d486592d5da459048f4e5c2d061541.source: Destroy the Hierophant Morlog before he learns the true name of the Great Destroyer.
b16ff3b747d486592d5da459048f4e5c2d061541.text: 在莫洛格大祭司得知伟大毁灭者的真名之前将其消灭。

0767a2ccbad5d991bff408b65f841a2116f90b63.source: Return the Tome of the Rubicon to the ancient ruins. Drop it where High Priest Alkar awaits.
0767a2ccbad5d991bff408b65f841a2116f90b63.text: 将卢比孔河之书带回远古废墟。把它扔到大祭司阿尔卡等待的地方。

aa0308a0b2f9d4613a440c04742a4bb300d977cf.source: Collect 4 shards of Balthazate crystal and place them near High Priest Alkar. You have [4..0] shards remaining. Be sure to protect the High Priest from enemy patrols.
aa0308a0b2f9d4613a440c04742a4bb300d977cf.text: 收集 4 块巴尔萨扎特水晶碎片并将它们放在高阶祭司阿尔卡附近。您还剩下 [4..0] 个碎片。一定要保护大祭司免受敌人巡逻队的伤害。

9fb0f77060b82e8b3c099c8632ea9cb891618226.source: 8,000 Experience (You must collect the reward before leaving Sorrow's Furnace.)
9fb0f77060b82e8b3c099c8632ea9cb891618226.text: 8,000经验（必须在离开悲伤熔炉前领取奖励。）

004f63484a604fd48214254a944d5e18061fc43b.source: To acquire this quest, you will first need to locate High Priest Alkar in Grenth's Footprint. You'll find him towards the northeast. You will then have to lead Alkar into Sorrow's Furnace, taking down several groups of Stone Summit along the way. Simply head towards the quest marker and enter Sorrow's Furnace, regardless of whether Alkar managed to keep up with your party.
004f63484a604fd48214254a944d5e18061fc43b.text: 要完成这个任务，你首先需要在古兰斯的足迹中找到高阶祭司阿尔卡。你会在东北方向找到他。然后你必须带领阿尔卡进入悲伤熔炉，击倒沿途的几组石峰。只需前往任务标记并进入悲伤熔炉，无论阿尔卡是否设法跟上你的队伍。

eea666d55f2745961f13b4457269f405bbba31ce.source: Getting the Tome of the Rubicon

6729e40d48246641a6e9d404a010b04174e2f1c1.source: Once inside, talk to Alkar again to accept this quest. Head past the large doors and down to engage the first enemy group. After taking down this group, Alkar will start moving on his own towards the Stone Basilica (taking a right at the first junction). It is important that the party keep an eye on Alkar, since his death will return the party to an outpost. Try to gather drops during a fight rather than after, since Alkar will immediately set off towards the quest marker the moment the last enemy falls.
6729e40d48246641a6e9d404a010b04174e2f1c1.text: 进去后，再次与阿尔卡交谈以接受此任务。穿过大门，向下与第一支敌军交战。消灭这群人后，阿尔卡将开始自行前往石大教堂（在第一个路口右转）。队伍要密切关注阿尔卡，这一点很重要，因为他的死将使队伍返回前哨基地。尝试在战斗中而不是战斗后收集掉落物，因为当最后一个敌人倒下时，阿尔卡会立即出发前往任务标记。

8846fc53ce8b65cd8313ca39ed72fa078833d0e6.source: Eventually, you'll see Hierophant Morlog, who is surrounded by many Summit Taskmasters. Pull the surrounding enemies to thin them before engaging the Hierophant, who will drop the Tome of the Rubicon upon defeat. Alkar will head back towards the stairs. Bring the Tome to him and drop it near him. Do not delay bringing the tome to Alkar because he will be attacked when he reaches the platform. You must return to defend him. The next (more difficult) part of the quest will start.
8846fc53ce8b65cd8313ca39ed72fa078833d0e6.text: 最终，你会看到圣职者莫洛格，他被许多峰会监工包围。在与圣职者交战之前，拉动周围的敌人来削弱他们，圣职者在被击败后会掉落卢比孔之书。阿尔卡将返回楼梯。将圣典交给他并放在他附近。不要拖延将书交给阿尔卡，因为当他到达平台时他会受到攻击。你必须回来保卫他。任务的下一个（更困难的）部分将开始。

b40039018e624422db8e9eae7b3e71ee200fd075.text: 收集四块巴尔塔扎特水晶

28570156b018d0b1896e76552d17811f9646f331.source: The second part of the quest will require you to retrieve four Balthazate Crystals to help power Alkar's ritual to bury the Tome of the Rubicon. The Balthazate Crystals will drop from the four newly-spawned Dredge Blastrocks. Each of the Dredge Blastrocks spawn amongst a group of Dredge, but are not part of the group. As such, depending on your luck, it may be possible to pull the Dredge Blastrock away from the Dredge group.
28570156b018d0b1896e76552d17811f9646f331.text: 任务的第二部分将要求你取回四颗巴尔塔扎特水晶，以帮助为阿尔卡埋葬卢比孔之书的仪式提供动力。巴尔萨扎特水晶将从四个新生成的挖泥爆弹石中掉落。每个挖泥机爆弹石都会在一组挖泥机中生成，但不是该组的一部分。因此，根据您的运气，也许有可能将挖掘者爆石从挖掘者队伍中拉开。

a89db531c5ea206c5470d30a1e242b6af0b17564.source: Alkar will remain on the platform. The party must split up at this point - a smaller group to protect Alkar (he will get attacked), and a larger group to retrieve the Balthazate Crystals. The group protecting Alkar should consist of at least a tank and a healer, but no more than three, or there may not be enough firepower to take down the Dredge Blastrocks.
a89db531c5ea206c5470d30a1e242b6af0b17564.text: Alkar 将继续留在该平台上。此时队伍必须分开——一个较小的小组来保护阿尔卡（他会受到攻击），一个较大的小组来取回巴尔塔扎特水晶。保护阿尔卡的队伍应该至少由一名坦克和一名治疗者组成，但不能超过三人，否则可能没有足够的火力来击落挖掘爆石。

aad9f598ad4a006b2e75779710da8b22b999cd7b.source: The quest marker will indicate the location of the next Dredge Blastrock, so use it to find them. Keep in mind that engaging and killing Dredge Blastrocks will trigger enemy spawns to charge down the stairs towards Alkar's position, so be ready to run back to help defend Alkar. Left alone, Alkar will fall very quickly.
aad9f598ad4a006b2e75779710da8b22b999cd7b.text: 任务标记将指示下一个挖掘爆石的位置，因此请使用它来找到它们。请记住，交战并杀死挖掘爆石会触发敌人生成，从楼梯上冲向阿尔卡的位置，所以准备好跑回来帮助保卫阿尔卡。如果放任不管，阿尔卡很快就会倒下。

8cab252eb57ba8b7ac18fbff4acfaed4995aa8dc.source: The first Dredge Blastrock is a short distance to the southeast. The third and fourth are further beyond, to the southeast and southwest respectively (watch out for overlapping patrols). The second Dredge Blastrock actually requires that you backtrack up the stairs. The tricky thing about taking down the Dredge Blastrock is that enemies will spawn and charge towards Alkar's position the first time a Dredge Blastrock is attacked and when a Dredge Blastrock is killed.
8cab252eb57ba8b7ac18fbff4acfaed4995aa8dc.text: 第一个疏浚爆石位于东南方向不远的地方。第三个和第四个在更远的地方，分别在东南和西南（注意重叠的巡逻）。第二个挖掘爆石实际上要求你原路返回楼梯。拿下挖泥爆石的棘手之处在于，当挖泥爆石第一次受到攻击以及挖泥爆石被杀死时，敌人会生成并向阿尔卡的位置冲锋。

e6ef4b86a73f5f67cca85e5d9348b6c53d66fa74.source: In other words, when a Dredge Blastrock is attacked for the first time, a small group of usually three Stone Summit will attack Alkar's position. Upon killing a Dredge Blastrock, a larger group of about 5 or 6 Stone Summit and spawn and charge Alkar's position.
e6ef4b86a73f5f67cca85e5d9348b6c53d66fa74.text: 换句话说，当挖掘爆石第一次受到攻击时，一小群通常由三个石峰组成的小队会攻击阿尔卡的位置。杀死挖掘爆石后，一大群约 5 或 6 个石峰会生成并向阿尔卡的阵地发起冲锋。

135357724324eb989782d6e22bd035ebfa26ca91.source: There are two things to keep in mind:

25ff76701491c1ad3ea30507b0b96d528df9d405.source: Kill all nearby Dredge before engaging a Dredge Blastrock and do not kill a Dredge Blastrock too quickly after engaging it (to avoid quickly overwhelming the defending group).
25ff76701491c1ad3ea30507b0b96d528df9d405.text: 在与挖泥爆石交战之前杀死附近的所有挖泥，并且在交战后不要太快杀死挖泥爆石（以避免快速压倒防御小组）。

af3edd60875114595d4772ed62ff041e2ebac439.source: When a Dredge Blastrock is almost dead, if the party has multiple players, have some of them start running back. If using henchmen, run back to Alkar immediately after killing a Dredge Blastrock. Consider ignoring the Balthazate Crystal first and come back for it later, after defending Alkar from the assault. Running back only after Alkar starts taking damage usually means it will be too late.
af3edd60875114595d4772ed62ff041e2ebac439.text: 当挖掘爆石几乎死亡时，如果队伍中有多名玩家，请让其中一些人开始跑回来。如果使用追随者，杀死挖掘爆石后立即跑回阿尔卡。考虑先忽略巴尔萨扎特水晶，然后在保护阿尔卡免受攻击后再回来拿它。仅在阿尔卡开始受到伤害后才跑回来通常意味着为时已晚。

fe288f21c4693f85d704dc59880fe6abb78365b1.source: For each Balthazate Crystal retrieved, just drop them near Alkar. Once you have successfully recovered four of them, a cutscene will trigger and the quest will be completed.
fe288f21c4693f85d704dc59880fe6abb78365b1.text: 对于每个取回的巴尔萨扎特水晶，只需将它们放在阿尔卡附近即可。一旦你成功恢复其中四个，就会触发过场动画，任务就会完成。

8b762748d2baf6cdc488284d53849517445de7f0.source: It may be possible to leave Alkar going one-on-one with Hierophant Morlog, possibly supported by just one healer. If they manage to fight to a standstill, it makes the second part of this quest much easier, since you don't have to worry about Alkar dying. You just need to know where the Dredge Blastrock will spawn (since they have not spawned yet), and also to keep your heroes, henchmen, or minions from killing the Hierophant.
8b762748d2baf6cdc488284d53849517445de7f0.text: 也许可以让阿尔卡与圣职者莫洛格进行一对一的战斗，可能只有一名治疗师的支持。如果他们能够战斗到停滞状态，那么这个任务的第二部分就会变得容易得多，因为你不必担心阿尔卡会死。你只需要知道挖泥爆石会在哪里生成（因为它们还没有生成），并防止你的英雄、追随者或小兵杀死圣职者。

e11d4897746465244f3b6e95bd9fdcc7c55e739e.source: If only using henchmen, completing this quest will be tricky. The key would be in knowing how to trigger the enemy spawn that attacks Alkar. The idea is that you trigger a spawn, then immediately run back to defend Alkar. Having party-wide speed boost skills will be helpful (e.g. "Charge!").
e11d4897746465244f3b6e95bd9fdcc7c55e739e.text: 如果只使用追随者，完成这个任务将会很棘手。关键在于知道如何触发攻击阿尔卡的敌人生成。这个想法是你触发一个重生，然后立即跑回去保卫阿尔卡。拥有全队速度提升技能将会很有帮助（例如“冲锋！”）。

abc227f6af7fb1eb2c7f15b5b15b4de5aecdd6e3.source: Leaving a single warrior with defensive stances and powerful AoE damage to defend Alkar is also possible, because Alkar is a powerful healer. A single trapping ranger would be even better. Covering the stairs in traps will decimate the enemies charging down it, or at least weaken them enough for the rest of the party to come back and help.
abc227f6af7fb1eb2c7f15b5b15b4de5aecdd6e3.text: 留下一个具有防御姿态和强大 AoE 伤害的战士来防守阿尔卡也是可能的，因为阿尔卡是一个强大的治疗者。一个诱捕游侠就更好了。用陷阱覆盖楼梯将消灭冲下楼梯的敌人，或者至少削弱他们的力量，让队伍的其他成员回来帮忙。

0d41599c4aedcf9771d8cad4e2f5bf358c3b9b78.source: The key to taking down Stone Summit groups is to take down any Priests of Sorrows first. The Summit Dark Binders will exploit corpses, so it may be useful to take them down early as well.
0d41599c4aedcf9771d8cad4e2f5bf358c3b9b78.text: 打倒石峰团体的关键是首先打倒悲伤牧师。顶峰黑暗束缚者会利用尸体，因此尽早消灭它们也可能有用。

3bef18f3e9f6ab3391df11bdb88358e03d3f1100.source: Similarly, for Dredge groups, take down the Dredge Spirit Keepers first, as they have Resurrect. Also, the Dredge Spirit Guards possess a Resurrection Signet.
3bef18f3e9f6ab3391df11bdb88358e03d3f1100.text: 同样，对于疏浚小组，首先击倒疏浚灵魂守护者，因为他们有复活。此外，挖泥精灵守卫还拥有复活徽记。

ffb60d664249131bbe33eb691ceaf457df499486.source: There is a resurrection shrine close to Alkar's position. As long as Alkar is not dead, the quest is not yet lost.
ffb60d664249131bbe33eb691ceaf457df499486.text: 阿尔卡的位置附近有一座复活神殿。只要阿尔卡没有死，任务就不会失败。

e37da037a648f21c9160581caacd91eabea8b2d1.source: Leave a minion master with Alkar to take advantage of the corpses and to have minions providing additional firepower and targets for the Stone Summit.
e37da037a648f21c9160581caacd91eabea8b2d1.text: 让小兵大师留在阿尔卡身边，以利用尸体，并让小兵为石峰提供额外的火力和目标。

98fdd6dba1f7903daf49d73bb738b090abdf09e9.source: If using a minion master, Alkar will follow you in an attempt to heal the minions for all but the second Balthazate crystal.
98fdd6dba1f7903daf49d73bb738b090abdf09e9.text: 如果使用随从大师，阿尔卡将跟随你尝试治愈除了第二个巴尔塔扎特水晶之外的所有随从。

ef8d7d10832abee9f162e85569d0337b4cd56cf9.source: Ward Against Melee may be a good skill to have when defending Alkar, since most of the attacking spawns will consist of Summit Deep Knights and Enslaved Ettins.
ef8d7d10832abee9f162e85569d0337b4cd56cf9.text: 在防守阿尔卡时，防御近战可能是一个很好的技能，因为大多数攻击生成将由顶峰深渊骑士和被奴役的埃廷斯组成。

aa46a823e57b0d9c5283d59021b152f28cd55546.source: Alkar may start to follow your minion master and heal his minions. You can lure him away from Stone Basilica this way. He also may get stuck on the wall and stop moving till your minion master comes back.
aa46a823e57b0d9c5283d59021b152f28cd55546.text: 阿尔卡可能会开始跟随你的随从大师并治愈他的随从。你可以用这种方法引诱他离开石殿。他也可能会卡在墙上并停止移动，直到你的随从大师回来。

1e25c7b46abbefeaa80b23f5e018ccc86c9c58a4.source: Defeat Kuunavang in the Unwaking Waters.
1e25c7b46abbefeaa80b23f5e018ccc86c9c58a4.text: 在不醒水域击败库纳旺。

b97bb9226a213aa798c64433ef9c24def9d8f97d.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 15 minutes.
b97bb9226a213aa798c64433ef9c24def9d8f97d.text: *奖励* 在 15 分钟内完成任务。

7094446227887a8d0e973eb8c4a4cf1319aef598.source: As per the Unwaking Waters mission.

6218861c1f31fd1f2f2db6970cfa1164b3c440e2.source: Clear the Unwaking Waters in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
6218861c1f31fd1f2f2db6970cfa1164b3c440e2.text: 在困难模式下清除玉海不醒水域中的所有敌人。

42a568e5238432bda0fa263748ba6abefde91535.source: Clear The Labyrinth of the invading Dryder Force. you have 6..0 groups remaining.
42a568e5238432bda0fa263748ba6abefde91535.text: 清除入侵的干燥部队的迷宫。您还剩下 6..0 组。

7851243c46921dd406ef18bac5decda953771ebd.source: Note: Before taking this quest you should clear the entire Labyrinth and free the Reapers of Forgotten Vale and Ice Wastes so that you can use the teleport function to attack the Keeper of Souls from behind. The quest Escort of Souls should not be taken at the same time.
7851243c46921dd406ef18bac5decda953771ebd.text: 注意：在接受这个任务之前，你应该清理整个迷宫并释放遗忘谷和冰原收割者，这样你就可以使用传送功能从背后攻击灵魂守护者。灵魂护送任务不应同时进行。

01b81f8cacac7acfbc644e680386d2794711d8a6.source: Once you accept the quest, six clusters of foes spawn throughout the Labyrinth. Each cluster consists of one Keeper of Souls, two groups of three Terrorweb Dryders, three groupless Skeletons of Dhuum and two groups of three Vengeful Aatxes. The Vengeful Aatxes are invulnerable, but they do less damage than Bladed Aatxes. In each cluster, the Aatxes and Dryders die immediately when the Keeper of Souls of the same cluster is killed. To complete the quest you need to kill all six Keepers of Souls.
01b81f8cacac7acfbc644e680386d2794711d8a6.text: 一旦你接受任务，迷宫中就会出现六群敌人。每个集群由一名灵魂守护者、两组三只恐网干燥者、三组无组的德姆骷髅和两组三只复仇剑组成。复仇 Aatx 刀枪不入，但它们造成的伤害比刃剑 Aatx 低。在每个集群中，当同一集群的灵魂守护者被杀死时，Aatxes 和 Dryder 会立即死亡。要完成任务，你需要杀死所有六名灵魂守护者。

8e170940c076189c44762ed4180788c6de4eb134.source: In some cases when you approach a cluster from behind you can kill all Terrorweb Dryders without aggroing the Aatxes or the Keeper. After killing them you will sometimes have a clear path to the Keeper of Souls and sometimes you will be required to aggro the Vengeful Aatxes on the way. The Keeper of Souls is easy to kill, but if you have to aggro the Aatxes you might have a tough time depending on your party. If possible someone should tank the Aatxes while the rest of the party kills the Keeper or the Dryders. You can also utilize traps which will knock down and cripple the otherwise invulnerable Aatxes.
8e170940c076189c44762ed4180788c6de4eb134.text: 在某些情况下，当你从后面接近集群时，你可以杀死所有恐网干燥者，而不会激怒 Aatxes 或守护者。杀死他们后，有时你会找到一条通往灵魂守护者的清晰道路，有时你会被要求在路上攻击复仇的 Aatxes。灵魂守护者很容易被杀死，但如果你必须攻击 Aatxes，你可能会遇到困难，具体取决于你的队伍。如果可能的话，应该有人坦克 Aatxes，而队伍的其他人则杀死 Keeper 或 Dryders。你还可以利用陷阱来击倒并削弱原本刀枪不入的 Aatxes。

ef85f6ebb5dc100115749802a17a19f9859a542e.source: After clearing all of the groups you can return to the Reaper of the Labyrinth to get your reward.
ef85f6ebb5dc100115749802a17a19f9859a542e.text: 清除所有小组后，您可以返回迷宫收割者处获取奖励。

4166919a97eb4f1c8cfb17d256b067bffb75d890.source: Terrorweb Dryders and Vengeful Aatxes spawned by this quest die when the Keeper of Souls in their cluster dies.
4166919a97eb4f1c8cfb17d256b067bffb75d890.text: 当集群中的灵魂守护者死亡时，由该任务生成的恐网干燥者和复仇巨兽也会死亡。

697fa37e0a837526f622a122f58d57c9b99e42c1.source: Sometimes one of the enemy groups can aggro the Reaper of the Labyrinth, killing it and sending the party back to the mortal world.
697fa37e0a837526f622a122f58d57c9b99e42c1.text: 有时，其中一个敌方团体可以攻击迷宫收割者，杀死它并将队伍送回凡人世界。

2873a453d728397cecc1dcc87d553c5fc4532473.source: Skeletons, who were added later, will not die when killing the Keepers of Souls.
2873a453d728397cecc1dcc87d553c5fc4532473.text: 后来添加的骷髅在杀死灵魂守护者时不会死亡。

afb59344139d85f3c4f44f538f7a3761ef957837.text: 杀死乌尔戈兹沃伦中的乌尔戈兹。

c42f135b11a3a791a29b99b52c296e63b8649112.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死乌尔戈兹。

3a09054eca7bc8b3d056eea1b30b254a788e9ad5.source: As per the Urgoz's Warren mission.
3a09054eca7bc8b3d056eea1b30b254a788e9ad5.text: 根据乌尔戈兹的沃伦任务。

ac098b3cddd3e9f31da17c333904c04935cc1bf7.source: Killing Urgoz spawns Urgoz's Chest, which offers each player:
ac098b3cddd3e9f31da17c333904c04935cc1bf7.text: 杀死乌尔戈兹会生成乌尔戈兹的宝箱，为每个玩家提供：

60433fbcc2e6e8b30456a11e30bd970f6532132f.source: Three Amber Chunks (6 Amber Chunks in Hard mode)
60433fbcc2e6e8b30456a11e30bd970f6532132f.text: 三个琥珀块（困难模式下有 6 个琥珀块）

a9dd9acb7bbec6c6249a9ae50c71921d015151c7.source: One Passage Scroll to Urgoz's Warren (Hard Mode only)
a9dd9acb7bbec6c6249a9ae50c71921d015151c7.text: 乌尔戈兹沃伦的一篇卷轴（仅限困难模式）

f5ab658f7221880e7906b837f118a03b9b1b310b.source: A rare inscribable item, including the following items exclusive to Urgoz's or Kanaxai's Chest:
f5ab658f7221880e7906b837f118a03b9b1b310b.text: 稀有的铭文物品，包括以下乌尔戈兹或卡纳赛伊宝箱独有的物品：

14d2f3d1871dcacbd316a800f35a5dcf8b8445da.source: A unique item available only from this chest:
14d2f3d1871dcacbd316a800f35a5dcf8b8445da.text: 仅可从该宝箱中获得的独特物品：

14c2f21d85a9211ec3e56aa6366b31a8f2d5c1b2.source: Urgoz's Warren is also one of only two places in which the following non-inscribable weapons can drop (either from a foe or through one of the chests):
14c2f21d85a9211ec3e56aa6366b31a8f2d5c1b2.text: 乌尔戈兹的沃伦也是仅有的两个可以掉落以下不可书写武器的地方之一（无论是从敌人身上还是通过其中一个箱子）：

31fc8ab2a56031b4f0547e4fb07567fdd1341c7d.source: Your goal is to make your way to Urgoz and defeat him. To do this, you must make your way through the Warren, a job complicated by Environmental Effects that are created by Twisted Barks; killing the tree-like creatures removes the effect, so they are often your primary targets as you traverse the area. Each room is blocked by a gate which can only open after defeating a Guardian Serpent; these are usually the least difficult challenge and can often be ignored until it is safe to move on.
31fc8ab2a56031b4f0547e4fb07567fdd1341c7d.text: 你的目标是找到乌尔戈兹并击败他。要做到这一点，你必须穿过沃伦，这项工作因扭曲树皮造成的环境影响而变得复杂；杀死树状生物会消除该效果，因此当您穿越该区域时，它们通常是您的主要目标。每个房间都被一扇门封锁，只有击败守护蛇后才能打开；这些通常是最简单的挑战，通常可以被忽略，直到可以安全地继续前进。

fb0310dc9964e5d2fcf7e0ad4b8d38fe9418f62e.source: Although proficient teams can complete the mission within 30 minutes, less experienced teams should allow for at least two hours.
fb0310dc9964e5d2fcf7e0ad4b8d38fe9418f62e.text: 虽然熟练的团队可以在 30 分钟内完成任务，但经验不足的团队应该至少需要两个小时。

dcbb3b0336c7f0321a2cbfbedbfaee575339ff49.text: 扭曲树皮的效果和条件

8b391017473ffa646ad12d5f2c2df8ed07a91f0d.source: Teams should be prepared to deal with the following effects and conditions created by the Twisted Barks. Any party members within range are affected. Ideally, party members should stand outside the range of the Twisted Barks while an ally pulls foes towards the group.
8b391017473ffa646ad12d5f2c2df8ed07a91f0d.text: 团队应该准备好应对扭曲树皮造成的以下效果和情况。范围内的任何党员都会受到影响。理想情况下，当盟友将敌人拉向队伍时，队伍成员应该站在扭曲树皮的范围之外。

2d93b6b83c14f8c549fa55933be7812797511369.text: 能量消耗（效果）：-4 能量退化。

4278d15923dc7de8a6636e393dc5c1b57c8d4f22.text: 生命消耗：-15 健康退化。

d621ff5d6b1229b50fb83de4fecff0d4181b4941.source: Sheer Exhaustion: Every spell cast causes Overcast.
d621ff5d6b1229b50fb83de4fecff0d4181b4941.text: 纯粹的疲惫：每施放一个法术都会导致阴天。

4d728c7f4ceaae72c53a36fb3ebe5a7adbc3cc1b.source: Weakness: You deal less damage with attacks and all of your attributes are reduced by 1.
4d728c7f4ceaae72c53a36fb3ebe5a7adbc3cc1b.text: 弱点：攻击造成的伤害减少，所有属性减少1。

41cf19e63ed50eed523f5dd38facb5bde32844a7.source: This area has Hopping Vampire and Thought Stealer popups at the start which use Suicide Health and Suicide Energy that either kill the target or take all of the target's energy respectively. They die in the process of using the skill. The easiest way to combat this is to move entire party back out of the corridor into the large room at the start. Consider using spirits as decoys for the suicidal creatures. Killing them at long range will avoid your health or energy depleting.
41cf19e63ed50eed523f5dd38facb5bde32844a7.text: 该区域一开始就有跳跃吸血鬼和思想窃取者弹出窗口，它们使用自杀生命值和自杀能量分别杀死目标或夺走目标的所有能量。他们在使用技能的过程中死亡。解决这个问题最简单的方法就是一开始就将整个队伍从走廊移回大房间。考虑使用灵魂作为自杀生物的诱饵。远距离杀死它们将避免你的健康或能量耗尽。

a532d627c2e83ee9b1a2f17befefed36c81543d7.source: Moving down the corridor you will experience your first Environment Effect (Weakness). A simple method for this room is to pull the dredge back towards the corridor you started in, out of range of the Weakness. The first group of Dredge will not pull very far into the corridor. Attempt to avoid aggroing the other four patrolling groups of Dredge while killing the first. Going too far into the room will initiate the patrols to swarm into the main area to protect the Twisted Bark. Retreat and back up the corridor to the edge of the effect and begin pulling groups of Dredge to your party. Be patient and watch the patrol patterns. Luring two groups at the same time will often result in early failure.
a532d627c2e83ee9b1a2f17befefed36c81543d7.text: 沿着走廊走下去，您将体验到第一个环境效应（弱点）。这个房间的一个简单方法是将挖泥机拉回你开始的走廊，超出弱点的范围。第一组挖掘机不会驶入走廊太远。杀死第一批的同时，尽量避免激怒其他四支挖掘机巡逻队。进入房间太远将会引发巡逻队涌入主要区域以保护扭曲树皮。撤退并退回走廊到效果的边缘，然后开始将挖泥机队伍拉到你的队伍中。要有耐心，观察巡逻模式。同时引诱两个群体往往会导致早期失败。

9b17f9efefae520b35c204b87302ae8345a3f48d.source: Once you have a clear run to the Twisted Bark, move in for the kill to remove the Environment Effect.
9b17f9efefae520b35c204b87302ae8345a3f48d.text: 一旦你顺利跑到扭曲树皮处，就可以前去击杀以消除环境效果。

775c567ca31d4354f88ca3698e8ef8914a9cd15f.source: Continue straight on up the stairs. Be careful here, because as soon as you enter this room two patrols will move in from the left and right. Due to this, try pulling back the stationary group down the stairs. Then kill the two patrol groups. Moving to the left or right of this chamber will initiate some popups of hidden Greater Blood Drinkers.
775c567ca31d4354f88ca3698e8ef8914a9cd15f.text: 继续直行上楼梯。这里要小心，因为一旦你进入这个房间，就会有两个巡逻队从左右移动。因此，请尝试将固定组拉下楼梯。然后杀掉两个巡逻队。移动到这个房间的左侧或右侧将会弹出一些隐藏的大型饮血者的弹出窗口。

115b54b07669f30c41be5d68b30bd907f862f6c3.source: Kill the Guardian Serpent to unlock the doors and move on to the next area.
115b54b07669f30c41be5d68b30bd907f862f6c3.text: 杀死守护蛇以解锁门并前往下一个区域。

b29bf9d3810b07fd3eacf2f45589045d6fca4981.source: Keep your group at the entrance to this area since there is a strong -15 health degeneration Environment Effect.
b29bf9d3810b07fd3eacf2f45589045d6fca4981.text: 将您的队伍留在该区域的入口处，因为存在强烈的 -15 健康退化环境效应。

004bef298f615d67b3236454b06285a80596bd6b.source: Once again best technique is to pull the closest groups of foes out of the environment effect. You will be able to lure all three Dredge groups with some patience. It is highly likely that you will spawn some Greater Blood Drinkers in the process. Using the walls can block the projectiles as the lure comes around the corner towards the team. Be mindful that this may also impact your team's ability to use ranged attacks.
004bef298f615d67b3236454b06285a80596bd6b.text: 再次强调，最好的技巧是将最近的敌人群体从环境影响中拉出来。只要有耐心，您将能够引诱所有三个挖泥机小组。在此过程中你很有可能会产生一些强效饮血者。当诱饵从拐角处向团队袭来时，使用墙壁可以阻挡射弹。请注意，这也可能会影响您的团队使用远程攻击的能力。

c7eef6a2bdb41b89ea6a750a73babf95d1b930fe.source: When the area is apparently clear, have your party rush to the Twisted Bark. You should be able to kill it before any party members die due to the degeneration.
c7eef6a2bdb41b89ea6a750a73babf95d1b930fe.text: 当该区域明显畅通无阻时，让你的队伍冲向扭曲树皮。你应该能够在任何党员因退化而死亡之前杀死它。

3356215ceb6fd8cdc8229f493dfac07d7d80615d.source: Do not rush forward at this point. This room is infested with more Greater Blood Drinkers. Proceed slowly towards the Guardian Serpent at the southern edge of the room.
3356215ceb6fd8cdc8229f493dfac07d7d80615d.text: 此时不要急于向前。这个房间里挤满了更多的高级饮血者。慢慢走向房间南边的守护蛇。

d04bdff573d3af1a75aff7bbd07599b74576d3e9.source: Once the gate opens, keep your team behind the gateway and pull the big groups of Brooding Thorns and Burning Brushes back to the gate and use a few party members to form a bottle neck trap to easily dispatch them. Beware rushing into the next room since there will be ranger traps that were laid by the Brooding Thorns.
d04bdff573d3af1a75aff7bbd07599b74576d3e9.text: 大门打开后，将你的队伍留在大门后面，将大群的沉思荆棘和燃烧灌木拉回大门，并使用几名队员组成瓶颈陷阱，轻松消灭它们。小心冲进下一个房间，因为那里会布满荆棘巢穴的游侠陷阱。

35e83205e3a6ce4b4eb07871bbb46fbf753987d8.source: Now you will see a bridge ahead, with a ramp at each side upto two sets of levers. Clear the room and pull both levers to open the gate to the next section. Your team could choose to shelter from the ranged attacks of the Dredge by standing beneath the bridge.
35e83205e3a6ce4b4eb07871bbb46fbf753987d8.text: 现在您将看到前面有一座桥，桥的两侧各有一个坡道，可通往两组杠杆。清理房间并拉动两个控制杆以打开通往下一部分的大门。你的团队可以选择站在桥下躲避挖泥船的远程攻击。

b1ad0355bf0ade5da6e4eb3b80dba0c87e542a31.source: This section consists of a long dark bridge over a pit, with Fire Flowers along each side. If someone runs onto the bridge, the Fire Flowers act like turrets and will spit fire at them. There are points along the bridge where groups of Thorn Wolves appear - these can easily kill your lure.
b1ad0355bf0ade5da6e4eb3b80dba0c87e542a31.text: 该部分由一座跨越坑的长黑桥组成，每侧都有火花。如果有人跑上桥，火花就会像炮塔一样向他们喷火。桥上的某些地方会出现成群的荆棘狼 - 这些可以轻松杀死你的诱惑。

563d8dbbb326c71f29cbe22741e5f36cbaf97f8e.source: After killing the first group of wolves along the bridge, setup a spirit decoy at the entrance to the bridge (if you have no spirits, you can later just kill the suicidal creatures at range before they reach your party). Proceed to the next wolf spawn, and kill them. Moving further along the bridge will spawn a third group of Wolves, kill them and then kill any remaining Hopping Vampires and Thought Stealers that spawned at the start of the bridge beside your spirit decoy. Continue to the end of the bridge, where another group of Hopping Vampires and Thought Stealers will spawn.
563d8dbbb326c71f29cbe22741e5f36cbaf97f8e.text: 杀死桥上的第一群狼后，在桥的入口处设置一个灵魂诱饵（如果你没有灵魂，你可以稍后在自杀的生物到达你的队伍之前杀死它们）。前往下一个狼产卵处，杀死它们。沿着桥继续前进会产生第三组狼，杀死它们，然后杀死在桥的起点处你的灵魂诱饵旁边产生的任何剩余的跳跃吸血鬼和思想窃取者。继续走到桥的尽头，那里会出现另一群跳跃吸血鬼和思想窃取者。

52eee6104b4878ea89017a18a86c9d304f9ef2d2.source: Kill the Guardian Serpent to continue to room 5.
52eee6104b4878ea89017a18a86c9d304f9ef2d2.text: 杀死守护蛇继续前往房间 5。

8d87bb75cbe2592ea87436c28481c6b086db58f9.source: This section has quite a big room with 3 exits, but you only need the exit to the west. Have your lure pull the Thorn Wolves that pop up by strafing around the room. The four hidden groups of wolves patrol underground. Lure them back to your party at the gate (where there is no exhaustion effect) and finish the wolves off.
8d87bb75cbe2592ea87436c28481c6b086db58f9.text: 这一段房间相当大，有3个出口，但你只需要西边的出口。让你的诱饵拉动在房间里扫射而弹出的荆棘狼。四群隐藏的狼群在地下巡逻。将他们引回到门口的队伍中（那里没有疲惫效果）并消灭狼群。

3eab00e9573881a7afb70152d1df2d4156749e09.source: When all four groups are defeated, head across the room through the vine gate on the left and onto the bridge - your party will now be under the Environmental Effect. It is much easier to just ignore the Twisted Bark in this room and move on to the next room.
3eab00e9573881a7afb70152d1df2d4156749e09.text: 当所有四个小组都被击败后，穿过房间，穿过左边的藤门，到达桥上 - 你的队伍现在将受到环境影响。忽略这个房间中的扭曲树皮并前往下一个房间要容易得多。

8c9dafd26b100a80f298eae585abf315b1595f6c.source: When you reach the end of the bridge there will be a small group of wolves that spawn in the next room. Across the bridge there is another chamber to the right which you should head to after. There is an area beside the vine gate in that next room where there is no exhaustion effect, consider letting your party's exhaustion levels lower before continuing.
8c9dafd26b100a80f298eae585abf315b1595f6c.text: 当你到达桥的尽头时，隔壁房间里会出现一小群狼。过了桥，右侧有另一个房间，您应该前往该房间。隔壁房间的藤门旁边有一个区域没有疲劳效果，在继续之前考虑让你的队伍的疲劳程度降低。

399c9212f2954d4487abd593488a8e9054b26e27.source: Again there is an exhaustion effect at the far side of the room, pull all the groups of wolves to your party (who should be standing in the area without the exhaustion effect).
399c9212f2954d4487abd593488a8e9054b26e27.text: 房间的另一边再次出现疲惫效果，将所有狼群拉到你的队伍中（他们应该站在没有疲惫效果的区域）。

c6b8d81ec6ab930d45b9b6333c24994542bb9166.source: Once the area is clear, proceed to the next gate.
c6b8d81ec6ab930d45b9b6333c24994542bb9166.text: 一旦该区域清理完毕，前往下一个门。

665a78e88c4747b3f8387f87885d3078c42d5810.source: You will see two Brooding Thorns in this next room, and there will be another two hidden groups of wolves but no exhaustion in this chamber. After killing them head west towards the valley with giant mushrooms at the sides.
665a78e88c4747b3f8387f87885d3078c42d5810.text: 你会在隔壁的房间里看到两只孵化荆棘，并且还会有另外两组隐藏的狼，但这个房间里不会疲惫不堪。杀死他们后，向西前往两侧有巨大蘑菇的山谷。

9e9567e5b08edb6279fa2f6a8046595200afa20f.source: The usual Thorn Wolf groups will appear out of the ground as your party makes its way to the north east towards the bridge. Deal with the wolves and continue across.
9e9567e5b08edb6279fa2f6a8046595200afa20f.text: 当你的队伍向东北方向的桥梁前进时，通常的荆棘狼群会从地下出现。解决掉狼群后继续穿越。

f7620a32f6cf39062bfea16f2c2ebe2fecb1eb0e.source: The next room contains a few more wolf patrols. Lure them out. In this room you will need to head south east to the vine gate, making a 270° turn on the map as you follow the walls of the path. This means enter the room and keep as much to the right hand side as possible. Head down the ramp towards the crystallised walls and follow the path which will take you under the bridge you were just on. There are no pops in the bright room but on your way to the next bridge you will encounter two underground wolf patrols so do not rush.
f7620a32f6cf39062bfea16f2c2ebe2fecb1eb0e.text: 下一个房间里还有几只狼巡逻队。把他们引出来。在这个房间里，您需要向东南方向前往藤蔓门，沿着小路的墙壁在地图上进行 270° 转弯。这意味着进入房间并尽可能保持在右侧。沿着坡道朝结晶墙走去，然后沿着小路走下去，将您带到刚才所在的桥下。明亮的房间里没有流行音乐，但在前往下一座桥的路上，您会遇到两个地下狼巡逻队，所以不要着急。

6bb1ffd38289874d0e894ed4c3b21549ad8c3718.source: Pause when you see the Guardian Serpent, do not step onto the bridge in front of it until you have read the next section.
6bb1ffd38289874d0e894ed4c3b21549ad8c3718.text: 当你看到守护蛇时请暂停，在阅读下一部分之前不要踏上它前面的桥。

4df66bd5603d10eac0df14fee6e66f8887660fb9.source: One player must stay behind at this point - if all the party members are in the room at the same time, 138 additional foes will spawn, which can be difficult in addition to the -4 energy degeneration Environment Effect. The image to the right depicts where the player/hero should stand until the rest of the party has crossed the room and the foes in section 8 have spawned - only then is it safe for the waiting player/hero to return to the main group.
4df66bd5603d10eac0df14fee6e66f8887660fb9.text: 此时必须有一名玩家留在后面 - 如果所有队伍成员同时在房间中，则会产生 138 个额外的敌人，除了 -4 能量退化环境效应之外，这可能会很困难。右图描绘了玩家/英雄应该站立的位置，直到队伍的其他成员穿过房间并且第 8 部分中的敌人已经生成 - 只有这样等待的玩家/英雄才能安全地返回主组。

f98fe5dc3e3378311a192c19c5c8d22a637dfa45.source: Even if your party isn't full, you still need to have one waiting before the bridge.
f98fe5dc3e3378311a192c19c5c8d22a637dfa45.text: 即使您的队伍未满，您仍然需要在桥前等候。

58536d09dcd3c742041e80496b71fd9160dc01be.source: There are 3 bridges in this room, 1 leading into the room, 1 within the room, and 1 leading out of the room.
58536d09dcd3c742041e80496b71fd9160dc01be.text: 这个房间里有3座桥，1座通向房间，1座通向房间内，1座通向房间外。

7bffe7431bc7dbc5b65672383ab0f427abe14578.source: With one player/hero waiting before the bridge leading to the first Guardian Serpent, the rest of the group can kill this Serpent and proceed across the internal bridge to the Twisted Bark. Killing it will remove the Environment Effect. (If you do not kill the Twisted Bark, there will be -4 energy degeneration in the final Urgoz battle on the southern side of the room.)
7bffe7431bc7dbc5b65672383ab0f427abe14578.text: 当一名玩家/英雄在通往第一条守护蛇的桥梁前等待时，团队的其余成员可以杀死这条蛇并穿过内部桥梁到达扭曲树皮。杀死它会消除环境效果。 （如果你不杀死扭曲树皮，在房间南侧的最后一场乌尔戈兹战斗中将会出现-4能量衰退。）

0a32cb2cba0ef3bb32bc895e19f41196a141cfd0.source: The incomplete party can now move to the second Guardian Serpent, kill it and continue across the bridge until the Wardens and Plants spawn in the next section.
0a32cb2cba0ef3bb32bc895e19f41196a141cfd0.text: 不完整的队伍现在可以移动到第二条守护蛇，杀死它并继续过桥，直到下一部分出现守望者和植物。

3b94c79f4a7258e6ab1dc6e3106a80969a7557a7.source: Only then can the waiting player/hero return to the main group.
3b94c79f4a7258e6ab1dc6e3106a80969a7557a7.text: 只有这样等待的玩家/英雄才能返回主组。

b9a7f7e9cb18784fe2fa6b729e2398a773740e2e.source: If all party members are in this room at the same time, 42 suicidal creatures and 96 wardens will spawn. The four Warden groups closest to the entrance can be pulled out of the effect, whereupon the group can then kill the Twisted Bark. There will be the first batch of suicidal creatures beyond the second Guardian Serpent, a large group of Wardens on the bridge, followed by a second batch of suicidal creatures at the far end of the bridge and another large groups of Wardens after the bridge.
b9a7f7e9cb18784fe2fa6b729e2398a773740e2e.text: 如果所有小队成员同时在这个房间里，将会生成 42 个自杀生物和 96 个守望者。距离入口最近的四个守望者小组可以被拉出效果，然后该小组就可以杀死扭曲树皮。在第二条守护蛇之后将会有第一批自杀生物，桥上有一大群守望者，接下来是桥远端的第二批自杀生物以及桥后的另一大群守望者。

5bd7341ad32fde159dcd8442e735e0c6153ff5dd.source: This is quite a difficult area where you are under two Environment Effects; Exhaustion to the south and Weakness to the north. It is best to kill the southern Twisted Bark first to get rid of the Exhaustion.
5bd7341ad32fde159dcd8442e735e0c6153ff5dd.text: 这是一个相当困难的区域，你受到两种环境影响；南有疲乏，北有虚弱。最好先杀掉南方的扭曲树皮来摆脱疲惫。

47a5a2e7e9e75d171b2165ee4215dc7569ac0aa8.source: Lure out the first Plant group towards the entrance to kill them safely away from the Environmental Effects. There are three other groups of plants - one at each of the two Twisted Barks, and a third at the Guardian Serpent blocking the gate. The third group can be lured when it is safe to do so, take care of the Warden's traps though. Do not rush in and attempt to kill the Guardian Serpent you see directly in front of you until later.
47a5a2e7e9e75d171b2165ee4215dc7569ac0aa8.text: 将第一批植物群引诱到入口处，以安全地杀死他们，使其远离环境影响。还有另外三组植物 - 两个扭曲树皮各有一组，第三组在阻挡大门的守护蛇上。在安全的情况下可以引诱第三组，但要小心守望者的陷阱。稍后不要冲进去并试图杀死你直接看到的守护蛇。

c48c5065f09962af08b123cadb49a5b231e0497f.source: There are also four groups of Wardens, two on each side, patrolling up and down. Lure each group outside the room one group at a time. It is advised to focus on the Maddened Earth Wardens (Earth Magic Elementalist nukers) before the Maddened Song Wardens (healers).
c48c5065f09962af08b123cadb49a5b231e0497f.text: 还有四组典狱长，每边两个，上下巡逻。将每一组引诱到房间外面，一次一组。建议先关注疯狂大地守望者（土系魔法元素核武者），然后再关注疯狂之歌守望者（治疗者）。

654a95c47bba5810f77bac02ac2f7358f8e9c0a5.source: Once the 4 groups of Wardens are disposed of, proceed to the left hill and take out the Plants and the Twisted Bark that caused the Exhaustion. It is possible to pull the Plants while standing at the bottom of the cliff into range of the Exhaustion-free safespot at the entry gate.
654a95c47bba5810f77bac02ac2f7358f8e9c0a5.text: 处理完 4 组守望者后，前往左侧山丘并取出导致疲惫的植物和扭曲树皮。站在悬崖底部时可以将植物拉入入口处的无疲劳安全点的范围内。

ca8e073c4ba9b3996eb9111ddf0b97a1cadef54f.source: Once the exhaustion effect is gone proceed over to the opposite hill and eliminate the group on top of it. Take out the Twisted Bark to get rid of the Weakness effect.
ca8e073c4ba9b3996eb9111ddf0b97a1cadef54f.text: 一旦疲惫效果消失，就前往对面的山丘并消灭山顶上的队伍。取出扭曲树皮来消除虚弱效果。

6bfa7d2cb5d337f8073a6a0b44aa5914692ac644.source: Go back to the middle of the room and kill the Guardian Serpent and the last Plant group to enter the next section.
6bfa7d2cb5d337f8073a6a0b44aa5914692ac644.text: 回到房间中间，杀死守护蛇和最后一个植物组，进入下一个区域。

b48a64948a69f5a663175837b682b2165885be7c.source: This room is filled with Wardens and stationary Plants (the plants can be ignored entirely). Lure the first group of Wardens to the top of the entry stairs (this will likely ball them up as they turn the corner). Again focus on the Maddened Earth Wardens first. This door will provide you with an excellent location to launch your attacks on the next set of groups, because the Wardens can be corner-blocked here.
b48a64948a69f5a663175837b682b2165885be7c.text: 这个房间里充满了守望者和固定植物（植物可以完全忽略）。将第一组守望者引诱到入口楼梯的顶部（这可能会在他们转弯时将他们聚集起来）。再次首先关注疯狂的地球守望者。这扇门将为你提供一个绝佳的位置，可以对下一批队伍发起攻击，因为守望者可以在这里被堵在角落里。

aa4f66102f704a6bacc6a40994534bda69cf3731.source: Kill any Plants as needed, they are guarding their spot and shouldn't move around too much. With the exception of the wardens in the north west corner, all Warden groups can be pulled to the stairway.
aa4f66102f704a6bacc6a40994534bda69cf3731.text: 根据需要杀死任何植物，它们正在守卫自己的位置，不应该走动太多。除了西北角的守望者之外，所有的守望者队伍都可以被拉到楼梯上。

12e816db3f752f1f0226685b7ec0b209e19cb889.source: Be careful of the traps the Burning Brushes leave behind and kill the last group of Wardens in the middle of the room (there is a big tree which your casters can hide behind).
12e816db3f752f1f0226685b7ec0b209e19cb889.text: 小心燃烧刷子留下的陷阱，并杀死房间中间的最后一组守望者（有一棵大树，你的施法者可以躲在后面）。

6606533f2ac629c015c3c4c189d1926b8ab84d2c.source: Kill the Guardian Serpent to move on to the next section.
6606533f2ac629c015c3c4c189d1926b8ab84d2c.text: 杀死守护蛇即可进入下一部分。

26d407ba35b5cdf014bc8400c2c1b4966f3ebf95.source: One player/hero must remain outside the next room beyond the linking corridor, this will avoid the door closing and the party being trapped inside with many spawns.
26d407ba35b5cdf014bc8400c2c1b4966f3ebf95.text: 一名玩家/英雄必须留在连接走廊之外的下一个房间外面，这将避免门关闭和队伍被困在里面有很多重生。

fdfe23f9923d8914218ef12afbf4f383005e409f.source: Pull all the visible groups of Thorn Wolves and Greater Blood Drinkers towards the gate, one group at a time. Killing one group of foes will enable another to spawn within the room at a random location, also bear in mind the underground patrols move around, so don't go too far into the room. NOTE: If your party advances too far into the room before the patrols and random spawns arrive, the entry doors will close behind you, cutting off any escape.
fdfe23f9923d8914218ef12afbf4f383005e409f.text: 将所有可见的荆棘狼和大饮血者群体拉向大门，一次一组。杀死一组敌人将使另一组敌人在房间内的随机位置产卵，还要记住地下巡逻队会四处走动，所以不要进入房间太远。注意：如果你的队伍在巡逻队和随机重生到达之前进入房间太远，入口门将在你身后关闭，切断任何逃生通道。

caa6c353a6adf754e28b47fd1b7425183e0b497b.source: You will know when the room is clear because the exit gate will open to the next section when clear. Continue to be wary as there are often a few more popups even after the gate opens.
caa6c353a6adf754e28b47fd1b7425183e0b497b.text: 您会知道房间何时畅通，因为畅通时出口门将打开至下一个区域。请继续保持警惕，因为即使在大门打开后，通常还会出现更多弹出窗口。

18ee04de028dcf81f2c48832e9e2ac643e8e8a8c.source: Once you have exited the room, continue down the path and you'll see a Twisted Bark causing the degeneration in this room, you can kill it easily as there are no hidden foes here. Ignore the first two Guardian Serpents on the right and left.
18ee04de028dcf81f2c48832e9e2ac643e8e8a8c.text: 离开房间后，继续沿着小路走，你会看到扭曲树皮导致这个房间退化，你可以轻松杀死它，因为这里没有隐藏的敌人。忽略左右前两条守护蛇。

24466e861a8338cae3bea3e51f7868ee9c86aebc.source: Cross the bridge and kill the various Plants awaiting your team. There are some hidden Brooding Thorns beside the Guardian Serpent that must be killed to open the final gate to Urgoz's chamber.
24466e861a8338cae3bea3e51f7868ee9c86aebc.text: 过桥并杀死等待你的团队的各种植物。守护蛇旁边有一些隐藏的沉思荆棘，必须杀死它们才能打开通往乌尔戈兹房间的最后一道门。

0804f96a3d92fc93ad36bf84417f02d2b9b8874a.source: Urgoz is in the center of this area, accompanied by two Greater Serpents. Urgoz uses Forest's Binding, which has an extremely long range, damages a foe and hexes them with Binding Chains. If characters get close enough to Urgoz, Explosive Growths will spawn. If it survives for several seconds, an Explosive Growth will die, causing an Exploding Spores effect, which will inflict 300 damage on you. Killing Explosive Growths will prevent the Exploding Spores effect. Don't stand still too long on the same spot or you will die.
0804f96a3d92fc93ad36bf84417f02d2b9b8874a.text: 乌尔戈兹位于这片区域的中心，身边有两条大蛇陪伴。乌尔戈兹使用森林的束缚，其射程极远，对敌人造成伤害，并用束缚链对他们施咒。如果角色距离乌尔戈兹足够近，就会产生爆炸性生长。如果它存活了几秒钟，爆炸生长物就会死亡，造成爆炸孢子效果，对你造成 300 点伤害。杀死爆炸性生长物将防止爆炸孢子效果。不要在同一个地方静止太久，否则你会死。

e10565e095b063078ff6dc487ad9134a3b02649d.source: Clear out the entrance to Urgoz's room to the east first and then clear and enter via the southern entrance. Just inside the southern entrance is a safe spot with a rock on the right. This is a safe place to flag your heroes, healers and your caster for Edge of Extinction--within Urgoz's attack range, but not Explosive Growth spawn range. Take a moment to run a player right up to Urgoz to ensure that Urgoz is in the area of effect for Edge of Extinction.
e10565e095b063078ff6dc487ad9134a3b02649d.text: 首先清理乌尔戈兹房间东边的入口，然后清理并从南边的入口进入。南入口内有一个安全地点，右侧有一块岩石。这是一个安全的地方，可以标记你的英雄、治疗师和施法者进入灭绝边缘——在乌尔戈兹的攻击范围内，但不在爆炸生长的生成范围内。花点时间让一名玩家跑到乌尔戈兹面前，以确保乌尔戈兹处于灭绝边缘的影响范围内。

9b35f6ed7f857a993b199499cf80081940078fd5.source: If you did not kill the Twisted Bark in Section 7, party members will face the added burden of -4 energy degeneration in the south half of the room.
9b35f6ed7f857a993b199499cf80081940078fd5.text: 如果你没有在第 7 部分杀死扭曲树皮，队员将在房间南半部面临 -4 能量衰退的额外负担。

d38682c9f6f8285b94eae09261e9f0a2c27bc1fd.source: Each Player can now run into the pop area for Explosive Growths, cast their Urgoz Skill (3 second cast time or less) and then move on and dodge Growths as needed. Keep running around the room using this technique. Once you reduce Urgoz to below 90% health it will start dying faster, but keep the pressure on with your Player characters.
d38682c9f6f8285b94eae09261e9f0a2c27bc1fd.text: 现在，每个玩家都可以跑进爆炸性生长的流行区域，施放他们的乌尔戈兹技能（施法时间为 3 秒或更短），然后继续前进并根据需要躲避生长。使用这种技术继续在房间里跑来跑去。一旦你将 Urgoz 的生命值降低到 90% 以下，它就会开始更快地死亡，但请继续对你的玩家角色施加压力。

2c184208ff8be962f69999f905e112cc263b372b.source: If using a team of only heroes, flag the healers and Edge of Extinction caster in the safe spot mentioned above. Queue the other heroes' spike skills and flag them directly in front of Urgoz. Several Explosive Growths will spawn along their path and next to Urgoz while they are casting their skills. After a couple seconds, flag the heroes towards the column closest to the gate you did not enter from, then back to the original entrance. Repeat this triangular pattern of movement; the spike skills and dying Explosive Growths will gradually wear down Urgoz's health. The gates will remain open during the fight so you can reset if needed.
2c184208ff8be962f69999f905e112cc263b372b.text: 如果使用仅由英雄组成的团队，请在上述安全地点标记治疗师和灭绝边缘施法者。将其他英雄的秒杀技能排列起来，并将它们直接标记在乌尔戈兹面前。当他们施放技能时，一些爆炸性生长物会沿着他们的路径并在乌尔戈兹旁边生成。几秒钟后，将英雄标记到距离您未进入的大门最近的列，然后返回原来的入口。重复这个三角形的运动模式；尖峰技能和垂死的爆炸生长会逐渐消耗乌尔戈兹的生命值。战斗期间大门将保持打开状态，因此您可以在需要时重置。

15471c930cd8489a148e3bb61202c68fae79cf63.source: Kill Urgoz and your objective is completed. You can mop up the Greater Serpents at your leisure.
15471c930cd8489a148e3bb61202c68fae79cf63.text: 杀死乌尔戈兹，你的目标就完成了。你可以在闲暇时清理巨蛇。

96909f8c20b11384d27808721fe735dc531e03ca.source: After Urgoz is defeated, an Urgoz's Chest spawns, the Explosive Growths stop spawning and a teleporter activates at the eastern end of the room. Using the teleporter removes you from the party and returns you to the Urgoz's Warren outpost.
96909f8c20b11384d27808721fe735dc531e03ca.text: 乌尔戈兹被击败后，乌尔戈兹的宝箱会生成，爆炸生长物会停止生成，并且传送器会在房间的东端激活。使用传送器会将你从队伍中移除并返回到乌尔戈兹的沃伦前哨站。

aa75df86a240d23284a82b784394c001c9ac3e15.source: There is no so called "standard build" for Urgoz's Warren, but there are key roles that are frequently used.
aa75df86a240d23284a82b784394c001c9ac3e15.text: 乌尔戈兹的沃伦没有所谓的“标准构建”，但有一些经常使用的关键角色。

beccbd9c1dcf8389efa3e7e34d5db03a5db27c1e.source: Lure/Guide (player): A person with a long range bow who knows where foes appear, where to go, and what to do.
beccbd9c1dcf8389efa3e7e34d5db03a5db27c1e.text: 诱饵/向导（玩家）：拥有远距离弓箭的人，知道敌人出现在哪里、去哪里以及做什么。

14e8493cfbc555bce10ceefc396ce510bfdbfeea.source: Linebacker/Tank (2-players or heroes): A good linebacker/tank team can keep the most dangerous foes from reaching the midline.
14e8493cfbc555bce10ceefc396ce510bfdbfeea.text: 线卫/坦克（2 名球员或英雄）：一支优秀的线卫/坦克团队可以阻止最危险的敌人到达中线。

6346e1bd55da82a5ca10e0ebacb3a1c3c5fbe1f1.source: Runner (player or hero): There are no resurrection shrines so if the entire party dies, it is all over, and you are teleported back to the Warren's entry point. Nominate a human player as a runner: a ranged attacker with Rebirth who can hold back and still contribute but runs away at the first sign of trouble. A speed boost might also be advantageous for this character.
6346e1bd55da82a5ca10e0ebacb3a1c3c5fbe1f1.text: 奔跑者（玩家或英雄）：没有复活神殿，所以如果整个队伍都死了，一切就结束了，你会被传送回沃伦的入口点。指定一名人类玩家作为跑步者：一名具有重生能力的远程攻击者，他可以阻止并仍然做出贡献，但一旦出现麻烦迹象就会逃跑。速度提升也可能对该角色有利。

ab3f40f3f53ada5abef82dcc136705484693b79a.source: Minion master (player or hero): A good minion master is useful. Include no fewer than 3 minion summons and Rotting Flesh. The monsters have no way of removing conditions, nor of passing disease back to your party, so this skill is exceptionally useful.
ab3f40f3f53ada5abef82dcc136705484693b79a.text: 随从大师（玩家或英雄）：一个好的随从大师很有用。包括不少于 3 个小兵召唤物和腐肉。怪物无法消除状况，也无法将疾病传回给你的队伍，所以这个技能非常有用。

0bc152ae8d20e290fb999035ef38547a79edbed2.source: Nukers (players or heroes): The bulk of the party will need to be able to dish out plenty of attacks using AoE damage. There are huge mobs of monsters in the warren, and you must destroy multiple targets at once if you are going to succeed.
