0bc152ae8d20e290fb999035ef38547a79edbed2.text: Nukers（玩家或英雄）：大部分队伍需要能够使用 AoE 伤害来发动大量攻击。沃伦中有大量怪物，如果你想成功，你必须一次摧毁多个目标。

e5620a0f8c29d150a0227bc1a80d7823194c61a7.source: Healers (players or heroes): Usually only two healers are used for a run through Urgoz's Warren using players (bring more healers if using heroes). This can be a combination of Protection, Spike Healing, Party Heals, etc., depending on your party mix. If your healers are predominantly heroes, make sure you spread them around the players.
e5620a0f8c29d150a0227bc1a80d7823194c61a7.text: 治疗者（玩家或英雄）：通常只有两名治疗者用于使用玩家穿越乌尔戈兹沃伦（如果使用英雄，请带更多治疗者）。这可以是保护、尖峰治疗、派对治疗等的组合，具体取决于你的派对组合。如果你的治疗者主要是英雄，请确保将他们分散到玩家周围。

20a76be4ce09efeddc48b7c39f8416b8d121ffbb.source: Edge of Extinction (player or flagged hero): This party member creates an Edge of Extinction spirit. This is very useful with a lot of AoE, because it damages anyone of the same type under 90% health when something is killed. Some also kill Urgoz with this spirit, by attacking Urgoz until he is under 90% health and then letting the pop ups around him blow themselves up, eventually killing Urgoz. Be wary of your team exploding too.
20a76be4ce09efeddc48b7c39f8416b8d121ffbb.text: 灭绝边缘（玩家或被标记的英雄）：该队伍成员创造了灭绝边缘精神。这对于大量 AoE 非常有用，因为当某物被杀死时，它会对生命值低于 90% 的同一类型的任何人造成伤害。有些人也用这种精神杀死乌尔戈兹，攻击乌尔戈兹直到他的生命值低于 90%，然后让他周围的弹出窗口自爆，最终杀死乌尔戈兹。也要警惕你的团队的爆炸。

0cba1249913bca59f029708078699cd9a1b1d4ca.text: 其他有用的各方考虑因素。

6bdbf8d43a01a0c2b97108b8698dc4a79dd52fbe.source: The more players the better. This can be done with a single player and seven Heroes but more players can speed up the run and makes Urgoz's room easier.
6bdbf8d43a01a0c2b97108b8698dc4a79dd52fbe.text: 玩家越多越好。这可以通过一个玩家和七个英雄来完成，但更多的玩家可以加快奔跑速度并使乌尔戈兹的房间变得更容易。

0be97016800972434dfdba6c86139ade1fae9def.source: When making a party, be aware of skill synergy - for example a paragon with "They're on Fire!" might be extremely useful when you have many elementalists with fire magic in your party. Or a Ritualist with Splinter Weapon with Barrage-rangers.
0be97016800972434dfdba6c86139ade1fae9def.text: 举办派对时，请注意技能协同作用 - 例如，一个典范会说“他们着火了！”当你的队伍中有许多拥有火魔法的元素主义者时，这可能非常有用。或者是拥有碎片武器和弹幕游骑兵的仪式者。

fd111cbf819ffaf8edbddbdbebed5f7e8e89e79e.source: Do not take too many healers as it will reduce your AoE offensive capability. Two should be sufficient for a Normal Mode run.
fd111cbf819ffaf8edbddbdbebed5f7e8e89e79e.text: 不要带太多治疗者，因为这会降低你的 AoE 攻击能力。对于正常模式运行来说，两个应该足够了。

b0dfb30c357879af42daaac4f2a91e11b05acd0d.source: Taking a minion master or spirit spammer helps occupy a mob while AoE damage destroys it.
b0dfb30c357879af42daaac4f2a91e11b05acd0d.text: 占领小兵大师或灵魂垃圾邮件发送者有助于占领小怪，而群体伤害则将其摧毁。

0da37310494dc12c380e0a34b42348b88eddb10c.source: Check if everyone has a minimum of 2 hours of time. A group has a higher chance of failing if they rush and aggro as much as possible to speed up the mission. Instances of one player running in (towards a chest for example) will endanger the whole mission. Make this clear to the group before starting.
0da37310494dc12c380e0a34b42348b88eddb10c.text: 检查每个人是否都有至少 2 小时的时间。如果团队尽可能地冲刺和仇恨以加快任务速度，那么他们失败的可能性就会更高。一名玩家跑进去（例如跑向箱子）的情况会危及整个任务。在开始之前向小组明确这一点。

deb18be5ddf7e2330e733c08bc4fabf9ae0940f1.source: Rangers: Barrage and Edge of Extinction (place the spirit behind doors or walls so it is not easily destroyed by foes).
deb18be5ddf7e2330e733c08bc4fabf9ae0940f1.text: 游骑兵：弹幕和灭绝边缘（将灵魂放置在门或墙后面，这样它就不会轻易被敌人摧毁）。

7c3f6f4380408330fa1c986894868975eecb15ca.source: Elementalists: Meteor Shower, Mark of Rodgort, or Searing Flames.
7c3f6f4380408330fa1c986894868975eecb15ca.text: 元素使：流星雨、罗德戈特印记或灼热烈焰。

7ba67b94bcc24c5a092f3957f317671f564105df.source: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor will help improve everyone's damage.
7ba67b94bcc24c5a092f3957f317671f564105df.text: 黑檀荣誉战旗将有助于提高每个人的伤害。

9aebdc7ea0a513742675d926bdec7cd90a9bd502.source: Mesmers: Energy Surge, Ineptitude (useful vs wolves), Panic, and Mistrust.
9aebdc7ea0a513742675d926bdec7cd90a9bd502.text: 催眠师：能量激增、无能（对抗狼有用）、恐慌和不信任。

e883981cace522924796bbbf33ba038f26daaed9.source: Necromancers: Spiteful Spirit combination with minions, Blood is Power Blood Magic build.
e883981cace522924796bbbf33ba038f26daaed9.text: 死灵法师：恶灵与仆从的组合，血就是力量血魔法构建。

426e0e3165b3fe2e7334c5e5ac276a9e76509d13.source: Heal Party, Divine Healing, Protective Was Kaolai, and Aegis are effective. Ritualist spirits and Paragon shouts that affect the party are also beneficial.
426e0e3165b3fe2e7334c5e5ac276a9e76509d13.text: 治疗派对、神圣治疗、防护瓦斯考莱和神盾有效。影响队伍的仪式精神和典范呐喊也是有益的。

dd65f33ed1200261fb23c16f499107bac9c8258d.source: Energy management: your party must be able to counter the energy loss effects in various rooms. Consider a battery.
dd65f33ed1200261fb23c16f499107bac9c8258d.text: 能源管理：您的团队必须能够应对各个房间的能源损失影响。考虑电池。

421c11c1393fec909e6085bc990fe80f3ad3c8c2.source: Protection spells: Protective Spirit or Shelter will prevent Thorn Wolves from killing your party members in one hit.
421c11c1393fec909e6085bc990fe80f3ad3c8c2.text: 保护法术：保护精神或庇护所将阻止荆棘狼一击杀死你的队伍成员。

785ca75345c69058c29abedf531aa2f0bbb5580e.source: Resurrection Spells: Remember to bring a resurrection spell. Spells used for in combat resurrection spells should resurrect at full health such as Resurrection Chant, and for long range resurrection spells in case party is required to retreat consider using spells like Rebirth. Unyielding Aura on a monk serves both these goals as well as boosting the healing of Divine Healing or Heal Party.
785ca75345c69058c29abedf531aa2f0bbb5580e.text: 复活法术：记得带上复活法术。用于战斗复活法术的法术应该在满血状态下复活，例如复活圣歌，而对于远距离复活法术，如果一方需要撤退，请考虑使用重生之类的法术。武僧身上的不屈光环既可以实现这些目标，也可以促进神圣治疗或治疗派对的治疗效果。

ba2e763511d1760c53fe95ad7c04ed8573fd5d61.source: Hex removal skills are useful, as Thorn Wolves use Shroud of Silence which can quickly render your monks useless.
ba2e763511d1760c53fe95ad7c04ed8573fd5d61.text: 去除妖术的技能非常有用，因为荆棘狼使用沉默裹尸布，它可以很快让你的武僧变得毫无用处。

15706e3136db0ed84a781a1f4c895b2d04ce2b8e.source: Environment effects: Try to lure enemy groups outside of the Environment Effects. Only enter the area of the Environment Effect when you are sure you can eliminate the Twisted Bark that is causing the effect.
15706e3136db0ed84a781a1f4c895b2d04ce2b8e.text: 环境效果：尝试将敌方群体引诱到环境效果之外。仅当您确定可以消除造成效果的扭曲树皮时，才进入环境效果区域。

91edd1cd2848f5476706579380989d46cb683f19.source: Luring: Let your Lure take their time and watch the patrols to lure only one group at a time. The Lure should be able to strafe: shoot and run backwards, running side to side as you retreat. This ensures groups stay aggroed and follow. Also, strafing in rooms should allow easier aggro of hidden underground (Thorn Wolves) and ceiling (Greater Blood Drinker) creatures.
91edd1cd2848f5476706579380989d46cb683f19.text: 引诱：让你的诱饵慢慢来，观察巡逻队，一次只引诱一组。诱饵应该能够扫射：射击并向后跑，在撤退时从一边跑到另一边。这可以确保团体保持关注并跟随。此外，在房间内扫射应该可以更容易地对隐藏的地下（荆棘狼）和天花板（更高的饮血者）生物产生仇恨。

94a68381d7c5aed143289293e24b8814ce9f4f94.source: Patience: Listen to your Guide and be patient. Also wait for your minion master to raise as many Minions as possible after each combat and then regenerate Energy for next combat. Allow relevant characters to raise Pets post-combat also.
94a68381d7c5aed143289293e24b8814ce9f4f94.text: 耐心：聆听您的指南并保持耐心。还要等待你的小兵大师在每次战斗后培养尽可能多的小兵，然后为下一场战斗再生能量。也允许相关角色在战斗后饲养宠物。

704fdd39d94a57eda04f31d76233cf8441625eaa.source: Ensure Edge of Extinction, wards, shouts, and healing spirits are up at all times. Control your Heroes manually if needed.
704fdd39d94a57eda04f31d76233cf8441625eaa.text: 确保灭绝边缘、守卫、呼喊和治疗之魂始终处于开启状态。如果需要，手动控制你的英雄。

44158212d72d9414e1bebc7acca2a2c8f74ebc44.source: Pets: Bring as many pets as you can. The party size of 12 means that a pet shield can be incredibly useful, especially since pets do not accrue Death Penalty.
44158212d72d9414e1bebc7acca2a2c8f74ebc44.text: 宠物：尽可能多地携带宠物。队伍规模为 12 人意味着宠物护盾非常有用，特别是因为宠物不会产生死刑。

1df935a7b5bc883d7859e841f4790d699b9e5344.source: Consumables: Bring some items that remove DP or give party bonuses to health and attributes. This is a long mission, and even with a good team, dying is an occupational hazard. A morale boost at critical points can potentially make or break an Urgoz run.
1df935a7b5bc883d7859e841f4790d699b9e5344.text: 消耗品：携带一些可以消除 DP 或给予队伍生命值和属性奖励的物品。这是一项漫长的任务，即使有再好的团队，死亡也是一种职业病。关键时刻的士气提升可能会决定乌尔戈兹竞选的成败。

424ff1211b9309753d2523e80d2099942d52e2d2.source: Chests and Treasure: Don’t forget to bring keys and lockpicks to open chests. Although these are expensive, the rewards from this area are worth it. Zodiac items can only be gained from Urgoz’s Warren and The Deep, and they are very valuable, popular skins. Do not rush forward to chests without telling the party your intentions - especially in uncleared areas.
424ff1211b9309753d2523e80d2099942d52e2d2.text: 箱子和宝藏：别忘了带上钥匙和开锁器来打开箱子。尽管这些都很昂贵，但该领域的回报是值得的。十二生肖物品只能从乌尔戈兹的沃伦和深渊中获得，它们是非常有价值、受欢迎的皮肤。不要在没有告诉对方你的意图的情况下冲向箱子——尤其是在未清理的区域。

77af0ae1733f25e4285623de2e0a65b3b81ef0b3.source: Killing Urgoz for the first time raises your account's Kurzick faction cap by 10,000.
77af0ae1733f25e4285623de2e0a65b3b81ef0b3.text: 首次杀死乌尔戈兹将使您帐户的库兹克派系上限提高 10,000。

ea9150f59cef28c237556a4a9dfc7f51452c8e11.source: Be sure to obtain the quest for the Miniature Island Guardian from Merrise, Sworn to Seas, at embark beach if attempting to do this dungeon in Hard Mode for the first time since the 2025 anniversary update.
ea9150f59cef28c237556a4a9dfc7f51452c8e11.text: 如果自 2025 周年更新以来第一次尝试在困难模式下完成这个地下城，请务必在登船海滩上从宣誓海洋的梅里斯那里获得微型岛屿守护者的任务。

e461d97e8d671e257ad5aa0c8344315dddfbc11f.source: If someone is too close to the gate in room 10 when it closes, that person can be trapped within the door and won't be able to move out of it.
e461d97e8d671e257ad5aa0c8344315dddfbc11f.text: 如果 10 号房间的门关闭时有人距离门太近，则该人可能会被困在门内而无法离开。

f1c1112705470fe0933768ebaaa49ea5503f088c.source: Seal the rifts in Vehtendi Valley by defeating all demons surrounding each rift. You have 3...0 rifts left to seal.
f1c1112705470fe0933768ebaaa49ea5503f088c.text: 击败每个裂缝周围的所有恶魔，密封维赫滕迪山谷的裂缝。你还有 3...0 个裂缝需要密封。

6ab7bb409b9e62bbce73a1352287efe98065f5cf.source: As in the preceeding quest, Yahnur Market is the closest starting point. Head into Vehtendi Valley and follow your quest pointer to each of the three rifts, where you must eliminate the Margonites around them to close the rift. When you have closed all 3 rifts, return to Prince Bokka in Resplendent Makuun for your reward.
6ab7bb409b9e62bbce73a1352287efe98065f5cf.text: 与前面的任务一样，亚努尔市场是最近的起点。前往 Vehtendi 山谷，按照你的任务指针到达三个裂痕，在那里你必须消灭它们周围的玛贡尼特以关闭裂痕。当您关闭所有 3 个裂痕后，请返回辉煌马库恩的博卡王子那里领取奖励。

b48bbdd0e206f1c205207fa942594d4a35b85df0.source: If this quest is active, Jarimiya the Unmerciful does not spawn.
b48bbdd0e206f1c205207fa942594d4a35b85df0.text: 如果此任务处于活动状态，无情者贾里米亚不会生成。

f5e0f788a2f2691648d37af40c1d3442ce95b264.source:
* Tyrian (Prophecies) character
* Character in pre-Searing Ascalon
* Level 10 or higher
f5e0f788a2f2691648d37af40c1d3442ce95b264.text:
* 泰瑞安（预言）角色
* 灼热阿斯卡隆前期的角色
* 10级或以上

704c96073e493d691ede789c1d5d2fcc5845088f.source: Find and kill the Bandit Ringleaders inside Regent Valley. [6...0] remain.
704c96073e493d691ede789c1d5d2fcc5845088f.text: 找到并杀死摄政谷内的强盗头目。 [6...0] 保留。

d9fba2f33d7f6924399c917700f7b28420515520.source: See Lieutenant Langmar for your reward.
d9fba2f33d7f6924399c917700f7b28420515520.text: 去找朗玛中尉领取奖励。

d308ff46199403ac463ade091e22dd1f63d0e7b1.source: The locations pointed out on the map are approximate. The Ringleaders may spawn more than compass range away from each of the 6 locations.
d308ff46199403ac463ade091e22dd1f63d0e7b1.text: 地图上指出的位置均为近似位置。首领可能会在距离 6 个地点超过罗盘范围的地方生成。

b1a5c0870ce5f10b2e2510dd48c6405ee323b66e.source: This quest can be done very quickly by some professions (mesmer for instance) by focusing only on Bandit Ringleaders and moving between groups under the effects of a Birthday Cupcake.
b1a5c0870ce5f10b2e2510dd48c6405ee323b66e.text: 某些职业（例如幻术师）可以通过仅关注强盗头目并在生日蛋糕的影响下在团体之间移动来快速完成此任务。

493f71d26e11b0f8520dbe7b472d9dc61a8c06c3.source: The bandits spawned by this quest are hostile to Mary Malone and Ivor Trueshot, and will occasionally spawn close enough to aggro and kill them.
493f71d26e11b0f8520dbe7b472d9dc61a8c06c3.text: 此任务产生的强盗对玛丽·马龙和艾弗·特鲁肖特怀有敌意，并且偶尔会产生足够近的距离来仇恨并杀死他们。

0d722b642bf1872f307307d66b4297d5ac1c0832.source: When one bandit leader remains, the quest text erroneously ends with 1 remain.
0d722b642bf1872f307307d66b4297d5ac1c0832.text: 当剩下一名强盗首领时，任务文本会错误地以 1 名剩余人结束。

303ab2a70131904f88d99cd5ce8891976be6b502.source: Find and kill the Charr Champions inside the Northlands. [6...0] remain.
303ab2a70131904f88d99cd5ce8891976be6b502.text: 找到并杀死北地内的查尔冠军。 [6...0] 保留。

9e85ef8661c471ae46764c49ddb3c4b90b9323c3.source: There are more than 6 potential spawn points. Another one is slightly east of the entrance from Lakeside County. Also spotted on the far east side past the double-bridge.
9e85ef8661c471ae46764c49ddb3c4b90b9323c3.text: 有超过 6 个潜在的生成点。另一处位于湖滨县入口稍东侧。在双桥后面的远东侧也发现了这种现象。

ce239801ec8a59091771a3e36741f8513a5b355f.source: The Champion Groups consist of a Charr Champion, and 2 Charr which might be of any combination of the lower levels. For example, a Charr Fire Caller and a Charr Stalker.
ce239801ec8a59091771a3e36741f8513a5b355f.text: 冠军组由一名 Charr 冠军和 2 名 Charr（可能是较低级别的任意组合）组成。例如，夏尔火焰召唤者和夏尔追猎者。

07c467be8ad71d57f967f3a0bf46bb8450cffe28.source: When one charr champion remains, the quest text erroneously ends with 1 remain.
07c467be8ad71d57f967f3a0bf46bb8450cffe28.text: 当剩余一名夏尔冠军时，任务文本会错误地以剩余 1 人结束。

a0a3c2e4ebfca0fce99707aef4c2cadb44a76d69.source: Find and kill the Undead Necromancers inside the Catacombs. [6...0] remain.
a0a3c2e4ebfca0fce99707aef4c2cadb44a76d69.text: 找到并杀死地下墓穴内的亡灵死灵法师。 [6...0] 保留。

6d75fe01f620bbc36c83550f2710012aa235b2a9.source: The Undead Necromancer just north of Ashford Abbey zone will kill the gargoyles as you approach and create minions; because of this, it is advised to trigger its spawn then go kill the other necromancers so that the minions will die on their own. You can also opt to spike the Necromancer first so that its underlings have to fend off the masterless minions.
6d75fe01f620bbc36c83550f2710012aa235b2a9.text: 当你靠近时，阿什福德修道院区域北部的不死死灵法师会杀死石像鬼并创造爪牙；因此，建议触发它的生成，然后去杀死其他死灵法师，这样小兵就会自行死亡。你也可以选择先刺杀死灵法师，这样它的下属就必须抵御无主的小兵。

e304f2a30b062b8b3a6898ff330f48fdabd83e11.source: The Undead Necromancer in the northwestern pit's room can spawn on either the left or right side of the room.
e304f2a30b062b8b3a6898ff330f48fdabd83e11.text: 西北坑房间中的不死死灵法师可以在房间的左侧或右侧生成。

df6533bf8aea904563e3cc743c00a39228ce36bb.source: Several active quests can provide allies:
df6533bf8aea904563e3cc743c00a39228ce36bb.text: 几个活跃的任务可以为盟友提供：

032048eda27f89b6c12621102ff373e230bf261d.source: A Monk's Mission and Rites of Remembrance will spawn allies in the area with the Swamp Water. Respectively, Paulus the Abbot, a level 3 ally with skills dealing holy damage, and several Restless Spirits, level 10 allies.
032048eda27f89b6c12621102ff373e230bf261d.text: 僧侣的使命和纪念仪式将在沼泽水区域生成盟友。分别是院长保卢斯，一个具有神圣伤害技能的3级盟友，以及几个不安的灵魂，10级盟友。

27a9fa2f2be35c95d601b2474b09e0e5cd0bfaf8.source: The Necromancer's Novice will have Necromancer Munne, a level 5 ally, guide you to the area before the spiders. However, you have to talk to her and this will override your secondary profession skills with necromancer skills.
27a9fa2f2be35c95d601b2474b09e0e5cd0bfaf8.text: 死灵法师的新手将有死灵法师 Munne，一个 5 级盟友，引导你到达蜘蛛之前的区域。然而，你必须与她交谈，这将用死灵法师技能取代你的次要职业技能。

b6f421ce2717bc9fcfaab79333438617095b45e9.source: Find and kill Blazefiend Griefblade inside the Northlands.
b6f421ce2717bc9fcfaab79333438617095b45e9.text: 在北地找到并杀死烈焰魔悲伤之刃。

a97669610d2d10798bb8fdf45fda9d7514c02f75.source: Find and kill Countess Nadya inside the Regent Valley.
a97669610d2d10798bb8fdf45fda9d7514c02f75.text: 在摄政谷找到并杀死娜迪亚伯爵夫人。

ce4bcadc438e5c8f8106fd138e8d4c15c1c8b80c.source: Countess Nadya's spawn location changes with every rezone, so locating her efficiently is the first priority. There are two viable routes depending on your preference.
ce4bcadc438e5c8f8106fd138e8d4c15c1c8b80c.text: 娜迪亚伯爵夫人的生成位置会随着每次重新分区而变化，因此有效地定位她是首要任务。根据您的喜好，有两条可行的路线。

da4acc69eea2e229ba13893cb1bd8537dece9b7e.source: Route 1: Starting from Fort Ranik: Enter Regent Valley from Fort Ranik and head to the southernmost marked point on the map. If she isn't there, her three remaining possible spawn locations can be checked consecutively from that point. Note that this route has less distance to cover but many more enemies to deal with.
da4acc69eea2e229ba13893cb1bd8537dece9b7e.text: 路线一：从拉尼克堡出发：从拉尼克堡进入摄政谷，前往地图最南端的标记点。如果她不在那里，则可以从该点开始连续检查她剩余的三个可能的重生位置。请注意，这条路线的距离较短，但需要对付的敌人较多。

5d43c87bc87f169b7b169151eeb29600730499e8.source: Route 2: Starting from Ashford Abbey: Exit through Ashford Abbey to Lakeside County and then Regent Valley and check the spawn locations near the portal. If she isn't there, re-enter Lakeside County through the portal and try again. While the route itself is longer, there are significantly fewer enemies to deal with along the way, making it quicker overall. Note that abandoning and retaking the quest appears to reset her spawn position.
5d43c87bc87f169b7b169151eeb29600730499e8.text: 路线2：从阿什福德修道院出发：从阿什福德修道院出口前往湖滨县，然后到达摄政谷，检查传送门附近的生成位置。如果她不在那里，请通过门户重新进入湖滨县并重试。虽然路线本身较长，但沿途要对付的敌人却明显减少，整体上速度更快。请注意，放弃并重新接受任务似乎会重置她的重生位置。

43d22d6ffdeea71a1b9efbfec4ab5d464ce9fb4e.source: Once you've identified her location, pull any wandering groups of Firestarters or Raiders away before engaging. Be especially cautious of any nearby Bandit Blood Sworn, as aggroing one can aggro more surrounding Vanguard foes. When you confront the Countess open with Firestorm and/or Backfire before closing in. Use a pet, minions, or the Fire Imp as a meatshield to absorb her powerful Backfire and Empathy. If you're lucky, she'll cast Shatter Delusions herself and inadvertently remove the hex.
43d22d6ffdeea71a1b9efbfec4ab5d464ce9fb4e.text: 一旦你确定了她的位置，在交战之前将所有游荡的点火者或袭击者群体拉开。要特别小心任何附近的血誓强盗，因为攻击者可能会攻击周围更多的先锋敌人。当你在接近伯爵夫人时使用火焰风暴和/或逆火对峙。使用宠物、小兵或火焰小鬼作为肉盾来吸收她强大的逆火和同理心。如果幸运的话，她会亲自施放粉碎妄想并无意中移除咒语。

8d60cc0f39fe7c8e4e7d3dd845b806d1dd1cf094.source: Similarly to all Vanguard Bounty targets, the Countess will speak the Intermediate Dialogue if you come close enough to her spawning point. If she's already dead when you do, one of the other quest-related Bandits nearby will say the dialogue instead.
8d60cc0f39fe7c8e4e7d3dd845b806d1dd1cf094.text: 与所有先锋赏金目标类似，如果您距离伯爵夫人的生成点足够近，伯爵夫人将说出中级对话。如果你这样做时她已经死了，附近的其他与任务相关的强盗之一将会说出对话。

070be2a36df49867d9624e7677890ad337755882.source: This quest occasionally spawns lone bandits near the portals in Regent Valley. This includes a spawn near Fort Ranik, which will lead to the death of Mary Malone.
070be2a36df49867d9624e7677890ad337755882.text: 这个任务偶尔会在摄政谷的传送门附近产生孤独的强盗。这包括拉尼克堡附近的产卵，这将导致玛丽·马龙死亡。

3ee5a52c8ddeeaafcec08dd1936915204c592559.source: Find and kill Utini Wupwup inside of Green Hills County.
3ee5a52c8ddeeaafcec08dd1936915204c592559.text: 在绿山县内找到并杀死乌蒂尼·乌普乌普。

6bcd955ebce6506b19b9f1dbf92ccd57dbbdb360.source: Leave from Barradin Estate. Utini spawns randomly in one of 4 possible locations in the area listed on the map to the right. Throughout the explorable, there are several groups of two grawls, which can be either warrior or monk. The boss itself is always accompanied by two warriors.
6bcd955ebce6506b19b9f1dbf92ccd57dbbdb360.text: 从巴拉丁庄园出发。乌蒂尼会在右侧地图上列出的区域中的 4 个可能位置之一随机生成。在整个探索过程中，有几组两只穴居人，可以是战士，也可以是僧侣。 Boss本身总是有两名战士陪伴。

85dfb4481a3a34af27ec9dc18da5457804bcde4f.source: It is a good idea to refrain from dealing a lot of damage to the Grawl warriors until they start attacking. This is because if they haven't taken too much damage they will use Frenzy, allowing you to deal double damage to them, as well as usually rendering their monks unable to outheal the damage (especially considering the fact that they also have Healing Signet which lowers their defense).
85dfb4481a3a34af27ec9dc18da5457804bcde4f.text: 在穴居人战士开始攻击之前，最好不要对他们造成大量伤害。这是因为，如果他们没有受到太多伤害，他们会使用狂乱，让你对他们造成双倍伤害，并且通常会使他们的僧侣无法治愈伤害（特别是考虑到他们还拥有治疗徽记，这会降低他们的防御力）。

89df034f3701dd788b7887a7cc60d59def1b66e4.source: Spells dealing AoE damage like Symbol of Wrath or Fire Storm are especially effective.
89df034f3701dd788b7887a7cc60d59def1b66e4.text: 造成 AoE 伤害的法术（如愤怒象征或火焰风暴）尤其有效。

f8725c3006a52f26118bc45ae7af3db6fc0c76ad.source: Don't wait for too long, however, as Hammer Bash can interrupt you in the middle of an important spell.
f8725c3006a52f26118bc45ae7af3db6fc0c76ad.text: 不过，不要等待太久，因为锤击可能会在重要咒语中打断你。

0fc2b0270bef5bbce4d74ebb9002c314abd73ef8.source: The holy damage caused by Utini Wupwup and the Grawl Shamans, especially from Symbol of Wrath and Banish, as well as the lack of exploitable corpses, usually makes attempts to use minions difficult if not impossible.
0fc2b0270bef5bbce4d74ebb9002c314abd73ef8.text:
乌蒂尼·乌普乌普和穴居人萨满造成的神圣伤害，尤其是来自愤怒象征和放逐的伤害，以及缺乏可利用的尸体，通常使得使用小兵的尝试变得困难，甚至不可能。

MAPPINGOUT_24e09cfb4aeec98_0
敌人的等级取决于等级最低的队员的等级：

7619f9563ca4c9628803ec7418ece187f7f2f0d0.source: After accepting the quest, enter Regent Valley from Fort Ranik and speak to Gelsan the Outfitter who is standing near the portal. Travel south until you can see some bandits, one of whom will drop the stolen goods when killed. Pick up the item and carry it back to Gelsan, and speak to him to receive the Vanguard Equipment. Return the Vanguard Equipment to Captain Arne to complete the quest.
7619f9563ca4c9628803ec7418ece187f7f2f0d0.text: 接受任务后，从拉尼克堡进入摄政谷，与站在传送门附近的装备者盖尔桑交谈。向南行驶，直到看到一些强盗，其中一名强盗被杀死后会掉落赃物。捡起该物品并将其带回给盖尔桑，并与他交谈以获得先锋装备。将先锋装备归还给阿恩队长即可完成任务。

66d3ddefaac066f41c55788c3939fa6f5d590500.source: Find and rescue Farmer Hamnet, who is lost in Wizard's Folly.
66d3ddefaac066f41c55788c3939fa6f5d590500.text: 找到并营救在巫师愚行中迷失的农夫哈姆内特。

765b267b96b085b8be86665a2161bcbff21e2ca3.source: Farmer Hamnet can be escorted back to any of the five portals in Wizard's Folly to complete the quest, even though places such as The Catacombs or Regent Valley are not really safer.
765b267b96b085b8be86665a2161bcbff21e2ca3.text: 农夫哈姆内特可以被护送回巫师愚蠢中的五个传送门中的任何一个来完成任务，尽管地下墓穴或摄政谷等地方并不真正安全。

41b807009081c0ba568d6675a5684883eaadc599.source: Be sure to wait for the quest to update before mapping out or zoning. Should Farmer Hamnet stop moving before he gets close enough, take a few steps in the direction of the portal until the quest updates.
41b807009081c0ba568d6675a5684883eaadc599.text: 在绘制地图或分区之前，请务必等待任务更新。如果农夫哈姆内特在足够接近之前停止移动，请朝传送门的方向走几步，直到任务更新。

df00c04b5225958e3db7021892f5e479fae8a877.source: While active, two vanguard bandits spawn very close to Foible's Fair, making it useful as an experience farm. Plus the Academy Monk will be healing near the Shrine. If you find farming just these first two bandits tedious (30 seconds or so), there are another two just up the hill (another 30 seconds) and another four (rarely only three) down around the south side of the big circle. It takes a fair amount of time to run to these final four and defeat them (closer to 60 seconds), but they're usually all together.
df00c04b5225958e3db7021892f5e479fae8a877.text: 活跃时，两个先锋强盗会在福布尔集市附近产卵，使其成为一个有用的体验农场。另外，学院僧侣将在神社附近治疗。如果你觉得只耕种前两个强盗很乏味（大约 30 秒），那么另外两个强盗就在山上（另外 30 秒），另外四个（很少只有三个）在大圆圈的南侧。跑到最后四名并击败他们需要相当长的时间（接近 60 秒），但他们通常都在一起。

372d4b9a2d229f69985d697181e1203902171bc8.source: Rescue Footman Tate, who is trapped behind enemy lines in the Northlands.
372d4b9a2d229f69985d697181e1203902171bc8.text: 营救被困在北地敌后的步兵泰特。

24445acd60baf5f1027d36e4c3e3aa84efa67317.source: The new Charr spawn in pairs, whereas the native Charr are almost always in groups of 4.
24445acd60baf5f1027d36e4c3e3aa84efa67317.text: 新的夏尔成对出现，而原生夏尔几乎总是 4 人一组。

86942a79d4ad2db9202a0a4a14381001ceea03f7.source: Footman Tate activates as an ally when you get close, and will follow you thereafter.
86942a79d4ad2db9202a0a4a14381001ceea03f7.text: 当你靠近时，步兵塔特会作为盟友激活，并随后跟随你。

4ff5ab1b6244525c6b6232b6222d5abcba0e2bd1.source: If Footman Tate spawns inside or close to a group of Charr, be careful when approaching. When you get close he will automatically become an ally and the Charr will attack him. At lower levels, they can quickly kill him causing the quest to fail.
4ff5ab1b6244525c6b6232b6222d5abcba0e2bd1.text: 如果步兵塔特在一群夏尔内部或附近生成，接近时要小心。当你靠近时，他会自动成为盟友，夏尔会攻击他。在较低级别，他们可以很快杀死他，导致任务失败。

4b6fca1a090497fecb2188ad2f4d93091ccaeba9.source: Footman Tate must be led to the exit to Lakeside County to complete the quest, even if the party has access to Piken Square.
4b6fca1a090497fecb2188ad2f4d93091ccaeba9.text: 即使队伍可以进入皮肯广场，步兵泰特也必须被引导到湖滨县的出口才能完成任务。

d13dda66444cc6a241b193a615d2e2fbc314e1ed.source: This quest spawns a total of 30 high level charr. This is ideal for farming for Legendary Defender of Ascalon.
d13dda66444cc6a241b193a615d2e2fbc314e1ed.text: 该任务总共产生 30 个高级夏尔。这是阿斯卡隆传奇防御者耕种的理想选择。

1d2c6141a6847815ffee26fbc5b3901f5448569e.source: Try combining with Vanguard Annihilation: Charr for additional foes (requires a party member with that quest active).
1d2c6141a6847815ffee26fbc5b3901f5448569e.text: 尝试与先锋歼灭：夏尔结合以获取更多敌人（需要活跃该任务的党员）。

2df8721421f06f57c046c7313efd80e545b5860b.source: You can rezone faster by letting yourself get killed by a charr group at the end of the run. This way you will get resurrected at the entrance of the area.
2df8721421f06f57c046c7313efd80e545b5860b.text: 你可以通过在跑步结束时让自己被一群夏尔杀死来更快地重新定位。这样你就会在该区域的入口处复活。

62435b8bd9367eb36b10933f97269972176aaa19.source: If you have a second account with a high level character in pre-Searing, you can alternatively simply team up and have that character rezone.
62435b8bd9367eb36b10933f97269972176aaa19.text: 如果您的第二个帐户在预灼热中拥有高级角色，您也可以简单地组队并让该角色重新分区。

9f14a1922de8f4fab9e2a7c36b053937ffc0ea01.source: Find Duke Gaban and escort him out of the Catacombs.
9f14a1922de8f4fab9e2a7c36b053937ffc0ea01.text: 找到加班公爵并护送他离开地下墓穴。

15473a0c2b18a762c32692fc108304fa43925256.source: Duke Gaban can be escorted to any of the exits of the Catacombs. You are not required to escort him to the specific entrance you entered the catacombs in order to complete quest.
15473a0c2b18a762c32692fc108304fa43925256.text: 加班公爵可以被护送到地下墓穴的任何出口。你不需要护送他到你进入地下墓穴的特定入口来完成任务。

7ed523c48a612b238dcdeec24e3a47cb48eb9db6.source: Two groups of foes can be lured into the Flame Geysers.
7ed523c48a612b238dcdeec24e3a47cb48eb9db6.text: 两组敌人可以被引诱到火焰间歇泉中。

290ecdd6e809d7089f76fdbeb5cafc53e4848e42.source: Search the Ruptured Heart for anyone who might know the whereabouts of Kwalanah.
290ecdd6e809d7089f76fdbeb5cafc53e4848e42.text: 搜索破碎之心，寻找可能知道夸拉纳下落的人。

7951b8897e0f4c1c1b4c241132933a5d29cba260.source: After receiving the quest, head west past the small strip of sulfurous sands to find Jehner. Speak to Jehner and return to Charen for your reward.
7951b8897e0f4c1c1b4c241132933a5d29cba260.text: 接到任务后，向西行进，穿过一小片硫磺沙地找到耶纳。与耶纳交谈并返回查伦领取奖励。

ff1b4f0972a1044d8c080547aea0c749a6b991bc.source: Occasionally, Charen will not give the reward for this quest. When this happens, you have to exit to an outpost, abandon the quest and and return to the area to restart
ff1b4f0972a1044d8c080547aea0c749a6b991bc.text: 有时，查伦不会给予该任务的奖励。发生这种情况时，您必须退出到前哨站，放弃任务并返回该区域重新开始

6f6795dfea402f71074aa2bed9581cc99506b79a.source: Clear the Varajar Fells in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
6f6795dfea402f71074aa2bed9581cc99506b79a.text: 在困难模式下清除远席瓦山脉瓦拉贾丘陵中的所有敌人。

9eff618140f4b5850013efee28b04b43a6ef1df7.source: Asterius the Mighty spawns in the green areas of the southwest quarter of the map and starts to patrol the southwestern part of the map, going as far as circling around the base of Olafstead.
9eff618140f4b5850013efee28b04b43a6ef1df7.text: 强大的阿斯特里厄斯在地图西南部的绿色区域中生成，并开始在地图的西南部巡逻，最远绕着奥拉夫斯特德的基地盘旋。

24e09cffb4aeec981e63bcd7ee595a4756805089.source: The level of the foes depends on that of the party member with the lowest level:
24e09cffb4aeec981e63bcd7ee595a4756805089.text: 敌人的等级取决于等级最低的队员的等级：

c97f6b0df79cfc29572a633876d179014fb66bf2.source: There are around 30 grawl in the area.
c97f6b0df79cfc29572a633876d179014fb66bf2.text: 该地区大约有 30 只穴居人。

49f20aff63795b765ecbf5419030efa418dbf348.source: Go to Regent Valley. Acquire the Vanguard equipment from Gelsan.
49f20aff63795b765ecbf5419030efa418dbf348.text: 前往摄政谷。从盖尔桑那里获得先锋装备。

9f7e7c8fd18d76aa3d9a77906e28b28f9e1fe777.source: Recover Gelsan's stolen goods from the bandits.
9f7e7c8fd18d76aa3d9a77906e28b28f9e1fe777.text: 从强盗手中夺回盖尔桑的赃物。

9caa9c76145b36de3937a7c0d6c5f767e4ffee16.source: Deliver the stolen goods to Gelsan.

53b08bf0bbb3fc22a67a3b3f1a1cb54712efe434.source: Deliver the Vanguard equipment to Captain Arne in Ascalon City.
53b08bf0bbb3fc22a67a3b3f1a1cb54712efe434.text: 将先锋装备交付给阿斯卡隆市的阿恩队长。

bc01f98a17ec9d3337022091a81e365bbe7c8bc7.source: Dazehl Brainfreezer does not spawn immediately; instead, he pops up after all the other Ice Imps west of Olafstead have been killed.
bc01f98a17ec9d3337022091a81e365bbe7c8bc7.text: Dazehl Brainfreezer 不会立即生成；相反，他在奥拉夫斯特德以西的所有其他冰小恶魔都被杀死后突然出现。

aa9ed67ff19973dee7050fe81cc985b388705d36.source: The skeletons surrounded by Crypt Slashers in the northeastern section of the map turn hostile when you approach them.
aa9ed67ff19973dee7050fe81cc985b388705d36.text: 当你接近地图东北部的地穴切割者时，那些被地穴切割者包围的骷髅会变得充满敌意。

7c5223b22ded21d3d5d0f31330fb657d63729ccd.source: The Ice Imps and the centaurs are hostile to each other.
7c5223b22ded21d3d5d0f31330fb657d63729ccd.text: 冰小恶魔和半人马彼此敌对。

ce4a0ac251e01007493be93ad533755015de6eec.source: There are hidden Vaettir throughout the southern half of the map, especially near other mobs and along the map edges.
ce4a0ac251e01007493be93ad533755015de6eec.text: 地图的南半部都有隐藏的维提尔，特别是靠近其他生物和地图边缘。

3fea11989c777190e6dd7470656ca72e532b898f.source: The eastern side of the map has a small enclosed section that is darkened by shadows. There are hidden individual Smoke Phantoms throughout this area.
3fea11989c777190e6dd7470656ca72e532b898f.text: 地图的东侧有一个小的封闭部分，被阴影变暗。整个区域都隐藏着单独的烟雾幻影。

fecb514bc262ce08fd6297418d61e1605b23b17c.source: The Path to Revelations affect this part of the map, where there is a ritual area of sorts.
fecb514bc262ce08fd6297418d61e1605b23b17c.text: 启示之路影响地图的这一部分，那里有某种仪式区域。

6da868bbeb01bd2952b0b12406f37df25a667ee1.source: If the quest is active, foes need to be triggered to appear, so it can be avoided entirely to reduce the kills needed.
6da868bbeb01bd2952b0b12406f37df25a667ee1.text: 如果任务处于活动状态，则需要触发敌人出现，因此可以完全避免它以减少所需的杀戮。

ba57c0dfd65c8bae44b232903f6607fbba023afa.source: If the quest is not active, hostile Crypt Slashers surround a non-hostile skeleton group led by Nifling the Chained. Moving into aggro range of the skeletons turn them hostile. The Crypt Slashers should be pulled away before attacking the skeletons. You do not have to hostile or kill the skeletons to complete vanquishing the area.
ba57c0dfd65c8bae44b232903f6607fbba023afa.text: 如果任务未激活，敌对的地穴砍杀者会包围由锁链尼夫林领导的非敌对骷髅小队。进入骷髅的攻击范围后，它们就会变得充满敌意。在攻击骷髅之前，应该将地穴切割者拉开。你不必敌对或杀死骷髅来完成征服该地区。

daace6ff2c82b784fcad11811f6254b5c2245b8e.source: If nobody in your party has yet completed A Gate Too Far, you will be unable to reach about twenty Frozen Elementals near outside Raven's Point; they are behind a gate which will otherwise be locked.
daace6ff2c82b784fcad11811f6254b5c2245b8e.text: 如果你的队伍中没有人完成过远之门，你将无法到达渡鸦点外附近大约二十个冰冻元素；他们在一扇门后面，否则门就会被锁上。

8e79f586aecf487f48493e56909ed2410b4e2cb7.source: This area is a popular choice for farming Norn title points. You can earn 4,000 points in Normal mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active or 450 points per 5 minute run in hard mode by just defeating the Facets. You can earn around 20,000 points in Hard mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active. See Norn farming for details.
8e79f586aecf487f48493e56909ed2410b4e2cb7.text: 该区域是种植诺恩头衔点数的热门选择。在正常模式下，通过清理激活“启示之路”的区域，您可以获得 4,000 点积分；在困难模式下，只需击败小面，每跑 5 分钟即可获得 450 点积分。在困难模式中，您可以通过清理激活“启示之路”的区域来获得大约 20,000 点积分。有关详细信息，请参阅诺恩农业。

0d0f470a9f146c4eda6bdb441dc1e163fdc4b3ec.source: Go to the palace and talk to the diplomats.
0d0f470a9f146c4eda6bdb441dc1e163fdc4b3ec.text: 前往宫殿并与外交官交谈。

9347aa14ada2e89186473923fa96c75d02f6a011.source: Clear out the remaining Am Fah from the Jade Sea.
9347aa14ada2e89186473923fa96c75d02f6a011.text: 清除玉海中剩余的阿姆法。

4d6f244e577c9e0a80989bea87547b4c5dfea94a.source: Clear out the remaining Jade Brotherhood from the Echovald Forest.
4d6f244e577c9e0a80989bea87547b4c5dfea94a.text: 清除埃科瓦尔德森林中剩余的翡翠兄弟会。

5ebcafd2de12346e836780edbb1b07770407f75f.source: Tell the diplomats that their lands are clear.
5ebcafd2de12346e836780edbb1b07770407f75f.text: 告诉外交官他们的土地是干净的。

471bd4083f54c48a1b402a161acd16b7491baae6.source: This quest essentially involves travelling to two different areas and defeat five groups of enemies in each area. Just follow the quest marker in each area to find them all.
471bd4083f54c48a1b402a161acd16b7491baae6.text: 该任务本质上涉及前往两个不同的区域并击败每个区域的五组敌人。只需按照每个区域的任务标记即可找到全部。

e4eb179fb5a26f36d143ce7e4d63aacd20c02b3b.source: Enter the Silent Surf from Leviathan Pits.
e4eb179fb5a26f36d143ce7e4d63aacd20c02b3b.text: 从利维坦坑进入寂静的冲浪。

b7ac66ff49a0112ba3c7012da1693df969c8568e.source: Enter the Eternal Grove from Vasburg Armory.
b7ac66ff49a0112ba3c7012da1693df969c8568e.text: 从瓦斯堡军械库进入永恒树林。

ecb4571818e755cd059e3c9121d0b4261078e6fc.source: The quest groups in both areas are hostile to the other enemies in the area. You may use this to your advantage, although the Am Fah groups are situated far apart enough that you may be able to avoid most, if not all, other enemy groups.
ecb4571818e755cd059e3c9121d0b4261078e6fc.text: 这两个区域的任务小组都对该区域的其他敌人怀有敌意。你可以利用这一点来发挥你的优势，尽管 Am Fah 团体的位置足够远，你可以避开大多数（如果不是全部）其他敌人团体。

035ed6e24c308975c1b0fc25093690fc3ce5933c.source: {{ bug|Sometimes the quest marker does not update after you killed 4 groups at the Jade Sea. This might be the case, that the groups got killed by other foes already. To update the quest you just have to head to Scourgewind, Elder Guardian via the path from the water.
035ed6e24c308975c1b0fc25093690fc3ce5933c.text: {{ bug|有时在翡翠海杀死 4 个队伍后，任务标记不会更新。情况可能是这样，这些团体已经被其他敌人杀死了。要更新任务，你只需通过水路前往远古守护者天灾风。

5ba926358394ffe790415f700105ac7806a18839.source: Killing groups of Jade Brotherhood or Am Fah before the quest tells you to kill them will not bug the quest. The quest marker will still point you to the direction of the group you've already killed, but simply walking to the location will update the quest and direct you to the next group of Jade Brotherhood or Am Fah to kill.}}
5ba926358394ffe790415f700105ac7806a18839.text: 在任务告诉你杀死 Jade Brotherhood 或 Am Fah 之前杀死他们不会妨碍任务。任务标记仍会将您指向已杀死的队伍的方向，但只需走到该位置即可更新任务并引导您前往下一组要杀死的 Jade Brotherhood 或 Am Fah。}}

2a5e09de3b06e4261a172e269b0854c5c82ffa86.source: While similar in all respects to the normal mode version of this quest, there are now seven groups that you must defeat in each area. The last two or three groups are found in areas where that are rather crowded with enemies. Consider taking advantage of the fact that the quest groups are hostile to everything else. Also consider vanquishing the zones if you need them for the title, since you will be traveling all over the map and it will be hard to avoid aggroing a large number of foes.
2a5e09de3b06e4261a172e269b0854c5c82ffa86.text: 虽然在所有方面都与此任务的正常模式版本相似，但现在每个区域都有七个小组需要击败。最后两到三组出现在敌人相当拥挤的地区。考虑利用任务小组对其他一切都充满敌意的事实。如果你需要这些区域来获得头衔，也可以考虑征服这些区域，因为你将在整个地图上旅行，并且很难避免激怒大量的敌人。

645d97e5e9865b0562c07c93f59105cfd9353e1b.source: Clear the Vehjin Mines in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
645d97e5e9865b0562c07c93f59105cfd9353e1b.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比维金地雷中的所有敌人。

765e6c77ad43d439597759b8ed87ebf288244012.source: This area lies outside the northwestern exit of Jennur's Horde. It can also be reached via Basalt Grotto, on the northeastern corner of Joko's Domain.
765e6c77ad43d439597759b8ed87ebf288244012.text: 该区域位于詹努尔部落西北出口外。也可以通过位于约科领地东北角的玄武岩洞到达。

4b069106cd9b8abc0a11511ae48870f39086348a.source: If you have not completed the Coffer of Joko quest (even if you haven't yet taken the quest), and you have Master of Whispers in your party, certain mobs may not spawn, including Nehpek the Remorseless. This can significantly reduce the difficulty/speed of vanquishing the area.
4b069106cd9b8abc0a11511ae48870f39086348a.text: 如果你还没有完成约科保险箱任务（即使你还没有接受任务），并且你的队伍中有低语大师，某些小怪可能不会生成，包括无情的内赫佩克。这可以显着降低征服该地区的难度/速度。

66b31605a8c79d1098cd370508e77c058dae4764.source: Clear the Vehtendi Valley in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
66b31605a8c79d1098cd370508e77c058dae4764.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比维赫滕迪山谷中的所有敌人。

48b16411774ee8aadba25897c8507e77ceddfdf4.source: Characters will first arrive in this area as part of the primary quest Rally The Princes, traveling from Yatendi Canyons from the southwest.
48b16411774ee8aadba25897c8507e77ceddfdf4.text: 作为主要任务“集结王子”的一部分，角色将首先从西南方向的亚坦迪峡谷到达该区域。

0d167284a127763ec03b4e25b56e46555207c709.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
0d167284a127763ec03b4e25b56e46555207c709.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.9%。

e60b45703686e8f401e24444fed263291692fd99.source: The quest Rally The Princes reduces the number of foes and removes the bosses Bohdalz the Furious and Jarimiya the Unmerciful.
e60b45703686e8f401e24444fed263291692fd99.text: 集结王子任务减少了敌人的数量，并移除了狂怒者博赫达尔兹和无情者贾里米亚这两个 Boss。

17993f6da89ccc6c6ee5a3bda18e6a4120cfec37.source: Starting the vanquish from Yahnur Market minimises the amount of backtracking to clear out the area on the other side of the outpost.
17993f6da89ccc6c6ee5a3bda18e6a4120cfec37.text: 从亚努尔市场开始征服可以最大限度地减少回溯以清理前哨另一侧的区域。

cd1da93d958a5a6db38d1826631d5a6553ad0081.source: If you are having trouble getting to the space in the center islands, recall that the path leads from the hanging gardens in the northeast.
cd1da93d958a5a6db38d1826631d5a6553ad0081.text: 如果您无法到达中心岛屿的空间，请记住这条路是从东北部的空中花园通向的。

178d7944ded719cfe4cc9f8b4a7e18b6471c483f.source: Be careful when vanquishing the southwestern area of the map. Four boss groups are relatively close to each other.
178d7944ded719cfe4cc9f8b4a7e18b6471c483f.text: 征服地图西南地区时要小心。四个boss组彼此距离比较近。

47909a5d2de409279725446262f9b7d0b1e90368.source: Pursue Rragar into the depths of the dungeon and eliminate him.
47909a5d2de409279725446262f9b7d0b1e90368.text: 追击拉加进入地牢深处并消灭他。

53c3fad1645bd793808da39f02d603e836e59f5a.source: See Gron Fierceclaw (Merchant) for your reward.
53c3fad1645bd793808da39f02d603e836e59f5a.text: 前往烈爪戈隆（商人）领取奖励。

cefd44293c4cb43b7d16663a39b158c458542a4e.source: Kill a Vengeful Aatxe in the Underworld.
cefd44293c4cb43b7d16663a39b158c458542a4e.text: 在地狱中杀死复仇者阿特克斯。

531369a93a9ba6dde49878ed825a48f8440f9d20.source: *BONUS* Kill a Vengeful Aatxe in Hard Mode.
531369a93a9ba6dde49878ed825a48f8440f9d20.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死复仇的 Aatxe。

057c61a3e1a90cfe0f1f9318034fbf1d1ae14ff5.source: Vengeful Aatxe are impervious to virtually all forms of damage and cannot be targeted by skills or attacks, but are killed automatically upon the death of their Keeper of Souls. As such, for practical purposes, the quest calls for the killing of a Keeper of Souls.
057c61a3e1a90cfe0f1f9318034fbf1d1ae14ff5.text: 复仇的阿特克斯几乎不受所有形式的伤害，也不能成为技能或攻击的目标，但在灵魂守护者死亡后会自动死亡。因此，出于实际目的，任务要求杀死灵魂守护者。

40b4b2f887af1655c5ada240ec6417c5c38bc007.source: See Unwanted Guests for a walkthrough of the quest.
40b4b2f887af1655c5ada240ec6417c5c38bc007.text: 请参阅不受欢迎的客人以了解任务的演练。

12db3dca63a106f0664144aca5ae4ea82bd931d6.source: It is possible, but tedious and difficult, to kill one through a combination of life stealing. See Invulnerability for more information.
12db3dca63a106f0664144aca5ae4ea82bd931d6.text: 通过结合夺命来杀死一个人是可能的，但乏味且困难。有关更多信息，请参阅无敌性。

e15b6420cbd3933f36bf619f2cda4769dd8ad513.source: This quest was first offered on 11th May 2009
e15b6420cbd3933f36bf619f2cda4769dd8ad513.text: 此任务首次提供于 2009 年 5 月 11 日

09959ae59ee97f8a9fc36e0b3a4d7d3f5883bbbd.source: Take Koss and escort the Sunspear evacuees from the Venta Cemetery to the boat at Dajkah Inlet.
09959ae59ee97f8a9fc36e0b3a4d7d3f5883bbbd.text: 乘坐科斯并护送烈阳之矛撤离者从文塔公墓到达吉卡湾的船上。

5534fa640568e8c9b994baaff3f7360c85fc2ff1.text: *奖励* 消灭所有 12 个哨所。

119a01ac1245eb69ad9fdabc59b0f0aa6fb6e30a.source: As per the Venta Cemetery mission.

d5a70b7a4b312ff1b3e11b37d3818df33b3720e8.text: 在凯塞克斯峰杀死维拉塔。

306fa990c5d1d80bffee816f4762a3d6075dc831.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Verata。

0560c2741ad15a2d66843086dee03ccee02b0533.source: See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.

9b653f1c570907982ec820a90e67152a9c42b01f.source: See the "Notes" sections of Verata the Necromancer and Kessex Peak.
9b653f1c570907982ec820a90e67152a9c42b01f.text: 请参阅《死灵法师维拉塔》和《凯塞克斯峰》的“注释”部分。

f6c6c2d8b2222f3857a896a6cfa588f81324fb29.source: Verata does not always spawn if The Villainy of Galrath or its hard mode counterpart are active.
f6c6c2d8b2222f3857a896a6cfa588f81324fb29.text: 如果加拉斯的恶棍或其困难模式对手处于活动状态，维拉塔并不总是会生成。

d205b3d2f26526693d9e7862cedd7a53c507dec7.source: Clear the Verdant Cascades in the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
d205b3d2f26526693d9e7862cedd7a53c507dec7.text: 在困难模式下清除黯淡海岸翠绿瀑布中的所有敌人。

28a4208587748bf3a21b78a815b5fddedf46a531.source: There is a large flock of moa birds to the north of the exit to Umbral Grotto.
28a4208587748bf3a21b78a815b5fddedf46a531.text: 暗影石窟出口北面有一大群恐鸟。

ec5e209b335fce31f3bd2c13433985054033f925.source: There is a large group of hostile elder crocodiles in the north at the waterfall cave.
ec5e209b335fce31f3bd2c13433985054033f925.text: 瀑布洞的北边有一大群充满敌意的长老鳄。

0a73280b49af0549b1ab5cb7143e04c91307ee43.source: Around each of the Notice to Trespassers, you will see some corpses as well as two Skelk. When you approach, a nearby group of Quetzal will charge the Skelk and attack them.
0a73280b49af0549b1ab5cb7143e04c91307ee43.text: 在每个侵入者通知周围，您都会看到一些尸体以及两只斯凯尔克。当你接近时，附近的一群绿咬鹃会冲向蛇蜥并攻击它们。

0360e106d12e016ab7face20c275bbe17aa5f0ba.text: 岩石滑坡（中心西北的洞穴）

a04bd36f94a510f433b9f23193048008496bc67b.source: The Skelk and Quetzal are hostile to each other.
a04bd36f94a510f433b9f23193048008496bc67b.text: 斯凯尔克人和绿咬鹃彼此敌对。

120194b704d7066c2c287c32febb1c0259ab08d0.source: There are hidden arachnids in the eastern side of the caves to the northeast.
120194b704d7066c2c287c32febb1c0259ab08d0.text: 洞穴的东侧东北方隐藏着蛛形纲动物。

fbbc248c79918c45d18a92dcd905818b38bf0d5b.source: There is one spot to the southwest of Wilderm Wrathspew's position where a few hidden Skelk appear one at a time.
fbbc248c79918c45d18a92dcd905818b38bf0d5b.text: 在狂怒怒喷位置的西南方向有一处地方，每次都会有几只隐藏的斯凯尔克出现。

24847c7e2de421669c373791ca656e9457d6c56d.source: Near the center, two groups of Quetzal appear to be dueling each other. You can either wait for one side to finish the other, or engage them.
24847c7e2de421669c373791ca656e9457d6c56d.text: 在中心附近，两组绿咬鹃似乎正在互相决斗。你可以等待一方完成另一方的任务，也可以与他们交战。

003a3cfaf24b0c8abe22342a6d7403ae61baebf5.source: Near the portal to Varajar Fells there is a cave full of Jotun if you have problems finding your last group.
003a3cfaf24b0c8abe22342a6d7403ae61baebf5.text: 如果你在寻找最后一组人时遇到问题，在瓦拉贾丘陵的入口附近有一个充满佐敦的洞穴。

09afeb25b1ce865600129ae9084f16e81b6e7332.source: Another place to look for your last group is along the southern boundary - there's a large hill with an easy-to-miss path behind it, directly south of the V in Verdant Cascades.
09afeb25b1ce865600129ae9084f16e81b6e7332.text: 寻找最后一组的另一个地方是沿着南部边界 - 有一座大山，后面有一条很容易错过的小路，就在 Verdant Cascades 的 V 形公路以南。

89f849ba7c58249779ed4bc8fab7992c424523f0.source: Locate and destroy the source of the plague in Kaineng City.
89f849ba7c58249779ed4bc8fab7992c424523f0.text: 找到并摧毁凯能市的瘟疫源头。

bb014a6fe42e02c3d76b0082f69376a463961b87.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 25 minutes. see the Notes section
bb014a6fe42e02c3d76b0082f69376a463961b87.text: *奖励* 在 25 分钟内完成任务。请参阅注释部分

3f130235d98207c2d424eb8aa79fd88921a9ae62.source: As per the Vizunah Square mission.

d60d1ddd76bf48b2541c1f42f34787c3dc4c8383.source: Similar to the mission, completing in under 35 minutes when doing this quest in Hard mode will still gain you the first bonus objective.
d60d1ddd76bf48b2541c1f42f34787c3dc4c8383.text: 与任务类似，在困难模式下完成此任务时，在 35 分钟内完成仍将为您带来第一个奖励目标。

c8e58770c27b706011e6a0f61ce38d907e21c219.source: Most of the first level can be explored without the required quest, allowing transport between the two outposts, but the quest is necessary to pass the door to the southeast near the Lost Note.
c8e58770c27b706011e6a0f61ce38d907e21c219.text: 第一个关卡的大部分内容都可以在没有所需任务的情况下探索，允许两个前哨站之间的运输，但任务需要通过失落笔记附近东南方的门。

d3873c60bc1f46372d721b7e62916740d0e03220.source: There are two routes to the first portal. Each route has a boulder trap, being rolled over by a boulder does not cause Death Penalty.
d3873c60bc1f46372d721b7e62916740d0e03220.text: 通往第一个传送门的路线有两条。每条路线都有巨石陷阱，被巨石滚倒不会造成死刑。

64bcdeb0ff861c79a86fd41c900ccb3fa1e43f3b.source: Rock Slides occur in level 1 and 2.
64bcdeb0ff861c79a86fd41c900ccb3fa1e43f3b.text: 岩石滑坡发生在第 1 层和第 2 层。

b830b95b1fb8fea60d7d460295c12acfcad3367c.source: Watch out for Poison Dart traps.

5b7dc0afc403147a0819f9ef502bcfadfedc8da3.source: There are 2-3 hidden groups of oozes on level 2, in a low-ceilinged waterway.
5b7dc0afc403147a0819f9ef502bcfadfedc8da3.text: 在第 2 层低矮的水道中，有 2-3 个隐藏的软泥怪群。

40e12ac7962ac33a52de02a35d133a648dc47aaa.source: When you kill an "ancient" Mummy or Elemental, it will revive in two minutes. Killing the foe again does not count towards Dwarven Raider and does not yield loot or experience; however, the ancient Mummies will leave exploitable corpses whenever they are killed.
40e12ac7962ac33a52de02a35d133a648dc47aaa.text: 当你杀死“远古”木乃伊或元素时，它会在两分钟内复活。再次杀死敌人不会计入矮人袭击者，也不会产生战利品或经验；然而，古代木乃伊在被杀时会留下可利用的尸体。

9d4a6b751fe176b5597ccdcad216f44534eafd16.source: When you have to face a large number of Stone Summit, it is possible for you to reactivate the first Resurrection Shrine which means you have to travel back through the entire length of level 2 to get back to where you were.
9d4a6b751fe176b5597ccdcad216f44534eafd16.text: 当你必须面对大量的石峰时，你有可能重新激活第一个复活神殿，这意味着你必须返回整个2级才能回到原来的地方。

4a7bb04ab813a5d2902dd8d6fd830079a2238bc7.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #9 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
4a7bb04ab813a5d2902dd8d6fd830079a2238bc7.text: 完成这个地下城将填写主地下城指南故事书的第 9 页。

9b94a5cbefd3f49483e03a63dcd313cbc28a136b.source: If Taskmaster Bellok is killed and the key retrieved, then the dungeon is exited or failed, sometimes if the quest is not abandoned, Bellok will not drop the key the next time one attempts the dungeon.
9b94a5cbefd3f49483e03a63dcd313cbc28a136b.text: 如果模仿大师贝洛克被杀死并且钥匙被取回，那么地下城就会退出或失败，有时如果任务没有放弃，贝洛克在下次尝试地下城时不会掉落钥匙。

b838ac78795f6f5bb6b0098e6403330d5f06fcbf.source: In hard mode it is very easy to be trapped and immediately killed at the resurrection shrine adjacent to Taskmaster Bellok, often leading to a failure of the dungeon.
b838ac78795f6f5bb6b0098e6403330d5f06fcbf.text: 在困难模式下，很容易被困在模仿大师贝洛克附近的复活神殿并立即被杀死，常常导致地下城失败。

941ef84a554015aaefc3c0ebfee9ef3dd5424aea.source: Set the trapped voices free from the jars.
941ef84a554015aaefc3c0ebfee9ef3dd5424aea.text: 将被困的声音从罐子中释放出来。

1a7f7b5eea4f46dd93ee6e43cf5e390710f4c2c1.source: See Elder Belin for your reward.
1a7f7b5eea4f46dd93ee6e43cf5e390710f4c2c1.text: 去找贝林长老领取奖励。

933a72ecefc0d68eb18d795e3e2c586d939e3735.source: You find Elder Belin in the non-incorporated village north of Jokanur Diggings, in the northwestern corner of Zehlon Reach. After accepting the quest you have to go to the northeastern corner of the area to fight the Evil Mime. The way to the mime is a straight line so he is not hard to find.
933a72ecefc0d68eb18d795e3e2c586d939e3735.text: 你可以在佐卡努矿区北部的非建制村庄中找到贝林长老，该村庄位于泽隆河段的西北角。接受任务后，你必须前往该地区的东北角与邪恶哑剧战斗。通往哑剧的路是一条直线，所以不难找到他。

3bc647cf502de4ac2c3cbe0abb51bbe4f9f9fe64.source: The Evil Mime is a level 24 Mesmer with skills like: Spirit Shackles, Backfire and Mind Wrack. Taking hex removal and knowing when not to cast spells/attack can be vital for you. The mime is only healed through using Ether Feast, so it is imperative that you interrupt this. Paragons are at a major disadvantage in this quest: the little island where the Evil Mime is standing has an area effect: Curse of Silence. This area effect means you can not use any chants or shouts. The effect will wear off shortly after the Evil Mime is slain.
3bc647cf502de4ac2c3cbe0abb51bbe4f9f9fe64.text: 邪恶哑剧是 24 级幻术师，拥有以下技能：精神枷锁、逆火和心灵毁灭。去除妖术并知道何时不施法/攻击对你来说至关重要。哑剧只能通过使用以太盛宴来治愈，所以你必须中断它。典范在这个任务中处于一个主要劣势：邪恶哑剧所站立的小岛有一个区域效果：沉默诅咒。该区域效果意味着您无法使用任何圣歌或喊叫。邪恶哑剧被杀死后不久，效果就会消失。

0c12bfd571a966ebbbf4eaeece6ee53d179f25cf.source: After you have slain the Evil Mime and the area effect has been lifted you can touch the jars to open them and free the trapped voices. There are three jars, two big ones and one smaller one that is easy to miss. You may have trouble setting them free due to some odd mechanics involving the jars. Double-clicking on the jars does not seem to work to free the voices. Instead, double-click on the yellow name that appears with the each jar. After freeing them, you can go back to Elder Belin for your reward.
0c12bfd571a966ebbbf4eaeece6ee53d179f25cf.text: 杀死邪恶哑剧并且区域效果解除后，您可以触摸罐子将其打开并释放被困的声音。一共有三个罐子，两个大一个小一个，很容易错过。由于涉及罐子的一些奇怪的机制，您可能无法将它们释放。双击罐子似乎无法释放声音。相反，双击每个罐子出现的黄色名称。释放他们后，你可以回到贝林长老那里领取奖励。

27ef74f5a8acc3e5f87f5fdeeb366f4e1dd5b224.source: The Trapped Voices will always spawn, even for non-Nightfall characters, despite the fact that non-Nightfall characters will not be offered this quest. Activating the Trapped Voice jars may not set them free, rendering this quest impossible to complete.
27ef74f5a8acc3e5f87f5fdeeb366f4e1dd5b224.text: 即使对于非夜幕降临的角色，被困之声也总是会产生，尽管事实上非夜幕降临的角色不会被提供这个任务。激活被困声音罐可能无法将它们释放，从而使该任务无法完成。

a7d3cf2e6feb973cbc465035f2ef5dad32a9641d.source: Clear Vulture Drifts in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
a7d3cf2e6feb973cbc465035f2ef5dad32a9641d.text: 在困难模式下清除所有敌人的水晶沙漠中的秃鹰漂流。

424c449b9c49d4c13b449a4b29e1c5752d42fdc9.source: Condition removal helps counter Plague Touch or Eruption and "Can't Touch This!" blocks the touch skills of scarabs.
424c449b9c49d4c13b449a4b29e1c5752d42fdc9.text: 条件去除有助于抵抗瘟疫接触或爆发和“不能碰这个！”阻挡圣甲虫的接触技能。

67b3350bd60dcde1518bdf2d21fe5879a979a413.source: There are a lot of hidden scarabs towards the northwest, especially near the northwestern corner. Move slowly to avoid over-aggroing.
67b3350bd60dcde1518bdf2d21fe5879a979a413.text: 西北方向有很多隐藏的圣甲虫，尤其是西北角附近。缓慢移动以避免过度攻击。

0e80e5f082dfa1b25c458699b911025c9edddfda.source: There are a few hidden devourers and possibly Sand Wurms in the southeastern and eastern sections.
0e80e5f082dfa1b25c458699b911025c9edddfda.text: 在东南部和东部地区有一些隐藏的吞噬者，可能还有沙亚龙。

4fb29c05ebd52b34fb4469a1d0ea7903de85acb9.source: The western section can be difficult due the knock downs from Sand Elementals and Sand Drakes; pull carefully, bring anti-KD skills, or, at least, keep your party spread out.
4fb29c05ebd52b34fb4469a1d0ea7903de85acb9.text: 由于沙元素和沙龙的击倒，西部部分可能会很困难；小心拉动，带上反 KD 技能，或者至少让你的队伍分散开来。

2e74be5dcd9d408228da070f4372dfceb8e4faa4.source: A lone Hydra group patrols the northwest and is easily missed because it starts circling clockwise when you enter its radar range. To avoid hunting for it, approach from the east when you first encounter it (so that it moves towards you); if you think you missed it, start your own patrol in a counter-clockwise direction. The group does not always spawn.
2e74be5dcd9d408228da070f4372dfceb8e4faa4.text: 一支孤独的九头蛇团体在西北方向巡逻，很容易被错过，因为当你进入其雷达范围时，它就会开始顺时针盘旋。为了避免追捕它，当你第一次遇到它时，从东边接近（这样它就会向你移动）；如果您认为自己错过了，请按逆时针方向开始自己的巡逻。该群体并不总是产生。

f4cd55943082229900b216c36aaec276b4e96128.source: There are also two lone sand drakes, one patrolling East-West in the NW and one patrolling North-South in the far West, which may not appear until after you have left that region of the map.
f4cd55943082229900b216c36aaec276b4e96128.text: 还有两只孤独的沙龙，一只在西北地区东西向巡逻，一只在遥远的西部南北方向巡逻，直到你离开地图的该区域后它们可能才会出现。

b1b4259878913f9599b3dd6c5103af7016bc1d02.source: Two groups of Sand Giants patrol the Eastern side of the zone.
b1b4259878913f9599b3dd6c5103af7016bc1d02.text: 两群沙巨人在该区域的东侧巡逻。

6dbc0f0cc8d809b484c73f1a46b3c0775e02a669.source: It might take some time to finding the last foes on this map as it is very vast to navigate.
6dbc0f0cc8d809b484c73f1a46b3c0775e02a669.text: 可能需要一些时间才能找到这张地图上的最后敌人，因为导航范围非常广阔。

d231ac3144d68fc6e5ed7301bfa8c76d6ffbfe42.source: Bring "Can't Touch This!" or "Don't Trip!": touch skills and AoE knockdown are abundant!
d231ac3144d68fc6e5ed7301bfa8c76d6ffbfe42.text: 带上“不能碰这个！”或“别绊倒！”：触摸技能和AoE击倒丰富！

e79a520b0d31080b31e3a24e057bdfebfd082b72.source: Clear the Wajjun Bazaar in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
e79a520b0d31080b31e3a24e057bdfebfd082b72.text: 在困难模式下清除凯能市 Wajjun 集市上的所有敌人。

2f53f1202c5fd538aeaeb5dfd0fe62af208262c3.source: Factions characters will first go through this area during the primary quest A Master's Burden.
2f53f1202c5fd538aeaeb5dfd0fe62af208262c3.text: 派系角色在主线任务“大师的负担”期间将首先穿过该区域。

a8e56651af26831322e68b6cccb6f6e71a2999d0.source: Characters from other campaigns will find it easiest to come here via the Marketplace.
a8e56651af26831322e68b6cccb6f6e71a2999d0.text: 来自其他战役的角色会发现通过市场来到这里是最简单的。

6e0e9867c6fb5539533eefc3384bb14939313a5d.source: Several quests that take place here can be done together at once since the quest givers, walkthrough and reward NPCs are all within the same area: Assassination Attempt, Closer to the Stars, Imperial Assistance, Little Lost Bear, Medical Emergency, Problem Salving and Red Tape.
6e0e9867c6fb5539533eefc3384bb14939313a5d.text: 在这里发生的几个任务可以同时完成，因为任务提供者、演练和奖励 NPC 都在同一区域内：暗杀企图、靠近星星、帝国援助、小失落的熊、医疗紧急情况、问题救助和繁文缛节。

ef3928cff5333faf2c61df92205a8bf110a67112.source: It is suggested to access the island of Jade Brotherhood from the central bridge, as the pathing at the other bridges encourages runaway hero AI.
ef3928cff5333faf2c61df92205a8bf110a67112.text: 建议从中央桥进入翡翠兄弟岛，因为其他桥上的路径会鼓励英雄AI逃跑。

b028c2878a437516e4f3df7f5e1799d5f883d059.source: The Gangs of Kaineng will increase the total number of foes to around 400.
b028c2878a437516e4f3df7f5e1799d5f883d059.text: 凯能帮的敌人总数将增加到400人左右。

3a78ee8c86465cbf190a8653c8a2300729070157.source: You can reduce the number of foes to approximately 90 and neutralize the Am Fah by completing The Search for a Cure and not completing any of these three quests: Seek out Brother Tosai, Drink from the Chalice of Corruption, or Refuse to Drink.
3a78ee8c86465cbf190a8653c8a2300729070157.text: 你可以通过完成“寻找治愈方法”而不完成以下三个任务中的任何一个来将敌人数量减少到大约 90 名并消灭 Am Fah：寻找 Tosai 兄弟、从腐败圣杯中喝水或拒绝喝酒。

100578d14f5ede9df8b7c2acb1e0b653765244cc.source: Without one of these in your quest log, you will encounter numerous hidden Am Fah groups, especially in the narrow pathways to the southeast and the cliffside path in the west.
100578d14f5ede9df8b7c2acb1e0b653765244cc.text: 如果你的任务日志中没有其中之一，你将遇到许多隐藏的 Am Fah 团体，特别是在东南方的狭窄通道和西边的悬崖边小路上。

9733f7c9ebdadf1c0dbc9fa119b121a1a9b1f0b2.source: With Seek Out Brother Tosai active, you can also avoid killing any mantids: enter from The Marketplace and target only the Jade Brotherhood in the north.
9733f7c9ebdadf1c0dbc9fa119b121a1a9b1f0b2.text: 激活“寻找东斋兄弟”后，您还可以避免杀死任何螳螂：从市场进入并仅瞄准北部的玉石兄弟会。

c5a06ebccb6cb2a8238c954b35025cd1d172f379.source: There is a hidden Jade Brotherhood group near both the central and western bridges of the northern island.
c5a06ebccb6cb2a8238c954b35025cd1d172f379.text: 在北岛中部和西部桥梁附近都隐藏着一个翡翠兄弟会团体。

a7daeacec7db634562835da80451c583af623737.source: Some players have reported problems with the kills-counter for vanquishing in this area under some narrow circumstances. If the player kills the mantids first, the counter might show 90% completion even though there are up to 200 more non-popup foes remaining. If the player kills the Jade Brotherhood first, then the Vanquish reward is given without killing the mantids.
a7daeacec7db634562835da80451c583af623737.text: 一些玩家报告说，在某些狭窄的情况下，在该区域获胜时的杀戮计数器会出现问题。如果玩家先杀死螳螂，计数器可能会显示 90% 的完成度，即使还剩下 200 个非弹出敌人。如果玩家先杀死翡翠兄弟会，则无需杀死螳螂即可获得胜利奖励。

67ec25adafe0c58e961503eca2276514d18c0020.source: Find Rohtu's mother in Lahtenda Bog.
67ec25adafe0c58e961503eca2276514d18c0020.text: 在拉赫滕达沼泽找到罗图的母亲。

f6005435db58da6200919175d786b7cbb53201d0.source: Return to Rohtu and tell him of his mother's fate.
f6005435db58da6200919175d786b7cbb53201d0.text: 返回罗图身边并告诉他他母亲的命运。

b857fbe57779765a39e8ecc57fa20c44b8066a00.source: Exit Blacktide Den and head south to find Bahlya's corpse surrounded by a group of Corsairs. Return to Rohtu and tell him of his mother's fate.
b857fbe57779765a39e8ecc57fa20c44b8066a00.text: 离开黑潮巢穴并向南走，会发现巴赫亚的尸体被一群海盗包围。返回罗图身边并告诉他他母亲的命运。

963d271fbf49ef17316209d8d3e79b926acc6c24.source: You can also do the quest Crypt-ology while working on this quest.
963d271fbf49ef17316209d8d3e79b926acc6c24.text: 你也可以在做这个任务的同时做任务“密码学”。

f5ad9273c967926bfcfb85a42a7343ad5f55c58a.source: Kill Amalek the Unmerciful in Watchtower Coast
f5ad9273c967926bfcfb85a42a7343ad5f55c58a.text: 在瞭望塔海岸杀死无情的亚玛力人

57004b73a7bdeb8c7b6bb2e29aac5cee301a5b63.source: *BONUS* Kill Amalek the Unmerciful in Hard Mode
57004b73a7bdeb8c7b6bb2e29aac5cee301a5b63.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死无情的阿玛力人

864d28e580a957f0b72a8d538a647eebdf3dc6fd.source: Complete the Base Objective for 10 War Supplies
864d28e580a957f0b72a8d538a647eebdf3dc6fd.text: 完成 10 件战争物资的基本目标

af6baa5150dd8c7e5f04592ef3c5433c82c70164.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies
af6baa5150dd8c7e5f04592ef3c5433c82c70164.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外 5 件战争物资

18e81440daf62420583c408e89871b012782a36e.source: Start from Divinity Coast and follow the map towards the second clearing and head up the slope to your left, towards the resurrection shrine, i.e. do not follow the road. (If you have trouble using the keyboard to navigate the route, click at the top of the incline, near the shrine, leaving it to the game's pathfinding AI.)
18e81440daf62420583c408e89871b012782a36e.text: 从神性海岸出发，按照地图前往第二个空地，然后爬上左侧的斜坡，前往复活神社，即不要沿着路走。 （如果您在使用键盘导航路线时遇到困难，请单击神社附近的斜坡顶部，将其留给游戏的寻路人工智能。）

e27bc957433d634accb22beba17c308a84262491.source: After the shrine, keep to your left, heading north and counter-clockwise to reach Amalek due north, but around the corner from the shrine. The number of groups you encounter along the way depend on several factors: which foes spawn, their party composition, and how close to each other. Amalek's group is easy enough to defeat on its own, although the boss does bring condition and hex removal that can slow you down.
e27bc957433d634accb22beba17c308a84262491.text: 离开神殿后，靠左行驶，向北逆时针方向行驶，即可到达正北的阿玛力人，但就在神殿的拐角处。你一路上遇到的队伍数量取决于几个因素：生成的敌人、他们的队伍组成以及彼此之间的距离。亚玛力人的队伍很容易单独击败，尽管 Boss 确实会带来条件和妖术移除，这可能会减慢你的速度。

792156ac2e41e49aa4e493ccb8d05be991e68d8f.source: However, the difficulty in reaching Amalek ranges from trivial to among the most difficult routes of all 21 of the Shining Blade bounties. Since the Mantle and Peacekeepers are hostile to the Tengu, Mergoyle, and Bog Skale, you can sometimes find only a few foes to mop up. In rare situations, a Mergoyle boss group will spawn close to Amalek and defeat him before you get close (allowing you to immediately return to Lion's Arch Keep for your reward); the only indication of this is when you receive the morale boost and your quest log updates.
792156ac2e41e49aa4e493ccb8d05be991e68d8f.text: 然而，到达阿玛力人的难度从微不足道到所有 21 条光刃赏金路线中最困难的路线不等。由于地幔卫士和维和卫士与天狗、墨高尔和沼泽斯卡勒敌对，所以有时你只能找到几个敌人来消灭。在极少数情况下，默高伊尔 Boss 团会在阿玛力人附近生成，并在你接近之前击败他（允许你立即返回狮子拱门以获得奖励）；唯一的迹象是当你收到士气提升和任务日志更新时。

6faa744cfee4d746e68c2c6c447ae95f8c268caa.source: In contrast, you can also end up with up to four groups of Mantle/Peacekeepers before reaching your target. The first group (located just after the resurrection shrine) is small and presents no trouble. However, the remaining full-strength groups typically overlap and can wipe even a well-balanced party. The second group is stationary, on the northeast corner of the bluffs (before you have to turn west); they can be pulled south, away from the remaining groups. The third group walks a tight-patrol path on the slope between the second group and the edge of Amalek's protective zone; you can pull them east (to the second group's original location). The fourth group is a patrol; you can avoid them with careful timing, although some find it safer to pull them south so that they do not combine forces with Amalek's team.
6faa744cfee4d746e68c2c6c447ae95f8c268caa.text: 相比之下，在到达目标之前，你也可以拥有最多四组地幔/维和人员。第一组（位于复活神殿后面）规模较小，不会造成任何麻烦。然而，剩余的全力队伍通常会重叠，甚至可以消灭一个平衡良好的队伍。第二组静止不动，位于悬崖的东北角（在您必须向西转向之前）；他们可以被拉向南方，远离剩余的群体。第三组在第二组和亚玛力保护区边缘之间的斜坡上走一条严密巡逻的小路；你可以把他们拉向东（到第二组原来的位置）。第四组是巡逻队；你可以小心地避开他们，尽管有些人发现将他们拉向南方更安全，这样他们就不会与亚玛力的队伍联合起来。

ee6490b445de811b0ffc7710749dc735b17af927.source: Kill Barthimus the Provident in Cursed Lands
ee6490b445de811b0ffc7710749dc735b17af927.text: 在诅咒之地杀死上帝巴蒂姆斯

628e1f61ff84034bfc75b0139892b9b2a017d5dd.source: *BONUS* Kill Barthimus the Provident in Hard Mode
628e1f61ff84034bfc75b0139892b9b2a017d5dd.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死普罗米斯·巴蒂姆斯

ff36a52ab68282917bdfa3f7f2c4ee4a25ec06c3.source: The fastest way to Barthimus avoids most enemies along the way.
ff36a52ab68282917bdfa3f7f2c4ee4a25ec06c3.text: 到达巴蒂姆斯的最快路线可以避开沿途的大多数敌人。

37d56f61735984e443bd2adc0e50759046d6a7db.source: Leave the Temple of the Ages with a balanced group. Either rescue your escort from the Reed Stalkers or just run east. Evade or dispatch the undead and make your way through the swamp. After the swamp, you need to cross the path. Wait a few seconds for the patrols to move away, then cross it without engaging any foes. Move past the Resurrection Shrine, then east. Dispatch the small White Mantle group without engaging the Lynx. There are a few White Mantle popups before the exit to Cursed Lands. If you're quick you can run past them to the portal.
37d56f61735984e443bd2adc0e50759046d6a7db.text: 带着均衡的队伍离开千古神殿。要么从芦苇追猎者手中救出你的护卫队，要么就向东跑。躲避或消灭不死生物并穿过沼泽。过了沼泽，你需要穿过小路。等待几秒钟，让巡逻队离开，然后在不与任何敌人交战的情况下穿过它。经过复活神殿，然后向东。在不与山猫交战的情况下派遣白斗篷小队。在出口到诅咒之地之前有一些白斗篷弹出窗口。如果你够快的话，你可以跑过他们到达传送门。

0cda72127506d67f7e04b24ad2503fe6dd26c7a5.source: In the Cursed Lands, your new escort is likely to aggro the group of Lynx. You can take it slow, dispatch each group, then tackle Barthimus. It's faster, but riskier, to lead the Lynx, other wildlife and the White Mantle to each other - they're hostile to each other. You can use the ensuing chaos to spike Barthimus, then map-travel back to Lion's Arch.
0cda72127506d67f7e04b24ad2503fe6dd26c7a5.text: 在诅咒之地，你的新护卫很可能会激怒山猫群。你可以慢慢来，派遣每个小组，然后对付巴蒂姆斯。将山猫、其他野生动物和白斗篷引向对方会更快，但风险更大——它们彼此敌对。你可以利用随之而来的混乱来刺杀巴蒂姆斯，然后通过地图旅行回到狮子拱门。

ed0ed1837da585e0219333d05587ca0f12ce944f.source: Sometimes when you get within compass range of him, this quest will become completed because the nearby group of Lynx will have killed him.
ed0ed1837da585e0219333d05587ca0f12ce944f.text: 有时，当你进入他的罗盘范围内时，这个任务就会完成，因为附近的山猫群会杀死他。

1ccfb5306a6c94a000d27540c4130f172b351ef3.text: 杀死瞭望塔海岸的灾难者

d995e066f14f596178d116a6275448c933673457.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死灾难者

ef88463aacd81ed2c830224c7369c0129ece9e06.source: Start from Beetletun, go north, carefully pulling Minea the Obscene and her group. Try to avoid pulling the two nearby groups together with the boss group. If Courier Falken spawns he usually rushes ahead and pulls all three groups, so it might be preferable to just let him go in front of you and die. After the boss and the nearby groups have been taken care of, continue going north killing the small groups. Calamitous and his cronies will be on the right side at the start of the beach area.
ef88463aacd81ed2c830224c7369c0129ece9e06.text: 从 Beetletun 出发，向北走，小心地拉着淫秽的 Minea 和她的团队。尽量避免将附近的两个组与boss组拉到一起。如果信使法尔肯出现，他通常会冲到前面并拉动所有三组，所以最好让他走在你前面然后死。解决完boss和附近的小队后，继续向北杀掉小队。 Calamitous 和他的亲信将位于海滩区域起点的右侧。

3a1d5cdf0e6670055cd49cde8c6ca4f42249c390.source: Kill Carnak the Hungry in The Black Curtain
3a1d5cdf0e6670055cd49cde8c6ca4f42249c390.text: 杀死黑幕中的饥饿者卡纳克

917cb63de890107fc9e4aaad47e623e9c6af89a6.source: *BONUS* Kill Carnak the Hungry in Hard Mode
917cb63de890107fc9e4aaad47e623e9c6af89a6.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死饥饿的卡纳克

5e9003a66ea4b789a3a7e088d904e8e11e310764.source: Complete the Base Objective for 7 War Supplies
5e9003a66ea4b789a3a7e088d904e8e11e310764.text: 完成 7 种战争物资的基本目标

47841ea0d6103d6f9a8cbdfa69ea0affbd426627.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 3 War Supplies
47841ea0d6103d6f9a8cbdfa69ea0affbd426627.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外 3 件战争物资

8f9db3a8cee605358f2d5c28870c4d33141f301c.source: Fight your way south from the Temple of the Ages and head through the swamp. You will encounter another boss point before you get to the target, and beware of drop down foes near to other mobs of enemies. The boss is located beside the Kessex Peak portal.
8f9db3a8cee605358f2d5c28870c4d33141f301c.text: 从世纪神殿一路向南，穿过沼泽。在到达目标之前你会遇到另一个boss点，并小心其他敌人小怪附近的掉落敌人。 Boss 位于凯塞克斯峰传送门旁边。

78653ecd3b6bcd236aaa194ffff746f5beab399e.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Ceris

4ea923e9f2924d4c566e392ffbc8b9f61d4c4e80.source: Complete the Base Objective for 10 War Supplies.
4ea923e9f2924d4c566e392ffbc8b9f61d4c4e80.text: 完成 10 件战争物资的基本目标。

c2ea7f35ce185263788404df5cc2f23f2ac57d31.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies.
c2ea7f35ce185263788404df5cc2f23f2ac57d31.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外 5 件战争物资。

5cf15f715d9bdc49b7a1c75d2d7f14a2a6c3732d.source: Cerris is an Aura of the Lich minion master, using Death Nova to cause potent AoE damage. Accordingly, it helps to bring enchantment removal, interrupts, anti-summon skills, and/or ways to deal with minions, such as Holy damage.
5cf15f715d9bdc49b7a1c75d2d7f14a2a6c3732d.text: 塞里斯是一名巫妖光环随从大师，使用死亡新星造成强大的 AoE 伤害。因此，它有助于带来结界移除、中断、反召唤技能和/或处理小兵的方法，例如神圣伤害。

6abfc31b018cfc2173d85df5f039251a26a6142c.source: Kill Destor the Truth Seeker in Kessex Peak
6abfc31b018cfc2173d85df5f039251a26a6142c.text: 杀死凯塞克斯峰的真相探索者德斯特

6d88581d4bcfafd2d00cba71a7ea6476c347779c.source: *BONUS* Kill Destor the Truth Seeker in Hard Mode
6d88581d4bcfafd2d00cba71a7ea6476c347779c.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死真相探索者德斯特

cf9e6fce0bf72ecf9bd87f7fe44f1c2eccade011.source: The Temple of the Ages is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through The Black Curtain to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and White Mantle/Peacekeepers along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest and you will eventually run into Destor. Kill him and then claim your reward.
cf9e6fce0bf72ecf9bd87f7fe44f1c2eccade011.text: 时代神殿是科瑞塔唯一一个可以让你组成八人队伍的前哨站，所以你应该从那里开始。穿过黑幕到达凯塞克斯峰，杀死沿途的各种生物和白斗篷/维和人员。在凯塞克斯峰 (Kessex Peak)，沿着西南偏南的小路前进，您最终会遇到德斯特 (Destor)。杀掉他然后领取你的奖励。

dd7a115b4bfa92ce232fde5c017f0fa59dcccef7.source: It is efficient to do this quest with Wanted: Justiciar Amilyn and Wanted: Justiciar Marron for a total of 45 supplies in Hard Mode. These bosses are close to each other and their bounties are relatively close in the quest cycle. You still need to accept each quest on the day it's available.
dd7a115b4bfa92ce232fde5c017f0fa59dcccef7.text: 在困难模式下用通缉：正义者艾米琳和通缉：正义者马龙来完成这个任务是有效的，总共 45 个补给品。这些boss彼此距离很近，在任务周期中他们的赏金也比较接近。您仍然需要在每个任务可用之日接受它。

5340e94d00cbf3b20de2fd668ae5866f28d00e82.source: Kill Greves the Overbearing in The Black Curtain
5340e94d00cbf3b20de2fd668ae5866f28d00e82.text: 杀死黑幕中的霸道格雷夫斯

9384c16920a27d2bcc42009335cdec9f39139db8.source: *BONUS* Kill Greves the Overbearing in Hard Mode
9384c16920a27d2bcc42009335cdec9f39139db8.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死霸道格雷夫斯

ca9a46965f72eb2a732b943bd16484bbd26e72fa.source: Exit south out of Temple of the Ages and make your way toward Greves the Overbearing. There are two groups of White Mantle close together, as well as some undead pop-ups. Try to pull the groups individually, as the undead plus the two groups of White Mantle could overwhelm your party. If you aggro too much, simply retreat a small distance toward Temple of the Ages, causing the farther white mantle group to lose aggro. Be sure to focus on the priests and ritualist enemies first as they will keep Greves the Overbearing healed.
ca9a46965f72eb2a732b943bd16484bbd26e72fa.text: 从世纪神殿向南退出，朝霸道格雷夫斯方向前进。有两组白斗篷靠得很近，还有一些不死生物弹出。尝试单独拉动队伍，因为不死族加上白斗篷的两组可能会压倒你的队伍。如果你仇恨太多，只需向世纪神殿后退一小段距离，让更远的白幔团失去仇恨。请务必首先关注牧师和仪式敌人，因为他们可以让霸道格雷夫斯得到治疗。

16a6c3f1fb5efb21723d04bdb38bb00ef379a6a8.source: Sometimes Greves the Overbearing may be killed by native foes, completing your quest before you get to him.
16a6c3f1fb5efb21723d04bdb38bb00ef379a6a8.text: 有时，霸道格雷夫斯可能会被本地敌人杀死，在你找到他之前完成你的任务。

e618853d450ca58576b84c28a750f279d32a7aa3.source: Kill Insatiable Vakar in North Kryta Province
e618853d450ca58576b84c28a750f279d32a7aa3.text: 杀死北科瑞塔省的贪得无厌的瓦卡

890867d9d36eb60620c63d5e2caf833067d55a39.source: *BONUS* Kill Insatiable Vakar in Hard Mode
890867d9d36eb60620c63d5e2caf833067d55a39.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死贪得无厌的瓦卡

a01c96cd85ccd17462dd0b2815b65337b3a18d76.source: Head west out of Lion's Arch or north from D'Alessio Seaboard. There are few enemies along the way and some of them can be avoided. Additional foes will popup as you approach Vakar's location. You can avoid the spawn by pulling Vakar away.
a01c96cd85ccd17462dd0b2815b65337b3a18d76.text: 从狮子拱门向西行驶，或从达莱西奥海滨向北行驶。一路上敌人很少，有些是可以避开的。当您接近瓦卡的位置时，将会出现更多敌人。你可以通过拉开瓦卡来避免出现。

aec499c915dc387be8f7fa44ef55cbb4ce6bda8c.source: Kill Joh the Hostile in Scoundrel's Rise
aec499c915dc387be8f7fa44ef55cbb4ce6bda8c.text: 杀死恶棍崛起中的敌对者约翰

490fed0cd3a8ef4e2067b9242906010dff37b80c.source: *BONUS* Kill Joh the Hostile in Hard Mode
490fed0cd3a8ef4e2067b9242906010dff37b80c.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死敌方乔

288f599701a17597a33a3f519a431326d7d6e34b.source: Complete the Base Objective for 3 War Supplies
288f599701a17597a33a3f519a431326d7d6e34b.text: 完成 3 件战争物资的基本目标

4786845b01483a80e75fd6f50628bda61e84c0da.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supplies
4786845b01483a80e75fd6f50628bda61e84c0da.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外 1 件战争物资

0da06256b51bea4bd68fc74bb2ada1f5f2362e7b.source: Starting from Gates of Kryta head north through the various Mergoyles. Head west along the sands and you can immediately see Joh the Hostile straight ahead. Kill him to complete the quest, and return to Princess Salma for your reward.
0da06256b51bea4bd68fc74bb2ada1f5f2362e7b.text: 从科瑞塔之门出发，向北穿过各个默戈伊尔。沿着沙滩向西行驶，您可以立即看到前方的敌对者乔。杀死他即可完成任务，然后返回萨尔玛公主那里领取奖励。

5a4ecc630ed618ffc597e52c45d2e8c94c0dc610.source: Kill Justiciar Amilyn in Kessex Peak
5a4ecc630ed618ffc597e52c45d2e8c94c0dc610.text: 在凯塞克斯峰杀死审判者阿米琳

5f0e282ef4b80a0b0139712e173a338babc78f49.source: *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Amilyn in Hard Mode
5f0e282ef4b80a0b0139712e173a338babc78f49.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死正义者阿米琳

bb83b9b617790e54c9fc2ce330ce1d1e4b594ef5.source: The Temple of the Ages is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through The Black Curtain to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and White Mantle/Peacekeepers along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest, turning west at first opportunity, and you will eventually run into Amilyn. Kill her and then claim your reward.
bb83b9b617790e54c9fc2ce330ce1d1e4b594ef5.text: 时代神殿是科瑞塔唯一一个可以让你组成八人队伍的前哨站，所以你应该从那里开始。穿过黑幕到达凯塞克斯峰，杀死沿途的各种生物和白斗篷/维和人员。在凯塞克斯峰，沿着西南偏南的小路走，一有机会就向西转，最终会遇到艾米琳。杀了她，然后领取你的奖励。

0f508f644e3c7cedbabae3f59c9a4b08a98a360b.source: It is efficient to do this quest with Wanted: Destor the Truth Seeker and Wanted: Justiciar Marron for a total of 45 supplies in Hard Mode. These bosses are close to each other and their bounties are relatively close in the quest cycle. You still need to accept each quest on the day it's available.
0f508f644e3c7cedbabae3f59c9a4b08a98a360b.text: 在困难模式下用通缉：德斯特真相探索者和通缉：正义者马龙来完成这个任务是有效的，共 45 个补给品。这些boss彼此距离很近，在任务周期中他们的赏金也比较接近。您仍然需要在每个任务可用之日接受它。

f109e7497e241422db41f5655d64f29463463114.source: Kill Justiciar Kasandra in D'Alessio Seaboard
f109e7497e241422db41f5655d64f29463463114.text: 在达莱西奥海岸杀死审判者卡桑德拉

59257ff6aad085bba29a30bbeba3650c39d70da6.source: Kill Justiciar Kasandra in Hard Mode
59257ff6aad085bba29a30bbeba3650c39d70da6.text: 在困难模式中杀死正义者卡珊德拉

2e78280e8ee578545acbc4bf84099c1727c1073e.source: Complete the Base Objective for 15 War Supplies
2e78280e8ee578545acbc4bf84099c1727c1073e.text: 完成 15 种战争物资的基本目标

afe1547f20100452ff8c53e4885a5fe4cf14c630.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 7 War Supplies
afe1547f20100452ff8c53e4885a5fe4cf14c630.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外的 7 件战争物资

85f9020b9ba76fe96c6e1dca2604696af2ab4358.source: Talk to Jiaju Tai at the docks in Lions Arch to gain passage to D'Alessio Seaboard. The Jade Cloak in Justiciar Kasandra's group can be isolated, but the others are more difficult to pull. This group has so many casters bunched in a tight area that a Mesmer armed with Panic can neutralize them, even in hard mode.
85f9020b9ba76fe96c6e1dca2604696af2ab4358.text: 在狮子拱门的码头与家驹泰交谈，获得前往达莱西奥海岸的通道。审判者卡珊德拉一行人的玉斗篷可以隔离，但其他的就比较难拉了。这个团体有如此多的施法者聚集在一个狭窄的区域，即使在困难模式下，配备恐慌的幻术师也可以压制他们。

02b095d75731ab8cc024325b262eba5abcfc1d7d.source: To break apart the Boss group, start by going left after crossing the bridge to take out all the enemies in the circular route around the fortress. Return to the central plaza. As soon as they attack, pull back and head left down the path, leaving some spirits (or minions) in the path; some of the group will attack and follow. Repeat until those foes move beyond the outer walls. Then, move down the road.
02b095d75731ab8cc024325b262eba5abcfc1d7d.text: 要打散Boss队伍，首先过桥后向左走，消灭要塞周围环形路线上的所有敌人。返回中央广场。一旦他们攻击，就向后退并沿着路径向左走，在路径中留下一些灵魂（或小兵）；一些群体会攻击并跟随。重复此操作，直到敌人移出外墙。然后，沿着路走。

e0061748f99df19103c933cd19f301537f3c0eff.source: Those separated will try go back to original position in center; some will make it through the gate, others will get stuck in outer wall. Your party should always return to the middle of the bridge when aggroed, leaving minions and/or spirits to engage the foe and weaken them. Continue to pull the White Mantle mobs until the plaza is clear, then ensure that no additional spawns can surprise you by circling the fortress, clearing any remaining Mantle from the area. Once complete, the main target force can be attacked, again relying on minions/spirits to bear the brunt of the foes attacks.
e0061748f99df19103c933cd19f301537f3c0eff.text: 分开的人会尝试回到原来的中心位置；有些人会穿过大门，有些人会被困在外墙里。当你的队伍受到攻击时，应该总是返回桥的中间，留下小兵和/或灵魂来与敌人交战并削弱他们。继续拉动白斗篷小怪，直到广场被清理干净，然后通过绕着堡垒转圈，清除该区域中任何剩余的斗篷，确保没有额外的生成会让你感到惊讶。完成后，可以攻击主要目标部队，再次依靠小兵/灵魂来承受敌人的攻击。

06be1b055f38d10f56bc4d0fa9a658aee261fd5b.text: 在无法忍受的神殿期间

dfd12ac90f65e49676f2ca024917cf0b2780104d.source: If Temple of the Intolerable mission is active, foes will not appear in the town. Speak to Dinas to enter through the gate and follow the Intolerable walkthrough. However you must kill Justiciar Kasandra before Koril the Malignant, otherwise you will not have time to complete the bounty.
dfd12ac90f65e49676f2ca024917cf0b2780104d.text: 如果无法忍受的神殿任务处于活动状态，敌人将不会出现在城镇中。与迪纳斯交谈，进入大门并按照无法忍受的演练进行操作。然而你必须在恶毒者科瑞尔之前杀死审判者卡桑德拉，否则你将没有时间完成赏金。

952099b41bba21abb085cc6a402200a9ace2fd42.source: If you wait three days after taking this quest, you can do it together with Zaln the Jaded.
952099b41bba21abb085cc6a402200a9ace2fd42.text: 如果你在接受这个任务后等待三天，你可以和疲倦的扎恩一起完成。

1122ca94b599f9c598ab06263362dbaf4188c0c3.source: If you die while in the D'Alessio Seaboard explorable area you will be resurrected on the southern beach where you entered.
1122ca94b599f9c598ab06263362dbaf4188c0c3.text: 如果您在达莱西奥海滨探索区域死亡，您将在您进入的南部海滩上复活。

718d2d9300eef1a7af06adfc139c7bd769385e9f.source: The available Level 10 henchmen are ineffective in normal mode against the Level 20+ foes. If you must include henchmen, use those that can offer AoE skills and pull carefully to take advantage of that.
718d2d9300eef1a7af06adfc139c7bd769385e9f.text: 可用的 10 级追随者在正常模式下对 20 级以上的敌人无效。如果你必须包括追随者，请使用那些可以提供 AoE 技能的人，并小心地利用这一点。

68c750c50748105bbf7cbc22923ac052b6f03ac8.source: Make your life easier by using the (repaired) bridge linking the Offering sites from the mission to get behind the Boss group.
68c750c50748105bbf7cbc22923ac052b6f03ac8.text: 使用（已修复的）桥梁连接任务中的奉献地点，让你的生活变得更轻松，以躲到 Boss 队伍后面。

b2485c3e875ddceb52366b6c99784a81bb03b9a0.source: The text for the bonus objective is phrased as if it were a second objective (rather than a bonus one).
b2485c3e875ddceb52366b6c99784a81bb03b9a0.text: 奖励目标的文本措辞就好像它是第二个目标（而不是奖励目标）。

e8f7f7e6be0db78ef5fdc86fb35aaa1fd9d1c230.source: Gain passage to Riverside Province and Kill Justiciar Kimii
e8f7f7e6be0db78ef5fdc86fb35aaa1fd9d1c230.text: 进入河滨省并杀死审判官基米

c8169ba60b0de7243f95351b33df5ec051b7e4a1.source: *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Kimii in Hard Mode
c8169ba60b0de7243f95351b33df5ec051b7e4a1.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死正义者 Kimii

c8028034ee05c629b16a58c7d5d79d74b8f19b27.source: Despite the quest marker leading you to Riverside Province, begin from Sanctum Cay by speaking with Blade Operative Paulina. Once inside, it is simply a matter of making your way to the Temple of the Unseen and killing your target; As she uses Conviction and Armor of Sanctity, you might consider enchantment removals and/or Weaken Armor to make killing her easier.
c8028034ee05c629b16a58c7d5d79d74b8f19b27.text: 尽管任务标记引导你前往河滨省，但还是从圣岛开始与刀锋特工宝琳娜交谈。一旦进入，你只需前往看不见的神殿并杀死你的目标即可；当她使用定罪和神圣护甲时，你可能会考虑移除结界和/或削弱护甲，以便更容易杀死她。

bf3fe18f02f4d5f1014edc09188d107b60707539.source: Note that Kimii can be killed during Riverside Assassination, but it's much harder to reach her with the quest active.
bf3fe18f02f4d5f1014edc09188d107b60707539.text: 请注意，Kimii 可以在河滨刺杀期间被杀死，但在任务激活时找到她要困难得多。

d9e44c69489e13d0c0f2639493a2db8c2e97dc51.source: Kill Justiciar Marron in Kessex Peak
d9e44c69489e13d0c0f2639493a2db8c2e97dc51.text: 在凯塞克斯峰杀死审判官马龙

b9e318517601b9562094e66ca2a6da96d6f71f07.source: *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Marron in Hard Mode
b9e318517601b9562094e66ca2a6da96d6f71f07.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死正义者马龙

2f17bfebda947ec9df1a504cff67c7dc95253346.source: The Temple of the Ages is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through The Black Curtain to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and White Mantle/Peacekeepers along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest, towards the southern edge of the map, and you will eventually run into Marron. Kill him and then claim your reward.
2f17bfebda947ec9df1a504cff67c7dc95253346.text: 时代神殿是科瑞塔唯一一个可以让你组成八人队伍的前哨站，所以你应该从那里开始。穿过黑幕到达凯塞克斯峰，杀死沿途的各种生物和白斗篷/维和人员。在凯塞克斯峰，沿着西南偏南的小路，向地图的南边缘前进，您最终会遇到马龙。杀掉他然后领取你的奖励。

856980f2b9df5d7b9e47ea3768fa84460bd1e889.source: It is efficient to do this quest with Wanted: Destor the Truth Seeker and Wanted: Justiciar Amilyn for a total of 45 supplies in Hard Mode. These bosses are close to each other and their bounties are relatively close in the quest cycle. You still need to accept each quest on the day it's available.
856980f2b9df5d7b9e47ea3768fa84460bd1e889.text: 在困难模式下用通缉：德斯特真相探索者和通缉：正义者阿米琳来完成这个任务是有效的，总共 45 个补给品。这些boss彼此距离很近，在任务周期中他们的赏金也比较接近。您仍然需要在每个任务可用之日接受它。

4d61af0eb0c0514d02716a96b1aea5daed7af95d.source: Take the Secret River Passage to Divinity Coast and kill Justiciar Sevaan.
4d61af0eb0c0514d02716a96b1aea5daed7af95d.text: 沿着秘密河流通道前往神性海岸并杀死审判者塞瓦安。

4ebaced986080ccdb8593bb5eafc0a2b77154afe.source: *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Sevaan in Hard Mode
4ebaced986080ccdb8593bb5eafc0a2b77154afe.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死正义者塞瓦安

af1af6196a570510bcafd90a2939a07f1a757ea3.source: Make your way (preferably from Temple of the Ages) to the Secret River Passage located in the north of Talmark Wilderness.
af1af6196a570510bcafd90a2939a07f1a757ea3.text: 前往（最好从世纪神殿出发）前往位于塔尔马克荒野北部的秘密河道。

b413b682a5e6b7f8aa1ae0602645dc60e0b654a6.source: To reach the Divinity Coast, exit from the Temple of the Ages into The Black Curtain and head to Talmark Wilderness. The Secret River Passage is on a patch of sand, next to Ember Whisperwind.
b413b682a5e6b7f8aa1ae0602645dc60e0b654a6.text: 要到达神性海岸，请从时代神殿出口进入黑幕，然后前往塔尔马克荒野。秘密河道位于一片沙地上，紧邻灰烬语风。

08e1ce3dbdbbd5804c5bb1705e1f9a4c06daf739.source: Combines well with A Little Help From Above, which also requires you to kill Justicar Sevaan.
08e1ce3dbdbbd5804c5bb1705e1f9a4c06daf739.text: 与上面的一点帮助很好地结合在一起，这也需要你杀死正义卡塞瓦安。

7d12f6c5121bc34ec443c473030031224d3000d9.source: Kill Lev the Condemned in North Kryta Province
7d12f6c5121bc34ec443c473030031224d3000d9.text: 杀死北科瑞塔省的死刑犯列夫

74599539302ca96b5ed2a265948a5e827776a428.source: *BONUS* Kill Lev the Condemned in Hard Mode
74599539302ca96b5ed2a265948a5e827776a428.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死被定罪者列夫

511baeef080226b7f2ca2028e42ca9629b45b3d0.source: If doing this quest with henchmen in normal mode, start from Bergen Hot Springs (with level 12 henchmen) rather than Lion's Arch (where they are level 10).
511baeef080226b7f2ca2028e42ca9629b45b3d0.text: 如果在正常模式下与追随者一起执行此任务，请从卑尔根温泉（有 12 级追随者）开始，而不是从狮子拱门（那里有 10 级）开始。

c2129a86442a26e1f0563b8ba7f452b19e32eec0.source: Once in North Kryta Province, pull Lev to the Ascalon Settlement, so that the friendly NPCs can help to defeat her. Unless your party can spike the boss, take down Lev's associates first and save her for last.
