c2129a86442a26e1f0563b8ba7f452b19e32eec0.text: 到达北科瑞塔省后，将列夫拉到阿斯卡隆定居点，以便友好的 NPC 帮助击败她。除非你的队伍能打败老板，否则先干掉列夫的同伙，最后再救她。

93d4b860c320c6c3ce782f64c1c993b23023f135.source: Kill Maximilian the Meticulous in Nebo Terrace
93d4b860c320c6c3ce782f64c1c993b23023f135.text: 在尼波台杀死一丝不苟的马克西米利安

2dc75de0d76bbb67fc879a23f39dc88eb67d544b.source: *BONUS* Kill Maximilian the Meticulous in Hard Mode
2dc75de0d76bbb67fc879a23f39dc88eb67d544b.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死一丝不苟的马克西米利安

bb5551f86394d5abdb2b580f3d4a43d43f60be4e.source: Exit Bergen Hot Springs and follow the northwesterly route to Maximilian. If you can tackle the undead just outside the springs, the rest of the journey should be uneventful. However, if the Skeleton rangers give you trouble, you could start from Beetletun instead, taking a longer route to avoid tackling the larger groups.
bb5551f86394d5abdb2b580f3d4a43d43f60be4e.text: 离开卑尔根温泉，沿着西北路线前往马克西米利安。如果你能在泉水外面解决不死生物，剩下的旅程应该会平安无事。然而，如果骷髅游侠给你带来麻烦，你可以从 Beetletun 出发，走更长的路线以避免对付更大的群体。

eaeb287b3be19c36becc5fb697ccdff6834b6ba1.source: You can use any party that works well in the War in Kryta, although holy damage (e.g. through Smiting Prayers) is useful against the undead along the route. Frozen Soil will help by preventing White Mantle/Peacekeeper groups from resurrecting (but remember to avoid using it when the foes are the undead).
eaeb287b3be19c36becc5fb697ccdff6834b6ba1.text: 你可以使用任何在科瑞塔战争中表现良好的队伍，尽管神圣伤害（例如通过重击祈祷）对于对抗沿途的不死生物很有用。冻土将有助于阻止白斗篷/和平卫士团体复活（但请记住当敌人是不死生物时避免使用它）。

8be55921e37cddba47c748ee578c88f46a078b3a.source: Kill Sarnia the Red-Handed in North Kryta Province
8be55921e37cddba47c748ee578c88f46a078b3a.text: 杀死北科瑞塔省的红手萨尼亚

4b9a6172368a90d91384504e35a083e5f373e5a2.source: *BONUS* Kill Sarnia the Red-Handed in Hard Mode
4b9a6172368a90d91384504e35a083e5f373e5a2.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死红手萨尼亚

6e4151cc41d5d2b1a133092087abc05d6d51b8ef.source: Complete the Base Objective for 3 War Supplies.
6e4151cc41d5d2b1a133092087abc05d6d51b8ef.text: 完成 3 件战争物资的基本目标。

a413c5a56fbc34ac64ac0eff01bb8730e312fe47.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supply.
a413c5a56fbc34ac64ac0eff01bb8730e312fe47.text: 完成*奖励*目标可获得额外 1 件战争补给品。

debeb71d8b0480e538510bdd5b2db441206ea9ca.source: Since Sarnia is an assassin, skills that deal damage on attacks are highly effective, such as Spiteful Spirit, Empathy, or Insidious Parasite. Note that hexes and conditions last only half their normal duration because Sarnia is a Prophecies boss.
debeb71d8b0480e538510bdd5b2db441206ea9ca.text: 由于萨尼亚是一名刺客，因此在攻击时造成伤害的技能非常有效，例如恶意之灵、移情或阴险寄生虫。请注意，六角形和条件仅持续正常持续时间的一半，因为萨尼亚是预言 Boss。

f248c8fd4a7f957e635523671fe2ad2531bd3284.source: Sarnia will not spawn when you have the quest Defend North Kryta Province active.
f248c8fd4a7f957e635523671fe2ad2531bd3284.text: 当您激活保卫北科瑞塔省任务时，萨尼亚不会生成。

140061bf3e7c363232cc094c8b9204154b1e3c08.source: Kill Selenas the Blunt in Twin Serpent Lakes
140061bf3e7c363232cc094c8b9204154b1e3c08.text: 在双蛇湖杀死钝器赛琳娜

f6f9af387920cbf1133171ed32aeeb8da4b5a9fb.source: *BONUS* Kill Selenas the Blunt in Hard Mode
f6f9af387920cbf1133171ed32aeeb8da4b5a9fb.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死钝器赛琳娜

25dd25c0e6b41b0abff1d822bd6061ba8926d20c.source: From Riverside Province, go north and around the bend. You will kill plenty of White Mantle/Peacekeeper groups. Travel along the west side of the lake, and you will eventually run into Selenas the Blunt. Kill her, and return to Princess Salma for your reward. Be careful when pulling mobs as they tend to congregate together and threaten to overwhelm unprepared parties (especially of H/H)
25dd25c0e6b41b0abff1d822bd6061ba8926d20c.text: 从河滨省 (Riverside Province) 出发，向北行驶并绕过拐弯处。你将杀死大量的白斗篷/维和人员团体。沿着湖的西侧行驶，你最终会遇到“钝器”赛琳娜。杀死她，然后回到萨尔玛公主那里领取奖励。拉动小怪时要小心，因为它们往往会聚集在一起并威胁压倒没有准备的队伍（尤其是 H/H）

df1ee3d0b26397b2253f8293ec839c12154b844a.source: Selenas appears near Valis the Rampant, whose bounty is available four days earlier.
df1ee3d0b26397b2253f8293ec839c12154b844a.text: 赛琳娜出现在猖獗的瓦利斯附近，四天前他的赏金就已经发放了。

399fe4cd570aace4d0f5ad8e2f581c8756049a1f.source: Kill Valis the Rampant in Twin Serpent Lakes
399fe4cd570aace4d0f5ad8e2f581c8756049a1f.text: 杀死双蛇湖中的猖獗者瓦利斯

e0e1352054096714fd1002bd3111acd3e041024a.source: *BONUS* Kill Valis the Rampant in Hard Mode
e0e1352054096714fd1002bd3111acd3e041024a.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死猖獗的瓦利斯

da3b8624221df7822d7d550a1b54b72a1d3b67ea.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supplies.
da3b8624221df7822d7d550a1b54b72a1d3b67ea.text: 完成*奖励*目标以获得额外 1 件战争物资。

c576cf298004833c67460b826c8f278faeffc285.source: This quest can be done with a hero/henchmen team (even though the hench will be level 15). It helps to bring your own healer, because the hench monk is probably not strong enough to keep your party alive.
c576cf298004833c67460b826c8f278faeffc285.text: 该任务可以由英雄/追随者团队完成（即使追随者等级为 15）。带上你自己的治疗师会很有帮助，因为随从武僧可能不够强大，无法让你的队伍存活下来。

5c801de584cf54b2e019dd096fcfbba0cd88c5cd.source: Reaching Valis is easy, as there are only a few small groups of White Mantle along the way. Once you reach the target, take out the healers (priest and ritualists) first before taking down the rest of group.
5c801de584cf54b2e019dd096fcfbba0cd88c5cd.text: 到达瓦利斯很容易，因为沿途只有少数白斗篷小团体。一旦你到达目标，先干掉治疗师（牧师和仪式师），然后再干掉团队的其他人。

be933a6093fb80d78b73b7ddd9e04e73edcfedd1.source: It helps to bring plenty of anti-melee to help defend against each group's archers/warriors. Blinding skills are especially useful.
be933a6093fb80d78b73b7ddd9e04e73edcfedd1.text: 它有助于带来大量的反近战能力，以帮助防御每个群体的弓箭手/战士。致盲技能特别有用。

7bc32a15d66ea9af30940fe79e25c0920a52faf4.source: Valis appears near Selenas the Blunt, whose bounty is available four days later.
7bc32a15d66ea9af30940fe79e25c0920a52faf4.text: 瓦利斯出现在“钝器”赛琳娜附近，四天后即可获得赏金。

7176785d83a273a33bbb049027d581012b0e21ee.source: Kill Vess the Disputant in Divinity Coast
7176785d83a273a33bbb049027d581012b0e21ee.text: 杀死神性海岸的争论者维斯

059ac2b968279a3099e8cb9d75bdafc2af1938d6.source: *BONUS* Kill Vess the Disputant in Hard Mode
059ac2b968279a3099e8cb9d75bdafc2af1938d6.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死争议者维斯

1c9cf895db8f53f77e0b5468d3bdf4249efeee26.source: Make your way (preferably from Temple of the Ages) to the Secret River Passage located in the north of Talmark Wilderness, and continue north and then west along the path indicated on the map. Beware of the patrols that can engage the party when making your way west. Always prioritize the enemy healers first, taking down groups by simply luring them one group at a time if attempted in Hard Mode.
1c9cf895db8f53f77e0b5468d3bdf4249efeee26.text: 前往（最好从世纪神殿出发）前往位于塔尔马克荒野北部的秘密河道，然后沿着地图上指示的路径继续向北，然后向西。当你向西行进时，要小心可能会与队伍发生冲突的巡逻队。始终优先考虑敌方治疗者，如果在困难模式下尝试，只需一次引诱一组即可将其击倒。

cb8951a1be0d7f2c88be36f08778f9300df91d14.source: When you have reached the castle that Vess the Disputant calls home, you will see a group of 3 enemies on the bridge directly in front of Vess' group. This group contains a warrior boss called Cairn the Berserker. You can lure this boss separately using a longbow, before approaching Vess' group.
cb8951a1be0d7f2c88be36f08778f9300df91d14.text: 当你到达争议者 Vess 称之为家的城堡时，你会在 Vess 队伍正前方的桥上看到一群 3 名敌人。该小组包含一个名为狂战士凯恩的战士首领。在接近 Vess 的队伍之前，你可以使用长弓单独引诱这个 Boss。

4eaa450555f49e118c9fd734d2b259cd73cbd155.source: It is worth taking the bounty if A Little Help From Above is active, since you can kill Vess on the way to completing that mission.
4eaa450555f49e118c9fd734d2b259cd73cbd155.text: 如果“上面的一点帮助”处于活动状态，那么获得赏金是值得的，因为您可以在完成该任务的途中杀死 Vess。

f9a6c007d8b77b00d22c2c8cc9f0e60d8a38f246.source: Though Vess has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns in the quest dialogue.
f9a6c007d8b77b00d22c2c8cc9f0e60d8a38f246.text: 尽管维斯有着女性化的外表，但在任务对话中却用男性代词来称呼他。

4ba66c6d88a9a577bd488eeec0bfe00bec4e011b.source: Gain passage to D'Alessio Seaboard and kill Zaln the Jaded
4ba66c6d88a9a577bd488eeec0bfe00bec4e011b.text: 到达达莱西奥海岸并杀死疲倦的扎恩

3247ca41fc578686272dd0e43495e91e01d3f1a3.source: *BONUS* Kill Zaln the Jaded in Hard Mode
3247ca41fc578686272dd0e43495e91e01d3f1a3.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死疲倦的扎恩

c2a1e8723c331c3727cfb15d6f0657783d241e73.source: Talk to Jiaju Tai in Lions Arch to gain access to D'Alessio Seaboard (explorable area). The party will spawn at the beach south of the village Hakewood.
c2a1e8723c331c3727cfb15d6f0657783d241e73.text: 与狮子拱门的贾居·泰交谈以进入达莱西奥海岸（可探索区域）。该队伍将在哈克伍德村以南的海滩产卵。

d7ad6b0089f093f25d6cb8c9d43735fbf6723e46.source: If any party member has Temple of the Intolerable active, there are no hostile White Mantle inside the village. Talk to Dinas (at the west gate), then leave the village through the northern gate. Otherwise, the party will have to fight through the village. Avoid engaging multiple groups at once.
d7ad6b0089f093f25d6cb8c9d43735fbf6723e46.text: 如果任何党员都活跃着不可忍受的神殿，那么村庄内就没有敌对的白斗篷。与迪纳斯（在西门）交谈，然后通过北门离开村庄。否则，该党将不得不通过村庄进行战斗。避免同时参与多个群体。

ab62b6de3a7649d7dcea8ddaef77ab83ddc337ef.source: Zaln the Jaded can be found just north of Hakewood, along with a small mob of White Mantle and a Jade Cloak or a Jade Armor.
ab62b6de3a7649d7dcea8ddaef77ab83ddc337ef.text: 翡翠者扎恩可以在哈克伍德北部找到，还有一小群白斗篷和翡翠斗篷或翡翠盔甲。

a212219bacbcc16ccf1d02f94a30002056a08c9d.source: Killing Justiciar Kasandra, whose bounty is offered three days earlier, can be combined with this quest.
a212219bacbcc16ccf1d02f94a30002056a08c9d.text: 杀死审判官卡桑德拉，其赏金是在三天前发出的，可以与这个任务结合起来。

7e7db824a69db1d37cf09d6e0524e27731043fe7.source: Rescue three warband members from the Cathedral of Flames in the Charr homelands.
7e7db824a69db1d37cf09d6e0524e27731043fe7.text: 从查尔故乡的火焰大教堂营救三名战帮成员。

4fbbda81e9ed972de4d4593766a2708f83788279.source: As per Warband of Brothers quest.

925fa4adf97399256aa19dc538fdcb2595efce21.source: Protect Arborstone from the wardens. You have 4 groups remaining.
925fa4adf97399256aa19dc538fdcb2595efce21.text: 保护阿伯斯通免受典狱长的侵害。您还剩下 4 组。

6f2660c4da2690fc2592f89472066350b69f7921.source: Follow the quest indicator a short distance to find Terrik zu Heltzer. He will be set upon by four groups of two level 24 Wardens, although he does not need to survive to complete the quest.
6f2660c4da2690fc2592f89472066350b69f7921.text: 跟随任务指示符走一小段距离即可找到泰里克·祖·赫尔策 (Terrik zu Heltzer)。他将受到四组两名 24 级守望者的攻击，尽管他不需要生存来完成任务。

671053c3d2ab5d3efe81670cd8a69bbb08e33987.source: As long as you do not get mobbed, the quest should be simple to complete successfully. Watch out for the Wardens of Earth, who can cause considerable damage and can knock you down.
671053c3d2ab5d3efe81670cd8a69bbb08e33987.text: 只要你不被围攻，任务应该很容易成功完成。小心地球守护者，他们会造成相当大的伤害，并可能把你击倒。

8a9c5781d01b26aadda4df02f1a8b0230f903362.text:
* Canthan（派系）角色
* 主要职业：战士

9693d6395c82258595cf71f55b968102aa8d0eac.source: This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. These sub-quests must be completed individually before the next sub-quest may be taken. The order of completion is entirely optional. The four sub-quests are listed in the objectives.
9693d6395c82258595cf71f55b968102aa8d0eac.text: 该任务需要完成吴教练给出的四个子任务。这些子任务必须在进行下一个子任务之前单独完成。完成的顺序完全是可选的。目标中列出了四个子任务。

fc1d9e3ac9b8ac17106a6340418815b7a2653cdc.source: Go to Green Hills County and defeat Agnar the Foot. (Use Hammer Bash to interrupt his Rage skill.)
fc1d9e3ac9b8ac17106a6340418815b7a2653cdc.text: 前往青山县并击败脚阿格纳尔。 （使用锤击打断他的狂暴技能。）

06889ee7d29b133236cbc387ef40c94debb60a5d.source: Duke Barradin will give you a Starter Hammer and the following skills upon taking the quest:
06889ee7d29b133236cbc387ef40c94debb60a5d.text: 接受任务后，巴拉丁公爵会给你一把入门锤和以下技能：

aee8e3682a3a4c4b25bb202f16479d086a8fe580.source: Agnar the Foot can be found on a hill south east of The Barradin Estate. He will not attack until he is attacked.
aee8e3682a3a4c4b25bb202f16479d086a8fe580.text: 阿格纳尔脚可以在巴拉丁庄园东南部的一座小山上找到。在受到攻击之前，他不会攻击。

1d32b69e25818d507a7513e2edfc9c8ce2e6e092.source: When his health goes below 50%, he will use his unique skill Agnar's Rage to knock foes down while healing himself.
1d32b69e25818d507a7513e2edfc9c8ce2e6e092.text: 当他的生命值低于50%时，他会使用他的独特技能阿格纳尔之怒击倒敌人，同时治疗自己。

5c9f422a2280f3ce99e5210e9f45a6f6bd967cb9.source: The quest is designed to favor the use of a hammer, as:
5c9f422a2280f3ce99e5210e9f45a6f6bd967cb9.text: 该任务旨在支持使用锤子，因为：

1d22541a5b20ccac32f0b82df2190d99c7b7d92c.source: Agnar is weak to blunt damage,
1d22541a5b20ccac32f0b82df2190d99c7b7d92c.text: 阿格纳尔的钝击伤害较弱，

0c5c6e302f8acbbf0435ff20b6efe62ff3deee4b.source: Hammer Bash and Bane Signet are the only skills in pre-Searing that can interrupt Agnar's Rage.
0c5c6e302f8acbbf0435ff20b6efe62ff3deee4b.text: 锤击和祸根徽记是灼热前唯一可以打断阿格纳尔之怒的技能。

a2aea5ca7c8fcdba4c54e19bc41966844fe99360.source: With enough damage output however, you can usually kill him before he gets the chance to heal.
a2aea5ca7c8fcdba4c54e19bc41966844fe99360.text: 然而，如果有足够的伤害输出，你通常可以在他有机会治愈之前杀死他。

51486c04de121f17b8a612d315b8df599fd124cf.source: Recover some prismatic gelatinous material from the ooze pit.
51486c04de121f17b8a612d315b8df599fd124cf.text: 从软泥坑中回收一些棱柱状凝胶状物质。

ce2a8bb751b239a78f2737b874255c59994df88f.source: Transport the prismatic gelatinous material to Seer Fiercereign.
ce2a8bb751b239a78f2737b874255c59994df88f.text: 将棱柱状凝胶材料运送到 Seer Fiercereign。

5206b524478f832ff265fd91d1aca75ce5021c01.source: Clear Watchtower Coast in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
5206b524478f832ff265fd91d1aca75ce5021c01.text: 在困难模式下清除科瑞塔瞭望塔海岸的所有敌人。

fd7b56d19871feb62a0abf421422a10ea4295c77.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.97% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
fd7b56d19871feb62a0abf421422a10ea4295c77.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 0.97%。

0f6d615d28c7de1f30e6330bdfd29628370289c4.source: This is the only explorable area in Prophecies that cannot be reached via caravan by a party of 8.
0f6d615d28c7de1f30e6330bdfd29628370289c4.text: 这是《预言》中唯一一个 8 人小队无法通过商队到达的可探索区域。

ab3cdf531ffde01ea9a1041f3afa6a54f379a2f6.source: {{Vanquisher|count = 160|low = 135|high = 176|notes=There are usually a few hidden Spined Aloes near the Oakhearts.}}
ab3cdf531ffde01ea9a1041f3afa6a54f379a2f6.text: {{Vanquisher|count = 160|low = 135|high = 176|notes=Oakhearts 附近通常有一些隐藏的刺芦荟。}}

01311a79f5c46539c3de09e922b4108ff21e2b12.source: The Undead Hordes will increase the number of foes in this area.
01311a79f5c46539c3de09e922b4108ff21e2b12.text: 亡灵部落将增加该地区的敌人数量。

9f825928b014f6bedcced82f9c94400d1563579f.source: Escort Kane back to Curator Ruras.
9f825928b014f6bedcced82f9c94400d1563579f.text: 护送凯恩回到鲁拉斯馆长身边。

e575e14080bddfeaee9d4bfa86dc9a5d6659ffda.source: See Curator Ruras for your reward.
e575e14080bddfeaee9d4bfa86dc9a5d6659ffda.text: 请见馆长鲁拉斯以获得奖励。

50861135edaa329524083042f4599bddd9462321.source: Start from the Lair of the Forgotten, and follow the quest pointer to track down the missing guide, Kane. Note that Kane is located on a rocky outcrop on the east side of The Shattered Ravines, which cannot be traveled while in wurm form. The party will find Kane under interrogation by a Margonite group when they arrive and the group will become hostile and attack the party. Once the Margonites are defeated, escort Kane back to Curator Ruras just outside the Lair of the Forgotten.
50861135edaa329524083042f4599bddd9462321.text: 从被遗忘者的巢穴出发，按照任务指针寻找失踪的向导凯恩。请注意，凯恩位于破碎峡谷东侧的岩石露头上，在亚龙形态下无法移动。当队伍到达时，他们会发现凯恩正在接受玛贡派的审讯，而该队伍会变得敌对并攻击队伍。击败玛贡尼特后，护送凯恩回到被遗忘者巢穴外的策展人鲁拉斯。

24d396b73181e2d8d8c3de70becd02232d09052e.source: Hostile creatures do not attack Kane while he is being escorted back to Curator Ruras, and since he is level 20, he is unlikely to come to much harm unless the party encounter severe AoE damage.
24d396b73181e2d8d8c3de70becd02232d09052e.text: 当凯恩被护送回鲁拉斯馆长时，敌对生物不会攻击凯恩，而且由于他的等级为 20 级，除非队伍遭遇严重的 AoE 伤害，否则他不太可能受到太大伤害。

8f02d83c02ff48c0538b232e2a5be974cc114c5f.source: Although it is not necessary to use wurms to travel (since the party does not cross the Sulfurous Haze), there is a Wurm Spoor a little way south of the Lair, which can allow the party to travel part of the way as wurms should they wish to.
8f02d83c02ff48c0538b232e2a5be974cc114c5f.text: 虽然没有必要使用亚龙旅行（因为队伍不会穿越硫磺雾霾），但在巢穴以南不远的地方有一个亚龙足迹，如果队伍愿意的话，它可以让队伍像亚龙一样旅行一段路程。

b7a6fa232e51e9d2b69a9313f7ce8d107469eed9.source: If any player in the party has completed this quest, neither Kane nor the margonites will appear.
b7a6fa232e51e9d2b69a9313f7ce8d107469eed9.text: 如果队伍中的任何玩家完成了这个任务，凯恩和玛贡尼特都不会出现。

7d9f7fa421a7364a0943649ac95a442c16182d32.source: This quest becomes unobtainable after the Rilohn Refuge mission is completed.
7d9f7fa421a7364a0943649ac95a442c16182d32.text: 瑞洛恩避难所任务完成后，该任务将无法完成。

1e1a54a5fff733b29fb1e557b9ce7fdba83769a9.source: Explore the area surrounding the Waterworks.
1e1a54a5fff733b29fb1e557b9ce7fdba83769a9.text: 探索自来水厂周边地区。

a8d27dacba49fca812830b4371adedfa50db9213.source: The best starting point for this quest is Rilohn Refuge, since the initial objective is just south of the outpost. Exploring the area, you will find Turlon, who is under attack from a group of heket, rescue him to complete the quest.
a8d27dacba49fca812830b4371adedfa50db9213.text: 该任务的最佳起点是里洛恩避难所，因为最初的目标就在前哨站的南面。探索该地区，你会发现Turlon，他正受到一群heket的攻击，营救他即可完成任务。

9b50193b14ba381d9120bc2d6c7ac8179bbe9eeb.source: Occasionally, the Heket will attack each other.
9b50193b14ba381d9120bc2d6c7ac8179bbe9eeb.text: 有时，赫克特人会互相攻击。

6a93e845f00989eb96dbbe737945c705380fe67d.text: 找到被俘虏的部落战士。

f552f13b5ec6b57dc84ad5447e21a2d4d0d9e18c.source: Kill the corsairs guarding the clansmen.

a7f613f0ff29d6f30c25a09c501eaab8145c91cd.source: Bring the surviving clansmen back to Blacktide Den.
a7f613f0ff29d6f30c25a09c501eaab8145c91cd.text: 将幸存的族人带回黑潮巢穴。

f2a111d5c9e1e1b91f5e0b1a629a834119b5ad19.source: After entering Lahtenda Bog from Blacktide Den, head south killing foes along the way. Bounties can be beneficial as there are many Mandragor groups along the way. Also make sure to get the Corsair bounty considering you will get a lot of Corsair kills.
f2a111d5c9e1e1b91f5e0b1a629a834119b5ad19.text: 从黑潮巢穴进入拉滕达沼泽后，向南杀掉沿途的敌人。赏金可能是有益的，因为沿途有许多曼德拉戈尔团体。还要确保获得海盗船的赏金，因为你会得到很多海盗船的杀戮。

115e735e265c81f14897c1ce8ee4dc19fa4f2534.source: Once you get to a huge mob of Corsairs it is recommended to pull the groups individually and fight them off one by one as rushing in might lead to being overwhelmed. Keep pulling and be prepared for Corsair popups.
115e735e265c81f14897c1ce8ee4dc19fa4f2534.text: 一旦你遇到一大群海盗，建议单独拉动这些团体并一一击退他们，因为冲进去可能会导致被淹没。继续拉动并为 Corsair 弹出窗口做好准备。

5f167873cbf94b9d2802c6e63a79ab952fce9500.source: Once you get the clansmen, be prepared for the way back because now there are random spawns of Corsairs throughout the rest of the map, which means that the route you took might not be clear anymore. Head back up to Blacktide Den as you will complete the mission once you get to the portal.
5f167873cbf94b9d2802c6e63a79ab952fce9500.text: 一旦你找到了族人，就准备好回去的路，因为现在地图的其余部分都会随机出现海盗，这意味着你所走的路线可能不再清晰。返回黑潮巢穴，因为一旦到达传送门，您就完成了任务。

68d43bad0a6b2c5dea1d132ac9350693c0762ed7.source: It is recommended to have a minion master along with the party considering there are many corpses. Do keep in mind that the minions tend to go out of earshot meaning that you will get more Corsairs than expected. Be prepared.
68d43bad0a6b2c5dea1d132ac9350693c0762ed7.text: 考虑到尸体很多，建议有一个随从大师和队伍一起。请记住，小兵往往会超出听力范围，这意味着您会遇到比预期更多的海盗。做好准备。

93954e0042af4539dbdc194eb9ccaa22b3a50c9c.source: If you are not bringing a minion master, make sure you can pull. If bringing heroes or henchmen, make sure you flag them away so they do not run in and aggro.
93954e0042af4539dbdc194eb9ccaa22b3a50c9c.text: 如果你没有带随从大师，请确保你可以拉。如果带来英雄或追随者，请确保将他们标记为远离，这样他们就不会跑进来并进行攻击。

d2e565864d69590b76b602b0b72e22d8e8c49b81.source: There is a Resurrection Shrine immediately next to the largest group of corsairs, near the clansmen. Consider taking the right way around to take advantage of this, avoiding the Sunspear Tomb area entirely.
d2e565864d69590b76b602b0b72e22d8e8c49b81.text: 在最大的海盗群旁边，靠近族人的地方，有一座复活神殿。考虑采取正确的方法来利用这一点，完全避开阳矛墓地区域。

6af9a9fac3e2e6ff14a8e9684de41861a47b5319.source:
* Guild Wars Eye of the North on the account
* Neither I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet nor Hole of Istan completed
* Level 10 or higher
6af9a9fac3e2e6ff14a8e9684de41861a47b5319.text:
* 帐户上的激战北方之眼
*《我感觉地球在凯莎脚下移动》和《伊斯坦之洞》都没有完成
* 10级或以上

0fea47a8ef507fc9772a5772640311f15a4b6e31.source: Investigate the earthquake aftermath in North Kryta Province.
0fea47a8ef507fc9772a5772640311f15a4b6e31.text: 调查北科瑞塔省的地震后果。

efdd9e33a7ebb2e5592619ce4b0f92bf1d455878.source: Investigate the Depths beneath North Kryta Province.
efdd9e33a7ebb2e5592619ce4b0f92bf1d455878.text: 调查北科瑞塔省地下深处。

14809c43b2d08f7bca269685fb147bb9e495b86c.source: Once this quest, Hole of Istan or I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet has been completed, the crevasse, fissure and chasm become permanent interactive objects of their respective explorable areas.
14809c43b2d08f7bca269685fb147bb9e495b86c.text: 一旦任务“伊斯坦之洞”或“我感觉地球在凯莎脚下移动”完成，裂缝、裂缝和裂缝将成为其各自可探索区域的永久互动对象。

09b75c5fe3ccbca29b8f34d42f843e4aa37a0328.source: The crevasse that you must get to is just slightly north from Lion's Arch. It is to the east of Miraba and Leighton Cranford. Click on the crevasse and choose to enter. You will be brought to Beneath Lion's Arch. Follow the path through the small cavern and into the ancient hall, killing some undead along the way. Keep going on the singular path until you see dwarven allies. Climb up the stairs and a cinematic will begin. The Beginning of the End is the follow-up primary quest that is automatically added to your quest log.
09b75c5fe3ccbca29b8f34d42f843e4aa37a0328.text: 你必须到达的裂缝就在狮子拱门稍北一点的地方。它位于米拉巴和莱顿克兰福德以东。点击裂缝并选择进入。您将被带到狮子拱门下。沿着小路穿过小洞穴，进入古老的大厅，沿途杀死一些不死生物。继续沿着单一的道路前进，直到看到矮人盟友。爬上楼梯，电影就会开始。终结的开始是后续主要任务，会自动添加到您的任务日志中。

200ca0180cef57d2ffcfc485231355769bdc0c2a.source: Any skill that deals holy damage is effective against the undead found in Beneath Lion's Arch.
200ca0180cef57d2ffcfc485231355769bdc0c2a.text: 任何造成神圣伤害的技能都对狮子拱门下的不死生物有效。

a1876676d2850c391094bc0be037d63610e8d156.source: This quest concludes automatically at the end of the cinematic; the follow-up quest, the Beginning of the End, is automatically accepted.
a1876676d2850c391094bc0be037d63610e8d156.text: 这个任务在电影结束时自动结束；后续任务“终结的开始”会自动接受。

218f3e375764802607c9c0f00e919d17d01a48a2.source: Anomaly: Doesn't work when the quest "Evil Residents" is active
218f3e375764802607c9c0f00e919d17d01a48a2.text: 异常：任务“邪恶居民”激活时不起作用

a87f10f1bca8d320c9ec9c7458feb23c8e7b6ccb.source: Meet Ministry Agent Oroku in the Undercity.
a87f10f1bca8d320c9ec9c7458feb23c8e7b6ccb.text: 在幽暗城与魔法部特工 Oroku 会面。

4031a2213840e132d694d0a84024486e0973c347.source: Escort Oroku to the corrupted locations so that he can purify them. [0...3] of 3 purified. Oroku must survive.
4031a2213840e132d694d0a84024486e0973c347.text: 护送 Oroku 前往腐化地点，以便他能够净化它们。 [0...3] 3 纯化。奥鲁库必须生存。

9ae98fa7f275b4b44e263fdee390cb457af95728.source: Find the source of the corruption.

7f1d30e2b26fae84afa6b1e2a058a0d7bb97fc6e.source: Defeat Kai Shi Jo and his corrupted kappa.
7f1d30e2b26fae84afa6b1e2a058a0d7bb97fc6e.text: 击败凯史祖和他腐败的河童。

a6c56857ca8128433f92794e7161e87ed4d5ff50.source: Baubao Wavewrath does not spawn in the Undercity during this quest.
a6c56857ca8128433f92794e7161e87ed4d5ff50.text: 在此任务期间，巴巴波怒火不会在幽暗城中生成。

17993b80b016028b51ff02adbb1c6116afc2f36c.source: Enter the Undercity from the Wajjun Bazaar, via the Nahpui Quarter outpost. Since Oroku must survive stay near him at the areas of corruption and let the Kappa come to you. At each site, the Kappa will attack in 4 waves from each entry point in groups of 3 or 4. Since the Kappa are large groups of spellcasters, area of effect skills and caster shutdown will be very helpful. Oroku will stay with the party between the sites, so the only danger during movement is the Am Fah. Take care with these mobs, as it is easy to over-aggro and fail the quest. It is safest, though time consuming, to clear out the path before taking Oroku (either by not entering from south Wajjun Bazaar, or by running past before he finishes the dialogue.)
17993b80b016028b51ff02adbb1c6116afc2f36c.text: 从 Wajjun Bazaar 穿过 Nahpui Quarter 前哨进入幽暗城。由于 Oroku 必须生存，请在腐败区域靠近他，让河童来找你。在每个地点，河童会以 3 或 4 人为一组，从每个入口点分 4 波进行攻击。由于河童是一大群施法者，范围技能和施法者关闭将非常有帮助。 Oroku 将与队伍一起在地点之间停留，因此移动过程中唯一的危险是 Am Fah。小心这些小怪，因为很容易过度仇恨并导致任务失败。尽管耗时，但最安全的做法是在进入 Oroku 之前清理出道路（要么不从南 Wajjun Bazaar 进入，要么在他完成对话之前跑过去。）

c980bb3f5bc97dc3e797352cbb2aa54f3a76d305.source: Once you have cleansed all 3 areas of corruption, Oroku will revive after dying from that point on.
c980bb3f5bc97dc3e797352cbb2aa54f3a76d305.text: 一旦你清理了所有 3 个腐败区域，Oroku 就会在死亡后复活。

5870e56d0b7cb62f900effa9d68a5d7e49bace74.source: If you have Cleansing the Undercity active, you can bring along Initiate Zei Ri as an extra ally to help make this quest easier. Just make sure to complete Oroku's quest first before killing the Afflicted mobs.
5870e56d0b7cb62f900effa9d68a5d7e49bace74.text: 如果你激活了净化幽暗城，你可以带上入门者泽里作为额外的盟友来帮助让这个任务变得更容易。只要确保在杀死受影响的小怪之前先完成 Oroku 的任务即可。

eed385897999980a985f4a294894f9e895078f0b.source: In Hard Mode at site 2, a good strategy is to: clear the site's 2 area from mobs. Then flag all Heroes upstairs on the left side (as looking from the site 2 into the corridor). Next, run with Oroku to start the waves and as soon as Kappas appear, run upstairs to your Heroes. Or stay down as melee support. Keep an eye on Heroes' health and move them as needed, good idea is to place two Heroes near the edge to keep Kappas' aggro and the rest as support which you move forward and backward when health drops. Give them Flesh of My Flesh for fast Resurrection.
eed385897999980a985f4a294894f9e895078f0b.text: 在站点 2 的困难模式中，一个好的策略是：清除站点 2 区域的小怪。然后在左侧标记楼上的所有英雄（从站点 2 向走廊看）。接下来，与 Oroku 一起奔跑以发起波浪，河童一出现，就跑上楼去找你的英雄。或者留在下面作为近战支援。密切关注英雄的健康状况并根据需要移动他们，好主意是将两名英雄放置在边缘附近以保持卡帕斯的仇恨，其余英雄作为健康下降时您向前和向后移动的支持。给他们我肉中的肉，以便快速复活。

15ffaa24e453df9f52ca9a370f50e18b7e736f9c.source: The waves are triggered by killing specified Kappas, probably Violent Kappa or Maddened Kappa. You should try to kill those specified Kappas last, but there are few Kappas of those types in a wave, so you can't be sure which one of them triggers a next wave.
15ffaa24e453df9f52ca9a370f50e18b7e736f9c.text: 这些波浪是通过杀死指定的河童（可能是暴力河童或疯狂河童）来触发的。你应该尝试最后杀死那些指定的卡帕，但一波中这些类型的卡帕很少，所以你无法确定其中哪一个会触发下一波。

661fed899ea8eefcc5ae0b980df8e3d683fc0eb6.source: As Kappas can be a little disoriented by the long way around to get upstairs, they can sometimes move back etc., so this strategy makes the site 2 doable without Consumables and with Heroes.
661fed899ea8eefcc5ae0b980df8e3d683fc0eb6.text: 由于卡帕斯上楼的路程很长，可能会有点迷失方向，他们有时会向后退等等，所以这个策略使得站点 2 在没有消耗品和英雄的情况下也能实现。

56b7a7b0c446c5c98811ec9e9d01163c9b0fbe1c.source: Before entering the site's 3 area - use Consumables to recover if you have any Death Penalty (specifically on the Heroes who kept aggro) and for safety add some party-wide boost.
56b7a7b0c446c5c98811ec9e9d01163c9b0fbe1c.text: 在进入站点的 3 区域之前 - 如果您有任何死亡惩罚（特别是保持仇恨的英雄），请使用消耗品来恢复，并且为了安全起见，添加一些全党的提升。

fcae580d93ada790fcf0431a9a487c6ff1eb3792.source: Again, aim for Violent Kappa first.
fcae580d93ada790fcf0431a9a487c6ff1eb3792.text: 再次强调，首先瞄准暴力河童。

e9734d3a851d9e01adb85e6059ee529322df9ae2.source: Find Gardener Tidak and tell that lazy bum to get back to work!
e9734d3a851d9e01adb85e6059ee529322df9ae2.text: 找到园丁蒂达克并告诉那个懒惰的流浪汉回去工作吧！

e653a1c471ce5e91170f5f72eb2dc3daa3f157ae.source: Kill the advancing beasts threatening Gardener Tidak.
e653a1c471ce5e91170f5f72eb2dc3daa3f157ae.text: 杀死威胁园丁蒂达克的前进野兽。

298a14b90c34470b4a2c87715d0391ac82ad9f21.source: After receiving the quest, the party will need to make their way back into the outer garden area, towards a point slighty north-east of the garden entry portal, where they will find Tidak. As you approach, a group of 4 Roaring Ethers spawn and run towards him.
298a14b90c34470b4a2c87715d0391ac82ad9f21.text: 收到任务后，队伍需要返回外花园区域，前往花园入口稍偏东北的地方，在那里他们会找到蒂达克。当你靠近时，一群 4 个咆哮以太会出现并向他跑来。

5295126f558475850bfc3e3ea630254510ae4eea.source: Although the objective mentions beasts threatening Tidak, none of the Ethers appear to attack him, they simply cluster in his general area waiting for the party to approach and fight them.
5295126f558475850bfc3e3ea630254510ae4eea.text: 尽管目标提到了威胁蒂达克的野兽，但似乎没有以太人攻击他，它们只是聚集在他的一般区域，等待队伍接近并与它们战斗。

7deb13727c50e244b420b866a7718633dfec679f.source: Although the threatening beasts of the quest are a group of Roaring Ethers, it's very likely that some Rain Beetles and Rock Beetles will pop up as well, when you approach Tidak.
7deb13727c50e244b420b866a7718633dfec679f.text: 虽然任务中的威胁野兽是一群咆哮以太，但当你接近提达克时，很可能也会出现一些雨甲虫和岩甲虫。

3ee7873e5885924d1268d863cea09e2be2db62f2.source: Combines well with Botanical Research and Plague of Frogs.
3ee7873e5885924d1268d863cea09e2be2db62f2.text: 与植物学研究和青蛙瘟疫完美结合。

2a2243ed216931f02490ad9df44b5128674c1d5a.source: Travel throughout Echovald Forest and slay 40 wardens. You have killed [0...40] of 40 wardens.
2a2243ed216931f02490ad9df44b5128674c1d5a.text: 穿越 Echovald 森林并杀死 40 名看守。您已杀死 40 名典狱长中的 [0...40] 名。

d228c7606999af8e6d87a483fb56e5d7510c56ee.source: See Dunmel Gorhopf for your reward.
d228c7606999af8e6d87a483fb56e5d7510c56ee.text: 请前往邓梅尔·戈霍普 (Dunmel Gorhopf) 领取奖励。

9cde6e6018bc721ace2d6c8e276b9b5f1a6411be.source: Find and kill 40 wardens, then return to Dunmel for your reward. Wardens can be found in any area of Echovald Forest, although Arborstone and Morostav Trail seem to have high concentrations of them.
9cde6e6018bc721ace2d6c8e276b9b5f1a6411be.text: 找到并杀死 40 名典狱长，然后返回邓梅尔领取奖励。守望者可以在埃科瓦尔德森林的任何区域找到，尽管阿伯斯通和莫罗斯塔夫步道似乎是守望者集中的地方。

9515631d0eb8b0ea307910e211d5c806c1ffd43b.source: Can be combined with Vanquisher title since this will require you to kill the wardens.
9515631d0eb8b0ea307910e211d5c806c1ffd43b.text: 可以与征服者头衔结合使用，因为这需要你杀死守卫。

047ac1a126363d1237f75f8e3de2d69130240432.source: This quest is very similar to Forgotten Retribution in the Nightfall campaign.
047ac1a126363d1237f75f8e3de2d69130240432.text: 这个任务与夜幕降临战役中的被遗忘的报应非常相似。

a1ee36ef775e67301de6048a769e86db09f9691a.source: Clear the Wilderness of Bahdza in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
a1ee36ef775e67301de6048a769e86db09f9691a.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比巴哈扎荒野中的所有敌人。

dd58be7222b3c2714698818b7d76e733fc9e1399.source: This optional area can be easily reached by heading out the eastern exit of the Dzagonur Bastion mission outpost.
dd58be7222b3c2714698818b7d76e733fc9e1399.text: 从扎古努尔堡垒任务前哨站的东部出口出发，可以轻松到达该可选区域。

2fe67447904f074f4aad6bf8dd942e347f3f8f3b.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.95% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
2fe67447904f074f4aad6bf8dd942e347f3f8f3b.text: 对该领域的完整探索为 Elonian 制图师头衔贡献了约 2.95%。

c3ab7c4fafd14de62567a61199478caca39e36e8.source: Spawns in this area permanently change after certain quests are completed.
c3ab7c4fafd14de62567a61199478caca39e36e8.text: 某些任务完成后，该区域的生成点会永久改变。

4a484cf719e44a37c4fa33ba9c1ab788f87da1aa.source: Completion of all the local quests will reduce the foe count by dozens of Harpies and Hekets. However, completing Destroy the Harpies causes Korrub, Flame of Dreams to spawn, who is considered to be one of the more difficult foes to defeat.
4a484cf719e44a37c4fa33ba9c1ab788f87da1aa.text: 完成所有当地任务将使敌人数量减少数十只鹰身女妖和赫克特。然而，完成摧毁鹰身女妖会导致梦之火焰科鲁布生成，他被认为是最难击败的敌人之一。

fdb8279a17c936eb766188d36d166a413428b082.source: There are a few hidden beetle groups in the southeast, some of which overlap patrol paths of other beetle groups and behemoth groups.
fdb8279a17c936eb766188d36d166a413428b082.text: 东南部有几个隐藏的甲虫群，其中一些与其他甲虫群和巨兽群的巡逻路径重叠。

14e5d9e137df51e6963234f1fa015606eb5a1436.source: After Scratcher or Screecher die, several harpy groups spawn and run towards the Resplendent Makuun exit. These new foes will not attack the party and they do not need to be killed to vanquish the area, unless they get stuck.
14e5d9e137df51e6963234f1fa015606eb5a1436.text: 刮伤者或尖叫者死亡后，几个鹰身女妖群体会生成并朝辉煌马库恩出口跑去。这些新敌人不会攻击队伍，也不需要杀死他们来征服该地区，除非他们被困住了。

1f8a0a93e995d38f9f68647a1de857f0763f8c63.source: The Minotaur Hunt bounty will be offered even though there are no minotaurs in the area until after completing Extinction.
1f8a0a93e995d38f9f68647a1de857f0763f8c63.text: 即使在完成灭绝之前该地区没有牛头怪，也会提供牛头怪狩猎赏金。

1e7a3fccf3fbc1102ac5e0edf3c9a678ca79fda0.source: Travel through the Sage Lands and await the druids at the base of the waterfall.
1e7a3fccf3fbc1102ac5e0edf3c9a678ca79fda0.text: 穿过贤者之地并在瀑布底部等待德鲁伊。

a127d01c999606976e76ba29a649cad73266c848.source: Kneel at the Statue of Dwayna in Druid's Overlook. She will appear and you can take the quest.
a127d01c999606976e76ba29a649cad73266c848.text: 在德鲁伊瞭望台的德薇娜雕像下跪。她会出现，你可以接受任务。

4dfa1ab204ca8607d41d8cf7902eaa82458c0d41.source: It's preferable to start out from The Wilds. The path is shorter and pretty much straight. From Druid's Overlook you will have to take a significant detour to the west when your path to the north is blocked; a detour that will practically take you to The Wilds doorstep.
4dfa1ab204ca8607d41d8cf7902eaa82458c0d41.text: 最好从荒野开始。路径更短而且几乎笔直。从德鲁伊观景台出发，当你向北的道路被封锁时，你将不得不绕道向西。这条绕道实际上将带您到达荒野家门口。

a7b767feb53ddb286e67797cd19ae48dc4e333c7.source: Once at the spot where the quest marker leads you, you will be attacked by successive groups of Maguuma Spiders (x2, x2, x3, then x3). The Druids will then appear after the spiders are defeated. Watch their ritual and talk to the Ancient Druid Spirit when they are finished.
a7b767feb53ddb286e67797cd19ae48dc4e333c7.text: 一旦到达任务标记引导您的地点，您将受到连续的迈古玛蜘蛛群的攻击（x2、x2、x3，然后 x3）。击败蜘蛛后，德鲁伊就会出现。观看他们的仪式并在仪式结束后与古代德鲁伊之灵交谈。

c1ac48b7d111f68de7c2c9f59285e7e1eaa63906.source: Be wary of going up the small hill to where the Maguuma Spider waves spawn, because there are several more spider spawns hiding in the trees, and Moss Scarabs hidden in the ground.
c1ac48b7d111f68de7c2c9f59285e7e1eaa63906.text: 小心爬上小山丘到迈古玛蜘蛛波产卵的地方，因为树上隐藏着更多的蜘蛛产卵，而苔藓圣甲虫则隐藏在地下。

83320325c7762146714d94e7c22f75a3d387d0b0.source: The Rider boss you need to kill for Eye For Profit is in the same spot, and can be killed at the same time regardless of whether you have spoken to Grahm.
83320325c7762146714d94e7c22f75a3d387d0b0.text: 你需要为“利润之眼”杀死的骑士老板位于同一地点，并且无论你是否与格雷姆交谈过，都可以同时杀死。

7144991285e56a0a8f298db012122d98247a76dc.source: Clear Witman's Folly in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
7144991285e56a0a8f298db012122d98247a76dc.text: 在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉中所有敌人的威特曼愚行。

e76ab65fe15d4f60656ba65b78cf12c27050146a.source: Witman's Folly lies southeast of Droknar's Forge and is usually traversed on the way to Port Sledge in the southwestern corner of this area.
e76ab65fe15d4f60656ba65b78cf12c27050146a.text: 威特曼的愚蠢之地位于卓克纳尔熔炉的东南方，通常会在前往该地区西南角的斯莱奇港的途中经过。

c55cd045f4d2826cf3186ba1fde7b7bd23083907.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
c55cd045f4d2826cf3186ba1fde7b7bd23083907.text: 对该区域的完整探索为泰尔制图师头衔贡献了大约 0.8%。

52e1ee37ecc8b67bdf4498f69d6bdb69e5400ec9.source: Be careful with approaching the Grawl groups as they patrol close to each other.
52e1ee37ecc8b67bdf4498f69d6bdb69e5400ec9.text: 接近 Grawl 群体时要小心，因为它们巡逻的距离很近。

42d2c7c4c37dad003294a403037c3a4abd75abb1.source: Consider clearing the western half first (the Grawl). The only visible groups in the eastern half are the two boss groups. Be careful of hidden Nightmare popups when approaching the two boss groups.
42d2c7c4c37dad003294a403037c3a4abd75abb1.text: 考虑先清理西半部（Grawl）。东半部唯一可见的群体是两个 Boss 群体。接近两个 Boss 组时，请小心隐藏的噩梦弹出窗口。

9a4ebdc883c6564125f1e373532f61ebc27cb675.source: There is a pair of Grawl that can easily be missed as they may travel the length of the path that connects to Droknar's Forge.
9a4ebdc883c6564125f1e373532f61ebc27cb675.text: 有一对穴居人很容易被错过，因为它们可能会沿着连接卓克纳尔熔炉的路径行走。

0572edfad423db0e401ec645f538c27b21413c3e.source: Skills can be captured faster by repeatedly entering from Port Sledge until the Grawl boss with the desired elite spawns near the portal.
0572edfad423db0e401ec645f538c27b21413c3e.text: 反复从斯莱奇港进入，直到带有所需精英的穴居人 Boss 在门户附近产卵，可以更快地捕获技能。

1aef29a4887ebf17bfe938b090cddc4de4f6dadc.source: The Grawl here have very few skills and even on hard mode they are easy to interrupt. This combined with their clustered nature makes the Wastrel skills extremely potent here.
1aef29a4887ebf17bfe938b090cddc4de4f6dadc.text: 这里的穴居人技能很少，即使在困难模式下也很容易被打断。再加上它们的聚集性质，使得废鼠的技能在这里极其有效。

ed45edfaac8e71aba5a82c26f4aa8899f6284c96.source: Three Shiverpeak Chests (Locked Chests in Hard mode) will always spawn in this area, occasionally one of the chests spawns directly outside of Droknar's Forge.
ed45edfaac8e71aba5a82c26f4aa8899f6284c96.text: 三个席瓦峰宝箱（困难模式下的锁定宝箱）总是会在该区域生成，偶尔其中一个宝箱会直接在卓克纳尔熔炉外生成。

fd76bb6fcdfe318a06428fb0dc5db64fdb654e05.source: Speak with Theatre Manager Daudi and find out how the Kournans were able to infiltrate the acting company.
fd76bb6fcdfe318a06428fb0dc5db64fdb654e05.text: 与剧院经理达迪交谈，了解库南家族是如何渗透到表演公司的。

3458a318c5190eaca3a6195a07d714453436c429.source: Return to Prince Bokka the Magnificent and relate what you have learned.
3458a318c5190eaca3a6195a07d714453436c429.text: 返回伟大的博卡王子那里并讲述你所学到的事情。

e6e91174c26febb4acf0713e593e18549fd261ab.source: Although Theatre Manager Daudi does not spawn during some quests, such as Til Death Do Us Part..., Norgu will speak his part of the dialogue upon approaching Daudi's normal location, allowing the quest to progress to the next objective.
e6e91174c26febb4acf0713e593e18549fd261ab.text: 虽然剧院经理 Daudi 在某些任务中不会出现，例如《直到死亡将我们分开……》，但 Norgu 会在接近 Daudi 的正常位置时说出他的部分对话，从而使任务能够进展到下一个目标。

aa99ab33f1278a222c076dc035e8976f317f3f9b.source: Prove your valor to Sif. Vanquish Koren Wildrunner in Drakkar Lake.
aa99ab33f1278a222c076dc035e8976f317f3f9b.text: 向西芙证明你的勇气。击败德拉卡湖的科伦野行者。

873a77eaadcb8dc23db8ce293ffba70a2bff1428.source: Continue proving your worth. Defeat Myish, Lady Of The Lake in Drakkar Lake.
873a77eaadcb8dc23db8ce293ffba70a2bff1428.text: 继续证明你的价值。击败达卡湖的湖中女士迈什。

fb160c8aae3531d85efa4567817e1cf3ae271b02.source: Flex your valor muscle. Stomp Nulfastu, Earthbound in Drakkar Lake.
fb160c8aae3531d85efa4567817e1cf3ae271b02.text: 展现你的勇敢肌肉。 Stomp Nulfastu，Drakkar 湖中的地球束缚。

517ff89cbdd11fccd60b62a88f79bbf9c7951512.source: You can kill the bosses in any order and at any time. See the articles for each boss for specific combat tips. In brief, they are:
517ff89cbdd11fccd60b62a88f79bbf9c7951512.text: 你可以随时以任何顺序杀死头目。有关具体的战斗技巧，请参阅每个 Boss 的文章。简而言之，它们是：

2a1a39097f29736b5dffbd45ad29717558298392.source: At the center of Drakkar Lake (northern green star).
2a1a39097f29736b5dffbd45ad29717558298392.text: 位于德拉卡湖（北方绿星）的中心。

debdc164bb3228184e3726f4d3f282d088f9ff4a.source: She is easy to kill if you first take out the Chilling Wisps and Elementals that patrol the lake.
debdc164bb3228184e3726f4d3f282d088f9ff4a.text: 如果你先干掉在湖里巡逻的冰冷小精灵和元素生物，她很容易被杀死。

1b7e25a58ff3ddf4db79affb3c00f3b4d38e7cbc.source: Patrols either clockwise or counterclockwise on the shore around the lake (possible initial positions marked in blue).
1b7e25a58ff3ddf4db79affb3c00f3b4d38e7cbc.text: 在湖周围的岸边顺时针或逆时针巡逻（可能的初始位置标记为蓝色）。

6e01f1188af088eb7eb9125f1761cd035ad13c24.source: Be careful of overlapping patrols when you confront Koren Wildrunner.
6e01f1188af088eb7eb9125f1761cd035ad13c24.text: 当你面对科伦野行者时，要小心重叠的巡逻队。

3a4f99b2869c9920c846abd9ceec7f4cb5e7e217.source: An easy way to find him, is to follow his trail of Spirits of Symbiosis.
3a4f99b2869c9920c846abd9ceec7f4cb5e7e217.text: 找到他的一个简单方法就是追踪他的共生之灵的踪迹。

2804e287a243c89d88b6719fece0e140e7f27434.source: In the southeast corner of the map (southern green star).
2804e287a243c89d88b6719fece0e140e7f27434.text: 在地图的东南角（南部绿星）。

d2160075577a5e26c99d302f4d6498de40403906.source: Follow a white rabbit down into a small glade.
d2160075577a5e26c99d302f4d6498de40403906.text: 跟随一只白兔进入一个小林间空地。

df116e05b68ba94a4700fdc014bb141bf095422a.source: Watch out for numerous popups at the top and then again at the bottom. It helps to move slowly, pulling foes to you.
df116e05b68ba94a4700fdc014bb141bf095422a.text: 请注意顶部和底部的大量弹出窗口。它有助于缓慢移动，将敌人拉向你。

48aa57ee7e0462ffaf05e62f8516b007a53442fe.source: You can combine this quest with the Zaishen bounty quests for Myish and Nulfastu.
48aa57ee7e0462ffaf05e62f8516b007a53442fe.text: 你可以将此任务与 Myish 和 Nulfastu 的 Zaishen 赏金任务结合起来。

cb2ef64163e255770bcec90e4631b17e53bcc828.source: Free the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale by killing the Terrorweb Dryders around Grenth's statue in the Forgotten Vale after accepting the quest Restoring Grenth's Monuments.
cb2ef64163e255770bcec90e4631b17e53bcc828.text: 接受恢复古伦斯纪念碑任务后，杀死遗忘谷古伦斯雕像周围的恐网干燥者，解救遗忘谷收割者。

41c00390735bc0febdd233d111983adeac4fa7f9.source: Eliminate the Wrathful Spirits before they destroy all the villagers.
41c00390735bc0febdd233d111983adeac4fa7f9.text: 在愤怒之灵消灭所有村民之前消灭它们。

8155636da93bb29cb89102fb54a957208ec045b3.source: Return to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale for your reward.
8155636da93bb29cb89102fb54a957208ec045b3.text: 返回遗忘谷收割者那里领取奖励。

b551a517290c083e15d26a6139b583e0329701ac.source: You should clear the closest patrolling groups of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights before taking the quest. When you take the quest, five groups of three hostile Tortured Spirits spawn nearby. Four of the groups spawn in the village in the midst of the allied Tortured Spirits and start attacking them. The last group will spawn on the nearby hill and can be ignored until the other groups have been handled.
b551a517290c083e15d26a6139b583e0329701ac.text: 在接受任务之前，你应该清除最近的冷火之夜和潜行之夜的巡逻队。当你接受任务时，附近会出现五组，每组三个敌对的折磨灵魂。其中四支队伍在村庄中的受折磨之灵联盟中重生，并开始攻击他们。最后一组将在附近的山上生成，可以忽略，直到处理完其他组。

7ffd53ed0757c666fe8cf9e85ee343c3436e98fd.source: Killing the hostile Tortured Spirits isn't as simple as killing a regular level 15 enemy. They use Illusionary Weaponry with a high level of Illusion Magic, inflicting 40 points of armor ignoring damage per hit. A full group of three spirits will therefore cause a very high amount of damage if they gang up on a single target.
7ffd53ed0757c666fe8cf9e85ee343c3436e98fd.text: 杀死敌对的折磨灵魂并不像杀死普通的 15 级敌人那么简单。他们使用具有高水平幻象魔法的幻象武器，每次攻击造成 40 点护甲值，无视伤害。因此，如果三个灵魂联合起来攻击一个目标，就会造成非常高的伤害。

3131d9e27349ac620f9cbaf0ca4243be84352158.source: In addition to having to cope with the enemy, you need to protect the allied spirits. If all of them die your quest will fail. In addition, the hostile spirits will attack Mayor Alegheri and the Reaper after killing all other spirits. If the mayor or reaper die your party will be returned to the outpost from which you left to the Underworld. The allied spirits far away will most likely die before you can reach them, so make sure to protect atleast one of the nearest allied spirits. Even one survivor is enough. If possible a monk should concentrate on healing one of the spirits, but you can also use traps, AoE and interruption.
3131d9e27349ac620f9cbaf0ca4243be84352158.text: 除了要对付敌人之外，你还需要保护盟友的灵魂。如果他们全部死亡，你的任务就会失败。此外，敌对灵魂在杀死所有其他灵魂后会攻击阿莱格里市长和收割者。如果市长或收割者死亡，你的队伍将被返回到你离开地狱的前哨站。远处的友军很可能会在你到达之前就死去，所以一定要保护至少一个最近的友军。哪怕只有一个幸存者就足够了。如果可能的话，僧侣应该集中精力治疗其中一个灵魂，但你也可以使用陷阱、范围和干扰。

c5da61dae4fda538c703a2b93418336f5b552c49.source: After defeating the hostile spirits in the village you can take out the last group on the hill. Then talk to the Reaper to receive your reward.
c5da61dae4fda538c703a2b93418336f5b552c49.text: 击败村庄里的敌对灵魂后，你可以消灭山上的最后一组。然后与收割者交谈以获得奖励。

ffdc8c1cd61dcccb030a74ae55cfabf99ea5a58a.source: Completing the quest will spawn an unlocked chest and a Black Widow next to the monument of Grenth, allowing a party member to charm it. If charming the pet, remember to ask the others not to attack it when it turns hostile. The chest will drop a random purple or gold item to one random member of the party.
ffdc8c1cd61dcccb030a74ae55cfabf99ea5a58a.text: 完成任务后会在古兰斯纪念碑旁边生成一个解锁的箱子和一个黑寡妇，让队员可以对它进行魅惑。如果对宠物进行迷惑，请记得要求其他人在它变得敌对时不要攻击它。箱子会随机向队伍中的一名成员掉落一件紫色或金色物品。

c00688eee2bfc7044a2f3163235b6b7556d42467.source: Tip: There is a trick to avoid the possibility of failing the quest. The friendly spirits you need to protect will spawn to the area after you kill the Grasping Darknesses near Mayor Alegheri. If you leave the first Darkness group alive, some of the spirits will not spawn making it so you cannot fail the quest. Just remember to avoid aggroing the darknesses when fighting the Wrathful Spirits. After you have cleared the area of most of the Wrathful Spirits you can kill the Grasping Darknesses.
c00688eee2bfc7044a2f3163235b6b7556d42467.text: 提示：有一个技巧可以避免任务失败的可能性。当你杀死阿莱格里市长附近的黑暗之手后，你需要保护的友好灵魂将会出现在该地区。如果你让第一个黑暗小组活着，一些灵魂将不会产生，所以你不会失败任务。只要记住在与愤怒之灵战斗时避免攻击黑暗力量即可。当你清除了该区域的大部分愤怒之灵后，你就可以杀死黑暗之握了。

ebef7224d64c60a040d79e357a82dca2c7877bf8.source: Place the toothed cog in The Cruncher's cog mouth. It is the only place a master gear won't fit.
ebef7224d64c60a040d79e357a82dca2c7877bf8.text: 将齿轮放入 Cruncher 的齿轮嘴中。这是唯一不适合主齿轮的地方。

0ea950264b93139cc0b6d2bd4536092c36f08355.source: Eliminate the [5...0] remaining rebel spirit keepers.
0ea950264b93139cc0b6d2bd4536092c36f08355.text: 消灭剩余的 [5...0] 叛军灵魂守护者。

729f450ba1e7b603737caa340aff83e73172f887.source: Take a Master Gear from a nearby working Gearbox, and use it on the gearbox by the gate south-east of Krak Flamewhip to open it. Follow the quest marker into the cavern beyond.
729f450ba1e7b603737caa340aff83e73172f887.text: 从附近正在工作的齿轮箱中取出一个主齿轮，然后在克拉克火鞭东南门的齿轮箱上使用它来打开它。跟随任务标记进入远处的洞穴。

01e20710416774af8c240ad853291257d9f8c7b6.source: Kill the Rebel Spirit Keepers until one drops the Toothed Cog and activate the proper gearbox indicated by the quest marker (the only one with square looking gears). Although the Rebel Spirit Keepers are not linked to any of the nearby Dredge groups, aggroing the patrolling additional Dredge is very likely.
01e20710416774af8c240ad853291257d9f8c7b6.text: 杀死叛军精神守护者，直到其中一个掉落齿轮并激活任务标记指示的正确变速箱（唯一一个带有方形齿轮的变速箱）。尽管反叛灵魂守护者与附近的任何挖掘者组织都没有联系，但很可能会攻击巡逻的额外挖掘者。

434bf56953e4bd771898525db14ab7f76bf3f049.source: Return to Krak Flamewhip for your reward.
434bf56953e4bd771898525db14ab7f76bf3f049.text: 返回克拉克火鞭处领取奖励。

52028fad681134f08c06eaeb1936c3d121055953.source: Rebel Spirit Keepers use Resurrect (monster skill) (8 second cast time, no recharge). Disabling this skill, either via Frozen Soil or interrupts (preferably using interrupts which also disable the skill, such as Distracting Shot) will make the Dredge groups easier to handle.
52028fad681134f08c06eaeb1936c3d121055953.text: 反叛灵魂守护者使用复活（怪物技能）（8秒施法时间，无需充能）。通过冰冻土壤或中断（最好使用同时禁用该技能的中断，例如分散射击）来禁用此技能将使挖泥机组更容易处理。

1067fc1b3cd6c8466aeac9677c236c59a824c6db.source: Sorrow's Belly can be scouted for Summit Slaves while fighting the Dredge.
1067fc1b3cd6c8466aeac9677c236c59a824c6db.text: 在与挖泥船战斗时，可以在“悲伤之腹”中寻找山顶奴隶。

b8098481908227d7d394e683aaeeb23d288eec73.source: Clear the Xaquang Skyway in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
b8098481908227d7d394e683aaeeb23d288eec73.text: 在困难模式下清除开能城 Xaquang Skyway 中的所有敌人。

e353d3682ba570c5e278bdc6cf8f0db3bfd8d53b.source: The portals from Bukdek Byway and Wajjun Bazaar are blocked until Nahpui Quarter is completed.
e353d3682ba570c5e278bdc6cf8f0db3bfd8d53b.text: Bukdek Byway 和 Wajjun Bazaar 的入口将被封锁，直至 Nahpui Quarter 竣工。

7bbba5fb397a5db1d2ad1108aed4b3b13fa4e585.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
7bbba5fb397a5db1d2ad1108aed4b3b13fa4e585.text: 对该区域的完整探索为 Canthan 制图师头衔贡献了约 1.8%。

14d373da48b6044fa82038095df68171ec777921.source: If you have started Winds of Change, consider vanquishing this area with Light My Fire or its hard mode version active: the foes will be the tougher Winds of Change version, but you will have powerful allies to compensate. Further, to complete either quest, you would need to kill most of the foes in the area.
14d373da48b6044fa82038095df68171ec777921.text: 如果您已经开始了变革之风，请考虑使用点燃我的火焰或其激活的困难模式版本来征服该区域：敌人将是更强大的变革之风版本，但您将拥有强大的盟友来补偿。此外，要完成任一任务，您都需要杀死该地区的大多数敌人。

41718f99613075b2ca3070358e6e1a8c6f898013.source: Pay attention to Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte. He will start running towards the entry of Senji's Corner once you reach his bridge, whether you approach him from the northern or the southern side. If you don't defeat him he will stay at Senji's Corner, which can be frustrating while vanquishing this area since it's not an obvious place for enemies to be.
41718f99613075b2ca3070358e6e1a8c6f898013.text: 注意宁静侍僧奥罗森。一旦你到达他的桥，无论你从北侧还是南侧接近他，他都会开始朝千司之角的入口跑去。如果你不打败他，他会留在森吉角，这在征服这个区域时可能会令人沮丧，因为这不是一个明显的敌人所在的地方。

66dba0a4022bd48c189b20dfc49fe8aed894b070.source: As with any bridges, NPC models in the area may not render when they are on the opposite side from the player: the bodies disappear, although the names can still be seen and they can still be targeted. {{Explorable areas in Kaineng City}}
66dba0a4022bd48c189b20dfc49fe8aed894b070.text: 与任何桥梁一样，该区域的 NPC 模型在位于玩家对面时可能不会渲染：尸体会消失，但仍然可以看到名字并且仍然可以成为目标。 {{开能市可探索区域}}

54de7b85479cd26b966c21ee25364707b58f2b39.source: Clear the Yatendi Canyons in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
54de7b85479cd26b966c21ee25364707b58f2b39.text: 在困难模式下清除瓦比的亚坦迪峡谷中的所有敌人。

1a3877501dfe12b67aaa1e0cd29e9f1ae86b5ac4.source: Characters will pass through here out of Wehhan Terraces as part of the primary quest Rally The Princes.
1a3877501dfe12b67aaa1e0cd29e9f1ae86b5ac4.text: 作为主要任务“集结王子”的一部分，角色将从维汉梯田穿过这里。

dd402d095699bf4e654420b3c479404c242368a8.source: Be wary of the southwestern area before the Fortress of Jahai. Several boss groups are placed quite near each other.
dd402d095699bf4e654420b3c479404c242368a8.text: 警惕贾海要塞前的西南地区。几个 Boss 组彼此距离很近。

c1ecdd26fe54c5558d3677c1a038439a7d0b3237.source: If the quest "Between a Rock..." is active, after killing the first group within the Fortress of Jahai, several groups of margonites will spawn and head to your location. Make sure you kill all of them before engaging the groups inside.
c1ecdd26fe54c5558d3677c1a038439a7d0b3237.text: 如果任务“岩石之间...”处于活动状态，在杀死贾海要塞内的第一组后，几组玛贡尼特将产卵并前往您的位置。确保在与里面的团体交战之前杀死所有的人。

a27a0c846ad06a96e300efb6f8664ba70249bbff.source: Kneeling at the statue of Balthazar resurrection shrine at the exit into Chantry of Secrets does not cause the Champion of Balthazar to appear. Also, while the world has Favor of the Gods, this statue of Balthazar is not animated.
a27a0c846ad06a96e300efb6f8664ba70249bbff.text: 在秘密教堂出口处的巴尔萨扎复活神殿雕像下跪不会导致巴尔萨扎冠军出现。此外，虽然世界有诸神的眷顾，但巴尔萨泽的这座雕像并没有动画。

3b4f2cbdc0ffbf6aa2a3e2ee57fbc6da7e150482.source: Jerob No-Spine has betrayed you. Help Margrid find him and mete out corsair justice.
3b4f2cbdc0ffbf6aa2a3e2ee57fbc6da7e150482.text: 杰罗布·无脊椎背叛了你。帮助玛格丽德找到他并伸张海盗正义。

1a6bafcedd062238627a6b95908f2f060105b316.source: Seek Ruthless Sevad on the Barbarous Shore.
1a6bafcedd062238627a6b95908f2f060105b316.text: 在野蛮海岸寻找无情的塞瓦德。

14277b027a1302f4416afc4cd2f5afea326da2d7.source: Find Herbalist Makala in Yohlon Haven.
14277b027a1302f4416afc4cd2f5afea326da2d7.text: 在 Yohlon Haven 找到草药师马卡拉。

596dab25266f9af5932713abe610dca73824ae61.source: Meet with Herdsman Mehnosi in the Marga Coast.
596dab25266f9af5932713abe610dca73824ae61.text: 在马尔加海岸与牧民梅赫诺西会面。

bcc01a8e1bfc5a8724a7d7ffc161705424cf5a8c.source: Seek out Jerob No-Spine along the southern Marga Coast.
bcc01a8e1bfc5a8724a7d7ffc161705424cf5a8c.text: 沿着玛加海岸南部寻找杰罗布·诺·斯派恩 (Jerob No-Spine)。

d16bb982788566fe2ad86cf3565c02d8c60c2de9.source: Start out from Camp Hojanu and go speak to Ruthless Sevad in the middle of the Barbarous Shore to see what he can tell you about Jerob No-Spine. After talking to Ruthless Sevad, it's quickest to map straight to Yohlon Haven and see Makala. From there, map to Nundu Bay and head out to the Marga Coast to meet with Mehnosi. His location depends on whether you have done a quest Herds to the Slaughter before. If yes, he is standing on the western side of the zone near the sea; otherwise he is near the small swamp southeast of the Kournan garrison. After speaking to Mehnosi, follow the quest pointer to find Jerob in the Marga Coast area.
d16bb982788566fe2ad86cf3565c02d8c60c2de9.text: 从霍贾努营地出发，去野蛮海岸中部与无情的塞瓦德交谈，看看他能告诉你关于杰罗布·无脊的事。与无情的塞瓦德交谈后，最快的方法是直接在地图上前往约隆避风港并查看马卡拉。从那里出发，前往南杜湾 (Nundu Bay)，然后前往马尔加海岸 (Marga Coast) 与梅诺西 (Mehnosi) 会面。他的位置取决于你之前是否完成过“群杀”任务。如果是的话，他就站在该区域的西侧靠近大海的地方；否则他就在库尔南驻军东南部的小沼泽附近。与梅诺西交谈后，按照任务指针在马尔加海岸地区找到杰罗布。

4f85b821e4326389f667511eec0804832a781ea8.source: Although friendly at first, Jerob will turn hostile and attack the party, but will soon return to his spineless ways and beg for mercy rather than die.
4f85b821e4326389f667511eec0804832a781ea8.text: 虽然一开始是友好的，但杰罗布会变得敌对并攻击队伍，但很快就会回到他的懦弱方式，求饶而不是死。

34f4653c8b65b27585c8742e80273bac37d8a541.source: If you have Toma with you, it is possible for him to kill Jerob with Feeding Frenzy. If this happens, Jerob will not respawn even if you rezone. You must abandon the quest and restart it from the beginning.
34f4653c8b65b27585c8742e80273bac37d8a541.text: 如果你有托马在身边，他就有可能用疯狂喂养杀死杰罗布。如果发生这种情况，即使你重新分区，杰罗布也不会重生。您必须放弃任务并从头开始。

5cf7924fd1fb930c4f1ebd9db0e630b3133b083e.source: If you rezone after completing the quest but before accepting the reward, Jerob will not spawn. You must abandon the quest and restart it from the beginning.
5cf7924fd1fb930c4f1ebd9db0e630b3133b083e.text: 如果您在完成任务后但在接受奖励之前重新分配区域，杰罗布将不会生成。您必须放弃任务并从头开始。

d6d3e0318ee83bc78266ef79cf748aa3457a1003.source: Even if you have the quest A Fool's Luck (in which you meet Jerob No-Spine in Barbarous Shore) you can't talk to him about the You Can Run... quest.
d6d3e0318ee83bc78266ef79cf748aa3457a1003.text: 即使你有“傻瓜的运气”任务（你在野蛮海岸遇到了杰罗布·无脊椎），你也不能和他谈论“你可以跑……”任务。

3fba7cd11f2ab1315562fdc6e9d44284de979ddc.source: Kill Z'him Monns in Bogroot Growths.
3fba7cd11f2ab1315562fdc6e9d44284de979ddc.text: 杀死博格鲁特生长区的齐姆·蒙斯。

9ff0c62dea19af55289aaa40803a398867cfb875.source: *BONUS* Kill Z'him Monns in Hard Mode.
9ff0c62dea19af55289aaa40803a398867cfb875.text: *奖励* 在困难模式下杀死 Z'him Monns。

8e7fe3ad38882209421622c7b7751ef1f0bcf602.source: Meet Field General Hayao on the Plains of Jarin.
8e7fe3ad38882209421622c7b7751ef1f0bcf602.text: 在贾林平原与哈药将军会面。

42c56d71629bef59c916f1f7c030f844e89a3108.source: Train the Zaishen Acolytes by defeating them in a test of might.
42c56d71629bef59c916f1f7c030f844e89a3108.text: 通过在力量测试中击败再神追随者来训练他们。

4a4441a582e7f6f36b15b0d95b51e7e7088172a2.source: Exit from Kamadan into the Plains of Jarin and follow the quest marker west until you find Field General Hayao. After the intermediate dialogue, fight Acolyte Sousuke and Acolyte Jin. After Sousuke and Jin have been defeated talk to Field General Hayao for your reward.
4a4441a582e7f6f36b15b0d95b51e7e7088172a2.text: 从卡马丹出口进入贾林平原，然后沿着任务标记向西行驶，直到找到陆军将军哈药。中间对话后，与侍僧宗介和侍僧金战斗。宗介和仁被击败后，与陆军将军隼对话以获得奖励。

3d8d8c6a8b16b02a87d47928d9fb36a39ec78b48.source: Clear Zehlon Reach in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
3d8d8c6a8b16b02a87d47928d9fb36a39ec78b48.text: 在困难模式下清除伊斯坦泽隆河段的所有敌人。

44441db752c0019cfaba0bd9d1091a6112be418e.source: Zehlon Reach is situated to the northeast of Jokanur Diggings. The primary quest that will first bring a character here is the Honorable General.
44441db752c0019cfaba0bd9d1091a6112be418e.text: 泽隆河段位于乔卡努尔矿区的东北部。首先将角色带到这里的主要任务是尊敬的将军。

f4f4853daed26443ed3f10a4172d8599b14e47f3.source: Many other secondary quests will lead to and take place here, such as Student Jin and Student Sousuke, To Dye For, and the Cult of the Stone Face.
f4f4853daed26443ed3f10a4172d8599b14e47f3.text: 许多其他次要任务将通向并发生在这里，例如金学生和宗介学生、染发和石面崇拜。

6b448bb922a1907a6dd8e0fcf8d9b8d02817af46.source: The Ridgeback Skales, Stormseed Jacarandas and Skale Blighters all have different levels. Watch their levels before attacking if your party is still at a low level.
6b448bb922a1907a6dd8e0fcf8d9b8d02817af46.text: 脊背斯卡勒、风暴种子蓝花楹和斯卡勒枯萎者都有不同的等级。如果你的队伍等级仍然较低，请在攻击前观察他们的等级。

7d9c008a042227f39d9f4449a2daadb3b56ac6b9.source: The eastern half of the area has many Skale Blighters capable of spreading Disease. Consider Condition removal or Health Regeneration skills.
7d9c008a042227f39d9f4449a2daadb3b56ac6b9.text: 该地区的东半部有许多能够传播疾病的斯凯尔疫病者。考虑条件消除或健康再生技能。

b37f9f472b17a03f1c09edebce205044a4782bb6.source: Approaching the small island with corpses (to the east of the village) will spawn 4 Corsairs.
b37f9f472b17a03f1c09edebce205044a4782bb6.text: 接近有尸体的小岛（村庄东边）会产生 4 只海盗。

243acaf2d1c5a8973e94a7862efd1f7d017ab78f.source: There are hidden Mandragors in several locations: northwest of Jokanur Diggings (outpost), north of Cliffs of Dohjok exit, and the central Plant-infested area.
243acaf2d1c5a8973e94a7862efd1f7d017ab78f.text: 在几个地点都有隐藏的曼德拉角：Jokanur Diggings（前哨站）的西北部、Dohjok 悬崖出口的北部以及中部植物出没的区域。

ea55d59c95f625be6742d730d7a953b003de8a0e.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.1% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
ea55d59c95f625be6742d730d7a953b003de8a0e.text: 对这一领域的完整探索为 Elonian Cartographer 主打歌贡献了约 3.1%。

85bbee4ae675e710f0bf3e0fa5a202ac6ed4bc7d.source: If approached, Suspicious Hermit turns hostile once his dialogue runs out. It is easy to leave the area before he becomes fully hostile and not notice. He is in the NE most tip of the map.
85bbee4ae675e710f0bf3e0fa5a202ac6ed4bc7d.text: 如果接近，可疑的隐士一旦对话结束就会变得充满敌意。在他变得完全敌对并且没有注意到之前离开该地区是很容易的。他位于地图的最东北端。

526de13bd15204e0f7aef9500fad941a923eec96.source: Starting from Blacktide Den or Beknur Harbor and arriving here via Cliffs of Dohjok will enable a party of 8 instead of 4.
526de13bd15204e0f7aef9500fad941a923eec96.text: 从 Blacktide Den 或 Beknur Harbour 出发，经 Dohjok 悬崖到达这里，可以组成 8 人而不是 4 人的队伍。

f846dd558c132646e256b752398bdf67002688ac.source: Kohanu and Shaudok will always initiate their conversation for A Loose Cannon and A Peaceful Solution.
f846dd558c132646e256b752398bdf67002688ac.text: 科哈努和肖多克总是会为《松散的大炮》和《和平解决方案》发起对话。

7c43535e93640794709bdd044e03bb7d27fb0d3f.source: Hatuk will always initiate his dialogue for Secret Passage.
7c43535e93640794709bdd044e03bb7d27fb0d3f.text: 哈图克总是会在《秘密通道》中发起对话。

9c4f9dab770d03187ca969576ccaf2c10b50163c.source: Several hostile Hungry Skale of the quest Skale and Magic Compass will always spawn.
9c4f9dab770d03187ca969576ccaf2c10b50163c.text: 任务斯卡勒和魔法罗盘的几个敌对饥饿斯卡勒总是会产生。

2e2960d05bbb9a341a78c49b569e0960ecd2c5ae.source: Trapped Voices for the quest Voices in the Night can always be seen.}}
2e2960d05bbb9a341a78c49b569e0960ecd2c5ae.text: 任务“夜间之声”中的被困声音始终可见。}}

0e27018c5f18720510e38a8ab76e7753daa504e0.source: Search Zen Daijun for the source of the infection.
0e27018c5f18720510e38a8ab76e7753daa504e0.text: 搜寻禅代君寻找感染源。

174f4908cf492900dc775daced0d82c00c189ffe.source: As per the Zen Daijun mission.

283c71bde65134b6b355c902e80ce25441406cfd.source: Clear Zen Daijun on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
283c71bde65134b6b355c902e80ce25441406cfd.text: 在困难模式下清除Shing Jea岛上的所有敌人的禅代君。

ffc7d304014ead30e234933696ffd4c2eb0b81f2.source: Kill Zoldark the Unholy in the Vloxen Excavations.
ffc7d304014ead30e234933696ffd4c2eb0b81f2.text: 在弗洛克森挖掘场杀死邪恶者佐尔达克。

b204b29e647bdc05dd19b03d92a3f921823d1e6a.source: *BONUS* Kill Zoldark the Unholy in Hard Mode.
b204b29e647bdc05dd19b03d92a3f921823d1e6a.text: *奖励* 在困难模式中杀死邪恶的佐尔达克。

fc138ba5a0a7c3bec6cf574dc4fb17161b13256a.source: Keep Battle Priest Calibos alive for as long as possible.
fc138ba5a0a7c3bec6cf574dc4fb17161b13256a.text: 让战斗牧师卡利波斯尽可能长时间地活着。

30117158493dfdc487cee18abcd41434abb19e27.source: Destroy Luxon Adepts to receive a morale boost and score bonus.
30117158493dfdc487cee18abcd41434abb19e27.text: 消灭 Luxon Adepts 即可获得士气提升和分数奖励。

e33a5de2ca2ff5cc0097b1d5919e02a6e06c8d4f.source: There is no time limit during this mission, however, if Battle Priest Calibos dies, the mission ends.
e33a5de2ca2ff5cc0097b1d5919e02a6e06c8d4f.text: 该任务没有时间限制，但是，如果战斗牧师卡利波斯死亡，任务就会结束。

e5582157923c9bbca8df0cf8834d3b2bcfa82d3b.source: Points can be obtained in three ways:
e5582157923c9bbca8df0cf8834d3b2bcfa82d3b.text: 积分可以通过三种方式获得：

30387dcdc21adf067ed427027c48d6a115c6c7ca.source: Completely defeating a wave of monsters. (Each wave is outlined in the table below.)
30387dcdc21adf067ed427027c48d6a115c6c7ca.text: 彻底击败一波怪物。 （下表概述了每一波。）

ea6203d12592f827f2e599600119d405179ce2bb.source: A 2 point hold-out bonus is awarded every minute.
ea6203d12592f827f2e599600119d405179ce2bb.text: 每分钟奖励 2 分奖励。

e5684b84e739f73bc07e9fb0111b30273689fb10.source: Killing the 6 Luxon Adepts scattered across the map. They're 3 points each and every 3 minutes their point value increases by 3. You can view their current point value in the quest log. Defeating one will give your team a morale boost and the effect Rage of the Sea.
e5684b84e739f73bc07e9fb0111b30273689fb10.text: 杀死分散在地图上的 6 名卢克森行者。他们每个都是 3 点，每 3 分钟他们的点值就会增加 3。你可以在任务日志中查看他们当前的点值。击败一个将给你的团队带来士气提升和海洋之怒效果。

a91e7afdc40ac13fc120e69b538ae400f528df3a.source: At the start of the mission, Battle Priest Calibos will greet the party and run to the top of the island. He will remain there to assist with healing and smiting spells, but cannot keep himself alive if left completely alone. Each wave is made up of several separate groups that immediately head toward the island once summoned.
a91e7afdc40ac13fc120e69b538ae400f528df3a.text: 任务开始时，战斗牧师卡利波斯会迎接队伍并跑到岛顶。他将留在那里协助治疗和重击法术，但如果完全独自一人，他将无法保住自己的生命。每波浪潮都由几个独立的群体组成，一旦被召唤，它们就会立即前往岛屿。

bd4437f4f53f3418aa661b31def19923a982b7e7.source: It is a good idea to flag any Heroes and Henchmen in your party near Battle Priest Calibos at the start of the mission; this will ensure that they cover both sides equally and do not allow enemies to slip in on an unprotected side. You will not be moving from this spot until much later, if at all, so it is very advisable to bring skills which take advantage of this. Wells and wards in particular can be very advantageous here, because they will nearly always affect a large number of allies or enemies. It is also almost essential to have a minion master, or even better a minion bomber type character in your party, because this will provide a valuable meat shield which enemies will target preferentially over your party or Battle Priest Calibos.
bd4437f4f53f3418aa661b31def19923a982b7e7.text: 在任务开始时，最好在战斗牧师卡利博斯附近标记你队伍中的任何英雄和追随者；这将确保它们平等地覆盖两侧，并且不会让敌人从未受保护的一侧溜进去。直到很久以后你才会离开这个地方（如果有的话），所以最好带上利用这一点的技能。水井和守卫在这里尤其非常有利，因为它们几乎总是会影响大量盟友或敌人。在你的队伍中拥有一个小兵大师，甚至更好的小兵轰炸机类型的角色也几乎是必要的，因为这将提供一个有价值的肉盾，敌人会优先瞄准你的队伍或战斗牧师卡利博斯。

de57753b52f10ff1fea08b3ff2ab2e810097d171.source: Due to the massive number of enemies it is also advisable that you bring plenty of area of effect damage. Skills such as Splinter Weapon really shine here, so you might consider bringing multiple copies.
de57753b52f10ff1fea08b3ff2ab2e810097d171.text: 由于敌人数量众多，建议您带来足够的效果伤害范围。诸如碎片武器之类的技能在这里非常闪耀，所以你可以考虑带多份。

5fa3d4d0d05f34282bcc7efe91cbeeaaa314fec8.source: If you start to have difficulty with the Naga you may have to start focusing damage on single targets. Naga Archers in particular have block stances, and a self heal. If trying to bring down more than one at once your damage may become spread too thin, and you will have more difficulty killing them. From wave four you will start to see Oni and Saltspray Dragons. These have the potential to inflict a large amount of damage on your party, so it is wise to focus damage on these to bring them down quickly.
5fa3d4d0d05f34282bcc7efe91cbeeaaa314fec8.text: 如果您开始对娜迦感到困难，您可能必须开始将伤害集中在单个目标上。娜迦弓箭手尤其具有格挡姿势和自我治疗能力。如果试图一次击倒多个敌人，你的伤害可能会变得太分散，并且你将更难以杀死它们。从第四波开始，您将开始看到鬼和盐雾龙。它们有可能对你的队伍造成大量伤害，因此明智的做法是集中伤害以快速击倒它们。

4829486fd56f2752df9e0f150809b642f6579a77.source: The reward for killing the 6 Luxon Adepts gradually increases, but they do not respawn, so it is advisable to wait as long as possible before defeating them. Rangers, ritualist spirits, or any character with ranged attacks can kill them while the rest of the party defends the priest. The location of each Adept is marked on the map above.
4829486fd56f2752df9e0f150809b642f6579a77.text: 击杀 6 名卢克森行者的奖励会逐渐增加，但他们不会重生，因此建议尽可能等待才能击败他们。游骑兵、仪式神灵或任何具有远程攻击能力的角色都可以杀死他们，而队伍的其他成员则可以保护牧师。每个专家的位置都标记在上面的地图上。

84f66bf509bc818562a6de434bce72ffaf3e23cb.source: After you reach wave eight, each wave will afterwards consist of six Siege Turtles scattered across the map in pairs. Defeating all six in the time allotted for that wave will grant you a 50 point bonus, plus 5 points for each wave of turtles you have successfully destroyed previously. The turtles will attack from a large range, but then will be vulnerable while their attack is recharging.
84f66bf509bc818562a6de434bce72ffaf3e23cb.text: 当你到达第八波后，每一波将由六只成对分散在地图上的攻城龟组成。在为该波分配的时间内击败全部 6 只海龟将为您提供 50 点奖励，此外，您之前成功消灭的每波海龟还可获得 5 点奖励。海龟会从大范围攻击，但在攻击充电时会变得脆弱。

b3bd908a36b346678cc824e065f11aa9358e7063.source: When the turtles start spawning, they will stop attacking and just walk back and forth near their spawn point, allowing for infinite points and faction without any risk or effort
b3bd908a36b346678cc824e065f11aa9358e7063.text: 当海龟开始生成时，它们将停止攻击，只是在生成点附近来回走动，从而无需任何风险或努力即可获得无限的点和派系

042638d56a9add67c601f589f5f606550cf8dbca.source: Skills like Protective Spirit will be extremely useful in surviving the initial cannon blasts, which each do up to about 300 points of damage to their main target, and slightly less to foes in their AoE. Turtles will also try to flee during the times when their attack skill is recharging, making snares somewhat useful. Running skills can also help greatly with this stage, although it may not be possible to bring them if you have trouble holding out beyond the initial seven waves.
042638d56a9add67c601f589f5f606550cf8dbca.text: 像防护精神这样的技能对于在最初的大炮爆炸中生存非常有用，每次大炮爆炸都会对其主要目标造成约 300 点伤害，而对其 AoE 中的敌人造成稍低的伤害。海龟在攻击技能恢复时也会尝试逃跑，这使得陷阱有点用处。跑步技能对这个阶段也有很大帮助，尽管如果你在最初的七波之后遇到困难，可能就无法使用它们。

233642321f0df070d229b1f6d19d1a3da85e7b47.source: Your faction cap will increase by 1,000 Luxon faction the first time you finish this mission with 100 points or more.
233642321f0df070d229b1f6d19d1a3da85e7b47.text: 当您第一次以 100 点或更多积分完成此任务时，您的派系上限将增加 1,000 Luxon 派系。

329c832e6c8b014217906b89477e061757d0a485.source: If Luxon faction is maxed the first time you get over 100, you do not receive the extra end mission faction even when the limit is raised.
329c832e6c8b014217906b89477e061757d0a485.text: 如果Luxon派系在您第一次超过100时就达到上限，即使提高限制，您也不会收到额外的最终任务派系。

3fd492135cd77ae56b880e59061bb0747507297e.source: This challenge mission can be AFK farmed for Luxon faction points. As noted above, after wave 7 the mission bugs out, and never sends wave 8 and later waves to the island where Battle Priest Calibos stands. This allows players to gain 50 faction / minute indefinitely without any risk or effort. Certain hero team comps can successfully complete the first 7 waves without any player input.
3fd492135cd77ae56b880e59061bb0747507297e.text: 此挑战任务可以通过 AFK 来获得 Luxon 派系点数。如上所述，在第 7 波之后任务就会出错，并且不会将第 8 波及之后的波发送到战斗牧师卡利波斯所在的岛屿。这使得玩家可以无限期地获得 50 个派系/分钟，无需任何风险或努力。某些英雄团队组合可以在没有任何玩家输入的情况下成功完成前 7 波。

372984f84b642f6890db8dcf88806bd2453104c6.source: "Those Am Fah must not know true beauty when they see it! I'm nothing like them..."

f34496be37e5a58fa81497c2351a1e4f0c1fd0f9.source: "You know *they* are working with the Am Fah. Plotting against you. If you tell me what you know, the voices will stop."
f34496be37e5a58fa81497c2351a1e4f0c1fd0f9.text: “你知道*他们*正在与 Am Fah 合作。密谋反对你。如果你告诉我你所知道的，声音就会停止。”

8a7b739f0663293b911890e6b3363b0b2954ca51.source: "Tell me what you know or I will drown you in whatever invisible slime you are standing in!"
8a7b739f0663293b911890e6b3363b0b2954ca51.text: “告诉我你知道什么，否则我会把你淹死在你所站的任何看不见的粘液中！”

69b2f1becc2b39a1157fed9093ed71d9a29d1c5f.source: * "I'm good for it, if you've got what I want." * "There's no risk to you; the Am Fah will have to deal with me, and that will be the end of them."
69b2f1becc2b39a1157fed9093ed71d9a29d1c5f.text: *“如果你能得到我想要的东西，我很乐意。” *“对你来说没有风险；Am Fah将不得不对付我，那将是他们的终结。”

98a5fc4020bfe2a4918f5e8d049e59b595529a30.source: * "Tell me what you know of the Am Fah or I'll throw you...um, far!" or "I'm good for it, if you've got what I want." * "I can offer you a punch in the face. It's obviously what you need!"
98a5fc4020bfe2a4918f5e8d049e59b595529a30.text: *“告诉我你对 Am Fah 了解多少，否则我会把你扔……嗯，扔得很远！”或者“如果你能得到我想要的东西，我很乐意。” *“我可以给你一拳。这显然就是你所需要的！”

f6f23ab4dbb267292ce2959a33f4c10c61dfe41f.source: * "I'm after something very specific. Maybe you can help me find it." * "Yeah, I'm looking for a fight. But it's with the Am Fah, not you."
f6f23ab4dbb267292ce2959a33f4c10c61dfe41f.text: *“我正在寻找一些非常具体的东西。也许你可以帮我找到它。” *“是的，我想打架。但这是针对 Am Fah，而不是你。”

6936cf2cef9af174d62b8be0bbca3babb950a0a1.source: * "The Am Fah. Tell me what you know about them now, or by the time I'm done with you, you'll look like a dredge. Only more so." or "I'm after something very specific. Maybe you can help me find it." * "Yeah, I think you could stand to have some smarts beaten into you."
6936cf2cef9af174d62b8be0bbca3babb950a0a1.text: *“Am Fah。告诉我你现在对他们了解多少，否则当我和你打交道时，你会看起来像一个挖泥工。甚至更是如此。”或者“我正在寻找一些非常具体的东西。也许你可以帮我找到它。” *“是的，我认为你可以忍受一些聪明才智的打击。”

d6ac2a5ad35e02aacf8800b09efe075c9c966ceb.source: "Oh, I'm very interested. Tell me about these special wares."
d6ac2a5ad35e02aacf8800b09efe075c9c966ceb.text: “哦，我很感兴趣，给我讲讲这些特色商品吧。”

6ec0d1eda443ea90619610cc0be621ab56ca3ea4.source: "I want to know about the Am Fah. And I want to hurt you. I can only have one of these things. Which will it be?"
6ec0d1eda443ea90619610cc0be621ab56ca3ea4.text: “我想知道关于Am Fah的事情。我想伤害你。我只能拥有其中一件。会是哪一件呢？”
