ef3f7ca4381fd8305e6bf05bf0377e1aa686ebb8.source: 0: spawn point. Beware of patrolling mobs near this spot as it is easy to over aggro the nearby mobs. Do NOT take the quest from Rastigan yet.
ef3f7ca4381fd8305e6bf05bf0377e1aa686ebb8.text: 0：生成点。小心这个地点附近巡逻的小怪，因为很容易过度激怒附近的小​​怪。暂时不要接受拉斯蒂根的任务。

bae1d22abdebad34501fedbe26642c0d59c1fde7.source: 1: clear mobs north and mainly south of your spawn point without aggroing any Abyssal or Shadow Ranger or Rastigan will run forward and probably die which will kill the party.
bae1d22abdebad34501fedbe26642c0d59c1fde7.text: 1：清除你的重生点以北和以南为主的小怪，而不骚扰任何深渊游侠或暗影游侠或拉斯蒂根，他们会向前跑，可能会死，这会杀死队伍。

be5a8091a6dc56059713fad351a0fd8aa092085a.source: 2: clear the remaining groups around the Tower of Courage. Rastigan will join the fight but you should be able to protect him now. Rastigan will open the tower gate and mobs will spawn in it. Take the quest Tower of Courage that should now be completed (quest 1) and take the follow-up quest for later.
be5a8091a6dc56059713fad351a0fd8aa092085a.text: 2：清除勇气之塔周围剩余的队伍。拉斯蒂根将加入战斗，但你现在应该能够保护他。拉斯蒂根将打开塔门，小怪将在其中生成。接受现在应该完成的任务“勇气之塔”（任务 1）并稍后接受后续任务。

45abcb67b734349c23cc274b77def6651e1b4ce7.source: 3*: (optional) head north to the Great Battle Field and clear it from patrolling mobs from east to west. Beware of regular pop up enemies. You may want to trigger some mobs pop on Priest of Menzies location while he hasn't spawned yet.
45abcb67b734349c23cc274b77def6651e1b4ce7.text: 3*：（可选）向北前往大战场并清除从东到西巡逻的小怪。小心经常出现的敌人。您可能想在孟席斯牧师尚未生成时触发他的位置上的一些小怪。

6528d275de6517056c2510004e1448ee63d0d73a.source: 4: West of the Great Battle Field, clear the shadow mob camp. Clearing it spawns NPCs. Take the quests Army of Darkness from Kromril the Eternal (for later) and The Eternal Forgemaster from Eternal Weaponsmith.
6528d275de6517056c2510004e1448ee63d0d73a.text: 4：大战场以西，清理暗影怪营地。清除它会产生 NPC。接受永恒克罗姆瑞尔（稍后）的黑暗军团任务和永恒武器匠的永恒锻造师任务。

9344530074e9f44750efa0c358d84a25a05cf1b4.source: 5: move towards Temple of War. Clear the mob in front of the gate and beware of the incoming mobs behind you (fight them or rush in the temple ignoring them). Enter the temple and carefully clear groups on the first floor all around, then clear the last foes on the top of the temple to complete the quest (quest 2). The Eternal Forgemaster will appear.
9344530074e9f44750efa0c358d84a25a05cf1b4.text: 5：前往战神殿。清除门前的小怪，并提防身后的小怪（与他们战斗或冲进寺庙而忽略他们）。进入神庙并小心地清除一楼周围的群体，然后清除神庙顶部的最后敌人以完成任务（任务2）。永恒锻造大师将会出现。

7a5e3ee930d6761d0391cd0db70b9dad4450244b.source: 6: take the quest Defend the Temple of War. Enemies come to the upper platform in pairs so no need to rush. They may take their time to move. The Eternal Forgemaster must survive. Once done (quest 3), other allied NPC's will in the temple. The south gate of temple is now open, you can defeat the group on this side and take care of incoming group right after just as for the north entrance.
7a5e3ee930d6761d0391cd0db70b9dad4450244b.text: 6：接受保卫战神殿任务。敌人成对来到上层平台，所以无需着急。他们可能需要一些时间才能搬家。永恒锻造大师必须生存。一旦完成（任务 3），其他盟军 NPC 的意志就会出现在神庙中。现在寺庙的南门已经打开，可以打败这边的队伍，然后像北门一样处理后面进来的队伍。

1e006e2274192abc8c0a1586f99f61a42b428862.source: 7*: (optional) you may want to head south toward the Spider Cave to clear it in advance to make next step a bit easier. Move carefully as many spiders will often pop up. Make your way up to the waterfall bordering the Fissure Shore. Beware at this spot as many groups will spawn.
1e006e2274192abc8c0a1586f99f61a42b428862.text: 7*：（可选）您可能需要向南前往蜘蛛洞，提前清除它，以使下一步更容易一些。小心移动，因为经常会出现许多蜘蛛。前往与裂缝海岸接壤的瀑布。小心这个地方，因为许多群体会产卵。

3e7dc491202a28e515acd8e808589a52106556ae.source: 8: in the Temple, take both quests from Forgemaster and the one from Eternal Lord Taeres. You will focus on quest Restore the Temple of War first.
3e7dc491202a28e515acd8e808589a52106556ae.text: 8：在圣殿中，接受锻造大师的两个任务和永恒领主泰雷斯的一个任务。您将首先专注于恢复战争神庙任务。

c20bd4f5134ce12a66370e81c116f883abf1a205.source: 9: take quest The Hunt from Nimros the Hunter: Shard Wolves will spawn at different location in the area, you will kill them while doing the other quests. A first spawn in right behind you.
c20bd4f5134ce12a66370e81c116f883abf1a205.text: 9：接受猎人尼姆罗斯的狩猎任务：碎片狼会在该地区的不同位置产卵，你将在执行其他任务时杀死它们。第一个重生点就在你身后。

54e8015f6d580f3fcb2b4a6d10367970dcda242e.source: 10: clear the Spider Cave from Seeds of Corruption that spawn with the Forgemaster's quest (quest 4). Sneak to the Shore to kill the second Shard Wolf there.
54e8015f6d580f3fcb2b4a6d10367970dcda242e.text: 10：清除蜘蛛洞中随锻造大师任务（任务 4）生成的腐化种子。潜入海岸杀死那里的第二只碎片狼。

3fbd3cbecc6a927ed59eb0fa4231a0624bfb7072.source: At this point: return to the Forgemaster to complete the quest. He will offer Obsidian armor crafting.
3fbd3cbecc6a927ed59eb0fa4231a0624bfb7072.text: 此时：返回锻造大师处完成任务。他将提供黑曜石盔甲的制作。

916a8092a47896efa35e9f02a3b63962526771ad.source: 11: head north toward the Tower of Strengh for the associated quest. Cautiously clear the zone up to the tower, you'll find multiple patrols overlaping and spawns. Be sure to kill the 5 Shadow Patrols. A third Shard Wolf will be there as well. Go back toward Temple of War to trigger the Tower Mage route, that will wait for you before the tower.
916a8092a47896efa35e9f02a3b63962526771ad.text: 11：向北前往力量之塔进行相关任务。小心地清理直到塔楼的区域，你会发现多个巡逻队重叠并生成。一定要杀死 5 个暗影巡逻队。第三只碎片狼也会在那里。返回战神殿触发塔法师路线，塔前会等你。

3f2b7373c95e256d9fff13d8ae7aeaaf5788bd50.source: 12: in the meantime, move south-east to the Lake of Fire for the Khobay the Betrayer quest. You can pull Khobay's group (or hopefully boss only) away from the last wurm if needed. Killing him will complete the quest (quest 5).
3f2b7373c95e256d9fff13d8ae7aeaaf5788bd50.text: 12：与此同时，向东南方移动到火湖，进行背叛者霍贝任务。如果需要的话，你可以将科贝伊的队伍（或者希望只是老板）从最后一只亚龙身边拉开。杀死他即可完成任务（任务 5）。

f53b782a8d4f37849a594d7c34a79acf42ac2016.source: 13: go back to Tower of Strength. After the NPC opens the tower, kill the last mob that will spawn inside to complete the quest (quest 6).
f53b782a8d4f37849a594d7c34a79acf42ac2016.text: 13：回到力量之塔。 NPC 打开塔后，杀死里面生成的最后一个生物即可完成任务（任务 6）。

4b0cbbec201f283f267edabf0f8dd55d3a2b906b.source: 14: move north to find Miko the Unchained and clear patrol that are wandering here.
4b0cbbec201f283f267edabf0f8dd55d3a2b906b.text: 14日：向北移动，找到无束缚的米科并清除在这里徘徊的巡逻队。

c9c472dc674fca8ce2054df7a626fc610578b30b.source: 15*: (optional) without Miko's quest, cautiously clear the Burning Forest, at least the main path to the end of the zone. There are multiple patrols overlapping, and any seemingly isolated mob is actually grouped with mixed foes. A fourth Shard Wolf is found here.
c9c472dc674fca8ce2054df7a626fc610578b30b.text: 15*：（可选）在没有米科的任务的情况下，小心地清理燃烧森林，至少是通往区域尽头的主要道路。有多个巡逻队重叠，任何看似孤立的暴民实际上都与混合的敌人组合在一起。第四只碎片狼在这里被发现。

b230e482f43fc23000e9e1e25683f895324df081.source: 16: get back to Miko and take his quest, then kill the 4 groups that appeared at the back of the Forest (quest 7). If you did not clear the zone, you may sneak to the right but do not forgot the fourth Shard Wolf.
b230e482f43fc23000e9e1e25683f895324df081.text: 16：回到Miko并接受他的任务，然后杀死出现在森林后面的4个小组（任务7）。如果您没有清除该区域，您可以潜入右侧，但不要忘记第四个碎片狼。

4ead213b95e562dad91315fe8e850c200e1f19a6.source: 17: head west, back to the Great Battle Field. Go north to complete the quest you took at point 3 by killing the Priest of Menzies. You may pull its surrounding groups away first then engage the lonely boss, or possibly pull the boss directly from below the cliff. He will drop a quest item you need to give back to the NPC (quest 8). On your way, you'll find a fifth Shard Wolf to kill.
4ead213b95e562dad91315fe8e850c200e1f19a6.text: 17日：向西走，回到大战场。向北走，杀死孟席斯牧师，完成第 3 点的任务。你可以先把周围的队伍拉开，然后再与孤独的boss交战，或者可以直接从悬崖下面拉boss。他会掉落一个你需要返还给 NPC 的任务物品（任务 8）。在路上，你会找到第五只需要杀死的碎片狼。

716b9392c367a9ce3e5d4eff6c6a15a9e4833ddc.source: 18: move west toward the Forest of the Wailing Lord for The Wailing Lord quest you received at point 2. Note that the zone will include an seemingly hostile foe, the Wailing Lord, but he must NOT be harmed. Clear the zone, without crossing the bridge leading to the Wailing Lord. A sixth Shard Wolf can be killed here, in north part, that could be pulled from main path. Be sure to clean the main path and south part, north is not needed.
716b9392c367a9ce3e5d4eff6c6a15a9e4833ddc.text: 18：向西前往哀嚎领主森林，进行在第 2 点收到的哀嚎领主任务。请注意，该区域将包括一个看似敌对的敌人，哀嚎领主，但不得伤害他。清理该区域，但不要穿过通向哀嚎领主的桥梁。第六只碎片狼可以在这里杀死，在北部，可以从主路上拉出来。一定要清理主干道和南边部分，北边不需要。

ab3b8cc9e166f9d900b68d5017364122b404aba8.source: 19: Carefully pull Banshees across the bridge, without harming the Wailing Lord. You can enter in Wailing Lord aggro zone, he will not attack you, but beware to have heroes flagged further. Try to pull out skeletons across the bridge as well. After you kill them all, the Wailing Lord will turn friendly and Shadow Beasts will spawns. You can validate the quest (quest 9) and take A Gift of Griffons. For this one you'll need to escort Griffons to Tower of Courage.
ab3b8cc9e166f9d900b68d5017364122b404aba8.text: 19：小心地将女妖拉过桥，不要伤害哀嚎领主。你可以进入哀嚎领主仇恨区，他不会攻击你，但要小心英雄被进一步标记。也尝试把桥上的骷髅拉出来。当你把他们全部杀死后，哀嚎领主会变得友好，暗影野兽也会出现。你可以验证任务（任务 9）并获得狮鹫的礼物。对于这一任务，您需要护送狮鹫前往勇气之塔。

a733f8a31eca988fe89671a194a5551bc3d1a4e3.source: 20*: (optional) as Griffons may be killed easily, you may want to make your way to Tower of Courage without them and quietly fight the hostile groups that appeared with this quest. This is safer but take a little bit more time. Griffons should stand still until you approach them but sometimes they rush to you right away. In this case, you may need to flag your heroes forward and let them deal with the fights, while you keep Griffons safe.
a733f8a31eca988fe89671a194a5551bc3d1a4e3.text: 20*：（可选）由于狮鹫可能很容易被杀死，你可能想在没有狮鹫的情况下前往勇气之塔，并悄悄地与此任务中出现的敌对团体作战。这更安全，但需要更多时间。狮鹫应该站着不动，直到你接近它们，但有时它们会立即冲向你。在这种情况下，你可能需要标记你的英雄前进并让他们处理战斗，同时确保狮鹫的安全。

57fff79d5453992ef94df523f555a9f374b197e3.source: 21: approach the Griffons so they start following you. Lead them to Rastigan to complete the quest (quest 10).
57fff79d5453992ef94df523f555a9f374b197e3.text: 21：接近狮鹫 让他们开始跟随你带领他们去拉斯蒂根完成任务（任务 10）。

011f9153030eea958bee5f842eb4bac88f942f0b.source: 22: the seventh and last Shard Wolf will be found just south of the tower. Kill him to complete the last quest (quest 11).
011f9153030eea958bee5f842eb4bac88f942f0b.text: 22 日：第七只也是最后一只碎片狼将出现在塔的南面。杀死他来完成最后一个任务（任务 11）。

f1fb7311aafd22f8ff5ce9211a39ac2b40b45a8f.source: At this point, even without getting quests rewards yet, The Fissure of Woe is completed! Make your way back to Temple of War to open the Chest of Woe. You can pick up quests rewards and resign to leave.
f1fb7311aafd22f8ff5ce9211a39ac2b40b45a8f.text: 至此，即使还没有获得任务奖励，悲哀裂痕也已经完成了！返回战争神殿打开悲痛宝箱。您可以领取任务奖励并辞职离开。

1b313b94b1eb847399fbd048cdee7a94cf1674ca.source: [Flashback Quest]: While this quest is in your Quest Log, the lands of Cantha will revisit the time of the Afflicted.
1b313b94b1eb847399fbd048cdee7a94cf1674ca.text: [闪回任务]：当这个任务在你的任务日志中时，凯珊的土地将重温受难者的时代。

315a7601e085d194e21f0c581f397c2322dabed7.source: "Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out."
315a7601e085d194e21f0c581f397c2322dabed7.text: “你好，公民！你听到这个消息了吗？在纯洁部领导下的凯珊人民的不懈努力下，诅咒我们伟大国家的瘟疫终于被赶走了。”

2e957514dd03ea2c8fbacb09ee8b948e6a43b6e4.source: "Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task."
2e957514dd03ea2c8fbacb09ee8b948e6a43b6e4.text: “请允许我与你们分享这些斗争的故事，以便我们纪念那些在这项崇高任务中牺牲的人们。”

86cb761232a61de8990ac03d7b0903382a8994a0.source: You must be the foreign recruits Kormir told me to expect. It's good to see so many heroes from beyond these shores coming to our aid. Spearmarshal Kormir is awaiting for you in the Plains of Jarin. You should hurry and catch up to her; she seems even more driven than normal these days and probably won't wait around long.
86cb761232a61de8990ac03d7b0903382a8994a0.text: 你一定就是科米尔告诉我的外籍新兵。很高兴看到这么多来自海外的英雄来帮助我们。科米尔矛元帅正在贾林平原等待着您。你应该快点追上她；这些天她似乎比平时更有动力，可能不会等太久。

1d9bd6c3fe1eccde6dc1c8b471493c56a116cbed.source: Good to see you again, . Today must be my lucky day! I won 200 gold on a bet with First Spear Jahdugar and then you show up just when I need to talk to you. Looks like it's time for you to begin learning about secondary professions. Why don't you head back to the encampment near Chahbek Village and speak to a few of the experts there. They can tell you all about life in the professions.
1d9bd6c3fe1eccde6dc1c8b471493c56a116cbed.text: 很高兴再次见到你，。今天一定是我的幸运日！我和 First Spear Jahdugar 打赌赢得了 200 金币，然后当我需要和你说话的时候你出现了。看来你是时候开始学习第二职业了。你为什么不回到查贝克村附近的营地并与那里的一些专家交谈呢？他们可以告诉您有关职业生活的所有信息。

4310ba7bd15c60205ee76d35d66d9c37b9e2e983.source: Now that you have learned more about the other professions, it's time to make a choice. Think carefully, now. Once you decide, you won't be able to change your mind for some time.
4310ba7bd15c60205ee76d35d66d9c37b9e2e983.text: 现在您已经对其他职业有了更多了解，是时候做出选择了。现在仔细想想。一旦你决定了，在一段时间内你将无法改变主意。

051f1258a89a0c78f41cd6e4f10fe26b8781ab75.source: Which secondary profession would you like to choose? (primary profession omited from list)
051f1258a89a0c78f41cd6e4f10fe26b8781ab75.text: 您想选择哪个第二职业？ （列表中省略了主要职业）

5f727c8e794988f11e782a9d5f302d5c9cd1d701.source: Yes I wish to take Mesmer as my secondary profession.
5f727c8e794988f11e782a9d5f302d5c9cd1d701.text: 是的，我希望将幻术师作为我的第二职业。

9a2a91a9287c25d0b98447f70d5d8990249a1141.source: Yes I wish to take Necromancer as my secondary profession.
9a2a91a9287c25d0b98447f70d5d8990249a1141.text: 是的，我想把死灵法师作为我的第二职业。

fd2b05bcda2e78e301fe7e86fcbfe8487e6abf83.source: Yes I wish to take Elementalist as my secondary profession.
fd2b05bcda2e78e301fe7e86fcbfe8487e6abf83.text: 是的，我想把元素师作为我的第二职业。

52a0cb466480f37a0d2efdc2758123649e7a9550.source: Yes I wish to take Monk as my secondary profession.
52a0cb466480f37a0d2efdc2758123649e7a9550.text: 是的，我想把僧侣作为我的第二职业。

2d8a1276c76d5ddae2ae7d06eb8f0e4277f7dd6c.source: Yes I wish to take Warrior as my secondary profession.
2d8a1276c76d5ddae2ae7d06eb8f0e4277f7dd6c.text: 是的，我想把战士作为我的第二职业。

d7e11826337a82a6057711b5a1099be8e7fadcb3.source: Yes I wish to take Ranger as my secondary profession.
d7e11826337a82a6057711b5a1099be8e7fadcb3.text: 是的，我想把游侠作为我的第二职业。

f19915f8bc8e40b4f01603161a4757a85f790567.source: Yes I wish to take Dervish as my secondary profession.
f19915f8bc8e40b4f01603161a4757a85f790567.text: 是的，我希望以苦行僧作为我的第二职业。

fa5b68bda544ed2e4e6be3958688e198b80ec962.source: Yes I wish to take Paragon as my secondary profession.
fa5b68bda544ed2e4e6be3958688e198b80ec962.text: 是的，我想把Paragon作为我的第二职业。

dc7e8cd9ad6a36644446cba2435efe38686bec13.source: No I am not ready to choose.

101d73ee417576ae05e91f1cd98a1bae35d2a42f.source: The Trial of Zinn is one part of the Guild Wars Beyond content. It takes place in an alternate version of Vlox's Falls. Speak with Chark outside Vlox's Falls to attend.
101d73ee417576ae05e91f1cd98a1bae35d2a42f.text: 津恩的试炼是激战超越内容的一部分。它发生在 Vlox 瀑布的另一个版本中。与弗洛克斯瀑布外的查克交谈以参加。

0a57d5e02c77d2222d2a2808660c7152c45faf2b.source: Access to this trial requires completion of the quest Zinn's Task or completion of The Knowledgeable Asura portion of the Eye of the North campaign. You may also join the party of a player who has met those requirements.
0a57d5e02c77d2222d2a2808660c7152c45faf2b.text: 进入此试炼需要完成辛恩的任务任务或完成北方之眼战役的知识渊博的阿修罗部分。您也可以加入满足这些要求的玩家的队伍。

88f38f37cb074adfbb9ba26d5b5ea6a26f2fe5c0.source: Chark: "You're finally here, bookah. Per Asuran custom, no one may speak to the council, defense, or persecution for the duration of the trial. So, quickly conclude any business you have with them, and step into the witness area when you are ready for us to begin."
88f38f37cb074adfbb9ba26d5b5ea6a26f2fe5c0.text: 查克：“你终于来了，布卡。按照阿苏拉的习俗，在审判期间，任何人都不得与议会、辩护方或迫害者交谈。所以，尽快结束你与他们之间的所有事务，并在你准备好让我们开始时进入证人区。”

38cabdb3ca1dc859cf38e865ef9641508d7216db.source: Enter the Lion's Arch Keep and approach Princess Salma. A dialogue will begin between her and the spy Dinas. After the dialogue concludes, the quest will become available from Salma.
38cabdb3ca1dc859cf38e865ef9641508d7216db.text: 进入狮子拱门并接近萨尔玛公主。她和间谍迪纳斯之间将开始对话。对话结束后，萨尔玛即可完成任务。

ec041fdf718a45bfbffa47a10387c38c1c93f1fe.source: Emperor's Voice: Emperor Kisu wishes to speak with you. When he received word that Shiro was within the city walls, he ordered the Imperial Army to surround the area. He is in the temple now seeking counsel from the spirits ensconced there, and he awaits your arrival.
ec041fdf718a45bfbffa47a10387c38c1c93f1fe.text: 皇帝之声：基须皇帝想与您交谈。当他收到四郎位于城墙内的消息时，他命令帝国军队包围该地区。他现在正在圣殿中向栖息在那里的神灵寻求建议，并等待着你的到来。

95991af0979615b53c1744eadc1aa52d7253a68a.source: "Great news! I bested Megundeh, the rune trader, in a game of cards and won this debt collection ticket from him. He says it's worth five platinum!
95991af0979615b53c1744eadc1aa52d7253a68a.text: “好消息！我在纸牌游戏中击败了符文商人梅根德，从他那里赢得了这张追债券。他说这价值五白金！”

d161b64d80f648ab49ec35bc4057ef9c1bc27eba.source: We must go to the Barbarous Shore and find Ruthless Sevad. He's the corsair with the debt. I can't wait... This sure is my lucky day!"
d161b64d80f648ab49ec35bc4057ef9c1bc27eba.text: 我们必须前往野蛮海岸找到无情的塞瓦德。他是欠债的海盗。我已经等不及了……这真是我的幸运日！”

ce65e746e04c8779d5468a39cd4accf2b00099da.text: 中级对话 1（无情的塞瓦德）

6a340ac88b10a20caa5875a3aee7ec6d96499f35.source: "A debt collection ticket? Interesting. Let's just open it up and see what's inside, shall we?
6a340ac88b10a20caa5875a3aee7ec6d96499f35.text: “收债票？有趣，我们打开看看里面有什么，好吗？

17d3a1834be8ebeabb142212c14bd63f5ddbf2bb.source: It says here you've agreed to pay off Megundeh's debt to me. Did he mention how much he owes? It's a sizable sum. The man doesn't know when to quit when he's behind, and he never, ever, manages to get ahead....
17d3a1834be8ebeabb142212c14bd63f5ddbf2bb.text: 上面写着你同意偿还梅根德欠我的债。他有没有提到他欠了多少钱？这是一笔相当大的数目。当一个人落后的时候，他不知道什么时候该放弃，而且他从来没有成功过......

e9f10ad91667c3a2b2ef71f3fb4f7bc0bdcf60f0.source: You've clearly bitten off more than you can chew. I'm feeling extremely generous today, so I'll give you a choice. You can pay the five platinum he owes me or you can work it off. The task is simple, but not one I care to perform personally. I want you to collect another debt. Wring the cash out of Jerob No-Spine and I'll consider Megundeh's debt paid in full. What's it to be?"
e9f10ad91667c3a2b2ef71f3fb4f7bc0bdcf60f0.text: 显然你已经咬得太多了。我今天感觉非常慷慨，所以我会给你一个选择。你可以付他欠我的五白金，也可以把它还掉。这项任务很简单，但我不想亲自执行。我要你再讨一次债。从杰罗布·诺·斯宾身上榨取现金，我会考虑全额偿还梅根德的债务。会是什么？”

9108c5d494cfb8f294571f1c83d4442926d23908.source: Option 1: "Thief! Here's your five platinum... and not a gold piece more."
9108c5d494cfb8f294571f1c83d4442926d23908.text: 选项一：“小偷！这是你的五白金……不能再多了。”

d7d1314b41dc19a406cfc1d3019a928e8481cd10.source: "Well, five platinum is quite a bit of money. Maybe I should think this through."
d7d1314b41dc19a406cfc1d3019a928e8481cd10.text: “嗯，五白金也是不少钱了。也许我应该考虑一下。”

d90951bd6f4de18da7f78d659df097ea09572346.source: Yes"Here's the money...five platinum." (If you have 5 platinum.)
d90951bd6f4de18da7f78d659df097ea09572346.text: 是的“这是钱……五白金。” （如果你有 5 白金。）

7c0cd0e4be6873e8ac5199a0855e5508717a7147.source: Yes"On second thought, I just can't afford it."
7c0cd0e4be6873e8ac5199a0855e5508717a7147.text: 是的“转念一想，我就是买不起。”

008d802be6cc577d66c53c8ffe278429970ac672.source: Option 2: "You want five platinum? Outrageous! I'll collect the other debt."
008d802be6cc577d66c53c8ffe278429970ac672.text: 选项2：“你想要五白金？太离谱了！我会收取其他债务。”

6171c322727e4a65b3994f249a25fc4b2f7c46e9.source: "Sevad sent you? Is he here? ... Look, I told him. I need more time. I'll get the money. I swear. It's just a matter of... please don't hurt me! I know the location of a rich, old corsair's loot. But it's protected by a beast he's tamed. My mum's been sick and I've got to tend her every need, bless her heart, so I haven't had time to... don't draw that weapon! I'm thinking, since you're not going to hurt me, right...right? I'm thinking you could collect that loot for me. Here, I'll mark the spot on your map. Then you can take care of it for us both."
6171c322727e4a65b3994f249a25fc4b2f7c46e9.text: “塞瓦德派你来的吗？他在吗？……听着，我告诉他。我需要更多时间。我会拿到钱。我发誓。这只是一个问题……请不要伤害我！我知道一个富有的老海盗的战利品的位置。但它受到他驯服的野兽的保护。我妈妈病了，我必须照顾她的一切需要，上帝保佑她的心，所以我没有时间……不要……不要拔出那把武器吧！我想，既然你不会伤害我，对吧……我想你可以帮我收集那些战利品。然后我会在你的地图上标记出这个位置，然后你就可以帮我们俩处理它了。”

a5167d08f05c81f8d296702be79bcc4dfc071b20.text: 中级对话3（无情的塞瓦德）

ee0f63dc07123a8963976aaa27ecf909ced803c7.source: "Megundeh's debt is paid. Looks like things worked themselves out. For me at least..."
ee0f63dc07123a8963976aaa27ecf909ced803c7.text: “梅根德的债已经还清了。看来事情已经解决了。至少对我来说……”

b48120d1cd1332331315a89258bca249a9ebb182.source: You think you're ready to go save the world? It's dangerous out there, and even a Sunspear can't do it alone. Luckily, you don't have to. You see these fine people stand next to me? They're called henchmen. They want to adventure with people, and they are looking for someone to take them along so they can fight the dangers of the world. You may need to call on their services often, so you should introduce yourself. Go ahead and add one to your party, then meet me out on the Plains of Jarin.
b48120d1cd1332331315a89258bca249a9ebb182.text: 你认为你准备好拯救世界了吗？那里很危险，即使是烈阳之矛也无法独自完成任务。幸运的是，您不必这样做。你看到我旁边站着这些好人了吗？他们被称为追随者。他们想与人一起冒险，他们正在寻找有人带他们一起去对抗世界上的危险。您可能需要经常致电他们的服务，因此您应该自我介绍。来吧，在你的队伍中添加一名成员，然后在贾林平原与我会面。

f781196af22b7e19be0c5ad2033f3f3ef96485f3.text: “在困难模式下清除黯淡海岸阿尔卡齐亚纠缠区的所有敌人。”

5325f865711c3f461daed1c812afa8f8ddd30bd8.text: 在此任务中得分，根据以下公式奖励库尔兹克派系、经验和黄金。值向下舍入。达到每日最佳、每月最佳或季度最佳的成绩可获得额外奖金。

e80a83fa7d6a76ee333306ac8dcbbc9050e9b857.text: “在困难模式下清除库尔纳野蛮海岸的所有敌人。”

09feaee809afc7098495ec4a563762378f4c4ca5.source: "Oh, I can tell you exactly where Duke Barradin went. Yes, he and a company of red-cloaked Vanguard troops passed north through this very gate. We rescued a deserter not long after that. Seems they fell under heavy attack, and the duke decided to push through, wanted to find refuge in the ruins of Piken Square."
09feaee809afc7098495ec4a563762378f4c4ca5.text: “哦，我可以告诉你，巴拉丁公爵具体去了哪里。是的，他和一队红袍先锋部队就是从这个城门北上的。不久之后，我们就救出了一名逃兵。看来他们受到了猛烈的攻击，公爵决定硬闯，想要在皮肯广场的废墟中避难。”

b9731b495df412c41eb0631f892a37704781ff91.source: "Listen, my duties keep me here at the Wall, but if you want to try to break through the whole Balthazar-cursed Charr army to meet up with Barradin, gods protect you, I say. No doubt the duke will greet you with open arms."
b9731b495df412c41eb0631f892a37704781ff91.text: “听着，我的职责让我留在长城，但如果你想突破整个被巴尔萨扎诅咒的夏尔军队与巴拉丁会合，我说，众神会保护你。毫无疑问，公爵会张开双臂迎接你。”

As such, it is recommended to clear the rest of the map before venturing to the northeastern corner.

18f3e396fbd635eee5fa27e3751a3c9c0f52a172.text: “清除法赫拉努尔，困难模式下伊斯坦所有敌人的第一座城市。”

46860fb5da1b80a6ce932e2e0594be118f199018.text: “在困难模式下清除埃科瓦尔德森林中芬代尔的所有敌人。”

bdabc0c70f0365bcbdb6811ce815255ffaea61b6.source: Your character must have the quest Round 1: Fight! in order to enter the tournament. Obtain the quest from Magni the Bison if this is the first time your character is entering the tournament or is re-entering the tournament after previously winning the tournament. Losing the tournament will keep that quest in your quest log. Talk to Gellir Frostshield to start the tournament. A fee of 100gold is automatically deducted from your character upon confirmation.
bdabc0c70f0365bcbdb6811ce815255ffaea61b6.text: 你的角色必须有任务第一轮：战斗！为了进入比赛。如果这是您的角色第一次参加锦标赛或在之前赢得锦标赛后重新参加锦标赛，请从野牛麦格尼那里获得任务。输掉比赛将会将该任务保留在您的任务日志中。与盖里尔·霜盾交谈以开始锦标赛。确认后，系统会自动从您的角色中扣除 100gold 的费用。

8f1df11f6d701e4d37df6f3893a9a8dbcbc7d448.source: There are six consecutive rounds that you must win in total to be considered the winner of the tournament. In the first five rounds, an opponent is randomly selected from a subset of those listed below, i.e. each opponent can appear in only a particular round so that each round has a different set of potential foes. In the sixth round, your opponent will be Magni the Bison (although, in extremely rare cases, you might face Palawa Joko during Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!).
8f1df11f6d701e4d37df6f3893a9a8dbcbc7d448.text: 您必须总共赢得连续六轮比赛才能被视为锦标赛的获胜者。在前五轮中，对手是从下面列出的子集中随机选择的，即每个对手只能出现在特定轮次中，因此每轮都有一组不同的潜在敌人。在第六轮中，您的对手将是野牛麦格尼（尽管在极少数情况下，您可能会在决赛，冠军版：战斗中面对帕拉瓦·约科！）。

90c02d9038db4791889fb70671b5640a11e46aa7.source: The tournament takes place in a small explorable area designed as an arena. Each of the 6 rounds of battle (5 random opponents and the final round) takes place in a different instance of the area. Your character starts each round in a side room. The door to the battle chamber is locked for 10 seconds; when the timer ends, the door opens and your previously neutral opponent turns hostile. However, you will not aggro your foe until you step out of the side-door, giving you extra time to cast enchantments or preparations. When you leave the side room, the door will close behind you and you must kill or be killed.
90c02d9038db4791889fb70671b5640a11e46aa7.text: 比赛在一个设计为竞技场的小型可探索区域举行。 6 轮战斗（5 个随机对手和最后一轮）中的每一轮都在该区域的不同实例中进行。你的角色在一个侧室开始每一轮。战斗室的门被锁上10秒；当计时器结束时，门打开，你之前中立的对手变得充满敌意。然而，在你走出侧门之前，你不会激怒你的敌人，这给你额外的时间来施展结界或准备。当你离开侧室时，门会在你身后关闭，你必须杀人或被杀。

553210c8386ae4cdf2b34b9ccd2f81e274c8a1c7.source: Upon winning the final round for the first time, you receive:
553210c8386ae4cdf2b34b9ccd2f81e274c8a1c7.text: 首次赢得最后一轮后，您将获得：

d52067fe374d36a9287e11a743a168ab3e6f4df3.source: Repeated completions of the tournament reward one Bison Championship Token each.
d52067fe374d36a9287e11a743a168ab3e6f4df3.text: 重复完成锦标赛每人奖励一枚 Bison 锦标赛代币。

5bd4a9b284e5176e8f3e456b474dbb4cf10bd3e7.source: Winning the first five rounds award Norn reputation points to characters with a Norn rank of less than eight: 5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25 (for a total of 75 points).
5bd4a9b284e5176e8f3e456b474dbb4cf10bd3e7.text: 赢得前五轮比赛会给诺恩等级低于 8 的角色奖励诺恩声望点：5 → 10 → 15 → 20 → 25（总共 75 点）。

578abb5038f6303d9b5193ee6ef33cd3fecdcda2.source: Defeating Xandra and Kahmu will unlock them as heroes.
578abb5038f6303d9b5193ee6ef33cd3fecdcda2.text: 击败桑德拉和卡穆会将他们解锁为英雄。

60f048a9097e3992d441742d2ee6502a168a77ad.source: After defeating Zho for the first time, you will receive Zho's Journal, which is required to obtain the Black Moa Chick.
60f048a9097e3992d441742d2ee6502a168a77ad.text: 第一次击败卓后，您将收到卓的日记，这是获得黑恐鸟小鸡所必需的。

48cf7e26cd219ca8d7db7f6796e98ff5f6dcb005.source: The first time you defeat the Great Zehtuka with Zehtuka's Great Horn in your inventory, he will replace it with Zehtuka's Horn; the new item will be customized to your current character.
48cf7e26cd219ca8d7db7f6796e98ff5f6dcb005.text: 当你第一次用泽图卡的大号角打败伟大的泽图卡时，他会用泽图卡的号角代替它；新物品将根据您当前的角色进行定制。

6d3be85072b5a666ce57ca1a241b789ca7f02eb6.source: Guide to the Norn Fighting Tournament

d12e822635fd5e4e72238fa8f64036895b78fa3b.source: Enchantment removal, to counter the monk opponents.
d12e822635fd5e4e72238fa8f64036895b78fa3b.text: 结界解除，对抗武僧对手。

0142d8c5d6b9b72f284b89b10b28f328ebfe13f4.source: A spirit spammer with sufficient damage (e.g. Signet of Spirits) and self-healing (e.g. Vampirism) or protection (e.g. Union).
0142d8c5d6b9b72f284b89b10b28f328ebfe13f4.text: 具有足够伤害（例如精神印记）和自我修复（例如吸血鬼）或保护（例如联盟）的精神垃圾邮件发送者。

e30c5d2f95ea15ebf2896bfb1f84d8d545ad75f5.source: snares to keep out of melee range, e.g. "You Move Like A Dwarf!".
e30c5d2f95ea15ebf2896bfb1f84d8d545ad75f5.text: 圈套以远离近战范围，例如“你像个侏儒一样移动！”。

9b06802fb311895e6659c72fc5144d4af18742bc.source: Skills that cause Blind to nerf his attacks.
9b06802fb311895e6659c72fc5144d4af18742bc.text: 导致盲人削弱攻击的技能。

09b766a42fea2926d025050faaca4056130fa70d.source: Interrupts, to prevent him from using his Bear Form.
09b766a42fea2926d025050faaca4056130fa70d.text: 打断，阻止他使用熊形态。

2bc34531e895a57e9fc4b5704d4d915667c5ff9e.source: The tournament cannot be fought in Hard mode; the game will always switch to Normal mode upon entering.
2bc34531e895a57e9fc4b5704d4d915667c5ff9e.text: 锦标赛不能在困难模式下进行；进入游戏后总是会切换到普通模式。

0744287ddcc6c1233a437c49c55a612ccbafe288.source: Opponents do not drop loot; however, their companions can drop seasonal items if they die before you win the round.
0744287ddcc6c1233a437c49c55a612ccbafe288.text: 对手不会掉落战利品；然而，如果他们的同伴在你赢得回合之前死亡，他们可能会掉落季节性物品。

00dcac42720eb8afa1d2bdec6d7b3569de1c9543.source: Spirits placed in the starting room will not have line of sight to the main battle; spirits placed in the starting room's doorway will. Alternatively, you can move the spirits into the main room just before the gate shuts.
00dcac42720eb8afa1d2bdec6d7b3569de1c9543.text: 放置在起始房间的灵魂不会看到主战；将烈酒放置在起始房间的门口。或者，您可以在大门关闭之前将灵魂转移到主房间。

9c503063a163164f3e06a692d0d58ed50327a9f9.source: A "You were not worthy." message appears if you die during the tournament.
9c503063a163164f3e06a692d0d58ed50327a9f9.text: A“你不值得。”如果您在锦标赛期间死亡，则会出现消息。

0be4515b8056565265d17c501dd9f8e64051afa2.text: 即使在前往鹰巢区域的任务之前，娜迦隐藏收藏家的地图图标也会显示在任务地图上，而实际的收藏家并不在鹰巢中。

3bd9d9b859393ca88fd4a717977f6a809dae9c2a.text: “在困难模式下清除席瓦山脉南部的洛纳通道中的所有敌人。”

7a8a83f39757d822b27da7ab505515b6df720241.source: "Now is your chance to prove yourself a loyal Sunspear. Infiltrate Dzaga's gang and follow him to the rendezvous. When you get there, use the advantage of surprise to break up the deal and bring the smugglers some Sunspear justice It's your choice. Remain loyal to the Sunspear cause, or go along with Dzaga's Gang and make some money on the side."
7a8a83f39757d822b27da7ab505515b6df720241.text: “现在是你证明自己是一名忠诚的烈阳之矛者的机会了。潜入扎加的帮派并跟随他前往会合点。到达那里后，利用出其不意的优势打破交易，为走私者带来一些阳矛正义。这是你的选择。保持对阳矛事业的忠诚，或者跟随扎加的帮派并赚点外快。”

a04a2da78f6bb560fdeabede6cfe6188a80358af.text: 击败：44-85个敌人。所有可见的敌人都集中在东半部，所以建议从千古神殿出发，从塔尔马克荒野接近。

39f947fe009ded5c8bd02a0cfee256be09d835ff.source: "Hey, guess what? My mom showed me how to map travel the other day! It's amazing! I just look at my map and select a place I've already been, and I go there instantly! It only works on cities I've marked with a big gold and green symbol, but once I start going to other towns and outposts I'll end up finding more places I can travel to instantly. I just saw you come out of town, so you should have a marker for town on your map. You should click on it and tell my mom thanks for inventing map travel!"
39f947fe009ded5c8bd02a0cfee256be09d835ff.text: “嘿，你猜怎么着？前几天我妈妈向我展示了如何绘制旅行地图！太神奇了！我只需查看地图并选择一个我去过的地方，然后立即前往那里！它只适用于我用大金色和绿色符号标记的城市，但一旦我开始前往其他城镇和前哨站，我最终会找到更多我可以立即前往的地方。我刚刚看到你从城镇出来，所以你的地图上应该有一个城镇标记。你应该点击它，然后告诉我妈妈，谢谢你发明了地图旅行！”

ad09d4ed653f19e988fa4bdd8b34c6f710d8a62e.text: “在困难模式下清除星甲岛盘江半岛的所有敌人。”

3db3d751d3acff5c0c3e64dd37c8bc399f9b4362.source: "Clear Perdition Rock in the Ring of Fire Islands of all enemies in hard mode."
3db3d751d3acff5c0c3e64dd37c8bc399f9b4362.text: “在困难模式下清除火环群岛中所有敌人的毁灭岩。”

e407c4d95b8740121b04eb8db3951053d857b2de.source: "Clear the Plains of Jarin in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."
e407c4d95b8740121b04eb8db3951053d857b2de.text: “在困难模式下清除伊斯坦贾林平原上的所有敌人。”

18f964eaa64d479927edb4424da146f6305d3e17.source: "Clear the Pockmark Flats in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
18f964eaa64d479927edb4424da146f6305d3e17.text: “在困难模式下清除阿斯卡隆麻子平地上的所有敌人。”

d04fbdc3517a446afb325f846181bfceb7f33446.source: Vanquishing: 135–234 foes. There are numerous Devourer pop-ups throughout the zone, with a large number in the northern valley surrounding the Searing Crystal.
d04fbdc3517a446afb325f846181bfceb7f33446.text: 击败：135–234 名敌人。整个区域有许多吞噬者弹出窗口，其中大量位于灼热水晶周围的北部山谷。

2dc56b596c5b6b5d1e5537637cc98087396178d6.source: "Clear the Poisoned Outcrops in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
2dc56b596c5b6b5d1e5537637cc98087396178d6.text: “在困难模式下清除所有敌人荒凉之地的有毒露头。”

30033db966e89e815b69ecb0141510952df181ad.source: Before you can participate in Polymock matches, you must first obtain three starter pieces from Hoff in Rata Sum and then register them with Denn. Each registration removes the Polymock piece from your inventory and is permanently tied to your character (as opposed to your account). Do not register the piece if you plan on trading it to another character.
30033db966e89e815b69ecb0141510952df181ad.text: 在参加 Polymock 比赛之前，您必须首先从 Rata Sum 的 Hoff 处获得三件起始棋子，然后向 Denn 注册。每次注册都会从您的库存中删除 Polymock 部件，并永久绑定到您的角色（而不是您的帐户）。如果您打算将其交易给其他角色，请不要注册该零件。

dbdc652a24e6e79d69d0dcf4e72015914cbaea1e.source: Once you have the three starter pieces, you can do the quest chain which starts from Polymock: Defeat Yulma. The objective of a Polymock match is to kill all three of your opponent's pieces before they kill yours.
dbdc652a24e6e79d69d0dcf4e72015914cbaea1e.text: 一旦你拥有了三个起始件，你就可以完成从Polymock开始的任务链：击败Yulma。 Polymock 比赛的目标是在对手杀死你的棋子之前杀死对手的所有三个棋子。

c711153e89cc0adf06f5f71f6e577a4176ed9377.source: After defeating the designated opponent (i.e. completed the quest and accepted the reward), you can return to those you have defeated and challenge them to a match under tournament rules. The one difference is that you are required to choose your Polymock pieces from all three rarities (white, purple, gold). If you did not register at least one Polymock piece for each rarity, you cannot challenge opponents using tournament rules. Winning such Polymock matches will earn you from 40 to 90 Asuran reputation points, depending on who you challenged.
c711153e89cc0adf06f5f71f6e577a4176ed9377.text: 击败指定对手（即完成任务并接受奖励）后，您可以回到已击败的对手并按照锦标赛规则挑战他们。一个区别是，您需要从所有三种稀有品（白色、紫色、金色）中选择您的 Polymock 作品。如果您没有为每种稀有度注册至少一件 Polymock 棋子，则您无法使用锦标赛规则挑战对手。赢得此类 Polymock 比赛将为您赢得 40 到 90 阿苏兰声望点，具体取决于您挑战的对象。

8ffc4d4d664d5cec2e6b9a738363b89609f83f79.source: Polymock takes place in several special explorable areas, depending on which region the opponent is found in:
8ffc4d4d664d5cec2e6b9a738363b89609f83f79.text: Polymock 发生在几个特殊的可探索区域，具体取决于对手所在的区域：

f7e7ce92b82c0a9d5ed7117263176143a8ee01cf.source: Polymock Coliseum in the Tarnished Coast.
f7e7ce92b82c0a9d5ed7117263176143a8ee01cf.text: 玷污海岸的波利莫克竞技场。

48c4f92aba54a19f187a10a69ad094cbcdc83696.source: Polymock Glacier in the Far Shiverpeaks.
48c4f92aba54a19f187a10a69ad094cbcdc83696.text: 遥远席瓦山脉的波利莫克冰川。

c3524a4ecb7d51d3a8265adff28454fe32e6dd3c.source: Polymock Crossing in the Charr Homelands.
c3524a4ecb7d51d3a8265adff28454fe32e6dd3c.text: 查尔故乡的波利莫克渡口。

03de3c7d194fe4bc9c257cfe0aebc6bfbc160d7f.source: After completing all polymock quests, you must play by tournament rules. The game is played with 3 pieces of different rarities polymock. To play, you must have 1 common piece, 1 uncommon piece and 1 rare piece.
03de3c7d194fe4bc9c257cfe0aebc6bfbc160d7f.text: 完成所有 Polymock 任务后，您必须遵守锦标赛规则。该游戏使用 3 件不同稀有度的模型进行。要玩游戏，您必须拥有 1 个普通棋子、1 个不常见棋子和 1 个稀有棋子。

600d2c4f0b4a2eec6a76b3474cb499a3f0012753.source: You win 90 Asuran reputation points for defeating Fonk, Volumandus, Teardrinker, Silverfist or Hoff, 80 points for defeating Blarp, 60 points for Plurgg and 40 points for Yulma.
600d2c4f0b4a2eec6a76b3474cb499a3f0012753.text: 击败 Fonk、Volumandus、Teardrinker、Silverfist 或 Hoff 可获得 90 点阿苏拉声望点，击败 Blarp 可获得 80 点，Plurgg 可获得 60 点，Yulma 可获得 40 点。

6bae99416574d190a7d551b4f61534062a2e188b.text: 为了最大化阿苏拉头衔

f70f69ffb94445dda7299ae336e1aea16b9c3131.text: 1 赢得 90 分。一场比赛持续 5 分钟。

53aee0d5edc34a9d47572809498f6ba8210eb803.source: It will take approximately 74 hours to reach tier 8 of the Asuran title if Asuran reputation points are gained exclusively using Polymock matches. No points are awarded past tier 8 therefore it is impossible to max the Asuran title by Polymock exclusively.
53aee0d5edc34a9d47572809498f6ba8210eb803.text: 如果仅使用 Polymock 比赛获得阿苏拉声望点，则需要大约 74 小时才能达到阿苏拉头衔的第 8 级。超过 8 级后不会获得任何积分，因此不可能通过 Polymock 独家获得阿苏兰头衔。

80b8e12b478d4d41d15146a3e0c81709f9959abb.source: Talk to Wokk to choose the three Polymock pieces that you want to use. After selecting your three pieces, you are then asked to select which of the three to start with. You are allowed to examine your skill bar before each round begins. Note that the platforms your piece and your opponent's piece are standing on are close to each other and that it is impossible to move out of range (although strafing to dodge projectiles is possible). Your character is replaced by the Polymock piece that you have chosen. Any enchantments or summons you have are removed. Your weapon and armor bonuses do not apply to Polymock skills.
80b8e12b478d4d41d15146a3e0c81709f9959abb.text: 与 Wokk 交谈以选择您想要使用的三个 Polymock 部件。选择三件作品后，系统会要求您选择三件作品中的哪一件开始。您可以在每轮开始之前检查您的技能栏。请注意，您的棋子和对手的棋子所站立的平台彼此靠近，并且不可能移出范围（尽管可以进行扫射以躲避射弹）。您的角色将被您选择的 Polymock 棋子所取代。你拥有的任何结界或召唤都会被移除。你的武器和护甲加值不适用于 Polymock 技能。

cb0e9e13a403cd861515f81e994cd88c0c5ddb83.source: When you use a white (common) Polymock piece, your maximum health is 3000 and your energy is 30. Purple (uncommon) pieces give a maximum health of 4000 and a maximum energy of 35. Gold (rare) pieces give you 5000 maximum health and 40 energy.
cb0e9e13a403cd861515f81e994cd88c0c5ddb83.text: 当你使用白色（普通）Polymock 碎片时，你的最大生命值为 3000，能量为 30。紫色（罕见）碎片的最大生命值为 4000，最大能量为 35。金色（稀有）碎片为你提供 5000 最大生命值和 40 能量。

9a2e43715f0d74d1dc768e0243d3eeaa953867ce.source: Skill use and effects during the match are similar to normal PvE, the only difference being conditions like Burning, Bleeding, and Disease always cause full -10 health degeneration.
9a2e43715f0d74d1dc768e0243d3eeaa953867ce.text: 比赛中的技能使用和效果与普通 PvE 类似，唯一的区别是燃烧、流血和疾病等条件总是会导致全 -10 生命值退化。

5873798ab75fd53ae1eda028d83f606fc4484cc2.source: When you are done reviewing your skills, you can tell Wokk to start the match. A 10-second countdown timer will begin, counting down to the start of the duel, at which point the opponent's Polymock piece turns hostile.
5873798ab75fd53ae1eda028d83f606fc4484cc2.text: 当你回顾完你的技能后，你可以告诉 Wokk 开始比赛。 10 秒倒计时将会开始，倒计时直到决斗开始，此时对手的 Polymock 棋子将转为敌对。

5043574b282b55e08b65df2b078af248e0eb6658.source: A round ends when one or both Polymock pieces loses all health. The loser is required to select another Polymock piece from the remaining two to start the next round. The winner retains its current level of health and energy, and all skills continue their recharge duration (i.e. the skills are not automatically recharged). Once the loser selects the next piece and starts the next round, the 10-second countdown will start again. If your opponent (i.e. the NPC) lost the previous round, the countdown timer starts almost immediately, since the winner is not prompted to start the next round.
5043574b282b55e08b65df2b078af248e0eb6658.text: 当一个或两个 Polymock 棋子失去所有生命值时，一轮结束。失败者需要从剩余的两块 Polymock 中选择另一块 Polymock 来开始下一轮。获胜者保留当前的生命值和能量水平，并且所有技能都会继续其充能持续时间（即技能不会自动充能）。一旦失败者选择下一个棋子并开始下一轮，10秒倒计时将重新开始。如果你的对手（即 NPC）输掉了上一轮，倒计时器几乎立即开始，因为获胜者不会被提示开始下一轮。

658a0a5b0c5e5ed04e1110ee6dcbc0bbcf2e5864.source: This continues until one side's three Polymock pieces have all been defeated. Win or lose, you will be returned to the previous location.
658a0a5b0c5e5ed04e1110ee6dcbc0bbcf2e5864.text: 这样一直持续到一方的三块 Polymock 棋子全部被击败为止。无论输赢，您都将返回之前的位置。

0eb517ce497d33a128bf6ab98f066194ba79e8f2.source: A good opening piece when you still need to use common pieces is the Skale because it does 150 damage with its spammable attack to enemies > 50% health and has two damage skills, both of which do a great deal of damage but take time to activate and thus benefit from facing a healthy opponent.
0eb517ce497d33a128bf6ab98f066194ba79e8f2.text: 当你仍然需要使用普通棋子时，一个很好的开局棋子是斯卡勒，因为它对生命值 > 50% 的敌人进行垃圾邮件攻击，造成 150 点伤害，并且有两种伤害技能，这两种技能都会造成大量伤害，但需要时间来激活，因此从面对健康的对手时受益。

8c973e2b36c7fc4c9312e9f1bfff366689dc1d76.source: When the opponent begins a round with a new piece, they will always start off with Polymock Glyph of Concentration, followed by either their most damaging spell or sometimes the light damage spell. This can be taken advantage of by using your 2-second spells right from the start. Even if your opponent attempts Polymock Power Drain after the glyph, you will almost always get your spell off. Using the 2-second spell here risks taking their high damage spell without being able to get Polymock Block off in time, so using your 1-second spell then Blocking instead may be preferred. Be careful to wait at least 30 seconds for your opponent's skills to recharge before beginning with your new piece so they will have the Polymock Glyph of Concentration available, otherwise they'll start the round in an unpredictable manner.
8c973e2b36c7fc4c9312e9f1bfff366689dc1d76.text: 当对手以新棋子开始一轮时，他们总是会以 Polymock 专注雕文开始，然后是他们最具伤害性的法术，有时是轻微伤害法术。可以通过从一开始就使用 2 秒法术来利用这一点。即使你的对手在雕文之后尝试Polymock Power Drain，你几乎总是会摆脱你的咒语。在这里使用 2 秒法术可能会冒着遭受高伤害法术而无法及时关闭 Polymock 阻挡的风险，因此使用 1 秒法术然后阻挡可能是首选。在开始使用你的新棋子之前，请小心等待至少 30 秒，让对手的技能恢复，这样他们就会拥有可用的 Polymock 专注雕文，否则他们将以不可预测的方式开始回合。

319dc1a631d02331f1925639cf230e9f0a44db84.source: Always watch your health and energy levels. When you're below 50% health, do not neglect the bonus damage offered by Polymock Glyph of Power. But do not activate it blindly, as the enemy will Polymock Power Drain your attempts to use the Glyph. Be aware of whether you have enough energy to pull it off, because the Glyph works very well with your spammable skill.
319dc1a631d02331f1925639cf230e9f0a44db84.text: 时刻关注您的健康和精力水平。当你的生命值低于 50% 时，不要忽视 Polymock 力量雕文提供的额外伤害。但不要盲目激活它，因为敌人会耗尽你使用雕文的尝试。请注意您是否有足够的精力来完成它，因为雕文非常适合您的垃圾邮件技能。

b2fc68f9285a23dde01334b9611f48e006a2b465.source: Do not forget to use Polymock Ether Signet the moment you reach zero energy. Trying to cast spells without energy wastes valuable time. If you or your opponent is weak, don't hesitate to waste a Polymock Power Drain or Polymock Block to use up your energy so that you can use the Ether Signet and hit them with a higher damage ability.
b2fc68f9285a23dde01334b9611f48e006a2b465.text: 当你达到零能量时，不要忘记使用 Polymock Ether Signet。尝试在没有能量的情况下施展法术会浪费宝贵的时间。如果你或你的对手很弱，请毫不犹豫地浪费Polymock Power Drain或Polymock Block来消耗你的能量，这样你就可以使用以太印章并以更高的伤害能力击中他们。

c39ff8eb35e7aa440dbd989c238779d5e372a5c0.source: Try to use Polymock Power Drain and Polymock Block wisely. Try to save them for highly damaging spells and time their recharge. Polymock Glyph of Power is a good interrupt target as well. Be aware of what type of spells can be blocked and what type can be interrupted but not blocked.
c39ff8eb35e7aa440dbd989c238779d5e372a5c0.text: 尝试明智地使用 Polymock Power Drain 和 Polymock Block。尽量让它们免受高伤害法术的伤害，并安排好它们的充电时间。 Polymock Glyph of Power 也是一个很好的中断目标。注意什么类型的法术可以被格挡，什么类型的法术可以被打断但不能格挡。

95e42f253fc6d1546bafd8591e6ca2fa3e61562a.source: Polymock Block can be used as an alternative to Polymock Glyph of Concentration if you use a 1 second spell right after it. Frequently the enemy won't react right away after having a spell blocked, giving plenty of time for your spell to complete. They will often be able to interrupt a 2 second spell after being blocked though, but if you can use the block while they're not casting then it will work for longer spells as well. If you have neither available, you can also slip a 1 second spell in right as the enemy is activating one of their spammable attacks to get it through uninterrupted.
95e42f253fc6d1546bafd8591e6ca2fa3e61562a.text: 如果您在紧随其后使用 1 秒法术，则 Polymock Block 可以用作 Polymock Glyph of Concentration 的替代品。通常，敌人在法术被阻挡后不会立即做出反应，从而为你的法术提供充足的时间来完成。他们通常能够在被阻挡后打断 2 秒的法术，但如果你可以在他们不施法时使用阻挡，那么它也适用于更长的法术。如果你两者都没有，你也可以在敌人激活其垃圾邮件攻击之一时在右侧插入一个 1 秒咒语，以使其不间断地完成。

5274ac5d58492cfe4e5125bdbf290ce4073ab7a9.source: The following opponents are listed in the order the quest chain introduces them:
5274ac5d58492cfe4e5125bdbf290ce4073ab7a9.text: 以下对手按照任务链介绍的顺序列出：

06c6fc692d344c650e8d30b84915173a807dfef7.source: Yulma (1) - uses the three starter pieces - see Polymock: Defeat Yulma
06c6fc692d344c650e8d30b84915173a807dfef7.text: 尤尔玛 (1) - 使用三个起始件 - 参见 Polymock：击败尤尔玛

640cc6b127e198e25bef844f93ff6e7be10cc540.source: Plurgg (2) - uses Fire Imp, Ice Imp, and Kappa - see Polymock: Defeat Plurgg
640cc6b127e198e25bef844f93ff6e7be10cc540.text: Plurgg (2) - 使用 Fire Imp、Ice Imp 和 Kappa - 参见 Polymock：击败 Plurgg

4f67ee673cbca46b8be335d08d6fc8c014f0b381.source: Blarp (3) - uses Earth Elemental, Ice Elemental, and Fire Elemental - see Polymock: Defeat Blarp
4f67ee673cbca46b8be335d08d6fc8c014f0b381.text: 布拉普 (3) - 使用土元素、冰元素和火元素 - 参见 Polymock：击败布拉普

891f372b72733c40596a18212c828380d086d025.source: Fonk (4) - uses Kappa, Aloe, and Wind Rider - see Polymock: Defeat Fonk
891f372b72733c40596a18212c828380d086d025.text: Fonk (4) - 使用 Kappa、Aloe 和 Wind Rider - 参见 Polymock：击败 Fonk

40921c14fbf42980d95e58228cb32809f6b52798.source: Dune Teardrinker (5a) - uses Charr Shaman, Charr Flamecaller, Titan - see Polymock: Defeat Dune Teardrinker
40921c14fbf42980d95e58228cb32809f6b52798.text: 沙丘饮泪者 (5a) - 使用夏尔萨满、夏尔唤火者、泰坦 - 参见 Polymock：击败沙丘饮泪者

249825e3bdc7702004d6cb26075bc3f01e088b6f.source: Grulhammer Silverfist (5b) - uses Dredge, Dolyak, Dwarf - see Polymock: Defeat Grulhammer Silverfist
249825e3bdc7702004d6cb26075bc3f01e088b6f.text: 格鲁哈默·银拳 (5b) - 使用挖掘机、多利亚克、矮人 - 参见 Polymock：击败格鲁哈默·银拳

94fa43c6d35de6fdde62e197f0f25a04139626f8.source: Necromancer Volumandus (5c) - uses Skeleton, Wraith, Dragon - see Polymock: Defeat Necromancer Volumandus
94fa43c6d35de6fdde62e197f0f25a04139626f8.text: 死灵法师 Volumandus (5c) - 使用骷髅、幽灵、龙 - 参见 Polymock：击败死灵法师 Volumandus

c47b7264d3239aa88dcea4a90fe66d783aca4102.source: Hoff (8) - uses random pieces - see Polymock: Defeat Master Hoff
c47b7264d3239aa88dcea4a90fe66d783aca4102.text: 霍夫 (8) - 使用随机棋子 - 参见 Polymock：击败霍夫大师

7163c00d159408d2f3506f1a19fd00992c15ac58.source: Begin the fight with your highest damage 1 second cast spell. This will hit your enemy while they are using their Polymock Glyph of Concentration. Optionally, if you cast your other high-priority spell right in the beginning, your opponent will not be able to interrupt it.
7163c00d159408d2f3506f1a19fd00992c15ac58.text: 以你的最高伤害 1 秒施法法术开始战斗。当你的敌人使用他们的 Polymock 专注雕文时，这会击中他们。或者，如果你一开始就施展其他高优先级法术，你的对手将无法打断它。

4f10c19f6f717dba013c267ed534a15897a13bdf.source: Use Polymock Block to interrupt your enemy's high powered spell.
4f10c19f6f717dba013c267ed534a15897a13bdf.text: 使用 Polymock Block 打断敌人的高能法术。

4b77c2e2f7476977150f00677c009a5ff85ebb9d.source: Use Polymock Glyph of Concentration followed by your other high-priority spell.
4b77c2e2f7476977150f00677c009a5ff85ebb9d.text: 使用 Polymock 专注雕文，然后使用其他高优先级法术。

2e6dbea93f363f7fa5f6737e5cf07673d6dc7fc8.source: Be ready to interrupt their 2 second cast or other high damage spell which is almost always used soon after.
2e6dbea93f363f7fa5f6737e5cf07673d6dc7fc8.text: 准备好打断他们的 2 秒施法或其他高伤害法术，这些法术几乎总是在不久后使用。

fd9fdec3c07fa16e053ac86af9c2bc82baba2cc5.source: Use Polymock Block instantly and start casting your 2-second spell. Usually, when the enemy finishes Concentration and tries to interrupt you, the Block will still be in effect.
fd9fdec3c07fa16e053ac86af9c2bc82baba2cc5.text: 立即使用 Polymock Block 并开始施放 2 秒法术。通常，当敌人完成集中并试图打断你时，格挡仍然有效。

17cac41ec53626398c702861b262cf1793f2b2a9.source: Use Polymock Power Drain to interrupt their high-powered spell which they generally try to cast now, but whose Concentration effect was wasted on trying to interrupt you.
17cac41ec53626398c702861b262cf1793f2b2a9.text: 使用Polymock Power Drain来打断他们现在通常尝试施放的高能法术，但其集中效果在试图打断你时被浪费了。

a89946b2d1dcf6eeebbf88c111e2cc67772215ee.source: Use Polymock Glyph of Concentration followed by your highest damage spell.
a89946b2d1dcf6eeebbf88c111e2cc67772215ee.text: 使用 Polymock 专注雕文，然后使用你的最高伤害法术。

376da03efd1bbda81a080e9cf9e851e99cfa005e.source: After opening with one of the above two starting attack chains, spam your primary low-damage spell continuously. It breaks the opponent's Block rapidly, and it delivers continual damage while you wait for skills to recycle, targets to interrupt, or while you think of tactics or are moving your mouse with the other hand. It is a very important default action requiring no thought.
376da03efd1bbda81a080e9cf9e851e99cfa005e.text: 使用上述两个起始攻击链之一打开后，连续向你的主要低伤害法术发送垃圾邮件。它能快速打破对手的格挡，并在你等待技能回收、目标打断、思考战术或用另一只手移动鼠标时持续造成伤害。这是一个非常重要的默认操作，无需思考。

c1283f05924f6ebbf4c9223d012579d684974843.source: While spamming and attacking with other spells, use the fast Polymock Block and Polymock Power Drain between them.
c1283f05924f6ebbf4c9223d012579d684974843.text: 在使用其他法术进行垃圾邮件和攻击时，请在它们之间使用快速 Polymock Block 和 Polymock Power Drain。

1a98cbaf78527cf65cbeb0a89afad8c9ce939cef.source: Cast Polymock Block whenever it is ready for use. Because of its fast cycle time (12s), don't delay using it, except when a high-damage spell will be ready for casting soon and Polymock Glyph of Concentration is not yet available.
1a98cbaf78527cf65cbeb0a89afad8c9ce939cef.text: 只要准备好使用，就铸造 Polymock 块。由于其快速循环时间（12 秒），请不要延迟使用它，除非即将准备好施放高伤害法术且 Polymock 专注雕文尚未可用。

1c6cefadebc3e939627afa227ae447f5cd487e72.source: Cast Polymock Power Drain tactically, don't waste it. Hover your mouse over the skill while you wait for something good to interrupt, meanwhile spamming away with your primary low-damage spell and casting Polymock Block periodically.
1c6cefadebc3e939627afa227ae447f5cd487e72.text: 战术上施放 Polymock Power Drain，不要浪费它。将鼠标悬停在技能上，等待有好东西打断，同时使用主要的低伤害法术并定期施放Polymock Block。

875c16e31211c6f7c14ec62d0696818d72be1f52.source: Always use Polymock Glyph of Concentration before casting your high-damage spell to reduce the chance of it being wasted.
875c16e31211c6f7c14ec62d0696818d72be1f52.text: 在施放高伤害法术之前，请务必使用 Polymock 专注雕文，以减少其被浪费的机会。

b9505a7dfc3d06edaa80e7295b71549517f820d9.source: When your energy is at 5 or below, focus almost exclusively on getting it to zero fast so that Polymock Ether Signet can be used. If you're down to energy 6 but your 6-energy high-damage spell is not yet available, forget it, focus on losing all your energy. Your main spam skill (cost 1e), Polymock Glyph of Power (1e) and Polymock Block (2e) are best for shedding your energy. Polymock Power Drain (3e) could be used, but it is such an important skill that it is best left for its primary role of interrupting tactically.
b9505a7dfc3d06edaa80e7295b71549517f820d9.text: 当你的能量为 5 或更低时，几乎完全专注于将其快速归零，以便可以使用 Polymock Ether Signet。如果你的能量已降至 6，但你的 6 能量高伤害法术尚未可用，那就算了，专注于失去所有能量。你的主要垃圾技能（成本 1e）、Polymock 力量雕文 (1e) 和 Polymock 阻挡 (2e) 最适合释放你的能量。可以使用Polymock Power Drain（3e），但它是一项非常重要的技能，因此最好保留它的主要作用是在战术上打断。

9a6f93e1c0c8b5d548bccdda5cc3df0a1d858d9b.source: Throughout all of the above, always use Polymock Glyph of Power if you are under 50% health. By adding 200 damage, it makes your primary low-damage spell a real powerhouse, and should be used at every opportunity.
9a6f93e1c0c8b5d548bccdda5cc3df0a1d858d9b.text: 在上述所有内容中，如果您的生命值低于 50%，请始终使用 Polymock 力量雕文。通过增加 200 点伤害，它使你的主要低伤害法术成为真正的强力法术，应该抓住每一个机会使用。

b83751c9d64ffbc3936754a97bfec2b89f233c4e.source: Using the above strategy, all the main quest opponents can be defeated very easily and almost automatically.
b83751c9d64ffbc3936754a97bfec2b89f233c4e.text: 使用上述策略，所有主线任务对手都可以非常轻松且几乎自动击败。

3dfbb69d887076b04eb2c073d10a4e2453e8bcfa.source: You can map travel out to abandon a match. This makes it faster to restart a match if it goes badly or if you've made a mistake selecting your pieces. Using /resign will let you teleport to the outpost without having to locate it on the world map.
3dfbb69d887076b04eb2c073d10a4e2453e8bcfa.text: 您可以计划外出旅行以放弃比赛。如果比赛进展不佳或您选择棋子时出现错误，这可以更快地重新开始比赛。使用 /resign 可以让你传送到前哨站，而无需在世界地图上找到它。

4ecc0f9b087cdeb6411e8b8d1017bc796e6c09b8.source: Survivors beware that losing all three battles will on rare occasion count as a death.
4ecc0f9b087cdeb6411e8b8d1017bc796e6c09b8.text: 幸存者要注意，在极少数情况下，输掉所有三场战斗将被视为死亡。

82772e537aa92344dee3a0903590a9977f65f151.source: When you are outside of your Polymock piece, you will be subject to all active Polymock effects. For example, if the match has ended and a projectile is already mid flight, it will still deal damage to you once it hits. Another example is an area damage over time skill such as Polymock Savannah Heat. Because of the high amounts of Polymock skill damage (most Polymock skills deal over 500 damage), you will die but you will be resurrected instantly without any animation. You might not notice your death mid-match, even if you actually defeat your opponent in the Polymock battle.
82772e537aa92344dee3a0903590a9977f65f151.text: 当您处于 Polymock 作品之外时，您将受到所有活动 Polymock 效果的影响。例如，如果比赛已经结束并且射弹已经在飞行中，那么它一旦击中仍然会对您造成伤害。另一个例子是随着时间的推移造成区域伤害的技能，例如 Polymock Savannah Heat。由于Polymock技能伤害很高（大多数Polymock技能造成500以上伤害），你会死，但会立即复活，没有任何动画。即使您实际上在 Polymock 战斗中击败了对手，您也可能不会在比赛中注意到自己的死亡。

84870c0a32656f486626a084f6dae3d1a56f34d3.source: After defeating an opponent Polymock piece, there's a short time window that allows you to activate another skill with an activation time of 1 second or less, such as Polymock Glyph of Power.
84870c0a32656f486626a084f6dae3d1a56f34d3.text: 击败对手的 Polymock 棋子后，有一个很短的时间窗口，允许您激活另一个技能，激活时间为 1 秒或更短，例如 Polymock Glyph of Power。

9290471059d4db4d7d6c4158e3d219d9a549e215.source: To make future runs easier, avoid registering the Ice Elemental, Aloe Seed, and Mirage Iboga pieces as you get them, and just complete the quest sequence with the Earth Elemental, Fire Elemental, and Kappa. Then pass the three unregistered pieces off to new characters that need to go through, and return them after completion. Note that this will prevent you from participating in Tournament Mode until you register a Rare piece.
9290471059d4db4d7d6c4158e3d219d9a549e215.text: 为了让以后的运行更容易，请避免在获得冰元素、芦荟种子和幻影伊博加碎片时注册它们，而只需使用土元素、火元素和河童完成任务序列即可。然后将未注册的三块交给需要经过的新角色，完成后归还。请注意，这将阻止您参加锦标赛模式，直到您注册了稀有棋子。

e8243eba2a8a12b414005e50e7ba9c254d7f51b0.text: “凯兰现在应该就在这里了。认识他，他很固执，愿意尝试步行。如果他这样做了……那可能会让他在铁砧岩附近的某个地方。那就是我们应该开始搜索的地方。拜托，这是我需要做的事情。

e7bb6059a4be75bbb0ec3c456c45cb91614fac5b.text: “在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林中所有敌人的缠结根。”

c1f53843e1c669bb7d3576c80a63c0eb41ba7e4a.source: "Clear Tasca's Demise in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
c1f53843e1c669bb7d3576c80a63c0eb41ba7e4a.text: “在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉中所有敌人的塔斯卡灭亡。”

2b45efcfb7164893229088c4fee57f3ab19c8dfb.source: "Clear Tears of the Fallen in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
2b45efcfb7164893229088c4fee57f3ab19c8dfb.text: “在困难模式下清除科瑞塔所有敌人的堕落者之泪。”

fbed13a8690be8dc1f6cbde972b500a205200c58.source: "Clear the Alkali Pan in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
fbed13a8690be8dc1f6cbde972b500a205200c58.text: “在困难模式下清除所有敌人的荒凉碱锅。”

c0ecf970187c94edd8c497a9e94e26dfe1a36de2.source: "Clear the Arid Sea in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."
c0ecf970187c94edd8c497a9e94e26dfe1a36de2.text: “在困难模式下清除水晶沙漠干旱海中的所有敌人。”

638c097dc9d42f49cd14e1f14b7b3936baa8031e.source: Scoring in this mission rewards Luxon faction, experience, and gold based on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.
638c097dc9d42f49cd14e1f14b7b3936baa8031e.text: 在此任务中得分，根据以下公式奖励卢克森派系、经验和黄金。值向下舍入。达到每日最佳、每月最佳或季度最佳的成绩可获得额外奖金。

eb4fb3fb66da3817985ed4f4440be2de908e7801.source: "Clear the Black Curtain in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
eb4fb3fb66da3817985ed4f4440be2de908e7801.text: “在困难模式下清除科瑞塔黑幕中的所有敌人。”

3f7bf497d2f96dae612494e2aa26b3e8a7d9ec24.source: Vanquishing: 207–306 foes. Has many hidden foes.
3f7bf497d2f96dae612494e2aa26b3e8a7d9ec24.text: 击败：207-306 名敌人。有许多隐藏的敌人。

1d8df6decf8c080db083b7e3638097ea0a983247.source: "Clear the Breach in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
1d8df6decf8c080db083b7e3638097ea0a983247.text: “在困难模式下清除阿斯卡隆突破口的所有敌人。”

6658fffd59abb50be43e5313399f3e30395f125d.source: Vanquishing: 100–134 foes. Has hidden Devourers and Crown of Thorns.
6658fffd59abb50be43e5313399f3e30395f125d.text: 击败：100–134 个敌人。隐藏了吞噬者和荆棘王冠。

4520ab73e08d09a1e1711feb801d75dd8476a288.source: A broken sword lies on the ground. The make of the blade is familiar. You've seen these before: standard issue for the White mantle. A small battle appears to have been fought here, and signs of movement suggest that is carried forward into Aurora Glade. The Scrying pool should be able to show you what happened here.
4520ab73e08d09a1e1711feb801d75dd8476a288.text: 一把断剑躺在地上。刀片的品牌很熟悉。您以前已经看过这些：白斗篷的标准问题。这里似乎曾发生过一场小规模的战斗，有动静的迹象表明战斗已进入极光林地。探知池应该能够告诉你这里发生了什么。

015644263d7916516a021073d2878544dff70041.source: Though we are battered, we are not broken...so long as we have you to lead us! At the back of the Sunspear Sanctuary is an area called the Command Post. This is where you can meet with your squad to discuss battle tactics and strategies. It also links to underground passages to other areas of Kourna so we can move about undetected by Varesh. Dunkoro is waiting in the Command Post. No doubt he has some plans about how we should proceed."
015644263d7916516a021073d2878544dff70041.text: 虽然我们遍体鳞伤，但我们不会破碎……只要有你的带领！烈阳之矛庇护所的后面有一个叫做指挥所的区域。在这里，您可以与您的小队会面，讨论战术和策略。它还连接着通往库尔纳其他地区的地下通道，这样我们就可以在不被瓦雷什发现的情况下四处走动。邓科罗正在指挥所等候。毫无疑问，他对我们应该如何进行有一些计划。”

39727393936a1fe28249e10a0170d4781960ac06.source: "Clear the Eternal Grove in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."
39727393936a1fe28249e10a0170d4781960ac06.text: “在困难模式下清除 Echovald 森林中永恒丛林中的所有敌人。”

9a425b81dfb9acd078dd03b34b3649b675da76bc.source: "Clear the Falls in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."
9a425b81dfb9acd078dd03b34b3649b675da76bc.text: “在困难模式下清除迈古玛丛林瀑布中的所有敌人。”

ae379fa7e94d722f6850f013d82b6c1fdbff9a92.source: "Clear the Floodplain of Mahnkelon in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
ae379fa7e94d722f6850f013d82b6c1fdbff9a92.text: “在困难模式下清除库尔纳马恩科隆洪泛区的所有敌人。”

d8e658e0bc8d28348c68f74995ffd77482f5f96d.source: "Clear the Hidden City of Ahdashim in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."
d8e658e0bc8d28348c68f74995ffd77482f5f96d.text: “在困难模式下清除瓦比艾哈达希姆隐藏之城的所有敌人。”

e10bef6b99f045c7a08bd77dd76c4f4d50ccca04.source: "Clear the Mirror of Lyss in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."
e10bef6b99f045c7a08bd77dd76c4f4d50ccca04.text: “在困难模式下清除瓦比利斯之镜中的所有敌人。”

42a420d3f306e413ccfd993fcda1cf3638d7211e.source: "Clear the Ruptured Heart in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
42a420d3f306e413ccfd993fcda1cf3638d7211e.text: “在困难模式下清除所有敌人的荒凉中的破碎之心。”

78cc889e62ebf328bdc1b58d76b49f3af02b96c0.source: "Clear the Scar in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."
78cc889e62ebf328bdc1b58d76b49f3af02b96c0.text: “在困难模式下清除水晶沙漠中所有敌人的伤痕。”

45a17415b6a4219713a8ba982e92f1797412dd23.source: "Clear the Shattered Ravines in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
45a17415b6a4219713a8ba982e92f1797412dd23.text: “在困难模式下清除荒凉中所有敌人的破碎峡谷。”

1f6f44cbfb62d8929211918e67ebeed424ccad8b.source: "So, you win a few duels and kill a few monsters and you think you have what it takes to be an Elementalist. Well, then, I have a task for you... a simple thing to be sure. Take this Stone of the Elements to Kupah Beach in Kinya Province. There you will find a stone pedestal. Place the Stone of the Elements upon the stone pedestal, and then return to me. It sounds straightforward, does it not? Just remember that the destination is often less important than the journey."
1f6f44cbfb62d8929211918e67ebeed424ccad8b.text: “所以，你赢得了一些决斗并杀死了一些怪物，你认为你拥有成为元素师的条件。好吧，那么，我有一项任务要交给你……这是一件很简单的事情。将这块元素之石带到基尼亚省的库帕海滩。在那里你会发现一个石基座。将元素之石放在石座上，然后回到我身边。听起来很简单，不是吗？请记住，目的地往往不如旅程重要。”

1e58ea831054e21e49fe592298d9482959633be9.source: "Clear the Sulfurous Wastes in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
1e58ea831054e21e49fe592298d9482959633be9.text: “在困难模式下清除荒凉中的硫磺荒原中的所有敌人。”

594f22c12e48b6d2ce2e8ba7c6fb0c09b8201035.source: Something on the ground catches your eye. It is faint, covered in dirt, and stained with old blood. Closer inspection reveals it to be the tarnished emblem of a high-ranking White Mantle member. What happened here? Perhaps the scrying pool can provide further answers.
594f22c12e48b6d2ce2e8ba7c6fb0c09b8201035.text: 地上的东西引起了你的注意。它很微弱，布满了泥土，还沾满了陈旧的血迹。仔细观察后发现，这是一名白斗篷高级成员的玷污徽章。这里发生了什么？也许占卜池可以提供进一步的答案。

033025aa3467fd418464b262d085c75efede0a06.source: "The toy business has been slow because of all the trouble with corsairs and evil plants lately. People would rather buy swords and shields than puppets and magical gadgets."
033025aa3467fd418464b262d085c75efede0a06.text: “由于最近海盗船和邪恶植物的困扰，玩具生意一直很缓慢。人们宁愿购买剑和盾牌，也不愿购买木偶和魔法器具。”

6e762c4000c70ea0905e55ba9fd60886aa38e8da.source: "But Lyssa's fates have smiled upon me. Toy buyers from Vabbi have arrived. If I can show them something wondrous, I can get a Vabbian contract signed in gold and encrusted with gems."
6e762c4000c70ea0905e55ba9fd60886aa38e8da.text: “但是莱莎的命运向我微笑了。瓦比的玩具买家已经到了。如果我能给他们展示一些奇妙的东西，我就能得到一份用黄金签署并镶满宝石的瓦比亚合同。”

da2a67cfcb2924421388e0376840a1f8dbaf7b6d.source: "Hmmm. That broken toy you have there would be perfect. I could never get it to work, though. It needs to be imbued with essence from a whimsical djinn to activate its magic. Perhaps a hero such as you could acquire the essence for me."
da2a67cfcb2924421388e0376840a1f8dbaf7b6d.text: “嗯。你那儿的那个坏玩具就完美了。但我永远无法让它发挥作用。它需要注入异想天开的神灵的精华来激活它的魔法。也许像你这样的英雄可以为我获取精华。”

cd1cd483c6fed02afca49d2f785871fa1641d7cc.source: "Oh dear! I'm almost out of swamp flower petals, but I can't stop stirring to find more or this dye I'm working on will be ruined! If you have time, I'd be willing to give you a fresh vial of dye from my most recent batch if you bring me some petals from the swamp flowers growing in the Zehlon Reach. Think you have some time for that?"
cd1cd483c6fed02afca49d2f785871fa1641d7cc.text: “哦亲爱的！我的沼泽花瓣快用完了，但我不能停止搅拌寻找更多，否则我正在研究的这种染料就会被毁了！如果你有时间，如果你给我带来一些生长在泽隆河段的沼泽花朵上的花瓣，我愿意给你一瓶我最近一批的新鲜染料。你觉得你有时间吗？”

7d1e6125cd9e9e504fc360de12f66645cd274d3d.source: "Now that I know I can trust you to handle a task, I have a job to offer you. It's cushy and pays well. I can see you are interested. All you need to do is escort a small group of Vabbian noblemen on a hike through Zehlon Reach. They absolutely insist on taking a closer look at the "real Istani countryside" no matter how dangerous I tell them the area can be. Accompany them on their little expedition and I'll reward you handsomely."
7d1e6125cd9e9e504fc360de12f66645cd274d3d.text: “现在我知道我可以信任你来完成一项任务，我可以为你提供一份工作。这份工作很轻松，报酬也很高。我看得出来你很感兴趣。你所需要做的就是护送一小群瓦比亚贵族徒步穿越泽隆河段。无论我告诉他们这个地区有多么危险，他们绝对坚持要仔细看看“真正的伊斯塔尼乡村”。陪他们进行一次小小的探险，我会奖励你的帅气地。”

0466f8416d2a31e00c05c2cc1628cafc48f3c6ea.source: "Those Vabbian merchants are a strange sort. They come here with big talk of trade between our people, but are they interested in our crops? No. Instead, they ask about shells. Shells! They're all over the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You just walk the dunes and look down. We never collect them; they're just shells. But that's what the Vabbians want. I need a "starter shipment" of 20 shells. If you gather them for me, I'll give you a share of the profits."
0466f8416d2a31e00c05c2cc1628cafc48f3c6ea.text: “那些瓦比商人是个奇怪的人。他们来到这里大谈我们人民之间的贸易，但他们对我们的农作物感兴趣吗？不。相反，他们询问贝壳。贝壳！它们遍布梅赫塔尼群岛的海滩。你只要走在沙丘上往下看。我们从不收集它们；它们只是贝壳。但这就是瓦比人想要的。我需要一批 20 颗贝壳的“首发货物”。如果你帮我收集它们，我会给你分享利润。”

f161a333a433addc3159f7db19c0b3dd70ae2902.source: "Clear Traveler's Vale in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
f161a333a433addc3159f7db19c0b3dd70ae2902.text: “在困难模式下清除北席瓦山脉北部旅行者谷的所有敌人。”

8fa8f7ac1a5b3268f7c069f380aaf6e844c27ba9.source: Vanquishing: 163–191 foes. There are hidden Juniper Barks throughout the area.
8fa8f7ac1a5b3268f7c069f380aaf6e844c27ba9.text: 击败：163–191 名敌人。整个地区都有隐藏的杜松树皮。

d948b0fee6dce0bd230096cbc3c3fc5082053d58.source: "Clear Turai's Procession in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
d948b0fee6dce0bd230096cbc3c3fc5082053d58.text: “在困难模式下清除库尔纳图莱的游行队伍中的所有敌人。”

61a3fe66645c22f98ffa1b24b5be3beb8abbb6e0.source: "Clear Twin Serpent Lakes in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
61a3fe66645c22f98ffa1b24b5be3beb8abbb6e0.text: “在困难模式下清除科瑞塔双蛇湖中的所有敌人。”

80a3ccca95f5bde078ca69ab0cd62464f5426efb.source: Vanquishing: 171–194 foes. A Spined Aloe is often hidden between Ancient Oakhearts.
80a3ccca95f5bde078ca69ab0cd62464f5426efb.text: 击败：171–194 名敌人。有刺的芦荟经常隐藏在古老的橡心树之间。

94b9dbf79a087b5ac2c67f68707cdaa0f780c4e1.source: "Clear the Unwaking Waters in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."
94b9dbf79a087b5ac2c67f68707cdaa0f780c4e1.text: “在困难模式下清除玉海不醒水域中的所有敌人。”

dd775032bcd3639f183fd0461001ff2bd70c84ad.source: "These bandit raids are getting ridiculous! Frankly, I don't care if their motives are greed, politics, or anything else, I just want them gone and out of our hair! I'm fairly sure if we take out their leaders, the rest will either flee or be too disorganized to pose a serious threat. If you are up to the task, go to Regent Valley and Kill all of the Bandit Ringleaders. That should let the rest of them know we aren't going to stand for this any longer!"
dd775032bcd3639f183fd0461001ff2bd70c84ad.text: “这些强盗袭击变得越来越荒谬了！坦白说，我不在乎他们的动机是贪婪、政治还是其他任何东西，我只想让他们消失，从我们的头发里消失！我相当确定，如果我们除掉他们的领导人，剩下的人要么逃跑，要么组织混乱，无法构成严重威胁。如果你能胜任这项任务，去摄政谷，杀死所有强盗头目。这应该让他们知道我们不会再忍受了！”

2d36b31aaa91e38a33b8854d9c8b649b6f93ceac.source: "We have heard reports that there are a number of Charr Champions up in the Northlands. Chances are the Charr are planning for something and have brought their finest warriors to be part of the attack. Rather than wait for the fight to come to us, we are going to get the upper hand by going north and killing the Charr's Champions, demoralizing them, and making them think twice before attacking. If you think you have what it takes to face these Charr Champions in battle, I will give you that opportunity. You cannot go alone, though. No one is permitted north of the wall without someone to watch their back!"
2d36b31aaa91e38a33b8854d9c8b649b6f93ceac.text: “我们听说北地有很多夏尔冠军。很可能夏尔正在计划一些事情，并带来了他们最优秀的战士来参与攻击。我们不是等待战斗降临到我们身上，而是要通过向北杀死夏尔冠军来占据上风，挫伤他们的士气，让他们在进攻前三思而后行。如果你认为你有能力在战斗中面对这些夏尔冠军，我会给你这个机会。你不过，如果没有人在背后看守，任何人都不能独自前往长城以北！”

b739edf464c4acdf292f0d9de046dd13a07c97a3.source: "Necromancer Munne may not want to admit it, but the number of roaming undead in the Catacombs is getting dangerous. Each day there are more decomposing abominations roaming the dark halls of that place. Recently, we've even encountered some making their way to the surface and frightening the locals. Or worse, attacking them!
b739edf464c4acdf292f0d9de046dd13a07c97a3.text: “死灵法师穆尼也许不愿意承认，但地下墓穴中游荡的亡灵数量正变得越来越危险。每天都有更多的腐烂怪物在那个地方的黑暗大厅里游荡。最近，我们甚至遇到了一些它们来到地表吓唬当地人。或者更糟糕的是，攻击他们！

c2edb4915a18d39dcf4185d5ff2148df94ef5113.source: We have discovered that the increasing number of undead in the Catacombs is caused by several powerful Undead Necromancers whose tombs have been disturbed. They are now going through the Catacombs, animating every corpse they come across. Go to the Catacombs and put those Necromancers back to rest, so we don't have to worry about walking dead in addition to Charr. Unless, of course, you're afraid of the dark..."
c2edb4915a18d39dcf4185d5ff2148df94ef5113.text: 我们发现，地下墓穴中亡灵数量的增加，是由几名强大的亡灵死灵法师的墓穴被扰乱造成的。他们现在正在穿过地下墓穴，激活他们遇到的每一具尸体。去地下墓穴，让那些死灵法师重新安息，这样我们就不用担心除了夏尔之外还有行尸走肉了。当然，除非你害怕黑暗……”

4d2d85f910930b2038723533910f04a0ae7d24ca.source: "Our scouts report that a Charr Legionnaire named Blazefiend Griefblade is amassing forces for his Warband in the Northlands. We're not sure what he is up to, but we do know we would be better off with one less Charr commander this close to Ascalon City! If you think you have what it takes to challenge the Charr, head to the Northlands. Don't travel alone, though. We will not allow lone travelers to cross the wall."
4d2d85f910930b2038723533910f04a0ae7d24ca.text: “我们的侦察兵报告说，一位名叫烈焰魔·哀刃的夏尔军团士兵正在北地为他的战队集结兵力。我们不确定他在做什么，但我们知道，在距离阿斯卡隆城这么近的地方少一个夏尔指挥官，我们的处境会更好！如果你认为自己有能力挑战夏尔，那就前往北地。不过，不要独自旅行。我们不会允许孤独的旅行者越过城墙。”

bd6adbc5c4a636fdb80d00237f09d353e696b2e4.source: "We have just received word from the residents of Ashford that Farmer Hamnet has gone missing. He was last seen heading up to Wizard's Folly to gather supplies, but was due back hours ago. His neighbors are starting to get nervous, so we have agreed to send a search party. Are you interested in leading the search? This seems like a perfect way for you to get some more experience under your belt!"
bd6adbc5c4a636fdb80d00237f09d353e696b2e4.text: “我们刚刚收到阿什福德居民的消息，农夫哈姆内特失踪了。他最后一次被看到是前往巫师之愚收集物资，但原定在几个小时前回来。他的邻居开始变得紧张，所以我们同意派出一支搜索队。你有兴趣领导搜索吗？这似乎是你获得更多经验的完美方式！”

99d07322b2ff59e6e570a866969b9bc22c79c67e.source: "I knew that greenhorn couldn't handle a foray into the Northlands! Footman Tate insisted he was ready to kill some Charr, so we allowed him to go along, but at the first sign of combat he vanished into the woods. We found a bit of blood where we last saw him, so chances are he is wounded as well as cowardly. That does not bode well for someone stuck behind enemy lines, especially when the Charr are involved!
99d07322b2ff59e6e570a866969b9bc22c79c67e.text: “我知道新手无法应对对北地的突袭！步兵泰特坚持说他已经准备好杀死一些夏尔，所以我们允许他一起去，但在战斗的第一个迹象他就消失在树林里。我们在最后一次见到他的地方发现了一点血，所以他很可能受伤并且胆怯。这对于被困在敌后的人来说不是好兆头，尤其是当夏尔参与其中时！

54ea8c9dde07a035e7484a6914e2cf77093eb1ee.source: If you feel you can fare better than he did, please head to the Northlands, find that poor fool, and bring him back to this side of the Great wall. You will need someone else to go with you, though. We don't let anyone travel alone north of the Wall."
54ea8c9dde07a035e7484a6914e2cf77093eb1ee.text: 如果你觉得你能比他做得更好，请前往北国，找到那个可怜的傻瓜，并把他带回长城的这一边。不过，您需要有人陪您一起去。我们不允许任何人单独前往隔离墙以北。”

bb8639d14a2f7b0341618eb9d2b9a49b61baf5f8.source: "I swear, one day those Devourers are going to be the death of Duke Gaban! Some rumor convinced him that there is an even bigger Devourer nest hidden within the Catacombs below Ashford Abbey, and that egg-obsessed fool actually went down there looking for it! Now we need to waste our limited resources to go on a rescue mission. Say, you don't look too busy; how would you like to go find the poor duke before something down there decides to eat him for breakfast?"
bb8639d14a2f7b0341618eb9d2b9a49b61baf5f8.text: “我发誓，有一天，那些吞噬者将会杀死加班公爵！有传言让他相信，在阿什福德修道院下面的地下墓穴中，隐藏着一个更大的吞噬者巢穴，而那个痴迷于鸡蛋的傻瓜竟然去那里寻找它！现在我们需要浪费我们有限的资源去执行救援任务。喂，你看起来不太忙；你想不想在下面的东西决定把他当早餐吃掉之前找到可怜的公爵？”

fc105ced6f30acc979978c93b66343e70a0c1967.text: “在困难模式下清除远席瓦山脉瓦拉贾荒原中的所有敌人。”

1c7718eb14ae92d3007107f0a48b0b4cf818d955.text: 击败：135–176 名敌人。橡心附近通常有一些隐藏的刺芦荟。

d24bc3636883134ab2f994bd1dc44fe0763af505.text: “在困难模式下清除南席瓦山脉所有敌人的威特曼愚蠢行为。”

16d005eb880b405cc800651925e106688826e287.source: "Oh, , I never got a chance to thank you for saving me. As for you, Norgu, stay away from my buffet!"
16d005eb880b405cc800651925e106688826e287.text: “哦，我一直没有机会感谢你救了我。至于你，诺尔古，离我的自助餐远一点！”

0c12848c0239272adb3a9f4c2624f5e64900eaf7.source: "I must admit, I am still rather shaken from the attempt on my life. I never thought that I could be a target in my own home...how could this have happened? I want to know, I want to know, and I want to know what you know, as soon as you know it! Norgu, you've dealt with that spineless Theatre Manager Daudi before. Go with and find out how he could let this happen! I am tempted to call my executioner again, I tell you, but I just got this new manager broken in. I go through them so quickly..."
0c12848c0239272adb3a9f4c2624f5e64900eaf7.text: “我必须承认，我仍然对自己的人生尝试感到震惊。我从来没有想过我会成为自己家中的目标……这怎么可能发生？我想知道，我想知道，我想知道你知道什么，一旦你知道了！诺尔古，你以前和那个没有骨气的剧院经理达迪打过交道。去看看他是如何让这种事情发生的！我很想再次给我的刽子手打电话，我告诉你，但我刚刚把这个新经理搞砸了我很快就浏览完了它们……”

a5ada3411c75bdc52b4e79e9e28153d6bf52e8ce.source: Theatre Manager Daudi: "Norgu! Oh, thanks the gods, I thought for sure you were the headsman."
a5ada3411c75bdc52b4e79e9e28153d6bf52e8ce.text: 剧院经理 Daudi：“Norgu！哦，感谢诸神，我确信你就是刽子手。”

ad93dc1e757690e82783e714e01dbcf6dcc25040.source: Norgu "Well, if you don't tell us how you let all those Kournans get to the prince, you'll be seeing him soon enough."
ad93dc1e757690e82783e714e01dbcf6dcc25040.text: Norgu：“好吧，如果你不告诉我们你是如何让那些库南人找到王子的，你很快就会见到他。”

1794870d2ff5b91e5d1c37ef70c558893011e03a.source: Theatre Manager Daudi: "But I didn't know they were Kournans! I had to hire more actors. My regulars quit! Bokka only pays them in bread. And these new actors applied! They agreed to work cheap, so I overlooked their lack of proper references...."
1794870d2ff5b91e5d1c37ef70c558893011e03a.text: 剧院经理达迪：“但我不知道他们是库尔南人！我不得不雇用更多演员。我的常客辞职了！博卡只付给他们面包。这些新演员申请了！他们同意廉价工作，所以我忽略了他们缺乏适当的推荐信......”

cd7a4268b394a352d5d26e0db1d998494c9d83a5.source: Norgu "Maybe you're right. I guess we'll have to let the prince decide what to do from here."
cd7a4268b394a352d5d26e0db1d998494c9d83a5.text: Norgu：“也许你是对的。我想我们必须让王子决定从这里做什么。”

2f0da743ed121418c0f9412b02d5e6020311044b.source: Theatre Manager Daudi: "You know I'd never do anything to hurt the prince. Please, you have to tell him it wasn't my fault...I have kids! Oh, it's no use. There's no way out...."
2f0da743ed121418c0f9412b02d5e6020311044b.text: 剧院经理达迪：“你知道我永远不会做任何伤害王子的事。拜托，你必须告诉他这不是我的错......我有孩子！哦，这是没有用的。没有出路......”

69f5db5c76f39fc61378d1064398d2006b7ba8b3.source: Norgu "Calm down...I'll do what I can. Just stop shaking. You're going to end up shaking this whole palace apart!"
69f5db5c76f39fc61378d1064398d2006b7ba8b3.text: Norgu “冷静……我会尽力而为。别再摇晃了。你最终会把整个宫殿震得四分五裂！”

cef902c1089f9c4468aa3b6b0e5338201dabdfb6.source: "What? The real actors all decided to go overseas and work for someone else who lets them keep their profits AND gives them sprawling buffets every night? How dare they! It's all THEIR fault this happened! My bread is just as good as any lousy buffet could ever be."
cef902c1089f9c4468aa3b6b0e5338201dabdfb6.text: “什么？真正的演员都决定去海外为别人工作，让他们保留利润，每天晚上给他们提供丰盛的自助餐？他们怎么敢！这都是他们的错！我的面包和任何糟糕的自助餐一样好。”

1bca10faf4f0a8cb5e15dbad96fb2aae10b2d80f.text: 与任何桥梁一样，该区域的 NPC 模型在位于玩家对面时可能不会渲染：尸体会消失，但仍然可以看到名字并且仍然可以成为目标。

e4469ba9b6bee15dae74ad44911d2bfa8eb54876.source:
To get to the Fissure of Woe, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). Players must then either use a Passage Scroll to the Fissure of Woe (in Embark Beach or any of the following locations below), or pay 1000 gold to the Champion of Balthazar at a Statue of Balthazar in any of the following locations:
Chantry of Secrets
Temple of the Ages
Zin Ku Corridor
e4469ba9b6bee15dae74ad44911d2bfa8eb54876.text:
要到达悲痛裂缝，队伍中的所有玩家都必须是飞升者或 Weh no Su（埃洛尼亚角色可能会完成任务“猎杀！”）。然后，玩家必须使用通往悲痛裂缝的通道卷轴（在出发海滩或以下任何以下位置），或向位于以下任何位置的巴尔萨扎雕像的巴尔萨扎冠军支付 1000 金币：
秘密教堂
历代神殿
津库走廊

44f9cb14ef440a2f147c12c3864a12be8db71767.source:
To get to the Underworld, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). The party must be in one of the locations below and have a player either use a Passage Scroll to the Underworld or pay 1000 gold to the Voice of Grenth at a Statue of Grenth.
Embark Beach (No statue, scroll only)
Chantry of Secrets
Temple of the Ages
Zin Ku Corridor
Southeast corner of Lornar's Pass (Statue only, no scroll)
44f9cb14ef440a2f147c12c3864a12be8db71767.text:
要到达地狱，队伍中的所有玩家都必须是飞升者或 Weh no Su（Elonian 角色可能会完成任务“猎杀”！）。队伍必须位于以下地点之一，并且让玩家使用通向地狱的通道卷轴或向古兰斯雕像处的古兰斯之声支付 1000 金币。
登上海滩（没有雕像，只有卷轴）
秘密教堂
历代神殿
津库走廊
洛纳通道东南角（仅雕像，无卷轴）

27bf1bfdb9f2155e5d9c5e4935bc8adfd5963954.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed A Formal Introduction (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Sunqua Vale will be closed.
A Formal Introduction grants access, but any Factions characters without a secondary profession will be left behind in Sunqua Vale.
Access through Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area) is unavailable because the gate from Kinya Province to Ran Musu Gardens is closed if the party contains any characters that have not completed Minister Cho's Estate.
27bf1bfdb9f2155e5d9c5e4935bc8adfd5963954.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有任何未完成正式介绍的派系角色（不需要接受奖励），桑夸谷的大门将关闭。
正式介绍会授予访问权限，但任何没有第二职业的派系角色都将被留在桑夸谷。
无法通过赵部长庄园（可探索区域）进入，因为如果队伍中包含任何尚未完成赵部长庄园的角色，从基尼亚省到兰姆苏花园的大门就会关闭。

2f972f50bdf606c1f826fb545fc9e7d3027632cb.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed To Zen Daijun (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Haiju Lagoon will be closed.
To Zen Daijun grants access.
Access through Zen Daijun (explorable area) is unavailable because Guard Lae Fao will not grant access if the party contains any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun.
2f972f50bdf606c1f826fb545fc9e7d3027632cb.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有任何未完成禅大君的派系角色（不需要接受奖励），海州泻湖的大门将关闭。
向禅代君授予访问权限。
通过 Zen Daijun（可探索区域）无法进入，因为如果队伍中包含任何未完成 Zen Daijun 的角色，Guard Lae Fao 将不会授予访问权限。

5ec6dfb4dcb72047a31f4f7ba22f8ffc350c52c2.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed Mayhem in the Market (accepting the reward is not required) or any foreign characters, the gate from The Undercity into Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) will be closed, and if the party contains any foreign characters that have not completed Welcome to Cantha (accepting the reward is not required) or any Factions characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter, the gate from Bukdek Byway into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) will be closed.
Mayhem in the Market grants access to the Local Quarter, but any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun will be left behind in The Undercity.
Welcome to Cantha grants access to the Foreign Quarter.
5ec6dfb4dcb72047a31f4f7ba22f8ffc350c52c2.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中包含任何未完成市场混乱（不需要接受奖励）的派系角色或任何外国角色，则从幽暗城进入维祖纳广场（本地区）的大门将关闭，如果队伍中包含任何未完成“欢迎来到坎萨”的外国角色（不需要接受奖励）或任何未完成纳普伊区的派系角色，则从 Bukdek Byway 进入的大门将被关闭。 Vizunah 广场（外国人区）将关闭。
市场混乱允许进入本地街区，但任何未完成禅大君的角色都将被留在幽暗城。
欢迎来到 Cantha 授予进入外国区的权限。

83b665bb4ea19f6a956b50567ca46b50affe0b94.source:

Closer to the Stars grants access, but any characters that have not completed Vizunah Square will be left behind in Wajjun Bazaar.
83b665bb4ea19f6a956b50567ca46b50affe0b94.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有任何未完成靠近星星的角色（不需要接受奖励），Wajjun Bazaar 的大门将关闭。
靠近星星可以进入，但任何未完成 Vizunah 广场的角色都将被留在 Wajjun Bazaar。

7d9e1efb1b855b000c83cea2d2f39f21fd5a72c7.source:

To Tahnnakai Temple grants access, but any characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.
7d9e1efb1b855b000c83cea2d2f39f21fd5a72c7.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有任何未完成前往塔纳凯神庙的角色（不需要接受奖励），神尊隧道的大门将关闭。
可以进入塔纳凯神庙，但任何未完成纳普伊区的角色都将被留在神尊隧道中。

454816858e50a257587abb7f435dc9eb4dd4a270.source:

The Count's Daughter grants access, but any characters that have not completed Tahnnakai Temple will be left behind in Arborstone (explorable area).
454816858e50a257587abb7f435dc9eb4dd4a270.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但阿伯斯通（可探索区域）的大门无法从该区域的北侧进入。然而，有一个小故障可以进入南侧，从那里你可以简单地走进任务前哨站。
伯爵的女儿授予访问权限，但任何未完成塔纳凯神庙的角色都将被留在阿伯斯通（可探索区域）。

5ca8abb527d676bf01dd1fbc7a1ab156f5c0a4c8.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed The Convocation (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Pongmei Valley will be closed.
The Convocation grants access, but any characters that have not completed Arborstone will be left behind in Pongmei Valley.
Access through Boreas Seabed (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Boreas Seabed.
5ca8abb527d676bf01dd1fbc7a1ab156f5c0a4c8.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有任何未完成集会的角色（不需要接受奖励），蓬美谷的大门将关闭。
集会授予访问权限，但任何未完成 Arborstone 的角色都将被留在庞美谷。
无法通过北风之神海底（可探索区域）进入，因为在未完成北风之神海底的情况下，没有通往那里的路线。

613c7327033a5c3b29b15cd6e0a42fa456860cde.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Battle in the Sewers (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Shenzun Tunnels will be closed.
Battle in the Sewers grants access, but any characters that have not completed Boreas Seabed will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.
613c7327033a5c3b29b15cd6e0a42fa456860cde.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有未完成下水道之战的角色（不需要接受奖励），神尊隧道的大门将会关闭。
下水道之战允许进入，但任何未完成北风之神海底的角色都将被留在神尊隧道中。

ceda0ee116dcc946fc8a2e9c1c5d1b715fa84085.source:
Your party will not be able to enter this mission unless it has eight members.
If the party contains any characters that have not completed Into the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Morostav Trail will be closed, and if the party contains any characters that have not completed Journey to the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Silent Surf will be closed.
Into the Whirlpool and Journey to the Whirlpool grant access, but any characters that have not completed The Eternal Grove will be left behind in Morostav Trail.
ceda0ee116dcc946fc8a2e9c1c5d1b715fa84085.text:
除非你的队伍有八名成员，否则你的队伍将无法进入此任务。
如果队伍中有未完成“漩涡之旅”（无需接受奖励）的角色，则“莫罗斯塔夫小道”的大门将关闭，如果队伍中有未完成“漩涡之旅”的角色（无需接受奖励），“寂静冲浪”的大门将关闭。
进入漩涡和漩涡之旅可以进入，但任何未完成永恒丛林的角色都将被留在莫罗斯塔夫小道中。

1fd91002b08a67b78fff57e5752e9bd3d5f91e61.source:
