The Defenders of the Forest grants access, but any characters that have not completed Befriending the Kurzicks will be left behind in Drazach Thicket.
Alternatively, it is possible for any character to walk into the outpost from The Eternal Grove (explorable area), but this first requires you to complete Unwaking Waters from the Luxon side and glitch through the gate from Unwaking Waters (explorable area) to Unwaking Waters (Kurzick).
1fd91002b08a67b78fff57e5752e9bd3d5f91e61.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中包含任何未完成森林保卫者的角色（不需要接受奖励），德拉扎克丛林的大门将关闭。
森林保卫者会授予访问权限，但任何未完成与库兹克交友的角色都将被留在德拉扎克丛林中。
或者，任何角色都可以从永恒树林（可探索区域）走进前哨站，但这首先需要您从卢克森一侧完成不醒之水，并从不醒之水（可探索区域）到不醒之水（库兹克）的大门出现故障。

5be3282a02d8db74c2ddd5f809cc9ee3037de813.source:

Stolen Eggs grants access, but any characters that have not completed Befriending the Luxons will be left behind in Maishang Hills.
Access through Gyala Hatchery (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Befriending the Luxons.
5be3282a02d8db74c2ddd5f809cc9ee3037de813.text:
开始任务没有任何要求，但如果队伍中有任何未完成偷蛋的角色（不需要接受奖励），麦尚丘陵的大门将会关闭。

4696d857133f7c8e8f92e3efb9445b77c32140d8.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Taking Back the Palace (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Raisu Pavilion will be closed.
Taking Back the Palace grants access, but any characters that have not completed Unwaking Waters will be left behind in Raisu Pavilion.

be87aa5f2c2782b90ba7d4d293459fde896d17a4.source: This mission highlights many deficiencies in the NPC pathfinding AI:
be87aa5f2c2782b90ba7d4d293459fde896d17a4.text: 该任务凸显了 NPC 寻路 AI 的许多缺陷：

5a5b869f0f0da9f159123244a6c95548b2483b05.source: If you bring minions, Mhenlo can get distracted in healing them, causing him not to reach his waypoints. A sign that this has happened is Togo standing still some distance behind the party. If this happens, try moving back towards Togo; when Mhenlo gets close enough, the missed waypoint will trigger and Togo will start moving again.
5a5b869f0f0da9f159123244a6c95548b2483b05.text: 如果你带了小兵，姆洛可能会在治疗他们时分心，导致他无法到达路径点。发生这种情况的一个迹象是多哥站在队伍后面一段距离。如果发生这种情况，请尝试返回多哥；当 Mhenlo 足够接近时，错过的航路点将触发，多哥将再次开始移动。

bd430ddb56a0c6603a8af3968f9a7bf2a6202617.source: In first person mode, you can see behind the walls if you stand next to them at certain points:
bd430ddb56a0c6603a8af3968f9a7bf2a6202617.text: 在第一人称模式下，如果您在某些点站在墙边，您可以看到墙后面：

240901829f28d4cc923609a69fbd93d9f057e4f6.source: On Level 2: an extra Asura Gate behind one of the walls.
240901829f28d4cc923609a69fbd93d9f057e4f6.text: 第 2 层：其中一堵墙后面有一个额外的阿修罗门。

03848f9ef69f4885fd57e9903796da4932d99347.source: The Count's Daughter primary quest will lead a party through here for the first time, although that part of this explorable area is actually in an isolated small section. To explore the rest of this explorable area will entail reaching the Altrumm Ruins first. From there, secondary quests like Song and Stone and Wardens On the March will bring parties here. From Arborstone, talk to Gatekeeper Becker. This will allow you to enter the northern part of the explorable area (with Lift Operator Shulz).
03848f9ef69f4885fd57e9903796da4932d99347.text: 伯爵的女儿的主要任务将带领一支队伍第一次穿过这里，尽管这个可探索区域的那部分实际上是在一个孤立的小区域中。要探索这个可探索区域的其余部分，首先需要到达阿尔特鲁姆废墟。从那里开始，像《歌与石》和《行军中的守望者》这样的次要任务将把派对带到这里。从阿伯斯通，与看门人贝克尔交谈。这将允许你进入可探索区域的北部（与电梯操作员舒尔茨一起）。

537d6f4982ed61df65e74ad31a792602ee617e79.source: Your character can bypass the lift by having more unspent faction of the allegiance not controlling Tanglewood Copse and not activating the resurrection shrine outside of Tanglewood Copse (by bribing the priest or killing the resurrection shrine NPCs). When your party wipes, your party will be resurrected at a shrine closer to Altrumm Ruins and/or the Arborstone outpost.
537d6f4982ed61df65e74ad31a792602ee617e79.text: 你的角色可以通过让更多未使用的效忠派系不控制坦格伍德小树林并且不激活坦格伍德小树林外的复活神殿（通过贿赂牧师或杀死复活神殿 NPC）来绕过电梯。当你的队伍被消灭时，你的队伍将在靠近阿尔特鲁姆废墟和/或阿伯斯通前哨站的神社复活。

65b07f8a31fc86bb1dc02d9330f62a9f16582a32.source: There are places here that allow a view of the eastern edge of the map. However, instead of the Qinkaishi Mountains, the player will see water.
65b07f8a31fc86bb1dc02d9330f62a9f16582a32.text: 这里有一些地方可以看到地图的东部边缘。然而，玩家看到的不是秦开石山脉，而是水。

89cb64d1ca652c8be2022235c89001eca60777ae.source: Each of the stone guardian bosses appear to be alone. However, they are guarded by spawns hidden in nearby pillars (typically 2 each of Stone Crushers, Reapers, and Rains). Be prepared to take on 6 pillars plus the boss.
89cb64d1ca652c8be2022235c89001eca60777ae.text: 每个石头守护者 Boss 似乎都是孤独的。然而，它们受到隐藏在附近柱子中的生成物的保护（通常为碎石机、收割机和降雨机各 2 个）。准备好应对 6 个支柱以及 Boss。

4ab9c1b02b08728021cafcdf9c1c81b7ad09eb2b.source: These extra guardians are not automatically released from the pillars: the Warrior Boss' guards are triggered when a human player walks over the top of the southwest ramp in the main room (from Altrumm Ruins); the caster bosses' guards are triggered by the northeast ramp.
4ab9c1b02b08728021cafcdf9c1c81b7ad09eb2b.text: 这些额外的守卫不会自动从柱子上释放：当人类玩家走过主房间（来自阿尔特鲁姆废墟）西南坡道的顶部时，战士老板的守卫就会被触发；施法者 Boss 的守卫由东北坡道触发。

502976de499f91bb871c1e35c0e0dfab5e3be8ca.source: Bosses can be pulled away from the pillars without triggering opening of the pillars. Alternatively, you can sometimes break the guardians out of the pillars without aggroing the nearby boss.
502976de499f91bb871c1e35c0e0dfab5e3be8ca.text: 可以将老板从柱子上拉开，而不会触发柱子的打开。或者，有时你可以将守卫者从柱子上打下来，而不会激怒附近的首领。

89d976f7fa215eb725b231db517bb5ae22859302.source: Cartographer candidates should scrape the edges of this small area (uncovering approximately 0.5% additional area).
89d976f7fa215eb725b231db517bb5ae22859302.text: 制图师候选人应该刮掉这个小区域的边缘（发现大约 0.5% 的额外区域）。

e977b02bd1791709746f033208895ed2c9b2ef93.source: You will be warned, "You must enter the Arborstone explorable area from Altrumm Ruins in order to vanquish it."
e977b02bd1791709746f033208895ed2c9b2ef93.text: 你会被警告，“你必须从奥特鲁姆废墟进入Arborstone可探索区域才能征服它。”

a48f7d94e53f70f0cdf94836781e37a681db149b.source: Some enemies in the Cathedral zu Heltzer may spawn out of sight in an area that has already been visited. While the exact spawn triggers are unknown, reported methods to trigger them include:
a48f7d94e53f70f0cdf94836781e37a681db149b.text: 赫尔茨大教堂中的一些敌人可能会在已经访问过的区域中出现在视线之外。虽然确切的生成触发器尚不清楚，但报告的触发它们的方法包括：

b9a9ab840f88ef1b7779a879837a458d7734d6c7.source: killing or approaching the bosses on one side of the cathedral
b9a9ab840f88ef1b7779a879837a458d7734d6c7.text: 杀死或接近大教堂一侧的首领

c4f3c1654ae19b1c05510e0b0a8a9cfcb90fdff2.source: crossing the opposite ramp near the Cathedral portal
c4f3c1654ae19b1c05510e0b0a8a9cfcb90fdff2.text: 穿过大教堂大门附近对面的坡道

f14eb2511a10870e0c96ad6cdfed21a01450b490.source: approaching the pillars where the stone enemies spawn.
f14eb2511a10870e0c96ad6cdfed21a01450b490.text: 接近石质敌怪生成的柱子。

45146df736efa799c1f94bb9d6ae5eaa8c8e72c4.source: In some cases, it may be necessary to revisit the cathedral multiple times to find all enemies.
45146df736efa799c1f94bb9d6ae5eaa8c8e72c4.text: 在某些情况下，可能需要多次重新访问大教堂才能找到所有敌人。

90d4493ea604d2e306cbaa77d702fe87aa71ebcd.source: Kneeling at the statue of Balthazar resurrection shrine at the exit into Altrumm Ruins will sometimes not cause the Champion of Balthazar to appear. If you reconnect after disconnect, any dead elemental will respawn. They will have to be killed again to count for a vanquish.
90d4493ea604d2e306cbaa77d702fe87aa71ebcd.text: 在阿尔特鲁姆废墟出口处的巴尔萨扎复活神殿雕像下跪有时不会导致巴尔萨扎冠军出现。如果断开连接后重新连接，任何死亡的元素都会重生。他们必须再次被杀死才能算作胜利。

32e6435991cd4103911934c34ded583d925eb346.source: This area is right outside the Zos Shivros Channel outpost. It is a mostly optional area, but it does have several secondary quests taking place in it.
32e6435991cd4103911934c34ded583d925eb346.text: 该区域就位于佐斯希夫罗斯海峡前哨站的外面。这是一个主要是可选的区域，但它确实有几个次要任务发生在其中。

4e6aaf7a8b9cf6bc29b43093c9d28968d64fe687.source: There are 5 hidden Oni groups (each with 3 or 4 of them):
4e6aaf7a8b9cf6bc29b43093c9d28968d64fe687.text: 有 5 个隐藏的 Oni 组（每个组有 3 或 4 个）：

cb724e652dade2714fecb40457d23f30f0d4599f.source: Just south of the northern central beach.
cb724e652dade2714fecb40457d23f30f0d4599f.text: 位于北部中央海滩以南。

2b14c9f5e57cb96a75ba6775d42ceb0686e1cda3.source: South of the beach where Sskai, Dragon's Birth is located.
2b14c9f5e57cb96a75ba6775d42ceb0686e1cda3.text: Sskai, Dragon's Birth 所在的海滩以南。

f7a65f51cd11ee20e358a4bb222e3783da539608.source: West of the beach where Sskai, Dragon's Birth is located.
f7a65f51cd11ee20e358a4bb222e3783da539608.text: Sskai, Dragon's Birth 所在的海滩以西。

ce36abe7f675913d2c6971c9e2fafe096f70e718.source: At the foot of the path leading up to the 1,000 Daggers guild hall.
ce36abe7f675913d2c6971c9e2fafe096f70e718.text: 通往千刀公会大厅的小路脚下。

150850fb06ff4e6210627fbe7ff5632dfc66c7a7.source: Near the north-west corner of the beach.

68e916f83ec94fcd2e1485f896091538f95a5504.source: The Naga and Outcasts will fight with each other. Waiting until they are done leaves you with significantly fewer foes, making a vanquisher run easier because you won't have to fight large groups anymore.
68e916f83ec94fcd2e1485f896091538f95a5504.text: 纳迦和流放者将互相争斗。等到他们完成后，你的敌人就会明显减少，让征服者更容易逃跑，因为你不再需要与大群人战斗。

87fe7d40013c40df11dc45a5dd15bb53afd73a77.source: On the bridge leading to the 1,000 Daggers guild hall, there are "blind spots" where allies and foes can become invisible. This error is also seen in Xaquang Skyway.
87fe7d40013c40df11dc45a5dd15bb53afd73a77.text: 通往千刀公会大厅的桥上有“盲点”，可以让盟友和敌人隐形。这个错误在 Xaquang Skyway 中也出现过。

07c71c1f6c1f6f3a0e999f4f9e142ff797be288a.source: The Bone Fiends and Servant of Murakai in the final room are not vulnerable to skills that affect summoned creatures, even though they are identified as being summoned. There are several rare bugs that can prevent the party from completing the dungeon:
07c71c1f6c1f6f3a0e999f4f9e142ff797be288a.text: 最后一个房间中的骨魔和村凯仆人不会受到影响召唤生物的技能的影响，即使它们被识别为被召唤。有几个罕见的错误可能会阻止队伍完成地下城：

56a5995bcbc78e5f79cdadf09249391755a65f3c.source: Level 3: If the Keymaster of Murakai is allowed to travel all the way back to its resting point, the dungeon key may drop over the edge of the lava stream, making it unreachable.
56a5995bcbc78e5f79cdadf09249391755a65f3c.text: 3级：如果村凯的钥匙大师被允许一路回到其休息点，地牢钥匙可能会掉落到熔岩流的边缘，使其无法到达。

fd2708bafcbabcde3ea6859f085eeee1a21dfcb0.source: Some foes do not consistently engage the party as expected:
fd2708bafcbabcde3ea6859f085eeee1a21dfcb0.text: 有些敌人并没有像预期的那样始终如一地与队伍交战：

004a489b5c450d79a34543fabab3c9b63f9c5d0a.source: The Master and his minions sometimes spawn behind the door to the third level, making them harder to kill.
004a489b5c450d79a34543fabab3c9b63f9c5d0a.text: 大师和他的爪牙有时会在第三层的门后生成，使他们更难被杀死。

e726f56f17acef0f15ccd6b2d2fc7ed96a91feb5.source: Guild Wars Prophecies on the account

16f7cbad801f0aafc0f0766db224887d01c1a8db.text: 主要或次要职业：死灵法师

874a75e32baedd718488e72de7a3f0c0e157ccaa.source: The resurrection shrines in this area do not always show the light animation of an active resurrection shrine:
874a75e32baedd718488e72de7a3f0c0e157ccaa.text: 该区域的复活神殿并不总是显示活跃复活神殿的灯光动画：

fdd96dec01d8a6a3532b89819322a5e7ff860e75.source: Upon entry from Beacon's Perch, the shrine animation at the Beacon's Perch shrine does not work.
fdd96dec01d8a6a3532b89819322a5e7ff860e75.text: 从灯塔栖息地进入后，灯塔栖息地神社的神社动画不起作用。

e0010bd6e3dbd1353e38943112cdb57d0bcfc3c0.source: Scores were previously kept on a leaderboard on the official guildwars.com site.
e0010bd6e3dbd1353e38943112cdb57d0bcfc3c0.text: 分数之前保存在 guildwars.com 官方网站的排行榜上。

9a723fc37cb6e9234de5f3ca82520c722dd26317.source: Slay kuskale and harvest their flesh for bait. You need [5...0] more [[Hunk of Fresh Meat|hunks of fresh meat.
9a723fc37cb6e9234de5f3ca82520c722dd26317.text: 杀死库斯卡勒并收获它们的肉作为诱饵。你还需要 [5...0] [[大块新鲜肉|大块新鲜肉。

8f6bee161ed035a3a23bc17369dc4e88ea3e81e6.source: A Melandru's Stalker obtained from the Zaishen Menagerie will not suffice. This quest rewards the skill Charm Animal, but you need the skill in order to charm a Melandru's Stalker in the first place.
8f6bee161ed035a3a23bc17369dc4e88ea3e81e6.text: 从再神动物园获得的梅兰德鲁追猎者是不够的。该任务奖励技能“魅惑动物”，但你首先需要该技能才能魅惑梅兰德鲁的追猎者。

86a791c0213a757e40aa1666f71420fd6fb849aa.source: You can buy the skill from Sir Bertran in Ascalon City.
86a791c0213a757e40aa1666f71420fd6fb849aa.text: 您可以从阿斯卡隆市的伯特兰爵士那里购买该技能。

3e755d6655cede9c6f88afec19887af71c101d08.source: Even though the area outside the ruins is freely accessible, the ruins themselves are not accessible for Nightfall characters until after completion of the Jokanur Diggings mission.
3e755d6655cede9c6f88afec19887af71c101d08.text: 尽管废墟外的区域可以自由进入，但黄昏角色在完成乔卡努尔挖掘任务之前无法进入废墟本身。

da0d42b1622f71c5c7ed063c4f90c5e35cd2ceeb.source: There are no primary quests that take place here but several secondary quests do, including the first two of Scholar Chago's quest chain (starting with A Perplexing Plague) and Defender's Choice.
da0d42b1622f71c5c7ed063c4f90c5e35cd2ceeb.text: 这里没有主要任务，但有几个次要任务，包括学者查戈的任务链的前两个（从令人困惑的瘟疫开始）和防御者的选择。

615777cdb9a86b44199666893d71387dc188be50.source: Although Istani civilization (and the Order of the Sunspears) originated here, Fahranur has been completely abandoned since the Scarab Plague.
615777cdb9a86b44199666893d71387dc188be50.text: 尽管伊斯塔尼文明（以及烈阳之矛骑士团）起源于这里，但法赫拉努尔自圣甲虫瘟疫以来就被彻底遗弃了。

9329cd8596f2a79e2844d1458168370f5858b70a.source: The fallen statue head in the opening cinematic of the Nightfall campaign appears to be the one that lies near the exit into Jokanur Diggings.
9329cd8596f2a79e2844d1458168370f5858b70a.text: 夜幕降临战役的开场动画中倒下的雕像头部似乎位于乔卡努矿区出口附近。

b602f7333227164a81a5c12740bf7d939a1c39ed.source: Librarian Gahmir Lenon's dialogue in the Halls of Chokhin hints at a connection between the First City and the kings of Orr.
b602f7333227164a81a5c12740bf7d939a1c39ed.text: 图书管理员加米尔·列侬在乔欣大厅中的对话暗示了第一城和奥尔国王之间的联系。

0bad3baf7fd170565e2cd8c9dcea7481d1c0c809.source: The entrance into the ruins is protected by falling crusher traps.
0bad3baf7fd170565e2cd8c9dcea7481d1c0c809.text: 废墟的入口受到掉落的破碎机陷阱的保护。

3e0d39e87d78439ed0bbfb313ebead18682023a3.source: Dying from being crushed does not cause Death Penalty and does not count as a death (for Survivors).
3e0d39e87d78439ed0bbfb313ebead18682023a3.text: 被压死不会导致死刑，也不算死亡（对于幸存者）。

462f8cf4e728a74d556d28c05f57d4ef75555bbb.source: The traps will kill player characters, but will not kill Heroes.
462f8cf4e728a74d556d28c05f57d4ef75555bbb.text: 陷阱会杀死玩家角色，但不会杀死英雄。

0536f33a98370b96d2d9c071a2d390b3dcc791ba.source: This area has a large number of low level Skale enemies near the entrance to the city itself. Characters with low Sunspear rank may want to kill these for the The Honorable General quest since there is a Sunspear Scout that provides Skale Hunt at the beginning of the map.
0536f33a98370b96d2d9c071a2d390b3dcc791ba.text: 该区域在城市入口附近有大量低等级 Skale 敌人。烈阳之矛等级较低的角色可能会为了尊敬的将军任务而杀死这些角色，因为在地图的开头有一个烈阳之矛斥候可以提供斯凯尔狩猎。

2c2f77a1c11b529de323d3b72108df64f62f9ae0.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
2c2f77a1c11b529de323d3b72108df64f62f9ae0.text: 对这一领域的完整探索为 Elonian Cartographer 主打歌贡献了约 2.9%。

829f81d89bd505deda6dcf139be006b4d375dde5.source: Consider starting from Blacktide Den for a party size of 8.
829f81d89bd505deda6dcf139be006b4d375dde5.text: 如果队伍规模为 8 人，请考虑从 Blacktide Den 开始。

2c7ed335f9eb75318eaf373b80008e30b0cdf2e1.source: Study the patrol paths of the mobs outside of the city ruins before engaging; many of them overlap.
2c7ed335f9eb75318eaf373b80008e30b0cdf2e1.text: 在交战前研究城市废墟外怪物的巡逻路线；其中许多是重叠的。

6637532c5ce4383bf257495e8daa22d35186d693.source: The quest A Perplexing Plague in particular will produce a lot more insect spawns.
6637532c5ce4383bf257495e8daa22d35186d693.text: 特别是任务“令人困惑的瘟疫”将产生更多的昆虫产卵。

b182cda2429ed1a41707ac6e9b07cfadb1ee0a3a.source: During Defender's Choice, Arred the Unready starts as hostile and turns friendly so that he may be interrogated. Some players have reported being unable to complete their vanquish unless they have decided to kill him instead.
b182cda2429ed1a41707ac6e9b07cfadb1ee0a3a.text: 在防御者选择期间，未准备者阿雷德一开始是敌对的，后来变得友好，以便他可以接受审讯。一些玩家报告说，除非他们决定杀死他，否则无法完成他们的征服。

0ea0a790608c3507a33f3576c7c40d0c27c0c1be.text: de:法赫拉努尔，第尔斯特斯塔特

f3158d2f375348d980ab23900a0a8fd2813748a4.source: Gain Goren neither active nor completed
f3158d2f375348d980ab23900a0a8fd2813748a4.text: 获得鬣蜥人既不活跃也不完成

c29bc6118a5ecfdad790b2a9de15a7d07cc348e8.source: There is an invisible wall between the exit from the cave into the forest area, north of the southern resurrection shrine and west across the wall from Whiskar Featherstorm.
c29bc6118a5ecfdad790b2a9de15a7d07cc348e8.text: 洞穴出口进入森林区域之间有一道无形的墙，位于南部复活神殿以北，西面与威斯卡·羽风暴隔墙相望。

20493ac664a1e247969b967aef2ce1afe471f478.source: Exit north from Leviathan Pits. Although Gyala Hatchery shares its border with the outpost of the same name, it cannot be reached from there.
20493ac664a1e247969b967aef2ce1afe471f478.text: 从利维坦坑向北退出。尽管嘉拉孵化场与同名前哨基地接壤，但无法从那里到达。

500e6ae60f7ea2b44de931d69c81960cf16307e9.source: On the western edge (near the area with washed out color on the map) is a huge Irukandji encased in a block of jade, in the center of a Flooded Jade Mine.
500e6ae60f7ea2b44de931d69c81960cf16307e9.text: 在西部边缘（靠近地图上颜色褪色的区域）是一个巨大的伊鲁坎吉，包裹在一块玉石中，位于水淹玉矿的中心。

c92e4732bb7e20598a0faace6a757a51309d70c0.source: Exploration is best done during the mission as, if you avoid triggering the turtles, you can explore most of the area without having to fight anyone.
c92e4732bb7e20598a0faace6a757a51309d70c0.text: 探索最好在任务期间进行，因为如果你避免触发海龟，你就可以探索大部分区域而无需与任何人战斗。

5aa1d3d7810bfe825588ef6e62ed53f1493bbb09.source: The Outcasts, Fish and Leviathans are hostile to each other. If you let them fight it out, it can reduce enemy numbers by 30-40. Jacqui The Reaver and Reefclaw Ragebound also fight, and one of them will eventually kill the other. If Jacqui survives the fight, he might start fighting Whyk Steelshell's group next and get killed by them.
5aa1d3d7810bfe825588ef6e62ed53f1493bbb09.text: 流放者、鱼和利维坦彼此敌对。如果让他们战斗的话，可以减少敌人30-40人。掠夺者杰奎和怒缚礁爪也会战斗，其中一个最终会杀死另一个。如果雅基在战斗中幸存下来，他接下来可能会开始与怀克·斯蒂尔谢尔的团队战斗并被他们杀死。

491752164a8d5d8ccdb5ec35c6b44e04a7391da2.source: There are four spots where hidden Oni will popup:
491752164a8d5d8ccdb5ec35c6b44e04a7391da2.text: 有四个地方会弹出隐藏的鬼：

9db1a9a1048cc7b164b2144ff51fda4f156804e2.source: Two at the large island in the southwestern corner.
9db1a9a1048cc7b164b2144ff51fda4f156804e2.text: 两个在西南角的大岛上。

39c012384ff6b906fead2176fc7b0ba53c327d2f.source: On the large eastern island, Bahnba Shockfoot and his Yetis are on a narrow path. Three Oni are on the other parallel path.
39c012384ff6b906fead2176fc7b0ba53c327d2f.text: 在东部的大岛上，巴恩巴·震脚和他的雪人走在一条狭窄的道路上。三个鬼在另一条平行路径上。

9871e89879b0b43871c2063b06c883e20607cc54.source: Two more on a spot just north of the previous spot, close to the path of the Naga patrols.
9871e89879b0b43871c2063b06c883e20607cc54.text: 在前一个地点以北的一个地点，还有两个地点，靠近纳迦巡逻队的路径。

2bc3f725563eee423e5d68ee022b153e94bc163f.source: No foes have hex removal and all are fleshy, so hex spells and minion masters work well here.
2bc3f725563eee423e5d68ee022b153e94bc163f.text: 没有敌人可以去除六角形，而且都是肉质的，所以六角形法术和仆从大师在这里效果很好。

eee89f3231447906e2024690a3897cb3eea152a9.source: The northern portal to the Gyala Hatchery's outpost is missing the white hazy barrier usually associated with Factions and Prophecies area transitions.
eee89f3231447906e2024690a3897cb3eea152a9.text: 甲拉孵化场前哨站的北部门户缺少通常与派系和预言区域过渡相关的白色朦胧屏障。

a8536f5898b4ace10c4b07ac8729f1ab1917766a.source: Guild Wars Eye of the North on the account
a8536f5898b4ace10c4b07ac8729f1ab1917766a.text: 帐户上的激战北方之眼

d2a41403de0ae91036aed864d9afea5f0639621e.source: Neither What Lies Beneath nor I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet completed
d2a41403de0ae91036aed864d9afea5f0639621e.text: 《What Lies Beneath》和《I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet》均未完成

616f5cfae161533e8fbed96ca3c4fdd33015aad5.source: Neither What Lies Beneath nor Hole of Istan completed

d0896610eb60063dd1e852fffb85fee79a5d2700.source: For non-Nightfall characters (only), there are several quest-related spawns or triggers that are incorrect. These quests cannot be done by non-Nightfall characters yet they affect the instance.
d0896610eb60063dd1e852fffb85fee79a5d2700.text: 对于非《夜幕降临》角色（仅限），有几个与任务相关的生成或触发器是不正确的。这些任务不能由非黄昏角色完成，但它们会影响实例。

4cd37a496b48a373efc9af56a0a0663d50be6c4e.source: Troublesome Flamingos for the quest Flamingo-ing... going... gone. always spawn.
4cd37a496b48a373efc9af56a0a0663d50be6c4e.text: 麻烦火烈鸟的任务火烈鸟-ing...去...消失了。总是产卵。

cb9212f582299e2b8891bec6436d0e0b7c6e0032.source: Melonni Goes Recruiting neither active nor completed
cb9212f582299e2b8891bec6436d0e0b7c6e0032.text: Melonni 的招聘既不活跃也不完成

a89016639d64dbbe20a9cf215cfd65a1a18f3420.source: Some of the dialogue is misleading:

6214f19c4a9fe4ba72c5298d84a7dd7f6d5d841a.source: Although a Shadow Blade Assassin states, "her blade took three of my fingers", he appears to have all ten fingers intact.
6214f19c4a9fe4ba72c5298d84a7dd7f6d5d841a.text: 尽管一名暗影之刃刺客声称“她的刀刃夺走了我的三根手指”，但他的十根手指似乎都完好无损。

457f434a398637455962c84105f2438cda2728e9.source: A Bastion In the North completed

9920f625473342d4fd6fb8f48acf629c8ff8a2bc.source: Koss Goes Recruiting neither active nor completed
9920f625473342d4fd6fb8f48acf629c8ff8a2bc.text: 科斯的招聘既不活跃也不完成

8ec0058bbd6696ffde3aee1f98403fda4b57943d.source: Guild Wars factions on the account

f10606750ef38dc3e2989cb0603fe918639c6ec0.source: Plague in Cantha neither active nor completed
f10606750ef38dc3e2989cb0603fe918639c6ec0.text: 凯萨的鼠疫既不活跃也不结束

19ab04b17116922a50182a9d6b7a485f68ebb2ed.source: The only entrance is from Ran Musu Gardens.
19ab04b17116922a50182a9d6b7a485f68ebb2ed.text: 唯一的入口是冉木宿花园。

978f6ee19a83f9e17658a3ad76cccf15e00afde4.source: If Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate has been completed and Memories of Purity is not active, all spawns will be replaced by Scavenger type enemies. It is recommended to activate the quest when vanquishing the area.
978f6ee19a83f9e17658a3ad76cccf15e00afde4.text: 如果赵部长庄园的救援已完成且纯洁记忆未激活，则所有生成点都将被清道夫类型的敌怪取代。建议在征服该区域时激活任务。

9b2b174c16c98b4fb541a52f25d300da4d89c78c.source: These quests affect the spawns in this area: Lost Treasure and Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate.
9b2b174c16c98b4fb541a52f25d300da4d89c78c.text: 这些任务会影响该区域的生成：赵部长庄园的失落宝藏和救援。

3a8b7799cc49b20ef15874d18e3d3e339d7c694f.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 2.6% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
3a8b7799cc49b20ef15874d18e3d3e339d7c694f.text: 对该区域的完整探索将为 Canthan Cartographer 主打歌带来约 2.6% 的收益。

db7a37a03b8d0b3db2606c9cff0ade8eb2f9b549.source: There are no bosses in this area, so avoid skills that recharge with Morale Boost (i.e. Resurrection Signet and Sunspear Rebirth Signet).
db7a37a03b8d0b3db2606c9cff0ade8eb2f9b549.text: 该区域没有 Boss，因此请避免使用士气提升充能的技能（即复活徽记和阳矛重生徽记）。

491051b25bbc5c80a8f42e4cee29f7e4c4eea071.source: Since you can only have a party of four, having a spirit spammer helps.
491051b25bbc5c80a8f42e4cee29f7e4c4eea071.text: 由于您只能组成四人聚会，因此拥有精神垃圾邮件发送者会有所帮助。

b48c16b03c0a489c792758eb716ffe97b9ed6604.source: There is a chain of islands to the northeast with foes that cannot easily be seen from the beach. Likewise, there are more foes inside the caverns to the southeast.
b48c16b03c0a489c792758eb716ffe97b9ed6604.text: 东北部有一系列岛屿，从海滩上很难看到敌人。同样，东南方的洞穴内还有更多的敌人。

5e3841275b54184174fc613f6787ebe1c8a8ad91.source: Exit from Senji's Corner or travel through Shenzun Tunnels.
5e3841275b54184174fc613f6787ebe1c8a8ad91.text: 从 Senji's Corner 退出或穿过 Shenzun 隧道。

0ecd5f9f5c702cd7a8f050754e391adccd83a73d.source: Vanquishing: 96–112 foes. Has hidden groups of Jade Brotherhood.
0ecd5f9f5c702cd7a8f050754e391adccd83a73d.text: 击败：96-112个敌人。拥有隐藏的翡翠兄弟会团体。

f7665b88d26825ae05172c15fcb477794276f0ba.source: The western section of the area (the Nahpui Quarter mission area) does not contain any creatures, friendly or hostile.
f7665b88d26825ae05172c15fcb477794276f0ba.text: 该区域的西部部分（Nahpui Quarter 任务区域）不包含任何生物，无论是友好的还是敌对的。

803010320685cca8743a81b58af1408d32031fc9.source: During Architect of Corruption, the number of foes rises to about 394. The western section of the area (the Nahpui Quarter mission area) will contain Am Fah.
803010320685cca8743a81b58af1408d32031fc9.text: 在《腐败建筑师》期间，敌人数量上升至约 394 名。该区域的西部部分（Nahpui 区任务区）将包含 Am Fah。

d0f87c9ec384c6c5276ba4bcc93aa44741492d4a.text: 请参阅[[Nenah|Nenah [收藏家]]以获得奖励。

d64466c7107fc0eba7f813c87fef251e09178a3c.source: A Friend in Need neither active nor completed
d64466c7107fc0eba7f813c87fef251e09178a3c.text: 一个有需要的朋友既不活跃也不完整

fd7d61b9a7e898e0730b93613a1c749d27a8065b.text: 主要或次要职业：死灵法师

b7a5fe89e37dc2ff87a5b26b9cf58c08e6259bc6.text: 令人不安的谣言已完成

3054abb2ea35b7613a639c79710fff739b9d88c1.source: Mhenlo's Request neither active nor completed
3054abb2ea35b7613a639c79710fff739b9d88c1.text: Mhenlo 的请求既未激活也未完成

046ef6cc53b34ee43fccf02e00b17c1084569d19.source: You must also have completed and accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh
046ef6cc53b34ee43fccf02e00b17c1084569d19.text: 您还必须已完成并接受《时辰已近》的奖励

4b620cf175942f437315bea3cc95311429594f70.text: 请参阅[[Chorben|Chorben [武器]]以获得奖励。

32a3607e0e8fe2b1289941bcfdfafba5bfe0defb.source: This explorable area can only be entered from the Imperial Sanctum outpost, and is therefore only accessible after completion of the Raisu Palace mission.
32a3607e0e8fe2b1289941bcfdfafba5bfe0defb.text: 这个可探索的区域只能从帝国圣地前哨进入，因此只能在完成莱苏宫任务后才能进入。

398a0bbadab7e07d235a78ce6a0d788a2afab969.source: There are globes of light scattered throughout the area. Those near a boss will spawn Shiro'ken if you approach too closely when fighting. To avoid this, pull the boss away from the globe. (The Ranger Boss does not have a globe in its vicinity.)
398a0bbadab7e07d235a78ce6a0d788a2afab969.text: 整个区域散布着光球。如果战斗时距离太近，那些靠近 Boss 的人会生成 Shiro'ken。为了避免这种情况，请将老板从地球上拉开。 （游侠 Boss 附近没有地球仪。）

3cdf15bbe8a0c55d9e31aeb2fa37b6dc8e5a27e9.source: The progress bar in the vanquish counter drastically overestimates progress, as most foes in the instance are not included in the total count until they enter compass range.
3cdf15bbe8a0c55d9e31aeb2fa37b6dc8e5a27e9.text: 征服计数器中的进度条大大高估了进度，因为实例中的大多数敌人在进入罗盘范围之前都不会包含在总计数中。

90e8975faeb5b6794638c3e6a7cb27428f5e8c58.source: The portal near the Imperial Sanctum outpost can be used, even though the gate sometimes appears to be closed.
90e8975faeb5b6794638c3e6a7cb27428f5e8c58.text: 帝国圣殿前哨站附近的传送门可以使用，尽管大门有时看起来是关闭的。

918c55b856ebdb3576864ebf000e57372e6ab941.source: The Great Northern Wall mission completed

e6e6126d542f9ef3e8890b335ff53195b255c33a.source: Search Ferndale for Luxon scout groups and destroy them. [4...0] Luxon scout groups remaining.
e6e6126d542f9ef3e8890b335ff53195b255c33a.text: 搜索芬代尔寻找卢克森侦察小组并消灭他们。 [4...0] 剩余的卢克森侦察小组。

1d6d7437886305bdaa5c4bdd5320f1b51dd84a42.text: 德：斯皮尔斯皮岑吉普菲尔

5160d3e472e5ba3eba2faa2b7a9f824fbf2ff3f8.source: Find and kill [[Special Ops: Flame Temple Corridor#Bosses|[Charr Boss Name], Charr legion leader.
5160d3e472e5ba3eba2faa2b7a9f824fbf2ff3f8.text: 找到并杀死[[特别行动：火焰神殿走廊#Bosses|[夏尔老板名字]，夏尔军团领袖。

e61ca7b691ae4bad464cfa0735470dac434919b4.source: Student Sousuke neither active nor completed
e61ca7b691ae4bad464cfa0735470dac434919b4.text: 宗介学生既不活跃也不完成

22a388d324d28183735c018b0ff6566f5f9eb80e.source: Student Jin neither active nor completed
22a388d324d28183735c018b0ff6566f5f9eb80e.text: 金同学既不主动也不完成

4429197834d362516f29fb1b2b241c5d03c03f55.source: The Count's Daughter primary quest will lead characters through this area. Exit from Zin Ku Corridor. Can also be entered from Pongmei Valley if all party members have completed Tahnnakai Temple, otherwise the gates of the Sunjiang District portal in Pongmei Valley will be closed.
4429197834d362516f29fb1b2b241c5d03c03f55.text: 伯爵的女儿的主要任务将引导角色穿过这个区域。从津库走廊出口。如果所有队员都完成了塔纳凯神庙，也可以从蓬梅谷进入，否则蓬梅谷孙江区门户的大门将会关闭。

08f595d1b2b4750ee4eee4a16abd566203c4aa2b.source: The kill count is substantially reduced during Cleansing the Sunjiang District (179).
08f595d1b2b4750ee4eee4a16abd566203c4aa2b.text: 清理孙江区期间，杀戮数量大幅减少（179）。

1b1bfada47fb71603e1c8e0af59b1a54a2eb88ae.source: The gate to the western region will be closed unless all players have completed Sunjiang District (and the necessary missions for this: Arborstone and Boreas Seabed). This prevents access to the Construct bosses.
1b1bfada47fb71603e1c8e0af59b1a54a2eb88ae.text: 除非所有玩家都完成了孙江区（以及为此所需的任务：Arborstone和Boreas Seabed），否则通往西部地区的大门将关闭。这会阻止对构造 Boss 的访问。

50695e5e26b32f0060f604b83cdcb5fc68c0b038.source: Equinox can be captured before completion of Sunjiang District via killing the Ranger's Construct behind the closed gate by waiting for the boss to patrol close enough to the gate to be pulled with a flatbow.
50695e5e26b32f0060f604b83cdcb5fc68c0b038.text: 可以在孙江区完成之前通过等待 Boss 巡逻到足够靠近大门并用扁弓拉动来杀死关闭的大门后面的游侠构造体来捕获春分。

5eb6ca1d59942c6ddc25fc963aacd6502a542711.source: The environmental traps of the mission are deactivated in the explorable area.
5eb6ca1d59942c6ddc25fc963aacd6502a542711.text: 任务的环境陷阱在可探索区域被停用。

d44556f3e02367de89acc4a5531e2cd71bafa9f0.source: Guild Wars Nightfall on the account

bca8052c79146ef696f8053ce4e5c83a1c1bbe84.source: Sunspears in Kryta neither active nor completed
bca8052c79146ef696f8053ce4e5c83a1c1bbe84.text: 科瑞塔的烈阳之矛既不活跃也不完整

9128e80944482886c7ab44a7f0794e709bf848d5.source: Zin Ku Corridor has the only entrance into this area.
9128e80944482886c7ab44a7f0794e709bf848d5.text: 津库走廊是进入该区域的唯一入口。

266398e29d1db0cc182bc740604952795093bac1.source: With the primary quest A Meeting With the Emperor active, there will be only 2 Temple Guardian foes to kill; however, be careful on your route or you will illuminate other foes that are still present to the north (a map is available here). It does not matter when you speak with the Emperor, as long as the quest is active.
266398e29d1db0cc182bc740604952795093bac1.text: 当主线任务“与皇帝会面”激活后，只有 2 个圣殿守护者敌人需要杀死；然而，要小心你的路线，否则你会照亮仍然存在于北方的其他敌人（这里有地图）。只要任务有效，什么时候与皇帝交谈并不重要。

19b684bf92370a9ffaa8fe0700a7f3d68d9f88c3.source: When vanquishing normally, take care when engaging the numerous Jade Brotherhood mobs. Spread out the party before engaging, as the casters can easily cause a party wipe. Anti-melee skills and elemental damage protection or mitigation are recommended.
19b684bf92370a9ffaa8fe0700a7f3d68d9f88c3.text: 正常征服时，与众多翡翠兄弟会小怪交战时要小心。在参与之前将队伍分散开，因为脚轮很容易导致队伍消失。建议使用反近战技能和元素伤害保护或缓解。

e69401b23ea1130c37b80b18c822ade691beb911.source: Jade Knights can cause serious damage to your back line, so it is recommended to take care of them first.
e69401b23ea1130c37b80b18c822ade691beb911.text: 翡翠骑士会对你的后线造成严重伤害，所以建议先处理掉他们。

c0542e8f93ca2890698fa75033e96e3e982e92c2.source: The shimmer on the exit portal to the Tahnnakai Temple outpost does not always show up, making it appear the same as any other door, so be careful you do not accidentally exit this area while vanquishing.
c0542e8f93ca2890698fa75033e96e3e982e92c2.text: 塔纳凯神庙前哨站的出口门户上的微光并不总是出现，使其看起来与任何其他门相同，所以要小心，不要在征服时意外退出该区域。

b631715c4c7d6ede3e60594695cb4e6936235ae9.source: The northern-most tip of this area contains a feature not found anywhere else in Guild Wars: a multi-level spiraling ramp that leads from the lower temple area mostly inhabited by Temple Guardian foes to a much higher area occupied by the Jade Brotherhood. The upper section contains its own system of watery areas and bridges across them, so if that is actually "ground level" then the spiraling ramp provides a good indication of the depth of the temple shrines and the Zin Ku Corridor within the sewers.
b631715c4c7d6ede3e60594695cb4e6936235ae9.text: 该区域的最北端有一个在《激战》中其他任何地方都没有的特征：一个多层螺旋坡道，从主要由圣殿守护者敌人居住的较低神庙区域通向由玉石兄弟会占据的较高区域。上部包含其自己的水域系统和横跨它们的桥梁，因此，如果这实际上是“地面”，那么螺旋坡道可以很好地指示寺庙神社和下水道内 Zin Ku 走廊的深度。

e6a8b73e0c3ea42aa11e7daa89af8d1fadec6bce.source: Vanquishing: 64–72 foes. A group of Bog Skale Icetooths may be difficult to spot in the southwestern corner, across a gap from Arris Weston.
e6a8b73e0c3ea42aa11e7daa89af8d1fadec6bce.text: 击败：64-72 名敌人。在西南角，与阿里斯·韦斯顿隔着一条缝隙，可能很难发现一群沼泽斯卡勒冰齿兽。

5bee4219cd8991554a0a656231ea5fff10cb5278.text: 德：埃本霍尔兹-马里克斯之歌

5c4acad32b217e6240b688e1900f88404b93dcc8.source: Exit from Vasburg Armory or travel north from Amatz Basin via Mourning Veil Falls.
5c4acad32b217e6240b688e1900f88404b93dcc8.text: 从瓦斯堡军械库出口或从阿马茨盆地向北行驶，途经哀悼面纱瀑布。

41e5b4c8b36cdd0dcd3b4c32949d0e88c2b75254.source: The Wardens and Mantis are hostile to each other. If you let them fight it out, it can save around 17 kills.
41e5b4c8b36cdd0dcd3b4c32949d0e88c2b75254.text: 守望者和螳螂彼此敌对。如果你让他们决一死战，大约可以减少 17 人的死亡。

2450d4917ea395e3f156baa0488ac5eef8b9ffa0.source: Take note that when approaching the seemingly solitary Flower Spiritgarden, at least 8 other Wardens will drop down from the trees behind it.
2450d4917ea395e3f156baa0488ac5eef8b9ffa0.text: 请注意，当接近看似孤独的花灵花园时，至少有 8 个其他守望者会从其后面的树上掉下来。

706db82370ad461754718e007cb03213bbdb735b.source: There are 4 hidden Oni groups (each consisting of 3 of them):
706db82370ad461754718e007cb03213bbdb735b.text: 有 4 个隐藏的鬼组（每个组由 3 个组成）：

164eb21ca447cb6da0ce7f2765d24621acf7fea8.source: At the southern edge of the area directly south of Vasburg Armory.
164eb21ca447cb6da0ce7f2765d24621acf7fea8.text: 位于瓦斯堡军械库正南区域的南缘。

fe7f790cd46dcc29115440fed0d2345e7461c610.source: Close to the western edge, in an underpass amidst several Warden groups.
fe7f790cd46dcc29115440fed0d2345e7461c610.text: 靠近西部边缘，在几个守望者小组中间的地下通道中。

0899432301b4fa2f5da023a78bf7b6fea21ae0cd.source: A short distance southeast from the Eternal Grove outpost.
0899432301b4fa2f5da023a78bf7b6fea21ae0cd.text: 距离永恒丛林前哨站东南不远。

58303d7e2c47463c1c3ef2a2068b94a59adb02ad.source: In the small lake near the southern edge.

a54dab1fa60612c7b84917794a81391f4908ddf2.source: Complete exploration of this area yields approximately 1.9% towards the Canthan Cartography title.
a54dab1fa60612c7b84917794a81391f4908ddf2.text: 完成该区域的勘探后，可获得 Canthan 制图标题的约 1.9% 收益。

c18bda9fb3c10333c6a92dae625712e99a871260.source: For various reasons, the quest can be completed without finishing all the activities:
c18bda9fb3c10333c6a92dae625712e99a871260.text: 由于各种原因，任务可以在未完成所有活动的情况下完成：

f41b1fdfcb45cc4455828f456fbf47b4988d207f.source: If you have completed up to the slalom, you can retake the challenge and succeed by heading straight for the pigs, who will now be easier to herd.
f41b1fdfcb45cc4455828f456fbf47b4988d207f.text: 如果您完成了障碍赛，您可以重新接受挑战并直接冲向猪群，从而获得成功，现在猪群更容易放牧了。

673573baa0267e3895901a7a8236fdedf0d74670.source: Collect [5...0] more [[Ruined Armor|ruined White Mantle armors.
673573baa0267e3895901a7a8236fdedf0d74670.text: 收集 [5...0] 个更多 [[毁坏的盔甲|毁坏的白斗篷盔甲。

ff9af77e4186df814ec58518078a0e3f2712bc92.source: Gain Norgu neither active nor completed
ff9af77e4186df814ec58518078a0e3f2712bc92.text: 获得 Norgu 既不活跃也不完成

5f7b9fd3c3486b3efc42352a8f632914001f35de.source: Can only be entered from Harvest Temple.

10dd87da397a2501b854aae362ef470c66ea098a.source: If every character in the party has completed Befriending the Luxons, Hylas will grant the group access to the Unwaking Waters (Luxon) mission outpost, and you will be able to explore the Luxon side without finishing the Gyala Hatchery mission.
10dd87da397a2501b854aae362ef470c66ea098a.text: 如果队伍中的每个角色都完成了与卢克森人交友，海拉斯将授予该团队进入不醒水域（卢克森）任务前哨站的权限，并且您将能够在不完成加拉孵化场任务的情况下探索卢克森一方。

aec5ed36da31dab1e033952e5e2a984df8e3ea2f.source: Similarly, if all characters in the party have completed Befriending the Kurzicks, talking to Gatekeeper Dedrick will give you similar access to the Unwaking Waters (Kurzick) mission outpost, and you can explore the Kurzick side without finishing the Eternal Grove mission.
aec5ed36da31dab1e033952e5e2a984df8e3ea2f.text: 同样，如果队伍中的所有角色都已完成与库兹克交友，与守门人戴德里克交谈将为您提供类似的访问不醒之水（库兹克）任务前哨站的权限，并且您可以在不完成永恒丛林任务的情况下探索库兹克一侧。

e57556adcb60d13067c66effbf83be47952abcd3.source: You can gate glitch both of these gates. Although this does take you to the Unwaking Waters (Kurzick) or Unwaking Waters (Luxon) outpost, your spawn location in both outposts after using the glitch is inside the Harvest Temple. This can be resolved by changing district or using map travel twice.
e57556adcb60d13067c66effbf83be47952abcd3.text: 您可以对这两个门进行门故障。虽然这确实会带你到不醒之水（Kurzick）或不醒之水（Luxon）前哨站，但使用故障后你在两个前哨站的重生位置都在丰收神庙内。这可以通过改变地区或使用地图旅行两次来解决。

30821d8e60f71a9d3985412765b63dc771c32d93.source: Be careful when fighting the Shiro'ken on the way down from Harvest Temple if your faction does not control the single resurrection shrine in the zone: if your party wipes, you will be returned to the outpost, since there is no place for you to resurrect.
30821d8e60f71a9d3985412765b63dc771c32d93.text: 如果你的阵营没有控制该区域中的单个复活神殿，那么在从丰收神殿下来的路上与白肯战斗时要小心：如果你的队伍消灭了，你将被送回前哨站，因为没有地方可以复活。

e07062c0737bf34b697f9e53c68ba754f9006e37.source: If you are cartographing the area, you will need to bring a shadow step skill to gain access to the south-western part of the area. You will have to use it on a Reef Lurker located near the shipwreck that is blocking your path.
e07062c0737bf34b697f9e53c68ba754f9006e37.text: 如果您正在绘制该区域的地图，则需要携带暗影步技能才能进入该区域的西南部。你必须对位于沉船附近阻挡你道路的礁石潜伏者使用它。

36468e864c516822e2c05a7a325596f5921c4777.source: There are a few hidden pairs of Oni.

66105417e15a498682475b2971b2d94d94200416.source: The shipwrecks or ruined buildings sometimes hide several Outcast Assassins.
66105417e15a498682475b2971b2d94d94200416.text: 沉船或毁坏的建筑物有时隐藏着数名被放逐的刺客。

b72f867ea975337c76bd9b48cdeaa0edcf7d0da4.source: You can gain up to 12,000 points of Luxon faction here, 0.6666666666666666 of which comes from vanquishing, the rest from taking the Luxon bounty); highly efficient teams can do this in about 15 minutes (although most groups will need around 30 minutes).
b72f867ea975337c76bd9b48cdeaa0edcf7d0da4.text: 在这里你可以获得最多12000点的卢克森派系积分，其中0.6666666666666666来自征服，其余的来自获得卢克森赏金）；高效率的团队可以在大约 15 分钟内完成此任务（尽管大多数团队需要大约 30 分钟）。

2e0aeab1f9de55462977c1c2d4572416d69f4f73.source: Additional foes during Outcasts in the Quarry, which can interfere with vanquishing (see the following bug note). Two additional groups of Outcasts will spawn in areas unreachable by foot while Outcasts in the Quarry is active (even though none of the quest objectives take place in Unwaking Waters): one on the path traversed during the mission, the other inside the Kurzick outpost. These can be managed by splitting the party on either side of the peninsula or cliff ledge and using non-projectile spells.
2e0aeab1f9de55462977c1c2d4572416d69f4f73.text: 采石场中的流亡者期间会出现额外的敌人，这可能会干扰征服（请参阅以下错误说明）。当采石场中的流放者处于活动状态时，另外两组流放者将在步行无法到达的区域中生成（即使没有任何任务目标发生在不醒水域中）：一组在任务期间经过的路径上，另一组在库尔兹克前哨站内。这些可以通过在半岛或悬崖边缘分裂队伍并使用非投射法术来解决。

79c7ea6e5d09d7b684ca09f0794f37714488505f.source: Occasionally characters will resurrect at the portal to the Harvest Temple even after activating the resurrection shrine (via having more unspent faction of their allegiance, killing them or bribing the priest).
79c7ea6e5d09d7b684ca09f0794f37714488505f.text: 有时，即使在激活复活神殿之后，角色也会在丰收神殿的入口处复活（通过拥有更多未效忠的派系，杀死他们或贿赂牧师）。

28fdcbfd5cc59b7de750b05db5e9143b578a7f22.source: Sometimes the quest marker does not update after you killed 4 groups at the Jade Sea. This might be the case, that the groups got killed by other foes already. To update the quest you just have to head to Scourgewind, Elder Guardian via the path from the water.
28fdcbfd5cc59b7de750b05db5e9143b578a7f22.text: 有时，在翡翠海杀死 4 支队伍后，任务标记不会更新。情况可能是这样，这些团体已经被其他敌人杀死了。要更新任务，你只需通过水路前往远古守护者天灾风。

5689ed9f75b3d3ee8c888a8c3fb3c719c790a8c8.source: Killing groups of Jade Brotherhood or Am Fah before the quest tells you to kill them will not bug the quest. The quest marker will still point you to the direction of the group you've already killed, but simply walking to the location will update the quest and direct you to the next group of Jade Brotherhood or Am Fah to kill.
5689ed9f75b3d3ee8c888a8c3fb3c719c790a8c8.text: 在任务告诉你杀死 Jade Brotherhood 或 Am Fah 之前杀死他们不会妨碍任务。任务标记仍然会将你指向你已经杀死的队伍的方向，但只需走到该位置就会更新任务并引导你到下一组要杀死的 Jade Brotherhood 或 Am Fah。

05b99f51298170e0778d6c7773896620b778fe0c.source: Neither I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet nor Hole of Istan completed
05b99f51298170e0778d6c7773896620b778fe0c.text: 我没有感觉到地球在凯莎脚下移动，也没有完成伊斯坦之洞

91799faf68432d6d6a1a90388d92b8de25c90a2e.text: 德：维尔德尼斯·冯·巴赫扎

423b95ba3bf7d4665d5d67f5f2963e4bba3b725b.source: Trapped Voices for the quest Voices in the Night can always be seen.
423b95ba3bf7d4665d5d67f5f2963e4bba3b725b.text: 任务“夜间之声”中的被困声音始终可见。

d3e2e3cda0b02afc47dd0e15b2f6e57cc18b9c26.source: The only way to reach this explorable area is to speak to Guard Lae Fao in Seitung Harbor, after completing the Zen Daijun mission.
d3e2e3cda0b02afc47dd0e15b2f6e57cc18b9c26.text: 到达这个可探索区域的唯一方法是在完成 Zen Daijun 任务后与 Seitung 港的守卫 Lae Fao 交谈。

8a9a25fe06e2735cb1fb0140af93818f946500b8.source: Zunraa can be summoned by using a Shrine of Zunraa and will follow your party as an ally.
8a9a25fe06e2735cb1fb0140af93818f946500b8.text: 可以使用 Zunraa 神殿召唤 Zunraa，并且 Zunraa 会作为盟友跟随你的队伍。

7772a5b12065aa269411795d2be3bee7a3ff48c7.source: There is a Komainu guarding the passage towards Kahnju Overlook.
7772a5b12065aa269411795d2be3bee7a3ff48c7.text: 有一名 Komainu 守卫着通往 Kahnju Overlook 的通道。

3a10e299a4455b48bc941a3638f27b6a824ec240.source: Most of the afflicted groups contain an Afflicted Ritualist; prevention of their Spirit Transfer and Recuperation is recommended.
3a10e299a4455b48bc941a3638f27b6a824ec240.text: 大多数受折磨群体都包含一名受折磨仪式师；建议预防其精神转移和恢复。

a1b2041812fe41a9ab4d815345c8fa8d0e856b5c.source: Afflicted Rangers, Monks, Mesmers and Elementalists are only found in two or three groups.
a1b2041812fe41a9ab4d815345c8fa8d0e856b5c.text: 受折磨的游侠、武僧、催眠师和元素师只出现在两到三个群体中。

e74048abffe1fd6b865b3173e3212af75a69058b.source: Factions characters can vanquish this area by killing or charming a single animal. This trick requires that all characters have completed An Unwelcome Guest and that Winds of Change is not active (either because the character has not started it or because Memories of Purity is active). It will not work if the party includes any Prophecies or Nightfall characters. This is an intended feature, rewarding Canthan natives for their role in clearing evil from the area. (Source: Gaile Gray at Inc Gamers, in 2008 (Broken link))
e74048abffe1fd6b865b3173e3212af75a69058b.text: 派系角色可以通过杀死或迷惑一只动物来征服这个区域。此技巧要求所有角色都已完成“不受欢迎的客人”并且“变革之风”未激活（因为该角色尚未开始它或因为“纯洁的记忆”已激活）。如果队伍中包含任何预言或夜幕角色，它将不起作用。这是一个有意为之的功能，旨在奖励凯珊当地人在清除该地区邪恶方面所发挥的作用。 （来源：Gaile Gray，Inc Gamers，2008 年（断开的链接））
